Koyuma, alimwi atulitondezye lwesu kuba bayumu nkaambo kabantu besu akaambo kamadolopo aLeza wesu, nkaambo Jehova uyochita chintu chibotu kumeso akwe,''
Aboobo Jowabu abasilumamba bampi yakwe bakinkilila kunembo ankondo kukulwisya ba Alamiya abo bakamanikizigwa kuti bachije kunembo lyampi ya Izilayeli.

Elyo basimpi baba Amoni nibakabona kuti ma Alamiya achiji, abalabo bakachija  kuzwa kuli Jowabu mwanike waAbbisayi alimwi bakabweda mukati kadolopo. Mpawo Jowabu wakabweda kuzwa kubantu baba Amoni akubweda kuJelusalema.
Elyo ba Alamiya nibakabona kuti bakali bazundwa kuzwa kuliba Izilayeli , bakabatumina batumwa kuzwa mutala amulonga Efilete, aaSofaki silutwe wa mpi waba Hadadezeli.
Eelyo Davida nakabuzigwa eezi. wakabungania baIzilayeli boonse, wazubuka Jodani. akusika nkubakaabede. Wabamba impi yankondo kuti balwisye baAlamiya, alimwi bakamulwisya.
Ba Alamiya bakachija kuzwa kuliba Izilayeli, alimwi Davida wakajaya zyuulu zili musanu azibili zyankalaki zyaba Alamiya abasimawulu bali zyuulu zilimakumi oone. Wakajaya aaSofaki, silutwe wampi.

Eelyo boonse bami bakali balanda ba Hadadezeli nibakabona kuti baundwa kubusyu bwa Izilayeli, bakachita luumuno aaDavida akulivuna lwabo. Aboobo bantu baAlamu tebakachili kuyanda pe kugwasya ba Amonayiti.

Lino chiindi chalwaaka chakasika, chiindi bami nibayinka kunkondo, awo Jowabbu wakazulwida impi munkondo akubweza nyika yaba Amoni. Wakayinka akusinkilizya Labba. Devidi wakasyala ku Jelusalemu. Jowabbu wakakoma Labba akuzunda.

Deviti wakagwisya munsini wa Mwami kumutwe wakwe, mpawo wakajana kuti ulema talenta lyangolide, mukati kayo mwakali ibbwe ijebesi. Munsini wakabikidwe amutwe wa Devidi. Mpawo wakagwisya zisalo zinji loko mumuunzi oyo.

Wakagwisya bantu bakali mumuunzi oyo akubaangila kuti babeleke azigonsyo azisisyo atuleba. Devidi mbwakachitila myunzi yonse amazyalani aba Amoni kuchita mulimu oyu. Lino Devidi abantu boonse bakabweeda ku Jelusalemu.
Lino kusule lyaya kwakabuka inkondo ku Gaza aba Filisitiya. Sibbekayi mu Hasyati wakajaya Sipayi, umwi wazyalani lya Lafeyimu, abobo ba Filisitiya bakakomwa.
Kwakaba ayimbi inkondo aba Filisitiya kuGobbu, Elihanani mwana wa Jeyi mu Bbetelehemu wakajaya Lahimu mukulana wa Goliyati mu Gititi, luti lwasumu lyakwe lwakali mbuli chisamu chasikuluka.

Kwakaba ayimbi inkondo ku Gati kwakali mwalumi wakali kulema loko wakali aminwe musanu awumwi kujanza limwi alimwi aminwe musanu awumwi kukantengeza kakukuulu kumwi akumwi. Alakwe wakali wezyalani lya Letayimu.
Wakasampula impi ya Izilayeli, Jehonadabbu mwana wa Syimeya, mukulana wa Devidi, wakamujaya.
Aba bakali zyalani lya Lefayimu waku Gati bakajayigwa ajanza lya Devidi ajanza lyaba silumamba bakwe.
Satani wakabukila Izilayeli wakasunka Devidi kuti abale ba Izilayeli.
Devidi wakati kuli Jowabbu akumupati wabasilumamba, ''Kamuya, mubale bantu ba Izilayeli kuzwa ku Bbiyesyebba kusikila ku Dani muboole mundibuzye, kuchitila kuti nzibe mweelwe wabo.''

Jowabbu wakati, ''Akube kuti Jehova achite impi eyi iyindululwe mwanda kukuvula kwinda mbwibede. Pesi mwami simalelo wangu, takwe kuti boonse babelekela simalelo wangu na? Nkamboonzi simalelo wangu nayanda eechi? Nkambonzi nabikka mulandu ali Izilayeli?''
Pesi ijwi lyakasungilizya Jowabbu. Elyo Jowabbu wayinka wanjila konse mu Izilayeli. Elyo wakaboola ku Jelusalemu.

Lino Jowabbu wakalungununa mweelwe wakubalwa kwabantu basikulwana ba Devidi. Bakali mu Izilayeli mwaanda wazyuulu amwanda wachuulu (1,100,000) baalumi bakezi kulwisya apanga. Juda alike wakali amwaanda wazyuulu zine amakumi musanu aabili (470,000) abasilumamba.
Pesi Levi a Bbenjamini tebakabaligwa pe akkati kabo. Nkambo nijwi lya mwami lyakasesemya Jowabbu.
Pesi makani aya akabija kuli Leza, elyo wakanyonyoona Izilayeli.
Devidi wakati kuli Leza, ''Ncabisya kapati akuchita eechi. Lino gwisya mulanda wamulanda wako,  nkambo ndachita chabufubafuba.''
Jehova wakabuzya Gadi, musinsimi wa Devidi,
''Kuya ukatedi kuli Devidi, ''Mbuboobu mbwawamba Jehova: Ndakupa zyakusala zitatu. Usale chimwi chazyo.'''
Elyo Gadi wakaya kuli Devidi wati kulinguwe, ''Jehova wati, 'Sala chimwi chazeezi:

Na minyaka iitatu yanzala, naa myeezi iitatu yakukomwa abasinkonyokwe akujiigwa kupanga lyabo, kana kuti mazuba atatu aapanga lya Jehova, echi, malawazi alikusalila munyika, amungelo wa Jowabbu kalikunyonyoona munyika yoonse ya Izilayeli.'' Lino nsandulo njintabwedezye kuli wandituma.''
Elyo Devidi wakati kuli Gadi, ''Ndimumapenzi mapati! ngandiwide mujanza lya Jehova kwinda mujanza lyamuntu, nkambo kwiita kwaluzyalo lwakwe nkupati.''
Elyo Jehova wakatumina bulwazi muchisi chaba Izilayeli, mpawo zyuulu musanu azibili zyabantu zyakafwa.

Leza wakatuma mungelo ku Jelusalemu kuyowunyonyoona. Awo kachiyanda kuunyonyoona, Jehova wakalanga wasandula miyeeyo yakwe yalunyonyoko. Wakati kumungelo walunyonyooko, ''Kwakkwana! Lino bwedezya ijanza lyako.'' Kulecho chiindi mungelo walunyonyooko wa Jehova wakaliimvwi alubuwa lwachipolelo lwa Onani mu Jebbusi.

Devidi wakalanga kujulu wabona mungelo wa Jehova uliimvwi akkati kanyika ejulu, kajisi ipanga lisomwedwe ulilinyampwide mujanza lyakwe kayeleka Jelusalemu. Mpawo Devidi abendelezi, bakazwata masaka, bavundama masyu aabo ansi.

Devidi wakati kuli Leza, ''Teensi ndime na ndakalayilila kuti impi ibalwe? Ndakachita chilewusi eechi. Pesi imbelele eezi, zyachitaanzi? Jehova Leza wangu! Ijanza lyako aliwume ndime empuli yangu, pesi kutabi kuti dwazi eeli likkalilile abantu bako.''
Elyo mungelo wa Jehova wakalayilila Gadi; kuti atedi kuli Devidi, kuti Deviti aye kukuyakila chipayililo cha Jehova kulubuwa lwakupolela lwa Onani mu Jebbusi.
Elyo Devidi wakinka mbuli Gadi mbwakamulayilila muzina lya Jehova.
Awo Onani kachili mukupola wiiti, wakacheba wabona mungelo. Lwakwe abana  bakwe balombe bakayuba.
Awo Devidi wakasika kuli Onani, Onani wakalanga wabona Devidi. Wakasiya chipolelo wayinka wafugama kuli Devidi busyu wavundama ansi.
Elyo Devidi wakati kuli Onani, ''Ndiwuzizye olu lubuwa lwakupolela, kuchitila kuti ndiyakile chipayililo cha Jehova. Ndiyobbadala muulo woonse, kuchitila kuti idwazi ligwisigwe kubantu.''

Onani wakati kuli Devidi, ''Bweza biyo, simalelo wangu chita kufumbwa chilulelme kumenso ako. Langa, Ndilokupa basune bachipayililo chakutenta, azileyi kuchita nkuni, antomwe a wiiti kuchita chipayizyo chazya kulima; Ndiyokupa biyo zyoonse.''
Mwami Devidi wakati kuli Onani, ''Pepe, ndakumbila kuula amuulo ukkwene. Nsikoyobweza zili zyako akuzichita mbuli chipayizyo chakutentela Jehova na kakutakwe mbadalo njindakabbadala.''
Elyo Devidi wakabbadala masyekeli ali myaanda musanu awumwi wangolida kawula busena.

Devidi wakayakila Jehova chipayililo oko akutula zipayizyo zyakutenta akupa zipo zyabulyidilano. Wakakwilila Jehova, oyo wakamuvwiila akutuma mulilo kuzwa kujulu akutenta zyonse zyakatulidwe achipayililo.
Mpawo Jehova wakapa malayilile kumungelo, mpawo mungelo wakabwedezya panga lyakwe munkomo yalyo.
Awo Devidi nakabona kuti Jehova wamusandula kuchipolelo cha Onani mu Jebbusi, wakapayila achipayilo nkukooko achiindi nchicheecho.
Lino kuli cheecho chindi tente lyambunganino ya Jehova, Mozesi ndyakachitide munkanda achipayililo chazipayizyo zyakutenta, zyakali abusena buli ajulu lya Gibbiyoni.
Nekuba boobo, Devidi wakakachilwa kwinka nkuko kuti akakumbile malayilile a Leza, nkambo wakachili yoweede ipanga lyamungelo wa Jehova.
Kuwawo Devidi wakati, ''Mpawano ing'anda ya Jehova mpiyelede kuba, achipayililo chakutentela cha Izilayeli.''
Elyo Devidi wakalayilila balanda bakwe kuti babunganie bazwakule boonse bakkede munyika ya Izilayeli wakabalayilila kuti bateme mabwe, kuti badyunkuule mabwe akuyasya ng'anda ya Leza.
Devidi wakapa zibulo zyiingi kuti kuchitwe zipikili zyamakkoma amilyango yamanjililo, amukkuba. Wakapa alimwi mukkuba mwiingi utabaliki,
alimwi azisamu zyaKkedali ezyo zyakali kubalika. ( Bantu baku Sidoni abaku Tayilani bakawula abalabo myiingi mi matanda amusida kuti awabalikizye Devidi.)

Devidi wakati, ''Mwanangu mulombe Solomoni uchili munini alimwi tanakubaluzibo pe, atala eng'anda iyelede kuyakilwa Jehova iyelede kukomena loko, ibe ampuwo abulemu muzisi zyoonse. Alimwi njolibambila buyakwe bwayo.'' Mpawo Devidi wakabamba zibelesyo zyayo zyiingi katana kufwa.
Elyo wakayita Solomoni mwana wakwe mulombe wamulayilila kuti ayakile Jehova Ing'anda, Leza wa Izilayeli.
Devidi wakati kuli Solomoni, ''Mwanangu, chali chiyandisyo changu kuti ndiyake ing'anda lwangu, nkambo kazina lya Jehova Leza wangu.
Pesi Jehova waza kuli ndime akwamba kuti, ''Wakatila ganzi ijingi akulwana nkondo nyingi. Toyelede kuyaka ng'anda kubusyu bwangu, nkambo wakatila iganzi ijingi anyika kubusyu bwangu.

Nikuba boobo, uyoba amwana muntu waluumuno. Ndiyomupa kulyokezya kuzwa kuli basinkondonyina kuzwa kumabbazu woonse. Nkambo izina lyakwe unoli Solomoni, mpawo ndiyopa lumuno abutontoozi kuli Izilayeli mumazuba akwe.
Uyoyaka ng'anda nkambo kezina lyangu. Uyoba mwanangu ambebo ndiyoba wisi. Ndiyoyimika chuno chabwaami bwakwe ali Izilayeli kwalyoonse.'
Lino, mwanangu Jehova abe ayebo akukonzezye nukuzwidilila. Uyake ng'anda ya Jehhova Leza wako, mbuli mmbwaamba kuti uyelede kwiyaka.
Biyo Jehova akupe kubona akumvwisisisya, kuchitila kuti uswilile milawu ya Jehova Leza wako nayokubikka kwendelezya Izilayeli.
Lino uyozwidilila, niwakaswilila malayilile amilazyo Jehova njakapa Mozesi atala a Izilayeli. Koba usimide abusungu. Utayoowi nikuba kutyompwa.

Lino, bona, bukanze bupati mbundabambila ng'anda ya Jehova mwaanda wazyuulu zyamatalenta angolida, mwaanda wamatalenta ansiliva, amukuba amweelwe mwingi walubulo, Ndapa alimwi masamu amabwe, uyelede kuyungizya zyiingi alizezi.
Uli abasimulimu biingi: basikugonka mabwe, basikubweza zisamu bantu bazi milimo yoonse, mumwelwe wamisyobo yonse,
bakonzya kubelesya ngolida, nsiliva, mukuba alubulo.'' Nyampuka utalike mulimu, alimwi Jehova abe anduwe.''
Devidi wakalayilila alimwi bendelezi ba Izilayili kuti bagwasye Solomoni mwana wakwe, wati,
Jehova Leza wanu uli anywebo wamupa luumuno konseni. Wapa lukono mujanza lyangu. Nyika ilizundide kubusyu bwa Jehova akubant bakwe.
Lino amuyanduule Jehova Leza wenu amyoyo yenu yoonse. Munyampuke mukayake busena bwa Jehova Leza. Elyo bbokesi lyachizuminano cha Jehova azintu zya Leza mung'anda yayakilwa zina lyakwe.''
Lino Devidi nakachembaala kali wasika afwifwi amagolelo abuumi bwakwe, wakachita Solomoni mwanakwe mulombe kuba mwami wa Izilayeli.
Wakayobolola boonse bendelezi ba Izilayeli, ba Pulisita aba Levi.
Ba-Levi bakala minyaka makumi aatatu ayiindide bakabalwa. Bakasika mweelwe wazyuulu makumi atatu amusanu azitatu zyuulu.
''Kuli baaba, zyuulu makumi abili azine zyulu bakali basikulanga mulimu wang'anda ya Jehova, mpawo zyuulu musanu achimwi bakali basilutwe ababetesi.
Zyuulu zine bakajisi mulimu wakulumbayizya Jehova azilizyo nzindakachita kukupa kulumbayizya, ''Devidi mbwakaaba.
Wakabawanzania mutubunga twendelene kuli Levi abana bakwe: Gesyoni, Kkohati, a Melali.
Kuzwa kuzyalani lya Gesyoni, kwakali Ladani a Syimeyi.
Bakali batatu bana balombe ba Ladani: Jehiyeli muzuluzi, Zetani, a Jowelu.
Kwakali batatu bana balombe ba Syimeyi: Syelomoti, Haziyelu, a Halani.  Aba bakali bazuluzi bazyalani lya Ladani.
Bakali baane bana balombe ba Syimeyi: Jahati, Ziza, Jewusyi, a Bbeliya.
Jahati nguwakali mupati, a Ziza nguwakali mutobezi, pesi Jewusyi a Bbeliya tebakalikwe bana pe, aboobo bakali kubwezwa mbuli zyalani limwi akuchita mulimo umwi.
Kwakali bana baane balombe ba Kkohati: Amulamu, Izya, Hebbuloni, a Uziyelu.

Kwakali bana balombe ba Amulamu: Aaloni a Mozesi. Aaloni wakabikkwa kuti asalazye zintu zisalalisya, kuti lwakwe azyalane lyakwe bape tununkilizyo tuli abweema bubotu kuti Jehova, akuti bamubelekele akulongezya zina lyakwe lyoonse.
Pesi Mozesi muntu wa Leza, izyalani lyakwe lyakali kubalilwa mumusyobo wa Levi.
Bana balombe ba Mozesi kwakali Gesyomu a Eliyeza.
Bana balombe ba Gesyomu kwakali Syubbayelu mupati.
Bana balombe ba Eliyeza kwakali Lehabbiya. Eliyeza takajisi banabaambi, pesi Lehabbiya wakajisi bana biingi.
Bana balombe ba Izyaa kwakali Syelomiti muzuluzi.
Balunyungu lwa Hebbuloni kwakali Jeliya, mupati, Amaliya nguwakali mutobezi, Jahaziyelu wakali watatu, a Jekkamimu wakali wane.
Bana balombe ba Uziyelu kwakali Mikka wakali mupati, a Isyija mutobezi.
Melali bana bakwe balombe kwakali Mahili a Musyi. Mahili bana bakwe balombe kwakali Eliyeza a Kkisyi.
Eliyeza wakafwa katakwe bana balombe pe. Wakajisi biyo bana basimbi. Bana balombe ba Kkisyi bakabakwata.
Musyi bana bakwe batatu balombe kwakali Mahilu, Eda, a Jelimoti.
Aba bakali bana ba Levi anzubo zyabo, bakali bazuluzi bakabalwa akulembwa amazina, Izyalani lyakatabeleka mu ng'anda ya Jehova, kuzwida amunyaka makkumi abili kaziya kunembo.
Nkambo Devidi wakati, Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, wapa kulyokezya kubantu bakwe. Wachita muunzi wakwe mu Jelusalemu kwalyoonse.
Ba Levi tabachelede kubweza tente lyakubunganina azibelesyo zibeleka mukati kalyo.''
Nkambo kumajwi akumamanino a Devidi ba Levi bakali balidwe, kuzwa kuminyaka makumi aabili ayine kaziya kunembo.
Milimu yabo yakali yakugwasya bana ba Aaloni mumulimu wamung'anda ya Jehova, bakali kulanga lubuwa, amaanda amukati, akusalazigwa kwazintu zya Jehova, akubeleka mumulimu wamung'anda ya Jehova.
Bakabamba alubo chinkwa chabuliwo, busu bunante bwazilyo zyazipo, azinkwa zitakwe buswezyo, zipo ziyokedwe, zipo ziswanizigidwe amafuta, amweelwe wazintu zyoonse.
Bakali kwima mazuba woonse kuseni kabalumba akulumbayizya Jehova, bakali kuchita alimwi echi goko
alimwi achipo chakutenta nichali kupegwa kuli Jehova, mubuzuba butegwa nsabata abwamwezi mupya amazuba amapobwe. Mweelwe aziyanza ziyandwa zyalikupegwa zyoone kunembo lya Jehova.
Mbabo bakali kulanga tente lyambunganino, busena busalala, akugwasya bana bakwabo ba Aaloni mumulimu wang'anda ya Jehova.
Tubunga twamilimo twakajatililide aalunyungu lwaAloni twakali ootu: Nadabbu, Abbihu, Eliyeza aItama.
Nadabbu aAbbihu bakafwa wisi wabo katanafwa. Tebakalikwe bana, eelyo Eliyeza, alimwi aItama bakabeleka mbuli bapayizi.
Devidi, aatnomwe aZadokku, silunyungu waEliyeza, aAhimeleki, silunyungu waItama, wakabapambula baba mutubunga twamilimo yabo mbuli bapayizi.

Bakali biingi baalumi bazulwida aakati kalumyungu lwaEliyeza kwiinda kulunyungu lwaItama, eelyo bakagabanisya lunyungu lwaEliyeza mututbunga tulikkumi amusanu akamwi. Bakachita eechi abasilutwe bamikkowa alimwi alunyungu lwaItama. Impambulo zyakali musanu azitatu mumweelwe, kazyeelana amikkowa yabo.
Bakazipambula mukuteelana ankakato nkaambo kwakaliki bazuluzi basalala alimwi bazuluzi baLeza, kuzwa kulunyungu lwaEliyeza akulunyungu lwaItama.

Syemayiya mwana mulombe waNetaneli mulembi, muLevi, wakalemba aansi mazina aabo kunembo lyaMwami, bazuluzi, Zadokki mupayizi, Ahimeleki mwana mulombe waAbbiyata, abazuluzi bempuli zyabapayizi abaLevi. Uumwi mukowa wakasalwa ankakato kuzwa kulunyungu lwaEliyeza, alimwi mpawo uutobela uyosalwa kuzwa kulunyungu lwaItama.
Nkakato ntaanzi yakawa kulki Jehoyalibbu, yabili kuliJedayiya,
yatatu kuliHalimu, yane kuli Seloyimu,
yamusanu kuliMalichija, yamusanu akamwi kuliMijamini,
yamusanu atubili kuliHakkozi, yamusanu atutatu kuli Abbija,
yamusanu atune kuliJesyuwa, yakkumi kuli Sekkaniya,
yakkumi akamwi kuli Eliyasibbu, yakkumi atubili kuli Jakkimu,
yakkumi atutatu kuli Hapu, yakkumi atune kuli Jesebbeyadi,
yakkumi amusanu kuli Bbiliga, yakkumi amusanu akamwi kuliIma,
yakkumi amusanu atubili kuliHezi, yakkumi amusanu atutatu kuli Hapizezi,
yakkumi amusanu atune kuli Petahiya, yamakkumi aabili kuli Jehezikeli,
yamakkumi aabili akamwi kuli Jakkini, yamakkumi aabili atubili kuli Gamuli,
yamakkumi aabili atutatu kuli Delayiya, yamakkumi aabili atune kuli Maziya.
Aaya ngaakali mabambe amulimo wabo, eelyo nibakaza mung'anda yaJehova, kutobelela malayilile ngibakapegwa aAloni sinsiku wabo mbuli Jehova, Leza waIzilayeli, mbakamulayililide.
Aaba boonse bakali balunyungu lwa Levi: Babana balombe baAmuleni, Syubbayeli; babana balombe ba Syubbayeli, Jehedeyiya.
Mbuli kuli Lehabbiya, bana balombe baLehabbiya: Isija muzululi.
Kuzwa kuIzalayiti: Selomoti; kuzwa kubana balombe baSelomoti: Jahati.
Bana balombe baHebbuloni: Jeliya muzuluzi, Amaliya wabili, Jahaziyeli watatu, alimwi Jekkamiyamu wane.
Bana balombe baUziyeli: Mikka; kuzwa kubana balombe baMikka: Sami.
Mukulana waMikka: Isija. Kuzwa kubana balombe baIsija: Zekkaliya.
Bana balombe baMelali: Mali aMusi; kuzwa kumwana mulombe waJaziya: Bbeno.
Bana balombe baMelali kuzwa kuliJaziya: Bbeno, Sohamu, Zakku, aIbbili.
Kuzwa kuliMali: Eliyeza, wakatalikwe bana balombe.
Kuzwa kuli Kkisyi: Mwana mulombe waKkisyi: Jelameli.
Bana balombe baMusi: Mali, Eda, aJelimoti. Aaba bakali baLevi bakaambidwe ampuli zyabo.

Aaba baalumi bakali basilutwe bamaanda aabamawisi alimwi awumwi wabanike bakwe wakawaala nkakato kunembo lyaMwami Deviti, Zadokki aAhimeleki, aantomwe abazuluzi bempuli zyabapayizi abaLevi. Bakawaala nkakato mbuli mbubakali kuchita balunyungu lwaAloni.
Devidi abendelezi bampi bakasala bamwi babana ba Asafu, Hemani, a Jedutuni kuti basinsime atuntimbwa anyeele antomwe azichokola. Ngaaya mazina aabalumi abo bakabeleka mulimu oyu:
Kuzwa kubana ba Asafu: Zakkuwa, Jozefu, Netaniya, a Asyalela, mbana ba Asafu  munsi abwendelezi bwa mwami.

Kuzwa kubana ba Jedutuni: Gedaliya, Zeli, Jesyayiya, Syimeyi, Hasyabbiya, a Matitiya, kabali musanu awumwi kubabikaamwi, munsi lyabwendelezi bwawisi Jedutuni, abo bakali kulizya kantimbwa kalikupa kulumba akulumbayizya Jehova.
Kuzwa kubana balombe ba Hemeni: Bbukkiya, Mataniya, Uziyelu, Syubbayelu, a Jelimoti, Hananiya, Hanani, Eliyata, Gidaluti, Lomamuti-Eza, Josyibbekasya, Maloti, Hoti, a Mahaziyoti.
Aba boonseni bakali bana balombe ba Hemani musinsimi wamwami. Leza wakapede Hemani bana balombe balikkumi abane abasimbi bane kuti banyampule lwija lwakwe.

Aba boonse bakali munsi lyabwendelezi bwamawisi. Bakali basikwimba mung'anda ya Jehova azichokola, nyeele, atuntimbwa, eelyo bakabeleka mung'anda ya Leza. Asafu, Jedutuni a Hemani bakali munsi lyabwendelezi bwa Mwami.
Lwabo abakwabo bakachenjede akuyisigwa kuti babeleke mulimu wakwimbila Jehova bakasika minyaka ibili, ilaamakkumi alimusanu amusanu ayitatu.
Bakawala chisolo chakwaabana milimu yabo, bonse, kwelede banini abapati, bayisi mbubonya abasikwiiya.
Lino kubana ba Asafu balombe: chisolo chitaanzi chakawida mpuli ya Jozefu; chisolo chabili chakawida mpuli ya Gedaliya, kkumi abantu babili mumweelwe;
chatatu chakawida kuli Zekkuli, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi ababili mumweelwe;
chaane chakawida Izilu, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi lyabantu mumweelwe;
chamusanu chisolo chakawida kuli Netaniya, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi babili mumweelwe;
Chamusanu akamwi chakawida Bbukkiya, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi lyabantu mumweelwe;
chamusanu azibili chakawida Jesalela, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi lyabantu kumweelwe;
chamusanu atutatu chawida kuli Jesyayiya, bana bakwe balombe abaluzubo lwakwe, kkumi ababili mumweelwe;
chamusanu atune chakawida kuli Mataniya, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi lyabantu mumweelwe;
chakkumi chakawida kuli Syimeyi, bana bakwe balombe akunzubo zyakwe, kkumi abantu babili mumweelwe;
chakkumi akamwi chakawida kuli Azalelu, bana bakwe balombe akunzubo zyakwe, kkumi lyabantu mumweelwe;
chakkumi atubili chakawida Hasyabbiya, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi abantu babili mumweelwe;
chakkumi atutatu chakawida kuli Syubbayelu, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi ababili bantu mumweelwe;
Chakkumi atune chakawida kuli Matitiya, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi lyabantu mumweelwe;
chakkumi amusanu chakawida kuli Jelimoti, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe;
chakkumi amusanu akamwi chakawida kuli Hananiya, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi ababili mumweelwe;
chakkumi amusanu atubili chakawida kuli Josyibbekasya, bana bakwe balombe akunzubo zyakwe, kkumi lyabantu ababili mumweelwe;
chakkumi amusanu atutatu chakawida kuli Hanani, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi lyabantu mumweelwe;
chakkumi lilamusanu atune chakawida kuli Maloti, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi abantu bobile mumweelwe;
chamakkumi obile chakawida kuli Eliyata, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi abantu bobile kumweelwe;
chamakkumi aabili akamwi chakawida kuli Hotili, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi ababili bantu kumweelwe;
chamakkumi abili atubili chakawida kuli Gidaluti, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi lyabantu abantu bobile kumweelwe;
chamakkumi abili atutatu chakawida kuli Mahaziyoti, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi lyabantu abantu bobile kumweelwe;
chamakkumi abili atune chakawida kuli Lomamuti-Eza, bana bakwe balombe anzubo zyakwe, kkumi lyabantu abantu babili mumweelwe;
Nzeezi inkamu zyabasimilyango: kuzwa kuli Kkola Meselemiya mwana mulombe wa Kkole, walunyungu lwa Asafu.
Meselemiya kali abana balombe: Zakkaliya kali ngomutanzi, Jediyazelu kali wabili, Zebbadiya kali watatu, Jatitiniyelu kali waane,
Elamu kali wasanu, Jehohanani kali wamusanu awumwi, Eliwunayi kali ngowa musanu ababili.
Obbedi Edomu kali abana balombe: Semeya kali ngomutanzi, Jehozabbedi kali wabili, Jowa kali ngowatatu, Sakkali kali wane, Nataniyeli kali wasanu,
Amiyelu kali wamusanu awumwi, Isakala kali wamusanu ababili, Puletiya kali wamusanu abatatu, nkambo Leza wakalongezya Obbedi Edomu.
Alakwe Semaya mwanamulombe wakwe wakazyala bana balombe bakeendelezya mpuli zyabo, bakali baalumi bachenjeede loko.
Bana balombe ba Semaya mbaaba Otini, Lefayelu, Obbedi, a Eluzabbadi. Inzubo zyakwe mba Elihu a Semakkiya bakali bantu bakali abusongo bwingi.

Aba boonse bakali balunyngu lwa Obbedi Edomu. Balo abana babo balombe abasiluzubonyina bakali bantu bachenjede akubeleka milimo yabo muchikombelo. Bakali makkumi aalimusanu alimwi ababili basiluzubonhyina Obbedi Edomu.
Meselamiya kajisi bana balombe abasiluzubonyina, bantu bachenjede bakali kkumi amusanu abatatu.
Hoosa, walunyungu lwa Melali wakali abana balombe: Simili mwendelezi (nikuba kuti takali mutanzi kukuzyalwa, wisi wakamubika kuti abe mwendelezi),
Awabili Hilukkiya, awatatu Tebbaliya, awane Zekkaliya. Boonse bana balombe ba Hoosa abasiluzubonyina boonse bakali kkumi abatatu mumweelwe.
Ezi nkamu zyabasimilyango, zililembedwe mbuli bapati bazyo, zyakapegwa mulimu wazyo mbubonya mbuli basiluzubonyina; bakali kubeleka mung'anda ya Jehova.
Bakawaala zisolo, banini abapati, munzubo zyamawisi, kuti baabilwe milyango.
Nichakawaalwa chisolo chakumulyango wakubuzwezuba, chakawida aali Selemiys. Elyo bakawaala chisolo cha Zekkaliya mwanakwe mulombe, sinkuta uuchenjede, eelyo chisolo chakazwa kunyika chakamuwida.
Obbedi Edomu wakapegwa mulyango wakumusanza abana bakwe bakapegwa milimo yakuziyobwedo.
Syupimu a Hoosa bakapegwa mulyango wakumbo ambali yamulyango wa Salekketi, kumugwagwa uyamujulu. Balangizi bakatalika bwampuli imwi ayimwi.
Kujwe kakuli ba Levi bali musanu awumwi, kunyika kakuli baane abuzuba, kumusanza kakuli bane abuzuba, alimwi kung'anda yachiyobwedo kakuli bobile bobile.
Kumanjililo akumbo kwakali bone bakabikidwe kumugwagwa alimwi bobile kumanjililo.
Eezi ninkamu zyabasimilyango bakali balunyungu lwa Kkola a Melali.
Akkati kaba Levi, Ahija nguwakali silutwe wang'anda yaziyobwedo zya Leza, ayaziyobwedo zyazintu zya Jehova.
Lunyungu lwa Ladani, kwakali lunyungu lwaba Gelisoni lwakazwa kuli Ladani, wakali silutwe wanzubo ezyo zyakali zya Ladani mu Gelisoni, wakali Jehiyeli
abana balombe ba Jehidi: Zetamu a Jowelu mukulana wakwe. Bakali basilutwe baziyobwedo zyang'anda ya Jehova.
Kuzwa kumusyobo waba Amulamu, akumusyobo waba Izila, kumusyobo waba Hibbuloni, alimwi akumusyobo waba Uuziyeli:
Shubbayelu, alunyungu lwaGelisomu mwana mulombe wa Mozesi, wakali silutwe waziyobwedo.

Babunyina ibakazwa kumusyobo wa Eliyezeli bakali bana balombe bakwe Lehabbiya, Jeshayiya mwana mulombe wa Lehabbiya, amwana mulombe wa Lehabbiya Jesyayiya, amwana mulombe wa Jesyayiya kali Jolamu, amwana mulombe wa Jolamu kali Zikkili, amwana mulombe wa Zikkili kali Selomiti.
Selomiti antomwe anzubo zyakwe bakali kulanga ziyobwedo zyoonse zyakajisi zintu zya Jehova, eezyo mwami Davida, muzulwidi wanzubo, abasilutwe babasilumamba bakapambulwa.
Bakali kusalazya zimwi zyazisalo nzibakasala munkondo zyabo kuti zigwasye milimo yang'anda ya Jehova.

Alimwi bakali kulanga zyoonse ezyo zyakasalazizigilwa Jehova amusinsimi Samuyeli, a Sawulu mwana mulombe wa Kkishi, Abbineli mwana mulombe wa Neli, a Jowabbu mwana mulombe wa Zeluyiya. Zyonse ezyo zyakasalazigilwa Jehova zyakali zya Selemoti abaluzubo lwakwe.
Izyalunyungu lwa Izala, Kkenaniya antomwe abana bakwe balombe abo bakali kwendelezya akulanga makani aanze a Izilayeli. Kwakali basilutwe ababetesi.

Amakani abalunyungu lwa Hebbuloni, Hasyabbiya antomwe abakkulana bakwe, 1,700 balumi bakali kukkonzya, bakali kwendelezya milimo ya Jehova antomwe amibeleko yamwami. Bakali kumbo kubbazu lya Jolodani.

Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Hebbuloni, Jeliya kali musolozi walunyungu lwakwe, kabalidwe kuzwa kumwendelezi wanzubo zyabo. Mumwaaka wamakkumi oone wabwami bwa Davida bakalangisisya bulembo eelyo kwakajanwa akkati kabo baalumi bachenjede mu Jezali muchisi chaGiliyadi.

Jelayiya kajisi basiluzubonyina bali  2,700, abo bakali basilutwe bachenjede bampuli zyabo. Davida wakabachita basikulanga misyobo ya Lubbeni a Gaadi, alimwi achisela cha Manase, kumakani woonse alangene a Leza, amakani amwami.

Oyu ngomulongo wabana ba Izilayeli bazuluzi bampuli, basilutwe bazyuulu, aba myaanda, abasilutwe babasilumamba bakali kubelekela mwami munzila zyandeene. Imwi ayimwi inkamu yakali kubeleka milimo yamweezi amwezi mumwaaka woonse. Imwi ayimwi inkamu yakali abantu balizyuulu zilimakkumi oobile azine.
Aatala ankamu kwamwezi mutanzi wa Jasyobbimu mwana mulombe wa Zabbidyelu. Munkamu yakwe kwakali makkumi abili azyulu zyone zyabalumi.
Wakali akkati kabalunyungu lwa Pelezialimwi wakali kwendelezya abasilumamba boonse abasilutwe kwamweezi mutanzi.

Aatala ankamu yamweziwabili wakali wa Dodayi, kuzwa ku luzubo lwamukowa kuzwa kuli Ahowa. Mikiloti wakali wabili kukutobelana kwabo muzyuno. Munkamu yakwe bakali makumi aabili azyuulu zyone zyabaalumi.
Silutwe wankamu yamwezi wataatu kali Bbenaya mwanamulombe wa Jehoyiyada, mupayizi alimwi kalimuzuluzi. Munkamu yakwe kamuli bantu bali zyuulu zili makkumi aatatu.
Oyu wakali Bbenayiya nguwakali muzuluzi wabali makkumi aatatu, akwinda kumakkumi aatatu. Amizabbadi mwanakwe mulombe wakali munkamu yakwe.
Silutwe wamwezi wane kali Asaheli mukulana wa Jowabbu. Zebbadiya mwana wakwe mulombe wakazoba silutwe musule lyakwe. Munkamu yakwe kwakali makumi obile azyuulu ezyulu zyone zyabaalumi.
Silutwe wankamu yamwezi wasanu wakali Syamuti, waluzubo lwa Izila. Munkamu yakwe kwakali makumi obile azyulu zine zyabaalumi.
Silutwe wankamu yamusanu awumwi mwezi wakali Ilaa mwana mulombe wa Ikkesyi, kazwa mu Tekkowa. Munkamu yakwe mwakali makumi aane azyuulu zyone zyabaalumi.
Silutwe wamumwezi wamusanu ayibili wakali Helezi mu Pelonite, kazwa kubantu baku Efulemu. Munkamu yakwe mwakali makumi obilwe azyuulu zyone zyabalumi.
Silutwe wamumwezi wamusanu ayitatu kali Sibbekayi mu Husati, kazwa kumukowa wakazwa ku Zelati, munkamu yakwe kakuli bantu bali zyuulu zili makkumi obile azine.
Silutwe wamwezi wamusanu ayine kali Ebbiyezeli mu Anatotite, kazwa kuluzubo lwa Bbenjamini. Munkamu yakwe mwakali makumi obile azyulu zine zyabaalumi.
Asilutwe wamwezi wakkumi wakali Mahalayi kazwa kudolopo lya Netofati, kuzwa kumukowa walunyungu lwa Zela. Munkamu yakwe mwakali makumi obile azyuulu zyone zyabaalumi.
Silutwe wamumwezi wakkumi awumwi wakali Bbenayiya kazwa kudolopo lya Pilatoni, kuzwa kumukowa wa Efulemu. Munkamu yakwe mwakali makumi aabili azyuulu zyone zyabaalumi.
Asilutwe wamumwezi wakkumi ayibili wakali Heledayi kazwa mudolopo lya Netofai,  walunyungu lwa Otiniyelu. Munkamu yakwe mwakali makkumi aabili azyuulu zyone zyabaalumi.
Aaba mbibakali bazuluzi bamikowa ya Izilayeli: Kumukowa wa Lubbeni, Eliyeza mwana mulombe wa Zikkili nguwakali muzuluzi. Kumukowa wa Simiyoni, Syepatiya mwana mulombe wa Maakka wakali muzuluzi.
Kumukowa wa Levi, Hasyabbiya mwana mulombe wa Kkemiyelu nguwakali muzuluzi, antomwe aZadokki wakazulwida balunyungu lwa Aaloni.
Kumukowa waJuda, Elihu, umwi wabakulana ba Davida, nguwakali muzuluzi. Kumukowa wa Izakka, Omili mwana mulombe wa Mikkayelu nguwakali muzuluzi.
Amukowa wa Zebbuluni, Isimaya mwana mulombe wa Obbadiya nguwakali silutwe. Amukowa wa Nafitali, Jelimoti mwana mulombe wa Azilileli wakali muzuluzi.
Amukowa wa Efulemu, Hosyiya mwana mulombe wa Azaliya wakali mulombe. Kuchisela chamukowa wa Manase, Jowelu mwana mulombe wa Pedayiya wakali muzuluzi.
Achiseela chamukowa wa Manase mu Giliyadi, Ayido mwana mulombe wa Zekkaliya nguwakali muzuluzi. Akumukowa wa Bbenjamini, Jiziyelu mwana mulombe wa Abbina nguwakali muzuluzi.
Amukowa wa Dani, Azalelu mwana mulombe wa Jelohamu nguwakali muzuluzi. Aaba mbibakali bazuluzi bamukowa wa Izilayeli.
Davida takali kubalape aabo bakali amyaaka yakali kusika ku makkumi obile na bachili banini, nkambo Jehova wakasyomezya kuyungizya ba Izilayeli mbuli nyenyeezi zyakujulu.
Jowabbu mwana mulombe wa Zeluyiya wakatalika kubala bachalumi, pesi takwepe nakamaninsya. Bukali bwakawida ali Izilayeli nkambo kacheechi. Oyu mweelwe tewakalembwa ansi pe mu Makkani a Mwami Davida.

Azimaveti mwana mulombe wa Adiyeli wakali kulanga ziyobwedo zyamwami. Jonatani mwana mulombe wa Uziya wakali aatala ang'anda yakulondweda mumyuunda, mumadolopo, antomwe amumyunzi, alimwi akumalambo akumanjililo.
Ezili mwana mulombe wa Kkelubbu wakali silutwe wabasikulima, abo bakalikulima myuunda.
Syimeyi mu Lamatite wakali aatala amyunda yamasansa, antomwe a Zabbidi mu Syifumite wakali aatala amyuunda yamichelo yama gilepusi antomwe ayawayini.
Aatala aminsamu yama olifa antomwe amisamu yamikuyu eyo yakali mumakkuti kwakali Bbaalu - Hanani uzwa ku Geda, alimwi aatala aziyobwedo zyamafuta kwakali Jowasyi.
Aatala amatanga ambono ezyo zyakali kwembelelwa mu Syiloni kwakali Syitilayi uzwa ku Syaloni, alimwi aatala amatanga ambono ezyo zyakali mumisena kwakali Syafati mwana mulombe wa Adilayi.
Aatala ankamela kwakali Obbilu mu Isyimayeli, alimwi aatala amadonki mazyazi kwakali Jedeyiya uzwa kuMelonoti. Aatala amatanga ambono kwakali Jazizi mu Hagiliti.
Jazizi mu Hagiliti wakali kulangisisya mbono zyonse. Aaba boonse basilutwe bakali kulanga imbono zyoonse zya Mwami Davida.
Jonatani, simyunzyaakwe Davida kali sinkuta, mbwakali mwaumi musongo alimwi kali mulembi. Jehiyeli mwana mulombe wa Hakkimoni wakali kubbasopa bana balombe bamwami.
Ahitofelu wakali sinkuta wamwami, antomwe a Husyayi uzwa kubantu ba Akkite abo bakali basikulaya mwami mukambetwa.
Chuno cha Ahitofelu chakabweza a Jehoyiyada mwana mulombe wa Bbenayiya, antomwe a Abbiyata. Jowabbu wakali silutwe wampi yamwami.

Davida wakabungania bendelezi baba Izilayeli boonse ku Jelusalemu: Bapati bamikowa, bapati batubunga twakali kubelekela mwami milimu muchiindi chakabikidwe, bapati babasilumamba bazyuulu abamyaanda, basikwendela zyazintu zyoonse abuvubi bwamwami abana bakwe mulombe, abapati abalumi basilumamba, kubikilizya abaabo bakayiide loko.

Mpawo mwami Davida wakanyampuka amawulu aakwe wakati, ''Amundiswilile, nobakulana bangu anobantu bangu. Ndakali kuyeeya kuyaka ng'anda yabbokesi lyachizuminano cha Jehova; achitandabalilo chamawulu aa Leza wesu, aboobo ndakatalika kulibambila kuyaka.
Pele Leza wakandambila kuti, 'tokoyoyakila izina lyangu ing'anda pe, nkambo ulimwalumi wenkondo alimwi wakatila bulowa.'

Nekubaboobo Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli wakandisala kuzwa kung'anda yoonse yataata kuti mbe mwami wa Izilayeli walyonse, wakasala Juda kuba musololi, akuzwa kung'anda yataata, alimwi kubana balombe boonse bataata wakabotelwa kundibika kuba mwami waba Izilayeli boonse.
Kuzwa kubana banji abo Jehova mbakapa ndime, wasala Solomoni, mwana mulombe wangu, kuti akkale achuno chabwami bwa Jehova, aatala a Izilayeli.
Wakandambila kuti, 'Solomoni mwana wako mulombe nguyoyaka ng'anda yangu abusena bwakubetekela, nkambo ndamusala kuti abe mwana wangu mulombe, alimwi ayoba wisi.
Njoyimikizya bwami bwakwe lyoonse, na wakakatila akuswilila milawu yangu ambeta zyangu, mbubonya mbobede sunu.'

Lino sunu, mumenso aba Izilayeli boonse, eeyi mbungano ya Jehova, akumenso aa Leza wesu, moonseni mwelede kubamba akusoleka kubamba milawu yoonse ya Jehova Leza wenu. Amuchite eezi kuti muvube nyika eeyi mbotu akuyiisya mumanza abana banu bachiza ibelukono lwabo kwalyoonse.

Ayebo, Solomoni mwanangu mulombe, swilila Leza wawuso, akumubelekela amoyo wako woonse amuuya uzumina. CAhita eezi nkambo Jehova ulalingula myoyo yoonse akuswilila kubotezegwa kwamiyeeyo yawumwi awumwi. Kuti wamuyanduula, ulamujana, pele na wamuleka, uyokukaka kwalyoonse.
Yibaluka kuti Jehova wakusala kuti uyake ng'anda eeyi bube busena busalala. Koyuma akuchita mbubo.''

Mpawo Davida wakapa Solomoni mwanakwe mulombe bwime bwachikozyanisyo chalukonkono lwakunembo lyantempele, abwiime bwayo, ang'anda yazilondwedo, atwanda twakujulu, atwaanda twamukati, ang'anda ilachivunisyo chaluzyalo.
Wakamupa chifwanikisyo nchakalembede chalubuwa lwang'anda ya Jehova, maanda woonse azyuungulukide, ng'anda yaziyobwedo mung'anda ya Leza, achaziyobwedo chazintu zya Jehova.
Wakamupa milawu yazibunga zyabapayizi azyaba Levi, amilimo yoonse yakubamba ng'anda ya Jehova, azintu zyoonse zyakubelesya mung'anda ya Jehova.
Wakayibalukwa bulemu bwazibikilo zyoonse zyangolida amulimo wachimwi achimwi,

bulemu bwachimikililo chansiliva amulimo wachimwi achimwi, abulemu bwangolida abwazintu zyonse zyangolida, zibe zyimikililo zyamalampi amalampi angolida, abulemu bwansiliva bwachimwi achimwi chimikililo chansiliva, mbuli chibelesyo chachimwi achimwi chimikililo chalampi.
Wakapa bulemu bwangolida bwamatebuli azinkwa zyakaliwo, bwatebuli limwi alimwi, abulemu bwansiliva bwamatebuli ansiliva.
Wakapa bulemu bwangolida iisalalisya aziyasyo zyanyama, ayandido, ankomesi, wakapa bulemu bwansambilo zyangolida imwi ayimwi, abulemu bwazisambilo zyansiliva yazimwi azimwi.
Wakapa bulemu bwangolida iisalazidwe yatununkilizyo twachipayizyo, achifwanikisyo cha kkelubbimu ooyo wakayala mababa aakwe akuvumba bbokesi lyachizuminano cha Jehova.
Davida wakamba kuti, ''Ndabika zyoonse eezi mubulembo mbuli Jehova mbwakanditondezya akundipa kumvwisisisya akuyeeya chifwanikisyo.''

Davida wakambila Solomoni mwanakwe mulombe kuti, ''Koyuma akuba singuzu. Chita mulimo. Utayoowi naa kukankama, nkambo Jehova Leza, Leza wangu, uuli ayebo. Takoyokusisya na kukuleka mane mulimo woonse wang'anda ya Jehova uukamane.

Bona, nzeezi nkamu zyabapayizi aba Levi bakubeleka milimo yoonse yang'anda ya Leza. Banoli ayebo, antoomwe aboonse bazumina abantu bajisi luzibo akukugwasya kumulimo akukuchita mulimo, bendelezi abantu boonse balibambilide kutobela malayilile aako.''

Mwami Davida wakambila imbungano yoonse, ''Solomoni mwana wangu mulombe, oyo alikke Leza ngwakasala, uchili mwana aluzibo luchili luche, amulimo mupati. Nkambo intempele tiili yabantu pe pele njiiya Jehova Leza.

Elyo ndachita zyoonse nzindakonzya kukugwasya kuntempele ya Leza wangu. Ndapa ingolida yazintu zichitwa angolida, ansiliva yazintu zichitwa nsiliva, amukkuba wazintu zichitwa amukuba, abutale bwazintu zichitwa abutale, azisamu zyazintu zichitwa azisamu. Alimwi ndilapa mabwe, ayelede kubikwa, mabwe akubikka mukati amabalamabala--amabwe mayandisi woonse amusyo musyobo--alimwi amabwe luuma mubwingi bwawo.

Lino, nkaambo kachiyandisyo changu mung'anda ya Leza wangu, ndilapa lubono lwangu kuzwa kuchiyobwedo changu changolide achansiliva. Ndikuchita eezi aatala azezyo zyoonse nzimbambilide intempele iisalala:
zyuulu zyotatwe zili musanu azibili zyamatalenta asalazidwe ansiliva, yakuziluluzya bulambo bwaziyake.
Ndikusanga ingolida yazintu zichitwa angolida, ansiliva yazintu zichitwa ansiliva, azintu zyamilimo yamisyobo yoonse ichitwa ababezi. Ngwani awumwi uyanda usanga kuli Jehova sunu akulipa kulinguwe.''
Elyo zipo zyakulimvwa zyakachitwa abazulwidi bempuli zyabasikale babo, bazulwidi bamikowa ya Izilayeli, basilutwe bazyuulu abamyaanda, abeendelezi bamulimo wamwami.

Bakapa kumulimo wang'anda ya Leza zyuulu zilimusanu zyamatalenta azyuulu zilikkumi zyampondo zyangolida, azyuulu zilikkumi zyamatalenta ansiliva, azyuulu zilikkumi amusanu azitatu zyamatalenta amukkuba 100,000 zyabutale.
Aabo bakali amabwe mayandisi bakaapa kuchiyobwedo chang'anda ya Jehova, mubwendelezi bwaJahieli, walunyungu lwaba Gelisoni.
Bantu bakasekelela nkambo kazeezi zipo zyakulimvwa, nkambo bakasanga amyoyo yoonse kuli Jehova. Alakwe mwami Davida wakasekelela kapati.
Davida wakalongezya Jehova kunembo lyambungano. Wakati, ''Kolumbayizigwa, Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli sikale wesu, kwalyoonse mane kukabe kutamani.
Nzizyako, Jehova, mubupati bwako, inguzu, ibulemu, iluzundo, alimwi abwami. Azyonse ezyo zili kujulu aansi nzizyako. Bwami mbubwako, Jehova, alimwi ulisumpwidwe mbuli simutwe wazyonse.
Zyonse buvubi abulemu zizwa kuli nduwe, alimwi ulendelezya bantu boonse. Mujanza lyako mulinguzu abupati. Wavubya nguzu abupati kuchita bantu babe bapati akupa nguzu kulumwi awumwi.
Mpawo linobu, Leza wesu, tulakulumba alimwi tulalumbayizya izina lyako bbotu.
Pele ndimeni mebo, alimwi mbaani bo bantu bangu, kuti tukonzye kupa kumaninide zintu eezi? Nkasimpe, zyonse zintu zizwa kwako, alimwi twabwedezya biyo kuli nduwe ezyo izyako.
Nkambo tulibeenzu alimwi tulibanakweenda kunembo lyako, mbubonya mbuli bwakabede basikale besu. Mazuba esu ansi ano alimbuli mwenzule, alimwi takwepe bulangizi bwakukkala kwalyonse anyika ano.
Jehova Leza wesu, boonse buvubi oobu mbutwabungika mukuti tuyakile zina lyako lisalala intempele--zizwa kuli nduwe alimwi nzizyako.

Ndilizi alimwi,  Leza wangu, kuti ulalanga moyo alimwi ulabotelwa bululami. Lwangu ndemwini, mukululama kwamoyo wangu ndayandisya kupa zintu ezi zyoonse, lino ndilakondwa abantu bako baliwo aano balipeda kupa zipo kuli nduwe.
Jehova, Leza wa Abbulahamu, Izakka, a Izilayeli--basikale besu----bamba echi kwalyoonse mumizezo amumakanze abantu bako. Koyenzya myoyo yabo kulinduwe.

Komupa Solomoni mwana wangu mulombe chiyandisyo chamoyo umaninide wakubamba milawo yako yoonse, chizuminano chambeta zyako amalayilile aako, akubweza mabambe woonse akuyaka ng'anda njindabambila makani.''
Davida wakambila mbungano yonse, ''Kwalino mulongezye Jehova Leza wenu.'' Imbungano yoonse yakalongezya Jehova, Leza wabasikale babo, alimwi bakamukotamina akutondezya kumulemeka antomwe akumwami.

Mubuzuba bwakatobela, bakachita chipayililo kuli Jehova akumpa chipayililo chakuumpa kuli nguwe. Bakapeda chuulu chabasipule, chuulu chabagutu, alimwi achuulu chabana bambelele, kubikilizya azipayizyo zyabo zyakunywa alimwi bakapayizya mubwingi bwabo bonse ba Izilayeli.

Mubuzuba obo, bakalya akunywa kubusyu bwa Jehova akusekelela kupati. Bakananika Solomoni, mwana mulombe wa Davida, mwami lwabili akumunanika abwami bwa Jehova kuba mwendelezi. Alimwi pawo bakananika Zadoki kuba mupayizi.
Mpawo Solomoni wakakkala achuno cha Jehova mbuli mwami muchibaka chakelede Davida wisi wakwe. Wakazwidilila, alimwi Izilayeli wonse wakamutelela.
Bazuluzi boonse, abasilumamba, abana balombe bamwami Davida bakapa bumboni kumwami Solomoni.
Jehova wakapa Solomoni bulemu bugambya kumenso aba Izilayeli boonse akumupa nguzu mpati kwinda bamwi baami bakamutangunina mu Izilayeli.
Davida mwana mulombe wa Jese wakeendelezya ba Izilayeli boonse.
Davida wakaba mwami wa Izilayeli kwamyaaka iili musanu ayibili mu Hebbuloni amyaaka iili makkumi oone. Wakeendelezya kwamyaka iili makumi otatwe amyaaka yotatwe mu Jelusalem.
Wakoongola kabotu mane lumwi wakafwa, musule lyakubotelwa buumi bulamfu, buvubi abulemu, Solomoni mwana wakwe mulombe ngwakalya izina lyakwe.
Makani matanzi amasyalizi aMwami Devidi alilembedwe mulwaano lwa Samiyele musinsimi, amulwaano lwa Natani musinsimi, amulwaano lwa Gadi musinsimi.
Zilembedwe oomo njemilimo yabwendelezi bwakwe, azintu izyakasika kulinguwe, akuchisi chaba Izilayeli, akubwami boonse bwakuzisi zimwi zyaanyika.
Pawulo, wakayiitwa aKkilisito Jesu kuti abe Mutumwa kwiinda mukuyanda kwaLeza, aSositinesi mukwesu,

kumbungano yaLeza iliku Kkolinto, abo bakasalazigwa muliKkilisitu Jesu akwambwa kuti mbantu basalala, antoomwe aboonse bali mumasena oonse abayiita zina lya Mwami Jesu Kkilisito, ulingonguwe Mwami waboandiswe.
Ngamube aluzyalo a lumunoluzwa kuli Leza Taata aMwami Jesu Kkilisito.
Ndilumba Leza nkambo kandinywe nkaambo kaluzyalo lwaLeza olo Kkilisito Jesu ndwakamupa.
Wakamuchita bavubi munzila zyoonse, mukwambula koonse aluzibo loonse,
alimwi mbuli bukamboni atala aKkilisito mbubwa boneka kuti mbwamasimpe akati kanu.
Aboobo tamubuli chipo chaMuuya mbumulindide chakulangila kuyubununwa kwaMwami wesu Jesu Kkilisito.
Uyoomuchita kuti mukasyome chakumaninina kusikila kumamanino, ikuti mutakabi amulandu mubuzuba bwaMwami wesu Jesu Kkilisito.
Leza ulisyomekede, wakamwita kuti mukabilane aMwana, Jesu Kkilisito Mwami wesu.
Lino ndamukumbila, nibakwesu, kwiinda muzina lyaMwami wesu Jesu Kkilisito, kuti moonse mulazuminana, akuti takuyoobi kupambukana antoomwe kamulamuzeezo umwi amakanze amwi.
Mbundakambilwa atala andinywe nobakwesu, kuzwa kubantu  baKkuluzi ikuti kulikujatana akati kanu.
Ndilikwamba eechi: umwi awumwi waamba kuti, "Ime ndili wa Pawulo," na kuti, "Ime ndili wa Apolosi," na kuti "Ime ndili wa Sifasi," na kuti "Ime ndili wa Kkilisito."
Ani sa Kkilisito ulipambukene na? Ani Pawulo wakagankamininwa ndinywe na? Ani mwaka bbabbatisigwa muzina lyaPawulo na?
Ndilumba Leza kuti takwe ngundakabbabbatizya pe, kunze kwa Kilisipasi aGayosi.
Eechi chakachitwa kuti kutabi waamba kuti mwakabbabbatizigwa muzina lyangu.
( Alimwi ndakabbabbatizya bang'anda yaSitefano. Kwiinda awo, tandikonzyi kuyeeya kuti kulibambi na mbindakabbabbatizya.)
Nkaambo Kkilisito takandituma kuti ndika bbabbatizye pesi ikuti ndikakambawuke makani mabotu kutaamba amajwi abuchenjezu, mukuti chingano chaKkilisito chitakawubulwi nguzu zyacho.
Nkaambo makani achingano chaKkilisito mbufubafuba kulabo balimukunyonyoka. Pesi akati kabaabo bafutulwa, ninguzu zyaLeza.
Nkaambo kulilembedwe kuti,"Ndiyomwayisya busongo bwabasongo. Ndiyokonga kumvwisisya kwabachenjede."
Ulikuli muntu musongo? Ulikuli mulembi? Ulikuli sikukazya wanyika eeno? Sa Leza takasandula busongo bwanyika kubufubafuba?
Nkaambo nyika mubusongo bwayo teyakamuziba Leza, Leza wakabotelwa kuti afutule abo basyoma kwiinda mubufubafuba bwakukambawuka.
Nkaambo maJuda bakumbila zitondezyo zigambya baGiliki bayandula busongo.
Pesi tukambawuka Kkilisto wakagankaminwa, Nchilebyo kumaJuda alimwi mbufubafuba kulibaMasi.
Pesi kulaabo Leza mbakayita, aantomwe baJuda abaGiliki, tukambawuka Kkilisito mbuli nguzu abusongo bwaLeza.
Nkaambo bufubafuba bwaLeza bulayinda busongo bwabantu, alimwi kukompama kwaLeza kulanguzu kwiinda bantu.
Amulange kwiitwa kwanu, nobakwesu teeboonse banu bakali basongo mbuli kunyama. Teeboonse banu bakali basinguzu. Teeboonse banu bakalizyedwe kabali bana babaami.
Pesi Leza wakasala zintu zifubafuba zyanyika kuti awusye nsoni basongo. Leza, wakasala echo chikompeme munyika kuti akawusye  nsoni echo chilanguzu.
Leza wakasala echo chilansi alimwi chawuubulwa munyika. Alimwi wakasala zintu zitegwa takwe mbuzibede pe, kuti akazijosye ansi ezyo, zilangilwa kuti zintu loko.
Wakazichita ezi kuti kutakabi nyama ilikankayizya kunembo lyakwe.
Nkaambo kacheechi Leza nchakachita, lino mwaba muliKkilisito Jesu oyo utubeda busongo buzwa kuli Leza. Wakaba bululami bwesu, busalali, alununuko lwesu.
Kuti kukabe mbuli mbukulembedwe kuti, " Na kuli ulikankayizya, alikankayizizye muMwami Leza."
Nindakaza kulindinywe, nobakwesu, tendakaza abunnone bwamulaka kana busongo awoo nindakompolola simpe lisisidwe ataala aLeza.
Nkambo ndakasala kutaziba chintu awo nindakali andinywe kunze kwaJesu Kkilisito, akugankaminwa kwakwe.
Alimwi ndakali andinywe mukubula nguzu amukuyowa, amukukankama.
Alimwi mulayizyo wangu akukambawuka kwangu tekwakali amajwi akukombelezya chabusongo. Pesi, akali achitondezyo chamuuya anguzu,
kuchitila kuti lusyomo lwenu talubi mubusongo bwabantu, pesi munguzu zyaLeza.
Lino twambula busongo mukati kabantu bazyikitide, pesi butali busongo bwanyika eeyi, kana bwendelezi bwalino, aboo bayobwinda.
Anukuti twambula abusongo bwaLeza musimpe lisisidwe, busongo busisidwe oobo Leza mbwakali wabikka kunembo lyamyaka yabulemu besu.
Takwe naba omwe wabendelezi balino wakachimvwisisisya, nkambo anoli bakachimvwisissya, nikuli tebakamukankamina pe Mwami wabulemu.
Pesi mbuli mbukulembedwe, ''Takwe lisyo lyabona, takwe kutwi kwamvwa, takwe moyo wamuntu waziyandula eezyo Leza nzyabambila aboo bamuyandula.''
Pesi Leza wayibununa zintu eezi kulindiswe kwiindila muMuuya. Nkambo Muuya ulayandula zintu zyoonse, nikuba zintu zyaLeza zinikide.
Nkambo ngwani uzi mizeezo yamuntu ado woMuuya wamuntu nuuli anguwe? Nkokuli alimwi, takwe muntu uzi zintu zyaLeza zinikide ado wo Muuya waLeza.
Pesi tetwakatambula Muuya wanyika pesi Muuya ooyo uzwa kuli Leza.
Twambule atala azintu eezi mumajwi akatayisigwa abusongo bwamuntu pesi aMuuya, kawupandulula zintu zyaMuuya kubantu baMuuya.
Muntu utakwe Muuya tazitambuli pe zintu zyaku Muuya waLeza, nkambo nzyabufubafuba kuli nguwe. Takonzyi pe kuzimvwisisisya nkambo ziselezegwa aMuuya.
Ooyo ulimuMuuya ngukonzya kweela zintu zyoonse, psi takonzeki kweelwa azimwi.
''Nkambo ngwani ulikonzya kuziba kuyeya kwaMwami chakuti unga ulamulayilila? Pesi ulijisi muzeezo waKkilisito.
Alimwi andime, bakwesu, tendalikunowambula kulindinywe mbuli bantu basimuuya, pesi biyo mbuli kubantu banyama, mbuli kubana baniini muliKkilisito.
Ndakamusanina amakupa, pe pe chakulya chiyumu, nkambo temwalina libambila; nikuba lino tamuna kulibambila.
Nkaambo inywebo muchili munyama. Kaambo aali buzuba akukazyanya akati kanu, tamulikupona mbuli basinyama, tamulikwenda mbuli  kupona kwamubuntu na?
Nkaambo umwi waamba kuti, ''Nditobela Pawulo,'' alubo umwi waamba kuti, ''Nditobela Apolosi,'' tamuli zilengwa zyabuntu biyo na?
Ngwani mpo Apolosi? Ngwani Pawulo? Babelesi kwiinda mumulawu ngwakazumina,  mbuli Mwaami mbakapa mulimu kuli umwi.''
Ndakabyala, alubo Apolosi wakatilila, pesi Leza nguupa kukomezya.
Mpo lino, te ooyo uubyala na utilila uli mbabede. Pesi nguLeza uupa kukomena.
Lino ooyo uubyala alubo uutilila mbamwi, alubo umwi uyootambula chaabilo chakwe mbuli kumulimu wakwe.
Nkaambo tuli basimulimunyina aLeza. Mulimuunda waLeza, mayake aLeza.
Mbuli kuluzyalo lwaLeza lwakapegwa ndime mbuli muyaki ukonzesya, ndakabika intalisyo alubo umwi ulayaka alinjiyo. Pesi muleke umwi uyeyesya Mbayaka alinjiyo.
Nkaambo takukwe uunga ulabamba ntalisyo imbi itali eeyo yakabikwa, kiili, Jesu Kkilisito.
Lino na umwi ulayaka aatala antalisyo a ngolide, nsiliva, mabwe ayandika, zisamu, makuba, matete,
mulimu wakwe ulakuyubununwa, nkaambo buzuba buyobuyubununa. Nkaambo uyooyubununwa mumulilo. Mulilo ulabweezya bube bwawumwi anzyakachita.
Na mulimu wawumwi ukayimikile, ulakutambula chabilo;
pesi na mulimu wawumwi wapya, ulakujana kuswekelwa, pesi we lwakwe uyofutulwa, mbuli ufutuka kwiinda mumulilo.
Tamuzi na kuti muli tempele yaLeza akuti muuya waLeza ukkala muli ndinywe?
Na umwi ulajaya tempele yaLeza, Leza ulamujaya muntu ooyo. Nkaambo tempele yaLeza ilasalala, alubo alwenu.
Kutabi umwi uulyena. Na umwi wenu akati kenu uyeya kuti musongo muchiindi echino, mumuleke abe '''mufubafuba'' kuti abe musongo.
Kaambo busongo bwenyika iino mbufubafuba aLeza. Kaambo kulilembedwe, ''Ulajata basongo mubuchenjezu bwabo.''
Alubo, ''Mwaami ulizi kuti kuyeya kwabasongo nkwabuyo.''
Akaambo kacheechi kutabi umwi ulikankayizya mubantu.Zyoonse zintu nzizyenu,
do Pawulo, na Apolosi, na Kefasi, na nyika, na buumi, na lufu, na zintu ziliko, na zintu zichiza. Zyoonse zintu nzizyenu,
alubo muli baKkilisito, alimwi Kkilisito ngu waLeza.
Mbuboobu muntu mbwayelede kutubona, mbuli balanda ba Kkilisito ababanzi bakasimpe ka Leza kasisikene.
Lino chiyandika kubabanzi nchakujanika mukusyomeka.
Pesi kulindime nchintu chinini kuti ndibetekwe andinywe nikuba nkutaya abantu. Nkambo nsikwe nindili beteka ndemwini.
Taakwe luzibo atala alubeteko lwachitwa atala andime, pesi echo tachaambi kuti ndategwa tandikwe kaambo. Oyo  undibeteka ngu Mwami.

Nkenkaako utambilizyi lubeta atala achimwi chintu kachitanasika chiindi, katanakubola Mwami. Uyoyeta kumumuuni zintu zisisikene zyamumudima  akuyubununa makanze amoyo. Mpawo umwi awumwi uyotambula kulumbayizigwa kuzwa kuli Leza.

Lino, nopbakwesu, ndakabelesya malayilile aya kulindime ndemwini a Apolosi nkambo kandinwe, kuchitila kuti kuzwa kulindiswe inga mulayiiya kuti, ''Utaakwindilili kuli zilembedwe.'' Eechi chili boobu kuchitila kuti kutabi umwi ulisumpula atala aluumwi.
Ino ngwani uubona nikuba musiyano akati kanduwe awumwi? Ninzi nchalacho eecho nchotatambwide ? Ikuti wakachitambula, nkamboonzi nolikankayizya mbotatedi tewakachitambula?
Ikaale mwakali azyo zyoonse nzimwali kunoyanda. Ikale mwababavubi ! Mwakatanguna kwendelezya alubo akuba ampela kuzwa kulindiswe ! Inchoonzyo, ndalikuyandisya kuti mwendelezye andinywe.
Nkambo ndiyeeya kuti Leza wakatubika ba Apositola akutondezya mbuli chakumaninizya mumunchali, mukubambulula, ambuli balumi batongelwa lufu. Twaba chitondezyo kunyika - akuba anelo, akubantususu.
Tuli bafubafuba nkambo ka Kkilisito, pesi mulibasongo muli Kkilisito. Twateta, pesi mulibayumu. Mwajatwa mubulemu, pesi twajatwa mukubawulwa.
Manedo kuchiindi echi tulenzala enyota, twazwata chabuchete, twawumwa, alimwi tatuchikwe myunzi.
Tubeleka chenuzu nkatubelesya maboko eesu. Nitwatukilwa twalongezegwa. Nitupenzewa, tulakakatila.
Nitusampawulwa, tulambuula chaluzyalo. Twachita biyo mbuli masifwinini biyo aanyika atombe lyazintu zyonse.
Tandili kulemba zintu ezi kukumufwisya bweeme pe, pesi kukumu chenjezya mbuli bana bangu bayandisi.
Aboobo nikuba kuti waba ezyuulu zilikkumi zyabasimalelo muli Kkilisito, tokwe bamawuso biingi pe. Nkambo ndakaba wuso wanu muli Kkilisito Jesu kwinda mumakani mabotu.
Aboobo ndamusunwazya kuti mube basikutobelezya ndime.
Nchenchicho nchindaka mutumina Timoti, muyandwi wangu amwana wanu usyomeka mu Mwami. Uyomuyeezya inzila zyangu muli Kkilisito, mbubonya mbuli mbundimuyiisya konse konse amumbungano zyonse.
Lino bamwi benu bakaba basikulisumpula, kabachitanga tandichibooli kuli ndinywe.
Pesi ndizoboola chakufwambana kulindinywe, naa kuti Mwami wayanda. Aboobo tandikwe kuyoziba majwi abuyo pe aboobo balisumpula, pesi ndiyobona nguzu zyabo.
Nkambo ibwami bwa Leza tabuli bwakwamba biyo pesi munguzu.
Niinzi nchimuyanda? Sena ndize kulindinywe ankoli naa aluyando mumuuya muteteete?
Twakamvwa mpuwo kuti mamambe akati kanu, musyobo wamalalane utazumizigwi akati kabatali bazumini.
Mwalumi ulala amwanakazi wawisi. Mwafundikila! Sena tamuyelede kulila, kuchitila kuti umwi wachita chiito eecho agwisigwe kuzwa akati kanu.
Nikuba nsiko mumubili, mpundili mumuya. Ndapa kale lubeteko ali wumwi wachita eechi, mbuli kubanga ndaliwo.
Kuti kamungene muzina lyaMwami wesu Jesu mpawo ndili andinywe mumuya aanguzu zyaMwami wesu Jesu mpuzili.
Mupe mwalumi oyu kuli dyabbulosi nkambo kakunyonyonwa kwanyama, kuchitila kuti muuya wakwe ufutulw mubuzuba bwaMwami.
Kulisumpula kwako tensi kubotu. Tuzi na kuti kaswezyo kache kalafufumuna chibunge?
Lisalazye lwako kuzwa kubuswezyo bukulukulu kuchitila kuti kube chiwela chipya, chitakwe buswezyo, mbuli mbumubede choonzyo. Kuli Kkilisito, kabelele kesu kakwindilila, kaka payigwa.
Lino atubotelwe pobwe, litakwe buswezyo bukulukulu, buswezyo bwazichito zibi aa buntu bubi. Pesi, atubotelwe aachibunge chitakwe buswezyo nchoozyo aa bwini.
Ndakamulembela mulugwalo lwangu  mutavwelani abantu abasimamambe.
Kakutakwe nzila imbi nsyambi basibwamu bayino nyika, olo muunyu, silweeno, kana kuti basimamambe, kuzwa kukkala kule ambabo muyelede kuzwa kunyika.

Lino ndamulembela kuti mutalivwelanganisyi amuntu uyitwa kuti mukwesu pesi upona mumalalane, kana kuti muunyu na kuti sibwamu, na kuti simakani alunyansyano, na kuti mukolwi, na kuti silweeno. Mutalyi chiiyo amuntu ulibobu.
Ndinjilali kukubeteka abo bali aanze achikombelo?
Pesi, tuyelede kubeleka aabo bali aanze. ''Gwasya muntu mubi kuzwa akati kanu.''
Kuti umwi ulakambo atala awumwi, ulayinka kumulawu na wabataluleme kwiinda kuti aye kubantu baLeza basalala?
Tamuzi na kuti bantu baLeza basalala bayoobeteeka nyika? Kuti na katuyoobeteka nyika, sa tamukonzyi kukkazikwa twaambo tunini?
Tamuzi na kuti tuyoobeteka baangelo? kwiinda biyeni mpo, sa ngatulabeteka makani abuumi obu?
Kuti na kamuyoochita lubeta lweendelene abuumi bwamazuba oonse, nkaambonzi nimutola twaambo kulibabo mbuli ootu kuli baabo balangilwa ansi mumbungano?
Ndamwambila eechi kuti ndimuusye nsoni. Takwe na umwi akati kanu musongo unga ulakonzya kukkazikizya twaambo kulibakwesu?
Pesi umwi mukwesu uya kumulawu atala awumwi mukwesu, alimwi kazi chitilwa kunembo lyabatasyomi pe!
Nkambo kakuti muyisi kubetekana chanu chanu muzundidwe kale. Nkambo nimutake mwalipeda kuba babi? Nkambo nywebo nubeni nimutakwe mwalipeda kubbidwa?
alimwi muchita eezi kuli bamwi banu!
Tamuzi na kuti bataluleme tabakoyookona Bwami bwaLeza? Muteenwi. Basimalalano, basikukomba mizimu, basibwamu, balumi baanu abo bakwatana chabo chabo,
babba, batangala, bakolwa, basikutamikizya, abasikulyamaanu takwe akati kabo uyookona bwami bwaLeza.
Mbubaalibede bamwi banu. Pesi mwakasanzigwa, akusalazigwa, akululamikwa muzina lyaMwami Jesu Kkilisito aMuuya waLeza.
''Zyoonse zilimumulawo kulindime,'' Pesi teezyoonse zipa mpindu. ''Zyoonse zilimumulawu kulindime'' Pesi tandikwe kwakwendeleezegwa nikuba achimwi chazyo.
''Chakulya nchabula, alimwi bula mbwachakulya'' Pesi Leza uyoozimwayisya zyoonse. Mubili tweesi wabwaamu, pesi mubili ngwaMwami Leza, alubo Mwami nguyoopa nziyanda mubili.
Leza antoomwe wakabusya Mwami alimwi uyootubusya aswebo munguzu zyakwe. Tamuzi na kuti mibili yanu nzizo zyaKkilisito?
Sa tulelede na kuti ndigwisye zizo zyaKkilisito akuziswanizya kubwamu? Kutabi mbuboobo!
Tamuzi na kuti oyo uswanizigwa kumamambe ngawaba mubili umwi anguwe? Mbuli malembe mbwaamba kuti, ''Babili bayoobanyama imwi.''
Pesi oyo uswanizigwa kuMwami ulaba muuya umwi anguwe.
Amuchije kumalalano! Kufumbwa chibi muntu nchachita chili kunze amubili, pesi malalano abisya mubili wako numwini.
Tamuzi na kuti mibili yanu nin'anda yaMuuya Usalala, upona mulindinywe, ngumulaawo muliLeza? Tamuzi na kuti tamulibenu pe? Nkambo mwakawulwa amuulo.
Nkikaako ngamulumbayizye Leza amibili yanu amumuuya wanu nkambo nzizyakwe.
Lino kumakani ngimwakandilembela, ''Nchibotu kuti mwaalumi atagumi mwanakazi.''
Pele akaambo kamasunko anchito zyiingi zyamamambe, umwi awumwi  mwaalumi weelede kuba a mwnwkazi wakwe, alkwe mwanakazi abe a mwaalumi wakwe.
Mwaalumi weelede kuzuzikizya mulimu wakwe akuba alulalano a mwanakazi wakwe, mbubonya oobo alakwe mwanakazi kumulimu wakwe.
Teensi mwanakazi uli abwaami kumubili wakwe, pele mulumi. Alimwi mwaalumi tajisi bwaami aatala amubili wakwe, pele mwanakazi nguujisi.

Mutakatazyanyi umwi awumwi, pele amuzuminane kuchita oobo zimwi zyiindi. Muchite oobo kuti mubike myoyo kukukomba. Eelyo mubole muswanane lubo, kuti Satani atamusunki nkaambo kakukachilwa kwanu kulijata.
Pele ndaamba makani aya miyeyo yangu pe pe mbuli mulayizyo.
Ndili kuyeya kuti woonse abe mbuli ndime. Pele umwi awumwi uli achipo chakwe kuzwa kuli Leza. Umwi uli awoyu musyobo wachipo, awumwi uulya musyobo.
Kuli batakwetwe akuli bamukabafu ndamba kuti nchintu chibotu kuti bukkale kabatakwetwe mbuli ndime.
Pele kuti kabatakonzyi kulijata, baleelede kukwata na kukwatwa. Nkaambo nchintu chibotu kuti bakwate na kukwatwa kwiinda kufwa amunyamunya.
Lino kuli bakwete, ndamupa mulawu ooyu, - teensi ndime, pele nguMwaami: ''Mwanakazi teeled kulekana amulumi wakwe.''
Pele waanzana amulumi wakwe, uleelede kukkala katakwetwe kana kubwedelana a mulumi wakwe.
Pele kuli boonse ndati - Ime, pe pe Mwaami - kuti mukwesu uli a mwanakazi utali muzumini, kuti kakkutisikene kukkala anguwe, teelede kumuleka pe.
Kuti mwanakazi uli a mwaalumi utali utazumini, kuti kakkutisikene kukkala anguwe, teelede kumuleka pe.
Nkaambo mwaalumi utazumini ulasalazigwa nkambo ka mwanakazi wakwe, alakwe mwanakazi utazumini ulasalazigwa nkambo kamunyina. Abalo bana benu nibatasalali, pele lino balasalala.
Pele kuti utazumini wayanda kweenda, muleke ayinke. Muchiimo chiliboobo, mukwesu na muchizi taangidwe pe kuchikonke chabo. Leza watwiita kuti tukkale muluumuno.
Mbobuti mbokonzya kuziba, yomwanakazi, amwi uyoofutula mwaalumi wako? Na mbobuti mbokonzya kuziba, yomwaalumi, amwi uyoofutula mwanakazi wako?
Nekubaboobo, mbuli kuti Mwaami wakapa umwi awumwi chibela chakwe, umwi awumwi mbuli Leza mbakamwiita. Ooyu ngumulayizyo wangu kumbungano zyoonse.
Sa kufumbwa muntu wakali mupalulwe nakitwa kukuzumina? Teeled kusoleka kuboneka katapalwidwe.  Sa kufumbwa muntu wakatapalwidwe nakitwa kukusyoma? Ooyo atapalulwi.
Teensi kuti kupalulwa na kutapalulwa nkukujisi makani. Chijisi makani nkuswilila milawu yaLeza.
Umwi awumwi akkale mbuli mbayitwa aLeza kukuzumina.
Wakali muzike na Leza naakakwiita? Utalikatazyi anzizyo. Pele kuti kokonzya kwaangunuka kulaba mbubo.
Ooyo wakiitwa aMwaami kalimuzike ngumwaangunuke waMwaami. Mbubonya oobo, alakwe wakali mwaangunuke nakitwa kukuzumina ngomuzike waKkilisito.
Mwawulwa amuulo, mutachibi bazike babantu.
Bakwesu, kufumbwa chiimo nchuwakabede nwakayitwa, umwi awumwi akkale aLeza.
Lino kumakani abanakalindu, nsikwe mulawu uuzwa kuMwaami. Pele ndamupa miyeeyo yangu mbuliumwi, muluse lwaMwaami, akuba uusyomeka.
Nkaambo kaako, ndayeya kuti nkaambo kamapenzi aaboola, nchintu chibotu kumwaalumi kuti akkale mbwabede.
Sa ulangidwe kumwanakazi. Utazyanduuli kulekana. Kuti kwaangunukide kumwanakazi, utayanduuli mwanakazi.
Pele kuti wakwata, tobisizye pe. Pele aabo bachita balaja mapenzi miingi anyama, pesi ndayanda kumuvuna kuli zeezi.
Lino ncheechi nchingamba, bakwesu: Chiindi nchifwifwi. Kuzwa sunu kuya kunembo, aabo bakwete banakazi babe mbuli batakwete.
Abaabo balili babe mbuli batalili, abaabo basekelela babe mbuli batasekeleli, abaabo bawula babe mbuli batavubide chintu.
Abaabo babelesya zintu zyaansi batapangiki myoyo yabo kukubelesya nzizyo. Nkaambo nyika chiimo nchilimulinchicho iya kumamanino.
Ndayanda kuti mwaangunuke mumakatazyo. Mwaalumi utakwete ulalikatazizya zintu zyaMwaami, kuti abotezye Mwaami.
Pele mwaalumi ukwete ulalikatazizya zintu zyaansi, kuti abotezye mukakwe -
ulaanzene. Musimbi utakwetwe ulalikatazizya kuzintu zyaMwaami kuti asalale nikuba kumubili nikuba kumuuya. Pele mwanakazi uukwetwe ulalikankayizizya zintu zyaansi, kuti abotezye mulumi wakwe.
Aaya ndawamba kuti mugwasigwe, nsiyandi kubika kakole kulindinywe. Ndaamba aaya kuti kube zyeelede zibotu, mukalitakate kuMwaami kaatakwe lunyonyoko.
Kuti mpali uyeeya kuti tachitili munakalindu wakwe kabotu - kali munsi aaminyaka yakukwatwa - weelede kuchita mbayanda. Talimukubisya pe. Beelede kukwatana.
Pele mwaalumi uyima akujatisya mukati kamoyo wakwe, kuti katamanikide pele ulakonzya kweendelezya kuyanda kwakwe, alimwi kuti wayeya kuchita eezi mumoyo, akkale mbwabede, ulachita kabotu.
Elyo  ooyo ukwata nakalindu ulachita kabotu, pele ooyo ulisalila kutakwata ulachita kabotu chakwiinda.
Mwanakazi ulaangidwe kumulumi wakwe nachipona. Pele mulumi wakwe aafwa, waangunuka kukwatwa kufumbwa ngwayanda, pele kali muMwaami.
Pele mukuyeya kwangu nchibotu loko kuti ukkale mbuli mbabede. Alimwi ndayeya kuti ndili aMuuya waLeza.
Lino atala azilyo zipayizigwa kuzikozyano: Tulizi kuti toonse tulijisi luzibo . Iluzibo lulatutundumika, pesi luyando lulatuyaka.
Na umwi muntu uyeeya kuti ulizi chimwi, ooyo muntu tana kuziba mbuli mbweelede kuziba.
Pesi na umwi wayanda Leza ooyo muntu ulaziba aanguwe.
Nkiinkako atala akulya kuzipayilizidwe kuzikozyano: Tulizi kuti chikozyano chili muli eeyi inyika nchabiyo ngwabiyo akuti takukwe Leza pesi umwi.
Nikuba kuti  nkubali bakali bakali kutegwa mbaleza, nikuba kujulu naba ansi ( mbuli mbubali bayingi ''baleza'' amubwini bwabo ''bami''),

nikubabobo kulindiswe kuli Leza umwi biyo Taatesu, nkuzyakazwida zintu zyonse alimwi nutuponena swebo, amwami numwi Jesu Kkilisito, akwinda mulinuwe zintu zyonse zilapona, alimwi swebo tuponena kulinguwe.

Aboobo, kuti luzibo olu taluli kuli boonse.Pesi kuti, chimwi chindi bakali kukomba chikozyano, alimwi bakalya kulya oku mbuli chintu chakapayizidwe kuzikozyano. Miyeeyo ili sofwede nkaambo ilikompeme.
Pesi tensi kulya takukoyo twimikilila kuli Leza. Takukonzyi kubija na tetwalya zili mbubo na twalya.
Pesi amuchenjele kuti lwangunuko lwenu lutabi chilebyo kuli wabo bakompeme kulusyomo.
Nakuti tutedi umwi wakubona, ulaluzibo, ulokulya mung'anda yazikozyano. Sa temizeezo ikompeme kuti abe amanjeezezya kukulya zipayizigwa kuzikozyano?
Nkambo kumvwisisisya kwanu atala abube bwazikozyano, oyo ukompeme wabunyina ngwakafwida Kkilisito, wanyonyoonwa.
Nchinchicho, nchimubisizya bakwesu akujaya miyeyo yabo ikompeme, mukubisizya Kkilisito.
Nkinkaako, na kulya chaba chilebyo kumukwesu, nsikoyoolya limbi nyama, kuti nditawisyi mukwesu.
Ani nsilimwangunuke? Ani nsili mutumwa? Te ndakamubona na Jesu Mwami wesu?
Kuti nketali mutumwa kulibwami, pele ndilinguwe kulindinwe. Nkambo inywe mulichitondezyo chabutumwa bwangu muMwami.
Echi nchili kwabilizyo changu kulabo bandi lungulula:
Tatukwe chelelo na chakulya alubo aunywa?
Tatukwe chelelo na chakwenda antomwe amukazi nyina, mbuli mbuba chita boonse batumwa, alubo bananyina baMwami, alubo aKefasi?
Na takuli Bbanabbasi andime abo batakwe chelelo chakubeleka?
Ngwani ubeleka mbuli silumamba ulifozya? Ngwani ubyala munda wamasansa aboobo atalyi muchelo yawo? Kana ngwani wembela butanga aboobo katanywi malili kuzwa kubutanga?
Tandambi ezi zintu kazizwa kunguzu zyamuntu? Awalo mulawu tawambi  obo na?
Nkambo kuli lembedwe mulawo waMozesi," mutamwangi mulomo musune ulyatuka miila." Alimwi musune na Leza ngwayanda.
Talikwambula atala andiswe na? Zyakalembelwa ndiswe,  kaambo oyo ulima welede kulima abulangilizi, pele upola welede abulangizi bwa kwabana mubutebuzi.
Ikuti twakabyala zintu zyamuya akati kanu, zilindide na kuti tutyole zintu zijatika kuzwa kulindinywe?

Kuti bamwi bakali kuchita zyelelo kuzwa kulindinwe, swebo tatwelede zyindilide na? Asi tetwakayanda echi chelelo. Asikuti twaka kkakatila zintu zyoonse kuti kutabi chikachizya makani aKkilisito. Sa tamuzi na kuti abo bachita milimo yamunganda yaLeza bajana kulya kwabo munganda yaLeza?
Sa tamuzi na kuti abo babeleka kuchipayilo babilana ezyo nzibatula echipayililo?
Munzila njiyeyo, Mwami wakalayilila kuti abo bakkambawuka makani mabotu belede kujana zyakuli gwasya kumakani mabotu.
Asi tendakayanda chimwi chezyelelo ezi. Alimwi nsilembeli kuti ndichitilwe chimwi chintu. Nizyakalikabotu mendifwe. Takwe muntu uyondisampawula kukulikankayizya oku!
Na kuti ndakambawuka makani mabotu, nsyelede kulisumpula, nkambo ndelede kuchita obo, alimwi maawe kuli ndime kuti tenda kambawuka makani mabotu!
Na kuti ndachita chakuyanda, ndila mpindu. Asi kuti chakutayanda ndichila bubanzi mbundakapegwa.Nimpindunzi yangu?
Na kuti nekambawuka, ndipe vangeli katakwe mbadalo alimwi nsibwezi chelelo chizwide mumakani mabotu.
Nikuba ndangunwidwe kulizyoonse, ndakaba muzike kuliboonse kuchitila kuti ndijane zyiingi.

Kuba Juda ndakaba mbuli muJuda, kuchitila kuti ndijane abo balimunsi amulawu. Ndakachita echi nikuba kuti nsilimunsi amulawu. (ULB ula: Ndakachita ezi ime lwangu nketali munsi lyamuwa. Magwalo  achi Giliki echindi kalimache alubo kayandika abumwi bupanduluzi  bwachindi asiya kunze munchali oyu.)
Kulabo balanze amulawu, ndakaba mbuli umwi ulanze amulawo, nekuba tendakali kunze amulawo waLeza lwangu asi kunsi amulawu waKkilisito.  Ndakachita ezi kuchitila kuti ndijane abo balanze amulawu.
Kuba teteete ndakaba muteteete, kuchitila kuti ndeete bateteete. Ndakaba zintu zyoonse kubantu boonse kuchitila kuti amwi anzila zimwi ndalikufutula bamwi.
Ndichita zintu zyoonse nkambo kamakani mabotu kuchitila kuti ndikabe achabilo muzyolwe zyamakani mabotu.
Tamuzi na kuti mumuzundano boonse bala chijana basikuchijana muzundano, asi omwe ngujana bulumbu.
Umwi awumwi uchijana welede kulijata muzintu zyoonse. Balazichita kuti batambule musini umana, asi tulazichita kuti tutambule  oyo utamani.
Aboobo mbubobu mbundichijana, mbuli utakwe utakwe makanze; mbubobu mbewuma, katalimbuli uwuuma luwo.
Asi ndazunda mubili wangu alimwi nduuchita muzike, kuchitila kuti ndamana kukambawuka kuli bamwi, ime lwangu ntakajaniki abubi.
Tandiyandi kuti mutazibi, bakwesu, kuti bamataatesu bakali munsi ajoba alimwi bakayinda mulwizi .
Boonse bakabbabbatizigwa muli Mozesi mujoba alimwi amulwizi,
alimwi bonse bakalya chilyo chamuuya chikozyania.
Bonse bakanywa chakunywa chamuuya chikozyania. Nkambo bakanywa kubbwe lyamuuya elyo lyakabatobela, alimwi ibbwe elyo lyakali Kkilisito.
Pele bonse bakabotelwa abiingi babo, alimwi mitunta yabo yakalisapeene munkanda.
Lino zintu ezi zyakali chitondezyo kuli ndiswe, kuti tutakabi abo bemuuzya zintu zibi mbuli mbubakeemuzya.
Mutabi basikukomba mituni mbuli bamwi babo mbubakabede. Echi chilobu mbuli mbukulembedwe, ''Bantu bakakkala aansi kuti balye akunywa, alimwi kunyampuka kuti balisenie.''
Tutachiti bwamu, mbuli biingi babo mbubakachita, muzuba limwi, zyuulu zyamakumi abili azitatu zyabantu bakafwa nkambo kanchicho.
Tutabiki Kkilisito mukusunkwa, mbuli biingi babo mbubakachita alimwi bakanyonyoonwa anzoka.
Alimwi mutangunguni, mbuli bingi babo mbubakachita alimwi bakanyonyoonwa amungelo walufu.
Lino ezi zintu zyakachitika kuli mbabo mbuli chitondezyo kuli ndiswe. Zyakalembelwa kuti lube lulayo kulindiswe - kuli ndiswe abo mamanino achindi ngasikilide.
Nkambo kaako kufumbwa ani uyeeya kuti ulimvwi alangisisye kuti atabi nawa.

Takwe musunko umusikila atali ayo azibinkene kubantu boonse. Pele, Leza ulisyomekede. Takaoyomuzumizya kuti mukasunkwe zyiinda munguzu anu. Kusunko uyobikka inzila yakulizwa yo, kuchitila kuti mukakonzye kulyiminina.
Nkambo kako nobayandwa bangu, amuchije kuzwa kukukkomba mituni.
Imebo ndiwambula kulindinywe mbuli bantu bali akumvwisisisya, abobo mulakonzya kulangisisya nzindaamba.
Ikanywido kazilongezyo ako nkitulongezya, sena takali kakwabilana mubulowa bwa Kkilisito? Chinkwa nchitukwamuna tachili chakwabilana mumubili wa Kkilisito?
Nkambo kuli chinkwa chimwi, iswe nituli bingi tuli mubili umwi. Toonse tutola kuchinkwa chimwi antoomwe.
Langa kubantu bakwa Izilayeli. Tabali abo balya zipayizyo bali achakuchita achipayililo?
Ndokwambanzi mpo? Kuti chikozyanio nchimwi chintu? Nanka kulya kupayizigwa kuchikozyanio nchimwi chintu?
Pele ndikwamba atala azintu bamaasi nzibapayila, kuti batula zintu ezi kumadimoni kutali kuli Leza. Tandiyandi kuti mube azyakuchita amadimoni!
Tamukonzyi kunywa kanywido ka Mwamiakanywido kamadimoni.
Naa tudyokola Leza kubuzuba? Tulamanguzu na kwinda mbwabede?
''Choonse chintu chilazumizigwa,'' pesi tazili zyonse zintu zigwasya. ''Chonse chintu chilazumizigwa,'' Pele tensi chonse chintu chiyaka bantu.
Takwe muntu uyelede kuyandula chigwasya nguwe luzutu. Asi, umwi awumwi uyelede kuyandula chigwasya ngwayakilene anguwe.
Ulakonzya kulya chonse chuzigwa kuchisambalilo kotabuzyi mibuzyo yakulilya mumizezo.
Nkambo nyika nja Mwami alimwi abuzulilo bwayo.''
Na utasyomi wakutamba kukulya chilyo, alimwikoyanda kwinka, lya kufumbwa chabikwa kunembo lyako kotabuzyi mibuzyo yakulilya mumizezo.
Pele na umwi wamba kuti kulinduwe, ''Echi chatuulwa kuchipayizyo,'' elyo utachilyi. Kuchitila yooyo wakwambila webo,  alimwi akambo kamiyeeyo yakulilya -

Amwi mabbuku achindi alamalembe achi Giliki alayungizya aya, nkambo nyika azyonse zintu zilimumo nzya Mwami. Pele mabbuku ayinda achindi amalembe achi Giliki tajisi ezi pe. Bingi basichikolo babona kuyungizya mbuli kwindulula munchali. Kulilya kwawumwi muntu, ndikwamba, alimwi chitali chako. Ino nkambonzi kulyendelela kwangu nikubetekwa akulilya kwawumwi?
Na ndalya chilyo amoyo usalala, nkambonzi imebo nentukililwa echo nchindapeda kulumba?
Nkambo kako, naa walya kana kunywa, kana kufumbwa nchochita, kochita zyonse kuti kube bulemu kuli Leza.
Utajapi mulandu kuba Juda akuba Giliki, nikuba kumbungano ya Leza.
Munzila ikozyenie ndeezya kubotezya bantu boonse muzintu zyonse. Tandiyanduli zindigwasyalwangu, pele ezyo zyabiingi. Ndilachita echi kuti antela bayinofutuka.
Amwiiye ndime, mbuli mbwendi sikwiiya wa Kkilisitu.
Lino ndilamulumbayizya nkambo mulajatisisya kutunsiyansiya mbuli mbondakamwambila.
Lino ndiyanda kuti mumvwisye kuti Kkilisito nguwe mutwe wamwanakazi akuti Leza mutwe wa Kkilisitu.
Kufumbwa mwalumi ukomba nekuba kusinsima kavumbide kumutwe wakwe wawubula mutwe wakwe.
Pesi kufumbwa mwanakazi ukomba nekuba kusinsima kavumbide mutwe wakwe ulawubula mutwe wakwe . Aboobo chilikozyenie akuti mutwe wakwe wakululwa.
Nkabela kuti mwanakazi tavumba mutwe wakwe, uleelede kugela masusu aakwe afwimpe. Na chitawusisya insoni kuti mwanakazi agele masusu naa kukululwa mutwe wakwe, avumbe mutwe wakwe.
Nkabela mwalumi tayelede kuvumba mutwe wakwe, nkambo kakuti nchikozyanisyo chabulemu bwa Leza. Pesi mwanakazi mbulemu bwamwaalumi.
Nkambo mwalumi takalengwa kuzwa kumwanakazi. Anukuti mwanakazi wakalengwa kuzwa kumwalumi.
Nkabela teensi mwalumi wakalengelwa mwanakazi. Anukuti, mwanakazi wakalengelwa mwalumi.
Nchenchicho mwanakazi nchayelede kuba chitondezyo chabulemu amutwe wakwe, nkambo kabaangelo.
Nekubaboobo, mu Mwami, mwanakazi taponi chakulyiminina katakwe mwalumi, naba mwalumi taponi chakulyiminina katakwe mwanakazi wakwe.
Mbuli mwanakazi mbwazwa kumwalumi, alakwe mwalumi uzwa kumwanakazi. Alimwi zintu zyonse zizwa kuli Leza.
Amulibeteke nobeni: Saa chililuleme kuti mwanakazi kakomba kuli Leza amutwe wakwe kutavumbidwe?
Saa bulenwe bwanu tabumuyiisyi kuti naa mwalumi waba amasusu malamfu, nkutalemeka kwakwe?
Bulengwe bwanu tabumuyiisyi naa kuti mwanakazi aaba amasusu malamfu, mbulemu bwakwe? Nkambo masusu akwe akapegwa kulinuwe mbuli chilivumbyo.
Pesi kuti umwi wayanda atala azeezi, tatukwe nechiba chimwi chaanza, neziba mbungano zya Leza.
Pesi mumalayilile atobela, tandikonzyi kumutembawula. Nikuba nemubungana, tensi nkwakubotya pesi nkwakubisya.
Nkabela lutanzi, ndilamvwa kuti nemuswanana mumbungano, kuli mipampo mipampo akati kanu, alimwi mubuche ndilasyoma.
Nkenkaako kulelede alimwi tubunga tubuna akati kanu, kuchitila kuti abo bakalomesegwa ngabala libonia akati kenu.
Nkenkaako nemubungana, tensi nchilyo chamwami nchemulya.
Nemulya, awumwi awumwi ulya kulya kwakwe mwini bamwi kabatana kujana chilyo chabo. Umwi waba anzala, alimwi umwi wakolwa.
Tamukwe maanda na mukalye akunywida mukati? Mulasampawulana  imbungano ya Leza akulangilila aansi abo batakwe nzebalazyo? Ngambe buti kulindinywe? Ndimutembawule na? Nsikomutembawula nkambo kazeezi!
Eelyo ndakatambula kuzwa ku Mwami makani ngendakamusiila, kuti Mwami Jesu, mansiku nakaabwa, wakatola chibune.
Musule akupa kulumba, wakachikwamuna akwamba kuti, ''Oyu mubili wangu, nonguwe wenu. Muchiite obu kukundiyeya ndime.''
Mbubonya obo wakatola nkomeki musule achilalilo, alimwi wakati, ''Eyi nkomeki nchizuminano chipya chabulowa bwanu. Amuchite boobo muzyindi nemubunywa, kuti mukandiyeeye.''
Kuchindi choonse nchemulya echi chibunge akunywa eyi nkomeki, kamuyeeya lufu lwa Mwami mane akaboole.
Nkabela, oyo, uulya chibune nawanywa inkomeki ya Mwami munzila italuleme uyoba amulandu wamubili abulowa bwa Mwami.
Muleke muntu alilingule lwakwe chakusanuna, alimwi muleyi inzila amumuleke alye chibune akunywa munkomeki.
Alakwe oyo uulya akunywa katalililinguli mubili walya akunywa lubeta kulinguwe mwini.
Nkenkako biingi akati kanu mulamana manguzu akuchiswa, alimwi bamwi benu bafwa.
Pesi kuti twalilingula tobeni, tatukoyo betekwa.
Pesi elyo notubetekwa a Mwami, tulalulamikwa, kuchitila kuti tutakabetekwi anyika.
Nkeenkako, nobakwesu, nemuswanana antomwe kukulya, amulindane.
Naa umwi wenu wafwanzala, mumuleke akalye kumunzi, kuchitila kuti nemuswanana antomwe kutakabi kwalubeta. Alimwi atala aamwi makani ngemwakalemba, ndiyomupa malayilile elyo ndasika.
Ataala azipego zyamuuya, nobakwesu, nsiyandi kuti mubule luzibo.
Mulizizi kuti nimwakatali kusyoma Mwami Leza, mwakali kwenzegwa munzila ziswekede kumituni yakatali kwambula , munzila kufumbwa nzemwakali kwenzegwa aazyo.
Aboobo njanda kuti muzibe kuti takwe muntu uwambuzigwa a Muuya wa Leza ukonzya kwamba kuti, ''Jesu mutuke.'' Takwe ukonzya kwamba kuti ''Jesu Mwami,'' ado Muuya Uusalala.
Lino kuli zipego zisiyene, pesi Muuya ngumwi.
Kuli milimo isiyene siyene, pesi Mwami ngonguwe,
alubo kuli kwaandana kwamisyobo yamilimu, pesi nonguwe Leza ubeleka zyonse muli zyonse.
Lino kuli umwi awumwi kulipedwe chimo cha Muuya kuti kugwasigwe boonse.
Nkambo kuli pedwe ku Muuya ijwi lyabusongo, mpawo kuli umwi ijwi lyaluzibo a Muuya omwe.
Kuli umwi kuli pedwe lusyomo anguwo Muuya, alimwi kuli umwizipo zyakuponesya anguwo Muuya omwe.
Kuli umwi kuli pedwe milimu yakuchita zigambyo, mpawo kuli umwi businsimi. Kuli umwi ulipedwe kukonzya kusiyanisya misyobo yandimi, mpawo kuli umwi kupandululwa kwandimi.
Eezi zyoonse milimu ya Muuya omwe biyo, kupa zipego kuli umwi awumwi, mbuli mbwasala.
Nkambo mubili mbuli umwi mpawo nkujisi zizo zyiingi mpawo zizo zyonse ezi nzyamubili omwe, mbuboobo mbukubede a Kkilisito.
Nkambo a Muuya omwe twaka bbabbatizigwa mumubili omwe, nibaba ba Juda nanka ba Giliki nibaba bazike na balubusi, aawo bonse bakachitwa kuti banywe ku Muuya omwe.
Nkambo mubili teensi chizo chomwe pe, pesi nzyiingi.
Ikuti kuulu kwati, ''Nkambo kakuti nsili mutwe, aboobo nsilichizo chamubili,'' tensi nchimpanzi chinini pe chamubili.
Na kuti ikutwii kwamba kuti, ''Nkambo kakuti nsili linso, nsilichimpanzi chamubili,'' tensi nchinini pe chamubili.
Ikuti mubili woonse lyaba linso, chimpanzi chakumvwa chilazwayi? Kuti mubili wonse kakuba kutwi, chimpanzi chakumvwabwema chalikuno zwayi?
Pesi Leza wakabika chimpanzi chimwi achimwi chamubili mbuli mbwakayanda.
Kaansinga kaziba chimpanzi chomwe, mubili nulikuli?
Aboobo linobu kuli zimpanzi zyiingi, pesi mubili ngumwi biyo.
Ilinso talikonzyi kwamba kuti kukuboko, ''Nsikwe mupundulo anduwe.'' Nanka mutwe kuti utedi kumawulu, ''Nsikwe mupundulo anduwe.''
Pesi zimpanzi zyamubili zilangika kukompama azilazyo zilamulimo,
alimwi azimwi zipanzi nzituyeyela kuti tazilemekwi, tuzipe bulemu bupati, aboobo bamwi besu batakwe chiiwa chitambulika babe abulemu bwini.
Lino bamwi besu balachiwa chitambulika tabakwe ziyandisyo zilobu. Kwindilila, Leza wakachita mubili, nkapa bulemu bupati kuzimpanzi zitakwaabo.
Wakachita ezi kuchitila kuti kutabi kwaanzana mumubili, pesi kuti zimpanzi eezi zigwasyanie amaboneno ayelene.
Kuti na chimwi chimpanzi chaba epenzi, zyonse ina zyabamupenzi; na chimwi chalemekwa, zyoonse zimpanzi zilabotelwa antomwe.
Lino muli mubili wa Kkilisito elyo umwi awumwi nchimpanzi chawo.

Alimwi Leza wakabikka muchikombelo lutanzi batumwa, bachibili mbasinsimi, bachitatu mbayiisyi, mpawo ababo bachita maleele, mpawo zipo zyakuponia, abaabo bagwasizya bamwi abo bachita milimu yabwendelezi, abaabo baala misyobo myiingi yendimi.
Boonse mbatumwa na? Mbasinsimi na boonse? Bonse mbayiisyi na? Bonse bachita maleele na? Bonse bachita milimu igambya na?
Boonse balazipego zyakuponia na? Bonse baambula myaambo na? Bonse bala pandulula na myaambo?
Musungwalile kuyandula zipego zipati. Pesi ndiyomutondezya inzila imbotu loko.
Nikuba kuti ndaambuula mundimi zyabantu azyabangelo. Pesi kuti kanditakwe luyando, nooli ndaba mulangu usabila naanka chisaka chichokola chokola.
Nikuba kuti ndachita chabusinsimi achakumvwisisisya toonse tusimpi tusisidwe aluzibo, mpawo akuba aaloonse lusyomo lwakunyampula zilundu. Pesi kuti kanditakwe luyando, nsichili chintu.
Alubo nikuba kuti ndapa boonse buvubi bwangu kukusanina bafwaba, akuti ndapeda mubili wangu kukuyotetwa. Pesi kuti kanditakwe luyando, takwe nchindijana.
Luyando lulabulindizi amuuya. Luyando taluli munyono mpawo talulidundizyi. Talulisumpuli.
Na chinguni. Talulilangilili chintu. Taluliniakidwe, na kulondola twaambo twabubi.
Talubotelwi mububi nakuti, kubotelwa mubwini.
Luyando lunyampula zyoonse zintu, lusyoma zyoonse zintu, lulangilila zyoonse zintu mpawo lulakakatila kuli zyoonse zintu.
Luyando talumani. Nikwali basinsimi, zyalinooyinda. Nikwali myaambo yalikuyoomana.
Nitwali luzibo, luyooyinda. Mbuli mbutuzi mubuche mpawo tusinsima mubuche.
Pesi eelyo bululami nibwaayoosika, oobo butazulilide buyooyinda.
Nindakachili munini, ndakalikwambuula mbuli munini, ndalikuyeya mbuli munini, ndalikubuzyania mbuli munini.

Nindakazooba mupati, ndakabikka kule zintu zyabunini. Mbuli mbutubona chakutilulama muchiboniboni, pesi kumeso akumeso. Lino ndizi mubuche, pesi eelyo ndiyooziba bumaninide mbuuli mbezibedwe bumaninide.
Pesi lino eezi zintu zitatu zisyeede: Lusyomo, bulangilizi mpawo aluyando. Pesi chipati loko kuli Leza nduyando.
Fundumanina luyando alimwi unangatile kukujana zipo zyamuuya, kapati nkukuti ukonzye kusinsima.
Nkambo ooyo uwambula mululimi tawambuli abantu pesi uwambuila a Leza. Nkambo takwe umumvwisisya nkambo uwaambula zigambyo zyamumuuya.
Pesi oyo usinsima wambuula abantu kuti aba yake, kubasimya akubawonga.
Ooyo wambula mululimi uliyaka lwakwe, pesi oyo usinsima uyaka mbungano.

Lino ndipeekezya kuti anoli moonse mukonzya kwambuula mundimi. Pesi nikuba kwinda ezyo, ndali kupeekezya kuti kansiinga mwali kusinsima. Oyo usinsima mupati kwinda kwinda ooyo uwambula mundimi ( ado umwi wapandulula kuchitila kuti imbungano ijane luzibo ).
Pesi lino, nobakwesu, kuti ndeza kulindinywe nkewambula mundimi, ngandamugwasya biyeni? Takwe pe, adokuti ndambula andinywe akuyubununa, na aluzibo, na businsimi, na kuyiisya.

Muli njiyeyo inzila, awo zibelesyo zitaponi nizichita muyoliyoli mbuli muteetele kana kantimbwa kuti tezyasiyana ndililo, umwi muntu nga ulaziba biyeni kuti ndwimbonzi lulikulizigwa amuteetele kana kantimbwa.
Nkambo kakuti inyele yasibwa akalizyo katazibinkene, umwi muntu nga ulaziba buti kuti chaba chindi chakubambila inkondo?
Njimwi inzila anduwe nowambula mundimi. Kuti waamba zyambo zyakubulunguzya, zilamvwisisigwa biyeni zilimukwambwa? Unoli kowambula muluwo biyo.
Chilizibinkene kuti kuli milaka myiingi isiyene siyene munyika, aboobo tuuwo pe utakwe nchuwamba.
Pesi kuti nkesizi mulaka nchuwamba, ndinoli muzwakule kuli oyo sikuwambula, alubo sikwambula unoli muzwakule kuli ndime.
Nkokuti chili kuli nduwe. Mbulikuti ulachiyandisyo chakuyubununwa kwamuuya, yanduula kuyungizizigwa kwambungano kuchitila kuti muvule.
Nkokuti oyo uwambula mundimi welede kukombela kuti akonzye kupandulula.
Nkambo kuti ndakomba mundimi, imuuya wangu ulakkomba, pesi mizeezo yangu inooli tayikwe michelo.
Ndicheteenzi? Ndilakomba amuuya wangu, pesi ndilakomba alimwi amiyeeyo yangu. Ndiyoyimba amuuya wangu, alimwi ndinoyimba amizezo yangu.
Anolikuti, na walongezya Leza amuuya, muntu wakunze ulaamba biyeni kuti ''Amen'' aawo nolikupa kulumba kuti kotazi nzli kwaamba?
Nkambo chanchonzyo ukwizi loko  kupa kulumba, pesi umwi muntu tabumbikene.
Ndilumba Leza kuti ndilamwinda monse kwambula mundimi.
Pesi mumbungano chili kabotu kuti ngambuule majwi musanu muku mvwisisisya kwangu kuchitila kuti ndikonzye kulayilila bamwi, kwinda kwamba kkumi lyamajwi mundimi.
Nobakwesu, tamubi bana mukuyeeya kwenu. Chilabota kuti, kuzibi mube mbuli zisukasuka. Pesi kukuyeeya muzikitizye chipati.
Mumulawu kulilembedwe kuti, ''Kwindilila kubantu bandimi zita zibinkene akumilomo yamazwakule ndiyowambula kubantu aaba. Nikuba obo tabakoyo ndimvwa,'' mbwawamba Mwami.
Nkokuti lino, indimi nzitondezyo, pepe kubasyomi, pesi kuli batasyomi. Pesi businsimi mbwa chitondezyo, peepe chabatasyomi, pesi chabasyomi.
Na, kakuli boobo, imbungano yoonse yaza aamwi alimwi boonse baambula mundimi, alimwi ibazwa kunze abatasyomi banjila, tabakombi kuti muli pengede na?
Pesi anoli moonse mwali kusinsimi alimwi utasyomi na oyo uuzwa kunze kanjila, wali kunotusika kuli zyonse nzyali kumvwa. Zyonse zyali kunowambwa zyali kunomubeteka.
Insiswa zyamumoyo wakwe zyali kunobbusigwa. Mbuli chitondezyo, wali kunowa kavundama akukomba Leza. Wali kunopa bukamboni kuti nchoonzyo Leza mpali akati kenu.
Niinzi chitobela bakwesu? Nimubungana, awumwi uli antembawuzyo, injiisyo, chiyubunuzyo, indimi, kana bupanduluzi. Amuzichite zyonse kuchitila kuti muyake imbungano.
