Nobalanda, amubaswilile basimalelo benu akunoobalemeka lyoonse. Mutanooswiilili basimalelo babotu abatontozi luzutu pe, pesi akulibaatalomene.
Nkaambo eechi chilalumbika, na wafwabila bululami kazi kuti takwe mulandu kazi kuti ulikuzuzikizya ziyanda Leza.
Ino kuli bulumbuunzi na wasubulwa akaambo kamilandu njiwachita mpawo wazitambula amoyo mulamfu?  Pesi na wasubulwa kochitide milimu mibotu, eechi chilalumbayizika kuliLeza.
Nchenchicho eecho nchimwakayitilwa, nkaambo Kkilisito lwakwe wakamufwabila. Wakamusiila chitondeezyo chakuti mukatobelezye mumukondo wakwe.
''Utakwe chibi nchakachita,
iwakati naakatukilwa, takabwedezya pe. Aawo nakafwabisigwa, taakabayosezya pe, pesi wakalipedekezya kuliyooyo uubeteka chakweelanisya.
Lwakwe mwini wakayumuna zibi zyesu mumubili wakwe achisamu kuchitila kuti swebo katuli  twafwa kuchibi tukaponene bululami. Amibunda yakwe mwakapona.
Nywebo moonse mwakali mbuli mbelele ziswekede, pesi kwalino mwakapiluka kuMweembeli aMulinguli wamyuuya yenu.
Nobamakaintu amulibombye kubalumi benu. Amuchite oobu nikuba kuli balaabalumi bataswiilili jwi, kuchitila kuti basanduke kwiindila munchito zyabakayintu babo, kabatakambawukilidwe pe.
Banoli babona kulemeka nkumubachita kuli aluyando.
Kulibotyabotya kwenu kutabi kwaanze luzutu pe, mbuli kulilungitizya masusu, kuzwata ngolide nikuba kulisamika mpasya zitentema.
Pesi, eechi ngachichitilwe muntu wamukati, nkaaambo mbombubo bweebesi bwamuuya wabubombe akulibatamika, koongola, oobo buyandisi kuliLeza.
Mbombubo banakazi bachiindi basalali basyoma muliLeza mbubakalibotezya kabalifwiinsya kubalumi babo.
Mbuli Sala, banyoko mbaakalibombya kuliAbbulahamu akumuti mwami. Lino nywebo mwaba bana bakwe kapati na mwachita zibotu alimwi kamutayoowi mapenzi.

Mubweelene, anywebo nobalumi mukazikane kabotu abakaintu benu mukumvwisisyania akubalemeka, mbuli chilongo chikompeme, nkamuzi kuti mbasimulya lukononyokwe lwaluzyalo lwabuumi nkokuti inkombyo zyenu tazikachizigwi.
Kumamanino, moonse, mube amuzeezo ukozyenie, mube akwetelelana, kuyandana mbuli babunyina, amoyo mutete, akulibombya.
Mutabweedezyi chibi kuchibinyina nikuba kubweedezya chisapi kuchisapinyina. Anukuti amubweedezye kulongezya, nkaambo eezi nzimwakayitilwa, kuti mukakonzye kuyookona zilongezyo.
''Ooyo uyanda kubona buumi bubotu akubona mazuba mabotu weelede kuti wakasya lulimi kububi amulomo wakwe kukwambuula lweeneeno.
Akube kuti alilesye kububi akunoochita zibotu luzutu. Ayanduule luumuno akulutobela.
Nkaambo menso aaMwami alabona baluleme, alimwi matwi aakwe alaswiilila kunkombyo zyabaluleme. Pesi busyu bwaMwami buli aabukali kulibaabo bachita zibi.''
Kabi ngwani ooyo unga ulamubisizya na mwasungwaala kukuchita zibotu?
Pesi na mwafwabisigwa nkaambo kabululami, mulilongezezegwe. Mutayoowi eezyo nzibayoowa. Mutapengi.
Pesi, musale Mwami Kkilisito kuti musalali mumyoyo yenu. Mukkale kamulibambilide kuti mukapandulwide boonse bamubuzya makani abulangilizi mbomujisi, mukulifwiinsya akulemeka.
Amube amamvwido mabotu kuchitila kuti nibamwaambikizya zitali kabotu akumwaambula anga ndinywe basizibi bakafwe bweeme akulijata kwenu kubotu muliKkilisito Jesu.
Kulimbubo, na kakuli kuyanda kwaLeza, kuti mukafwabisigwe akaambo kakuchita zibotu kwiinda kuchita zibi.
Alakwe Kkilisito wakafwaba lomwe kafwabila zibi. Ooyo wakaluleme wakafwabila nitwakataluleme pe, kuchitila kuti atuswenzye kuliLeza. Wakajayigwa kunyama, pesi wakabusigwa kuMuuya.
MuMuuya, wakiinka akuyookambawuka myuuya iilimuntolongo kwalino.
Eeyo yakataswiilila pe kuchiindi nchaakachili kukazika moyo wakwe Leza mumazuba aaNowa, mumazuba akuyakwa kwabwaato, mpawo Leza wakavuna bantu bache biyo, myuuya musanu ayitatu, kwiinda  mumaanzi.
Eechi nchitondeezyo chamubbabbatizyo ooyo umuvuna lino, teensi kwaamba kuti mbuli mbotusamba tombe amubili pe, pesi mamvwido mabotu kuliLeza, kwiindila mububuke bwaJesu Kkilisito.
Ooyo wakaya kujulu, uulikujanza lyalulyo lwaLeza, bangelo, beendelezi, abasimanguzu boonse, bakabikwa kunsi lyakwe..
Akaambo kakuti Kkilisito wakatufwabila kunyama, anywebo mulisamike munzila yeelene aanjiyeeyi, nkaambo kufumbwa muntu wafwa kunyama ulaanzeene achibi.
Aboobo ooyu muntu, mubuumi bwakwe boonse tacheelede pe kuponena kunkosya zyanyama, pesi kuluyando lwaLeza.
Nkaambo chalampa chiindi kamuliikuponena ziponenwa aabamasi, kuponena munkosya zyamubili, mukweemuzya, bukolwi,  amukuyobuchita zisesemyo zyakukomba mituni.
Mulicheechi zilabagambya kuti tamuchijatili aamwi pe ambabo munchito zitaluleme, aboobo baambuula bubi aatala andinywe.
Bayoolyaambilila kulinguwe ooyo ulibambilide kuzoobeteka bawumi abafwide.
Akaambo kaako Makani mabotu akakambawukwa akubafwide, kuchitila kuti, nikuba bakabetekwa  abantu kunyama, pesi bapone kumuuya mbuli mbabede Leza.
Mamanino aazintu zyoonse aswena. Aboobo amube amiyeeyo mibotu mulondoke kuchitila kuti kamunokomba kabotu.
Chipati kwiinda zyoonse, amusungwaalile kuyandana, nkaambo luyando luvumba mulwi wazibi.
Amukatambulane akuchitilana kabotu, kakutakwe unyontooka pe.
Mbuli umwi awumwi mbaakapegwa chipo, amuzibelesye kukugwasyania, mbuli babaanzi bazyiimo zyaandeene zyaluzyalo lwaLeza.

Na kwaba waambuula, kwambuula kwakwe akube kwamajwi aLeza. Na kakuli ubeleka milimu, abeleke kazizwa kunguzu nzyamupa Leza, kuchitila kuti mulizyoonse Leza alemekwe kwindila muliJesu Kkilisito, nkaambo bulemu anguzu nzizyakwe kwalyoonse alyoonse. Ameni.
Nomuyandwa, tamugambi pe aatala amasunko makolokolo aalikumuchitikila, kwaba anga malweza.
Pesi, amukondwe kuti mulikwaabana mafwabi aaKkilisito, kuchitila kuti anywebo mukakondwe kuchiindi chakuyubununwa kwabulemu bwakwe alukondo lupati.
Na mwakutukilwa akaambo kazina lyaKkilisito, mulilongezezegwe, nkaambo Muuya wabulemu antoomwe aMuuya waLeza unooli alindinywe.
Kutabi umwi wenu uyoofwaba akaambo kakuti mujayi, mubbi, na simuchita zibi, nanka sikudyobokela mutwaambo twabantu.
Pesi na umwi wafwabila bunaKkilisito, atawusi pe; anukuti, ngalumbayizye Leza akaambo kezina lyakwe.
Nkaambo chindi chasika chakuti lubeta lutalike empuli yaLeza. Na lwatalika aswebo, bayooyiima aali  batazumini makani mabotu aaLeza?
Alubo ''na kachili chiyumu kubaluleme kuti bakafutulwe, ino bayooba buti aabo batakwe buleza antoomwe abasizibi?''
Aboobo aabo bafwabisigwa chaluyando lwaLeza, mukuchita zibotu, ngabapedekezye myuuya yabo kuMulengi usyomekede.
Ndikusungwaazya baalu bali akati kenu, mbuli mbendi mwaalu andime, amukamboni wamafwabi aaKkilisito, alubo ndime umwi wabatakaabane mubulemu oobo butazooyubununwe.
Amweembele butanga bwaLeza oobo mbomuliikubbasopa, chabalangi peepe chakusungilizigwa, nikuba chakuyanda kujana mpindu, pesi chakuliyandila.
Muteendelezyi  bantu balimunsi lyenu mbuli bami, pesi mube chitondeezyo kubutanga.
Eelyo Mweembeli Mupati aakuyubununwa, muyoopegwa munsini wabulemu uutakulumpali pe.

Munzila imwi, nywebo nobalombe, amulibombye kubaalumi bapati kulindinywe. Moonse, mulifwiinsye, mulisamike bubombe kuli umwi awumwi. Nkaambo Leza ulabakazya basikulisumpula, pes ulapa luzyalo kubabombe.
Nkiikaako amulibombye munsi lyejanza pati lyaLeza nkokuti akamusumpule kuchiindi cheelede.
Amusowele kulinguwe woonse makataazyo eenu nkaambo ngumubamba.
Amukalondoke akuchenjela, nkaambo sinkondonyokwe saatani uleendeenda mbuli mulavu uvuuluma, kavwima ngwatalye.
Mukamukazye mukiime njii mulusyomo, nkaambo mulizi kuti aaya mafwabi ngaalikuswaanwa ababunyina benu kumanyika woonse.
Pesi musule akufwaba kwakayiindi kaniini, Leza waluzyalo loonse, ooyo wakamwiita mubulemu bwakwe butamani muliKkilisito, uyoomulomania, uyoomusimpa, uyoomusimya, akuyoomuzikitizya.
Akube bwendelezi kwalyoonse alyoonse kulinguwe. Ameni.

Kwiindila muliSiluvenasi mukwesu usyomekede (mukumuziba kwangu) ndamulembela mubufwifwi, chakumusungwaazya akupa bukamboni kuti eezyo nzindakalemba nkasimpe kaluzyalo lwaLeza. Amwimikile njii mulinkako.
Mbungano yamuBbabbiloni, eeyo usalidwe antoomwe andinywe, iliikumujuzya loko. Alakwe Makki, mwana wangu, uliikumujuzya.
Amujuzyanie alumyontano lwaluyando. Luumuno lube kulindinywe moonse nimuli muliKkilisito.

Kwakali umwi mwalumi waku Lamatayimu mu Zufitesi, wakuchisi chakuchilundu cha Efulemu; izina lyakwe kali Elikkana mwana mulombe wa Jelohamu mwana mulombe wa Elihu mwana mulombe wa Tohu mwana mulombe wa Zufi, mu Efulemu. ( bumwi bupanduluzi bwamazubano bulijisi LamatayimuZofimu, pesi kulamvwisisika kuti Zofimu lwalyo lyamba kuchisi omo mwakazwide mukowa wa Zufu muwakali kukkala)
Wakali abanakazi babili; izina lyamutanzi wakali Hana, awabili wakali Penina. Penina wakali abana, pesi Hana takalikwe bana pe.

Oyu mwalumi wakali kwinka kukukomba kudolopo amunyaka amunyaka kukuyokomba akuyopayila kuli Jehova akuyomutembawula mu Shilo. Ibana babili balombe ba Eli, Hofini a Finiyasi, bapayizi ba Jehova, bakali wo.
Elyo izuba nilyakasika kuti Elikkana apayile. Kulumwi munyaka, wakalikupa lyoonse chimpanzi chanyama kuli Penina mukayintu wakwe, akubana bakwe balombe abasimbi.
Pesi kuli Hana wakali kupa chaabilo chindulwidwe choonse chiindi wakali kuyandisya Hana, nikuba kuti Jehova kasinkide zyalilo lyakwe.
Mukwatwanyina wakali kumupenzya loko, kuti amunyemye nkambo Jehova wakasinkide izyalilo lyakwe.
Amunyaka amunyaka, nakali kutanta kung'anda ya Jehova ampuli yakwe, mukwatwanyina wakali kumupenzya. Aboobo wakali kulila alimwi takwe nakali kulya pe.
Elikkana mulumi wakwe wakali kkede kamwambila kuti, ''Hana, ulilanzi? Ulekelanzi kulya? Moyowako ubijilidwenzi loko? Tandili mubotu na kuli nduwe kwinda bana balombe balikkumi?''
Kuli chimwi chezyindi ezi, Hana wakanyampuka nibakamaninsya kulya akunywa ku Shilo. Li o Eli mupayizi wakali kkede atala achuno chakwe chabwami amulyango kuntempele lya Jehova.
Wakali chisidwe loko mumoyo; wakakomba kuli Jehova akukwilisya loko.

Wakachita chikonke akwamba kuti, ''Jehova wamakamu makamu, kuti kobona mafwabi amulanda wako, akundiita mumiyeyo, alimwi kotalubi mulanda wako, pesi kopa mulanda wako mwana mulombe, mpawo ndiyomupeda kuli Jehova mazuba oonse akupona kwakwe, aboobo takwepe lunyoolo luyoguma mumutwe wakwe.''
Nakachili kwinkilila kunembo akukomba kuli Jehova. Eli wakalangisisya mulomo wakwe.
Hana wakambula mumoyo wakwe. Milomo yakwe yakaputuka, pesi ijwi telyakali kumvwikka pe. Aboobo Eli wakayeeya anga ulikkoledwe.
Eli wakamwambila kuti, ''Watola chindi chilamfu biyeni kokoledwe? Uuleke wayini wako.''
Hana wakasandula kuti,  ''Pepe, mwami wangu, ndimukayintu uchiswa mumuuya wangu. Tandinywide wayini penikuba chakunywa chikola, pesi nditula muuya wangu kunembo lya Jehova.
Utanditoli mbuli mukayintu uwuusya bweme pe ndemulanda wako; ndalikwambula kuzwa kubwiingi bwabupati bwakuli katazya kwangu akubijilwa.''
Mpawo Eli wakasandula akwamba kuti, ''Yinka mulumuno; Leza wa Izilayeli kakupa ezyo nziwakumbila.''
Wakamba kuti, ''Leka mulanda wako ajane choolwe mumeso aako.'' Mpawo mukayintu wakiinka akuyolya; busyu bwakwe tebwakachibijilidwe pe.
Bakafuma kuseni loko akuyokomba kunembo lya Jehova, alimwi bakabweeda lubo kung'anda yabo ku Lama. Elikkana wakaswanana abanakwe, Elyo Jehova wakamuyeeya.
Chiindi nichakakkwana, Hana wakaminta akuzyala mwana mulombe. Wakamuziika izina lyakuti Samiyele, kawamba kuti, ''Nkambo ndamukumbila kuzwa kuli Jehova.''
Alimwi Elikkana aboonse bang'anda yakwe bakayinka kuyoopa chipayizyo chamunyaka akuyobbadala chikonke.
Pesi Hana takayinka pe; wakambila mulumi wakwe kuti, ''Tandikoyinka pe mane do mwana aleke kunyonka; mpawo ndiyomweta, kuchitila kuti akalibonie, kunembo lya Jehova akuyokkala lyoonse nkuko.

Elikkana mulumi wakwe wakamwambila kuti, ''Chita echo nchobona kuti nchibotu kuli nduwe. Kolindila manedo umulesye; we, Jehova azuzikizye ijwi lyakwe.'' Aboobo mukayintu wakakkala akumunyonsya mwana mulombe mane wamulesya.

Elyo nakamulesya mwana, wakinkawe, antomwe  amupele waminyakitatu yakuzyalwa, ( bumwi bupanduluzi bwabensiku mumalembe achi Hebbulayo awamba kuti bapule batatu pepe kuti mupule omwe wamyaka iitatu yakuzyalwa)  achisuwo chabusu, ambodela yawayini, akumweeta kung'anda ya Jehova mu Shiilo. Lino mwana wakachili munini.
Bakajaya mupule, alimwi bakeeta mwana kuli Elii.
Wakamba kuti, ''Ooh, mwami wangu! mbuli mbopona, mwami wangu, ndimukayintu wakayima kumbali afwifwi nkindokukomba kuli Jehova.
Oyu ambebo mwana ngundakakombela a Jehova wandipa chikumbilo eecho nchindakakumbila.
Ndamupeda kuli Jehova, kufumbwa kachipona ndamukweletya kuli Jehova.'' Mpawo wakakomba Jehova ooko. (amwi malembe amazubano alabupanduluzi bwakuti Mpawo bakakomba Jehova mpuwawo)
Hana wakakomba akwaamba kuti, "Moyo wangu wakondwa muli Jehova. Lwija lwangu lwasumpulwa muli Jehova.Mulomo wangu walikankayizya aali basinkondoma, nkaambo ndasekelela mulufutuko lwako.
Taakwe uusalala mbuli Jehova, nkaambo takukwe kunze kwanduwe; taakwe bbwe lili mbuli Leza wesu.
Utalidundi limbi chakutalisumpula loko; mweebwa utazwi mumilomo yenu pe. Nkaambo Jehova ngu Leza waluzibo; aanguwe nchito zileelekwa.
Buta bwabaalumi basintaze bwatyoka, pesi aabo basedeluka basamikwa nguzu mbuli lukumba.
Aabo bakalizulide bakalyaaba mukubelekela chinkwa; abaabo bakali aanzala bakayima kubaanzala. Nekuba ngomwa yakatumbuka kuli bali musanu ababili, pesi mwanakazi uli aabana bayingi woongelwa.
Jehova nguujeya akupa buumi. Nguwe uunjizya mukabanda akubusya.
Jehova nguuchitya bamwi buchete abamwi kubuvubya. Ulaafwiinsya, pesi alubo ulasumpula.

Ulabusya bachete kuzwa kulusuko. Ulasumpula babulidekuzwa kiumulwi wamulota kubachita kukkala aamwi abana babaami akukona chuuno chabulemu. Nkaambo misemo yanyika njiya Jehova alimwi wakabika nyika aajulualinjiyo.
Uyokwabilila mawulu aabantu bakwe basyomekede, pesi babi bayowumuzigwa mumudima, kakutakwe pe uyoozunda aanguzu.
Aabo bakazya Jehova bayopwayuulwa mubuche buche; uyoobakalalila kuzwa kujulu. Jehova uyobeteka magolelo aanyika; uyoopa nguzu kumwaami wakwe akusumpula luja lwamunanike wakwe."
Eelyo Elikkana wakauya ku Lama, kung'anda yakwe. Mwana waklabelekela Jehova kubusyu bwa Eli mupayizi.
Lino bana balombe ba Eli bakali mbobola zyabaalumi. Yebakalizi Jehova pe.
Chiyanza chabapayizi abantu chakali chakuti na muntu wapeda chipayizyo, mulanda wamupayizi wali kusika kalaamfologo ilaamenyo aatatu muluboko lwakwe, aawo nyama niyachi;i kubila.

Walikununa akwiibika muchikangilo, na kketelo, na muchilongo na mumpoto. Zyoonse mfologo nziyali kununa mupayizi walikubweza lwakwe mwini. Baka.i kuziita mu Silo antoomwe abaku Izilayili boonse bakeza nkuko.

Kuyindila, kabatana uumpa mafuta, mulanda wamupayizi walikusika,kuli kuti kumwaalumi walikupayizya, "Ndipe nyama njokele mupayizi; aawo mbuli kuti tayoyitambuli pe yakujika iizwa kuli nduwe, pesi imbisi luzutu."
Na ooyo mwaalumi wati kuli nguwe, '"Beelede kusanguna kuumpa mafuta saansi, alubo mubweze kufumbwa ngimuyanda."Mpawo uyooti, "Pe, uleelede kundipa mebo lino; na pe. Njoobweza aanguzu."
Chibi chabakubusi baalumi aaba chakali chipati loko kunembo lya Jehova, nkaambo bakasampawula chipayizyo cha Jehova.
Pes Samuyeli wakali kubelekela Jehova mbuli mwana uusamikidwe dembo lya efodi.
Banyina bakali kumuchitila kazwaato kaniini kabamutolela kuzwa kuluumwi mwaka aamwaaka, nakali kwiinka amulumiwakwe kuyoopa chipayizyo chamwaaka.
Eli wakali kulongezya Elikkana amwanakazi wakwe akwaamba kuti, "Inche Jehova aakupe bana bayingi kumwanai ooyop nkaambo kachikumbizyo nchayita aa Jehova." Mpawo balikubweeda kumyuunzi yabo.
Jehova alubo wakagwasya Hana, alimwi wakamita lubo. Wakazyala bana balombe batatu abana basimbi babili. Mbubonya oobo mwana Samuyeli wakakula kumeso aa Jehova.
Lino Eli wakachembaala loko; wakamvwa zyoonse bana bakwe nzibakali kuchita kuba Izilayili boonse ambubakali koona aabanakazi aabo bakali kubeleka kumulyango watente lyambunganino.
Wakati kuli mbabo, "Nkamboonzi nimuchita zintu ziliboobu? Nkaambo ndimvwide milimo yanu mibi kuzwa kubantu aaba boonse."
Pe, bana bangu; nkaambo teensi mbotu pe mpuwo njindili kumvwa. Muyoochita bantu ba Jehova kutaswiilila.
Na mwaalumi wabisizya uumwi Leza uyoomubeteka; pesi na mwaalumi wabisizya Jehova, nguni utukamwaambwiide?" Pesi taakwe nibakaswiilila jwi lyawisi wabo, nkaambo Jehova wakayanda kubajeya.
Mwana Samuyeli wakakomena akubota kumeso aa Jehova akumeso aabantu.
Lino kwakasika muntu wa Leza kuli Eli wakamwaambila kuti, "Jehova waamba kuti, 'Tendakalibonia na kung'anda yawuso eelyo nibakachili mu Ijiipiti mubuzike kung'anda ya Falo?

Ndakamusala kuzwa kumisyobo yoonse yaba Izilayili kuti abe mupayizi wangu, kukwiinka kuchipayililo changu, akuumpa tununkilizyo akusama efodi kubusyu bwangu.  Ndakapa kung'anda yawuso zipayizyo zyoonse zyabantu ba Izilayili zichitidwe aamulilo.

Nkamboonzi, mpawo, nimunyansya zipo azituuzyo zyangu nzindakaamba mubusena oomo mundikkala? Nkamboonzi nulemeka bamna bako balombe kwiinda ndime mukulineneesya kwanu kuzipayizyo zyoonse zibotu zyabantu bangu ba Izilayili?

Nkaambo Jehova, Leza wa Izilayili, waamba kuti, 'Ndakasyomezya kuti n g'anda yako ang'anda yawuso beelede kweenda kunembo lyangu kwalyoonse.' Pesi lino Jehova waamba kuti, 'Ngakube kule kuzwa kulindime kuchita eezi, nkaambo ndiyoolemeka aabo bandilemeka, pesi bandinyansya bayowubawulwa.
Bona mazuba alasika nindiyoogonka nguzu zyako anguzu zyakung'anda yawuso, kuti kutayoobi nikuba uumwi uchembala mung'anda yako.
Uyoobona mapenzi mubusena oomo mundikkala. Nikuba kuti bubotu buyoopegwa ku Izilayili, taakwe nikuyoba uumwi uchembala mung'anda yako.
Kufumbwa umwi wanu ngunditagwisizye kuzwa kuchipayililo changu, ndiyoomutya kuti meso aanu akawofwaale, akuyoopenzya myoyo yanu. Mpawo umwi awumwi walunyungu lwako uyoofwa.
Eechi chiyooba chitondeezyochako chiyooza kubana bako balombe babili, Hofini a Finiyasi: Boonse bayoofwa mubuzuba bumwi.
Njobusya mebo lwangu mupayizi usyomekede uyoochita zili mumoyo wangu amumioyeeyo yangu. Ndiyoomuyakila ng'anda yachoonzyo, a;limwi uyooyenda kunembo lya mwaami wangu uunanikidwe kwalyoonse.
Woonse ucheede mung'anda yako uyooza akumukotamina, akulombela chipanzi chansiliva alofu yachinkwa, alimwi uyoowamba kuti, "Nche ndipedelekezye kuzyuuno zyabapayizi kuti ndikalye kapanzi kachinkwa.""
Kachili mwana Samiyele wakabelekela Jehova kali  munsi lya Eli. Ijwi lya Jehova lyakali kuyandika mazuba ayo; kakutakwe bulangizi bwampuwo zyabusinsimi zyachilengano pe.
Kuchindi echo, eelyo Eli wakali ameso abona atalika kuyobofwala, katakonzyi kubona, wakalilede abuulo bwakwe.
Nkabela ilampi lya Leza kalitana kuzima, alimwi Samiyele wakalilede chakoona muntempele lya Jehova mulyakabede bbokesi lya Leza.
Jehova wakayita Samiyele, nkabela wakavwiila wati, ''Mpendi.''
Samiyele wakachijanina kuli Eli, alimwi wakamba wati, 'nkaambo wandiita.'' Eli wakasandula, ''nsikwitide pe; lala lubo.'' Mpawo Samiyele wakabweda alimwi wakulala.

Jehova wakamwiita lubo, 'Samiyele, ''Alubo Samiyele wakanyampuka alimwi wakaya kuli Eli alimwi wakaamba wati, ''Mpendi, nkaambo wandita.'' Eli wakasandula, ''Nsikwitide pe, mwana wangu mulombe; lala lubo.''
Lino Samiyele katana kumuziba Jehova, alilalyo ijwi lya Jehova kalitana kumubonekela.
Jehova wakiita Samiyele lubo lwachitatu. Samiyele wakanyampuka lubo alimwi wakaya kuli Eli alimwi wakwamba wati, ''Mpendi, nkaambo wandita.'' Mpawo Eli wakayeya kuti Jehova ngulokwita mulombe.
Mpawo Eli wakambila Samiyele wati, ''koya ukalale lubo; kuti akwiite lubo, uvwiile kuti, kowamba, Jehova, nkambo mulanda wako ulaswilila.'' Nkabele Samiyele wakayinka alimwi wakulala kubusena bwakwe.
Jehova wakasika alimwi wakiima; wakamwiita mbuli zyiindi zyoonse, Samiyele, Samiyele.'' Mpawo Samiyele wakavwiila wati, ''Kowamba nkambo mulanda wako ulaswilila.''
Jehova wakambila Samiyele, 'Bona, Ndamba kuchita chimwi chintu mu Izilayeli, eelyo kufumbwa muntu uyochimvwa amatwi akwe oonse obile tayokkalinkana pe.
Mubuzuba obo njozuzya kuli Eli woonse makani ngindakambiide atala ang'anda yakwe, kuzwa kumasangunino kusikila kumamanino.
Nkambo ndakamwambila kuti ndabeteka ng'anda yakwe nkambo kamulandu ngwakabona, nkambo bana bakwe balombe balyetelela lutuko lwabo alimwi we tabakasyi pe.
Nkaambo kako ndakonkezya kung'anda ya Eli kuti izibi zyang'anda yakwe taziyolekelelwa pe akulipeda na kupa chipo.''
Samiyele wakalala mane kwakucha; mpawo wakajula milyango yang'anda ya Jehova. Pesi Samiyele wakali kuyowa kwambila Eli atala achilengano.
Mpawo Eli wayita Samiyele alimwi wati, ''Samiyele, mwana wangu mulombe.'' Samiyele wakaamba wati, ''Mpendi.''
Wakabuzya wati, Makaninzi ngowambilwa ? Utasisi kulindime pe. Leza achite mbubo kulinduwe, alimwi nikuba nzyiingi, kuti wandisisa chintu nichiba chomwe akati makani oonse ngakwambila.''
Samiyele wakamwambila makaani woonse; takwe nichiba chomwe nchakamusisila. Eli wakaamba wati, ''Ngu Jehova. Achite kufumbwa chimubotela kumenso akwe.''
Samiyele wakakomena, alimwi Jehova wakali awe, alimwi takawisya ijwi lyakwe niliba lyoomwe.
Ma Izilayeli woonse kuzwa ku Dani kusika ku Bbiyashebba bakaziba kuti Samiyele wakabikkidwe kuba musinsimi wa Jehova.
Jehova wakali bonia lubo mu Shilo, nkaambo wakalibonia kuli Samiyele mu Shilo kujwi lyakwe.
Ijwi lya Samiyele lyakasika kuba Izilayeli boonse. Lino ba Izilayeli bakayinka kuyolwana aba Filisiti. Bakabamba musasa wabo ku Ebbeneza, alimwi ma Filisiti bakabamba musasa ku Apeki.
Mpawo ba Filisiti bakalibamaba kuyolwana aba Izilayeli. Eelyo nkondo niyakakomena, ma Izilayeli bakakomwa kuma Filisiti, akati kabasilumamba bamusokwe balajaya bali mbuli zyuulu zyoone.

Eelyo bantu nibakasika kumisasa, bapati baba Izilayeli bakaamba bati, ''Nkambonzi Jehova natukoma sunu kunembo lyama Filisiti ? Atuliyandule bbokesi lyachizuminano cha Jehova okuno kuzwa ku Shilo, lisike akati kesu, lituvune kumaanza abasinkondoma besu.''

Nkiinkako bantu bakatuma balumi ku Shilo; kuzwa ooko bakalibweza bbokesi lyechizuminano cha Jehova wamakamu makamu, ukkala akati kama kkelubbimu. Bana balombe bobile ba Eli, Hofini a Finiyasi, bakaliko antomwe abbokesi lyachizuminano cha Leza.
Elyo bbokesi lyachizuminano cha Jehova nilyakasika kumusasa, boonse bantu ba Izilayeli bakoompolola kapati, alimwi nyika ayilayo yakavwiila.

Eelyo ma Filisiti nibakamvwa ijwi lyakoompolola, bakaamba bati, ''Ninzi ijwi lyalompololo elipati lilikuzwa kumisasa wama Hibbulu nzilyamba ?'' Mpawo bakayeeya kuti ndibbokesi lya Jehova lyasika kumusasa.
Ma Filisiti bakayoowa; bakaamba bati, ''Leza wasika kumusasa.'' Bakaamba bati, ''Nkondo kulindiswe ! Takwe chilibobu chakachitikene nikuba kumasangunino !
Nkondo kulindiswe ! Ngwani uyotuvuna kumanguzu amizimu eeyi ? Njiyeyi mizimu yakawuma MA Ijiputi engumyo zyoonse munkanda.
Amuliyumye, alimwi mube balumi, noba Filisiti, kuti mutabi bazike kuma Hibbulu mbuli mbubakaba bazike kulindiswe. Amube baalumi, alimwi mulwane.''

Ma Filisiti bakalwana, alimwi ma Izilayeli bakakomwa. Woonse umwi awumwi mwalumi bakachijila kumaanda aabo, alimwi kujayigwa kwakali kwiingi, kwakajayigwa akati kama Izilayeli basimyeendo basilumamba bali zyuulu zili makumi otatwe.''
Ibbokesi lya Leza lyakabwezegwa, alimwi bana balombe babili ba Eli, Hofini a Finiyasi, bakafwa.
Mwalumi mu Bbenjamini wakachija kuzwa kunkondo alimwi wakusika ku Shilo mbuboobo buzuba, wakasika ampasya zyakwe zidelukide alimwi mutwe wakwe wakali eevu.

Eelyo nakasika, Eli wakali kkede achuno chakwe kubbazu kunzila wakali kulangila nkambo moyo wakwe tewakachikkalinkene pe akuyeeya bbokesi lya Leza. Eelyo mwalumi nakasika muchisi alimwi akwaamba makani, chisi choonse chakalila.
Eelyo Eli nakamvwa muzumo wakukwila, wakabuzya wati, ''Ino ndupyopyonganonzi olu luchita muzuzumo ?'' Lino mwalumi wakafwambana kusika alimwi akwambila Eli.
Lino Eli wakali aminyaka iili makumi musanu amakumi ane alamusanu ayitatu; menso akwe akawofwala, alimwi takali kukonzya kubona.
Mwalumi wakambila Eli wati, ''Ndime ndakazwa kunkondo. Ndachija sunu kuzwa kunkondo.'' Eli wakabuzya wati, ''Zyakeenda biyeni mwana wangu mulombe ?''
Mwalumi sikweta makani wakasandula alimwi wati, ''Ma Izilayeli bakachija kuzwa kuma Filisiti. Alubo, bana bako balombe bobile, Hofini a Finiyasi bafwa, alimwi bbokesi lya Leza lyabwezegwa.''

Eelyo nakamba bbokesi lya Leza, Eli wakawa kusule achuuno chakwe kubbazu kumulyango. Insingo yakwe yakatyoka, alimwi wakfwa, nkambo wakali wakomena, kali mulemu.Wakabeteka ma Izilayeli myaka ili makumi one.

Lino mukamwana wakwe, mwanakazi wa Finiyasi, wakamintide bula alimwi wakali waba afwifwi akuyotumbuka. Elyo nakamvwa wisizyala akuti ibbokesi lya Leza lyakabwezegwa alimwi akuti wisizyala antomwe amulumi wakwe bafwa, wakakotama alimwi wakatumbuka, pesi machise akutumbuka akamuyumina alimwi takachili kuyeeya kabotu pe.
Nakaamba kufwa banakazi bakali kumulangilizya bakamba bati kulinguwe, ''Utayowi pe, nkambo watumbuka mwana mulombe.'' Pesi takwe nakasandula pe nikuba kubikka mumoyo.
Mwana wakamuuzika izina lya Ikkabbodi, wakamba kuti, ''Bulemu bwalonga kuzwa ku Izilayeli !'' nkambo kakuti bbokesi lya Leza lyakabwezegwa, alimwi nkambo kawisizyala alimwi amulumi wakwe.
Wakaamba wati, ''Bulemu bwalonga kuzwa ku Izilayeli, nkambo bbokesi lya Leza lyakabwezegwa.''
Lino baFilisiti nibakabweza ibbokesi lya Leza, bakalibweza kuzwa ku Ebeneza akulitola kuli Asidodi.
MaFilisiti nibakalanga bbokesi lya Jehova, bakalibweza balitola mung'anda ya Dagoni, akulyimika kumbali lya Dagoni.
Eelyo bantu baku Ashidodi bakabuka chifumofumo muzuba litobela, bakabona kuti, Dagoni wawa wavundama alubuwa kwakali bbokesi lya Jehova. Eelyo bakalanga Dagoni akumwimika mubusena bwakwe.

Alimwi nibakabuka chifumo-fumo kumazuba atobela akuseni, bakabona kuti, Dagoni wawa ulivundeme alubuwa kwakali bbokesi lya Jehova. Mutwe wa Dagoni amaanza woonse akalaansi kanengedwe amulyango. Eelyo chitimbi - timbi cha Dagoni nchichakasyala.
Nkinkaako eechi chamba kuti, ambulisunu, bapayizi ba Dagoni abamwi nibakasika mung'anda ya Dagoni tibakasotoka amulyango mu Ashidodi.
Kuboko kwa Jehova kwakali kulemu kubantu baku Ashidodi. Wakabanyonyoona akubayumya azyuyute, bantu baku Ashidodi antomwe ambibakabambene aabo.

Eelyo mwalumi waku Ashidodi nakazibona zili kuchitika, wakamba kuti, bbokesi lya Jehova waku Izilayeli talyelede kukkala andiswe, nkambo luboko oolu nduyumu kuli ndiswe alimwi akuli Dagoni leza wesu.''

Aboobo bakatuma akutola milawo yoonse yaba Filisiti; akubabuzya kuti, ''Ino tulalichita kutyeni bbokesi lya Leza waba Izilayili ?''  Bakasandula, ''Bbokesi lya Leza waku Izilayeli amulitole afwifwi aku Gati.'' Eelyo bakabweza bbokesi lya Leza waku Izilayeli ooko.

Pesi nibakamana kulitola akuyolisisya, kuboko kwa Jehova kwakasubula chisi, akuchita lupyopyongano lupati. Zyakachisa mwalumi wamu chisi, bonse banini abapati; alimwi  zyuyute zyakawida alimbabo boonse.

Eelyo bakatumina bbokesi lya Leza kuli Ekiloni. Pesi kwalino bbokesi lya Leza lyakasika mukati kuli Ekkiloni, baku Ekkiloniti bakatalika kulila akwamba kuti, ''Balyeta okuno bbokesi lya Leza waba Izilayeli kuti tujayigwe abantu besu.''

Aboobo bakatuma akutola milawo yoonse yaba Filisiti, akubabuzya kuti, ''Amutumine bbokesi lya Leza waku Izilayeli, alibweede ooko nkulyakazwida kubusena, kutegwa litatujayi antomwe abantu besu.''   Bantu boonse bakayoowa kuti balafwa chisi choonse; kuboko kwa Jehova kwakali kulemu kuli mbabo.
Mwalumi wakaleka kufwa wakawumizigwa azyuyute, kulila kwamuchisi kwakinka kujulu.
Lino ibbokesi lya Jehova lyakali munyika yaba Filisiti kwamyezi musanu ayibili.
Eelyo bantu baba Filisiti bakayita bapayizi abasondi, bakaamba kuti kulimbabo, ''Tulachita biyeni aatala abbokesi lya Jehova? Mutwambile mbutwelede kuchita kuti tulijosye munyika yalyo.''

Bapayizi abasondi bakati, ''Naa mwajosya ibbokesi lya Leza kwa Izilayeli, mutalijosyi kalitakwe chipo; muli zyoonse amutumine chipayizyo chamilandu. Mpawo muyoponesegwa, alimwi muyoziba kuti nkaambo kanzi ijanza lyakwe nelyakatagwisigwa kulindinywe kusika lino.''

Eelyo bakaamba kuti, ''Ngalulaba luliyo lulibiyeni ndotunga tulaliya kulinguwe?'' Bakasandula kuti, ''Zikoto zilamusamu zyangolida ambeba zilimusanu zyangolide ooyo ukozyenie mbuli musamu nkawuli mweelwe ooyo ukozyenie mbuli mweelwe wabendelezi baba Filisiti. Ukozyenie amapenzi akamusikila abendelezi benu.

Aboobo mwelede kuchita zikozyanio zyazikoto, antomwe azikozyanio zyambeba zyanu, eezyo zizibisya nyika, alimwi mupe bulemu kuli Leza wa Izilayili. Ambweni uyogwisya janza lyakwe kuzwa kuli ndinywe, kulibaleza banu, alimwi akuzwa kunyika yanu.

Nkambo kanzi nimuyumya myooyo yanu, mbuli ba Ijipita a Faalo mbubakayumya myoyo yabo kuchiindi echo Leza waba Izilayili nchakabeleka ambabo chabuyumuyumu; ba Ijipita tebakabatuma bantu, mpawo bakeenda?.
Elyo lino, amubambe nkalaki mpya nzyazi zibili zyang'ombe zitanakusungwa jokwe. Mwange ng'ombe kunkalaki pesi mubweze bana bazyo mubatole kung'anda kule akuli nzizyo.

Elyo mubweze ibbokesi lya Jehova akulibika munkalaki. Mubike zintu zyangolide nzimulikubwedezya kulinguwe mbuli chipayizyo chalulyo mubbokesi kulubazu lumwi lwalyo. Mpawo amulitumizye alimwi muleke lyeende anzila yalyo.

Elyo mulangilizye; na lyeenda mujulu munzila yakunyika kwalyo ku Bbeti Semesi, mpawo ngu Jehova walekela mapenzi aaya mapati. Pesi kuti telyayinka mbubobo, mpawo tulaziba kuti tekuboko kwakwe pe kwatwetela mapenzi, kwinda kuti tuyoziba kuti zyakachitika kulindiswe muchoolwe.''
Balumi bakachita mbuli mbubakambilidwe bakabweza inzyazi zyobile zyang'ombe, bakazyanga kunkalaki, alimwi akujalila bana bang'ombe kumunzi.
Bakabika ibbokesi lya Jehova ankalaki, aantomwe achibikkilo chila mbeba zyangolide azikozyanio zyazikoto.

Ing'ombe zyakalulama kunzila ya Bbeti Semesi. Zyakeenda imwi itendebede, kazilila nizyakali kuyobwenda, alimwi tezyakaleya pe nikuba kululyo nikuba kuchimweensi. Bendelezi baba Filisiti bakali kuyobutobela kwakusika kumugaano wa Bbeti Semesi.
Lino bantu ba Bbeti Semesi bakali kutebula wiiti mumusena nibakatambya menso aabo akubona bbokesi, bakabotelwa.

Nkalaki yakanjila mukati kamuunda wa Joshuwa kuzwa mudolop[o lya Bbeti Semesi akwimikila nkukonya. Ibbwe pati lyakaliko alimwi bakamwaya nkuni kuzwa kunkalaki akupayilila ing'ombe mbuli chipayizyo chakuumpilizya kuli Jehova.

Ba Levi bakabweza ibbokesi lya Jehova achibikilo chalyo, oomu mwakali zintu zyangolida, alimwi akuzibikka abbwe pati. Balumi ba Bbeti Semesi bakatuula zipayizyo zyakuumpilizya alimwi bakachita zipayizyo mbuboobo buzuba kuli Jehova.
Chindi bendelezi balimusanu baba Filisiti nibakabona eechi, bakabweeda mbubo buzuba ku Ekkiloni.

Eezi zikoto zyangolida eezyo baFilisiti  nzibakajosya mbuli chipayizyo chaluliyo kuli Jehova - chimwi kachili che Asidodi, chimwi kachili cha Gaza, chimwi kachili cha Asikkeloni, chimwi kachili  cha Gati, chimwi cha Ekkiloni.

Imbeba zyangolide zyakalelene mumweelwe mbuli mweelwe wamyunzi yoonse yaba Filisiti yakali yabendelezi balimusanu, yoonse myuunzi izyungulukide alimwi anyika zyamumyunzi. Ibbwe pati, kutaamba eelyo ndibakabikka ibbokesi lya Jehova, kwakachala kabuli bukamboni asunu mumuunda wa Joshuwa ku Bbeti Semesiti.

Jehova wakalwanisya bamwi balumi baku Bbeti Semesi nkambo bakalanga mubbokesi lya Jehova, wakajaya 50,070 balumi. Bantu bakakwila nkambo Jehova wakawuma bantu aluumo lupati kwiinda kuti 50,070 balumi, amwi malembe abasyasunu basandulula kabaamba kuti, makumi alimusanu aabili.
Balumi baku Bbeti Semesi bakati, ''Ngwani ukonzya kwimikila kunembo lya Jehova ooyu Leza Uusalala?  Nkuliini ibbokesi nkulitaye kuzwa kulindiswe?''
Bakatuma batumwa kubantu bakali kukkala ku Kkiliyati Jiliyamu, nkabati, ''Ba Filisiti baboozya ibbokesi lya Jehova; amuseluke mubwede aalyo.''
Baalumi ba Kkiliyati Jelimu bakasika, bakabweza bbokesi lya Jehova, alimwi bakalyeeta mun'anda ya Abbinadabbu aachilundu. Bakasalazya mwana wakwe mulombe Eliyeza kuti abambe bbokesi lya Jehova.

Kuzwa mubuzuba bbokesi nilyakasyaala mu Kkiliyati Jelimu, chiindi chilamfu chakiinda, minyaka ili makkumi obile. Yoonse n'anda ya Izilayeli yakalila alimwi yakaba achiyandisyo chakupilukila kuli Jehova.

Samiyele wakati kun'anda ya Izilayeli yoonse, ''Na mwaboola kuli Jehova a moyo wenu woonse, amugwisye baleza beenzu alimwi a ba Asitolesi kuzwa aakati kenu, mubozye myoyo yanu kuli Jehova, alimwi mukombe nguwe  luzutu, mpawo uyomuvuna kuzwa kujanza lya ba Filisitiya.''
Mpawo bantu ba Izilayeli bakagwisya ba Bbaala alimwi a ba Asitolesi, alimwi bakakomba Jehova luzutu.
Mpawo Samiyele wakati, ''Amubunganie ba Izilayeli boonse ku Mizipa, alimwi ndiyoomukombela kuli Jehova.''

Bakabungana ku Mizipa, bateka manzi alimwi bakaatila kunembo lya Jehova. Bakalyiimya kulya oobo buzuba alimwi bakati, ''Twabisizya Jehova.'' Nkonkuko ooko Samiyele nkwakatalika kubetaka mpyopyongano zyabantu ba Izilayeli alimwi wakabazulwida bantu.
Lino eelyo ba Filisitiya nibakamvwa kuti bantu ba Izilayeli bakali bungene ku Mizipa, baami ba baFilisitiya bakalwana Izilayeli. Eelyo bantu ba Izilayeli nibakazimvwa, bakayowa baFilisitiya.
Mpawo bantu ba Izilayeli bakati kuli Samiyele, ''Utaleki kwiita kuli Jehova Leza wesu nkaambo kesu, aboobo uyotuvuna kuzwa kujanza lya baFilisitiya.''
Samiyele wakabweza mbelele iinyonsya alimwi wakiipeda mbuli chituzyo chakutenta chizwide kuli Jehova. Mpawo Samiyele wakalila kuli Jehova akaambo ka Izilayeli, alimwi Jehova wakamusandula.

Awo Samiyele nakachili kupa chituuzyo chakutenta, baFilistiya bakasika kuzolwana baIzilayeli. Pesi Jehova wkandindima amuzumo mupati buzuba oobo aatala a baFilisitiya alimwi wakabawaalila mukuswekelwa mizezo, alimwi bakakomwa kunembo lya Izilayeli.
Baalumi ba Izilayeli bakazwa ku Mizipa, alimwi bakatandaania baFilisitiya alimwi bakabajaya kule afwifwi a Bbeti Kkali.
Mpawo Samiyele wakabweza bbwe alimwi walibika aakati ka Mizipa a Seni. Wakalyuuzika kuti Ebbeneza, kwaamba,''Kusikila okuno Jehova watugwasya.''
Aboobo baFilisitiya bakazundwa alimwi takwe nibakanjila mugaano wa Izilayeli. Janza lya Jehova lyakalwana ba Filisitiya mazuba woonse aa Samiyele.

Madolopo baFilisitiya ngibakali babweza kuzwa ku Izilayeli akabwedezegwa kuli Izilayeli, kuzwa ku Ekkiloni kusika ku Gati; ba Izilayeli bwakaboozya nyika yabo kuzwa ku baFilisitiya. Mpawo kwakaba luumuno aakati ka Izilayeli a ba Amoli.
Samiyele wakabeteka Izilayeli woonse mazuba abuumi bwakwe.
Awumwi munyaka wakali kuyabuzyunguluka ku Bbeteli, ku Giligali, alimwi a ku Mizipa. Wakalikubeteka mpyopyongano zya Izilayeli mumasena woonse aaya.
Mpawo wakalikukonzya kubweda ku Lama, nkaambo n'anda yakwe nkuyakabede; alimwi ooko wakalikubeteka mpyopyongano zya Izilayeli. Alubo wakayaka chipayililo nkukooko chakupayilila kuli Jehova.
Eelyo Samiyele nakachembaala, wakachita bana bakwe balombe baba babetesi aatala a Izilayeli.
Izina lya mwana wakwe mutaanzi lyakali Joweli, almwi izina lyamwana wakwe mulombe lyakali Abija. Bakali babetesi mu Bbiyaseba.
Bana bakwe balombe tebakeenda minzila zyakwe, pesi bakayanduula mpindu zyakutasyomeka. Bakali kutambula zyakweeneenwa alimwi kababisizya bululami.
Mpawo boonse bapati ba Izilayeli bakabungana aantomwe alimwi bakaza kuli Samiyele ku Lama.
Bakati kulinguwe, ''Langa, wachembaala, alimwi bana bako tabeendi munzila zyako. Tusalile swebo mwaami sikutubeteka mbuli woonse manyika.''
Pesi zyakamubijila Samiyele eelyo nibakati, ''Tupe mwaami sikutubeteka.'' Aboobo Samiyele wakakomba kuli Jehova.
Jehova wakati kuli Samiyele, ''Lemeka jwi lyabantu kuli zyoonse nzibaamba kulinduwe; nkaambo tabakukakide pe webo, pesi bakakaka ndime kukuba mwaami aatala ambabo.
Balikuchita lino munzila ikozyenie mbuli mbubakali kuchita kuzwa buzuba nindakabagwisya mu Ijipiti, kundisiya mebo, alimwi kumanina bamwi baleza milimu, alimwi aboobo balikuchita alubo kulinduwe.
Lino baswiilile; pesi bachenjezye chakasimpe alimwi ngabazibe nzila mwaami njatakabeendelezye aanjiyo aatala ambabo.''
Aboobo Samiyele wakabaamba majwi woonse aa Jehova kubantu bakali kukumbila mwaami.

Wakati, ''Eechi chiyooba chichito cha mwaami uyomweendelezya nywebo. Uyoobweza bana benu balombe alimwi akabasale kuti babe basinkalaki zyakwe alimwi kuti babe ba simabbiza bakwe, alimwi bakachijaane kunembo lya nkalaki zyakwe.

Uyoolisalila mwini basilutwe ba zyuulu alimwi basilutwe ba makkumi ali musanu. Uyoochita bamwi kuti bakalime nyika yakwe, bamwi bakatebule butebuzi, alimwi bamwi bakachite zyakulwanisya kunkondo a zibelesyo zya nkalaki zyakwe.
Alubo uyobweza bana banu basimbi kuba ba sikununkilizya, ba sikujika, alimwi ba sikuyoka zibunge.
Uyoobweza zibotu loko zyamyuunda yenu, myuunda yenu ya masaansa, alimwi amyuunda yenu ya ma olifa, aimwi akazipe kubalanda bakwe.
Uyoobweza chakkumi chazilyo zyenu alimwi achamasaansa enu alimwi akazipe basilutwealimwi akubalanda bakwe.
Uyoobweza balanda benu baalumi alimwi abalanda benu banakazi alimwi a n'ombe zyenu mbotu alimwi ambongolo zyenu; uyozibika aantomwe kuti zibelekele nguwe.
Uyobweza chakkumi cha matanga eenu, alimwi muyooba bazike bakwe.
Mpawo mubuzuba oobo uyolila nkaambo kamwaami  wenu ngumwakalisalila nobeni; pesi Jehova takoyoomusandula mubuzuba oobo.''
Pesi bantu bakakkaka kumuswiilila Samiyele; bakati, ''Pe! Kweelede kube mwaami aatala andiswe
kuchitila kuti tube mbuli amwi manyika woonse, alimwi kuchitila kuti mwaami wesu akonzye kutubeteka alimwi akutuzulwida alimwi akutulwanina nkondo zyesu.''
Eelyo Samiuele nakamvwa woonse majwi abantu wakayindulula mumwati a Jehova.
Jehova wakati kuli Samiyele, ''Lemeka jwi lyabo alimwi uchite umwi kuti abe mwaami wabo.'' Aboobo Samiyele wakati kubaalumi ba Izilayeli, ''Woonse muntu weelede kubweda kuchisi chakwe.''

Kwakaliwo mwaalumi mu Bbenjamini, mwaalumi muyungi. Zina lyakwe wali Kkisi mwana mulombe wa Abbiyeli mwana mulombe wa Zeloli mwana mulombe wa Bbekkolati mwana mulombe wa Afiya, mwana mulombe wamu Bbenjamini.
Wali aa mwana mulombe walikutegwa Sawulu, mukubusi mubotu. Aakati kabantu ba Izilayili tekwali mwaalumi wali kumwiinda kubota. Kuzwa kumakwiko aakwe kaziya kujulu wali mulamfu kwiinda bantu boonse.
Lino madonki aa Kkisi, wisi wa Sawulu, aakali sweekede. Mpawo Kkisi wakati kuli Sawulu mwana wakwe mulombe, "Bweza umwi wabalanda anduwe; nyampuka akwiinka mukalanguule madonki."

Mpawo Sawulu wakayinda munyika yaziilundu zya Efuleyimu akwiinda munyika ya Salisa, pesi tabaajene pe. Eelyo bakayinda munyika ya Salimu, pesi taakalimo pe nkuko. Mpawo wakayinda munyika yaba Bbenjamini, pesi tabaajene pe.
Nibakasika kunyika ya Zufu, Sawulu wakaamba kuti kumulanda wakwe wakali aanguwe, "Boola, aatujokele, na taata ulakonzya kuleka kuyeeya madonki akutalisya kupengaana aandiswe."

Pesi mulanda wakati kuli nguwe, "Swiilila, kuli muntu wa Leza mumuunzi ooyu. Muntu uli aabulemu; choonse nchaamba nchachoonzyo.   Atwiinke nkuko; ambweni ulakonzya kutwaambila kuti njiili nzila njitukonzya kutola lweendo lwesu."

Elyo, Sawulu wakati kumulanda wakwe, "Pesi na twiinka, nchinzi nchitukonzya kutolelela muntu? Nkaambo chibunge munkomwe yesu chamana, alimwi taakwe chipo chakutolelela muntu wa Leza. Niinzi nchitujisi?
Mulanda wakasandula Sawulu akwaamba kuti, "Aano, ndili aachipanzi chane chasyekelu yansiliva eelyo ndinsikamupe muntu wa Leza, kuti akatwaambile nzila njitunga tuliinka aayo.
(Kale mu Izilayili, muntu nanuunga wayinka kuyolanguula luzibo lwakuyanda kwa Leza, walikwaamba kuti, "Boola, atwiinke kumusondi." Nkaambo basinsimi basunu kale kale balikutegwa mbasondi.)
Mpawo Sawulu wakati kumulanda wakwe, "Waamba kabotu. Boola, antwiinke." Eelyo bakayinka kumunzi ooko muntu wa Leza nkwakabede.
Mbubakayo butanta kumuunzi wa chilundu bakajana bakubusi banakazi kabayinka kuyooteka maanzi, Sawulu amulanda wakwe bakati kulimbabo, "Musondi mpali na?"
Bakasandula akwaamba kuti, "Mpali, amubone, uli kunembo lyanu. Amufwambaane, nkaambo wasika sunu kumuunzi, nkaambo bantu balokupayizya kubusena busalala.

Mbumuyoonjila muunzi biyo muyoomujana, katana kutanta kubusena busalala kuyoolya. Bantu tabakoyoolya mane akaboole, nkaambo uyoolongezya chipayizyo; kumana kwaboobo batambidwe bayoolya. Lino aamutante, nkaambo muyoomujana mpawo mpawo."
Mpawo bakatanta kumuunzi. Mbubakanjila muunzi, bakabona Samuyeli kalookuzwa kaswaanana aambabo, kuyootanta kubusena busalala.
Lino kakuchicheede zuba lyomwe Sawulu katanasika Jehova wakali wayubununa kuli Samuyeli:

Juunza kuchiindi eechino ndiyokutumina mwaalumi uzwa kunyika ya Bbenjamini, mpawo uyoomunanika kuti abe mwaami kubantu bangu Izilayili. Uyoofutula bantu bangu kuzwa kuluboko lwaba Filisiti. Nkaambo ndalanga chaluzyalo aabantu nkaambo kwiita kwabo kwakuyanda kugwasigwa kwasika kulindime.
Samuyeli nakabona Sawulu, Jehova wakamwaambila kuti, "Ngoyu mwaalumi ngundakakwaambila aatala! Nguwe uyooyendelezya aatala aabantu bangu."
Eelyo Sawulu wakaswena aafwifwi kuli Samuyeli mumulyango akwaamba kuti, "Ndaambile nkuuli nkwiibede ng'anda yamusondi?

Samuyeli wakasandula Sawulu akwaamba kuti, Ndime musondi. Tanta kunembo lyangu kubusena butantukide, nkaambo sunu uyoolya aandime. Kuseeni ndiyookuleka ukayinke, alimwi ndiyokwaambila zyoonse zili aamuzeezo wako.

Kwamadonki aako aakaswekede mazuba aatatu ayinda, utalipenzyi aatala aangawo nkaambo aajanika. Eelyo mpalini ziyandisyo zyoonse zya Izilayili mpuzibikidwe? Sena takuli aalinduwe akung'anda yoonse yawuso?"

Sawulu wakasandula akwaamba kuti, "Sena nsili mu Bbenjamini, uzwa kumikowa miniini loko ya Izilayili? Sena mukowa wangu tuuli muche loko kumikowa yoonse yaluzubo lwa Bbenjamini? Nkamboonzi nwambuula boobu kuli ndime?"
Mpawo Samuyeli wakabweza Sawulu amulanda wakwe, wabaleta kung'anda yakulida, akubakkazika aabusena bwaatala bwabaabo bakatambidwe, aabo bakatikabe makumi aatatu aabantu.
Samuyeli wakaamba kuti kuli sikupeka, "Leta chaabilo eecho nchindakakupa, eecho nchindakati kulinduwe, 'Chibike aambali."

Mpawo sikupeka wakabweza chibelo acheecho chakali aali nchicho akuchibika kunembo lya Samuyeli. Eelyo Samuyeli wakati, "Bona eecho chalilondwedwe chabikwa kunembo lyako. Chilye, nkaambo chalilondwedelwe nduwe mane kuchiindi cheelede, kuzwa kuchiindi nchindakati, 'Ndatamba bantu."' Mpawo Sawulu wakalya aa Samuyeli buzuba oobo.
Nibakaseluka kuzwa kubusena bwaatala bakanjila mumuunzi, Samuyeli wakambuula aa Sawulu aatala lyalululi.

Eelyo nibwakacha, Samuyeli wakayita Sawulu aa chiluuli akwaamba kuti, "Nyampuka, kuti nkonzye kukweendesya mulweendo lwako."Mpawo Sawulu wakanyampuka, kabali babili we a Samuyeli bakayinka aanze munzila.

Eelyo nibakali kwiinka kumamanino aa muunzi, Samuyeli wakati kuli Sawulu, "Ambila mulanda kuti ayinde kunembo lyesu," - alimwi wakayinda kunembo- pesi weelede kukkala aano kwakayindi, kuti ndikulwiide jwi lya Leza."
Mpawo Samiyele wakabweza kankuli kakwe kamafuta akutila amutwe wa Samuyele, akumumyonta. Wakaamba kuti, ''Jehova tewaka kunanika kuti ube muzululi atala alukono lwakwe na?

Wandisisya sunu, uyojana balumi babili afwifwi achuumbwe cha Lacheli, mubusena bwa Bbenjamini ku Zeliza. Bayokwambila kuti, imbongolo nziwali kuyanduula zyajanika. Lino wuso, tachilokulikatazya ambongolo ezi pele wamba kulikatazya atala anduwe, kalokwamba ikuti, ''Ndichiteenzi atala amwanangu mulombe?''
Mpawo uyoyindila kunembo, ukasike ku mubanga waku Tabba. Balumi ibatatu bayokuswana nkuko, umwi unojisi tupongo totatwe, umwi unojisi zinkwa zyotatwe, umwi unojisi kankuli kali amusansa.
Bayokujuzya akukwabila zinkwa zibili, nzyotakatole mumaboko abo.
Kuzwaawo, uyosika achilundu cha Leza, awa aling'anda yabasimamambe baba Filisitiya. Wasika mudolopo, uyoswana basinsimi kabaselela kuzwa kubusena atuntimbwa kunembo lyabo; banosinsima.
Muuya wa Jehova uyoselela changuzu alinduwe, uyosinsima ambabo, akusanduka akuba mbul mwalumi uumbi.
Lino ezi zitondezyo zyasika kulinduwe, ukachite kufumbwa maboko ako nchayojana chakuchita, nkambo Leza uli ayebo.

Uyinke ukunuke ukandindile ku Giligali.  Mpawo ndiyoseluka akuza kulinduwe kuzopa zipayizyo zyumpidwe akupa zipayizyo zyaluumuno. Ukandilindile kwamazuba alimusanu aabili kuti ndizosike kuli nduwe akukutondezya nzyoyelede kuchita.''
Sawulu wakatukwida Samiyele, Leza wakamupa moyo uumbi mpawo zitondezyo eezi zyakachitika mubuzuba oobo.
Nibakasika kuchilundu, ikabunga kabasinsimi kakamuswana, amuuya wa Leza waka muselukila changuzu zyakuti wakasinsima antomwe ambabo.
Ibantu boonse nibakamubona kasinsima, bakambilana kuti, ''Ino niinzi zilokuchitika kumwana wa Kkishi? Sawulu waba umwi waba sinsimi na?
Mwalumi wakali kuzwa kubusena oobo wakasandula, ''Mpo yisi ngwani?   ''Nkambo kazeezi, kakaba kaambyo kakuti, ''Sawulu nguumwi wabasinsimi na?''
Nakamana kusinsima, wakasika abusena buli atala.
Wisilenzi wa Sawulu wakati kuli nguwe akumuzike wakwe, ''Mwali mwaya kuli?'' Wakasandula, ''Kukuyoyanduula imbongolo. Mputwakabona kuti tatuli kuzijana, twazoya kuli Samiyele.''
Wisilenzi wa Sawulu wakati, ''Ndalomba mundibuzye Samiyele nzyamwambila.''
Sawulu wakasandula yisilenzi kati, ''Wakatubuzya kuti imbongolo zyakajanika.'' Pesi tamwambilide pe atala abwami, Samiyele mbwakambide.
Lino Samiyele wakita bantu boonse antomwe kunembo lya Jehova ku Mizipa.

Wakati kubantu ba Izilayeli, ''Nzeezi Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli nzyawamba: Ndakagwisya Izilayeli kuzwa mu Ijipiti, alimwi akumwangununa kujanza lyaba Ijiputi, akumaboko abaami boonse bali kumudyamizya.
Pesi sunu mwamukaka Leza wanu, umwangununa kuli woonse mapenzi anu, akukatazika kwenu koonse; mwamwambila kuti, 'Tubikile mwami ajulu lyesu.' Lino amulyete kunembo lya Jehova lunyungu alunyungu.''
Nkiinkako Samiyele wakeeta lunyungu loonse lwa Izilayeli afwifwi, lunyungu lwa Bbenjamini lwakasalwa.
Mpawo wakeeta lunyungu lwa Bbenjamini afwifwi anzubo zyabo; luzubo lwa Matilitisi lwakasalwa; alimwi Sawulu mwana mulombe wa Kkishi wakasalwa. Pesi mpubaka muyanduula, tebakamujana pe.
Mpawo bantu bakali kuyanda kubuzya mibuzyo myiingi kuli Leza, ''Kuchili umwi mwalumi utasike na?'' Jehova wakasandula, ''Walisisa akkati kazikwama.''
Bakachijana bakumugwisya Sawuli. Nakiima akkati kabantu, wakali mulamfu kwinda boonse kuzwida amakkuko akwe kaziya kujulu.
Mpawo Samiyele wakambila bantu kuti, ''Naa muli mubwene mwalumi Jehova ngwaasala? Takwe ulimbuli nguwe akkati kabantu boonse!'' Bantu boonse bakoompolola, ''Ngapone kwalyoonse mwami!''
Mpawo Samiyele wakambila bantu milawo yabwami, wakilemba mulugwalo, akwibika kunembo lya Jehova. Samiyele wakamwayisya bantu, umwi awumwi kung'anda yakwe.

Sawuli wakinka kung'anda ku Gibbiya, abalumi basimulimu wa Leza mbakaguma myoyo. Pesi bamwi balumi batakwe bulemu bakati, ''Mwalumi oyu ulatuvuna byeni?'' Aba bantu bakamulangila aansi Sawulu akutamwetela izipo.

Pesi Sawulu wakuumuna. (amwi malembe alayungizya kulobu bapanduluzi mumunchali oyu akampanzi aka: Nahashi mwami waba Amoni wakabapenzya loko ba Gaditisi aba Lubbeni. Wakafokweda anze linso lyakululyo lyawumwi awumwi mwalumi takwepe nakazumizya kuti kube sikubavuna ba Izilayeli. Kuyosika ku mulonga Jodani takwe muna Izilayeli wakasiigwa linso lyachilisyo a Nahashi mwami waba Amoni ndyakatanonkola. Pesi balumi bali zyuulu musanu azibili bakaloboka kuba Amoni basikuchijila ku Jabbeshi Giliyadi).
Lino Nahasi muAmoni akuyoolwana kuJabesi Giladi. Boonse baalumi bakuJabesi bakati kuli Nohasi, "Chita chizuminano andiswe alimwi tuyokukkutawukila.
Nahasi muAmoni wakasandula, "Muli eyi inzila njochita chizuminano anduwe, chakuti ndikadonkole meso aanu moonse aakuchilisyo, alimwi eechi cheeta lutuko mwa Izilayeli.
Lino bapati bakuJabesi bakamusandula bati, "Tuleke atulike kwamazuba musanu aabili, kuti tutumine batumwa muchisi cha Izilayeleli. Lino,tuyoolyaaba  kuti kaatakwe utatuvune, tuyolyaaba kulinduwe."
Batumwa bakasika kuGibbiya oko nkwakali kukkala Sawuli, alimwi bakaambila bantu zyakuchita. Boonse bantu bakalilisya.
Lino Sawuli walikuyobutobela basune kuzwa mumuunda. Sawuli wakati, '' Nchinzi chabija kubantu kuti kabalikulila?'' Bakabuzya Sawuli nzibakamba balumi baku Jabesi.
Sawuli nakamvwa nzibakaamba, muuya waLeza wakafwambana alinguwe, alimwi wakanyema loko.

Wakabeza jogwe lyabasune, wakaligonkola zimpazi, wakazitumizya muchisi cha Izilayeli choonse abatumwa. Wakati, ''Oyo utaleke kutobela kusule Sawuli akusule lya Samuyele, basune bakwe bayochitwa mbuboobu.'' Eelyo kuyoosya kwaJehova kwakaselukila bantu boonse, alimwi bakaswanana antomwe mbuli muntu omwe.
Lino nakababala ku Bbezeki bantu baku Izilayeli bakali zyuulu zilimyaanda yotatwe alimwi balumi bana Juda bakali zyuulu zili makumi otatwe.

Bakati kubatumwa bakazide, ''Muyobuzya balumi baku Jabesi Giladi, 'Junza, achindi chakupya kwezuba, munoli mwafutulwa.''' Aboobo batumwa bakiinka alimwi kuyowambila balumi baku Jabesi alimwi bakabotelwa.
Mpawo balumi baku Jabesi bakati kuli Nahasi, '' Junza tuyolyaba kulinduwe alimwi uyochita kufumbwa chitakakubotezye alindiswe.''

Mubuzuba butobela Solu wakabika bantu munkamu zyotatwe. Banjila akati kankamba muchindi chachifumofumo nikwakangwemuka, alimwi bakalwana akuzunda baAmoni mane do zuba lyawumpa. Aabo bakafutuka bakanzana kakutakwe nikuba bolile bakachala kabali aamwi.
Mpawo bantu bakati kuli Samuyele, '' Ngwani wakali kuti, 'Solu kujana watwendelezya na?' Mwete baalumi, kuti tubajaya.''
Pesi Solu wakati, ''Takwe muntu utajayigwe pe mubuzu obu nkaambo sunu Jehova wavuna Izilayeli.''
Mpawo Samiyele wakati kubantu, ''Muboole, tweende ku Giligali tukabukulusye bwami nkukooko.''

Aboobo bantu boonse bakaya kugiligali alimwi bakakubika Solu kuti abe mwaami kunembo lya Jehova mu Giligali. Ooko bakakupayizya zipo zyalumuno kunembo lya Jehova, alimwi Solu aboonse baalumi baku Izilayeli bakabotelwa kapati.
Samiyele wakati kuba Izilayeli boonse, ndazimvwa zintu zyoonse nzimwamba kulindime, alimwi ndamubikila mwaami atala andinywe.
Lino ngooyu mwaami utamuzulwide; alimwi ndacheembala akutuba mumutwe; abana bangu mulabo. Ndeenda kunembo lyanu kuzwa kubulombe bwangu kusikila sunu.

Mpaano mpembede; amupe bukamboni atala andime kunembo lya Jehova akunembo lyamunanike wakwe, musune wani ngundakabweza ? Nimbongolo yani njindakabweza sinkamulomo kuti lindoofwazye kumenso ? Amupe bukamboni atala ambebo alimwi ndilamubwedezya.''
Bakati, ''Taakwe nuwakatwena, kutudyamizya na kubba chintu kuzwa mukuboko kwamuntu.''
Wakati kulimbabo,  ''Jehova ngukamboni akati kanu, amunanike wakwe ngukamboni sunu, kuti tamujene chintu mumaboko aangu.'' Bakasandula, ''Jehova ngokamboni.''
Samiyele wakati kubantu, ''Ngu Jehova wakabika Mozesi a Aaloni, akugwisya bamawuso kuzwa munyika ya Ijiputi.
Lino kakulobo, amulyeete, aboobo kuti ndikombelele andinywe kunembo lya Jehova atala anchito zya Jehova zisalala, ezyo nzyakachita kulindinywe akuli basikale banu.
Lino Jakobo nakeza ku Ijiputi, bamawuso bakalilila Jehova, mpawo Jehova wakatuma Mozesi a Aaloni, wakazulwida bamawuso kuzwa mu Ijipita akukkala mubusena obu.
Pele bakaluba Jehova Leza wabo; wakabawuzya mujanza lya Sisela, mupati wabasilumamba ba Hazo, mukuboko kwama Filisitiya, amukuboko kwamwaami waba Mowabbu; aba boonse bakalwana aba mawuso.
Bakalilila Jehova akuti, 'Twabisya, nkambo twaleka Jehova akubelekela ba Bbaala a Asitoleti. Pele lino tuvune mukuboko kwabasinkondoma, alimwi tuyokukkomba.''
Aboobo Jehova wakatuma Jelubbi Bbala, Bbedani, Jefuta, a Samiyele, alimwi wakamupa luzundo kulibasinkondonyina bamuzyungulukide. Aboobo kuti mukkale nkamu kwabililidwe.
Mpawo nimwakabona kuti Nahashi mwaami wabantu ba Amoni nakamubukila, mwakati kulindime pepe, kwelede kuti, mwaami welede kutwendelezya - nikuba Jehova Leza wenu wali mwaami wanu.
Lino ngoyo mwaami ngumwasala, ngumwakumbila alimwi Jehova ngwaatondeka kuba mwaami atala andinywe.
Kuti mwamuyowa Jehova, mumubelekele, akutelela kujwi lyakwe, akutayomupapila chakukaka mbeta zya Jehova, mpawo monse inywebo amwaami oyo umwendelezya muyoba batobeli ba Jehova Leza wanu.
Kuti temwaswilila kujwi lya Jehova, pesi mupapile mbeta zya Jehova, elyo ijanza lya Jehova liyomubukila, mbuli mbukwakali kumawuso.
Nikuba lino amulitule alimwi mubone chintu chipati Jehova nchakachita kunembo lyamawuso aanu.

Tensi ndyakutyola witi na sunu ? Ndiyo yita Jehova, kuti atume tulabi a mvula. Elyo muyoziba akuyobona kuti busofwazi bwenu mbupati, mbumwakachita kunembo lyabusyu bwa Jehova, kukulikumbilila mwaami.''
Aboobo Samiyele wakiita kuli Jehova; alimwi ndilelyo izuba Jehova wakatuma tulabi a mvula. Eelyo bantu boonse bakamuyoowa kapati Jehova a Samiyele.
Elyo bantu boonse bakati kuli Samiyele, ''Kombela balanda bako kuli Jehova Leza wako, aboobo kuti tutafwi. Nkambo twaliyungizizya izibi zyoonse achibi chakulikkumbilila mwaami.''
Samiyele wakasandula, ''Pele mutapambuki kuzwa kuli Jehova, pesi mukombele Jehova amyoyo yenu yoonse.
Mutapambuki akutobela zintu zyabuyo zitakwe mpiindu kana kumuvuna, nkambo nzyabuyo.
Nkambo kazina lyakwe ipati, Jehova takoyotakata bantu bakwe, nkambo chakonda Jehova nkuti amuchite mube bantu bakwe.
Imebo lwangu, tazichiti pe kuti mbisizye Jehova akuleka kumjukombela. Anukuti, ndiyomuyiisya inzila mbotu ayiluleme.
Kupela muyoowe Jehova akumukomba mubwini chamoyo woonse. Muyeeye zintu zipati nzyakamuchitila.
Pesi kuti wakkakatila mukuchita bubi, moonse inywebo amwaami wanu muyonyonyoonwa.''
Sawulo wakali aminyaka ilimakumi atatwe yakuzyala naakasangunakuba mwendeez; elyo kali wendelezya Izilayeli kwaminyaka ili makumi one,

wakasala baluumi baIzilayeli bali zyulu zyotatwe. Balizyulu yobile bakalanguwe kuMichimasi amuzilundu zya Bbeteli, nkabela bali chulu kabali aJonatani muGibbiya yakuBbenjamini. Bamwi babasilumamba wakababwedezya awumwi kuteente lyakwe.
Jonatani wakazundaa basikondo babaFilisitiya bakali kuGebba alimwi baFilisitiya bakazimvwa. Mpawo sawulo wakasiba mweembo muchisi choonse, wakamba kuti, " Abaswilile baHebbelu."

Izilayei woonse wakamvwa kuti Sawulo wakabazunda basinkondo babaFilisitiya ,alimwi auti Izilayeli chaba chisesemyo kubaFilisitiya. Mpawo basilumamba bakabunganisigwa kuti bakatobele sawulo kuGiligala.

IbaFilisitiya bakabungana antomwe kuyolwanisya Izilayeli, ankalaki zili zyuulu zyotatwe abaluumi basikutanta nkalaki balizyuulu zilimusanu achimwi, abantu biingi mbuli musele ulankomwe yalwizi. Bakinka akuyobamba matente kuMichimasi, kujwe lyaBbeti Aveni.
Elyo balumi baIzilayeli nibakabona kuti baba mumampenzi - nkekako bantu bakawusa, bantu bakayuba mumapako, amumateyo, amumabwe, muzikala, amumalindi.
Bamwi babaHebbelu bakaya mutala lyaJolodani kuya kunyika yaGadi aGiledi. Pesi Sawulo wakachili kuGiligala, alimwi boonse bantu bakamutobela chakuyowa.
Wakalindila kwamazuba aalimusanu aabili, chiindi Samiyele chankabambide. Pesi Samiyele takwe nakasika kuGiligala, alimwi bantu bakamwayika kuzwa kuliSawulo.
Sawulo wakamba kuti, "Mundeetele zituzyo zyakutenta azipayizyo zyalumuno." Mpawo wakatuula chituuzyo chakutenta.
Amane buyo kutuula chituuzyo chakutenta, wakasika Samuyele. Sawulo wakiinka kuyomuswanizya alimwi kuyomujuzya.
Mpawo Samiyele wakati, "Nchizi nchowachita?" Sawulo wakavuwa, "Nendakabona kuti bantu bandimwayika, akuti  ayebo tuwasika kuchiindi cheleede, alimwi akuti baFilisitiya bakali bungene kuMichimashi,
Ndakamba kuti, 'Lino baFilisitiya balandizida kuGiligala, nkabela tendayandula luzyalo lwaJehova.' Nkenkaako ndakalisinikizya kutula chituuzyo chakutenta."
Elyo samiyele wakati kuli Sawulo, "Wachita Chabufubafuba. Tewabamba pe mulawo waJehova Leza wako ngwakakupa. Nkaambo Jehova wayinosimpya bweendelezi bwako atala a-Izilayeli kwalyoonse.

Pesi kwalino bweendelezi bwako tabukoyinkilila kunembo. Jehova walisalila kale muntu muntu ulamoyo wakwe, nkabela Jehova musala kuti abe mweendelezi wabantu bakwe, nkambo kakuti iwebo tewakachita nzyakakulayilila pe."
Mpawo Samiyele wakanyampuka wakatanta kuzwa kuGiligali akuya kuGibbiya wa Bbenjamin.Nkabela Sawulo wakabala bantu mbakalabo, kabalibalumi bali myaanda ilimusanu awumwi.
Sawulo mwanakwe Jonatani, abantu mbakali abo bakakkala muGebba waBbenjamini. Pesi baFilisitiya bakabambide matente kuMichimasi.
Bafumpi bakazwa kumatente abaFiilisitiya kabali inkamu zyotatwe. Imwi nkamu yakalanzya kuOfula, kuchisi chaSyuwali.
Imwi Nkamu yakalanzya kumugaano ulangene aamumpata waZebboyimu kuya kunkanda.
Takwe nekwakalikujanwa mufuzi pe muchisi choonse cha Izilayeli, nkambo baFilisitiya bakamba bati, "BaHebbelu balachita mapanga naba masumu abo beni."
Pesi ba Izilayeli boonse bakali kuseluka kabaya kubaFilisiti, umwi awumwi sensemuzya milomo yamapulawu akwe, ijamba lyakwe, kaleba kakwe, ajekesyo lyakwe.
Chibbadazyo chakali zipanzi zyobile muzipanzi zyotatwe zya Sekela cha milomo yamapulawu, amamba, achipanzi chomwe muzipanzi zyotatwe chasyekela kukusensemuzya tuleba akoolola masumu.
Nkekakaako mubuzuba bwankondo, tekwakali mapanga pe naba masumu mumanza abasilumamba bakali aSawulo aJonatani; Sawulo amwanakwe Jonatani luzutu mbabo bakalazyo.
Basinkondo babaFilisitiya bakazwa akuya kuchito chaMichimasi

Bumwi buzuba, Jonatani mwana wa Sawulo mulombe wakati kumwalumi munini sikumubwezela zilwanisyo, ''Koboola, twinke mutala omiya kuli basilumamba ba Filisitiya kuleeliya bbazu.'' Pele takwe pe naakamwambila wisi.
Sawulo wakali kukkala afwifwi aku Gibbiya munsi amusamu wamu pomegilanayiti uuli mu Migiloni. Baalumi bakasisike kumyaanda musanu awumwi mbakalaabo,

kujatikizya a Ahija mwana mulombe wa Ahitabbbu ( mwana wakwabo Ikkabbodi ) mwana mulombe wa Finiyasi mwana wa Eeli, mupayizi wa Jehova ku Shilo, wakali kuzwata chizwato chabupayizi. Bantu tebakaziba pe kuti Jonatani winka kuli.

Kubbazu limwi alimwi lyamumpata mpakayanda kwinda  kuti akonzye kusikila lumamba lwaba Filisitiya, kwakali bweenga bwamampangala amabwe kubbazu limwi alimwi. Bumwi bweenga bwamabwe bwali  kutegwa Bbozezi alimwi bumwi bweenga bwamampangala amabwe bwali kutegwa Seene.
Bumwi bwenga bwakiimvwi kumusanza kunembo lya Mikkimashi, alimwi bumwi bwenga bwamabwe bwakiimvwi kunyika kunembo lya Gebba.

Jonatani wakati kuli sikumubwezela zilwanisyo wechinini, ''Kweeza, tutalukile okiya kulumamba lwababa balumi batapalwidwe, chimwi chindi Jehova inga ulatubelekela, nkambo takwe chikonzya kumukachizya Jehova kuvuna bingi bantu nibaba bache.''
Sikumubwezela zilwanisyo wakasandula,  ''Kochita zyoonse zili mumoyo wako. Yinkilila kunembo, bona, ndilayebo, kukuteelela malayilile aako oonse.''
Mpawo Jonatani wakati, ''Tulataalukila kubalumi abaya tukalibonie kuli m babo.
Naa baamba kuti kulindiswe, ''Amulindile nkukooko mane tusike oko kuli ndiswe, Ámulindile nkukooko mane tusike oko kuli ndinywe elyo tulakkala mubusena bwesu alimwi tatukootalukila kuli mbabo pe.
Pesi na basandula kabati, Ámuze okuno nkotubede; elyo tuyotaluka, nkaambo Jehova watupa mbabo mukuboko kwesu. Echi chisyobo nchitondezyo kuli ndiswe.''
Aboobo boonse bobile bakalibonia kuli basilumamba baba Filisitiya. Ba Filisitiya bakaamba kuti, ''Laanga, ba Hebbulayo bazwa mumalyango mubakayubide.''

Eelyo balumi balumamba bakiita Jonatani asikumubwezela zilwanisyo, bakati, ''Amuze ookuno nkotubede tumutondezye zimwi zintu.'' Jonatani wakati kuli sikumubwezela zilwanisyo, ''Nditobela, nkambo Jehova wabaaba mukuboko kwaba Izilayeli.''

Jonatani wkatanta amaboko alimwi amawulu aakwe, alimwi sikumubwezela zilwanisyo wakatobela musule lyakwe. Ba Filisitiya bakajiigwa kunembo lya Jonatani, alimwi alakwe sikumubwezela zilwanisyo wakajaya bamwi musule lyakwe.
Oku nkulwanisya kutanzi kwakachitwa a Jonatani a sikumubwezela zilwanisyo, kwakajazya balumi bakatisike kumakumi aabili mukkati kabusena bwakasyelane akawunda kanini biyo

Mwakaba kutamuka kwakuyoowa munkambe, mumyunda, alimwi akkati kabantu. Nibaba basilumamba abakazidilide kulwanisya bakakkatamuka chakuyoowa. Inyika yakateketa, alimwi kwakaba kukkatamuka kwakuyoowa kupati.
Mpawo balindizi ba Sawulo mu Gibbiya  ya Bbenjamini bakabona; inkamu yabasilumamba baba Filisitiya kiizwa akweenda kabali mbuli bantu batezi nkobaya.
Elyo Sawulu wakati kubantu mbaakali aabo, ''Amubole mubone kuti ngwani uutawo aakati kesu.'' Elyo nibakabala, Jonatani asikumubwezela zilwanisyo tebakaliwope.
Sawulo wakati kuli Ahija, ''Koyeta okuno ibbokesi lya Leza,'' nkambo kuli echo chiindi lyakali abantu ba Izilayeli.
Awo Sawulo nakali kwambula amupayizi, kunyonga mumusasa waba Filisitiya kwakali kuyakunembo akuvula. Elyo Sawulo wakati kumupayizi, ''Kogwisya kuboko kwako.''
Sawulo abantu bonse mbakali abo chakubelekela amwi bakanjila munkondo. Icheba lyamu Filisitiya wonse lyakalangana amuntu wakunyika yabo, alimwi kwakaba kunyongana kupati.
Lino abaya ba Hebbulayo bakali aba Filisitiya musule bakali babatobela mumasasa munkambe, bakajatana aba Izilayeli wakali a Sawulo a Jonatani.
Lino balumi ba Izilayeli bakali baliyubya muzilundu afwifwi a Efulemu nibakamvwa kuti ba Filisitiya bachipasule balunangamana, nekubobo bakabaandila musule lyabo munkondo.
Aboobo Jehova wakavuna Izilayeli elyozuba, alimwi inkondo yakinda ku Bbeti Aveni.

Obo buzuba balumi ba Izilayeli bakali tyompedwe nkambo Sawulo wakali wabikka bantu munsi lyachikonke kati, ''Ngwabe utukidwe mwalumi uyoolya kufumbwa chakulya mane do golezya alimwi nkeli ndakkwichizya aali basinkoma.'' Aboobo takwepe silumamba wakalabila chakulya.
Mpawo bantu boonse bakanjila mulusaka alimwi mwakali buchi aansi.
Elyo bantu nibakanjila mulusaka, buchi bwakakunka pele takwepe wakabikka kuboko kwakwe kumulomo wakwe nkambo bantu bakayoowa chikonke.

Pele Jonatani takwe nakamvwa kuti wisi wakali waanga bantu achikonke. Wakatandabika musako wakali mujanza lyakwe akodompa musazi lyabuchi. Wakanyampula ijanza lyakwe kumulomo wakwe, alimwi menso akwe akapampuka amwenguka.
Mpawo umwi wabantu, wakavwiila, ''Wuso wasimya loko kubantu achikonke, kati, ''Ngwabe utukidwe oyo mwalumi uyoolya chilyo mubuzuba obu,' nikuba kuti bantu bawizuka enzala.''
Mpawo Jonatani wakati, ''Ndeende wipenzya inyika. Bona menso angu mbwali apampuka nkambo ndalabila tuchi ootu.
Chalikunobota byeni kansyonga bantu sunu balya kabangunukide musaalo wabasinkondonyina ngubajana? Nkambo ndilyo lino kujaya tensi kwali kupati akati kaba Filisitiya.''
Bakabalwana ba Filisitiya obo buzuba kuzwa ku Mikkimashi kuyosikila ku Ayijaloni. Bnatu bakali bakatala loko.
Bantu bakavuumukila musaalo chamataalo akutola mbelele, ng'ombe alimwi atunamani akuzijaya. Bnatu bakazilya egazi.
Mpawo bakaambila Sawulo, ''Langa bantu balii kubisizya Jehova akulya abulowa.'' Sawulo wakati, ''Mwachita chakutasyomeka. Lino amundikunkulisizye ibbwe pati awa.''

Sawulo wakati, ''Kamuya mukati kabantu, alimwi mubaambile, 'Akube kuti mwalumi umwi awumwi ngayete ng'ombe zyakwe alimwi embelele zyakwe, azijaye mpawawa azilye. Mutabisizyi Jehova akulya nyama abulowa bwayo.'' Aboobo umwi awumwi muntu wakaleta musune wakwe mansiku ngayayo akumujaya mpawawo.
Sawulo wakayaka chipayililo kuli Jehova, chakaba chipayililo chitanzi nchakayakila Jehova.

Mpawo Sawulo wakati, ''Atubatobele ba Filisitiya mansiku tukabanyonyone mane do buche chifumo; tutasiyi naba omwe wabo kapona.'' Bakavuw, ''Kochita echo nchobona kachili chibotu kuli nduwe.'' Pele mupayizi wakati, ''Atusikile Leza awa.''
Sawulo wakabuzya Leza, ''Ndibatobele na ba Filisitiya ? Uyobaaba na mujanza lya Izilayeli?'' Pele Leza takwe nakamuvuwa pe elyo izuba.
Lino Sawulo wakati, ''Amuze aano, moonse nobazuluzi babantu; amwiiye mubone mbuchakachitika chibi echi sunu.
Nkambo mbuli, Jehova mbwapona, oyo uuvuna Izilayeli, nikuba kuti chili muli Jonatani mwanangu, nchobeni ulafwa luzutu.'' Pele, takwe pe naba omwe mwalumi aakati kabantu bonse wakamuvwiila.
Elyo wakati kuli Izilayeli woonse, ''Mwelede kwiima bbazu lyomwe alimwi mube amwana wangu Jonatani tulimw limwi bbazu.'' Bnatu bakati kuli Sawulu, ''Chita zilangika kazili zibotu kuli nduwe.''

Sawulo wakati, ''Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli ! Na kuti echi chibi chachitwa andime nakuti mwana wangu Jonatani, elyo, Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli kopa Ulimu. Pele na echichibi chachitwa abantu bako ba Izilayeli, kopa Tumimu.'' I ULB iyobutobela bupanduluzi bwensiku bwechi Giliki mulizyaambwa kondipa insandulo iili njiyo iilomene. Lino Jonatani a Sawulo bakajatwa chisolo pele basilumamba bakajanwa kabatakwe mulandu.
Pele Sawulo wakati, ''Amuwale zisolo akati kangu a Jonatani mwanangu.'' Lino Jonatani wakajatwa chisolo.
Lino Sawulo wakati kuli Jonatani , ''Kondambila chuwachita.'' Jonatani wakamwambila, ''Ndalabila tuchii kumpela amusako walimujanza lyangu. Ndime uuno; andifwe.
Sawulo wakati, ''Leza achite mbubo mane akwindilila kulindime kuti watafwa, Jonatani.''

Mpawo bantu bakati kuli Sawulo, ''Jonatani afwe, oyo wetela Izilayeli kuzunda kupati kuli boobu ? Tazichiti pe ? Jehova mbwapona, takwe susu lyamumutwe wakwe niliba lyomwe liyowida ansi, nkambo wabeleka a Leza sunu.'' Elyo bantu bakamuvuna Jonatani aboobo tafwide pe.
Mpawo Sawulo wakaleka kutobela ba Filisitya, alimwi ba Filisitiya bakaya kubusena bwabo.

Muchindi Sawulo nakatalika kuzulwida ba Izilayeli, wakalwana abasinkondonyina kumabazu woonse. Wakalwana aba Mowabbu, ba Amonnitisi, Edomu, abamwi baku Zobba, alimwi aba Filisitiya. Kufumbwa nkwakachengunukila,  wakabapa chisubulo.
Wakachita abusichaamba bupati akuzunda bama Ameleki. Wakavuna Izilayeli kuzwa mumaboko abaabo basikubanyonyoona.
Bana balombe ba Sawulo bakali Jonatani, Ishivi, a Malukkishuwa. Mazina abana bakwe basimbi bobile akali kutegwa, Melobbu, mutanzi, alimwi Milika nguwakali munini.
Izina lyamwanakazi wa Sawulo lyakali kutegwa Ahinowamu; wakali mwana wa Ahimazi. Izina lyasilutwe wabasilumamba bakwe wakali Abbina mwana wa Neli, siminzyabo wa Sawulo,
Kkishi wakali wisi wa Sawulo; alimwi a Neli, wisi wa Abbina, wakali mwana wa Abbiyeli.
Kwakali kulwana kupati aba Filisitiya mumazuba aa Sawulo woonseni. Sawulo wakanoonga aabona mwaalumi singuzu, na mwalumi mukozu, wamujatikizya kuli nguwe.
Samiyele wakati kuli Sawulu, 'Jehova wandituma kuti nkunanike ube mwaami wabantu bakwe bakwa Izilayeli. Kwayino telela majwi a Jehova.
Eezi nzenzizyo nzyawamba Jehova wamakamu, 'Ndakachibona Amaleki nchakachitila Izilayeli mukumukatazya mulwendo lwabo, elyo kabazwa mu Ijiputi.
Kwayino mwinke mukalwane a Amaleki akuyomunyonyoona chakumaninina azezyo nzibaleezyo. Mutakabalekeleli, pesi mukajaye balumi abanakazi, bana babo abavwanda, ng'ombe ambelele, nkamela  ama donki.''
Sawulu wakabayita bantu akubabala muchisi cha Telayimu - miyanda ibili yazyuulu zyabalumi benda amyeendo, azyuulu zilikkumi zyabalumi baJuda.
Kuzwawo Sawulu wakeza kuchisi cha Ameleki akuyolindila mumusena.

Mpawo Sawulu wakati kuliba Kkenitisi, ''Kamuya mwinke, amulange kuzwa mukati kaba Ameleki, kuchitila kuti nsika mujayikizyi antomwe ambabo. Nkambo mwakatondezya buuya kubana baba Izilayeli bonse, awo nibakazwa muIjiputi.'' Mpawo ba Kkenayiti bakazwa bayakule kuzwa kuba Ameleki.
Elyo Sawulu wakawuma ba Ameleki, kuzwa ku Havila kule mbuli ku Shuli, ilikubuzwezuba kwa Ijiputi.
Mpawo wakatola Agagi mwaami waba Amaleki kalimumbulu; wakabanyonyoona boonse bantu epanga.

Pesi Sawulu abantu bakwe bakamuleka Agagi, ambelele imbotu ang'ombe, banamani bakaneneede abana bambelele. Ezimwi zyoonse mbono zyakali mbotu, tebakazinyoonyona pe. Pesi bakanyonyoona zyoonse chakumaninina kufumbwa zyakasampukide azyonse zyakatalikwe milimo.
Lino ijwi lya Jehova lyakeza kuli Samiyele, kaliti,
''Zyandeempya mebo zyakuti ndakabika Sawulu kuti abe mwaami, nkambo wasanduka kuzwa kukunditobela alimwi takwepe nakachita milawu yangu.'' Samiyele wakanyema; wakoomoka kuli Jehova busiku boonse.
Samiyele wakafuma kubuka kuyoswanana a Sawulu chifumofumo.Samiyele wakambilwa, ''Sawulu wakasika ku Kkalimeli alimwi wakalibikila chitondezyo chakwe, mpawo wakapiluka wayinka kunsi ku Giligali.''
Lino Samiyele wakasika kuli Sawulu, alimwi Sawulu wakati kulinguwe, ''Ulilongezezegwe lwako a Jehova ! Imebo ndazuzikizya mulawu wa Jehova.''
Samiyele wakati, ''Aniimpokwambaanzi oku kulila kwembelele mumatwi angu, akulila kwang'ombe oku nkundamvwa ?''

Sawulu wakasandula, ''Bakuuzyeta kuzwa kuba Amelekitisi. Nkambo bantu bakuzilondola zimwi mbotu mbelele eng'ombe, kuti bazopayile kuli Jehova Leza wako. Ezi zimwi zyoonse twazinyonyoona chakumaninina.''
Mpawo Samiyele wakati kuli Sawulu, ''Imikila, alimwi njokwambila eezyo Jehova nzyandaambila mansiku.'' Sawulu wakati kulinguwe, ''Kowamba !''
Samiyele wakati, ''nikuba ulimunini mukubona kwako, takulikuti wakachita mutwe wamisyobo ya Izilayeli ? Alimwi Jehova wakakunanika kuba Mwaami wa Izilayeli,
alimwi Jehova wakakutuma mulwendo lwako akwamba kuti, 'Koya ukajaye chakunyonyoona basizibi, ba Ameleki, alimwi akuyolwana ambabo mane bakamane.'
Nkambonzi niwakatatelela ijwi lya Jehova, pesi anukuti wakakubweza mbono mbotu akuyochita zitalomene mumeso a Jehova ?''
Alimwi Sawulu wakati kuli Samiyele, ''Chanchoonzyo ndakatelela ijwi lya Jehova, alimwi ndakenda munzila eyo Jehova njakandituma. Ndakakumujata Agagi, mwaami waba Ameleki.
Pesi bantu bakabweza imbono - mbelele ang'ombe, azibotu zyiindilide zyakelede kunyonyoonwa, kuti bakapayile kuli Jehova Leza wenu mu Giligali.''
Samiyele wakasandula, ''Sa Jehova ulabotelwa muzipayizyo zitentwa azituuzyo, mbuli mukutelela ijwi lya Jehova ? Kutelela nkubotu kwinda chipayizyo, alimwi kuswilila nkubotu kwinda mafuta abagutu.
Nkambo kupapila kuli mbuli chibi chabulozi, alimwi kutalayika kuli mbuli kasampusampu akuba amichito mibi. Nkambo mwakaka ijwi lya Jehova, alakwe wakukaka kuti ube mwaami.''
Mpawo Sawulu wakati kuli Samiyele, 'ndakabisya; nkambo ndakatyola milawu ya Jehova antomwe amajwi ako, nkambo lwangu ndakayoowa bantu alimwi ndakatobela majwi abo.
Kwayino, ndakombelela undilekelele chibi changu, mbwede andime kuti nkakombe Jehova.''
Samiyele wakambila Sawulu, ''Nsikoobweda ayebo pe; nkambo wakakaka ijwi lya Jehova, alimwi Jehova wakukaka kuti ube mwaami waba Izilayeli.''
Mbakati anzeemuke kuyanda kubweda Samiyele, Sawulu wakajata mombe walukumba lwakwe, alimwi lwakadeluka.
Samiyele wakati kulinguwe, ''Jehova wanzanisya bwami bwa Izilayelu kuzwa kuli nduwe lyasunu alimwi wabupa kuli simayakilane wako, oyo ulikabotu kwinda nduwe.
Alubo, inguzu zya Izialyeli tazikoyobeja nikuba kumusandula mizezo yakwe; nkambo tensi muntu pe, kwakuti ulabona wasandula mizezo yakwe.''
Mpawo Sawulu wakati, ''Imebo ndabisya. Pesi ngamundilemeke kwayino kunembo lyabazuluzi babantu akunembo lya Izilayeli. Bweda lubo andime, kuti ambebo nkakombe Jehova Leza wenu.''
Alimwi Samiyele wakabweda kusindikila Sawulu, alimwi Sawulu wakakukomba Jehova.
Mpawo Samiyele wakati, ''Amweete Agagi mwaami waba Amelekitisi okuno kulindime.'' Agagi wakeza kulinguwe kaangidwe nketani alimwi wakati, ''chaanchoonzyo kulula kwalufu kwiinda.''

Samiyele wakasandula, ''Mbuli ipanga lyako mbolyakachita bamakayintu kukkala kabatachikwe bana, abalabo banyoko balasyala kabatachikwe mwana akati kabamakayintu nyina.'' Mpawo Samiyele wakamugonkoola Agagi kunembo lya Jehova ku Giligali.
Samiyele wakaya ku Lama, alimwi Sawulu wakiinka kung'anda yakwe ku Gibbiya yaku Sawulu.
Samiyele takweepe nakamubona Sawulu mane kuyosikila mubuzuba bwakufwa kwakwe, nkambo wakamoomoka Sawulu. Jehova wakeempwa kuti wakali wabika Sawulu kuba mwaami waba Izilayeli.

Jehova wakati kuli Samiyele, ''Kuyosikalili kolila Sawulo mbuli kuti wakamukaka kuba mwami wa Izilayeli? Zuzya lwija lwako amafuta uyinke. Ndiyokutuma kuli Jese waku Bbetelehemu nkambo ndasala mwami akati kabana bakwe baombe.''
Samiyele wakati, ''Ino ndinka biyeni? Na Sawulo wazimvwa ulandijaya.'' Jehova wakati, ''Bweza ng'ombe mpwizi alimwi ukambe kuti, 'Ndazida kuzopa chipayizyo kuli Jehova.'
Uutambe Jese kuchipayizyo, alimwi njokutondezya nzotakachite. Uyondinanikila ooyo ngwensikakwambile.''
Samiyele wakachita mbuli Jehova mbwakamwambila alimwi wakayinka ku Bbetelehemu. Bapati bamuunzi bakati waza mulumuuno na?''
Wakamba kuti, ''Mulumuno; Ndaza kuzopayilila kuli Jehova. Mubambe kulisala alimwi muze andime kuchipayililo.'' Mpawo wakasala Jese abana balombe alimwi wakabatamba kuchipayililo.
Elyo nibakasika wakalanga Eliyabbu alimwi walyambila kuti munanike wa Jehova nchobeni wakalimvwi kunembo lyakwe.

Pesi Jehova wakambila Samiyele kuti, ''Utalangi chiwa chakwe nibuba bulamfu bwachiimo chakwe; nkambo ime ndamukaka. Jehova talangi mbuli muntu mbwalanga; muntu ulanga achiwa luzutu, pele mebo nde Jehova ndilanga mumoyo wamuntu.''
Mpawo Jese wakayita Abbinadabbu akumwiinzya kunembo lya Samiyele. Mpawo Samiyele wakati, ''Alakwe ooyu tamusalide pe Jehova.''
Jese wakayinzya Syama afwifwi, pesi Samiyele wakati, ''Naba oyu Jehova tamusalide pe.''
Jese wakiinzya bana bakwe balombe bali musanu ababili kuli Samiyele. Mpawo Samiyele wakati kuli Jese, ''Jehova takwe omwe ngwasala akati kabaaba.''

Mpawo Samiyele wakati kuli Jese, ''Mpubali na bana bako balombe boonse aawa?'' Wakasandula, ''Mpali wasyala munini wabo, pesi ulikukwembela butanga bwambelele.'' Samiyele wakati kuli Jese, ''Mutumine muntu asike nkambo tatukonzyi kukkala ansi katana sika okuno.
Jese wakabatuma mpawo bakamweeta. Lino oyu mulombe mubotu kalachiimo chibotu. Mpawo Jehova wakati, ''Nyampuka, umunanike; nkambo ngonguwe oyu.''
Samiyele wakabweza lwija lwamafuta wakananika Deviti akati kabakulana bakwe. Muuya wa Jehova wakaselukila ali Deviti changuzu kuzwa mubuzuba oobo. Mpawo Samiyele wakanyampuka winka ku Lama.
Lino muuya wa Jehova wakazwa kuli Sawulo, alimwi Jehova wakalekela muya mubi kuti umupenzye.
Mpawo babelesi ba Sawulo bakati kulinguwe, ''langa muuya mubi uzwa kuli Jehova ulikukupenzya.
Simalelo wesu tulayilile tobabelesi bako, netuli wano, kuti tuyandule muntu uuzi kabotu mbokuumwa kalumbu. Mpawo elyo muuya mubi uuzwa kuli Leza niwakusikila uyokalizya mpawo uyoba kabotu.
Sawulo wakati kubabelesi bakwe, ''Amundilangwide muntu uukonzya kuuma kabotu, mumweete kulindime.''
Umwi wababelesi bakwe wakasandula kuti, ''Ndakali ndabona umwi mwana wa Jese waku Bbetelehemu uuzi kuuma kabotu, ulanguzu, silumamba,ulakanana chabusongo, mwalumi mubotu. Alimwi Jehova uli anguwe.
Aboobo Sawulu wakatuma bantu kuli Jese akwamba kuti, ''Nditumina mwana wako Devidi mwembeli wambelele.''
Jese wakabweza chinkwa achibikilo chawayini wazibika a donki antomwe akana kempongo kanini, wakazitumizya aamwi amana wakwe Deviti kuli Sawulu.
Mpawo Devidi wakasika kuli Sawulu, akutalika mulimu. Sawulu wakamuyanda kapati loko, wakaba sikumubwezela zilwanisyo.
Sawulo wakalayizya kuli Jese kawamba kuti, ''Devidi ndamuyandisya, muleke ku Lama akkale okuno kuli ndime.''
Kufumbwa kuti muuya mubi uzwa kuli Leza mpuwakali kubweza kalumbu akukalizya. Aboobo Sawulu wakali kunonga wabukulusigwa akuba kabotu amuuya mubi wayinonga wamuyaanuka.
Lino ba Filisitiya bakabunganisya basilumamba babo kuti balwane nkondo. Bakali bungene ku Sokko, eyo yakali yaba Juda. Bakali babungana akkati ka Sokko a Azekka, mu Efesi Damimu.
Sawulu abalumi ba Izilayeli bakabungana alimwi bakakkala mu Mweezi wa Ela, alimwi bakakomezya inkondo yabo mumundando kuti bakaswanane aba Filisitiya.
Ba Filisitiya bakimvwilidi kuchilundu kuli limwi bbazu, alimwi ba Izilayeli achilundu kuli limbi bbazu kakuli musena akkati kabo.
Mwalumi usimide wakaza kuzwa kwakabungene bama Filisitiya, mwalumi wakali kwitwa ezina lyakuti ngu Goliyati mu Gati, wakali abulamfu bwakali musanu akamwi katukokola alimwi achimwi chisela.
Wakali angowani yamukkuba amutwe wakwe, alimwi wakali samide chibaki chankondo chakabikidwe mapapa. Mapapa akalikulema musanu zyulu zyamasyekeli amukuba.
Wakazwete zikwabilizyo zyamukkuba kumawulu alimwi wakajisi sumu lyamukkuba akati kamakkuko akwe.

Nkabela luuti lwasumu lyakwe lwakali lupati, kaluli akakole kakuwala ndulo mbuli kakkole kali ajulu achisamu chasikuluka.  Mutwe wasumu lyakwe wakali kulema masyekeli zyabutale zilimwanda ilimusanu awumwi. Nkabela sikubweza intobo yakwe wakali kunembo lyakwe.

Wakayimikila alimwi wakompolola kuli basilumamba baba Izilayeli, ''Nkambonzi nimwaza kuzobambila nkondo? Saa nsili mu Filisitiya andime, alimwi tamuli balanda ba Sawulo na? Amulisalile mwalumi wenu alimwi asike kuli ndime.
Na kakonzya kundilwana mpawo andijaye alimwi tulaba balanda benu. Pesi kuti ndimuzunde alimwi akamujaya, mpawo mulaba bazike besu basikutubelekela milimu.''
Limwi mu Filisiti wakati, ''Nsimubali pe basinkondo bama Izilayeli sunu. Na mundipe mwalumi tulwane.''
Lino Sawulo antomwe aboonse ba Izilayeli abakamvwa mu Filisitiya nzyaakamba bakatyompwa akumvwa kuyoowa kupati.

Lino Devidi kali mwana mulombe waba Efulatayiti baku Bbetelehemu mu Juda, wakali ezina lyakuti Jese. Wakalijisi bana balombe bali musanu abatatu. Jese wakali munene wakachembede mumazuba achindi a Sawulo, kachembede loko akati kamanene. Bana balombe bapati ba Jese bakali batobela Sawulo kunkondo.

Mazina abana bakwe bataatu abo bakatobela Sawulo kunkondo. Mazina abana bakwe bataatu abo bakinka kunkondo bakali Eliyabbu mwanakwe mutanzi, wabili kuli nguwe ngu Abbinadabbu, alimwi wachitatu kali Shama.
Devidi nguwakali ngomunini loko. Aba batatu bapati bakali batobela Sawulo.
Lino Devidi wanonga chimwi chindi waya kukulanga basilumamba ba Sawulo chimwi chindi waya kumbelele zyawisi ku Bbetelehemu, kuchitila kuti akazisanine.
Kwamazuba makkumi aane mu Filisitiya mwalumi wakasimide wakaza afwifwi chifumo fumo zuba limwi alimwi achindi chagoko kali kulyimikizizya nkondo.

Kuzwawo Jese wakambila mwanakwe mulombe Devidi kuti, ''Bweza utolele bakulana bako katwida kamayila ayokedwe antomwe azezi zibunge zilikkumi, alimwi uzibweze utolele bakulana bako chakufwambana nkubabungene.
Alubo bweza zinkuli zyabwanda zilikkumi uzitolele silutwe wankamu yabo. Ukalange kuti bakulana bako balikabotu na, alimwi ukandetele chisimyo chizwa kulimbabo chakuti balikuchita kabotu.
Bakulana bako bali a Sawulo antomwe abalumi boonse ba Izilayeli mu Musena wa Eela, balwana aba Filisitiya.''

Alimwi Devidi wakafuma loko alimwi wakazisiya mbelele asikuzyembela.  Nkabela wakalongela bulilu alimwi wakasunduka, mbuli mbwakalayilidwe a Jese. Nakasika kumisasa mpimpawo basilumamba nibakali kuya kuzilawo zyabo zyankondo kawompolola chakukwiila nkondo.
Ma Izilayeli aba Filisitiya bakali kuli bambila mumindando, basilumamba kabalangeneabasilumamba.
Alimwi Devidi wakasiya bulilu bwakwe kuli oyo wakali kuzilanga, nkabela wakachijanina kunkondo, alimwi wakakujuzya bakulana bakwe.

Elyo nakali kwambula ambabo, mwalumi usimide, mu Filisitiya waku Gati, Goliyati ndyezina lyakwe, alimwi wakazwa anze amisasa yaba Filisitiya, alimwi wakambula majwi akozyenie angakambide kutanguna, mpawo Devidi wakamvwa majwi aya.
Muchindi balumi boonse ba Izilayeli nibakabona mwalumi oyu, bakachija kuzwa kuli nguwe alimwi bakali yowa.

Bonse balumi baku Izilayeli nibakamubona mwalumi oyu, bakachija alimwi bakayoowa kapati. Alimwi bama Izilayeli bakati, ''Mwamubona na mwalumi wasika? Ninchobeni wasika kuzotukila ma Izilayeli. Alimwi mwami uyomunotya mwalumi oyo utamujaye mpawo ulamupa mwana wakwe musimbi alimwi ulachita mpuli yawisi kuti iwangununwe mu Izilayeli.''

Alimwi Devidi wakati kubalumi bakiimvwi anguwe, ''Ninzi chitachitilwe mwalumi oyo utajaye oyu mu Filisitiya alimwi agwisye chisampuzi kuzwa kuli Izilayeli? Ngwani oyu mu Filisitiya utapalwidwe pe kuti unotukila basilumamba ba Leza muumi''
Mpawo bantu bakiindulula ezyo nzibakazwide mukwamba akumulungulwida, ''Mbombubo mbokuyochitilwa oyo mwalumi utakamujaye.''

Lino Eliyabbu mukulana wakwe mupati wakamumvwa naakali kwambula abantu. Mpawo bukali bwa Eliyabbu bwakabukila Devidi, alimwi wakati, ''Nkambonzi niwasika okuno? Ngwani nguwasiila tubelele otuya tuche munkanda? Ndikwizi ulisumpula kwako, alimwi abubi bwamoyo wako; nkambo nziwazida nkuzobona nkondo.''
Devidi wakati, ''Ninzi nchindachita? Takuli kuti walimubuzyo biyo na?''
Alimwi waka chengunukila kulumbi muntu akwamba mbuli ngawo makani  akozyenie. Alimwi bantu bakamusandula ngawo majwi ngibakambide kutanguna.
Elyo muchindi majwi ngakaamba Devidi nakamvwigwa, basilumamba bakayindulula kuli Sawulo.
Alimwi wakamutumina bantu Devidi. Alimwi Devidi wakati kuli Sawulo, ''Kutabi moyo wamuntu utakachilwe nkambo kamu Filisitiya oyo; mulanda wako uliinka akuyolwana anguwe oyo mu Filisitiya.''
Sawulo wakati kuli Devidi, ''Tokokonzya pe kuti uyinke ukalwane amu Filisitiya; nkambo uchili mwanikenike uchikula, alimwi welwakwe mwalumi wankondo kuzwa kubunini bwakwe kachikula.''
Pesi Devidi wakati kuli Sawulo, ''Mulanda wako uzibide kubbasopa mbelele zyawisi. Muchindi mulavu naba suntwe nasika alimwi natola mwana mbelele mubutanga,
Ndakali kumwandila akuyomulwana, alimwi akuyovuna mwana mbelele kumulomo wakwe. Elyo nakali kuyanda kundilwana, ndakali kumujata mumavwele akwe, akumuyasa, alimwi akumujaya.
Mulanda wako wakajaya zyonse mulavu asuntwe. Oyu mu Filisitiya utapalwidwe ulaba mbuli chimwi chazeezi, mbokunga ulokudyokola basilumamba ba Leza muumi.''
