Devidi wakati, ''Jehova wakandivuna kuzwa kumaala amulavu antomwe akumaala abawumpe.  Uyondivuna mebo kuzwa kujanza lyamu Filisitiya oyu.'' Mpawo Sawulo wakati kuli Devidi, ''Koya, alimwi akube kuti Jehova abe ayebo.''
Sawulo wakazwatika Devidi zizwato zyenkondo. Wakamuzwatika ingowani yamukkuba amutwe wakwe, alimwi wakamuzwatika chibaki chamapapa abutale.

Alimwi Devidi wakapakata fulo lyakwe atala azizwato zyankondo. Wakeezya kweenda pesi wakakachilwa, nkambo takwepe mpakazyezezye. Mpawo Devidi wakati kuli Sawulo, ''Tandikonzyi pe kuyolwana azeezi, nkambo takwepe mpondaka yiyilide anzizyo.'' Mpawo Devidi wakazizwatununa.

Mpawo wakabweza musako mujanza lyakwe akusalula tumbulunge mbulunge twamabwe ntwakabwezelela mukasensa; alimwi akutulongela munkomo yasimpongo. Inkwilipo yakwe yakali mujanza lyakwe, alimwi waka mululama mu Filisitiya.
Alimwi mu Filisitiya wakaswena afwifwi a Devidi, asikumubwezela intobo kali kunembo lyakwe.
Elyo mu Filisitiya nakalanga, akubona Devidi, wakamunyansya nkambo wakachili munini loko, kachibalangala alimwi kali mubotu keebeka.
Alimwi mu Filisitiya wakati kuli Devidi, ''Mebo ndimubwa na, zyakuti iwebo uzakuli ndime akaponda?,'' alimwi mu Filisitiya wakatukila Devidi abaleza bakwe.
Mu Filisitiya wakati kuli Devidi, ''Kobola kuli ndime, alimwi ndiyopa mubili wako kubayuni bakujulu alimwi akubanyama bamulusaka.''
Devidi wakasandula kumu Filisitiya, ''Uyobuza kuli ndime afulo, a sumu, alimwi amungwala. Pesi Mebo ndaza kuli nduwe muzina lya Jehova wamakamu, Leza wabasilumamba baba Izilayeli, oyo ngolokunyansya.

Sunu Jehova ulandipa kuzunda ajulu lyako, alimwi ndilakujaya mpawo ndigusye mutwe wako kumubili wako. Sunu ndiyopedekezya chidumbu chamu Filisitiya silumamba kubayuni bakujulu alimwi akubanyamankala bamunyika, kuchitila kuti nyika yoonse ikazibe kuti kuli Leza mu Izilayeli,
alimwi akuchitila kuti yoonse eyi mbungano ikazibe kuti Jehova tapi luzundo akambo kasumu akafulo. Nkambo inkondo njiya Jehova, alimwi uyokwaba mujanza lyangu.''
Elyo mu Filisitiya wakanyampuka alimwi wakamululama Devidi, mpawo Devidi wakachijana chakufwambana kuya kuli sinkondonyina kuti akamuswanizye.

Devidi wakanjizya kuboko kwakwe muchikwama chakwe, wakagusya bbwe mukati, wakalivwililisya, alimwi wakawuma mu Filisitiya ankumu. Ibbwe lyakabbila mukati kankumu yamu Filisitiya, mpawo wakawa chakuvundama abusyu anyika.
Aboobo Devidi wakazunda mu Filisitiya abbwe lyankwizo abbwe mukati. Wakatulula mu Filisitiya alimwi akumujaya. Takwe nikwakali ikafulo mujanza lya Devidi.

Mpawo Devidi wakachijana alimwi wakwimikila ajulu lyamu Filisitiya mpawo wabweza kafulo kakwe, wakasomona muchibikilo chako, mpawo wamugonka mutwe ankako. Elyo ba Filisitiya nibakabona kuti mwalumi wabo simanguzu wafwa, bakalunangamana bachija.

Mpawo balumi baku Izilayeli antomwe aba Juda bakanyampuka alompololo, alimwi bakabatandania ba Filisitiya kuyosika kule mbuli ku mwezi alimwi akumanjililo aku Ekkiloni. Ba Filisitiya bakafwa bakalala kabatobezya nzila iyaku Shalayimu, nzila yoonse kuyosika ku Gati antomwe aku Ekkiloni.
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakanyona kukuyobubandila ba Filisitiya, alimwi bakamwayula mpobakabungene.
Devidi wakabweza mutwe wamu Filisitiya alimwi wakuyeta ku Jelusalemu, pesi wakabikka zizwato zyankondo mu dumba lyakwe.

Muchindi Sawulo nakabona Devidi kabbuda kuya kukulwana mu Filisitiya, wakati kuli Abbina, silutwe wabasilumamba, ''Abbina, mwana wani oyu mulombe uchikula?'' Abbina wakati, ''Mbuli mbopona, mwami, Tandikwe pe nchenzi.''
Mwami wakati, ''Buzya buzya kuli babo bamwizi, kuti mwana wani oyu mulombe.''
Muchindi Devidi nakaboola kuzwa kukujaya mu Filisitiya, Abbina wakamubweza, alimwi wakamweta kunembo lya Sawulo antomwe amutwe wamu Filisitiya mumanza akwe.
Sawulo wakati kulinguwe, ''Ulimwana wani webo, iwe mulombe?'' Devidi wakasandula, ''Imebo ndimwana mulombe wamulanda wenu Jese waku Bbetelehemu.''
Eelyo nakamana kwaambula kuli Sawulu, miyo wa Jonatani wakaangwa kumoyo wa Deviti, alimwi Jonatani wakamuyanda mbuli moy wake mwini.
Sawulu wakabweza Deviti mukumubelekela buunsi oobo; takwe nakamuzumizya kubweda kun'anda ya wisi.
Mpawo Jonatani a Deviti bakachita chizuminano chabweenzinyina nkaambo Jonatani wakali kumuyanda mbuli moyo wakwe mwini.
Jonatani wakagwisya chizwaato eecho nchakazwete alimwi wakachipa kuli Deviti aamwi azizwaato zyakulwania, kuswanizya apanga lyakwe, kanta, a lukumba.

Deviti wakali kwiinka koonse ooko Sawulo nkwakali kumutuma, aimwi wakali kuzwidilila. Sawulo wakamubika waba aajulu lyabaalumi benkondo. Eechi chakali kubotezya mumenso abantu boonse alimwi lubo mukubona kwabalanda ba Sawulo.

Nibakasika amunzi kuzwa kukuzunda ba Filisitiya, banakazi bakasika kuzwa kuma dolopo woonse a Izilayeli, kabali kwiimba a kuzyana, kuyooswaanana a Mwaami Sawulo, a nsaka, alukondo, alimwi azyoonse zilizigwa.
Banakazi bakali kwiimba umwi kuli umwi mbuli mbubakali kulizya. Bakali kwiimba: ''Sawulo wajaya zyuulu zyakwe, alimwi Deviti zyuulu zili kkumi.''
Sawulo wakanyema loko, alimwi lwiimbo olu telwakamubotezya pe. Wakati, ''Baamba zyuulu kkumi kuli Deviti, pesi baamba biyo zyuulu kulindime. Niinzi lubo nchakonzya kuba aacho pesi bwaami?''
Sawulo wakalanga Deviti chakumuyeeyela kuzwa buzuba oobo kaziya kunembo.

Ibuzuba butobela muuya unyonyoona kuzwa kuli Leza wakaselukila ali Sawulo alimwi wakali kuzyana mun'anda. Aboobo Deviti wakalizya kantimbwa kakwe, mbuli mbwakali kuchita buzuba bumwi abumwi. Sawulo wakali aasumu muluboko lwakwe.
Sawulo wakawaala sunu , nkaambo wakayeya, ''Ndilaswaanizya Deviti kubulambo.'' Pesi Deviti wakachija kuzwa kunembo lya Sawulo tubili munzila eeyi.
Sawulo wakayowa Deviti, nkaambo Jehova wakali anguwe, pesi takachili a Sawulo pe.
Aboobo Sawulo wakamugwisya kunembo lyakwe alimwi wamubika kuba mulayilizi wa bali chuulu. Munzila eeyi Deviti wakazwa alimwi wasika kunembo lyabantu.
Deviti wakali kuzwidilila munzila zyakwe zyoonse, nkaambo Jehova wakali anguwe.
Eelyo Sawulo nakabona kuti wazwidilila, wakamugamba loko.
Pesi Izilayeli woonse a Juda bakayanda Deviti nkaambo wakanoonga wiinka aanze alimwi waboola kunembo lyabo.

Mpawo Sawulo wakati kuli Deviti, ''Ngoyu mwana wangu musimbi mupati Melabbu. Ndilamuipa kulinduwe mbuli mukayintu. Luzutu ba a busichaamba akkambo kangu alimwi ulwane nkondo zya Jehova.'' Nkaambo Sawulo wakayeeya, Leka nditabiki kuboko kwangu alinguwe, pesi leka luboko  lwa ma Filisitiya lube alinguwe.''
Deviti wakati kuli Sawulo, ''Ndimeni, alimwi mbaani nzubo zyangu, na bamukowa wa taata mu Izilayeli, kuti ndibe mukwaansa wa Mwaami?''
Pesi kuchiindi echo eelyo Melabbu, mwana musimbi wa Sawulo, mpakeelede kupegwa kuli Deviti, wakapegwa kuli Adileyili mu Meholati mbuli mukayintu.
Pesi Mikkalu, mwana musimbi wa Sawulo, wakayanda Deviti. Bakaambila Sawulo, alimwi eezi zyakamubotezya.
Mpawo Sawulo wakayeeya, ''Ndiyomupa kuli nguwe, aboobo abe kakole kulinguwe, alimwi kuti kuboko kwa ba Filisitiya kumulwisye.'' Aboobo Sawulo wakati kuli Deviti lwabili, ''Uyooba mukwaansa wangu.''

Sawulo wakalayilila balanda bakwe, ''Mwaambule a Deviti muchimpetu, alimwi mutedi, 'Langa, mwaami ulabotelwa mulinduwe, alimwi abalanda bakwe boonse balakuyanda. Lino mpawo, ba mukwaansa wa Mwaami.'''
Aboobo balanda ba Sawulo bakaamba majwi aaya kuli Deviti. Mpawo Deviti wakati, ''Nchintui chiniini na kuli ndinywe kuba mukwansa wa mwaami, mbukunga ndili muntu ufwaba, alimwi uulangililwa aansi?''
Balanda ba Sawulo bakwaamba kulinguwe imajwi aayo Deviti ngakaamba.

Mpawo Sawulo wakati, ''Mukaambe boobu kuli Deviti, 'Mwaami talombozyi imbadalo yaluselo kunze kwazikumba zili mwaanda zyakunembo kwa bwaalumi bwa ba Filisitiya kubwedezegelwa kuli basinkondo ba mwaami.''' Lino Sawulo wakayeeya kuchita Deviti kuti awe aluboko lwa ba Filisitiya.
Eelyo balanda bakwe bakaambila Deviti majwi aaya, zyakabotezya Deviti kuba mukwaansa wa mwaami.

Musule lyamazuba ayo kaatanamana, Deviti wakiinka a baalumi bakwe alimwi wakajaya myaanda yobile ya ba Filisitiya. Deviti wakeeta zikumba zyakunembo kwa bwaalumi bwabo, alimwi bakazipa amyeelwe izwide ku mwaami, kuchitila kuti abe mukwansa wa mwaami. Aboobo Sawulo wakamupa Mikkali mwana wakwe musimbi mbuli mukayintu wakwe.
Eelyo Sawulo wakabona, alimwi wakaziba kuti Jehova wakali a Deviti, alimwi kuti Mikkali, mwana musimbi wa Sawulo, wakali kumuyanda,
Sawulo wakaba akuyowa Deviti kupati. Sawulo wakali sinkondonyina wa Deviti kwalyoonse.

Mpawo bana balombe ba mwaami ba Filisitiya bakasika kuzolwana, alimwi mbuli mbubakali kusika sika, Deviti wakali kuzwidilila kwiinda boonse balanda ba Sawulo, aboobo kuti izina lyakwe lyakalemekwa kapati.
Sawulo wakatikuli Jonatani mwana wakwe mulombe alimwi akuli boonse balanda bakwe kuti beelede kujaya Deviti. Pesi Jonatani, mwana mulombe wa Sawulo, wakli kubotelwa loko muli Deviti.
Aboobo Jonatani wakaambila Deviti kuti, ''Sawulo taata wangu uyanduula kukujaya. Nkinkaako libambile chifumo alimwi ulisise nomwini mubusena busisikene.
Ndiyooyinka aanze alimwi ndikiimikile kumbali lya taata wangu mu muunda ooko nkobede, alimwi ndiyowambuula a taata aatala anduwe. Na ndamvwa chimwi chintu, ndilakwaambila.''

Jonatani wakaambuula kabotu aatala a Deviti kuli Sawulo wisi wakwe alimwi wakati kuli nguwe, ''Utalekeli mwaami abisye aatala lya mulanda wakwe Deviti. Nkaambo kakuti takwe nabisizye pe aatala anduwe, almwi nchito zyakwe zyakweetea bubotu.

Nkaambo wakabweza buumi bwakwe mujanza lyakwe alimwi wakajaya mu Filisitiya. Jehova wakeeta kuzunda kupati ku ma Izilayeli. Mwakazibona alimwi mwakabotelwa. Nkaambonzi notabisye aatala abulowa butakwe mulandu akujaya Deviti kakutakwe chizato?''
Sawulo wakaswiilila kuli Jonatani. Sawulo wakakonkezya, ''Mbuli Jehova mbapona, takoyoobigwa kulufu pe.''
Mpawo Jonatani wakayita Deviti, alimwi Jonatani wakamwaambila zyoonse eezi zintu. Jonatani wakeeta Deviti kuli Sawulo, alimwi wakali kuli nguwe mbuli chiindi.
Kwakaba nkondo alubo, alimwi Deviti wakayinka alimwi waakulwana a ba Filisitiya alimwi wakabazunda alunyonyoono lupati. Bakachija kunembo lyakwe.
Muuya mubi uzwa kuli Jehova wakasika ali Sawulo aawo nakakkede mun'anda yakwe asumu lyakwe mujanza lyakwe, alimwi aawo Deviti nakali kulizya kantimbwa kakwe.
Sawulo wakeezya kunamatizya Deviti ku bulambo asumu lyakwe, pesi wakachia kuzwa kubusyu bwa Sawulo, chakuti Sawulo wakayasa sumu mu bulambo. Deviti wakachija alimwi wakaloboka mbuboobo busiku.

Sawulo wakatuma batumwa kun'anda ya Deviti kuti bakamulange kuti amwi ulabona wamujaya chifumo. Mikkala, mukayintu wa Deviti, wakamwaambila, ''Na tewafutula buumi bwako busiku obuno, junza ulajayigwa.''
Aboobo Mikkala wakaseluzya Deviti aachimpulunguzyo. Wakiinka alimwi wachija, alimwi wakaloboka.
Mikkala wakabweza chitoombe chaan'anda alimwi wachilazika aabulo. Mpawo wakabika musego waboya bwempongo kumutwe wacho, alimwi wakachivumba azizwaato.
Eelyo Sawulo nakatuma batumwa kuti bakamubweze Deviti, wakati, ''Ulichisidwe.''
Mpawo Sawulo wakatuma batumwa kuti bakamubone Deviti; wakati, ''Mukamweete kulindime kali aabulo, kuchitila kuti ndikonzye kumujaya.''
Eelyo batumwa nibakanjila, langa, chitoombe chaan'anda chakali aabulo kachili amusego waboya bwempongo kumutwe wacho.

Sawulo wakati kuli Mikkala, ''Nkaambonzi nimwandeena alimwi mwalekela sinkondoma weenda, chakuti waloboka?'' Mikkala wakasandula Sawulo, ''Wati kulindime, 'Ndileke mebo ndeende. Nkaambonzi nensikujaye?'''

Lino Deviti wakachija alimwi waloboka, alimwi wakayinka kuli Samiyele ku Lama alimwi wamwaambila zyoonse eezyo Sawulo nzyakachita kuli nguwe. Mpawo wenya a Samiyele bakeenda alimwi bakukkala mu Nayiyoti.
Zyakaambwa kuli Sawulo, kutegwa, ''Bona, Deviti uli ku Nayiyoti mu Lama.''

Mpawo Sawulo wakatuma batumwa kuti bakatumbe Deviti. Eelyo nibakabona nkamu ya basinsimi kabali kusinsima, a Samiyele kayiimvwi kali silutwe aakati kabo, Muuya wa Leza wakaselukila batumwa ba Sawulo, alimwi abalabo bakasinsima.
Eelyo Sawulo nakaambilwa eechi, wakatuma bambi batumwa, alimwi abalabo bakasinsima. Aboobo Sawulo wakatuma batumwa chiindi chatatu, alimwi abalabo bakasinsima.
Mpawo alakwe wakaya ku Lama alimwi alimwi wakusika kusawu linikide lili mu Seku. Wakabuzya, ''Samiyele a Deviti?'' Umwi wakati, ''Bona, bali ku Nayiyoti mu Lama.''
Sawulo wakaya ku Nayiyoti mu Lama. Mpawo Muuya wa Leza wakaselukila alinguwe, alimwi aawo nakayobwiinka wakayobusinsima kusikila ku Nayiyoti mu Lama.

Wakagwisya zizwato zyakwe alimwi alakwe wakasinsima kunembo lya Samiyele. Wakalala chinkuna buzuba oobo alimwi a mansiku woonse aayo. Eechi nchenchicho nchibabuzya, ''Alakwe Sawulo uli aakati kabasinsimi na?''
Mpawo Davida wachija kuzwa kuNayoti muRama akusika  alimwi wakati kuli Jonatani, Ndakachitanzi? Ndamulandunzi? Ndachibiinzi kunembo lyawuso, kuti ulokuyandula kubweza buumi bwangu?"
Jonatani wakati kuli Deviti. ' bakul anzizyo ;  tukofwa pe . Taata tachiti chimwi  nikuba chipati na chinini katambide kuti ndime . Nkambonzi nanga taata ulalisisa chintu kuzwa kulindime?

Pesi Deviti wakakonka atwabili kawambula kuti, ''Wuuso wako uzi kabotu loko kuti ndijenu luse kubusyu bwako.Wamba kuti ; naziziba pe Jonatani ezi, mbunga uyowusa loko ! Pesi mbuli Jehova mbalimuumi chonzyo, anduwe mbuli muumi ; kulibiyo pesi intamo imwi akati kangu alufu.''
Mpawo Jotani wakati kuli deviti, ''Kufumbwa nchowamba ndiyokuchitila nchicho"
Deviti wakati kuli jonatani, junza ulakkala mweezi, alimwi neyokkala ansi akulya amwi amwami.Pesi leka mebo njinke, kuchitila kuti nkaliyubike lwangu mumuunda kusikila kumazuba atatu angolezya.
Kuti wuso wandibula kwalyonse, mpawo wambe kuti, Deviti inchozyo wakumbila kwiinka kulindime kuti ndelede kwinka ku Bbetelehemu kuchisi chakwe; nkambo waba munyaka wakuyopayila okokwaluzubobo lonse.'
Kuti wamba wati, 'Nkubotu,' mulanda wako ajane lumuno. Pesi kuti wabukilwa lunyemo, mpawo ziba kuti walisalila bubi.

Aboobo weelede kundeetelela nemulanda wako. Nkaambo wakeeta mulanda wako muchizuminano cha Jehova anduwe. Pesi kuti kakuli chibi mulindime, ndijaye mebo lwako; nkaambo nkaambonzi noyondeeta kuli wuso?''
Jonatani wakati, ''Ngazibe kule kuzwa kulinduwe! Na ndaziba kuti taata wangu wayeeya bubi kuti busike aatala anduwe, kujana ndaleka kukwaambila na?''
Mpawo Devidi wakaambila Jonatani, "Ngwani utazondibuzye kuti kwaba mweenya wawuso zyanooli wasandula chabukali?"
Jonatani wakaambila Devidi kuti, "Kuza, tweendekumuunda."Awo mububili bwabo bakeenda kumuunda.

Jonatani wakati kuli Devidi, "Jehova, Leza waIsilayeli, abe kamboni. Kuchiindi nindalokuzibisya kuli taata muchiindi nchicheechi juunza, naakuzuba lyatatu. Bona, kuti kakuli bubotu kuli Devidi, saa nsikoyokutumizya mpawo alimwi akuzibwa kulinduwe?
Kuti zyakubotezya taata kukuchitila bubi, Jehova akachite Jonatani akwiindilide obo kuti tendakuzibya webo akukuchijisya kule, kwitila kuti uyinke chaluumuno. Jehova abe ayebo, mbuli mbaakali ataata.
Kuti kandichipona, tokonditondezya na chizuminano chakusyomeka kuliJehova, kuti kanditafwi?
Utakugonki pe chizuminano chalusyomo kuzwa kuluzubo lwesu mane kukabe kutamani - mazuba woonse chiindi Jehova nchayoogonka woonse umwi wabasinkondo nyina wa Devidi kuzwa kubusyu bwanyika."
Awo Jonatani wakachita chizuminanoaluzubo lwa Devidi akwaamba kuti, "Jehova ayande bupanduluzi kuluboko lwabasinkondonyina baDevidi."
Jonatani wakachiitila Devidi chikonke lwabili, nkaambo kaluyando ndwakalaaloanguwe, nkaambo wakalikumuyandisya muuya wakwe mwini.
Mpawo Jonatani wakati kulinguwe, "Juunza kukkala mweezi mupya. Uzoyanduulwa nkaambo chuno chako tachikonoli amuntu pe.
Chiindi wayokkala mazuba aatatu, ukaseluke chakufwambaana akusika kubusena nkoyoyubila lwako chiindi mulimu wanoli mujaanza, alimwi ukakkale aabbwe lya Ezeli.
Ndiyowaala tusumu tutatu kumbali aalyo, mbulikuti ndokuwaala chakusinizya.

Mpawo ndiyotuma mulombe muniiniakwaamba kutikulinguwe, "Yinka ukayandule tusumu.' Kuti ndati kumulombe muniini , "Langa, tuli kubbazu eeli lyako; ukatubweze ," mpawo uboole; nkaambo kunooli kulaangunukide kulinduwe alimwi kaatakwe bubi, mbuli Jehova mbwapona.

Pesi naa ndati kumulombe muniini, 'Langa, tusumu tusumu tuli kusule lyako, 'mpawo yinka ayako nzila, nkaambo Jehova wakuchijisya.

Aboobo Sawulo taakwe nchakaamba eelyo zuba, nkaambo wakayeya kuti, "Ngazyachitika chimwi chiindi kulinguwe. Taselede pe, kasimpe taselede."

Pesi mubuzuba bwabili, kuzwa kukukkala kwamweezi, chuunu chaDevidi kachitakwe uukkala. Sawulo wakati kuli Jonatani mwana mulombe wakwe, "Nkamboonzi mwana mulombe waJese katazide kukuzolya nekuba jilo naa sunu?"
Jonatani wakasandula Soolu kuti, "Nkasimpe Devidi wakakumbila mvumo kuzwa kuli ndime kuti aye kuBbetilehemu.

Jonatani wakasandula wisi Soolu , 'Nkamboonzi noyanda kubikwakulufu? Niinzi nchwakachita?"
Mpawo  Soolu wakamuwaala sumu kuti amujaye. Eelyo Jonatani wakaziba kuti wakalibambide kukubika Devidi kulufu.
Jonatani wakanyampuka kuzwakutafula kanyemede loko akutalya chakulya kubuzuba bwabili bwamweezi, nkaambo wisi wakamuusya nsoni.
Chifumo, Jonatani wakiinka anze mumunda kumabambe ngibakambilene aDevidi, alimwi amwana mulombe muniini wakalaawe.
Wakaambila mulombe muniini, "Chijaana ukabweze tusumu ntundawaala ." Nakachili kuchijana mwana mulombe, wakawaala kasumu kusule lwakwe.
Kuchiindi mwaalumi muniini naakasika kubusena oko tusumu Jonatani ntwakawalide, Jonatani wakiita mwaalumi muniini, alimwi wakati, "Teensi  naakalimusule lyako?"
Mpawo Jonatani wakiita mwaalumi muniini , "Fwambana, utiimikili pe!"
Eelyo mwaalumi munini waJonatani wakabunganisya tusumu akusika kumupati  wakwe. Pesi mwaalumi muniini taakwe nchakaziba. Chita Jonatani aDevidi mbikakaziba makani.

Mpawo Devidi wakanyampuka akweenda, alimwi Jonatani wakapiluka kudolopo.
Mpawo Davida wakasika ku Nobbi kuti abone Ahimeleki mupayizi. Ahimeleki wakasika akuswanana a Davida akukankama loko akwamba kulinguwe kuti, ''Nkambonzi nolawulikke alimwi takwe ngolawe pe?''

Davida wakati kuli Ahimeleki mupayizi, ''Mwami wandituma mumulimu akwamba kuti kuli ndime, 'Kutabi naba omwe uziba makani ngendakutumina, alimwi kufumbwa nzendakulayilila webo. 'Ndananizya umwi mwalumi munini kubusena butedi.
Lino mpawo ninzi ncholacho mujanza? Kondipa zinkwa zilimusanu, naa kufumbwa chilaano.''
Mupayizi wakasandula Davida akwamba kuti, ''Tandikwe zinkwa ziligwa abantu biyo mujanza, pesi zisalala-kuti balombe balizibambide lwabo kuzwa kubanakazi.''

Davida wakasandula mupayizi, 'Nkasimpe banakazi bakalibambidwe kuzwa kulindiswe kwamazuba aatatu, mbuli mazuba woonse kuchindi nchindakanyampuka. Izinatu zyabalombe mbuzibambidwe nikuba kuti ndweendo lwabantu biyo. Nzyiingi buti sunu kuleezyo zilaakati kabo!''

Elyo mupayizi wakamupa zinkwa zisalazigilwe. Nkambo kakutakwe zinkwa oko kunze kwazinkwa zyabuliwo, ezyo zyakagwisigilwe kuzwa kunembo lya Jehova, kuti kubikwe zinkwa zipya abusena bwazyo mubuzuba mbuzyakabwezedwe.
Lino umwi wabalanda ba Sawulu wakaliwo buzuba oobo, wakalikasigilwe kunembo lya Jehova. Izina lyakwe kali Dayegi mu Edomayiti, kali singuzu akkati kabasilutwe ba Sawulu.
Davida wakati kuli Ahimeleki, ''Lino takwe na mujanza nikuba sumu nanka kafulo? Nkambo nsyelede nikuba fulo nekuba chichilivwisyo changu, nkawamba mulimu wamwami wakaba wakufwambana.''

Mupayizi wakati, ''Ifulo lyaGoliyati mu Filisiti, oyo ngwakajaya mumumpata wa Ela, mpulili ano lililambidwe amulembo kusule lyachizwato chamupayizi. Kuti koyanda kubweza elyo, bweza ndilyo, nkambo takwe chimwi chilwanisyo ano.'' Davida wakati, ''Takwe limbi ifulo likozyenie alelyo; amundipe.''
Davida wakanyampuka akuchija elyo zuba kuzwa kuli Sawulu alimwi wakinka ku Akkisi, mwami waku Gati.

Balanda ba Akkisi bakati kulinguwe, ''Oyu tengu Davida na, mwami wanyika? Tensi nguwe ngobakali kwiimba kulumwi awumwi atala anguwe kukuzyana, 'Sawulu wakajaya bakwe zyuulu, alimwi Davida wakajaya makumi azyuulu?''''
Davida wakabamba makani aya mumoyo alimwi wakayowesya loko a Akkisi, mwami wa Gati.
Wakachincha zichito zyakwe kunembo lyabo akulipenzya-penzya mumanza aabo; akulembula kumilyango yamakoma akuwisya inte zyakwe kwendelela kuchilezu.
Mpawo Akkisi wakati kubalanda bakwe, ''Mulange mwamubona mwalumi upengede. Nkambonzi nimwamweeta kuli ndime?
Ndibulide bapengede na, kukweeta oyu okuno akuchita mbuli umwi kubuliwo bwangu? Sa oyu muntu nchonzyo uyonjila mung'anda yangu?''
Aboobo Deviti wakazwa aawo wachijila kunkomwe ya Adulamu .Eelyo bakulana bakwe alimwi boonse ban'anda yawisi nibakanvwa, bakayinka ooko kulinguwe.

Woonse wakali mumawuse, woonse wakali muchikwelete, alimwi woonse wakatakutisikene-boonse bakabungana kulinguwe .Deviti wakaba silutwe wabo.Ooko bakali kukonzya kusika mnyaanda iine yabaalumi bakali aanguwe.
Mpawo Deviti wakeenda kuzwa aawo waya ku Mizipa mu Mowabbu. Wakati kumwalumi wa Mowabbu, '' ikaka leka taata wangu a baama bangu bayinke anze anduwe kusikila ndaziba kuti Leza uyoondichitilanzi''.
Wakabasiya amwaami waMowabbu.Taata wakwe abanyina bakakkala anguwe chiindi choonse aawo Deviti nakali muchiyubilo chakwe .
Mpawo musinsimi Gadi wakati kuli Deviti, '' utakkali muchiyubilo chako. Zwa alimwi wiinke munyika yaJuda'' Aboobo Deviti wakazwa aawo alimwi wayinka mulusaka lwa Heleti.

Sawulo wakanvwa kuti Devit waboneka, aantomwe  abaalumi bakali anguwe . Lino Sawulo wakakkede mu Gibbiya munsi lyamunsamu mutamalisi mu Lama, asumu lyakwe muluboko lwakwe, alimwi boonse balanda bakwe bakalimuzyungulukide kabayinvwi.

sawulo wakati kubalanda bakwe bakayinvwi kabamuzyungulukide, ''Muswilile lino, bantu  ba Bbenjamini! kujana mwana mulombe wa Jesse akape  umwi awumwi wenu muunda embaya zyamasaansa?kujana moonse wamuchita basilutwe bazyuulu abasilutwe bamyaanda,

mukuchinchaania moonse numulikubamba kundibukila?takwe nikuba umwi wenu undambila eelyo mwana wangu mulombe wachita chikonke amwana mulombe wa Jesse, takwe nikuba umwi  wenu undifwida insoni .Takwe nikuba umwi wenu undambila kuti mwana wangu mulombe wapempeka Deviti mulanda wangu kubukila ndime.''
Mpawo Dowegi mu Edomu, wakayinvwi abalanda ba sawulo, wakasandula, '' ndamubona mwana mulombe wa Jesse kaza ku Nobbu, kuli Animeleki mwana mulombe wa Ahitulo.
Wakomba kuli Jehova kuti amugwasye, alimwi wamupa zyakubelesya apanga lya Goliyati mufilisitiya''.
Mpawo mwaami wakatuma uumwi kukwiita mupayizi Ahimeleki mwana mulombe wa Ahitabbi alimwi aboonse ben'anda ya wisi wakwe, bapayizi bakali mu Nobu. Boonse bakaza ku mwaami.
Sawulo wakati, ''Swiilila lino, mwana  mulombe wa Ahitabbi.'' Wakasandula, ''Ndili aano, simalelo wangu.''

Sawulo wakati kulinguwe, ''Nkaambonzi niwabamba kundibukila, iwe amwana mulombe wa Jese, mukuti wamupa chibunge, alimwi a panga, alimwi wakomba kuli Jehova kuti amugwasye, kuchitila kuti andibukile, kuyuba mu chimpetu mbuli mbaachita sunu?''

Mpawo Ahimeleki wakasandula mwaami alimwi wati, ''Ngwani aakati kabalanda bako boonse uusyomekede mbuli Deviti, mukwaansa wa mwaami alimwi uli aajulu lya basikulinda bako, alimwi ulalemekwa mun'anda yako?

Sa sunu nchiindi chitanzi nchindakakomba kuli Leza kuti amugwasye? Ngazikabe kule andime! Utaleki mwaami ape mulandu ku mulanda wakwe na kun'anda yoonse ya taata wangu. Nkaambo mulanda wako takwe nchazi akaambo aaka koonse.''
Mwaami wakasandula, ''Nchobeni uyoofwa, Ahimeleki, iwe alimwi aboonse ban'anda ya wuso.''

Mwaami wakati kuli basikulinda bakayimvwi kabamuzyungulukide, ''Mukkone alimwi mujaye bapayizi ba Jehova. Akaambo kakuti nchintu zyabo zili aa Deviti, alimwi nkaambo balizi kuti wachija, pesi tebazibbusya pe kulindime.'' Pesi balanda ba mwaami tebakatandabika luboko lwabo ku kujaya bapayizi ba Jehova.

Mpawo mwaami wakati kuli Dowegi, ''Kkona alimwi ujaye bapayizi.'' Abbobo Dowegi mu Edomu wakakkona alimwi wabukila bapayizi; wakajaya bantu bali makkumi aali musanu aatatu ali amusanu aabo bakazweete bulukwe bwa bupayizi oobo buzuba.
Alubo wakajaya Nobu, chiisi cha bapayizi, boonse baalumi abanakazi, bana baniini a tunsabila, alimwi an'ombe zyabo, mbongolo ambelele, wakazijaya.
Pesi umwi wabana balombe ba Ahimeleki mwana mulombe wa Ahitubi, uutegwa Abbiyata, wakanzwenga alimwi watobela Deviti.
Abbiyata wakaambila Deviti kuti Sawulo wajaya bapayizi ba Jehova.
Deviti wakati kuli Abbiyata, ''Ndakaziba mubuzuba oobuya, eelyo Dowegi mu Edomu wakaliwo, kuti nchobeni uzowambila Sawulo. Ndilibalidwe ku lufu loonse kumpuli ya wuso!
Kkala ambebo alimwi utayowi. Akaambo kakuti ooyo uuyanduula buumi bwako ulayanduula bwangu alubo. Uyoobambikana andime.''
Bakaambila Deviti, ''Langa, ba Filisitiya balikulwana a Keyila alimwi balikubabbida mbuwa.''

Aboobo Deviti wakakomba kuli Jehova kayanda lugwasyo alimwiwakamubuzya, ''Ndiinke na alimwi ndikalwane ba Filisitiya aaba?'' Jehova wakati kuli Deviti, ''Koya alimwi ukalwane ba Filisitiya alimwi uvune Keyila.''
Baalumi ba Deviti bakati kuli nguwe, ''Bona, twayowa omuno mu Juda. Kuyooba biyeni aawo nitutakayinke ku Keyila kukulwanisya impi zya ba Filisitiya?''
Mpawo Deviti wakakomba kuli Jehova kukumbila lugwasyo alubo. Jehova wakamusandula, ''Nyampuka, inka ku Keyila. Nkaambo ndiyokupa kuzunda aatala a ma Filisitiya.''
Deviti a baalumi bakwe bakiinka ku Keyila alimwi bakalwana a ba Filisitiya. Wakabinga n'ombe zyabo alimwi wakabawuma a lunyonyoono lupati. Aboobo Deviti wakavuna bantu ba mu Keyila.
Eelyo Abbiyata mwana mulombe wa Ahimeleki kali wachijila kuli Deviti ku Keyila, wakaza achizwato cha bupayizi mujanza lyakwe.
Sawulo wakaambilwa kuti Deviti wakali waya ku Keyila. Sawulo wakati, ''Leza wamupa mujanza lyangu. Nkaambo ulijalilidwe mukati akaambo kakuti wanjila muchisi chili amilyango almwi atubulo.''
Sawulo wakiita basilumamba bakwe boonse be nkondo, kuti bayinke ku Keyila, kuyoosinkilizya Deviti a baalumi bakwe.
Deviti wakalizi kuti Sawulo wakali kukanza bubi aatala anguwe. Wakati kuli Abbiyata mupayizi, ''Eta ookuno chizwato chabupayizi.''
Mpawo Deviti wakati, ''Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, mulanda wako nchobeni wamvwa kuti Sawulo ulayanda kuza ku Keyila, kuzoonyonyoona chisi nkaambo kangu.

Kujana baalumi ba ku Keyila bandipedekezya kujanza lyakwe? Kujana Sawulo uyoosika na , mbuli mulanda wako mbaamvwa? Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, ndakombelela, kaka ambila mulanda wako.'' Jehova wakati, ''Ulasika.''
Mpawo Deviti wakati, ''Kujana baalumi ba ku Keyila bandipedekezya ime abaalumi bangu mujanza lya Sawulo?'' Jehova wakati, ''Bayookupedekezya.''

Mpawo Deviti alimwi abaalumi bakwe, bakali kukonzya kusika myaanda musanu awumwi, bakanyampuka alimwi bakeenda kuzwa ku Keyila, alimwi bakeenda kuzwa ku busena abusena. Zhyakaambilwa Sawulo kuti Deviti wakaloboka kuzwa ku Keyila, alimwi wakaleka kumutobela.
Deviti wakakkala muzichijilo munkanda, munyika yazilundu munkanda ya Zifi. Sawulo wakalikumulanguula mazuba woonse, pesi Leza taakamupedekezya mujanza lyakwe pe.
Deviti wakabona kuti Sawulo wakazwida aanze kayanduula buumi bwakwe; lino Deviti wakali munkanda yaku Zifi ku Holesi.
Mpawo Jonatani,  mwana mulombe wa Sawulo, wakanyampuka alimwi wakayinka kuli Deviti ku Holesi, alimwi wakasimya kuboko kwakwe muli Leza.
Wakati kulinguwe, ''Utayowi. Nkaambo kuboko kwa Sawulo taata wangu takukoyookujata pe. Uyooba mwaami atala a Izilayeli, alimwi ndiyooba afwifwi anduwe. Sawulo taata wangu alakwe ulizi eechi.''
Bakachita chizuminano kunembo lya Jehova. Deviti wakachaala ku Holesi, alimwi Jonatani wakaya kumunzi.
Mpawo Zifitisi wakasika kuli Sawulo ku Gibbiya alimwi wakati, ''Deviti tayubide na aakati kesu muzichijilo ku Holesi, kuchilundu cha Hakila, chili ku musansa wa Jesimoni?
Lino selela, mwaami! Mbuli mukupekeezya kwako, selela! Chesu chimpanzi kunoli nkumupedekezya mukuboko kwa mwaami.''
Sawulo wakati, ''Ikaka mulongezegwe a Jehova. Nkaambo mwandifwida nsoni.
Mwiinke, mukabe aakasimpe loko. Mukayiye alimwi mukalanguule kuti busena bwakwe bwakuyubila bulaali alimwi kuti ngwani wakamubona nkukooko. Ndakazyakaambilwa kuti uchenjede loko.

Aboobo mulange, alimwi mwiiye masena woonse ooko nkwayuba. Mukaboole kulindime amakani aakasimpe, alimwi mpawo ndiyoobweda andinywe. Na kali munyika, ndiyomulanguula aakati kazyuulu zyoonse zya Juda.''
Mpawo bakanyampuka kuya ku Zifi kunembo lya Sawulo. Lino Deviti alimwi abaalumi bakwe bakali munkanda ya Mayoni, mu Alabba ku musansa wa Jesimoni.

Sawulo alimwi abaalumi bakwe bakayinka kuyoomulanguula. Pesi Deviti wakali wazibisigwa, aboobo wakeenda waselelela kuchilundu chamwaala alimwi wakakkala munkanda ya Mayoni. Eelyo Sawulo nakazimvwa, wakaanda Deviti munkanda ya Mayoni.

Sawulo wakeendela kubbazu imwi lya chilundu, alimwi Deviti a baalumi bakwe bakayobweendela uli limwi bbazu lya chilundu. Deviti wakeendesya kuti abe kule a Sawulo. Aawo Sawulo alimwi abaalumi bakwe nibakali kuzyungulukila Deviti alimwi a baalumi bakwe kuti bababweze,
mutumwa wakasika kuli Sawulo alimwi wakati, ''Mufwambane alimwi musike, nkaambo ba Filisitiya baza kuzolwanisya nyika.''
Aboobo Sawulo wakaboola kuzwa kukutobela Deviti alimwi wakaya kukulwana ba Filisitiya. Akaako busena oobo butegwa Bbwe lya Chiyubilo.
Deviti wakeenda kuzwa ooko alimwi wakakkala muzichijilo zya Engedi.
Eelyo Sawulo nakaboola kuzwa kukwaandila ba Filisitiya, wakaambilwa, ''Deviti uli munkanda ya Engedi.''
Mpawo Sawulo wakabweza baalumi basalidwe bali zyuulu zyotatwe kuzwa ku Izilayeli yoonse alimwi wakiinka kuyooyandula Deviti alimwi abaalumi bakwe ku Myaala ya Mpongo zyalusaka.
Wakasika kuzyaata zyambelele munzila, ooko kwakali nkomwe. Sawulo wakanjila mukati kuyoovumba mawulu akwe. Lino Deviti alimwi abaalumi bakwe bakalikkede kulekule musule munkomwe.

Baalumi ba Deviti bakati kulinguwe, ''Eli ndilyo zuba eelyo Jehova ndyakali kwaamba eelyo nakati kulinduwe, 'Ndiyokupa sinkondonyokwe mumaboko aako, kuti uchite kulinguwe mbuli mbulombozya.''' Mpawo Deviti wakanyampuka alimwi chuumunizi wayavulila kunembo alimwi wakanenga kulupimpito lwa chigogo cha Sawulo.
Kuzwa aawo moyo wa Deviti wakawuma nkaambo wakali wanenga kulupimpito lwa chigogo cha Sawulo.
Wakati kubaalumi bakwe, ''Ikaka Jehova ngakasye kuti ndichite chintu eechi kuli samalelo wangu, munanike wa Jehova, kubika luboko lwangu kumulwisya, nkemubone kali munanike wa Jehova.''
Aboobo Deviti wakakalalila baalumi bakwe amajwi aaya, alimwi takabazumizya pe kulwisya Sawulo. Sawulo wakanyampuka, wazwa munkomwe, alimwi wayinkilila kunembo alweendo lwakwe.

Musule, Deviti alakwe wakanyampuka, wazwa munkomwe, alimwi wakasompezya Sawulo: ''Simalelo wangu mwaami.'' Eelyo Sawulo nakalanga musule lyakwe, Deviti wakakotamina aansi abusyu bakwe alimwi wakamutondeezya kulemeka.
Deviti wakati kuli Sawulo, ''Nkaambonzi noswilizya ku baalumi aabo bati, '''Langa, Deviti uyandula kukunyonyoona?'

Sunu menso ako abona oobo Jehova mbwakubika mumaboko angu eelyo nitwali munkomwe. Bamwi bali bandaambila kuti ndikujaye, pesi ndakuleka. Ndati, 'Nsikoobika luboko lwangu kukulwisya Simalelo wangu; nkaambo munanike wa Jehova.'

Langa, taata wangu, lupimpito lwa chigogo chako muluboko lwangu. Akaambo kanchoonzyo lyakuti ndanega lupimpito lwa chigogo chako alimwi tandikujayide pe, weelede kuziba alimwi ubone kuti takwe bubi na bujayi muluboko lwangu, alimwi takwe nchindakubisizya pe, nikuba uvwima buumi bwangu kuti ububweze.
Ikaka Jehova ngatonge aakati kako a ndime, alimwi ikaka Jehova ngandibwedezezye kuli nduwe, pesi luboko lwangu talukokulwisya pe.
Mbuli kasimpe kachiindi kati, 'Kuzwa ku mubi kuzwa zya bubi.' Pesi luboko lwang talukokulwisya pe.
Nguni ooyo mwaami wa Izilayeli ngwazida? Nguni ooyo ngoyobutobelela? Kutobela munkala ufwide! Kutobela kantantabwa!
Ikaka Jehova ngabe mubetesi alimwi ape lubeta aakati kako a ndime, alimwi bona kuti, alimwi amvwe mafwabi aangu alimwi andizumizye ndifutuke kuluboko lwako.''
Eelyo Deviti nakamana kwaambula majwi aaya kuli Sawulo, Sawulo wakati, ''Eeli ndijwi lyako na, mwanaangu mulombe Deviti?'' Sawulo wakanyampula ijwi lyakwe alimwi wakalila.
Wakati kuli Deviti, ''Uliluleme loko kwiinda mbundibede. Nkaambo wiindulula kundiliya abubotu, aawo mpundiindulula kukuliya abubi.
Waamba sunu mbuli mbuwachita bubotu kuli ndime, nkaambo tewandijaya pe eelyo Jehova nali wandibika muluzyalo lwako.
Nkaambo na muntu wajana sinkondonyina, kujana ulamuleka na ayende kalondokene? Ikaka Jehova ngakulumbule abubotu akaambo kanziwachita kuli ndime sunu.
Lino, ndaziba kuti simpe uzooba mwaami alimwi kuti bwaami bwa Izilayeli buyookomena mu luboko lwako.
Konkezya kuli ndime a Jehova kuti tokoyoodunsula lunyungu lwangu musule lyangu alimwi kuti tokozoomwaya zina lyangu kuzwa kun'anda ya taata.''
Aboobo Deviti wakachita chikonke kuli Sawulo. Mpawo Sawulo wakaya ku munzi, pesi Deviti alimwi a baalumi bakwe bakaya ku chiyubilo.
Lino Samiyele wakafwa. Ba Izilayeli boonse bakabungana antoomwe akumomooka, akumuzikka mung'anda yakwe ku Lama. Mpawo Davida wakabuka alimwi wakinka wakunukila kunkada yaku Palani.

Kwakali muntu umwi ku Mayoni, wakali ambono zyakali ku Kkamelu. Oyu mwalumi wakavubide loko. Wakalijisi mbelele zili zyuulu zyotatwe ampongo zili chuulu chomwe. Wakali kugela mbelele zyakwe muKkamelu.

Izina lyamwalumi oyu wakali kutegwa nguNabbalu, alimwi izina lyamwanakazi wakwe wakali Abbigeyili. Imwanakazi wakwe wakali musongo alimwi kali mubotu kuchiwa chakwe. Pele mwalumi wakwe kalimukkali amilimu yakwe kili mibi. Wakali wamukowa wwang'anda ya Kkalebbu.
Davida nakali munkanda wakamvwa kuti Nabbalu ulimukugela mbelele zyakwe.
Eelyo Davida wakatuma balombe balikkumi. Davida wakambila balombe kuti, ''Kamuya ku Kkamelu, kamwinka kuli Nabbalu, mukamujuzye muzina lyangu.
Mukaambe kuti kulinguwe, 'Kopona mukuzwidilila. Lumuno kuli nduwe alimwi lumuno kung'anda yako, alimwi lumuno alube kuli zyoonse nzyojisi.
Ndamvwa kuti ulijisi basikugela. Beembeli bako bakali andiswe, nkabela tetwakababisizya pe, alimwi kaatakwe nchibakaswekelwa chiindi choonse nibakali muKkamelu.

Buzya balombe bako, elyo balakwambila. Lino balombe bangu bafwide luzyalo mumenso aako, nkambo twasika mubuzuba bwapobwe. Ikaaka kopa kufumbwa chintu nchojisi mujanza kubalanda bako akumwana mulombe wako Davida.''
Eelyo balombe ba Davida nibakasika, bakamwambila majwi woonse Nabbalu muchibaka cha Davida elyo bakalindila.
Nabbalu wakavwiila balanda ba Davida, ngwani Davida, amwana mulombe wa Jese ngongwani? Bavula balanda sunu baloboka kuzwa kuli basimalelo babo.
Sa mbweze insima yangu amanzi aangu anyama yangu njindajiila basikugela bangu akupa bantu mbentezi ankubazwa?''
Mpawo balanda ba Davida bakabweeda munzila yabo akuyosika, elyo bakamwambila zyoonse zyakaambwa.
Davida wakambila bantu bakwe kuti, ''Mwalumi woonse alyaange ipanga lyakwe. Myaanda yoone yabalumi bakatobela musule lya Davida, myaanda yobile yakasyala kilinda zintu zyabo.
Pele umwi mulombe wakambila Abbigeyili kuti, muka Nabbali; wakati, ''Davida watumide batumwa kuzwa kunkanda kuzojuzya simalelo wesu, pele wakabasampawula.
Pesi bantu aba bakali babotu loko kulindiswe. Tetwakakatazigwa alimwi tetwakabula chintu kufumbwa nitwakali kwendaabomumyuunda.
Bakatubeda bulambo isikati lyoonse amansiku, chiindi choonse nitwakali ambabo mukwembela imbelele.
Nkiinkako koziba mboyelede kuchita, nkambo mwami wesu ulikkanzilidwe bubi, abasing'anda bakwe boonse. Muntu ngumutakonzyi kwambila niliba lyoomwe.''

Mpawo Abbigayeli wakafwambana wabweza zinkwa zili myaanda yobile, minkuli yobile yambote, mbelele zilimusanu zyakabambidwe kale, ansuwo zilimusanu zyamusozya, amwanda wamitunge yamasansa ayanikidwe, azibunge zyankuuyu zili myaanda yobile, elyo wakazibika amadonki.
Wakambila abalombe bakwe kuti, ''Kamuya kunembo lyangu, elyo ndatobela musule lyanu.'' Pele takwe nakambila mulumi wakwe Nabbalu.
Nakachili kweenda andonki yakwe akuyabuseluka kuzwa kubusena busisidwe bwakuchilundu, Davida abantu bakwe bakaseluka kuli nguwe kuzomuswanizya, elyo wakaswanana aabo.

Lino Davida wakambide kuti, ''Nkasimpe ndasowa biyo chiindi changu kukulangula zyoonse nzyajisi muntu oyo munkanda, aboobo katakwe chintu nichiba chomwe mulizyonse zyakali zyakwe chakabulika, pele wandibwedezezya bubi mubusena bwabubotu.
Leza andichitile oobo, Davida, amuchitile chakwiindilila, naa ndamusiila mwana ng'ombe naba womwe kusikila kubuchedo.''
Lino Abbigeyili nakabona Davida, wakafwambana kuseluka kuzwa kundonki yakwe walala aansi kunembo lya Davida akukotamika busyu bwakwe aansi akumufugamina.
Wakalala kumawulu aakwe wamwambila kuti, ''Ube alindime, simalelo wangu, ubemulandu. Akaka zumizya mulanda wako kuti awambule kuli nduwe, alimwi uswilizye kumajwi amulanda wako.

Kutabi kuti simalelo atabikki moyo wakwe kuliyoyu muntu mubi, Nabbalu, nkambo uli mbubonya mbuli zina lyakwe, mbubonya obo mbwabede. Nabbalu ndyezina lyakwe, alimwi bufubafuba buli alinguwe. Pele mebo ndemulanda wako tendakababona pe balombe basimalelo wangu, abo mbiwakatumide.

Mpawo lino, simalelo wangu, mbuli Jehova mbwapona, alimwi mbuli mbopona, mbokunga Jehova wakukasya kukutila bulowa, alimwi akuzobwedezya lwako omwini ajanza lyako, linobu basinkondonyokwe ababo boonse bayanduula kuchita bubi kuli simalelo wangu, ngababe mbuli Nabbalu.
Lino echi chipo nchindaleta ndemulanda wako kuli simalelo wangu chipegwe aabo batobela mwami wangu.

Ikaaka kolekelela mulandu wamulanda wako, nkambo Jehova ulayakila simalelo wangu ing'anda iyimvwi njii, nkambo simalelo wangu ulokulwana nkondo ya Jehova; eelyo bubi tabukoyojanwa muli nduwe kufumbwa wanopona.

Nikuba kuti bantu babuka akuyanduula kubweza buumi bwako; pele buumi bwasimalelo wangu buyowangwa muchimpusa chabawumi a Jehova Leza wako; alimwi buumi bwaba sinkondonyokwe, uyobusowa mbuli chintu chifusigwa ankwilipo.
Jehova nazochitila simalelo wangu zyoonse nzyaka kusyomezya, alimwi wakusala kuti ube muzuluzi waba Izilayeli.
Eechi tachikozooba buusu na mukuli kulinduwe--akambo kakutila bulowa butakwe mulandu, na nkaambo simalelangu wayanda kulilwanina. Awo Jehova nazochitila simalelangu bubotu, koyeeya mulanda wako.''
Davida wakambila Abbigeyili, ''Akube kuti Jehova, Leza waba Izilayeli, alongezegwe, oyo wakutuma kuti uzondiswanizye sunobu.
Busongo bwako buli longezezegwe alimwi ayebo ulilongezezegwe nkambo wandilondola lyasunu kuti nsikatili bulowa alimwi kuti nsikabwedezyi mulandu ilwangu amaanza angu!

Nkambo mukasimpe, mbuli Jehova, Leza waba Izilayeli, mbwapona, oyo wandibamba kuti nsikakunynyoni, adokuti kofwambana kuti uzondiswanizye, zyakasimpe takwepe naba omwe walikunosyala kuli Nabbalu nikuba wachalumi munini kuyosika chifumofumo.''
Elyo Davida wakatambula kuzwa kumaanza akwe ezyo nzyakamwetelede; wakati kuli nguwe ''Koya mulumuno kung'anda yako; bona, Ndatelela kumajwi aako alimwi ndakutambula.''

Abbigeyili nakabweda kuli Nabbalu; amubone, wakali epobwe mung'anda yakwe, mbuli pobwe lya mwami; alimwi moyo wa Nabbalu wakalikondeledwe mulinguwe, nkambo wakakoledwe loko. Aboobo takwepe anchakamubuzya kwalyonse manedo kwazoba kuseni izuba kalili lyazwa.
Nikwaba mafumina, awo imbote nakazwa kuli Nabbalu, mukayintu wakwe wakamwambila aayo makani; wakafwida mumoyo, mpawo wakaba mbuli bbwe.
Nikwakiinda mazuba alikkumi Jehova wakawuma Nabbalu mpawo wakafwa.

Mpawo Davida nakamvwa kuti Nabbalu wakafwa, wakati, ''Alumbwe Jehova, iwakabweza makani alusampawulo lwangu ndundakasampawulwa kuzwa kujanza lya Nabbalu alimwi wakandikasya ndemulanda wako-kuchita bubi. Wabwedezya bubi bwa Nabbalu amutwe wakwe.''
Elyo Davida wakatumina akwambila Abbigeyili, akumubweza kuba mwanakazi wakwe. Elyo balanda ba Davida nibakasika kuli Abbigeyili kuKkamelu, bakamwambila kuti aabe mukayintu wakwe.''
Wakabuka, wakotamika busyu bwakwe aansi, wakati, ''Bona mulanda musimbi wako mulanda wakusanzya mawulu abalanda basimalelangu.
Abbigeyili wakafwambana kunyampuka, watanta andonki abalanda basimbi bosanwe mbakali aabo bakamusindikila; nkabela wakatobela batumwa ba Davida elyo wakaba mukayintu wakwe.
Lino Davida wakabweza alimwi Ahinowamu waku Jezileli mbuli mwanakazi wakwe; muchibili chabo bonse bakaba banakazi bakwe.
Alakwe, Sawulo wakali wapeda Mikkalu mwanakwe musimbi, mwanakazi wa Davida, kuli Palutieyelu mwana mulombe wa Layisyi, oyo wakali waku Galimu.
Ba Zifi bakasika kuli Sawulu ku Gibbiya akuti, ''Tensi kuti Deviti uliyubide mukalundu ka Hakkila, kali musule lya Jeshimoni?''
Elyo Sawulo wakanyampuka akuselemukila kunkanda ya Zifi, kali azyuulu zitatu zyabantu basalidwe ba Izilayeli amwi anguwe, kukuyandula Deviti munkanda ya Zifi.
Sawulu wakakukkala kukalundu ka Hikkila, musule lya Jeshimoni, kumbali lyamugwagwa. Pesi Deviti wakali kukkala munkanda, mpawo wakabona kuti Sawulo ulokumuyandula munkanda.
Elyo Deviti wakatuma basikutweela akubona kuti nchobeni Sawulo uleza.

Deviti wakanyampuka akuya kubusena oko Sawulo nkwakakkede; wakabona busena oko Sawulo nkwakali koona, mpawo Abbina mwana mwalumi wa Neli, mupati wampii yakwe; Sawulo wakalala munkambe, mpawo bantu bakali muzyungulukide, boonse bakoona.

Elyo Deviti wakati kuli Ahimeleki mu Hiti, mpawo akuli Abbishayi mwana mulombe wa Zeluya, mukulana wa Jowabbu, ''Ngwani uyoseluka andime kuya kuli Sawulo kunkambe?'' Abbishayi wakati, ''Ndime! Ndilayinka ndiseluke anduwe.''
Elyo Deviti a Abbishayi bakayinka kumpi mansiku. Sawulo wakalimo uloona munkambe asumu lyakwe lilijimpikidwe aansi kumbali amutwe wakwe. Abbina abasilumamba bakwe bakalala chakumuzyunguluka.
Elyo Abbishayi wakati kuli Deviti, ''Sunu Leza wabikka basinkondonyokwe mumaboko aako. Lino wenche ngandimuyasikizye anyika kusumu amfuso yomwe. Nsikomuyasa akachibili.''
Deviti wakati kuli Abbishayi, ''Utamujayi; kufumbwa utandabika ijanza lyakwe kubananike ba Jehova uli batajisi mulandu?''
Deviti wakati, ''Mbuli Jehova mbwapona, Jehova ulamuyeya, nakuti izuba lyakwe lilaza kukufwa, nakuti kuya kunkondo akuyofwa,
Akube kuti Jehova akasye kutandabika janza lyangu abananike bakwe; pesi lino, ndakukumbila, bweza sunu lilimujanza akwe amunkuli wamanzi, akutuleka kuti tuyinke.''

Elyo Deviti wakabweza sumu amunkuli wamanzi kuzwa amutwe wa Sawulo, mpawo bakanjila inzila. Takwe naba umwi wakababona nikuba kuziba atala azezi, nikuba wakasinsimuka, nkambo boonse bakalikoona, akambo kakuti ng'onzi mpati kuzwa kuli Jehova zyakawida alimbabo.
Lino Deviti wakayinka kulilimwi bbazu akuyoyimikila atala achilundu kule-kule; kakuli m usinzo mupati akati kabo.
Deviti wakoompolola kubantu akuli Abbina mwana mulombe wa Neli; wakati, ''Tewavwila, Abbina?'' Mpawo Abbina wakavwiila wati, ''Nduweni nuwompolola kumwami?''
Deviti wakati kuli Abbina, ''Sa toli mwalumi uzumenene ? Ngwani ulimbuli nduwe mu Izilayeli? Nkambonzi lino niwatalanga biyo simalelo wako mwami? Nkambo ulanjila akujaya mwami simalelo wako.

Elyo chintu nchiwachita tachili chibotu kufumbwa Jehova kachipona, uyelede kufwa nkambo tewayinkilila anembo pe kulanga simalelo wako, munanike wa Jehova. Lino bona nkulibede sumu lyamwami amunkuli wamanzi zyali afwifwi amutwe wakwe!''
Sawulu wakaziba ijwi lya Deviti wakati, ''Ndijwi lyako na mwanangu Deviti?'' Deviti wakati, ''Nijwi lyangu, mwami, simalelowangu.''
Wakati, ''Nkambonzi simalelo wangu ulanditobelela? Ndachitaanzi?  Nchibinzi chili mumanza angu?

Lino nkinkaako, ndakukumbila, akube kuti simalelo wangu mwami wangu aswilizye kumajwi amulanda wakwe. Naa ngu Jehova wakubusya kuzondilwisya, ngatambule chipayizyo; pesi na mbantu biyo, ngabatukwe kumenso a Jehova, nkambo sunu banditandila anze, kutegwa nkitajatilili kuchaabilo cha Jehova; baamba kuti kuli ndime, 'Kuya akukomba bamwi baleza.'
Lino nkinkaako, utaleki iganzi lyangu kuwida anyika kule kuzwa kubuliwo bwa Jehova; nkambo mwami wa Izilayeli waza kuzoyandula kanini mbuli umwi uvwima kwale mumalundu.''
Elyo Sawulo wakati, 'Ndabisya. Boola, Deviti, mwanangu; nkambo nsichikakubisizyi limbi, nkambo buumi bwangu bwalikuyandika mumenso ako sunu. Bona, ndachita chiteelede akufubaala kapati.''
Deviti wakavwiila wakati, ''Bona, sumu lyako lili aano, mwami! Chita kuti umwi wabachikula bako aze azobweze akulyeeta kulinduwe.
Akube kuti Jehova ape mpindu kuli umwi mwalumi nkambo kabululami bwakwe akusyomeka kwakwe; nkambo Jehova wakabikka mukuboko kwangu sunu, pesi tandikwe nindabisizya munanike wakwe pe.
Bona, mbuli mbubwalikuyandika buumi bwako mumeso angu sunu, nkambo kaboobo buumi bwangu abuyandike kapati mumenso a Jehova, akuti andivune kumapenzi wonse.''
Elyo Sawulo wakati kuli Deviti, ''Ulongezegwe, Deviti mwanangu ! Kuchita ulachita zintu zipati akuyozwidilila muli nzizyo.'' Elyo Deviti wakayinka, mpawo Sawulo wakabweeda kubusena bwakwe.

David wakati mumoyo wakwe, ''Lino ndiyomana limwi zuba akuboko kwa Sawulu; takwe chibotu kulindime kwinda kuti ndiyube mubusena bwaba Filisitiya; Sawulo wakatakata kundiyandawula lubo mukati kamigaano ya Izilayeli; muli eyinzila ndilasupuka kuzwa mukuboko kwakwe.''
Deviti wakabuka akwiinda awo, welwakwe abantu bali myanda musanu awumwi abobakali anguwe, kuya kuli Achishi mwana wa Mooko, mwaami waku Gati.
Deviti wakakukkala a Chishi ku Gati, welwakwe abantu bakwe, awumwi mwalumi ampuli yakwe, alimwi Deviti abanakazi bakwe bobile, Ahinomu mwanakazi mu Jezilelayiti, mwanakazi wa Nabbale.
Sowulu wakaambilwa kuti Deviti wachijila ku Gati, nkinkako takachili kumuyanduula lubo.

Deviti wakati kuli Achishi, ''Kuti ndajana nsoni mumenso aako, leka bandipe busena muli limwi dolopo munyika, oko nkundikonzya kuyokkala. Nkaambonzi mubelesi wako nayelede kukkala mudolopo lya bwami anduwe.
Nkiinkako obo buzuba Achishi wakamupa Zikkilagi; nchichakachita kuti Zikkilagi abe wabaami baku Juda ambulisunu obuno.
Mweelwe wamazuba ayo Deviti ngakakkala mubusena bwaba Filisitiya wakali munyaka uzwide amyeezi yone.

Deviti abantu bakwe bakalwana masena miingi, kababunga ba Jeshulayiti, ba Gizayiti, aba Amalayiti, nkambo misyobo eyi njiyakakkede mubusena kuti koya ku Shula, mubulamfu bwabusena bwa Ijiputi. Kwakali kukkala mumomu mubusena kuzwa kuchindi chansiku.
Deviti wakalwana busena alimwi takasiya mwalumi nam mwanakazi kapona. Wakabweza imbelele ang'ombe, amadonki, makkamela, azyakusama. Mpawo wakaboola alimwi wabweda ku Achishi.

Achishi wakali kukonzya kwamba kuti, ''Ngwani nguwakalwana akubunga sunu ?'' Deviti wakasandula kuti, ''Abakunsi lya Juda,'' kanakuti ''Abakunsi lya Jelamelitisi,'' kanakuti ''Abakunsi lyaku Kkenayitisi.''

Deviti takalikuleka mwalumi nibaba banakazi bawumbulu kuti abete ku Gata, kawamba kuti, ''Kuchitila kuti tabakonzyi kutwaanga, 'Deviti wakachita obu abobu.'' Ezi nzyakachita chindi chonse nchakapona kunyika yaba Filisitiya.
Achishi wakali kumusyoma Deviti, kawambakuti, ''Wachita kuti bantu bakwe ba Izilayeli bamulemeke loko; nkinkaako uyoba mubelesi wangu kwalyonse.''

Izyakachitika mulayo mazuba kuti ba Filisitina bakabungania basilumamba babo antomwe kubambila nkondo kukulwana a Izilayeli. Achishi wakati kuli Deviti, ''Ziba chanchoonzyo kuti uzoinka aanze andime mulumamba, iwe abantu bako.''
Deviti wakati kuli Achishi, ''Kuti ako nkikaambo, uyoziba echo mubelesi wako nchakonzya kuchita.'' Achishi wakati kuli Deviti, ''''Nkokuti ndiyokuchita lumamba lundilinda kwamazuba ako woonse.''
Lino Samiyele wakali wafwa, alimwi kwalyonse Izilayeli yakali yamuseka akumuvwika mu Lama, mudolopo lyakwe mwini. Alimwi, Sawulo wakali wajalisya mubusena obo kaambuula abafwide nakuti amyuuya.
Mpawo ba Filisitina bakalibungania antomwe akuza kukukkala ku Shunemu; alimwi Sawulo wakabungania ba Izilayeli antomwe, alimwi baakukkala ku Gilubboya.
Awo Sawulo nakabona lumamba lwaba Filisitina, alimwi moyo wakwe wakazazama loko.
Sawulo wakakombela lugwasyo kuli Jehova, pesi Jehova takwe nakamusandula pe - nikuba kumaloto, na kukusonda, na kubasinsimi.

Mpawo Sawulo wakati kubabelesi bakwe, ''mundiyandwide mwanakazi uwambula abafwide, kuchitila kuti ndiinke kulinguwe kukulayilwa.'' Babelesi bakwe bakati kuli nguwe, ''Bona, kuli mwanakazi mu Endoli ulyaamba kwambual abafwide.''

Nkiinkako Sawulo wakalifungula, wazwaata zimbi zizwato akwenda; lwakwe abalumi bobile mbakali abo. Bakayinka kumwanakazi oyo mansiku. Wakati, ''Ndimunikile a muuya alimwi undeetele ooyo ngundaamba izina.''
Mwanakazi wakati kuli - nguwe, ''Bona, ulizi Sawulo nzyakachita, mbakajalisya mubusena aabo bambuula abafwide kana myuuya. Nkiinkako nkamboonzi noteya kakole kabuumi bwangu, kuti undijazye ?''
Sawulo wakakonkezya Jehova kuli nguwe akwamba kuti, ''mbuli Jehova mbwapona, takwe chisubulo chitakachitike kuli nduwe akaambo kacheechi chintu.''
Mpawo mwanakazi wakati, ''Ngwani ngwesikubusizye ?'' Sawulo wakati, ''Ndibusizye Samiyele.''
Aawo mwanakazi ndakabona Samiyele, wakalila ajwi pati akwambula a Sawulo, kaamba kuti, ''Nkambonzi niwandeena? Nkaambo nduwe Sawulo?''
Mwaami wakati kuli nguwe, ''Utayowi. Niinzi nchiwabona ?'' Mwanakazi wakati kuli Sawulo, ''Ndabona kaleza kali kuza kuzwa munyika.''
Wakati kuli nguwe, ''Uboneka mbuliinzi ? Wakati, ''Munene uyobuza; uzwete igubo.'' Sawulo wakayeyela kuti ngu Samiyele, alimwi wakakotama abusya bwakwe aansi akumutondezya kulemeka.

Samiyele wakati kuli Sawulo, ''Nkambonzi niwandichelezya akundeeta ajulu?'' Sawulo wakasandula, ''Ndatyompwa loko, mukuti ba Filisitina bali kubambila inkondo andime, alimwi Leza wandisisya alimwi tachindisanduli lubo, nikuba kubasinsimi, kana kumaloto. Nkinkako ndayita nduwe, kuti undizibisye nzyesichite.''
Samiyele wakati, ''Niinzi mpo nzondikumbila, kuzwa mukuti Jehova wakusiya, alimwi waba sinkondonyokwe ?''
Jehova wachita kuli nduwe nzyaakamba kuti ulachita. Jehova wadelula bwaami kuzwa mujaanza lyako alimwi watupa umwi muntu uumbi - kuli Deviti.
Nkambo tewalemeka ijwi lya Yahuwe alimwi tewachita bukali bwakwe buyoosya aali Amaleki, nchaachita obu sunu kuli nduwe.
Jehova uyoopa basilumamba ba Izilayeli kuswanizya anduwe mujaanza lyaba Filisitina.''

Awo mpawawo Sawulo wakawa mubulamfu bwakwe boonse aansi alimwi wakayoowa loko nkambo kamajwi a Samiyele. Temwakachili nguzu pe muli nguwe, nkambo takwe nchakalyide pe izuba lyoonse, nikuba busiku boonse obo.

Mwanakazi wakaza kuli Sawulo akubona kuti wakali wapeengana loko, wakati kuli nguwe, ''Bona, mubelesi wako mwanakazi waswilizya ijwi lyako; ndabika buumi bwangu mujaanza lyangu alimwi ndaswilizya majwi ngiwandaambila.

Nkiinkako lino obu, ndakukumbila, swilizya alimwi kujwi lyamubelesi wako mwanakazi, alimwi leka ndibike kulya kuche biyo kunembo lyako. Lyaa kuchitila kuti ujane nguzu zyakweenda musinzo wako.'' Pesi Sawulo wakakkaka akwamba kuti, ''Nsikoolya pe.''
Pesi babelesi bakwe, antoomwe amwanakazi ooyo, bakamukombelezya, alimwi wakaswilizya kujwi lyabo. Aboobo wakabuka kuzwa aansi alimwi wakakkala aabulo.
Imwanakazi wakali achana chang'ombe chakanenede mubbondo; wakafwambana alimwi wakuchijaya; wakabweza busubunante, wabukanda, alimwi wakajika chibunge chabuumi ambubo.
Wakacheeta chibunge kunembo lya Sawulo ababelesi bakwe, alimwi bakalya. Aawo bakanyampuka akweenda busiku oobo.
Lino ba Filisitiya bakabungania boonse basinkondo babo ku Afeki, alimwi Izilayeli wakayaka musasa kumbali lya kasensa kali mu Jezileli.
Bana balombe ba baami ba ba Filisitiya bakayobweenda mumyaanda alimwi a muzyuulu; Deeeviti alimwi a baalumi bakwe bakeenda muchikkwabilizyo chamusule cha Achisi.

Mpawo bana balombe ba ba Filisitiya bakati, ''Nchizi aaba ba Hebbulu nchibachita aawa?'' Acisi wakati kulibamwi bana balombe ba baami ba ba Filisitiya, ''Te nguwe na ooyu Deviti, mulanda wa Sawulo, mwaaami wa ba Izilayeli, ooyo wali andime aaya mazuba, na kuti eeyi minyaka, alimwi takwe nindajana kampenda pe alinguwe kuzwa nakasika kusika obuno buzuba?''

Pesi bana balmbe ba baami ba ba Filisitiya bakamunyemena alimwi bakati, ''Muboozye ooyo muntu, kuti abweede kubusena mbwakamupa. Takooyinka andiswe pe kunkondo nkaambo uyotupandukila muchiindi chakulwana. Nkaambo mbubuli bumwi mbanga ulachita kuti atambulike kuli simalelo wakwe kutali kuti abweze mitwe yabantu besu?
Ooyu te Deviti na ngubakayimba umwi kuli umwi mukuzyana, nkabati, 'Sawulo wajaya bakwe bali zyuulu,alimwi Devit bali zyuulu zilikkumi'?''

Mpawo Achisi wakiita Deviti  alimwi wakati kulinguwe, '''Mbuli Jehova mbwapona, iwebo waliluleme, alimwi kwiinka kwako alimwi akuboola kwako andime munkondo nkubotu mukubona kwangu; nkaambo kakuti takwe nindajana bubi kulinduwe kuzwa buzuba bwakusika kwako kulindime kusika buzuba oobuno. Nekubaboobo, bana balombe ba baami tabakuyandi pe webo.
Aboobo lino bweeda alimwi wiinke muluumuno, kuchitila kuti utanyemyi bana balombe ba baami ba ba Filisitiya.''

Deviti wakati kuli Achisi, ''Pesi ninzi nchindachita? Ninzi nchiwajana kumulanda wako kuzwa kuchiindi nchindakaba anduwe kusikila buzuba oobuno, kuti nsikonzyi kwiinka akuyoolwana basinkondonyina ba simalelo wangu mwaami?''

Achisi wakasandula alimwi wakati kuli Deviti, ''Ndilizi kuti tokwe kampenda pe mukulanga kwangu mbuli mungelo wa Leza; nikubaboobo, bana balombe ba baami ba ba Filisitiya bakati, 'Tayelede pe kwiinka andiswe kunkondo.'
Aboobo lino buka chifumofumo abalanda ba simalelo wako bakaza aanduwe; chakufwambana nimwabuka chifumofumo alimwi mwaba aamumuni, mweende.''
Aboobo Deviti wakabuka chifumo, wenya alimwi abaalum bakwe, kuti beende chifumo, kababweeda munyika ya ba Filisitiya. Pesi ba Filisitiya bakaya ku Jezileli.
Nichakaba boobo, Davida abantu bakwe bakasika ku Zikkilegi mubuzuba bwatatu, ba Ameleki nibakali kufumpa Negevi alimwi a Zikkilagi. Bakalwanisya Zikkilagi, bakawuumpa,
alimwi bakajata banakazi awoonse wakali muumo, kujatikizya banini abapati. Takwe ngubakajaya, pesi bakababweza binkaabo nkubakali kuya.
Awo Davida abantu bakwe nibakasika mudolopo lyakaliwumpidwe, alimwi banakazi babo, bana balombe babo, abana basimbi babo bakali batolwa mubuzike.
Elyo Davida abantu bakalanguwe bakoomoka akukwila mane basika mpobamana manguzu akukwiila.
Banakazi babili ba Davidi bakali toledwe, Ahinawomi mwanakazi mu Jezileti, a Abbigeli mwanakazi wa Nabbali mu Kkamelayiti.
Davidi wakali tyompedwe loko, nkambo bantu bakali kwambula akuti bonse bakali lutide mumoyo. Umwi awumwi nkambo kabana babo balombe abasimbi; pesi Devidi wakali yumya muli Jehova, Leza wakwe.
Davida wakati kuli Abbiyata mwana wa Ahimeleki, imupayizi, ''Ndakukumbila webo, undetele chizwato chabupayizi okuno.'' Abbiyata wakeeta chizwato chabupayizi kuli Davida.

Davida wakakomba kuli Jehova kuti atondezegwe inzila, kati, ''Naa ndatobela inkamu yabasilumamba ndiyobezya na?''  Jehova wakamusandula, ''Batobele, nkambo ulabezya biya alimwi chanchonzyo uyoboozya zyoonse.''
Elyo Davida wakayinka lwakwe abalumi bali myaanda musanu awumwi bakali anguwe, bakasika kukalonga ka Bbesa, oko abo bakasiidwe musule nkubakakkede.

Pele Davida wakinkilila kunembo kuyobutobela, welwakwe abalumi bali myaanda iine, nkambo bamwi bali miyanda iibili bakasyala kabakkede musule, abo bakali bakkatala zyakuti tebakachili kukonzya kwinda kukalonga ka Bbesa
Bakajana mu Ijiputi mumunda alimwi bakamweeta kuli Davida; bakamupa chibunge, alimwi wakalya, bakamupa manzi akunywa;
alimwi bakamupa kampanzi kachibunge chankuyu azikkata zibili zyamasansa. Naakamana kulya,wakaba amanguzu lubo, nkambo takwe nakalyide chibunge nikuba kunywa maanzi kwamazuba atatu amansiku atatu

Davida wakati kuli nguwe, ''Ulimuntu waani ? Alimwi uzwa kuli ?'' Wakati, ''Imebo ndimulombwana waku Ijiputi, mulanda wama Amalekki,  simalelo wangu wakandisiya mazuba atatu ayinda nkambo ndakachiswa.
Twakafumpa Negevi ya Kkeletiti, antomwe azya Juda, a Negevi ya Kkalebbu, alimwi twakateenta Zikkilegi.''

Davida wakati kulinguwe, ''Sa ulakonzya kundisisya nkwiibede inkamu yabasikutufumpa ?'' Mu Ijiputi wakati, ''Kkonka kulindime a Leza kuti tokozondijaya na chakundaaba mumaanza asimalelo wangu, elyo ndiyokusisya nkwiibede inkamu yabafumpi aba.''
Awo mu Ijiputi nakasisya Davida bafumpi bakali sanseene konse konse, kabali kulya akunywa alimwi kabali kuzyana nkambo kambono zyoonse nzibakabweza kunyika yama Filisiti akuzwa kunyika ya Juda.
Davida wakabalwisya kuzwa kumabbililo ezuba kuyosika mansiku ezuba lyakatobela. Takwe naba omwe wakachija ado balombe balimiyanda yone, abo bakagada inkamela alimwi akuchija.
Davida wakaboozya zyoonse nzibakatolede bama Amelekki; alimwi Davida wakavuna, banakazi bakwe babili.
Takwe pe chintu chakataliwo, nichiba chinini na chipati, nekuba bana balombe naa bana basimbi, nekuba lubono, naa kufumbwa chintu bafumpi nchibakatolede. Davida wakaziboozya zyoonse.
Davida wakatola mbelele zyoonse ang'ombe, ezyo balumi nzibakabinga kunembo azimwi zivuubwa. Bakati, ''Olu ndubono lwa Davida.''

Davida wakasika kubalumi bali miyanda yobile abo bakakkatede loko kumutobela, mbabo mbabo mbibakachita kuti bakkale akalonga ka Bbesa. Balumi aba bayinka kunembo kuyoswanana a Davida abantu bakali anguwe. Awo Davida nakasika kubantu aba, wakabajuzya.

Mpawo bantu babi abatakwe lugwasyo akati kabo bakayinkide a Davida bakati, ''Nkambo kakuti aba balumi tebakinkide aswebo, tatukoyobapa chintu, kulubono ndutwaka kubozya. Nikuba boobo, awumwi mwalumi ulakonzya kutola mwanakazi wakwe abana ayende.''
Mpawo Davida wakati, ''Tamwelede kuchita boobu, bakwesu achecho Jehova nchatupa. Watubamba alimwi waaba bafumpi mumaanza esu bakazide kukutulwisya.
Ngwani utamuswilizye kumakani aya ? Mbuli mbuchibede chabilo chayooyo uyinka kunkondo, chilelede kuba mbubo chaabilo chayoyo ulinda zintu; bala bilana chakwelana.''
Zili mbubo kuzwa zuba elyo kusika kuzuba lyasunu, nkambo Davida wakachichita mulawu achiyanza mu Izilayeli.
Awo Davidi nakasika ku Zikkilagi, wakatumizya zimwi mbono kubapati ba Juda, akubeenzinyina, kati, ''Amulange cheechi chipo chanu chizwa kumbono zyazwa kuli basinkonyina a Jehova.''
Alubo wakatumizya zimwi kubapati bakali mu Bbeteli akuli baabo bakali mu Lamoti yamusanza, akuli baabo bakali mu Jitili,
akuli baabo bakali mu Aloyeli, akuli baabo bakali mu Sitimoti, akuli baabo bakali mu Eshitemoya.
Alubo wakatumizya zimwi mbono kubapati bakali mu Lakkalu, alimwi akuli baabo bakali mumadolopo aku Jelamelitisi, alimwi akulibaabo bakali mumadolopo akuba Kkenitisi,
alimwi akuli baabo bakali mu Homa, akulibaabo bakali mu Bbo Ashani, alimwi akuli baabo bakali mu Atakki,
alimwi akulibaabo bakali mu Hebbuloni, akuli baabo boonse bakali mumasena Davida lwakwe mwini antomwe abantu bakwe nkubakali kukkala kabayinka.
Lino ba Filisitiya bakalwana a Izilayeli. Baalumi ba Izilayeli bakachija kuzwa kunembo lya ba Filisitiya alimwi bakawindaansi akufwa a  Chilundu cha Gilibowa.
Ba Filisitiya bakaswenenena nkabayobwaandila Sawulo abana bakwe balombe. Ba Filisitiya bakajaya Jonatani, Abinadabi, a Maliki-Suwa, bana bakwe balombe.
Inkondo yakaba ndemu  kuli Sawulo, alimwi basikuyasila midaantambwa bakamwiinda. Wakaba amachise mapati loko nkaambo kabo.

Alubo Sawulo wakambila  sikumubwezela chisamo chankondo, "Gwisya ipanga lyako undiyase andilyo , . Ambweni, aaba bakatapalulwa balasika akundijata bubi. "Pesi sikumubwezela chisamo chankondo takazichita pe, nkaambo wakayowa kapati. Aboobo Sawulo wakabweza ipanga lyakwe wasikuwida aatala aandilyo.
Eelyo sikumubwezela chisamo chankondo nakabona kuti Sawulo wafwa, wakawida aatala apanga lyakwe munzila ikozyene alimwi wakafwa anguwe.
Aboobo Sawulo wakafwa, bana bakwe balombe batatu, alimwi asikumubwezela chisamo  chankondo - boonse aaba baalumi bakafwa antomwe mubuzuba oobo bomwe.

Eelyo baalumi ba Izilayeli abo bakali kubbazu eeliya lyamusena, ababo bakali mutala a Jodani, nibakabona kuti baalumi ba Izilayeli bachija, alimwi kuti Sawulo abana bakwe balombe bafwa, bakasiya zisi zyabo bachija, alimwi ba Flisitiya bakasika akukkala mulinzizyo.
Zyakachitika muzuba litobela, eelyo ba Filisitiya nibakasika kukugwisya bafwide, kuti bakajana Sawulo abana bakwe balombe kabafwide a Chilundu cha Gilibowa.
Bakakosola mutwe wakwe akumugwisya zisamo zyakwe zyankondo, bakatuma batumwa kunjila munyika ya ba Filisitiya yoonse kuyoosisya makani kumatempele azikozyano zyabo alimwi akubantu.
Bakabika chisamo chakwe chakunkondo  mutempele yaku Asitoletisi, alimwi bakaangilila mutunta wakwe  kubulambo bwachisi cha Beti Sani.
Eelyo bantu ba mu Jabesi Giliyadi nibakamvwa eezyo ba Filisitiya nzibakachita Sawulo,

boonse baalumi benkondo bakanyampuka alimwi bakeenda busiku boonse alimwi bakabweza mutunta wa Sawulo amitunta yabana bakwe balombe kuzwa kubulambo bwa Beti Sani. Bakaya ku Jabesi akubatenta nkukooko.
Mpawo bakabweza mafuwa aabo alimwi bakawavwikila  munsi amunsamu  mu tamalisiki ku Jabesi, alimwi bakalyiimya chakulya kwamazuba alimusanu aabili.
Pawuli, Siluvanisi aTimoti, kumbungano yakuTesalonika muli Leza Taata a Mwaami Jesu Kkilisito. Lino luzyalo alumuno alube kulindinywe kuzwa kuli Leza  Taata a Mwaami Jesu Kkilisito
Lyoonse tupa kulumba kuli Leza kamulimoonse mbuli mbutumwaamba kwalyonse munkombyo zyesu.
Tulayeya kuti Leza wesu aTaata kumulimu yalusyomo milimo yaluyando, ayabulindilizi mukulangilila mu Mwaami Jesu Kkilisito.
Bakwesu nimuyandwa a Leza, tulizi wakamusala,

nkaambo majwi mabotu akasika kulindinywe peepe mumajwi luzutu, pesi aalubo manguzu mu Muuya uu Salala, mpawo amubwingi bwazisyomezyo. Munzila iikozyania, mulizi kuti twakali bantu bali biyeni aakati kanu nkaambo kanu.
Mwakaba basikwiya kulindiswe a ku Mwaami, nimwaka tambula majwi mumakataazyo alukondo kuzwa kumuya usalala.
Aboobo, mwakaba chitondeezyo kuli boonse bali ku Masedoniya a ku Kkayiya basyoma.

Nkaambo kuzwa kulindinywe ijwi lya Mwaami lyayitwa, alimwi nikutali ku Masedoniya luzutu pe a ku Kkayiya, pesi lusyomo kuli Leza lwakazulila koonse-koonse. Nkaambokako tatuyelede kwamba chintu kufumbwa.
Nkaambo bo lwabo balaamba aatala andiswe kuti ndutambuloonzi ndutwakali aalo aakati kanu, alimwi kuti mwakasanduka buti kuli Leza kuzwa kuzitoombe kuya kukubelekela Leza wabwini alimwi uupona,
akulindila Mwana wakwe kuzwa kujulu, ooyo wakabuka kuzwa kubafu - Jesu, uunununa kuzwa kubukali buzabuza.
Mbuli mbumuzi lwanu, bakwesu, kuti kuza kwesu kuli ndinywe tekwali kwabiyo.
Mulizi kuti chiindi chiinda twakafwabisigwa akujatwa chakuusa ku Filipi. Twakasima muli Leza wesu kwaambula kuli ndinywe makani mabotu aa Leza mukoombozeka kupati.
Nkambo kakukombelezya kwesu tetwaka zwa kukubisya, mbuli nakwakazwa kukusalalamikuba kulweeno.
Kwinda mbuli mbutwakazumininwa a Leza, akusyomeka kumakani mabotu, lino tulambula, chakutabotezya muntu, pesi Leza ngonguwe uyoolanga myoyo yesu.
Nkaambo takwe nitwakabelesya majwi aalweeno, mbuli mbumwizi, nikuba amuzeezo wakuvumba butangazu - Leza ngu kamboni wesu.
Na tuyandula bulemu buzwa kubantu, nikuba kuzwa kulindinywe, na ba apositolo aabami.
Nikubaboobo, twakaba batete aakati kanu mbuli banyina bawumbulizya bana babo.
Munzila eeyi twakali kumuyanda. Twakabotelwa kwabana andinywe kakutali kumani aa Leza luzutu pesi alimwi abuumi bwesu. Mbuli kuti mwakati mwaba bayandwi kulindiswe.
Mbuli mbumuyeya, bakwesu, milimu yesu amamanino. Mansiku asikati twakali kubeleka kuti tuatabi mukuli kulumwi awumwi akati kanu. Mbuli mbutwaka kambawuka makani mabotu aa Leza.
Inywe mulibakkamboni, alimwi aaLeza mbuli mbwasalala, mbwaluleme,  achakutaba amulandu, yakuba imponeno kuli ndinywe nimusyoma.
Munzila njiyeeyo mulizi mbutwakalibede kuli umwi awumwi wanu, mbuli wisi kubana bakwe, ndamusiya akumumbulizya akumukombelezya
kuti mweende munzila iyeelede ya Leza, umwita kubwami akubulemu.

Nkambo kakaako alimwi tilumba Leza lyoonse, kuti na mwatambula ijwi lya Leza eelyo ndimwakamvwa kuzwa kuli ndiswe, temwakalitambula anga lyakazwa kumuntu, pesi mbuli akakasimpe, ndijwi lya Leza alimwi lila aamulimui mulindinywe nimusyoma.

Alimwi bakwesu mwakaba basikwiiya bambungano zya Leza zili muJudiya muliKkilisito Jesu. Nkikaako alimwi mwakafwabisigwa muzintu zikozyene kuzwa kubantu banyika yanu, mbuli mbubakachita kuzwa kumaJuda.
Bakajaya antoomwe Mwaami Jesu abansimi  alimwi bakatutandila anze. tababotezyi Leza. Kwinda, Kukazyanya abantu boonse.
Batukasya kwambula abaMasi kuti bafutulwe. Impindu njakuti lyoonse bakali kuzuzya zibi zyabo kusikila kumamanino.
Pesi iswe bakwesu, twakali pambukene andinywe kwachiindi chifwifwi  mubuntu peepe mumoyo. Twakalipeda loko, achiyandisyo chipati kuti tubone masyu anu.
Mbokunga twakali kuyanda kusika kulindinywe - ichonzyo me - Pawulo, lumwi alubo - pesi Satani wakatwimikizya.
Nkaambo ninzi bulangizi bwesu na kubotelwa, na musini wakulisumpula kunembo lya Mwaami Jesu kukuboola kwakwe? Tensi nduwe?
Nkaambo uli bulemu alukondo lwesu.
Nkekako, muchiindi netwaka tachilikukonzya, twakayeya kachili chibotu kusyala musule muAtene luzutu.
Twakatuma Timoti mukwesu alimwi simulimunyina wa Leza mumakani aKkilisito, kukusimya akumumbulizya katulangana alusyomo lwanu,
kuchitila kuti takwe uyozunganisigwa amapenzi aaya. Nkaambo inywe nobeni mulizi kuti eezi nzitwakasalilwa.
Kasimpe nitwakali anywebo, twaka mwambila kakuchilichindi kuti twakali twabafwifwi kunjila mumapenzi, alimwi zyakachitikan mbubonya obo, mbuli mbomuzi.
Nkambo kaako, nendaka takachilikukonzya, ndakatumina kuti ambweni ndalikunoziba zili ajulu alusyomo lwanu. Ambweni sikusunka mulimwi nzila wakamunsuka, mpawo mulimu wesu wakaba wabiyo.
Pesi Timoti wakasika kulindiswe kazwa kulindinywe akutwetela makani mabotu aalusyomo lwaano aluyando. Waka twaambila kutimualtuyibalikwa lyoonse alimwi kuti mulayandisya kumubona aswebo.
Nkaambo kazeezi, nobakwesu, twaka wumbulizigwa andinywe nkaambo kalusyomo lwanu, mubuusu akupenga kwesu koonse.
Nkekaako lino tulapona, na mwayima nji mu Mwaami.
Nkaambo nchilumboonzi nchetunga tulapa kuli Leza nkaambo kanu, nkaako luyando loonse ndotulaalo kunembo lya Leza wesu alube alindinywe.
Mansiku asikati tulakomba chamanguzu kuti tukonzye kubona busyu bwako alimwi akupa eezyo zibulikide mulusyomo lwanu.
Tukumbila kuti Leza wesu alimwi Taata lwakwe, a Mwaami wesu Jesu batululamikile nzila yesu iiza kulindinywe.
Akube kuti Mwaami amuchite kuti muvule alimwi akumufwasusya muluyando lwawumwi amwenzinyinaakuli boonse bantu, mbubonya mbotu muchitila.
Akube kuti amuyumye mumoyo kuchitila kuti ibe myoyo itakwe kampenda mubusalali kunembo lya Leza alimwi Taata wesu akuboola kwa Mwaami Jesu aantomwe abasalali bakwe boonse.

Kumamanino, bakwesu, tuza kulindinywe akumukombelezya tulamusungilizya mu Mwaami Jesu. Mbuli mbumwakatambula malayilile kuzwa kulindiswe atala mbumweledee kwenda akubotezya Leza, alubo munzila yalwendo olu kuchitila kuti mwinkilile kunembo.
Mulaazi malayilile ngitwakamupa mu Mwaami Jesu.
Nkaaambo ooku nkuyanda kwa Leza, kulisalazya kwanu, kuti muleke bwamu,
kuti umwi wanu azibe mbwayelede kujana chibelesyo chakwe mubusalalialimwi mubulemu,
kutali mumiyeyo yabubi (mbuli bamasi batazi Leza.)
Kutabi muntu uubisiszya akunyemya munyina kuleeyi nzila. Nkaambo Mwaami nguubwedezya muzintu zyoonse eezi, mbuli mbutwakamuchenjezya akumupa bukamboni.
Nkaambo Leza taakamwitila kutasalala pesi kubusalali.
Alimwi ooyo ukaka eeli takakili muntu, pesi Leza uupa muuya usalala kuli ndinywe.
Nkatwamba aluyando lwabunyina, tamuchelede umwi muntu amulembele, kambo inywe lwanu muyisigwa a Leza kuti muyande umwi awumwi.
Nchobeni, mulachita ezi akuba kwesu boonse balikuMasedoniya. Pesi tulamusungilisya, bakwesu kuti muchitisye echi.
Tula musungilizya kuti mulangilile kupona buumi bwalumuno, langana azyako, akubeleka amaboko ako, mbuli mbutwakamulayilila.
Kuchitila kuti mwende obotu kunembo lyabali anze alusyomo olu alimwi akutabula chintu.
Tatuyandi kuti mube batabizigwa, bakwesu, abaabo boona, kuchitila kuti mutapengi mbuli boonse, abo batakwe bulangilizi.
Nkaambo kuti nkatusyoma kuti Jesu wakafwa wabuka alimwi wakabuka lubo, aboobo Leza uyoyeta aantomwe aJesu aabo bakoona mulinguwe.
Aboobo twamba ezi kulindinywe ajwi lya Mwaami, kuti iswe nituchipona, abo basyede kukubola kwa Mwaami, kasimpe tatukoyo tangunina abo bakatanguna koona.
Nkaambo Mwaami lwakwe uyoselela kuzwa kujulu. Uyoboola amongololo, ajwi lyamungelo silutwe, alimwi amweembo wa Leza. Alimwi bafwide muli Kkilisito bayobuka kusanguna.
Mpawo swe tobawumi, basyeede, tuyobwezwa toonse ambabo mumayoba kuyoswana Mwaami mumulengalenga. Munzila eyi tunoli aantomwe a Mwaami.
Aboobo, amuumbulizyanie umwi awumwi amajwi aaya.
Lino katulangene achindi alimwi azyindi zyamwaka nobakwesu, tamukwe chimunga mulalembulula.
Nkambo anywebo lwanu mulizi kabotu kuti bunsi bwa Mwaami busika mbuli mubbi mansiku.
Eelyo nibati, "Luumuno alimwi akubambikana," mpawo kunyonyoka kwamachampmamo kulobasikila. Kunoli mbuli machise akuzyala kumwanakazi ulaada. takukwe mbubanga balapuzuka.
Pesi inywe, nobakwesu, tamuli mumudima zyakuti buzuba nga bulamuzida mbuli mubbi.
Nkambo nywe moonse muli bana balombe bamumuni alimwi bana balombe babuzuba. Tatuli bana balombe bamansiku naa bamudima.
Nkinkako tatoni mbuli bingi mbubachita. Ani kuti, tusinsimuke akuba changa.
Nkambo abo bawona bachita obo mansiku, alimwi abo bakolwa bachita obo mansiku.
Pesi mbutuli babuzuba, twelede kukkala katuli changa alimwi akuzwata lusyomo aluyando mbuli ntobo, alimwi bulangilizi bwalufutuko bwangwani yesu.
Nkambo leza takatusalila bukali, pesi kujana lufutuko kwindila muli Mwaami Jesu Kkilisito.
Nguwe wakatufwida swe kuti, nikuba tulalanga na tulona, tukapone amwi anguwe.
Nkinkanko mumbulizyanye umwi awumwi alimwi muyakane, mbuli mbumulokuchita kale.
Tulokumukombelezya chamoyo, nobakwesu kuti muyeye abo babeleka akati kanu alimwi abo balajulu lyanu mu Mwaami alimwi bamulayilila.
Twamukumbila alubo mubalemeke loko muluyando nkambo kamilimo yabo. Ngamube alumuno  akati kanu.
Tulamusungwazya, nobakwesu; muchenjezye abo bakandu, musungwazye batyompedwe, mugwasye batete, alimwi mube amoyo mulamfu kulibonse.
Mubone kuti Takwe naba omwe ubwedezya chibi achibi kuli umwi. Anu kuti, mutobele ezyo zibotu kuli umwi awumwi alimwi kulibonse.
Mukondwe lyonse.
Mukombe katakwe kwimikila.
Mulizyonse mupe kulumba. Nkambo oku nkukuyanda kwa Leza muli Kkilisito Jesu kulindinywe.
Mutatontozyi Muuya.
Mutanyansyi businsimi.
Musunke zintu zyonse. Mujatilile kuzibotu.
Muswene kule kuzwa kububi bwamisyobo yoonse.
Inche Leza walumuno amusalazye kumaninide. Inche amuuya wanu wonse, moyo, alimwi, mubili zibambwe katakwe mulandu nkambo kwakuboola kwa Mwaami wesu Jesu Kkilisito.
Ulisyomekede oyo umwiita, oyo ulozichita lubo.
Nobakwesu, mutukombele aswebo.
Mujuzye bakwesu a nkisi isalala.
Ndamulayilila chamoyo wonse kwinda mu Mwaami kuti olu lugwalo lubalwe kubakwesu bonse.
Iluzyalo lwa Mwaami Jesu Kkilisito lube anywebo.
Pawulu, mutumwa waKkilisito Jesu mbuli mumalayilile aLeza Mufutuli wesu a Kkilisito Jesu bulangilizi bwesu,
kuli Timoti, mwanan mulombe wasimpe mulusyomo: Lizyalo, luse, a luumuno kuzwa kuli Leza Taata aKkilisito Jesu Mwaami wesu.
Mbuli mbundakakusungwaazya kuti uchite aawo nindakali kuzwa kuya kuMasedoniya, syaala mu Efeso nkokuti ukonzye kulayilila bamwi bantu kutibatayiisyi iimwi njisyo iisiyene.
Nikuba boobo bataswilizyi twaano amazyalani aatagoli. Eezi zichita kukazyanya kwiinda kuba balondozi baLeza, kabuli bwa lusyomo.
Lino bulangilili bwa malayilile nduyando luzwa mumoyo uusalala, kuzwa mukulimvwida kubotu, a kuzwa mulusyomo lwini.
Bamwi bantu balookusweka kuzwa kuzintu eezi akusandukila kukwaambula kwabufubafuba.
Bayanda kuba bayisi bamulawu, pesi tabamvwisisisyi eezyo nzibaambula nikuba eezyo nzibazikitizya kwaamba.
Pesi iswe tulizi kuti mulawu mubotu ikuti na umwi wawubelesya chamulawu.

Swe tulizi, kuti mulwawu tewakabikilwa baalumi baluleme pe abusena, pesi kuli aabo batakwe mulawu alimwi bantu bakapanduka, aabo bantu batakwe bunaleza alimwi a basizibi, abaabo batasalali alimwi kabateeli, nguwabaabo bajaya mawisi a manyina, ngwabajayi,

ngwabantu bayandisya zyakulalana, ababo bachita zyakulalana lwabo lwabo, ababo babba bantu akubachita bazike, ngwababeja, abaamba bukamboni bwakubeja alimwi kufumbwa zyoonse eezyo zikazyanya aanjisyo ntuloko.
Oku kulayilila kuli mbuli makani mabotu aabulemu bwaLeza ulongezegelwe kuli ngawo ngindakapegwa.
Ndilumba Kkilisito Jesu Mwaami wesu. Wakandisimya, nkaambo wakandiyeya mbuli uusyomekede, alimwi wakandinanikila mulimu.
Ndakali kusampawula Leza, mufwabyi, alimwi mwaalumi wankondo. Pesi ndakatambula luse nkaambo ndakalikuchita mukutaziba a mukutasyoma.
Alimwi luzyalo lwaMwaami wesu lwakafusuka aantomwe a lusyomo alimwi a luyando oolo luli muli Kkilisito Jesu.
Ooyu mulumbe nguwanchoonzyo alimwi uleelede kutambulwa koonse, kuti Kkilisito Jesu wakasika munyika kuzofutula basizibi.
Pesi nkaambo kaboobo ndakapegwa luse, kuti mulindime, mutanzi, Kkilisito Jesu akonzyed kutondezya moyo mulamfu. Wakachita eechi mbuli chitondezyo kulibaabo bayosyoma mulinguwe kubuumi butamani.
Lino kuMwaami wachindi, utafwi, utabonwi, Leza uumwi luzutu, ngakube bulumbu alimwi bulemu kuli lyoonsea lyoonse. Ameni.
Ndilokubika malayilile aaya kunembo lyako, Timoti, mwana wangu, mukweendelana kwabusinsimi bwakachitwa musule aatala a nduwe kuti ukonzye kulwana kulwana kubotu,
kojisilidi kulusyomo alimwi akukulimvwida kubotu. Aakukaka eezi, bamwi bakasweekelwa alusyomo lwabo.
Bo mba Himeniyasi a Alekizanda, aabo mbindakapeda kuli Satani kuchitila kuti bakakuyisigwe kutasampawula Leza.
Nkinkaako, lutanzi kuli zyoonse, ndasungwazya kuti nkumbizyo, nkombyo, nkumbililo, alimwi kupa kulumba kuchitilwe bantu boonse,
kwa Baami alimwi aboonse bali mubweendelezi, kuchitila kuti tupone buumi bwaluumuno alimwi butontwede mubunaleza boonse akuzikatila.
Eechi nchibotu alimwi chilatambulika kunembo lyaLeza Mufutuli wesu.
Uulombozya kuti bantu bonse bafutulwe alimwi akusika kuluzibo lwasimpe.
Nkaambo kuli Leza umwi, alimwi kuli mwiiminini omwe waLeza a muntu, mwaalumi Kkilisito Jesu.
Wakalipa lwakwe mbuli muulo waboonse, mbuli bukamboni kuchiindi cheelede.
Nkaambo kamakanze aaya ndakasalilwa kuba mukambawusi akuba mutumwa - ndokwamba simpe, tandilokubeja pe - alimwi muyisi wa baMaasi mulusyomo a musimpe.
Nkinkaako, ndiyanda baalumi mumasena woonse bakombe alimwi banyampule maboko aasalala kakutakwe kunyema akukazyanya.
Munzila yomwe, bayelede kuzwata ingubo ntuloko, zipa buntu alimwi alikujata, kabatakwe masusu aalukidwe na ngolide na zyebeka na ingubo zidula,
pesi zyeelela banakazi aabo baamba bunaLeza kwiindila amilimu mibotu.
Mwanakazi uyelede kwiiya muchuumunizi amukulibombya koonse.
Tandizumizyi mwanakazi kuyisya na kubelesya bweendelezi aatala amwaalumio, pesi kupona muchuumunizi.
Nkaambo Adamu wakasanguna kulengwa, mpawo Eva.
Adamu takenwa pe, pesi mwanakazi nguwakeenwa alimwi wakaba mubisyi.
Nikubaboobo, uyofutulwa kwiinda mukuzyala bana, kuti bayinkilila mulusyomo a muluyando a mukusalazigwa aantomwe amunse wamiyeyo.
Eechi chaambyo chilinchicho: Na muntu kayanda kuba mupati wambungano, ulombozya mulimu mubotu.

Nkinkaako mupati wambungano teelede kuba akampenda pe. Uyelede kuba mulumi wa mwanakazi umwe. Uleelede kuba muntu uli achiimo chibotu, uyeya kabotu, uzikatide, alimwi usamawusya. Uyelede kukonzya kuyisya.
Teelede kuba muntu uyandisya wayini, utakazyi a kutalwana pe, pesi aboobo, kalisibuuya, siluumuno. Teelede kuba simuyanda mali pe.
Abe muntu ukonzya kubamba n'anda yakwe kabotu, alimwi uyeelede kuba aanchonzyo kuti bana bakwe balamuswilizya akumulemeka munzila zyoonse.
Nkaambo na mwaalumi katazi kubamba n'anda yakwe mwini, kujana ulakonzya biyeni kubamba mbungano yaLeza?
Teelede kuba muntu uuchisanduka, kuchitila kuti katazimbi chakulisumpula alimwi ulakonzya kuwida mukupegwa mulandu mbuli Satani.
Aboobo abe muntu ulempuwo mbotu kuli baabo balaanze, kuti atawide mu mawuse a mukakole ka dyabbulosi.
Munzila ikozyenye, madikkoni beelede kuba abulemu, batabi bandimi-zyobile. Tabeelede kunywa loko wayini a kutangala.
Baleelede kubamba nsiswa chalusyomo a miyeyo isalala.
Baleelede kuzumininwa lutanzi, alimwi elyo beelede kubeleka nkaambo tabakwe kampenda.
Munzila ikozyenye, banakazi babo beelede kuba abulemu, batakwe manwa, pesi balijisi alimwi basyomekede muzintu zyoonse.
Badikkoni kabali balumi ba mwanakazi umwi. Baleelede kubamba kabotu bana babo a n'anda zyabo.
Nkaambo aabo bakabeleka kabotu balajana lwabo kwimikila kubotu alimwi a busichaamba bupati mulusyomo luli muliKkilisito Jesu.
Mbuli mbundikulemba zintu ezi kulinduwe, ndabulangilizi bwakusika kulinduwe akufwambana.
Pesi na ndanonoka, ndikukulembela kuti uzibe kuti kulibambwa biyeni mun'anda yaLeza, ili njiyo mbungano yaLeza muumi, njembandama a mugwasyi wasimpe.
toonse tulazumina kuti insiswa yabunaleza nimpati loko:
Lino Muuya ulaamba entanganana kuti muzyiindi ziyotobela bamwi bantu bayosiya lusyomo alimwi bakaswiilile myuuya yalweeneeno akunjiisyo zyabadayimona
mukubeja kwakuupawupa, mamvwido aabo beni kaali asizigwa.
Bayokasya bantu kuti bakwatane alimwi akuyanda kuti balilesye kuzilyo Leza nzyakalenga kuti zitambulwe chakupa kulumba abaabo basyoma akuziba kasimpe.
Nkaambo choonse chilengwa chaLeza nchibotu, alimwi takwe pe chitambwidwe kakulikupa kulumba chiyokakwa.
Nkaambo chakasalazigwa ajwi lyaLea ankombyo.
Na wabika eezi zintu kunembo lyabakwesu, uyooba mulanda mubotu wa Jesu Kkilisito. Nkaambo mulikukomezegwa amajwi alusyomo  alimwi akunjiisyo mbotu nzimwakatobela.
Pesi amukake twaano twanyika twakayandwa aabanakazi bapati. Aboobo, amukaliyiisye nobeni mubunaleza.
Nkaambo kuliyiisya kwamumubili kuli empindu nini, pesi bunaLeza bulabelesegwa kuzintu zyoonse. Kujisi chisyomezyo chabuumi bwalino alimwi akubuumi buza.
Mulumbe ooyu ulisyomekede alimwi uleelede kutambulwa kuzwide.
Nkaambo nkinkaako nchitubeleka akulwisya. Nkaambo tulalangilila muliLeza muumi, Mufutuli wabantu boonse, pesi ikapati wabasyomi.
Mubululami layilila alimwi yiisya zintu eezi.
Kutabi muntu uulangilila aansi bukubusi bwako. Aboobo, kulibaabo basyoma, ba chitondezyo mukwaambula, mukuchita, muluyando, mukusyoma a mubusalali.
Mane do ndisike, kkala mukubala, mukulumbayizya alimwi a mukuyiisya.
Utalekeleli chipo chili mulinduwe, chakapegwa kulinduwe kwiinda muchisinsimi , akubikwa maanza abapati bembungano.
Bamba zintu eezi. Ba mulinzizyo, kuti kuzwidilila kwako kukaboneke kubantu boonse.
Kolibamba chakulangisisya lwako mwini akukuyiisya. Kkalilila muzintu eezi. Nkaambo mukuchita oobo, uyolifutula lwako alimwi abaabo batakaswiilizye nduwe.
Utanokkalalili mwaalumi mupati. Aboobo, komunyampula mbuli mukuti ngundeende. Kobanyampula baalumi banini mbuli bakulana,
banakazi bapati mbuli mamama, alimwi basimbi banini mbuli bachizi, mubusalali boonse.
Lemeka bamukabafu, bamukabafu banchoonzyo.
Pesi kuti mukamufu kali aabana na bazukulu, ngabatangune lwabo kwiiya kutondezya kulemeka mun'anda yabo beni. Ngababweedezezye bazyali babo nkaambo eechi chilbotezya kuli Leza.
Pesi kulooyo mukamufu wanchoonzyo, uucheede kali alike, ubikide bulangilizi bwakwe kuliLeza akwwinkilila kunembo mukuchita nkumbizyo alimwi akupa nkombyo mansiku a sikati.
Nikubaboobo, mwanakazi uupona chakulikondelezya ulifwide nikuba kachipona.
Mubululami layilila eezi lubo, kuchitila kuti batabi amulandu.
Pesi na umwi katakonzyi kupa banzubo zyakwe, kapati kuli aabo bamun'anda yakwe, unoli wakaka lusyomo alimwi wabija kwiinda utasyomi.
Leka mwanakazi alembwe mbuli mukamufu utali munini kuminyaka iili makkumi aali musanu alimwi kukomena, kali mwanakazi wa mulumi uumwi.

Uli aampuwo yakuchita milimu mibotu, nikuba kuti wakabambide bana, na wakali kusamawusya beenzu, na wali kusanzya mawulu aabasalali baLeza, na wakalikulemutuzya bali aamapenzi, na wakalilipedelede kumilimu yoonse mibotu.
Pesi kuli bamukabafu bachili banini, kaka kubalemba mulibamwi. Nkaambo elyo bakuzundwa kuziyandisyo zyanyama kukubukila Kkilisito bayanda kukkwatwa.
Muliyeeyi nzila bayojana milandu nkaambo banoli bakachilwa mukulipeda kwabo kutaanzi.

Muchiindi nchicheecho, bayoyiya kuba bakandu akweenda chakuzyunguluka kuzwa kun'anda akun'anda. Tabakoyooba bakandu biyo pe, pesi bayowambuula zitakwe munse akunjila zyaambo zyabamwi, kabaamba zintu nzibateelede kwaamba.
Nkinkaako ndiyanda banakazi banini kuti bakkwatwe kuti bazyale bana, kuti babambe mpuli, alimwi akutapa mweenya kuli sinkondonyina kuti atwaambe bubi.
Mbuli bamwi mbubakabwedela kuli Satani.
Na kuti kakuli mwanakazi musyomi uli abamukabafu, ngabagwasye, kuchitila kuti imbungano itabi aamukuli, kuti igwasizye bamukabafu banchoonzyo.
Leka bapati bembungano beendelezya kabotu bapegwe bulemu bwiindulwidwe, kwaambisya aabo babeleka ajwi alimwi amukuyiisya.
Mbuli makani mabotu mbawamba kuti, ''Utamwaangi kumulomo musune aawo nachilyatila zilyo'' alimwi ''Similimu  uleelede kujana mpindu yakwe.''
Utatambuli kubejelezya kwiiminana abapati, adukuti kube babili na batatu bapa bukamboni.
Lulamika basizibi kunembo lyabantu boonse kuchitila kuti bamwi bayowe.
Mubululami ndakulayilila iwe, kunembo lyaLeza aJesu Kkilisito akubangelo basale, kukubamba malayilile chakutabasikusaluuzya, akutachita chimwi chintu chakuteelanya.
Utabiki maanza chakufwambana aluumwi. Utaabilani muzibi zyawumwi muntu. Weelede kulibamba chabusalali.
