Tucheelede limbi kunywa manzi. Aboobo, uyeelede kunywa wayini muche kuchitila bula amalwazi aako akkala kakuchisa.
Zibi zyabamwi bantu zilizibikene aantanganana, alimwi zyeenda kunembo lyabo mulubeta. Pesi zibi zimwi zitobela musule.
Mbubonya oobo, imwi milimu mibotu ilizibidwe antaanganana, pesi nikuba imwi tikonzyi kusisigwa.
Leka boonse balimunsi ejogwe mbuli bazike babone basimalelo babo kabeelela boonse bulemu. Beelede kuchita eechi kuchitila kuti izina lyaLeza alimwi aluyiisyo lutakasampawulwi.

Bazike bali abasimalelo babo basyoma tabeelede kutondezya kutabalemeka nkaambo mbananyina. Aboobo, beelede kubabelekela milimu mukwiindilila. Nkaambo basimalelo bagwasikana amilimu yabo mbasyomi alimwi mbayandisi. Yiisya alimwi waambe eezi zintu.
Na umwi wayiisya injiisyo yakubeja alimwi katazuminani amajwi aalamunse aMwaami wesu Jesu Kkilisito alimwi ayabunaleza injiisyo,
ulalisumpula alimwi takwe nchamvwisisisya pe. Uli aachiyandisyo chisofweede mukukazyanya akubonisyanya aatala amajwi ayeta lunyemo, kulwana, zisapi, kuyeeyelana bubi,

alimwi akulwana kutamani aakati kabantu bali aabuntu bwamiyeyo mibi. Bakasweekelwa simpe alimwi bayeya kuti bunaleza ninzila yakujanisya mali nyingi. Amwi malembe achiindi alayungizizya mukulumbayizya, Musosoloke kuzwa kuzintu ziliboobu. Pesi malembe mabotu achiindi lok taajisi.
Lino bunaleza buli aakukkutisikana nkulijanina kupati,
nkaambo takwe nchitwakeeta munyika, alimwi takwe nchiinga tulakonzya kugwisya mulinjiyo.
Aboobo, ngatukakkutisikane achakulya akuzisamo.
Lino aabo bayanda kuba bavubi bawida mumasunko, mukakole. Bawida mubufubafuba bwiingi amuziyandisyo zinyonyoona, alimwi kufumbwa mulizimwi zibbizya bantu mukunyonyooka amukumwaya.
Nkaambo luyando lwemali muyanda wamisyobo yoonse yabubi. Bamwi bantu bayiyanda bakasowegwa kulusyomo alimwi bakaliyasa akumvwa machise mapati.
Pesi iwe, muntu waLeza, chija kulizeezi zintu. Tobela bululami, bunaleza, kusyomeka, luyando, lukakatilo, alimwi a bubombe.
Lwana kulwana kubotu kwalusyomo. Jatisya buumi butamani ooko nkuwakiitwa, alimwi ooko nkuwakapa kwaamba kabotu kunembo lyabakamboni biingi.
Ndapa malayilile aaya kulinduwe kunembo lyaLeza, uupa buumi kuli zyoonse zintu, alimwi kunembi lyaKkilisito Jesu, wakaamba chakasimpe kuzumina kubotu kunembo lyaPontiyasi Pilato,
kuti abambe mulawu kakutakwe kampenda na kusolwa, kusikila kukuboneka kwaMwaami wesu Jesu Kkilisito.
Leza uyootondezya kuboneka kwaKkilisito aachiindi cheelede - Leza, wakalongezegwa alimwi Singuzu alike, Mwaami weendelezya aMwaami uutonga.
Alike utafwi alimwi uukkala mumumuni utakonzyi kuswenegwa aafwifwi. Tawo pe muntu kumubona na ukonzya kumulanga. Kulinguwe akube bulemu abweendelezi butamani. Ameni.

Mubululami layilila ibanotede munyika iino kuti batabi balisumpula alimwi batabi balangilila kubunoti, butazibinkene. Aboobo, beelede kuba aabulangilizi muliLeza. Ulapa kulindiswe toonse bunoti bwanchoonzyo kuti tunonenwe.
Baambile bachite bubotu, banote mumilimu miubotu, akupa kwiindilide alimwi bayandisye kwaabana.
Munzila eeyo bayoolilondweda beni intalisyo mbotu yacheecho chizoosika, kuti bakalijatile buumi loko.
Timiti, kkwabilila chakapegwa kulinduwe. Kaka kubula bunaleza, kwaambula kutasalali amiyeeyo iikazyanya kulicheecho chibejelwa kuti nduzibo.
Bamwi baalumi baamba eezi bakasweeka kuzwa kulusyomo. Luzyalo lube aandinywe.
Solomoni mwana mulombe wakalisimide mumulawo wakwe, a Jehova Leza wakwe wakali aanguwe wakamuchita kuti abe singuzu loko.
Solomoni wakambula kuma Izilayeli, boonse kubendelezi bazyuulu abe miyanda, akubabetesi, alimwi akubendelezi boonse bakwa Izilayeli, basilutwe bamyunzi yabamawisi.
Nkabela Solomoni ambungano yoonse yakali aanguwe bakinka kubusena butantide oko ku Gibbiyoni, mbuli mbukwakali teente lyakuswanana a Leza, eelyo Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova, ndyakalunda kali munkanda.
Pesi Devidi wakeeta ibbokesi lya Leza kuzwa ku Kkiliyati Jilimu kuyosika kubusena obo mbwakabambilide, mbuli mbwakabikka tente mu Jelusalemu.

Mukuyungizya, chipayililo chamukuba chakachitwa a Bbezalelu mwana mulombe wa Uli mwana mulombe wa Huli oyo wakaliwo kunembo lyatente lyakubunganina lya Jehova; Solomoni ambungano bakinka nkuko. ( amwi malembe abensiku muchi Hibbulu alijisi, chipayililo chamukkuba chakapangwa a Bbezalelu mwana mulombe wa Huli, wakachibika awo kunembo lyatente lyakubunganina lya Jehova, oko nkwawamba kuli Devidi).
Solomoni wakiinka nkuko kuchipayililo chamukkuba kunembo lya Jehova, eelyo lyakali ateente lyakubunganina akupeda zipayizyo zili chuulu chomwe zipayizyo zyakutenta.
Leza wakalibonia kuli Solomoni mansiku aayo akwamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Kumbila! Ninzi nchitakupe ?''
Solomoni wakati kuli Leza, ''Wakatondezya chizuminano chisyomekede chipati loko kuli taata Deviti, akundichita mwami mubusena bwakwe.
Lino, Jehova Leza, chita chisyomezyo kuli Devidi taata chizuzikizigwe mbuli mbuwandichita mwami wakwendelezya bantu banji mbuli lusuko lwanyika.
Lino kondipa busongo amanu, kuchitila kuti njendelezye bantu bako, mbingi loko mumweelwe?''

Leza wakati kuli Solomoni, Nkambo eechi chakali mumoyo wako,akambo kakuti tewakumbila buvubi pe, mbono na bulemu, nikuba buumi bwabasinkondonyokwe, na buumi bulamfu bwako, pesi wakumbila busongo amaanu aako, kuchitila kuti ukonzye kuzulwida bantu bangu ajulu ababa mbendakuchitila kuti ube mwami, eechi nchicho nchensichite.
Ndilakupa lino busongo amanu. Ndakupa lubo buvubi, ambono, abulemu kwiinda baami boonse ibakakutangunina akwinda boonse bakakutobele.''
Nkabela Solomoni wakeza mu Jelusalemu kubusena butantide mbwakali mu Gibbiyoni, kuzwa kunembo lyateente lyakubunganina; akwendelezya ba Izilayeli.

Solomoni wakabungania inkalaki abasimabbiza, wakali azyuulu zine amiyanda iine yankalaki azyuulu zilikkumi azibili zyaba simabbiza eezyo nzyakabikka inkalaki mumadolopo, kabali anguwe, mwami mu Jelusalemu.
Mwami wakachita nsiliva, angolida kuti zibe zintu zijayilikide mbuli mabwe. Alimwi wakachita zisamu zya Kkedali wazivuzya mbuli nkuyu zili mutulundulundu.
Mbuli mbubwakali kuyandika mabbiza kuzwa ku Ijiputi aku Kkuu kuli Solomoni, basambazi bakawula kuzwa ku Kkuu amuulo.
Bakakuula nkalaki mu Ijiputi, amiyanda ili musanu awumwi yamasyekeli ansiliva, a Bbiza lyamuyanda oomwe amakkumi alimusanu amasyekeli. Bakawuzizya lubo ba Hititi aba Alamiyenisi.
Lino Solomoni wakalayilila mayake ang'anda yazina lya Jehova amayake ang'anda yabwami bwakwe.

Solomoni wakatuma baalumi zyuulu zili musanu azibili kuti babweze mikuli abali zyuulu musanu azitatu mbuli basikunenga mabwe muzilundu, abalumi bali zyuulu zitatu amyaanda musanu awumwi kuti babe basikubalanga nibalokubeleka.
Solomoni wakatuma mutumwa kuli Hilamu mwami wa Tulo, kawamba kuti, ''Mbuli mbwakachita kuli Davida taata, kumutolela matanda aseda kuti ayake ing'anda kuti ukkale mukati, chita mbubo akuli ndime.

Langa njanda kutazika kuyaka ing'anda yazina lya Jehova Leza wangu, kuti njibambile nguwe, kuti nteente tununkilizyo tubotu kunembo lyakwe, kubambila aanze chinkwa chabuliwo bwakwe, achazipayizyo zyuumpidwe kuseni amansiku mubuzuba butegwa nsabata akuchiindi chamweezi mupya, akuchindi chaambidwe chepobwe lya Jehova Leza wesu. Eechi nchaalyonse, kuli Izilayeli.
Ing'anda eyo njinzoyaka inoli mpati loko, nkambo Leza wesu mupati kwinda boonse baleza.
Pesi ngwani ukonzya kuyakila Leza ing'anda, kuzwida kunyika yoonse alimwi nikuba ijulu lwalyo talikonzyi pe kumujata? Ndimeni kuti muyakile ing'anda, kwinda kuumpa zipayizyo kunembo lyakwe?

Aboobo nditumine mwalumi ooyo uzi kubeleka mulimu wangolida, insiliva, mukkuba abutale, alimwi uzi milimu yamasani ilimumusyobo wantumbula, aasalala, abuluba bwasyamuteme, mwalumi uzi kuchita yoonse misyobo yazisamu zibezedwe kabotu. Uunoli abalumi aabo bazi mulimu aabo banoli andime mu Juda amu Jelusalemu, aabo Davida taata mbakagwasya.
Unditumizye lubo siida, seyipulesi, a misamu ya alugumu kuzwa ku Lebbanoni, nkambo ndizi kuti bazike bako balizi kuti zisamu batema biyeni ku Lebbanoni. Laanga, balanda bangu bayoba abalanda bako,
kuchitila kuti undibambile zisamu mubwingi, nkambo ing'anda eeyo njinjenda inoli mpati akugambya.

Langa, ndiyokupa bazike balumi bayogonka zisamu, zyuulu makumi abbali zyalubuwa lwawiti, zyuulu makumi abili azisuwo makumi abili zyabbali, zyuulu makumi abili anongo zyawayini azyuulu makumi abili anongo yamafuta.''
Mpawo Hilamu, mwami wa Tulo, wakasandula mumalembe, aayo ngakatumizya kuli Solomoni: ''Nkambo Jehova uyanda bantu bakwe, wakakuchita kuti ube mwami kuli mbabo.''

Mukuyungizya, Hilamu wakati, ''Alongezegwe Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, wakalenga ijulu anyika, wakapa kuli Davida mwami mwana mulombe musongo, upedwe maanu akumvwisisisya, ooyo utakayake ing'anda ya Jehova ang'anda yabwami bwakwe.
Lino ndilatuma mwalumi uuzi mulumu kwindilila, Hilamu - Abbi, ooyo upedwe achipo chakumvwisisisya.

Mwana mulombe wamwanakazi wabaana basimbi ba Dani. Wisi wakali mwalumi waku Tulo. Ulikwizi kubeleka mulimu wangolida, nsiliva, mukkuba, butale, mabwe azisamu, alimwi yamasani amuntumbula, muteme, alimwi abuluba busalala amasani atuba. Ulikwizi lubo kulunda kufumbwa bwabulembo alimwi amukulunda kufumbwa bube. Akube busena mbwatabambilwe akati kababelesi bako, azyabaabo basimalelo aangu, Davida, wuso.
Lino mpawo, i witi a bbali, mafuta awayini, eeyo simalelo wangu njakali wamba, atumizye zintu eezi kubazike bakwe.
Tuyogonka zisamu kuzwa ku Lebbano mubwiingi mbuli nzyoyanda. Tuyozitola kuli nduwe mbuli mapulanga mulwizi kuyosika ku Jopa alimwi muyobweza kusikila ku Jelusalemu.''
Solomoni wakabala boonse bazwa kule aabo bakali munyika ya Izilayeli, kayabutobezya munzila eeyo Davida wisi njakabalide. Bakajanika kuti bakali 153,600.

Wakatuma balumi bali zyuulu zili musanu azibili zyabwami kuti babweze mikuli balizyuulu zili musanu azitatu kuti babe basikunenga mabwe muzilundu abali zyuulu miyanda iitatu amyanda musanu awumwi kuti babe basikubalanga kuti babikke bantu mukubeleka.

Elyo Solomoni wakatalika kuyaka ng'anda ya Jehova mu Jelusalemu kuchilundu chitegwa Moliya, Oko Jehova nkwakalibonia kuli Davida wisi wakwe. Wakabamba busena oobo Davida nkwaka chibambilide, muchipolelo cha Onani mu Jebbusayiti.
Wakatalika kuyaka mubuzuba bwabili mumwezi wabili, mumunyaka waane wakwendelezya.

Lino obu mbobusasa bwantalisyo eyo Solomoni njakayaka bwang'anda ya Leza. Kabelesya chiyanza chachindi tukokola, bulamfu bwayo bwakali tukokola makumi musanu akkumi lyomwe, alimwi busasa bwacho bwakali makkumi abili aatukokola.

Bulamfu bwalukonkono bwang'anda nkwili kunembo bwakali tukokola tuli makumi obile, kabwelene abusasa. Akulampa kwayo kwakali tukokola tuli makkumi obile alimwi Solomoni wakazilulula mukati angolida loko.
Wakibotya mukati azisamu zyamulombe, eyo njakazilulula angolida loko, alimwi akwivumbya misamu yamikunka anketani.
Wakisakatizya ng'anda amabwe meebesi; ingolida yakali ngolida yaku Paluvayimu.
Alimwi wakanzika minseende, maseketi, bulambo, amakkoma ali angolida, wakabeza chelubbimu kubulambo bwayo.
Wakayaka busena busalalisya. Bulamfu bwayo bwakalelene abusasa bweng'anda tukokola tuli makkumi obile. Wakizilulula angolida yanchoonzyo, zyakali kusika ku myaanda ilimusanu awumwi wamatalenta.
Ikulema kwenembe bwakali mashekeli alimakkumi musanu amashekeli angolida. Wakiziliulula mabbazu ayo amujulu angolide.
Wakachita zitombe zyobile zyaKkelubbimu zyabusena busalalisya; basikubeza bakazizilulula angolide.

Mababa a kkelubbimu akalimakkumi abili atukokola bulamfu boonse antomwe; ibbaba lyomwe lyakkelubbimu lyakali tukokola tuli musanu bulamfu, kalisikila kubulambo bwang'anda; limwi bbaba lyakalikozyenie lyakali musanu tukokola, kalisikila kubbaba limbi.
Ibbaba limbi lya kkelubbimu lyakali tukokola musanu, kalisikila kubulambo bwa ng'anda; alimwi ibbaba lyalyo kalili tukokola musanu lubo, kaliguma ibbaba tanzi lyakkelubbimu.
Mababa amakkelubbimu akalanzeene kusika kumweelwe wa makumi abili atukokola. Ikkelubbimu lyakimikila amawulu abo, masyu abo kalangene ang'anda mpati.
Wakachita chilisitilizyo chamusyobo wamuteme, chamuntumbula, alimwi achamusinza wanyangu amasani atubatuba, alimwi wakabotya botya kkelubbimu alinjiyo.
Alimwi Solomoni wakachita minsi ibili, umwi kawuli tukokola tuli makumi otatwe amusanu kukulampa, nkambo nkunembo lyang'anda; chimikililo chakali atala lyayo twakali tukokola musanu bulamfu.
Wakachita inketani yaminsi alimwi wibika atala lyayo; alimwi wakachita mwanda omwe wama pomegilanayiti akwaswanizya amwi kunketani,
Wakayimikizya minsi kunembo lyachikombelo, limwi kuchilisyo, alimwi kuchimweensi; wakawuzika munsi wakali kuchilisyo kuti Jakkini, alimwi munsi wakali kuchimwensi wakuti Bbowazi.
Kukuyungizya wakachita chipayizyo chamukkuba; bulamfu bwacho kachili tukokola tuli makumi obilea abusasa bwachokachili makumi obile. Bulamfu bwabwime bwakali tukokola kkumi.

Alimwi wakapanga chibaanga nchilambwa chamanzi chabutale, tukokola tulikkumi kuzwa kunkomwe imwi kusika kulimbi. Bulamfu bwabwime bwacho chakali tukokola musanu, alimwi chilambwa chakali makkumi atatu atukokola kuchipimyo.
Munsi lyankomwe yakanzemukide chilambwa kwakali basune, kkumi kuli kamwi katukokola, zyakafulwa achimwi chimpanzi elyo dambwa nilyakali kufulwa.

Idambwa pati lyakazibinkene kalili ''Iziba'' lyakali bikidwe ajulu abasune balikkumi ababili, botatwe kabalangide kunyika, botatwe kabalangide kumbo, botatwe kabalangide kumusanza, alimwi botatwe kabalangide kujwe.

''Iziba'' lyakatandabikidwe ajulu alimbabo, alimwi awoonse masule abo akalangide mukati.  ''Iziba'' lyakalidini mbuli busasa bwejanza, alimwi ankomwe yakabumbidwe mbuli nkomwe yankomeki, mbuli maluba luba. Izuba kalili azyulu zyotatwe zyanongo zyamanzi.

Wakachita lubo malambwa alikkumi akwachila zintu; wakabikka musanu kubbazu lyakumusanza, azilimusanu kubbazu lyakunyika, zintu zyakali kubelesegwa nikwali kuchitwa chipayizyo chakutentwa zyakali kuwachwa mulinzizyo. Idambwa pati lyakali zibinkene kalili ''Iziba'' lyakali kubelesegwa abapayizi kuti bawache.
Wakachita zyimikililo zyamalampi zilikkumi ezyo zyakachitwa kwinda mumalayilile abwiime bwao; wakzibika muchikombelo, musanu kochilisyo, amusanu kuchimweensi.
Wakachita matafula alikkumi akwabikka muchikombelo, musanu kochilisyo, amusanu kochimweensi. Wakachita zibikkilo zili mwaanda zyangolida.
Mukuyungizya wakachita bbetekelo lyabapayizi, abbetekelo pati amakkoma abbetekelo akuzilulula makkoma abo amukkuba.
Wakabikka zisambilo zizibinkene kutegwa ''Iziba'' lyakabikwa kubbazu kujwe lyachikkombelo, kalilangide kubbazu kumusanza.
Hulamu wakapanga mipika, badiiko, azisambilo nzyakusansayizya. Aboobo Hulamu wakamaninsya mulimu ngwakalikuchita mwami Solomoni mung'anda ya Leza:

minsi yobile, azyakali kubanga nzisambilo zyakanzikidwe ajulu lyaminsi ibili, alimwi azipani zibili zyazibezwa zyebesi zyakali kuvumba zibanga nzisambilo zyakali ajulu lyamiinsi zyakalibikkidwe ajulu amiinsi.

Wakachita ma pomegilanayiti ali mwanda yoone atunsabwe twebeka twamitabi: mindaando iibili yama pomegilanayiti akamwi kansabwe achimikililo kukuvumbya mitabi yobile ilimbuli chimikililo echo chakali aminsende.
Alimwi wakachita zyimikililo azisambilo kuti zibikwe azyimikililo;
lwizi lomwe abasune balikkumi ababili kunsi alyo,
alimwi amipika, badiko, mfologwe, azimwi zyoonse zibelesyo ezyo Hulamu -Abbi nzyakachita akuzibumuzya mukkuba wamwami Solomoni, Kung'anda ya Jehova.
Mwami wakabafulila muntandabale ya Jodani, munyika yabulongo akkati ka Sakkoti a Zaletani.
Nguwenya Solomoni nguwakachita zyonse ezi mubupati amubwiingi; aboobo bulemu bwamukkuba tabuchizibinkani.
Solomoni nguwe wakamaninsya zyonse zyakali mung'anda ya Leza, achipayililo changolida, amatafula akubikila zibunge zyabuliwo bwakwe zyakelede kubikwa;
zyimikililo zyamalampi antomwe amalampi azyo, ayo akapangilidwe kuti kanomunika kunembo lya ng'anda yamukkati-ezi zyakapangidwe andolida yanchoonzyo;
alimwi amaluba luba, zimunisyo, alumano, zyangolida, angolida isalalisya.

Alubo atugele twamalampi, zisambilo, bachooncho, alimwi atununkilizyo tuumpwa zyoonse zyakachitidwe angolida usalala. Kukwamba kumanjililo akuya mung'anda, imakoma amukkati akunjila mubusena busalala amakkoma ang'anda, kwamba kuti, amuntempele, akachitidwe angolida.

Eelyo milimo eyo Solomoni njakachitila ing'anda ya Jehova niyakamana, Solomoni wakanjizya zintu ezyo Davida, wisi wakwe, nzyakabikilide mulimo oyu, kubikilizya nsiliva, angolide, alimwi azyoonse zibelesyo wakazibika muchiyobwedo chang'anda ya Leza.

Mpawo Solomoni waka bungania bapati ba Izilayeli, boonse basilutwe balunyngu, alimwi abazuluzi bampuli zyabantu ba Izilayeli, mu Jelusalemu, kuti beete bbokesi lyachizuminano mudolopo lya Devidi, kwamba kuti, Ziyoni.
Bonse balumi ba Izilayeli bakabungana antomwe kunembo lyamwami kupobwe, elyo lyakachitwa mumwezi wamusanu ayibili.
Boonse bapati ba Izilayeli, alimwi aba Levayiti bakanyampula bbokesi.
Bakabweza ibbokesi, atente lyakuswanana, azyonse zisalala zyabelesya ezyo zyakali mutente. Bapayizi abo bakali balunyungu lwa Levi bakayete zintu ezi.
Mwami Solomoni ambungano yoonse ya Izilayeli yakeeza antomwe kunembo lyabbokesi, bapayilizya mbelele ang'ombe ezyo zitabaliki.
Bapayizi bakanjizya ibbokesi lyachizuminano cha Jehova kubisena bwelyo, mukati kang'anda, kubusena busalalisya, munsi lyamababa aba kkelubbimu.
Nkambo kkelibbimu bakali tandabikide mababa abo atala lyabusena bwabbokesi, alimwi bakavumbilila ibbokesi azisamu nzilyakanyampuzigidwe.
Zisamu zyakali zilamfu loko elyo kumpela lyazyo kwakali kuboneka kuzwa kubusena busalala kunembo lya ng'anda yamukati, pesi tezyakali kuboneka pe kuzwa aanze. Mpuzili akuzuba elino.
Takwepe chakalimo mubbokesi do mabwe obile ayo Mozesi ngakali wabikka mukati ku Holebbu, elyo Jehova nakachita chizuminano abantu ba Izilayeli, elyo nebakabbuda mu Ijiputi.
Awo nikwakasika kuti bapayizi babbude kuzwa kubusena busalala. Boonse bapayizi abo bakaliwo bakalisalazya lwabo kuli Jehova, akutalikatazya kumakani azyaabilo zyabo.

Alubo ba Levayiti abo bakali basikwimbilila, bonse, akubikilizya a Asafu, Hamani, Jedutuni, abana babo, abakwabo, bakazwata masani atuba alimwi bakali basikusibana zisobano, tuntimbwa atunamaala alimwi bakalimvwi kubbazu lyakujwe lyachipayilo. Kabali 120 bapayizi kabali kusiba myeembo.

Alimwi nikwakasika kuti basikusiba mweembo abasikwiimba kabelede kutelezya majwi abo mbuli ijwi lyomwe kukutembawula akakulumba Jehova. Bakasumpula majwi aabo amyeembo atuntimbwa azimwi zibelesyo, alimwi bakatembawula Jehova. Bakayimba, ''Nkambo mubotu, luzyalo lwakwe talumani.'' Mpawo ing'anda, ing'anda ya Jehova, yakazuzigwa ajoba.
Bapayizi bakakachilwa kwimikila kuti babeleke nkambo kajoba, nkambo kabulemu bwa Jehova bwakazuzya ng'anda yakwe.
Mpawo Solomoni wakati, ''Jehova wakamba kuti uyokkala mumudima usiya mbii,
pesi ndakuyakila ng'anda ndamfu, ibusena bwako kuti ukakkale kwalyoonse.''
Mpawo mwami wakachebukila mpawo walongezya mabunga woonse aba Izilayeli, nkaachimvwi woonse mabunga aba Izilayeli.
Wakati, ''Ikaka Jehova, Leza waba Izilayeli, alumbayizigwe, oyo wakambula kuli Davida taata, mpawo wazuzikizya amaboko akwe mwini, waamba kuti,

''Kwinda zuba elyo ndindakagwisya bantu bangu kuzwa munyika ya Ijiputi, takwe chisi nchindakasala kuzwa kumikowa yoonse ya Izilayeli kukuyaka ng'anda yangu, kuchitila zina lyangu kuti likabe nkuko. Nekuba kusala naba omwe muntu kuti akabe mwendelezi atala lyabantu bangu Izilayeli.
Nekuba boobo, ndasala Jelusalemu, kuchitila kuti izina lyangu likabe nkuko, mpawo ndasala Davidi kuti abe atala lyabantu bangu Izilayeli.'
Lino chakali mumoyo wa Davidi taata, kuti ayakile izina lya Jehova ing'anda, Leza wa Izilayeli.
Pesi wakati kuli taata Davidi, 'Mulichecho chakali mumoyo wako kuti uyakile izina lyangu ing'anda, wakachita chibotu kulinchicho kuti chiibe mumoyo wako.
Nekuba boobo, tokoyoyaka pe ng'anda; pesi, mwana wako, oyo uyozwa mumaala ako, uyoyakila ng'anda izina lyangu.'
Jehova wazuzikizya majwi akwe ngaakambide, mebo ndabuka muchibaka cha Devidi, taata, mpawo ndikkede achuno cha Izilayeli, mbuli Jehova mbwakasyomezya. Ndakayakila izina lya Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli.
Ndibikide ibbokesi nkuko, momumo muli chizuminano cha Jehova, nchakatangana abantu ba Izilayeli.''
Solomoni wakayimikila kunembo lyachipayililo cha Jehova kunembo lyamabunga woonse a Izilayeli, mpawo wakatandabika maboko akwe.

Nkambo wakapangide chimikilo chamukkuba, tukokola tuli musanu bulamfu, musanu tukokola kukwiinga, mpawo tukkokola tuli tutatu bwiime. Wakachibika mukkati mubusena wakimikila atala lyacho mpawo wafugama kunembo lyamabunga oonse aba Izilayeli, mpawo watandabika maboko akwe kumajulu.

Wakati, Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, takwepe umbi Leza ukozyania anduwe kujulu nikuba anyika ano ansi, abo babamba chizuminano aluayandolwakwe luteeli abalanda bako abo beenda kunembo lyako amyoyo yabo yoonse;
lwako oyo wakabamba amulanda wako Devidi taatesu, echo nchwakamusyomezya. Iyi wakamba amulomo wako akuzuzikizya akuboko kwako, mbuli mbukubede sunu.

Nkambo kako, Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, wazuzikizya echo nchaka syomezezye kumulanda wakwe Davidi taata, eelyo niwakati, 'Tokoyokachilwa kuba amuntu kumenso angu utakakkale achuno cha Izilayeli, na bana bako beenda kabotu mumilawu yangu, mbuli mbwakeenda kunembo lyangu.'
Nkiinkako, Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, chita ijwi lyako lizuzikizigwe, nduwe wakambula kumulanda wako Davida.

Pesi sa Leza nchobeni ulakkala abantu aansi ano? Langa ijulu ajulu lwalyo tokonzyi kukkala - lino ukkale buti muchikombelo echi nchindakayaka! Nekuboobo ndakumbila ulemeke chikombyo chamulanda wako ankumbizyo zyakwe,
Jehova Leza wangu; swilila kukwila achikombyo echo mulanda wako nchakombya kunembo lyako.
Ikaka menso ako ajule kunembo lyachikombelo echi buzuba amansiku, ibusena oko nkowakasyomezya kubika izina lyako. Ikaka koswilila kuchikombyo mulanda wako nchakomba kubusena obu.
Swilila kunkombizyo zyamulanda wako akubantu ba Izilayeli elyo netukomba kunembo lyabusena obu. Iyii koswilila kuzwa kubusena oko nkokkala, kuzwa kumajulu; mpawo elyo niwaswilila, kolekelela.
Namuntu wabisizya simabambanwa wakwe mpawo wasungilizigwa kukonka chikonke, mpawo nawasika akukonka chikonke kunembo lyachipayililo chako mung'anda eyi,
swilila kuzwa kumajulu akuchita. Beteka balanda bako, ubeteke sizibi akumupa echo nchakachita atala amutwe wakwe munini. Pesi mululami komululamika akumupa zyendelene abululami bwakwe.
Elyo bantu ba Izilayeli nibayokonwa kuli sinkondonyina nkambo babisizya nduwe, nababoola kuli nduwe, bambazina lyako, bakomba, akukumbila lulekelelo kunembo lyako muchikombelo echi -
aboobo ikaka koswilila kuzwa kumajulu mpawo lekelela chibi chabantu ba Izilayeli; kobaboozya kunyika eyo njiwakabapa akuli bamawisi babo.
Elyo majulu ajala mpawo nkakutakwe mvula nkambo bantu babisizya nduwe - na bakomba kunembo lyabusena obu, akwiita zina lyako, akuboola kuzwa kuzibi zyabo elyo noli kubapenzya --

aboobo swilila kujulu akulekelela zibi zyabalanda bako mpawo azyabantu ba Izilayeli, eelyo niwabayiisya inzila mbotu mulinjiyo njibelede kwendela. Kolosya mvula anyika yako, eyo njowakapa bantu bako mbuli lukono.
Na mwaba inzala munyika, kana kuti kwaba idwazi, naa ndyomba na sikunkwe, na chisozi, na bachamusokonia; na kuti basinkondonyina babasinkilizya mumyunzi munyika yabo, na kufumbwa penzi na idwazi --
mpawo nakuti ezyo nkombyo azikumbizyo zyachitwa amuntu na abantu boonse ba Izilayeli--umwi awumwi nkazi ipenzi abuusu mumoyo wakwe mbuli mbwatandabika maboko akwe kunembo lyachikombelo echi.
Aboobo koswilila kuzwakujulu, kubusena oko nkokkala; lekelela, akupa mpindu woonse muntu mbuli inzila zyakwe; uluzi moyo wakwe, nkambo nduwe olikke oozi myoyo yabantu.
Chita echi kuchitila kuti bakuyoowe, bakonzye kwenda munzila zyako zyonse mazuba ayo ngibapona anyika eyo njowakabapa kuli basikale.
Alakwe mwenzu utali umwi wabantu bako ba Izilayeli, pesi uzwa kuchisi chakule nkambo kazina lyako paati, kuboko kwako kupati, akuboko kwako kutandabete -- basika kuzokkomba kunembo lya ng'anda eyi,

aboobo koswilila kuzwa kujulu, kubusena oko nkokkala, mpawo chitila zyoonse ezyo bazwakule nzibakakumbila kuli nduwe, kuchitila kuti boonse bantu baansi bazibe izina lyako akukuyoowa, mbuli mbubachita bantu bako ba Izilayeli, mpawo akuti bakonzye kuziba kuti eyi ng'anda ninda kayaka yiitwa muzina lyako.
Naa bantu bako bayakukulwana abasinkondonyina, kufumbwa nkobatuma, mpawo na bakomba kuli nduwe chakulanga kumunzi uuno ngosalide akung' anda njinjakilide izina lyako.
Aboobo koswilila kuzwa kujulu kunkombyo zyabo, chikumbizyo, akubagwasya makani.
Nakuti bakubisizya -- nkambo takwepe naba omwe uutabiosyi--mpawo na wabanyemena akubaaba kuli basinkondonyina, kuti batolwe mubuzike kuchisi chimbi, nikuba kule nikuba kufwifwi.

Nakuti bayibuluka kuti balimunyika oko nkubatolwa, mpawo na basanduka akuyandula luzyalo kuzwa kuli nduwe omo munyika yabuzike bwabo. Na kuti baamba, 'Twaka chita chakule akukubisizya. Twakaleya akutyola mulawu.'

Nakuti bajoka kuli nduwe achamyoyo yabo yoonse achamiyeyo yoonse omo munyika yabuzike bwabo, oko nkubakabatola, mbuli bazike, mpawo na bakombela nyika yabo, eyo njiwakapa bamawisi, akuchisi echo nchiwakasala,akukombela chisi echo nchiwakabapa kuli basikale babo, alimwi akudolopo elyo ndiwakasa,alimwi akung'anda eyo njindakayakila  izina lyako.
Alimwi kotelela kunkombyo zyabo kuzwa kumajulu, kubusena nkokkala, akunkumbizyo zyabo, akubagwasizya kumakani abo. Kolekelela bantu bako, abo bakakubisizya.
Lino, Leza wangu, ndakumbila, chita menso ako ajulwe, mpawo chita matwi ako aswilile kunkombyo ezyo zichitwa mubusena obu.

Nkiinkako kobuka, Jehova Leza, kubusena bwachilyokezezyo chako, lwako abbokesi lyanguzu zyako. Chita bapayizi bako, Jehova Leza, basamikwe alufutuko, mpawo chita basikukusyoma bako, basekelele mububotu bwako.
Jehova Leza, utafutatili busyu bwamunanike wako. Koyibuluka luzyalo lwako nduwakatangana a Davidi mulanda wako.''
Lino kuchiindi Solomoni nakamana kukomba, mulilo wakaza aansi kuzwa kujulu akusyukuta zituuzyo zyakuumpa azipayizyo, mpawo bulemu bwa Jehova bwakazuzya n'anda.
Bapayizi tebakachili kunjila mun'anda ya Jehova nkambo kabulemu bwakwe bwakazyuzya n'anda yakwe.

Muchindi bantu bonse ba Izilayeli nibakabona mulilo waseluka aansi abulemu bwa Jehova atala angánda, bakakotamisya masyu aabo ansi mukazila kakuli Jehova. Bakati, ''Nkambo mubotu, nkambo chizuminano chalulemeko lwakwe chibe kwalyoonse.''
Mpawo mwaami abantu boonse bakatula zipayizyo kuli Jehova.
Mwaami Solomoni wakatula zipayizyo zili makumi aabili atubili zyazyuulu zyamatanga ang'ombe alimwi a 120,000 mbelele ampongo. Mpawo mwaami abantu boonse bakasalazya n'anda ya Leza.

Bapayizi bakayimikila, awumwi kayimvwi nkubabelekela; ba Levi abalabo kabali azibelesyo zyakwimbisya nyimbo zya Jehova, ezyo mwaami Devidi nzyakapangide kuti ape kulumba kuli Jehova mulwimbo, ''Nkambo chizuminano chakwe chikabe kwalyonse chakusyomekesya.'' Bapayizi bonse bakalizya myeembo kunembo lyabo, mpawo, mpawo ba Izilayeli boonse bakayimikila.

Solomoni wakasalazya akati kalubuwa kunembo lya n'anda ya Jehova oko nkwakatuula chituuzyo chakuumpa achamafuta akulidilizyana,  nkambo chipayililo chamukuba chakali bumbidwe techakali kukonzya pe kubweza zituuzyo zyakuumpa zituuzyo zyazilyo, amafuta
Elyo Solomoni wakachita pobwe kuchiindi echo kwamazuba alimusanu aabili, aba Izilayeli boonse kabali anguwe, imbungano mpati loko, kuzwa ku Lebbo Hamati kusika kukalonga ka Ijiputi.
Mubuzuba bwamusanu aatatu bakachita imbungano isalala nkambo bakabamba kupedekezya kwa chipayililo kwamazuba musanu aabili apobwe kwamazuba musanu aabili.

Mubuzuba bwamakumi abili aatatu bwamumweezi wamusanu ayibili, Solomoni wakabwedezya bantu kumyunzi yabo amyoyo kiboteledwe akukondwa nkambo kabubotu Jehova mbwakatondezya kuli Devidi, Solomoni, aba Izilayeli, bantu bakwe.
Nkinkaako Solomoni wakamaninsya n'anda ya Jehova an'anda yakwe. Zyoonse eezyo zyakasika mumoyo wa Solomoni kuti achite mun'anda ya
Jehova amun'anda wakalibonia kuli Solomoni mansiku akwamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Ndamvwa inkombyo yako, alimwi ndasala busena obu kuba bwangu mbuli n'anda yakupayilila.
Atwambe kuti ndajala majulu kuti kutawi imvula, na ndalayilila chisozi kuti chilye nyika, na ndatuma malwazi akati kabantu bangu,
eelyo na bantu bangu, bayitwa muzina lyangu, balibombya, bakomba, bayanduula busyu bwangu, akusiya nzila zyabo zyabubi, ndiyomvwa kuzwa kujulu, kulekelela chibi chabo, akusilika nyika yabo.
Lino meso angu ayojulika amatwi angu ayoswilila kunkombyo ziyochitwa mubusena oobu.
Nkaambo lino ndasala akusalazya n'anda eeyi kuti izina lyangu ngalilaba mumo kwalyoonse. Menso angu a moyo wangu ziyoba nkuko mazuba woonse.
Mbuli nduwe, na weenda musule lyangu mbuli wuso Devidi mbwakenda, kuswilila zyoonse nzindakulayilila akubamba milawu yangu,
eelyo ndiyotanga chuuno chabwami bwako, mbuli mbundakaamba muchizuminano awuso Devidi, nindakamba kuti, 'Lunyungu lwako talukoyokachilwa kuba mwendelezi mu Izilayeli.'
Pesi na mwaleya, akusiya milawu amilayizyo yangu njindakamubikila kunembo lyenu alubo na mwayinka akukomba baleza bambi akuba kotamina,

eelyo ndiyobanonkoola kuzwa kunyika yangu njindakabapa. Eeyi n'anda njindakalisalila akambo kezina lyangu ndiyoyimwaya kuzwa kunembo lyangu, alimwi ndiyoyichita kuba nsesya achisesyo akati kabantu boonse.
Nekuba kuti n'anda ya Leza eyi lino ileebeka, woonse uyinda mpawo uyogamba akuyonyontooka. Bayobuzya kuti, 'Nkaambonzi Jehova naachita eechi kunyika eyi a ku n'anda eyi?'

Bamwi bayosandula kuti, 'Nkambvo bakakaka Jehova, Leza wabo, wakagusya basikale babo kuzwa kunyika ya Ijiputi, alimwi bakajatilila kuli baleza bambi akuba kotamina akubakomba. Nchinchicho Jehova nchakabaletela lunyonyoono olu loonse kulimbabo.''
Kwakaba kuti kumamanino amyaaka ili makumi aabili, muchiindi echo Solomoni nakayaka n'anda ya Jehova alimwi ayakwe n'anda,
kuti Solomoni wakayakulula madolopo Hilamu ngakamupa, alimwi wakakkazika bantu ba Izilayeli muli ngawo.
Solomoni wakalwisya Hamatizoba akumuzunda.
Wakayaka Tadimo munkanda, awoonse magunzi aziyobwedo, ayo ngakayaka mu Hamati.
Alubo wakayaka Bbeti Holoni yaatala a Bbeti Holoni yamukkuti, magunzi akwabilidwe amalambo, milyango, azibulo.

Wakayaka Bbalati amagunzi woonse aziyobwedo ayo ngakalawo, amagunzi woonse ankalaki zyakwe amagunzi abasimbongolo bakwe, alimwi kufumbwa nchayanda kuyaka  chimukonda mu Jelusalemu, mu Lebbanoni, amuzisi zyoonse zili ansi abwendelezi bwakwe.
Kwabantu bonse abo bakachaala baba Hiti Amoli, ba Pelizi, ba Hivi, aba Jebbusi, batali ba Izilayeli,
inyungu zyabo zyakasyaala mukwinda kwabo minyaka, abo mbibate bakanyonyoona bantu ba Izilayeli - Solomoni wakabaangila kuba basimilimu, ezyo nzibabede kusika sunu.
Nekubaboobo, Solomoni taakangila basimilimu kubantu ba Izilayeli. Anukuti, bakaba basilumamba bakwe, bapati bampi, basimilimo yabwendelezi, bapati babasimpi yankalaki zyakwe abasimbongolo bakwe.
Aba alubo bakali babelesi bapati bakwendelezya basikubelesya abo bakali ba Mwaami Solomoni, 250, abo bakabelesya bantu bakali kuchita milimu.

Solomoni wakaleta mwana wakwe musimbi wa Falo kuzwa aanze mugunzi lya Devidi kuya ku n'anda eyo njakamuyakila, nkambo wakati, ''Mukayintu wangu teelede kukkala mu n'anda ya Devidi mwaami wa Izilayeli, nkambo kufumbwa oko bbokesi lya Jehova nkulyakasika kulasalala.''
Mpawo Solomoni wakapa zipo zyakuumpa kuli Jehova achitentelo nchaakali wayaka kunembo lya n'anda yakwe.

Wakaaba zituuzyo mbuli mabambe amazuba woonse; wakabapa, kutobelezya malayilile  ajanika mumilayizyo ya Mozesi, mumazuba a Sabata, mumyezi mipya, akumapobwe abambidwe tutatu amunyaka: Pobwe lyachinkwa chitakwe bumena, pobwe lyansondo ansondo, a pobwe lyamadumba.

Mukubamba makani akasinizigwa aa wisi Devidi, Solomoni wakasala akusayinisya bapayizi kumilimu yabo, aba Levi muzibela zyabo, kuchitila kutembawula Leza akubeleka kunembo lyaba Payizi, mbuli mabambe abuzuba abuzuba mbwakali kuyandika. Wakasala alubo basikubamba milyango kusiyanisya kumulyango woonse, nkambo Devidi, muntu wa Leza, wakazilayilila azyalo ezi.
Aba bantu tebakaleya kuzwa kumilayizyo ya Mwaami kuba payizi akuba Levi atala kufumbwa makani, naa atala amaanda aziyobwedo.
Mulimu woonse wakaambwa a Solomoni wakamana, kuzwa kubuzuba intalisyo ya n'anda ya Jehova niyakabikwa kusikila yamana.
N'anda ya Jehova yakamana. Mpawo Solomoni wakayaku Eziyoni Gebba alimwi aku Elati kunkonkosi, munyika ya Edomu.

Hilamu wakamutumina maato ayendelezegwa abasimilimu bakwe, baalumi balizi lwizi, antomwe ababelesi ba Solomoni bakaya ku Odfa akuyobweza kuzwa oko 450 yamatalenta angolide akwaleta ku Mwaami Solomoni.

Mwaami wachanakazi waku Shebba nakamvwa mpuuwo zya Solomoni, wakeza ku Jelusalemu kuzomweezya amibuzyo miyumu. Wakeeza ampuumba ndamfu, ulankamela zinyampuzidwe tununkilizyo, ngolida nyiingi, amabwe mayingi mayandisi. Nakasika kuli Solomoni, wakamwambila zyoonse zyakali mumoyo wakwe.
Solomoni wakasandula mibuzyo yakwe yoonse; takukwe mubuzyo oyo ngwatakasandula pe.
Mwaami mwanakazi waku Shebba nakabona busongo bwa Solomoni amaanda abwaami ngakayaka,

zyakulya antafula yakwe, makkalilo abalanda bakwe, mulimu wabalanda bakwe azisamo zyabo, abalabo basikumukutawukila azisamo zyabo, alimwi azipo zyakuumpa nzyakachita kun'anda ya Jehova, takachili alyakwaamba pe mulinguwe.
Wakati kumwaami, ''Niinchonzyo, impuwo njindakamvwa munyika yangu yamajwi aako abusongo bwako.
Tendakasyoma nzindakamvwa kusikila ndasika aano, alimwi kwalino menso angu achibona. Teechisela pe nchindakaambilwa atala abusongo bwako abuvubi ! Wayinda mpuwo eyo njindakamvwa atala anduwe.
Balongezezegwe byeni balumi bako, alimwi balongezezegwe biyeni balanda bako bayima kunembo lyako lyoonse, nkambo bamvwa busongo bwako.

Alongezegwe Jehova Leza wako, wakakondelwa mulinduwe, oyo wakakubika achuuno chakwe chabulemu, kuba mwaami wa Jehova Leza wako. Nkambo Leza wako wakayanda Izilayeli, kuti abayumye kwalyoonse, wakakuchita kuti ube mwaami wabo, kuti uchite mbukwelede abululami !''
Wakapa mwaami 120 amatalenta angolida amulwi mupati watununkilizyo amabwe mabotu. Takukwe nikwakali kwaba tununkilizyo tulimbuli otu ooto mwaami mwanakazi waku Shebba ntwakapa mwaami Solomoni.
Balanda ba Hilamu abalanda ba Solomoni, abo bakaleta ngolida kuzwa ku Ofu, alubo bakaleta zisamu zyamu alugomu amabwe mabotu.

Azisamu zyamu alugamu, mwaami wakachita matantilo akun'anda ya Jehova aakun'anda yakwe, atulato tuntimbwa amitetele yabasikwiimba. Takukwe zisamu zyakali mbuli eezi zyakabwenekede lutanzi munyika ya Juda.
Mwaami Solomoni wakapa mwaami wachanakazi waku Shebba zyoonse nzyakayanda akufumbwa nchakalomba, wakamupa zyiinda nzyakaleta kumwaami. Mpawo wakazwa akubweda kunyika yakuli mbabo, we abalanda bakwe.
Lino bulemu bwangolida obo bwakasika kuli Solomoni mumunyaka umwi bwakali 666 amatalenta angolida,
kutaamba angolide yakaletwa aba sikuula aba sambazi. Baami boonse ba Alabbiya abendelezi munyika bakaleta ngolida ansiliva kuli Solomoni.
Mwaami Solomoni wakapanga myaanda yobile yantobo mpati zichitidwe angolide. Masyekeli aali miyanda musanu alimwi alikunjila mulimwi ayimwi.
Alubo wakapanga ntobo zichitidwe angolida zili myaanda iitatu. Zikoto zitatu zyangolida zyalikunjila kuli iimwi ayimwi intobo; mwaami wakazibika mun'anda yakulusaka lwa Lebbanoni.
Mpawo mwaami wakapanga chuuno chabwami chipati chameja akuchibika ngolida ikwizingidwe.

Kwakali matantilo ali musanu alimwi kusika achuuno chabwami, achakubika mawulu chakali namatizidwe kuchuuno chabwami. Kuli limwi alimwi bbazu lyachuuno chabwami kwakali zyakugwabamikila maboko kazijilabalavu babili bayimvwi kulubazu kwachimwi achimwi.
Balavu kkumi ababili bakalimvwi amatantilo, umwi ambali lyamatantilo woonse kali musanu alimwi. Takukwe nikwakali chuuno chabwami mbuli nchicho mubwami bumbi.

Zyonse nkomeki zyakunywida zyamwaami Solokoni zyakali zyangolida, azyonse nkomeki zyakunywida mun'anda yakulusaka lwa Lebbanoni zyakali zyangolida mubotu. Takwepe yakali yansiliva nkambo nsiliva teyali abulemu mumazuba akwe Solomoni.
Mwaami wakali amaato miingi kulwizi ayenda mulwiizi lupati antomwe amaato miingi a Hilamu. Kamwi mumyaaka itatu maato miingi alikuleta ngolida, nsiliva, ameja, abalo bachimpanze abasokwe.
Mawo mwaami Solomoni wakayinda baami boonse bamunyika mubuvubi abusongo.
Baami boonse banyika bakayandula kubakwa Solomoni kuchitila kuti bamvwe busongo bwakwe, obo Leza mbwakabika mumoyo wakwe.
Abo bakali kuswaya bakali kuleta zipo, mitiba yansiliva ayangolida, zisamo, zilwanyo, atununkilizyo, azyalo mbongolo abana bazyo, munyaka amunyaka.
Solomoni wakali azyuulu ziine zyazyaata zyambongolo ankalaki, azyuulu zilikkumi azibili zyabasimbongolo, eezyo nzyakabika mumagunzi ankalaki anguwe mu Jelusalemu.
Wakeendelezya baami boonse kuzwa kumulonga Ifuleti kusika kunyika yaba Filisitina, akumugano wa Ijiputi.
Mwaami wakali ansiliva mu Jelusalemu nyiingi mbuli mabwe aalubuwa. Wakachita misamu yasiida ivule mbuli mikuyu yasikkamo eyo ilimunyika zyamukkuti.
Bakeetela Solomoni imbongolo kuzwa ku Ijipiti akuzwa kunyika zyoonse.

Kuli zimwi zyaambo zyendelana a Solomoni, chakutanguna akumaninizya, sena tazilembedwe mulwaano lwa Natani musinsimi, muchisinsimi chakwe Ahija mu Shiito, amuzilengano zya Ayido sikubona ( zyakali amakani aatala a Jelobbowamu mwana mulombe wa Nebbati )?
Solomoni wakeendelezya mu Jelusalemu a Izilayili yoonse kwaminyaka makumi aane.
Wakoona abasikale bakwe alimwi bantu bakamuzika mumunzi wa Devidi wisi wakwe Lehobbowamu, mwana wakwe mulombe, wakaba mwaami mubusena bwakwe.
Lehobbowamu wakayinka ku Sekkemu nkambo ba Izilayeli boonse bakali kusika ku Sekkemu kuyomuchita mwaami.
EelyoJelobbawamu mwana mulombe wa Nebbati nakamvwa eechi ( nkambo wakali mu Ijiputi, nkwakali wachijila kuzwa ku Mwaami Solomoni ), wakabweda kuzwa ku Ijiputi.
Mpawo bakatuma akuyomwiita, alimwi Jelobbowamu aba Izilayeli boonse bakasika; bakaambula kuli Lehobbowamu akwaamba kuti,
''Wuso wakatulemezya aajokwe lyesu. Nkiinkako lino, wuubya jokwe idemu eelyo ndyakabikka aali ndiswe, mpawo tuyokubelekela.''
Lehobbowamu wakaamba kuti kulimbaabo, ''Mubweede lubo kuli ndime mazuba aatatu aamana.'' Mpawo bantu bakayiinka.
Mwaami Lehobbowamu wakabuzyania aabalumi bapati aabo bakayiimvwi kunembo lya Solomoni wisi kachipona; wakaamba kuti, ''Ngamulandilaya buti kuti ndilete nsandulo kubantu aaba ?''
Bakaambula kuli nguwe akwaamba kuti, ''Naa uli mubotu kubantu aaba akubabotezya, akwamba majwi mabotu kulimbabo,  eelyo nayoba bazike bako lyoonse.''
Pesi Lehobbowamu wakanyansya lulayo lwa baalumi bapati oolo ndobakamupede, akubuzyanya abakubusi baluumi aabo bakakomena limwi aanguwe, bakayimvwi kunembo lyakwe.
Wakaamba kuti kulimbabo, ''Ndulayoonzi ndomundipa, kuti tusandule bantu aabo bakaambula kulindime akwaamba kuti, Wubya jokwe eelyo wuso ndyakabikka aalindiswe?''

Bakubusi baalumi aabo bakakomena limwi a Lehobbowamu bakambuula kuli nguwe, bakati, ''Mbuboobu mboyelede kwambuula kubantu aabo bakakwambila kuti Wuso Solomoni wakabalemezya jokwe lyabo pesi kuti ulyuubye.  Ncheechi nchoyelede kwaamba kuli mbabo, kantengeza kangu nkapatimkwinda chikungu chataata.
Mpawo lino, nikuba taata wakamulemezya ajokwe demu, ndiyoyungizya kujokwe lyenu. Taata wakamuuma amoondo, pesi mebo ndiyoomuma atubanze.''
Mpawo Jelobbowamu abantu boonse bakasika kuli Lehobbowamu mubuzuba bwatatu, mbubonya mwaami mbwakambide kuti, ''Mubweede kuli ndime mubuzuba bwataatu.''
Lehobbowamu wakambula chabukali kuli mbabo, kanyansya lulayo lwabalumi bapati.
Wakaambula kuli mbabo kabotelezya lulayo lwabakubusi baluumi, wakati, ''Taata wakamulemezya aajokwe, pesi mebo ndiyomuyungizya aalindilyo. Taata wakamuuma amoondo, pesi mebo ndiyomuuma atubanze.''
Eelyo mwaami takwe nakaswilila kubantu pe, nkaambo zyakali zyazwa kuli Leza, kuti Jehova welede kugwisya jwi lyakwe eelyo Ahija mu Silo ndyakambuula kuli Jelobbowamu mwana mulombe wa Nebbati.

Ba Izilayeli boonse nibakabona kuti mwaami taakwe nakaswilila kuli mbabo, bantu bakamusandula akwamba kuti, ''Nchaabilonzi nchotujisi muli Devidi ? Tatukwe lukono mumwana mulombe wa Jese ! Umwi awumwi wanu weelede kubweeda kuteente lyakwe, Izilayeli. Lino bona kun'anda yako nomwini, Devidi.'' Mpawo ba Izilayeli boonse bakabweeda kumateente aabo,
Pesi mbuli bantu ba Izilayeli abo balikukkala mumyuunzi ya Juda, Lehobbowamu wakabeendelezya.

Elyo Mwaami Lehobbowamu wakatuma Adonilamu, ooyo wakali mupati wachibbalo, pesi bantu ba Izilayeli bakamutulula mabwe mane wakafwa aamabwe. Mwaami Lehobbowamu wakachijila munkalaki chakufwambana waya ku Jelusalemu.
Mpawo Izilayeli wakaba mubupapi aatala an'anda ya Devidi kusikila sunu.
Elyo Lehobbowamu nakasika mu Jelusalemu, wakabungania n'anda ya Juda a Bbenjamini, 180,000 balumi bakalisalidwe bakali basilumamba, kuti balwane a Izilayeli, kuti baboozye bwami kuli Lehobbowamu.
Pesi ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli Semayiya muntu wa Leza, akwamba kuti,
''Amba kuti kuli Lehobbowamu mwana mulombe wa Solomoni, Mwaami wa Juda, aku Izilayeli yoonse mu Juda a Bbenjamini,

Jehova waamba echi, ''Toyelede kumulutuzya na kuchita nkondo kubana atala abakwanu. Woonse welede kubweeda kun'anda, yakwe nkambo ndachita echi kuti chibewo.'''''  Mpawo bakalemeka majwi a Jehova alimwi bakabweda kuzwa kukulwisya Lehobbowamu.
Lehobbowamu wakakkede mu Jelusalemu alimwi wakayaka miinzi mu Juda yachikwabilizyo.
Wakayaka Bbetelehemu, Etamu, Tekoya,
Bbeti, Zuwa, Sokko, Adulamu,
Gati, Malesha, Zifu,
Adolayimu, Lekkishi, Azekka,
Zola, Ayijaloni, a Hebbuloni. Eyi njimyuunzi yakali bayilidwe mu Juda a Bbenjamini.
Wakabayilila mayake akubika basilutwe mulingawo, kalazibikilo zyachakulya, amafuta, a wyini.
Wakabikka intobo amasumu mumyuunzi alimwi bakaba basinguzu loko. Eelyo Juda a Bbenjamini zyakaba zyakwe.
Bapayizi aba Levi abo bakali mu Izilayeli yoonse bakaya kunembo kulinguwe kuzwa mumigano yabo.

Mbuli ba Levi bakasiya machelelo a zintu zyabo kuchitila kuti baye ku Juda a Jelusalemu, nkambo Jehobbowamu abana bakwe balombe bakabagwisya eelyo tebakachili kukonzya kuchita mulimu wabupayizi kuli Jehova.
Jelobbowamu wakalisalila lwakwe mwini bapayizi bamasena ataala ampongo a zitombe zyabana ba ng'ombe nzyakali chitide.
Bantu bazwa kumikowa ya Izilayeli yakaza kunembo lyabo, abo babika myoyo yabo kuyanduula Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, bakeza ku Jelusalemu kuyopayizya kuli Jehova, Leza waba mataata wabo.
Elyo bakayumya  bwami bwa Juda akuchita Lehobbowamu mwana mulombe wa Solomoni kusima kwamyaaka iitaatu, alimwi bakeenda kwamyaaka itaatu munzila ya Davida a Solomoni.
Lehobbowamu wakalibwezela mwanakazi wakwe: Mahalati, mwana musimbi wa Jelimoti, mwana wa Devidi mulombe, alimwi wa Abbihayili, mwana musimbi wa Eliyabbu, mwana mulombe wa Jese.
Wakamuzyalila bana balombe: Jewushi, Shemaliya, a Zahamu.
Nikwakazwa Mahalati, Lehobbowamu wakabweza Maakka, bana basimbi ba Abbisalomu wakamuzyalila Abbija, Atayi, Ziza, a Shelomiti.

Lehobbowamu wakayanda Makka, mwana musimbi wa Abbisalomu, kwinda banakazi bakwe boonse, aba simamambi bakwe ( wakabweza bamakayintu bali kkumi amusanu abatatu amakkumi alimusanu alimwi aba simamambe, alimwi wakaba wisi wabana balombe bali makumi abili aatatu amakkumi alimusanu alimwi abana basimbi ).
Lehobbowamu wakasala Abbija mwana mulombe wa Makka kuti abe Simwaami, mwendelezi akati kabana bakwabo; wakali amuyeyo wakumuchita kuti abe Mwaami.

Lehobbowamu wakeendelezya chabusongo; wakamwayiisya bana bakwe boonse balombe munyika yoonse mbuyizulwa ya Juda a Bbenjamini ku munzi woonse ubayilidwe.Alimwi wakabapa lubo chakulya chiingi akubalangwida banakazi biingi.
Nichakasika chiindi bwendelezi bwa Lehobbowamu bwakalemekwa alimwi wasikuba nguzu, zyakuti wakaleka mulawu wa Jehova - aba Izilayeli boonse mbakali abo.
Chakachitika mumwaka wamusanu wamwaami Lehobbowamu, mwaami wa Ijiputi wakasika kuzolwisya atala a Jelusalemu, nkambo bantu tebakachi syomekede kuli Jehova.
Wakasika ankalaki zili chuulu amyaanda ibili azyuulu zili makumi musanu alimwi zyabasimabbiza. Basilumamba batakwe mweelwe bakasika anguwe kuzwa ku Ijiputi. Ba Libbiya, ba Sukkitisi, aba Kkushitisi.
Wakabweza myuunzi, ikwabilidwe eeyo yakali ya Juda alimwi wakasika ku Jelusalemu.

Lino musinsimi Semayi wakasika kuli Lehobbowamu akubasalali baba Juda bakabungene aamwi ku Jelusalemu akambo ka Sisakki. Semayi wakati kulimbabo, ''Ncheechi Jehova nchawamba: Mwandikkaka, mpawo ambebo ndamupeda mumaboko aa Sisakki.''
Eelyo bana babaambi ba Izilayeli amwaami bakalibombya akwamba kuti, ''Jehova uliluleme.''

Jehova nakabona kuti balibombya lwabo beni, ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli Semayi, kaliti, ''Balibombya beni. Tandikobanyonyoona; ndiyobavuna mulizimwi, abukali bwangu tabukoyotila a Jelusalemu akambo kakuboko kwa Sisakki.
Nekubabobo, byakuba bazike bakwe, kuchitila kuti bakamvwisye kuti nkutyeni kubelekela ndime akubelekela bendelezi bamanyika aambi.''

Mpawo Sisakki, mwaami wa Ijiputi wakasika wabukila Jelusalemu akubweza buvubi bwakali mun'anda ya Jehova, abuvubi bwakali mun'anda yamwaami. Wakabweza zyoonse; alubo wakabweza intobo zyangolida ezyo Solomoni nzyakachitide.
Mwaami Lehobbowamu wakachita intobo zyamukkuba mubusena bwazyo akuzipa mumaanza abasilutwe babalindizi, bakalikulinda mulyango kun'anda yamwaami.
Chakachitika kuti kufumbwa mwaami nakali kunjila mun'anda ya Jehova, basikulinda bazinyampula, eelyo balikuzibwezedezya mun'anda yabalindizi.
Muchindi Lehobbowamu nakalibombya mwini, lunyemo lwa Jehova lwakazwa kulinguwe, kuchitila kuti atamunyonyooni chakumaninina; kunze kwaboobo, kwakachiliko bamwi babotu bajanika muli Juda. .

Mpawo mwaami Lehobbowamu wakasimya bwami bwakwe mu Jelusalemu, alimwi wakendelezya, mpawo wakendelezya kwamyaka ilikkumi amusanu ayibili mu Jelusalemu, munzi oyo Jehova ngwakalisalilide kuzwa kumisyobo ya Izilayeli kuchitila kuti akabike izina lyakwe nkuko. Izina lyanyina wakali Naama mukayintu mu Amoni.
Wakachita bubi, nkambo takwe nakabika moyo wakwe kukuyandula Jehova.

Kulizimwi zilatala a Lehobbowamu, kukusanguna akumamaninino, sa tazilembedwe mubulembo bwa Semayi musinsimi abwa Ayido sikubona, oobo alubo buli abulembo bwamazyalani akwendelela kwankondo akkati ka Lehobbowamu a Jelobbowamu ?
Lehobbowamu wakoona abasikale bakwe akuzikwa mumuunzi wa Devidi; Abbija mwanakwe mulombe wakazoba ngomwaami aabusena bwakwe.
Mumunyaka wakkumi amusanu ayitatu yamwaami Jelohobbowamu, Abbija wakatanguna kwendelezya Juda.
Wakeendelezya kwamyaaka iitatu mu Jelusalemu, izina lyanyina wakali Mikkaya, mwana musimbi wa Izilayeli waku Gibbiya. Kwakali nkondo akati ka Abbija a Jelobbowamu.

Abbija wakiinka kunkondo abasilumamba basimide, basilumaba bakozu, balumi bali 400,000 bakasalidwe. Jelobbowamu wakabamba mindando yazilwanisyo akati kakwe yakali abalumi bali 800,000 bakasalidwe, basimide, basilumamba bakozu.
Abbija wakimikila achilundu cha Zemalayimu, chili munyika yachilundu cha Efulemu, alimwi wakaamba kuti, ''Muswilile kulindime, Jelobbowamu a moonse noma Izilayeli !
Tamuzina kuti Jehova Leza wa Izilayeli wakapa bwami bwa Izilayeli kuli Devidi alunyungu lwakwe kwalyoonse achizuminano chitamani ?
Pesi Jelobbowamu mwana mulombe wa Nebbati, mulanda wa Solomoni mwanakwe mulombe wa Devidi, wakabuka akupapila simalelo aakwe.

Balumi babuyo, bantu balangilwa aansi, baka mubunganina. Bakasika akupapila Lehobbowamu mwana mulombe wa Solomoni, chiindi Lehobbowamu nakachili mwanikenike alimwi takalikweluzibo pe akutakonzya kubayimikilila.

Eelyo lino nywebo mubamba kukaka bwami bwa Jehova bwakabikwa mumaanza alunyungu lwa Devidi, nkambo muli basilumamba biingi, alimwi mulatunamani twangolide ooto Jelobbowa ntwakamuchitila kuti tube baleza benu.

Pesi temwakanda bapayizi ba Jehova, lunyungu lwa Aaloni, aba Levi, akuchita bapayizi benu munzila ikozyenie abantu bamunyika zimbi mbubachita? Kufumbwa usika akubeleka mbuli mupayizi, kupayilila musune munini abagutu bambelele balimusanu ababili ngawaba mupayizi wabaabo batali baleza.
Pesi mbuli kulindiswe, Jehova ngu Leza wesu alimwi tatuna kumuleka, tulapayizya, lunyungu lwa Aaloni, babelekela Jehova, aba Levi, bali mumilimu yabo.

Chifumo woonse agoko balawumpila Jehova zipayizyo zyakumpilizya atununkilizyo. Alimwi bakali kubamba chinkwa chabuliwo aatebuli lisalala, balikubamba lubo zyakubikila malampe zyangolida nkazili amalampe azyo, kuchitila kuti bawumpe goko agoko. Tulabamba milazyo ya Jehova, Leza wesu, pesi inywe mwamukaka buyo.

Langa, Leza ulandiswe kumutwe wesu, abapayizi bakwe bali waano azyakulizya mweembo kuti alizye mweembo kuti bazomulwisye. Bana balombe ba Izilayeli, mutalwani a Jehova, Leza wabasikale babo, nkambo tamukoyozwidilila pe.''
Pesi Jelobbowamu wakabambila basikuyuba bakali musule lyabo, basilumamba bakwe bakali kunembo lya Juda, abasikuyuba bakali musule lyabo.
Juda nakalanga musule, wakabona, kulwana kwakali koonse kunembo lyabo. Bakalilila Jehova, mpawo bapayizi bakali kulizya myeembo.
Eelyo balumi baku Juda bakakompolola, nibakoompolola, zyakaza mbuli kuti Leza wakawuma Jelobbowamu ama Izilayeli wonse kunembo lya Abbija a Juda.
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakachija kunembo lya Juda, alimwi Leza wakabapeda mumaanza a Juda.
Abbija abasilumamba bakwe bakabajaya aluumo lupati, 500,000 balumi bakasalidwe baku Izilayeli bakajayigwa.
Munzila eeyi, bantu baku Izilayili mbubakachitwa kuchindi eecho; bantu baku Juda bakazwidilila nkambo bakali kuponena kuli Jehova, Leza wabasikale babo.
Abbija wakayindilila kunembo kuli Jelobbowamu; wakabweza myuunzi kuli nguwe: Bbeteli amagunzi awo, Jesana amagunzi aawo, a Efuloni amagunzi aawo.
Jelobbowamu takajana nguzu lubo mumazuba a Abbija; Jehova wakamuuma, mpwawo wakafwa.
Pesi Abbija wakaba anguzu, wakabweza banakazi bakali ikkumi abane alimwi wakaba wisi wabana balombe bali makkumi aabili abana basimbi balikkumi amusanu awumwi.
Yoonse milimu ya Abbija, inchito zyakwe, amajwi alilembedwe mulwaano lwamusinsimi Ayido.
Abbija wakoona abasikale bakwe, alimwi bakamubamba mumuunzi wa Devidi.
Asa mwanakwe mulombe, wakaba mwaami mubusena bwakwe. Mumazuba aakwe anyika yakalumwide kwaminyaka ilikkumi. Asa wakachita zibotu aziluleme mumenso a Jehova Leza wakwe,
nkambo wakagwisya zipayililo zyeenzu amasena aatala. Alimwi kupwaya misemo yamabwe akugonkela aansi matanda a Asila.
Wakalayilila ba Juda kuti bayandawule Jehova, Leza wabasikale wabo, akutobelezya milawu amalayilile.
Aboobo wakabweza masena aatala atununkilizyo twazipayililo kuzwa mumyuunzi yoonse ya Juda. Bwami bwakakkala aansi akwe.
Wakayaka myuunzi ibayilidwe mu Juda, nkambo nyika yakali wumidwe, alimwi takali nkondo mumyaaka eyo, nkambo Jehova wakamupa luumuno.

Nkaambo Asa wakamba kuti kuli Juda, ''Ngatuyake eeyi myuunzi akubikka bulambo buzyungulukide njiiyo, maanda malamfu, milyango, aminkulu; nyika ichili yesu nkambo twayandawula Jehova Leza wesu. Twamuyandawula, alimwi watupa luumuno mumabazu woonse.'' Eelyo bakayaka akuzwidilila.

Asa wakali abasilumamba bakali kunyampula intobo amasumo, kuzwa ku Juda wakali a 300,000 balumi, alimwi kuzwa kuli Bbenjamini, 280,000 balumi bakali kunyampula intobo akuwaala ibuta. Boonse aaba bakali baalumi basinguzu.
Zela mu Kkushiti wakaza kuzobalwisya abasilumamba bali zyuulu zili chuulu enkalaki zili myaanda yotatwe, wakeza ku Malesa.
Eelyo bakabamba kuti aswanane anguwe, alimwi bakabamba miyeyo yazilwanisyo mbuli syena lya Zefata ku Melasa.

Asa wakalayilila kuli Jehova, Leza wakwe alimwi wakati, ''Jehova, takwepe uumbi pesi webo kukugwasya ooyo utakwe nguzu nalangana abanji. Tugwasye, Jehova Leza wesu, nkambo tuponena nduwe, amuzina twasika kuzolwisya, mweelwe mipati eeyi. Jehova , nduwe Leza wesu; utalekeli bantu kuti bakuzunde.''
Eelyo Jehova wakawuma ba Kkushiti kunembo lya Asa a Juda; ba Kkushiti bakachija.

Asa abasilumamba mbakalabo wakaba kombelezya kuli Gela. Eelyo ba Kkushiti biingi bakayeeya aanga tabakopona pe, nkambo bakajayigwa chakumaninsigwa kunembo ya Jehova abasilumamba bakwe. Basilumamba bakabweza misalo myiingi.

Basilumamba bakamwayula myuunzi myiingi yoonse iyaka zyungulukide Geela, nkambo zigambyo ziyosya zya Jehova zyakasika kuzivuubwa. Basilumamba bakasala myuunzi yoonse, alimwi kwakali mbono inyiingi mulinjiyo.
Basilumamba bakamwaya lubo madumba akali kukkala aabo bakali kweembela  bwendeenda. Bakabweza imbelele mubwiingi bwazyo kubikkilizya enkamela, alimwi kuzwa aawo bakabweeda ku Jelusalemu.
Muuya wa Leza wakasika aali Azaliya mwana mulombe wa Obbedi.

Wakazwa kuyoswanana aa Asa akwaamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Ndiswilile, Asa,  aba Juda boonse aba Bbenjamini: Jehova uli anywebo, na nywebo muli anguwe. Na mwamulangula, uyojanwa aandinywe; pesi na mwamutakata, uyomutakata.
Lino kwachiindi chilamfu, Izilayeli tewakali a Leza wanchoonzyo, katakwe mupayizi wakuyiisya, akubula mulawo.
Pesi nibakali mukufwaba bakachebukila kuli Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, akumuyanduula, wakajanwa ambabo.
Mulizeezyo zyiindi tekwakali luumuno kuli yooyo walikuzwa, na kuliyooyo walikunjila; anukuti, mafwabi mapati akali abakkali boonse bamunyika.
Bakapwayikana muzimpanzi, chisi achisi nyina, amunzi amunzinyina, nkambo Leza wakali kubafwabya aamapenzi woonse.
Pesi koyuma, akutazuminina maanza ako kuteta, nkambo mulimu wako uyolumbulwa.''

Asa nakamvwa majwi aya, businsimi bwamusinsimi Obbedi, wakaba mukozu akugwisya zyakali kuchisya moyo kuzwa munyika yoonse ya Juda a Bbenjamini, akuzwa mumyuunzi eeyo njakali wabweza kuzwa kunyika yazilundu zya Efulemu, mpawo wakayakulula chipayililo cha Jehova, eecho chakali kunembo lyakkota lya mun'anda ya Jehova.

Wakabungika ba Juda boonse aba Bbenjamini, abaabo bakakkede ambabo - bantu bakali kuzwa kuli Efuleyimu a Manase, akuli Simiyoni. Nkambo bakasika kulinguwe mumweelwe mupati kabazwa ku Izilayeli, nibakabona kuti Jehova Leza wakwe wakali anguwe.
Mpawo bakabungana antomwe ku Jelusalemu mumwezi watatu, mumwaaka wakkumi amusanu wabwendelezi bwa Asa.
Bakapayizya kuli Jehova mubuzuba oobo zimwi zyazisaalo eezyo nzibakatelede: myaanda ili musanu ayibili yamitwe yang'ombe ambelele zili zyuulu zili musanu azibili ampongo.
Bakanjila muchizuminano kukuyanduula Jehova, Leza wabasikale babo, amoyo wabo woonse amuuya wabo woonse.
Bakazuminana kuti kufumbwa wakakaka kuyanduula Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, welede kujayigwa, nikuba muntu munini naba mupati, nikuba mwalumi naba mwanakazi.
Bakakkonka kuli Jehova ajwi pati, akoompolola, atuntimbwa amyeembo.

Ba Juda boonse bakabotelwa kuchikonke, nkambo bakakonkede aamoyo wabo woonse, alimwi bakayanduula Leza achiyandisyo chabo choonse, mpawo wakajanwa aambabo. Jehova wakabapa luumuno kumabazu akaba zyungulukide.

Alubo wakagwisya Maakka, banyinakulu, kuzwa kukuba mwendelezi wachanakazi, nkambo bakali bachita chikozyanio chichisya moyo kuzwa kutanda lya Asela Asa wakagoonkola chikozyanio chichisya moyo, wachikwiiya kuba lusuko akuchuumpa kukalonga ka Kkidiloni.
Pesi masena aatala taakwe nakagwisigwa pe ku Izilayeli. Nikuba boobo, moyo wa Asa wakalilipedelede chakumaninina mazuba aakwe woonse.
Wakaleta mun'anda ya Leza nsiliva angolida azintu eezyo nzyakasalazya azyasalazigwa aawisi nkambo kamulimu.
Tekwakachili nkondo limbi pe mane mwaaka wachimakkumi aatatu amusanu wabwendelezi bwa Asa.

Mumwaka wamakumi aatatu amusanu awumwi wabwendelezi bwa Asa, Bbaasha, mwaami wa Izilayeli, wakatondezya chabukali aatala a Juda akuyaka Lama, kuti aleke kuzuminina naba uumwi kuzwa na kunjila munyika ya Asa, mwaami wa Juda.
Elyo Asa wakagwisya nsiliva angolida aanze aamanda aakubikila mun'anda ya Jehova amun'anda yamwaami, akwiitumina kuli Bbeni Hadadi mwaami wa Alamu, ooyo wakali kukkala mu Damasikkasi. Wakaamba kuti,

''Aakube chizuminano aakati kangu anduwe, mbuli mbukwakabede aakati kataata awuso. Bona, ndatumina kuli nduwe nsiliva angolida. Tyola chizuminano chako, aa Bbasa, mwaami wa Izilayeli, kuti andisiye endikke.''

Bbeni Hadadi wakaswilila kuli Asa akutumina bapati bampii atala amyuunzi ya Izilayeli. Bakalwanisya Ijoni, Dani, Abbelu Mayimu, Busena butegwa Abbelu Mayimu mbombubonya butegwa Abbelu Bbeti Maakka. Langa 2 Samiyele 20:14-15, amadolopo woonse amaatala aa Nafitali.
Kwakaba kuti Bbasa nakamvwa eechi, wakaleka kuyaka Lama akuleka mulimu wakwe.
Eelyo mwaami Asa wakabweza ba Juda boonse anguwe. Bakagwisya mabwe amatanda aa Lama nzyakali wayasya madolopo Bbasa. Eelyo mwaami Asa wakabelesya zibelesyo nzizyonya kuyaka Gebba a Mizipa.

Kuchiindi echi Hanani sichilengano wakayinka kuli Asa, mwaami wa Juda, akwaamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Nkambo wakasyoma aamwaami wa Alamu, akutasyoma aali Jehova Leza wako, impii ya mwaami wa Alamu yapuzuka kuluboko lwako.
Sena ba Kkusyi aba Libbiya tebakali impii mapti, ankalaki zyiingi abeenzyi bamabbiza na? Nekuba boobo, nkambo wasyoma aali Jehova, wakakupa luzundo aalimbabo.

Nkaambo meso a Jehova alalanga langa koonse konse munyika yoonse, kuti alitondeezye nguzu muchibela chabaabo bali amyooyo iluleme kuli nguwe. Pesi muliyeeyi nkani wachita mbuli mufuba fuba. Kuzwa lino kaziya, uyooba ankondo.
Eelyo Asa wakanyemena sizilengano; wakamubika muntolongo, nkambo wakamunyemena aatala ankani eeyi. Kuchiindi nchichonya, Asa wakadyamizya bamwi babantu.
Aamubone, milimu ya Asa, mitaanzi ayakumamanino, amubone, ililembedwe mubbuku lya baami ba Juda a Izilayeli.

Mumwaaka wamakkumi aatatu amusanu aane mwaka wabwendelezi bwakwe, Asa wakajatwa aachilwazi mumawulu aakwe. Nekuba kuti chilwazi chakwe chakali chipati, taakwe nakalangula lugwasyo pe kuli Jehova, pesi kubasondi.
Mpawo Asa wakoona abasikale bakwe, wakafwa mumwaaka wamakkumi aane awumwi wakwendelezya kwakwe.

Bakamuvwika mukabanda kakwe, nkaakali walisyida mumuunzi wa Devidi. Bakamu woneka aabulo obo bwakazwide bweema bubotu atununkilizyo twamisyobo twakabambidwe ababambi batununkilizyo. Eelyo bakamuchitila mulilo mupati mululemeko lwakwe.
Jehosafati mwana wa Asa nguwakazoba mwaami mubusena bwakwe. Jehosafati wakaliyumya kukulwisya ba Izilayeli.
Wakabikka basilumamba mumabaya woonse amyuunzi ya Juda, alimwi akubikka basilumamba munyika ya Juda amumyunzi ya Efulemu, eeyo Asa wisi njaakajata.
Jehova wakali a Jehosafati nkambo wakeenda munzila intaanzi yawisi Devidi, alimwi tewakalanguula ba bbaali. Amwi malembe taakwe Devidi, bumwi bupanduluzi bwakasiya kunze.
Kunze kwaboobo, wakabika moyo kuli Leza wa Wisi, akwenda amumilayizyo yakwe, kutali kuchita mbuuli munzila yaba Izilayeli.
Mpawo Jehova wakabumba mulawu mujanza lyakwe; ba Juda boonse bakaleta zipo kuli Jehosafati. Wakali abuvubi abulemu bwiingi.
Moyo wakwe wakali lipedelede munzila zya Jehova. Alimwi wakagwisya masena aatala amisemo ya Ashela kuli Juda.
Mumwaka watatu wabwendelezi bwakwe wakatuma basimilimu bakwe Bbeni-Hayili, Obbadiya, Zekkaliya, Netaneli, a Mikkayiya, kuti bayiisye mumyunzi ya Juda.
Bakali aba Levi: Shemayiya, Netaniya, Zebbadiya, Asahelu, Shemilamoti, Jehonatani, Adonija, Tobbija, a Tobbu-Adonija; ambakali abo bakali bapayizi Elisama a Jolamu.
Bakayiisya mu Juda, kabajisi bbuku lyamulawu wa Jehova ambabo. Kabaya bweenda mukati kamyunzi yoonse ya Juda akuyiisya akati kabantu.
Chiyoosyo cha Jehova chakawida bwami boonse bwanyika ezyo zyakazyungulukide Juda, kuti batachitili Jehosafati inkondo.
Bamwi baba Filisitiya baketela Jehosafati zipo, ansiliva mbuli zipo. Ba Alabbiya abalabo bakamwetela matanga ambono 7,700 bagutu bambelele aa 7,700 mpongo.
Jehosafati wakaba singuzu mpati. Wakayaka maanda amyuunzi yaziyoobwedo mu Juda.
Wakali ambono zyiingi mumyunzi ya Juda, abasilumamba-basimide, baalumi basinguzu - mu Jelusalemu.
Eezi zyakali zimpanzi zyabo zilembedwe azina lyamaanda awisi: Kuzwa kuli Juda, mupati wazyuulu; Adina mupati ambaakali aabo 300,00 baalumi basikulwana.
utobela kuli nguwe Jehohanani mupati wenkondo ambakali aabo 280,000 baalumi;
utobela kuli nguwe Amasiya mwana mulombe wa Zikkili, ooyo iwakalipeda kuyanda kubelekela Jehova; ambaakali abo 200,000 baalumi basikulwana.
Kuzwa kuli Bbenjamini: Eliyada, mwalumi singuzu iwakali achamba, antomwe ambakalabo bali 200,000 balumi bakalibambilide ezilwanisyo bakajisi buta antobo;
utobela nguwe wakali Jehozabbadi, ambakali abo 180,000 balibambilide inkondo.
Aaba mbakali aabo bakabelekela mwaami, kuzwa kwabaabo mwaami mbakabikkide mumabaya amumyunzi yoonse ya Juda.
Li o Jehosafati kajisi buvubi abulemu; wakapanga chizuminano a Ahabbu akubweza umwi wempuli yakwe kuti akwate mwana musimbi .
Nikwakayinda myaaka, wakazokunukila kuli Ahabbu ku Samaliya. Ahabbu wakamujayila imbelele zyiingi ang'ombe abantu mbakalaabo. Alimwi Ahabbu wakamukombelezya kuku lwanisya Lamoti - Giliyadi anguwe.

Ahabbu, mwaami wa Izilayili, wakati kuli Jehosafati mwaami wa Juda, ''Ngatulayinkamwi na ku Lamoti - Giliyadi ?'' Jehosafati wakamusandula, ''Imebo ndili mbuli nduwe, abantu bangu balimbuli bantu bako. Tuyoba anduwe munkondo.''
Jehosafati wakambila mwaami wa Izilayeli kuti, ''Weenche sanguna kuyanduula ijwi lya Jehova kunsandulo yako.''

Mpawo mwaami wa Izilayeli wakabunganya basinsimi aamwi, myaanda iine yabalumi, akwaamba kuti kuli mbabo, ''Ngatulayinka na ku Lamoti - Giliyadi kukuyolwana, nakuti nditayinki?'' Bakamusandula kuti, ''Kiilwanisye, nkaambo Leza uyoyipa mujaanza lya mwaami.''
Pesi Jehosafati wakati, ''Sa takuchikwe uumbi musinsimi ngutunga tulayandula inchenjezyo?''

Mwaami wa Izilayeli wakaamba kuti Johoshafati, ''Kuchili uumwi mwalumi wa Leza ngutunga tulayandula inchenjezyo, Mikkaya mwana wa Imula, pesi ndimusulide nkambo taakwe nasinsima kabotu atala andime, pesi lyoonse usinsima bubi.'' Pesi Jehosafati wakati, ''Mwaami teelede kwamba obo.''
Mpawo mwaami wa Izilayili wakiita mubelesi akumwambila kuti, ''Fwambana kuyomweeta Mikkaya mwana wa Imula.''

Lino Ahabbu mwaami wa Izilayili a Jehosafati mwaami wa Juda bakali kkede umwi awumwi achuno chabwami, kabasamide zizwaato zyabo, abusena buli antanganana kumanjililo amulyango wa Samaliya, abasinsimi boonse bakali kusinsima kunembo lyakwe.
Zedekkiya mwana mulombe wa Kkenana wakalichitila meja alubulo akwamba kuti, ''Jehova waamba oobu: Aazezi uyotonta ba Alamu kusikila bamenwe.''
Boonse basinsimi bakasinsima bwelene, bakati, ''Ukawulwisye Lamoti Giliyadi akuyowuzunda, nkambo Jehova wawupa mujanza lya Mwaami.''
Lino mutumwa wakiinka kuyoyita Mikkaya wakuti kuli nguwe, ''Langa, majwi abasinsimi ngomulomo kaali abubotu kumwaami. Leka majwi aako azuminane aabo, akwamba makani mabotu.''
Mikkaya wakasandula,  ''Kuti mbuli Jehova mbwali muumi, kachili nchicho Leza nchawamba nchicho nchendiyowamba.''
Eelyo nakasika kumwaami, mwaami wakati kulinguwe, ''Mikkaya, nga tulayinkana kuyolwana naa pe ?'' Mikkaya wakamusandula kuti, ''Ukamulwanisye akuba muzundi, kuyoba luzundo lupati.''
Eelyo mwaami wakati kuli nguwe, ''Ziindi zili zingana nzinjelede kwamba kuti ukonke kuti uwambe manwa pesi kasimpe muzina lya Jehova ?''

Mpawo Mikkaya wakati, ''Ndabona boonse ba Izilayili balimwayikide atala azilundu mbuli imbelele zitakwe mwembeli, alimwi Jehova wakati,  'Aba tabakwe pe mwembeli. Leka muntu woonse abweede kun'anda yakwe muluumuno.''
Mpawo mwaami wa Izilayili wakati kuli Jehosafati, ''Saa tendakakwambila kuti takwe noyoosinsima zili kabotu atala andime, pesi bubi luzutu ?''
Eelyo Mikkaya wakati, ''Nkambo kaako moonse mulelede kumvwa ijwi lya Jehova: Ndakabona Jehova kakkede achuno chabwami, amakamu woonse aakujulu akalimvwi kululyo lwakwe akulumwensi lwakwe.
Jehova wakamba kuti, 'Ngwani utakakongelezye Ahabbu, mwaami waba Izilayili, kuti akayinke kuyonyonyoona ku Lamoti Giliyadi?' Umwi wakaamba eechi awumbi eechiya.
Eelyo muuya wakaselukila kunembo akwimikila kunembo lya Jehova akwamba kuti, ''Ndiyomongelezya.''Jehova wakati kuli nguwe, ''Biyeni ?''
Imuya wakasandula, 'Ndiyoyinka akuyooba muuya wabubeji mumilomo wabasinsimi bakwe boonse. Jehova wakasandula kuti, 'Uyomongelezya, alimwi uyozwidilila. Koya lino akuyochita oobo.'
Lino langa, Jehova wabika muuya wabubeji mumilomo yabaaba basinsimi bako, alimwi Jehova wazumizya lunyonyooko nkaambo kako.''
Mpawo Zedekkiya mwana mulombe wa Kkenana, wakaza, wamuuma Mikkaya kuseya akwamba kuti, ''Munzilaanzi muuya wa Jehova ngawabweza kuti uzwe kuli ndime kuti uwambule kuli nduwe ?''
Mikkaya wakaamba kuti, ''Bona, uyooziba kuti mubuzuba oobo, eelyo noyoochijana mumaanda amukati kuyoyuba.''
Mwaami wa Izilayili wakamba kuti kuli bamwi balanda, inywe nobantu mujate Mikkaya akumutola kuli Aamoni, mwendelezi wamunzi, akuli Joyasi, mwana wangu mulombe.
Inywe nobantu muyowamba kuti kulinguwe, 'Mwaami wati: Mumubikke mwaalumi oyu muntolongo mpawo mumusanizye akasima kanini amaanzi mache biyo, kusikila ndibwede kabotu.''
Eelyo Mikkaya wakamba kuti, ''Naa wabweda kabotu, eelyo Jehova teensi wambuula andime.'' Mpawo wakayungizya akuti, muswilile eechi, moonse nobantu.''
Mpawo Ahabbu, mwaami wa Izilayili, a Jehosafati, mwaami waba Juda, bakatanta kukuyolwisya Lamoti Giliyadi.
Mwaami wa Izilayili wakaamba kuti kuli Jehosafati, ''Ndiyolyenenia akunjila mukulwana pesi usame zisamo zyabwami. Mpawaw mwaami wa Izilayili wakalyenenia akunjila mukulwana.
Lino mwaami wa Alamu wakalayilila bapati bankalaki zyakwe, akwamba kuti, ''Mutakalwisyi basilumamba banini naa bapati. Anukuti, mukalwisye mwaami luzutu wa Izilayili.''

Nikwakasika muchindi eecho bapati bankalaki nibakabona Jehosafati bakamba kuti, ''Uulya ngomwaami waba Izilayili.'' Bakazyungulukila musule kuyomulwisya, pesi Jehosafati wakalila, alimwi Jehova wakamugwasya. Leza wakabajosya kuzwa kuli nguwe.
Nikwakaba muchiindi eecho eelyo bapati bankalaki nibakabona kuti tensi ngowakali mwaami waba Izilayili, bakabweeda musule kuzwa kukumwandilila.

Pesi umwi mwalumi wakafusa buuta bwakwe chakutaziba mpawo bwamuyasa mwaami wa Izilayili akati aswananina zikwabilizyo zyakwe. Mpawo Ahabbu wakaambila mweenzyi wankalaki kuti, ''Nzemukila musule akutola kunze kwankondo, nkambo ndayaswa bubi.''
Inkondo yakakomenesya buzuba oobo alimwi mwaami wa Izilayili wakanyampulwa munkalaki yakwe kalangide aba Alamu kusikila goko. Kusikila chiindi izuba nilyakamba kubbila, wakafwa.
Jehosafati mwaami wa Juda wakajoka mulumuno mun'anda yakwe ku Jelusalemu.

Mpawo Jewu mwana mulombe wa Hanani, sizilengano, wakazwa kuti aswanane anguwe alimwi wakati kumwaami Jehosafati, ''Uyelede kugwasya babi na? Uyelede kuyanda aabo basulide Jehova na? Nkambo kanchito eeyi, bukali bwakusikila kuzwa kuli Jehova.''
Nikuba boobo, kuti zintu zibotu zijanika mulinduwe, mwakabweza matanda a Asila kuzwa kunyika, alimwi wakachita moyo wako kukuyandawula Leza.''
Jehosafati wakali kukkala mu Jelusalemu; alimwi wakeenda kuzwa akkati kabantu bazwa ku Bbiyesebba akusika kunyika yazilundu zya Efulemu akubajosya kuli Jehova waba mawisi abo.
Wakabika babetesi munyika kuzyunguluka myunzi yonse ibalidwe ya Juda, munzi amunzi.
Wakati kubabetesi, ''Amuchenjele nzimwelede kuchita, nkambo tamulokubetekela muntu pe, pesi kubetekela Jehova, ulandinywe munzila yakubeteka.
Lino kuzwawo, kuyoosya kwa Jehova ngakube andinywe. Amuchenjele chiindi nimubeteka, nkambo takwe bubi pe kuli Jehova Leza wesu, nikuba kusalula na masinkamulomo abwezwa.''

Kwinda kwaboobo, mu Jelusalemu Jehosafati wakabika bamwi ba Levi aba payizi, abamwi bapati bamizimu yan'anda yaba Izilayeli, mukwendelezya bubetesi bwa Jehova, alimwi akambo kambpyopyongano. Bakali kukkala mu Jelusalemu.
Wakabalayilila kuti, akwamba kuti, ''Mwelede kubeleka kamutobelezya Jehova, chakusyomeka, amoyo wanu woonse.

Kufumbwa chiindi lupyopyongano nilumusikila kuli ndinywe kuzwa kubakulana benu bakkala mumyunzi yabo, nikuba ayendelana akutika kwabulowa, nikuba aatala amilawu amalayilile, milazyo na imbeta, muleelede kubachibula, kuchitila kuti batabi amulandu kunembo lya Jehova, na bukali buyoza kuli ndinywe alimwi buyooza kubakulana banu. Mwayochita echi alimwi tamukwe kuyoba amulandu pe.

Amubone, Amaliya mupayizi mupati ngomupati wenu mumakani wonse a Jehova. Zebbadiya mwana mulombe wa Isumayili, mweendelezi wan'anda ya Juda, nguyendelezya makani oonse amwaami. Alimwi, ba Levi bayoba basilutwe bakumubelekela. Amusime akulemeka malayilile, alimwi Jehova abe abaabo balikabotu.''

Nichakayinda echi chakaba, kuti bantu ba Mowabbu aba Amoni, ambabo bamwi ba Meyunitisi bakaza kuli Jehosafati kuti bamulwane. (kubalwa Meyuni zyimikilila kubambululwa kubulembo bwachi Hebbulu, mbuli mbuzyakambwa aba Giliki bansiku kunsandululo. Bulembo bwachiindi bwachi Hebbulu bubalika boobo. Zyingi zyakabambululwa zyalino zizuminano kuti Meyuni wakali mutanzi abo)

Mpawo bamwi bakasika abo bakambila Jehosafati, bakati, ''Makamu miingi alikuza kuzokulwisya kuzwida kulubazu lwaku lwizi lufwide, kuzwa ku Edomu. Bona, bali mu Hazazeni Tama,'' oyo ngonguwe, Engedi. (kulesi kuti Edomu, zyachiindi zyama Giliki amu Latini zyakusandulula azimwi zyelino zyakasandululwa zibala Alamu).
Jehosafati wakayoowa akubika lwakwe mwiini kuti ayanduule Jehova. Wakaambilizya kuba Juda boonse kuti balyiimyee.
Juda bakabungana antoomwe kuti bayandule Jehova; bakaza kuzoyandula Jehova kuzwa kumyunzi yoonse ya Juda.
Jehosafati wakayimikila kumbungano ya Juda a Jelusalemu, ku n'anda ya Jehova, kunembo alubuwa lupya.
Wakati, ''Jehova, Leza wabasikale besu, toyenensi Leza ul;ikujulu na? Toyensi mwendelezi wabwami boonse bwamasi na? Nguzu abupati zili mumaanza ako, aboobo takwe umwi ukonzya kukukakila.
Leza wesu, tenduwe na wakagwisya bakkali banyika eyi kunembo lyabantu ba Izilayeli, alimwi wakiipa kwalyonse kulunyungu lwa Abbulahamu?
Bakakkala mulinjiyo akukukyakila busena busalala mulinjiyo nkambo kazina lyako, akwaamba kuti,

'na penzi lyatusikila - ipanga, na malwazi, na inzala - tuyoyimikila kunembo lya n'anda eyi, akunembo lyako ( nkambo izina lyako lili mun'anda eyi ), alimwi tuyokulilila mumapenzi esu, alimwi uyotumvwa akutufutula muchindi chakubeteka zimwi zyachiindi azyalino zyakusanduula, zibalika kuti zambangulwe.

Langa lino, mbaba bantu ba Amoni, Mowabbu aba Kuchilundu cha Seyili abo mbutakwe niwakalekela Izilayeli kuti ayilwisye chiindi nibakazwa munyika ya Ijiputi; nekuba boobo, Izilayeli wakabweda kuzwa kulimbabo alimwi takabanyonyoona pe.
Bona mbobali kutupa bulumbu; balikuza kuzotugwisya kuzwa munyika yako eyo njiwakatupa kuti twikone.
Leza wesu, tokoyo babeteka na? Nkambo tatukwe nguzu atala aampi eyi mpati izobuza kukutulwisya. Tatwizi chakuchita, pesi menso esu alikuli nduwe.''
Ba Juda boonse bakimikila kunembo lya Jehova, abanini babo, banakazi, abana.

Mpawo akati kambungano iMuuya wa Jehova wakasika ali Jahaziyelu, mwana mulombe wa Zekkaliya, mwana wa Bbenayiya, mwana mulombe wa Jeyiyelu, mwana mulombe wa Mataniya, mu Levi alimwi kali walunyungu lwa Asafasi.

Jahaziyeli wakati, ''Muswilizye, moonse noba Juda anywebo nimukkala mu Jelusalemu, a mwaami Jehosafati. Eechi nchicho Jehova nchaamba kulindinywe, mutayoowi; mutatyompwi nkambo kaampi impati eeyi nkambo nkondo tenjiyenu, pesi kuli Leza.
Mulelede kwinka kuyobalwisya juunza. Bona, bazobuza enzila izwida ku Ziizi. Muyobajana kumamanino amusena, kunembo ankanda ya Jelulu.

Tamukoyoyanda kulwana munkondo eeyi.  Amwime muzilawu zyenu, amwime mpawawo alimwi muyobona kuvuna kwa Jehova aalindinywe, Juda a Jelusalemu. Mutayoowi nikuba kutyompwa. Mwende mukabalwisye juunza, nkambo Jehova ulaandinywe.''
Jehosafati waka kotamisya mutwe wakwe abusyu bwakwe aansi. Ba Juda boonse abakali kukkala mu Jelusalemu bakawa kunembo lya Jehova, bamukomba.
Ba Levi, aabo bakulunyungu lwaba Kkohatisi aba Kkolahitisi, bakayimikila akulumbayizya Jehova Leza wa Izilayeli, ajwi lyalompololo pati.

Chifumo bakabuka akwiinka munkanda yaku Tekkowa. Mbubonya nibakazwa anze, Jehosafati wakayimikila akwamba kuti, ''Amundiswiilile, Juda, anywebo nobakkali baku Jelusalemu ! Musyome muli Jehova Leza wanu, alimwi muyogwasigwa. Musyome basinsimi bakwe, alimwi muyozwidilila.

Kuzwa nakabuzya bantu, wakasala aabo basikwimbila Jehova abaabo ibakalumbayizya akambo kabupati buyoosya nibakeenda kunembo aampi, bakamba kuti, ''Mupe kulumba kuli Jehova, nkambo chizuminano chakwe chisyomeka chiyobawo kwa lyoonse.''
Nibakatalika kwimba akulumbayizya, Jehova wakayubika balumi kuyolwisya bantu ba Amoni, Mowabbu, akuchilundu cha Seyili abo bakalikuza kukulwisya Juda. Bakazundigwa.

Nkambo bantu ba Amoni aba Mowabbu bakabuka kuti balwane abakkali baku chilundu chaku Seyili, kuchitila kuti bajaye chakumaninizya akubanyonyoona. Nibakamana akubakkali bakuchilundu cha Seyili, boonse bakagwasyania kunyonyona umwi awumwi.
Juda nakasika kubusena kukuzolanga nkanda, bakalanga impi. Amubone, bakali fwide, baliwide aansi; takwepe wakachija.

Eelyo Jehosafati abantu b akwe nibakasika kuti babweze zisalo kuzwa kuli mbabo, bakajana akati kabo zintu zyiingi, zyakusama, zintu zijanika zidula ezyo nzibakali bwezela zyingi kwiinda nzibakali  kukkonzya kunyampula, zyakababtolela mazuba atatu kuti bakonzye kunyampula ezyo zintu. Kwakali zyingi loko. (muchindi chakuti akati kabo, zimwi zyachindi a zyalino zyakusandulula zibalika kuti ng'ombe. Kutali zisamo, zimwi zyachiindi azyalino zyakusandululwa zibalika kuti mibili ifwide).
Mubuzuba bwane bakabungana kumusena wa Bbelakka. Oko bakalumbayizya Jehova, aboobo izina lyabusena obo litegwa ''Musena wa Bbelakka'' kusika sunu obu.
Eelyo bakabweda bantu boonse ba Juda a Jelusalema, a Jehosafati mukusolwedela kwabo, kuti bakeende lubo ku Jelusalemu akubotelwa, nkambo Jehova wabachita kutibabotelwe kwinda basinkonyina.
Nibakasika ku Jelusalemu aku n'anda ya Jehova atuntimbwa, aampeta amyeembo.
Kuyosya kwa Leza kwali aabwami bwamasi nibakamvwa kuti Jehova walwisya basinkondo ba Izilayel.
Eelyo bwami bwa Jehosafati bwakalumwide, nkambo Leza wakwe wakamupede lumuno loonse lumuzyungulukide.

Jehosafati wakendelezya Juda: wakali aminyaka ili makkumi atatu amusanu nakatalika kwendelezya, alimwi wakeendelezya mu Jelusalemu kwamyaaka ili makkumi aabili amusanu. Izina lyabanyina lyakali kutegwa  Azubba, mwana musimbi wa Shilihi.
Wakeenda munzila zya Asa, wisi takwe pe nakalewuka kuzwa kuli nzizyo; wakachita zyakali kabotu kumenso a Jehova.
Nekubaboobo, masena alaatala takagwisigwa. Mbubonya bantu tebakabika myoyo yabo kuli Leza wabasikale babo.
Nkambo mbuli tumwi twambo tuli atala a Jehosafati, kumatalikilo akuma manino, amubone, zililembedwe mulwaano lwa Jehu mwana mulombe wa Hanani, ezyo zilembedwe mumalembe amagwalo abaami ba Izilayeli.
Kwinda kwazezi Jehosafati mwaami wa Juda, wakajatana aa Ahaziya, mwaami wa Izilayeli, ooyo wakachita bubi.
Wakajatana anguwe kuti ayake maato kuti ayinke ku Tasyisyi. Bakayaka maato ku Eziyoni Gebba.

Mpawo Eliyaza mwana mulombe wa Dodavawu wa Malesha, wakasinsima aatala a Jehosafati; wakati, ''Nkambo wajatana aa Ahaziya, Jehova wajaya nzimwakabamba.'' Maato akakwamuka aboobo takachili kukonzya pe kweenda.
Jehosafati wakoona abasikale bakwe alimwi wakavwikwa ambabo mumuunzi wa Devidi; Jeholamu, mwana wakwe mulombe, wakaba mwaami mubusena bwakwe.
Jeholamu wakali aabakulana, bana bakwe balombe ba Jehosafati; Azaliya, Jehiyeli, Zekkaliya, Azaliyahu, Mikkayeli, a Shefatiya. Boonse aba bakali bana balombe ba Jehosafati, mwaami wa Izilayeli.
Wisi wabo wakapede zipo zipati zyansiliva, ngolida, azimwi zintu zibotu, akusimya madolopo mu Juda, pesi wakapa bwami kuli Jeholamu.
Lino Jeholamu wakabukila bwami bwawisi akuliyumya mbuli mwaami, wakajaya bakulana bakwe apanga, alimwi abamwi bazululi ba Izilayeli basiyenesiyene.
Jeholamu wakali aamyaka ilimakkumi aatatu ayibili nakatanguna kwendelezya, alimwi wakeendelezya mu Jelusalemu kwamyaaka musanu ayitatu.
Wakayenda munzila zyabami ba Izilayeli, mbubonya n'anda ya Ahabbu mboyakali kuchita, nkambo wakali kwete mwana musimbi wa Ahabbu, alimwi wakachita bubi mumenso a Jehova.
Nekubabobo, Jehova tewakayanda kunyonyoona n'anda ya Devidi, nkambo kachizuminano eecho nchakachitide a Devidi; wakasyomezezye kuti wali kunomupa buumi lyoonse alunyungu lwakwe.
Mumazuba a Jeholamu, Idomu wakapapa kuzwa kumanguzu aa Juda, alimwi bakalibikila mwaami wabo beni.
Eelyo Jeholamu wakazubuka abasilutwe bakwe ankalaki zyakwe zyonse. Kwakali mansiku nakanyamuka akulwana aatala aba Edomu aabo bakamuzyungulukide abasilutwe benkalaki zyakwe.

Mbubobu Idomu mbwakali mubupapi kuzwa kumanguzu aa Juda kusika kubuzuba bwamusanu. Libbuna alakwe wakapapa kuchiindi nchichonya kuzwa kumanguzu aakwe, nkambo Jeholamu wakaleka Jehova, Leza wabasikale bakwe.
Mukuyungizya, Jeholamu alubo wakayakide masena malamfu mumalundu aa Juda alimwi wakachita bakkali bamu Jelusalemu kuti bapone mbuli basibuvuule, alimwi wakasowesya Juda

Lugwalo lwakazwa kumusinsimi Elija lwakasika kuli Jeholamu. Lwakamba kuti, ''Ncheechi Jehova; Leza wa Devidi, sikale wako, nchaamba: Nkambo takwe nowakeenda munzila zya Jehosafati, wuso, na munzila zya Asa, mwaami wa Juda,

pesi bakeenda munzila zyabaami ba Izilayeli, alimwi wakachita Juda abakkali bamu Jelusalemu kuti bachite mbuli sibuvuule, mbuli n'anda ya Ahabbu mbuyakachita - mpawo nkambo wakajaya bakulana bako babotu kwinda nduwe -
Bona, Jdehova uyowuma aluumo lupati bantu bako, bana bako, banakazi bako, ambono zyako.
Webo lwako uyooba amachise manji abulwazi mumala aako, mane bulwazi bukachite mala ako kuti azwe aanze, alimwi eechi chiyoyendelela buzuba abuzuba.''
Jehova wakasungilizya muya waba Falisi aatala Jeholamu, awaba Alabbiya aabo bakali aafwifwi aba Kkusi.

Bakalwanisya Juda, bakamubweza changuzu, akubweza buvubi boonse oobo bwakajanika mun'anda yamwaami. Alubo bakabweza bana bakwe balombe abanakazi bakwe. Taakwe mwana mulombe wakasyeede kulinguwe aado Jehoyahazi, mwana wakwe mulombe munini loko.
Musule azyoonse eezi, Jehova wakamuuma mumala aakwe abulwazi butasilikiki pe.

Kwakaba kuti nichakayinda chiindi, kumamamino aamyaka ibili, kuti mala aakwe akazwa aanze nkambo kamachise aakwe, akuti wakafwa abulwazi bupati.  Bantutu bakwe tabamukunkilidile mulilo pe mukumulemeka mbuli mbobakachitide kuli basikale bakwe.

Wakatanguna kwendelezya naakali amyaka makkumi aatatu ayibili; wakeendelezya mu Jelusalemu kwamyaaka musanu ayitatu, alimwi nakeenda taakwe pe wakamukwiila. Bakamuvwikka mudolopo lya Devidi, pesi tebakamuvwika  kumavwikka aabami pe.

Bantu bakali kukkala mu Jelusalema bakachita Ahaziya, mwana munini mulombe wa Jeholamu, mwaami mubusena bwakwe, kwakasika impuumba yabaalumi bakeza ama Alabbu bakanjila mumusansa bakajaya boonseni bana balombe bapati. Mpawo Ahaziya mwana mulombe wa Jeholamu, mwaami wa Juda, nguwakaba mwaami.
Ahaziya wakali aminyaka makumi aabili aabili kukomena kwakwe nakatanguna kwendelezya; wakeendelezya kwamunyaka umwi mu Jelusalemu. Izina lyabanyina wakali Ataliya; kali mwana musimbi wa Omuli.
Alubo wakali kweenda munzila zyan'anda ya Ahabbu nkambo banyina bakali kumulayilila mukuchita zintu zibi.
Ahaziya wakali kuchita zibi kubusyu bwa Jehova, mbuli bakun'anda ya Ahabbu, mbubali kuchita, nkambo bakali baluliki bakwe akuzwa kulufu - lwawisi, kusikila kulunyonyooko lwakwe.
Alubo wakatobela lulayo lwabo; wakali kwenda a Jolamu mwana mulombe wa Ahabbu, mwaami wa Izilayeli, mukulwanisya Hazayeli, mwaami wa Alamu, ku Lamoti Giliyadi. Ba Alamu bakamuyasa Jolamu.

Jolamu wakabwedela kuyosilikwa zilonda ku Jezili ezyo nzibakamupa ku Lama, naka lwanisya Hazayeli, mwaami wa Alamu. Mpawo Ahaziya mwana mulombe wa Joholamu, mwaami wa Juda, wakakunukila kuli Jezeleli kuyobuna Jolamu mwana mulombe wa Ahabbu, nkambo Jolamu wakaliyasidwe.

Lino kunyoonyoka kwa Ahaziya kwakaletwa a Leza kwiinda kukuswaya kwa Ahaziya kuli Jolamu. Nakasika, wakeenda aamwi a Jeholamu kuyolwisya Jewu mwana mulombe wa Nimisi, oyo Jehova ngwakasalide kunyonyona n'anda ya Ahabbu.
Chakaba kuti, Jewu wakali kuchita lubeta lwa Leza kun'anda ya Ahabbu, awo mpaakajana basilutwe ba Juda abana balombe babakulana ba Ahaziya. Jewu wakabajaya.

Jewu wakalangula Ahaziya; bakamujata kayubide mu Samaliya, bakamweeta kuli Jewu, mpawo wamujaya. Eelyo bakamuzika, nkambo bakaamba kuti, ''Oyu mwana mulombe wa Jehosafati, wakali kuyandula Leza amoyo wakwe woonse.'' Mpawo n'anda ya Ahaziya teyakachili anguzu pe zyakwendelezya bwami.
Lino Ataliya, banyina aa Aahaziya, naakabona kuti mwana wakwe mulombe wafwa wakabuka akujaya boonseni bana ba mwaami mu n'anda ya Juda.

Pesi Jehoshebba, mwana musimbi wamwaami, mukavwindi wakabweza Jowasi mwana mulombe wa Ahaziya wamutola kunze kuzwa kubana balombe abo bakali bayanda kujayigwa. Wakamubikka amuleli wakwe mun'anda yakoona. Lino Jehoshebba, mwana musimbi wamwaami Jeholamu, kali mwanakazi wa Jeyoyada mupayizi, (nkambo wakali muchizi wa Ahaziya), wakamuyubika kuzwa kuli Ataliya, kuchitila kuti Ataliya atamujayi.
Wakali amwi ambabo, kabasisidwe mun'anda ya Leza kwaminyaka musanu awumwi. Ataliya kali kwendelezya munyika.
