Mumwaka wamusanu ayibili, Jehoyiyada wakatondezya nguzu zyakwe alimwi wakanjila muchizuminano abasilumamba ba myaanda, Azaliya mwana mulombe wa Jelohamu, Ishumayeli mwana mulombe wa Jehohanani, Azaliya mwana mulombe wa Obbedi, Maseyiya mwana mulombe wa Adayiya, antomwe a Elishafati mwana mulombe wa Zikkili.
Bakayinka ku Juda akubunganya ba Levi kuzwa mumyunzi yoonse ya Juda, akubikilizya abasololi ba n'anda yabasikale ya Izilayeli, alimwi bakaza ku Jelusalemu.

Yoonse imbungano yakachita chizuminano a mwaami mun'anda ya Leza. Jehoyiyada wakabambila kuti, ''Amubone, mwana mulombe wamwaami uyoyendelezya, mbuli mbwakaamba Jehova kazilangene alunyungu lwa Devidi.
Echi nchicho nchayelede kuchita: Chisela chatattu chenu chaba payizi aba Levi baza kunoyendelezya musabata banoli balindizi amilyango.
Chimwi chisela chatatu banoli aan'anda yamwaami, alimwi bamwi chisela chatatu banoli Amulyango wantalisyo. Boonse bantu banoli mulubuwa lwan'anda ya Jehova.

Mutakazumizya naba umwi akkati kanu kuti akanjile mun'anda ya Jehova, kusiya bapayizi aba Levi batanoyendelezye. Balelede kunjila nkaambo balasalala. Pesi boonse bantu bambi balelede kulemeka milawo ya Jehova.

Ba Levi balelede kuzyunguluka mwaami kumabazu woonse, awumwi muntu kajisi chilwanyo mumaanza akwe. Kufumbwa utakasike mun'anda, ngakajayigwe. Mukakkale a mwaami nayosika mukati alimwi anayobbuda anze.''

Mpawo ba Levi aba Juda boonse batanoyendelezye munzila zyoonse bakachite mbuli mbakalayilila Jehoyiyada mupayizi. Awumwi wakabweza bantu bakwe, abo bakalikuza kuzobeleka mubuzuba butegwa Sabata, aboonse abo balikunoleka kubeleka mubuzuba ibutegwa Sabata, nkambo Jehoyiyada mupayizi takayungizya  kufumbwa mipampo mipampo yabo.
Elyo Jehoyiyada mupayizi waketa kuli basilutwe bampi masumu amanini antobo mpati zyakali zyamwaami Devidi ezyo zyakali mun'anda ya Leza.

Jehoyiyada wakabikka basilumamba boonse, awumwi muntu achilwanio chakwe mukuboko kwakwe, kuzwa kulubazu lwakululyo lwatempele kusikila kulubazu lwakuchimweensi lwatempele, kumbali achipayililo chatempele, kabazyungulukide mwaami.

Elyo bakeeta mwana mulombe wamwaami, bakamubika musini, akumupa chizuminano chamulawo. Mpawo bakamuchita mwaami, alimwi Jehoyiyada abana bakwe balombe bakamunanika. Mpawo bakamba kuti, ''Ngawongole mwaami.''
Muchindi Ataliya nakamvwa kuyowela kwabantu kabachijana akulumbayizya mwaami, wakeza kubantu mun'anda ya Jehova,

alimwi wakalanga, mpawo, wakabona mwaami wakalimvwi amusemu wakwe kumanjililo alimwi basilutwe abasikulizya mweembo bakali a mwaami. Bantu boonse munyika bakali kubotelwa akusiba myeembo, alimwi basikwiimba bakali kuuma zibelesyo zyakulumbayizya akwendelezya kwimba kwakulumbayizya. Eelyo Ataliya wakadabuula zisani zyakwe akoompolola, ''Nkubisizya chisi oku ! Nkubisizya chisi !''

Mpawo Jehoyiyada mupayizi wakeeta basilutwe ba miyanda bakali kulanga basilumba akwaamba kuti kuli mbabo, ''Amumugwisye akati kamatente; kufumbwa uyomutobela, akajayigwe a panga.'' Nkambo mupayizi wamba kuti, ''Mutakamujayili mun'anda ya Jehova pe.''
Mpawo bakamukwela nakenda kumanjililo amulyango wamabbiza wan'anda yamwaami, alimwi oko bakamujaya.
Elyo Jehoyiyada wakachita chizuminano lwakwe mwini, bantu boonse, amwaami, kuti belede kupa bantu ba Jehova.
Aboobo bantu boonse bakaya kun'anda ya Bbaali akuyoyimwaya. Bakapwachuula zipayilo zya Bbaali amituni yakwe, alimwi akujaya Matani, mupayizi wa Bbaali, kunembo ezipayililo ezyo.

Jehoyiyada wakasala babelesi ban'anda ya Jehova kunsi akuboko kwamupayizi, bakali ba Levi, abo Devidi mbakatuma kun'anda ya Jehova, kuti bakape zipayizyo zyakuumpa kuli Jehova, mbuli mbukwakalembedwe mumulawo wa Mozesi antomwe akubotelwa akwiimba, mbubonya Devidi mbwakapede malayilile.
Jehoyiyada wakabikka balindizi kumilyango ya n'anda ya Jehova, mpawo takwe pe nikuba wakasofwede nikuba mulimwi nzila wakali kukonzya kunjila.

Jehoyiyada wakabwezelezya basilutwe ba myaanda anguwe, balemekwa, baleli babantu, abantu boonse banyika. Wakeeta mwaami kuzwa kun'anda ya Jehova; bantu bakazida kumulyango wakujulu wen'anda yamwaami alimwi bakakkazika mwaami achuuno chabwami. (zimwi zyalino lino zyasandululwa nzila, bakeeta mwaami)
Mpawo bantu boonse bamunyika bakabotelwa, alimwi muunzi wakaba muchumunizi. Mbuli kuti Ataliya, bakali bamujaya apanga.
Jowasi wakali aminyaka musanu ayibili naakatanguna kweendelezya; wakeendelezya kwaminyaka makumi aane mu Jelusalemu. Izina lyabanyina wakali Zibbiya, waku Bbiyashebba.
Jowasi wakachita ziluleme kumenso a Jehova mazuba oonse a Jehoyada mupayizi.
Jehoyada wakamubwezela banakazi babili, mpawo wakazoba wisi wabana balombe abasimbi.
Kwakaba kuti kwiinda echi, kuti Jowasi wakayeya kubambuulula n'anda ya Jehova.

Wakabungania antomwe bapayizi aba Levi, alimwi wakaamba kuti kuli mbabo, ''Kamwinka aanze amunyaka kumagunzi a Juda akuyobunganya mali izwa ku Izilayeli yoonse mukamamike n'anda ya Leza wenu. Mube anchonzyo mutangune ndilyo lino.'' Ba Levi takwepe nzibakachita kumasangunino.

Mpawo mwaami wakayita Jehoyada mupayizi mupati akwamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Nkambonzi niwakatabuzya ba Levi kweeta mukati zyakazwa kwa Juda aku Jelusalemu mutelo wakatelesegwa a Musa mulanda wa Jehova antomwe ambungano ya Izilayeli kubbunganino lyechizuminano chamilawu ?''
Kwabana balombe ba Ataliya, ulya mwanakazi mubi, bakapwaya n'anda ya Leza alubo bakapa zintu zyoonse zisalala zyamun'anda ya Leza kuli ba Bbaala.
Eelyo mwaami wakalayilila, mpoo bakachita bbokesi balibika aanze kumulyango wan'anda ya Jehova.
Mpawo bakachita chizibisyo kwiinda mu Juda amu Jelusalemu, kubamba kwetela Jehova mutelo Musa mulanda wa Leza ngwakatelesya boonse bantu ba Izilayili munkanda.
Bazulwidi boonse abantu boonse bakabotelwa akweta mali mukati akwibika mubbokesi mane bakamaninsya kulizuzya.

Zyakachitika kuti kufumbwa bbokesi nilyakali kweeta kuli basilutwe baMwaami mumaboko abaLevi, Alimwi kufumbwa nibali kubona kuti kwaba nyingi mukati, mulembi waMwaami abapayizi bapati balajulu balikuza, kuzogwisya zilimubbokesi akulibweza, akunyampula akulibwedezya kubusena bwalyo. Balikuchita echi buzuba abuzuba, kubungania mali inyingi loko.

Mwaami Jehoyada bakapa mali kuli babo balikuchita mulimu wakukutawuka mun'anda ya Jehova. Baalumi aba balikubeleka babezi bamabwe ababezi kukubukulusya n'anda ya Jehova, alimwi abaabo bakali kubeleka mulubulo amubutale.
Mpawo basimilimo bakabeleka, alimwi mulimu wakumamununa wakayinkilila kunembo kwinda mumaboko aabo; bakalulamika n'anda ya Leza mubweebe bwayo bwachiindi akuyisimya.

Nibakamaninsya, bakeeta mali yoonse kumwaami akuli Jehoyada. Eyi mali yakabelesegwa kukupanga zibelesyo zyamun'anda ya Jehova, zibelesyo zyankombelo zyazi payizyo - bachooncho azibelesyo zyangolida ansiliva. Bakali kupeda zipayizyo zyakuumpa mun'anda ya Jehova kwalyoonse mazuba ngakapona Jehoyada.
Jehoyada wakacheembala alubo kalamazuba mayingi, mpawo wakafwa, wakala minyaka 130 nakafwa.
Bakamuzikka mumunzi wa Devidi akkati kabaami, nkambo wakachita ziluleme mu Izilayeli, kunembo lya Leza, akun'anda ya Leza.
Lino kuzwa alufu lwa Jehoyada, basilutwe ba Juda bakeeza akulemeka kumwaami. Mpawo mwaami wakabaswilila.
Bakaleka n'anda ya Jehova, Leza wabasikale babo, akukomba baleza ba Asela amizimu. Bukali bwa Leza bwakeza ali Juda a Jelusalemu akambo kakuchita bubi bwabo.
Mpawo wakatuma basinsimi kuli mbabo kuti bakeete lubo kulinguwe, Jehova; basinsimi bakapa bukamboni aatala abantu, pesi bakakaka kuswilila.

Muuya wa Leza wakeeza ali Zakkaliya mwana mulombe wa Jehoyada, mupayizi; Zakkaliya wakabukila ajulu lyabantu akwamba kuti kulimbabo, ''Leza wawaamba bobu: Nkambonzi nimwataluka milawo ya Jehova, nchiichecho chiyomulesya kujana choolwe ? Kuzwa mpuwakaka Jehova, alakwe wamukaka.''
Pesi bakavwiya atala anguwe; kuzwa kukulayilila kwamwaami, bakamutulula mabwe mulubuwa lwen'anda ya Jehova.

Mubwiime obu,, Jowasi, mwaami, wakanyansya buuya obo Jehoyada, wisi Zekkaliya, mbwakachita kulinguwe. Nikuba obo, wakajaya mwana mulombe wa Jehoyada. Elyo Zekkaliya nakalimukufwa, wakati, ''Jehova ngachibone eechi akukupa kambo.''
Kwakaba kuti kumamanino amwaka basilumamba ba Alamu bakasika kuzolwanisya Jowasi. Bakaza ku Juda aku Jelusalemu; bakajaya zisalo zyoonse kuzwa kulimbabo kumwaami wa Damasikkasi.

Nikuba kuti iimpi yaba Alamu bakeza abasilumamba bache, Jehova wakabapa luzundo atala ampii mpati loko, nkambo Juda bakamukaka Jehova, Leza wabasikale babo. Muli eyinzila ba Alamu bakaleta lubeta ali Jowasi.

Achindi echo ba Alamu, kabeendaede, Jowasi wakaliyasidwe kapati loko. Balanda bakwe bakavwiiya atala anguwe nkambo kakujaya bana balombe ba Jehoyada, mupayizi. Bakamujayila mubulo bwakwe, akufwa; bakamuzikka mumunzi wa Devidi, pesi mutensi mutubanda twabaami pe.
Abo bantu mbakali abo bakavwiiya atala anguwe: Zabbadi mwana mulombe wa Simiti, mwanakazi mu Amoni; a Jehozabbadi mwana mulombe wa Similiti, mwanakazi mu Mowabbayiti.

Lino milandu atala abana bakwe balombe, zisinsimi zipati zyakaambwa atala anguwe, akuyakululwa kwan'anda ya Leza, bona, tazilembedwe na mubu panduluzi mubbuku lyabaami. Amaziya mwana wakwe mulombe nguwakaba mwaami mubusena bwakwe.

Amaziya wakaba amyaaka yakuzyalwa ilimakumi obilwe amusanu nakatalika kwendelezya; wakendelezya myaka ilimakumi obile amusanu ayine muJelusalemu. Banyina Izina lyabo wakali Jehoyadani, Waku Jelusalumu.
Wakachita  zyakaluleme mumeso a Jehova, pesi peepe amoyo woonse.
Eelyo buzwidilile bwendelezi bwakwe, wakajaya balanda bakali bajaya wisi, mwaami.

Pesi takwe nakabika bana babajayi mulufu, pesi wakachita mbuli zyakalembedwe mumulawu, mubbuku lya Mozesi, mbuli Jehova mbwakalayilide,'' Bamawisi tabelede kufwida bana, naakuti bana bafwide bamawisi. Nikuba kuti, woonse muntu welede kufwida chibi chakwe mwiini.''
Aatala, lyaleelyo, Amaziya wakabunganya Juda aantomwe, akubabambulula amaanda abasinsiku babo, munsi abasololi bazyuulu abamyaanda- boonse baJuda  aBenjamini.

Wakababala kuzwa kumyaka ilikkumi obilwe aakuzyalwa kaziya kujulu, wakajana bali 300,000 balumi basalidwe, bakonzya kuya kunkondo, bakonzya kujata sumu antobo. wakakweta alubo 100,000 baalumi balwana kuzwa kuli Isilayeli wabapa mwaanda wamatalenta aasiliva.
Pesi muntu wakaza kulinguwe akuti,'' Mwami, atazumizyi inkamu yasilumamba ya Isilayeli kuti yinke anduwe, nkaambo Jehova tali a Isilayeli pe- takwe naba omwe wabantu ba Ifulemu.
Pesi nikuba winka alimwi nkozumenene alimwi nkosimide munkondo,Leza ulokusowela ansi kunembo lyabasinkondonyokwe, nkaambo Leza ulanguzu zyakugwasya, alimwi nguzu zyakusowela aansi.''
Amaziya wakati kumuntu waLeza,'' Pesi tulochita buti amatalenta alimwaanda ngindapa inkamu yasilumamba ya Isilayeli?'' Muntu wa Leza wakasandula,'' Jehova ulakonzya kukupa zyiingi kwiinda eezyo.''
Aboobo Amaziya wakanzaanya inkamu yabasilumamba eeyo yakaza kulinguwe kuzwa ku Ifulemu; wakapilusya lubo muunzi. Aabobo kunyema kwakavula atala aJuda, alimwi bakabweda kumunzi mukunyema kuyoosya.
Amaziya wakaba abusichamba akuzulwida bantu bakwe kuti baye kukkuti lyaMwiinyo; ooko wakazunda zyuulu zili kkumi zyaabalumi ba Seya.

Inkamu yabasilumamba ya Juda yakabweza                         buumbulu bamwi bali zyuulu zili kkumi. Bakabatola    aatala amweenga kamabwe alimwi bakabawalila ansi kuzwa waawo, chakuti boonse bakatyokooka mutumpazi.

Pesi balumi bankamu yabasilumamba Amaziya mbaakapilusya, kuti batayinki anguwe kunkondo, bakalwiisya myuuzi ya Juda kuzwa ku Samaliya kusikila ku Beti Holoni. Bakajaya zyuulu zitatu zyabantu alimwi bakabweza mbono zyiingi.

Lino, kuzwa eelyo Amaziya naakaali waboola kuzwa kukujaya ba Edomu, kuti wakeeta baleza babantu ba Seya, akubabika kuti babe baleza bakwe mwiini. Lino, kuzwa eelyo Amaziya naakali waboola kuzwa kukujaya ba Edomu, kuti wakeeta baleza babantu ba Seya, akubabika kuti babe baleza bakwe mwiini. Wakakotama kunembo  lyabo alimwi wakabatentela  tununkilizyo.
Aboobo kunyema kwa Jehova kwakavula atala lya Amaziya. Wakatuma musinsimi kulinguwe, wakati,''Nkaambonzi niwayanduula baleza babantu bakatavuna biyo bantu babo kukuboko       kwako?''

Eelyo musinsimi nakali kwambula anguwe, mwaami wakati kulinguwe, '' Twakuchita sikulaya wamwami na? Leka! Nkaambozi notajayigwe?'' Mpawo musinsimi wakaleka alimwi wasikuti, ''Ndilizi kuti Leza wazeeza kukunyonyona nkaambo wachita eechi chichito alimwi takwe nuwaswilizya kulaya kwaangu.''

Mpawo Amaziya mwaami waJuda wakabuzisisya kuli basikulaya alimwi wakatuma batumwa kuli Johoyasi mwaana wa Jehoyahazi mwana waJehu, mwaami wa Izilayeli, nkati, ''Boola, atuswanane busyu kubusyu munkondo.''

Pesi Jehoyasi mwaami wa Isilayeli wakatuma batumwa musule kuli Amaziya mwaami wa Juda, kati , '''mukkoka wakali mu Lebbanoni wakatuma mulayizyo kumu sidali mu Lebbanoni,wakati, 'Kopa mwanaako musimbi kumwaanaangu mulombe kuti abe mukakwe, pesi chinyama chamusokwe mulebbanoni chakeendenda alimwi chakatyolweda aansi mukkoka.
Wamba wati, 'Langa, ndazunda Edoni, 'alimwi moyo wako wakusumpula.Lisumpule kukuzunda kwako, pesi kkala aamunzi, nkaambo nkaambonzi notalichitile penzi nomwini alimwi uwe, moonse anduwe a Juda?''

Pesi Amaziya takwe nakaswilila, nkaambo eechi chichitiko chakalikuzwa kuli Leza, aboobo alakonzya kwaaba bantu ba Juda mujaanza lyasinkondonyina, nkaaambo bakali bayandula kuchenjezegwa kulibaleza ba Edoi.
Aboobo Johoyasi, mwaami wa Izalayeli, wakalwisya; we aAmaziya, mwaami wa Juda, baakaswanana busyu kubusyu ku Bbeti Semesi, ya Juda.
Juda wakanyonyonwa kunembo lya Isilayeli, alimwi woonse muntu wakachijila kumuunzi.

Jehoyasi, mwaami wa Isilayeli, wakajata Amaziya mwana mulombe wa Johoyasi mwana wa Ahaziya, mwaami wa Juda ,ku Bbeti Semesi.Wakamweta ku Jelusalemu kuzwa kumulyaango wabulambo bwa Jelusalemu kuzwa kumulyaango wachooko musinzo usika kutukokola tulimyaanda    yone.

Wakabweza yoonse ngolide asiliva, zyoonse zintu zyakajanwa mung'anda ya Leza a Obedi , Edomu, alimwi azintu zyabuvubi zyakajanywa mung'anda ya mwaami, abasikumubamba alubo, alimwi wakabweeda ku Samaliya.
Amaziya mwaana mulombe wa Joyasi,mwaami wa Juda, wakapona myaaka iilikkumi amusanu musule akufwa kwa Johayazi, mwaami wa Izilayeli.
Amakani aamwi ayendelana aAmaziya, kumatalikilo akumamanino, Langa taalembendwe na mubhuku lyaabaami ba Juda a Izilayeli?
Lino kuzwa chiindi Amaziya nakapilukakuzwa kukutobela Jehova, bakatalika kuchita muzeezo mubi aatala anguwe mu Jelusalemu. Wakachijila ku Lachisi alimwi bakubunganya nkukoonya ooko.
Bakamubozya amabbiza alimwi bakamuzikka antoomwe abasikale bakwe bajuda.
Boonse bantu ba Juda bakabweza Uziya, ooyo wakali aaminyaka ikkumi amusanu awumwi wakuzyalwa kwakwe, akumubika aabusena bwawisa Amaziya.
Nguwe wakayakulula Elati akubweedezya kuli Juda. Kuzwa aawo mwami wakoona abasikale bakwe.

Uziya wakali aaminyaka kkumi amusanu awumwi yakuzyalwa kwakwe elyo naakatanguna kweendelezya. Wakeendelezya kwaminyaka ilimakkumi musanu ayibili mu Jelusalema. Izina lyabanyina kali Jekkoliya, wakalikuzwa muJelusalemu.
Wakachita ziluleme kumenso aaJehova, kalookuyobelezya zitondeezyo zyawisi, Amaziya, muli zyoonse.
Wakabambila lwakwe kukuyanduula Lezamumazuba aaZakkaliya, wakamuyiisya kulemeka Leza. Kufumbwa awo makani kuyanduula Jehova, Leza wakamuchita kuzwidilila.

Uziya wakayinka aanze alimwi akuyoolwisya baFilisitiya. Wakadilisizya aansi malambo amugunzi lya Gati, aku Jabbineya, alimwi aku Asidodi; wakayaka mugunzi munyika ya Asidodi alimwi aakati kama Filisitiya.
Leza wakamugwasya kulwisya ma Filisiyiya, akulwisya ma Alabbiya baliikukkala mu Gubbala, alimwi  akulwisya ma Amuyunetisi.
Ma Amoni bakabbadala mitelo kuli Uziya, alimwi mpuwo yakeendelela, akuyoosika kumilyango yamu Ijipiti, nkaambo wakalkuba manguzu miingi loko.
Mukuyungizya, Uziya wakayaka zisanza mu Jelusalema kumulyango wa Chooko, kumulyango wamukkuti, alimwi bulamba mpubunyonena, alimwi wakayumya.
Wakayaka zisanza zyakulangila munkanda. Akusya mikalo mingi mumakuti amuntandabae.Wakali aabulumi basikulima masaansa mutulundu alimwi mumyuunda ilabutebuzi, nkaambo wakali kuyandisya kulima.

Mukuyungizya, Uziya wakaliaampi yabaalumi balwana bakabbuda kuya kunkondo muzibunga eezyo zyakabambidwe mumweelwe wabo wakabalidwe a jeyiyeli, mulembi, amaseyiya, silutwe, waansi abwendelezi bwa Hananiya, umwi wabapati bamwaami.
Mweelwe wabazulwidi bampili aabo bakazulwida basinguzu babaalumi bakali 2,600.
Munsi lyajanza lyamwakali mpi yabaalumi bali 307,500 balumi abo bakachita nkondo anguzu mpati kukugwasya mwaami kukulwisya sinkondonyina.
Uziya wakababambila -bampi yoonse- ntobo, masumu, nguwani, azibaki zyakulwisya, atunta, mabwe akutuluzya.

MuJelusalemu wakapanga minchina yakabambidwe aabalumi bakali aalizibo kuti ibe aatusanza alimwi amalambo malamfu aakuwalila tunta amabwe mapati. Mpuwo yakwe yakazulila mumanyika aakule, nkaambo wakagwasigwa kapati  alimwi wakaba aamanguzu miingi.

Pesi kuchiindi Uziya nchakaba aanguzu mpati, moyo wakwe wakasumpulwa aboobo wakachita zintu zitaluleme; wakabisizya Jehova Leza wakwe, nkaambo wakayinka mung'anda ya Jehova kukutenta tununkilizyo atala aachipayililo chatununkilizyo.
Azaliya, mupayizi, wakamutobela mukkati, alimwi abapayizi bali musanu abatatu ba Jehova, baalumi basichaamba.

Nkabela bakamulula mwaami Uziya, akwaamba kuti kuli nguwe, ''Teensi nzizyako eezi, Uziya, kuti utente tununkilizyo kuli Jehova, pesi nzyabapayizi, balunyungu lwa Aloni, aaba basalazigilwe kukutenta tununkilizyo. muzwe mubusena busalala, nkaambo tewalisyomekede pe alimwi tukoyolemekwa a Jehova Leza.''

Mpawo Uziya wakanyema kajisi chibikilo chatununkilizyo mujaanza lyakwe kuti atente tununkilizyo. Kuchiindi naakachinyemenede bapayizi, chipele chakaba aankumu yakwe kunembo lyabapayizi kung'anda ya Jehova, kumbali aachipayililo chatununkilizyo.

Azaliya mupayizi mupati aboonse bapayizi bakamulanga, alimwi, amulange, waba aachipele kunkumu yakwe. Bakafwambaana kumugwisizya aanze. Nchobeni, alakwe wakafwambaana kuya aanze, nkaambo Jehova wakali wamuuma.

Uziya, Mwaami, wakali sichipele kusikila kubuzuba bwalufu lwakwe alimwi wakapona kung'anda ilaayilike kuzwa aawo nakaba sichipele nkaambo wakaliwagonkwa kuzwa kung'anda ya Jehova. Jotamu, mwanaakwe mulombe wakabweza ng'anda yamwaami weendelezya bantu ba nyika.
Amwi makani alangana a Uziya, kuzwa kumatangunino kosika kumamanino, akalembwa aamusinsimi Ayizaya mwana mulombe wa Amozi.
Aboobo Uziya wakoona abasikale bakwe; wakamuzikka abasikale bakwe munyika yatubanda twabaami, nkaambo bakaamba kuti, ''Ngusichipele.'' Jotammu, mwana wakwe mulombe, wakaba mwaami mubusena bwakwe.

Jotamu nakali aminyaka iili makumi aabili amusanu wakazyalwa eelyo nakatalika kweendelezya; wakeendelezya kwaminyaka iili kkumi amusanu awumwi mu-Jelusalemu. Izina lyabanyina bakali Jelusa; wakali mwana musimbi wa- Zadoki.
Wakali kuchita ziluleme kumeso a- Jehova, kutobelezya chitondezyo chawisi, Uziya, muzintu zyoonse. Alubo wakalikasya kunjila mung'ánda ya-Jehova. Pesi bantu bakachili kupona munzila imbi.
Wakayaka mulyango wejulu zisi munyika yezilundu zya- Jehova, aatala lyachilundu cha- Ofeli wakayaka loko.
Alubo wakayaka zisi munyika yezilundu zya- Juda aamulusaka wakayaka maandamayumu aamaanda malamfu.

Wakalwana lubo amwami wabantu ba- Amoni alimwi wakabazunda. Mumunyaka nguwo, bantu ba-Amoni  bakamupa zipo zilimwaanda omwe wamatalenta wensiliva, azyuulu zilikkumi mumyelwe wawiiti, azyuulu zilikkumi mumyelwe wabbali. Bantu ba- Amoni bakamupa zikozyene mumunyaka wabili awatatu.
Aboobo Jotamu wakabasinguzu nkaambo walikweenda kabotu kunembo lya- Jehova Leza wakwe.
Aalimwi makani a- Jotamu, nkondo zyakwe zyoonse, anzila zyakwe, bona, zililembedwe mubbuku lyabaami ba- Izilayeli a- Juda.
Wakali aminyaka yakuzyalwa iili kkumi abili amusanu eelyo nakatalika kweendelezya; wakeendelezya kwaminyaka iili kkumi amusanu awumwi mu- Jelusalemu.
Jotamu wakalazikwa aamwi abasikale bakwe, alimwi bakamuzikka muchisi cha- Davida. Ahazi mwana mulombe wakwe, wakaba mwami abusena bwakwe.

Ahazi wakali aminyaka ili makumi abili nakatalika kwendelezya, alimwi wakendelezya kwaminyaka ilikumi amusanu awumwi mu Jelusalemu. Takachita ziluleme pe kunembo lyamenso aJehova, mbuli Devidi sikale wakwe mbakalikuchita.
Nkabela, wakenda munzila zyabaami ba Izilayeli; alubo wakafula zikozyano zyaba Bbaala.

Mukuyungizya, wakatenta tununkilizyo Mumpata lya Beni Hinomu alimwi wakachita kuti bana biinde mumulilo; mukwinda mukutobelezya bukombi bwazikozyano zyabantu aabo Jehova mbakali watanda kuzwa munyika yabo kunembo lyabantu ba Izilayeli.
Wakapayilila akutenta tununkilizyo anyika zinanukide aatala lyezilundu amunsi lyamusamu woonse wesokwe teete.

Nkinkaako Jehova Leza wa Ahazi wakamupeda kujanza lyamwaami wa Alamu. Ba Alamu bamuzunda alimwi bakabweza baange biingi, kubeeta ku Damasikasi. Ahazi alubo wakapedekezegwa mujanza lyamwami wa Izilayeli ibakamuzunda alujayo lupati.
Nkaambo Peka mwana wa Lemaliya muzuba lyomwe wakajaya basilumamba bali 120 000 mu Juda alimwi boonse bakali baalumi basinguzu, nkaambo bakalibakaka Jehova Leza wabasikale babo.
Zikili, mwalumi singuzu uzwa ku Efulayimu, wajaya Maseyiya mwana wamwaami, Azilikamu, silutwe wangánda yamwaami, alimwi Elukana, wakali afwifwi amwaami.
Basilumamba baba Izilayeli bakabweza bazike kuzwa muluzubo lwabo bali 200 000 banakazi, balombe abasimbi. Alubo bakabweza lubono lwakwangila oolo ndubakabweeda aalo ku Samaliya.

Pesi musinsimi wa Jehova wakaliwo, izina lyakwe wakali Odedi. Wakinka koswanana abasilumamba bakalikuza mu Samaliya. Wakati kuli mbabo, '' Jehova, Leza wabasikale benu, wakanyema aJuda, wakabapedekezya mujanza lyako. Pesi wakabajaya chabukali bwakasika akujulu.
Lino uyanda kulele baalumi abanakazi ba Juda aJelusalemu mbuli bazike bako. Pesi tamukwe mulandu na wazibi zyanu aatala aJehova Leza wenu?
Mpawo lino muswilile kulindime: Amubwedezye baange, aabo mbimwakabweza babakulana benu, nkaambo bukali bwa Jehova bulalindinywe.''

Mpawo bamwi bazuluzi babantu ba Efuleyimu- Azaliya mwana Jehonani, Belechiya mwana wa Mesilemoti, Jehizikiya mwana wa Salumu, Amasa mwana Hadilayi, wakanyampuka nkalwana ababo bakabola kuzwa kunkondo.

Bakati kulimbabo, ''Tamwelede kweeta baange okuno, nkaambo muyanda kuchita chimwi chintu eecho chitatwetele chibi kuli Jehova, kuyungizya kuzibi zyesu amilandu, nkaambo mulandu wesu mupati, alimwi kulibukali buyumu aatala lya Izilayeli.''
Aboobo baalumi basilumamba bakasiya baange alimwi ambono zyakwangila kunembo lyabazuluzi ambungano yoonse.

Baalumi aba bakakwamba azina bakabuka alimwi bakabweza baange, akubazwatika boonse bakalichinkuna akati kabo aalubono lwakwangila. Bakabazwatika alimwi bakabapa nsangu. Bakabapa chakulya kuti balye akunya. Bakabasilika zilonda zyabo akubweza abo boongedwe aamadonki. Bakababwedezya kumpuli zyabo ku Jeliko, ( bakamba kuti chisi cha Palumuzi). Mpawo bakabweda ku Samaliya.
Muchiindi eecho mwaami Ahazi wakatuma batumwa kubaami ba Asiliya kobakumbila kuti bamugwasye.
Alubo ba Idomu bakasika alimwi bakalwisya ba Juda, bakabweza baange.

Ba Filisitiya alubo bakanjila babweza zisi zilimunyika ilimunsi azya Negevu wa Juda. Bakabweza Betisemesi, Ayijaloni, Gedeloti, Soko amgunzi aayo, Timina amagunzi aayo, Gimizo lubo amgunzi aayo. Bakayinka kokala mumasena aayo.
Nkaambo Jehova wakaboozya Juba munsi nkaambo ka Ahazi, mwaami wa Izilayeli; nkaambo wakanyonganiya mu Juda alimwi wakali wabisizya Jehova chakwindilila loko.
Tigilati- Pilesa, mwami wa Izilayeli, wakasika kulinguwe alimwi wakamupenganiya kutali kumusimya.
Nkaambo Ahazi wabba mungánda ya Jehova alimwi mumamanda abazuluzi, kuti ape baami ku Asiliya zintu zibotu.  Pesi kuchita boobu takwe nchichakamugwasya.
Ngonguwe mwami Ahazi wakabisya loko zyiindilide kuli Jehova muchiindi chakwe chakufwaba.

Nkaambo wakapayilila kuli ba leza ba Damasikasi, baleza bakalibamuzunda. Wakati, ''Nkaambo kabaleza babaami ba Alamu bakabagwasya, ndiyoopayilila kulimbaabo, kuchitila kuti balakozya kugwasizya ambebo.'' Pesi bakalikumusofwazya aba Izilayeli boonse.

Ahazi wabunganisya antomwe zibelesyo zyamungánda ya Leza alimwi wakazigonkola muzipanzi. Wakajala milyango yengánda ya Jehova alimwi wakalichitila lwakwe mwini zipayililo mumabazu woonse a Jelusalemu.
Muchisi choonse cha Juda waachita masena asumpukide aakutentela zipayizyo kuli bamwi ba leza. Wakabisizya Jehova, Leza wabasikale bakwe, kuti anyeme.
Lino zichito zyakwe zyoonse, anzila zyakwe zyoonse, kumatalikilo akumamanino, bona zililembedwe mu bbuku lyabami ba Juda aIzilayeli.
Ahazi wakalazikwa abasikale bakwe, alimwi bakamuzika muchisi, mu Jelusalemu, pesi tibakamweta pe kutubanda twabaami ba Izilayeli. Hezekiysa, mwanakwe mulombe, wakaba mwaami abusena bwakwe.

Hezekkiya wakatagun kweendelezya eelyo nakali aminyaka ili makkumimobile amusanu kukomena; wakeendelezya minyaka ili makkumi obile amusanu ayine mu Jelusalema. Izina lya banyina wakali Abija; wakali mwana musimbi wa Zekkaliya.
Wakachita zyakaluleme kumenso a Jehova, mbuli Deviti wisi wakwe mbakachita.
Mumunyaka mutaaanzi wakweendelezya kwakwe, mumweezi mutanzi, Hezekkiya wakajula makkoma aan'anda ya Jehova alimwi wakaabambulula.
Wakeeta bapayizi alimwi a ba Levi, alimwi wakababungania aantomwe mulubuwa kubbazu lya kujwe.
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Muswiliile kulindime inywe no ba Levi! Mukalisalazye, alimwi mukasalazye n'anda ya Jehova, Leza wabamataata benu, alimwi mukagwisye busofwazi kuzwa kubusena busalala.
Nkaambo baataata bsu bakasotoka milawu alimwi bakachita zyakalikutondwa kunembo lya Jehova Leza wesu; bakamusiya, bakagwisya masyu aabo kuzwa kubusena oko Jehova nkwakkala, alimwi babufutatila.
Alimwi bakajala milyango ya chinjililo alimwi bazima malampi; tebakatenta pe tununkilizyo na kupa zipo zyakutenta mubusena busalala kuli Leza wa Izilayeli.
Aboobo bukkali bwa Jehova bwakaselukila Juda a Jelusalema, alimwi wakabachita kuti babe zintu zyabuyoofu, zipa kuyowa alimwi zibula bulemu mbuli mbumubona amenso enu.
Aaka nkinkaako ba mataata besu nchibakajiigwa epanga, alimwi bana besu balombe, bana besu basimbi, alimwi a bakayintu besu nchibali mubwaange akaambo kacheechi.
Lino zili mumoyo wangu kuti ndichite chizuminano a Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, kuchitila kuti kunyema kwakwe kuyoosya kusosoloke kuzwa kulindiswe.
Nobana bangu balombe, mutabi batolo lno, nkaambo Jehova wamusala kuti mwiimikile kunembo lyakwe, kuti mumukombe, alimwi kuti mube balanda bakwe alimwi mutente tununkilizyo.''

Mpawo ba Levi bakabuka: Mahati mwana mulombe wa Amasayi, a Joweli mwana mulombe wa Azaliya, kubantu ba ba Kkohati; alimwi kubantu ba Melali, Kkisi mwana mulombe wa Abudi, a Azaliya mwana mulombe wa Jehaleleli; alimwi ku ba Gesoni, Jowa mwana mulombe wa Zima, a Edeni mwana mulombe wa Jowa;
kulunyungu lwa Elizafani, Simuli a Jehuweli; alimwi akulunyungu lwa Asafu, Zekkaliya a Mataniya;
kulunungu lwa Hemeni, Jehuweli a Simeyi; alimwi akulunyungu lwa Jedutani, Semayiya a Uziyeli.
Bakabunganisya bakkulana babo, bakalisalazya beni, alimwi bakanjila mukati mbuli baakalayilila mwaami, mukutobelezya majwi a Jehova, kuti asalazye n'anda ya Jehova.

Bapayizi bakanjila muchimpanzi chamukati chen'anda ya Jehova kukuyoochisalazya; bakagwisya busofwazi boonse mbubakajana mutempele ya Jehova mulubuwa lwa n'anda. Ba Levi bakabubweza kuti bakabugwisye akubutola ku kalonga Kkidiloni.

Lino bakatanguna lusalazyo mubuzuba butaanzi bwa mweezi mutaanzi. Mubuzuba bwa musanu aatatu bwa mweezi bakasikila chinjililo cha Jehova. Mpawo kwamazuba aambi aali musanu aatatu bakasalazya n'anda ya Jehova. Mubuzuba bwa kkumi alyomwe zuba lya mweezi mutanzi bakamaninsya.

Mpawo bakiinka kuli Hezekkiya, mwaami, mukati ken'anda ya mwaami alimwi bakati, ''Twayisalazya yoonse n'anda ya Jehova, chipayililo chazipo zyakutenta azibelesyo zyacho zyoonse, alimwi a tafula lya chibunge cha buliwo, azibelesyo zyalyo zyoonse.
Akaako twabamba limwi twasalazya zyoonse zintu eezyo Mwaami Ahazi nzyakagwisizye eelyo nakachita chakutasyomeka muchiindi chabweendelezi bwakwe. Bona, zili kuembo lya chipayililo cha Jehova.''
Mpawo Hezekkiya wakabuka chifumo alimwi wabungania bazululi ba chisi; wakayinka kun'anda ya Jehova.

Bakeeta basune bali  musanu ababili, bagutu bali musanu ababili, mbele zili musanu azibili, alimwi a zipule zili musanu azibili mbuli chipo cha chibi cha bwaami, cha lukwabililo a cha Juda. Wakalayilila bapayizi ba lunyungu lwa Aloni, kuti bazipayile aachipayilo cha Jehova.

Aboobo bakajaya basune, alimwi bapayizi bakatambula bulowa alimwi bakabusansiila aachipayililo. Mpawo bakajaya bagutualimwi bakasansiila bulowa bwabo aachipayililo; alimwi alubo bakajaya mbelele alimwi bakasansiila bulowa bwayo aachipayililo.
Bakeeta mpongo n'enze zyachipo chachibi kunembo lya mwaami a chibunga; bakabika maanza aabo alimbabo.

Bapayizi bakazijaya alimwi bakachita chipo chachibi abulowa bwazyo achipayililo kuchita lubweedezyo lwa Izilayeli woonse, nkaambo mwaami wakali walayilila kuti chipo chakutenta a chipo chachibi cheelede kuchitwa kuli Izilayeli woonse.

Hezekkiya wakabika ba Levi mun'anda ya Jehova  ili abuntimbwa, mitetele a myeembo, kuzibamba mbuli mumalayilile a Deviti, Gadi, linso lya mwaami, Natani, musinsimi, nkaambo malayilile akazwide kuli Jehova kwiinda mubasinsimi bakwe.
Ba Levi bakiimikila azilizyo zya Deviti, alimwi bapayizi amyeembo.

Hezekkiya wakabalayilila kuti bape chipo chakutenta aachipayililo. Eelyo chipo chakutenta nichakatanguna, lwiimbo lwa Jehova lwakatalika alulalo, aantomwe a myeembo aantomwe a zyakulizya zya Deviti, mwaami wa Izilayeli.
Choonse chibunga chakakomba, bayimbi bakayimba, alimwi basikulizya myeembo bakalizya; zyoonse eezi zyakayinkilila kunembo kusikila chipo chakutenta chamana.
Eelyo nibakamana zipo, mwaami aboonse bakaliwo anguwe bakakotoma alimwi bakakomba.
Mukuyungizya, Hezekkiya, mwaami, abazululi bakalayilila ba Levi kuti biimbe ntembawuzyo chalukondo, alimwi bakakotama alimwi wakomba,
Mpawo Hezekkiya wakati, ''Lino mwalisalazya kuli Jehova. Muze okuno alimwi mweete zituuzyo a zipo zyakulumba, alimwi boonse bakali amoyo uyanda bakeeta zipo zyakutenta.

Mweelwe wazipo zyakutenta mbungano nziyakeeta wakali basune bali makkumi ali musanu aabili, bagutu bali mwaanda, alimwi ambelele n'enze zili myaanda yobile. Zyoonse eezi zyakali zyachipo chakutenta kuli Jehova.
Zipo zyakasalazigwa zyakali nkabe zili myaanda ili musanu awumwi alimwi ambelele zili zyuulu zyotatwe.

Pesi bapayizi bakali bache loko kuti bafunde zyoonse zio zyakutenta, aboobo bakulana babo ba Levi, bakabagwasya kusikila mulimu wamana, alimwi kusikila bapayizi balisalazya beni, nkaambo ba Levi bakali kulangisisya kapati kukulisalazya beni kwiinda bapayizi.

Mukuyungizya, zipo zyakutenta zyakali zyiingi loko; zyakachitwa aamafuta aazipo zyabulyidilano, alimwi kwakali zipo zyakunywa kuli chimwi achimwi chipo chakutenta. Aboobo kubeleka kwan'anda ya Jehova kwakabambwa kabotu.
Hezekkiya wakabotelwa, alimwi abantu boonse lubo, akaambo kazeezyo Leza nzyakabambila bantu, nkaambo mulimu wakachitwa chakufwambana.

Hezekkiya wakatuma batumwa kuli boonse ba Izilayeli abaJuda, alubo wakalembela Efulemu a Manase magwalo, kuti basike kung' anda ya Jehova mu Jelusalemu, kuzobotelwa pobwe lyakwindilila kuli Jehova, Leza waba Izilayeli.
Nkaambo mwami, abazuluzi bakwe, alimwi aboonse bembungano yamu Jelusalemu bakabuzisisya aantomwe, nkabalokuzeza kubotelwa iPobwe lyakwindilila mumwezi wabili.
Tebakali kubotelwa ipobwe chiindi choonse, nkambo tibakalikwe bapayizi balisalazizye lwabo kukusekelela pobwe alimwi bantu tebakalinakubungana aantomwe mu Jelusalemu.
Aaya makani akaboneka nkaaluleme kumenso amwami ambungano yoonse.

Aboobo bakazumina kumwaya ijwi mu Izilayeli yoonse, kuzwa kuBbiyasyebba kuyosika ku Dani, kuti bantu beelede kusika kuzosekelela ipobwe lyapasika kuli Jehova, Leza waba Izilayeli, mu Jelusalemu. Nkambo tibalinabuunsi balichita amyeelwe mipati yabantu mukutobelezya mumalembe.

Aboobo batumwa bakiinka amagwalo kuzwa kumwami abazuluzi bakwe kuli boonse ba Izilayeli a Juda, mbuli mukulayililwa kwamwami. Bakati, '' Inywe bantu ba Izilayeli, amubole kuli Jehova, Leza wa Abulahamu, Isaki, aIzilayeli, kuchitila kuti aboole kulibamwi bakachala ibakachija kuzwa kujaanza lyabaami ba Asiliya.
Mutabi mbuli basikale benu na bakulana benu, bakabisizya Jehova, Leza wabasikale wabo, kuchitila kuti bachite chigambyo, mbuli mbumukubwene.

Lino mutayumwi nsingo zyenu, mbuli mbubakabede basikale benu; anukuti, mulipedekezye lwenu kuli Jehova alimwi musike mubusena bwakwe busalala, obo mbwakasalazya kwalyoonse, alimwi mukombe Jehova Leza wenu, aboobo kuchitila kuti bukali bwakwe buyosya bwalinozwa kulindinywe.

Nkaambo na mwabola kuli Jehova, bakulana benu abana balinojana kufwidwa luzyalo lutanzi kulabo bakabapilusya mbuli baange, alimwi bayoboola muleyi nyika. Nkambo Jehova Leza wenu uli aluuse abuya, alimwi takoyogwisya busyu bwakwe kuzwa ndinywe, na mwaboola kulinguwe.''
Aboobo batumwa bakazyendela zisi zyoonse mumasena aEfulemu aManase, munzila yoonse kosika kuZebuluni, pesi bantu bakabaseka akubafubazika.
Nikuba boobo, bamwi baalumi baku Asa aManase aZebuluni bakalibombya alimwi basika mu Jelusalemu.
Jaanza lya Leza alubo lyakasika aatala lyaa Juda kuzobapa moyo uumwi, kukuchita malayilile amwaami abazuluzi kuzwa mujwi lya Jehova.
Bantu biingi, mbungano mpati, bakabungana mu Jelusalemu kuzolya Pobwe lyakindilila lyachikwa chitakwe bumena mumwezi wabili.
Bakanyampuka alimwi babweza zipayililo zyakali mu Jelusalemu, alimwi azipayililo zyoonse zyatununkilizyo; bakaswela mumulonga wa Kidiloni.

Mpawo bakajaya tubelele twe pobwe lyakindilila mubuzuba bwa kumi aane bwamwezi wabili. Bapayizi aba Levi bakafwa nsoni, aboobo bakalisalazya alimwi bakeeta zipayizyo zitentedwe zyezipo mung'anda ya Jehova.
Baakima abusena bwabo mbuli mutubunga twabo, nkabalokutobelezya malayilile apedwe mumulawu wa Mozesi, mwalumi wa Leza. Bapayizi bakasansila bulowa oobo mbubakatambula kuzwa mumaboko aba Levi.

Nkaambo bakalibingi mumbungano bakatanalisalazya lwabo beni. Nkinkaako ba Levi bakajaya tubelele twe Pobwe lyakwindilila twawoonse walitanasalazigwa alimwi tibalino salazya zipayizyo zyabo kuli Jehova.

Nkaambo mubule bwabantu, bwiingi bwabo baazwa kuli Efulemu aManase, Izaka aZebuluni, tibalinalisalazya lwabo beni, nkabali bakalya chilyo chapobwe lyakwindilila, zitalinzizyo zyakalembebwe mumalayilile. Nkambo Hezekiya wakali wabakombela nkati, ''Leza mubotu nikuli walekelela muntu woonse
wabika moyo wakwe kukuyandula Leza, Jehova Leza wabasikale,wakwe, nikuba kuti talina lisalazya mbuli mumwelwe  wakulisalazya kwabusena busalalisya.
Aboobo Jehova wakaswilila Hezekiya akuponia  muntu.

Ibantu  ba Izilayeli bakaliwo mu Jelusamu bakabamba pobwe lyachinkwa chitakwe bumena kwamazuba alimusanu aabili akubotelwa kupati, ba Levi aba payizi bakalumbayizya Jehova buzuba abuzuba, balikwimba azilizyo zyompolola kuli Jehova.

Hezekiya wakasungilizya boonse ba levi bakamvwisisya mulimu wa Jehova. Aboobo bakalya balimanisizya pobwe kwamazuba alimusanu aabili, akupeda zipayizyo zyabulidilano, alimwi akulyamba zibi kuli Jehova, Leza wabasikale babo.
Mpawo mbungano yoonse mbizulwa yakazuminana kuti babotelwe pobwe kwamazuba aambi alimusanu aabili, bakachita mbubo akubotelwa.

Nkaambo Hezekiya mwaami wa Juda wakapa mbungano bajende beng'ombe bali chuulu chomwe ambele zili zyuulu zilimusanu azibili mbuli chipo; alimwi bazuluzi bakapa mbungano bajende beng'ombe bali chuulu chomwe azyuulu zilikumi zyembelele ampongo. Bapayizyi biingi bakalisalazya lwabo beni.
Yoonse mbungano ya Juda, abapayizi aba Levi alimwi aboonse bantu bakaza antomwe kuzwa ku Izilayeli, abeenzu bakasikide kuzwa kunyika yaku Izilayeli ababo bakali kukala ku Juda- boonse bakabotelwa.
Aboobo kwakaba kubotelwa kupati mu Jelusalemu, nkaambo kuzwa muchindi cha Solomoni mwana wa Devidi, mwaami wa Izilayeli, tikwakalinaba chintu chilimbuli nchichechi mu Jelusalemu.
Mpawo bapayizi, ba Levi, bakanyampuka alimwi bakalongezya bantu. Ijwi lyabo lyakamvwika, ankombyo zyabo zyakayinka kujulu, busena busalala aawo Leza mpakala.

Lino elyo zyoonse nizyakamana, bantu boonse ba- Izilayeli bakaliwo bakinka anze chisimcha- Juda akupwayula busyapu bwamabwe amisumpululu akutemena ansi ziyako zya- Asela, alimwi bakamwaya masena asumpukide azipayililo mulijuda boonse a- Bbenjamini, amuli Efulemu a- Manase kusikila bazimwaya zyoonse. Mpawo bantu boonse ba- Izilayeli bakapiluka, umwi awumwi kuchilawo chakwe akuchisi chakwe.

Hezekkiya wakalayilila kuti zyabilo zyabapayizi aba- Levi zibambwe mbuli muzyabilo zyabo, umwi awumwi wakalayililwa kumulimo wakwe, antoomwe bapayizi aba- Levi. Wakabalayilila kuti bachite zituuzyo zyakutenta azituuzyo zyabulyidilano kubeleka, kupa kulumba, akulumbayizya kumilyango yang' anda ya- Jehova. Wakalayilila kuti chimpanzi chachituko aakutenta chamwami kuzwa kuzintu nzyakalazyo, nkokuti, chitulo chakutenta chachifumofumo achamangolezya, kukkala kwamyezi, azipobwe zibambidwe, mbuli mbukwakalembedwe mumulawo wa- Jehova.

Nkabela wakalayilila bantu bakali kukkala ku-Jelusalemu kupa bapayizi aba- Levi zimpanzi aboobo kuti bagame kulemeka mbeta zya- Jehova. Imbeta mbuzyakatumizigwa, bantu baku- Izilayeli bakapa chabuuya kabalwebalwe kazilyo, wayini mupya, mafuta, buchi, alimwi kuzwa kubutebuzi bwamumyuunda. Baketa chakkumi chezintu zyoonse, zyakazwa.

Bantu baku- Izilayeli abaku Juda bakali kukkala muzisi a- Juda abalabo baketa chakkumi chan' ombe ambelele, achakkumi chazintu zisalala ezyo zyakabikilidwe Jehova Leza wabo, alimwi bakazilundika mumadwi. Kwakali mumweezi watatu nibakakkazika kubungika nzibakagwisya, alimwi bakazomaninsya mumweezi wamusanu ayibili. Eelyo Hezekkiya abazululi nibasika akubona madwi, bakalongezya Jehova abantu bakwe ma- Izilayeli.
Mpawo Hezekkiya wakabuzya kubapayizi aba- Levi atala amadwi.

Azaliya, mupati wabapayizi, wakung' anda ya- Zadoki, wakamusandula alimwi wati, ''Kuzwida bantu nibakakkazika kweta zipo mung' anda ya- Jehova, twakalya alimwi wati, ''Kuzwida bantu nibakakkazika kweta zipo mung' anda ya Jehova, twakalya alimwi twakakkuta, alimwi nzyiingi zyakasyala, nkambo Jehova wakalongezya bantu bakwe. Zyakasyala ngaya madwi mapati alawa.''
Hezekkiya wakalayilila kuti maanda akulondweda abambwe mung'anda ya Jehova, alimwibakabamba.
Mpawo bakeeta ziipo chakusyomeka , zyekkumiazintu zya Jehova. Kkonaniya muLevi nguwakali silutwe wakabalangide, amwalu wakwe Syimeyi wakalimutobezi wakwe.

Jehiyelu, Azaziya, Nahati, Asahelu, Jelimoti, Jozabbadi, Eliyelu, Isimakiya, Mahati, a Bbenaniya bakali basilutwe munsi akuboko kwa Kkonaniya a Syimeyi mwalu wakwe, nkabatuminwe a Hezekkiya, mwami, a Azaliya, silutwe wang' anda ya Leza.
Kkole mwana mulombe wa Ima mu Levi, sikubumba amulyango wakubuzwezuba, wakalangide zipo zyakulimvwida zya Leza, wakalangene akwaaba zipo kuli Jehova azipo zisalalisya.
Munsi lyakwe kwakali Edeni, Miniyamini, Jesyuwa, Syemayiya, Amaliya, a Sikaniya, muzisi zyabapayizi. Bakabuzya zyabilo zyabubanzi, kuti bape zipo banabakwabo mumyeelwe, boonse bapati abanini.
Bakapa alimwi kulabo baalumi balaminyaka yotatwe akuyakunembo, bakalembedwe mumalembe abasikale babo balikunjila mung'anda ya Jehova, mbuli mbukwelede kumabambe abuzuba, kukubeleka mbubakabambilidwe
Bakaaba kubapayizi mbuli malembe abasikale babo, akuba Levi bakali aminyaka makkumi obile akuyakunembo, mbuli mumilimo azyabilo zyabo.
Bakabikilizya antomwe abatete babo, banakazi babo, bana balombe babo, abana basimbi muluundu loonse, nkambo bakalisyomekede mukulibamba nkabasalala.

Nkambo bapayizi, ndunyungu lwa Aaloni, aabo bakali mumyunda yamumyuunzi yakuzisi zyabo, nanka muzisi zyoonse, bakali baalumi bakatondekedwe amazina kukupa zimpanzi kubaalumi boonse akkati kabapayizi, akuliboonse bakalembedwe mumagwalo abasikale mbuli akati kaba Levi.
Hezekkiya wakachita ezi mu Judiya yoonse. Wakamaninsizya zyoonse zibotu, ziluleme azisyomekede kunembo lya Jehova, Leza wakwe.
Kumilimo yoonse njakakkazikide mung'anda ya Leza, mulawu, malayilile, kukuyanduula Leza wakwe, wakazichita amoyo wakwe woonse, alimwi wakazwidilila.
Musule azintu eezi anchito zyakusyomeka, Senakkelibbu, mwami wa Siliya, wakaza akunjila mu Juda. Wakaza kuzolwanisya idolopo lilalubaya, elyo ndyakalangilide kulitola lwakwe mwini.
Muchindi Hezekkiya nakabona kuti Senakkalibbu weza akuti uyanda kulwisya Jelusalemu,
wakabuzya bazuluzi bakwe abalumi basinguzu kuti basinke tusensa twamanzi twakali aanze edolopo; bakamugwasya kuti achite mbubobo.
Aboobo bantu biingi bakabungana antomwe akwimikizya tusensa atulonga twakali kukkunka nkatwinda akkati kenyika. Bakati, ''Nkambonzi baami ba Asiliya nibataze akujana maanzi miingi?''
Hezekkiya wakaba mukozu alimwi wakayaka bulambo bwakali bwadilika. Wakayaka maanda malamfu, abumwi bulambo bwaanze wakasimya Milo mudolopo lya Devidi, akuchita zilwanio zyingi antobo.
Wakabika basilutwe benkondo kubantu. Wakabangika kuli nguwe antomwe mubusena bujulikide kumulyango wadolopo akwambula chakusungilizya kuli mbabo. Wakati,
''Amuyume akuba bakkozu. Mutayoowi nikuba kutyompwa nkambo kamwami wa Asiliya aampi yonse njalayo, nkambo mpali ulandiswe mupati kwinda mbalabo.
Njalayo nimpi yenyama, pesi ulaswebo ngu Jehova, Leza wesu, kukutugwasya, akukulwana nkondo yesu'' Mpawo bantu bakalyombozya amajwi a Hezekkiya, mwami wa Juda.

Musule azezi, Senakkelibbu, mwami wa Asiliya, wakatuma balanda bakwe ku Jelusalemu ( lino wakali kunembo lya Lakkisi, ampi yakwe yakali anguwe), kuli Hezekkiya, mwami wa Juda, aboonse ma Juda bakali mu Jelusalemu. Wakati,
''Mbubobu Senakkelibbu, mwami wa Asiliya, mbwaamba: Musyomedeenzi kuti musinkilizigwe mu Jelusalemu?
Hezekkiya takali kumwena na, kuti amupedekezye kukujigwa anzala anyota, elyo nakamwambila kuti, ''Jehova Leza wanu uyotuvuna kujanza lyamwami waku Asiliya'?
Teensi oyu Hezekkiya nguwaka mwaya masena asumpukide azipayililo akulayilila Juda a Jelusalemu, 'achipayililo chomwe mpomwelede kukkombela, alinchicho mpomwelede kutentela zipayizyo'?
Tamuzina imebo abasikale bangu nzitwakachita kubantu boonse bakuli zimwi nyika? Teensi baleza babantu bazyungulukide nyika tebalikukkonzya kuvuna nyika zyabo kuzwa kumanguzu aangu?

Akkati kabaleza boonse bazisi eezyo basikale nzibakanyonyoona kumaninsya, kwalo kwakali Leza na wakavuna bantu bakwe kuzwa kujanza lyangu? Nkambonzi Leza wanu naanga ulakkonzya kumuvuna kuzwa kumanguzu aangu?

Lino mutaleki Hezekkiya amwenene nikuba kumuyunga yunga muli yeyi nzila. Kamutamusyomi, nkambo takwe leza wenyika naba bwami bwaka kkonzya kuvuna bantu bakwe kuzwa kujanza lyabasikale bangu. Nkujana nywebo leza wanu wamuvuna biyeni mukuboko kwangu?''
Balanda ba Sanikkalebbu bakambula zyingi atala a Jehova Leza alimwi aatala a Hezekkiya mulanda wakwe.

Senakkelibbu wakalemba amagwalo kuti aniake Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, akwambula nkalangene anguwe. Wakati, ''Mbukunga abaleza bayimwi mikowa yenyika tabakonzezye kuvuna bantu babo kuzwa kujanza lyangu, aboobo baleza ba Hezekkiya tabakoyovuna bantu bakwe kuzwa kujanza lyangu.''
Bakakwila mumulaka wachi Juda kubantu baku Jelusalemu abo bakali abulambo, kukubayoosya akubakkatazya, kuti batole dolopo.
Bakaamba kuli Leza waku Jelusalemu mbuli mbwakamba kulaze bazimwi nyika, bakali milimu yamaanza abantu.
Hezekkiya, mwami, antomwe a Isaya mwana mulombe wa Amozi, musinsimi, wakakomba nkambo kamakkani aya alimwi wakakwilila ijulu.

Jehova wakatuma angelo, oyo wakajaya balumi basikulwana , bapati benkondo, abasilutwe bamwami mumusansa. Aboobo Senakkelibbu wakabweda kunyika yakwe nkawuside abuusu kumenso akwe. Eelyo nakaya mung' anda ya Leza wakwe, bamwi bana bakwe bakamujaya epanga.
Muleyi inzila, Jehova wakavuna Hezekkiya abakkala mu Jelusalemu kuzwa kujanza lya Senikkalebbu mwami wa Asiliya, akuzwa mukuboko kwabamwi boonse, akubapa kulyokezya kuzwa kumabazu woonse.
Banji bakeeta zipo kuli Jehova mu Jelusalemu, azipo ziyandisi kuli Hezekkiya mwami wa Juda, elyo wakasumpulwa mumenso azisi zyoonse kuzwa kulecho chiindi akuya kunembo.
Kuli ayo mazuba Hezekkiya wakachiswa chakufwa. Wakakkomba kuli Jehova, wakambula kuli nguwe akumupa chitondezyo kuti uyopona.
Pesi Hezekkiya takabbadala kuli Jehova lugwasyo ndwakapedwe, nkambo moyo wakwe wakasumpulwa. Aboobo bukkali bwakamuselukila akuli Juda aku Jelusalemu.
Nikubaboobo, Hezekkiya wakazolibombya kukulisumpula kwamoyo wakwe, lwakwe abakali mu Jelusalemu, aboobo kuti bukkali bwa Jehova tebwakasikila mumazuba a Hezekkiya.
Hezekkiya wakali abuvubi bwiingi abulemu. Wakali chitila maanda akulondweda nsiliva, angolida, mabwe mayandisi, abutwizyo azya ntobo azya zyoonse zintu ziyandisi.
Wakali amaanda alimwi akutyolela zilyo, wayini mupya, amafuta azyaata zyazivubwa zisiyene siyene. Wakali amatanga alimwi amuzyaata zyawo.
Mukuyungizya, wakali amadolopo ambono zyambelele ang'ombe nyiingi, nkambo Leza wakali wamupa buvubi bwingi loko.
Ngonguwe oyu Hezekkiya wakajala kasensa kaajulu kamaanzi ku Gihoni, alimwi wayinzizya nkaluleme kumbo lyamuunzi wa Davida. Hezekkiya wakazwidilila mumilimo yakwe yoonse.

Nekuba boobo mumakani abangambela abapati baku Bbabbiloni, ibakatuma kukubuzya mibuzyo yababo bakeezi, atala azitondezyo zigambya eezyo zyaka chitikene munyika, Leza wakamaninsya alikke lwakwe, kuti amusunke, akuti azibe zyoonse zyakali mumoyo wakwe.

Lino mumakani aamwi alangene a Hezekkiya, kubikilizya anchito zyakwe zyachizuminano zyabululami, ulabona kuti zyakalembedwe muchilengano chamusinsimi Isaya mwana wa Amozi, amubbuku lyabaami ba Juda aba Izilayeli.

Hezekkiya wakoona antomwe abamawisi, alimwi bakamuvwikka muchilundu chatubanda twakali twalunyungu lwa Davida. Ba Juda boonse abakkala mu Jelusalemu bakamulemeka kukufwa kwakwe. Manase mwana wakwe mulombe nguwakaba mwami mubusena bwakwe.
Manase wakali aminyaka ilikkumi ayibili yakuzyalwa nakatalika kuba mwendelezi;  wakeendelezya minyaka ili makkumi alimusanu amusanu mu Jelusalemu.
Wakachita bubi mumenso a Jehova, mbuli zisesemyo zyabamaasi aabo Jehova mbakatanda kubusyu bwabana ba Izilayeli.

Nkenkaako wakayakulula zikombelo zyakuzilundu ezyo wisi wakwe  Hezekkiya nzyakali wamwaya, alimwi wakayaka zipayililo zyaba bbaala, wakachitazisamu zya Asela, akukotamina nyenyezi zyakujulu akuzikomba.
Manase wakayaka zipayililo mung'anda ya Jehova, nekuba kuti Jehova wakalayilila kuti, ''Mu Jelusalemu moliyoba izina lyangu kwalyoonse.''
Wakayaka zipayililo zyanyenyezi zyoonse zyakujulu mumibanzo yobile yamung'anda ya Jehova.

Mukkuti lya Bbeni Hinomu wakachita kuti bana bakwe biinde mumulilo. Wakalikusonda, akulowa akubala zyabulozi alimwi wakali kubuzyanya abaabo balikwambuula abafwide abaabo balikwaambula amyuuya. Manase wakachita bubi bwindilide kubusyu bwa Jehova, alimwi wakamunyemya.

Ichikozyanyo chibezedwe nchakapanga, wakachibikka mung' anda ya Leza. Njiiyeyi ing'anda Leza njakambila Devidi a Solomoni mwanakwe; wakatedi, ''Muuli njiyeeyi ng'anda alimwi mu Jelusalemu , eyo njindakasala kuzwa kumisyobo yoonse ya Izilayeli, kuti ndiyobika izina lyangu kwalyoonse.

Nsikoyobagwisya limbi bana ba Izilayeli kuzwa munyika njindaka babambila kuli bamawisi, na kuti bachita kabotu kukubamba zyoonse nzendakabalayilila, kutobelezya mulawu, milazyo ambeta nzendakapa kwindila kuli Mozesi.''
Manase wakazulwida ba Juda abantu bamasi abo Jehova mbakajaya kubusyu bwaba Izilayeli.
Jehova wakambila Manase, akubantu bakwe, pesi takwepe nebakaswilila.
Nkeenkako Jehova wakabetela bapati babasilumamba bamwami wa Asiliya, bakajata Manase akumwaanga, bakamwanga ensimbi, akumutola ku Bbabbiloni.
Manase nakali mumapenzi, wakakombelezya kubusyu bwa Jehova, Leza wakwe, akulibombya kapati kubusyu bwa Leza wabamawisi.
Wakakomba kulinguwe; alimwi Leza wakakombelezegwa anguwe, akumvwa inkombyo yakwe alimwi wakamubwedezya ku Jelusalemu, mubwami bwakwe. Eelyo Manase wakaziba kuti Jehova ngu Leza.

Kusule lyaaya, Manase wakayaka bulambo kunze lyamuunzi wa Devidi, kubbazu lyakumbo lya Gibboni, mukkuti, kusikila kumulyango wa Nswi. Wakazyunguluka chilundu cha Ofelu ambubo akubalampya kapati bulambo. Wakabikka basilutwe bakozu bampi mumyuunzi yoonse yaba Juda ilamabaya.
Wakagwisya ba Leza beenzu, azikozyanyo zyamituni mung'anda ya Leza azipayililo zyoonse nzyakabikkide muchilundu chang'anda ya Jehova amu Jelusalemu, akuzisowa aanze lyamuunzi.
Wakayakulula chipayililo cha Jehova akupayila alinchicho zituuzyo chabunyina akundumbyo; wakalayilila ba Juda kuti bakombe Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli.
Nekuba boobo, bantu bakachili kupayila kuzilundu, pesi kabapayila kuli Jehova luzutu, Leza wabo.
Amwi makani atala a Manase, inkombyo yakwe kuli Leza, amajwi abalunguluzi ibakamubambila muzina lya Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, ngaya, alilembedwe mubbukulyanchito zya baami ba Izilayeli.

Mumalembe aya muli lwaana luli atala ankombyo zyakwe ambuli Leza mbwakasundwa anjiiyo. Alimwi kulilembedwe zibi zyoonse ansotoko amasena nkwakali wayaka zipayililo zyamuzilundu akwimika zisamu zya Asela azikozyanyo zibezedwe, katana kulibombya -- zililembedwe mumakani abalunguluzi.
Elyo Manase bakazomulazika abasikale bakwe, akumuvwikka mung'anda yakwe mwini. Amoni, mwanakwe, mwalumi, ngwakatola bwami bwakwe.
Amoni wakali aminyaka ili makkumi obile ayibili yakuzyalwa nakanjila mubwami; wakayendelezya kwaminyaka yobile mu Jelusalema.
Wakachita bubi kumenso a Jehova, mbuli Mananse, wisi, mbwakali kuchita. Amoni wakali kupayila kuzikozyanyo zyoonse zibezedwe eezyo Manase wisi nzyakali wachita, akuzikomba.
Takwe nakalibombya pe kubusyu bwa Jehova, mbuli Manase wisi mbwakachitide. Anukuti, nguyoyo Amoni wakabisya chakwindilila.
Balanda bakwe bakamuvwiiya akumujaya mung'anda yakwe.
Pesi bantu bamuchisi bakabajaya abo boonse ibakamuvwiya mwami Amoni, akubika Josiya, mwanakwe, kuti abweze bwami.
Josiya wakali aminyaka ili musanu ayitatu yakuzyalwa nakatalika kwendelezya; wakendelezya kwaminyaka ili makumi otatwe awumwi mu Jelusalemu.
Wakachita ziluleme kubusyu bwa Jehova, akweenda munzila zya Devidi wisi, alimwi takwepe nakaleya kuchilisyo nikuba kochimweensi.

Elyo mumunyaka wamusanu ayitatu yamu bwendelezi bwakwe, nakachili mwanike, wakatalika kuyanduula Leza wa Devidi, wisi. Mumunyaka wakkumi ayibili wakatalika kusalazya Juda a Jelusalemu mukumwayula zipayililo zyakuzilundu, amasamu a Asela, azikozyanyo zibezedwe alimwi azikozyanyo zifulidwe.

Bantu bakamwayula zipayililo zyaba Bbaala kubusyu bwakwe; wakatema zipayililo zyatununkilizyo zyakali alinzizyo. Wakatyola masamu a Asela azikozyanyo zifulidwe akuba bufwefwelenga mane bwaba lusuko. Wakalumwaya mwaya lusuko atubanda twababo ibakali kupayila kulinzizyo.
Wakatenta mafuwa abapayizi bazyo aazipayililo zyabo. Muli yeyi inzila wakasalazya Juda a Jelusalemu.
Wakachita zikozyenye mumyunzi ya Manase, Efulemu, aku Simiyoni, akunzila zyonse manekuyosika ku Nafutali, alimwi amumatongo akabazyungulukide.

Wakatyolweda ansi zipayililo, wakawuma zisamu zya Asela antomwe azikozyanisyo zyakubeza zyabalusuko zyazukila, alimwi wakagonka wanzanisya zyoonse zipayililo zyatununkilizyo munyika yoonse ya Izilayeli. Mpawo wakabweda ku Jelusalemu.

Lino munyaka wakkumi amusanu ayitatu yabwendelezi bwakwe, nakamana kusalazya nyika ang'anda ya Leza, wakatuma Sofani mwana wa Azaliya, Maseya, silutwe wamunzi, alimwi Jowa mwana mulombe wa Jowazi mulembi, kuti bayakulule ng'anda ya Jehova Leza wakwe.

Bakaya kuli Hilikkiya, mupayizi mupati, bakamupa mali yakeetwa mung'anda ya Leza, kuti ba Levi, basikulinda milyango, njebakabungika kuzwa kuli Manase a Efulemu, akulamwi masena aba Izilayeli ibakasyaala, kuzwa kuli boonse ba Juda aba Bbenjamini, akuzwa kulibabo balikukkala mu Jelusalemu.
Bakapa mali kubalumi balikulanga mulimo atala eng'anda ya Jehova. Aba balumi bakabbadala basikubeleka abo bakayakulula akubambulula ng'anda ya Jehova.
Bakapa basikuupanga kaluli abasikuyaka kuti bawule mabwe abezedwe azisamu zyakuswanizya, akuti ba maate mayake ayo bamwi bami ba Juda ngebakasiya banyonyoona.

Aba balumi bakachita mulimo chakusyomeka. Basilutwe babo ibalikubabelesya mba Johati a Obbediya, ba Levi, bana ba Melali; a Zakkaliya a Mesulamu, bazwa kubana ba Kkohati. Bamwi baba Levi, boonse bakachita obotu kuli zyakwiimba, bakeendelezya basimulimo.
Aba ba Levi bakali kubalanga abo balikubweeza mikuli yakayaka aboonse bakali kubeleka milimo yamisyobo misyobo. Kwali ba Levi alimwi ibakali balembi, basilutwe, abasikulinda milyango.
Nebakagwisya mali eyo yakeetwa mung'anda ya Jehova, Hilikkiya mupayizi wakajana bbuku lyamulawu wa Jehova ngwakapa kwindilila kuli Mozesi.
Hilikkiya wakambila Safani mulembi kuti, ''Ndajana bbuku lyamulawu mung'anda ya Jehova.'' Hilikkiya wakatola bbuku lyamulawu kuli Safani.
Safani wakatola bbuku kumwami, alimwi wakamwambila wati, ''Balanda bako balokuchita obotu zyoonse nzebakapegwa kuti bazichite.
Bakagwisya yoonse imali yakajanwa mung'anda ya Jehova, alimwi bakiipeda mumaanza aba silutwe abasimilimo.''
Safani mulembi wakalwiida mwami, ''Hilikkiya mupayizi wandipa bbuku.'' Elyo Safani wakabala mulindilyo babalila mwami.
Elyo mwami nakamvwa majwi amumulawu, wakadelula zyakusama zyakwe.
Mwami wakalayilila Hilikkiya, Ahikkamu mwana wa Safani, Abbudoni mwana wa Mikka, Safani mulembi, a Asaya, mulanda wakwe, kuti,

''Amwinke mukabuzye luyando lwa Jehova alindime, abaabo ibasyeede mu Izilayeli amu Juda, nkambo kamajwi aabbuku elyo lyakajanwa. Nkambo bwakomena, bukali bwa Jehova obo bwakatilwa alindiswe. Bwakomena, nkambo bamataatesu tebakaswilila pe kumajwi aleeli ibbuku kukubamba makani woonse alembedwe mulindilyo.''

Nkeenkako Hilikkiya ababo mwami mbakalayilila bakiinka kuli Hulida musinsimi mwanakazi, muka Salumu mwana wa Tokkati mwana wa Hasila, sikubamba zisamo (walikukkala mu Jelusalemu mu Bboma lyabili), alimwi bakambuula anguwe mbuboobu.
Wakabaambila kuti, ''Mbubobu Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, mbwaawamba: Amukawambile mwalumi wamutuma kulindime,
'mbubobu Jehova mbwawamba: Amubone, mebo ndayanda kweeta mapenzi anyika eyi abantu bayo, woonse matusi alembedwe mubbuku ndibakabala kubusyu bwa mwami wa Juda.
Ezi ziyochitika nkambo bakandileka akutentela mizimu myeenzu tununikilizyo, alimwi bandikalazya azyonse nzebachita amanza aabo, eelyo bukali bwangu buyotilwa abusena oobu, alimwi tabukoyolesegwa pe.'
Pesi kumwami wa Juda, oyo wamutuma kuyobuzya Jehova ezyo nzyayelede kuchita, nzeezi nzyotakamwambile, 'Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli waamba oobu: Atala amajwi ayo ngwakamvwa,

nkambo moyo wako wakali mutete, alimwi wakalibombya kubusyu bwa Leza niwakamvwa majwi aakwe atala aboobu busena abantu bakkede mumo, alimwi kuti wakalibombya kubusyu bwangu akudelula zyakusama zyako akulila kubusyu bwangu, ambebo ndakuswilila -- nkooku kwambuula kwa Jehova --
Bona, ndiyokusisya kukabanda kako mulumuno, alimwi menso ako takoyobona neliba lyomwe lyamapenzi ngesikayete aliyeyi nhyika abakkala mulinjiiyo.'''Balumi bakatola aya makani kumwami.
Elyo mwami wakatuma batumwa akubunganya antomwe boonse bapati ba Juda a Jelusalemu.

Mpawo mwami wakayinka kung'anda ya Jehova, aboonse bantu ba Juda abakakkede mu Jelusalemu, abapayizi, ba Levi abantu boonse, kuzwa kubapati kuyosika kubanini. Wakabala kumatwi aabo woonse majwi aabbuku lya chizuminano elyo lyakajanika mung'anda ya Jehova.

Mwami wakima abusena bwakwe akupanga chizuminano kubusyu bwa Jehova, chakweenda munzila zya Jehova, akubamba milazyo yakwe, milawu yakwe, ambeta zyakwe, chamoyo wakwe wonse achamuya wakwe woonse, kukuswilila majwi achizuminano ayo akalembedwe mulindilyo bbuku.
Wakazumizya boonse bakajanika mu Jelusalemu amuchisi cha Bbenjamini kukwiima mu chizuminano. Akukkala mu Jelusalemu bakachita chakulibombya muchizuminano cha Leza, oyo Leza waba sikale babo.

Josiya wakabweza zintu zyoonse zisesemya kuzwa munyika yakapedwe bantu ba Izilayeli. Wakachita kuti boonse bakali mu Izilayeli bakkombe Jehova, Leza wabo. Kumazuba aakwe woonse, tebakapambuka pe kuzwa kukutobela Jehova, Leza wabasikale babo.
Josiya wakabamba Pasika lyaJehova muJelusalema, alimwi wakajaya tubelele twaPasika mubuzuba bwa kkumi aane mumweezi wakusanguna.
Wakabika bapayizi mubusena bwabo akubasungilizya kumilimu yang'anda yaJehova.

Wakabambila baLevi aabo bakali kuyiisya  Izilayeli woonse alimwi abo boonse bakapambwidwe kuliJehova, ''Amubike bbokesi lisalala lyachizuminano mung'anda ya Solomon mwana waDevidi, mwaami mwaba Isilayeli njaakayaka. Mutalibwezi nkamuloobuzyunguluka aamakkuko eenu lubo. Lino amukombe Jehova Leza wanu, alimwi mugwasye bantu batu bakwe baIsilayeli.
Amulibambilile lwanu kwiindilila mumazina amaanda abasikale ankamu zyanu, kutobelezya malembe ngaakalayilila Devidi, mwaami waIsilayeli, aayo aSolomoni, mwana wakwe.
Mwiime mubusena busalala, mubweze nkamu zyanzubo zyamaanda aakwanu, lunyungu lwabantu, akubweza busena bwanu ankamu zyaluzubo lwamaanda abaLevi.
Mujaye tubelele tapasika mulisalazye nobeni, mubambe tubelele twabaalu benu kuchita mbuli ijwi lyaJehova eelyo lyakapegwa muluboko lwa lwaMozesi.

Josiya wakapa zyuulu zyotatwe zyatubelele atupongo kuzwa mubutanga bwachipo chapasika kubantu boonse bwakaliwo, alimwi wakapa lubo zyuulu zyotaatwe zyang'ombe - eezi zyoonse zyakazwa kulubono lwa mwaami.

Bazuluzi bakwe bakapa chipo chakulimvwida kubantu, bapayizi, abaLevi. Hilikiya, Zakkaliya, aJehiyeli, basilutwe bakalandide ng'andayaLeza, bakapa kubapayizi 2600 zipo zyapasika amyaanda yotatwe yang'ombe.
Alakwe Kkonayiya, aSemayiya, Jeyiyeli, aJozaddadi, mupati wabaLevi, bakapa zipo zyapasika zili zyuulu zyosanwe kuba Levi amyaanda yosanwe yang'ombe.
Aboobo mulimu wakabambwa, alimwi bapayizi bakiima aabusena bwabo, akuswiilila malayilile aamwami.
Bakajaya tubelele twapasika, alimwi bapayizi bakasansiila bulowa mbubakatambula mumabokoaabaLevi, alimwi baLevi bakafnda tubelele.
Bakagwisya zitulozyakutena , kuti baabile nkamu zyamaanda aanyungu zyabantu, kuti bape kuli Jehova, mbuli mbukulembedwe mubbuku lyaMozesi. Bakachita boobo akung'ombe.
Bakayoka tubelele twepasika mumulilo nkabatobelezya malayilile. Mbuli zipo zisalazigidwe, bakabizya mumpoto, amumabbodo, amumampane, alimwi bakafwambana kuzitola kubantu boonse.
Musule bakabamba zyabo zipoazyabapayizi, lunyungu lwa Aloni, bakalijisinkini mukutula zipo zyakutenta amafuta kusikila kwasiya, aboobo baLevi bakabamba zipo zyabo azyabapayizi, lunyungu lwa Aloni.

Basikwiimba, lunyungu lwaAsati, bakali mubusena bwabo, mbuli mbubakalayililwa aDevidi, Asati, Hemeni aJedutuni sichilengano chamwaani, alimwi basikulinda bakali kumilyango yoonse. Teebakeelede kusiya busena bwabo, kaambo kabunyina baLevi bakali kubabambila zyabo.
Aboobo, kuleecho chiindi mulimuwoonse waJehova wakali kuchutilwa pobwe lyapasika akutula chipo chakutenta achipayililo chaJehova, mbuli mwaami Josiya mbwakalayilila.
Bantu baIsilayeli bakaliwo bakabamba pasika kuleecho chiindi, apobwe lyachinkwa chitakwe busweezyo kwamazuba musanu aabili.

Pobwe lyePasika liloobu taakwe nilyakalinachitwa mu Izilayeli kuzwa kumazuba aaSamuyeli musinsimi, nikuba umwi wabaami wa Izilalayeli wakali wapobola Pasika mbuli Josiya mbakachita, antoomwe abapayizi baLevi abantu boonse baJuda abaIsilayeli bakaliwo, abakala muJelusalema.
Eeli Pasika lyakabambwa mumunyaka wakumi amusanu ayitatu mubweendelezi bwaJosiya.
Musule lyazeezi zyoonse, wakamaninsya kubamba ng'anda yaLeza, Neko, mwaami wa Ijipiti , wakaya kuyolwanisya Kakemisi kumulonga Yufulatisi, almwi wakinka kuyomulwana.

Pele Neko wakatuma bangambela kulinguwe wati, ''Ndichiteenzi ayebo, mwaami waJuda? Nsiyobuzida nduwe sunu,  pele ndizida ndanda eeyo njendiyanda kuchita nkondo anjiyo. Leza wandilayilila kuti ndifwambaane, abooboleka kupilingana aLeza, ooyoulaandime, kana wakunyonyoona.''
Nikiubaboobo, Josiya wakakkaka kuti amusiye kuzwa kuli nguwe. Wakalyeneniya kuti amulwane. Taakaswilila majwi aaNeko ayo akazwa mumulomo waLeza; aboobo wakiinka kukuyomulwana mukkuti llya Megido.
Basimata bakayasa mwaami Josiya, alimwi mwaami wakati kubalanda bakwe, ''Amunsigwisye nkaambo ndayaswa bubi.''
Aboobo balanda bakwe bakamugwisya munkalaki, akumubika munkalaki iimbi. Bakamutola kuJelusalema, nkwaakakufwida. Wakavwikwa mutubanda twabamawisi. BaJuda boonse abakuJelusalemabakamulila Josiya.
Jelemiya wakalila Josiya; aboonse basikwiimbabaalumi abanakazi balamulila Josiya kusikila asunu. Eezi nyimbo zyakaba chiyanza kuIsilayeli;  langa munyimbo zyakuli.
Amwi makani alatala aJosiya, amilino yakwemibotu njakachita mukulibombya kulezyo zilembedwe mumulawu waJehova -
amilimo yakwe, kuzwakumatalikilo ado kumamanini, zililembedwe mubbuku lyabaami baJuda abaIsilayeli.
Mpawo bantu bamunyika bakabweza Jehoyahazi mwana wa Josiya, akumuchita mwami abusena bwawisi mu- Jelusalemu.
Jehoyahazi wakalaminyaka makumi obile ayitatu yakuzyalwa nakakkazika kweendelezya, alimwi wakendeezya myezi yotatwe mu- Jelusalemu.
Mwami wa- Egepita wkamugwisya mu- Jelusalemu, akubbadalisya nyika mwanda wamatalenta aniliva lyomwe lyangolida.

Mwami wa- Egepita wakabika Eliyakkimu, wakali mukulana wa- Jehoyahazi kuba mwami wa- Juda a-Jelusalemu (alimwi wakasandula zina lya Eliyakkimu kuba Jehoyiyakkimu). Mpawo Nekko wakabweza Eliyakkimu mukulana wa- Johoyahazi akumutola ku- Egepita.
Jehoyakkimu walaminyaka iili makumi obile ayili musanu yakuzyalwa nakatalika kwendelezya, alimwi wakendelezya minyaka ilikkumi lyomwe awumwi mu- Jelusalemu. Wakachita bubi mumeso a- Jehova Lez wakwe.
Mpawo Nebbukadineza, mwami wa- Bbabbiloni, wakamulwana akumwanga amanketani wamubweza wamutola ku- Bbabbiloni.
Nebbukadineza lubo wkabweza zintu zyamung''anda ya- Jehova kutola ku- Bbabbiloni, akuzibika mung''anda yamwami ku- Bbabbiloni.

Alimwi amwi makani anangene a- Jehoyiyakkimu, zintu zibili nzyakachita, alimwi zyakajanwa kulinguwe, langa, zililembedwe mubbuku lyabami ba- Juda aba- Izilayeli. Elyo Jehoyiyakkini mwana wakwe, wakaba mwami abusena bwakwe.
Jehoyiyakkini wakala minyaka musanu ayitatu yakuzyalwa nakatalika kwendelezya ; Wakendelezya mwezi yotatwe amazuba alikkumi mu- Jelusalemu. Wakachita bubi kumeso a- Jehova.
Kulwaka, mwami Nebbukkadineza wakatuma balumi akumweta ku- Bbabbiloni, azintu ziyandisi zizwa mung' anda ya- Jehova, akubika Zedekiya, waluzubo lwakwe, kuba mwami wa- Juda a- Jelusalemu
Zedekiya wakali aminyaka makumi obile awumwi yakuzyalwa nakatalika kwendelezya; Wakendelezya minyaka ilikkumi awumwi mu- Jelusalemu.
Wakachita bubi mumeso a- Jehova Leza wakwe. Takwe nakalibombya kunembo lya- Jelemiya misinsimi, wakambula kuzwa kumulomo wa- Jehova.
Zedekkiya lubo wakapapila mwami Nebbukkadineza, wakamuchitide kuti akonkezye kulibombya kulinguwe a-Leza. Pesi Zedekkiya wakayumya nsingo yakwe akuyumya moyo kukupapila Jehova, Leza wa- Izilayeli.
Nikubaboobo, bazuluzi boonse babapayizi abantu teebakachisyomekede pe, alimwi bakatobela ziyanza zibi zyabantu. Bakasofwazya ng' anda ya- Jehova njakasalazizye mu- Jelusalemu.
Jehova, Leza wabamawisi, wakatuma ijwi kulimbabo bakwe chakwindulula, nkaambo wakalaluzyalo abantu bakwe abusena mpakali kukkala.
Pesi bakasika batumwa ba- Leza kunyansya majwi abo, akutukila basinsimi bakwe, ado bukkali bwa- Jehova bwakabukila bantu bakwe, kusikila takwe nikwakachili lugwasyo.

Aboobo Leza wakabaletela mwami waba Chalidiyeni, wakajaya balumi babo baniini apanga mung' anda yakupayilila alimwi tabafwidilide nsoni pe balumi baniini naa basimbi, balumi bapati naa bakatuba mumutwe. Leza wakababa boonse mumaanza akwe.
Zyoonse zibelesyo zyamunda ya- Leza, zipati aziniini, buvubi bwamung' anda ya- Jehova, abuvubi bwamwami abasilutwe- Eezi zyoonse wazitola ku- Bbabbiloni.
Bakatentelansi ng' anda ya- Leza bamvwayula bulambobwa- Jelusalemu, batenta maand akumwaya zintu zyoonse zyakalimukati.
Mwami wakatola ku- Bbabbiloni aboonse bakali bachija panga. Bakakuba balnd bakwe abana bakwe kusikila kubwendelezi bwaku Pesiya.

Eezi zyakachitikna kukuzuzikizya ijwi lya- Jehova kuzwa kumulomo wa- Jelemiya, kusikila nyika ikabotelwe mukulyokezya Sabata. Yakabamba Sabata lyoonse nkaambo yakasyala ayilikke, kuti kukinde minyaka ilimakumi musanu abili nkilobo.

Lino mumunyaka wakusanguna wa- Sayilasi, mwami wa- Pesiya, aboobo kuti ijwi lya- Jehova kuzwa mumulomo wa- Jelemiya lizuzikizigwe, Jehova wakabusya muuya wa- Sayilasi, mwami wa-Pesiya, aboobo kuti wakamwaya mulumbe mubwami bwakwe boonse alimwi wakubikka lubo mumalembe wakati,

''Mbuboobu Sayilasi, mwami wa-Pesiya, mbwakaamba: Jehova, Leza wakujulu, wandipa bwami boonse bwenyika. Wandilayilila kuti ndimuyakile ng' anda ku- Jelusalemu, iliku- Juda, kufumbwa ulakati kanu kuzwa kubantu bakwe boonse, Jehova Leza wanu abe anduwe. Muleke ayinke kunyika.''
Pawulu apositolo waKkilisito Jesu mumaknze aLeza aTimoteyo mukulana wesu kumbungano yaLeza ilimuKkolinto, akubantu baleza boonse basalali muchisi choonse cheAkkasia.
Luzyalo kaluba mulindinwe aluumuno buzwa kuli Leza Tata wesu aMwami Jesu Kkilisito.
Alumbwe Leza aTata Mwami wesu Jesu Kkilisito. Ngu Tata waluzyao aLeza wakumbulizya koonse.
Leza wakatumbulizya kumasukusyo esu woonse, kuti tukakonzye kumbulizya abo balimumasukuzyo. Tulumbulizya bamwi alumbulizyo ndulonya Leza ndwatumbulizya alo.
Mbuli machise aKkilisto mbwakavula nkambo kesu, lino aboobo kumbulizigwa kwesu kwakavulisya kwindila mumachise aKkilisito.
Pesi na twapenzegwa, ndumbulizyo lwanu alufutuko; na twawumbulizigwa anwebo mwawumbulizigwa. Lumbulizyo lwanu lulokubeleka kabotu mukwabana kupenzegwa kukozyenye akwesu.
Bulangizi bwesu kulindinwe taluteketi : nkambo tulizi kuti mbumwabana mapenzi mwakabana, akumbulizigwa kwesu.
Nkambo tatuyandi kuti muleke kuzibisigwa nobakwesu, atala amasukusyo ngitwakalawo muEziya. Twakali kulemenwa kwinda nguzu zyesu, lino kuti tutakate nikuba buumi bwesu.
Iyii twakabetekelwa milandu yalufu. Pesi zyakali zyakuti tutabikki kusyomeka mulindiswe pesi muliLeza ubusya bafu.
Wakatuvuna mumapenzi ajeya, uyotuvuna lubo. Mulinguwe twabika bulangizi bwakuti ulatuvuna.
Wazichita ezi mbuli mbumulokutugwasya ankombyo zyanu,mpawo bingi bayotulumbila nkambo kazipo zyaluzyalo nzitupegwa kulindiswe kwindila munkombyo zyingi.
Makanze akulisumpula kwesu ngaaya: kutaba aluzyalo kwesu kuntwakachita lwesu munyika abusalali abantu abuleza bwini kutaponena mubusongo bwanyama pesi muluzyalo lwaLeza.
Takwe nchitwakalemba pe kulindinywe chitabaliki akumvwisikana ndasyoma kuti mulaba akumvwisisya kumaninide.
Mbuli mbumwakatumvwa mubuche kuti mukalikankayizizye atala andiswe mubuzuba bwaMwami Jesu, mbuli mbutuyolikankayizya andinywe.
Nkambo ndakasimpe azezi ndalikuyanda kusanguna kusika kulindinywe kuti mutambule zipo zysluzyalo zyabili.
Ndalikuyeya kumuswaya nkinjindililakuyosika kuMasedoniya. Alubo ndayandide kumswaya ndakuzwa lubo mulwendo lwaku Masedoniy, akuti nkayindilile kuya kuJudiya.
Nindakachili kuyeya nzila eyi, ndakalengwana na? Sena ndibamba zintu munyama? Lino ndakati, " iyii, iyii " a "pe pe" muchindi chimwi ?
Pesi mbuli Leza mbasyomekede, majwi esu kulindinywe tesi akuti " Iyii"a "pe."
Nkaambo Mwana aLeza, Jesu Kkilisito, oyo Silivanasi, Timoteyo andime ngutwakakupandulula akati kanu tensi "iyii" a "pe. Anukuti, ngu iyii kwalyoonse.
Nkambo zisyomezyo zyoonse zyaLeza ngu "iyii"Mulinguwe. Lino aboobo kwinda mulinguwe twamba kuti "Ameni" kubulemu bwaLeza.
Lino nguLeza uzuzikizya ndiswe andinywe muliKkilisito, wakatunanika swe.
Wakadinda chidindo alindiswe akutupa muuya mumyoyo yesu mbuli chitondezyo chibola.
Pesi ndayita Leza kuti abe kamboni amuuya wangu kuti tendakakkonzya pe kusika kuKkolinto lino kuti ndizomusiye.
Eechi tachambi kuti tuyanda kuba baami kulusyoma lwanu. Anukuti, tuli basimilimo nyokwe akukondwa kwanu, mbuli mbumwimvwi mulusyomo lwanu.
Elyo ndakayeya kulubazu lwangu kuti sikoza kulinduwe muzyiindi zichiza.
Na ndachita kuti umvwe kuchisa, nguni unga ulandisekelezya pesi oyo nguwenya ngundachisa moyo ime?

Ndalemba mbuli mbunda chita kuchitila kuti ndaza kulinduwe nditachisigwi moyo ababo belede kundichita kuti ndikondelelwe. Ndilalusyomo atala andinywe moonse kuti lukondelo lwangu lulikozyene alukondelelo ndimulalo.
Ndakulembela chakupengana kupati akuchisa kwamoyo, alubo amisozi mingi. Tendalikuyanda kuti ndikwetele kuchisa. Nkabela, ndalikuyanda kuti uzibe bukomezi bwaluyando ndwejisi kulinduwe.
Kuti kuli wakachita kuti ube mumachise, teewaka zichita kulindime, pesi ayimwi nzila-kuti atakulemezyi - kulindinywe moonse.
Echi chisyubulo chamuntu oyu abinji zilikwene.
Lino kwinda chisyubulo, mweelede kulekelela akumumbulizya we. Muchiteezi kuti atakatazigwi amawuse manji.
Ndamukumbila kuti mutondezye luyando kulinduwe.
Nkaambo nchenchicho nchindakamulembela, kuti ndimusunke alubo ndizibe kuti mulaswilila mulizyoonse.
Elyo mwalekelela muntu chintu, ambebo ndamulekelela oyo muntu. Nchindalekelela - kuti ndalekelela nchintu -chilalekelelwa nkaambo kanduwe mubube bwaKkilisito."
Ezi zilobu kuti Satani atatchengi toonse. Nkaambo tatuli bafubafuba kumaano akwe.
Mulyango wakajulwa kulindime aMwami ninda kaza kudolopo lyaTekisasi kuzokambawuka makani mabotu aKkilisito oko.
Taakwe nindakaangunikide mu muuya nkaambo takwe nindakajana Tayitasi oko. Ndakabasiya alubo ndaya kuMasedoniya.
Pesi alumbwe Leza unga muliKkilisito utuzulwida mukuzunda lyoonse. Kwindilila mulindiswe ulayubununa mununko unona waluzibo lwakwe koonse.
Nkambo kuliLeza tuli tununkilizyo tunona muliKkilisito antomwe ababo baponede alubo akati kababo balikufwa.
Kubantu balikufwa, nkanunkililo kazwa kulufu kaya kulufu. Kulibabo baponesegwa  nkanunkilizyo kuzwa kubumi kuyakubumi. Nguni welede ezi zintu?
Nkaambo tatulimbuli bantu binji bawuzya ijwi lyaLeza kuti bajane mpindu. Asi kuti, akusalala kwamizezo, tulambula muliKkilisito, mbuli mbututumvwa kuzwa kuli  Leza kubusyu bwaLeza.
Ani tulokutalika kulilumbayizya lwesu lubobiya na? Swe tatuyandi lugwalo lwachizibyo kuli ndinywe na kuzwa kuli ndinywe, mbuli bamwi bantu, nga tulachita obo?
Inywe lwanu muli lugwalo lwachizibyo, lulembedwe amyoyo yesu, tulizibikene alimwi akubalwa abantu boonse.
Mutondezya kuti mulilugwalo kuzwa kuli Kkilisito, Impindu yamulimu wesu. Te yaka lembwa achilembyo pesi aMuuya waLeza upona. Te yakalembedwe atala abbwe, pesi atala amyoyo yabantu.
Alimwi eechi nchichisimizyo nchitujisi kwindila muli Kkilisito kunembo lyaLeza.
Tatukwe luzibo muli ndiswe mukwamba nikuba chili mbuli chizwa kulindiswe, pesi kuti luzibo kuzwa kuli Leza.
NguLeza wakatuchita twakonzya kuba balanda bachizuminano chitali cha lugwalo pesi chaMuuya, nkaambo luwalo lulajeya, pesi Muuya upa buumi.

Lino mulimu wa lufu- wakavundikwa mulugwalo lulamabwe - wakasika muli obu bulemu kuti bana balombe bamuIzilayeli tebakakonzya pe kulangana abusyu bwaMozesi. Echi nkambo kabulemu bwabusyu bwakwe, bulemu bwakali kuzima.
Ngabula vula byeni bulemu bwakubeleka bwamuuya mbukuyoba?
Nkambo na mulimulimu wakupa mulandu wakalabulemu, mbuvule bwingi bulibyeni buchita mulimu wabululami bukkalila mubulemu!
Mukwambisya echo chakali mulichimwi chindi chachitwa chaba abulewe tachichikwe bulemu muchimo echi, nkambo kabulemu obu bwindilila.
Nkambo kuti echo chiinda chakali abulewe ngabuloba bwingi bulibyeni bulewe kulichecho chikalilila !
Mbuli mbutujisi obu bulangilizi, tulibatakwe kuyowa.
Tatuli mboli Mozesi, wakabika chisitikizyo kubusyu bwakwe kuchitila kuti bana ba-Izilayeli tebakakonzya kulangana kumamanino abulemu obu bwakakali kwinda.

Pesi miyeyo yabo yakayumisigwa. Nkambo kusika sunu, elyo nibakali kubala chizuminano chipya, echo chisitikizyo chomwe mpuchichili. Takwe nichakagwisigwa pe, nkambo muliKkilisito kupela muchikonzya kugwisigwa.
Pesi nikuba sunu elyo kufumbwa Mozesi nabalwa chisitikizyo chivwinika myoyo yabo.
Pesi elyo muntu kasandukila kuMwami, chisitikizyo chilagwisigwa.

Lino Mwami nguMuuya oko kuliMuuya kulikwangunuka, lino swe toonse katuli abusyu bugwisigile chisitikizyo, tubona bulemu bwaMwami. Tulabukulusigwa kunjila mubulemu bukozyanya bomwe kuzwa kuchibela chomwe chabulemu kunjila mulichimwi mbuli kuzwa kumwami oyo uliMuuya.
Nkinkako, nkambo tuli amulimu oyu alimwi mbuli mbutwakatambula luzyalo, tatusiki mukutyompwa.
Pesi, twakakkaka nsiswa anzila zyabusu. Tatwendi mububumbwe mpawo tatujati bubi pe ijwi lyaLeza akupedekezya kasimpe, twalizumizya tobeni kuliwonse mbwamvwa kubbazu lyaLeza.
Pesi na esu makani avumbwa, avumbidwe kupela kulibabo balimukunyonyoka.
Mukambo kabo, baLeza bayeyi nyika bawofwazya ikutasyoma kwamizezo. Nkambo kambubobu, tabakonzyi kubona mumuni wamakani mabotu abulemu bwaKkilisito, ulichikozyanyo chaLeza.
Nkambo tatuli lungululi tobeni, pesi KkilisitoJesu mbuliMwami mpawo swebo mbuli babelesi banu nkambo kaJesu.
Lino Leza nguwenya wakati, "Mumuni oyu munika mumudima." Wakatondezya mumyoyo yesu kupa mumuni waluzibo lwabuna Leza mubuliwo bwaJesu Kkilisito.
Pesi tuli abuvubi muchibikilo chanongo, Kuchitila kuti kuboneke nguzu zyindilide mpati nzizyaLeza pepe kulindiswe.
Twapenzegwa munzila zyoonse, pesi pepe kuzundwa. Twakanyonganisigwa pesi pepe akuzuzigwa akupupulwa.
Twapenzegwa pesi pepe kusiyigwa, twakasowelwa pesi pepe kunyonyoka.
Lyoonse katubwezede mulindiswe mumibili yalufu lwaJesu, kuchitila kuti bumi bwaJesu alubo bukayubununwe mumibili yesu.
Kulindiswe nitupona twakapedekezegwa kulufu nkaambo kaJesu kuchitila kuti buumi bwaJesu buyubununwe mumubili wesu wanyama.
Lino lufu luli amilimu mulindiswe pesi buumi buli amilimu mulindinywe.
Pesi tuli amuuya omwe walusyomo mbuli echo chakalembedwe: " Ndasyoma, alubo ndamba." Alubo tulasyoma aboobo tulamba.
Nkambo tulizi oyo wakabusya Mwami Jesu alubo andiswe oyo uyotubusya amwi aJesu mpawo akutweta antomwe mubuliwo bwakwe.
Kulizyoonse nkambo kandinywe kuchitila luzyalo kuti lusikile kuliboonse bantu bachite kulumbayizya kuyungizigwe kubulemu bwaLeza.
Lino tatwelede kuba batyompwa. Nikuba kuti chanze tulikuswekelwa, chamukati tulabukuluka buzuba abuzuba.
Echi chiyezyo mapenzi mawubawuba alikutubambila butamani bundemenene bwabulemu obo bwindilila zyoonse zyelesyo.
Lino tatulangililwi kuzintu ezyo zibonwa pesi kuzintu zitabonwi. Zintu ezi nzitubona zilamana, pesi zintu zitabonwi tazimani.
Tulizi kuti na nganda yesu yansi chilawu - yamwayisigwa, tulabuyaki kuliLeza. Ninganda itayakwi amaboko abantu pesi nganda itamani, ilikujulu.
Nkambo muchilawu echi tulalila kapati, kuti tukasamikwe abukalo bwesu bwakujulu.
Tulabulangilila bukkalo obu nkambo na twabusama tatukoyo janika katuli azintanda.
Kasimpe nituchili muchilawu echi tulalila kapati akulemenwa. Tatuyandi pe tukaleke kusamikwa. Pesi, tuyanda kusamikwa kuti echo chifwa chikamenegwe abuumi.
Watubambila echi chintu nguLeza, wakatupa muuya usalala mbuli chitondezyo cha echo chiyosika.
Aboobo amube alusyomo, kuti katuchili kumunzi mumubili, tuli kule aMwami.
Nkambo twenda akusyoma pepe akubona.
Lino tuli akusyomesesya katutali mumibili pele katuli mumunzi aMwami.
Lino twita kuti chibe chintulangilila swebo nekuba tuchiliku munzi nekuba katutali nkuko kuti mukamubotezye.
Mbunga toonse tuyoboneka kunembo lyachuno chalubeta chaKkilisito kwitila kuti umwi awumwi utakatambule zilengene azintu zichitwa mumubili na bubotu nekuba bubi.
Nekuba boobo, kuziba kuyowa Mwami tukombelezya bantu. Kulabonwa kabotu mbutubede aLeza, ndilangilila kuti kulibabo kumanjezezya anu.

Tatuli kwezya lubo kukombelezya ndinywe katuboneka katulibasyomekede pesi tunokumupa makani makani akulidunda atala andiswe, kuti mukabe ansandulo kuli babo balikankayizya atala akuboneka kwabo pesi kakutali mbukubede mumoyo.
Na tulizwide mumiyeyo yesu nkukwaLeza; pele na kuti mumiyeyo mibotu nkuyanda kwako.
Luyando lwaKkilisito lwatuchunda nkambo twakamanisya echi. Kuti muntu umwi wakafwida boonse aboobo boonse bakafwa.
Wakafwida boonse kuti bapona kabatachiponeni lwabo beni pesi baponene oyo nkambo nkako wakabafwida akubusigwa.
Ankambo kachechi kuzwa lino kaziya kunembo tatukabwene mumwi mukwinda munyama , nekuba kuti twakali muzi Kkilisito mukwinda munyama. Pesi kwalino tatuchizi.
Nkikako na umwi uli muli Kkilisito, waba chilenge chipya. Zintu zyachindi zyayinda. Bona zyaba zipya.
Ezi nzitu zyoonse zizwa kuliLeza , wakatubwedezya mulinguwe lubo mukwinda muliKkilisito akutipa mulimo wakubwedezyanya.
Nkokuti muli Kkilisito leza unolikubwedezyanya nyika kuli nguwe, kutesi kubala milaka ilatala ambaabo. Unokutupa makani akubweedelana.
Aboobo twakatondekwa mbuli bayimikilila baKkilisito mbuli anga Leza walikuchita kukombelezya mukwinda mulindiswe."Twamukumbila, ankambo kwakuyanda kwaKkilisito: Amubwedelane aLeza."
Wakamubumba oyo wakalezi chibi kuti abe chibi kulindiswe, kuti tukabe bululami bwaLeza mulinguwe, kuti abe chibi kulindiswe, kuti tukabe bululami bwaLeza mulinguwe.
Mbuli mbutubeleka aamwi anguwe, yulamukumbila kut mutatambuli luzyalo lyaLeza chabiyo.
Mbuli mbaamba kuti; ''Kuchiindi cheelede ndakakuswiilizya, amubuzuba bwalufutuko ndakakugwasya.'' Bona, lino nchiindi cheelede. Bona, lino ndizuba lya lufutuko.
Tatukonzyi kubika zilebyo kunembo lyawumwi awumwi, kuchitila kuti milimu yesu itasampawulwi.
Ani kuti, munchito zyesu zyoonse tulalitondezya kuti tulibalanda baLeza. Tulibalanda mulukakatilo lupati, mumapenzi, amumakatazyo, amubuyumu,
mukuumwa, mukubikwa muntolongo, mulupyopyongano, mukubeleka changuzu, mukubula n'onzi, munzala,
mubusalali, muluzibo, kuba aamoyo mulamfu, mubuuya, amuMuuya uusalala, muluyando lwini.
Tulibalanda bakwe mujwi lyakasimpe, munguzu zyaLeza. Tulaazilwanyo zyabululami kujanza lyachilisyo alyachimwensi.
Tubeleka mubulemu amukunyansigwa, amumpuwo mbi amukulumbayizigwa mbuli balaalweno pesi katuli bakasimpe.
Tubeleka mbuli batazibidwe anu kuti tulizidwe kabotu. Tulabeleka mbuli bafwide - bona! - tuchipona. Tubeleka mbuli bali muchisubulo chanchito zyesu pesi mbuli batapedwe mulandu walufu.
Tubeleka mbuki bawuside, pele tulabotelwa chalyoonse. Tubeleka mbuli bafwaba, pele tulokuvuzya buvubi. Tubeleka mbuli batakwe ani kuti tuli azintu zyiingi.
Twakaambula kasimpe koonse kulindinywe, nibaKkolinto, alimwi moyo wesu ulaangunukide loko.
Teensi musyanikizigilwe aandiswe pe, pele mulilisyanikizizye lwenu mumyoyo yenu.
Lino mukwaabilana kweelene - ndamwaambila mbuli bana - andinywe mujule myoyo yenu.
Mutasungwi jogwe aantomwe abatali bazumini. Nga bululami bulalyidilana buti abubi? Nga mbulyidilanoonzi buli aakati amumuni amudima?
Nchizuminano nzi Kkilisito nchakonzya kuzuminana aBbeliyali? Muzumini ulaatwambo nzi aantomwe  awutali muzumini?
Ani n'anda yaLeza ijisi chizuminanoonzi amituni? Tuli n'anda yaLeza iipona, mbuli Leza mbaakaamba: ''Ndiyookkala aakati kabo akweenda aakati kabo. Ndiyooba Leza wabo, abalabo bayooba bantu bangu.''
Aboobo, ''Amuzwe aakati kabo, akulitantamuna,'' mbwaamba Mwaami. ''Mutagumi chintu chitasalali, eelyo ndiyomutambula.
Ndiyooba Taata wenu, alimwi muyooba bana bangu balombe abasimbi,'' mbwaamba Mwaami Singuzuzyoonse.
Nobayandwa, mbukunga tuli aazisyomezyo eezi, muleke tulisalazye tubeni kubusofwazi boonse bwakunyama akumuuya. Amuleke tutobele busalali mukuyowa Leza.
Amutupe mweenya! Takwe ngutwabisizya.
Takwe nitwakanyonganya muntu. Nkaambo ndakazyaamba kale kuti muli mumyoyo yesu, kuti tufwe aantomwe akuti tupone aantomwe.
Ndili aakutayowela kupati mulindinywe, alimwi nkupati kulidunda aatala andinywe. Ndilizwide aluumbuluzyo/. Ndilafwasuka alukondo nikuba mumafwabi eesu.
Elyo nitwakasika kuMasedoniya, nyama zyesu tezyakali akulyookezya. Asikuti, twakakatazigwa munzila yoonse akutakkalinkana kunze alubo akuyowa mukati.
Pesi Leza, wuumbulizya balaansi, wakatuumbulizya akusika kwaTayitasi.

Tekwali kusika kwakwe biyo pe Leza nchaakatuumbulizizya. Alubo chakali alumbuluzyo Tayitasi ndwakatambwide kulindinywe. Wakatwaambila aatala aluyando lwanu, mapenzi anu, alubo chiyandisyo chenu kulindime. Akaako ndakakondelwa kwiindilide.
Nikuba kuti lugwalo lwangu lwakamuchita kuti musululwe, takwe nindilipa mulandu pe. Pesi ndakalipa mulandu eelyo nindakabona kuti lugwalo lwangu lwamusuluzya, nikuba kwali kwachiindi chiniini biyo.
Lino ndilakondwa, pe pe akaambo kakuti mwakalikatazikene, pesi nkaambo kusululwa kwenu kwakamuleta kukweempwa. Mwakabona kuusa kwabuLeza, kwakuti takwe nimwakasweekelwa pe akambo kandiswe.
Nkaambo kuusa kwabuLeza kuleta kweempwa oko kuzuzikizya lufutuko kakutakwe kulipa mulandu. Kuusa kwakunyika, biyeni obo, kuleta lufu.

Amubone bupati bwakuyandisisya kwakuuasa kwabuLeza mbubwakaleta mulindinywe. Kwakali kupati biyeni kuyandisisya mulindinywe mukutondeezya kuti tamukwe mulandu. Kwalibupati biyeni kusesemwa kwenu buyofu bwenu, kutaakizya kwenu, bunkutwe bwenu, alubo chiyandisyo chanu kubona kuti kubeleka kabotu makani kweelede kuchitwa.
Nikuba kuti ndakalemba kulindinywe, tendakalemba akaambo kasimuchita chibi, na ooyo wakachitilwa chibi, pesi kuti kuyanda kwanu kubotu kulindiswe kuchitwe kuti kuboneke kulindinywe kumenso aLeza.
