Bbazilayi wakasandula mwami, ''Ngaangane mazuba acheede muminyaka yabuumi bwangukuti njinke a mwami ku Jelusalemu?

Ndaaminyaka makumi musanu aatatu. Nkujana ndakonzya na kusiyanisya akkati kachibotu achibi? Mulanda wako uchikonzya na kulabila akumvwa kulya nkwalya na nchanywa mbuchibede? Ndichimvwa na majwi abaalumi aabanakazi bayimba? Nkambonzi mpo mulanda wako natabe mutolo kuli simalelo wangu mwami?
Mulanda wako uyanda kusika a Jodani a mwami. Nkambonzi mwami natandiliye ampindu iliboobu?

Ndakombelela uzumizye mulanda wako abweede kumunzi, kuchitila kuti nkafwe muchisi chakesu kumbali akabanda kandeende abaama. Pesi bona, ngoyu mulanda wako Kkimamu. Ngazubuke antomwe a simalelo wangu mwami, akuyo muchitila kufumbwa ziboneka nkazili zibotu kuli nduwe.''
Mwami wakasandula, ''Kkimamu uyozubuka aandime, ndiyomuchitila chibotu kumenso aako, akufumbwa nchoyanda kuli ndime, ndakuchitila.''
Eelyo bonse bantu bakazubuka Jodani, amwami wakazubuka, simwami wakamyonta Bbazilayi akumulongezya. Elyo Bbazilayi wakabweeda kumunzi wakwe.
Aboobo mwami wakazubuka waya ku Gilugali, a Kkimamu wakazubuka antomwe anguwe. Yoonse impi ya Juda yakazubuka anguwe mwami, achisela champi ya Izilayeli.

Kuzwaawo boonse baalumi bamu Izilayeli bakasanguna kusika kumwami akwaamba kuti, ''Nkambonzi bakwesu, baalumi ba Juda, nibakubba akweeta mwami ampuli yakwe mutala a Jodani, aboonse baalumi ba Davida anguwe lwakwe?''

Aboobo baalumi ba Juda bakasandula baalumi ba Izilayeli, ''Kulibobu nkambo mwami ngusiluzubo wafwifwi kuli ndiswe. Nkambonzi echi nichakunyemya? Kuli nchitwakalya na mwami nchakabbadalila? Kuli zipo nzyakatupa na?''

Baalumi ba Izilayeli bakasandula baalumi ba Juda, ''Tulamikowa iilikkumi lyaluzubo a mwami, aboobo tula chelelo kuli Davida kwinda ndinywe. Nkambonzi nimutulangila ansi? Sa kukanza kwesu kubozya mwami wesu chakamvwigwa lutaanzi?'' Pesi majwi abaalumi ba Juda akalabukali kwinda abaalumi ba Izilayeli.

Awo alimwi zyakachitika kulimbubo busena kuti kube simubusya nkondo walikutegwa Syebba mwana mulombe wa Bbikili, muBbenjamayiti. Wakasiba mweembo kawamba kuti, ''Tatukwechesu pe muli Devidi, tatukwe nikuba lukono mumwana mulombe wa Jese.Amuleke woonse mwaalumi abweede kumuunzi wakwe, Izilayeli.''

Aboobo boonse baalumi baku Izilayelibakamusiya Devidi batobela Sebba mwana mulombe wa Bhikili.Pesi baalumi baku Suda bakatobela aafwifwi amwami wabo, kuzwa ku Jodani musinzo woonse kusika ku Jelusalemu.

Aawo Devidi naakasika ku nganda yakwe yabwaami ku Jelesalemu, wakabweza banakazi bakwe bazike mbaakasiide kabalinda busena, alimwi wakabika munganda kabalindidwe. Wakalikubapa zyoonse nzibayanda, pesi takwe nakawona abo limbi pe. Nkinkaako bakajalilwa mane kubuzuba bwalufu lwabo, kabapona mbuuli bamukabafu.
Mpawo mwami wakati kuli Amasa, ''Ita baalumi bakuJuda aantomwe mumazuba otatwe; Iwe weelede kuba aano, ayebo.''
Nkinkaako Amasa wakiinka kukwiita Juda, pesi wakachelezegwaakuba musule aachindi eecho mwami nchakamubambilide.

Nkinkaako Devidi wakati kuli Abbichayi, ''Lino Sebba mwana mullombe wa Bbikili ulatuchitila buyumuyumu kwiinda zyakachita Abbusalomu. Bweza babelesi basimalelo wako, basilumamba bangu, mumuyanduule kanokano, amwi uyojana madolopo aasisinkene akatuyube tukamubule."
Mpawo balumi baJowabbu bakazwa bamutobela, antoomwe abaKeletayiti aba Peletayitialoonse lumamba lupati. Bakasiya Jelusalema kayiyaandula Syebba mwana mulombe waBbikili.

Aawo nibali kubbwe pati eelyo lili kuGibbiyoni, Amasa wakaza kukubaswanizya. Jowabbu wakasamide zyankondo eezyo nzyakazwete, zyalikuswanizya ibbanti muchibuno chakwe lili aafulo linonedwe lisyomekedwe kulindilyo. Nakalikwenda kuya kunembo, ifulo lyakasomoka lyawa.
Nkinkaako Jowabbu wakati kuli Amasa, "Umvwide kabotu na, mwana wasimyuunzi yesu?" Jowabbu wakajata Amasa amulezu kukuboko kwachilisyo wamumyonta.

Amasa taakabwene pe chipanga chakali mukuboko kwaJowabbu kwachimweensi. Jowabbu wakayasa Amasa mwida alimwi mala aakwe akawayukila aansi. Jowabbu taakamutyunga lubo pe, alimwi Amasa wakafwa. Nkinkaako Jowabbu aAbbisyayi mukulana wakwe bakayanduula Syebba mwana mulombe waBbikili.
Mpwawo umwi wabantu baJowabbu wakiima kubbazu lya Amasa, alimwi mwaalumi ooyu wakati, "Ooyo uyanda Jowabbu, alimwi ooyo uyanda Devidi, mumuleke atobele Jowabbu."

Amasa wakalede kalikugwalaya mugaze lyakwe akaati kamugwagwa. Awo mwaalumimnibakabona kuti bantu boonse biima chakukankabala, wakabweza Amasa wamugwisya mumugwagwa wamubika mumuunda. Wakawaala jansi lyamuvumba nkaambo wakabona kuti woonse muntu walikuza aafwiifwi walikwima chakukankabala.
Musule akugwisya Amasa mumugwagwa, boonse baalumi bakeenda kutobela Jowabbu kuyanduula Syebba mwana mulombe waBbikili.
Syebba wakiinda mumisyobo yabantu baIsilayeli kusika kuli Abbelu Bbeti Maakka, alimwi kwiinda yonse nyika yabaBbikilayiti aabo bakabungene aantomwe alimwi kabayandula Syebba.
Baakumweezya alimwi bamusinkilizya muli Abbelu Bbeti Maaka. Bakayaka dantaala litanta bulambo bwadolopo. Boonse basilumamba bakali aJowabbu bakambandama bulambo kuti babuwisye aansi.
Mpawo mwanakazi musongo wakakwiila kazwa mudolopo, "Swilizya, inche swilizya Jowabbu! Kweza aafwiifwi andime kuchitila kuti ndaambule aanduwe."
Nkinkaako Jowabbu wakaza aafwiifwi anguwe, "Nduwe Jowabbu na?" Wakasandula, "Ndime."

Mpawo wakati kulinguwe, "Swiilizya kumajwi aamubelesi wako." Wakasandula, "Ndilikuswiilizya." Mpawo wakaambuula, "Muchiindi chansiku bakalikwaamba kuti, "Nchoonzyo kulayigwa kuAbbeli,' alimwi kulayigwa ooku kwakali kumaninsya penzi.
Tulidolopo limwi lilaaluumuno akusyomeka kwiindilide muIsilayeli. Ulikwezya kumwaya nyina wedolopo muIzilayeli. Nkamboonzi noyanda kumena lukono lwaJehova?"
Nkinkaako Jowabbu wakasandule wati, "Zilikule, zilikule kulindime, kuti nkubona ndamena nkana kumwaya.

Teensi simpe pe. Pesi mwaalumi uzwa kunyika yazilundu yaIfulemu, utegwa Syebba mwana mulombe waBbikili wanyampula kuboko kwakwe mukusulana amwami, mukusulana aDevidi. Amwaabe nguwe alike, alimwi ndilaleka akuzwa aadolopo." Mwanakazi wakati kuliJowabbu, "Mutwe wakwe ulawaalwa kulinduwe aatala lyabulambo."

Mpawo wakiinka kubantu boonse mubusongo bwakwe. Bakatema akudunsula mutwe waSyebba mwana mulombe waBbikili, alimwi bawuwala aanze kuliJowabbu. Mpawo wakasiba mweembo alimwi bantu baJowabbu bakazwa aadolopo, awumwi awumwi mwaalumi wakya kumunzi wakwe. Mpawo Jowabbu wakabweda kuJelusalema kumwaami.
Lino Jowabbu wakaba aatala alumamba loonse lwaIsilayeli, alimwi Bbenayiya mwana mulombe waJohoyida wakaba aatala lyabaKkeletayiti alimwi aatala lyabaPeletayiti.
Adonolamu wakaba aatala lyabantu bakali kuchita mulimu wakwaangila, alimwi Johosyafati mwana mulombe waAhiludi wakaba simutola twaambo.
Syeva wakaba mulembi alimwi Zadokki aAbbiyata bakali bapayizi.
Ila muJayililti wakali mwaami wabasilutwe baDevidi.

Kwakali inzala muchiindi cha Deviti nkitobelezyenie minyaka yotatwe, Davida wakalanga kubusyu bwa Jehova. Nkabela  Jehova wakati, ''Eeyi inzala ilikuli nduwe nkambo ka Sawulu abasing'anda yakwe bajayi, nkambo wakajaya ba Gibbiyonayiti.''

Lino ba Gibbiyonayiti bakali kuzwa kubantu ba Izilayeli, bakazwa kuli baabo bakasyala kuli ba Amoli. Bantu ba Izilayeli bakaleka kubajaya, pesi Sawulu wakeezya kuti abajaye boonse mumulawu mbuli bantu ba Izilayeli aba Juda.

Nkabela mwami Davida wakabayita antoomwe ba Gibbiyoni akubambila kuti, ''Niinzi nchintamuchitile nywebo? Mbubuli mbensichite chizuminano, kuchitila kuti ndongezye bantu ba Jehova, aabo basikukona bubotu bwakwe azisyomezyo?''

Ba Gibbiyonayiti bakamusandula, ''Taali makani a nsiliva angolide akati kesu a Sawulu kana abasing'anda yakwe. Munzila ikozyania yakuti, ndiswe ndiswe nitwati utujaye kufumbwa muntu ulimu Izilayeli. ''Devidi wakasandula,  ''Ninzi nchelokwamba kuti nchintakuchitile iwebo?''
Bakamusandula mwami, ''Mwalumi wakeezya kujaya ndiswe toonse, wakatunyonyoona iswe, kuchitila kuti tumwayisigwe kakutachikwe busena mumigano ya Izilayeli--

akube bantu bali musanu ababili kuzwa kulunyungu lwakwe bapegwe kuli ndiswe, akubajaya kunembo lya Jehova mu Gibbiya lya Sawulu, ooyo umwi wasalwa a Jehova. Nkabela mwami wakati, ''Ndilamupa inywebo.''
Pesi mwami wakaleka Mefibboshoti mwana mulombe wa Jonatani mwana mulombe wa Sawulu, nkambo kachikonke cha Jehova akati kabo, akati ka Davida mwana mulombe wa Sawulu.

Pesi mwami wakabweza babili bana balombe ba Lizipa mwana musimbi wa Ayiya, bana balombe mbakazyala kuli Sawulu -- bana balombe babili mbakawuzika kuti Amoni a Mefibbosheti; alimwi Devidi wakatola bana balombe bali musanu ba Melabbu. Mwana musimbi wa Sawulo, oyo ngwakazyala kuli Adiliyeli mwana mulombe wa Bbazilayi mu Meholatiti.
Wakamupedekezya mumaanza aba Gibbiyoniti. Bakabangilila kunembo achilundu cha Jehova, alimwi bakafwa kabali musanu ababili boonse. Bakajigwa kuchindi chakutyola, kumazuba akusanguna kwakutyola bbali.

Mpawo Lizipa, mwana musimbi wa Ayiya, wakabweza chizwato chasaka alimwi walizyungulusya ajulu amutunta afwifwi amitunta, kuzwa kumasangunino akutyola kusikila imvula ikabawide kuzwa kujulu. Takwepe nakazumizya bayuni bakujulu kuti balye mitunta  mubuzuba nakuti banyama bamusokwe balye mansiku.
Zyakaambwa kuli Devidi ninzi Lizipa, mwana musimbi wa Ayiya, mwanakazi muzike wa Sawulo, nzyachita

Nkabela Devidi wakiinka akubweza mafuwa a Sawulu amafuwa a Jonatani mwana wakwe kuzwa kubantu ba Jabbesyi Giliyadi, abo bakabba antanganana kuzwa kuntandabale ya Bbeti - Syani, ooko ba Filisitiya nkubaka bangilila, musule akuti ba Filisitiya bamujaya Sawulo mu Gilubbowa.
Devidi wakabwezelela mafuwa a Sawulo kuzwa kule amafuwa a Jonatani mwanakwe mulombe, alubo bakabwezelela mafuwa aabantu balimusanu ababili aabo bakajiigwa abalabo.

Bakavwikka mafuwa a Sawulo  a Jonatani mwana wakwe mulombe munyika ya Bbenjamini mu Zela, kukabanda ka Kkishi wisakwe. Bakachita zyoonse mwami nzyakabalayilide. Nibakamana Leza wakasandula nkombyo zyabo munyika.
Mpawo ba Filisiti bakaya kunkondo lubo aba Izilayeli. Nkabela Devidi wakaseluka aansi abasilumamba bakwe akulwana aba Filisitiya. Devidi wakazundwa kunkondo akukatala.
Ishibi-Bbenobbu, walunyungu lwamabbabbani, ooyo ulasumu lilema masyekeli alimiyanda yotatwe aamukkuba awoyo iwakalwana apanga pya, kayanda kujaya Devidi.

Pesi Abbisyayi mwana mulombe wa Zuliya wakamuvuna Devidi, akulwisya mu Filisitiya, alimwi wakamujaya. Mpawo muntu wa Devidi wakamukonkezya, akwamba kuti, ''Toyelede kuyakunkondo limbi andiswe pe, kuchitila kuti tozozimi chimunisyo chaba Izilayeli.''
Yakasika lubo niyakiinda kuti kuzooba lubo inkondo aba Filisitiya ku Gobbu, muchindi Sibbekkayi mu Hushatiti nakajaya Safu, oyo wakali umwi walunyungu lwa mu Lefayimu.
Yakasika lubo inkondo amaFilisitiyaku Gobbu, kuti Elihanani mwana mulombe wa Jayi uzwa mu Bbetilehemiti wakajaya Goliyati mu Gititi, muntu iwakajisi isumu lyakali aluti mbuli chisamu chasikuluka.
Yakabuka lubo imbi inkondo ku Gaati ooko kwakali mwalumi mulamfu loko wakali aminwe musanu awumwi kukuboko komwe alimwi atunwe musanu akamwi kumawulu akwe, makumi obile atunwe tone kukubikaamwi.
Alimwi wakali walunyungu lwa Lefayimu. Elyo nakatukila Izilayeli, Jonatani mwanamulombe wa Shimiya, mukulana wa Deviti, wakamujaya.
Aaba bakali balunyungu lwa Lefayimu waku Gaati, alimwi bakajayigwa akuboko kwa Devidi alimwi akuboko kwaba silumamba bakwe.
Davida wakayimbila Jehova lwimbo mubuzuba Jehova nakamuvuna kuzwa kujanza lyabasinkondonyina boonse, akuzwa kumaanza a Sawulu.
Wakakomba, ''Jehova nibbwe lyangu, ninguzu zyangu, nguwe undivuna.
Leza nibbwe lyangu.  Ndijana mayubilo mulinguwe. Nintobo yangu, ndwija lwalufutuko lwangu, ngonguwe undikwabilila, ngundivuna kuzwa kunkondo.
Ndiyoyita Jehova, uyelede kutembawulwa, alimwi ndiyovunwa kuli basinkondoma.
Nkambo mayuwe alufu andizyunguluka, maanzi ayendesya alunyonyooko akandizunda.
Tukole twabusangu twakandizyunguluka; tukole twalufu twakandicha.
Mukupenga kwangu ndayita Jehova, ndakiita Leza wangu; wakamvwa ijwi lyangu kuzwa kuntempele yakwe, akwita kwangu kwakuyanda kugwasigwa kwakinka kumatwi aakwe.
Mpawo inyika yakateketa akukankama. Intalisyo yajulu yakakankama alimwi yakazuungana, nkambo Leza wakali wanyema.
Busi bwakazwa mumpemo zyakwe, amulilo ubalama wakazwa kumulomo wakwe. Makkala akamweka aalikke.
Wakajula majulu akuseluka ansi, amudima usiya mbii wakali kunsi lyamawulu akwe.
Wakatanta abakkelebbimu akuuluka. Wakaboneka amababa aluuwo.
Wakachita mudima ateente mpakabede, wabungania mayooba amvula nyingi mumu lengalenga.
Kuzwa kuku mweka mweka kwabusyu bwakwe makkala amulilo akaloka.
Jehova wakazuzuma kuzwa kumajulu. Usumpukide wakoompolola.
Wakawaala kanta akubamwayisya basinkonyina -- indabi azyanzyo zyabutale wakazimwayisya.
Milonga yalwizi yakaboneka; antalisyo yanyika yakayubununwa antanganana nkambo kakutapatila kwa Jehova, nkambo kakuyowa kwampemo zyakwe.
Wakasika ansi kuzwa kujulu, wakandibweza akundibukata ! Wandigwisya mumanzi miingi.
Wakandivuna kuzwa kuli basindoma bali anguzu, kuli babo bandisula, mbuli mbubakali anguzu kwinda ndime.
Bakasika akundigwisya mubuzuba bwakupenga kwangu, pesi Jehova wakandigwisya.
Alubo wakandeeta aanze abusena bukwazeme. Wakandivuna nkambo wakali botedwe andime.
Jehova wakandipa impindu iyelene akululama kwangu. Alimwi wakandichitulula kwelene abusalali bwamaboko aangu.
Nkambo ndakabamba inzila zya Jehova alimwi tendakachita chabufubafuba pe kuzwa kunembo lya Leza.
Imbeta zyakwe amilawu yakwe zyakali munsi lyangu; mbuli milawu yakwe, tendakapambuka kulinjiyo pe.
Alimwi ndakali luleme kunembo lyakwe, akulikasya kuchibi.
Aboobo Jehova wakandichitulula mumweelwe wabululami bwangu, abulemu bwabusalali kumenso akwe.
Kubasyomi,  ulalitondezya kuba musyomesi; kumuntu utakwe butonawusi, ulalitondezya lwako kubula kampenda.
Kulibabo basalala uyolitondezya lwako kuba musalalali, pesi uligogomene kulibapilingene.
Ulagwasya kuntu bamvwide machise, pesi meso ako ngusinkondonyina kuli basikulisumpula, alimwi ulabaselusya ansi.
Nkambo ulichimunisyo changu, Jehova. Jehova ulandimunikila mumudima wangu.
Nkambo kanduwe ndakonzya kutaluka basyajinga; a Leza wangu ndakonzya kusotoka wonse malambo.
Mbuli Leza, Inzila zyakwe zililuleme. Ijwi lya Jehova lililondokede. Nintobo kuli boonse bayubila mulinguwe.
Nkambo ngwani Leza kunze kwa Jehova, alimwi ngwani bbwe kunze kwa Leza?
Leza mayubilo aangu, alimwi ulasotosya bantu batakwe butongawusi munzila zyakwe.
Ubambya mawulu aangu mbuli nsya akundibikka ajulu akalundu kalamfu.
Ulayiiisya maboko angu inkondo, amaboko angu kagogomeka idantambwa lyamukkuba.
Wandipa intobo yalufutuko lwako alimwi luzyalo lwako lwandichita kuti ndibe mupati.
Wandikomezezya busena kunsi lyamawulu angu, aboobo mawulu angu tatezemuki.
Ndakatanda basinkondoma akubanyonyoona, tendakaboola pe manedo ndabanyonyoona.
Ndakabapwachuula akuba zavuula; kuti batabuki limbi pe. Bakawida munsi lyamawulu angu.
Ubikka inguzu mulindime mbuli lukumba lwamunkondo; ubabikka munsi lyangu boonse basikundibukila akundilwisya.
Wakandipa isule lyansingo yabasinkondoma; Ndakanyonyoona abo bandisulaika.
Bakalilila kugwasigwa, pesi tekwakali sikuvuna; bakalilila Jehova, pesi takwe nakabavwiila pe.
Ndakabawuma mutumpanzi tunini mbuli lusuko lwamulubuwa, ndakabalyatawula mbuli bulongo bwamunzila.
Wandivuna alimwi kulupyopyongano lwakubantu bangu. Wandibikka kuti ndibe muzuluzi wazisi. Abantu mbintazi balandigwasya.
Bazwakule bakali kwangilwa kundikotamina. Achakufwambana nibakamvwa biyo andime, bakandilemeka.
Bazwakule bakasika akukankama kuzwa kubukali bwabo.
Jehova ulapona ! Kalitembawulwa ibbwe lyangu. Kanyampulwa, indomba lyalufutuko lwangu.
Oyu ngu Leza ngundibozezya inkoto, oyo uboozya bantu munsi lyangu.
Wakandigwisya kuzwa kuli basinkoma, nchobeni, wandisumpula atala abaaba bandibukila. Wakandivuna kuzwa kubantu bakkali.
Aboobo ndapa kulumba kulinime Jehova, akati kazisi, njoyimba intembawuzyo kuzina lyako.
Leza ulapa kuzunda kupati kubaami bakwe ulatondezya chizuminano chisyomekede kubananike bakwe, kuli Davida akulunyungu lwakwe kwalyoonse.
Lino ngaya majwi a Davida--Davida mwana mulombe wa Jese, mwalumi oyo walikulemekwa loko, umwi wakananikwa a Leza wa Jakobo, sikwimba intembawuzyo nono loko ya Izilayeli.
''Muya wa Jehova wakaamba mulindime, alimwi ijwi lyakwe lyakali alulimi lwangu.
Leza wa Izilayeli wakambula, Ibbwe lya Izilayeli lyakati kuli ndime, Óyo uyendelezya bantu chakululama, uyendelezya chakuyowa Leza.
Uyoba mbuli mumuni wakuseni, awo izuba niliyobutanta, kuseni kakutakwe mayoba, tusokwe tuteete nituyakula kwinda kubalama kwazuba niyamana kuwa imvula.

Nchobeni, impuli yangu tensi mbibede na kunembo lya Leza? Tensi wakachita chizuminano chitamani andime na, kuchaamba akuchibika munzila zyoonse? Tensi wakayungizya na ilufutuko lwangu akuzuzikizya ziyandisyo zyamoyo wangu?
Pesi batakwe bulemu banoli mbuli maamvwa ayelede kusowelwa kule nkambo takonzyi pe kubozezya ajanza limwi.
Muntu uyanda kubaguma uyelede kubelesya chibelesyo chabutale nakuti chisamu chang'umba. Belede kutentelwa nkubalala.''
Aya ngemazina abalumi basintaanze ba Davida mbakali abo: Joshebbu-Bbashebbeti mu Takemonayiti, wakali muzuluzi wabalumi basintaanze. Wakajaya balumi bali myanda musanu ayitatu muchiindi chimwi.

Musule lyayoyu Eliyaza mwana mulombe wa Dodayi mu Ahohite, umwi wababo bali batatu balumi basintaanze.  Wakali antomwe a Davida nibakali kusampawula ba Filisiti aboo bakabungene antomwe  kuti bachite inkondo, alimwi baalumi bamu Izilayeli bakainka kuyolwana.

Eliyaza wakanyampuka akulwana aba Filisitiya mane kuboko kwakasika akukakatala akuboko kwakakatila kufumbatunuka kupanga lyakwe. Jehova wakeeta luzundo lupati kubuzuba oobo. Basilumamba bakabweda kusule lya Eliyaza, nakabona kwachaala mitunta ilede.
Kusule lyakwe kwakali Shama mwana mulombe wa Agii, mu Halaliti. Ba Filisitiya bakabungana oko kwakali muunda wanyangu, aba silumamba bakachijila nkuko.
Pesi Shama wakanyampuka wimikila akati kamuunda akubakasya. Wakajaya ba Filisitiya alimwi Jehova wakeeta luzundo lupati.
Batatu babasilumamba bali makumi aatatu bakaseluka kuya kuli Davida kuchiindi chakutebula, kumpangala lya Adulamu. Basilumamba baba Filisitiya bakalikkede mukkuti lya Efulemu.
Kulicheecho chiindi Davida wakali zwide bukali, ampangala, aboobo inkamu yasilumamba bakalila batalisya mu Bbetelehemu.
Davida wakali sukeme manzi akwamba kuti, ''Nikwali kuchita umwi andipe manzi akuchikala chaku Bbetelehemu ndinywe, chikala chili kumbali lyamulyango!''

Mpawo balumi batatu basintaanze bakapola akati kabasilumamba baba Filisitiya akuyoteka manzi muchikala chamu Bbetelehemu, chikala chili amulyango!  Bakabweza maanzi akwayeta kuli Davida, pesi wakakaka kwanywa. Anukuti, wakatila kuli Jehova.

Mpawo wakamba kuti, ''Jehova, konditantamuka mebo, kuti ndichite eechi.  Sa ndilanywa bulowa na bwabantu aba bakeenda chakutayoosya mawumi abo?'' Mpawo wakakaka kwanywa. Eezi zyakachitwa abasintaanze botatwe.

Abbishayi, mukulana wa Jowabbu mwanamulombe wa Zeluya, wakali mwendelezi wabatatu. Wakalwana asumu lyakwe akati kabantu bali myanda yotatwe alimwi wakabajaya. Wakali empuwo aantomwe abasilumamba batatu.
Teensi wakali zibinkene na kwinda batatu? Wakachitwa mwendelezi wabo. Nikuba boobo, kuzibinkana kwakwe tekwakelene pe akuzibinkana kwabasilumamba batatu.

Bbenayiya uzwa ku Kkabbuzili wakali mwana mulombe wa Jehoyiyada; wakali mwalumi wakasimide loko wakachita pobwe pati. Wakajaya bana balombe babili ba Aliyeli mu Mowabbu. Alimwi wakakunukila mudindi alimwi akuyojaya mulavu nakali kuvuluma.
Mpawo wakajaya mwalumi mu Ijiputi mupati. Mu Ijiputi wakali esumu mujanza lyakwe, pesi Bbenaya wakamulwana a luuti kupela. Wakanyanzya mu Ijipita ing'umba mujanza akumujazya ndilyo isumu lyakwe.
Bbenaya mwana mulombe wa Jehoyada wakachita pobwe eeli, alimwi wakawulikwa kwelene abalumi basintaanze batatu.
Wakalemekwa kwinda basilumamba bali makumi otatwe, pesi takalemekwa kwinda basintanze botatwe pe. Nikuba Davida wakamubika kukwendelezya basikumulinda.
Balimakumi otatwe balajatikizya aba batobela: Asahelu mukulana wa Jowabbu, Eluhana mwana mulombe wa Dodo uzwa ku Bbetilehemu,
Shama mu Haloditi, Elikka mu Haloditi,
Helezi mu Palutiti, Iila mwana mulombe wa Ikkeshi mu Tekkoyite,
Abbiyeza mu Anatoti, Sibbekayi mu Hushatiti,
Zalumoni mu Ahohiti, Mahalayi mu Netofatiti.
Helebbu mwana mulombe wa Bbaana, mu Netofatiti, Itayi mwana mulombe wa Libbayi uzwamu Gibbiya kalimu Bbenjamayiti,
Bbenayiya mu Pilatoniti, Hidayi wakumisena yaku Gashi.
Abbi-alubboni mu Abbatiti, Azimaveti mu Bbahumiti,
Eliyabba mu Shalubboniti, abana balombe bba Jasheni Jonatani mwana mulombe wa Shama mu Halaliti;
Ahiyamu mwana mulombe wa Shala mu Halaliti,
Elifeleti mwana mulombe wa Ahasibbayi mu Maakkatiti, Eliyamu mwana mulombe wa Ahitofelu mu Giloniti,
Hezilo mu Kkamelayiti, Palayi mu Abbiti,
Igayi mwana mulombe wa Natani uzwa ku Zobba, Bbani uzwa kuluzubo lwa Gaadi,
Zelekki mu Amonayiti, Nahalayi mu Bbilotiti, sikunyampula zilwanisyo zya Jowabbu mwana mulombe wa Zeluyiya,
Ila mu Itiliti, Galebbu mu Itiliti,
Uliya mu Hititi-makumi aatatu ababili kubabikaamwi.
Alimwi bukali bwa Jehova bwakabukila Izilayeli, alimwi wakeenzya Davida kuli mbabo kawamba kuti, ''Yinka ukabale Izilayeli a Juda.''

Mwami wakati kuli Jowabbu mupati wabasilumamba, ooyo ngwakali awe, ''Yinka kumikowa yoonse ya Izilayeli kuzwa ku Dani kuyosikila ku Bbelishebba, akubala boonse bantu, kuchitila kuti nzibe mweelwe wabalumi banga baleleela kunjila kunkondo.''
Jowabbu wakati kumwami, ''Kwanoli Jehova Leza wako wayungizya mweelwe wabantu kwazyiindi zili mwaanda, akuti menso amwami wangu azibone kazilokuchitika. Pesi nkambonzi mwami naziyanda eezi?''
Nikuba oobo, ijwi lyamwami lyakaba lyakumaninizya atala a Jowabbu atala amupati waba silumamba. Mpawo Jowabbu abapati babasilumamba bakazwa aanze kubuliwo bwamwami kuyobala bantu ba Izilayeli.
Bakazubuka Jolodani akukkala afwifwi a Aloyeli, kubbazu kochilisyo kwadolopo mumusena. Mpawo bakeenda bayinda mu Gaadi kuyosika ku Jaza.
Bakasika ku Giliyadi akunyika ya Tahitimu - Hodishi, mpawo aku Danu Jani akuyozyunguluka kabaya ku Sidoni.
Bakasikila kumampangala a Tulo amumadolopo woonse aba Hiti aba Kkananayiti. Mpawo bakinda kuzwa ku Wegibbi mu Juda ku Bbiyasyebba.
Nibakayinda nyika yoonse, bakaboola ku Jelusalemu nikwakayinda myeezi musanu ayiine amazuba makkumi abili.

Mpawo Jowabbu wakaamba mweelwe wabalumi basikulwana nkondo kumwami.  Mu Izilayeli bakaliwo bakali zyuulu musanu azitatu balumi bali achibindi, aabo bakagwisya mapanga, abalumi baba Juda bakali 500,000 balum.

Mpawo moyo wa Davida wakamuchisa naakamana kubala baluumi. Aawo wakati kuli Jehova, ndakubisizya loko kwinda kulechi chiindi chita, lino, Jehova tola mulandu wamulanda wako, nkambo ndachita zyabufubafuba loko.''
Lino Davida nakabuka kuseni, ijwi lya Jehova lyakasikila kumusinsimi Gaadi, musondi wa Davida, kalyamba kuti,
''Yinka ukaambe kuti kuli Davida: ''Eechi nchiicho Jehova nchawamba,'' Ndakupa zintu zitatu zyakuti usalule. Usalule chimwi akati kazyo.''''

Mpawo Gaadi wakaya kuli Davida akuyomwambila kuti, ''''Iyosika na minyaka yotatwe yanzala itakasike munyika yako? Naa kuti uyochija kwamyeezi itaatu kabaya bukwandila? Naa kuyoba mazuba atatu achilwazi munyika yako? Lino yeeya insandulo njintakabozye kuli ooyo wakandituma.''
Mpawo Davida wakati kuli Gaadi, ''Ndaba mumapenzi mapati. Atulibike mumaanza a Jehova kwinda kumaboko amuntu, nkambo inchitoyaluzyalo lwakwe nimpati loko.''
Eelyo Jehova wakatuma chilwazi ku Izilayeli kuzwa kuseni kuyosikila kuchiindi chakambidwe, alimwi bamwi bantu balizyuulu zili musanu azibili bakafwa kufwa kuzwa ku Dani kuyosika ku Bbelisyebba.

Kuchindi mungelo nakagwisya ijanza lyakwe kunembo a Jelusalemu kuti ayimwaye, Jehova wakachincha miyeyo yakwenkambo kalunyonyooko lwakayinochitika, alimwi wakati kumungelo ooyo wakali kujaya bantu, ''Kwakkwana ! Lino bwedezya kuboko kwako.'' Kuli eecho chiindi mungelo wa Jehova wakalimvwi alubuwa lwachipolelo lwa Alawuna mu Jebbusi.

Mpawo Davida wakambuula kuli Jehova nakabona mungelo ooyo wakali kujaya bantu, alimwi wakati, ''Ndabisya, alimwi ndamulandu. Pesi eezi imbelele, ninzi nchizyachita? Inche ijanza lyako lisubule ndime empuli yataata !''
Mpawo Gaadi elyozuba wakaza kuli Davida akwamba kuti kuli nguwe, ''Yinka achilundu alimwi ukayake chipayililo cha Jehova alubuwa lwachipolelo cha Alawuna mu Jebbusiti.''
Eelyo Davida wakatanta achilundu mbuli Gaadi mbakali wamulayilila kuti achite mbuli Jehova mbwaka mulayilide. Alawuna wakalanga aanze alimwi wakabona mwami abalanda bakwe kabazabuza.
Mpawo Alawuna wakayinka aanze alimwi wakavundama ansi kumwami busyu bwakwe kabulangide alubuwa.

Mpawo Alawuna wakati, ''Nkamboyi simalelo wangu mwami naza kuli ndime, mulanda wakwe?'' Davida wakasandula,  ''Kuti azowule lubuwa lwakupolela, kuchitila kuti njake chipayililo cha Jehova, kuchitila kuti chilwazi chikonzye kugwisigwa kuzwa kubantu.

Alawuna wakati kuli Davida, ''Chitole mbuli chako simalelo wangu omwami. Chiita eecho chibotu kumenso aako. Boona mbaba basune bang'ombe bachiipo chachipayizyo chuumpidwe achileyi chakupolela alimwi a jokwe lyabasune lyachisamu.
Zyoonse ezi, mwami wangu, mebo Alawuna, ndazipa kuli nduwe. Mpawo wakati kumwami, ''Aanoli Jehova Leza wako wakutambula.''

Mwami wakati kuli Alawuna, ''Pepe, mebo ndasimisya akuchuula acho amuulo. Nsikoyoopa mbuli chipayizyo chuumpidwe kuli Jehova chintu nichiba eecho chitakwe muulo pe.'' Mpawo Davida wakawula lubuwa lwakupolela abasune amashekeli makumi musanu ansiliva.

Davida wakayaka chipayililo cha Jehova awo akupeda alinchiicho chipayizyo chuumpidwe achipo chabulyidilano. Mpawo Jehova wakasandula inkombyo yakayimvwilidi chibeela chanyika, alimwi chilwazi chakamana ali Izilayeli.
Pawulu, aSilivansi, aTimoti, kumbungano yakuTesalonika muli Leza Taatesu aMwami Jesu Kkilisito.
Luzyalo kulindinywe aluumuno luzwa kuli Leza Taatesu aMwami Jesu Kkilisito.

Twelede kupa kulumba lyoonse kuli Leza nkambo kenu, nobakwesu, mbuli mbukwelede, nkaambo lusyomo lwanu lulikukkomena bwindilide abwindilide, alimwi aluyando nwebo ndumulalo kuli umwi awumwi lulikuyungizigwa.
Elyo iswe lwesu tulalidundilizya atala andinywe mumbungano ya Leza nkambo lukakatila alusyomo muliwonse masukusyo aanu, amumapenzi aayo ngimuswanana awo.
Eechi nchitondezyo chalubeta lwa Leza lusalala, kuchitila kuti mukeele loko kubwami bwa Leza mbumulikupenzegwa biyo.
Nkaambo nchobeni, chililuleme kuli Leza kubwedezya mapenzi kuli baabo bamupenzya,
akubwedezegwa kulindinywe aabo bapenzegwa andiswe, elyo mwami Jesu nayolibonya kuzwa kujulu abangelo bakwe basinguzu.
Mubbalabala lyamulilo, uyobwedezya zibi kulibabo batamwizi Leza akuli babo batalemeki kujwi lyamwami wesu Jesu.
Bayopengana achisubulo chalunyonyoko lutamanikuzwa kunembo lyaMwami akuzwa kubulemu bwanguzuzyakwe.
Uyochita eezi nayoboola mubuzuba obo kuti akalumbayizigwe mubantu bakwe basalala akulumbayizigwa abantu boonse abo bamusyoma, nkaambo bukamboni bwesu kulindinwe bakasyoma.
Nkaambo kazezi tulamukombela chakutaleka, nkokuti Leza wesu akalangisisye lokokubwitwe bwenu, anguzu zyakwe uyozuzikizya wonse makanze mabotu ayoonse milimu yalusyomo.
Tukomba boobu kuchitila kuti zina lyamwami Jesu lilumbayizigwe mulindinywe andinywe mulinguwe, kwiinda muluzyalo lwa Leza a Mwami Jesu Kkilisito.
Lino atala, akuboola kwaMwamiJesu Kkilisito akubungana kwesu katulantomwe kuti tukabe awe, twamukumbila changuzu bakwesu,
kuti mutakazungani kumiyeyo na kumafwabi anu, nekuba mumuuya, na kujwi, nekuba kulugwalo lubanga luzwa kulondiswe. Chakuyeya kuti buzuba bwaMwami buliswenede kale.
Kutabi muntu umwena kufumbwa munzila ilibyeni. Nkaambo tabukoyosika mane kulebwa kusike, alimwi muntu mubi ayubunuke, mwana walunyonyoko.
Oyo ukazya akulisumpula mwini ajulu azyoonse zyaamba Leza na zikombwa . Kuzwano ngukala mung'anda ya Leza akulyamba kuti, ndime Leza.
Tamuyeyi nindakalandinywe mbundakamwambila ezi zintu?
Lino mulichizi chintu chimukasya kuti, uyoyubunuka luzutu kuchindi chelede.
Nkaambo makani asisidwe akusotoka mulawu alikubeleka kale, luzutu kulumwi umukasya mane akagwisigwe munzila.
Elyo nayoyubunuka sikusotoka milawo, oyo mwami Jesu ngwayonyonyona amuuya wamulomo wakwe akumulobya akulibonya kwakubola kwakwe.
Kuboola kwasikusotoka milawu uyobeleka milimo yaSatani anguzu zyoonse, azitondezyo, azigambyo zyakubeja,
amisyobo yoonse yabubi akweena abo bali mukunyonyoka, nkaambo tebakatambula luyando lwakasimbe kuti bafutulwe.
Akaambo kaako, Leza wabatumina nguzu zyalweeno kuti bakasyome kuli yakubeja
alimwi kuti boonse bakapegwe mulandu akutasyoma kasimpe abaabo balibotezya mukutalulama.
Pesi tuleelede lyoonse kupa kulumba kuli Leza akaambo kanu bakwesu bayandwa a Leza wakamusala mbuli michelo mitaanzi kwiindila mukutambula lufutuko amukusalazigwa kunguzu zyamuuya akusyoma kasimpe.
Wakamwiita kwinda kumakani mabotu esu. Kuti mukavube bulemu  bwa Mwami wesu Jesu Kkilisito.
Nkaambo kaako bakwesu, amwime nji akujatisya kumilawu njemwakayisigwa, nikuba kujwi na kulugwalo lwesu.
Elyo Mwami wesu Jesu Kkilisito mwini a Leza Taatesu, wakatuyanda akutupa lumbulizyo lutamani abulangilizi bubootu kwiinda muluzyalo,
awumbulizye akusimya myooyo yanu kumilimu yoonse mibotu akujwi.
Lino nobakwesu amutukombele, kuti ijjwi lyaMwami lyeende alimwi libe abulemu mbulimbuzibede zilimulindinwe.
Alimwi kuti tukangununwe kububi akubantu babi, nkaambo teboonse pe balalusyomo.
Pesi Mwami ulasyomeka, uyomusimya akumukwabilila kuzwa kumubi.
Tulachibindi muMwami atala andiwe, kuli zyoonse zyomuchita alimwi tulendelela anembo kuchita zintu zitulayilila.
Mwami alulamike myoyo yanu kuluyando lwa Leza akulukakatilo lwaKkilisito.
Lino tulamulayilila kuti, bakwesu, muzina lyaMwami wesu Jesu Kkilisito, kuti mukasya woonse mukwesu weenda munzila italuleme alimwi taponi katobelezya ziyanza nzimwakatambula kuzwa kulindiswe.
Nganywebo lwenu mulizi kabotu mulindinywe kutobelezya ndiswe, nkaambo tetakalibulikidwe nitwakali andinywe.
Tetwakalya chinkwa chawumwi katutachibhadalide, pesi twakalikubeleka isikati amansiku mukuminwa kapati kuti tutalemwi kufumbwa wanu.
Twakachita ezi zitambi kuti tetwakalikwe bwendelezi, pesi twakachita echi chibe chitondezyo kulindinywe, kuti mukatutobelezye.
Ngambuli mbutakali andinywe, twakamulayilila, "Ooyo uutazumini kubeleka tayelede kulya pe."
Ngatwamvwa kuti bamwi aakati kanu beenda mukuleya, kutali kujatikana akubeleka, pesi mibili ijatikene.
Lino bali boobo tulabalayilila akukombelezya muMwami Jesu Kkilisito, kuti belede kubeleka chabuninzi alimwi balye chinkwa chabo.
Pesi nywebo, nobakwesu, mutakatali mukuchita zibotu.
Pesi na umwi katalemeki ijwi lyesu mulugwalo olu amulangisisye alimwi mutabi abulidilane anguwe, kuchitila kuti akanyansigwe.
Nikuba boobo mutakamubwezi mbulisinkondo nyokwe, pesi mukamuchenjezye mbuli munyokwe.
Lino Mwami walumuno lwakwe mwini amupe lumuno chiindi choonse munzila zyoonse. Mwami abe andinywe moonse.
Ime ndiPawulo, ndalemba ezi aluboko lwangu, chili chichitondezyo mumagwalo woonse ngindilemba.
Luzyalo lwaMwami wesu Jesu Kkilisito lube andinywe moonse. Ameni.
Pawulo, mutumwa wa Kkilisito Jesu mukwiinda mu luyando lwaLeza, mukwiinda mu chisyomezyo cha buumi buli muli Kkilisito Jesu,
kuli Timoti, mwana muyandwi: Luzyalo, lweetelelo a luumuno kuzwa kuli Leza Taata aKkilisito Jesu Mwaami wesu.
Ndilumba Leza, ngwekomba  kuzwa kuli bamataata, amoyo uutakwe kampenda, mbuli mbemuyeya munkombyo zyangu mansiku a sikati.
Mbuli mbendiyeya misozi yako, ndiyandisya kukubona, kuti ndizule alukondo.
Ndali kuyeezegwa alusyomo lwako lwinilwini, oolo lwakali muli banyookulu Loyisi anbanyoko Yunisi, alimwi ndili aakasimpe kuti lulakkala mulinduwe ayebo.
Nkenkaako nkendakuyeezezya kuti ubukulusye chipo chaLeza chili mulinduwe chakaba kandikubika maboko.
Nkaambo Leza taakatupa muuya wabuyoofu, pesi wamanguzu a luyando akulibamba.
Aboobo utabi eensoni abukamboni bwa Mwaami wesu, na lwangu, Pawulo, mwaange wakwe. Nikuba boobo abila mumachise kuchitila makani mabotu mukwiindila munguzu zyaLeza.

Ngu Leza wakakufutula alimwi wakatwiita alwiito lusalala. Wakachita eezi, kutali kumilimu yesu, pesi mukwiindilila mumakanze aakwe aluzyalo. Wakatupa zintu zyoonse eezi muli Kkilisito Jesu zintu zyoonse nkazitanabawo.
Pesi lino lufutuko lwaLeza lwakayubununwa mukulibonia kwaMufutuli wesu Kkilisito Jesu. NguKkilisito wakamaninsya lufu akweeta buumi butamani kumunika kwiindila mumakani mabotu.
Nkaambo kacheechi, nchindakasalwa kuba mukambawusi, mutumwa, alimwi muyiisi.
Akaambo kacheechi ndilafwabila eezi zintu. Pesi nsifwi bweeme, nkaambo ndilizi ooyo ngwesyoma. Ndili aakasimpe kuti ulakonzya kubamba eezyo nzindakamupa kusikila eelyo zuba.
Bamba chitondeezyo chamajwi aamvwika aayo nguwakamvwa kulindime, alusyomo aluyando eezyo zili muli Kkilisito Jesu.
Zintu zibotu Leza nzyaakakupa, zibambe mukwiinda mu Muuya Uusalala, uukkala mulindiswe.
Ulichizi eechi, kuti boonse bakkala kuAsiya bakandipapila. Mukabunga aaka muli Figelasi a Hemojinisi.
Mwaami ngape luzyalo kun'anda ya Onesifolasi, nkaambo wakali kundibukulusya alimwi taakaba aamawuse aakwaangwa kwangu.
Nikubaboobo, nakali kuLoma, wakandiyanduula chabusungu, alimwi wakandijana.
Mwaami amujanie luzyalo kulinguwe muli eelyo zuba. Nzila zyoonse nzyakandigwasya mu Efeso, ulizi kabotu.
Iwe akooko, mwanaangu, koyuma muluzyalo luli muli Kkilisito Jesu.
Zintu nziwakamvwa kulindime aakati kabakamboni biingi, zipe kubantu basyomekede aabo bakonzya kuyiisya bamwi abalabo.
Njila mubuyumu aantomwe andime, mbuli silumamba mubotu wa Kkilisito Jesu.
Takwe silumamba uubeleka aawo kachaangidwe mumakani aabumi oobu, kuti aantela ulabotezya ooyo wakamunjizya mumulimu.
Alimwi, kuti umwi kazundana mbuli sikuchijaana, tapegwi  musini ado wabamba milawu yakuchijaana.
Chileelede kuti mulimi uubeleka changuzu atambule chaabilo chabutebuzi kusanguna.
Yeeya aatala anzindili mukwaamba, nkaambo Mwaami uyokupa kumvwisisisya muzintu zyoonse.
Koyeeya Jesu Kkilisito, walunyungu lwaDeviti, ooyo wakabusigwa kuzwa kubafu. Eezi zileendelana amakani aangu mabotu,
ayo ngendifwabila kusika kuchiimo chakwaangwa anketani mbuli simulandu. Pesi ijwi lyaLeza talyangidwe.
Aboobo ndakakatila muzintu zyoonse akaambo kabasale, kuti ambweni abalabo bakatambule lufutuko oolo luli muli Kkilisito Jesu, abulemu butamani.
Ooku nkwaamba kusinizizye: ''Twakafwa anguwe, tuyopona alimwi anguwe.
Na twakakatila, tuyoyendelezya aawe. Kuti twamukkaka, alakwe uyootukkaka,
na katutasyomekede, we unoosyomekede lyoonse, nkaambo takonzyi kulitama mwini.''
Inkilila aanembo nkobayeezya zintu eezi. Bachenjezye kunembo lyaLeza aatala akukazyania aatala ambala; tazigwasyi, aboobo zijaya aabo baswiilila.
Kosungwaala kulitondeezya kunembo lya Leza mbuli muntu uutambulika, simulimu utakwe chintu chimuusya nsoni, uuyisya kabotu makani aalusinizyo.
Leka majwi aabufubafuba, aatola kububi bwiindilide.
Zyaambo zyabo zilasaalila mbuli kkuni. Aakati kabo kuli  Hameniyasi a Filetasi,
aabo bakaleya kusimpe. Baamba kuti bubuke bwabasalali bwakachitikana kale, alimwi bamwaya lusyomo lwabamwi.
Nekubaboobo intalisyo yaLeza iliimvwi. Ilembedwe oobu: ''Mwaami ulibezi bakwe'' alimwi ''Woonse waamba izina lyaMwaami weelede kusosoloka kububi.''
Mumuunzi wabuvubi, teensi zibilkilo zya ngolide a nsiliva luzutu. Kuli zibikilo zya zisamu azya bulongo. Zimwi zyazeezi nzyabulemu, alimwi zimwi teensi zyabulemu.
Pesi kuti muntu walisalazya kubusofwaazi, uba chibikilo chabulemu. Ulasalwa, abelesegwe asimalelo, alimwi abambililwe milimu mibotu.
Kochija ngemuzyo zyabukubusi. Yanduula bululami, lusyomo, luyando, alimwi a luumuno ababo bayita Mwaami mumoyo uusalala.
Pesi kokaka mibuzyo yabufubafuba  a yakutaziba. Ulizi kuti izyala nkazyanio.
Muzike waLeza tayeelede kulwana pe. Anu kuti weelede kuba mubombe kuli boonse, uukkonzya kuyiisya, alimwi mubombe.
Weelede kuyiisya chamoyo mubombe aabo bamukazya. Antela Leza ulabapa kusandukila ku luzibo lwa kasimpe.
Kuti antela bali kuboola kumiyeeyo yabo alimwi akusiya tukkole twa Saatani, ooko nkubakaangilidwe ku luyando lwakwe.
Pesi ziba eezi; kumazuba amamanino kuyooba zyiindi zyabuyumuyumu.
Bantu bayooba basikuliyanda, basimuyanda mali, basimuntumbwantumbwa, basikakomokomo.basikasankusanku.batamvwi bazyali, batamvwi bazyali, alimwi batakombi.
Basikanchimwa, basimfundiilili, basiluvwiyo lwakutamikizya, batalyeendeleli, basilupyopyongano, batayandi bubotu.
Basikuuzyania, basikayinya, basikulisumpula, bayandisya misalo yaansi kwiinda kuyanda Leza.
Bayooba  achiwa chabukombi, pesi bayowatama manguzu aabo.
Eelyo bamwi babo bayoba baalumi banjila mumanda akubweza banakazi bafubafuba.
Aaba mbanakazi bazwide zibi alimwi bayendelezegwa azisusi zyamisyo misyobo. Aaba banakazi balayiya chiindi choonse, pesi balakachilwa kusika kuluzibo lwakasimpe.
Mbubo mbuli Jenisi  a Jambulesi mbubakayiminana akukazyania a Mozesi. Muleeyi nzila aaba bayiisi abalabo balakazyania akasimpe. Mbantu balamiyeyo mibi, ibatalomene kulusyomo.
Pesi tabakoya kunembo. Nkaambo  bufubafuba bwabo buyolibonia kuli boonse, mbubo mbuli bwabaabo bantu.
Pesi webo, wakatobela njiisyo yangu, kweendelezya, makanze, lusyomo, mukkazika moyo, mukuyandaana amulukakatilo,
mukupenzegwa, mukuchiswa azeezyo zyakachitika kulindime ku Antiyokkiya, ku Ikkoniyamu, aku Lisitiya. Ndakalemenwa mapenzi, kuzwa, muli woonse, Mwami wakandinununa.
Aabo boonse bayanda kupona chakululama muli Kkilisito Jesu uyoopenzegwa.
Baantu babi abasikulibeja bayooyindilizya kukubisya. Bayoyenena bamwi. Abaalabo beni balalemenwa.
Pesi webo kojatisya kuzintu nzwakayiiya akuzuminisya.
Ulizi kuti kuzwa kubwanikenike wakaziba malembe aasalala. Ulakonzya kukuchita kuti ube musongo mukufutulwa kwiinda mulusyomo muli Kkilisito Jesu.
Magwalo wonse akayoyelwa a Leza. Alikondede kukuyiisya, akoloola akukupandulula makani abululami.
Kuliboobo kuchitila kuti muna Leza alibambe, azulile kuchita wonse mulimu mubotu.
Ndakupa lulayililo kunembo lyaLeza aKkilisito Jesu, Oyu uyobeteka bawumi abafwide, alimwi nkaambo kakulibonya kwakwe abwami bwakwe:
Kambawuka ijwi kolibambila kuchindi cheelede akuchindi chiteelede. Kosungwala kulaya, akukalila, akukombelezya, akukkazikizya  moya alimwi akuyiisya.
Eno chilasika elyo bantu nchebatakaleke kuzumina injisyo yanchobeni. Elyo bayoliyandwida beni bayiisi mukwiindila mukuyanda kwabo.Bayokondelelwa kubaswilila kwabo.
Bayosinka matwi aabo kuzwa kukasimpe, alimwi bayotobela zintu zyabuyo.
Pesi iwebo, kolibamba muzintu zyoonse, kofwabalika, kochita mulimu wamukambawusi; kozuzikizya mulimuwako.
Nkambo imebo ndazulila kale. Ichiindi changu chakwinka chasika.
Ndakalwana inkondo imbotu; ndakalumana lweendo, Ndakulubamba lusyomo.
Musini wabusalali ndilubambilidwe, oyo Mwami, mubetesi ululeme ngwayondipa mubuzuba obo, alimwi kutali ndime luzutu, pesi akuli boonse baynada kulibonya kwakwe.
Kosungwala kuchita kabotu kuti uze kulindime chakufwambana.
Nkaambo Demasi wandikaka. Wayanda zintu zyanyika alimwi winka  kuTesalonika. Kkilisensi wakaya kuaGalatiya, alimwi Tayitasi wakaya kuDalumatiya.
Luka alike ngulandime. Katole Maako uze awe nkambo ndugwasyo kulindime mumulimu.
Tayichikkasi ndakamutuma kuEfeso.
Chibaki ncendakasiya kuTiloyasi aKkalipasi, uzacho niwasika, amabbuku, ikapati mapepa.
Alekizanda mufuzi wakatondezya incito mbi kulindime. Mwami uyobwedezya kuli nguwe kwiindila mnchito zyakwe.
Ayebo ulelede kulikwabilila kuzwa kulinguwe, nkaambo wakakazya kapati makani eesu.
Kukubetekwa kwangu kutaanzi, takwena omwe wakimikila andime. Nkekaako boonse bakandisiya. Nekwakali kuti batakapegwi  mulandu.
Pesi Mwami wakandiiminina akundiyumya kuchitila kuti, kwiinda mulinduwe, kukambawukwa kuzulile koonse, akuti baMasi boonse bakakonzye kumvwa, ndakanununwakuzwa kumulomo wamulavu.
Mwami uyondivuna kulizyoonse incito mbi akundifutula nkaambo kabwami bwakwe bwakujulu. Kulinguwe kube bulemu kwalyoonse alyoonse. Ameni.
Umujuzye Pulisila, Akkwila, abanganda yaOnesifolasi.
Elasitasi wakasyaala kuKkolinto, Pesi Tilofimasi ndakamusiya nkachisidwe kuMiletasi.
Kosungwala kuboola nechitanasika chiindi champeyo. Yubbulasi ulakujuzya, alakwe Pudensi, Linasi, Kkilawudiya aboonse bakkwesu.
Mwami abe amuuya wako, luzyalo lube anduwe.
Mupati kuli uyandika Gayiyasi, ooyo ngwenjanda chakasimpe.
Oyandwa, Ndikukkombela ikuti zintu zyoonse zikwendele kabotu alubo upone kabotu, mbuli mbopona kabotu mumuuya wako.
Nkambo ndakakondwa ndakabotelwa loko inzubo nizyakasika akupa bukamboni bwakasimpe kaako , mbuli mboyenda mukasimpe.
Nsikwe kubotelwa kumbi kwinda oku pe, , ikumvwa kuti bana bangu benda mukasimpe.
Oyandwa, uchita michito chalusyomo mpobelekela inzubo akubenzu,
aabo bakazopa bukamboni bwaluyando lwako kunembo lyembungano. Uchita kabotu kubasindikila munyeendo zyabo chakubotezya Leza,
nkambo kezina eelyo ndibayobwendela, nkabata tambwide chintu kuli bamasi.
Aboobo aswebo tulachitambula mbubo, ikuti tukabe basimulimo nyokwe mukasimpe.
Kuli nzindakalembela imbungano, pesi Diyotilefesi, oyo uyandisya kuba mutanzi akati kabo, tatutambuli pe swebo.

Eelyo, nindasika, nzomuyeezya milimo yakwe njali kuchita, yakututamikizya chakubeja amajwi mabi kulindiswe. Mukutakkutisika, takaki biyo kutambula ibana bakwabo, pesi ulakasya alubo kulaabo ibayanda kubatambula benzu mpawo akubatanda mumbungano.
Noyandwa, utatobeli kuchita zibi pesi kuleezyo zibotu. Ooyo uchita zibotu nguwa Leza; simuchita zibi tanakubona Leza,
Demetiliyasi wakatambula bukamboni bubotu kuli boonse amukasimpe. Alubo andiswe tuli bakamboni, alubo ayebo ulizi kuti bukamboni bwesu mbwakasimpe.
Ndali ezyiingi zyakukulembela pesi nsikkonzyi kukulembela pe zyoonse empesele amulende.
Pesi ndilangila kuzokubona lino lino, elyo tuzowambuula katulangene.
Lumuno alube ayebo. Benzuma balikumujuzya. Ujuzye ibeenzuma oko muzina.
Tiyofilasi,lugwalo lutanzi ndundakalemba, ndakaamba zyoonse eezyo Jesu nzyakatalika kuchita akwiisya,
mane kubuzuba mbwakatolwa kujulu, nakamana kupa mulalilo kwiinda mu Muuya Uusalala kuba tumwa mbakasalide.
Nakamana kupenga, wakalitondezya lwakwe muzitondezyo zyiingi zizundikizya.
Chindi nakali kubungana aamwi ambabo,wakabalayilila kuti batazwi mu Jelusalema,pesi bakalindile chisyomezyo cha Taata, Eecho nchaakamba kuti, "mwakamvwa kulindime
kuti choonzyo, Joni waka bbabbatizya a meenda, pesi nywebo mumazuba mache biyo muyo bbabbatizigwa muMuuya Uusalala."
Aawo nibaka bungene aamwi bakabuzya kuti, "Mwami, sena echi nchechindi nchoyobusilizya Bwami ku Izilayeli?''
Wakabambila kuti, ''tachili kulindinywe kuziba zyiindi eezyo Taata nzyakabamba munguzu zyakwe.
Pesi muyotambula nguzu aawo Muuya Uusalala nuyosika aalindinywe, mpawo muyooba bakamboni bangu mu Jelusalemu amu Judiya moonse amu Samaliya, akumamanino anyika.''
Chiindi Mwami Jesu nakaamba eezi zintu, mpawawo kabachilangide kujulu, wakanyamoulwa mujulu, mpawo ijoba lyakamusisa kuzwa kumeso aabo.
Mbubonya kabachilangisisya kujulu mbuli mbwakeenda, mpawo mpawo, baalumi babili bakayimikila kulubazu lwabo kabasamide zisamo zituba.

Bakaamba kuti, ''Yo balumi baku Galili, nkambonzi nomwimvwi aano akulanga mujulu? Jesu ooyu watansiikwa kuzwa kulindinywe kuya kujulu, mbubonya uuyobola muchiimo nchichonya nchomwamubona kayinka aacho kujulu.
Mpawo bakajokela ku Jelusalema kabazwa kuchilundu chitegwa Oliveti, eecho chili aafwifwi aku Jelusalemu, lweendo lwabuzuba bwa Sabata.

Mpawo nibakasika, bakatanta mung'anda yamujulu, oomo mubakali kukkala. Bakali Pita, Joni, Jemusi, Andulo, Filipu, Tomasi, Bbatolomyu, Mateyo,Jemusi mwana wa Alufiyasi, Sayimoni mu Ziloti, a Judasi mwana wa Jemusi.
Boonse bakali peda kumulimo wakukomba antomwe abanakazi, a Meli banyina ba Jesu Kkilisito abanabakwabo.
Mumazubayo Pita wakiimikila akati kababakwabo, bakati kabe mwaanda amakkumi aabili, akwamba kuti,
''Nobakwesu, chakalelede kuti magwalo azuzikizigwe kuti Muuya Uusalala wakamba lutanzi kumulomo wa Devidi azya Judasi, ooyo wakazulwida aabo bakaanga Jesu.
Nkaambo wakaluumwi wesu mpawo wakatambula chaabilo chamulimo ooyu.''
Lino mwaalumi ooyu wakawula muunda a mpindu nzyakatambula mububi bwakwe, eelyo nkukonya wakawa watola mutwe lutaanzi amubili wakwe wakabbaluka alimwi mala aakwe akafwasukila kunze.
Boonse bakkali bamu Jelusalemu bakamvwa ataala achechi, mpawo bakawulika muunda ooyo mumwaambo wabo ''Akeludama, ''nkukwamba kuti, ''Muunda wa Bulowa.''
''Nkaambo kuli lembedwe mulugwalo lwa Ntembawuzyo,
Nkinkako, kulelede, kuti umwi wabantu bakeenda aswe chiindi choonse Mwami Jesu nakanjila akuzwa aakati kesu,
kutalikila kuzwa kulubbabbatizyo lwa Joni kulosika kubuzuba mbwakabwezegwa kuzwa kulindiswe, abe kamboni andiswe kububuke bwakwe.''
Mpawo bakabika baalumi babili kunembo, Jozefu uutegwa Bbasabbasi, ooyo wakawulikwa lubo izina lyakuti Jasitasi, a Matiyasi.
Eelyo bakakomba akwamba kuti, ''Mwami, webo, ulizi myoyo yabantu boonse, nkinkaako yubununa kuti nguuli wababili aaba ; ooyo ngosalide
abweze busena mumulimo oyu abutumwa oobo mbwakasiya Judasi akuya kubusena bwakwe.''
Mpawo bakawuma chisolo, alimwi chisolo chakawida kuli Matiyasi, mpawo wakabalwa aamwi abatumwa bali kkumi awumwi.
Nibwakasika buzuba bwa Pentekosita, boonse bakali aantomwe aabusena bomwe.
Mpawaawo kwakasikka muzuzumo wakazwa kujulu ulimbuli kuunga waguwo pati, wakazuzya ng'anda yoonse mubakabede.
Mpawaawo kwakalibonia ndimi zilimbuli zyamulilo zyakabakkala, alimwi zyakabakkala umwi awumwi.
Boonseni bakazula aMuuya Uusalala mpawo bakatalika kwaambuula mumilaka, mbuli mbubakazumininwa aMuuya.
Lino kwakali baJuda bakali kukkala mu Jelusalemu, bakalo aabuna leza, balikuzwa kumanyika woonse alimunsejulu.
Ooyu muzuzumo niwakamvwigwa, makamu makamu aabantu akaboola aamwi alubo bakagamba nkaambo bakabamvwa kabaambuula mumilaka yabo.
Bakayoowa akugamba; bakati sena aaba boonse balikwaambula tabali bamu Galilii na?
Nkamboonzi nitulikubamvwa, umwi awumwi mumilaka yabuzyalwe bwesu?
Baku Patiya abaku Medesi abaku Elamiya, abaabo bakkala ku Mesopotamiya, mu Judiya abaku Kkapadokkiya, ku Pontasi aku Ezhia,
ku Pirigiya aku Pamfiliya, ku Ejipiti aamwi mabazu a Libbiya aku Sayilini, abeenzu bakalikuzwa ku Roma,
baJuda abakasanduka baku Kkilete abana Arabiya, twabamvwa balaambuula mumilaka yesu aatala amilimu iigambya yaLeza."
Boonse bakakankama akuyoowa kupati, bakambuula umwi kuluumwi, "Eechi chaambaanzi?"
Pesi bamwi bakabaniaka bati, "Bakkuuta wayini mupya."

Pesi Pita wakayimikila abalikumi awumwi, wakatola muju jwi lyakwe, wakabaambila kuti, "Nobaalumi bamu Judiya, antoomwe amoonse nimukkala mu Jelusalema, eechi achizibinkane kulindinywe; amuteelele loko kumajwi aangu.
Nkaambo aaba bantu tabakoledwe pe mboli mbumulikubayeyela, nkaambo lichili biyo wola lyatatu lyabuzuba.
Pesi eechi nchenchicho chakaambidwe kuzwa kumusinsimi Jowelu:
'Kuyooba kumazuba akumamanino,' Leza uwamba oobo, 'Ndiyotila muuya wangu aatala anyama yoonse, bana benu balombe abasimbi bayoosinsima, bakubusi bayoobona zilengaano, abamanene benu bayoolota ziloto.
Chanchoonzyo balanda bangu bachaalumi abalanda bachanakazi mumazuba aayo nindiyotila Muuya wangu, bayoosinsima.
Ndiyotondezya zigambyo kujulu azitondezyo aanyika, bulowa, mulilo, akawuntumusi kabusi.
Zuba liyoosiya amweezi uyooba bulowa, kabutana kusika buzuba bupati bwakuboola kwa Mwami.
Kuyoba kuti boonse bayita muzina lya Mwami bayofutulwa.

Nobaalumi baku Izilayeli, amumvwe majwi aaya: Jesu muNazalata, wakali mwaalumi ngumwakasalilwa a Leza amanguzu mapati antoomwe azigambyo azitondezyo nzyakachita Leza kwiinda mulinguwe akaki kenu, mbubonya mbuli mbomuzi.
Ooyu mwaalumi mwakamupegwa kwiinda mumakanze amuluzibo; andinywe, kwiinda mumaanza aabatalemeki mulawu, mwakamubambula akumujeya;
pesi Leza wakamubusya, wakamwaangununa kumachise aalufu, nkaambo teensi chakalikukonzeka kuti akkalilile mulindulo.
Nkaambo Devidi waamba boobu aatala anguwe, 'Ndakabona Mwami lyoonse kubusyu bwangu, nkaambo uliko kulubazu lwakululyo kuti nsikasunzulusigwi.
Nkenkaako moyo wangu wakabotelwa alulimi lwangu lwakakondwa. Alubo, nyama yangu iyookkala mubusichaamba.
Nkaambo tokoyoolekela muuya wangu mu Hadesi, nikuba kuyozumina Musalali wako kuti akabone bubozi.
Wakachita kuti zizibwe kulindime nzila zyabuumi; uyondipa kuti ndikazule lukondo kubusyu bwako.'
Nobayandwa, eechi chililuleme kulindime kuti ngambuule aatala asikale Devidi, wakafwa akuvwikwa, kabanda kakwe mpukachili ambulisunu akati kesu.
Nekubaboobo, wakalimusinsimi alubo wakalizi kuti Leza wakali wasyomezya muchikonke kulinguwe kuti, uyoonanika umwi wamumazyalane aakwe uutakakkale aachuuno chakwe.
Wakabona zyakali kuyanda kuchitika muchiindi chiboola kwaamba aatala abubuke bwa Kkilisito, 'Taakwe pe anakalekelwa mu Hadesi, nuuba amubili wakwe taakwe niwakabola pe.'
Ooyu Jesu, Leza ngwaakabusya, uuli ngonguwe toonse ngotuli kaamboni.
Nkenkaako kwiinda mukusumpulwa akubikwa kujanza lyalulyo lwa Leza alubo amukutambula Muuya Uusalala wachisyomezyo kuzwa kuli Wisi, wakatila eechi, eecho nchimubona akumvwa.
Nkaambo Devidi taakwe pe naakatanta kuya kujulu, pesi uwamba kuti, 'Mwami wakati kuMwami wangu,' "Kokkala kujanza lyakuulyo lwangu
mane ndikachite basinkondonyokwe chilyatilizyo chandyatyo zyamawulu aako."'
Aboobo, akube kuti yoonse ng'anda ya Izilayeli izibe kuti Leza nguwakamuchita kuba Mwami a Kkilisito, ooyu Jesu ngumwakabambula."
Lino nibakamvwa eezi zyoonse, bakayaswa mumyoyo yabo, bakaambila Pita antoomwe abatumwa boonse bati, "Nobakwesu, tuchite biyeni?"
Mpawo Pita wakabaambila kuti, "Amusanduke, alubo mubbabbatizigwe, umwi awumwi wenu muzina lya Jesu Kkilisito kuti mulekelelwe zibi zyenu, mpawo muyootambula chipo cha Muuya Uusalala.
Nkaambo chisyomezyo nchichanu abana banu aboonse bazwa kule, abuvule bwabantu boonse mbatanoli wiita Mwami Leza."
Aambi majwi miingi wakabapa bukamboni akubalayilila, akwaamba kuti, "Amulifutule kuzwa kuli eeli zyalane lyabubi."
Mpawo bakatambula ijwi lyakwe, bakabbabbatizigwa, bakayungizigwa oobo buunsi bakasanduka kabayeyelwa kusika kuzyuulu zitatu.
Bakalipeda kunjiisyo zyabatumwa, akubulyidilano, mukukwamuna chinkwa amukukomba.
Kuyoowa kwakabawo kumuntu amuntu, antoomwe azigambyo azitondeezyo zyiingi zyakachitwa kwiinda mubatumwa.
Boonse bakazumina bakali antoomwe kabali aazintu zyoose mukuba aamwi,
mpawo bakawuzya nzibakali aazyo ambono zyabo, akuzyaabana boonse akati kabo, umwi awumwi mbuli kubula kwabo.
Mubuzuba abuzuba bakalikulipeda lwabo amaboneno omwe muchikombelo, alimwi bakali kukwamuna chinkwa mumaanda aabo, kabaabana chakulya antoomwe chakukondwa amyoyo iwangunukide;
bakatembawula Leza akuba aaluzyalo kubantu boonse,  alubo mazuba woonse Mwami wakayujngizya mweelwe wabaabo bakalikufutulwa.
Lino Pita a Jon bakalikuya muchikombelo muchiindi chakukomba, muwola lyamusanu atune.

Lino umwi mwaalumi wakalemene kuzwa mwida lyabanyina wakali kunoongwa wabwezwa wakutulwa aamulyango wachikombelo ooyo wakalikutegwa Mubotu. Bakalikumutula mpawaawo abuzuba kuchitila kuti kalikukumbila zipo kubantu banjila muchikolmbelo chazipo.
Naakabona Pita a Joni kabalikwaamba kunjila muchikombelo, wakabakumbila zipo.
Pita wakamulangisisya, kali a Joni, wakati "Tulange."
Mwaalumi uulemene wakabalanga kalangila kutambula chimwi chintu kuzwa kulimbabo.
Pesi Pita wakati, "Nsiliva angolide nsikwe pe, pesi nchelaacho ndilakupa.  Muzina lya Jesu Kkilisito waku Nazaleta, enda."
Kamujisi akuboko kwakuchilisyo, Pita wakamunyampula, mpawo ingo amawulu aakwe akasima.
Wakasunkutila mujulu, mwaalumi mulema wakanyampuka wasanguna kweenda, mpawo wakanjila a Pita a Joni muchikombelo kayabweenda, kayabusunkuta akulumbayizya Leza.
Bantu boonse bakamubona kayabweenda akulumbayizya Leza.
Bakabona kuti nguwe uulya mwaalumi wakali kukumbila zipo kubantu aaMulyango Mubotu wachikombelo; mpawo bakagamba chakwiindilila nkaambo kachakachitika kulinguwe.
Nakachijisilidi kuli Pita a Joni, bantu boonse bakachijanina kulimbabo kubbazu litegwa ndilya Solomoni, kambagambide loko.
Pita nakazibona eezi wakabasandula bantu wati, "Inywe nombaalummi ba Izilayili nkamboonzi nimugamba? Nkamboonzi nimutulangisisya, aanga ndiswe twamuponia amangu eesu nakuti abu Leza bwesu?
Leza wa Abbulahamu, awa Ayizeki, awa Jakobo, Leza wama taata eesu, wapa bulemu kumulanda wakwe Jesu. Nguwe ngumwakapeda mwamukaka kubusyu bwa Payileti, aawo we naakasalide kumwaangununa.
Mwakakaka Musalali a Mululami. Pesi mwakalikumbilila mujayi kuti awangununwe.
Mwakajaya Sikwaanza buumi, ooyo Leza ngwakabusya kubafu, tulibakamboni bazyo eezi.
Nkaambo kalusyomo muzina lyakwe, zina lyakwe lyapa kuti ooyu mwaalumi, ngumubwene akuziba, kuti asime. Lusyomo kwiinda muli Jesu lwamupa bulondozi bubotu kunembo lyanu.
Lino nobakwesu ndilikwaamba kuti mwakachita mukutaziba, mbuli mbubakachita batongi benu.
Pesi zintu nzyakaamba Leza kwiinda mumilomo yaba sinsimi boonse, kuti Kkilisito wakwe uzopenzegwa, lino wazizuzikizya.
Amusanduke, aboobo, muboole, nkokuti zibi zyenu zisalazigwe. Kuchitila kuti kwaba zyiindi zyakulyookezya ku Mwami;
mpawo ulamutumina Kkilisito ngumwakasalilwa Jesu.
Ngonguwe weelede kutambulwa ajulu mane zintu zyoonse zikabweedezegwe muchiimo chazyo, aatala aazintu Leza nzyakaambuula kwiinda mumilomo yaba sinsimi basalala.
Mozesi kampatila wakati, Mwami Leza uzoobusya musinsimi uulimbuli ndime kuzwa aakati kabakwenu. Muyooswiilila zyoonse nzyatakaambe kulindinywe.
Chiyooba mbubo kuti muntu woonse uutakaleke kumuswiilila ooyo musinsimi uyoonyonyoonwa akati kabantu.
Iyii, aboonse basinsimi kuzwa kuli Samuyele abaabo bakazoza musule lyakwe, bakaambula akuzibisya aatala amazuba aaya.
Mulibana babasinsimi abachizuminano nchakachita Leza abasikale benu, mbuli mbakaamba kuli Abbulahamu kuti, 'Mumbuto yako, azikkalongezegwe mpuli zyoonse zyaanyika.'
Leza wakabusya mulanda wakwe wamutumina kulindinywe sansina, kuti amulongezye moonse akusandula umwi awumwi wenu kuzwa kuzibi zyakwe."
Pita a Joni nkabali kwambula kubantu, bapaizyi amuzulwidi wa tempele,aba Sadusi bakabasikila.
Baka pengana kapati nkaambo Pita a Joni bakali kuyiisya bantu akubakambaukila Jesu akubuka kwakwe kubafu.
Bakabajata bababika muntolongo maane buzuba butobela, nkambo lyakali lyaba goko.
Pesi bantu biingi bakamvwa aya makani bakasyoma, imweelo wabalumi bakasyoma bakali zyuulu musanu
Nibwakaba buzuba butobela,bendelezi, bapati abalembi bakabungana aamwi mu Jelusalema.
Anasi mupayizyi mupati wakaliwo,Kefasi, Joni aa Alekizanda, abaabo boonse nzubo zyamupaizyi mupati.
Nibakabika bika Pita aa Johani akaati kabo, bakababuzya," nzizyani nguzu, niliba zina ndimwachita aalyo eezi.
Pesi Pita, nkazwide Muuya Uusalala, wakati kulimbabo,
Inywe nobendelezyi abapati, babantu, kuti mwatubeteka sunu atala amulimo mubotu ngutwakachita aliyoyu mwalumi uchiswa, akuti wapona buyeni.
Ngakuzibinkane kulindinywe moonse akubantu bamu Izilayeli kuti oyu mwalumi uyimvwi kunembo lyanu nkaponede muzina lya Jesu Kilisito wa Nazaleta, Ooyo ngumwakabambula, ooyo Leza ngwakabusya kubafu.
Jesu Kkilisito ndibbwe bayaki ndibaka kaaka lyakaba chooko ( chiswi )
Takwe lufutuko mumuntu naba omwe, nkambo taakwe zina aansi ajulu lipedwe kubantu nditwelede kufutulwa.''
Lino nibakalanga busichamba bwa Pita aa Joni, mpawo bakaziba kuti mbantu babuyo,batayiide,bakagamba,nkabazi kuti Pita aa Johani bakali a Jesu.
Nkaambo bakabona mwalumi wakaponesegwa nkayimvwi aambabo, bakabula zyakwamba ataala nzizyo.
Pesi nibakabalayilila batumwa kuti babbude munkuta yabechipala, bakiizya akati kabo.
Bakati, ''tuchite buyeni ataala abalumi aaba?Nkambo kamasimpe alabukamboni bwachitwa ambabo bwazibinkana kubantu boonse bamu Jelusalema" tatukonzyi kuzikazya.
Pesi kuti zileke kuyakunembo akati kabantu, ngatubachenjezye ikuti batambili naba omwe muzina eeli."
Lino bakabita Pita a Joni babalayilila kuti batambuli nekuba kuyiisya alimwi muzina lya Jesu.
Pesi Pita aa Joni  bakavwiila bati kulimbabo, ''Saa nchibotu kumeso a Leza kuswiilila ndinywe kwiinda nguwe, amuli beteke.
Tatukonzyi kuti tuleke kwambula atala azeezi zintu nzitwakamvwa akubona.''
Nibakaba sinizya Pita a Joni,bakabaleka beenda. Tebakajana mulandu uyanda chisubulo, nkaambo bantu boonse bakali kutembaula Leza azeezyo zyakachitwa.
Oyo mwalumi wakajana oku kupona wakali aminyaka iyiinda kumakumi oone akuzyalwa.
Nibakangununwa, Pita aa Joni bakaza kulibamukowa wabo mpawo bakubambila zyoonse mupati wabapayiizyi abapati nzibakabambila.
Lino nibakamvwa eezi, bakoompolola ajwi limwi kuli Leza mpawo bati, ''Mwami, wakalenga majulu aanyika alwizi, azyoonse zilimuli nzizyo.
webo owakambula a Muuya Uusalala kwindila mumulomo wabalanda bakwe, taata wesu Davida,
Ibaami banyika bakakkala aansi aamwi,
Ninchonzyo, aba babili Helodi aa Pontiyasi Payileti, antomwe abamaasi bakabungana  aamwi muchisi cha Izilayeli, kukwimikilana amulanda Uusalala Jesu, munanike wako.
Bakabunganamwi kuti bachite zyoonse eezyo luboko amabambe aako nguwakakanzide kale kale achiindi chibola atachitike.
Lino, Mwami, laanga inchenjezyo yabo alimwi ubape busichaamba balanda bako kuti bambule ijwi lyako.
Tandabika luboko lwako kuti uponie akubapa zitondezyo azigambyo kwindilila muzina lyamulanda wako Uusalala Jesu."
Nibakamana kukomba, busena boonse bwakazula a Muuya Uusalala mpawo bakamba jwi lya Leza abusichaamba.
Mweelwe mupati wabaabo bakasyooma bakaba amoyo amuya woomwe. Takwe naba oomwe wakamba kuti nchakalacho nchichakwe, pesi bakalijisi zyelelne mubube bwabo.
Munguzu mpati batumwa bakakambauka bukamboni atala abubuke bwa Mwami Jesu, aboobo luzyalo lupati lwakaba mulimbabo boonse.
Akati kabo katakwe wakabula kufumbwa chiintu, nkambo boonse bakajisi nyiika amaanda bakaasambala mpawo beeta mali yanzezyo nzibakawuzya.
Mpawo bakatula kumawulu abatumwa, mpawo yakabwa kulumwi awumwi mbuli mukubula kwakwe.
Jozefu, mu Levi, ooyo batumwa ngubakalikuti Bbanabbasi ( zina lilabupanduluzi ibuti mwana wabusungwazyi ) mu-Levi, mwalumi waku Sayipulasi,
wakasambala muunda wakwe mpawo waketa mali witula kumawulu abatumwa.
Lino umwi mwalumi uutegwa Ananiyasi, nkali a Safila mwanakazi wakwe, bakawuzya chimpanzi chabuvubi,
alimwi wakabamba musule chimpanzi chamuulo wamali ( mwanakazi wakwe kabiyo wakalizizi ezi ), alimwi wakeeta chimpanzi chazyo alimwi wakachibika kumawulu amu abatumwa.
Pesi Pita wakati, ''Ananiyasi, nkambonzi satani naazuzya moyo wako kuti ubeje ku Muuya Uusalala alimwi kuti ubambe musule chimpanzi chamuulo wamuunda?

Niwalikusyaala nkawutawuziziwwe, tensi wakayimvwi kawuli wako, alimwi akuzwa nkawuli wawuzigwa, saa wakali munsi lyanuzu zyako? Nwani oyo wabika eyi milimo mumoyo wako? Teensi wabejela muntu pesi kuli Leza.''
Naakamvwa majwi aya, Ananiyasi wakawida aansi mpawo wayoya kwakumaninsizya, alimwi kuyoowa kupati kwakasika kuli boonse bakamvwa eezi.
Balombe bakanyampuka alimwi bamuvunilizya, alimwi bakamubweza alimwi bakumuvwikka.
Nikwakiinda biyo otatwe mahoola, mwanakazi wakwe wakanjila, katezi kuti niinzi zyachitika.
Pita wakati kulinuwe, ''Ndibuzye naanka mwawuzya muunda azeezi, ''wakati, ''Iyii, azeezi.''
Mpawo Pita wakati kulinuwe, ''Mbuubuli mbumwazuminana moonse kuti musunke muuya wa Leza? Bona mawulu abaalumi bavwikka mulumi wako ali amulyango, alimwi bayokubweza ayebo.''
Mpawo mpawo wakawida ansi kumawulu aakwe alimwi wakayoya kwakumaninsizya.Elyo baluumi nibakanjila, bakamujana nkafwide, alimwi bakamubweza alimwi bakumuvwikka kumbali lyamulumi.
Kuyoowa kupati kwakasika akkati kayoonse imbungano alimwi aakati kaboonse aabo bakamvwa eezi.
Zyingi zitondezyo alimwi azigambyo zyakalikuchitika akati kabantu kwiinda mumaanza abatumwa. Bakali antoomwe kumulyango wa Solomoni.
Pesi takwe wabo wakaba aachiyandisyo chakuba antomwe ambabo; nikuba boobo bantu bakabalemeka.
Kabiyo biingi basyomi bakali kuyungizizigwa ku Mwami, bantu biingi bechalumi mpawo abanakazi,
nkokuti bakali kubweza bachiswa muchisi alimwi babalazika aabulo amuzitobo, kuchitila kuti awo Pita nayosika, muzuzumbwe wakwe wayino wida alibamwi babo.
Mpawo bakasika kabiyo antomwe bantu biingi bazwa muchisi chilafwifwi a Jelusalema, nkabeeta bachiswa alimwi abaabo bajiswi aa myuya yamatombe, alimwi balikuponesegwa boonse.
Pesi mupayizi mupati wakanyampuka, mpawo aboonse abo bakali anguwe ( aabo benkamu yama Sajusizi ); alimwi bakazwa munyono
alimwi bakabika maanza aatala lyaba tumwa, mpawo babawala muntolongo yakazibinkene.
Elyo muchindi chamansiku mungelo wa Leza wakajula mulyano wentolongo alimwi wakabagwisya aanze, mpawo wakati,
''Mwiinke, mwime muntempele mpawo mwambule kubantu majwi woonse abuumi.''

Nibakamvwa eezi, bakanjila muntempele nkakuli kwamba kucha mpawo bayiisya. Pesi mupayizi mupati wakasika mpawo ababo bakali anguwe, alimwi bakayita mulubeta antomwe, boonse bapati babantu bamu Izilayeli, mpawo babatuma kuntolongo kuti bakeete batumwa.
Pesi bakapokola abo bakayinka tebakabajana pe muntolongo, mpawo bakaboola kukuzowamba,
''Twajana intolongo mbuli mbukwelede kazijalidwe kabiyo balindizi kabiimvwi amulyango, pesi nitwajula, twajana takwe pe ulimukati.''
Lino basilumamba bentempele antomwe abapayizi bapati nibakamvwa aya majwi, baka bulikilwa atala ambabo kuti mbobuli mbubanga balazwa kulinzizyo.
Elyo umwi wakasika mpawo wabaambila, ''Balumi aabo mbimwakabika mukkati kentolono balimvwi mukkati kantempele mpawo balikuyiisya bantu.''
Eelyo silumamba wakiinka aamwi abakapokola, mpawo wababoozya musule, pesi kakutakwe kulwana, eelyo nkabayowede kuti balabatulula mabwe.
Nibaka beeta, baka bakkazika munsi ababetesi. Mupayizi mupati wakaba buzisisya, nkati,
''Twalayilila ndinywe a mulawu kuti mutayiisyi muzina eeli, mpawo lino mwazuzya Jelusalema enjiisyo achiyandisyo chenu alimwi mwayeya akweeta bulowa bwamwalumi oyu atala lyesu.''
Alimwi Pita abatumwa bakasandula, ''Twelede kulemeka Leza kwinda muntu.
Leza wabamataata wakabusya Jesu, oyo numwakajaya akumwanzika mumusamu.
Leza wakamunyampula kubbazu lyakuchilisyo kuti abe mwana wa Mwami mpawo amufutuli, kuti ape kusanduka ku Izilayeli, mpawo akulekelelwa kwazibi.
Ndiswe bakamboni bazeezi zintu, mpawo ngu Muuya Uusalala, oyo Leza ngwakapa kulibaabo bamulemeka.''
Eelyo bazuluzi bamwi nibakamvwa eezi, bakanyema alimwi bakayanda kujaya batumwa.
Pesi mufalisi uutegwa Gamaliyeli, muyiisyi wamulawu oyo wakalikulemekwa aboonse bantu, wakanyampuka mubazuluzi mpawo wakalayilila batumwa kuti bagwisigwe kwakiindi kanini.
Mpawo wakati kulimbabo, ''Nobaluumi bamu Izilayeli, amuswilizye loko kuli nzimwa zuminana kuti muchite kubantu aba.

Nkambo musule amazuba aya, Tewudasi wakanyampuka nkali kuyanda kuba uumwi, mpawo bantu biini, basika myaanda iine, bakaba antomwe anuwe. Wakajayigwa, eelyo boonse abo bakali kumulemeka baka mwayisiwampawo kwakamana.
Nikwakazwa ooyu mwalumi, Judasi waku Galili wakanyampuka mumazuba akubalwa kwabantu mpawo wakachunzya kule abantu kuzwa kulinuwe. Alakwe wakajayigwa, mpawo boonse abo bakali kumulemeka bakamwayika.
Lino ndamba kulindinywe, ikuti muye kule kuzwa kubantu aba mpawo ubayiisye abalikke, kjuti aya mabambe naa mulimo kuti nkazili zyamuntu, ziyosowegwa.
Pesi kuti nkazili zya Leza, tamukoyo kkonzya pe kuzimwaya; muyojana kuti munoyolwana a Leza.'' Eelyo bakazumina.
Eelyo bakayita batumwa mukkati alimwi babawuma mpawo babalayilila kuti taba nochambuli muzina lya Jesu, mpawo bakabaleka beenda.
Bakaya kule kuzwa musule abazuluzi nkaba boteledwe kuti bakali baswanana kabiyo akupenzegwa akuwisya bulemu bwezina.
Kuzwa wawo woonse mazuba, mukkati kentempele alimwi kuzwa kung'anda akung'anda, bakali kwinkilila anembo akuyobuyiisya alimwi akuyobumwaya milumbe mibotu kuti Jesu ngu Kkilisitu.

Lino kumazubayo nobakali kuyabuvula basikwiiya ba Giliki bakatalisya kutongawukila ba Hebbulayo, nkambo bamukabafu bakuli mbabo bakatongawuka amakani azyakulya nzibakali kupewa buzuba abuzuba zyakuliwasya.
Balikkumi ababili bakayita basikwiiya boonse mubwiingi bwabo babambila kuti, ''Tachili chibotu kuti iswebo tuleke ijwi lya Leza nkambo kamakani azyakulya.
Aboobo bakwesu mulelede kusala balumi bali musanu ababili akati kanu. Balumi bali ampuwo mbotu, bazwide Muuya usalala antomwe awabusono, abo mbitutabike mumulimu oyu.
Kwalo iswebo, tulinkilila kunembo lyonse akukomba akukambawuka ijwi lya Leza.''

Eno ijwi lyabo lyakabotezya nkamu yabantu boonse. Aboobo bakasala Sitivini mwalumi uzwide lusyomo alimwi a Muuya Uusalala, a Filipi, a Pulokkolasi, Nikkanoli, Tayimoni, Pamenasi, antomwe a Nikkolasi, mukombi wachi Juda wakali kuzwa ku Antiyokki.
Basyomi bakabayimika balumi aba kumawulu abatumwa, mpawonya bakabakombela alimwi bakabikka manza alimbabo.
Elyo ijwi lya Leza lyakayinkilila kunembo aboobo basikwiiya bakavulisya mu Jelusalemu ababo bapayizi bayingi bakali bombya akusyoma.
Lino Sitivini kazwide luzyalo anguzu, wakali kuchita zigambyo zipati azitondezyo akati kabantu.

Pesi bakanyampuka bamwi bantu baku chikombelo chaambwa kuti nchikombelo cha Fulidimeni, wakuba Sayilini akuba Alekizandiliya, antomwe abamwi bazwaku Silisiya aku Eziya. Aba bantu bakali kukazyania a Sitivini.
Pesi tebakalikwe nguzu pe zyakukazyania abusongo  a muuya walikwambula muli Sitivini.
Mpawo bakapa bamwi balumi masinkamulomo kabati, ''Twakamumvwa ulamba majwi akusampawula Mozesi alimwi kambula bubi atala a Leza.''
Bakasungilizya bantu abapati, abalembi bayinka, bamujata Sitivini bamweta kulubeta.
Bakeeta bakamboni basikubeja, kabamba kabati, ''Oyu mwalumi taleki pe kusampawula busena obu busalala amulawu.
Nkambo twakamumvwa kaamba kuti Jesu waku Nazaleta uyobumwaya busena obu, asandule ziyanza zyakatupa Mozesi.
Boonse bakakkede mulubeta bakamulangisisya, babona busyu bwakwe bwasanduka bwaba mbuli busyu bwamungelo.
Mupayizi mupati wakati, ''Makani aya ngakasimpe na?''
Sitivini wakati, ''Nobakwesu anomataata, mundiswilizye: Leza wabulemu wakalibonia kuli taata wesu Abbulahamu kali ku Mesopotamiya, katana kukkala mu Halani;
wakati kulinguwe, ''Longa uzwe munyika yakulindinywe abantu bakulindinywe, mpawo uye kunyika njensikakutondezye.''
Mpawo wakazwa wasiya inyika yaba Kkaludiya akuyokkala ku Halani, kali nkuko oku wisi nakafwa, Leza wakamweeta munyika omuno mumukkede lino.

Takwe nakamupa kuti ibelukono lwakwe pe, nikuba mweenya wakuti alyate kulinjiyo. Pesi wakamusyomezya -  kuti uzomupa nyika eyi kuti ibe lukono lwakwe amazyalani akwe, nikuba takalina kuba amwana pe - kuchindi echo mpakati uzomupa nyika eyi mbuli lukono kulinguwe akumazyalani ayotobela nguwe.
Leza wakambula anguwe anzila eyi kuti bana bakwe bayokkala munyika yabwenzu, akuti bana banyika eyo bayobajata buzike akabapenzya kapati kwaminyaka ili myanda iine. Leza wakati,
''Pesi ndiyobeteka musyobo wabantu abo ibayobajata buzike, kuzwa awo bayozwa bazoze omuno bazondikombe mubusena obuno.'

Mpawo Leza wakapa Abbulahamu chizuminano chabupalule, elyo Abbulahamu wakazyala Ayizeki mpawo wamupalula mubuzuba bwamusanu aatatu; Ayizeki wakazyala Jakkobbu, mpawo Jakkobbu wakazyala ibalikkumi ababili.
Lino nkambo kakuti Jozefu, bananyina bakamuchitila ibbivwe bakamuuzya ku Ijiputi, pesi Leza wakali anguwe
wakamuvuna kuzwa kumapenzi akwe. Wakapa Jozefu choolwe abusongo kunembo lya Falo, mwami waku Ijiputi, iwakamusala kuba mwendelezi mu Ijiputi aatala lyempuli yakwe.
''Lino kwakaba bbalanwe, amapenzi mapati mu Ijiputi yoonse amu Kkenani, mpawo bamataata bakabulikilwa chakulya.
Pesi Jakobbu nakamvwa kuti ku Ijiputi kuli chakulya, wakatuma bamataata kulwendo lutanzi.
Mulwendo lwabo lwabili Jozefu wakalitondezya kubakulana baklwe, mpawo wakabazibya kuli Falo.
Mpawo wakatuma bakulana bakwe kuti babwede bakaambile wisi kuti aze ku Ijiputi, antomwe abanzubo zyakwe bonse, kabali mweelwe wabantu bali makumi ali musanu aabili abantu bali musanu.
Lino Jakobbu wakayinka wakukkala mu Ijiputi wakufwida mumo, welwakwe abamataata.
Bakabwezegwa batolwa ku Shekkemu bakubambwa mukabanda ka Abbulahamu nkakawula amuulo wansiliva kuzwa kubana ba Hamoli mu Shekkemu.
Lino nichakamba kuzulila chiindi chachisyomezyo nchakali waamba kuli Abbulahamu, bantu bakakomena akuvula mu Ijiputi,
lumwi kwaba uumbi mwami wakeendelezya Ijiputi mwami utakwe anchakalizi pe azya Jozefu.
Wakeena bantu besu akubamanikizya kuti bazibye kuzyalwa kwabana bacheche kuchitila kuti abajaye.
Muchiindi nchicho echo Mozesi wakazyalwa wakali kweebeka loko kubusyu bwa Leza, wakalondolwa kwamyezi iitatu mung'anda yawisi.
Eelyo nakagwisigwa aanze, mwana musimbi wa Falo wakamutangila akumukomezya mbuli mwana wakwe mulombe.
Mozesi wakali yiide mulibonse busongo bwaba Ijiputi, mpawo wakabasinguzu mumajwi akwe amumilimu yakwe.
''Pesi nakaamba kuzulizya minyaka ilimakumi aane wakayeeya mumoyo wakwe kuti aswaye babunyina ibazyalani lya Izilayeli.
Wakabona mu Izilayeli kalo kutamizigwa, Mozesi wakamuvuna mu Izilayeli nyina, wakali  kupenzegwa mpawo wajaya mu Ijiputi:
Wakachita eezi kayeeyanga bantu bamukowa wakwe balaziba kuti Leza kwindila mukuboko kwakwe uyobapa lwangunuko pesi bo tebaka zimvwisisisya pe.
Mubuzuba butobela wakabona balumi babili kabalo kulwana, wakeezya kubavuna chaluumuno wati, ''Nobalumi, muli bantu bamwi biyo, nkambonzi nimulokuchisana lwanu lwanu?''
Pesi ulya umwi wakali wabisizya mwenzinyina wakamutontela kule mpawo wati, 'ngwani wakakusala kuti ube mwendelezi konotubeteka?
Uyanda kundijaya na andime mbulimbwakajaya mu Ijiputi ulya ijilo?
Lino Mozesi nakamvwa obu wakachija, wakakuba muzwakule munyika yaba Midiyani oko nkwakakuzyala bana balombe babili.
Elyo nikwakinda minyaka ilimakumi aane angelo wakalibonia kuli nguwe munkanda yakuchilundu cha Sinayi mumabangabanga amulilo kali muchiteeyo.
Lino Mozesi nakabona mulilo, zyakamuambya eezi, mpawo nakalikuya buswena afwifwi kuti abonesesye loko, kwakazwa ijwi lya Mwami lyakati,
''Ndime Leza wabamawuso, Leza wa Abbulahamu awa Ayizeki a Jakobbu.' Mozesi wakayoowa takwe nakayanda kulanga lubo pe oko.
Lino Mwami Leza wakati kulinguwe, gwisya insangu kumawulu aako, nkambo abusena mpoyimvwi mbusena busalala.
Ndabona loko kupenzegwa kwabantu bangu balimu Ijiputi; Ndamvwa kukwila kwabo, alimwi Ndasika kuza kuzobavuna; kwalino kweza, Ndilakutuma ku Ijiputi.'

Oyu Mozesi nguwe ngubakakkaka nibakamba kuti, ''Ngwani wakakubikka buzuluzi amubetesi?'' - nguwe ngwakatuma Leza kuti abe muzuluzi amuvuni. Leza wakamutuma kwinda mukuboko kwamungelo iwakalibonia kuli Mozesi muchiteyo.
Mozesi wakabazulwida wabagwisya mu Ijiputi, nakachita zigambyo azitondezyo mu Ijiputi akuLwizi lwa Matete, amunkanda muminyaka ili makumi aane.
''Oyu Mozesi ngonguwe wakaamba kuti kuba Izilayeli, 'Leza uyomupa musinsimi kazwa akati kababunyina, musinsimi uli mbuli ndime.'
Oyu ngomwalumi wakali mukwiizya amungelo wakali kwambula awe atala achilundu cha Sinayi, iwakali aamwi abamataata, iwakatambula imajwi apona kuti atwambile iswebo.
''Pesi bamataata bakakaka kumuswilizya; bakamutontela kule kuzwa kulimbabo, mpawo mumyoyo yabo bakabweda ku Ijiputi.
Echo chindi bakambila Aaloni kuti tupangile baleza batatuzulwide. Oyu Mozesi, wakatugwisya mu Ijiputi tatuzi pe ichachitika kulinguwe.'
