Eeyi milayizyo ilayubununa busongo, akulibombya beni akulibombya kweeta kusilikwa kwamibili yabo. Pesi tazijisi milimu yakutukasya kuzumina zichito zibi mumyoyo yesu.
Kuti kakuli kuti Leza wakamubusya amwi a Kkilisito, amuyanduule zintu zyakujulu, oko Kkilisito nkwakkede kujanza lyechilisyo lya Leza.
Amuyeeye atala azintu zyakujulu, pepe azimwi zili aansi.
Nkambo mwakafwa, mpawo buumi bwenu bulisisidwe a Kkilisito muli Leza.
Awo Kkilisito nazolibonia, uuli mbobumi bwenu, awo muyolibonia aamwi anguwe mubulemu.
Muzibike kulufu, mpawo, zizo zyamunyika - bwamu, busofwazi, mpeekezyo, kuyandisya zibi, abusyachivulemwangu, kazili mituni.
Nkambo kazeezi bukali bwa Leza nchibusikila bana bakutaswilila.
Mulizeezi zintu nzimwakali mwenda mulinzizyo nimwakali kupona mulinzizyo.
Pesi lino muyelede kuchenjela kuzintu zyonse ezi - bukali, lunyemo, mpeekezyo imbi, lunyansyo,amatusi kuzwa mumilomo yenu.
Mutanowambilani zyakubeja umwi amwenzinyina, mbuli mbumwaka samununa buntu bukulukulu amwi azyiimbo zyabo,
mpawo mwakazwata muntu mupya iwakachitwa mupya muluzibo mbukwelede kuchiimo chawoyo iwakachilenga.
Awo mpawo atakwe muGiliki a muJuda, upalwidwe awutapalwidwe, basikubwelebweza, mu Sitiyeni, muzike, silwangunuko, pesi Kkilisito ulizulide, akuba muli zyoonse.
Amuzwaate, mpawo, mbuli basale ba Leza, basalali bayandika, amuzwate moyo waluuse, buuya, kulibombya, kulifwinsya akukakatila.
Amukkazikane myoyo umwi awumwi, amube aluzyalo umwi awumwi. Nakuti kuli uli akambo kumwenzinyina, umulekelele mbuli Mwaami mbwakamulekelela.
Atala azintu zyoonse, amube aluyando, lulindondulo chaanzyo chabubotu.
Luumuno lwa Leza lwendelezye mumyoyo yenu, nkambo kandulolu lumuno nchimwakayitilwa mumubili omwe. Amube akulumba.
Akube kuti Ijwi lya Kkilisito lipone mulindinywe, kuyiisya akululamikana umwi awumwi abusongo boonse, mukwimba nyimbo antembawuzyo anyimbo zyamumuya akulumba mumyoyo yenu kuli Leza.
Alimwi zyoonse nzimuchita, mumajwi amumichito, amuzichite zyoonse muzina lya Mwaami Jesu. Amupe kulumba kuli Leza Taata kwinda mulinguwe.
Nobanakazi, amulifwinsye kubaalumi benu, nkambo nchicheelede mu Mwaami.
Nobaluumi, amuyande banakazi benu, nkabela mutanobi abukkali kulimbabo.
Nobana, amuswilile bazyali benu muzintu zyoonse, nkambo eezi zilabotelezya mu Mwaami.
Nomataata, mutanokkalalili bana benu, kuchitila kuti baleke kusululwa.
Nobazike, amulemeke basimalelo benu  munyama amuzintu zyoonse, pepe chipameso biyo, mbuli bantu basikuupaupa, pesi amoyo wanchoonzyo. Muyowe Mwaami.
Zyoonse nzimuchita, mubeleke kuzwa kumuuya wa Leza alubo pepe kubantu.
Mulizi kuti muyotambula kuzwa ku Mwaami mpindu yalukono. Ngu Mwaami Kkilisito ngumubelekela.
Nkambo kuliwoonse utachiti bululami ulatambula chisubulo chakutalulama kwakwe nkwachita, nkambo takulangwi chiimo chamuntu pe.
Nobasimalelo, amupe balanda benu chakululama achakweleka. Mbumwizi kuti anywebo mulijisi simalelo uli kujulu.
Amujatisye kukomba, musungwalile nkuko akulumba.
Nkabela amutukombele aswebo, kuti Leza atujulile myeenya yajwi, kwamba makani masisike a Kkilisito. Nkambo kacheechi, ndilangidwe anketani.
Amukombe kuti nkakonzye kulungulula, mbunjelede kuyowamba.
Amweende chabusongo kulibaabo balaanze, amununune chiindi.
Kwamba kwenu akube kwaluzyalo lyoonse, kulweezegwe amwinyo wakulumba, kuti mube abusongo bwakuvwiila kabotu kubantu boonse.
Lino kumakani alatala andime, Tuchikasi mukwesu ulachita kuti mwaazibe. Mukwesu uyandika, simulimoma musyomesi, muzikema mu Mwaami.
Ndamutuma kulindinywe nkaambo kacheechi, kuti amuzibye makani andiswe, akusungilizya myoyo yenu.
Ndilamutuma antomwe a Onesimasi, ulisyomekede alimwi mukwesu uyandika, kali umwi wenu. Bayomuzibisya zyoonse zyakachitika okuno.
Alisitachasi, mwangema, ulokumujuzya, antomwe a Maakki, mwenzinyina wa Bbanabbasi (mulitambwide kale mulazyo wakuti, asika kulindinywe, mumutambule),
antomwe a Jesu uyiitwa kuti ngu Jusitasi, Abo boonse babupalule mbasimilimoma mumulimo wabwami bwa Leza. Mbibakali lumbulizyo lwamoyo wangu.
Epafulatasi ulokumujuzya loko. Nguumwi wenu alubo muzike wa Kkilsito Jesu. Ukkala kamwitilila munkombyo, kuchitila kuti mukiime chakuzulila akuba bwiini kulizyoonse muluyando lwa Leza.
Ndipa bukamboni kuti umubelekela chamanguzu, kuli aabo balimu Layodisiya, antomwe akulibaabo balimu Hilapolisi.
Lukka musilisi uyandika antomwe a Demasi balokumujuzya loko.
Mujuzye bakwesu balimu Layodisiya, aku Nimfu, embungano ilimu ng'anda yakwe.
Olu lugwalo lwamana kubalwa kulindinywe, amuchite kuti lubalwe akulako kumbungano yabaku Layodikiya.
Amwambile Akkipa kuti, ''Langa kabotu kumilimo njiwakatambula ku Mwaami, kuti uyelede kuzuzikizya.''
Oolu lujuzyo ndalulemba amaboko aangu - ndime Pawulu. Kamuyeeya inketani zyangu. Luzyalo alube anywebo.
Mumunyaka watatu mubweendelezi bwa Jewakkimu mwami waJuda, Nebbukkatineza mwami waBbabbiloni wakaza kuJelusalema alimwi wakazyungulukila chisi kusinkilizya zyoonse zinjila mulinchicho.

Mwami wakapa Nebbukkatineza kuzunda ataia lya Jewakkimu mwami waJuda, alimwi wakamupa zibelesyo zisalala kuzwa mung'anda yaLeza. Wakazyeeta kunyika yaku Bbabbiloni, kung'anda yaLeza wakwe, alimwi wakabikka zibelesyo zisalala muchilondwedo chaLeza wakwe.
Mwami wakambila Asipenazi, silutwe wakwe,kweta bamwi bantu ba Izilayeli, kubikkilizya bempuli yabwami abalaabwime busumpukide_
baalumi bachikomena batakwe tumpenda, beebeka, balabusongo kulizyoonse, bazwide luzibo akumvwisisisya, alimwi beelede kubelekela mung'anda yamwami. Wakelede kubayisya malembe amwambo wabalumi bayide.

Mwami wakababambila chaabilo chabo chabuzuba abuzuba kuzilyo zyakwe zinono ayimwi wayini njakali kunywa. Aba balumi bachikomena bakali basikuyisigwa kwaminyaka itatu, alimwi kuzwa awo, balakonzya kubelekela mwami.
Akati kababa kwakali Daniyeli, Hamaniya, Miselu, aAzaliya, abamwi bantu baku Juda.
Silutwe wakabapa mazina: Daniyeli wakamwita kuti Bbelitiseza,Hahaniya wakamwita liti Sadileki, Miseki wakamwita liti Miseki, aAzaliya wakamwita liti Abbedinigo.
Pesi Daniyeli wakalibeteka mumoyo wakwe kuti takonzyi kulisofwazya azilyo zinono zyamwami na awayini njakalikunwywa. Aboobo wakakumbila kuzwa kuli silutwe kuti takonzyi kulisofwazya lwakwe mwini.
Lino Leza wakapa Daniyeli lweetelelo aluzyalo kwiinda mukulemeka oko silutwe nzyakamwetela.

Silutwe wakati kuli Daniyeli, ''Ndamuyowa simalelo wangu imwami. Wakalayilila chakulya akunywa nchimwelede kujana. Nkaambonzi nimuyanda kuti amulanga abone nkamwindilide loko kuli abo bamwi balumi bachikomena basanyokwe? Mwami ulakonzya kundigonka mutwe nkaambo kanu.''
Mpawo Daniyeli wakambula amulengi oyo silutwe ngwakapede mulimu atala lyaDaniyeli, Hananiya, Miseki aAzaliya.
Wakati, ''Tusunke, tobalanda bako, kwamazuba alikkumi. Mutupe chisyu luzutu tulye amanzi
akunywa. Mpawo mutulingule mutweelanisye kulangika kwesu akulangika kwabalumi bachikomena balya zilyo zinono zyamwami, alimwi utuchitile, tobalanda bako, mbubonya mbotanoli wabona.''
Aboobo mulangi wakamuzuminnina kuchita eezi, alimwi wakabasunka kwamazuba alikkumi.
Mumamanino kwamazuba alikkumi kulangika kwabo bakali kufwefwema loko, alimwi bakalinenede, kwinda boonse balumi bachikomena bakalya zilyo zinono zyamwami.
Aboobo mulangi wakagisya zilyo zinono awayini yabo alimwi wakabapa chisyu luzutu.
Aba balumi bachikomena bane, Leza wakabapa luzibo amanu akumvwisisisya woonse malembe abusongo, alimwi Daniyele wakalikumvwisya akupandulula zyoonse zilengano amaloto.
Kumamanino achiindi chakabikkidwe amwami kuti babeete, silutwe wakabeta kunembo lya-Nebukadineza.
Mwami wakambula abo, alimwi akati kabo tekwjanwa nikuba umwi welanisigwa a-Daniyeli, Hananiya, Misyeli, a-Azaliya. Bakayima kunembo lyamwami, nkabalibambilide kumubelekela.
Kuli woonse mubuzyo wabusongo akumvwisisisya mwami ngwakababuzya, wakajana balayinda zyiindi zilikkumi kulaboboonse bachapi ababo balyamba baambula abafwide bakali mubwami bwakwe.
Daniyeli wakaliwo kusika mumunyaka mutanzi wamwami Silasi.
Mumunyaka wabili wabweendelezi bwa Nebbukkadineza, wakali aamaloto. Moyo wakwe wakapengaana alimwi wakaba aachilabila.

Mpawo Mwami wakalayilila bachapi abaabo balyaamba kuti baambula aabakafwa. Alubo wakiita basondi a baalumi bayiide. Wakali kubayandila kuti bamupandulwide maloto aakwe. Aboobo bakasika alimwi bakaakwiimikila kunembo lya Mwami.
Mwami wakti kulimbabo, ''Ndalota, alimwi muyeeyo wangu ulayandisya kuziba chaamba loto.''
Mpawo baalumi bayiide bakaambula aa Mwami muchi Alamayiki, ''Mwami, pona lyoonse! Amba loto kulindiswe, tobalanda bako, alimwi tuyoopandulula.''
Mwami wakasandula baalumi bayiide, ''Aaya makani akakalilwa aansi. Na temwandiyubunwida loto abupanduluzi bwalyo, mibili yanu iyogonkoolwa alimwi maanda anu ayoochitwa malwi malwi aatombe.
Pesi na mwamndaambila loto abupanduluzi bwalyo, muyootambula zipo kuzwa kulindime, mpindu, akulemekwa kupati. Aboobo amundaambile loto a bupanduluzi bwalyo.''
Alubo bakasandula, bakati, ''Mwami atwaambile loto, tobalanda bako, alimwi tuyookupandulwida.''
Mwami wakasandula, ''Nchobeni ndilizi kuti muyanda chiindi chilamfu nkaambo mwabona buyumu bwa mizeezo aatala azeezi.

Pesi na temwandaambila loto, kuli chisubulo chomwe chenu. Mwazeeza kulibambilila majwi aakubeja aanyongene ngimwazuminina antoomwe kwaambila ndime kusikila ndasandula moyo wangu. Aboobo mundaambile loto, alimwi ndiyooziba kuti mulakonzya kupandulula loto.''

Basibusongo bakasandula Mwami, ''Takwe muntu pe naba womwe aanyika uukonzya kuchita nzyayanda Mwami. Takwe nikuba Mwami mupati na mweendelezi wakayandide chintu chiloobu kuzwa kufumbwa muchapi na kuzwa kulinaba umwi ulyamba kuti wambula bakafwa, na kuzwa kulumwi muntu uyiide.''
Eezyo nzyamba mwaami nziyumu, alimwi takwe nikuba umwi unga ulazibuzya mwaami kutali baleza, alimwi alimwi tabakkali akati kabatu.''
Eezi zyakachita kuti mwaami anyeme abukali bupati , alimwi wakalayilila kuti banyonyonwe boonse baalumi bachenjende mu Bbabbiloni.
Aboobo mulumbe wakayika anze kuti boonse baalumi bachenjede belede kujayigwa. Nkaambo kayooyu mulumbe, bakalangula Daniyeli abenzinyina kuti bajigwe.
Mpawo Daniyeli wakasandula chabusongo amanu Aliyoki silutwe wabalindizi bamwaami, wakali wazida kuzojaya boonse baalumi bachenjede mu Bbabbiloni.
Daniyeli wakabuzya silutwe wamwami, ''Kambonzi mulumbe wamwami nuwafwambana?'' Aboobo Aliyoki wakambila Daniyeli eezyo zyaakachika.
Mpawo Daniyeli wakinka alimwi kuyokumbila kubikilwa chiindi amwaami kuchitila kuti ape bupanduluzi kumwami.
Mpawo Daniyeli wakaya kung'anda yakwe alimwi wakapandulwida beenzinyina, Hananiya, Miseli, a Azaliya zyakachitika.
Wakabasungilizya kuti bayandawule luzyalo kuzwa kuli Leza wakujulu aatala amakani aaya aasisidwe kuchitila kuti Daniyeli a beenzinyina batanyonyoonwi kumwi abaabobaalumi bachenjede ba Bbabbiloni.
Mansiku aayo makani aasisidwe akayubununwa kuli Daniyeli muchilengano. Mpawo Daniyeli wakatembawula Leza wakujulu
alimwi Daniyeli wakati, ''Alitembawulwe zina lya Leza lyoonse nkaambo busongo anguzu nzizyakwe.
Uchinchulua zyiindi azibaka; ulagwisya alimwi ulabika Baami aazyuuno zyabo. Upa busongo ku basongo a luzibo kuli baabo bali aakumvwisisisya.
Ulayubununa zintu zinikide a zisisikene nkaambo ulizi kuti niinzi chili mumudima, alimwi mumuni ukkala kulinguwe.
Leza wabasikale bangu, ndilakulumba akukutembawula nkaambo kabusongo anguzu nzimwakandipa. Lino wachita kuti ndizibe nzitwakakumbila kulinduwe; wakachita kuti tuzibe makani aakataazya Mwami.''

Mpawo Daniyele wakiinka kuyoobona Aliyoki (ooyo wakasalwa a Mwami kuti akajaye woonse wakachenjede mu Bbabbiloni). Wakiinka alimwi wakati kulinguwe, ''Utanyonyooni baalumi bachenjede mu Bbabbiloni. Nditole ku mwami alimwi ndiyootondeezya Mwami bupanduluzi bwe loto lyakwe.''
Mpawo Aliyoki akufwambana kakeeta Daniyeli kunembo lyamwaami alimwi wakati, ''Akati kabazike ba Juda ndajana mwalumi utayubunune bupanduluzi bweloto lyamwaami.''
Mwaami wakati kuli Daniyeli ( wakalikutegwa izina lyakwe ngu Belitisaza), ''Ulakonzya na kundibuczya loto ndindakabona alimwi abupanduluzi bwalyo?''

Daniyeli wakasandula mwaami alimwi wakati, ''Insiswa mwaami njaabuzya kuyubununwa abaalumi basongo bachenjede, na ababo balyamba kuti bambula abakafwa, na bachapi, alimwi peepe abalingula zyangeengezi.

Nekubaboobo, mpali Leza ukkala kumajulu, uyubununa nsiswa, alimwi wazichita kuti uzizibe, Mwaami Nebukadineza, eezyo zitakachitikane mumazuba achiyobuza. Eezi ndiloto azilengano zyamiyeyo yako nolala abulo bwako.
Mbulinduwe, mwaami, mayeyelo ako abulo bwako akali atala azintu ziyobuza, alimwi oyo wakuyubunwida nsiswa wachita kuti uzizibe eezyo ziyanda kuzochitikana.

Mbulindime, eeyi nsiswa tesi yakayubunwidwa ndime nkaambo kabumwi busongo mbundaabo bwinda naba umwi muntu upona. Eeyi nsiswa yakayubununwa kuli ndime kuchitila kuti iwe, mwami, ukonzye kumvwisisya bupanduluzi, alimwi uzibe mayeyelo amuzezo wako.
Mwaami, wakalanga kujulu alimwi wakabona chikozyano chipati. Eechi chikozyano, chakali chipati alimwi chakali chibotu kwindilide, chakiima kunembo lyako. Kubalama kwacho kwakalikuyosya.
Mutwe wechikozyano wakachitidwe angolida mbotu. Kaango kacho amaboko akali ensiliva. Chitimbitimbi chacho azibelo zyacho zyakachitidwe amukuba,
alimwi myendo yacho yakachitide abutale. Zituta zyacho zyakachitidwe azipanzi zyabutale azipanzi zyabulongo.
Wakalanga kujulu, alimwi bbwe lyakagonkwa nekuba kutali aamaboko amuntu, alimwi kyakawuma maboko achikozyano kuzituta zyacho zyabutale abulongo, lyakachipwachula.

Mpawo butale, bulongo, mukuba, nsiliva, angolide muchindi chomwe zyakatyokoka zyababupanzipanzi alimwi zyakaba mbuli buungu bwalubuwa lwakupolela lyaminza. Luuwo lwakazibweza alimwi tikwakachala nikacheya kazyo. Pesi bbwe lyakawuma chikozyano lyakaba chilundu chipati alimwi chazuzya nyika yoonse.
Eeli ndilyo loto. Lino tulabuzya mwami bupanduluzi.
Iwebo mwami, imwami wabaami oyo Leza wakujulu ngwapedekezya bwami, anguzu, akusima,alimwi abulemu.
Wazibikka mukuboko kwako abusena awo bantu mpub8akkala. Wapedekezya banyama bamyuunda abayuni bakumajulu mukuboko kwako, alimwi wakuchita mweendelezi wazyoonse. Nduwe mutwe wangolida wechikozyano.
Kwazwa nduwe, bumwi bwami buyobuka buteelene anduwe, alimwi kuyoba bwami bwatatu bwamukuba buyoyendelezya nyika yoonse.
Kuyoba bwami bwane, busimide  mbuli butale, nkaambo butale butyola zimwi bupwayulula zyoonse.  Bulapwaya zyoonse zintu akuzivwinyuna.

Mbuli mbuwakazibona, zituta atunwe zyakali chipanzi chabulongo butentedwe achipanzi chabutale, aboobo buyoba bwami bwaanzene; kumwi kusima kubutale bunoliwo mulimbubo, mbuli mbuwakabona butale kabuswenene abulongo.
Mbuli tunwe twazituta twakachitidwe achipanzi chabutale achipanzi chabulongo, aboobo bwami bunoli achipanzi chiyumu achipanzi chipwayuka.
Mbuli mbuwabona butale buswenene abulongo, aboobo bantu banovwelene; tabakoyokkala antomwe pe, mbuli butale mbubutaswanani abulongo.

Mumazuba abaabo bami, Leza wakujulu uyoyimikizya bwami butakaleke kunyonyonwa, na kozundwa abamwi bantu. Buyotyolola bumwi bwami bukabe zipanzipanzi alimwi akubumaninizya kosika kumanjililo abo boonse, alimwi bayoyima nji kwalyoonse.

Mbuli mbuwakabona, ibbwe lyakaloka kuzwa kuchilundu, pesi kutali amaboko amuntu. lykatyolola butale, mukuba, bulongo, nsiliva, angolida zyakaba bupanzipanzi, Leza mupati wachita kuti zizibikane kuli nduwe, mwami, kuti ninzi zitakachitikane musule lyazezi. Iloto ndyakasimpe alimwi bupanduluzi obu mbwasimpe.''
Mwami Nebbukkatineza wakawa akubusyu bwakwe kunembo lya Daniyeli alimwi wakamupa bulemu, wakalayilila kuti kuchitwe chipo alimwi atununkilizyo zipedekezegwe nguwe.
Mwami wakati kuli Daniyeli, ''Nchobeni Leza wako nguLeza wabaleza, Mwami wabami, alimwi nguwe wayubununa insiswa nkaambo wakonzya kuyubununa eyi nsiswa.

Mpawo mwami wakachita Daniyeli kuti abe abulemu bupati alimwi wakamupa zipo zyiingi zigambya. Wakamuchita waba mwendelezyi atala lyachilikiti choonse chaBbabbiloni. Daniyeli wakaba mwami wabendelezi atala boonse balumi bachenjede baBbabbiloni. Daniyeli wakachita chikumbizyo kumwami, alimwi mwami wakapa Sadileki, Miseki aAbbedinikko kuti babe bendelezi atala achilikiti cha Bbabbiloni .Pesi Daniyeli wakachala kali munkuta yamwami.
Mwaami Nebukadineza wakachita chikozyano changolide chakali tukokola makumi musanu alimwi bulamfu atukokola musanu akamwi busasa. Wachimika muntandabale ya Dula muchikati cha Bbabbiloni.

Mpawo Nebukadineza wakatuma milumbe yakubungana aantomwe beendelezi bazilikiti, beendelezi bebboma, abeendelezi bazilawo, aantomwe amakkansila, basimubamba mali, basinkuta, babetesi, abasilutwe balajulu bazisi kuti baze kukujulwa kwachikozyano mwaami nchaakali wiimika.

Mpawo beendelezi babbome, aantomwe amakkansela, basikubamba mali, basinkuta, babetesi, abasilutwe balaajulu bazisi bakabungana antomwe kukujulwa kwachikozyano mwaami Nebukadineza nchaakali wiimika. Bakiima kunembo lyacho.
Mpawo similumbe wakompololisya, ''Mwalayililwa, nobantu, nozisi, amisyobo yoonse,

kuti chiindi nimuyomvwa kulila kwanyele, myeembo, mabbanjo, tuntimbwa, zinamondoga, amitetele, aziimbyo zyoonse, mweelede kuwida aansi akukomba chikozyano changolide eecho Mwaami Nebukadineza nchakali wiimika.
Nikubaani utawi aansi akukomba, mulecho nchicho chindi, uyowalilwa akati kaziba lyamulilo wamabanganga.''

Aboobo bantu boonse nibakamvwa kulila kwanyeele, mweembo, mabbanjo, tuntimbwa, zinamondonga, amitetele, aziimbyo zyoonse, boonse bantu, zisi, amisyobo bakawida aansi alimwi bakakomba chikozyano changolide eecho Nebukadineza mwaami nchakali wiimika.
LIno kulechino chindi bamwi baKkaladiya bakeza alimwi bakeeta twaambo aatala lyaba Juda.
Bakati kuli Nebukadineza mwaami, ''Mwaami, kopona lyoonse!
Iwe, mwaami, wachita mulawu kuti woonse muntu umvwa kulila kwanyeele, mweembo, mabbanjo, tuntimbwa, zinamondonga, mitetele, aziimyo zyoonse, weelede kuwida aansi akukomba chikozyano changolide.
Kufumbwa utawidi aansi akukomba welede kuwalilwa aakati kaziba lyamulilo wamabangabanga.

Lino kuli bamwi maJuda mbobikide mubwendelezi bwa chisi chaBbabbiloni; mazina aabo mba Sadileki, Miseki aAbedinigo. Aaba baalumi, mwaami, tabakuswilili webo. Tabayo manina baleza bako milimu, na kukomba chikozyano changolida nchuwayimika.''
Mpawo Nebukadineza, wakazula kunyema abukali, wakalayilila kuti Sadileki, Miseki aAbediniko beetwe kulinguwe. Aboobo bakabeta aba baalumi kunembo lya mwaami.
Nebukadineza wakati kulimbabo, ''Sena mwachinchulula myooyo yenu, Sadileki, Miseki aAbediko, kuti tamuyobamanina milimu baleza bangu nakukomba kuchikozyano changolide nchindayimika?

Lino kuti nkamulibambilide- eelyo nimuyomvwa kulila kwanyeele, myeembo, mabbanjo, tuntimbwa, zinamondonga, amitetele, aziimbyo zyoonse- kuti mukawide aansi akukomba chikozyano nchindachita, zyoonse zinoli zibotu. Pesi kuti timwakomba, muyowalwa ndilyonya akati kaziba lyamulilo wamabangabanga. Ngwani ulileza ukonzya kumuvuna kuzwa kumanza aangu?''
Sadileki, Miseki, Abedinigo bakasandula mwaami, ''Nebukadineza, tatukwe nchetukonzezya kukusandula kumakani aaya.
Kuti na kuli nsandulo, njakuti Leza wesu ngotumanina milimu uakonzya kutubamba kabotu kuzwa kuziba lyamulilo wamabangabanga, alimwi ulatuvuna kuzwa kujanza lyako, mwaami.
Pesi kuti pe, azizibinkane kuli nduwe, mwaami, kuti tatukobamanina milimu baleza bako, alimwi tatukoyokomba chikozyano nchuwayimika.''

Mpawo Nebbugadinezawakazuzigwa aabukali; bulangiki bwakubusyu bwakachincha aatala lya Sadileki, Miseki, a Abbedinigo. Wakalayilila kuti ziba lipyisigwe zyiindi zi musanu azibili kwiinda mbulyakali kupya lyoonse.
Mpawo wakalayilila bamwi baalumi basimide ba mpi yakwe kuti baange Miseki, Sadileki, a Abbedinigo alimwi babawaale muziba lyamulilo wamabangabanga.
Bakaangwa kabasamide zisamo zyabweendelezyi, matalawuzi, ngwaani, azimwi zisamo, alimwi bakawaalilwa mukati kaziba lyamulilo wamabangabanga.
Nkaambo kulayilila kwamwaami kwakatobelezegwa chanchobeni alimwi ziba lyakali kupyisya chiindilila, mabangabanga aamulilo akajaya aabo baalumi bakanyampula Miseki, Sadileki, a Abbedinigo.
Aaba baalumi botaatwe, Sadileki, Miseki, a Abbedinigo, bakawida aakati kaziba lyamulilo wamabangabanga eelyo nkabaangidwe.
Mpawo Nebukadineza wakagamba alimwi wakanyampuka kufwambaana. Wakabuzya kulibasimaanu bakwe, ''Sena tatuweede baalumi botatwe baangidwe mumulilo?'' Bakasandula ku mwaami, ''Mbubo loko, mwaami.''
Wakati, ''pesi ndibwene baalumi bone bataangidwe ballokwendenda mumulilo, alimwi taakwe nibapya. Kunjenjema kwawane kulimbuuli kwamwana mulombe wa Leza.''

Mpawo Nebukadineza wakeza afwifwi amulyango waziba lyamulilo wamabangabanga alimwi wakiita, ''Sadileki, Miseki, aAbedinigo, balanda baLeza usumpukide loko, amubbude! amuze okuno!'' Mpawo Sadileki, Miseki, aAbedinigo bakazwa mukati kamulilo.

Beendelezi bazilikiti, beendezi bebboma, abeendelezi bazilawu, abasimaanu bamwaami bakali babungana bakababona aaba baalumi. Mulilo takwe nuwakatenteede mibili yabo; masusu mumitwe takwe nakapyide; zikobela zyabweendelezi takwe nizyakanyonyokede; alimwi takwe nikwakali mweema wamulilo alimbabo.

Nebukadineza wakati, "Atusumpule Leza waba Sadileki, Miseki, aAbediniko, watuma mutumwa wakwe alimwi wavuna balanda bakwe ibasyomede mulinguwe, alimwi babika kumbali kulayilila kwamwaami, alimwi bakapeda mibili yabo kula kumanina milimu naa kukomba umwi leza kunze kwa Leza wabo.

Akaako ndachita mulawu wakuti nibaba bantu, zisi, naa milaka bambuula zikazyania a Leza wa Syadileki, Misyekki, a Abbedinego welede kudelulwa aakati, alimwi ng'anda zyabo zyeelede kuchitwa malwi malwi atyombe nkambo takukwe uumbi Leza uukonzya kuvuna boobu.''
Mpawo mwami wakasumpula Syadileki, Misyekki, a Abbedinego muchisi chaBbabbiloni.
Mwaami Nebbukkadineza wakatuma mulawu ooyu kubantu boonse, zisi amisyobo bakali kupona aanyika: Anoli luumuno lwanu kaluvula.
Chalangika kabotu kulindime kukubuzya azitondeezya azigambyo eezyo Leza Uusumpukide loko nzyakandichitila.
Nzipati biyeni zitondezyo zyakwe alimwi nzipati biyeni zigambyo zyakwe! Bwaami bwakwe mbwaami butamani, alimwi bwendelezi bwakwe bulakalililakuzwa kuzyalani akuzyalani.''
Ime, ndeNebbukkadineza, ndali kukkala chakubotelwa mung'amda yangu, alimwi alimwi wakalikukondelela kuzwidilila mung'anda yangu yabwaami.
Pesi chiloto nchindakabaacho chakandiyoosya. Nindakachilede aawo, zikozyano nzindakabona azilengano zyakali mumoyo wangu zyakandipenzya.
Aboobo ndakapa malayilile kuti kweetwe kunembo lyangu boonse basyabusongo baBbabbiloni kuti bazondipandulwide loto.
Mpawo bakaza basondi abaabo balyaamba kukonzya kwaambula aabakafwa, baalumi bayiide, alimwi abasyabusongo. Ndakabaambila chiloto, pesi taakwe nibakakonzya kuzibya bupanduluzi kulindime.
Pesi kumamanino Daniyele wakanjila - ooyo utegwa Bbelitisyaza wuuzikidwe zina lyaleza wangu, almwi mulinguwe mulimuuya wabaleza basalala - akumwaambila chiloto.
''Bbelitisyaza mwaami wabasondi, ndilizi kuti takwe chigambyo chiyumu loko kulinduwe. Ndibuzye bube bwachiloto changu abupanduluzi bwacho.
Eezi nzizyo zintu nzindakabona mumiyeeyo yangu nindakalede aabulo bwangu: Ndakalanga, alimwi kwakali musamu aakati kanyika, alimwibulamfu bwawo bwakali bupati loko.
Musamu wakakomena akuba aakusima. Imela yawo yakali kusika kumajulu, alimwi wakalikuboneka kumagozyo aanyika yoonse.

Matu awo akalimabotu, muchelo wawo wakali mwiingi loko, alimwi aalinguwo kwakali chilyo chazyoonse. Banyama bamusokwe bakajana cheenzule munsi lyawo, alimwi bayuni bakumajulu bakalikukala mumitabi yawo. zyoonse zilengwa zipona zyakalikusaninwa kuzwa kulinguwo.
Ndakabona mumoyo wangu nindakalede aabulo bwangu, alimwi mulangilizi, uusalalisya wakaza aansi kuzwa kumajulu.
wakoompolola kati, 'Tema musamu alimwi ugonkoole ntabi zyawo, pulula matu aawo, alimwi umwaye muchelo wawo. Leka banyama bachije kuzwa munsi lyawo abayuni bawuluke kuzwa muntabi zyawo.

Siya chisiko chamiyanda yawo munyika kachaangidwe achhanzy chabutale amukuba, aakati kasokwe tete lyamumuunda. Leka chitete alume alume luzwa kumajulu. Achikapone abanyama aakati kamisamu iili aanyika.
Miyeeyo yakwe ayisandulwe kuzwa kumiyeeyo yamuntu, alimwi miyeeyo yamunyama iipegwe nguwe kusikila minyaka ilimusanu ayibili ikiinde.

Aaya makani aachisubulo aambwa amalayilile aabalangilizi ,muzeezo wachitwa aabasalala, kuchitila kuti aabo bapona bazibe kuti uusumpukide kapati ulendelezya aatala lyaabwami bwabantu akubupa kuli kukufumbwa muntu ngwayanda  kubikka aalimbabo, nikuba kubaalumi balibombya chachobeni;

Ime, mwami Nebbukkadineza, ndali achiloto eechi. Lino iwebo, Bbelitisaza, ndibuzye bupanduluzi, nkaambo tatukwe umwi wabasyabusongo bamuchisi changu ukonzya kundipandulida ime. Pesi ulakonzya kuchita boobu, nkaambo muuya wabaleza basalalisya ulimulinduwe.

Mpawo Daniyele, alubo wakali kutegwa Bbelitisaza, wakanyema kapati kwachiindi chifwiifwi, alimwi miyeeyo yakwe yakamuyoosya. Mwaami wakati,''Bbelisyazya, utalekeli chiloto na bupanduluzi bwacho kuti bukuyosye.''Bbelitisyaza wakasandula,' Simalelo wangu, chiloto achibe chabaabo bakusula; bupanduluzi bwacho abube bwasinkondo nyokwe.
Musamu nguwakabona -wakakomena akuba musimu uulampela yalikusika kumajulu, alimwi eeyo yakali kulibonia kumagolelo anyika.

Ooyo wakali aamatwi mabotu, alimwi wakali amichelo myiingi, aboobo mulinguwo mwakali chakulya chaboonse, alimwi munsi lyawo banyama bamumunda bakali kujana mweenzule, alimwi bayuni bamumajulu mubakali kukkala-
ooyu musamu nduwe, mwaami, iwe nuwakomena changuzu. Bupati bwako bwakomenesya kusikila kujulu abwendelezi bwako busika kumagolela anyika

Iwe, mwaami, wakabona mulindi, uusalala kaza aansi kazwa kujulu akwaamba kuti, 'Gonka musamu alimwi wuunyonyoone, pesi usiye chisiki chamyaanda wawo munyika wawo munyika, kachaangidwe achaanzyo chabutale amukuba, aakati kamasokwe matete mumuunda. Achikabe chitete alume luzwa kumajulu. Achikakkale abanyama bamulusaka mumyuunda mane do kukabe minyaka ilimusanu ayibili.
Oobu mbobupanduluzi , mwaami. Mulazyo wayooyo uusumpukide loko ooyo wakusikila.

Uyotandwa kuzwa aakati kabantu, alimwi uyokkala abanyama bamulusaka mumyuunda. Uyochitwa kuti ukalye masokwe mbuli ng'ombe, alimwi uyoteta alume luzwa kumajulu, alimwi myaaka misanu ayibili iloyinda notakazumine kuti Uusumpukide Loko uleendelezya aatala abwaami bwabantu alimwi ulabupa kuliini kufumbwa ngwayanda.
Mbuli mbukwakalayililwa kusiya chisiko chamiyanda wamusamu, muleeyi nzila bwaami bwako buyoboozegwa kuzwa kuchiindi nuyooziba kuti julu lileendelezya.

Nkinkaako, mwaami, nchenjezyo zyangu zibotezya kulinduwe.  Leka kubisya alimwi uchite chiluleme. Kosanduka kuzwa kuzwa kuzibi zyako akutondezya luzyalo kulibapenzegwa, alimwi kuyabo kuti kuzwidilila kwako kuyoyungizigwa.
Zyoonse zintu eezi zyakachitika kumwaami Nebbukkanineza.
Niyakayinda myeezi kkumi ayibili wakalikuya bweendenda aakaluli kang'anda yabwaami muBbabbiloni,
alimwi wakati, Sateenjiyonya eeyi Bbabbiloni mpati, njindakayaka kuti chibe chikalilo chabwaami bwangu, kakukomena kwamagunzi aangu alimwi abulemu  bwabupati bwangu?''
Kuchiindi eecho majwi naakachili aamulomo wamwaami, ijwi lyakeza kuzwa kujulu: ''Mwaami Nebbukkadineza, zyakambilizigwa kulinduwe kuti oobu bwaamibwabwezegwa kuzwa kuli ndime.

Uyotandwa kuzwa kubantu, alimwi muunzi wako uyooba aantomwe abanyama bamusaka mumyuunda kuti ukaalye masokwe mbuli ng'ombe. Myaaka musanuayibili kusikila ukazumine kuti Uusumpukide Loko uleendelezya aatala lyazisi zyabantu alimwi ulazipa kuli nikubaani ngwayanda.''

Ooyo mulazyo aatala aNebbukkadinezawakachita chakufwambana. Wakatandwa wazya mubantu. Wakalya masokwe mbuli ng'ombe, alimwi mubili wakwe wakali mutete alume luzwa kumajulu. Masusu aakwe akalampa mbuli milimba yansika, alimwi maala aakwe akaba mbuli maala aabayuni.

Kumamanino aamazuba ime, ndeNebbukkadineza, ndakanyampwida meso aangu kujulu, alimwi mizeezo mibotu yakaboola kulindime. ''Ndakasumpula Uusumpukide Loko, alimwi ndakapa bulemu akulemeka ooyo uupona lyoonse. Nkambo bweendelezi bwako mbweendelezi butamani, alimwi bwaami bwakwe bulakkalilila kuzwa kumazyalane kusikila kuli woonse mazyalane.

Zyoonse zikala kulinguwe uzibweza kazili zyabuyo; ulazichita aakati kampi yakujulu alimwi azikkala aanyika nikuba kufumbwa cheendelana aakuyanda kwakwe. takwe ukonzya kumwiimika naa kumukazya. Takwe uukonzya kwaamba kuti, 'Nkamboonzi niwachita eechi?''

Muli nchicho chiindi awo mizeezo yangu niyakaboola kulindime, bupati bwangu akumweka kwakaboola kulindime nkaambo kabulemu bwabwaami bwangu. Basikundilulamika abapati bangu bakayandula choolwe changu. Ndakaboozegwa kuchikalilo changu alimwi bupati ndakabupegwa.

Lino ime, ndeNebbukkadineza, ndatembawula, ndasumpula, alimwi ndalemeka mwaami wajulu, nkaambo zyoonse zichito zyakwe nzyakasimpe, alimwi nzila zyakwe zililuleme. Ulabombya aabo beenda mukulisumpula kwabo beni.
Mwami Bbelusyaza wakachitila basilutwe bakwe bali chuulu pobwe pati, alimwi wakanwa wayini kunembo lyaboonse bali chuulu chomwe.

Mbubonya Bbelusyaza mbwakalabila wayini, wakalayilila kuti kuletwe zibikilo zyakachitidwe aangolida na siliva eezyo Nebbugadineza wisi nzyakagwisizye kuzwa kung'anda yakukombela Leza mu Jelusalemu, kuzwa kuli nzizyo mwaami, basilutwe bakwe, abanakazi bakwe abasimamambe banywide mulinzizyo.
Balanda bakaleta zibikilo zyangolida eezyo nzyakagwisidwe munganda yakukombela Leza, ng'anda ya Leza, muJelusalema. Mwaami, basilutwe bakwe, abanakazi bakwe abasimamambe bakanywa kuzwa kulinzizyo.
Bakanywa wayini akutembawula zikozyanio zyabo zyakachitidwe angolide asiluva, mukuba,butale,zisamu amabwe.
Kuchiindi eecho minwe yajaanza lyamuntu yakaboneka kunembo lyachibikilo chalampi akulemba kubulambo buzululudwe mung'anda ya mwaami. Mwaami wakabona chipanzi chajaanza mbuchakali kulemba.
Eelyo busyu bwamwaami bwakasanduka alimwi miyeeyo yakwe yakamuyoosezya; manungilo aatusolo twakwe akatontola, amazwi aakwe akalikugoontana.

Mwaami wakoongolola lulayo lwakuti kuletwe aabo bakali kulyaamba kuti baambula abafu, baalumi bayiide, abachape. Mwaami waamba kuti kubasongo baku Bbabbiloni, ''kufumbwa uubala bulembo akuziba bupanduluzi bwabo kuli ndime uyoosamikwa zisamo zya ntumbula alimwi uyoobikwa luwenjemsingo yakwe. Uyooba aanguzu zyamweendelezi mupati wachitatu mubwaami.''
Mpawo baalumi basongo boonse bamwaami bakanjila, pesi teebakakonzyape kubala bulembo nakuziba bupanduluzi bwabo kumwaami.
Eelyo mwaami Bbelusyazya wakayoowa loko akulangika kusanduka busyu bwakwe. Basilutwe bakwe bakamba.

Lino mwaami mwanakazi wakanjila mung'anda yapobwe nkaambo kacheecho mwami abasilutwe bakwe nchibakaambide. Mwaami mwanakazi wakaamba kuti, ''Mwami, kopona kwalyoonse! utleki miyeeyo yako kukupenzya.Utaleki kulangika kwabusyu bwako kusanduka.

Kuli muntu mubwaami bwako uujisi muuya wabaleza basalala. Mumazuba aawuso, mumuni akumvwisya abusongo mbuuli busongo bwa Leza bwakajanwa muulinguwe. Mwaami Nebbugadineza, wuso mwami, wakamuchita kuti abe mupati wabasondi , mbubonya mbuuli mupati wabaabo aabobaambula aabafu, wabaalumi bayiide, awabachape.

Muuya mubotu, luzibo, kumvwisisisya, kupandulula maloto, kulabununa tulabiko akusalazya makani aakataazya- eezyo zyoonse zyakajanwa mumuntu ooyu Daniyeli, ooyo mwaami ngwakawulika kuti Bbelutisyezya. Lino koyita Daniyeli alimwi uyookwambila bupanduluzi.''
Mpawo Daniyeli wakaletwa kunembo lya Mwaami. Mwaami wakaamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Nduwe Daniyeli ooyu, umwi wabantu babazike bwa Juda, ooyo taata wangu mwaami ngwakaleta kuzwa ku Juda.
Ndakamvwa aatala anduwe, kuti muya waba leza uli mulinduwe, akuti mumuni akumvwisya busongo bubotu zilajamwa mulinduwe.

Lino baalumi basongo abo balyamba kwambula abafwide akaletedwe mukati kunembo lyangu kukubala bulembo obu akubuzibya kulindime bupanduluzi bwabo, pesi tebekakonzya pe kuzibya bupanduluzi bwamakani kulindime.

Ndakamvwa kuti ulakonzya kupa bupanduluzi busalazya makani. Lina na ulakonnzya kubala bulembo akuzibya bupanduluzi bwawo kulindime, uyosamikwa zisamo zyantumbula akubikwa luwenje lwa ngolida luzyunguluka nsingo yako, alimwi uyoba aanguzu zyamwendelezi watatu waatala loko.''

Mpawo Daniyeli wakasandula kunembo lyamwami, '' Kuti zipo zyako azibe zyako, alimwi zilumbyo zyako uzipe umbi muntu. Nekuba boobo ndiyobala bulembo kulinduwe, mwaami, alimwi ndiyokwambila bupanduluzi.
Kwanduwe, mwaami, Leza usumpukide loko wapa wuso Nebukadineza bwami, bupati, lulemeko anguzu.

Nkaambo kabupati Leza mbwakamupa, bantu boonse, masi, amyaambo bakakankama akumuyowa. Wajaya abo mbakayanda kuti bafwe, akuponia abo mbayanda kuti kabaopona. Wakasumpula abo mbakayanda akufwiinsya abo mbakayanda kufwiinsya.
Pesi moyo wakwe niwakalisumpula alimwi muuya wakwe niwakayumisigwa chakuti wakachita chakubbondosya, wakafwiinsigwa kuzwa kuchuuno chakwe chabwaami, mpawo wakamugwisya bulemu bwakwe.

Wakatandwa kuzwa kubantu, wakaba aamiyeyo yamunyama, wakakkala amadonki amusokwe.Wakalya bwizu mbuli ng'ombe. Mubili wakwe wakalikuteta aalume luzwa kumajulu mane wakaziba kuti Leza ulisumpukide loko nguyendelezya aatala aabwami bwabantu alimwi kuti ngukkazika aali mbabo kufumbwa ngwayanda.
Webo numwana wakwe mulombe, Bbeliseza, tokwe nwakabombya moyo wako, nekuba kuti wakachiziba choonse echi.

Walisumpula aatala amwami wakujulu. Kuzwa kung'anda yakwe bakakuletela zibikkilo ezyo webo, basilutwe bako, banakazi bako abasimamambe bako mwakanywa wayini kuzwa kulinzizyo, alimwi mwakalumbayizya zikozyanio zyakachitwa ansiliva angolida,mukuba, butale, zisamu amabwe- zikozyanio zitaboni pe, zitamvwi pe na kuziba nechiba chintu. Takwe nemwakalemeka Leza ujisi muuya wanu mujaanza lyakwe alimwi uuzi nzila zyanu zyoonse.
Eelyo Leza wakatumina janza kuzwa kuli nguwe alimwi bulembo oobu bwakalembedwe.
Aaya ngemalembe aakachitwa: 'Mene, Mene, Tekele, alimwi Pasini.'
Mbubobu bupanduluzi bwamakani: 'Mene,,' 'Leza wabala mazuba abwami bwako akubusisya kumamanino.'
Tekele,' 'Wapimwa muzipimo alimwi wabula bulemu.'
'Pasini,' 'Bwami bwako bwaandanisigwa akupegwa kuba Medi aba Peziya.'''

Mpawo Bbeliseza wakalayilila, alimwi bakasamika Daniyeli zisamo zyantumbula. Luwenje lwangolida lwakabikwa munsingo yakwe, alimwi mwami wakachita longoololo atala aanguwe lwakuti uleelede kubaanguzu zyabeendelezi batatu basumpukide  mubwami.
Busiku obo Bbeliseza, mwami waBbabbiloni, wakajayigwa,
mpawo Daliyasi muMedi wakatambula bwami nakali amyaka yakatibe makumi musanu awumwi wakuzyalwa.
Chakabotezya Daliyasi kuti asale bendelezi 120 atala abwami bwazilikiti bayoyendelezya atala abwami boonse.

Atala ambabo kwakali bendelezi basilutwe bapati batatu, mpawo Daniyeli wakali uumwi wabo. Aba bendelezi basilutwe bapati bakasalilwa kuti kabalanga bendelezi bachilikiti, kuchitila kuti mwami atakabi nafwaba akuswekelwa.
Daniyeli wakaboneka busiyene atala abamwi bendelezi basilutwe bapati abendelezi bachilikiti nkaambo kala amuuya windilide ngwakali awo mwami wakali kubamba kuti amubikke atala abwami boonse.

Eelyo bamwi beendelezi basilutwe bapati abendelezi bachilikiti bakayandula kubisya mulimu wakwe Daniyeli ngwakachita wamubwami, pesi tebakajana bubi na kukachilwa kumulimu wakwe nkaambo wakalisyomekede. Takwe kulewuka na kutayita obotu kwakajanika mulinguwe.
Mpawo balumi aaba bakamba kuti, ''Tatukoonga tulajana kufumbwa kambo kakumutamikizya Daniyeli chita tuyandule chmwi atala anguwe mukwiinda mumulawu wa Leza wakwe.''
Eelyo beendelezi basilutwe abendelezi bachilikiti bakaza amabambe kunembo lyamwami. Baakmba kuti kuli nguwe, ''Mwami Daliyasi, ngamupone kwalyoonse !

Boonse bendelezi basilutwe abapati babwami, beendelezi bachisi, abendelezi bachilikiti, mangambela, abeendelezi bakaswanana antomwe akuyeya kuti webo, welede kugwisya mulawu akuyumisya lukasyo, kuti kufumbwa uchita chikombyo kufumbwa kuli umwi Leza na kumuntu kwamakumi atatu amazuba, kutali kuli nduwe mwami, muntu ooyo weelede kuwalilwa mukkomba lyabalavu.
Lino, mwami, kugusya lukasyo akudinda bulembo kuti kutakubi nibuchinchululwa, mbuli mbubede mulawu waba Medi aba Peziya, kuti butachinchululwi,''
Mpawo mwami Daliyasi wakalemba bulembo, bwalukasyo.

Daniyeli wakaziba kuti bulembo bwakalembwa, kuba mulawu, wakayinka kung'anda yakwe [lino mpulungwido zyakwe zyakalijulikide mukanda kakwe kamujulu kuya kuJelusalema], mpawo wakafugama aansi amazwi akwe, mbuli mbakalikuchita ziindi zitatu abuzuba,mpawo wakamba akupa kulumba kunembo lya Leza wakwe mbuli mbakalikuchita kale .
Eelyo balumi aaba bakabamba kutamikizya antomwe bakabona Daniyeli kachita zikombyo akuyandula lugwasyo kuzwa kuli Leza.

Mpawo bakasikila mwami akwambula anguwe atala alukasyo: ''Tewakachita lukasyo na kuti woonse uchita chikumbizyo nikuba kuli leza umwi na kumuntu kumazuba atobela alimakumi aatatu, ibiyo kuli nduwe luzutu. mwami, weelede kuwalilwa mukkomba lya balavu?'' Mwami wakasandula kuti, ''Makani alibambidwe mbubonya mbubonya mbubede mulawu waba Medi abaPeziya, tukonzyi kumwayisigwa.''

Mpawo bakasandula mwami, ''Muntu olya Daniyeli, kali umwi wabantu babuzike kuzwa kuli Juda, takwe naswilila pe kuli ndiswe, mwami, nikuba kulukasyo olo ndwakalemba. Ulakomba kuli Leza wakwe tutatu abuzuba''
Eelyo mwami nakamvwa echi wakabijilwa loko, mpawo wakabelesya muzezo kuti angunune Daniyeli kuzwa mukubeteka oku. Wakabeleka lumwi kumabbililo keezya kuti avune Daniteli.

Mpawo balumi aba bakabumba lutamikizyo bakabungana amwi amwami akwamba kuti kuli nguwe, '''Ziba, mwami, kuti mulawu waba Medi aba Peziya, kuti takwe lukasyo na mulayizyo oyo mwami ngwaamba unga ulawusandula.''
Eelyo mwami wakapa malayilile, alimwi bakamweta Daniyeli, mpawo bnamuwala mukkomba lyabalavu. Mwami wakamba kuti  kuli Daniyeli , ''Leza wako, ooyo ngubelekela lyoonse akuvune.''
Ibbwe lyakeetwa kumulyango wakkomba lyabalavu, mpawo mwami wakalinamatizizye chinamatizyo chakwe azinamatizyo zyabasilutwe bakwe kuti kutakubi chinga chilasandululwa azyaDaniyeli.
Mpawo mwami wakayinka kung'anda yakwe yabwami akumana busiku mulimbubo kalyimya kulya. Takwe nchakabotezya chakeetwa kunembo lyakwe, angonzi zyakachija mulinguwe.
Eelyo kuchilyokezezyo mwami wakanyampuka alimwi wakafwambana kuya kukkomba lyabalavu.

Mbubonya asike munsi kukkomba lyabalavu, mwami wakayita Daniyeli mujwi lyuuside, kaamba kuti kuli Daniyeli, ''Daniyeli, mulanda waLeza upona, Leza wako, ooyo ngu belekela lyoonse wakonzya na kukwangununa kuzwakubalavu?''
Eelyo Daniyeli wakamba kuti kumwami, Mwami, mupone kwalyoonse!

Leza wangu wakatuma mutumwa wakwe mpawo wajala  milomo yabalavu aboobo tebandichisa. Nkaambo tendakajanika kambo kunembo lyaakwe mpawo akunembo lyako, mwami, alimwi takwe nindakakuchitila chikuchisa.''

Eelyo mwami wakabotelwa loko. Wakapa malayilile kuti beeledee kugusya Daniyeli anze kuzwa kukkomba lyabalavu. Aboobo Daniyeli wakasumpulwa kuzwa kukkomba lyabalavu. Takwe kulichisa kwakajanika alinguwe, nkaambo wakali syomede muli Leza wakwe.

Mwami wakapa malayilile, alimwi wakabeta balumi aabo bakatamikizya Daniyeli mpawo wabawalila mukkomba lyabalavu- bo,abana babo, abanakazi babo, Kabatanasika aansi, balavu bakabazunda mpawo batyolola zifuwa zyabo zyoonse akuba tupanzipanzi.
Eelyo mwami Daliyasi wakalembela bantu boonse, zisi zyoonse, akumyambo yoonse eeyo ipona munyika yoonse: ''Luumuno luvule nkaambo kanu.''

Ndilaano kubikka mulawu kuti mubweendelezi boonse bwamubwami bwangu balumi bakankame akuyowa kunembo lyaLeza wa Daniyeli, nkaambo nguLeza upona alimwi ulapona lyoonse, abwami bwakwe tabukanyonyonwi; bweendelezi bwakwe bukabe kumamanino.
Ulatuchita bakwabilidwe akutuvuna, mpawo ulachita zitondezyo azigambyo mujulu amunyika, nguwe wakabamba Daniyeli chakukwabililwa kuzwa kunguzu zyabalavu.
Aboobo Daniyeli wakazwidilila kuzindi zyabweendelezi bwa Daliyasi akuzindi zyabweendelezi bwa Silasi muPeziya.

Mumwaaka mutanzi wa Bbelisyaza mwami wa Bbabbiloni, Daniyele wakaba achiloto azilengano mumizezo yakwe nakalede abulo bwakwe. Mpawo wakalemba aansi ezyo nzyakabona muchiloto. Wakalemba aansi makani mapati loko azichitiko zipati:
Daniyele wakapandulula, ''Muchilengano changu mansiku ndakabona kuti myuuwo yone yakujulu yalikukopa lwizi lupati.
Banyama bone bapati, awumwi kasiyene, wakafumpuka kuzwa mulwizi.
Mutanzi wakali mbuli mulavu pesi kali amababa asikwaaze. Nindakachili kulangisisya, mababa aakwe akakulumbuka alimwi ayime amawulu obile, mbuli muntu. Miyeeyo yamuntu yakapegwa kulinguwe.
Mpawo kwakaba munyama wabili, ulimbuli simasekese, alimwi wakali koteme; wakali atumpango tutatu akkati kameno mukkanwa lyakwe, wakaambilwa,  'Nyampuka akulya bantu banji.'

Kwiinda kwachechi ndakalanga lubo. Kwakali umbi munyama, umwi wakali kuboneka mbuli nemba. Kusule lyakwe wakali amababa aane alimbuli mababa amuyuni, alimwi wakali amitwe iine. Wakapegwa nguzu zyakwendelezya.

Kwinda kwacheechi ndakabona muzilengano zyabusiku munyama wane, ukankamya, uyoosya kalanguzu loko. Wakali amenyo mapati alubulo; wakalya, katyolola mutumpanzi, akulyatuuka ansi amawulu zyakacheede. Wakali siyene kuzwa kulibamwi banyama, alimwi wakali ameja alikkumi.

Nindakachili kulangisisya meja, ndakalanga akubona kumwi kwija nkakumena akati kawo, keja kanini. Meja aatatu mataanzi akadaduulwa kumiyanda. Ndakabona mulwija oolu menso mbuuli menso aamuntu alimwi mulomo wakalikulidunda aatala lyazintu zipati.

Mbundakali langide, zyuuno zyakabambwa mubusena, alimwi sinsiku wakakkala. Zisamo zyakwe zyakali kutuba mbuuli nyengenge, alimwi susu lyamutwe wakwe lyakali kutuba mbuuli buluba. Chuuno chakwe chakali mabangabanga amulilo, amavwili acho wakali mulilo uuyaka.
Mulonga wamulilo wakali kweenda kuzwa kunembo lyakwe; zyuulu zyazyuulu bakali kumubelekela, alimwi mwaanda wazyuulu zyazyulu bakalimvwi kunembo lyakwe. Nkuta yakakkala, mpawo mabbuku akajulwa.
Ndakeendelela kandilanga akambo kamuzuzumo wamajwi akulidunda alwija. Ndakali kulangisisisya munyama kajiigwa, amubili wakwe wakanyonyoonwa, alimwi wakaabwa kuti ukawumpwe.
Kwabanya boonse baane, nguzu zyabo zyakwendelezya zyakabwezwa, pesi mawumi abo akayungizigwa kwachindi chilikunembo.
Muzilengano zyangu busiku obo, ndakabona umwi keza amayoba akujulu mbuli mwana mulombe wamuntu; wakeza kuli sinsiku akutolwa kunembo lyakwe.

Nguzu zyabwendelezi abulemu anguzu zyabwami zyakapegwa kulinguwe kuchitila kuti bantu boonse, zisi, alimwi amilaka kuti bamumanine milimo. Nguzu zyakwe zyakwendelezya ninguzu zinoliko lyoonse ezyo zitakayindi, alimwi bwami bwakwe mbobo butakoyonyonyonwa.
Kwandime, Daniyele, muuya wangu wakapengaana mukati kangu, azilengano nzindakabona mumiyeyo yanguzu zyakandikatazya.
Ndakasikila umwi wabo wakayimvwi nkuko akumubuzya kuti anditondezye bupanduluzi bwazintu eezi.
Banyama bapati aba, bane mumweelwe, mbaami bane abo batakubukile kuzwa munyika.
Pesi bantu basalala ba Simajulu bayotambula bwami, alimwi bayobubweza kwalyoonse.'

Mpawo ndakali kuyanda kuziba zyiingi aatala amunyama wane - wakali siyene kuzwa kuli bamwi alimwi kayoosya ameno awo alubulo amala amukuba; wakalya, kutyolola mutumpanzi, akulyatawuka amawulu awo ezyo zyakasyeede.

Ndakayanda kuziba aatala ameja alikkumi akali amutwe wawo, alimwi atala alumwi lwija lwakamena, alimwi atala ameja aatatu akawidaansi. Ndakali kuyanda kuziba atala alwija olo lwakali amenso aatala amulomo wakali kulidunda aatala azintu zipati zyakali kuboneka kuba zipati kwinda menzinyina.
Nindakachili kulanga, lwija olu lwakabusya nkondo kulwisyana abantu basalala akubazunda
kusikila sinsiku asike, akubetekwa kabotu kwabasalali baSimajulu kwakaba. Mpawo chiindi chakasika eelyo basalali nibakabweza bwami.
Nzeezi nzyakamba muntu ooyo, 'Kwamunyaka wachine,  bunoli bwami bwane anyika obo bunoli kabusiyene kuzwa kumaami amwi. Buyolwi nyika yoonse, alimwi buyolyatawukila ansi akwityolawula mutumpanzi.
Kwameja alikkumi, kuzwa kubwami bulakubukila bamwi. Unoli kasiyene kuzwa kubatanzi, alimwi uyozunda baami batatu.
Uyowamba makani alwisya aSimajulu akuyodyamizya bantu basimajulu. Uyoyezya kusandula zyiindi amulawu zintu ezi ziyopedwa mumaanza akwe kwamwaaka omwe myaaka yobile, achisela chamwaka.
Pesi basinkuta bayokkala, alimwi bayobweza nguzu zyabwami bwakwe buyonyanzigwa akunyonyoonwa kumamanino.
Bwaami abwendelezi, abupati bwamaami aansi aajulu lyoonse, buyopegwa kubantu babasalali ba Simajulu, Bwami bwakwe mbwaami bwalyonse, alimwi amwi maami ayomaninina milimo akumuswilila.'
Nkooku kumaninina kwamakani, kwandime, Daniyele, mizezo yangu yakandigambya kapati alimwi busyu bwangu bwakasanduka muchiimo. Pesi ndakalondola eezi zintu mulindime.''
Mumwaaka watatu wa bwendelezi bwa Mwami Bbelusyaza, mebo, nde Daniyele, ndakajana chilengano chakaboneka kulindime (musule kwachimwi eecho chakaboneka kulindime lutaanzi).
Muchilengano ndakabona, mbuli ndakali kulanga, kuti ndakali mung'anda yaku Susa muchilitiki cha ku Elamu. Muchilenganondakabona kuti ndakali kumbali aa Ulayi Kkanalu.

Ndakatambya menso aangu alimwi ndakabona mugutu kunembo lyangu wakali aameja obile, kayimvwi kulubazu lwa lwizi. Lumwi lwija lwakali lulamfu kwiinda lumwi, pesi lulamfu lwakali kulampa buniini buniini kwiinda lufwiifwi alimwi lwakayindwa mubulamfu andulo.
Ndakabona mugutu kachundila kumbo, mpawo kaya kunyika, alimwi eelyo kumusanza; takwe umwi munyama wakakonzya kwiima kunembo lyakwe. Wakachita kufumbwa nchakali kuyanda, alimwi wakaba mupati.

Mbubonya mbundakali kuyeeya aatala acheechi, ndakabona mupule wampongo kazwa kumbo, ooyo wakatimbula aatala lya nyika yoonse, kachijaana chakufwambaana, kaboneka katalyati aanyika. Impongo yakali aalwija lupati aakati kamenso aayo.
Yakasika kumugutu wakali aameja obile - ndakabona mugutu kayimvwi aankomwe yalwizi - alimwi mpongo yakachijaanini mugutu mubukali bwanguzu.

Ndakabona mpongo kayisika afwiifwi a mugutu. Yakanyemena mugutu, mpawo yakadinka mugutu akutyola meja aawo obile. Mugutu wakabula nguzu zyakwiimikila kunembo lyampongo. Mpongo yakamuwisizya aansi akumulyatuuka. Takukwe naba umwi wakakonzya kuvuna mugutu kuzwa kunguzu zyakwe.
Eelyo mpongo yakaba mpati loko. Pesi niyakasima, lwija lupati lwakatyoka, alimwi mubusena bwalo kwakamena meja aane mapati aakatondeka myuuwo yone yamajulu.
Kuzwa kuli lumwi wawo kwakakomena lumwi lwija, kaluli luniini kumatangunino pesi lwakazookula changuzu ku musanza, kujwe, alimwi a ku nyika mbotu.
Lwakakomena chakulinjizya munkondo a mpi yakujulu. Bamwi be mpi eeyo azimwi nyenyeezi zyakawaalilwa aansi munyika, mpawo yakazilyatuuka.
Yakalichita kuba mupati mbuli silutwe wa mpi. Yakabweza kuzwa kulinguwe chipayizyo chakutenta chamazuba woonse, abusena bwawo bwabusalali bwakasofwaazigwa.
Akaambo kabupapi, impi iyoopedekezegwa kulwija lwa mpongo, alimwi chipayizyo chakutenta chiyooyimikizigwa. Lwija luyoosowela ansi lusinizyo, mpawo luyoozwidilila muli nzyiichita.

Mpawo ndakamvwa musalali kambuula alimwi umwi uusalala kamusandula kati, ''Eezi zintu ziyoobawo kwachiindi chilamfu biyeni, chilengano eechi aatala a chipayizyo chakutenta, chibi cheeta lunyonyooko, kupedekezegwa kwabusena busalala, akulyatilwa kwa mpi ya kujulu?''
Wakati  kulindime, ''Ziyoobawo kwamagolezya azifumo zili 2,300. Musule lyaawo busena busalala buyoobukuluka.''
Mebo, nde Daniyele, nindakabona chilengano, ndakeezya kuchimvwisisisya. Eelyo kunembo lyangu kwakayimikila wakali kulangika aanga muntu.
Ndakamvwa ijwi lyamuntu kalyiita aakati ka nkomwe zya Ulayi Kkanalu. Wakaamba kuti, ''Gabbuliyelu, gwasya muntu kumvwisisisya chilengano.''

Aboobo wakaswena afwiifwi nkundakayimvwi. Eelyo naakasika ndakayoosegelwa kapati, ndakavundama. Pesi wakati kulindime, ''Mvwisisisya, mwana mulombe wa muntu, kuti chilengano nchamamanino aa chiindi.''
Naakambuula kulindime, ndakawida mung'onzi kandivundeme. Mpawo wakandiguma akundibusya.
Wakati, ''Bona, ndiyookuzibya eecho chiyoochitika kumamanino muchiindi chabukali nkaambo chilengano chili cha chiindi chisalidwe chakumamanino.
Kwamugutu nguwabona, ooyo wakajisi meja obile - mbaami ba Midiya a Peziya.
Mupule wampongo mwami wa Gilisi. Lwija lupati aakati kamenso aakwe mwami mutaanzi.
Lwija lwakatyolwa, mubusena oomo mwakazoobuka amwi aane - mami one ayoobuka kuzwa kuchisi chakwe, pesi peepe anguzu zyakwe.
Kuchiindi chitobela cha mami aayo,  aawo basikubisya nibayoogolelwa, mwami mukali, uusongokede, uyoobuka.
Nguzu zyakwe zinoli mpati - pesi peepe anguzu zyakwe. Unoyoogambya muli zeezyo nzyayoonyonyoona; uyoochita akuzwidilila. Uyoonyonyoona bantu bapati aakati kabasalala.
Abuchenjezu bwakwe uyoozwidilizya lweeno. Uyooba mupati mumizeezo yakwe mwini. Uyoonynyoona bantu biingi kabalyiibide. Uyoobukila Mwami wa bami, alimwi uyoonyonyoonwa, pesi peepe aluboko lwa muntu.
Chilengano chaatala a magolezya azifumo eecho nchiwakaambilwa nchanchoonzyo. Pesi jala chilengano nkaambo nchamazuba miingi aatobela.''
Mpawo mebo, Daniyele, ndakazundwa akulala chakumana nguzu mazuba miingi. Mpawo ndakabuka ndayinka ku mulimu wa mwami. Pesindakagambisigwa a chilengano alimwi takwe wakachimvwisisisya pe.
Mumwaaka mutaanzi waDaniyele mwana mulombe waAhasuyelasi - wazyalani lya Medi, wakachitwa mwaami atala abwami bwaba Kkaludi -

mumwaaka mutaanzi wabweendelezi bwaDaliyasi. imebo ndiDaniyele, ndakali kudunamina mabbuku aajisi ijwi lyaJehova, ijwi eelyo lyakazwa kuli Jelemiya musinsimi. Ndakabona kuti kuyooba minyaka ilimakkumi musamu aabili kusikila kunyonyoonwa kwaJelusalema kukamane.
Ndakachengunusya busyu bwangu kumwaami Leza kukumuyandawula ankombyo azikumbizyo zyakuliombya, akulyiima, akusama zisamo zyamasaka, akukkala mudyota.

Ndakakomba kuliJehova Leza wangu, akulyaamba zibi zyesu. Ndakaamba kuti, ''Ndakukumbila, Mwaami - nduwe mupati alimwi nduwe Leza uugambya - nduwe uumwi uubamba chuzuminano alimwi ulasyomeka kuli aabo bakuyanda akubamba milawo yabo.
Twakabisya akuchita chitaluleme. Twakachita bubi akupapa, twaleya kuzwa kumilayizyo yakoambeta zyako.
Teetwakaswilila balanda bako basinsimi bakaambula muzina lyako kubaami besu, bazululi besu, basikale besu, akubantu boonse banyika.

Kulinduwe, Mwaami, kuli bululami. Kulindiswe biyo kuli mawuse kumasyu eesu - nkaambo bantu baJuda abaabo bakkala muJelusalema, aku Isilayili yoonse. Eechi chibikkilizya aabo bali aafwiifwi abaabo bali kule munyika  zyoonse ooko nkwaakasanguna. Eechi nkaambo kumilimo yabusyomesi eeyo njitwakachita aatala anduwe.
Kulindiswe, Jehova, kuli mawusekumasyu eesu - kubaami besu, kubazululi besu, akulibasikale besu - nkaambo twakabisya aatala anduwe.
KuMwaami Leza wesu kuli luzyalo alulekelelo nkaambo twakamupapila.
Tetwakaswilila ijwi lyaJehova Leza wesu mukwiinda mumilawu yakwe njakatupa mukwiinda mubalanda bakwe basinsimi.

BaIsilayeli boonse basotoka milawo yako akuchengunukila kumbali, kukaka kuswiilila ijwi lyako. Lutuko achikonk e eezyo zilembedwe mumulawu waMozesi, mulawu waLeza, zyakatilwa kulindiswe, nkaambo twamubisizya.

Jehova wazuzikizya majwi aakwe aayo aatala andiswe aatala abeendelezi besu bali atala abendelezi besu bali atala lyesu akutuletela mapenzi aayosya. Nkambo kunsi kwajulu lyoonse takukwe nitwakachitide chimwi chintu eecho chinga chilakozyanisigwa acheecho chakachitika kuJelusalema.
Mbuli mbukulembedwe mumulawo waMozesi, mapenzi woonse aaya aza kulindiswe akuchenguluka kuzwa kuzibi zyesu akuswilizya kuzya kukasimpe kako.
Nkinkaako Jehova wakatubambila mapenzi kuli ndiswe, nkaambo Jehova Leza wesu ulasalala munchito zyoonse nzyancita, nekuba teetwakaswilizya ijwi lyakwe.
Lino, Mwami Leza wesu, wakagwisya bantu bako kuzwa kunyika yaIjipiti ajaanza lilaanguzu, akulichitila impuwo yazina lyako mbuli mubuzuba oobino. Pesi bobo twakabisya; twakachita zintu zyabubi.

Mwami, nkaambo kamilimo yako yoonse iiluleme, leka lunyemo abukkali bwako buzwe kuzwa kummunzo wako wakuJerusaleu, chilundu chako chisalala. Nkaambo kazibi zyesu, akaambo kamilandu yabasikale besu, Jelusalema abantu bako chaba chintu chabuyo chakuniyaka kuli aabo batuzyungulukide.
Lino, Leza wesu, swilila kuchikombyo chamulanda azikumbizyo zyakwe zyakulibombya; nkaambo kaako, Mwaami, chita busyu bwako bumweke aabusena busalala bwako oobo busiyide.

Leza wangu, chenjeka matwi aako akuswilila; jula meso aako mpawo ubone. Twakanyonyoonwa; langa kumuunzi ooyo wiitwa aazina lyako. Tatuleti nkumbizyo zyesu zibombede kuli nduwe nkaambo kabululami bwes, pesi nkaambo kaluzyalo lwako lupati.
Mwaami, swiilila! Mwaami kolekelela! swiilila akubweza ntamo. Nkaambo kaako, utachedwi, Leza wangu, nkaambo muunzi wako abantu bakobayitwa azina lyako.''
Kandili mukwaambula - kukomba akulyaamba chibi changu achibi chabantu bangu baIsilayeli, akuleta zikumbizyo zyakulibombya kunembo lyaJehova Leza wangumuchiimo chachilundu -
kandiliakukomba, Mwaalumi Gabbuliyeli, ooyo ngundaka bona muchilengano kusanguna wakuulukila aansi kulindime muluno, kuchiindi chachipayizyo chagolezya.
Wandipa kumvwisisisya akwaamba kuti kuli ndime, ''Daniyele, lino ndaza kuzokupa kubonesya akumvwisisisya.
Nwaakatalika kuleta nkumbizyo zyenu zyakulibombya, malayilile aakapegwa alimwi ndaza kuzokwambila nsandulo, nkaambo ulimuyandisi . Nkinkaako swiilila ijwi lyangu eeli akumvwisisisya chilengano.

Makumi alimusanu aabili amvikiakabikilwa bantu bako akumuunzi wakouusalala kukumanina milandu akubika kumana kuchibi, kuyanzanisigwa kububi, kuleta bululami butamani, kukweendelezya chilengano achisinsimi, busalazigwe busena busalalisya .

Kuzibya akumvwisya ooko kuzwa kukubikwa kwamulayizyo wakubukulusya akuyakululwa kwaJelusalema kukuboola kwawunanikidwe ( uyooba muzulwidi), kuyooba musanu atubili musanu atubilialimwi amakumi musanu alimwi atubili twamusanu atubili. Jelusalema iyooyakululwa amigwagwa alukomba, nikuba kuti zyiindi zyamapenzi.

Nikwakayinda mviki zilimakumi musanu alimwi azibili, umwi uunanikidwe uyoonyonyonwa akubula chintu. Impi yamweendelezi uboola iyoonyonyoona muunzi abusena busalala. Mamanina aayo aazambangulwe, alimwi kuyooba nkondo mane kusikila kumamanino. Buusu bwakabikwa.

Uyosimya chizuminano abiingi mumviiki yomwe. Mukati kamviki uyobika mamanino kuchipayizyo akuchituzyo. Aatala aabbaba lyazisesemyo kuyooz umwi uyoochita buusu. Kunyonyoonwa kukamane eecho chakaambwa chatiligwa aatala awumwi ooyo wakachita buusu.

mumwaka watatu wabwami bwa bwaSIyilasi mwami Pesiya , makani akuyununidwa Daniyeli ,ngonguwe wakapegwa izina lya Bbelitisyaza . Aaya makani aakusinizya. Akali aankondo impati . Daniyeli wakamvwisya makani nakalangisya kuzwa kuchilengano .
Mumazuba aaya mebo, nde Diniyeli, ndakali kulila nsondo zyotatwe.
Teendakali kulya zilyo zinono pe, teendakalya nyama, teendanywa wayini, alimwi nsikwe nendakalinanika amafuta mane insondo zyotatwe zyakamaninina.
Mubuzuba bwamakumi obile aane bwamwezi mutaanzi, nendakayinwa kumbali amulonga mupati [nkokuti, Tigilisi ]
Ndakatambya meso angu alimwi ndakabona mwaalumi usamide masani aatentema, uwangide kuchikungu lukumba lwa goludi ya Ufazi.

Mubili wakwe ulimbuli topazi, abusyu bwakwe kabuli mbuli lulabi. Meso aakwe kakozyania achimwinisyo, alimwi maboko aakwe amawulu aakwe kanjenjema mbuli mukuba uusyobwedwe. Ijwi lyamwambo wakwe kalili mbuli ijwi lyamakamu mapati.
Mebo, endikke nde-Daniyeli, ndime ndakabona chilengano, nkaambo mbendakali aabo tebakabona chilengano. Nekuba boobo, bakasikilwa kukankama kupati, alimwi bakachija kuyooyuba.
Aboobo ndakachaala andikke alimwi ndakabona chilengano chipati. Katakwe nguzu zyakasyaala mulindime; Busyu bwangu bwakabalangala bwakasanduka chakuyoosya, anguzu zyangu zyakandimanina.
Mpawo ndakamvwa majwi aakwe-alimwi ndimvwe biyo, ndakafwida mung'onzi chakuvundana ansi.
Ijanza lyakandiguma, alimwi chakandipa kukankama mumazwi aangu amaanza amaboko angu.

Angelo wakandambila kuti '' Daniyele, muntu uuyandwa loko, swiilila majwi ngendi mukukwambila. Imikila kabotu, nkaambo ndatumwa kulinduwe.'' Nakamana kwaamba majwi aaya kulindime, ndakayimikila chakukankama.

12Mpawo wakandaambila kuti,'' utayoowi,Daniyele. Kuzwa mubuzuba butaanzi nowakabikka moyo wakokukumvwisya makani akulibombya kubusyu bwa Leza wako, majwi aako akali kumvwigwa,alimwi ndasika nkaambo kamajwi aako.
Mwaami wachisi cha Peziya wakasiyande kundikasya, alimwi ndakakabambwa nkuko abaami ba Peziya mazuba aali makumi obile abuzuba bumwi. Pesi Mikkayeli umwi mwaami mupati, wakaza kuzondigwasya.
Lino ndaza kuzokugwasya kumvwisya makani aayo achitwa kubantu bako kubuzuba bwakumamanino.  Nkaambo chilengano nchamazuba atanasika pe.''
Nakachili kundaambila kabelesya majwi aaya,  ndakawida aansi chakuvundama akuba syataambi.

Umwi wakali mbuli bana balombe babantu wakkampa milomo yangu mpawo ndakabbanuna mulomo wangu akwambula kuli nguwe wakayimvwi kumpela kwangu: ''Mwami wangu, ndajatwa machise nkaambo kachilengano; Anguzu zyangu zyandimanina.
Me ndilimulanda wako. Ndambule buti ayebo Mwami wangu? Nkaambo nsichikwe nguzu, akuyooya kwandikachila.''
Alubo umwi uuli mbuli muntu wakandaampa akundisimya.
Wakaamba kuti, ''Utayoowi, muntu uyandwa loko. Luumuno lube kulinduwe! Lino koyuma, koyuma!'' Amane kundimbila, ndakaba anguzu. Ndakati, ''Mbubo Mwami wangu aambe, nkaambo wandipa nguzu.''
Wakaamba kuti, ''Sena ulizi nchendzida kuli nduwe? Ndabweeda kuyoolwisya Mwami wa-Peziya. Ndazwa buyo, mwami waba-Gilisi uyoosika.
Pesi njookulwiida chilembedwe mubbuku lyalusinizyo. Taakwe naba oomwe ulitondeezya kusima kukulwisya aaba, kunze kwa-Mikkayeli mwami wanu.''
Mumwaaka mutaanzi waDaliyasi muMedi, ime lwangu ndakasika kukumuyumya akumugwasya Mikkayeli.

Lino ndiyokwaambila nchoonzyo. Baami batatu batobuka ku Peziya, nkabela wane unooli muvubi kwiinda bamwi boonse. Nanoozoojisi nguzu kwiinda mubuvubi bwakwe, uyoobusya boonse aatala aabwaami bwa Gilisi.
Mwaami singuzu uyoobuka uyoyendelezya bwaami bupati, alimwi uyochitwa kufumbwa nzyayandisya.

Nayobuka, bwaami bwakwe buyoomwayika akupalangana kumyuuwo yone yakujulu, pesi peepe kulunyungu lwakwe mwini, alimwi peepe amanguzu ngaakajisi naakali kweendelezya. Nkaambo bwaami bwakwe buyoononkolwa alimwi akupegwa bamwi batali balunyungu lwakwe pe.
Mwaami wakuMusaanza uyoba aanguzu, pesi umwi wabasilutwe uyooba singuzu kwiinda nguwe akuyooba aabwendelezi bupati.

Kwiinda kwamyaaka miche, chiindi nichiyozulila, bayochita chizuminano. Mwana musimbi wamwaami wakuMusanza uyoosika kumwaami wakuNyika kuyoosimya chizuminano. Pesi taakwe kuyojatilila kunguzu zyaluboko lwakwe, nekuba kuyooyima, naa luboko lwakwe. Uyochijigwa - we abaabo bamutelela, awisi, ayooyo wakamugwasya kuchiindi eecho.
Pesi mutabi uuzwa kumiyanda yakwe uyyoobukamubusena bwakwe. Uyolwisya impi akunjila chilyido chamwaami wakuNyika. Uyoolwisya impi, alimwi alimwi uyoobazunda.
Uyootolelela baleza babo, , aantomwe azikonzyano zyabo zyakafulwa azibelesyo zyabo ziyandisi zyasiliva angolide akuzitola kuIjipiti. Nkambo imwi myaaka uyoososoloka kuzwa kumwaami wakuNyika.
Eelyo mwaami wakunyika uyoonjila mubwaami bwamwaami wakuMusanza, pesi uyoobweda kunyika yakwe.
Bana bakwe balombe bayoolibambila akubungika impi mpati. Bayoboola alimwi bayookukulula zyoonse; chiyoyinda munzila yoonse akusikila kuchilyido chakwe.
Mpawo mwaami wakuMusaanza uyoonyema loko, uyoo; Uyoyinka akulwana aatala aanguwe, mwaami wakuNyika. Mwaami wakuNyika uyoobusya impi mpati, pesi mpi iyopegwa mujaanza lwakwe.
Mpi iyoogwisigwa alimwi moyo wamwaami wakuMusanza uyoosumpulwa, mpawo uyoocita makumi azyuulu kukuwa, pesi taakwe kuyooba muzundi pe.
Eelyo mwaami wakuNyika uyoobusya ayimwi mpi, mpati kwiinda ntaanzi. Kwiinda kwamyaaka ayimwi, mwaami wakuNyika chonzyo uyoboola ampi mpati kiipedwe zibelesyo ziingi.
Muzyiindi eezyo bayingi bayobukila mwaami wakuMusaanza. Bana balombe babukali akaati kabantu bako bayolibamba mukuzuzikizya  chilengano, pesi bayoosedemuka.

Mwaami wakunyika uyoobola, kutilila kunze nyika nkaambo kachitantala chakulya, akuzunda muunzi uyakilidwe kabotu. Basilumamba bakuMusanza tabakoyooyiminina nekuba basale babasilumamba babo. Tabakoyooba anguzu zyakwiiminana.
Pesi, ooyo uboola uyochita kuyanda kwakwe aatala anguwe;  takwe pe uyoyima munzila yakwe. Uyooyima muBubotu bwaNyika, alimwi lunyonyoko luyooba mujaanza lyakwe.

Mwaami wakuNyika uyolanzya busyu bakwe kukuboola anguzu zyabwaami bwakwe boonse, alimwi anguwe kuyooba chizuminano eecho nchayichita amwaami wakuMusanza. Uyomupa mwana musimbi wakuba mwanakazi mulukwatano kukupalazya bwaami bwamwaami wakuMusanza. Pesi mabambe taakwe kuyozwidilila pe na kumugwasya.
Kwiinda kwacheechi, mwaamiwaku Nyika uyolanzya busyu bwakwe kunyika zyakunkomwe yalwizi alimwi zyiingi zyazy uyozijata. Pesi silutwe uyoochita lusampawuko lwakwe kubweedela kulinguwe.
Eelyo uyolanzya kuzilwanino zyanyika yakwe, pesiuyoosendemuka akuwa; takwe kuyojanwa pe.
Mpawo umwi uyobuka mubusena bwakwe oyo uyochita simutelo kwiinda aakati nkaambo kazisaalo zyamwaami. Pesi mubuzuba butobela uyoonyonyonwa, pesi peepe mubukali na munkondo.
Mubusena bwakwe kuyoobuka muntu usampawidwe kuli nguwe bantu nkubatakwe kuyoopa lulemeko lwanguzu zyabwaami,uyoosika chakutazibikana alimwi uyobweza bwami achakujata kumenso.
Mpi iyookukululwa mbulizambangulwe kunembo lyakwe. Boonse bempi eeyo amuzulwidi wabo  chizuminano bayobelesegwa.
Kuzwa kuchiindi nikwakachitwa chizuminano angwe, uyoochita chalweno; amweelwe muche buyo wabantu uyojata nguzu.

Nkakutakwe luchenjezyo pe uyonjila muchipanzi chachisi chilabuvubi loko, alimwi uyochita eecho chakachitwa nekuba wisi na wisi wawisi. Uyootakanya aakati kabatobeli bakwe mbono, zisaalo abuvubi. Uyobamba miyyeyo yakuwisya zilwiida, pesi kwakayindi biyo.

Uyobusya nguzu zyakwe amoyo wakwe aatala amwaami kwaku Musanza ampi mpati. Mwaami waku Musanza uyolwa nkondo mpati loko ampi njumu kampatila, pesi takwe uyooyima nkaambo bamwi bayochita makanze aatala anguwe.
Abalabo abo balya chakulya chakwe chinono bayoyezya kumunyonyona. Mpi yakwe iyokukululwa mbulizambangulwe, alimwi balingi babo bayoowa kabajayide.

Boonse baami aaba, amyoyo yabo iyobikwa aabubi umwi awumwi                                        ,bayokkala kutebuli limwi akubejelana kulumwi awumwi, pesi ziyobula mulimo. Nkaambo mamanino ayoobola kuchiindi eecho chibikidwe.
Eelyo Mwami wakuNyika uyobweeda munyikwa yakwe abuvubi bupati, amoyo wakwe uyosula chizuminano chisalala. Uyoochita alimwi eelyo uyoobweda kunyika yakwe mwini.
kuchiindi chiibikidwe uyoobweda akusikila nyika yaku Musanza lubo. Pesi chiindi echoni tachikwe kuyoba mbuli lutanzi pe.

Nkaambo maato aakkitimuayoobola kumulwisya, alimwi uyoowa. Uyobweeda akuba aalunyemo ataala achizuminano chisalala,mpawo uyootola ntaamo. Uyobweeda akutondezya lusalulo kuli baabo basiya chizuminano chisalala.
Basilumamba bakwe bayoobuka akusofwaazya zilwiido busena busalala. Bayoogwisya chipayizyo chakuumpa chalyoonse, alimwi bayoyimika chiisesemyo eecho chipa kuusa .
Kwaababo bakachita bubi aatala achizuminano, uyobeena akubawunyina.Pesi bantu aabo bazi Leza wabo bayooyuma akutola taamo.
Aabo bachenjezya aakati kabantua bayoozibya bayingi kumvwisya. Pesi bayosedemuka apanga amulilo  mubuzike akubbindwa kwamazuba.
Mukusedemuka kwabo, alugwasyo luche. Mukuupawupa bayingi bayoliswania ambabo.
Bamwi babaabo bachenjezu bayosedemuka kuti kusalazigwa kukachitike kulimbabo, akubotesegwa, akutubisigwa, mane chiindi chakumamanino. Kwachiindi chibambindwe chichibola.

Mwaami uyochita mbuli kuyanda kwakwe. Uyoolisumpula akulichita mupati aatala lyabaleza boonse. Aatala lyaLeza wabo, Leza uyowamba zintu zigambya nkaambo uyoozwidilila mane bukkali bukamane. Nkaambo chakakosolwa.
Takoyoobika moyo nkaambo kabaleza bawisi, naba leza uyandwa abanakazi nikuba kuyobika moyo kuli leza uuli woonse, pesi uloolisumpula kwiinda boonse.
Uyolemeka leza wazilwido muchiindi chabaaba. Nguleza ooyo bamawisi ngubakataziba kuti uyoomulemeka angolige asiliva, amabwe mayandisi azimwi zinti ziyandisi.
Uyoolwanisya zilwwido ziyumu loko alugwasyo lwaleza mweenzu. Kuli woonse uumuziba, uyoomupa lulemeko lupati. Uyoobachita beendelezi aatala lyabantu biingi, alimwi uyowabaniya nyika mbuli lukono.
Kuchiindi chakumamanino, mwaami wakuMusanza uyoolwisya. Mwaami wakuNyka uyoobola mbuli kambizi ankalati abasimabbiza alimwi amato miingi. Uyoobulkila nyika, kubakukulula, akwiinda mukati.
Uyoonjlia munyika mbotu, alimwi makumi aazyuulu zyaba Isilayeli bayoowa. Idomu, Mayabbu, abachicheede babantu baba Amoni.

Uyootandabika jaanza lyakwe munyika, nyika yaIjipiti tikoyoovunwa. Uyoyendelezya aatala lwaziyobwedo zyangolida azyasiliva, alimwi azyoonse zintu ziyandisi zya Ijipiti; baLibbiya abaKkusyi bayomutobela.
Pele impuwo kuzwa Kujwe akuNyika iyoomuyoosya, alimwi uyoozwa abukkali bupati kuyonyonyoona chakumaninizya akupambwiida baangi lunyonyoono.
Uyooyaka tente lyabukkalo bwabwaami  bwakwe akatikati kalwizi aachilundu chabubotu bwabusalali. Uyosika kumamanino aakwe, alimwi takukwe kuyooba wakumugwasya.

''Kuchiindi eecho Mikkayeli silutwe, silutwe mwana mulombe mupati wamwaami ullind bantu bako, uyoobuka. Kuyooba chindi chamapenzi aakataliwo  kuzwa kumatalikilo aazisi kusikila kuchiindi eecho, bantu bako bayofutulwa, boonse balamazina ayoojanika kaalembedwe mubbuku.
Biingi babo balede mulusuko lwanyika, bamwi kubuumi butamani abamwi kukusa nsoni akuba chisesemyo chitamani.
Abo balaluzibo bayobekema mbuli kubalama kwajulu lilaatala, abaabo basandula bayingi mubululami bayoba mbuli nyenyezi kwalyoonse alyoonse.
Pele webe Daniyele jala majwi aaya; bamba bbuku kalijalidwe kusikila chiindi chamamanino. Bayingi bayoochijaana aawa awalya, aluzibo luyooyindilila.
Eelyo mebo, ndiDaniyele, ndakalanga , mpawo kwakali bamwi bobile bakalimvwi kunkomwe yakokuno lyamulonga.
Umwi wabo wakaamba kuti kumwaalumi wakazweete zisamo zinjenjema, wakayimvwi kumbali aamulonga, ''Kuyooba chiindi chilamfu biyeni kuti zigambyo eezi zikamane?''

Ndakamvwa mwaalumi wakasamide zisamo zinjenjema, ooyowakali kumbali aatala aamulonga - wakatambika luboko lwakwe lwalulyo alyalumweensi kujulu, akukonkezya kuli yooyo uupona lyoonse kuti nga kuyoba kwachiindi azyiindi, achisela chachiindi. nibatamane kumweya nguzu zyabantu basalali, zintu zyoonse eezi eezi ziyoomaninina.
Ndakamvwa, pesi teendakamvwisisisya pe. Aboobo ndakabuzya, ''Simalelowangu, niinzi chiyoozwa kuzintu zyoonse ezi?''
Wakaamba kuti, ''Koya anzila yako. Daniele, nkaambo majwi ajalwa aakumatalikilo kusikila kuchiindi chamamanino.
Bayingi bayosalazigwa, akusanzigwa, pesi babi bayochita chabubi . Taakwe wabasizibi uyoomvwisisisya pesi aabo balaaluzibo bayoomvwisisisya.
Kuzwa kuchiindi eecho chakuumpa chipayizyo chalyoonse nichigwisigwa achisesemyo eecho cheetelezya lunyonyono chabikwa, kuyooba mazuba aali 1290.
Ngfgusichoolwe ooyo uulindila kusikila mamanino aamazuba aali 1335. Weede kweenda munzila yako do kumamanino, mpawo uyoolyokezya. Uyoobukilwa kubusena mbubambilidwe kumazuba aamamanino.

Aaya ngimajwi ngaakamba Mozesi kuba Izilayeli boonse kusule lya Jodani munkanda, muntandabale yamusena wamulonga Jodani kazilangene a Safu, akkati ka Palani, Tofelu, Labbani, Hazeloti, antomwe a Dizahabbu.
Ndwendo lwendwa mazuba alikkumi abumwi kuzwa ku Holebbu anzila yaku Chilundu Seyili koya ku Kkadeshi Bbaniya.
Zyakachitika mumunyaka wachine, mumwezi wakkumi awumwi, mubuzuba butanzi bwamwezi, kuti Mozesi wakambula kubantu ba Izilayeli, kalikubabuzya ezyo Jehova nzyakamulayilila atala ambabo.
Ezi zyakachitika musule akuti Jehova wakali walwana Sihoni mwami waba Amolayiti, wakali kukkala mu Heshibboni, antomwe a Ogi mwami wa Bbashani, oyo wakali kukkala mu Aahitaloti ku Edileyi.
Musule lya Jodani, munyika ya Mowabbu, Mozesi wakatalika kwambilizya malayilile aya, kati,
Jehova Leza wesu wakaambula kuli ndiswe ku Holebbu, kawambobu, 'Wakapona kwachindi chilamfu kwakkwana munyika yazilundu.

Bweda alimwi ubweze lwendo lwako, alimwi uyinke kunyika yazilundu yaku Amolayiti akumanyika woonse alafwifwi ankuko munkwalale yamusena wamulonga Jodani, munyika yachilundu, mumisena ilansi, mu Negevi, alimwi akumbali lyalwizi-nyika yaba Kkenanayiti, amu Lebbanoni kule mbuli kulwizi lupati, oyo Ufuleti.

Langa, ndakabamba nyika kunembo lyako; koya mukati ukivube nyika eyo Jehova njakakonkezya kuli bamawuso- kuli Abbulahamu, kuli Ayizeki, akuli Jakobo-kuti uyobapa lwabo antomwe akulunyungu luyotobela musule lyabo.'
Ndakambula kuli nduwe kuchindi echiya, ndakati, 'Imebo tandikonzyi pe kumubweza lwangu endike.
Jehova Leza wenu wamuvuzya nywebo, alimwi, langa, nywebo sunu mwavula mbuli nyenyezi zyamujulu.
Akube kuti Jehova, Leza wabamawuso,, amuchite kuti mube zyuulu zyindulwidwe twingi mbuli mbomubede, alimwi amulongezye, mbuli mbwaka musyomezya lwanu!
Pesi mbubuli mbwenga endike ndabweza mikuli yenu, makatazyo enu, alimwi ankazyanio zyenu?
Bweza balumi basongo, bamvwisisisya, alimwi balumi balampuwo imbotu kulumwi awumwi mukowa, alimwi ndiyobachita kuti bakabe bendelezi benu.'
Mwakandisandula akwamba kuti, 'Echo chintu nchiwambula nchibotu kuli ndiswe kuti tuchichite.'

Abobo ndakabweza bendelezi bamikowa yenu, balumi basongo, antomwe abalumi balempuwo mbotu, alimwi akubabikka bendelezi banu, basilutwe bazyuulu, basilutwe bamyaanda, basilutwe bamakkumi musanu, basilutwe bakkumi, antomwe abasizyuuno, mukowa amukowa.
Ndakalayilila babetesi benu kuchiindi echo, ndakati, 'Amutelele kukazyania kuli akkati kabakkulana banu, alimwi mubabeteke chakululamika akkati kawumwi amukkulana wakwe, alimwi akumuzwakule wakwe.

Utakatondezyi lubazu kulumwi mukukazyania, uyomvwa zinini alimwi azikolondo bukozyenie. Tokoyoyoowa pe niwayobona busyu bwamuntu, nkambo kubeteka nkukwa Leza. Lukazyanio itakakuyumine loko webo, uyolweta kuli ndime, alimwi ndiyolutelela.'
Ndakakulayilila lwako kuchindi echiya zyoonse zintu nzyoyelede kuchita.

Twakeenda kuzwa ku Holebbu alimwi katwiinda zyoonse zipati aziyumu munkanda ezyo nziwakabona, nitwakali munzila katuya kunyika yakalundu kama Amoli, mbuli Jehova Leza wesu mbwakatulayilila, alimwi twakasika kuKkadeshi Bbaniya.
Ndakamwambila kuti, 'Mwasika kunyika yachilundu yaku Amolayiti, eyo Jehova Leza wenu njalikupa kulindiswe.
Langa, Jehova Leza wabikka nyika kunembo lyenu; kamuya, mukivune, mbuli Jehova, Leza wabamawuso, mbwawamba kuli ndinywe; mutakayowi,  nikuba kutyompwa.'

Umwi awumwi wenu wakaza kuli ndime akwamba kuti, ''Ngatutume balumi kunembo lyesu, kuchitila kuti bakatuyandwide nyika, alimwi bakatwetele ijwi atala enzila njituyo balwana anjiiyo, alimwi atala azisi ezyo nkotuyosika.'
Machenjezyo akandibotela mebo; Mebo ndakabweza balumi kkumi ababili kulindinywe, umwi mwalumi kuzwa kumikowa yoonse.
Bakabweeda alimwi bakatanta munyika yakalundu, bakakusika mumusena waku Esikkolu, alimwi bakakazyunguluka.
Bakabweza bumwi butebuzi bwanyika mumaanza abo akubweeta aansi kuli ndiswe. Alimwi bakatweetela ijwi alimwi bakati, 'Ninyika mbotu eyo Jehova Leza wesu njali kutupa.'
Inywebo mwaka kaka kuyobalwana, pesi mwakapapila mukuswilila milawu ya Jehova, Leza wenu.
Mwakatongawuka mumatente enu alimwi mwakati, Nkambo kakuti Jehova wakatusulayika nchakatugusya anze munyika ya Ijiputi, akutubika mukati kamanza aba Amoli kuti batujaye.

Tulaya kuli yino? Bakkulana besu bachalumi bakachita myoyo yesu kuti iyaaye, kabali kuti, Áboobo bantu mbapati alimwi mbalamfu kwinda mbotubede; madolopo aabo mapati alimwi aliyakilidwe kuyosika kujulu; mukuyungizya, twababona bana balombe baba Anakkimu nkuko.''
'Mpawo ndakati kuli nduwe, 'Tamunoonga mulakankama, nikuba kuyoowa mbabo.
Jehova Leza wenu, oyo umuzulwida kunembo lyenu, uyomulwanina, mbuli zyoonse nzyakamuchitila mu Ijiputi kunembo lyamenso enu,
alimwi amunkanda, oko nkomwakabona  Leza wenu mbwakamubweza, mbuli muntu mbwabweza mwana wakwe, kufumbwa nkumwakaya lumwi mwazosika kubusena obuno.'
Inywebo nikuba ajwi eli takwepe nimwakamusyoma Jehova, Leza wako,
oyo wakayinka kunembo lyako munzila kukuyokulangwida busena bwakuti ukachite misasa, amulilo mansiku alimwi amujoba abuzuba.
Jehova wakamvwa muzumo wamajwi aako alimwi wakanyema; wakakonka alimwi wakati,
'Ninchobeni takwe umwi wabalumi aaba bazyalane aazibi bayokona nyika mbotu njaka konkezya kuyopa basikale,
kunze kwa Kkalebbu mwana mulombe wa Jefuni. Uyoyibona alimwi ndiyomupa antomwe alunyungu lwakwe eyonyika njakalyata alinjiyo, nkambo wakatobela Jehova chakumaninina.'
Alakwe Jehova wakali nyemede nkambo kenu, kawamba kuti, 'Ayebo tokoyoyinka pe kukuyonjila mukati;
Joshuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni, uyimikila kunembo lyako, uyoyinka akanjile mukati; musungwazye  lwakwe, nkambo uyozulwida ba Izilayeli kuti bakikone.
Ajulu azezyo, bana benu banini, abo mbimwakati bayolwisigwa, abo lyasunu batakwe luzibo azibotu azibi-bayoyinka mukati omiya. Kulimbabo ndiyobapa, alimwi bayoyivuba.
Pesi kulindinywe, amunyone mubweze lwendo lwanu lwamunkanda kamutobezya nzila yaku Lwizi Lwamatete.'

Mpawo mwakandisandula alimwi mwakandambila kuti, 'TwakamubisizyaJehova; tuyoyinkaalimwi tukalwane, alimwi tuyotobelezya zyoonse ezyo Jehova Leza nzyalayilila kuli ndiswe kuti tuzichite.' Wonse mwalumi akkati kenu alibwezele chilwanisyo chakwe chakunkondo, alimwi mwakali libambilide kukuyolwisya nyika eyo.
Jehova wakati kulindime, 'Bambile kuti, ''Mutakabasokoli alimwi mutakalwani, nkambo nsikoyoba andinywe pe, alimwi muyozundwa abasinkondo nyokwe.'
Ndakambula anduwe munzila eeyi, pesi tewakandiswilila pe alimwi mwakalwisya kunyika yakalundu.
Pesi ba Amoli bakali bakkala munyika yakalundu aako, alimwi bakakumina aansi mu Seyili, mbuli kule mbuli ku Hooma.
Mwakabweda alimwi mwakakwila kunembo lya Jehova; pesi Jehova takwe nakamuswilila kukukwila kwenu pe, naa akumulanga biyo.
Aboobo mwakakkala mu Kkadesi mazuba mingi, woonse mazuba ngimwakakkala nkuko.
Eelyo bakanyona balanga lweendo lwabo munkanda anzila iiya kulwizi lusalala, mbuli Jehova mbakabambula kuli ndime; bakenda mu Edomu kwamazuba miingi.
Jehova wakambula kuli ndime, wakati,
'Mwakkala kwachiindi chilamfu muchilundu amunyone musule mutozye kulubazu lwakunyika.
Ubazibye bantu, kuti, ''balaafwifwi kunjila munyika yabakwanu, balunyungu lwa Isawu, ooyo ukkala mu Edomu; bayomuyoowa. Amuchenjele

mutakalwani anguwe, eelyo tandikonzyi kuyomupa kampanzi kanyika yabo nikacheya bauti, peepe, nikuba nizicheya mutakasotoki mukati amawulu eenu; ee ndakapa nyika eeyi kuli Isawu kuti ibe yakwe iimugeme.
Naa bamupa chakulya muule amali, kuchitila kuti mulye , eelyo mweelede kuula amanzi kulimbabo amali yenu kuchitila kuti munywe.

Mbuli Jehova Leza Mwaami wenu mbwakalongezya milimu yoonse yakuboko; Ulizi kweenda kwenu koonse kuzwa munyika mbotu yankanda. Kwamyaka iili makumi oone Jehova Leza Mwaami wesu wakali andiswe, takwe nichiba chintu nchibakabula.''

Nkinkaako twakabayindilila bakwesu, balunyungu lwa Isawu bakkala munyika ya Edomu, kule- kule amugwagwa wa Alabba, kuzwa kuli Elati akuzwa kuli Eziyoni Gebba.. Eelyo bakanyona balanga mugwagwa wamunkanda kuyaku Mowabbu.

Jehova wakandambila kuti, 'mutapenzyi ba Mowabbu, mutalwani nakubusya nkondo kuli nguwe. Eelyo nsikoyomupa nyika yanu imugeme, nkambo nyika ya Aa ndakayipa kulunyungu lwa Loti, kuti iibe yabo ibageme.'
Munyika eyi chiindi kwakali kukkala ba Emi, aaba bakali bantu banji basinguzu, alimwi akali mantu mbubonya mbuli bwakali ba Anakki;
baka zaalikizigwa kuti balepa, mbubonya mbuli ba Anakki, balo ba Mowabbu bakali kubayita kuti mba Emitisi.

Ba Holitisi abalabo bakali kukkala mu Seyili kuchindi chakiinda, pesi lunyungu lwa Isawu lwakazobatolela. Bakabanyonyona akubaanda mpoonya biikkala mbabo, mbuli ba Izilayili mbobakachita kubantu abo bakali kukkala munyika eeyo njakabapa Jehova.)
''Ino munyampuke mwiinke kuyozubuka mulonga wa Zeledi.

Élyo twakenda twakwinda akasensa ka Zeledi. Lino mazuba esu kuzwa kuchindi nitwakazwa kuzwa mu Kkadeshi Bbaneya kuyosikila nitwakakutampuka mulonga Zeledi, akali makumi atatu amusanu amyaka itatu. Chiindi echo boonse bamusela uulya wakali kukonzya kuya kunkondo bakamanide kale kufwa, mbubonya mbuli Jehova mbwaka konkezya kulimbabo.
Chakwindilila, kuboko kwa Jehova kwakalangisisya kapati izyalane elyo kuchitila kuti abanyonyona boonse bantu mane lumwi bamaninine.
( Nichakachitika eecho, boonse balumi bakali kukkwana kukulwana alimwi bamwi bakafwa kabafwida bantu babo,
ooyo Jehova wambula kuli ndime, wati,
'Sunu mulaandulula nyika yaba Mowabbu munzila iiya kumunzi wa Aa.

Mwakusika afwifwi abantu ba Amoni, mutakabasoki naa kubusya nkondo kuli mbabo, nkambo nsikoyomupa kabeela kanyika kabantu ba Aamoni, kuti iibe yabo iibageme; nkambo eeyo nyika ndakiipa balunyungu lwa Loti kuti iibe yabo.''
( Achalo echi chilangika kuti yakali nyika yaba Lefayimu. Ba Lefayimu bakali bakkala awo kuchindi chakiinda - pele ba Amoni bakabayita kuti mba Zamuzumimu -
Aaba bakali bantu biingi basinguzu alimwi akali mantu mbubonya mbuli ba Anakki. Pesi Jehova wakabanyonyoona eelyo ba Amoni, bakabatanda akukkala munyika yabo.

Eechi Jehova mbwakachitila bantu ba Isawu, bakali kukkala mu Edomu, eelyo bakanyonyonwa ba holitisi kuzwa kulimbabo, alimwi lunyungu lwa Isawu lwakabatolela alimwi mbibakakkala mubusena bwabo nikuba ambulisunu.
Kwamba zyaba Avivitisi bakali kukkala kumasena akali kule mbuli ku Gaza, iba Kkafutolimu, ibazwa ku Kkafuta, bakabanyonyona alimwi bakakkala abusena bwabo. )

''Lino amunyampuke, mutole lwendo lwenu, alimwi mukinde kumusena waba Alinoni; langa,  Ndaaba mujanza lyako Sihoni mu Amoliti, mwaami wa Heshibboni, alimwi enyika yakwe. Amutalike kwitola, alimwi mulwane anguwe munkondo.
Sunu ndilatalika kubika buyofu alimwi bukali bwenu kubantu boonse bali munsi ejulu; nibayomvwa impuwo atala andinywe alimwi bayoteketa alimwi baypluma ntwino akambo kenu.'
Ndakatuma batumwa kuzwa munkanda yaku Kkedemoti kuli Sihoni, mwaami waku Heshibboni, amajwi aluumuno, ndakati,
'Ámundizumizyenjinde munyika yenu; ndilayinka nkintobezya mugwagwa mupati; nsikoyoleya nekuba kochilisyo kana kochimweensi.
Twakuyanda chakulya mukatuuzizye amuulo wawo, kuchitila kuti ndikalye; mukatupe maanzi mukatuuzizye amuulo wawo, kuchitila kuti ndikanywe; kapati tuyokumbila kwinda munyika yenu amawulu eesu;

mbuli bwakachita balunyungu lwa Isawu bakkala munyika ya Edomu, alimwi aba Mowabbu bakkala ma Aa, kabachitila ndime; twiinde biyo mane tuzubuke mulonga Jodani akuyonjila munyika eeyo Jehova Leza wesu njayotupa.'
Nikuba boobo Sihoni, mwaami wa Heshibboni, takwe naakatuzumizya kuti twinde kulinguwe; nkambo Mwaami Leza wenu wakamuchita kuti mube basichinguni mukuti amwabile mpawo, mbuli mbokubede sunu.
Jehova wati kulindime, 'Bona, ndatalika kwaaba Sihoni antomwe anyika yakwe kulindime; amwusale iibe yenu.'
Mbombuboobu Sihoni mbakasika abantu bakwe boonse kuti bazolwane a Jahazi.
Jehova Mwaami wesu wakamwaaba kulindiswe, twakamuzunda abana bakwe abantu bakwe boonse.
Chiindi eecho twakalanga zisi zyoonse akuzinyonyoona twakajaya boonse baalumi abachikayintu abana; takwe nikuba woonse ngutwakasiya kachilimuumi.
Biyo ng'ombe nzitwakatola antomwe alubono lwechisi eecho nchitwakasala.

Kuzwida kumunzi wa Aloyele, uuli kumbali amulonga wa Alinoni, alimwi akuzwa mudolopo ilili mumusena, mane dokuyosika ku Giliyadi, tekwakalikwe dolopo ndiytwakali kuti lyatukomenena pe. Jehova Mwaami wesu wakabaaba mumanza eesu.
Pele kunyika yaba Amoni tetwakayinda pe, nikuba kuchisi chili kumbali amulonga wa Jabboki, kubikkilizya akunyika zila tulundu-lundu ooko Jehova Mwaami wesu nkwakatukasizye kuti tukasike.
Alimwi twakabweeda alimwi twakaya twatantizya kunzila yaku Bbasyani. Ogi, mwami waku Bbasyani, wakasika akutulwisya swebo, lwakwe abantu bakwe boonse, kuti balwane ku Edeleyi.

Jehova wakati kuli ndime, Útayowi; nkambo ndakupa luzundo atala lyakwe alimwi ndabika boonse bantu bakwe anyika yakwe munsi abwendelezi bwako. Uyochita kuli nguwe mbuli mbwakachita kuli Sihoni, mwami wa Amoni, oyo wakakkede ku Hesyibboni.'

Aboobo Jehova Leza wesu alimwi wakatupa luzundo atala lya Ogi mwami wa Bbasyani, abantu bakwe boonse bakabikwa munsi lyabwendelezi bwesu. Twakabawumina aansi kusikila nkakutachikwe naba omwe wabantu wakasyala.
Twakabweza madolopo akwe kuchindi echo. Takwe nekwakaba neliba lyoonse lyamadolopo alimakkumi musanu alimwi ndetwakatola kuzwa kuli mbabo - chonse chilikiti cha Agobbu, bwami bwa Oogi mu Bbasyani.
Aya ngakali madolopo woonse akaliyakilidwe amalambo malamfu, milyango, aminkulu; echi chakali kumbali lyamagunzi miingi atayakilidwe.
Twakabamwayula chakumaninsya boonse, mbuli mbutwakachita ku Sihoni mwami wa Hesyibboni, akumwayisya chakumanininsizya woonse madolopo - balumi abanakazi abana banini.
Pesi zyoonse zivuubwa azintu zitakwe mulimu zyamumadolopo ngitwakalisalila tobeni.
Kuchindi echo twakabweza nyika kuzwa mumaboko abaami babili ba Amolayiti, abo bakali kunembo lya Jodani, kuzwa ku Kkuti lya Anoni kuya ku Chilundu Helimoni
( Chilundu Helimoni chiitwa kuti Siliyoni aba Sidoniyeni, alimwi ba Amolayiti bachita kuti Senili)
alimwi woonse madolopo amuntandabale woonse ma Gilidi, antomwe aba Bbasyani, manedo kuyosika ku Saleka a Ediyeli, madolopo abwami bwa Ogi mu Bbasyani.''
