(Kuli zyakasyala kuli ba Efuleyimu, Ogi mwami wa Bbashani nguwakasyala luzutu. Langa ! Bulo bwakwe bwakali bulo bwansimbi. Sa temwakali, mu labba na, oko lunyungu lwa Amoni nkulwakali kukkala? Bulamfu bwabo bwakali tukokola tuli musanu atuune akukwazamuka kwabo kwakali tukokola tuli tune, bantu mbubakali kweela.)

Eyi nyika eyo njitwakatola mulukono achindi echo -kuzwa ku Alo, oko kulubazu lwaku Musena waku Anoni, alimwi achimpanzi chamunyika yakalundu ka Giliyadi, amadolopo acho - ndakapa kuba Lubbenayiti aku Gaditi.

Boonse ba Gidi aboonse ba Bbasyani, ibwami bwa Ogi, ngandakupa kuchimpanzi chalunyungu lwa Manase. ( choonse chilikiti cha Agobbu, aboonse ba Bbasyani. Nchicho chikkalilo chakawulikwa kuti nyiika ya Lefayimu.
Jayi, silunyungu lwa Manase, wakatola zilikiti zya Agobbu kumugaano waku Gesyuliti aba Makkatiti. Wakawulika chilikiti, nekuba ba Bbasyani, kuzina lyakwe mwini, Havoti Jayi, kusika sunu.)
Ndakapa Gidi ku Makkili.
Kuba Lubbeni akuma Gidi ndakapa busena kuzwa ku Gidi kusikila ku Musena wa Anoni - akkati kamusena mbusena bwakumugano -abwaku mulonga wa Jabboku, nkuti mugaano abalunyungu lwa Amoni.

Achimbi chamigano yacho yantabale lyamulonga wakumusena wa Jodani, kuzwa ku Kkinalati kuyosika ku Lwiizi lwa Mwinyo lwaku Alabba ( kwamba kuti, Lwizi lwa Mwinyo) kuyosika kuminku yachilundu cha Pisiga lyaku jwe.
Ndakakulayilila kuchindi echo, kuti, Jehova Leza wako wakupa nyka kwikkona; lwako, abalumi boonse bankondo, bayoyinda atala lyaba silumamba kunembo lyaba kkulana bako, bantu ba Izilayeli.
Pesi bamakayintu benu, abanini benu, azivuubwa zyanu ( ndilizi kuti mulazivuubwa zyingi), muyokkala mumadolopo enu ayo ngindakamupa,

kusikila Jehova akape kulyokezya kuba kkulana banu, mbuli mbamubambilide, kusikila abalabo bakakone nyika eeyo Jehova Leza wanu njalikubapa mutala lya Jodani; mpawo muyobweeda, na, woonse muntu akkati kenu, kulubono lwenu olo ndundamupa.'
Ndakalayila Joshuwa kuchindi echo, nkanditi,  menso ako akabona zyoonse ezyo Jehova Leza wako nzyakakuchitila kuti baba baami babili; Jehova uyochita zikozyenie kubwami boonse oko nkumwinda.
Tamukoyo bayoowa pe, nkambo Jehova Leza wanu ngonguwe uyo mulwanina.'
Ndakakombelezya Jehova kuchindi echo, nkenditi,

'O Mwami Jehova, watalika kutondezya mulanda wako bupati bwako alimwi akuboko kwako kulanguzu; abobo ngwani Leza uliwo kujulu kana munyika oyo ukonzya kuchita milimo ikozyenyie mbuli mbwakachita, amilimo mipati ikozyanya?
Ndileke njinde, ndakukumbila, alimwi ndibone nyika imbotu eyo ilikutala lya Jodani, eyo nyika mbotu yakuchilundu, ayilayo Lebbanoni.''
Pesi Jehova wakandinyemena nkambo kenu, takaswilila kuli ndime. Jehova wakati kuli ndime, 'Muleke echi chizulile kuli ndinywe utachambuli limbi kuli ndime atala ankani eyi:
tantizya atala lya Pisiga akunyampula menso ako kolangide kulubazu lwakumbo, kunyika, kumusanza, kujwe; langa amenso ako nkambo tokoyotaluka Jodani.
K Anukuti, layilila Joshuwa akumusungwazya alimwi akumusimya, abobo uyoyenda kunembo lyabantu aba, alimwi uyobachita kuti bakkone nyika eyi njotabone.'
Mpawo twakalanga mumusena ulangene a Bbeti Piyoli.
Kwaino, Izilayeli, swilizya kumilawu amalembe ayo nginjanda kukuyiisya, kuti uwachite; kuchitila kuti upone alimwi ukanjile akuvuba nyika eyo Jehova, Leza wamawuso, njayokupa.
Tokoyoyungizya pe kumajwi ayo ngindakulayilila, nekuba kwachesya kuchitila kuti ukonzye kubamba malayilile a Jehova Leza wako ooyo nginjanda kukulayilila.
Menso ako akabona eezyo Jehova nzyakachita nkambo ka Bbaalu wa Piyoli, kuli boonse balumi abo bakatobela Bbaalu Piyoli, Jehova Leza wako wakabajaya kuzwa akati kenu.
Pesi inywebo nimujisilidi kuli Jehova Leza wanu muliponede sunu, moonse.
Langa, ndakakuyiisya milawu amalembe, mbuli Jehova Leza wangu mbakandilayilide, kuti uyelede kuchita obo mukati kanyika eyo njoyankuko kuchitila kutegwa ukayivube.
Aboobo abambe akwachita: nkambo obu mbusongo bwako akumvwisisisya kwako kumenso abantu abo batakamvwe atala azintu eezi akwamba kuti; 'Nchobeni inyika eyi mpati ilabusongo abantu bamvwisisisya.'
Njiili imwi inyika mpati iliwo eeyo ili abaleza bali afwifwi ambabo, mbuli Jehova Leza wesu mbwabede kuchiindi choonse nchitumwiita?
Njili imbi nyika impati iliwo eyo ilamilawu amalembe aluleme mbuli woonse ooyu mulawu ngundokubikka kunembo lyako sunu?

Swilizya biyo alimwi uchenjele ulikwabilile lwako, kuchitila kuti utalubi zintu eezyo menso ako nzyakabona, kuchitila kuti atasiyi moyo wako kumazuba ako woonse. Pesi zichite kuti zizibinkane kubana bako akubana babana bako.

Mubuzuba obo mbwakayimikila kunembo lya Jehova Leza wako ku Holebbu, awo Jehova mpakawti kuli ndime, ''Ndibunganisizya bantu, alimwi njobachita kuti bakamvwe majwi aangu, kuti bakakonzye kwiiya kundiyoowa woonse mazuba ngibayopona munyika akuti bayiisye bana babo.'
Wakasika alimwi wakiimikila munsi achilundu. Chilundu chakapya amulilo kuyosika kumoyo wajulu, amudima, ijoba, alimwi amudima usiisya.
Jehova wakambula kuli nduwe aanze akkati kamulilo; wakamvwa ijwi amajwi alyo, pesi takwe pe buube mbwakabona; wakamvwa ijwi biyo kupela.
Wakamba kuli nduwe chizuminano eechi nchakalayilide nduwe kuti ukachichite, milawu ilikkumi. Wakilemba amabwe aabili.
Jehova wakandilayilila kuchilundu eecho kuti nkuyiisye malayilile amilawu kuchitila kuti ukakonzye kwichita munyika eeyo njoyakukuzubukila kuti ukakonzye kwivuba.
Aboobo akube kuchenjela kupela loko kuli ndinywe - nkambo takwepe nchiwakabona pe nikuba chintu nikuba musyobo mubuzuba eelyo Jehova ndyakaambula akati kamulilo ku Holebbu -
kuti tamwelede kulibisizya lwenu kwinda mukulibezela zikozyanio mubube bwachintu kufumbwa muchiimo, muchikozyanisyo chamwalumi na mwanakazi,
kufumbwa chikozyanisyo chamunyama ulanyika, chikozyanisyo chikozya kufumbwa chamuyuni ulamababa, ooyu uwuluka kujulu, kufumbwa.
Chikozyanisyo echo chiyavula anyika, nakuti ilimumaanzi munsi anyika.

Toyelede pe kulanzya menso aako kujulu akulanga zuba, mwezi, nakuti inyenyezi - azyonse zijisi julu - alimwi akukwelelwa kule kuti uzikombe akuzilemeka - eezyo zintu Jehova Leza wako nzyakapa chaabilo kubantu boonse amajulu woonse.
Pesi Jehova wakakutola akukuboozya kuzwa mubuyumuyumu, kuzwa mu Ijiputi, kuti kulinguwe tube bantu balukono lwakwe, mbuli mbumubede sunu.
Jehova wakandinyemena nkambo kanduwe. Wakakonka kuti nsyelede pe kuya kuzubuka Jodani alimwi nsyelede pe kwinka munyika mbotu, inyika Jehova Leza wako njayopa nduwe mbuli luko.
Nikuba obo, njelede kufwa munyika eeyi. Nsyelede pe kuzubuka Jodani; pesi uyozubuka akuyovuba eeyo inyika mbotu.
Muswilizye loko, kuchitila kuti utalubi chizuminano cha Jehova Leza wako, alimwi akutalichitila chibezwa chili mubube oobo Jehova Leza wako nzyakamukasya kuti muzichite.
Nkambo Jehova Leza wako mulilo ujaya, alimwi ngusibuzuba.

Mwayozyala bana abana babana, babana benu, mwakuba munyika kwachiindi chilamfu, alimwi namwalibisizya lwanu akulichitila zikozyanisyo zibezedwe munzila kufumbwa, akuchita chibi kumenso a Jehova Leza wako. Eecho chimuchitya kunyema --

Ndayita ijulu enyika kuti zibe kamboni atala anduwe sunu. Kuti akufwambana uyofwa kuzwa munyika eeyo njoyozubuka Jodani kuti ukayivube. Tokoyolansya pe mazuba ako kulinjiyo, pesi uyofwidilila chakumaninina.
Jehova uyomwaya akati kabantu, alimwi muyochala bache mumwelwe akati kazisi, ooko Jehova nkwayo muzulwida.
Oko muyokomba baleza bambi, milimu yamaboko amuntu, chisamu abbwe, chitaonzyi kubona, kumvwa, kulya na kununka.
Pesi kuzwa awo uyoyanduula Jehova Leza wako, alimwi uyomujana, wakumuyanduula amoyo wako woonse amuya wako.
Wakuba mubuyumuyumu, alimwi zyoonse zintu zyayomusikila alindinywe, mumazuba ayo atobela ngemuyoboola kuli Jehova Leza wanu akuswilizya kujwi lyakwe.
Nkambo Jehova Leza wako ngu Leza waluzyalo; takoyokukachizya pe nikuba kukujaya, nikuba kuluba chikonke chabamawuso eecho nchakakonka kuli mbabo.

Buzya lino atala amazuba akayinda, ayo akalimusule achindi chako, kuzwa kuzuba elyo Leza ndyakalenga muntu anyika, buzya kuzwa kugolela limwi bbazu lyajulu akuli limwi, naa kuli chimwi chipati mbuli eechi, naa kuti mpuchili na chili mbuli nchicho chakali chamvwikkwa?
Bakamvwa na bantu ijwi lya Leza kalilokwambula akati kamulilo, mbuli mbumwakalimvwa, akupona?

Nakuti mpakali wezya na Leza kuti alyinkile lwakwe kuyotola chisi chakwe akati kachimwi chisi, mubuyumu, muzitondezyo amuzigambyo, akwinda munkondo, akwinda mujanza pati, ajanza litandabikidwe, aziyoosyo zipati, mbuli zyoonse Jehova Leza wako nzyakakuchitila mu Ijiputi kumenso ako?
Kulinduwe zintu ezi, zyakatondezegwa, kuchitila kuti uzibe kuti ehova ngu Leza, akuti takwepe uumbi uyinda nguwe.
Kuzwa kujulu wakakuchita kuti umvwe ijwi lyakwe, kuchitila kuti akulayilile: anyika wakachita kuti ubone mulilo wakwe mupati; wakalimvwa ijwi lyakwe akati kamulilo.
Nkambo wakayandisya bamawuso, wakasala lunyungu lwabo kunembo lyabo akubagwisya kuzwa mu Ijiputi abulemu bwakwe, anguzu zyakwe mpati;
kuchitila kugwisya kunembo lyenu zisi zipati alimwi zipati kwinda zyenu, kuti amweete mukati, kumupa nyika yabo mbuli l ukono, ambuli sunu.
Ziba aboobo sunu alimwi zibambe mumoyo wako, kuti Jehova ngu Leza kujulu alimwi aanyika aansi. Takwepe umbi.
Uyobamba makani akwe amilawu eeyo njindokumulayilila sunu, kuti zibe kabotu anduwe abana bako kunembo lyako, akuti ukalansye mazuba aako munyika Jehova Leza wako njyokupa kwalyoonse.''
Mpawo Mozesi wakasalula zisi zitatu kujwe lya Jodani,
kuchitila kuti kufumbwa muntu akonzye kuchijila nkuko kuti wajaya muntu katayeyeli, katali sinkondonyina pe kuchindi chakayinda. Kuchijila kulaya madolopo, kuti amwi akonzye kupona.
Kwakali Bbezeli;  Bbezeli munkanda, inyika itandabete, yamusyobo wa Lubbeni, Lamoti mu Giliyadi, yaba Gaditi, a Golani mu Bbasyani, yaba Manase.
Oyu nguwo mulawu wa Mozesi ngwakabikka musule lyabantu ba Izilayeli.
eezi nzizuminano, malembe, milawu aamwi malembe ayo ngaakambula kubantu ba Izilayeli nibakazwa ku Ijiputi.

nibakali kujwe kwa Jodani, mumupata ulangeene a Bbete Piyoli, munyika ya Sihoni, mwami waba Amoni, wakali wakkala ku Hesyibboni, ooyo Mozesi abantu ba Izilayeli mbibakali bazunda nibakazwa ku Ijiputi.
Bakatola inyika yakwe mbuli chivubwa, anyika ya Ogi, mwami wa Bbasyani -- aba, bami babili baba Amolayiti, bakali kule a Jodani kuya kubuzwezuba.
Busena obu bwakali kuzwida ku Aloyeli, kumamanino amumpata wa Anoni, kuya kuchilundu cha Sihoni, ( nakuti kuchilundu cha Hemoni),
akubikilizya amwi ayoonse ntandabale yamulonga amumpata wa Jodani, kubuzwezuba kwa Jodani, kuya kulwizi lwaba Alabba, akuminki yaku Chilundu cha Pisiga.
Mozesi wakayita kuli bonse bana ba Izilayeli akubambila kuti, ''Swilila, Izilayeli, kumulawu amabambe ngintambe mumatwi anu sunu, kuti muyiye akwibamba.
Jehova Leza wesu wakachita chizuminano andiswe ku Holebbu.
Jehova takachita chizuminano echi abasikale besu, pesi andiswe, toonseni nitupona ano sunu.
Yahuwe wakambula anduwe busyu kubusyu atala chilundu kuzwa mukati kamulilo
( ndakima akati ka Jehova anduwe kuti echo chindi, kuti njubunune ijwi lyakwe kuli nduwe; nkambo wakali yowede akambo kamulilo, alimwi toinkide pe atala achilundu). mbwakamba Jehova,
Ndime Jehova Leza wako, oyo wakakweta anze ya Ijipita ang'anda yabuzike.
Tokoyoba abambi baleza kunembo lyangu.
Tokoyolichitila chimwi chimo chakubeza pe nikuba chimwi chikozyanio chachimwi chintu echo chili atala lyejulu, nakuti echo chilimunyika ansi, nakuti echo chilimumanzi munsi.

Tokotobakotamina nakuti kubabelekela, nkambo ndime Yahuwe Leza wanu, ndime Leza sibuzuba. Ndapachisubulo kububi bwabasikale mukweta chisubulo akubana, akumazyalane bwatatu abwane bwababo batandiyandi,
akutondezya luyando lwimvwi njii kuzyuulu zyababo bandiyanda akubamba milazyo yangu.
Tokoyobweza izina lya Jehova Leza wenu chabuyo, nkambo Jehova takoyomujana katakwe mulandu pe oyo ubweza izina lyakwe chabuyo.
Langa izuba litegwa Sabata kukulibamba kalisalala, mbuli Jehova Leza wako mbakalayilila.
Kwamazuba musanu alimwi uyobeleka akuchita yoonse milimu yako;

pesi izuba lyamusanu aabili ndyasabata kuli Jehova Leza wenu. Mulindilyo takwe mulimo ngotakachite pe - iwebo pe, nikuba mwana wako mulombe, nikuba mwana wako musimbi, nikuba mubelesi wako mwalumi, nikuba mubelesi wakomwanakazi, nikuba basune bako, nikuba madonki ako, nikuba kufumbwa zivubwa zyako, nikuba muzwakule uuli alubuwa lwako. Echi chilibobu mukuti mubelesi wako mwalumi amubelesi wako mwanakazi bakonzye kulyokezya abalabo mbulinduwe.

Muyoyeya kuti mwakali babelesi munyika ya Ijiputi, alimwi Jehova Leza wenu wakamugwisya kuzwa nkuko akuboko kupati alimwi ajanza litandabikidwe. Nkinkaako Jehova Leza wenu wakulayilila kubamba buzuba butegwa sabata.
Lemeka wuso abanyoko, mbuli Jehova Leza wako mbakulayilila kuti uchite, kuti ukonzye kupona chindi chilamfu m unyika eyo Jehova Leza wako  njakupa, alimwi kuti zikonzye kukwendela kabotu anduwe.
Tokoyojaya.
Tokozochita bumambi.
Tokoyobba.
Tokoyopa bukamboni bwakubeja atala ayoyo ngoyakilene awe.

Tokoyoyemuzya mwanakazi wangoyakilene awe, tokoyoyemuzya ng'anda yangoyakilene awe, munda wakwe, nakuti mubelesi wakwe mwalumi, nakuti mubelesi wakwe mwanakazi, nibaba basune bakwe, nakuti madonki akwe, nakuti kufumbwa nchalecho ngoyakilene awe.'

Ayamajwi Jehova wamba mujwi lyakoompolola kuli zyonse imbungano zyako atala achilundu kuzwa mukati lyamulilo, lyajoba, alimwi kumudima usiisya; takwe nakayungizizya ambi pe majwi. Walemba ansi kumazeteko obile amabwe akwapa ndime.
Zyakachitika mukuti, awo niwakamvwa ijwi kuzwa mukati kamudima, kuchiindi chilundu nichakali kuyaka, kuti ukaze afwifwi andime - boonse bapati abazuluzi bamisyobo yenu.
Wakati, 'Bona, Jehpva Leza wesu watutondezya bulemu bwakwe abupati bwakwe alimwi tamvwa ijwi lyakwe kuzwa mukati lyamulilo, twabona sunu kuti awo sunu Leza nawambula abantu, balakonzya kupona.
Pesi nkambonzi nitwelede kufwa ? Nkambo you mulilo m upati ulatulya; kuti twamvwa ijwi lya Jehova Leza wesu kalichiya kunembo, tulakonzya kufwa.
Nkambo ngwani kunze kwandiswe uliwo mukati kanyama iwakamvwa ijwi lya Leza upona kalyambula kuzwa mukati kamulilo alimwi wakapona, mbuli mbutwakachita ?
Mbuli zyako, welede kwinka akuyoswilizya zyoonse Jehova Leza wesu nzyawamba;  uyindulule kulindiswe zyonse ezyo nzyatakwambile Jehova Leza wesu; tuyoziswilizya akuzilemeka.'
Jehova wamvwa majwi ako niwambula kulindime. 'Ndamvwa majwi abantu aba, nzibamba kulinduwe. Nzibaamba zyalizibotu.
Oh, kuti kwalimoyo ulibobo mulimbabo, kuti bakonzya kundilemeka akubamba lyonse malayilile angu, kuti zikonzye kubendela kabotu ambabo alimwi abana babo kwalyonse !
Inka ukambe kuti kulimbabo, ''Amubwede kumabbakasa enu.''
Pesi mbulinduwe, imikila ano alindime, alimwi ndiyokwambila lyonse milayo, milawu amabambe ezyo nzotakabayiisye, kuchitila kuti bakazilondole munyika eyo njesibape kuti bayilele.'
Muyolele abo, ezyo Jehova Leza wenu nzyamulayilila; tokoyochengunuka kubbazu kukuboko kwechilisyo nakuti kwechimweensi.

Uyoyenda munzila zyonse ezyo Jehova Leza wenu nzyamulayilila, kuchitila kuti mukonzye kupona, alimwi kuchitila kuti zikonzye kumwendela kabotu andinywe, alimwi kutimukonzye kulansya mazuba munyika eyo njimuyolela.
Lino eyi n jimilayizyo, amilawu, amabambe ayo Jehova Leza wanu njakandilayilila kuti ndimuyiisye, aboobo mulelede kuti mwibambe munyika eyo njimuya kuli njiyo ku Jodani kuti mukivube;

kuchitila kuti mukalemeke Jehova Leza wanu, kuchitila kuti mukabambe yoonse milawu yakwe amalayilile ayo ngindamulayilila inywebo - lwanu, abana banu balombe, mumazuba enu wonse abuumi bwenu, kuchitila kuti mazuba enu ayungizizigwe.
Aboobo amubaswilizye, Izilayeli, akubabamba, kuti zikende kabotu kulindinywe, kuti mukavulisye, munyika ikunka malili abuchi, mbuli Jehova, Leza wabamawuso, mbwakamusyomezya kuyti mukachite.
Swilizya, Izilayeli, Jehova Leza ngumwi.
Ulelede kuyanda Jehova Leza wako amoyo wako woonse, akumuuya wako woonse, alimwi anguzu zyako zyoonse.
Majwi aya ngindamulayilila sunu alaba mumyoyo yanu;
alimwi muyoyiisya bana benu chamoyo woonse; muyowambula atala angawo mwakukkala ansi mumanda anu, mwakweenda munzila zyanu, mwakulala ansi, akuchindi nimuyobuka.
Muyoyiwanga mbuli chitondezyo kumaanza anu, alimwi iyomuvuna mbuli chibalusyo akati kamenso enu.
Muyoyilemba azikukunguzyo zyamanda enu alimwi akumilyango yanu.
Naa Jehova Leza wanu wamweta munyika eyo njakakonkeezya kuli bamawuso, kuli Abrahamu., kuli Ayizeki, kuli Jakobbu, eyo njayomupa, madolopo mapati, mabotu ayo ngimwakatayaka,
amaanda azwide misyobo yazintu ezyo nzimwakatapanga pe, azikala nzimwakatasya pe, a myuunda yamasansa aminsamu yama Oliva njimwakatazikkila pe, muyolya akuyokkuta-
mpawo amuchenjele kuti mutakalubi Jehova, wakamugwisya munyika ya Ijiputi, kuzwa mung'anda yabuzike.
Muyolemeka Jehova Leza wenu; lwakwe muyomukomba,alimwi muyokonka muzina lyakwe.
Tamukoyotobela baleza bambi, baleza babantu bamuzyungulukide nywebo--
nkambo Jehova Leza wanu akkati kanu ngu Leza sibuzuba - kuti mwazichita, bukkali bwa Jehova Leza wanu buyomubukila alimwi ulamunyonyoona kuzwa atala anyika.
Tamwelede kusunka Jehova Leza wenu pe mbuli mbuli mbomwakasunka Musa.
Muyobamba malayilile a Jehova Leza wanu chamoyo woonse, milazyo yakwe ilemekeka, ambeta zyakwe, ezyo nzyakamulayilila.
Myuchitaezyo ziluleme azibotu kumenso a Jehova, kuti chikamubotele anywebo, akuti mukayinke akuyovuba nyika imbotu eyo Jehova njakakonkezya kuli bamawuso,
kuti agwisye basinkondo nyokwe kuzwa kumenso anu, mbuli Jehova mbwakamba.
Nibayomubuzya bana benu balombe kuchiindi chiboola, kuti, ''Niinzi chizuminano amabambe, imbeta, alimwi ayimwi milawu eyo Jehova Leza wanu njakamulayilila lwanu?'
mpawo muyowamba kuti kubana benu balombe, 'Twakali bazike ba Falo mu Ijiputi; Jehova wakatugwisya swebo ajanza pati,
alimwi wakatondezya zitondezyo zyamaleele, mapati anguzu, kuba Ijiputi, kuli Falo, akung'anda zyakwe zyoonse, kumenso esu;
alimwi wakatugwisya oko, kuchitila kuti akatwete okuno mukati, kuti azotupe nyika yakakonkezezegwe kuli bamataata.
Jehova wakatulayilila kuti lyoonse katubamba eyi milawu, kukuyowa Jehova Leza wesu kuti kubote kuli ndiswe kuchitila kuti atubambe katuli bawumi, mbuli mbotubede sunu.
Kuti twabamba woonse malayilile aya kunembo lya Jehova Leza wesu, mbuli mbwakatulayilila swebo, ezi ziyoba bululami bwesu.

Awo Jehova Leza wenu akumusisya kunyika eyo njemuya kukutola, uyogwisya zisi kunembo lyenu - ba Hititi, ba Gigashiti, ba Amolayiti, ba Kkenani, ba Pelizitisi, ba Hiviti, aba - Jebbusiti - zisi zili musanu azibili zipati loko alimwi zilamanguzu kwinda ndinywe.
Ngu Jehova Leza wenu umwabila mbabo awo mpomubazunda, alimwi muyelede kubanyonyona chakumaninina. Tamuko chita chizuminano ambabo, alimwi mutabatondezyi buuya.
Nekuba kuyobamba makwatano ambabo. Tamukoyopa bana benu basimbi kubana babo balombe, alimwi tamukoyobweza bana babo basimbi kupa bana benu balombe.
Nkambo bayolesya bana benu balombe kunditobela, kuchitila kuti bakombe bambi ba Leza. Aboobo bukali bwa Jehova bulamubukila, alimwi uyomunyonyoona chakufwambana.
Mboobu mbumwelede kubachita: Muyomwayula zipayililo zyabo tube tufwefwelenga, akutemena ansi ziyako zyabo zya Ashila, alimwi mutente zikozyano zyabo zibumbidwe.
Nkambo mulichisi chisalilidwe Jehova Leza wanu. Wakamusala kuti mube bantu bakwe kuti amuvube, kwinda bantu boonse bali munyika.
Jehova tensi wakabikka luyando lwakwe alindinywe naa kumusala nkambo mulibiingi kumweelwe kwinda bamwi bantu - nkambo mwakali bache loko kubantu boonse -

pesi nkambo ulamuyanda, alimwi ulemuzya kubantu chikonke nchakakonkezya bamawuso benu. Nkiinkako Jehova nchakamugwisya ejanza lyamanguzu alimwi wakamunununa kuzwa kung'anda yabuzike, kuzwa mujanza lya Falo, mwaami wa Ijipiti.
Nkambo kako muzibe kuti Jehova Leza wenu - ngu Leza, Leza usyomekede, uubamba zizuminano alimwi kusyomeka kumazyalane aali chuulu kulibaabo bamuyanda akubamba milazyo yakwe,
pesi ulabwedezya kulibaabo bamusula kumeso abo, kubanyoonyona, Takoyobozya moyo kuli woonse umusula, uyobwedezya kulinguwe zizulide.
Nkambo kako muyobamba milawu yakwe amalayilile, alimwi mbeta ezi nzindimukumulayilila sunu , kuti mukayichite.
Na mwaswilila imbeta akuzibamba alimwi muzichite, kuyochitka kuti Jehova Leza wenu uyobamba kulindinywe chizuminano alimwi abusyomezi  obo mbwakakonka kumawuso enu.

Uyomuyanda, uyomulongezya, akumuvuzya. Uyolongezya michelo yamazyalilo enu, michelo yanyika yenu - maila, wayini wako mupya, amafuta ako - bana bang'ombe zyanu abana bembelele zyanu munyika eyo njindakakonkezya bamawuso benu kwipa ndinywe.
Muyolongezegwa kwinda bantu boonse: Takukoyoba mwalumi utakabule bana na mwanakazi ngomwa akati kenu na akati kazivuubwa zyanu.
Jehova uyogwisya malwazi akati kenu, Takwe nibuba bulwazi bubi bwamu Ijiputi obo mbomwizi buyobikwa alindinywe, pesi uyobubika kulibabo bamusula.
Muyonyonyona bantu boonse abo Jehova Leza wenu mbayopeda kulindinywe, alimwi linso lyenu talikoyobafwida insoni. Tamukoyokomba ba leza babo, nkambo echo chiyoba kakole kulindinywe.
Na waamba mumoyo wako, ''zisi ezi nzyiingi kwinda ndime; Ino inga ndabazunda na ?'-
mutayoowi; muyoyibulukwa echo Jehova Leza wenu nchakachita kuli Falo aku Ijipita yoonse;

ayo mapenzi mapati menso anu ngakabona, zitondezyo, azigambyo, ijanza lyenguzu, alimwi akuboko kutandabikidwe oko Jehova Leza wanu wakumugwisya aanze. Jehova Leza wenu uyochita zikozyenie kubantu boonse abo mboyoowa.
Ajulu azezyo, Jehova Leza wenu uyotuma manko akati kabo, mane abo bonse bachede abaabo bayubide bamane kabatachibonwi kumenso enu.
Tamukoyoyosegwa ambabo, nkambo Jehova Leza wenu ulakati kenu, Leza mupati loko alimwi uyoosya.
Jehova Leza wenu uyososolosya zisi kuzwa kulinduwe bunini bunini. Tamukoyobazunda pe boonse antoomwe, mbokunga banyama bamusokwe bakabe biingi loko bakuzyungulikide.
Pele Jehova Leza wako uyokupa kuzunda awo mpomuyoswanana kunkondo; uyoba vilinga loko mane bakanyonyoke.
Uyobika bami babo munsi lyabwendelezi bwenu, alimwi uyochita kuti izina lyabo liziimane ansi ejulu. Takwe naba omwe uyokonzya kwima kunembo lyako, manedo mukabanyonyone.

Muyotenta zikozyanisyo zibezedwe zyabaleza babo - mutakalombozyi nsiliva na ingolida ezyo zibavumbide akuzitola kuzichita zyenu, nkambo na mwachita, muyolisungilila anjiyo - nkambo nchisesemyo kuli Jehova Leza wenu.
Tokoyoyeta chisesmyo mung'anda yako akuchikomba. Uyochisesemwa akuchisula loko, nkambo chipambwididwe kunyonyoonwa.
Welede kubamba imbeta zyoonse nzendamupa sunu, kuti mukapone akuyovula, akwenda mukati akutola nyika eyo Jehova njaka kkonkezya kuli bamawuso.
Muyoyubulukwa nzila zyoonse Jehova Leza wako nzyakwenzya eeyi minyaka ili makumi oone munkanda, ikuti akamubombye, kuti akamusunke akuziba zyakali mumyoyo yanu, kuti na muyobamba mbeta zyakwe na pe.

Wakamubombya, akumufwisya inzala, akumusanina mana, ngimwakataziba abamawuso ngibakataziba. Wakachitila kuti muzibe kuti bantu tabaponi achibunge achilikke, nikuba, aasi azyoonse zintu zizwa kumulomo wa Jehova kuti bantu bapone.
Zizwaato zyenu tezyakazakala akuwa kuzwa kulindinywe, amawulu anu takwepe nakazimba muminyaka eeyo ili makumi oone.
Muyoziyeya mumyoyo yanu, biyeni, mbuli mwalumi mbwalaya mwanakwe mulombe, elyo Jehova Leza wanu mbalaya ndinywe.
Muyobamba imbeta zya Jehova Leza wanu, kuti mukeende munzila zyakwe akumulemeka.
Nkambo Jehova Leza wanu ulikumweeta munyika mbotu, inyika yatulonga twamanzi, yamasawu amasensa, akunka kuya mukati akati katulundu;
nyika ya witi abbali, masansa, mikkuyu, ama pomegilanayiti, nyika yamisamu yama olifa abuchi.
Ninyika njimutakabule kulya chitali chakufwaba alimwi momutakabule kubula chintu, nyika yamabwe achitidwe ansimbi, alimwi kuzwa kulezyo zilundu muyosya kkopa.
Muyolya akukkuta, alimwi muyolongezya Jehova Leza wanu nkambo kanyika mbotu njapa ndinywe.
Amuchenjele kuti mutalubi Jehova Leza wanu, akukachilwa kubamba malayilile akwe ambeta zyakwe amilayizyo yakwe njendimulayilila sunu.
Ambweni, elyo mwakulya akukkuta, alimwi elyo mwakuyaka maanda mabotu akukkala mulingawo, myoyo yanu iyosumpuka.
Amuchenjele elyo matanga eng'ombe amatanga ambelele aakuvula alimwi nsiliva angolida zyenu zyakuvula, azyoonse nzimulazyo zyakuvula,
mpawo myoyo yanu ikalisumpule alimwi muyoluba Jehova Leza wanu, oyo wamugwisya kuzwa munyika ya Ijiputi, kuzwa mung'anda yabuzike.
Mutamulubi oyo wakamuzulwida mukati kenkanda mpati alimwi iyoosya, enzoka zyayo ziyoosya atubanze anyika ilenyota kwakatali manzi, wakamwetela manzi kuzwa mubbwe jumu.
Wakamusanizya mana munkanda ayo bamawuso ngibatakazi, kuti amubombye akumusunka, amuchitye bubotu kumamanino,
pesi mwamba kuti mumyoyo yanu, manguzu angu abuyumu bwajanza mbubwandijania buvubi oobu.'
Pele muyomuyeeya Jehova Leza wanu, nkambo nguwe umupa imanguzu kuti mujane buvubi, kuti atondezye chizuminano nchakakonkezya bamawuso, mbubonya mbuli mbukubede sunu.
Kuyochitika obo, kuti mwakuluba Jehova Leza wanu akutobela bamwi baleza, kubakomba, akubakotamina, ndamwambila sunu inywe kuti nkasimpe muyoloba.
Mbuli manyika ayo Jehova ngayobunyonyoona kunembo lyenu, mbubonya mbomuyonyonyooka, nkambo munoli temwaswilila kujwi lya Jehova Leza wanu pe.
Swiilila, Izilayeli; waamba kuzubukila mutala lyaJodani sunu, kunjila kuya kukumwayuula zisi zipati zili aanguzu kwiinda ndinywe, amyuunzi mipati iiyakilidwe kusika kujulu.
Bantu bapati akulampa, bana balombw babaAnakkimu, aabo mbemwizi alimwi aabo mbimwakamvwa bantu nkabaamba kuti, 'Ngwani utakayimikile kunembo lyabana baAnakki?'

Nkinkaako muzibe sunu kuti Jehova Leza wanu ngonguwe utakeende kunembo lyanu mbuli mulilo uusyukuta; uyobamwayuula alimwi uyobakkolomweda aansi kunembo lyanu; aboobo uyobatandila aanze akubachita kuti bamane achakufwambana mbuli Jehova mbakamwaambila.

Mumoyo wako utaambi, nkali Jehova Leza wako wabayiilila aanze kuzwa kunembo lyanu, 'Zyakaba boobo nkaambo kabululami bwangu kuti Jehova wakandeeta kuzovuba nyika eeyi, nkaambo kakuti kwakaba bubi bwazisi eezyo Jehova ulikubaanda kuzwa kunembo lyanu.

Teensi nkaambo kabululami bwanu pe na busalali bwamyooyo yanu kuti mukanjila akuyoovuba nyika yabo, pesi akaambo kabubi bwazisi eezyo Jehova Leza wanu nzyayobandila kuzwa kunembo lyanu, alimwi kutyi abachite kuti basike mpubaamba kasimpe kujwi ndyakakonka kuli basikale babo, kuli Abbulahamu, Ayizeki aJakkobbu.
Nkinkaako amukazibe kuti Jehova Lea wanu takoyomupa nyika mbotu eeyi kuti mwiivube nkaambo kabuliulami bwanu, nkaambo muli bantu basichinguni.
Kamuyeeya akutaluba mbumwakamusokola Jehova Leza wanu kukunyema munkanda; kuzwa mubuzuba oobo mbumwakasiya nyika yaIjipiti kusikila mwasika kubusena oobu, mwali basikupapila Jehova.
Alimwi akuHolebbu mwakamusokola Jehova kukunyema, alimwi Jehova wakanyema loko andinywe kukumunyonyoona.

Eelyo nindakatanta aachilundu kuyotambula mabwe mapapalete, mapapalete aachizuminano eecho Jehova nchaakachita andinywe, ndakakkala aatala achilundu kwamazuba makkumi one amansiku ali makkumi one; tendakalya chinkwa nanka kunywa manzi.

Jehova wakandipa mabwe obile mapapalete aalembedwe amunwe wakwe; aalingawo kwakalilembedwe zyoonse mbuli woonse majwi aayo Jehova ngakamwaambila aatala lyachilundu kuzwa aakati kamulilo mubuzuba bwakubungano.
Zyakachitikana kumamanino aamazuba ngayaayo aali makkumi one amansiku aali makkumi one aayo Jehova ngakandipa mabwe obile mapapaleti; mapapalete aachizuminano.

Jehova wakandaambila kuti, 'Nyampuka, useluke chakufwambana kuzwa aano, akaambo kabantu bako, aabo mbuwakagwisya kuzwa muIjipiti, bakalisofwaazya beni. Bakapiluka chakufwambana kuzwa munzila eeyo njindakabalayilila. Bakalibumbila chikozyanio.
Mukuyungizya, Jehova wakambuula mkulindime akuti, 'Ndababona bantu aabo; mbachuungutwi.
Muleke ndime andiike kuchitila kuti nkabanyonyoone akuzima zina kuzwa munsi lyajulu, alimwi ndiyookuchita chisi chileenguzu mpati kwiinda mbabo.'
Alimwi ndakazyunguluka akuseluka aansi kwachilundu, alimwi chilundu chakalikuyaka. Mabwe obile mapapalete aachizuminano akali mumaboko aangu.
Ndakalanga, alimwi ndakabona, mwakabisizya Jehova Leza wanu. Mwakali mwalibumbila chileza. Mwafwambaana kusowa nzila eezyo Jehova nzyakamulayilila.
Ndakabweza mabwe apapalete obile akwasowela ansi kuzwa mumaboko angu. Ndakapwachuula kunembo lyamenso aako.

Alimwi ndakavundama busyu bwangu ansi kunembo lya Jehova kwamazuba makumi one amansiku makumi oone; tendakalya chinkwa nekuba kunywa manzi, nkambo kazibi zyabo zyoonse ezyo nzibakali bachita, mukuchita oobo lwakali luuni mumenso a Jehova, aboobo mbuli kumusokola kuti anyeme.
Nkaambo ndakali yoowede alunyemo akubijilwa kupati kuli echo Jehova nchakanyemenede lyoonse atala akukunyonyoona. Pesi Jehova wakandiswiilila kuli eecho chindi alwabili.
Jehova wakanyemena Aaloni loko aboobo wakali wayanda kumunyonyoona; Ndakamukombela Aaloni akwachiindi nchicheecho.

Ndakabweza zibi zyako, ching'ombe nchwakali wapanga eecho, aakuchitenta, kuchuuma, akuchipwachuula anyika loko, kusikila chabambuli lusuko. Ndakawala lusuko lwacho mukalonga ako kaseluka kuzwa muchilundu.
Ku Tabbela, ku Maasa, aku Kkibbuloti Hatava, niwakasokola Jehova kuti abe abukali.

Eelyo Jehova nkakamugwisya kuzwa ku Kkadesyi Bbaniya aakuti, 'Kamuya kutola buvubi bwanyika eeyo njindakamupa;  mpawo mwakapapila atala amalayilile a Jehova Leza wanu, alimwi temwakasyoma nanka kuswilila kujwi lyakwe.
Mwakali kupapila atala a Jehova kuzwa kubuzuba nindakakuziba.
Aboobo ndakavundama abusyu ansi kunembo lya Jehova mumazuba ngaayo ali makkumi one, nkambo wakali waamba mbuboobo kuti uyomunyonyoona.
Ndakakomba kuli Jehova wakwe; mwami wa Jehova, utanyonyooni bantu bako nanka lukkono oolo bantu ndwakali wafutula kwinda mubupati bwako, Nikuba nduwakagwisya kuzwa ku Ijiputi kuzwa ajanza pati.
Koyibulukwa balanda bako Abbulahamu, Isaka, alimwi a Jakobo;  utalangi kulibasichinguni bwabantu  aaba, nanka kubuubi,
nanka kuchibi chabo, kuti eyi nyika kuzwa oko nkumwa katweeta iyowamba kuti, '' Nkambo Jehova takwakakonzya kubeeta munyika eeyo njakabagwisya anze kuzobajaya munkanda.''
Sena mbantu bako alimwi ndukono lwako, abo mbeakagwisya  anze anguzu zyako akutandabala kwanguzu.
Kuli eecho chiindi Jehova wakati kuli ndime, 'Bweza mabwe mapapali obile aali mbuli aakusanguna ,utante uze kuli ndime aachilundu, alimwi uchite bbokesi lyazisamu.
Ndiyoolemba aamabwe mapapali majwi aakali aamabwe mapapali  aakusanguna nguwakapwachula, alimwi uyowabika mubbokesi.'
Aboobo ndakachita bbokesi lyazisamu zyamu akasiya, alimwi ndakabweza mabwe obile mapapali aali mbuli aakusanguna alimwi ndakatanta  chilundu, nkendijisi mukuboko kwangu mabwe mapapali obile.

Wakalemba aamabwe mapapali, mbuli zyakalembendwe kusanguna, milawu iili kkumi njaakali waamba Jehova kuli nduwe aachilundu kuzwa aakati kamulilo mubuzuba bwakubungana; mpawo Jehova wakiipa kuli ndime.
Ndakachengunuka akuselela kuzwa muchilundu, akubika mabwe mapapali mubbokesi  eelyo ndindakali ndachita; oomo mwaabede, mbuli Jehova mbwaakandilayilila.''
(Bantu ba Izilayili bakeenda kuzwa ku Bbiloti Bbene Jaakani kabaya ku Mosela. Ooko Aloni nkwaakafwida, alimwi nkuko nkwaakazikilwa; Eliyeza, mwana wakwe ,wakabeleka mulimu wabupayizi mubusena bwakwe.
Kuzwa aawo bakeenda kuya ku  Gadigoda, alimwi kuzwa ku Gadigoda bakaya ku Jotibbata, nyika yatulonga twameenda.
Muchiindi eecho Jehova wakasala musyobo wa Levi kuti ubweze bbokesi lya chizuminano cha Jehova, akwiima kunembo lya Jehova akumubelekela, akulongezya bantu muzina lyakwe, mbuli sunu.
Aboobo Levi takwe chaabilo niluba lukono lwanyika antoomwe abana bakwabo; Jehova ngonguwe lukono lwakwe, mbuli Jehova Leza wenu mbwakambuula kuli nguwe.)
''Ndakakkala eechilundu mbuli kusanguna, mazuba makumi one amansiku makumi one. Jehova wakaswiilizya kulindime alakwe eecho chiindi; Jehova taakwe naali kuyanda kunyonyoona.
Jehova wakati kuli ndime, 'Nyampuka, uye kunembo  lyabantu kuti ubazulwide mulweendo lwabo; bayoonjila mpawo   bakiitole nyika njindakakonkezya kuli  bamawisi kubapa njiyo.
Lino , Izilayili , Jehova Leza wenu niinzi nchayanda kuzwa kuli ndinywe, biyo kuyoowa Jehova Leza wenu , kweenda munzila zyakwe zyoonse, kumuyanda, akumukomba Jehova Leza wenu amoyo wenu woonse,
akubamba milawu ya Jehova, ambeta zyakwe, nzindilikumulayilila sunu kazibotela ndinywe?
Amubone, kuli Jehova Leza  wenu nkokuli julu ajulu lyamajulu, inyika, azyoonse zili muli nzizyo.
Alike biyo Jehova nguwakaaba chakubotelwa mumawuso kuti abayande, alimwi nguwakamusala balunyungu lwenu ,musule lyabo, kwiinda bamwi bantu boonse, mbuli mbwachita sunu.
Aboobo amupalule lulomo lwamoyo wenu, alimwi mutayumyi  nsingo zyenu,
nkaambo Jehova Leza wenu, ngu Leza wabaleza alimwi uuyoosya, uutalangi chinso chamuntu alimwi tatambuli masinka mulomo.
Uubeteka chamulawu kuli ooyo uutachikwe wisi amukamufu, alimwi utondezya luyando kumuzwakule akumupa chakulya azisamo.
Aboobo muyande muzwakule, nkaambo mwakali bazwakule munyika ya Ijipiti.
Muyoyoowa Jehova Leza wenu; we ngumuyookomba. kuli  nguwe nkumweelede kujatilila, alimwi ezina lyakwe ndimuyookonka aalyo.
Ngonguwe ntembawuzyo zyenu, alimwi ngu Leza wenu, wakamuchitila eezi zintu zipati azintu ziyoosya, eezyo zyakabonwa ameso eenu.
Bamawuso bakiinka baselukila mu Ijipiti kabali bantu bali makumi aali musanu amakumi aabili; lino Jehova Leza wenu wakamuvuzya mbuli nyenyeezi zyamujulu.
Nkikaako muyoyanda Jehova Leza wanu akubamba lyoonse milayizyo yakwe, milawu yakwe, mbeta zyakwe, malayilile aakwe.
Boona kuti tandili kwambuula kubana banu pe, aabo batakwe nibakaziba na kuti kubona chisyubulo  cha Jehova Leza wanu, bupati bwakwe, janza lyakwe lilaanguzu, na luboko lwakwe lutandabikindwe,
zitondeezyo azyiito eezyo nzyakachita aakati kaba Ijipiti kuli Falo, Mwaami wa Ijipiti, akunyika yakwe yoonse.

Takukwe nibakabona eecho nchakachita kulibasilumamba ba Ijipiti, kumbong'olo zyabo, na kunkalaki zyabo, ibiyeni mbakachita manzi aá Lwizi lwa Matete akubavumba nibakali kumutobela, alimwi mbubonya Jehova mbwakabanyonyoona akusikila  sunu,
na eecho nchakamuchitila munkanda kusikila musike kuli boobu busena.

Taakwe nebakabwene eecho Jehova nchakali wachita kuli Datani a Abbilamu, bana balombe ba Eliyabbu mwana mulombe wa Lubbeni, kuti nyika yakajula buti mulomo wayo akubamena, bamasuwa babo,matente aabo, azyoonse zipona zyakabatobela, aakati kaba Izilayili boonse.
Pesi meso aanu akabona milimo mipati yoonse ya Jehova eeyo njakachita.
Nkikaako mubambe malayilile aayo woonse ngindookumulayilila sunu, kuti ngamulasima, akunjila mukati akubweza nyika ooko nkumuli kuya kuyooyibweza,
akuti ngamulavuzya mazuba aanu munyika eeyo Jehova njakakonkezya kumataata aanu kwiipa mbabo anyungu zyabo, nyika ikunka malili abuchi.
Nkaambo nyika, ooko nkumulikunjila kuyooyibweza, tiili mbuli nyika ya Ijipiti pe, kuzwa ooko nkumwakazwa, ooko nkumwali kubyala nseke akwiitilila amawulu aanu, mbuli chilili chazisyu;
pesi nyika, ooko nkomuyoobwiinda kuyoobweza,

ninyika yazilundu, amasena, alimwi inywa mvula yamumajulu, ninyika eeyo Jehova Leza wanu njabamba; meso a Jehova Leza wanu akkede kaali aalinjiyo, kuzwa kumatalikilo kwamunyaka kusika kumamanino aamunyaka
Ziyoochitika, na mukaswiilile chakusungwaala kumalayilile aayo ngindamulayilila sunu, kuyanda Jehova Leza wanu akumubelekela chamoyo wanu woonse amiyeeyo yanu yoonse,
kuti ndiyoopa mvula yanyika yanu muchiindi chayo, mvula yakutanguna amvula yakusyaalila, kuti nga mulatebula zilyo zyanu, wayini mupya, amafuta aanu.
Ndiyoopa sokwe kumyuunda yanu lyang'ombe zyanu, alimwi muyoolya akukkuta.
Amukaliswiilile nubeni kuchitila kuti myoyo yanu itakeenwi, akufutata akukomba bamwi baleza akubakotamina;

kuchitila kuti bukali bwa Jehova butakayaki kulindinywe; akuchitila kuti atakajali majulu kuti kutayoobi mvula, almwi nyika itakayoozyali michelo yayo, akuchitila kuti mukalobe chakufwambaana kuzwa kunyika mbotu eeyo Jehova njalikumupa.
Nkikaako londola majwi aangu mumoyo wako amumuuya, mwaange mbuli chindeezyo aa maanza aanu, akwaaleka abe mbuli chiibalusyo aakati kameso aanu.
Muyowayiisya kubana banu akwambuula aatala angawo nimukkede mung'anda, nimweenda munzila, nimoona ansi, animubuka.
Muyoowalemba kuzikunguzyo  zyamaanda aanu akumilyango yamiinzi yanu,
kuti mazuba aanu amazuba abana banu akawungizigwe munyika eeyo Jehova njakakonkezya kuli basikale banu kubapa kufumbwa majulu kali aatala anyika.
Nkaambo na mwalondola chamaanu milayizyo yoonse eeyi njindili kumulayilila, kuti mwiichite, kuyanda Jehova Leza wanu, kweenda munzila zyakwe zyoonse, akujatilila kulinguwe,
eelyo Jehova uyootandila aanze zyoonse zisi kuzwa kunembo lyanu, mpawo muyonyanzya zisi zipati alimwi zili aanguxu kwiinda ndinywe.
Busena boonse ooko ndyato zyakumawulu aanu nkuziyoolyata buyooba bwanu; kuzwa kunkanda kusika ku Lebbanoni, kuzwa kumulonga, Yufuleti, kusika kulwizi lwakumbo uyooba mugaano wanu.
Takukwe muntu uyookonzya kwiima kunembo lyanu. Jehova Leza wanu uyoobika buyoofu bwandinywe akuyoowa kwandinywe aatala anyika yoonse eeyo njimuyoolyata, mbuli mbaamba kulindinywe.
Langa, ndabika kunebo lyanu chilongezyo alutuko;
chilongezyo na mwaswiilila milayizyo ya Jehova Leza wanu eeyo njindili kumulayilila sunu,
alutuko, na temwasiilila milayizyo Jehova Leza wanu, pesi muchenguluke kuzwa kunila eeyonjindamulayilila sunu, kuya butobela bamwi baleza aabo mbumutana kuziba.
Ziyoochitika, Jehova Leza wanu nayomuleta munyika njimuyoobweza, kuti muyobika chilongezyo aa Chilundu cha Gelizimu, alutuko aa Chilundu cha Ebbalu.
Sena tazili kutala lya Jodani, kumbo kwakumbo kwa nzila, munyika yaba Kkenani aabo bakkala mu Alabba, kutala kulengene aa Giligalu, kulubazu lwamasamu aa Mole?
Nkaambo mweelede kuzubukila mutala lya Jodani kuti mukanjile kuyoobweza nyika eeyo Jehova leza wanu njaliikumupa, akwiibweza akukkala mulinjiyo.
Muyoobamba malayilile ambeta eezyo nzindabika kunembo lyanu sunu
Eyi njemilayizyo ambeta eyo njemwelede kuyobamba munyika eeyo Jehova, Leza wamawuso, njamupa kuti mwibaambe, kumazuba woonse ngemuyopona munyika.
Nkasimpe muyomwaya masena woonse oko zisi eezyo nzimuyotanda nkuzyali kukomba ba Leza baabo, muzilundu zilamfu, mutulundu, aansi amusamu woonse kamweemvwe.

Muyotyola zipayililo zyabo aansi, kupwaya kuba tunini misemo yabo yamabwe, akuumpa matanda aabo a Asela. Mwelede kugonka zikozyano zibezedwe zyaba Leza babo ansi akumwaya izina lyabo kuzwa kubusena bwabo.
Tamukoyo komba oobo peJehoha Leza wanu.
Pele kubusena oobo Jehova Leza wenu mbwayosala kuzwa kumisyobo yoonse yanu kuti abikke zina lyakwe, kuyoba kubusena oko nkwakkala, alimwi nkuko nkomwelede kwinka.
Nkuko nkumwelede kweeta zipayizyo zyenu zyakuumpa, azituuzyo zyenu, azyekkumi zyenu, azipo zichitwa amaboko enu, abana batanzi bang'ombe zyanu abutanga bwambelele.
Nkukoko nkomuyolya kunembo lya Jehova Leza wenu akubotelwa kuli zyonse eezyo nzimwabikka kuboko kwanu kuli nzizyo, nywebo abesuwa lyanu oko Jehova Leza wanu nkwaka mulongezya.
Tamukoyochita pe zintu zyoonse ezyo nzetulokuchita ano sunu;  lino woonse unoyochita kufumbwa chiluleme kumenso akwe;
mbukunga tamuna kusika kukulyokezya, kulukono oolo Jehova Leza wanu ndwayokupa.

Pesi nimuyo yinka mutala lya Jolodani akuyokkala munyika eyo Jehova Leza wenu njamuchitila kuti nywebo mwikone, mpawo uyomupa kulyokezya kuzwa kuli basinkondonyokwe boonse bamu zyungulukide, kuti mukakkale chakwangunuka.

Elyo kubusena oko Jehova Lezan wenu mbwayosala kuti abike lyakwe kupona nkukooko muyoleta zyoonse nzindimuku mulayilila: zipayizyo zyanu zyakuumpa, zituuzyo zyanu, zyekkumi zyanu, azipo zitentwa akuboko kwanu, azyoonse zipo zyazikonke zyenu zibotu eezyo nzimuyokonka kuli Jehova.

Muyobotelwa kunembo lya Jehova wanu - nywebo, bana benu balombe, bana banu bachisimbi, bazike benu balumi, bazike benu banakazi, aba Levi bali akkati kamilyango yanu, nkambo nkambo tabakwe nibakalachabilo na lukono akati kanu.
Swililisya loko lwako kuti utakapayili zipayizyo zyako zyakuumpa kufumbwa kubusena mbunya;
Pesi kuusena oobo Jehova mbwayosala akati kawuumwi wamisyobo yanu eeyo njemuyo payizya zipayizyo zyakuumpa, alimwi oko nkumuyochita zyoonse ezyo nzindamulayilila.

Aboobo, muyojaya akulya banyama akati kamilyango yenu yoonse, mbuli mbomuyanda, kukutambula zyoolwe zya Jehova Leza wenu zyaboonse ezyo nzyamupa; bantu batasalali abasalala boonse belede kulya nchicho, banayama bali mbuli mbabala ansya.
Pesi tamwelede kulya bulowa; muyobutila aansi anyika mbuli meenda.

Mukati kamilyango yenu tamwelede kulya kuzwa kuli chakkumi chazilyo zyenu, wayini wenu mupya, mafuta enu, na mwana mutanzi wabutanga bwang'ombe zyenu na imbelele; mpawo tamwelede kulya kufumbwa nyama njimupayizya ayimwi yazikonke ezyo nzemuchita nekuba ezyo zyakupa zipo zyakuyanda nikuba chipo nchiweta akuboko kwako.

Muchiindi chakuti, uyolya kunembo lya Jehova Leza wako kubusena oobo Jehova Leza wako mbwayosala - webo, mwana wako mulombe, mwana wako musimbi, mulanda wako mwalumi, mulanda wako mwanakazi, amu Levi uli akati kamulyango wako; uyobotelwa kunembo lya Jehova Leza wako atala azyoonse nzyobika kuboko kwako.
Amuswilile loko lwenu kuti mutamufutatili mu Levi na kamuchipona munyika yenu.
Na Jehoava Leza wenu wakomezya migaano yenu, mbuli mbwaka syomezya, alimwi wamba kuti, 'Mebo ndiyolya nyama; nkambo kakuyandisya kulya nyama, ulalya nyama, mbuli muyeyo wako loko mbuyandisya.

Na busena oob Jehova Leza wako mbwasala kubika zina lyakwe kakuli kule loko kuzwa kulinduwe, eelyo uyojaya zimwi kuzwa kubutanga akumbelele eezyo Jehova nzyakakupa, mbuli mbundakakulayilila; ulalya mukati kumilyango yako, mbuli miyeyo yako mbwiyandisya.
Mbuli mbabalala ansya zilaligwa, aboobo uyolya nzizyo; bantu batasalali abasalala belede kulya kwelene.
akaupela mube akasimpe kakuti mutalti pe bulowa, nkambo bulowa mbuumi; tamwelede kulya buumi anyama.
Tamwelede kwiilya; muyotila aansi munyika mbuli meenda.
Tamukayilyi pe, kuchitila kuti zikakwendele obotu abana benu batobela andinywe, nimuyo chita zyelede kumenso a Jehova.
Pesi kuzintu ezyo zya Jehova nzolazyo azipo zyako zyazikonke - uyozibweza ezi mpawo winke kubusena Jehova mbwasala.
Oko muyopayizya zituuzyo zyakuumpa, nyama abulowa, achipayililo cha Jehova Leza wenu; bulowa bwazipayizyo zyanu buyotilwa achipayililo cha Jehova Leza wenu, alimwi muyolya nyama.
Amulangisisye akuswilila kumajwi woonse ngendimuku mulayilila, kuti nywebo zikamwendele kabotu abana benu balikunembo lyanu kwalyoonse, nimunoli mwachita zibotu aziluleme mumenso a Jehova Leza wenu.
Na Jehova Leza wenu wapakunya zisi kuzwa kulindinywe, na mwayinka mumo kukuyobatanda, mpawo mwakubatanda akukkala munyaka yabo,

uchenjele lwako omwini kuti utakajayigwi mukutobela mbabo, nibanoli banynyoonwa kuzwa kuli ndinywe -  kucheegwa mukuyandula ba Leza babo, mukubuzya, 'Zikomba biyeni ba Leza bazyo zisi eezi? Ndiyochita mbubonya.'

Tamwelede kukomba Jehova Leza wenu munzila eeyi, mbokunga choonse echo nchisesemyo kuli Jehova, zintu ezyo nzyosulide - bakazichita eezi abaleza babo; alubo bakawuumpa bana babo balombe abasimbi mumulilo kuba baleza babo.
Kufumbwa nchindamulayilila, amuswilile nchicho. Mutayungizyi nekuba kugwisya kulinchicho.
Na kwabuka musinsimi aakati kenu, na sikulota maloto, mpawo na wamupa chitondeezyo na chigambyo,
alimwi na chitondeezyo na chigambyo chizulila, pesi waamba kulindinywe akwaamba kuti, 'Atutobele baleza bambi, aabo mbumutezi, alimwi aatubakombe,'
mutaswiilili majwi aamusinsimi ooyo, na kuli sikulota maloto; nkaambo Jehova Leza wanu ulookumweezya kuti aazibe na mulamuyanda Jehova Leza wanu amoyo woonse amiyeeyo yanu yoonse.
Muyootobela Jehova Leza wanu, kumulemeka, kulondola milayizyo yakwe, akulemeka jwi lyakwe, alimwi muyoomukomba akunamatila kulinguwe.

Ooyo musinsimi na simalota maloto ooyo uyoojayigwa, nkaambo wambuula chabupapi aatala a Jehova Leza wako, ooyo wakamugwisya kuzwa kunyika ya Ijipiti, alimwi wakamunununa kuzwa kung'anda yabwaange. Ooyo musinsimi uyanda kumugwisya aanze aanzila mulinjiyo Jehova Leza wanu njakamulayilila kuti mweendele. Nkikaako amugwisye bubi kuzwa aakati kenu.

Twambe kuti mukulana wako, mwana mulombe wabanyoko, na mwana wako mulombe, na mwana wako musmbi, na mwanakazi alaamoyo wako, na mweenzinyokwe uuli mbuli miyeeyo yako, wakweena chakusisikizya akwaamba kuti, 'Atweende akuyookomba baleza bambi aabo mbotezi, kuba nduwe na basikale bako-
kufumbwa babaleza babantu aabo bakuzyungulukide, aafwifwi anduwe,na bali kule anduwe, kuzwa kumagolelo amwi enyika kuyoosika kulaamwimagolelo enyika.'
Tamweelede kumupa na kumuswiilila, alimwi tamweelede kuzumizya liso lyenu kuti limufwide luzyalo, alimwi tamweelede kumusiya na kumusisa.
Pesi, nchobeni muyoomujaya; kuboko kwako kuyooba kutaanzi aalinguwe kukumujaya, mpawo kuzwa waawo maboko aabantu boonse.
Muyoomutulula aamabwe mane aafwe, nkaambo wakeezya kumutantamuna kuzwa kuli Jehova Leza wanu, ooyo wakamugwisya kuzwa kunyika ya Ijipiti, kuzwa kung'anda yabwaange.
Boonse ba Izilayili bayoomvwa akuyoowa, mpawo tabakoyooyindilila kunembo pe kabachita bubi bwamusyobo ooyu aakati kabo.
Kuti wamvwa umwi muntu uwamba aatala aachimwi chemuunzi wako, ooyo Jehova Leza wako ngwakupa kuti ukkale mumo:
Bamwi batobeli babubi bazwa aakati kenu akugwisya bantu bamiinzi yabo akwaamba kuti, 'Atweende alimwi tukakombe baleza bambi aabo mbimutazi pe.
Mpawo mulalingula bukamboni, kuyanduula, akubuzisisya loko. Nimujana kuti nisimpe akukkutisikana kuti nchintu chisesemya chachitikana aakati kenu, eelyo mubaachakuchita.
Inchobeni muyoolwisya bantu bamumuunzi ooyo ooyo abbazu lyapanga, muyoowupalazya chakuumanisya abantu boonse balimukati kawo, antoomwe azivuubwa,  abbazu lyapanga.
Muyoozibungika zyoonse zibi kuzwa kulinzizyo mukati kanzila mpawo ndiyootenta muunzi, antoomwe azintu zilimukati- zya Jehova Leza wanu. Muunzi uyooba matongo kwalyoonse; tuyelede kuyakululwa lubo pe.

Taakwe kwazeezyo zintu zibambilidwe kunyonyoonwa ziyelede kukkala mumaboko aako. Eechi cheelede kuba mbuboobo, kuchitila kuti Jehova alijosye kulunyemo lwakwe luyoosya, akutondeezye luzyalo, abe aaluyando aalindinywe, akumuyungizya mumweelwe, mbubonya mbuli mbwakakonkezya kuli bamawuso.
Uyoochita eechi nkaambo ulikuswiilila kujwi lya Jehova Leza wako, kulondola malayilile aakwe woonse aayo ngendokumulayilila sunu, kuti muchite eecho chiluleme mumeso aa Jehova Leza wanu.
Mulibantu ba Jehova Laza wanu. Mutali temuni lwanu nekuba kulinyoola kumenso anu nkambo kabaafu.
Mbuli mbomuli musyobo uli afwafi a Jehova Leza wanu, mpawo Jehova wakamusala nywebo kuti mube bantu mbuli muchimo chakwe, kwinda bantu boonse baali ajulu anyika.
Tamwelede kulya chintu chisesemya.
Nzeezi zinyama nzimwelede kulya: Imusune, imbelele, ampongo,
a sinsya, antomwe a koonze, injelele, lwengu amunyumbwe.
ulelede kulya kufumbwa munyama ulansumba zyanzeene, eezi zili, ansumba zibili zyanzeene, nzezyo ziselula.
Nekubaboobo, tamwelede kulya banyama baselula nakuti balansumba zibili zyanzeene: inkamela, kasulwe achibila nkambo, zilaselula pesi insumba tazyanzeene pe kuli nduwe, tazisalali pe kulinduwe.
Ingulube tisalali kuli nduwe lwako nkambo ilenzene insumba pesi tiseluli pe; ilisofwede kulinduwe. Toyelede kulya nyama yangulube, amitumba yayo tamwelede kwiguma pe.
Kuli eezi zintu zili mumaanzi mwelede kulya: kufumbwa chintu chijisi tuyambyo amaamba;
pesi kufumbwa chintu chitajisi tuyambyo amaamba; chilisofwede.
Boonse bayuni basalala balaligwa.
Pesi aba bayuni mbimutelede kulya mbaba: chuungwe, makubi a syatoongo.
lubanze a biimbe, amisyobo yonse yamagumbe.
Toyelede kulya kufumbwa musyobo wachikwangwala,
impoo, basikoolyo, inyengenge, kufumbwa basikoze bamisyobo misyobo, chipolo,
katumba kanini, tumba utuba,
sikooze akabinda.
Toyelede kulya itongola, inkolekole, ing'anga yabayuni a simudima.
Zyonse kaziwuluka, zilisofwede kulundinywe: tazyelede kulyigwa.
Mwelede kulya zyonse zisalala zintu ziwuluka.

Tamwelede kulya kufumbwa chilifwida; amupe bazwakule baali mumadolopo, ikuti kulya mbabo; nakuti muzizye bazwakule. Mbumuli musyobo ulafwifwi a Jehova Leza wanu. Utabizyi kana kampongo mumalili anyina.
Ulelede kupa chakkumi kuli zyonse nzyotebula, eezyo nzyogwisya mumunda munyaka amunyaka.

Uyelede kulya kunembo lya Jehova Leza wako, kubusena obo bwasalwa bwakuswananina, ichakkumi chazilyo, achamisansa, achamafuta, abana bakutanguna mutanga amubutanga bwanu; ikuti mwiiye kulemeka Jehova Leza wanu kwalyoonse.
Ikuti lwendo ndulamfu loko kulinduwe tokonzyi kulubweza, nkambo kabusena Jehova Leza wako mbwasala bwakuswananina kuti kabuli kule kuzwa kulinduwe, mpawo eelyo Jehova Leza nakulongezya webo,
ulachincha chipo chako chibe mali, sunga mali mukuboko kwako, akwinka kubusena mbwayosala Jehova Leza wako.
Ooko nkoyobelesya imali kufumbwa nchoyanda: ng'ombe, imbelele, wayini ukola kufumbwa, nakuti kufumbwa nchonoyanda.  Mpawo muyolya kubusyu bwa Jehova Leza wanu akubotelwa, inywe abasing'anda yenu.
Ba Levi bali mumilyango - mutabalubi, mbuli mbubatakwe chabilo nikuba lukono andinywe.
Kumamanino aminyaka yotatwe munoyeta kwalyonse zyonse zipo zyenu zyakkumi nzemijana mumunyaka nguwo, amukazibambe mumilyango yanu;

aba Levi, nkambo tabakwepe chabilo nikuba lukono andinywe, ibazwakule, abamuchaala, bamukabafu bali mumilyango yenu, balasika kuzolya akukkuta. Amuchite oobu kuchitila kuti Jehova Leza wenu amulongezye kumilimo yoonse yamaboko aanu njimuchita.
Kumamanino kwamyaaka yoonse yamusanu ayibili, weleede kuzima zikwelete.

Eeyi ninzila yakulekelela: Woonse sikukolota uyoozima  eecho nchakakweleta kuli simabambanwa wakwe, takwe kuyochisesa pe kuzwa kulisimabambanwa wakwe na mukulana wakwe nkaambo kuzimwa kwazikwelete a Jehova kwakaambilizigwa.
Kuzwa kumweenzu weleede kuchisesa, pesi kufumbwa chako chili amunyooko wako luboko lwako lwelede kwaangunuka.
Nekuba boobo, takweelede kuba muchete akati kanu (nkaambo Jehova nkasimpe uyomulongezya munyika njamupa mbuli lukono kuti ikabe yanu) ,
na biyo mwaswilizisya changuzu kujwi lya Jehova Leza wanu, kubamba yoonse milazyo eeyo njindili kumulayilila sunu.
Nkaambo Leza wanu uyomulongezya , mbuli mbakamusyomezya; muyookolotosya  zisi zyiingi, pesi tamukoyokoleta; muyoyendelezya zisi zyiingi, pesi lwabo tabakamwendelezyi pe.
Na kuli muntu ukweleta akati kanu, umwi wabunyina, uli akati kamilyango munyika yanu eeyo Jehova Leza wanu njamupa,
pesi choonzyo weleede kujula luboko lwako kulinguwe alimwi choonzyo weleede kumukweleta nzyabula.

Kuchenjelela kuti utabi amuyeeyo mubi mumoyo wako, akwamba kuti, 'Mwaka wamusanu ayibili mwaaka wakwangununa uli aafwaafwi, kuti utakabi muunyu kwiinda kumunyoko muchete akutamupa chimwi, ulakonzya kulila kuli jehova  aatala anduwe alimwi chilakonzya kuba chibi chako.
Choonzyo weleede kumupa, amoyo wako tuyelede kumupa kunsyoloka, nkaambo musule lyacheechi Jehova Leza wako uyokulongezya kumilimu yako yoonse amuli zyoonse nzubikka jaanza lyako kulinzinzyo.
Nkaambo bacheta tabakoyooleka kubawo munyika, nkikaako ndakulayilila akwaamba kuti, 'Choonzyo weleede kujula luboko lwako kumunyoko, kuli baaboo bako babulide munyika yako.'

Na munyoko , mu Hibbulu mwaalumi na mu Hibbulu mwanakazi wawuzigilwa nduwe akukubelekela kwamwaaka musanu awumwi, mpawo mumwaka wamusanu ayibili weleede kumuleka ayeende chakwangumuka kuzwa kuli nduwe.
Na wamuleka weenda chakwangunuka kuzwa kulinduwe, utamuleki ayinke chinkwamaanza.
Weleede kumupa achalwangunuko kuzwa kubutanga bwako, kuzilyo zyako zyakuchibbulilo. Mbuli Jehova Leza wako mbakulongezya, welede kumupa.
Mweleede kuyeya kuti mwakali bazike munyika ya Ijipita, akuti Jehova Leza wakamunununa; nkikaako ndikumulayilila sunu kuti muchite eechi.
Kuyooba kuti na wati kulinduwe, 'Tandikozozwa kulinduwe,' nkaambo ulakuyanga ang'anda yako, akaambo kabuti ulikabotu anduwe,
eelyo weleede kubwezya chidonkwezyo akudonkola kutwi kwakwe kusika kwaba mulyaango, eelyo uyooba mulanda wako kwabuumi. Welede kuchita mbubonya kumulanda wako mwanakazi.

Chitabi aanga chiyumu kulindime kuti ayinke chalwangunuko kuzwa kulinduwe, nkaambo wakakubelekela kwamyaaka musanu awumwi akukupa zidulwidwe mbuli zyamuntu zitambidwe. Jehova Leza wako uyokulongezya  kulizyoonse nzuchita.
Boonse bana beenze bataanzi bangombe  abambelele zyanu mwelede kuzisalila Jehova Leza wanu. Tamukoyochita mulimu abana bataanzi  bangombe zyanu na kugela booya bwabana bataanzi bambelele zyanu.
Muleleede kulya bana bataanzi kunembo lya Jehova Leza wanu mwaka amwaaka kubusena Jehova nkwayosala, nywebo abang'anda banu.
Na kakali akampenda- mbuli chitondezyo, na kakali kalema, nekuba koofu, nekuba kali akamwi kampenda kali buti tamweelede kukampayizya kuli Jehova Leza wanu.
Muyoolya  mumilyaango yanu, batasalali abasalala bantu bali boobo beelede kukalya, mbuli mbumunga, mulalya mbabala na moondwe.
Ibiyo tamweelede kulya bulowa bwako; mweleede kutila bulowa bwako aansi aanyika mbuli maanzi.
Amubambe mwezi wa Abbibbi, alimwi mubambe Pasika kuli Jehova Leza wanu, nkambo mumwezi wa Abbibbi Jehova Leza wanu wakamugwisya mu Ijiputi chindi chamansiku.
Muyotuula Pasika kuli Jehova Leza wanu azimwi mbelele ang'ombe mubusena obo Jehova mbwayosala mbuli busena bwakupayilila.

Muyolya chinkwa chitakwe buswezyo pe andilyo, mazuba musanu aabili kamunoyolya chinkwa chitakwe busweezyo andilyo, chinkwa chamapenzi; nkambo mwakazwa munyika ya Ijiputi chakufwambanisigwa. Amukachite ezi mazuba oonse abuumi bwanu kuchitila kuti mukayeye buzuba elyo nimwakazwa munyika ya Ijiputi.
Takwe busweezyo buyelede kuboneka akati kanu mumigano yoonse mumazuba aali musanu aabili; nekuba nyama eyo njemutula chiindi chagoko mubuzuba bwakusanguna iyoosyala kusikila chifumo.
Tamukonzyi kutuula chipayizyo cha Pasika pe kuli kufumbwa mulyango wegunzi eelyo Jehova Leza wanu ndyamupa.

Anukuti, mukatuule abusena obo Jehova Leza wanu mbwayomusalila mbuli busena bwakupayila. Oko muyochita zituuzyo zya Pasika chindi chagoko izuba kaliya kukubbila, kuchindi chamunyaka nchemwakazwa aacho ku Ijiputi.
Mulelede kuchiyooka akuchilya abusena obo Jehova Leza wanu mbwayosala; chifumo muyobweda kumatente anu.
Kwamazuba ali musanu abumwi muyolya chinkwa chitakwe buswezyo; mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili kuyoba muswangano usinizizye wa Jehova Leza wanu; elyo izuba tamwelede kuchita mulimu pe.
Muyobala imviki zili musanu azibili; kuzwa kuchindi nchemuyotalika kutyola maila muleelede kutalika kubala imviki zili musanu azibili.
Mulelede kubamba Pobwe lya Mviki lya Jehova Leza wanu azipo zyakulimvwida mumaboko anu kuti mukape, mbuli Jehova Leza wanu mbwamupede choolwe.

Muyobotelwa kunembo lya Jehova Leza wanu - Inywe, bana banu balombe, bana banu basimbi, balanda banu banakazi, balanda banu balumi, mu Levi oyo ulimumilyango yegunzi lyenu, amwenzu, abamuchaala, alimwi aba mukabafu bali akati kenu, abusena obo Jehova Leza wanu mbwayosala kuba bwakwe.
Muyoyeya kuti mwakali bazike mu Ijiputi, mulelede kuchenjela akubamba ezi mbeta.
Mulelede kubamba i Pobwe lya Zilawu kwamazuba ali musanu aabili musule lyakubungania zilyo kuzwa kuzipolelo akuzidinino zyenu zya wayini.
Muyosekelela chindi chepobwe lyanu - inywe, bana banu balombe, bana banu basimbi, balanda banu balumi, abalanda banu banakazi, ba Levi, abeenzu, abamuchaala aba mukabafu bali mumilyango yanu.

Kwamazuba musanu aabili mwelede kubamba pobwe lya Jehova Leza wanu abusena Jehova mpaatakasale, nkambo Jehova Leza wanu uyomulongezya muzilyo amumilimo yoonse yamanza anu, alimwi melelede kubotelwa chakumaninina.

Zyiindi zyotatwe mumunyaka balumi benu boonse baleleede kuboneka kunembo lya Jehova Leza wanu aabusena obo mbwakalisalila: aa Pobwe lyachinkwa chitakwe busweezyo, aa Pobwe lya Mviki, alimwi a Pobwe lya Zilawu. Takwe uyoboneka kunembo lya Jehova nkanoli chinkwamanza;
anukuti, umwi awumwi uyoopa mbuli mbwakonzya, kuchitila kuziba choolwe echo Jehova Leza wanu chamupa.
Muleelede kubika babetesi abasilutwe mumyuunzi yanu yoonse eyo Jehova Leza wanu njalikumupa; bayosalwa kuzwa kuli umwi awumwi wamisyobo yanu, alimwi balelede kubeteka bantu alubeta lululeme.
Tamwelede kugwisya bantu chamanguzu, tamwelede kutondezya lusalulo kana kubweza masinkamulomo nkambo masinkamulomo alofwazya menso abasongo akupilingania makani abaluleme.
Mulelede kutobela bululami, bululami luzutu abulikke, kuchitila kuti atene mwalikunopona akuyokona inyika eyo Jehova Leza wanu njalokumupa.
Mutakalibambili lwanu nobeni chi Ashela, kufumbwa musyobo wasamu, kunze kwachipayililo, cha Jehova Leza wanu nchemuyolipangila nobeni.
Tamwelede nikuba kulibambila nobeni musemu wamabwe ngwasulide Jehova Leza wanu.
Toyelede kupa chipayizyo kuli Jehova Leza wako musune niiba imbelele ilakampenda naa chimwi chiibi aali njiyo nkambo  chiliboobo chisesemyo kuli Jehova Leza wako.
Naa kwajanika akati kanu, mumanjililo amadolopo eenu awo Jehova Leza wenu ngalikumupa, kufumbwa mwalumi naba mwanakazi uuchita bubi mumenso aa Jehova Leza wanu akubusizya chizuminano chakwe,
Kufumbwa wakiinka kuyokoomba bamwi baleza akuyobakotamina, do mbuzuba, na mwezi, nikuba do chilengwaanzi chakujulu - takwe nchindakalatilila
- alimwi naa mwazyambilwa ezi, na kuti mwazimvwa, eelyo mwelede kubuzisisya. Na kaali masimpe abwini kuti ayo malweza aali boobo akachitika muli Izilayeli, echi nchimwelede kuchita.
Mwelede kumweeta oyo mwalumi nanka mwanakazi, wachita chibi echi, kumanjililo aamadolopo eenu, oyo mwalumi lwakwe nanka mwanakazi, mwelede kumufusa mabwe mane afwe.
Kujwi lyabakamboni bobile, nibaba bakamboni botatwe, oyo welede kufwa ngajiigwe; pele kujwi lyakamboni umwi biyo toyelede kujiigwa pe.
Jaanza lyabakamboni lyelede kuba ndilyo taanzi kumujaya, alimwi musule kulatobelamaanza abantu boonse, aboobo muyogwisya bubi akati kenu.

Na kuti kwabuka kambo kakuyumina kukabeteka - atutedi amwi nkabujayi nakuti kufwa kwamuntu antenda kotayandi kumujaya, kuchelelo chawumwi muntu achelelo chawumbi, naa kuti makani akuchisa umwi kwaba kupiyana kwatwambo kumanjililo amadolopo eenu, naa kwaba boobo welede kutanta kubusena obo Jehova Leza wako mbwayosala mbuli chikombelo chakwe chisalala.
Welede kuya kumupayizi, walunyungu lwa Levi, akumubetesi utanojisi bwendelezi muleecho chiindi; ukayanduule lugwasyo lwabo, aboobo bayokupa kukosola kwabo
Eelyo welede kuchita mbuli mbubakwambila kuti uchite, kubusena obo Jehova mbwayosala. Uchenjele kuchita zyoonse nzibakakuyiisya.
Tobela mulawu ngubakakuyiisya, alimwi uchite mbuli kusala nkobakupa. Utaleyi kuzwa kuleezyo nzibakwambila, kuchilisyo nikuba kochimwensi.

Kufumbwa muntu uuchita chakasampusampu, mukutamuswilila mupayizi oyo uyendelezya kunembo lya Jehova Leza wako, nikuba kutateleela mubetesi - oyo muntu ngusikufwa, muyoogwisya bubi kuzwa kuli Izilayeli.
Boonse bantu bayeleede kumvwa akuyoowa, alimwi batakachiti limbi nchiito zyaka sampu - sampu.
Nimuyosika kunyika Jehova Leza wenu njamupa, alimwi nimuyoyivuba  akutalika kukomena mulinjiyo, elyo, mukatedi, 'Ndiyolibikila mwaami eetala lyangu, mbubonya mbuli zisi zindizyungulukide;

Eelyo nchobeni mwelede kuyolibikila etala lyenu mwaami oyo Jehova Leza wenu ngwayosala. Mwelede kuyolibikila mwaami eetala lyanu umwi kuzwa kuli babunyina banu. Mutakabiki muzwakule, uutali munyooko eetala lyenu.
Pele atalivuzizyi mabbiza mwiini, na kuchita kuti bantu bajokele ku Ijiputi kuchitila kuti avuzye mabbiza, nkambo Jehova wakamba kuti kuli ndinywe, 'Tamuchiyobweedi limbi oko pe.
Tayelede kulitolela banakazi biingi pe, kuchitila kuti moyo wakwe utaleeyi. Tayelede kuliyobweda nsiliva angolida nyiingi pe.
Awo nayokkala aachuno chabwami bwakwe, ngakalilembele mwini mumagwalo oyu mulawu, kuzwa kumulawu uuli kunembo lyabapayizi, abo bali ba Levi.

Ilugwalo lulembedwe mulawu welede kukkalalo alimwi welede kubala mulindulo mazuba aabumi bwakwe oonse, kuchitila kuti ayiiye kulemeka Jehova Leza wakwe, nkokuti akonzye kubamba majwi woonse aamulawu oyu amalayilile aya kuti aachite.

Welede kuzichita eezi kuchitila kuti moyo wakwe utalisumpuli kwinda bana bakwabo, alimwi nkokuti ataleyi kuzwa kumilawu, kutozya kululyo nikuba kochimweensi, kuchitila kuti alilansizye mazuba mubwendelezi bwakwe, ilwakwe mwini alunyungu lwakwe akati ka Izilayeli.
Bapayizi, kabali ba Levi, alimwi amukowa woonse wa Levi, tabakayobi ancimpanzi nikuba lukono aamwi a Izilayeli; baleelede kulya zipayizyo zya Jehova zichitwa amulilo mbuli lukono lwabo.
Tabeelede kuba alukono aakati kabananyina; Jehova ngonguwe lukono lwabo, mbuli mbakaamba kulimbabo.
Eechi nchicho chaabilo chipegwa ku bapayizi, chipegwa kulimbabo kuzwa kubantu aabo bapa zipayizyo, nikuba kube musune na mbelele: ikkuko, maseya aabili, alimwi azyamukati.
Michelo mitanzi yazilyo zyanu, ya wayini wanu mupya, alimwi amafuta anu, alimwi aboya butanzi bwambelele zyanu, muleelede kumupa.
Nkaambo Jehova Leza wanu wakamusala kuzwa aakati kamikowa yanu yoonse kukwiimikila kukubeleka muzina lya Jehova, wenya abana bakwe balombe kwalyoonse.
Na mu Levi wasika kuzwa kuli limwi  lyama dolopo anu kuzwa mu Izilayeli yoonse kuzwa oko nkwakkala, alimwi walombozya a moyo wakwe woonse kusika kubusena Jehova mbwatasale,
mpawo uleelede kubeleka muzina lya Jehova Leza wakwe mbuli boonse bananyina ba Levi mbubachita, aabo bayimikila oko kunembo lya Jehova.
Baleelede kuba azimpanzi zyeelene ku kulya, kutali ezyo zizwa kukuuzya kwalukono lwampuli yakwe.
Eelyo mwakusika munyika eyo Jehova Leza wako njaayokupa, towelede kwiiya kulemeka zisesemyo zya zisi eezyo pe,

takweelede kujanika aakati kanu naba umwi upayilila mwana wakwe mulombe na mwana wakwe musimbi mumulilo, woonse ubelesya busondi na baamba zitobela, na babala zitondezyo zijanika munkomeki, na bachita bulozi,
naba wamasalamusi, woonse ooyo uyita myuuya, naba umwi usonda naba waambula a myuuya yabafwide.
Nkaamb woonse ooyo uchita nzintu ezi nchisesemyo kuli Jehova;  nkambo kazezi zisesemyo Jehova nchalikubagwisya kuzwa kuzwa kunembo lyanu.
Muleelede kuba batakwe kampenda kunembo lya Jehova Leza wanu.
Nkaambo ezi zisi ezyo nzimuyotolela busena ziswilizya kulibabo baswilizya zya nkakata a masalamusi; pesi mbuli ndinywe, Jehova Leza wanu tamuzumizizye pe kuti muchite oobo.
Jehova leza wanu uyomubusizya musinsimi kuzwa aakati kanu, umwi wabananyokwe, mbuli ndime. Muleelede kumuswilizya.
Eechi nchicho nchimwakakumbila kuli Jehova Leza wanu ku Holebbu mubuunsi bwakuswaanana, kamuti, 'Tatuchikamvwi limbi ijwi lya Jehova Leza wesu, nikuba kubona mulilo mupati ilubo, nkaambo tuyofwa.'
Jehova wakati kuli ndime, 'Eezyo nzibakaamba nzibotu.
Ndiyobusya musinsimi wabo kuzwa aakati kabananyina, uli mbuli nduwe. Ndiyobika majwi angu mumulomo wakwe, alimwi uyowambuula kuli mbabo zyoonse ezyo nzindinoli ndamulayila.
Kuyoochitika kuti na umwi taaswilila kumajwi angu ayo ngawambula muzina lyangu, ndiyomwambila aatala anzizyo.
Pesi musinsimi wambuula ijwi chakutaswilizya muzina lyangu, ijwi ndindatamulayilila kuti awambule, nikuba ooyo wambuula muzina lyabamwi baleza, ooyo musinsimi uleelede kufwa.'
Eechi nchicho nchuweelede kwamba mumoyo wako: 'Nga tulaziba biyeni mulumbe ooyo Jehova ngwatambide?'

Muyoyibalukwa mulumbe ooyo Jehova ngwakambuula eelyo musinsimi nakambuula muzina lya Jehova. Na eecho nchintu techabawo nikuba kuchitika, mpawo eecho nchimwi chintu Jehova nchataambide alimwi musinsimi wachaa mukutaswilizya, alimwi tamweelede kumuyowa pe.
Eelyo Jehova Leza wanu akunyonyoona zisi, abo bali anyika Jehova Leza wanu njayomupa, alimwi eelyo nimuyobatobela alimwi akukkala mu madolopo amumaanda abo,
muleelede kulisalila madolopo atatu aakati kanyika yanu eyo Jehova Leza wanu njayomupa kuti mubweze.

Muleelede kuyaka mugwagwa alimwi mwaanzanie migaano yanyika yanu muzipanzi zitatu, inyika eyo Jehova Leza wanu  njayomuchitila kuti mukakone, kuchitila kuti woonse oyo ujaya umwi muntu achijile nkuko.
Aya ngemalayilile aatala awoyo ujaya umwi alimwi wachija kuzwa oko kuchitila kufutula buumi bwakwe - oyo watajaya simayakilani wakwe achaali katakwe kumuzonda kuchiindi chantenda.

Chikozyanisyo, na muntu waya mulusaka  aamwi a simayakilani wakwe kuyotema zisamu, alimwi wagonka akaleba kuti awisye musamu, alimwi kaleba kazwa mumwini kaakutema simayakilani wakwe alimwi kamujaya mpawo oyo muntu weelede kuchijila kuli limwi lyamadolopo aaya alimwi afutule buumi bwakwe.

Chimwi chindi sikubwedezya wagazi ulakonzya kutobela oyo wabweza buumi, alimwi mukupya kwakunyema kwakwe akamwenzye, ikuti musinzo kuli mupati loko, akamugonke alimwi amujeye, nikuba kuti oyo mwalumi tayelede kufwa pe kufwa pe, mbukunga  takwe nalikuzonda muyakilani wakwe musule
Nkikako ndamulayilila mulisalile madolopo atatu.
Ikuti JEhova Leza wanu wakomezya mugano yanu, mbuli mbakakomezya kuli basikale banu kuti achite, alimwi  akumupa inyika yonse eyo njakasyomezya kupa kuli basikale banu,

ikuti mwabamba malayilile woonse aya akwacita, ayo ngindokumulayilila sunu _malayilile akuyanda Jehova  Leza wanu alimwi kweenda mazuba woonse munzila zyakwe, mpo muleleede kuliyungizizyz ambi madolopo ataatu, atali aya atatu.
Muchite echi abobo kuti igazi litakwe chibi talitiligwi akati  kanyika eyo Jehova Leza wanu njalokumupa mbuli lukono, abobo kuti kutabi mulandu  waganzi alindinywe.
Pesi kuti kufumbwa umwi uzonda muyakilani wakwe, wamulindila, wabukila kumulwisya, alimwi wamuchisa mubili abobo kusika wafwa, alimwi wachijila kulilimwi lyamadolopo aya_
Mpawo baalu badolopo lyakwe  bayelede kutuma alimwi bamuboozye kuzwa nkuko, alimwi bamwete mumaboko anzubo zyakwe, abobo kuti akafwe.
Menso anu tayelede kumufwida nsoni, anikuti, mwelede kugwisya mulandu wagazi kuzwa mu Izilayeli, kuti zimubotele.
Tamwelede kugwisya inkanka yabayakilani banu eyo njibakabikka abusena chindi loko, mulukono lwanu ndumulokon, munyika eyo Jehova Leza wanu njalokumupa kuti mubweze.

Bukamboni bwamuntu umwi tabulelede kubukila akulwisyanya a mwalumi nkambo kachibi, na kufumbwa chibi  chibi, kufumbwa munkani eyo njabisya, kumilomo yabakamboni babil, na kumilomo yabakamboni batatu, inkani iyelede kusinisigwa.
Twambe kuti kamboni utaluleme wabukila kulwisya kufumbwa mwalumi kapa bukamboni kalwisya kuti tachiti kabotu.
Mpawo boonse balumi, abo balalupyopyongano zipona akati kabo, bayelede kwimikila kunembo lya Jehova, kunembo lyabapayizi alimwi kubabetesi babeleka mumazuba ayo.
Babetesi bayelede kuyandulisisya, kubona kuti kamboni kali kamboni ubeja alimwi wapa bukamboni bwakubeja kambila mwananyina,
Mpawo mwelede kulinguwe, mbuli mbwali kulombozya kuchita ku mwananyina, alimwi mulogwisya ibubi kuzwa akati kanu.
Mpawo abo banoli basyala bazonvwa alimwi bayowe, alimwi kuzwa awo kuya kunembo tabakalochiti lubo bubi buli mbuli obu akati kanu.
Menso anu tayelede kuba alweletelelo, buumi bulobhadalila buumi, liso ku liso, linyo  ku linyo, luboko kuluboko, kuulu ku kuulu.

Eelyo mwaakwiinka kunkondo kubukila basinkondonyokwe, alimwi mukabone mabbiza, nkalaki, alimwi a bantu bavulide kwiinda ndinywe, tamweelede kuyobayoowa pe, nkaambo Jehova Leza wanu uli aandinywe, ooyo wakamweeta kuzwa munyika ya Ijipiti.
Eelyo mwakuyanda kunjila kukulwana, mupayizi weelede kwiinka alimwi akaambule kubantu.
Weelede kwaamba kuti kulimbabo, ''Muswiilile, Izilayeli, muya kukulwana basinkondonyokwe. Mutaleki myoyo yanu ikatale. Mutayowi na kuteketa. Mutakabayowi.
Nkaambo Jehova Leza wanu nguwe uyobwiinka aandinywe kukuyomulwanina kuloi basinkondonyokwe alimwi akuyomufutula.'

Basilutwe beelede kwaambula kubantu alimwi batedi, 'Ngwani mwaalumi uliwo ooyo wakayaka n'anda mpya alimwi tanayisalazya pe? Mumuleke ayinke alimwi abweede kun'anda yakwe, kuchitila kuti atafwidi munkondo alimwi umwi mwaalumi azoyisalazye.
Mpali na umwi wakabyala muunda wamasaansa alimwi tanaalya michelo yawo pe? Mumuleke abweede kumnzi, kuti atafwidi munkondo alimwi umwi mwaalumi azolye michelo yawo.
Ngwani mwaalumi uliwo ooyo wakatumina kukukwata mwanakazi pesitanamukwata pe? Mumuleke abweede kumunzi kuchitila kuti atafwidi munkondo alimwi umwi mwaalumi azomukwate sikutuminwa.'

Basilutwe beelede kwaambula kubantu alimwi batedi, 'Ngwani mwaalumi muyoofu na uli amoyo muniini? Mumuleke ayinke alimwi abweede kun'anda yakwe, kuchitila kuti moyo wamukulana wakwe utakayaayi mbuli moyo wakwe mwini.'
Eelyo basilutwe bakumaninsya kwaambula kubantu, beelede kuyoosala balayilizi aatala ambabo.
Eelyo mwakwiinka akubukila chisi, mukachite bantu aabo chipo chaluumuno.
Na bazumina chipo chanu alimwi akujula milyango yabo kulindinywe, boonse bantu bayoojanika muloinchicho beelede kuba bazike banualimwi beelede kumubelekela.
Pesi na bakaka kuchita lumuno kulindinywe, pesi babusya nkondo biya aatala andinywe, mpawo muleelede kubasinkilizya,
alimwi eelyo Jehova Leza wanu aakumupa kuzunda alimwi akubabika munsi lyabweendelezi bwanu, muleelede kujaya mwaalumi woonse mudolopo.

Pesi banakazi, baniini, lubono, alimwi zyoonse zili mudolopo, alimwi zyoonse zyamumuunzi, muyozibweza mbuli zisaalo zyanu. Muyoolya zisaalo zyabasinkondonyokwe, eezyo Jehova Leza wanu nzyaapa kulindinywe.
Muleelede kuchita munzila eeyi kuli woonse madolopo alikule loko kuzwa kulindinywe, madolopo aatali madolopo amanyika aaya aatobela.
Mumadolopo abantu aaba Jehova Leza wanu ngali kumupa mbuli lukono, takwe nchimweelede kusiya kachipona choonse chiyoya.
Pesi, muleelede kunyonyweeda aato zyoonse: ba Hiti, alimwi a ba Amoli, ba Kkenani, ba Pelizi, ba Hivi, alimwi a ba Jebbu, mbuli Jehova Leza wanu mbakamulayilila.
Mukachite eechi kuchitila kuti batakamuyiisyi kuchita nikuba kuli umwi mbuli mbubakachita abaleza babo. Na mwachita, muyoobisya aatala a Jehova Leza wanu.

Eelyo mwakusinkilizya dolopo kwachiindi chilamfu, nimuyoobusya nkondo aatala andilyo kuyolibweza, tamweelede kunyonyona misamu yalyo pe akwiitema akaleba. Nkaambo muyokonzya kulya kuzwa kulinjiyo, aboobo tamweelede pe kwiitema akwiiwisizya aansi. Nkaambo musamu wamumuunda na ngumweelede kusinkilizya?
Luzutu misamu njimwizi kuti tensi misamu yakulya, mulakonzya kwiinyonyoona alimwi akwiiwisizya aansi; muyooyaka zyakusinkilizya aatala adolopo libusya nkondo andinywe, kusikila lyazundwa.
Kuti umwi wajanika kajiidwe munyika eyo Yahuwe Leza wenu njalikumupa kuti mwibambe, kalede mumuunda, alimwi kakutazibinkenwe pe kuti ngwani wamuchitobo;
mpawo bapati benu ababetesi benu belede kuzwa anze, alimwi belede kuyoyela kuzisi ezyo zimuzyungulukide oyo sikujigwa..
Alimwi balupati bachisi chilafwifwi amutumba wamwalumi sikujiigwa belede kubweza kang'ombe kapwizi kuzwa mubutanga, mpwizi itana buzuba yabelesegwa, alimwi itana bunsi yabikwa ijokwe.
Mpawo belede kukakwenkwelesya kunsi kumusena ulamanzi ayenda, imusena utana bunsi walimwa na kubyalwa, alimwi omo mumusena belede kuyodunsula nsingo yempwizi.

Bapayizi, lunyungu lwaba Levi, belede kuza kunembo, nkambo Yahuwe Leza wenu wakabasala kuti bamubelekele lwakwe akupa zilongezyo muzina lya Yahuwe alimwi akuyeeya aliyonse milandu yakutamvwana akupa chisubulo amajwi abo.
Bazuluzi boonse bamuchisi echo chilafwifwi amwalumi sikujiigwa belede kusamba maboko abo ajulu emng'ombe mpwizi eyo yakagonkwa nsingo kumusena;
Alimwi belede kupa nsandulo kumulandu kabati; 'Maboko esu takwepe nakatila bulowa, nekuba menso esu takwepe nakabubona..

Kolekelela, Yahuwe, bantu bako ba Izilayeli, abo mbiwakafutula, akutapa mulandu kubulowa bwakatilwa  kabutakwe mulandu akati kabantu bako ba Izilayeli.'Mpawo bulowa bwakatilwa buyolekelelwa kulimbabo.
Munzileyi muyotantamwidwa bulowa butakwe mulandu akati kenu, kufumbwa nimwacita zyelede mumeso a Yahuwe.
Chiindi nimuzwa kuya kukulwana inkondo abasinkondo nyokwe alimwi Yahuwe Leza wenu uyomupa luzundo akuyobabika munsi lyenu, alimwi muyobabweza akubatola akati kabazike,
Na mwabona mwanakazi mubotu akati  kabazike, alimwi mwaba achiyandisyo chakwe alimwi mwapekezya kumubweza mbuli mukayintu wenu,
elyo uyomweta kumunzi kung'anda yako; uyo linyoola susu lyakwe kumutwe akuyo nengulula maala akwe.

Alimwi uyomusamununa mpasya ezyo nzyakazwete chiindi nakeetwa mubuzike alimwi uyokkala mung'anda yako alimwi akomooke wisi abanyina kwa mweezi. Musule aboobu elyo uyowoona awe akuba mulumi wakwe, alimwi uyoba mukayintu wako.
Pesi kuti tewajana bubotu mulinguwe, ukonzya kumuleka ayinke kufumbwa nkwayanda. Pesi toyelede kumusambala amali, alimwi toyelede pe kumutola mbuli muzike, nkambo wamuubula webo.

Kuti mwalumi kajisi bamakayintu bobile alimwi umwi kayandwa umwi katamuyandwi, alimwi boonse kabamuzyalilide bana - boonse uyandwa amukayintu utayandwi - kuti kakulikuti mwana mutanzi mwalumi kaliwayooyo utayandwi,
mpawo mubuzuba obo mwalumi nazochita kuti alye lukono lwanzyalezyo, tayelede pe kutola mwanakazi uyandwa mbuli mutanzi mumeso awoyo ulabanyina batayandwi, kakuli k uti ngonguwe mutanzi.
Anukuti, uyelede kulumbula mutanzi, mwana wamukayintu utayandwi, akumupa zimpanzi zibili zyembono zyakwe nzyaleezyo; nkambo oyo mwana ngematalikilo enguzu zyakwe; zyelelo zyamwana mutanzi nzizyakwe.
Kuti muntu kali amwana utateeleli chungutwi oyo utamvwi ijwi lyawisi nikuba kumajwi abanyina, alimwi oyo, nikuba bamuzyololola, tateleli pe kulimbabo;
elyo wisi abanyina belede kumubweza akumutola kubapati bechisi akumulyango wamanjililo echisi chakwe.
Belede kuyowambila bazuluzi bechisi,  'oyu mwana wesu nguchungutwi alimwi ngumumvwazyakwe; takoyotelela pe kujwi lyenu; ngusilayigwi alimwi ngu nchankoolwa.
Mpawo bonseni balumi bamuchisi belede kugusya bubi akati kenu. Bonseni ba Izilayeli batakazimvwe bayoyowa.
Kuti mwalumi wachita chibi chelede lufu alimwi wajiigwa,

mpawo mutunta wakwe tuyelede kusyaala kwabusiku bonseni echisamu. Anukuti, mulelede kumuvwikka mbubobo buzuba; nkambo kufumbwa oyo uwanzikwa mumusamu ulitukidwe a Leza . Amukutelele oyu mulawu nkokut mutakasofwazyi nyika eyo Yahuwe Leza wenu njamupa kuti nywebo ibe lukono lwenu.
Toyelede biyo kwebela ing'ombe yamwenzinyokwe mu Izilayeli niba imbelele kiyabupampala mpawo webo waliyubika kuli nzizyo; uyelede kuziboozya kuli nguwe.
Naa mwenzinyokwe mu Izilayeli katali afwifwi anduwe, na tomwizi, elyo uyelede kuboozya munyama kung'anda yako, mpawo uyelede kuba alinduwe kusikila azoyibbutule, mpawo uyelede kwibwedezya kuli nguwe.

Uyelede kuchita bukozyenie akumbong'olo yakwe; uyelede kuchita zikozyania akuchizwato chakwe; uyelede kuchita zikozyenie akuchintu chiswekede chamwenzinyokwe  mu Izilayeli, kufumbwa chilibuti nchasowa mpawo wachijana; toyelede kuchisisa pe.
Toyelede imbong'olo yamwenzinyokwe mu Izilayeli nikuba ng'ombe iliwide munzila mpawo waliyubika kuti nzizyo; nchobeni uyelede kumugwasya kuzibusya alimwi.
Mukayintu tayelede pe kuzwata zizwato zyachalumi, nikuba mwalumi kuzwata zizwato zyachanakazi; kufumbwa uchita zili bobu nchisesemyo kuli Jehova Leza wenu.

Na chitendele chakayuni zyachita kuti chibe kunembo lyako munzila, mumusamu na anyika, atwana twakayuni nikuba maji mulinchicho, akanyina kakalimbide atwana nikuba amaji, toyelede pe  kubweza kanyina antomwe atwana.
Nchobeni uyelede kuleka kanyina keende, pesi itwana ukonzya kulibwezela. Lemeka mulayizyo oyu kuti zikonzye kwenda kabotu kulinduwe, mpawo akuti ulampye mazuba aako.
Na wayaka ing'anda mpya, elyo uyelede kuchita chitabilizyo chakaluli kako kuchitila kuti utayeleli ng'anda yako mulandu wabulowa kuti umwi wazowa kuzwa mpawo.
Toyelede kubyala muunda wamasansa amisyobo wambuto zibili, kuchitila kuti butebuzi butasalalili busena busalala, imbuto njuwabyala abutebuzi bwamasansa.
Toyelede kufolozya ing'ombe antomwe ambongolo.
Utazwati zizwato zyamisyobo ivwelene busumyo antomwe amulembo.
Uyelede kuli chitila mayayiyila mumabbazu ali achizwato chako echo nchozwata.
Na mwalumi wakwata mwanakazi, waswanana awe alubo na wamusula,
akumunyontokela zintu ziwusisya bweeme akumupa kaambo, kakuti, 'Ndakakwata mukayintu nindakaza munsi lyakwe, tendakajana bukamboni bwabu nakalindu muli nguwe.'
Elyo wisi abanyina bamusimbi bayelede kutola bukamboni bwabunakalindu bwakwe kubantu kumulyango wachisi.
Wisi amusimbi uyelede kuti kubantu, 'Ndakapa mwanangu kuloyu mwalumi mbuli mwanakazi, pesi wamusula.
Bona, wamunyontawukila azintu zifwisya bweeme akuti, 'Nsijene bumboni bwabunakalindu.' Elyo balayala mulembo wabukamboni kunembo lyabantu bamunzi.
Elyo baalu bechisi bayelede kubweza oyo mwalumi akumusubula;
akumubbadalisya mwanda wamasyekeli ansiliva, akwapa wisi wamusimbi. Nkambo mwalumi unoli wachita masampu kuli nakalindu wa Izilayeli uyelede kuba mukakwe; tayelede kumuleka mazuba akwe woonse.
Pesi na chiintu echi nchaanchonzyo chakuti bukamboni tabujanikide mumusimbi,

eelyo bayelede kweeta musimbi mumulyango wang'anda yawisi, mpawo bantu bamuchisi bayelede kumupwaya mabwe kusikila kulufu. Nkambo wachita chintu chitaluleme mu Izilayeli, kuchita bwamu kachili mung'anda yawisi; mpawo mwagwisya chibi akati kenu.
Na mwalumi wajanika kawona amwanakazi ukwetwe awumwi mwalumi, elyo aba bobile bayelede kufwa, mwalumi wawona amwanakazi mpawo amwanakazi lwakwe;  munoli mwagwisya chibi akati kanu.
Na kuli musimbi nakalindu, utangidwe kumwalumi, mpawo umwi mwalumi wamujana kumulyango wachisi akoona awe,

mubweze kabali babili mubatole kumulyango wachisi, mubatulule mabwe bafwe. Muyelede kutulula musimbi nkambo takwepe nakakwiila, nikuba wakali mukati kachisi. Muyelede kutulula mwalumi nkambo wasofwazya mukamwenzinyokwe; mpawo munoli mwagwisya chibi akati kenu.
Pesi na mwalumi wajana nakalinduutangidwe musokwe, mpawo wamwandila akona awe, lino oyo mwalumi wakoona anguwe welede kufwa.
Pesi kumusimbitamwelede kuchita chintu chibi pe; takwe chibi chiyelede lufu kumusimbi. Akambo kacheechi kuli mbuli mwalumi wabukila mwenzinyina akumujaya.
Nkambo wamujana musokwe; musimbi utangidwe wakwiila, pesi takwepe sikumuvuna.
Na mwalumi wajana musimbi nakalindu utatangidwe, wamuvumpila akona awe, mpawo wabonwa,
elyo mwalumi wawona anguwe uyelede kupa makumi musanu asyekeli wansiliva kuli wisi wamusimbi, mpawo uyelede kuba mwanakazi wakwe, nkambo wamusofwazya. Tayelede kumuleka mazuba akwe woonse.
Mwalumi tayelede kukwata muka wisi mbuli mwanakazi wakwe; tayelede kubweza zyelelo zyakukwatana kwa wisi.
Taakwe mwaalumi uli azizo zyakwe zyakuunsi zipwachwidwe naa zigonkedwe uyonjila mumbungano ya Jehova.
Takwe mwana uzyedwe kubazyali bakwe batakwetene uyooba mumbungano ya Jehova; kusikila kuzyalani lyalunyungu lwakwe, takwepe wabo uyoba wambungano ya Jehova.
Mu Amonayiti na mu Mobbayiti tabakoyooba bambungano ya Jehova; kusikila kuzyalani lyakkumi lyabasilunyungu lwakwe, takwe wabo uyooba simbungano ya Jehova.

Eechi chilaakuti nkambo takwe nibakakuswaana achinkwa alimwi amanzi mumugwagwa eelyo nibakazwa aanze a Ijiputi, alimwi bakatamba Bbalaamu mwana mlombe wa Bbiyooli uzwa ku Peto iilimu Amulamu Nahalayimu, kuti akutuke.
Pesi Jehova Leza wakatali kuswilila kuli Bbalaamu; anukuti, Jehova Leza wako wakasandula lutuko lwakaba chilongezyo chako, nkambo Jehova Leza wako wakakuyanda.
Toyelede kuyanduula Luumuno lwabo naa kuzwidilila, mumazuba aako.
Toyelede kusampawula mu Edomu, nkaambo muchizi wako; tamwelede kutuka mu Ijiputi, nkambo wakali muzwakule munyika yakwe.
Basilunyungu bazyalani lyatatu bazyedwe kuli mbabo bakonzya kuba bambungano ya Jehova.
Eelyo nimuyoyenda mbuli impi aatala lyabasinkondonyokwe, mpawo mwelede kulibamba kuzwa kuchintu chibi choonse.
Kuti nkakuli naba mwalumi uusofweede akkati kanu nkambo kazyachitika kulinguwe mansiku, mpawo welede kuzwa munkambe yampi; tayelede kuoola munkambe.
Eelyo golezya niliyoosika, welede kulisanzya mumaanzi; eelyo izuba niliyoobbila, uyooboola mukkati kunkamba.
Mwelede kuba abusena alimwi aanze aankamba nkoloyinka;
alimwi uyooba achimwi akati kazibelesyo zyako chakusisya; eelyo noyosunsumana aansi kuti ulivune, welede kusya musele anchicho alimwi ubwedezye musele mpawo uvwikkile eezyo zinoli zyazwa kulinduwe.

Nkambo Jehova Leza wanu, uleenda aakati kankaamba yanu kukumupa kuzunda alimwi akupeda basinkondonyokwe mumaanza eenu. Aboobo nkamba yenu iyelede kusalala, nkokuti ataboni nichiba chintu aakati kanu alimwi amufutatile.
Tamwelede kubwedezya kuli simalelo wakwe muzike uuchijide kuzwa kuli simalelo wakwe.
Mumuleke apone andinywe, muli niliba lili dolopo ndyaasala. Mutamupenzyi.
Kutakabi naba omwe sibwaamu akati kanu nabaani mubana basimbi ba Izilayeli, naakuti naba omwe sibwamu akati kabana balombe ba Izilayeli.
Muteeti mpindu zyasibwaamu naa mpindu zyamubwa mung'anda ya Jehova Leza wanu akambo kanechiba chikonke; nkambo zyobilwe eezi zilatondwa kuli Jehova Leza wanu.
Tamweelede kukweleta chakujana mpindu kumu Izilayili nyokwe -- mpindu yamali, mpindu yachilyo, naa mpindu yachiliba niinzi chikweletwa chakujania mpindu.

Kumuzwakule mulakonzya kukweleta chakujania mpindu; pesi kumu Izilayeli nyokwe tamwelede kukweleta chakujania mpindu, kuti Jehova Leza wanu amulongezye kuli zyoonse nzimubika kuboko kwenu, munyika njimuyonjila kuti mukiivube.
