Eelyo nimuchita chikonke kuli Jehova Leza wenu, tamwelede kumuka kuchizuzikizya, nkambo Jehova Leza wenu nchobeni uyochiyanda; chiyooba chiibi kulinduwe kutachizuzikizya.
Pesi kuti tokonzyi, tachinoli chibi pe kulinduwe.
Eecho chakazwa mumilomo yako welede kuchilangisisya alimwi echichite; mbuli mbwakakonka kuli Jehova Leza wako, nichiba chilibuti nchiwaka syomezya chakulimvwida amulomo wakwe.
Eelyo nonjila mumuunda wamasansa wasimayakilane wako, uyolya misansa myiingi njoyanda, pesi utakabikki niliba limwi muchisuwo.
Eelyo nonjila mumuunda wasimayakilane wako aatubide, ulakonzya kutyola mitwe yamayila akuboko kwako, pesi utabiki jekeso kumayila asimayakilane wako aatubide.

Na mwalumi wabweza mwanakazi akumukwata, kuti takwe najana buuya mumeso aakwe nkambo takwajana zintu zibotu kulinguwe, elyo welede kulembela chitupa chakulekwa, kuchibika mumaboko aakwe, akumutanda kuzwa mung'anda yakwe.
Eelyo nazwa mung'anda yakwe, uleenda akuyokwatwa awumbi mwalumi.
Kuti mwalumi wabili wamusula akumulembela chitupa chakulekwa, kuchibika mumaanza akwe, akumutanda kuzwa mung'anda yakwe; nikuba kuti mulumi wabili abe mwanakazi wakwe -

mpawo oyo mulumi wakwe wakusanguna, oyo wakasangwine kumutanda, tayelede lubo kuti abe mwanakazi wakwe, musule akusofwala; eechi chilaba chisesemyo kuli Jehova. Toyelede kuchita nyika kuti iibe amulandu, inyika Jehova Leza wanu njamupa mbuli lukono lwanu.
Eelyo mwanakazi wabweza mwanakazi mupya, tayinki kunkondo aampi, nekuba kupegwa umwi mulimu; weelede kwangunuka kuba kumunzi kwamunyaka omwe akusamawusya mwanakazi wakwe ngwaakwata.
Taakwe mwalumi ubweza ziyo kana mwanaweziyo mbuli chisyomezyo, nkambo unoli wabweza buumi bwamuntu mbuli chisyomezyo.
Kuti mwalumi wajanika nkalikubba umwi wababunyiina kuzwa akati kkabantu bamu Izilayeli, akumujata mbuli muzike akumuuzya, oyo mubbi ngafwe, alimwi muyogwisya bubi kuzwa akati kanu.
Amuchenjele kubulwazi bwachipele kuchitila kuti mubambe mukalangisisye chabuluziluzi akuyotobelezya malayilile ngibamupa bapayizi, ba Levi, ngibamuyiisya, mbuli mbendamulayilila, aboobo muchite.
Amuyubulukwe Jehova Leza wanu nzyakachita kuli Miliyemu nimwakali kuzwa ku Ijiputi.
Elyo nokweletesya ngoyakilene awe kufumbwa chikwelete, toyelede kunjila mung'anda yakwe kuyotola nchasyomezya.
Ulimikila anze, alimwi mwalumi nguwakweletesya uleeta nchaasyomezya aanze kulinduwe.
Kuti nkali mwalumi muchete, toyelede kuyowona anchiwasyomezya mubuvubi bwako.
Nkasimpe welede kubwedezya nchiwasyomezya kulinguwe izuba lyaya kukubbila, kuti awone muli chakulivumba chakwe akulongezye; chinosalala kulinduwe kunembo lya Jehova Leza wako.
Toyelede kudyamiizya simulimu muchete ufwaba, nikuba munyokwe mu Izilayeli, kana muzwakule oyo ulimunyika yanu ulimumilyango yadolopo lyanu.

Izuba limwi alimwi welede kumupa mufolo wakwe; zuba talyelede kubbila makani akwe katana bambidwe, nkambo muchete alimwi ulangilide ali nzizyo. Chita oobo kuti atakwambilizyi kuli Jehova, akuti utachiti chibi
Bazyali tabelede kufwida milandu yabana, nikuba bana bajiilwa milandu yabazyali. Anukuti, umwi awumwi welede kufwida milandu yakwe mwini.
Toyelede kubelesya chakwangila kukugwisya bululami bwelede muzwakule kana muchaala, kana kubweza chilivumbyo chamukamufu mbuli chisyomezyo.
Anukuti, mwelede kuyubulukwa kuti mwakali bazike anywebo mu Ijiputi, alimwi Jehova Leza wanu wakamuvuna kuzwa oko. Aboobo ndikumulayilila kuti mubambe mulayiizyo oyu.

Elyo nimutyola butebuzi bwanu mumyuunda yanu, alimwi kuti mwaluba chisuwo chamiila mulukuba, tamwelede kubweeda kuyochitola, cheleede kuba chabenzu, bamuchala kana bamukabafu, kuti Jehova Leza wanu amulongezye kumilimo yamanza anu.
Nimutikinia minsamu yanu yama Olifa, tamwelede kwiyindulula lubo mitabi, iyooba yabeenzu, bamuchaala, kana bamukabafu.
Elyo nimubungika masansa munkuba, tamwelede kuchela chakwindulula. Ezyo zisyaala ziyoba zyabeenzu, bamuchala aba mukabafu.
Mwelede kuyubulukwa kuti mwakali bazike munyika ya Ijiputi; aboobo ndikumulayilila kuti mubambe mulayizyo oyo
Kuti kwaba kutamvwanana akati kabalumi awumwi binka kunkuta, ababetesi bababeteka, elyo balangununa mululami akupa mulandu kuli utaluleme.
kuti wajanwa amulandu nkayelede chisubulo chakuumwa, elyo wati alale awumwe mumeso akwe mumweelwe wazyuumyo, mbuli mulandu wakwe.

Mubetesi ukonzya kumupa zyumo zilimakumi oone, pele tayelede kwinzizya oyo mweelwe, nkambo na ulinzizya mweelwe oyo akumuuma azyumyo zyingi, elyo babunyina bako ba Izilayeli bayoba bweeme kunembo lyamenso ako.
Utamwangi mulomo musune ulyatuuka mayiila.

Kuti bana bakwabo bakala antomwe alimwi umwi wafwa, nkatakwe mwana mwalumi, elyo mwanakazi wasikufwa tayelede kuzwa akuyokwatwa kumbi kunze empuli.  Anukuti, mwanike kana mukulana wasikufwa welede kwinka kulinguwe akumubweza kuba mwanakazi wakwe, akuchita milimo yamukulana wamulumi kumwanakazi.
Echi nkukuti mwana mutaanzi ngwatazyale uyoolya izina lyamukulana mufwi, kuti izina lyakwe litalobi mu Izilayeli.

Nakuti tayanda kubweza banamukulana elyo banamukulana belede kuya kumulyango kubapati akuti, mwalumi wamulimangu wakaka kubusizya mwalu wakwe izina mu Izilayeli; tayandi kubeleka milimo yamwalu wakwe kulindime.
Elyo bapapti bedolopo lyakwe balamwiita akumubuzisisya. Pele nawinkilila anembo akuti, ''nsilimvwidi kumubweza.'
Elyo banamwalu wakwe belede kwinka kulinguwe kunembo lyabapati, bagwisye nsangu zyakwe kumawulu, akumuswida kumenso. Bamusandule kuti, ezi nzizichitwa kumuntu utayandi kuyaka ng'anda yamwaalu wakwe.'
Izina lyakwe liyotegwa mu Izilayeli, 'Ninganda yayoyo wakagwisigwa insangu.'
Kuti balumi balwana umwi amwenzinyina, alimwi mwanakazi wawumwi waza kuzovuna mulumi wakwe kuzwa mumaboko ayoyo wamuuma, alimwi kuti watandabika kuboko kwakwe akumubwezala mutambo kunsiswa,
mpawo welede kumukosola kuboko kwakwe, linso lyako talyelede kumufwida luzyalo.
Toyelede kuba abulemu busiyene muchikomo chako, bupati abunini.
Toyelede kuti mung'anda yako kube mweelwe isiyene, impati anini.
Bulemu bululeme abulemu buzwide welede kubabo; mweelwe uzwide awululeme ngoyelede kubaawo, aboobo kuti ube amazuba malamfu munyika eyo Jehova Leza wako njakupa.
Aabo boonse bachita zintu ezi, boonse babeleka zitaluleme, nzisesemyo kuli Jehova Leza wako.
Koyubulukwa eezyo Ameleki nzyakakuchitila mumugwagwa nkamuzwa mu Ijiputi.
mbuli mbakakuswanizya mumugwagwa akulwana abamwi banu bakali musule, boonse bakakkatede bakali musule lyenu. Nimwakawizukide akukkatala; takalemeka Leza.

Nkiinkako, elyo Jehova Leza wanu wamupa kulyokeezya kuzwa kuli basinkondonyokwe bamwengelede, munyika eyo Jehova Leza wanu njamupa kuti mwiivube mbuli lukono, tamwelede kuluba kuti mwelede kunyonyoona chibalusyo chaba Ameleki kuzwa ansi lyejulu.
Chiindi nutayoosike munyika eeyo Jehova Leza wanu njalikukupa mbuli lukono, alimwi nutayooyivube akukkala mulinjiyo,

eelyo welede kubweza zimwi zitaanzi zyabutebuzi boonse bwanyika Jehova Leza wanu njalikukupa. Weleede kubika muchisuwo alimwi wende kunyika eeyo Jehova Leza wanu  njatasale mbuli lubuwa lwake lwakukombela.

Weleede kweenda kumupayizi ooyo utanoobeleke mumazuba  aayo akwaamba kuti kulinguwe, 'Ndazumina sunu kuli Jehova Leza wanu kuti ndasika kunyika eeyo Jehova njakakonkezya kuli basikale besu kuti atupe.'
Mupayizi uleleede kubweza chisuwo kuzwa kuluboko akuchibikka kunembo lyachipayililo cha Jehova Leza wanu.

Weelede kuyowamba kunembo lya Jehova Leza wako, 'Sikale wangu mu Alamu. Simutuntuli wakaya ku Ijipiti akwakukkala nkuko, alimwi bantu bakwe bakali bache mumweelwe. Nkukooko wakaba mupati, singuzu akuba aachisi chilampuwo.
Ba Igipita bakatule bubi akutupenzya bakatuchita kuti tuchite milimu yabuzike.
Twakalilila Jehova wabama taata esu akubona kupenzegwa kwesu, kubeleka kwesu akudyamininwa kwesu.
Jehova wakatugwisya mu Igipita ajaanza lilanguzu, aluboko lutandabede, aziyoosyo zipati, azitondezyo, azigambyo,
alimwi watweeta kubusena oobu akatupa nyika eyi, nyika eeyi yeeta maliili abuchi.
Lino laanga, ndeeta butebuzi butaanzi bwanyika eeyi yako Jehova, njindakupa: uleleede kubikka kunembo lyakwe.
Alimwi uleleede kubotelwa kuli zyoonse zibotu  eezyo Jehova Leza wanu nzyamuchitilabanganda yako_iwe, abaLevi, bazwakule abali akati kanu.

Nimutayomane kupa zyakkumi  zyoonse  zyabutebuzi kukkole lyachitatu, eezi zimbuli kuti , kkole lyachakkumi, mponya uleleede kuzipa kuba Levi, kubazwakule, kulibamuka muchaala, akulibamuka bafu,   kuchitila kuti balye mudolopo lyanu akukkuta.

Muleleede kwaamba kunembo lya Jehova Leza wanu, ndeeta kuzwa kunganda yanu zintu zyakuli Jehova, alimwi ndazipa kuba Levi, kubazwakule, kuli bamuchala, akuli bamuka bafu, akwendelana amilayo yoonse eeyi njindamupa. Takwe nindatyola kufumbwa mulawwo wako,na ndayiluba.

Takwe nindalya kufumbwa wachincho mukulila kwangu, nikuba ndachibikka kumbi nindakachili sizinyonyono, na ndachipa kufumbwa mukulemekezya kufwide. Ndaswilizya kujwi lya Jehova Leza wangu; ndakalemeka zyoonse nzimwakandilayilila kuti ndichite.
Langa aansi kuzwa kubusena busalala nkukkala kuzwa kujulu, alimwi longezya bantu bako Izilayili, anyikanjwakatipa, mbuli mbwakakonkezya kuma taata esu, nyika yeeta maliili abuchi.
Sunu Jehova Leza wanu ulikulayilila kuti lemeka milayo eeyi amilaazyo, nkinkaako uyoyibamba, alimwi ukabachitile amooyo wako woonse.
Wakazumina sunu kuti Jehova ngu Leza wanu, alimwi kuti muyoyeenda munzila zyakwe  akubamba milayo yakwe, amulayilile ake, ambeta zyakwe, akuti uyoswilizya ijwi lyakwe.
Sunu  Jehova  wazumina kuti mulibantu bakwe bali ndoolukono lwakwe, mbuli mbakamusomezya, alimwi kuti mubambe milayo yakwe yoonse,
alimwi uyoomusumpula aajulu azyoonse zisi zimbi nzyakachita, alimwi muyotambula kulumbayizigwa, kuzibikana, abulemu.  Muyoba bantu basalindwe kuli Jehova  Leza wanu, mbuli mbwaamba.
Mozesi abapati ba Izilayeli bakalayilila bantu akwamba kuti, ''Amubambe woonse ngindamulayilila sunu.
Mubuzuba nimutayoyinde Jodani kunyika eyo Jehova Leza wanu njalikumupa, ulelede kubika mabwe mapati alimwi akwalamba amulambo.

Ulelede kulemba alingawo woonse mabala mulawu oyu nimutayozubuke; kuti mukayinke munyika eeyo Jehova Leza wanu njalikumupa, nyika yeeta malili abuchi, mbuli Jehova, Leza wabasikale banu, mbakamusyomezya.
Nimutayozubuka Jodani, mukabike mabwe aya ngindikumulayilila atala angawo sunu, a Chilundu cha Ebbalu, akwazilulula amulambo.
Ooko mwelede kuyoyaka chipayililo kuli Jehova Leza wanu, chipayililo chamabwe; pesi mutakabelesyi chibelesyo chalubulo kuti chibeleke mabwe.
Mulelede kuyaka chipayililo cha Jehova Leza wanu amabwe atana belesegwa; alimwi mulelede kupa azipayizyo zyakutenta alinchicho kuli Jehova Leza wanu,
alimwi mukapayizye zipayizyo zyalumvwanano mpawo muyolya nkukoko muyobotelwa kunembo lya Jehova Leza wanu.
Uyolemba amabwe mabala woonse amulawo oyu kabotu antandabale.''
Mozesi abapayizi ba Levi bakaambula ku Izilayeli yoonse akwaamba kuti, ''Amumune alimwi muswilizye, Izilayeli: Sunu mwaba bantu ba Jehova Leza wanu.
Nkiinkako mwelede kuluka ijwi lya Jehova Leza wenu alimwi mulemeke malayilile amilayizyo eyo njindimukumulayilila sunu.''
Mozesi wakalayilila bantu buzuba mbuboobo akwamba kuti,
''Mikowa eyi yelede kwimikila a chilundu cha Gelizimu kuti balongezye bantu kuzwa nibatayozubuke Jolodani: Simiyoni, Levi, Juda, Izakka, Jozefu, a Bbenjamini.
Eyi njemisyobo iyelede kwimikila a chilundu cha Ebbalu kuti bambilizye intuko: Lubbeni, Gadi, Asha, Zebbuluni, Dani, a Nafutali.
Ba Levi bayosandula akwamba kuti kubalumi boonse ba Izilayeli ajwi pati:
Ngatukwe muntu ooyo uchita chikozyanio na chibezedwe, chisesemyo kuli Jehova, mulimu wamaboko wasikubeza, alimwi achibika asisikene.' Eelyo bantu boonse balelede kusandula akwamba akuti , Ameni.
Ngaatukwe muntu oyo uutalemeki wisi na banyina.' Elyo bantu boonse bawambe kuti, Ámeni.'
'Atukwe muntu oyo uugwisya mugaano wasimabambane wakwe.' Elyo bantu boonse baambe kuti, Ámeni.
Atukwe muntu ooyo uchitaa moofu kuti ayempete kuzwa munzila.' Eelyo bantu boonse baambe kuti, Ámeni.'
Atukwe muntu ooyo ubelesya chamanguzu kuti agwisye lumuno kwiinda kumuzwakule, bamuchaala, na mukamufu. Elyo bantu boonse baambe kuti, Ámeni.
''Atukwe muntu ooyo uwona amwanakazi wawisi, nkambo wabweza zyelelo zyawisi.' Eelyo bantu boonse bambe kuti, Ámeni.'
'Atukwe muntu oyo uwona amunyama.' Elyo bantu boonse baambe kuti, 'Ameni.'
'Atukwe muntu oyo uwona amuchizi wakwe, mwana musimbi wawisi, na mwana musimbi wabanyina.' Elyo bantu boonse baambe kuti, 'Ameni.'
'Ngatukwe muntu oyo uwona abanyinazyala.' Elyo bantu boonse baambe kuti,  'Ameni.
'' Atukwe muntu ooyo ujaya simabambanwa wakwe chakumusisikizya. Elyo bantu boonse baambe kuti, 'Ameni.'
'Atukwe muntu oyo umubweza masinkamulomo kukujaya muntu utakwe mulandu. Elyo bantu boonse baambe kuti, 'Ameni.'
'Atukwe muntu oyo utazuminini mabala a mulawu oyu, kuti akilemeke.' Elyo bantu boonse baambe kuti, 'Ameni.
Kuti waswilizya kabotu kujwi lya Jehova Leza wako kuchitila kubamba yoonse milawu yakwe eeyo njindili kukulayilila sunu, Jehova Leza wako uyokubika atala amanyika woonse aanyika.
Zyoonse zilongezyo eezi ziyoza aalinduwe alimwi ziyokuvulila, kuti waswilizya kujwi lya Jehova Leza wako.
Kulongezegwa uyobaako mudolopo alimwi kulongezegwa uyobaako mumuunda.
Kuyolongezegwa muchelo wabula bwako, imuchelo walubuwa lwako amuchelo wazivuubwa zyako, akuyungizigwa kwatanga lyang'ombe alukwichi lukwichi lwambelele zyako.
Kuyolongezegwa insangwa yako abulondozi bwako.
Uyolongezegwa aawo noyonjila mukati, alimwi uyolongezegwa aawo notakazwe aanze.

Jehova uyochita kuti basinkondonyokwe bakakubukile ikuti bakapwayilwe aansi kunembo lyako; bayoozwa aantanganana kukulwana munzila yomwe pesi bayomwayikizyania kunembo lyako munzila zili musanu azibili.
Jehova uyolayilila zilongezyo kuti zize aali n duwe muntombo zyako akuli zyoonse eezyo nzyobika kuboko kwako; uyokulongezya munyika eeyo njali kukupa.
Jehova uyomuchita kuti mukabe bantu bapambwididwe nguwe, mbuli mbakonkezya kuli ndinywe, kuti mwabamba milayililo ya Jehova Leza wako, alimwi mweende munzila zyakwe.
Bonse bantu banyika bayoobona kuti mwiitwa aazina lya Jehova, alimwi bayomuyoowa.
Jehova uyomuchita kuti mukazwidilile loko mumichelo yabulo bwenu, mumuchelo wazivuubwa zyanu, alimwi amumuchelo walubuuwa lwanu mubusena oobo mbwakonka kumawuso kuti bamupe.
Jehova uyojula kulindinywe ing'anda yabulondozi yamajulu kuti akamupe imvula yanyika yanu muchindi cheelede, akulongezya milimo yakuboko kwako; uyoboleka kumanyika miingi, pesi tokoyokweleta pe.

Jehova uyokuchita mutwe, alimwi peepe muchila; uyoba ajulu kwalyoonse, alimwi takwe notakabe munsi, kuti waswilizya milawu ya Jehova Leza wako eeyo njindili kumulayilila sunu, kuchitila kuyilangisisya akuyoyichita,
alimwi kuti tewafutatila nikuba limwi lyamajwi aayo ngindili kukulayilila sunu, kukuboko kwachilisyo na kwachimwensi, kukuti utobele bamwi baleza kukubabelekela.

Pesi kuti tewaswilila kujwi lya Jehova Leza wako, kukubamba yoonse milawu yakwe alimwi azyiimo zyakwe zyamulawu eezyo nzindili kukulayilila sunu, awo yoonse milandu iyoza aali nduwe alimwi iyokuzunda.
Uyoba kotukidwe mudolopo, alimwi uyooba kotukidwe mumuunda.
Kuyotukwa insangwa yako alimwi abulondozi bwako.
Kuyotukwa muchelo wabula bwako, imuchelo walubuwa lwako, ibana balutanga lwang'ombe zyako, alimwi alukwichi lukwichi lwambelele zyako.
Uyotukwa aawo notakaze mjkati, alimwi uyotukwa aawo notakazwe aanze.

Jehova uyotuma zituko aali nduwe, lunyonyongano, akukakilwa muli zyoonse nzotakabike kuboko kwako kuli nzizyo, mane ukamwayigwe, alimwi mane mukamane kufwambana akambo kabusofwazi bwanchito zyako eezyo nzotanooli wandikkaka aazyo.
Jehova uyochita kuti chilwazi chikalengelele aalindinywe mane amumwaye kuzwa aabusena oobo mbumuyobuya mukati kuti bube bwanu.
Jehova uyomulwana amalwazi atabukila, antuntumanzi, achimyoonzi, alimwi abbalangwe akupya kupa matumpwiza, alimwi amabbubbule aaluwo aalume lwampeyo. Eezi ziyomunangatila mane mukamane.
Majulu ako aali atala lyamutwe wako ayooba mubala wa bbulonzi, anyika iili munsi lyako iyooba butale.
Jehova uyochita mvula yabusena bwako ikabe busu alusuko; kuzwa kumajulu iyooza aansi aali nduwe, mane ukamwayike.

Jehova uyochita kuti ukapwachwidwe aansi kunembo lyabasinkondonyokwe; uyoozwa aanze munzila yomwe kukubalwana pesi uyochija kunembo lyabo munzila zili musanu azibili. Uyowaalilwa ooku akooku mukati kabwami bwaansi.
Mubili wako uufwide uyooba kulya kubayuni boonse bamujulu akubanyama balusaka lwaansi; takukoyoba muntu utakabakonge kuti bachije.
Jehova uyokulwana azilondampongo zyaku Ijiputi abulondamaala, bweele, alubaabo, eezyo nzotakonzyi kusilikwa.
Jehova uyokulwana ampengo, aboofu, akunyongaana kwamizeezo.
Uyowumpulika biyo kalibaala isikati mbuli moofu mbawumpulika mumudima, alimwi tokoyozwidilila pe munzila zyako; uyodyamizigwa kwalyoonse akubbidwa, alimwi takukoyoba muntu utakakuvune.
Uyoba akuyandana amwanakazi, pesi umwi mwalumi uyomubweza akamoone chakwangila. Uyoyaka ng'anda pesi tokoyolala mulinjiyi; uyobyala mumunda wamichelo pesi tokoyoyinonezya pe michelo yawo.

Imusune wako uyoneneya kunembo lyamenso ako, pesi tokoyoyilya pe inyama yawo; idonki lyako liyobwezwa changuzu kuzwa kunembo lyako alimwi talikoyoboozegwa pe kulinduwe. Imbelele zyako ziyopegwa basinkondonyokwe, alimwi tokoyoba amuntu pe utakakugwasye.
Ibana bako balombe abasimbi bayopegwa kulibambi bantu; menso aako ayobayanduula bweeni bwezuba lyonse, pesi uyokachilwa akubazimba. Takukoyoba nguzu pe mukuboko kwako.
Ibutebuzi bwabusena bwako aboonse bwanguzu zyako - inyika njotazi iyobulya; uyodyamiizigwa lyonse akumanikizigwa,
kuchitila kuti ukabe chiteeleli achecho nchotakabone kachichitika.
Jehova uyokulwana mumazwi amawulu azilondampongo eezyo nzyotakabule kusilikika, kuzwa kunsi lyamawulu aako kusika aatala lyamutwe wako.
Jehova uyokutola amwaami ooyo ngotakabike atala lyako kuchisi nchotana ziba, nikuba nduwe na basikale bako; ooko muyokomba bamwi baleza bachisamu amabwe.
Uyoba chisiko chaziyoosya, ikasimpi, alimwi agambilambali, mukati kabantu boonse ooko Jehova nkwayokuzulwida kwinka.
Uyobweza imbuto inyingi kuzwa kutola mumuunda, pesi uyobwezelela mbuto inche, nkambo insozi ziyoyilya.
Uyobyala imichelo akuyisakwida, pesi takwe notakanywe kufumbwa wayini, nikuba kana kubwezelela misansa, nkambo zivwinyu ziyowalya.
Uyoba amisamu ya olivi mubusena bwako boonse, pesi tokoyonana pe nikuba mafuta aalinduwe, nkambo minsamu yako ya olivi iyokunkumuna yoonse michelo yayo.
Uyoba abana balombe abasimbi, pesi tabakoyokukkalilila kabali bako pe, nkambo bayoyinka mubuzike.
Yoonse imisamu yako amichelo yalubuwa lwako - insozi ziyoyibweza.
Imuzwakule uuli akkati kenu uyosumpuka kuya aatala andinywe aaajulu julu; Iwe lwako uyoselela aansi aansi.
Uyokucheneka, pesi iwe tokoyomucheneka pe; we uyoba mutwe, alimwi iwe uyooba muchila.

Zyoonse izituko eezi ziyoza alinduwe alimwi ziyokunangatila akukuzunda mane ukamwayike. Eezi ziyochitika nkambo tewaswilila pe ijwi lya Jehova Leza wako, mbuli mukubamba milawu yakwe azyiindo zyakwe ezyo nzyakakulayilila.
Eezi zituko ziyoba aali nduwe mbuli zitondezyo azigambyo, alimwi kulunyungu lwako kwalyonse.
Nkambo tewakomba Jehova Leza wako akubotelwa akulumba kwamoyo aawo niwali mukuzwidilila,
nkinkako uyobelekela basinkondonyokwe aabo Jehova mbayotuma kuzokulwana; uyobabelekela munzala, munyota, muchintanda, mubuchete. Uyobika ijokwe ensingo yako mane akakumwaye.
Jehova uyoyeeta ichisi chitazokulwane kuzwa kule, kuzwa kumagolelo aanyika, mbuli insika mbwiwuluka kuya kuli nchiilya kukuyochinyonyona, ichisi chamulaka ngotamvwisisisyi;
ichisi chili abusyu buyoosya  eecho chitalemeki bacheembala alimwi chitatondezyi insoni kubanini.

Bayoolya ibana bazivuubwa zyako amuchelo wabusena bwako mane ukamwayike. Tabakoyokusiila nseke yechilyo, iwayini mpya, nikuba mafuta, takwe itunamani twetanga lyako nikuba lukwichi lukwichi lwambele zyako, mane bakachite kuti umane.

Bayokujalila kumilyango yoonse yadolopo lyako, mane bulambo bwako bulamfu bwamweelo mulemu bukolomokele busena bwako boonse, ibulambo mbuwali kusyoma. Bayokujalila mukati kumulyango kubusena boonse obo Jehova Leza wako mbwakakupede.
Uyolya muchelo wamubili wako mwini, inyama yabana bako balombe ayabana bako basimbi, aabo Jehova Leza wako mbakakupa, mukujalilwa alimwi mukutyompwa oko basinkondonyokwe nkubabika aalinduwe.
Imwalumi imubombe alimwi utentuusya loko mukati kenu - uyooba sikwemuzya kumukulana amwanakazi muyandwi wakwe mwini, akubana kufumbwa mbasiya.

Nkokuti  takoyopa naba umwi wabo inyama yabana bakwe mwini eeyo njatalye, nkambo takwe nchatakasyale aacho pe mukujalilwa amukutyompwa oko basinkondonyokwe nkubayobika aali nduwe mukati kamilyango yoonse yadolopo.

Imwanakazi imubombe alimwi utentuusya mukati kenu, utakabule kuyanda kubika itako lyano lyakwe aansi mubutentuusyi abubombe - uyooba mutangazu kumwalumi muyandwi wakwe mwini, akubana bakwe balombe akubana bakwe basimbi,

akuli wakwe wakazyalwa mupya ooyo uzwa aanze kuzwa akkati kamawulu akwe , akubana aabo mbatakalele. Uyobalya chakusisikizya mukubula chimwi chintu chawumbi musyobo, muchindi chakujalilwa alimwi mukutyompwa oko basinkondonyokwe nkubatakabike aalinduwe mukati kamilyango yadolopo lyako.
Kuti tewabamba woonse majwi amulawu ooyu aayo alembedwe mubbuku eeli, mukulemeka eeli zina akuyoosya, Jehova Leza wako,
awo Jehova uyochita kuti malwazi aako akaleme, ababo balunyungu lwako; bayooba amalwazi mapati kwachindi chilamfu, amalwazi makali kwachindi chilamfu.
Alimwi uyoyeta aalinduwe malwazi woonse aku Ijipiti aayo ngiwali kuyowa; ayojatilila aalinduwe.
Alimwi choonse chilwazi achipadwazi echo chitalembedwe mubbuku lyamulawu ooyu, ezyo azilazyo Jehva uyoyeta aalinduwe mane nkamwayike.
Muyochala kamuli bache kumwelwe, nikuba kuti mwakali mbuli nyenyezi zyamujulu kumweelwe, nkambo temwakaswilila kujwi lya Jehova Leza wako.

Mbuli Jehova mbakali wabotelwa lomwe atala anduwe mukumuchitila kabotu, akukumuvuzya, nkokuti uyobotelwa atala andinywe mukuchita kuti mumane akumumwaya. Muyogwisigwa mubusena obo mumuyonjila kuti mukabulele.

Jehova uyomusansania mukati kabantu boonse kuzwa kuli limwi golelo lyanyika kusika kulilimbi igolelo lyanyika; oko muyokomba bamwi baleza abo mbimwatakalina kuziba, nikuba ndinywe kana basikale benu, baleza bazisamu abamabwe.
Mukati kezisi ezi tamukoyojana kuubilwa, alimwi takukoyoba kulyokezya kuzwa kunsi lyamawulu enu; anukuti, Jehova uyomupa moyo uteketa oko, menso aakachilwa , amuuya uulila.
Buumi bwenu buyolengelela mukudoneka kunembo lyenu; muyoyoowa busiku boonse abuzuba alimwi tamukoyoba abwiini lyoonse mubuumi bwenu.
Chifumofumo muyowamba kuti, 'Ndipeekezya kuti anoli lyali golezya!' alimwi golezya muyowamba kuti, 'Ndipeekezya kuti anoli lyalikuseni !'akambo kakuyowa mumyoyo yenu azintu menso aanu nzyatakabone.
Jehova uyomweta mu Ijipiti lubo amaato, munzila eyo njindali ndamwambila, 'Tamukoyobona Ijipiti alimwi.'oko muyolipedekezya kuli basinkonyokwe mbuli balumi abanakazi bazike, pesi takwe utakamuule.''
Aaya ngemalayilile Jehova ngakalayilila Mozesi kuti awambile bantu bakwa Izilayeli mubusena bwaku Mowabbu, majwi akayungizizigwa kuchizuminano echo nchakali wachita ambabo ku Holebbu.
Mozesi wakayita boonse ba Izilayeli akubaambila kuti, ''Mwabona zyoonse Jehobva nzyakachita kunembo lya menso enu kuli Falo mubusena bwa Ijiputi, kubabelesi bakwe boonse, akubusena bwakwe boonse -
imachise mapati aabonwa amenso eenu, izitondezyo, azezyo zigambyo zipati.
Pesi ambuli sunu Jehova tanamupa pe moyo wakaziba, menso aakubona, nikuba matwi aakumvwa.
Ndamuzulwida kwamyaaka makumi oone mulusaka; zisamo zyenu tezyakazakala pe aali ndinywe, alimwi insapato zyenu tezyakazakala pe kumawulu eenu.
Temwakalya pe chibunge, alimwi takwe nimwakanywa wayini nikuba kamwi kakunywa kali aabukande, kuchitila kuti mukonzye kuziba kuti ndime Jehova Leza wenu.
Nimwakasika kulobu busena, Sihoni, mwaami waku Heshibboni, a Ogu, mwaami waku Bbashani, wakaza aanze kuzotulwana, alimwi twakabawuma bawidaansi.
Twakabweza busena bwabo akuyiipa mbuli lukono kuba Lebbenayiti, kuba Gadayiti, akuchisela chamusyobo wa Manase.
Nkiinkako mubaambe majwi achizuminano achakwachita, kuchitila kuti muzwidilile kulizyoonse nzimuchita.
Mwayima sunu, moonse, kunembo lya Jehova Leza wenu; baami benu, misyobo yenu, bapati benu, abasimilimo benu - boonse baalumi baku Izilayeli,
iitwanikenike twenu, banakazi benu, amuzwakule uuli mukati kenu mubbwalo lyenu, kuzwa kuli nguwe utema zisamu zyenu kuli nguwe uuteka maanzi enu.
Muli aano kuchitila kuti m unjile muchizuminano cha Jehova Leza wenu amuzikonke ezyo Jehova Leza wenu nchali kuchita andinywe sunu,
Kuchitila kuti akonzye kumuchita sunu mube bantu bakwe, akuti abe Leza wenu, mbuli mbakamwambila, alimwi mbuli mbakakonkezya kuli basikale benu, kuli Abbulahamu, kuli Ayizeki, akuli Jakobbu.
Nkambo nsilikuchita chizuminano echi achikonke echi andinywe biyo -
amuntu woonse uyimvwi andiswe aano sunu kunembo lya Jehova Leza wesu - pesi alimwi ababo batawo pe aano andiswe sunu.
Mulizi mbutwakapona mubusena bwa Ijipiti, ambuli mbutwakazwa mukati kazisi oomo mumwakiinda.
Mwakazibona zileza zyabo zisesemya zichitidwe amabwe, nsiliva angolide, ezyo zyakali mukati kabo.

Mubone kasimpe kuti mukati kenu takwe mwalumi, mwanakazi, mukowa kana musyobo ulaamoyo uchengunuka sunu kuzwa kuli Jehova Leza wesu, kaya kukukomba baleza bamanyika ayo. Mubone kasimpe kuti takwe muyanda mukati kenu upanga mululwe achisamu chamayoka.
Aawo muntu oyo namvwa majwi achituko echi, ulalilongezya mumoyo wakwe akwamba kuti, 'Ndiyojana luumuno, nikuba kuti ndiyobweenda abulundumazi bwamoyo wangu. Ézi zyali kujaya butete antomwe abuyumu.

Jehova takondilubila, pesi anukuti, bukali bwa Jehova abbivwe lyakwe ziyosima kulangana amwalumi oyo, amilandu yoonse ilembedwe mubbuku eeli iyooza ali nguwe, alimwi Jehova uyozima izina lyakwe kuzwa munsi lyajulu.
Jehova uyomubika kumbali kuzwa kumisyobo yoonse ya Izilayeli kuti akajane lunyonyoono, mukubamba yoonse milandu yachizuminano eyo ilembedwe muli eli bbuku lya mulawu.
Izyalane liza, bana benu batakomene musule lyanu, amuzwakule uzwa kubusena bwakulekule, bayowambula awo bakubona zyuuka abusena obu amalwazi ayo Jehova ngachita kuti ichiswe -

alimwi nibabona kuli boonse busena bwaba salufa amwiinyo uyaka nakuumpa, awo atakwe chibyalwa na kuzyala muchelo, atakwe chikonzya kumena, mbuli kufwidilila kwa Sodomu a Gomola, Adina a Zebboyimu, ezyo Jehova nzyakajana mubukali alunyonyoono lwakwe -
bayowamba antomwe amanyika amwi, 'Nkambonzi Jehova nachita echi kubusena obu? Kupya kwabukali bupati kwambaanzi ?'
Mpawo bantu balaamba kuti, ''Nkaambo kakuti bakasowa chizuminano cha Jehova, Leza wabasikale baabo, echo ndakachita ambabo awo nakabeeta kuzwa mubusena bwa Ijiputi,
alimwi nkambo kakuti bakiinka bakubelekela bamwi baleza akubakotamina, baleza mbibakatalina ziba alimwi mbatakabapa pe.
Nkiinkaako bukali bwa Jehova bwaka nyemununwa atala abusena obu, kuchitila kuti kwetwe aalinjiyo yoonse milandu eyo ilembedwe mubbuku eeli.
Jehova wabanyukula kuzwa mubusena bwabo abuluti, mulunyonyoono, amukunyema kupati, alimwi wabasowela muli bumbi busena, mbuli sunu.'
Makani asisidwe nga Jehova Leza wesu alike; pesi izintu zyayubununwa zyonse nzizyesu kwalyoonse alunyungu lwesu, kuchitila kuti tukonzye kuchita woonse majwi amumulawu oyu.
Niziyosika zintu ezi zyoonse kulindinywe, zilongezyo alutuko oolo ndondakabika kunembo lyenu, na mwayeezya zisi zimwi oko Jehova Leza wenu nkwakamutandila,
alimwi na mwabola kuli Jehova Leza wanu akuswilila jwi lyakwe, akutobela zyoonse ezyo nzindamulayilila buzuba obuno - nywebo abana banu  - amyoyo yanu yoonse achamuuya woonse,
elyo Jehova Leza wanu uyomubozya kuzwa kuzwa kubwange alimwi uyomufwida luzyalo; uyomuboozya alimwi akumukkazika akati kabantu boonse oko Jehova Leza wanu nkwakamutandilide.
Nekuba kuti bantu banu batandilidwe kumasena alikule kunsi ajulu, kuzwa oko Jehova Leza wanu uyomugwisya, alimwi kuzwa oko uyomuboozya.
Jehova Leza wanu uyomuboozya munyika eyo bamawuso njibakavbide, alimwi muyoyivuba lubo; uyomuchitila zibotu alimwi uyomuvuzya kwinda bamawuso babamawuso.
Jehova Leza wanu uyopalula myoyo yanu amyoyo yalunyungu lwanu, aboobo muyoyanda Jehova Leza wanu amoyo wanu woonse amuuya wanu woonse, nkokuti mukapone.
Jehova Leza wanu uyobika intuko ezi zyoonse kul;i basinkondonyokwe akuli babo bamusula, aboo bakamupenzya.
Anywebo muyobola alimwi mukaswilile ijwi lya Jehova, alimwi muyochita yoonse milayizyo yakwe eyo njendimukumulayilila buzuba obuno sunu.

Jehova Leza wanu uyomuvuzizya buvubi mumilimo yamanza anu, amumichelo yamibili yanu, amichelo yazivubwa zyanu, alimwi amumichelo yanyika yanu, ibe buvubi nkambo Jehova uyokondwa alimwi akumuchitila kuti muzwidilile, mbuli mbwakakondwa kuli bamawuso.

Uyozuzikizya makanze akwe na mwaswilila ijwi lya Jehova Leza wanu, mbuli kubamba milayizyo yakwe amalayilile akwe ayo alembedwe mubbuku eeli lyamulawu, na mwaboola kuli Jehova Leza wanu chamoyo woonse achamya wanu woonse.
Nkambo mulayizyo oyu ngundikumulayilila buzuba obuno tulimuyumu pe kulindinywe, nikuba kuba kule.
Tuuli kujulu, nkomukonzya kwamba kuti, ngwani ukonzya kuya kujulu kuyowuleta kuti tuuswilile, kuti tukakonzye kuuchita ?'
Nokuba kuti uli mutala lyalwizi, kuti mukonzye kwamba kuti, ngwani ukonzya kuzubuka mutala alwizi kuti akatwetele kuti tuuswilile, kuti tukonzye kuuchita ?'
Pesi ijwi lilafwifwi loko andinywe, lili mukanwa lyanu amumyoyo yanu, kuti mulichite.
Langa, sunu ndabika kubusyu bwako buumi abubotu, lufu abubi.

Kuti mwaswilila milawu ya Jehova Leza wanu, eyi njendi mukumulayilila buzuba obuno muyandisye Jehova Leza wanu, mweende munzila yakwe, ambeta zyakwe, muyopona akuvula, alimwi Jehova Leza wanu uyomulongezya munyika eyo njomuyo njila akwivuba.
Pesi kuti myoyo yanu yalanga musule, alimwi mwabula kuswilila pesi mwagwisigwa munzila akukotamina baleza bambi akukomba mbabo,
elyo ndamuzibya buzuba obuno kuti nkasimpe muyomana; tamukoyowongola munyika nimuyozubuka mutala lya Jodano akwivuba.
Ndatamba ijulu anyika buzuba obuno zibe bakamboni ndabika kunembo lyanu buumi alufu, zilongezyo alutuko; nkiinkako amusale buumi kuti mukonzye kupona, inywebo alunyungu lwanu.

Amuswilile akuyandisya Jehova Leza wanu, kuswilila ijwi lyakwe, alimwi amukakatile nguwe. Nkaambo mbobuumi bwanu amazuba akoongola kwanu; amuchite eezyo Jehova nzyakakonkezya bamawuso, kuli Abbulahamu, a Izaka alimwi a Jakobo, akupa mbabo.''
Mozesi wakiinka wakwambila bana ba Izilayeli boonse majwi aya.
Wakati kulimbabo, kwalino ndaba myaka ili mwana amukumi obilwe; Nsichikonzyi pe kuya bwendenda; Jehova wakandambila kuti, tokoyozubuka oyu Jodani.'
Jehova Leza wanu, uyomuzulwida; uyomunyonyweda eyi mikowa ili kunembo lyanu, alimwi muyobatanda, Joshuwa, uyomuzulwida, mbuli Jehova mbakaamba.
Jehova uyobachitila mbubonya mbwakachitila Sihoni a Ogi, baami baba Amoli, akunyika yabo, eyo njakanyonyoona.
Jehova uyobaaba kulindinywe, alimwi muyobachitila zintu zyonse nzindakamulayilila.
Amuyume akuba basinguzu, mutayoowi, alimwi mutakabakankami; nkambo Jehova Leza wanu, ngumwenda awe, takoyokachilwa nikuba kumulekelezya.''

Mozesi wakayita Joshuwa alimwi wamwambila kumeso aba Izilayeli boonse, ''Kobasinguzu akuba muyumu, nkambo nduwe uyoyinka abantu aba  munyika eyo Jehova Leza njakakonkezya kupa bamawisi babo; nduwe uyobavubya njiyo.
Jehova, ulikunembo lyanu, uyoba aanywebo; takoyomusiya nikuba kumuleka biyo, mutayoowi, mutatyompwi.''
Jehoa wakalemba oyu mulawu alimwi wakawupa bapayizi, bana balombe ba Levi, basikubweza bbokesi lyechizuminano cha Jehova; alimwi wakapa imwi kubapati boonse ba Izilayeli.
Mozesi wakabalayilila wati, ''Kumamanino amyaaka yoonse ili musanu ayibili, kuchiindi chibikidwe chazimpanzi zyalwangunuko, kuchiindi chapobwe lyazilawu;
awo ba Izilayeli boonse nibayoboneka kunembo lya Jehova Leza wanukubusena obo mbwayosala bwachikombelo chakwe, mubale mulawu oyu mumatwi aba Izilayeli boonse.
Amubunganie bantu, balumi, abanakazi, abana, abeenzu bakkede kumilyango yamyuunzi yanu, kuti bakonzye kumvwa akwiiya, kuti bakonzye kulemeka Jehova Leza wanu akubamba majwi woonse amumulawu oyu.
Muchiite obo kuti bana babo, batana kuziba, bakonzye kumvwa akwiiya kulemeka Jehova Leza wanu, kufumbwa mwanopona munyika eyo njemuyovuba mutala a Jodano.''

Jehova wakambila Mozesi kuti, ''Langa, buzuba bwasika uyelede kufwa; yiita Joshuwa mukalitondezye mukatikatente lyakubunganina, kuti nkamupe malayilile.'' Mozesi a Joshuwa bakanjila balitondezya beni mutente lyakubunganina.
Jehova wakalibonia mumusumpululu mujoba mutente; musumpululu wajoba wakayima kumulyango watente.

Jehova wakambila Mozesi kuti, ''Langa, uyowona abamawuso; bantu aba bayozubuka akuyabuvula abaleza bambi abo bali akati kabo munyika eyo nkobayinka. Bayondileka mebo akutyola chizuminano changu echo nchindaka tangene ambabo.

Lino mubuzuba obo, bukali bwangu buyobabukila alimwi ndiyobasiya. Ndiyosisa busyu bwangu kuzwa kulimbabo, nkabela bayosyukuta. Manji makatazyo amapenzi ayobasikila mane bakambe mubuzuba obo; kuti sa aaya makatazyo atusikila nkambo kakuti Leza wesu tali akati kesu ?'
Nkasimpe njosisa busyu bwangu kuzwa kulimbabo mubuzuba obo nkambo kabubi boonse mbubakachita, nkambo batobela baleza bambi.
Lino nkiinkaako lemba olu lwiimbo omwini akuyiisya bantu ba Izilayeli. Bikka mumilomo yabo, elyo kuti lwiimbo olu lube kamboni wangu kubana ba Izilayeli.

Nkambo ninjobasisizye kunyika njindaka konkezya bamawisi, inyika ikunka buchi amalili, alimwi nibayoolya akukkuta akuneneeya, elyo bayotobela baleza bambi akuyo bakomba alimwi bayondisampawula mebo akutyola chizuminano changu.

Nibayosikilwa bubi amapenzi manji bantu aba, lwimbo olu luyobabeda bukamboni kunembo lyabo ( talukoyo lubwa kumilomo yalunyungu lwabo ) Nkambo ndizi kale miyeeyo yabo njibayeya sunu, nekuba kuti nsinakuba sisya kunyika eyo njindakabasyomezya.''
Eelyo Mozesi wakalemba olu lwimbo mubuzuba obo akuyiisya bantu ba Izilayeli.
Jehova wakalayilila Joshuwa mwana wa Nuni wati, ''Kobasinguzu alimwi akuyuma kubotu; nkambo nduwe uyonjizya bantu ba Izilayeli munyika eyo njindakabakonkezya, elyo ndiyoba ayeebo.''
Chakachitika kuti awo Mozesi nakamana kulemba majwi amulawu oyu mubbuku,
Wakalayilila ba Levi basikubweza bbokesi lyachizuminano cha Jehova, wati,
''Bweza ibbuku eli lyamulawu mulibikke kul;ubazu lwabbokesi lyachizuminano cha Jehova Leza wanu, likkale nkuko libe kamboni kulindinywe.
Nkambo ndizi kupapa kwanu abuyumu bwamyoyo yanu; langa, asunu nenchipona akati kanu sunu, muliba sichizindwe kuli Jehova; sa tamukoyoyindilila ndafwa ?
Amuyobololwe kulindime bapati boonse bamikowa yanu yoonse, abasilutwe banu, kuti ngambe majwi aya mumatwi aabo ntambe ijulu anyika zibe kamboni kulimbabo.

Nkambo ndizi kuti kusule lyakufwa kwangu muyolisofwazya lwanu nobeni akuleya munzila eyo njindakamulayilila; mapenzi ayomusikila mumazuba aboola.  Echi chiyochitika nkambo mwachita bubi mumeso a Jehova, aboobo mwamukalazya akambo kamilimo yamanza anu.''
Mozesi wakamba mumatwi ambungano yoonse ya Izilayeli majwi alwiimbo olu mane wamaninizya woonse.
Swiililila, yomajulu, alimwi ngaambule. Ayilayo nyika itelele majwi amulomo wangu.
Luyiisyo lwangululoke mbuli imvula, majwi angu aseluke mbuli luume, mbuli imvula isansiila esokwe lyakamwemvwe, alimwi mbuli lunywaanywa amisamu.
Nkaambo ndiyowamba izina lya Leza, alimwi akuyopa bupati kuli Leza wesu.
Ibbwe, milimu yakwe ililuleme; eelyo nzila zyakwe zyoonse zililuleme. Ngu Leza uusyomekede, uutakwepe chibi. Uliluleme alimwi abuluzi.
Bakachita zitalomene akwiminana anguwe. Tabali bana  bakwe. Nkubula luzyalo lwabo. Balipilingene alimwi mukowa utaluleme.
Mulabwedezya mpindu na kuli Jehova enzila eyi, inywebo nobafubafuba bantu batakwe manu pe? Wakamubumba akumukkazika.
Amuyeeye mumizezo mazuba azyindi zyansiku, amuyeye atala aminyaka myiindi yabantu bakayinda bansiku.  Mubuzye kuli wuso alimwi uyomutondezya, bapati banu alimwi bayomwambila.
Eelyo Mupati Kampatila wakapa manyika lukono lwabo - eelyo nakanzanisya bantu bamisyobo yonse, alimwi wakabikka migano yabantu, mbuli mwakayumisizya mweelwe wabaleza babo.
Jehova chaabilo chakwe mbantu bakwe; Jakkobbu ndukkono lwakwe lubikidwe.
Wakamujana munyika yenkanda, mutazyali chintu, munyika yakulila; wakamukkwabilila akumulela, wakamukwabilila mbuli mulanga walinso lyakwe.
Mbuli nsika eyo ikwabilila chizumbo cheyo akuuluka wuluka ajulu lyabana bayo, Jehova wakatandabika mababa aakwe akubabweza alimwi wakababweza mumababa aakwe.
Jehova alikke wakamuzulwida, takwe baleza benzu bakali anguwe pe.
Wakamuchita kuti atante aabusena buli ajulu aanyika, alimwi wakamusanina michelo yawamuunda, wakamunanika abuchi buzwa mubbwe, alimwi amafuta azwa munyika yamabwe.
Wakalya mafuta akazwa mumutwe akunywa malili akazwa mubutanga, amatanga ambelele, bagutu ba Bbasyani ampongo, abunante bwampunga - alimwi wakanywa wayini wakapangwa kuzwa kumusinza wamasansa.
Pesi Jesuluni wakakomena kanenede akuzunda - wakakomena koneneede, wakaneneede loko, alimwi wakalyide zyakulikkutya kwako - wakaluba Leza wakamulenga, alimwi wakasulayika Ibbwe lyalufutuko lwakwe.
Bakachita Jehova kuti abe abbivwe akambo kabaleza babo beenzu; azisesemyo zyabo bakamunyemya.
Bakali[eda kuba dayimona, abo bakatali Leza -- baleza mbibakatezi, baleza bakayandozoba, baleza bakatayowedwe abamawisi.
Mwakakaaka Ibbwe, Oyo wakaba wuso, alimwi mwakaluba Leza oyo wakamuzyala.
Jehova wakabona ezi alimwi wakabakaka, nkambo bana babo balombe babo basimbi bakamuniaka mbubo.
''Ndiyosisa busyu bwangu kuzwa kuli mbabo,'' wakati, ''Alimwi ndiyobona magolelo abo mbaatakabe, nkaambo nizyalane litaluleme, bana batasyomeki.
Mwakandipa ibbivwe azezyo zitali leza alimwi mwakandinyemya azintu zitakwe lugwasyo pe. Njobafwisya bbivwe abaabo batali bantuloko pe; abantu bafubafuba ndiyobanyemya.
Nkambo mulilo wadukulwa kuli mbabo akunyema kwangu alimwi ulikuyaka kuyosika kunsi lya Shiyoli; uyonyonyoona nyika abutebuzi bwayo; ilokudukula mulilo kuntalisyo yazilundu.
Ndiyolundika lunyonyono kuli mbabo; ndiyowaala yonse mivwi yangu kuli mbabo;
Bayonyonyoonwa enzala akuyonyonyoonwa a puumina lipya akumwayulwa kwindilide; ndiyotuma kulimbabo meno abanyama bamulusaka, abuyoka bwezintu ziyavula mulusuko.
Awanze achilwanio ndiyojaya, amumuunda akulala ndiyochita mbubo. Uyonyonyoonwa antomwe abalumi bachili banini abanakalindu, bana bachinyonka, alimwi abalumi bali amasusu edyota.
Ndazyamba ezi kuti ndiyo bamwaya kule, kuchitila kuti ndikachite miyeyo yabo ikalubwe akati kamisyobo yabantu.
Oko kutali nkwindakayoowa kuniakwa abasinkondoma, alimwi oko basinkondonyina nkubatakalange chakulubizya, alimwi oko nkubatakatedi, kuboko kwesu kuli lemekedwe, ndiyochita zyoonse ezi.
Nkambo Izilayeli nchisi chizwide busongo, alimwi taakwe kumvwisisisyania muli mbabo.
Maawe, kwanoli bali basongo, kuti kaba mvwisisisya eechi, kuti nkabalangisisye chitakaze kumamanino!
Mbubuli mbwanga woomwe ayende achuulu, alimwibobile babikke zyuulu makkumi kuti zyuuluke, aanze akuti ibbwe lyabo lyabawuzya, alimwi Jehova wakapeda kujulu?
Nkambo ibbwe lyabasinkondoma talili mbuli ibbwe lyesu pe, kufumbwa nikuba basinkondoma bazumizya.
Nkambo masansa aabo azwa kumisansa ya Sodomu, alimwi kuzwa mumyunda ya Gomola; masansa aabo masansa akola; zikkata zyawo zilalula.
Wayini wabo mbuyooka bwenzoka abuyooka bukkali bwenzoka zyamumaanzi.
Teensi aaya maanu akabambidwe andime chakusiswa, ijalilidwe akati kabulondozi bwangu?
Ubwedezya chibi ndime kukupa, akuyobwedezya, kulecho chiindi mawulu aabo nayolebwa, nkambo mazuba alunyonyooko kulimbabo abaafwifwi, azintu ezyo ziyobuza aalimbabo ziyofwambana kuchitika.''
Nkambo Jehova uyobeteka bantu bakwe, alimwi uyofwida luzyalo balanda bakwe. Uyobona kuti inguzu zyabo zyiinka, alimwi takwepe wasyaala, bazike babo na bantu banguunukide.
Eelyo uyowamba kuti, ''Balikuli baleza babo, ibbwe omo nkobakali kuyubila,
baleza bakali kulya mafuta azipayizyo zyabo zinenede alimwi akunywa wayini wazipayizyo zyabo zinywigwa? Ngababuke akumugwasya; ababe chilikwabilizyo chenu.

Mubone kuti lino imebo, nikuba lwangu, ndime Leza, alimwi takwepe umbi leza kunze kwangu; Ndilajaya, alimwi ndilapa buumi; Ndilapa machise, alimwi ndilaponesya, alimwi tawope unga uyomuvuna kuzwa kubupati bwangu.
Nkambo ngandanyampula kuboko kwangu kumajulu akwamba kuti, 'Mbuli mbwempona kwalyonse, Ndiyochichita.
Elyo nindakanona panga lyangu libalamisya,, alimwi naa kuboko kwangu kwatalika kweeta lubeteko, ndiyopa mpindu imbi kuli basinkondoma, alimwi ndiyobwedezya kuli bako batandiyandi.
Ndiyochita mivwi yangu ikakkolegwe agaze, alimwi panga lyangu liyoolya nyama agaze lyabajayigwa abalimubuzike, alizwa mumutwe yabazuluzi babasilumamba.''
Mubotelwe, nywebo yozisi, abantu ba Leza, nkambo uyobwedezya gaze lyabalanda bakwe; uyobwedezya bubi kuli basindonyina, alimwi uyochita chizuminano kunyika yakwe, akubantu bakwe.
Mozesi wakasika akubandika woonse majwi aalwimbo olu mumatwi abantu, lwakwe, a Joshuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni.
Mpawo Mozesi wakamaninsya kwiimba woonse majwi kulibonse ba Izilayeli.
Wakati kuli mbabo, ''Amubike myoyo yenu kumajwi woonse ngiibamba kuli ndinywe sunu, kuchitila kuti mukalayilile bana benu kuti baachite, woonse majwi amumulawu oyu.
Nkambo echi tachili chintu chinini kuli ndinywe, nkambo mawumi aanu, alimwi kwindilila kuli eechi chintu muyowongola kumazuba akupona kwanu munyika eyo njimuyovuba mutala lya Jolodani.''
Jehova wakambula kuli Mozesi muli mbuboobo buzuba akwamba kuti,
''Taanta muchilundu echi cha Abbalimu, atala akalundu ka Nebo, echo chili munyika ya Mowabbu, ilangene a Jelikko. Uyolanga munyika ya Kkenani, eyo njilikupa kubantu ba Izilayeli mbuli lukkono lwabo.
Uyofwa muchilundu echo nchotakatante, alimwi uyobunganinwa kubantu bako, mbuli Aloni mwenzinyokwe mu Izilayeli mbakafwa mukalundu ka Holi alimwi wakabunganinwa kubantu bakwe.
Ezi ziyochitika nkambo tewakasyomeka pe kuli ndime akati kabantu ba Izilayeli kumaanza a Melibba mu Kkadeshi, munkanda ya Ziini; nkambo temwakandipa bulemu pe akundilemeka akati kabantu ba Izilayeli.
Kubona ulabona nyika kunembo lyako, pesi tokoyoyinka nkuko pe, munyika eyo njendimukupa bantu ba Izilayeli.''
Eechi nchechilongezyo Mozesi mulanda wa Leza nchakalongezya bantu ba Izilayeli katana kufwa kwakwe.

Wakati: Jehova wakazwa ku Sinayi alimwi wakabuka kuzwa ku Seyili alimbabo. Wakamweka aanze kuzwa muchilundu chaPalani, alimwi wakaza azyuulu zyazyuulu zyabasalali, kukuboko kwakuchilisyo kwakali mimuuni yandabi.
Nchobeni, wakayandisya bantu bakwe; bantu bakwe boonse basalala bali mujanza lyako, alimwi bakakotama aansi kumawulu ako; bakatambula majwi aako.
Mozesi wakatulayilila mulawu, lukono lwambungano ya Jakobo..
Mpawo kwakali mwami mu Jeshuluni, eelyo bazuluzi babantu nibakabungene, yoonse misyobo ya Izilayeli antomwe.
Leka Lubbeni apone alimwi atafwi, pesi bantu bakwe ngabacheye.
Eechi nchilongezyo cha Juda. Mozesi wakati: swilizya, Jehova, kujwi lya Juda, alimwi akumweta kubantu bakwe lubo. Umulwanine; ube mugwasyi kuli basinkondonyina.
Aatala a Levi, Mozesi wakati: Tumimu wako alimwi a Ulimu uyoba wababo bako basyomekene, aabo mbiwakasunka ku Maasa, aamwi ayooyo ngwakalwisyania awe kumanzi a Melibba.
Mwalumi wakambula aatala awisi abanyina, ''Tendakababona pe,'' nikuba kutambula bakulana bakwe, nikuba kuluba bana bakwe. Nkambo wakabamba majwi aako akubamba chizuminano chako.
Uuyiisya Jakobo malayilile ako a Izilayeli milawu yako. Uyobika tununkilizyo kunembo lyako akuteenta chipayizyo chikwene achipayililo chako.
Longezya, Jehova, imbono zyakwe, akutambula mulimu wamaboko akwe. Bawume muchibuno aabo babukilana ambabo, akuli baabo bantu bamusula, kuchitila kuti tabazobuki lubo pe.
Alatala a Bbenjamini, Mozesi wakati; Ooyo uyandwa a Jehova upona kabotu mulinguwe. Jehova ulamubamba izuba lyonse alimwi ulapona akati kamaboko a Jehova.
Alatala a Jozefu, Mozesi wakati: Inyika yakwe ilongezegwe a Jehova aziyandisi zibotu zyakujulu, ziluleme alimwi kazinikide kuyansi.
Inyika yakwe ilongezegwe azintu ziyandisi zibotu zizwa kukutebula kwazuba, ziyandisi zibotu zizwa kumyeezi.
alimwi a zintu zibotu loko zyamuzilundu zyachiindi, alimwi azintu zibotu zyamuzilundu zitamani.

Inyika yakwe ilongezegwe azintu ziyandisi zibotu zyanyika amubwiingi zwazyo, amububotu bwayoyo iwakali musokwe. Zilongezyo azize amutwe wa Jpsefa, alimwi aajulu amutwe wayoyo wakali mupati kaba kulana bakwe.

Mutanzi kukuzyalwa mwana ng'ombe wamusune, mupati kampatila nguwe, alimwi meja akwe alimbuli meeja a nyati yamusokwe, ambabo, bonse kusikila kumagolelo aanyika aaba mwanda yazyuulu zya Efulemu aba nchechuulu cha Manase.
Alatala a Zebbuloni, Mozesi wakati: Kondelelwa, Zebbuloni, mukwenda kwako nuzwa, anduwe Izakka, mutente lyako.
Bayoyita banrtu kuzilundu, ooko bayopa zipayizyo zyabululami, nkambo bayonyonka zyiingi zyamulwizi amumuseele wakunkomwe yalwizi.
Aalatala a Gadi, Mozesi wakati: Alongezegwe ooyo ukomezya Gadi. Uyopona oko mbuli mulawu alimwi uyokwamuna kuboko nakuti mutwe.
Wakalipeda chibeela chibotu chazizo zyakwe, nkambo kwakali chaabilo chamuzuluzi chanyika yakabambidwe. Wakaza amitwe yabantu. Wakabweza milimu iluleme ya Jehova alimwi amalayilile a Izilayeli.
Alatala a GDani, Mozesi wakati: Dani mwana wamulavu ooyo usotoka kuzwa ku Bbasyani.
Aalatala a Nafutali, Mozesi wakati: Nafutali, Ulikkusyi aluzyalo, akuzula azilongezyo zya Jehova, mutole buvubi kuzwa kubuzwezuba kuyosika kumusanza.
Aalatala a Asha, Mozesi wakati: Alongezegwe Asha kwinda bamwi bana balombe; atambulwe kubakulana bakwe, alimwi abbizye mawulu aakwe mumafuta akunanika.
Idolopo lyako minkulu yalyo lilaba butale wamukuba, mbuli kutanoli mazuba ako, mbuli mbukubede kukwabililwa kwako.
Tawope ulimbuli Leza, Jeshuluni -- oyo ululeme, oyo katantide kwinda kujulu kulugwasyo lwako, alimwi amubupati bwakwe mumayoba.
Leza uuteli ngemachijilo, alimwi munsi anyika muli maboko akwe alyonse. Ulaanda basinkonyokwe kunembo lyako, akwamba kuti, ''Nyonyoona !''
Izilayeli wakakkede chakulyiiba. Kasensa ka Jakobo kakali bambikene munyika yamayila awayini mupya; chanchobeni, akube kuti ijulu lilosye lume alinguwe.

Zilongezyo zyako nzyiingi, Izilayeli ! Ngwani ulimbuli nduwe, bantu bakafutulwa a Jehova, intobo yalugwasyo lwako. Asumu lyabupati bwako? Basinkondonyokwe basika kaba kankama kuli nduwe; muyowinsya masena aabo asumpukide.
Mozesi wakayinka kuzwa kuntabale ya Mowabbu, kaya kuchilundu cha Nebbo, chilundu cha Piga, eechi chilangene a Jelikko. Nkuko Jehova nkwakamutondezya yoonse nyika ya Giliyadi kuyosika ku Dani,
ayoonse Nafitali, anyika yoonse ya Efulemu a Manase, anyika yoonse ya Juda kuyosika kulwizi lwakumbo,
aku Negevi, akuntabale yamumpata wa mumusena wa Jelikko, idolopo lyakutukunka akuyosikila ku Zowa.

Jehova wakati kuli nguwe, ''Eyi njiiyo inyika njindakakonkezya kuli Abbulahamu, kuli Ayizeki, akuli Jakobo, nkingamba kuti nzoyipa kulunyungu lwako; ndakuzumizya kuti uyilange buyo ameso ako, pesi tokozoyinkape nkuko.
Mpawo Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova, wakafwa muumo munyika yamu Mowabbu, mbuli ijwi lya Jehova mbulyakasyomezezye.
Jehova wakamuvwikkila mumumpata munyika ya Mowabbu ilangene a Bbeti Poyeli, pesi takwepe uuzi oko kuli kabanda kakwe kuzosika sunu.
Mozesi wakali aminyaka mwaanda umwi amakumi aabili nakafwa; menso akwe takali agubi pe, nikuba inguzu zyakwe tezyakamanide pe.
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakamukwila Mozesi muntandabale ya Mowabbu kwamazuba makumi aatatu, alubo mazuba akulila Mozesi akamana.
Joshuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni wakazwide muuya wabusongo, nkambo Mozesi wakamubikkide maboko alinguwe. Bantu ba Izilayili bakali kumusungilizya akuchita eezyo Jehova nzyakalayilila Mozesi.
Takwe pe umbi musinsimi wakali wabuka mu Izilayili uli mbuli Mozesi, ooyo Jehova ngwakezi kumenso akumenso.

Takwepe nikwakali kwaba naba uumwi ulimbuli nguwe muzitondezyo zyoonse amuzigambyo eezyo Jehova nzyakamutumide kuti azichite munyika ya Ijiputi, kuli Falo, akuli boonse bazike bakwe, akunyika yakwe yoonse.
Takwepe nikwakali kwaba pe uuli mbuli nguwe mubapati boonse munguzu zigambya nzyakachita Mozesi kunembo lyaba Izilayeli boonse.
Ngaaya majwi aamuyiisyi, walunyungu lwa Devidi amwami wa Jelusalemu.
''Nzyabuyo! Nzyabuyo! Mbwawamba muyiisi. ''Zyoonse nzyabuuyo! Zyonse nzyabuyo.''
Nimpinduunzi muntu njajana kumulimo woonse ngwabeleka aansi ezuba?
Izyalane limwi lyayinda; alimwi limbi lyatobela, pesi nyika inoliwo kwalyoonse.
Izuba lilazwa, alimwi lilabbila akufwambaana kubweda kubusena nkulizwida lubo.
Luuwo lulawunga kumusanza akuzyungulukila kunyika, akuya bweenda akuzyunguluka nzila yawo akubweda musule lubo.
Milonga yoonse ikunkila kulwizi, pesi lwizi taluzuli pe. Kubusena ooko milona nkwiiya, nkonkuko nkwitozya alimwi.
Zintu zyoonse zyakatala, alimwi kaatakwe uumwi ukonzya kuchipandulula. Linso talikkutikani anzilibona, nekuba kutwi kuzuzikizya acheecho nchikumvwa.
Kufumbwa chakaliwo nchechiyooba, alimwi kufumbwa chakachitika nchechiyochitwa. Takukwe chipya pe aansi azuba.
Sena nkuchili na chintu chaambwa alinchicho, Langa, eechi nchipya? Kufumbwa chiliwo chakaliwo kale kwachiindi chilamfu, muzyindi eezyo zyasika musule lyesu.
Takwepe umwi wakaboneka kwibaluka zintu ezyo zyakachitika muzyindi zyakale, mpawozintu ezyo ziyochitika musule azeezyo ziyochitika mulibwejuunza tazikoyoyeyegwa limbi.''
Mebo ndili muyiisyi, mpawo ndakali mwami atala a Izilayeli mu Jelusalemu.
Ndakabika mizeezo yangu mukudunamina akulingulula busongo bwazintu zyoonse eezyo zili ansi ajulu. Bulinguluzi oobo mulimu ukatazya oyo Leza ngwakapa bana babantu kuti bajatikane anguwo.
Ndabona inchito zyonse zichitwa aansi azuba, mpawo langa, zyoonse biyo nzyabuyo akwandilila iuwo.
Chipilingene tachikonzeki koolololwa! Chibulikide tachibalwi!
Ndakaamba mumoyo wangu, kwamba kuti, ''Langa, Ndajana busongo bupati kwinda boonse bakali kunembo lyangu mu Jelusalemu. Miyeeyo yangu yabona busongo bwiingi aluzibo.''
Aboobo ndibikka moyo wangu kukuziba busongo mpawo alimwi busondosi abufubafuba. Ndasika kukumvwisisisya kuti eechi alimwi chakali kweezya kwembela iguwo.
Nkambo mubusongo bwiini muli kuusa kupati, alimwi ooyo uyungizya luzibo ulayungizya kuusa.
Ndakaamba kuti mumoyo wangu, ''Koboola lino, Ndiyokweezya akukondwa. Aboobo botelelwa lukondo.''  Pesi langa, eechi alimwi nchabuyo.
Ndakaamba atala ansesya, ''nkusondoka,'' Alimwi aatala kubotelwa, ''Chibelekaanzi?''

Ndakeezya mumoyo wangu kuti ndilibotezye biyeni awayini. Ndakazuminina muzezo wangu undendelezye abusongo nikuba ndachili jisilidi kubufubafuba.  Ndasiyande kulanguula kuti ncheechili chibotu chakuchita kubana babantu aansi ajulu mumazuba akupona kwabo.
Ndakachita zintu zipati. Ndakaliyakila maanda akulibyalila myuunda yamasansa.
Ndiliyakile zilili azilyokezezyo, alimwi ndakabyala misyobo yoonse yaminsamu yamichelo mulinjiyo.
Ndachita malambwa amanzi akutilizya lusaka oomo muzikkidwe minsamu.

Ndakawula bazike baalumi abazike banakazi; Ndakali abazike bakazyalilwa mung'anda yangu yabwami. Alimwi kandijisi buvubi bwiingi amatanga azivuubwa, kwiinda boonse baami bakeendelezya musule lyangu mu Jelusalemu.

Alubo mebo ndakalijanina nsiliva angolide, buvubi bwabaami azilikiti kandijisi basikwiimba, boonse baalumi abanakazi, mpawo abasimamambe banji, kubotezya kwabana babantu. (Nsandululo zyiingi zyachiindi zipandulula kampanzi kakumaninina amunchali ooyu)
Aboobo ndakaba mupati akuba mubuvubi kwiinda boonse bakaliwo musule lyangu mu Jelusalemu. Alimwi busongo bwangu bwakakkalilila muli ndime.

Kufumbwa menso nchakayandisya, tendakakasya kuzwa kulinzizyo. Tendakakasya moyo wangu kuzwa kuli chimwi chibotezya, nkambo moyo wangu wakakondwa kumulimo wangu woonse akubotelwa njiyakali mpindu yamulimo wangu woonse.
Eelyo ndakalanga milimo yoonse eeyo maanza angu njiyakachita, alimwi amilimo eeyo njindakachita, pesi alubo, zyoonse zyakali zyabuyo-- mbuli kwandilila luuwo.

Tekwakali mpindupe ansi azuba mulinjiyo.  Mpawo ndakatalika kuyeeya busongo, alimwi alubo busondosi abufubafuba. Nkaambo niinzi chimbi kumuntu ooyo utabe mwami utobela nchatachite kwinda eecho mwami nchakachitide kale?
Mpawo ndakatalika kumvwisisisya busongo oobo kuti buli abubotu atala abufubafuba, mbuli mumuni ulampindu kwinda mudima.
Mwaalumi musongo ubelesya menso ali amutwe wakwe kukubona nkwaya, pesi mufubafuba uleenda mumudima, nikuba ndizi kuti chintu chikozyenie chilachitika kuli mbabo boonseni.

Eelyo ndakaamba kuti mumoyo wangu, ''Eechi chichitika kumufubafuba, chiyochitika alimwi akulindime. Aboobo musiyang'onzi nguchichita naa ndaba musongo loko?'' Ndakajinsya mumoyo wangu kuti, ''Achilacho eechi nchabuyo.''
Nkambo muntu musongo, mbuli mufubafuba tayeyegwi kwachindi chilamfu loko. Mumazuba achiza zyoonse zinoli zyalubinkana. Muntu musongo ulafwa mbuli mufubafuba mbwafwa.
Aboobo ndakasula buumi nkambo mulimo woonse uuchitwa aansi azuba bwakali bubi kuli ndime. ''Nkaambo kakuti eezi zyoonse nzyabuuyo--mbuli kwandilila luuwo.
Ndakasula mulimu wangu woonse ooyo ngandakabeleka aansi azuba nkambo ndelede kusiila muntu unditobela.
Nkambo ngwani uzi kuti uyooba muntu musongo naa mufubafuba? Kakuli kuyooba simalelo aatala azintu zyoonse aansi azuba kukubeleka kwangu, abusongo nzizyakayaka.
Aboobo ndakatalika kupeda moyo wangu kukubula bulangizi atala akubeleka kwangu koonse nkundakachita aansi azuba.
Nkaambo ngakulaba umwi muntu ubeleka chabusongo, achaluzibo alimwi achabunamaanu, pesi uyosiya zintu zyoonse nzyali azyo kumuntu utakwe nakachita chintu. Eezi alimwi nzyabuyo -- nchibi chipati.
Nimpinduunzi muntu njajana kuzwa kumilimo yoonse akuzwa kukukakatila kwamoyo ooyo wakubeleka aansi azuba.
Mazuba woonse mulimo wakwe ulachisa akukatazya, aboobo mansiku muuya wakwe tujani kulyookezya pe. Eechi achilacho nchabuyo.
Takwepe chintu chibotu kumuntu kwiinda kulya akunywa buyo akujana kubotelwa mukubeleka kwakwe. Ndakabona kasimpe aka kuti kazwa kujanza lya Leza.
Nkaambo ngwani uunga ulalya naa kuba amusyobo wakubotelwa kutazwi kwa Leza?

Nkaambo kumuntu umubotezya, Leza ulamupa busongo aluzibo akukondwa. Nikubaboobo, kuli sizibi ulamupa mulimo wakubunganya akubamba kuchitila kuti achipe uumwi ubotezya Leza. Eechi alimwi nchabuyo -- mbuli kwandinanya luuwo.
Nkambo zintu zyoonse zilibikilidwe chiindi, alimwi makani woonse aansi ezuba ali amazuba aawo.
Kuli chiindi chakuzyalwa achiindi chakufwa, chindi chakuzikila achindi chakunonkoola zizikidwe,
chindi chakujaya avchindi chakusilika, chindi chakumwaya achindi chakuyakulula.
Kuli chindi chakulila achindi chakuseka, chindi chakoomoka achindi chakuzyana,
chindi chakusowa mabwe achindi chakubungika mabwe, chindi chakukumbata bamwi bantu, alimwi achindi chakulikasya kukumbata.
Kuli chindi chakuyanduula zintu achindi chakuleka kuyanduula, chindi chakubamba zintu achindi chakusowa zintu,
chindi chakudeluula chisamo achindi chakusuma zisamo, chindi chakuumuna achindi chakwambuula.
Kuli chindi chakuyanda achindi chakusula, chindi chankondo achindi chalumuno.
Nimpinduunzi simulimo njajana mukubeleka kwakwe?
Ndakabona mulimo ooyo Leza ngwakapa kubantu kuti bawumane.

Leza wakabotezya zintu zyonse kuchindi chazyo. Alimwi wakabika boongozi mumyoyo yabo. Pesi bantu tabamvwisisisyi milimo eeyo Leza njakachita, kuzwa kumatalikilo aabo nzila yoonse kusika kumamanino aabo.
Ndilizi kuti takwepe chintu chobotela muntu kwinda kukondwa akuchita bubotu mbubonya kachipona--
akuti umwi awumwi welede kulya akunywa, alimwi weelede kumvwisya mbwayelede kujana lukondo mumulimo wakwe. Eechi nchipo cha Leza kubantu.
Ndilizi kuti kufumbwa Leza nchachita chilakkalilila. Taakwe chikonzya kuyungizigwa kulinchicho na kugwisigwa, nkambo ngu Leza wakachichita boobo kuti bantu bakamusikile akumulemeka.

Kufumbwa chiliwo chakaliwo kale; kufumbwa chiyobawo chakaliwo kale. Leza uchita muntu kuti ayanduule zintu zisisikene. ( muchindi chakuti Leza uchita muntu kuti ayanduule zintu zisisikene. Zimwi nsandululo zipandulula keengo aaka munzila zisiyene).
Ndakabona kuti aansi aazuba akali bubi, aawo akeelede bululami, alimwi mubusena bwabusalali, kwakali bubi.
Ndakamba kuti mumoyo wangu, ''Leza nguyobeteka basalali abasizibi kuchindi cheelede nkambo makani woonse amilimo yoonse.''
Ndakamba kuti mumoyo wangu, ''Leza ulasunka bantu kuti abatondeezye kuti bali mbuli banyama.''
Nkambo chisikila bana babantu achisikila banyama chilikozyenie. Lufu lwawumwi lulimbuli lufu lwawumbi. Kuyoya kwabo boonse kulikozyenie. Taakwe bubotu kubantu bwinda bwabanyama. Zyoonse nzyabuyo.
Zyoonse zilaya kubusena bomwe. Zyonse zizwa kulusuko, alimwi zyoonse zilapiluka kulusuko.
Ngwaani uzi na muuya wamuntu ulaya kujulu amuuya wabanyama naa ulaya aansi munyika? (zimwi nsandululo zijisi uuzi muuya wabantu, oyo wiinka kujulu, amuuya wabanyama, ooyo wiinka aansi munyika?)
Aboobo ndayelensya lubo kuti taakwe chibotela muntu kwiinda kuli botezya mulimo wakwe, nkambo eecho nchaabilo chakwe. Ngwani uunga ulamuboozya kuti azobone eezyo zichitika musule lyakwe?

Alimwi ndakayibalukwa aatala akupenga koonse ooko kuchitika aansi aazuba. Mpawo ndakabona, misozi yabantu bapenzegwa, alimwi tebakali asikubawumbulizya pe! Inguzu zyakali mujanza lyaba sikubapenzya babo, mpawo tekwakali uumwi wakaubawumbulizya!
Aboobo ndakayeeya kuti aabo bakafwa kale balabotelwa kwiinda bawumi, aabo bachipona.
Nikuba boobo, ubotelwa kwiinda boonse ngooyo umwi uutana kupona, uumwi ooyo uutana kubona kufumbwa milimo yanchito imbi eezyo zichitika ansi azuba.
Eelyo ndakabona inchito yoonse yamulimo amaanu woonse amulimo zyakaba bbivwe lyawumwi wasi mabambanwa. Eechi achilacho nchabiyo - mbuli kwandilila luuwo.
Mufubafuba ulalikumbatila akutabeleka, aboobo chakulya chakwe mubili wakwe.
Pesi nkankamaanza yaluumuno nimbotu kwiinda nkankamaanza zibili zili amulimo oyo wakwezya kweembela luuwo.
Ndakapiluka mpawo ndakabona chimwi chintu chabiyo aansi aazuba.

Kuli uumwi muntu uuli alikke. Tajisi mwenzinyina pe, tajisi mwana mulombe pe naa mwanike, alimwi nekubaboobo mulimo wakwe woonse tuyinki, mpawo menso aakwe taakkuti abuvubi bujanwa. Ulalikatazya kati, ''Nkambo kani nindibeleka boobu akulilesya bubotu?'' Achilacho eechi nchabuyo -- nchitu chibi.
Bantu babili babeleka kabotu kwiinda uumwi; kabali antomwe balajana muvolo mubotu kumulimo wabo.
Nkambo na umwi wawa, uumwi ulakonzya kubusya mwenzinyina. Nikuba boobo, mawuse alamusikila umwi uuli alikke naawa na takukwe umwi wakumubusya.
Naa babili bawona aamwi, balakasalilwa, pesi uumwi ulakasalilwa buti alikke?
Muntu umwi alikke ulakonzya kuzundwa, pesi babili balakonzya kwiminana akulwana, alimwi kakole kayindulwidwe tutatu takafwambani kudunsuka pe.
Nchibotu kuba muchete pesi koli mulombe musongo kwinda munene amwami mufubafuba uutachizi mbokuswililwalulayo.
Eechi nchakasimpe nikuba mukubusi waba mwami kuzwa muntolongo, naa kufumbwa kali muchete mubwami bwakwe.
Ndakabona bawumi boonse mpawo bakali kweendeenda aansi azuba, antomwe amulombe wakali kunoobuka kuti akabweze busena bwakwe.
Tekwakali kubalika kubantu boonse bakayanda kuswilila mwami mupya, pesi kumamanino baanji babo tabakoyomulumbayizya. Nkasimpe eechi achilacho nchabiyo -- mbuli kwandila luuwo.
Langisisya nzila zyako nuya kunga'anda yaLeza. Inka afwiifwi ukaswiilizye kwiinda kupa chipayizyo chabafubafuba, batamvwisisisyi kuti balikuchita chitaluleme.
Utanofwambaani kwambuula amulomo wako alimwi utalekeli moyoy  wako kuti ufwambaane kuchita kufumbwa kaambo kunembo lyaLeza. Leza ulikujulu pesi nywebo muli aansi, aboobo majwi aanu aacheye.
Na koli aazintu zyiingi zyakuchita akulikataazya anzizyo, ulakonzya kuba aamaloto mabi. Mukuvula kwamajwi ngowambuula, nkukuvula kwazintu zyabufubafuba nzokonzya kwaamba.
Eelyo nochita chikonke kuli Leza, utanonoki kuchichita nkaambo Leza takwe chakuchita abafubafuba. Chita nchiwakonkezya kuti ulachita.
Chilimbubo kuti utachiti chikonke kwiinda kuchita chimwi nchotakonzyi kuchita.

Utazumizyi mulomo wako kuti uchitye muuya wako kuti ubisye. Utaambi kuli simutolatwaambo wamupayizi kuti, ''Chikonke eechiya bwakali bulewusi.'' Nkaambonzi nimunyemya Leza mukukonka chakubeja, kamunyemya Leza kuyti kujaye milimu yamanza enu?
Nkaambo aawo nikwaba maloto miingi amajwi miingi, ngabuyo. Pesi, amuyowe Leza!

Eelyo nimubona bachete nibalikudyamizigwa akubbidwa bululami akujatwa kabotu muchisi chenu, utagambi nikuba takwe uzi, nkaambo kulibantu bali aanguzu balangisisya aabo bali aansi lyabo, alimwi mpubali bali aajulu lyabo.
Mukuyungizya, butebuzi bwanyika mbwamuntu woonse, alimwi mwami mwini ulabweza butebuzi kuzwa mumyuunda.
Kufumbwa uyandisya nsiliva takoyokutisikana ansiliva, alimwi uyandisya bunoti uyanda zyiingi. Eechi achilacho nchabuyo.
Kuzwidilila nikwayinkilila kunembo, abantu babulya balavula. Mbubotuunzi buli mubuvubi kulimunaabo kunze kwakububona amenso aakwe?
Koona kwamuntu uubeleka nkunono, nikuba walya ziche na zyiingi, pesi buvubi bwamuntu munoti tabumuzumizyi pe kuti awone kabotu.
Kuli chibi nchindakabona aansi azuba: bunoti bwiindilide mbubwamunaabo alimwi buleta mpindu mukuusa kwakwe.
Eelyo muvubi nasweekelwa bunoti bwakwe kwiinda mukubula cholwe, mwana wakwe mulombe ngwakazyala takwe nchayochaala acho pe mumaboko akwe.
Mbuli muntu mbakazwa muda lyabanyina, aboobo lubo uyokkala maya. Takoyoobweza naba womwe muchelo ngwayotebula mukubeleka kwamanza akwe.
Chimwi chibi ncheechi, mbuli muntu mbaza, aboobo uyoyenda. Aboobo kuli mpinduunzi kuliwoyo uubelekela muuwo?
Kwamazuba akwe ulalya mumudima alimwi ulawusa chakwiindilila mukuchiswa amulunyemo.

Langa, niinzi nchindabona kachili kabotu mpawo kacheelede kumuntu kuti alye, anywe alimwi ajane kubotelwa mukubeleka kwakwe natebula aansi azuba kwamazuba aakwe aayo Leza ngaamupa. Nkaambo ooyu mulimu wamuntu.
Kufumbwa muntu ooyo Leza ngwakapa bunoti abuvubi anguzu kuti atambule lukono lwakwe akubotelwa mubutebuzibwakwe - eechi nchipo kuzwa kuli Leza.
Nkaambo tayeeyi chiindi chiingi mazuba aabumi bwakwe akaambo kakuti Leza umuchita kuti ukkale kabeleka kuzintu nzyabotelwa kuchita.
Kuli bubi mbundakabona aansi anyika alimwi bulemena bantu.

Leza ulakonzya kupa buvubi, bunoti abulemu kumuntu kuti atabuli chintunchayandisya, pesi mpawo Leza tamupede nguzu zyakuti abotelwe. Pesi umwi ulabelesya zintu zyakwe. Eechi nchabuyo alimwi ndupenzyo lupati.

Na mwaalumi wazyala bana bali mwaanda alimwi wapona minyaka miingi kuchitila kuti mazuba aaminyaka yakwe avula, pesi na moyo wakwe tewakkutisikana pe azibotu alimwi taazikwa pe, mpawo ndaamba kuti mwana wazyalwa kafwide ulimbubo kwiinda mbuli mbabede wenya.
Ooyu mwana ulizyedwe kali wabuyo alimwi uliinda mumudima. Izina lyakwe lilayinda mumudima.
Nikuba mwana ooyu taabona zuba nikuba kuziba chintu, walyookezya nikuba muntu ooyo takwe nchabona.
Nikuba muntu wapona kwaminyaka iili zyuulu zibili pesi tayelede kuyiya kuti anoneezegwe zintu zibotu uliinka kubusena bomwe mbubonya mbuli umwi awumwi.
Yoonse milimu yamuntu njamulomo, pesi chiyandisyo chakwe tachikkutisiki pe.
Nchobeni, mbubotuunzi musongo mbwali aabo aatala amufubafuba? Mbubotuunzi untu muchete mbwali aabo na waziba kuchita kunembo lyabamwi bantu?
Eecho linso nchilibona nchibotu kwiinda eecho muuya nchuyanduula. Eechi achilacho nchabuyo - mbuli kwaandila muuya.
Kufumbwa chipona chakalipedwe kale zina lyacho alimwi muntu mbabede wakalizibinkene kale. Aboob chaba chabuyo kuti muntu akazyanie awumwi uuli aanguzu mpati uubeteka boonse.
Bwiingi bwamajwi mbwabede mbobwiingi bwazyabuyo. Mbubotuunzi oobo kumuntu?
Nkaambo ngwani uzi bubotu bwamuntu mubuumi, mumazuba mache aabuyo ulayinda mbuli cheenzule? Ngwani unga ulaambila muntu chiyochitika aansi aazuba musule kali wayinda?
Izina bbotu ndibbotu kwinda mafuta aadula, alimwi buzuba bwakufwa mbubotu kwinda buzuba bwakuzyalwa.
Nchibotu kuya kung'anda yakoomoka kwinda kuya kung'anda yakupobola, nkambo koomoka kusikila bantu boonse kumamanino aabuumi, aboobo bantu bapona belede kuchibika mumoyo.
Kuusa nkubotu kwinda luseko, nkambo musule kwakuusa kwabusyu kusika kwakubotelwa kwamoyo.
Myoyo yabasongo ilimung'anda yakoomoka, pesi myoyo yabafubafuba ili mung'anda yakupobola.
Chilikabotu kuswilila kulutapatilo lwamusongo kwinda kuswilila lwiimbo lwabafubafuba.
Nkambo chili mbuli insasi zyamamvwa ziyaka aansi achilongo, mbombubo alimwi luseko lwabafubafuba mbulubede. Echi achilacho nchabuyo.
Kunyansya kufubaazya muntu musongo, mpawo masinkamulomo alabijisya moyo.
Mamamanino amakani aalimbubo kwinda masangunino; alimwi bakazika moyo mumuuya balimbubo kwinda balisumpula mumuuya.
Utafwambi kunyema mumuuya wako, nkambo lunyemo lukkala mumyoyo yabafubafuba.
Uutaambi kuti, ''Nkaambonzi mazuba achiindi mabotu kwinda eezi?'' Nkambo takweensi kuti nkambo kabusongo kuti ubuzye mubuzyo ooyu.
Busongo, mbuli lukono, mbubotu. Bulagwasya aabo babona zuba.
Nkambo busono bupa lukwabililo mbuli mali mbinga ilapa lukwabililo, pesi kugwasya kwaluzibo nkuti busongo bupa buumi kuli yooyo uli aabo.
Bona inchito zya Leza: Ngwani uunga ulalulamika chimwi nchakapanga kachipilingene?

Ziindi nizili kabotu, pona chakusekelela mubotu oobo, pesi naa zyiindi nzibi, yeeya eechi: Leza waka zizumizya kuti zibewo mbazu ambazu. Nkambo kacheechi, takukwe uumwi uyoyanduula kufumbwa chili eecho chiboola musule lyakwe.
Mubuumi bwangu bwabuyo ndakabona zyoonse. Kuli muntu ululeme ufwa nekuba kabululami bwakwe, alimwi kuli muntu sizibi upona buumi bulamfu nekuba kazibi zyakwe.
Utalisalazyi lwako, musongo mumenso aako. Nkamboonzi notalinyonyoone lwako?
Utabi sizibi loko naa mufubafuba. Ulafwidaanzi chiindi chako kachitana zulila?

Nchibotu kuti ujatilile abusongo oobu, mpawo utalekeleli bululami bukuzwe. Nkambo muntu woonse uyoowa Leza uyobuzuzikizya nzyayelede kuchita. (mukwinda kuti uyobuswania boonse buyumuyumu bwakwe, bansandululo zyingi zyachiindi zijisi bupanduluzi busiyene bwachibalo chiyumu echi).
Busongo bulanguzu mumuntu musongo, kwiinda bendelezi balikkumi mumunzi.
Takwe muntu ululeme munyika uchita chibotu mpawo atakwe naabisya.
Utaswilili kulilyonse ijwi lyambulwa, nkambo nga ulamvwa muzike wako kakutukila.
Mbukukozyenie, lwako ulizi kabotu kuti kuzyiindi zyingi wakatukila mumoyo wako.
Choonse echi ndachilungula abusongo. Ndamba kuti, ''Ndiyoba musongo,'' pesi chalikwinda mbundalelede kuba.
Busongo bulikule loko akunika loko. Ngwani unga ulabujana?
Ndakabika moyo wangu kukwiiya akukulingulula akuyanduula busongo abulunguluzi bwanchoonzyo, mpawo akumvwisisya kuti bubi mbufubafuba akuti bufubafuba mbusondosi.
Ndakajana kuti chilula loko kwinda lufu mwanakazi nekuba ngwani ulamoyo uzwide tukole atunsabwe, mpawo ulamanza anketani. Kufumbwa uubotezya Leza uyoyokoka, pesi sizibi uyojatwa anguwe mwanakazi.
''Bikkila manu kulinzindakabona,'' mbwaamba muyiisyi.  '''Ndalikuyungizya chimwi nchindabona kuli chimwi kuti ndijane bupanduluzi bwanchoonzyo.
Eechi nchicho nchendili kuyaanduula, pesi tendachijana pe. Ndajana mwalumi umwi ululeme akati kabali zyuulu, pesi mwanakazi tendamujana pe akkati kabaabo.
Ndakabbutula eechi biyo: Leza wakalenga bantu kabaluleme, pesi bakazwa bakaya kule kukuyanduula zyiingi zikatazya.''
Nguuli muntu musongo? Nguuli uuzi bupanduluzi bwazichitiko zyabuumi? Busongo mumuntu bumuchita kuti busyu bwakwe bubalangale, alimwi buyumu bwabusyu bwakwe bwasanduka.
Ndimuchenjezya kuti mubambe makani amwami akaambo kachikonke chaLeza kuti chimukwabilile.
Utafwambaani kuzwa kubusyu bwakwe, alimwi utasakwidi makani mabi, nkaambo mwami ulachita kufumbwa nchayanda.
Ijwi lyamwami lileendelezya, nkaako ngwani utakaambe kulinguwe kuti, ''Ulikuchitaanzi?''
Kufumbwa ubamba milayizyo yamwami takoyoojana bubi pe. Moyo wamusongo ulizi zichitika alimwi achiindi chakuchitika.
Nkaambo woonse makani alijisi kabotu mpindu achiindi chakuvwiila, nkaambo bubi bwabantu bwabalemena.
Tawo naba womwe pe uuzi zitasike kunembo. Ngwani uutamwaambile eezyo zichiza?
Tawo pe uujisi manguzu akumuzya muuwo, nkinkaako takwe uujisi nguzu mubuzuba bwalufu lwakwe. Takwe lulekelelo chiindi chankondo, alimwi bubi tabukonzyi kuvuna aabo bazike kulimbubo.
Ndakazinanzelela zyoonse eezi; ndakabika moyo wangu kumilimu yoonse iichitwa aansi azuba. Kuli chiindi muntu nayendelezya muntunyina kukumubisizya.

Aboobo ndakabona basizibi mbubakazikwa chaantanganana. Bakabwezegwa kuzwa kubusena busalala akuzikwa alimwi bakalumbilizigwa abantu bamudolopo oomu nkubakali kuchitila milimu yabo mibi. Eezyi azilazyo nzyabuyo.
Eelyo lubeta lwamilimu mibi nilwatachitwa, myoyo yabantu ilakakatila kuchita zibi.
Nikuba kuti sizibi ulabisya zyiindi zili mwaanda akupona chiindi chilamfu, pesi ndilizi kuti bayowa Leza bayooba kabotu, kulibaabo bayimikila kunembo lyakwe akumutondezya lulemeko.
Pesi tazikoyooyenda kabotu kulisizibi; buumi bwakwe tabukotoolansigwa pe. Mazuba aakwe alimbuli mweenzule wiinda  kaambo talemeki Leza pe.

Kulichimwi chintu chabuyo chilokuchitika aansi: kuli bantu basalali bajana eezyo basimuchitazibi nzibeelede, alimwi alimwi nkubali basizibi basikiwa bulumbu bweelede baluleme. Ndakati eechi achilacho nchabuyo.

Nkaambo kaako ndatembawula kukondwa, nkaambo muntu takwe chintu chibotu ansi ano kwiinda kuti alye akunywa akusekelela. Nkubotelwa kukalilila mulinguwe mumilimo yakwe mazuba woonse aabuumi bwakwe Leza ngamupede ansi aazuba.
Nindakabika moyo wangu kukuziba busongo akumvwisya makani aachitika ansi aano, milimo iichitwa kabatawoni neliba sikati naaba mansiku,

mpawo ndakabona milimo yoonse yaLeza, alimwi kuti muntu takonzyi kumvwisya milimo yoonse iichitwa ansi aazuba. Nikuba kuti muntu wabeleka loko mukulingula kwakwe, takonzyi kubumvwisya. Nikuba kuti muntu musongo wasyoma kuti ulizi takonzyi kumvwisya pe.

Aboobo zyoonse zyazeezi ndazibika kumoyo wangu, kuti zimvwika kabotu, alimwi ndakaziba kuti baluleme abasongo, alimwi zyoonse nzibachita, zili mujanza lya Leza, pesi takwe pe uzi naa nduyando naa ndusulo lumulindide.

Umwi awumwi ulasikilwa bweelene, izisikila bantu baluleme abantu basizibi, ibubotu, (zimwi nsandwido zyalino zyendelana ansandululo zyachiindi eezyo zilabubotu abubi, muli yeeyi nzila, bachita kuti munchali umaninine. Bsanduzi balayeeya kuyiiya mbabo) basalala abatasalali, alimwi awumwi upayila ayooyo utapayili. Mbuli bantu babotu mbubayoofwa, nkokuti awalo sizibi. Mbuli umwi oyo ukonka uyoofwa, aboobo oyo muntu uyoowa kuchita chikonke.

Kuli chintu chabubi kuli zyoonse ansi ezuba, chichitiko nchichonya chilachitikila kuli mbabo boonse. Myoyo yabantu ilizwide bubi, alimwi busondosi buli mumyoyo yabo nibachipona. Aboobo kuzwa awo balayinka kubafu.
Kufumbwa ujisini abawumi boonse uli abulangizi - nikuba mubwa upona ulimbubombubo kwinda mulavu ufwide.
Nkaambo abo bawumi balizi kuti bayoofwa, pesi bafwide tabezi chintu. Tabachikwe mpindu nkambo tawepe nchibachiyeeya.
Luyando lwabo, lusulo lwabo, alimwi ebbivwe lyakamwayika chiindi. Tabachiyojani lubo pe busena muzintu zichitwa aansi azuba.
Koya enzila yako, kolya chinkwa chako chakukondwa, alimwi konywa wayini wako amoyo ubotelwa, nkambo Leza watambula kale inchito zyako.
Chita kuti izisamo zyako kazituba amutwe wako, kawunanikidwe mafuta.
Kondelelwa buumi bwako amwanakazi wako ngoyanda mazuba woonse ayo abuumi bwabuyo. Nkambo eyi njimpindu yabuumi nkambo kamibeleko miyumu njiwakabeleka ansi ezuba.
Kufumbwa ijanza lyako nchilikonzya kuchita ukabeleke changuzu zyako nkambo takwe pe mulimu nibuba bupanduluzi naa luzibo nibuba busongo mukabanda, oomo moyobuya.

Ndakabona zintu zibotezya ansi ezuba: muzundano tuuzwi kubantu basiluno pe. Chinkwa tachizwi kubantu balabusongo pe. Buvubi tabuzwi kubantu bamvwisisisya pe. Luyando taluzwi kubantu balaluzibo pe. Kakuli oobo, chiindi amwenya zyoonse zilabasikila.

Nchobeni, takwepe naba omwe uuzi chiindi chakwe nichiyooza. Mbuli inswi mbozichegwa mukazamba kabi, naa bayuni balachegwa mukakole, bana babantu balachegwa azyiindi zyabubi ezyo zifwamba kwinda alimbabo.
Alubo ndakabona busongo alimwi ansi azuba munzila yalikuboneka kilimpati kulindime.
Kwakali umwi muunzi munini wakali abaalumi bache mukati, alimwi mwami mupati wakeza kuzowulwanisya, wakawuzyunguluka akuyaka ziyubilo zipati.
Lino mumunzi oomo mwakajanika mwalumi muchete, mwalumi musongo, oyo busongo bwakwe bwakavuna munzi. Kakuli boobo, takwepe naba omwe wakazomuyeeya ulya  mwalumi muchete.
Aboobo ndakamaninizya kanditi, ''Busongo mbubotu kwinda nguzu, pesi busongo bwa mwalumi muchete bulanyansigwa, alimwi amajwi aakwe taamvwigwa pe.''
Majwi abantu basongo wambulwa chumunizi alamvwikka obotu kwinda kwakoompolola kwawumwi mwendelezi akati kaba fubafuba.
Busongo mbubotu kwinda zilwanisyo zyankondo, pesi uumwi sizibi ngabulabozeka bubotu bwiingi.
Mbuli inzinini zifwide zilachitya kununkilila kwamafuta kuti kununke, mbubonya bufubafuba bunini bulazunda busongo abulemu.
Moyo wamuntu musongo ulamutola kuchilisyo, pesi moyo wamufubafuba ulamutola kuchimweensi.
Kuti mufubafuba wakunukila munzila, akuyeeya kwakwe nkuche,  kuyeeya kwakwe nkuche, kulibonia kuli umwi awumwi kuti mufubafuba.
Naa bukali bwamwendelezi, bwakubukila utaleki pe mulimu wako. Kuumuna kulakonzya kumuzya bukali.
Kuli bubi mbundakabona aansi azuba, musyobo wabubi, obu buzwa kumwendelezi:
Bafubafuba mbibapegwa zyuuno zyabuzulwidi, kakuli baalumi bavubi mbibapegwa zyuuno zilaansi.
Ndakabona bana bazike kabayenda ambongolo, mpawo bana babaami kabeendela anyika mbuli bazike.
Ooyo uusya idindi uyowida mulindilyo, alimwi kufumbwa udoonkola bulambo nga uyolumwa anzoka.
Kufumbwa ugonka mabwe nga alamupwaya, alamwi mwalumi sikugonka zisamu uyolichisa anzizyo.
Naa mulomo walubulo wasiba kutachibosyi, alimwi mwaalumi do tewawunona, awo ulelede kuvuzya inguzu nyingi, pesi busongo bulapa mweenya wakuzwidilila.
Naa inzoka yaluma kitana koondolwa, mpawo ngataachikwe chilangililo chasikoondola.
Majwi amumulomo wamwalumi musono alijisi luzyalo, pesi milomo yamufubafuba musongo ilamumana.
Mbuli majwi atanguna kutuntuumuka kuzwa kumulomo wamufubafuba, bufubafuba bulazwa aanze, alimwi kumamanino mumulomo wakwe mulatuntumuka bubi bwakupenga.
Mufubafuba ulavuzya majwi, pesi atakwe umwi uuzi kuti niinzi chiboola. Ngwani uzi chizobumutobelela musulakwe?
Milomo yamufubafuba ilabakatazya, zyakuti tabachizi niba inzila iiya kudolopo.
Maawe kuli nduwe, nunyika, naa mwami wako mulombe muniini, alimwi naa bazulwidi bako basanguna kupobola muchifumo!
Pesi ulilongezezegwe, nonyika, naa mwami wako mwana mulombe wabulemu, alimwi naa bazulwidi bako balya chiindi cheeledwe, nkambo kanguzu, alimwi peepe nkambo kabudakwi!
Nkambo kabutolo lululi lwawida mukati, alimwi nkambo kamaanza matete ing'anda ilazuza.
Bantu babamba chilyo chakuseka, wayini uleta lukondo kubuumi, amali ilazuzikizya ziyandikana zyoonseni.
Utatukili mwami, nimuba mumizeezo yako, alimwi utatukili bantu bavubi mung'anda yakoona. Nkambo kayuni kamumulengalenga kalabweza majwi aako; kufumbwa chila mababa chilakonzya kumwaya kaambo kako.
Tumina chinkwa chako atala amanzi, nkambo uyochijana lubo kunembo kwinda mazuba maanji.
Chabulule kulibali musanu ababili, nekuba bantu bali musanu abatatu, nkambo tatuzi pe lunyonyoono lusika anyika.
Naa mayoba aazwide imvula, atilila anyika, alimwi naa musamu wawida kumusanza naa kunyika, kufumbwa munsamu nkwawida, nkukonya nkuyokkala.
Oyo webela luuwo teelede kubyala, alimwi webela mayoba telede kutebula.

Mbuli mbotazi inzila yaluuwo, naa mbozikula zifuwa zyamwana mwida lyawuminsi, (zimwi nsandululo zyachiindi zijisi aa mbuli mbutazi inzila yamuuya kuzifuwa zyamwana mwida lyawuminsi) aboobo alimwi tokonzyi kumvwisisisya mulimu wa Leza, wakalenga zyoonse.

Muchifumo byala mbuto yako, kusika goko, beleka amanza aako mbuli mbochiyandika, nkambo tozi pe chiyozwidilila, ngakulaba chifumo naa mangolezya, naakuti eechi naa echiya, naakuti zyoonse zikozyenie ziyoba zibotu.
Nchoonzyo mumuni ulabotezya, alimwi chintu chibotu kumenso kuti abone zuba.
Naa umwi wapona myaka miinji, muleke abotelwe muli zyoonse, pesi ayeeye atala amazuba amudima aboola; nkambo anoli manji. Zyonse ziboola nzyabuyo.

Bweza lukondo, nomukubusi, mubulombe bwako, alimwi chita moyo wako kuti ukondelelwe mumazuba abukubusi bwako. Yanduula ziyandisyo zibotu yanda moyo wako alimwi kufumbwa chili mukuboneka amenso ako. Nekubaboobo, ziba kuti Leza uyokweta mulubeta nkambo kanzizeezi zyonse zintu.
Gwisya lunyemo mumoyo wako mpawo utalikatazyi kufumbwa zichisa mumubili wako, nkambo bukubusi anguzu zyabo nzyabuyo.
Alubo koyeeya mulengi wako mumazuba abukubusi bwako, mazuba amapenzi naatanasika, amyaaka nitana kusika noyowamba kuti, ''Nsichibotelwi mulimbabo'';
muchite eechi musule amumuni wazuba amweezi anyenyeezi nizitana kusiya, alimwi mayoba asiya naatana kubweeda niyamana imvula.
Nchenchicho chiindi basikulinda ing'anda yamwami nibazobbila, alimwi baalumi basinguzu nebazoongomana, abasikuziya nebazoleka nkambo kakucheya, abaabo basondela kuzipulo nibazoosiilwa.
Ncheechiindi awo milyango niizojaligwa yakumugwagwa, alimwi muzuzumina wakuziya nuzoyimikila, aawo muntu nazobuka kuchindi chakwiimba kwatuyuni, alimwi basimbi basikwimba majwi abo azomana.

Nchenchicho chiindi aawo bantu nebayoyoowa chilundu chilamfu akuyoowa kweenda mumugwagwa, alimwi musamu wa Alumondi nuuzosyuka, mpawo idingo nilizokokoba, alimwi munsamu wakubusya tuuchibeleki. Mpawo muntu ulaya kuchikkalilo chakwe abasikulila balendeenda mumigwagwa.
Koyeeya mulengi wako intambo yansiliva nitana kudunsuka, naa mutiba wangolide nuutana kupwayika, naa chitesyo nechitana kufwa kuchikkala,
lusuko kalutana kupiluka kunyika mbubwakabede, alimwi muuya muuyopiluka kuli - Leza wakupede.
''Nzyabuyo! Nzyabuyo! mbwaawamba Muyiisyi. ''Zyoonse nzyabuuyo!''
Muyiisyi wakali musongo, wakachili kuyiisya bantu luzibo. Wakayeeya akulinguula akubamba tusimpi tunji.
Muyiisyi wakali kuyaanduula akulemba majwi aabotezya, wakaliluleme kukulemba majwi alusinizyo.
Majwi abasongo alimbuli zibinzyo. Mbuli manembe akankamidwe atusimpi tuyobolwedwe, ntwamweembeli umwi.
Mwanangu, chenjela kuzintu azimwi kutali eezi. Kulemba mabbuku manji takumani, alimwi kwiiya kunji kwakataazya mubili.
Mamanino atwambo kunembo ngakuti zyoonse zyamvwigwa, nkukuti lemeka Leza akubamba milazyo yakwe, nkambo kuchita oobo nchelelo choonse chamuntu.
Nkambo Leza uyobeteka milimo yoonse, amakani woonse asisidwe, naaba mabotu naaba mabi.
Pawulu, mutumwa wa Kkilisito Jesu kwiindila mukuyanda kwa Leza, ku basalali ba Leza mu Efisasi, basyomekede muli Kkilisito Jesu.
Luzyalo kuli ndinywe a lumuuno luzwa kuli Leza Taata wesu, a Mwaami Jesu Kkilisito.
Ikaka Leza a Taata wa Mwaami wesu Jesu Kkilisito ngatembawulwe, ooyo wakatulongezya azyoonse zilongezyo zyamuuya mumasena aakujulu muli Kkilisito.
Leza wakatusala mulinguwe kuzwa kumatalikilo enyika kuti tukabe basalali akubula chibi kumenso akwe muluyando.
Leza wakatusala chiindi swebo kukubwezwa mbuli bana balombe kwiinda muli Jesu Kkilisito, mbuli mukubota kwakuyanda kwakwe.
Kubwezwa kwesu kweeta kutembawula kuluzyalo lulabulemu oolo we ndwakatupa swe kakutakwe muulo muli Umwi ngwakayanda.
Muli Jesu Kkilisito tuli aalwangunuko kwiinda mugaze lyakwe akulekelelwa kwazibi zyesu, kwiindila mubuvubi bwaluzyalo lwakwe.
Wakavuzya luzyalo  kulindiswe a boonse busongo akumvwisisiya.
Leza wakazichita kuti zizibwe kulindiswe zisisikene zyakuyanda kwakwe, kwindila kulizezyo zyakamubotezya, azyakatondezya muli Kkilisito,
nkali a maboneno kukubambila kuzulila kwachindi, kukweta zintu zyoonse antoomwe, zyoonse zintu zilikujulu azilaansi, munsi aamutwe womwe, nikuba Kkilisito.
Muli Kkilisito twakasalwa mbuli basilukono. Twakasalilwa chiindi kwiindila mumabambe aakwe ooyo ubeleka kuzwa kulizyoonse kwiindila kumakanze akuyanda kwakwe.
Leza wakatusala swe mbuli basilukono kuchitila kuti swe, tobatanzi kubulangizi muli Kkilisito, tukabe bakutembawula bulemu bwakwe.
Muli Kkilisito, inywe kabiyo, eelyo nimwakamvwa ijwi lyakasimpe, makani mabotu alufutuko lwenu, mwakasyoma mulinguwe mpawo mwakasinizigwa a chisyomezyo cha Muuya Uusalala,
ooyo mwakabikwa kulukono lwesu kuyosika ku luununuko lwanzituli aazyo, kukutembawula bulemu bwakwe.
Kuleechi chizato, kuzwa nkesinaamvwa aatala alusyomo lwanu mu Mwaami Jesu aluyando lwenu kuli boonse bantu ba Leza basalala,
tendakaleka kulumba Leza akaambo kenu mbuuli mbendimwaamba munkoombyo zyangu.
Ndakomba kuti Leza wa Mwaami wesu Jesu Kkilisito, Taata wabulemu, uyoopa kulindinywe muuya wabusongo aziyubunuzyo muluzibo lwakwe.
Ndakomba kuti meso amyoyo yanu amunikilwe, kuti mukazibe bulangizi kuli zezyo nzyakamwitila bantu ba Leza basalala.
Munkombyo zyangu ndikumbila kuti muzibe mbuzibede inguzu zyakwe mpati loko zyiinda nzyajisi kulindiswe nitusyoma, kwiindila mukubeleka kwanguzu zyabulemu bwakwe.
