Eezi nzenzizyo nguzu ezyo Leza nzyaakabelesya muli Kkilisito eelyo nakamubusya kuzwa kubafu akumukkazika kujanza lya lulyo lwakwe mumasena akujulu.
Wakakkazika Kkilisito kule aatala lya yoonse milawu abweendelezi anguzu abasinguzu, alyoonse zina eelyo lyuuzikidwe Kkilisito uyoyendelezya kutensi mulicheechi chiindi luzutu, pesi amuchiindi chiza.
Leza wakabikka zyoonse zintu mukuzipeda kuunsi lyamawulu aKkilisito alimwi wakamupa kumbungano mubili mutwe atala lyazyoonse zintu.
Imbungano mubili wakwe, buzule bwakwe oyo uzuzya zyoonse muli zyoonse.
Alimwi kulindinywe, mwakalifwide mumilandu yenu azibi.
Mwakali kupona kwindila kumuzuluzi wamulawu wamuuya, muuya oyo ulikubeleka mubana batakwe lulayo.

Eelyo toonse twalikupona akati kabantu aba, kuzuzikizya makanze asiluuni wamibili yesu, akubweza makanze eenyama alimwi amiyeyo. Twakali kwindilila mubwiime bwabana babukali, mbuli bumwi bwabuntu. Twakali abuntu bwabwana babisya mbuli kuchita bamwi.
Pesi Leza ulabuvubi muluzyalo nkambo kaluyando lwakwe lupati oolo ndwakatuyandisya swe.
Nikuba twakalifwide mumilandu, wakatuchita bawumi antomwe muli Kkilisito aluzyalo mwakafutulwa.
Leza wakatubusya antomwe a Kkilisito, alimwi Leza wakatuchita kuti tukkale a Kkilisito, alimwi Leza wakatuchita kuti tukkale antomwe mumyenya yakujulu muli Kkilisito Jesu.
Kuchitila kuti muminyaka iza akatondezya kulindiswe kulindiswe buvubi bwakwe bupati buteleki kwa luzyalo lwakwe lutondezegwe mulwetelelo lwakwe kulindiswe muli Kkilisito Jesu.
Nkambo a luzyalo mwakafutulwa kwindila mulusyomo, alimwi echi techakazwa kulindinywe, nchipo cha Leza.
Pepe kuzwa kumilimo, kuchitila kuti takwe atakali kankayizye.
Nkambo tuli basimilimo ba Leza, bakalongezegwa muli Kkilisito Jesu kukuchita milimu mibotu eyo Leza njakatubambila kalekale, kuchitila kuti tukeende mulinjiiyo.
Nkiinkako amuyeeye kuti bamaasi munyama mwiitwa kuti ''chitapalwidwe'' acheecho chitegwa a ''kupalulwa.. munyama chakuchitwa amaboko amuntu.
Nkambo kachecho chiindi mwakalanzanisizigwe kuli Kkilisito kamuli bazwakule kuchisi chamu Izilayeli, batuba kuzizuminano zyachisyomezyo, kamutakwe bulangizi alimwi nkakutakwe Leza munyika.
Pele lino muli Kkilisito Jesu inywe nimwakali kule loko kuzwa kuli Leza mwakaboozegwa afwifwi kwindila mugaze lya Kkilisito.
Nkambo ngonguwe lumuuno lwesu. Wakachita kuti kubili baabe umwi. Kwinda kunyama yakwe wakanyonyoona bulambo bwankoondo bwakatwanzanisizye.
Nkinkako, wakalobya mulawu wamilawu amalayilile kuchitila kuti alenge muntu omwe mupya mulinguwe, nkokuti kube lumuuno.
Kkilisito wakababoozya amwi bantu bobile mumubili omwe kuli Leza kwinda muchiingano, kukujaya nkondo yakali akati kabo.
Jesu wakasika akukambawuka makani mabotu aluumuno kulindinywe nimwakali kule alumuno kuli aabo bakali afwifwi.
Eelyo kwindilila muli Jesu toonse mutujana luswano mumuuya omwe kuli Taata.
Nkambo kaako, lino inywe nobamaasi tamuchili batuuba amazwakule pe. Nkokuti muli benyika yomwe abantu ba Leza basalala abantu bamung'anda ya Leza.
Chamba kuti mwakayakilwa entalisyo yabatumwa abasinsimi, alimwi Kkilisito Jesu lwakwe ngonguwe bbwe lyachooko.
Mulinguwe ing'anda yoonse ikkwana oobotu antoomwe alimwikikkomena kabotu mbuuli tempele iisalala mu Mwaami.
Mulinguwe omo mumulikuyakwa kabiyo antomwe mbuli chikkalilo cha-Jesu mu Muuya.
Nkambo kacheechi ime, Pawulu, ndimwaange wa Kkilisito Jesu nkaambo kandinywe bamaasi.
Ndasyoma kuti mwakamvwa abubanzi bwaluzyalo bwa Leza obo bwakapegwa kuli ndime nkambo kenu.
Ndilikulemba kwindila kuchiyubunuzyo nchindakazibisigwa. Aka nkikasimpe kasisidwe nkindaka mulembela mubufwifwi kulindinywe.
Nimuyobala aatala azeezi, muyokkonzya kumvwisisisya atala a Kkilisito.
Kumvwisisisya kwangu muli aka kasimpe tekakazibisigwa kubana babantu. Pesi lino kayubununwa a Muuya kubatumwa bakwe basalala abasinsimi.
Aka kasimpe kasisidwe nkakuti bamasi mbasilukkononyokwe, alimwi mbasizizonyokwe mumubili, alimwi balabilana chisyomezyo muli Kkilisito Jesu kwiindila mumakani mabotu.
Eelyo ndakaba mulanda wamakani aya nkwinda kuchipo chaluzyalo lwa Leza ndwindakapegwa kwindila mukubeleka kwanguzu zyakwe.
Kuli ndime - nikuba kuti ndendime muniini kuli boonse bantu ba Leza basalala - olu luzyalo wakapegwa, kukukambawuka  kuli bamaasi buvubi butayanduliki bwa Kkilisito
akweeta kumumuni kuli boonse mabambe  - ezintu zyakasisidwe kwaminyaka myiingi muli Leza, wakalenga zintu zyoonse.
Aya mabambe akazibisigwa kwindila  mumbungano kuchitila kuti bendeelezi abasinguzu bamumilenga lenga akujulu bakasike mpubaziba mabazu - mingi abube bwabusongo bwa Leza.
Eezi zyakachitika kwindilila kumabambe atamani ayo ngakazuzikizya muli Kkilisito Jesu Mwaami wesu.
Eelyo muli Kkilisito tulijisi busichaamba akuswenenena alusinizyo nkambo kalusyomo.
Nkinkaako ndamukumbila kuti mutalengwani nkambo kamafwabi aangu nkefwabila ndinywe, wo mbobulemu bwenu.
Nkambo kaaka ndafugamina Taata amazwi aangu,
kuzwa kulinguwe zyoonse mpuli zyakujulu aansi ziluzikidwe.
Ndakamba kuti akamupe kwindila kubuumi bwabulemu bwakwe, kuti mukasimisigwe anguzu kwinda kumuuya wakwe oyo uuli mubuntu bwenu bwamukati.
Ndakomba kuti Kkilisito akkale mumyoyo yenu kwinda kulusyomo, miyanda yenu antalisyo muluyando lwakwe, kuchitila
kuti muka kkonzye kumvwisisya, antoomwe aboonse bantu ba Leza basalala , kuti mbuubuli busasa, bwanda, bulamfu bwakuya kujulu akunika muluyando lwa Kkilisito.
Akuziba luyando lwa Kkilisito, lwiinda aluzibo, kuchitila kuti mukazule buzule bwa Leza boonse.
Lino kuli nguwe oyo ukkonzya kuchita kwindilide kulizyoonse nzitukkumbila naa kuyeya, kwindila kunguzu zyakwe zibeleka mulindiswe,
Kulinguwe akube bulemu mumbungano amuli Kkilisito Jesu kumikkowa yoonse kwalyoonse alyoonse. Amen.
Nekubabobo, mbuli mwange nkambo ka Mwaami, ndamukombelezya kuti mwende chakwelela kubwiite obo mbumwakiitwa.
Ndamukombelezya kuti mupone akulibombya kupati achakulitoba aansi akubamoyo mulamfu, mumvwidilane luzyalo umwi awumwi muluyando.
Muchite zyelede kukulondola kujatana kwamuuya kunchoonzyo achalumuno.
Kuli mubili omwe amuuya omwe, kabiyo mbuli mbumwakiitwa mubulangizi boomwe bwabwitwe bwenu.
Alimwi kuli Mwaami omwe, lusyomo lomwe, lubbabbatizyo lomwe, a Leza womwe a Taata waboonse,
uletela lyazyoonse alimwi kwindila kulizyoonse amulizyonse.
Kuli umwi awumwi wesu luzyalo wakapegwa kwindila mumwelo wachipo cha Kkilisito.
Kuli mbuli malembe mbwaamba kuti:
Chambanzi kuti, ''Wakatanta kujulu,'' kunze aakuti wakaseluka kunsi anyika ?
Ooyo wakaselukide ngonguwe muntu kabiyo wakatanta kule atala lyamajulu oonse, kuti azuzye zyoonse zintu.
Kkilisito wakapa bamwi kuti babe batumwa, bamwi mbuli basinsimi, bamwi babe bakambawusi alimwi bamwi babe bembeli abayiisi.
Wakapa zipo ezi kusamika bantu ba Leza basalala kubasamikila mulimu wakugwasya nkachitila kuyakwa kwamubili wa Kkilisito.
Kwinkilila anembo akuyaka mubili wakwe maane toonse tukasikile lujatano lwalusyomo aluzibo lwaMwana Leza, akuti tukasime akusikila mwelwe wabuzule bwa Kkilisito.
Kkilisito wakatuyaka kuchitila kuti tatuchinoli bana bapupulwidwe musule akunembo aguuwo, kubwezegwa aguwo lyonse lyanjisyo yabuchenjezu bwabantu mumabambe abo alweno.
Twelede kwaamba kasimpe muluyando, twelede kukomena mulizyonse inzila mulinguwe ooyo silutwe, nkokuti Kkilisito.
Kkilisito uyaka mubili wonse, alimwi yonse igwasizya, alimwi mubili kuti ukomene kuchitila kuti uliyake mwini muluyando.
Nkinkako, ndaamba kuti ndasimya  kuleezi mu Mwaami kuti tamuchinoyendi mbuli kweenda bamaasi, mubufubafuba bwamyoyo yabo.
Bali siyilidwe mukumvwisisisya kwabo, kuti kulimbabo, nkambo kakuyuma kwamyoyo yabo.
Tabakwe nsoni alimwi bakalipeda kutubuno, alimwi bakiiya yoonse misyobo yazibi abulyabi.
Pele tensi mbubo mbumwakayiya atala akkilisito.
Ndiyeyela kuti mwakamvwa atala anguwe, akuti amwakayisigwa mulinguwe, mbuli kuti bwini buli muli Jesu.
Mwakayisigwa kuti musowe zyoonse zyemponeno yechiindi akusowa muntu wechiindi. Muntu wechiindi ngonguwe nguusofwede nkaambo kalweno lwaziyandisyo zyakwe.
Musowe buntu bwechiindi kuti  mulengululwe bupya mumiyeyo yanu,
muchite echi kuti muzwate muntu mupya oyo ulengedwe muchiimo cha Leza-mubululami bwakasimpe abusalali.
Nkinkaako, amusowe bubeji, alimwi muleke uumwi awumwi wanu aambe kasimpe kulisimabambanwa wakwe, nkambo tulichizo chawumwi awumwi.
''Nyema, pele utabisyi.'' Utazumini kuti zuba likabbile nkochinyemede.
Utapi mweenya kuli dyabulusi.
Ooyo wakali kubba atachinobbi lubo welede kubeleka, kubelekela kulecho chibotu amaanza akwe, kuchitila kuti abe achimwi chakwabilana ababo babulide.
Utazumizyi kwambuula kuchisa kuti kuzwe mumulomo wako. Belesya biyo majwi mabotu kuchitila kugwasigwa kwabaabo bakuyanda, kuchitila kuti majwi ako ape luzyalo kulaabo baamvwa.
Alimwi mutapenzyi Muuya Uusalala wa Leza, nkaambo nguwe wakamusimisizya buzuba bwalununuko lwenu.
Musowe boonse buluti amaambani, lunyemo, ndutiluti azisapi aantomwe abubi boonse.
Mube aluzyalo kuli umwi awumwi, moyo mubombe, mwambilane umwi awumwi, mbuli Leza muli Kkilisito mbwakamulekelela.
Nkinkaako amube basikwiya ba Leza, mbuli bana bayandisi.
Alimwi mweende muluyando, mbuli Kkilisito mbwakatuyanda swe akulyabilila lwakwe nkambo kesu. Nchinunkilizyo chachituuzyo achipayizyo kuli Leza.
Pesi takwelede nikuba kwambula akati kenu atala abwaamu na kufumbwa misyobo yabusofwazi naa buunyu, nkambo ezi taziluleme kubantu ba Leza basalala.
Eelyo kutabi zisapi, kutabi twambo twabufubafuba, abuchapa kukwambula zyoonse azezyo zitali zyabululami. Nikuba kuti kwelede kuba chipo chakulumba.
Alimwi mbuli mbumuzi kuti takwe sibwamu, sibusofwazi naa muntu muunyu ayooyoy sikukomba mituni - uli alukono mubwami bwa Kkilisito a Leza.
Kutabi umwi umweena amajwi abuuyo, eelyo nkambo kazeezi zintu bululami bwa Leza bulaza atala lyabana bataswilili.
Nkinkaako, mutaswanani antomwe ambabo.
Elyo mwakali mumudima, pesi lino mwakaba mumumuuni mu Mwaami.
Amweende mbuli bana bamumumuuni.  (Nkambo michelo yamumuni mwiili muli zyonse zibotu, busalali, akasimpe),
alimwi mwiiye ezyo zikoonda Mwaami.
Mutanoobi aamwi amilimu itazyali michelo yamumudima pesi amwiyubunune.
Nkaambo mawuse nikuba kwaamba zintu nzibachita mu chimpetu.
Pesi kuti kufumbwa chintu chabikwa mumumuuni, ngachalibonia.
Nkaambo kufumbwa chintu chilibonia mumuni.
Langisisisya kabotu kabotu mbayeenda - pepe mbuli bafubafuba pesi mbuli basongo.
Bamba chiindi nkambo mazuba mabi.
Nkinkaako, mutabi bafubafuba, pesi mumvwisisye kuti kuyanda kwa Mwaami nkukuli.
Alimwi mutakkolwi abukkande, nkambo bwetela budakwi mumizeezo. Nikuba kuti, amuzuzigwe a Muuya Uusalala,
amwambule kuli umwi awumwi muntembawuzyo enyimbo alimwi enyimbo zyamuuya, kwimba akulumbaizya ku Mwaami amyoyo yanu yoonse,
Lyoonse kamupa kulumba kuli zyoonse, muzina lya Mwaami wesu Jesu Kkilisito kuli Leza Taata,
akuli bombya kuli umwi awumwi mukulemeka Kkilisito.
Nobanakazi amulibombye kubalumi banu, mbuli ku Mwaami.
Nkambo mwalumi ngomutwe wamwanakazi mbuli Kkilisito mbwali mutwe wembungano, welwakwe mufutuli wamubili.
Pesi mbuli mbungano mbilibombya kuli Kkilisito, eelyo anywebo nobanakazi kubalumi banu muli zyoonse.
Nobalumi, amuyande banakazi benu, mbuli Kkilisito mbwakayanda mbungano akulipeda lwakwe kuli nguwe.
Kuchitila kuti akamusanzye, kuti ayisalazye, kukwisalazya akwisanzya kwamanzi ejwi,
kuti akapede mbungano kulinguwe mbuuli bulemu butakwe kabata naa bubi naa kamwi kampenda kamusyobo oyo, pesi isalala akutaba akampenda.
Munzila iyendelene abululami belede kuyanda banakazi mbuli mibili yabo beni. Oyo uyanda mwanakazi ulaliyanda mwini.
Eelyo takwe umwi wakabijilwa amubili wakwe, pesi ulawubamba akusilika chamaanu, mbubonya mbuli Kkilisito mbwakananika akusilika mbungano chamaanu,
nkambo tuli bana bamubili wakwe.
''Nkambo kacheechi mwalumi unonga kasiya wisi abanyina alimwi uyoba antomwe amwanakazi wakwe, alimwibabili bayoba nyama yomwe.''
Obu bwini busisidwe mbupati - pesi ndikwambula atala a Kkilisito ambungano.
Nikuba boobo, umwi awumwi wanu kabiyo welede kuyanda mwanakazi wakwe mwini mbuli lwakwe, alimwi mwanakazi welede kulemeka mulumi wakwe.
Banike, amulemeke bazyali benu mu Mwaami, nkambo eechi chililuleme.
''Lemeka Uuso abanyoko'' ( ooyu ngomulayizyo mutaanzi uli eechisyomezyo ),
''kuchitila kuti kubekabotu kulinduwe akupona chiindi chilamfu munyika.''
Anywebo, nomataata, mutanoniaki banabenu kukunyema nikuba kuti, mubanyampule mululayo amulayilile a Mwaami.
Nobazike, amumvwe kubaami benu kwindila kunyama akulemeka kunikide achakuyoowa, mukusyomeka kwamyoyo yanu.
Amumvwisisisye kulimbabo mbuli mbumumvwisisisya kuli Kkilisito. Amumvwisisisye mubabotezye. Nikuba kuti, amubeleke mbuli bazike baKkilisito, abo bachita kuyanda kwa Leza kuzwa mumoyo yanu.
Beleka amoyo wako woonse, mbuli kuti mulikubelekela Mwaami pepe bantu,
nkaambo tulizi kuti kufumbwa zichito zibotu awumwi muntu nzyachita, uyotambula mpindu kuzwa ku Mwaami, nikuba muzike na ufutwidwe.
Nubaami, mubelesye bazike benu munzila yelene. Mutabakanzi bubi mulizi kuti oyo uuli kobile mubelesyi wabo awanu ulikujulu, alimwi mulizi kuti takwe pe kulangilwa kwachiwa chamuntu.
Kumaninizya, amusime mu Mwaami amunguzu zyabupati bwakwe.
Muzwate mulizyoonse zilwanyo zya Leza, nkokuti mukakkonzye kwiimininana amanjezezya akuyeya kwa dyabulosi.

Eelyo kupengana kwesu takwiminene enyama abulowa, pesi kwiminene abendelezi abeendelezi, kwiiminana aatala anguzu ezi ziliwo zyamudima, kwiminana abwendelezi bwamyuya mibi ili mumilengalenga yakujulu.
Nkinkaako muzwate zyoonse zilwanio zya Leza, kuchitila kuti mukakonzye kwimikila mubuzuba bwakabi, alimwi nkamuli mwamaninsya kuchita zyoonse, kukwiimikila nji.
Mwime njii, alutambo lwabwini luzyungulukide zikkungu zyenu, alimwi mulizwatike zizwaato zyakukaango zyabululami,
alimwi, azituta zibambwe kukuzwatikwa amakani amakani mabotu alumuno.
Muli zyonse zyiindi mubweze ntobo yalusyomo, mbubonya muyokonzya kugwisya yoonse mivwi iyaka ya mubi.
Alimwi mubweze ngwaani ya lufutuko apanga lya Muuya, lilindendilyo ijwi lya Leza.
Azyoonse nkombyo azikkumbizyo, mukombe kuzyiindi zyoonse mu Muuya. Kumamanino, lyoonse kamulangilizya aboonse busungu nkamupeda nkombyo kuli boonse bantu ba Leza basalala.
Alimwi mundikombele, kuti mulumbe ukapegwe kulindime nindayojula mulomo wangu.  Mukombe kuti ndikazibisigwe kasimpe kasisidwe aatala evangeli.
Ndendilyo lye vangeli elyo ndiyobuzulwida oyo uli mumacheni, kuchitila kuti ndikaambe akanzambwenene, mbuli mbiyelede kwamba.
Pele nkukuti mukakonzye kuziba amabelekelo angu mbwendikuchita, Tayichikkasi, mwalumi muyandisi alimwi mulanda usyomeka mu Mwaami, uyomubuzya zyoonse, kuchitila kuti mukazibe mbuli mbwendikuchita.
Ndakamutuma kulindinywe kulingaaya ya makanze, kuchitila kuti mukazibe mbutubede, alimwi kuchitila kuti akusungwazye myoyo yenu.
Akube kuti lumuno lube kubakwesu, alimwi luyando alusyomo luzwa kuli Leza Taata a Mwaami Jesu Kkilisito.
Luzyalo alube kuli boonse abo bayanda Mwaami wesu Jesu Kkilisito aluyando lutakwe kampenda.
Mumazuba a Ahazwelasi, Ahazwelasi alimwi ulizibinkene kuti ngu Zakizesi, ( ooyo ngu Ahazwelasi wakeendelezya kuzwa ku Indiya akuyosika ku Kkusyi, ajulu a 127 zisi),
mumazubayo mwami Ahazwelasi wakakkala aachuno chabwami bwakwe chakali mugunzi lya Susa.
Mumunyaka watatu mubwendelezi bwakwe, wakapa ipobwe kuli boonse bendelezi bakwe abazike bakwe. Basilumamba ba Pezyiya aba Midiya, baleli, abendelezi bazisi bakali mubuliwo bwakwe.
Wakabatondezya buvubi bubotu bwabwami bwakwe akulemekwa kwabulemu bwakwe akulemekwa kwabulemu kwabupati kwamazuba miingi, kwamazuba 180.

Elyo mazubaya nakamana, mwami wakapa pobwe lyakatola mazuba aali musanu aabili. Lyakali lyabantu boonse bakali mu Susa, kuzwida kubapati kuyosika kubanini bakali kuyandikana, lyakachitilwa mulubuwa lwachilili chamung'anda yamwami.

Busena bwachilili bwakali botezegelwe amalembo abuluba butuba asiyasiya aakangidwe aankole zyamasani amusyobo wantumbula, zyakanzikidwe amubalo wansiliva kuzwa kuminsende yabbwe ibbotu. Kwakali chuno changolida ansiliva akabambidwe kuzwa kububambululwe bwa mozesi kuzwa kubbwe bbotu, jebesi, ijina-lya bwebesi, alimwi kalilamibalabala yamabwe.
Zinywigwa zyakali kupedwa muzinywido zyangolida. Aachimwi chinywido chakali siyene, alimwi kwakaliwo wayini ooyo wakaza akambo kaluzyalo lwamwami.

Kunywa kwakabwezedwe aanze kwinda mumalembe, ''Takweelede kuba lusalulo pe,'' Akambo kakuti muli eyinzila mwami wakali wapa malayilile kuli boonse bendelezi bamung'anda yakwe kuti bachite mbuli umwi awumwi muntu mbwayanda.
Alakwe Namalelo Vashiti wakapa ipobwe lyabana kazili mung'anda yabwami Ahazwelasi.

Muzuba lyamusanu aabili, eelyo mooyo wamwami niwakamvwa kubotelwa akambo kawayini wakambila Mehamani, Bbizita, Habbona, Bbigita, Abbagata, Zeta a Kkakasi ( bendelezi musanu ababili abo bakali kubelekela munsi lyakwe),
kuti kweetwe Namalelo Vashiti munsi lyakwe amunsini wabwami bwakwe. Wakali kuyanda kutondezya bantu bakwe bubotu bwakwe, nkambo kabube bwakwe bubotu loko.
Pesi Namalelo Vashiti wakakaka kuti asike kujwi lyamwami eelyo lyakali lyeetwa kulinguwe abendelezi. Mpawo mwami wakanyema loko; bukali bwakwe bwakayaka mulinguwe.
Aboobo mwami wakabuzya kubalumi bakazibinkene kuti mbasongo, bakali kumvwisisisya zyiindi (nkambo eyi nkani yakali nzila yamwami kuli boonse abo bakazi zyamulawu akubetekwa).

Lino abo bakali afwifwi anguwe bakali ngu Kkasyena, Syeta, Adimata, Tasyisyi, Melesi, Masena, a Memukani, banakazi babaami bali musanu ababili bab Pezyiya aba Midiya. Bakali kusika afwifwi amwami alimwi bakalijisi zyuuno zilajulu mubwendelezi mubwami.
''Mukwinda kumulawu, niinzi cheelede kuchitwa kuli Namalelo Vashiti nkambo takaswilila pe kumalayilile amwami Ahazwelasi, aayo akeetedwe kuli nguwe abeendelezi?''
Memukkani wakamba kunembo lyamwami abeendelezi, ''Teensi mwami luzutu Vashiti ngwabizya, pesi abendelezi boonse abantu boonse bali muchisi chamwami Ahazwelasi.

Nkambo makani a Namalelo alazibwa abanakazi boonse. Eechi chiyochita kuti banakazi bakachite chakutalemeka balumi babo. Bayowamba kuti, ''Mwami Ahazwelasi wakalayilila Vashiti namalelo kuti ayetwe kunembo lyakwe, pesi wakakaka.
Kalitanamana eeli izuba banakazi balemekeka bamu Pezyiya abamu Midiya aabo bakamvwa makani a Namalelo bayowamba chintu echi nchichonya kubendelezi bang'anda yamwami. Kuyoba kulemeka kupati akunyema.

Na chamubotelezya mwami, akube malayilile azwa kumwami aakuti atandwe kuzwa kulinguwe, alimwi azilembwe mumulawu yaba Pezyiya aba Midiya, eecho chitakonzeki kusandulwa kuchitila kuti Vashiti katanochisiki kunembo lya mwami. Akube kuti mwami ape uumbi bwendelezi bwabu Namalelo kuli uumbi uyinda nguwe.
Eelyo malayilile amwami anowambwa mubwami bwakwe boonse, alimwi abonse banakazi bayolemeka balumi babo, kuzwa kubapati kuyosikila kubanini balachakuchita.''
Mwami antomwe abendelezi bakwe bakabotelwa anchenjezyo eyi, alimwi mwami wakachita mbubonya mbuli Memukkani mbwakayeyelede.

Wakatumizya magwalo kuliwonse masena abwami bwakwe, kuchisi chimwi achimwi mumalembe aacho, akumusyobo wabantu umwi awumwi mumulaka wabo. Wakalayilila kuti umwi awumwi mwalumi abe mutwe wang'anda yakwe. Aya malayilile akapegwa mumulaka wawumwi awumwi muzisi zyabwami bwakwe.
Nizyakayinda zintu eezi, eelyo bukali bwamwami Ahazwelasi nakanyemunukwa, wakayeeya ataala a Vashiti azezyo nzyakali wachita. Wakayeeya  alubo amalayilile ngaakali wabamba atala anguwe.
Mpawo balombwana banini bamubelekela bakati, ''Akube kuyangawulwa kwaba nakalindu bachinini alimwi babotu kubbazu lya mwami.

Akube kuti mwami abikke bendelezi muzisi zyoonse zyabwami bwakwe, kuti kubunganisigwe aamwi banakalindu beebeka banini kumwalumi uumwi mumunzi wa Susa. Akube kuti boonse babikkwe mumanza a Hegayi, mwendelezi wamwami, ooyo unolanga banakazi, alimwi abape mafuta aabo akunana kumenso.
Akube kuti ooyo nakalindu munini ooyo utakabotelezye mwami akabe Namalelo abusena bwa Vashiti. Aaya machenjezyo akakondya mwami, alimwi wakachita oobo.
Nchobeni kwakaliwo mu Juda mumunzi wa Susa wakali ezina lyakali kutegwa Modekkayi mwana mulombe wa Jayile mwana mulombe wa Simeyi mwana mulombe wa Kkishi, ooyo wakali mu Bbenjamini.
Wakali watolwa mubuzike kuzwa ku Jelusalema abazike aamwi ababo bakali batolwa mubuzike a Jowakkimu, mwami wa Juda, oyo Nebbukkadineza mwami wa Bbabbiloni ngwakatolede mubuzike.

Wakali kulanga Hadasa, chaamba kuti Esita, wakali mwana musimbi wa simyunzabo, nkambo takwakalikwe wisi nakuti banyina. Mwanakazi munini wakali achiwa chibotu alimwi wakali kweebeka. Modekkayi wakamubweza mbuli mwanakwe musimbi ngwazyala.

Eelyo malayilile amalembe amwami nakaambwa, bachanakazi bakeetwa mumunzi wa Susa. Bakabikwa alimwi munsi lya Hegayi kuti kalokubalanga. Alakwe Esita wakatolegwa mung'anda ya mwami, alimwi wakabikkwa munsi lya Hegayi, wakali kulanga banakazi.

Kasimbi aka kakamukondya loko mwami alimwi kakujana luzyalo mulinguwe. Achakufwambana wakamugwasya mafuta akwe achibeela chakulya. Wakamutuma kubazike bali musanu ababili kuzwa kung'anda yamwami, alimwi wakamutola aamwi abazike bali  musanu ababili kung'anda imbotu loko mung'anda yabanakazi.
Esita takwepe ngwakali wabuzya kuti bantu nikuba bamusyobo wakwe mbaani, nkambo kakuti Modekkayi wakali wamulayilila kuti ataambi.

Mazuba woonse Modekkayi wakali kweendenda kunembo amusule kunembo lyalubuwa lwang'anda aanze kung'anda yabanakazi, kuti ayiiye atala azyakuligwasya kwa Esita alimwi aatala azezyo nzyayelede kuchitilwa.

Chindi nichakasika chawumwi awumwi musimbi kuti ayinke kumwami Ahazwelasi--  mukutobelezya malayilile nakuti milawu yabanakazi kwamyeezi ikkumi ayibili, nkambo eechi chakali chiindi bubotu bwabo mpobwakali kumamanino akusikwa kwabo. Myeezi musanu awumwi amafuta amuulo alimwi musanu awumwi amuunde amafuta --
elyo kuchindi musimbi nakali kuya kumwami, kufumbwa eecho nchakali kuyanda wakali kuchipegwa, kuzwa kung'anda yabanakazi kuti lwakwe atole kung'anda yamwami.

Mansiku wakali kunjila mukati, alimwi kuseni walikunga wabweeda kung'anda yabili yabanakazi, akung'anda nkubakali kulelwa ya Syasyagazi, mwendelezi wamwi, ooyo wakali kulanga basimamambe. Taakali kunga wabweda lubo pe kumwami aadokuti kwajanika kukondwa kupati muli nguwe alimwi walikumwita azina.

Lino chindi cha Esita nichakasika (mwana musimbi wa Abbihayila wisilenzi wa Modekkayi, ooyo wakali wamutola  mbuli mwanakwe ngwazyala)kuti ayinke kumwami, takwepe nchakabuzya pesi eecho Hegayi mwendelezi wamwami, ooyo wakali kulangana abanakazi nzyakayeeya.

Lino Esita wakatambula luzyalo kuli baabo boonse bakamubona. Esita wakatolegwa kumwami Ahazwelasi mumunzi wamwami mumwezi wakkumi ulinguwo mwezi wa Tebbeli, mumunyaka wamusanu ayibili wabwendelezi bwakwe.

Mwami wakayandisya Esita kwinda boonse banakazi alimwi wakatambula luzyalo munsi lyakwe kwinda boonse banakalindu. Aboobo wakabamba munsini wabwami amutwe wakwe alimwi akumuchitila namalelo muchiimo cha Vashiti.

Lino mwami wakapanga pobwe pati kuli boonse bendelezi abalanda bakwe. ''Pobwe lya Esita,'' alimwi akumupa eechi nchakali wakumbila mukubotelwa kuzwa mitelo yazisi. Wakamupa lubo chaabilo chabwami muluzyalo.
Lino eelyo banakalindu nibakabunganisigwa aamwi lwabili, Modekkayi wakali kkede amulyango wa mwami.

Esita takwepe ngwakayina kubuzya atala anzubo zyakwe nikuba bantu bakwe, mbuli Modekkayi mbwakali wamulayilila. Wakayimikila anembo akutobelezya machenjezyo a Modekkayi, mbuli mbwakachitide eelyo nakaleledwe anguwe.

Mumazubayo, kuchindi  Modekkayi nakakkede amulyango wamwami, Bendelezi babili ba mwami, Bbigitani a Telesi, aabo bakali kulindila mulyango uya mung'anda, bakanyema alimwi bakayandula kuti bamuchisa mwami Ahazwelasi.
Eelyo makani nakazibinkana kuli Modekkayi, wakabuzya namalelo Esita, alimwi Esita wakambula kumwami muzina lya Modekkayi.
Mulumbe wakayandulwa alimwi wakajanika, mpawo balumi babili bakanzikwa achanzikilo. Aaya makani akalembwa mubuliwo bwamwami, mubbuku lyazyiindi zyabwendelezi bwakwe.
Nikwakayinda zintu ezi, Mwami Ahazwelasi wakasumpula Hamani mwana mulombe wa Hamedata mu Agagite, alimwi akumubika achuno chabwendelezi bwakwe atala aliboonse bendelezi mbakali aabo.
Boonse bazike bamwami aabo bakali amulyango wa mwami kabafugeme akukotama aansi kuli Hamani, mbuli mwami mbwakaba layilide kuti bachite. Pesi Modekkayi takafugama pe nikuba kukotama.
Mpawo boonse bazike ba Mwami aabo bakali amulyango bakati kuli Modekkayi, ''Nkambonzi nokaka malayilile a Mwami?''

Bakali kwambuula kuli nguwe buzuba abuzuba, pesi wakakaka kuti achite eezyo nzibakali kuyanda kuti achite eezyo nzibakali kuyanda. Aboobo bakaambula a Hamani kuti babone nankubona makani atala a Modekkayi akachala kalimbubo na. Nkambo wakababuzizye kuti mu Juda.
Eelyo Hamani naakabona kuti Modekkayi taakafugama  pe akumutondezya kutamulemeka, Hamani wakazula bukkali.

Wakaba akuzumina kua amuzezo wakaujaya Modekkayi, nkambo bazike ba mwami bakali bamubuzya kuti bantu ba Modekkayi mbani, Hamani wakeezya kujaya boonse ba Juda, bantu ba Modekkayi, aabo bakali mubwami bwa Ahazwelasi boonse.

Mumweezi wakutanguna (ulingomwezi wa Nisani), muminyaka kkumi ayibili ya Ahazwelasi, Puli --chaamba nkakata -- yakawaalwa aansi kunembo lya Hamani, kuti kusalwe buzuba amweezi.  Bakawala nkakata akuzyindulula mane nkakata yakuwa mumwezi wakkumi ayibili (chaamba mwezi wa Adda).

Mpawo Hamani wakati ku Mwami Ahazwelasi, ''Kuli bamwi bantu balimumasena babikkidwe akkati kazisi zyabwami bwako zyoonse. Milawu yabo ilisiyene ayabamwi bantu, alimwi tababambi pe milawu ya mwami, abobo tacheelede pe ku Mwami kuti abaleke bakkale.

Naa kachikondelezya kumwami, ngaape malayilile kuti abajaye, alimwi njoyeela mweelo wamakkumi kkumi achuulu chamatalenta ansiliva kuli baabo bali mubwendelezi bwa mulimu wa mwami, kuti lwabo babike munkomo yamwami.''
Mpwo mwami wakabweza chitondezyo chanweenwe kuzwa kukuboko akwipa kuli Hamani mwana mulombe wa Hamedata mu Agagiti, sinkondonyina waba Juda.
Mwami wakati kuli Hamani, ''Nzoobona kuti imali iyopegwa lubo kuli nduwe akubantu bako. Uyochita kufumbwa mboyanda anjiiyo.''

Mpawo balembi ba mwami  bakayitwa mubuzuba bwakkumi mwatatu lyamwezi mutanzi, alimwi malayilile aakajisi zyoonse eezyo Hamani nzyakali waamba zyakalembelwa kubendelezi bonse bazisi ba Mwami, aabo bakali ajulu abendelezi boonse bazisi kuchisi choonse mubulembwe boonse bwacho, alimwi akumikowa yoonse, mumilaka wabo. Zyakalembwa muzina lyamwami Ahazwelasi alimwi akudindwa anweenwe yakwe.

Magwalo akatolwa amaboko abasikwendelezya magwalo kuzisi zyoonse zya mwami, kuti banyongania akujayigwa, akumwaya boonse kubapati, bana abanakazi, muzuba limwi - mubuzuba bwakkumi aatatu mumwezi wakkumi ayibili aatatu mumwezi wakkumi ayibili (ulinguwo mweezi wa Adda) - alimwi yoola lukono lwabo.
Malayilile akali mumagwalo akachitwa mumulawu muzisi zyoonse. Muzisi zyoonse kwakachitwa kuti kuzibwe kubantu boonse kuti belede kubambilila izuba eli.

Basikutola magwalo bakayinka alimwi bakafwambana kutola mulayizyo wa Mwami. Malayilile alwo akatolwa mukati kamyuunzi ya Susa. Mwami antomwe a Hamani bakakkala aansi kuti banywe, pesi dolopo lya Susa lyakaba mukukatazika.
Elyo Modekkayi wakayiiya azezyo zyoonse zyakali zyachitikana, wakadelula zyakuzwata alimwi wakasama masaka adyota. Wakayinka akkati kadolopo, akukwila loko ajwi lilajulu kwakunyema.
Wakayinka kupela kuloyiila amulyango wamwami, nkambo tawope wakali kuzumizigwa kwinda mpawo kazwete masaka.
Muchisi choonse, kufumbwa malayilile a mwami amalembe nkwakasikila, kwakaba kukwila akkati kama Juda, akulyiimya akomooka. Biingi baabo bakalilede amasaka adyota.

Elyo mwanakazi munini wa Esita amuzike wakwe nibakasika akumubuzya Namalelo wakaba akuusa kupati. Wakatumizya zizwato zyakuti Modekkayi akazwate. (kuchitila kuti agwisye masaka). Pesi takwepe nakazizumina.
Mpawo Esita wakayita Hataki, umwi wabeendelezi bamwami ooyo wakatumudwe kuku mubelekela. Wakamukumbila kuti ayinke kuli Modekkayi kuti akayiiye eezyo zyakali zyachitika akuti zyakali kwambanzi.
Aboobo Hataki wakayinka kuli Modekkayi aakati kalubuwa lwa dolopo kunembo amulyango wa mwami.
Modekkayi wakamwambila zyoonse zyakali zyachitika kuli nguwe, abuvule bwamweelwe wansiliva eeyo Hamani njakasyomezezye kweta alimwi akubikka muchibanzilo chamwami kuchitila kubikka ba Juda kulufu.

Wakamupa alubo ipeepa lyamalembe elyo lyakapedwe mu Susa akambo kakujayigwa kwaba Juda. Wakachita eechi kuchitila kuti Hatakki achitondezye Esita, alimwi kuti welede kumupa mulimo wakuya kumwami kuti akakumbile luzyalolwakwe, alimwi akukumbila anguwe kayimvilide bantu bakwe.
Aboobo Hataki wakayinka akuyowambila Esita eezyo Modekkayi nzyakali waamba.
Mpawo wakambula a Hataki akumulayilila kuti abwede lubo kuli Modekkayi. Wakati,

''Bonse bazike bamwami abantu bamuzisi bazibe kuti kufumbwa mwalumi na mwanakazi uyinka kumwami mukati kalubuwa katayitidwe, kulumwi kupela mulawu: kuti welede kuti ajigwe- kusiya uumwi ooyo mwami ngwanoli ujisilidi mufungo wangolida kuchitila kuti apone. Nsina kwiitwa pe kuti nzeku mwami kwamazuba makumi atatu aaya.''
Aboobo Hatakki wakasisya majwi a Esita kuli Modekkayi.
Modekkayi wakabwedezya makani aaya kuli Esita. ''Twelede pe kuyeeya eezyo mung'anda yamwami, uyochija kufumbwa kwinda boonse bamwi ba Juda.

Naa wawumuna kuli echi chindi, lugwasyo aluvuno luyoyima kuba Juda kuzwa kuli bumwi busena, pesi iwebo ang'anda yawuso muyofwidilila. Ngwani uuzi nakuyochitikilanzi nwasika kubusena bwabwami akambo kachindi chili mbuli eechi?''
Mpawo Esita wakatumizya makani aya kuli Modekkayi.

''Yinka, ukabunganie aamwi boonse ba Juda aabo bakkala mu Susa, alimwi mukalyiimye nkambo kaangu. Mutakalyi pe nikuba kunywa kwamazuba aatatu, mansiku nikuba sikati. Mebo abasimbi bangu banini tiyolyiimya munzila ikozyania. Mpawo njoyinka kumwami, nikuba kuti kazitali mumulawu, alimwi nakuti nkufwa njoofwa.''
Modekkayi wakiinka akuyochita zyonse eezyo Esita nzyakali wamubuzya kuti azichite.
Nikwakinda mazuba atatu, Esita wakazwata zisamo zyabwami akwimikila mulubuwa lwang'anda yamwami, kunembo aang'anda yamwami. Mwami wakali kkede achuno chabwami kalangide kumulyango wang'anda.
Eelyo mwami nakabona Esita namalelo kayimvwi mulubuwa, wakatambula luzyalo mumenso akwe. Aboobo Esita wakaswena alimwi akuguma impela yamufungo.
Mwami wakati kulinguwe, ''Niinzi nchoyanda Namalelo Esita? Nchichili chikumbilo chako? Kuyosika kuchisela chabwami bwangu, chiyopegwa kuli nduwe.''
Esita wakati, ''Naakuti chabotezya mwami, Mwami a Hamani basike sunu kupobwe eelyo ndindamubambila.''
Mwami wakati, ''Yeta Hamani kufwambana, kuti azochite eezyo Esita nzyakaamba. Aboobo mwami a Hamani bakiinka kupobwe eelyo Esita ndyakali wabamba.
Elyo wayini niwakali kupegwa kupobwe, mwana wakati kuli Esita, ''Nchichili chikumbizyo chako? Chiyopegwa kuli nduwe. Nchikumbizyo nzii chako? Kuyosika kuchisela chabwami, uyochipegwa.''
Esita wakasandula, ''Chikumbilo changu achikumbizyo nceechi, nakuti ndajana luzyalo kumenso a mwami alimwi

nakuti chilakondezya mwami kuti andipe kukukumbila kwangu achikumbizyo changu alimwi akulemeka chikumbizyo changu, aboole mwami a Hamani kupobwe eelyo ndyentakababambile junza alimwi ndiyosandula mubuzyo wamwami.''

Hamani wakazwa aanze eelyo zuba kakondeledwe akubotelwa mumoyo. Pesi muchindi Hamani nakabona Modekkayi kumulyango wamwami, takakankamana pe nikuba kuyoowa kunembo lyakwe katakwe nikuba buyofu, wakazula lulaka aatala a Modekkayi.
Nekuba boobo, Hamani wakalijata alimwi wakaya kung'anda yakwe. Wakatuma benzinyina akubabungania aamwi, a Zelesi banakwe.

Hamani wakabalila lubo buvule bwabuvubi bwakwe, mweelwe wabana bakwe balombe biingi, boonse busumpwidwe kwinda muli oobo mwami  mbwaka mulemeka, alimwi ambuli mbwakazwidilila kwinda boonse beendelezi abazike ba mwami.
Hamani wakati, ''Namalelo Esita takwe pe ngwakatambide pesi mebo lwangu a mwami kupobwe ndyakabambide. Nikuba junza ndilitambidwe lubo anguwe katuli a mwami.
Pesi zyoonse eezi takwepe nchizindigwasya kufumbwa nkumbwene Modekkayi mu Juda kakkede kumulyango wa mwami.''

Mpawo Zelesi banakwe bakati kuli Hamani abazolwani bakwe boonseni, ababambe chanzikilo chamakkumi alimusanu bulamfu. Kuseni ubambwidwe a mwami kuti badine Modekkayi achanzikilo. Mpawo uyinke akukondwa a mwami kupobwe.'' Echi chakakondelezya alimwi wakabamba chanzikilo chamana.
Obo busiku mwami takwe pe nakona. Wakambila babelesi bakwe kuti beete ibbuku lyakalembedwe zyakachitika mubwendelezi bwakwe, alimwi lyakabalwa chakoompolola ku mwami.
Kwakajanwa kakulembedwe omo kuti Modekkayi wakamba atala Bbigitana a Teleshi, bobile basilutwe bamwami bakali kulinda mulyango wakumanjililo, abo bakali beezya kuyanda kuchisa mwami Ahazwelasi.
Mwami wakabuzya, '' Niinzi chakachitwa kupa bulemu nikuba kuyeyegwa kuli Modekkayi akuchita eezi?'' Mpawo balumi bachinini bakali kubelekela mwami bakati, ''Takwe nchakachitwa pe.''
Mwami wakamba kuti, ''Ngwani sikulinda mulyango ?'' Lino wakanjila kumulyango waanze wang'anda yamwami kuzomwambila atala akujayigwa kwa Modekkayi apulanga ndyaka mubambilide.
Babelesi ba mwami bakamwambila kuti, ''Amumwambile anjile.''

Eelyo Hamani nakanjila, mwami wakamwambila kuti, ''Ninzi cheelede kuchitilwa muntu mwami ngwabotelelwa mukumulemeka?''Lino Hamani wakalibuzya mumoyo wakwe kuti, ''Ngwani mwami ngwakonzya kubotelelwa akulemeka kwinda ndime?''
Hamani wakambila mwami, ''Kumuntu mwami ngwabotelelwa akulemeka,
kazyetwe zisamo zyabwami, zisamo ezyo mwami nzyakasamide, abbiza elyo mwami ndyakagede amusini wabwami kumutwe walyo.

Mpawo zisamo abbiza zipegwe silutwe mwami ngwayandisya. Azizwate zisamo muntu mwami ngwakondelwa akulemeka, alimwi akube basikumutobela kali atala abbiza kwinda mumugwagwa wamudolopo. Kube basikumompolweda, 'Ezi nzyachitilwa oyo mwami ngwakondelwa akulemeka !''
Mpawo mwami wakambila Hamani kuti, ''Fwambana bweza zizwato abbiza, mbuli mbwawamba, akuchitila Modekkayi mu Juda ukkala amulyango wamwami. Kutabi mpokachilwa pe kutwambo toonse ntuwamba.''
Mpawo Hamani wakabweza chisamo abbiza. Wakazizwatika Modekkayi akumwinzya mumugwagwa yamudolopo. Wakoompolola kusule lyakwe, Eezi nzyachitilwa muntu ngwakondelwa mwami akulemeka!''
Modekkayi wakabweeda kumulyango wa mwami. Pesi Hamani wakafwambanina kung'anda yakwe kayabukwila, amutwe wakwe kavumbidwe.

Hamani wakambila banakwe Zelesi abenzinyina boonse zyakachitika atala anguwe. Mpawo balumi bakwe bakazibinkene abusongo kuli nguwe, ''Kuti Modekkayi, kunembo lyakwe ngotalikuwa, mu Juda, takoyo muzunda pe, pesi uyowa kunembo lyakwe.''
Nibakachili kwambula anguwe, babeleki bang'anda bakasika. Bakafwambana kutola Hamani kupobwe elyo ndyakabambide Esita.
Aboobo mwami antomwe a Hamani bakayinka kupobwe antomwe a Esita namalelo.

Muli eli zuba lyachibili, chindi nibakali kupegwa wayini, mwami wakambila Esita kuti, ''Ninzi nchokumbila, Namalelo Esita? Chiyopegwa kuli nduwe. Niinzi chikumbilo chako? Mane kuyosika kuchibela chabwami, alimwi chiyopegwa.''

Mpawo Namalelo Esita wakasandula, ''Na nkijene choolwe kumenso aako, mwami, alimwi kuti kachikubotezya, leka buumi bwangu bupegwe kuli ndime - eechi nchechikumbilo changu, alimwi ndakumbila obu lubo kubantu bangu.

Akambo twakawuzigwa, imebo abantu bangu, kuti tunyonyoonwe, kujayigwa, tukafwidilizye. Nansyo twakatolwa mubuzike luzutu, mbuli balumi abanakazi bazike, ndalikuno wumuna biyo, kupenzegwa kuli boobu nkasimpe takwepe mpokukonzya kubisizya mwami.''
Mpawo mwami Ahazwelasi wakambila Esita namalelo kuti, ''Ngwani oyoo? Ulikuli muntu oyu nkwajanika wazuzya moyo wakwe akuchita zintu zili boobo?''
Esita wakati, ''Ngusikambooma, uulya sinkondoma, nguyoyu mubi Hamani!'' Mpawo Hamani wakayowa kunembo lya mwami a namalelo.

Mwami wakanyampuka chabukali kuzwa kukunywa wayini apobwe akulya muchilili chang'anda, pesi Hamani wakachala kalokukombelezya buumi bwakwe kuli Namalelo Esita. Wakabona kuti lunyonyooko lwayeyelwa kuli nguwe a mwami.

Mpawo mwami wakaboola kuzwa kuchilili chang'anda wanjila mung'anda mulyakabede pobwe, wayini mwakabede. Hamani wakali wawida achuuno cha Esita mpakakkede. Mwami wakamba kuti, ''Ngaula wuma namalelo nkendiwo mung'anda yangu?'' Chakufwambana mbuwakamvwigwa mulandu kuzwa kumulomo wamwami, babelesi bakavumba busyu bwa Hamani.

Mpawo Habbona, umwi wabasing'anda oyo walikubelekela mwami, wakati, ''Nkochili chanzikilo kung'anda kuli Hamani bulamfu bwacho madumpwa kkumi chakabambilidwe Modekkayi, oyo wakamangala kuti akwabilile mwami. Mwami wakamba kuti, ''Mukamwanzike alinchicho.''
Elyo bakamwanzika Hamani a pulanga ndyakabambilide Modkkayi. Mpawo bukali bwa mwami bwakamana.
Mubuzuba obo Mwami Ahazwelasi wakapa namalelo Esita lubono lwa Hamani, sinkondonyina wama Juda, alimwi Modekkayi wakatalika kubelekela mwami, nkambo Esita wakamwambila kuti wakali nzubowakwe.
Mwami wakagwisya nwenwe ilachidindo, eyo njakabweza kuli Hamani, akwiipa Modakkeyi. Esita wakabikka Modekkayi kuti ayendelezye lubono lwa Hamani.

Mpawo Esita wakambuula a mwami lubo. Wakavundamika busyu bwakwe alubuwa akukwila kamukombelezya kuti amaninsye mabambe mabi ngakabambide Hamani mu Agagiti, kuchiyungo echo nchakalayilila chakunyonyongania ba Juda.
Mpawo mwami wakatambikizya Esita kafunko kangolida, wakanyampuka akwiima kunembo lya mwami.

Waamba kuti, ''Ikuti kazibotezya mwami,akuti kandijene choolwe mumenso akwee, na kachilangika kuti chililuzi kunembo lya mwami, akuti kandikonda kumenso akwe, alembwe malembe akusandamuna lugwalo lwakalembwa a Hamani mwana mulombe wa Hamedata mu Agagiti, magwalo ngakalemba kukunyonyoona ba Juda abo boonse bakali muchisi cha mwami.
Nkambo inga ndilawumuna buti nkibona lunyoonyoko kaluwida bantu bangu? Inga ndilawumuna buti nkindokubona lunyonyoko kunzubo zyangu?''
Mwami Ahazwelasi wakambila Namalelo Esita a Modekkayi mu Juda, ''Langa, ndapa Esita ng'anda ya Hamani, alimwi bamwanzika epulanga lyachanzikilo, nkambo nkambo wakali kuyanda kulwanisya ma Juda.
Lemba ambi malayilile kuma Juda muzina lya mwami alimwi mudinde anweenwe yamwami. Kumalayilile alya akalembedwe kale muzina lyamwami alimwi mudinde anwenwe yamwami itakonzyi kusandulwa.''

Mpawo balembi bamwami bakayita kuli cheecho chindi, mumwezi watatu, ngomwezi utegwa Sivani, mubuzuba lyamakkumi abili amazuba atatu mumwezi. Malayilile akalembwa ngakalayilila Modekkayi bwendelezi bwendelene ama Juda. Akalembwa kubendelezi bazisi, baleli ababambi bang'anda zyazisi ezyo zyakayakidwe kuzwa ku Indiya kusika ku Kkushi, 127 zisi, kuzisi bakalembelwa mubulembo bwabo, akubantu boonse kumilaka yabo, akuba Juda mubulembo bwabo amwambo wabo.

Modekkayi wakalemba muzina lya Mwami Ahazwelasi akudinda anweenwe ilachidindo chamwami. Wakatumina lugwalo kubatumwa bagede mabbiza, ankondo ngakali kubelesya mwami, mabbiza akazyedwe mukkuti lya mwami.

Mwami wakapa ba Juda bakali mumadolopo woonse kuti babungane antomwe akulivuna mawumi aabo: kulunyonyooko, kujaya, akumwaya basilumamba kufumbwa kuli muntu nikuba zisi ezyo zinga zila balwisya, bana abanakazi abalabo, nikuba kusaala mbono zyabo.
Ezi nzizyakeelede kuzuzikizigwa muzisi zya Mwami Ahazwelasi, muzuba lyakkumi mwatatu lyamwezi wakkumi ayibili, ngomwezi utegwa Ada.
Majwi akulayilila ayelede akutondezya antanganana kubantu boonse. Ba Juda bakelede kuli bambila eelyo zuba kuti babwedezye basinkondonyina.
Eelyo basimposo bakagada mabbiza a mwami ayo ngakali kubelesya mwami mumilimu yakwe mwami. Bakayinka chakufwambana. Kulayilila kwamwami kwakaambwa mu Susa mumunzi wa mwami.

Mpawo Modekkayi wakazwa kunembo lyamwami kazwete zikobela zyabwami zyasyamuteme, azituba antomwe amusyini mupati wangolida azikobela zyadowa lyankusu lyamalembo aluleme aboobo dolopo lya Susa lyakoompolola  akubotelwa.
Ba Juda bakaba amuumuni akubotelwa, alukondo abulemu.

Muzisi zyoonse amumadolopo woonse, konse konse ijwi lya mwami amalayilile akwe woonse akasika, kwakaba kukondwa akubotelwa akati kaba Juda, apobwe azuba lyalwangunuko. Bayingi kuzwa kumisyobo myiingi yabantu bamunyika bakaba ba Juda, nkambo kuyowegwa kwakali kwabawida lwabo.

Lino mumwezi wakkumi ayibili, ngumwezi utegwa Ada, muzuba lyamakkumi atatu, eelyo mulawu wamwami amalayilile nakelede kuchitwa, muzuba basinkondonyina aba Juda nibakali kuyeyela kubazunda, zyakababolela. Ba Juda bakazunda boonse bakabasulide.

Ba Juda bakabungana muma dolopo abo akwindilila kuzisi zyamwami Ahazwelasi, kuti batanmdabike maboko kuli baabo bakeezya kweeta lunyonyooko kuli mbabo. Tawope ukonzya kwiminana abo, nkambo kyosya kwabo kwakawida atala abantu bonse.
Boonse basilutwe bazisi, abendelezi bazisi, abaleli, ababo bakajisi milimo yamwami, bakagwasya ba Juda nkambo kuyowegwa kwa Modekkayi kwakabawida.
Nkambo Modekkayi wakali mupati mung'anda ya mwami, akuzibinkana kwakwe kwakendelela muzisi zyoonse, nkambo mwalumi Modekkayi wakali waba mupati.
Aboobo ba Juda bakalwana aba sinkondonyina, akuchita mbubayanda kuli mbabo bakabasulide.
Mukuli simya kwamu Susa kwalo kwaba Juda bakajaya bantu bali myaanda ilimusanu.
Bakajaya Pasyadata, Dalufoni, Asipata,
Polata, Adaliya, Alidata,
Pamasita, Alisayi, Alidayi, Valizata,
alimwi akkumi lyabana balombe ba Hamani ma=wana mulombe wa Hamedata, sinkondonyina waba Juda. Pesi takwepe nchibakatola anguzu pe.
Eelyo zuba mweelwe wabakajayigwa mukulwana kwamu Susa, kwakaambwa kumwami.

Mwami wakambila Esita namalelo, ''Ba Juda bakajaya myaanda musanu mukulwana kwamu Susa kubikkilizya antomwe abana balombe balikkumi ba Hamani. Niinzi alimwi nchomuyanda? Myozipegwa. Niinzi nchokumbila? Uyochipegwa.''
Esita wakati, ''Kuti kachimubotela lubo mwami , leka ba Juda bali mu Susa bazumizigwe malayilile achitwa sunu achitwe junza alimwi mibili yabana ba Hamani balombe balikkumi bakanzikwe achanzikilo.''
Elyo mwami wakalayilila kuti echi chichitwe. Malayilile akachitwa mu Susa, alimwi bakaanzika bana balombe balikkumi ba Hamani.
Elyo ba Juda bakali mu Susa bakabungana antomwe muzuba lyakkumi aane lyamwezi wa Ada, akujaya bantu balimyanda yotatwe lubo mu Susa, pesi tebaka tandabika maboko pe kukusala imbono.

Bamwi ba Juda bakali muchisi chamwami bakabungania kuti bakwabilile mawumi aabo, alimwi bakabwedezya basinkondonyina akujaya zyuulu zyakali makkumi osanwe mwabili amusanu wababo bakabasulide, pesi tebakatandabika maboko pe kumbono zyababo mbibakajaya.
Ezi zyakachitika mubuzuba bwamakkumi otatwe mumwezi wa Ada. Amubuzuba bwakkumi mwane bakalyokezya kabachita buzuba obo kuba bwakupobola akukondwa.
Pesi ba Juda bakali mu Susa bakabungana antomwe muli bwakkumi mwatatu amuli bwekkumi aane. Muzuba lyakkumi amusanu bakalyokwezya akuchitila zuba lyapobwe akubotelwa.

Nkinkakako ba Juda bamutunzi, bakayaka myunzi yabo mudolopo tuli mumyunzi, bakachiyta izuba lyakkumi aane lyamwezi wa Ada mbuli izuba lyakukondwa akupobola, azuba elyo ndibatumizyania zipo zyakulya kuli umwi awumwi.
Modekkayi wakalemba ansi zintu ezi akutumizya lugwalo kuba Juda boonse bakali muzisi zyoonse zyamwami Ahazwelasi, antomwe afwifwi akule,
Kubalaya kuti kababamba zuba lyakkumi aane alya kkumi amusanu zuba lyamwezi wa Ada munyaka amunyaka.

Aya ngemazuba ba Juda nibakafutuka kuli basinkondonyina, amwezi elyo kuusa nikwakasanduka kuba kubotelwa akukwila akunjila muzuba lyakusekelela. Bakali kwachita mazuba akupobola akukondwa, akutumizyania zipo zyazilyo kuli umwi awumwi, azipo kubachete.
Elyo  ba Juda bakinkilila anembo kuli nzibakatalika kukuchita, ezyo Modekkayi nzyakabalembela.

Kuli echo chindi Hamani mwana mulombe wa Hamadeta mu Agagiti, sinkondonyina waba Juda boonse, wakabambide kunyonyoona ba Juda, alimwi wakawala Puli ( kwamba kuti, wakawala nkakata), kuti abapenzye akubanyonyoona.

Pesi elyo makani nakasika kunembo amwami, wakalayilila alugwalo kuti mabambe mabi Hamani ngakali wazwidilizya akulwania ba Juda ayelede abole atala amutwe wakwe, alimwi lwakwe abana bakwe balombe belede kwanzikwa achanzikilo chamapulanga.
Aboobo bakanzika mazuba ayo kuti pulimu, kusule azina lyapuli. Nkambo kakuti zyoonse zyakalembedwe mulugwalo olu, azyonse ezyo nzibakabona azezyo zyakabachitikila,
ba Juda bakazimina chiyanza chenzu akuchichita. Chiyanza chinoli chabo beni, alunyungu lwabo, ababo bakaswanana abo. Kuyoba kuti kabasekelela aya mazuba munyaka amunyaka.

Aya mazuba akelede kuyeyegwa akusekelela mumazyalani wonse, zyoonse mpuli, a pulimu takelede kukachila pe. Kuzwa akkati kama Juda, alimwi luyeeyo lwangawo lutakamani kulunyungu, mpuli imwi ayimwi, zisi zyoonse, alimwi dolopo adolopo. Aba ba Juda antomwe abalunyungu lwabo tabelede kuyoleka kutobelezya chakusyomekana kuyeya mazuba aya a Pulimu, kuchitila kuti batakalubi.
Namalelo Esita mwana musimbi Abbihayili a Modekkayi mu Juda wakalemba anguzu zyabwami kayimika lugwalo olu lwabili lwa pulimu.
Lugwalo lwakatumizigwa kuba Juda boonse muzisi zili mwaanda amakkumi obile alamusanu azibili zyamuzisi zyabwami, kayeyela majwi aalumuno akasimpe.

Aya magwalo akali kwamba mazuba a pulimu muzyiindi zyawo zitondekedwe mbuli Modekkayi mu Juda a Namalelo Esita mbwakasungilizya ma Juda. Ba Juda bakazumina kusungilizigwa kwabo alunyungu lwabo, aboobo bakazuminana zyiindi zyakulyiimya kulya akuusa.
Malayilile a Esita atondezya milawu iyendelana Aa pulimu, alimwi akalembwa mumabbuku.
Mwami Ahazwelasi wakabikka mulawu wakutelesya munyika alimwi amutusuwa twamulwizi.
Konse kuzwidilila kwanguzu zyakwe abupati, antomwe abupanduluzi buzwide bwabupati bwabwendelezi bwa Modekkayi oko mwami nkwakamusumpwida, zililembedwe mubbuku lyamakani abaami baku Mediya aku Peziya.

Modekkayi mu Juda wakali wachibili kuzyuno zyabwami bwa Ahazwelasi. Wakali mupati akkati kaba Juda akuyandwa loko kubakkulana bakwe biingi ba Juda, nkambo buponi bwabantu bakwe akwambula lumuno lwabantu bakwe boonse.
Aya ngawo mazina abaana balombe ba Izilayeli bakaza a Jakobo mu Ijipita, aawumwi ang'anda yakwe:
Lubbeni, Simiyoni, Levi a Juda,
Isakka, Zebbuloni, a Bbenjamini.
Dani, Nafitali, Gadi a Aasha.
Boonse bantu aabo bakali lunyuungu lwa Jakobo bakali makumi musanu aabili mumwelwe. Jozefu wakali waaba mu Ijipita kale.
Mpawo Jozefu, bakkulana bakwe boonse, aalyoonse izyalane bakafwa.
Ba Izilayeli bakazyalisya bakavulisya loko mumweelwe, alimwi bakaba enguzu loko; Inyika yakazwide mbaabo.
Lino mpawo kwakabuka mwami mupya mu Ijipita, ooyo wakatazi pe aatala a Josefa.
Wakati kubantu bakwe, ''Mubone, ba Izilayeli bavuzyania alimwi balenguzu kwinda ndiswe.
Muboole tulangane aabo chabusongo, ambweni balinkilila akuyabuvula mumwelwe wabo, mpawo kuti inkondo yabuka, bayogwasyania abasinkondoma, akulwana andiswe, alimwi akuyoosiya nyika.''
Eelyo bakabika basikubabikkila basikubalanga kuti babapenzye amilimu milemu. Ba Izilayeli bakayakila Falo zimumbwa: Pitomu a Lamisese.
Pesi ba Ijipita bakayinkilila aanembo akubapenzya, abalabo ba Izilayeli nibakavulisya mumwelwe bakasaalila. Eelyo ba Ijipita bakatalika kubayoowa.
Ba Ijipita bakachita kuti ba Izilayeli babelesegwe achalunya.
Bakachita kuti buumi bwabo buyume amilimu miyumu yabulongo bwezitina, ayoonse misyobo yamilimu yamumyunda. Milimu yoonse njibakayelede kuchita yakali miyumu.
Mpawo mwami wa Ijipita wakaambula abasikutumbusya ba Hibbulu; izina lyawumwi wabo wakali Syifula alimwi umwi wabo wakali Puuwa.
Wakati, ''Kuchiindi nimugwasizy banakazi ba Hibbulu achuno chakutumbuka, mulange kuchindi nibatumbuka. Kuti kali mulombe, mpawo mwelede kumujaya.''
Pesi kuti kaali musimbi, welede kupona.  Pesi basikutumbusya bakayoowa Leza alimwi tebakachita mbuli mwami wa Ijipita mbwakalayilila; kwinda kuti, bana balombe bapone.
Mwami wa Ijipita wakiita basikutumbusya akwaamba kuti kuli mbabo, 'Nkambonzi nimwachita eechi, alimwi mwaleka bana balombe balikupona?'' Basikutumbusya bakasandula Falo,
''Banakazi bachi Hebbulu tabali mbuli ba Ijipita pe, balenguzu alimwi balafwambana kukutumbuka sikutumbusya katana kusika kulimbabo.''
Leza wakabakwabilila aba bantu mbusi. Bantu bakavuzyania mumweelwe akuuba anguzu loko.
Nkambo kakuti, basikutumbusya bakali kuyoowa Leza, wakabapa mpuli.
Falo wakalayilila boonse bantu bakwe, ''Mwelede kuwala woonse mwana mulombe mumulonga, pesi woonse mwana musimbi mumuleke akapone.
Linomwaalumi wa mukowa wa Levi wakakwata mwanakazi mu Levi.
Mwanakazi wakaminta alimwi wakatumbuka mwana mulombe. Naakabona kuti mwana mulombe uuzyalikene kabotu, wakamusisa kwa myeezi itatu.
Pesi nakatachili kukonzya ku musisa, wakabumba chisuwo cha matete akuchisinka anzuka. Mpawo wakabika mwana mukati alimwi wachibika aakati kamatete mumanzi kumbali lya mulonga.
Muchizi wakwe wakayimikila kule-kule kuti abone chitachitike kulinguwe.

Mwana musimbi wa Falo wakaza kuzoosamba ku mulonga aawo basikumulinda bakali kuyoobweenda kabatobezya mulonga. Wakabona chisuwo aakati kamatete alimwi wakatuma umwi musimbi wabasikulinda kuti akachibweze.
Eelyo  nakachivununa, wakabona mwana. Langa mwana wakali kulila. Wakamufwida luzyalo alimwi wakati, ''Ooyu nkasimpe ngumwi mwana wa ba Hebbulu.''
Mpawo muchizi wa mwana wakati kumwana musimbi wa Falo, ''Ndiinke na alimwi nkakuyandwiide mwanakazi mu Hebbulu sikukulelela mwana?''
Mwana musimbi wa Falo wakati kulinguwe, ''Koya.'' Aboobo mwana musimbi muniini wakayinka alimwi wakweeta banyina ba mwana.
Mwana musimbi wa Falo wakati kulibanyina bamwana, '''Bweza mwana ooyu alimwi umulele, alimwi nzokubbadala mufolo wako.'' Aboobo mwanakazi wakabweza mwana alimwi wakumulela.
Eelyo mwana nakakomena, wakamweeta kumwana musimbi wa Falo, alimwi wakaba mwana mulombe wakwe. Wakamuuzika kuti ngu Mozesi alimwi wakati, ''Nkaambo ndakamugwisya mumanzi.''
Ewlyo Mozesi nakali wakomena, wakayinka kubantu bakuli mbabo akulanga milimu yabo miyumu. Wakabona umwi waku Ijipiti kali kuuma mu Hebbulu, umwi wabantu bakwe mwini.
Wakalanga kunzila eeyi ayilya, alimwi nakabona kuti takwe wakaliwo pe, wakajaya mu Ijipiti akusisa mubili wakwe mumuseele.
Wakabweda lubo buzuba butobela alimwi wakabona ba Hebbulu babili kabalookulwana. Wakati kuluumwi wakabisizye, ''Nkaambonzi nulookuchisa mweenzinyokwe?''

Pesi mwaalumi wakati, ''Ngwani wakuchita kuti ube muzuluzi a kuba mubetesi aatala andiswe? Ulokubamba kundijaya na mbuli mbuwakajaya uulya mu Ijipiti?'' Mpawo Mozesi wakayowa  alimwi wakati, ''Eecho nchindakachita nchobeni chakazibinkana kuli bamwi.''
Lino Falo nakamvwa aatala acheechi, wakeezya kujaya Mozesi. Pesi Mozesi wakachija kuzwa kuli Falo akuyookkala munyika ya Midiyeni. Ooko wakakkede kumbali lya chikala.
Lino mupayizi wa Midiyeni wakali aabana basimbi bali  musanu ababili. Bakaza, bateka manzi, alimwi bazuzya zinywido kuti banywisye lutanga lwa wisi.
Beembeli bakasika akweezya kubatanda, pesi Mozesi wakayinka alimwi wabagwasya. Mpawo wakanywisya lutanga lwabo.
Eelyo basimbi nibakabweeda kuli Lewuli wisi wabo, wakati, ''Nkaambonzi nimwafwambaana kusika kumunzi sunu?''
Bakati, ''Mu Ijipita watuvuna ku beembeli. Alubo watutekela manzi alimwi wanywisya lutanga.''
Wakati kubana bakwe basimbi, ''Ani uli kuli? Mwamusiilaanzi? Mumwiite kuti akonzye kulya andiswe.''
Mozesi wakazumina kukkala amwaalumi, ooyo wakamupa mwana wakwe musimbi Zipola kuti amukwate.
Wakazyala mwana mulombe, alimwi Mozesi wakati zina lyakwe ngu Gesyomu; wakati, ''Ndakalikkede munyika yabwenzu njesizi.''
Musule lya chiindi chilamfu, mwaami wa Ijipiti wakafwa. Ba Izilayeli bakatongawuka akaambo kamulimu wabuzike. Bakalilila lugwasyo, alimwi kukwiila kwabo kwakasika kuli Leza akaambo kabuzike bwabo.
Eelyo Leza nakamvwa kulila kwabo, Leza wakayeya chizuminano chakwe a Abbulahamu, a Ayizeki alimwi a Jakkobbu.
Leza wakabona ba Izilayeli alimwi wakamvwisisisya chiimo chabo.
Lino Mozesi wakachilikwembela tanga lyambelele lya Jetulo wisizyala, mupayizi waku Midiyani. Mozesi wakabinga tanga lyambelele kule kubbazu lyakunkanda akusika ku-Holebbu, kuchilundu cha Leza.
Ooko mungelo wa Jehova nkwakalibonia kulinguwe mumabangabanga amulilo mulusaka. Mozesi wakalangisisya, mpawo, chiteyo chakali kuyaka, pesi chiteyo techakali kupya pe.
Mozesi wakati, ''Ndazyunguluka kumbali mbone chintu chigambya, nkamboyi chiteyo nichitalokupya.''
Eelyo Jehova nakabona kuti wakazyungulukila kumbali kuti abone, Leza wakamwita kuzwa muchiteyo kuti, ''Mozesi, Mozesi. ''Mozsi wakati, ''Mpaano mpumbede.''
Leza wakati, ''Utaazi afwifwi ! Gusya insangu zyako kumawulu, ibusena mpobede mpoyimvwi ninyika ibambilidwe ndime.''
Wakayungizya kuti, ''Ndime Leza wawuso, Leza wa Abbulahamu, Leza wa Izaka, a Leza wa Jakobo.'' Mpawo Mozesi wakalivumba kumenso, mbubonya mbwakayowede kulanga Leza.
Jehova wakati, ''Ndibwene loko mapenzi abantu bangu bali mu Ijiputi. Ndimvwide loko kompolola kwabo nkambo kababo bababelesya, mbuli mbunzi machise aabo.

Ndaza aansi kuzobaangununa kuzwa kumanguzu aba Ijiputi nguunzi akubagwisya kunyika eeyi kuya kunyika mbotu, mpati, kunyika iyenda malili, abuchi; dokulubbazu lwa Kkenani, ba-Hititi, Amolayiti, Pelezitisi, aba Jebbusayiti.
Lino kompolola kwabantu ba Izilayeli kwasikila kulindime. Mukuyungizya, ndabona mafwabi akachitwa aba Ijiputi.
Lino mpawo, ndakutuma kuli Falo kuti ukabone bantu bangu, ba Izilayeli, kuzwa mu Ijiputi.''
Pesi Mozesi wakati kuli Leza, ''Ndimeni mebo, unga ulakonzya kuya kuli Falo akuyobozya bana ba Izilayeli kuzwa ku ijiputi?''
Leza wakamusandula, ''nchobeni ndayebo. Eechi chiyoba chitondezyo kuli nduwe kuti ndime ndakakutuma. Niwayobagwisya bantu kuzwa ku Ijiputi, muzondikomba muchilundu eechi.''
Mozesi wakati kuli Leza, ''Ndayoyinka kuba Izilayeli akubambila kuti ngu Leza wandituma kuli ndinywe; ani bayondambila kuti, ''Ngwani izina lyakwe?'' Njobambila kutyeni?''
Leza wakati kuli Mozesi, ''NDIME NGU NDIME.''  Leza wakati lubo kuli Mozesi, ''Uyelede kwamba kuti kuma Izilayeli, ''NDIME nguwe nguwandituma kulindinywe.''

Leza wakati lubo kuli Mozesi, ''Uyelede kwambila ba Izilayeli, Jehova, Leza wabamawuso, Leza wa Abbulahamu, Leza wa Ayizeki, a Leza wa Jakobo, wandituma kulindinywe. Eeli ndizina lyangu mpaka kukabe kutamani, oobu mbubo mbuntakayeyegwe kumazyalane oonse.

Ýinka ukabunganie bazululi ba Izilayeli antomwe. Ukabambile kuti,  'Jehova, Leza wabamawuso, Leza wa Abbulahamu, awaba Ayizeki, awa Jakobo, waliyubununa kulindime akuti, 'Ninchobeni ndakamulangisisya alimwi ndakabona nchakachita kuli ndinywe mu Ijiputi.
Ndakasyomezya kumugwisya mumakatazyo mu Ijiputi kuyosika munyika yaba Kkenani, Hititi, Amoli, Pelizayiti, Hivayiti antomwe aba Jebbusayiti, nyika iyenda malili abuuchi.''

Bayoswilizya nduwe. Iwebo abaalu ba Izilayeli munyika kumwami wa Ijiputi, uyelede kuyomwambila Jehova, Leza waba Hebbulayo, waswanana andiswe lino atwende mazuba otatwe'' alwendo kuyosika munkanda, kukulipeda kuli Jehova, Leza wesu.'
Pesi ndizi kuti mwami wa Ijiputi takoyokuzumizya dokuboko kwakwe kukaangilwe.
Ndiyotandabika kuboko kwangu akubalwisya ba Ijiputi, amalele nginchita akati kabo. Kuzwawo, uyokuzumizya kwinka.
Njobaapa aaba bantu luzyalo kuzwa kuba Ijiputi aabobo eelyo, nimwayoyenda, mutakeendi kamutakwe nchimujisi - mumaboko.

Woonse mwanakazi akakumbile nsiliva a ngolide azyakuzwata kuli Ijiputi aba simayakilane akufumbwa mwanakazi ngwakkala aawe aang'anda. Muyobikka kubanabenu balombe abasimbi. Munzila eyi muyozunda ba Ijiputi.''
Mozesi wakasandula, ''Ani kuti nibatayondisyoma nikuba kundiswilila akwamba kuti, "Yawe tana kuliyubununa pe kulinduwe?
Yawe wakamwambila kuti, '"Ninzi eecho chili mujanza lyako? Mozesi wakamba kuti, "Musako".
Yawe wakati, "Waala aansi, "Mozesi wakawaala aansi, eelyo wakasanduka waba nzoka. Mozesi wakachija chibundasule.
Yawe wakambila Mozesi kuti, "Taandabika janza lyako wiijate kumuchila". Eelyo wakatandabika janza akwijata . Nzoka yakasanduka yaba musako lubo mujanza lyakwe.
Eechi chiyoba chitondezyo chiyochita kuti basyome kuti Yawe, Leza wabamataata, Leza wa Abbulamu, Leza wa Isaaki a Leza wa Jakobe, walibonia kuli nduwe.

Aluubo Yawe wakamwambila kuti, "Lino bika janza lyaako mukati kachikobela chako". Aboobo Mozesi wakabika janza lyakwe mukati kachikobela chakwe, awoo nakagwisya, kuboko kwakwe kwakali kwaba achipele chituba buu mbuli nyengenge.
Yawe wakati bika kuboko kwako lubo". Eelyo Mozesi wakabika lubo muchikobela chakwe, awo nakakugwisya, wakabona kwapona lubo, mbuli mubili woonse.
Yawe wakamba kuti, "Kuti tebakusyoma - Na tebakuswilila kuchitondezyo chakusanguna changuzu zyangu nikuba kusyoma kuli nchicho, aboobo bayosyoma chitondezyo chabili.
Naa kuti tebakusyama kuzitondezyo zibili zyanguzu zyangu, nikuba kukuswilila, mpawo ukateke manzi amumulonga akwatila atala anyika njumu . Manzi ngutakateke ayoba mbuli bulowa aanyika njumu.

Mpawo Mozesi wakambila Yawe, "kuti mwami nsikonzyi pe kwambula kabotu, nikuba kuzyindi zyakinda nakuba kuchindi nchemwambula amulanda wanu. Ndila bebezya alimwi lulimi lulakankam". Yawe wakati kuli nguwe,

Ngwani wakalenga mulomo wamuntu? Ngwani wakachita muntu kuti kawambula nikuba kuti tawambuli na kuboona na kuba moofu. Teensi ndime na ndi Yawe?
