Mpawo Yawe wakanyemena Mozesi. Wakati, ulibuti Aaloni, mukulana wako mulevi? Ndizi kuti uwambula kabotu. Aboobo uyobuza kuzoswanana aayebo, alimwi nakubona, uyobotelwa mumoyo wakwe.
Uyomwambila alimwi uyomubika mabala akwamba mumulomo wakwe. Ndiyoba amulomo wako antomwe aamulomo wako, aboobo njomutondezya antomwe mbumuyochita.
Uyokwambwida abantu. Uyobasimulomo wako, alimwi uuyobanga kulinguwe ndime, ndi Leza.
Uyobweza musako ooyu mujanza lyako. Anguwo uyochita zitondezyo".
Eelyo Mozesi wakabweda kuli wisizyala Jetulo, "Ndileke    ndibwede kunzubo zyangu zili ku Egepita akuyobabona kuti bachipona na". Jetulo wakambila Mozesi kuti, "koyinka mulumuno!
Yawee wakambila Mozesi mu Midiyana, "Yinka, bweeda ku Egipita nkambo baalumi boonse bakasitole buumi bwako tabachiwope bakafwa".
Mozesi wakabweza bakayintu bakwe abana bakwe balombe wababika aadonki. wakabweda kunyika ya Egipita akubweza musako wa Leza mujanza lyakwe.

Yawee wakati kuli Mozesi, "nwabweda ku Egipita ukachite zitondezyo kunembo lya Falo zyoonse zigambyo ezyo nzindabikka mugunzi lyako. Pesi ndiyoyumya moyo wakwe, aboobo takayoleka bantu kuti biinke pe.
Uyelede kubambila kuti Falo, ''Mbubobu mbwamba Jehova: Izilayeli mwana wangu, mwana wakusanguna,
aboobu ndamba obu kuli nduwe, '''Leka mwana wangu mulombe, kuti andikombe''. Pesi mbwakaka kuti ayende, ndiyeleya bana bako, bana batanzi.''
Lino mukati kalweendo, nibakayimikila kwabusiku, Leza wakaswanana aMozesi akuyanda kweezya kumujaya.
Mpawo Zipola wakabweza kafulo kwbwe jumu libosya akuyanda akumupalula mwana wakwe mulombe akujaya kumawulu akwe. Mpwo wakamba kuti, ''''Nkasimpe uli asibwiinga kuli ndime mubwindila mubulowa.''
Lino Jehova wakamuleka alikke. Wakati, ''Nduwe sibwiinga wamubulowa'' Nkambo kabupalule.
Jehova wakambila Aaloni ''kuyinka munkanda akuswanana a Mozesi.'' Aaloni wakayinka, waswanana awe muchilundu chaLeza, alimwi wakamumyonta.
Mozesi wakambila Aaloni majwi a Jehova kuti Leza wamutuma akwamba zyoonse zitondezyo zya Jehova anguzu nzyakamulayilila kuti azichite.
Mpawo Mozesi a Aaloni bakayinka akubungania boonse bapati bamu Isilayeli.
Aaloni wakambula majwi woonse Jehova ngakambide kuli Mozesi. Alimwi wakatondezya zitondezyo anguzu kunembo lyabantu.
Bantu bakasyoma. Nibakamvwa kuti Jehova wayeya Izilayeli akuti wamvwa akubona kupenzegwa, mpawo bakakotama ansi akumukomba.

Musule akuchitika kwazintu ezi, Mozesi a Aaloni bakayinka kuli Falo bakuti, ''Nzeezi Yawe, Leza wa Izilayeli, nzyawamba: 'Leka bantu bangu bayinke, kuchitila kuti bakabe pobwe lykusekelela ndime munkanda.''
Falo wakati, ''Ngwani Yawe? Nkambonzi ninjelede kuswilila kujwi lyakwe alimwi kuti ndileke ba Izilayeli kuti bayende?  Nsimuzi Yawe; aboobo, nsikoyoleka Izilayeli ayende.''
Bakati, ''Leza waba Hibbulu waswanana andiswe leka twende lwendo lwamazuba atatu munkanda akupayilila kuli Yawe Leza wesu kuchitila kuti atatuumyi amalwazi a panga.''
Pesi mwami wa Ijipita wakati kuli mbabo, ''Mozesi a Aaloni, nkambonzi nimulikugwisya bantu amulimo wabo? Amubwede kumulimu wanu.''
Wakati alimwi, ''Kwaba bantu biingi lino munyika yesu, alimwi mulokubalesya milimu yabo.''
Muzuba ndilelyo, Falo wakapa malayilile kubendelezi akuli basikubabelesya. Wakati,
''Kutali mbuli kusanguna, tuchiyelede kupa bantu bwizu limbi kuti bawume zitina. Baleke bayinke bakalyete bwizu beni.
Nikuboobo, uyelede kuyanda kuli mbabo mwelwe  ukozyania wazitina mbuli mbubali kuchita lutanzi. Utatambuli ziche, nkambo mbakandu. Nkiinkako nchibawompolola, tuleke tuyinke tukapayilile Leza wesu.
Yungizya kulema kwamulimu kubantu kuchitila kuti bawubambe akutachinoswilila makani akubeja.''
Eelyo bapati ababelesyi babantu bakayinka bakwambila bantu bati, ''Nzeezi Falo nzyawamba: Nsichikamupi limbi bwizu.''
Nywe lwanu mulelede kwinka akulijanina bwizu nkomukonzya kubujana, pesi kulema kwamulimu wenu takukowubisigwa pe.''
Eelyo bantu bakamwayika munyika yonse ya Ijipita kukuyandula zisiko-siko zyabwizu.
Basikubabelesya bakabasungwazya akuti, ''Mumaninsye milimu yenu, mbuli kuti bwizu bwapegwa kulindinywe.''

Basimulimu ba Falo bakawuma basikubabelesya baba Izilayeli, abo bantu mbibakabikkide kuti babe bapati babasimulimo. Bapati bamulimu bakaliswini kubabuzya kuti, ''Nkambonzi nimwatagwisya zitina  zyonse  nzimwambilwa, nikuba jilo kana sunu, mbuli mbumwalikuchita lutaanzi?''
Elyo basikubabelesya ba Izilayeli bakeza kuli Falo akulila kulinguwe. Bakati, nkambonzi nujata balanda bako enzila ilibobu?
Takuchikwe  bwizu buchipegwa kubalanda bako alimbi, pesi bachitwambila: mupange zitina! 'Swebo, tubalanda bako, tulikumvwa nikuba lino,
Pesi Falo wakati, ''Mulibakandu ! Mulibakandu ! Mulati, 'tuzumizye tuye tukapayile kuli Yawe.
Eelyo lino mubwede kumulimu. Takuchikwe bwizu buyopegwa kulindinywe, pesi muyelede kuchinochita mwelwe ukozyania wazitina.''
Basikubabelesya bana ba Izilayeli bakabona kuti bakali mumapenzi nibakabuzigwa, ''Tamuyelede kuchesya mwelwe walubbe wezitina.
Bakaswanana a Mozesi a Aaloni, bakayimvwi aanze ang'anda yamwami, bakalizwide kuzwa kuli Falo.
Bakati kuli Mozesi a Aloni, ''Yawe alange kuli ndinywe akumupenzya, nkambo mwatuchita chisampawuzyo mumeso a Falo abalanda bakwe, mwabikka ipanga mujanza lyabo kuti batujaye.''
Mozesi wakabwedakuli Yawe akuti, ''Mwami, nkambonzi mwetela mapenzi kubantu aaba? Nkambonzi niwakandituma lutanzi?
Kuzwa kuchindi chindaza kuli Falo akwambula awe muzina lyako, wachita mapenzi kubantu aba, alimwi takwe aniwangununa bantu bako abunini.''

Eelyo Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, '' Lino uyoobona  nzinjohita kuli Falo. Uyochibona echi, nkambo uyoobaleka kuti beende akambo kajanza lyangu jumu. Akaambo kajanza lyangu jumu, akambo kajaanza lyaangu jumu uyoobenzya kuzwa kunyika yakwe.''
Leza wakaambula kuli Mozesi kulinguwe, '' Ndime Jehova.
Ndakalibonia kuli Abbulahamu, kuli Ayizekki, mpawo akuli Jakkobbu mbuuli Leza singuzu zyoonse; pesi akambo kazina lyangu, Jehova, Tendakazibikene kuli mbabo.
Alimwi ndakabamba chizuminano changu ambabo, kuchitila kuti ndibape nyika ya kkenani, Nyika njibakkala mbuuli beenzu, nyika njibakali kukkala-kkala.
Aboobo, ndimvwide kutongela kwa Izilayeli aabo ba Igipita mbibakachitide bazike, Mpawo ndiyeeya chizuminano changu.
Nkaambo kaako, muteeci kuba Izilayeli,' Ndime Jehova njomugwisya kuzwa kubwaange  Egepita,Njoomwangununa kuzwa kumanguzu aabo. Njomuvuna akulibonia kwanguzu zyangu, mpawo anchito mpati zyalubeta.
Ndiyomuleta kulindime  mbuuli bantu ngu, mpawo njooba Leza wanu, wakamugwisya kuzwa mubwaange bwa Igipita.
Ndiyoomuyiisya munyika njindakakonkezya kuli Abbulahamu, kuli Ayizekki, mpawo kuli Jakkobbu njoopa mbuuli lukkono lwanu. Ndime Jehova .!!!
Awo Mozesi wakabuzya bana ba Izilayeli eechi , Teebakakonzya kumuswiilila akambo kakuchisa kwamyoyo yabo akambo kabuyumuyumu mbubakasweene.
Eelyo Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, kati,
''yiinka ubuzye Falo, mwami wa Igipita, kuti aleke bantu ba Izilayeli kuti bazwe munyika yakwe.''
Mozesi wakati kuli Jehova,'' kuti ba izilayeli tebakandiswilila, Nkaambonzi Falo natakandiswilile, mbuuli mbutakonzyi kwaambula oobotu?''
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi akuli Aloni. Wakabapa malayilile kuba Izilayeli akuli Falo, mwami waEgipita, agwisye ma Izilayeli kuzwa muchisi cha Egepita.
Aba basilutwe bamaanda zyabamawisi: Bana balombe ba Lubbeni, mwana mwana mutaanzi wa Izilayeli, Wakati Hanokki, Palu,Heziloni, mpawo akkani. Aaba zyakali nzubo zya Lubbeni.
Bana balombe ba Simiyoni kwakali Jamuyeli,Jamini,Ohadi,Jakkini,Zohali, mpawo shawuli mwana mulombe wa wamwanakazi mukkanana.Aba zyakali nzubo Simiyoni.

Ngaaya mazina abana balombe aalembedwe ba Leevi, aantomwe azyalani lyabo. kwakali Gelisoni, kohati,mpawo Melali. Levi wakapona kusikila waba aminyaka iili mwaanda amakkumi atatu aalaminyaka musanu ayibili.
Bana balombe ba Gelisoni kwakali libbimu mpawo a Shimeyi, mumpuli zyabo.
Bana balombe Kkolati kwakali Amulamu , Iziha, Hebbuloni a Uziyeli Kkohati wakapona munyika minyaka iili mwaanda amakkumi aatatu aminyaka iitatu.
Bana balombe ba Melali kwakali Mahili  aMushi. Aba bakaba zyalanilyaba Levi aantomwe alunyungu lwabo.
Amulamu wakakkwata Jokkebbedi, muchizi wawisi. Wakamuzyalila Alonia Mozesi, Amulamu wakapona minyaka iili mwanda amakkumi aatatu amusanu ayibili eelyo wakafwa.
Bana balombe ba Izalakwakali kkola, Nefegi, a zikkili.
Bana balombe ba Uziyeli Mishayeli, Elizafani,a Sitili.
Aloni wakakkwata Elishabba ,mwana musimbi wa Aminadabu, muchizi wa Nashoni. Wakamuzyalila Nadabu mpawo a Ahibu, Eliyeza a Hamala
Bana balombe ba Kkola kwakali Asili , Elikana a Abbiyasafu. Eezi nzizyo nzubo zyakkola.
Eliyeza, mwana wa Aloni wakakkwata uumwi wabana basimbi ba Patiyeli. Wakamuzyalila Fayinasi. Aba bakali basimitwe bangandayabawisi akati kaba Levi, mukwiindilila mumikowa wabo.
Aba balumi babili bakali Aloni a MOzesi kuli mbabo J ehova nkwakati,'' mugwisye ba Izilayeli kuzwa kunyika ya Egipita, kwiindila munkamu zyabantu bakulwana.''
Aloni a Mozesi bakawambuula a Falo, mwami wa Egepita, abazumizye kugwisya bana ba Izilayeli  kuzwa mu Egepita. Aba bakali mbabo bamwi Mozesi a Aloni.
Eelyo Jehova nakambula kuli Mozesi munyika ya Egepita ,

wakati kuli nguwe,'' Ndime Jehova. Wamba kuti kuli Falo, mwami wa Egepita, zyoonse nzitakwambile. Pesi Mozesi  wakati kuli  Jehova,'' nsikonzyi kwaambula obotu, abobo nkaambonzi Falo natakandiswilizye.''
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''bona, ndakuchita mbuli Leza kuli Falo. Aaloni mukulana wako uyoba musinsimi wako.
Uyowamba zyoonse nzindakakulayilila kuti uwambe. Aaloni mukulana wako uyowambila Falo kuti aleke bantu ba Izilayeli kuti bazwe munyika yakwe.
Pele njoyumya moyo wa Falo, alimwi ndiyobika zigambyo zyiingi, munyika ya Ijiputi.
Pele Falo takoyoswilila, aboobo ndiyobika janza lyangu ku Ijiputi akugwisya makamu aampi yangu yabanlumi, bantu bangu, bantu ba Izilayeli, kuzwa munyika ya Ijipita alubeteko lupati.
Ba Ijipita bayoziba kuti ndime Jehova nenjotandabika janza lyangu ku Ijipita akupozya bana ba Izilayeli kuzwa akati kabo.
Mozesi a Aaloni bakachita oobo; bakachita mbubonya Jehova mbwakabalayilila.
Mozesi wakali amyaka ilimakumi alimusanu atatu, alakwe Aaloni wakali amyaka ilimakumi ali musanu aatatu aminyaka itatu nibakambuula a Falo.
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi a Aaloni,
''Lino Falo aakuti kulindinywe, ''Amuchite maleele, eelyo uwambile Aaloni, bweza musako wako uwuwaale aansi kunembo lya Falo, ikuti ibe nzoka.''
Mpawo Mozesi a Aaloni bakiinka kuli Falo, elyo bakachita mbuli Jehova mbwakalayilila. Aaloni wakawaala ansi musako wakwe kunembo lya Falo akubalanda bakwe, mpawo yabanzoka.
Eelyo Falo alakwe wakayita basongo bakwe abachapi. Bakachita zikozyenie kumabiibo abo.
Umwi awumwi mwalumi wakawaala musako wakwe aansi, mpawo misako yakanzoka.
Pele musako wa Falo wakayumisigwa, eelyo takwe nakaswilila, mbuli Jehova mbwakamba.
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Moyo wa Falo wayuma, eelyo wakaka kuti bantu bayinke.
Yiinka kuli Falo chifumo akuyaanze akuya kumanzi. Yima ankomwe yamulonga uswanune anguwe, bweza mujanza musako wako wakasanduka kuba inzoka.
Umwambile kuti, ''Jehova waba Hebbulayo, wandituma kulinduwe kuti ndikwambile, 'Leka bantu bangu biinke, ikuti bakandikombe munkanda. Kusikila lino tonakuswilila.''
Jehova wamba echi: ''Acheechi uyoziba kuti ndime Jehova. Ndiyowuma manzi ali mumulonga Nayili amusako ulimujanza lyangu, elyo mulonga uyosanduka kuba bulowa.
Ibaswi abo balimumulonga bayofwa, amulonga uyonunka. Ba Ijiputi tabakoyokonzya kunywa maanzi mumulonga.''

Lino Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Ambila Aaloni, bweza musako wako uvungunune  janza lyako kumaanzi a Ijiputi,akumilonga yabo, akutulonga twabo, akumalambwa abo, akumikala yabo yoonse, kuti maanzi abo abebulowa. Chiita oobo kuti kube bulowa munyika yoonse ya Ijipita, nikuba muzibikilo zyabo zyezisamu azyamabwe.''
'Mozesi a Aaloni bakachita mbuli Jehova mbwakalayilia. Aaloni wakanyampula musako mpawo wawuma maanzi alimumulonga, kumenso a Falo abalanda bakwe. Manzi woonse mumulonga akasanduka kuba bulowa.
Abaswi bali mumulonga bakafwa, amulonga wakatalika kununka. Ba Ijipita tebakakonyza pe kuywa maanzi amumilonga ya Ijipita.
Pesi aba basimabibo ba Ijipita bakachita mbubonya abo amabibo aabo. Aboobo moyo wa Falo wakayumisigwa, eelyo wakakkaka kuswilila kuli Mozesi a Aaloni, mbuli Jehova mbwakaamba kuti ziyochitika.
Eelyo Falo wakafutumuka mpawo wayinka mung'anda  yakwe. Taakwe nakaswilila abunini kulicheechi.
Boonse ba Ijipita bakasya kumbali amulonga kuti bajane manzi akunywa, pele tebakakonzya kwajana manzi amumulonga lwawo.
Mazuba musanu aabili akayinda awo Jehova nakamana kusofwazya mulonga.
Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Mosesi, ''Yinka kuli Falo ukamwambile kuti, Jehova wamba bobu: Leka bantu bangu bayinke kuti bandikombe.
Kuti wakaka kubaleka kuti bayinke, ndapenzya nyika yako yoonse abasyachande.
Mulonga uyoyambwa abasyachande. Balazwa oko banjile munganda yako, munganda yakulala, abulo bwako. bayoyinka kubantu bako, akuzikko, amuzyaambikwa zyako.
Basyachande bayokusikila, abantu bako, abazike bako boonse.
Jehova wakambila Mosesi, "ambila Aroni ,''Tandabika janza lyako akaponda kako atala lyamulonga , atulonga, amalambwa. Kuti muzwe basyachande atala  lyadolopo lya Egipita".
Aroni wakatambika janza lyakwe atala lyamanzi a Egipita, ezyo basyachande bakazwa bazuzya dolopo lyoonse lya Egipita.
Pele basimabibo bakachita bukozyenie kumabibo abo; bakaleta basyachande atala anyika zya Egipita.
Mpawo Faro wakita baMosesi a Aroni wati, "Mukombe kuli Jehova kuti agwisye basyachande kuzwa kulindime    akubantu bangu. Elyo njobaleke bantu kuti bayinke, kuti bakapayile kuli nguwe".

Mosesi wakati kuli Faro, ''Ulijene mwenya kundambila ndilili noyanda kuti nkukombele, bazike bako, abantu bako, ikuti basyachande bakagwisigwe kuzwa kulinduwe akumaanda aako bakkale mumulonga luzutu".
Faro wakati, "Junza''. Mosesi wakati, "akube mbuli mbowamba, kuti ukazibe kuti taakwe naba omwe uli mbuli Jehova, Leza wesu.
Basyachande bayozwa kulinduwe akumaanda ako, akubazike bako, akubantu bako. Bayokkala mumulonga luzutu".
Mosesi a Aron bakazwa kuli Faro. Nkabela Mosesi wakakwilila kuli Jehova akaambo kabasyachande aabo mbakaletela Faro.
Jehova wakachita mbuli Mosesi mbwakakumbila: Basyachande bakafwa mumanda, amumabetekelo aabo amumyuunda yabo.
IBantu bakabungika antoomwe muzilwi zilwi, anyika yakanunka.
Pele Faro nakabona kuti kwaba buyoyelo, wakayumya moyo wakwe alubo takwe nakaswilila Mosesi a Aron, mbubonya Jehova mbwakaliwamba kuti ulachita.
Jehova wakati kuli Mosesi, "ambila Aroni, 'tandabika kaponda kako ume lusuko lwako lwansi, kuti lusanduke kuba mansenya muchisi choonse cha Egipita"'.
Bakachita obo. Lino Aron nakatambika janza lyakwe akaponda kakwe akuma lusuko ansi, mansenya akasika kubantu akubanyama. Loonse lusuko lwakali ansi lwakaba mansenya muchisi choonse chaEgepita.
Basimabibo bakasoleka abalo mubuchapi bwabo kuti bachite mansenya, pele tebakachikonzya. Elyo kwakaba mansenya kubantu akubanyama.
Mpawo basimabibo bakambila Faro, "Oyu munwe waLeza". Pele moyo waFaro wakayumisigwa, elyo wakakaka kubaswilila. MbuliJehova mbwakamba Faro mbwakelede kuchita.
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, "buka chifumo ukayime kunembo lya Faro anoyinka kumulonga. Umwambile kuti, 'Jehova wamba kuti: Leka bamtu bangu kuti bazwe bandikombe .

Pele kuti tewaleka bantu bangu kuti bayinke njotuma matanga amazi kulinduwe, akubazike bako, akubantu bako, akumaanda anu. Maanda aba Egepita ayozula matanga amazi, aalo ansi mpobayimvwi ayozula mazi.
Pele mubuzuba obo ndiyobamba chisi cha Gosheni bwandene, inyika bantu bangu mobakkede, kuti kutabi matanga amazi oko. Echi chiyochitwa kuti mukazibe kuti ndime Jehova mukati kanyika eezi.
Njowandanya bantu bangu abantu bako. Echi nchitondezye changuzu zyangu chiyotola busena junza"".
Jehova wakachita obo, matanga mapati amazi akasika munganda ya Faro amumaanda abazike bakwe. Amunyika zyoonse zya Egepita, inyika yanyonyoka nkambo kamatanga amazi.
Falo wakayita Mozesi a Aaloni wati, "kamuya, mukapayile Leza wenu munyika yesu."

Mozesi wakati, "tachiluleme kulindiswe kuchita oobo nkambo zipayizyo nzituchitila Jehova Leza wesu nzisesemyo kuliba Ijipita, kuti twachita zipayizyo kumeso abo ezyo zisesemya ba Ijipita, tabakoyotutulula mabwe?
Pe, ndweendo mazuba otatwe kusika munkanda kuti tuchite kuti tukapayile Jehova Leza wesu, mbuli mbwakatulayilila."
Falo wakati , ''ndamuzuminina kuti mwinke mukapayilile Jehova wenu munkanda pele mutayinki kule. Amundikombele"
Mozesi wakati, ''lino ndazwa biyo kulinduwe ndiyokomba kuliJehova kuti matanga amazi  akuleke , Falo, abazike bako abantu bako junza. Pele utatweni limbi kukutaleka bantu kuti bakapayile Jehova.
Mozesi wakazwa kuli Falo wakukomba kuli Jehova.
Jehova wakachita mbuli kukumbila kwaMozesi; elyowakagwisya matanga anzikuzwa kuliFalo, akubazike bwakwe, akubantu bakwe. Taakwe neliba lyomwe lyakasyala.
Pele Falo weakayumya moyo wakwe lubo kuchindi echi, taakwe nakabaleka bantu kuti bayinke.
Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''koya kuli Falo ukamwambile kuti; Jehova Leza wama Hibbulu, wakamba eechi: ''Muleke bantu bangu beende kuchitila kuti bakandikombe.''
Pesi na mwakaka kuti beende, na kamuchibabikide musule,
Mpawo luboko lwa Jehova luyoyeta chiyoosyo kuzivubwa zyanu zili mumunda - mabbiza, madonki, inkamela, ang'ombe ambelele.
Pesi Jehova uyoyita musiyano akati kazivuubwa zyama Izilayeli akuzivuubwa zyaku Ijipiti, kuchitila kuti takwe munyama wama Izilayeli utakafwe pe.
Jehova takachincha chindi, wakati, nijunza ninsikachite chintu echi munyika eyi.''
Jehova wakachita echi izuba litobela. Zyonse ng'ombe zyamu Ijipiti zyakafwa, pesi takwe nikuba umwi munyama wama Izilayeli wakafwa, takwe nikuba umwi munyama.
Falo nakalangisisya, alimwi, amubone, takwe nikuba umwi munyama wama Izilayeli wakafwa. Pesi moyowakwe wakali achiguni, aboobo takalekela bantu kuti beende.
Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi akuli Aaloni, ''Amubweze amuzuzye maanza anu amulota kuzwa ku Kkilini. Iwebo, Mozesi, welede kusowa mulota k ujulu mumuuya Falo kalangilizizye.
Luyoba lusuko lunante atala enyika yoonse ya Ijipiti. Buyochita busina azilonda kuti zikajaye bantu abanyama mukati kenyika yoonse ya Ijipiti.

Aboobo Mozesi a Aaloni bakabweza bakabweza mulota kuzwa ku Kkilini akwimikila kunembo lya Falo. Mpawo Mozesi wakasowa mulota mumuya. Mulota wakabachitya matumpwiza azilonda kuti zijaye bantu abanyama.
Alimwi basimabibo nibakali kukonzya kutobelezya Mozesi nkambo kamatumpwiza akala busina bwakali alimbabo akuli boonse bamwi ma Ijipita.
Jehova wayumya moyo wa Falo, aboobo Fallo takaswilizya Mozesi a Aaloni. Ezi zyakali mbuli mbakambide kuli Mozesi kuti Falo uyochita.

Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Mozsi, ''ubuke chakufwambana kuseni, uyimikile kunembo lya Falo, akwamba kuti kulinguwe, 'Jehova, Leza wama Hibbulu wamba eechi; Leka bantu bangu biinke kuchitila kuti bakandikombe.
Mbuli echi chiindi ndiyotumizya zikankamaninsya mulinduwe lwako omwini, kubalanda akubantu bako. Ndiyochita echi kuchitila kuti mukabone kuti takwe umwi ulimbuli ndime munyika yoonse.
Pesi lino ndilelede kusika  aluboko lwangu akukusoka abantu bako amalwazi alimwi muyolonzegwa kuzwa kunyika.
Pesi zyakali mukambo aka ndakamuzumizyankuti mupone: Kuchitila kuti izina lyangu likambawukwe kwindila munyika yoonse.
Uchili kulinyampuka lwako omwini akati kabantu banguakutabalekela kuti beende.
Swilizya junza atala achindi echi, ndiyoyeta ichivulamabwe chikali, eezyo zitanaboneka mu Ijipiti kuzwa izuba nizyakasanguna kusikila lino.

Mpawo lino, tuma muntu akayandule zivubwa zyanu azyonse nzemulazyo zivubwa zyenu  azyonse nzemulazyo  mumunda kubusena bulikabotu. Woonse muntu amunyama ezyo zilimumuunda alimwi tazyetedwe kumunzi - chivulamabwe chiyosika kulimbabo - alimwi bayofwa.''
Mpawo aba balanda ba Falo basyoma muli Jehova ijwi lyakasika chakufwambana kuti beete bazike baabo azivuubwa mumanda.
Pesi abo bakatabweza ijwi lya Jehova chakubosya bakasiya bazike baabo mumyuunda yabo.
Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Nyampula ijanza lyako kujulu kuchitila kuti kube chivulamabwe munyika ya Ijipiti, kubantu akubanyama, azyonse amisamu yamumyunda ya Ijipiti.
Mozesi wakasika amusako wakwe kujulu alimwi Jehova wakatuma muzuzumina, chivulamabwe atulabi aansi. Alubo wakawisya chivulamabwe munyika ya Ijipiti.
Aboobo kwakaba chivulamabwe atulabi zivwelengene. kazichisa loko, mbulikuti teyakaliwo munyika yoonse ya Ijipiti kuzwa niyakaba chisi.
Kwinda minyaka yoonse ya Ijipiti, chivulamabwe chakajaya zyoonse zyakali mumyunda, boonse bantu abanyama chakajaya woonse munsamu mumyunda akutyolola minsamu yoonse.
Kupela domunyika ya Gosheni, ma Izilayeli nkubakali kukkala, techakaliwo pe chivulamabwe.
Mpawo Falo wakatuma bantu akwambila Mozesi a Aaloni wakati kulimbabo, ''Ndabisya ichindi echi Jehova uliluleme, alimwi imebo abantu bangu tulibasizibi.
Atukombe kuli Jehova, nkambo ndiyomuleka kuti mweende, alimwi tamukoyokkala aawa limbi pe.''
Mozesi wakati kulinguwe, ''lino ndazwa mumunzi, ndiyowanzania maanza angu kuli Jehova tulabi tuyomana, alimwi takukabi limbi chivulamabwe. Munzila njiyeyi muyoziba kuti ijulu ndilya Jehova.
Pesi mbuli ndinywe akubalanda bako, ndilizi kuti tamunalemeka Jehova Leza  chanchobeni.''
Lino butonje a bbali zyakanyonyonwa, bbali yakali yalampa kusika mumatwi, atonje yakali yaba abuluba.
Pesi i wiiti a sipeliti tezyakanyonyonwa pe nkambo zyakali zilyo zinonoka.
Eelyo Mozesi nakasiya Falo a munzi, wakayanzania maanza akwe kuli Jehova, tulabi achivulamabwe zyakamana, alimwi imvula takwepe niyakasika aansi limbi.
Eelyo Falo nakabona kuti imvula, chivulamabwe atulabi zyamana, wakbisya lubo akuyumisya moyo wakwe, wakabisya lubo akuyumisya moyo wakwe, antomwe abalanda bakwe.
Imoyo wa Falo wakayuma, aboobo takaleka bantu ba Izilayeli kuti beende, mbuli Jehova mbaakambide kumanza a Mozesi.
Yahweh wakati kuli Mozesi, "Kuya kuli Falo mbulikuti ndakakumya moyo wakwe amyoyo yabalanda bakwe. Ndakachita echi kuti ndimutondezye nguzu zyangu akati kabo.

Ndakachita lubo echi kuchitila kuti muzobuzye bana banu abazukulu zintu nzindakachita, mbundakajata Ijipiti inzila iiteelede, alimwi mbundakapa zitondeezyo zisiyene-siyene zyanguzu zyangu akati kabo. Munzila eeyi muyoziba kuti ndime Yahweh.''

Aboobo Mozesi aAloni bakaya kuli Falo akuti kuli nguwe, "Jehova, Leza wama Hibbulu, wamba kuti echi: ''Kwachiindi chilamfu chilibieni nchimuyokaka kulifwiinsya kunembo lyangu? Muleke bantu bangu beende kuchitila kuti bakandikombe.
Pesi naa mwakaka kuti bantu bangu beende, swilizya, juunza ndiyoyeta nsozi mukatimkanyika yako.
Ziyovumba atala lyanyika kuchitila kuti takwe nikuba uumwai utakabone nyika. Ziyolya kufumbwa zyakachede kuchivulamabwe. Ziyolya lubo woonse musamu ukomenena munyuunda.

Ziyozuzya ng'anga yako,  eezyo zyoonse zyabalanda bako, azezyo zyoonse zyama Ijipiti - zimwi zitanabonegwa nikuba wuso nikuba abasyanyokulu, takwe nizyakabwenwe kuzwa buzuba nibakali ansi ambulisunu.''' Mpawo Mozesi wakazwa weenda kuzwa kuli Falo.
Balanda ba Falo bakati kulinguwe, "Kwachindi chilibuti mwalumi oyu nchayotupenzya? Muleke ma Isilalayiti beende kuchitila kuti bakakombe Jehova Leza wabo. Tonakuzibona na kuti Ijipita yajayigwa?''
Mozesi a Aloni bakeetwa lubo kuli Falo, wakati kulimbabo, ''Mweende mukakombe Yahweh Leza wanu. Pesi bantu bali batayoyende?''
Mozesi wakati, ''Tuyoyenda abanike nike besu abapati, abana balombe besu abasimbi. Tuyoyenda ambelele zyesu ang'ombe, mbuli kuti twelede kuchuta pobwe lyaJehova.
Falo wakati kulimbabo, ''Ikaka Jehova abe andinywe chakasimpe, naa ndamulekelelal kuti mwende abanini banu beende. Mulange mulabubi mumiyeyo.
Pepe! Mweende, kufumbwa mwalumi akati kanu, akukomba Jehova, mbulikuti ezyo nzimuyanda. '' Mpawo Mozesi aAloni bakagwisigwa kuzwa kubube bwa Falo.
Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Nyamuna luboko lwako kunyika ya Ijipiti kunsozi, kuti zinjile munyika ya Ijipito akulya musamu woonse ulimulinjiyo, zyoonse zyakasiyigwa achivulamabwe.''
Mozesi wakasisya musako wakwe kunyika ya Ijipiti, alimwi Yahweh wakeeta moya kunyika boonse buzuba oobo amansiku. Nikwakali mansiku, moya wakujwe waketa nsozi.
Nsozi zyakeenda mukati kanyika yoonse ya Ijipiti akunjila loonse lubbazu lwayo. Takwe nikwakali chikungo chansozi zilobo munyika, alimwi takwe zili boobo ziyosika munyika kuzwa ezi.

Zyakavumba nyika yoonse aboobo yakasiya. Zyakalya masamu woonse munyika amichelo yoonse yamisamu yakasiyigwa achivulamamwe.Mukati kanyika yoonse yaIjipiti, takwe musamu wakamwemvwe wakachala, nikuba umwi musamu nikuba musamu mumunda.
Mpawo Falo wakayita Mozesi a Aloni chakufwambana akuti, ''Ndakabisizya Jehova Leza wako anduwe.
Lino mpawo, ndilekelele milandu yangu kwachiindi echi, alimwi ukombe kuli Jehova Leza wako kuti abweze lufu olo kule andime.''
Aboobo Mozesi wakenda kuzwa kuli Falo akukomba kuli Jehova.
Jehova waketa guwo lisimide kuzwa kumbo eelyo lyakabweza nsozi akuzitola mulwizi lwamatete; takwe nikuba imwi nsozi yakachaala munyika ya Ijipiti.
Pesi Yahweh wakayumya moyo waFalo, alimwi Falo takalekela maIsilalayiti kuti beende.
Mpawo Yahweh wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Tambika jaanza lyako kujulu, kuchitila kuti kube mudima munyika ya Ijipiti, mudima umvwigwa.''
Mozesi wakasisya jaanza lyakwe kujulu, alimwi kwakaba mudima mupati munyika yoonse ya Ijipiti kwamazuba aatatu.
Takwe umwi wakalikubona umwi lubo;  takwe wakasiya munzi wakwe kwamazuba aatatu. Aboobo boonse ma Isilalayiti bakali a lambe kunyika nkubakali kukkala
Falo wakayita Mozesi akuti, ''Enda ukakombe Yahweh. Nikuba impuli yako yelede kweenda anduwe, pesi ng'ombe zyako ambelele zyelede kuchala.
Pesi Mozesi wakati, ''Tuzumizye kuti tuchite zipayizyo akumpa tununkilizyo kuchitila kuti tukazipedekezye kuli Yahweh Leza wesu.

Ng'ombe zyesu zilelede kweenda azilazyo andiswe, takwe nikuba butanga bwazyo bweelede kuchala musule, mbulikuti twelede kuzibweza kuti zikakombe Leza wesu. Mbulikuti tatuzi kuti mbyeni mbutwelede kukomba Yahweh kusikila tukanyampuke ooko.''
Pesi Yahweh wakayumya moyo wa Falo, alimwi taakabalekela kuti beende.
Falo wakati kuliMozesi, , ''Enda kuzwa kuli ndime! Chenjela achintu chimwi, kuti tokoyondidona lubo, mbulibuzuba notazobone busyu bwangu, uyofwa.
Mozesi wakamba, ''Iwe lwako wambula. Tandikoobona busyu bwako lubo.''
Lino Yawe wakambila Mozesi kuti, ''kuchili chuumo chimwi echo nchindiyoleta ali Falo mu Ijiputi. Kwainda eecho eecho, uuyomuleka mukeende kuzwa okuno. Lino ayomuleka kuti mukeende uyomutandila kule.
Layilila bantu aabo kuti woonse mwalumi amwanakazi kuti akumbile kulinguwe ngwayakilene aawe zintu zyensiliva azintu zyengolida.''
Lino Yawe wakachita kuti ba Ijipiti bayande kubotezya ba Izilayeli. Kwinda boobo, mwalumi Mozesi wakali kubotezya mumeso abalanda ba Falawo abantu bamu Ijipiti.
Mozesi wakati, ''Yawe waamba oobu: 'mbuli akati kamansiku ndayinda mu Ijipita.

Boonse bana batanzi munyika ya Ijipita bayoofwa, kuzwa kumwana mutanzi wa Falawo, ukkede achuuno chabwami, kuyosika kumwana mutanzi wamuzike mwanakazi ulikusule lyaziyo linokuziya, akuli boonse bana batanzi bazivuubwa.
Lino kuyoba kulila kupati munyika yoonse ya Ijipiti, kutali mbuli kwakabwenwe na kuyoba alubo.
Pesi takwe naba mubwa uyokkuwa kufumbwa kumuntu wa Izilayeli, nekuba kumuntu na munyama. Munzila njiyeyi muyoziba kuti ba Ijipiti ndilababweza munzila isiyene aba Izilayeli.
Boonse aaba bazike bako, Falawo, bayoseluka aansi kuli ndime akundivundamina. Bayowamba kuti, 'koya, webo abantu boonse bakutobela!' kusule lyayaaya ndiyozwa.'' Mpawo kuli Falawo kafundikide abukali.
Yawe wakambila Mozesi kuti, 'Falawo takokuyokuswilila pe. Nkinkaako kuti ndikachite zyiingi zigambyo munyika ya Ijipiti.''
Mozesi a Aaloni bakachita zigambyo eezi kunembo lya Falawo, pesi Yawe wakayumya moyo wa Falawo, mpawo Falawo tewakalekela bantu ba Izilayeli kuti bazwe munyika yakwe.
Yawe wakambila Mozesi a Aaloni munyika ya Ijipiti. Wakati,
''kuli ndinywe, mwezi uno uyoba matangunino yamyezi, mwezi mutaanzi wamwaka kuli ndinywe.
Wambila imbungano ya Izilayeli, 'mubuzuba bwamwezi uuno umwi awumwi ulelede kubweza kabelele na kana kampongo, imwi ayimwi mpuli ichite obo, kabelele kayimwi ayimwi ng'anda.

Na beng'anda bacheya kukabelele mwalumi ambabambene aabo beleede kubweza kabelele na inyama yakana kempongo eeyo inga ilazulila kumwelo wabantu. Yelede kuzulila kuli woonse kuti balye, aboobo belede kubweza inyama izulila boonse.
Kabelele kenu naa kana kampongo takelede kuba akampenda, kagutu kamwaaka umwi. Welede kubweza imwi yambelele na impongo.
Weleede kukabamba kusikila mubuzuba bwakkumi atune bwamwezi ooyo. Mpawo imbungano yoonse ya Izilayeli yelede kujaya banyama aaba igolezya.
Mulelede kubweza bumwi bulowa akububika aatala lyamabazu aabili amulyango aatala lyazikunguzyo zyamaanda mumuyolyida nyama.
Mwelede kulya inyama mansiku aayo, mwamana kwiyoka mumulilo. Mwiilye achinkwa chitakwe bumena, azisyu zilula.
Mutakilyi kili mbisi na kijikidwe amanzi. Kwinda boobo, mwiyoke mumulilo amutwe wayo, myeendo azyamukati.
Tamwelede kwisiya kusikila bukache. Mwelede kuumpa kufumbwa chicheede nibwacha.
Mbubobu mbumwelede kwiilya: kamulyangide muzibuno, ansangu kumawulu anu amifunko mumaboko aanu. Mwelede kulya chakufwambana. Ndipobwe lyakwindilila lya Yawe.
Yawe waamba obu: Ndiyoyinda akati kanyika ya Ijipiti busiku oobo akujaya boonse bana babantu batanzi ababanyama bali munyika ya Ijipiti. Ndiyoyeta chisubulo kuliba Leza ba Ijipiti. Ndime Yawe.
Bulowa buyoba chitondezyo amaanda aanu chakuboola kwangu kuli ndinywe. Eelyo ndabona bulowa, ndiyoyindilila kuli ndinywe nindiyolwisya nyika ya Ijipiti. Luumo olu talukoyomusikila pe akumujaya.
Buzuba oobu buyoba buzuba bwakuyeeya kuli ndinywe, mbumwelede kuyeya mbuli pobwe kuli Yawe, kwindilila kumazyalani anu, ncheezyanisyo nchimwelede kubamba mbuli pobwe kwalyoonse.

Muyolya chinkwa chitakwe bumena mumazuba alimusanu aabili. Mubuzuba butanzi muyogwisya bumena kuzwa kumaanda anu. Kufumbwa ulya chinkwa chila bumena kuzwa kubuzuba butanzi kuyosikila buzuba bwamusanu aabili, muntu oyo weelede kugwisigwa mu Izilayeli.

Mubuzuba butanzi kuyooba kubungana kusalalisya kuli ndime, mpawo mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili kuyoba kubungana kuliboobu. Takwe mulimu uyoochitwa mumazuba aaya, kunze kwakujikila boonse kuti balye. Oyu ngomulimu unga ulachitwa aandinywe.

Mwelede kulemeka ipobwe lyachinkwa chitakwe ibumena nkambo mbobuzuba obo mbundakagwisya mukwanzanisigwa kwanu munyika ya Ijipiti. Aboobo mulelede kulemeka buzuba oobu mumazyalane aanu woonse mbuli chezyanisyo kwalyoonse.
Mwelede kulya chinkwa chitakwe bumena kuzwa golezya lyabuzuba bwakkumi aane bwamwezi mutanzi wamwaaka kusikila golezya lyabuzuba bwamakkumi abili abumwi bwamwezi.

Kumazuba alimusanu aabili, takwe bumena bwelede kujanwa mumaanda anu. Kufumbwa ulya chinkwa chilabumena welede kutandwa mumunzi wa Izilayeli, nikuba kuti muntu oyo muzwakule naba muzyalwe wamunyika yenu.
Tamwelede kulya chintu chipangwa abumena. Kufumbwa nkumukkala, mwelede kulya chinkwa chitakwe bumena.''''
Mpawo Mozesi wakayita bapati boonse ba Izilayeli wabaambila kuti, ''kamuya mukasale tubelele na twana twampongo ooto tuyozulila kusanina impuli zyenu alimwi mukajaye kabelele kakwindilila.
Mpawo mukabweze mumpusa wahisopu akunika mubulowa oobo bunoli muchisambilo. Mukazile bulowa buli muchisambilo kujulu achikkunguzyo aminsende kuzwa aanze amulyango wang'anda kusikila buchee.

Nkambo Yawe uyoyinda akati akulwanya ba Ijipiti. Nayobona bulowa bwakuchikunguzyo akuminsende iibili, uyoyindilila kumilyango yanu alimwi takoyozumizya basikujaya kuti basike kumaanda enu kuti bamujaye.
Mwelede klemeka chitiko echi. Ooyu nguyoba mulawu wanu walyoonse abana banu.
Eelyo nimuyonjila munyika eeyo Yawe njayomupa mbuli mbwakasyomezya kuchita, mulelede kulemeka bukombi oobu.
Na bana banu bamubuzya kuti, bwambanzi bukombi bwamusyobo ooyu?'

mpawo mwelede kwamba kuti, wayindilila, nkambo Yawe wayindilila mumaanda aba Izilayeli bali mu Ijipiti muchindi nakali kubalwanya ba Ijipita. Wakaangununa impuli zyesu.'' Mpawo bantu bakavundamina Yawe akumukomba.
Ba Izilayeli bakachita mbubonya mbuli Yawe mbwakalayilila Mozesi a Aaloni.

Zyakachitika akati kabusiku kuti Yawe ajaye boonse bana batanzi munyika ya Ijipita, kuzwa kumwana mutanzi wa Falawo, wakakkede achuno chabwami, kusikila kumwana mutanzi wamuntu ulimuntolongo abana batanzi bazivuubwa.
Falawo wakabuka akati kabusiku - we, abalanda bakwe, aba Ijipita boonse. Kwakaba kulila kupati mu Ijipita nkambo tekwakali ng' anda yakatali amuntu wakafwide pe.
Falawo wakayita Mozesi a Aaloni mansiku akubambila kuti, munyampuke, muzwe akati kabantu bangu, inywe aba Izilayeli. Kamuya, mukakombe Yawe, mbuli mbumwambide kuti muyanda kuchita.
Amubweze mbelele zyenu ang' ombe zyenu, mbuli mbumwamba mpawo mwinke alimwi mundilongezye.''
Lino ba Ijipita bakakulubizya kapati kuti babatande munyika, nkambo bakaamba kuti, ''toonse tuyofwa.''
Aboobo bantu bakabweza mupelela wabo kabatabikide bumena. Zilongo zyabo zyakali zyaangwa kale amilembo amakkuko aabo.
Lino bantu ba Izilayeli bakachita mbuli Mozesi mbwakabambila. Bakakumbila ba Ijipita zintu zyansiliva, azintu zyangolida mpawo azyakusama.
Yawe wakachita ba Ijipita kuyanda kubotezya ba Izilayeli. Aboobo ba Ijipita bakabapa kufumbwa nchibakakumbila. Munzila njiyeyi, ba Izilayeli bakabbida ba Ijipita.

Lino ba Izilayeli bakeenda kuzwa Lamasesi kusikila ku Sikkoti. Bakali mweelwe wakasiyande kuba kumyanda yazyululu zili makkumi alimusanu alimwi (600,000) wabalumi benda amawulu, kuyungizya abanakazi abana.
Makamu avwelengene alawo akeenda aabo,  antomwe ambelele ang'ombe, amweelwe mupati wazivuubwa.
Bakajika chinkwa chitakwe bumena mumimpelela eeyo njibakeeta kuzwa ku Ijipita. Teyakali abumena nkambo bakali batandwa kuzwa ku Ijipita akubula mweenya wakubamba chakulya.
Lino ba Izilayeli bakali kukkala mu Ijipita kwamyaka ili myanda iine amakkumi aatatu. (430)
Kumamanino amyaka iili makumi ilimyanda iine amakumi aatatu, mubuzuba oobo, boonse makamu abasilumamba ba Yawe bakazwa kunyika ya Ijipita.
Oobu bwakali busiku bwakulindila, bwa Yawe mbwakaba gwisya kuzwa kunyika ya Ijipita. Oobu bwakali busiku bwa Yawe kuti alemekwe aboonse ba Izilayeli mumazyalane aabo boonse.
Yawe wakambila Mozesi a Aaloni, ''ngoyu mulawu wapobwe lyakwindilila: Takwe muzwakule uunga ulaabana mukulya.
Nikuba boobo, muzike woonse waba Izilayeli, uwulidwe amali, nga ulalya amana kupalulwa.
Ibeenzu ababelesi tabelede kulya kufumbwa chakulya.
Lino kulya kulelede kulyidwa mung'anda imwi. Tamwelede kubweza inyama izwa mung'andampawo tamwelede kupwaya kafuwa kayo.
Iguunzi lyoonse lya Izilayeli lilelede kulemeka ipobwe.

Na kuli mwenzu ngumukkala aawe alimwi akuyanda kulemeka ipobwe lyakwindilila kuli Yawe, baluzubo bakwe balumi baleelede kupalulwa. Mpawo ngaulabola akulilemeka. Nga ulaba mbuli bantu bakazyalilwa munyika. Nikuba boobo, takwe muntu utapalwidwe unga ulalya kufumbwa chakulya.
Mulawu nguwoyu ulabeleka kuli boonse bazyalwa muchisi akubeenzu bakkala akati kenu.
Lino bana ba Izilayeli bakachita mbubo mbuli mbwakabalayilila Mozesi a Aaloni.
Nikwakaba buzuba mbubbobo Yawe wakagwisya Izilayeli kuzwa munyika ya Ijipita ankamu zyaba silumamba zyabo.
Kuzwaawo Yahuwe wakambuula kuli Mozesi, wakati,
''Kondibikila ambali bonse bana balombe batanzi - nkambo kufumbwa chitaanzi kukujula izyalilo akati kaba Izilayeli unoli nguwangu, nibaba bantu neziba zinyamankala.''

Mozesi wakati kubantu, ''Elizuba kamunoliyeeya mumizezo yenu, buzuba mbomwakazwa anze lya Ijiputi, kamuzwa anze mung'anda yabuzike, kwinda kujanza ijumu lya Yahuwe ndyakamugwisya alyo kuzwa mubusena obu. Takwe chibunge chilabumena chelede kulyigwa.
Mulazwa anze a Ijiputi obuno ibuzuba , mumwezi wa Abbibbi.

Elyo Yahuwe nayomweeta munyika yaba Kkenanayiti, Hititisi, Hivanayitisi, alimwi aba Jebbusayisi, inyika njakakonkezya basikale kuti uyomupa, inyika ikunka malili abuchi - mpawo mwelede kubamba eyiinzila yabukombi mumwezi oyu.
Kwamazuba musanu awabili mwelede kulya chibunge chitakwe bumena; mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili kuyoba ipobwe lyakulemeka Yahuwe.
Chibunge chitakwe bumena chelede chikalyigwe mumazuba musanu aabili; takwepe chibunge chila bumena chelede kuyobonwa akati kamigaano kenu.
Mubuzuba obo mwelede kuyoti kubana benu, 'Echi chilibobu nkambo kazezyo Yahuwe nzyakandichitila elyo nindakazwa anze lya Ijiputi.'

Echi chiyoba chibalusyo chako kujanza lyako, alimwi nchibalusyo ankumu yako. Echi chilibobu kuti mulawu wa Yahuwe ukakkale mumulomo wako, nkambo nkujanza ijumu elyo Yahuwe ndyakakugwisya alyo kunze lya Ijiputi.
Nkenkaako mwelede kubamba mulawu oyu mbuli mbubambilidwe chindi kuzwa kumunyaka akumunyaka.
Eelyo Yahuwe akumusisya munyika yaba Kkenani, mbuli mbwakasyomezya ndinywe abasikale kuti uyozichita, alimwi akwaba nyika kulindinywe,
mwelede kuyobika kumbali kuli Yahuwe izitanzi kukuzyalwa kumazyalilo woonse. Zyonse zitanzi kuzyalwa kumbono zyenu zyonse ezyo zyeenze, ziyoba zya Yahuwe.
Bonse bana batanzi bama donki mwelede kubaliya amwana wambelele. Kuti kotakonzyi kuzokawula lubo, elyo uyelede kukatyola insingo yako. Pesi bonse bana batanzi kubawula kuti bajoke.
Elyo mwana wako ayokubuzya, ''Echi chambaanzi?'elyo uyelede kuyomwambila, ''Kwakali kujanza ijumu Yahuwe ndyakatugwisya alyo anze kuzwa mu Ijiputi, kuzwa mung'anda yabuzike.

Elyo Falo wakaka chakuyumya moyo kuti atuleke twende, Yahuwe wakajaya zyonseni zyakali zitanzi kukuzyalwa mu Ijiputi, zyonse zitanzi kubantu ezitanzi kubanyama. Nchenchicho nchendimukupayila kuli Yahuwe zyonse zyenze ezyo zitanguna kujula izyalilo pesi bonse batanzi bana balombe ndilababoozya.'
Echi chiyoba chiyeezyo kumaanza enu, alimwi nchiyeezyo ankumu zyenu, nkambo kwakali kujanza jumu lya Yahuwe ndyakatugusya alyo iswebo aanze lyaku Ijiputi.''

Elyo Falo nakazumizya bantu kuti binke, Leza takabazulwida enzila iyinda kuba Filisitina, nekuba kuti eyi njiyakali mfwifwi. Nkambo Leza wakati, ''Ambweni ulabona bantu bakachinche mizezo yabo elyo bakuswanana enkondo alimwi bakajokele lubo ku Ijiputi.
Nkinkaako Leza wakazulwida bantu chakubanzemusya kwindila munkanda manedo ku Lwizi lwa Matete. Bana ba Izilayeli bakeenda chakuzwa anze kanyika yaba Ijiputi bakali bambilide inkondo.
Mozesi wakabweza zifuwa zya Jozefu, nkambo Jozefu wakali wakonkezya ku bana ba Izilayeli wakati, ,''Leza chakasimpe uyomuvuna, alimwi mwelede kubweza zifuwa zyangu akwinka azyo.''
Ibana ba Izilayeli bakalonga beenda kuzwa ku Sakkoti alimwi bakakukkala ku Etamu kumagolelo enkanda.
Yahuwe wakayo bwenda kunembo lyabo kalimujoba lyamulilo kuti abape mumuuni. Mansika wakali kubazulwida kali mumusumpululu wamulilo kuti abape mumuuni. Muleeyi nzila bakeenda mansiku esikati.
Yahuwe takwepe nakabanyanzya kuzwa kumatalikilo ibantu musumpululu wejoba wamubuzuba niliba ejoba lyamansiku kuli musumpululu wamulilo.
Mpawo Jehova wakaambula kuliMozesi, kati,

Amba kubana Isilayelikuti belede kuleya akuyaka musasa kunembo lya Pi Hahiloti, akati kaMigidoli, alwizi, kabatana sika Bbalu Zefoni. Mukayake musasa ambali lyalwizi zilangane a Pi Hahiloti.

(02) @EXO 14:4	<p-n>@Kulonga 14:4</p-n>	Ndiyoyumya moyo waFalo, alubo uyobaandila. Ndiyojana bulemu akaambo kaFalo abasilumamba bakwe boonse. Bana Ijipiti bayoziba kuti ndime Jehova. 'Mpo bana Isilayeli bakayaka musasa mbuli mbubakali balayililwa.
Elyo mwami nakambilwa kuti bana Isilayeli bachija, Miyeyo yaFalo ababelesi bakwe bakabukila bantu. Bakati, " Ino twachitanzi? Twangununa bana Isilayeli kukutubelekela."
Mpawo Falo wakabambila nkalaki zyakwe akubweza basilumamba bakwe anguwe.
Wakabweza nkalaki zilimyanda misanu, muyimwi isalidwe azimwi zyonse nkalaki zyaIjipiti, antomwe abasimilimo muzyonse.
Jehova wakayumya moyo waFalo, mwami waIjipiti, alimwi mwami wakaandila  bana Isilayeli. Lino bana Isilayeli bakali beenda chakukondwa.

Pesi bana Ijipiti bakabaandila, antomwe ambongolo ankalaki, basimbongolo bakwe, abasilumamba bakwe. Bakabayinda bana Isilayeli kumusasa ambali lyaLwizi kubbazu lya Pi Hahiloti, kutana sika Bbalu Zefoni.
Elyo Falo nakasika afwifwi, bana Isilayeli bakalanga kunembo akugamba. Bana Ijipiti bakalikubatobela, alubo bakayowa. Ba Isilayeli bakalila kuliJehova.
Bakati kuli Mozesi, " Akambo kakuti tatukwe tubanda na muIjipiti, ikuti utubweze kuti tuzifwide munkanda? Nkambonzi nuwatujata obu, kutugwisya anze lyaIjipiti?
Ezi tazili nzizyo na nzitwakakwambila muIjipiti? Twakati kulinduwe, ' Tusiye atulike, kuti tubelekele bana Ijipiti.' Zyalikuba mbubo kulindiswe  kubabelekela kwiinda kufwida munkanda."
Mozesi wakati kubantu, " Mutayowi . Mwime buuyo mubone kunwa kwanu oko Jehova nkwatamupe sunu. Nkambo takukwe nimuyobabona alubo bana Ijipiti aba mbomubwene sunu.
Jehova ulakumulwanina, alubo mwelede kuyoyima biyo."
Mpawo Jehova wakati kuliMozesi, ' Nkambonzi webo, Mozesi, nuswini kwiita kulindime? Ambila bana Isilayeli kuti baye kunembo.
Nyampula musako wako, tandabika ajanza lyakoatala lyalwizi akulwandula mububili kuchituila kuti bantu baIsilayeli biinde mulwizi anyika njumu.
Kazizibwe kuti ndiyoyumya myoyo yabana Ijipiti kuti bakatobele. Ndiyojana bulemu ankambo kaFalo abasilumamba bakwe, nkalaki zyakwe, abasimbongolo bakwe.
Mpawo bana Ijipiti bayoziba kuti ndime Jehova elyo ndakujana bulemu nkambo kaFalo, nkalaki zyakwe, abasimbongolo bakwe."
Mutumwa waLeza, oyo walikwenda kunembo lyankamu yaIsilayeli, wakazwa akuya kusule lyabo. Musumpululu wajoba wakeenda kuzwa kunembo lyabo akwima kusule lyabo.
Ijoba lyasika akati kamusasa waIjipiti amusasa waba Isilayeli. Lyakali joba lisiya kubana Isilayeli,  kuti limwi bbazu telyakaza afwifwi alimwi busiku boonse.
Mozesi wakatandabika janza lyakwe atala lyalwizi. Jehova wakachunda lwizi lwaboola amuuwo mupati wakujwe busiku boonse obo akuchita lwizi kuba nyika njumu.
Munzila eyi manzi akapambukana. Bana Isilayeli bakeenda akati kalwizi anyika njumu. Manzi akabachitila bulambo kululyo lwabo akulumwensi lwabo.
Bana Ijipiti bakabaandila. Bakabatobela kusika akati kalwizi - mbongolo zyonse zyaFalo, nkalaki, abasi mbongolo.
Pesi muzyiindi zyachifumo, Jehova wakalanga ansi alibasilumamba baIjipiti kwinda mumusumpululu wamulilo ajoba. Wakaleta kuyowa akati kabana Ijipiti.
Mavili ankalaki zyabo zyakajatwa, abasimbongolo bakeenzya abuyumu. Mpo bana Ijipiti bakati, " Atuchije, kuzwa ku-Isilayeli, nkambo Jehova ulikubalwanina kulwisya ndiswe."
Jehova wakati kuliMozesi, "Tandabika janza lyako atala lyalwizi kuchitila kuti manzi nga alabweda atala lyabana baIjipiti, nkalaki zyabo abasimbongolo babo."
Mpo Mozesi wakatandabika janza lyakwe atala lyalwizi, akubweda kubube bwaloelyo nikwaba kuseni. Bana Ijipiti bakachijala mulwizi, alubo Jehova waka baandila akati kalwizi bana Ijipiti.
Manzi akabweda akuvumba nkalaki zyaFalo, basimbongolo, abasilumamba boonse bakatobede angolo mulwizi. Takwe umwi wakafutuka.
Nikuba obo, bana Isilayeli bakeenda anyika njumu mukati kalwizi. Manzi akali bulambo bwabo kululyo lwabo akulumwensi lwabo.
Jehova mpo wakafutula bana Isilayeli buzuba obo kuzwa kujanza lyabana Ijipiti, alimwi bana  Isilayeli bakabona bana Ijipiti bafwide kumbali lyalwizi.
Elyo Isilayeli nakabona nguzu mpati Jehova nzyakabelesya kulwisya bana Ijipiti, bantu bakalemeka Jehova akusyoma muliJehova akumulanda wakwe Mozesi.
Elyo Mozesi abantu ba Izilayili bakayimba lwiimbo oolu kuli Jehova. Bakayimba, "Ndiyoyimbila Jehova nkaambo wazunda  chabulemu; mbong'olo amweenzyi wayo wakazisowela mulwizi.
Yahweh ninguzu zyangu alwiimbo, wakandibeda lufutuko lwangu. Ooyu ngu Leza wangu alimwi ndiyoomutembawula, Leza wa taata, ndiyomusumpula.
Jehova muzundi; Yahweh ndizina lyakwe.
Wakawaala nkalaki zya Falo abasilumamba mulwizi. Basimulimu basalidwe ba Falo bakabbizigwa mu Lwizi lwa Matete.
Bunike bwakabavumba; bakabbila mubunike mbuli bbwe.
Luboko lwako lwachilisyo, Jehova, luli aabulemu munguzu; luboko lwako lwachilisyo, Jehova, wakamwaya basinkondo.
Mubupati wakasowa aabo bakakubukila. Wakatumina bukali bwako; bwakabalobya mbuli zisense.
Akuyoya kwampemo zyako maanzi akaba ntunduundu; maanzi ayeta akayimikila mulwi; maanzi malamfu aakayuma mumoyo walwizi.
Sinkondo wakati, 'Ndiyobaandilila, ndikabayinde, ndiyoobanyanzya nzibalaazyo; chiyandisyo changu chiyoozulila kuli mbabo; ndiyoosomona panga lyangu;  luboko lwangu luyoobanyonyoona.'
Pesi wakawungya luuwo lwako mpawo lwizi lwakabavumba; bakabbila mbuli lubulo mumaanzi makali.
Nguni uli mbuli nduwe, Jehova, akaati katuleza leza? Nguni uli mbuli nduwe, uli aajulu mubusalali, ulemekwa muntembawuzyo, uchita malele?
Wakatandabika luboko lwako lwachilisyo, mpawo nyika yakabamena.
Muchizuminano chako cheelede wakazulwida bantu mbwakavuna. Munguzu zyako wakabazulwida kubusena busalala ooko nkukkala
Bantu bayoomvwa, alimwi bayookankama; buyoofu buyoojata bakkala mu Filisitiya.
Mpawo baami ba Idomu bayoyoowa; basilumamba baku Moyabbu bayookankama; bakkali boonse baku Kkenani bayoyaaya.
Buyoofu akukankama kuyoowida aalimbabo. Nkaambo kanguzu zyaluboko lwako, bayooba mbuli bbwe litasunzuluki mane bantu bako bakayinde, Jehova- mane bantu mbwakavuna bakayinde.
Uyoobayobola akubabyala achilundu chalukono lwako, abusena, Jehova, mbwakachita kuti kukkalwe mumo, busalala, Mwami wesu, oobo maboko aako mbwakayaka.
Jehova uyooyendelezya kwalyonse alyoonse."
Nkaambo mbong'olo zya Falo zyakeenda ankalaki zyakwe abeenzyi mulwizi. Jehova wakaboozya maanzi akulwizi aalimbabo. Pesi ba Isilayili bakeenda aanyika njumu mukati kalwizi.
Miliyemu musinsimi wachanakazi, muchizi wa Aloni, wakabweza nsaka, aboonse banakazi bakazwa kabali ansaka, balazyana aanguwe.
Miliyemu wakayimba kuli mbabo: "Mwiimbe kuli Jehova, nkaambo wazunda chabulemu. Mbong'olo amweenzyi wayo wakazisowela mulwizi."
Mpawo Mozesi wakasolwedela bantu kuzwa ku Lwizi lwa Matete. Bakazwa baya kunkanda ya Syuli. Bakeenda kwamazuba aatatu munkanda mpawo kakutajaniki maanzi.
Mpawo bakasika ku Mala, pesi tebakakonzya pe kunywa maanzi nkaambo akali kulula. Elyo bakawulika busena oobo kuti Mala.
Mpawo bantu bakatongawukila Mozesi akwaamba kuti,    '''Tulanywaanzi?"

Mozesi wakalila kuli Jehova, mpawo Jehova wakamutondeezya musamu. Mozesi wakawusowela mumaanzi, mpawo maanzi akaba manono kukunywa. Nkuko ooko Jehova wakabapa mulawu muyumu muyumu, alimwi nkuko ooko wakabasunka.

Wakati, "Na mwaswiilila kabotu loko kujwi lya Jehova Leza wanu, akuchita chiluleme mumeso aakwe, akupempeka matwi kumalayilile aakwe akuswiilila milawo yakwe yoonse- tandikwe kuyoobika chilwazi aalindinywe eecho nchindibika kuba  Ijipiti, nkaambo ndime Jehova umusilika."
Mpawo bantu bakasika ku Elimu, ooko kwali misawu yamaanzi ili kkumi ayibili amakumi musanu aabili aa misamu itegwa palumu. Bakakkala nkuko ooko kumbali aa maanzi.
Bantu bakeenda kuzwa ku Elimu, alimwi luundu loonse lwaba Isilayeli lwakasika munkanda ya Sini, ili akati kaElimu a Sinayi, mubuzuba bwakkumi amusanu mumweezi wabili kabali bazwa munyika ya Ijipiti.
Luundu loonse lwabaIsilayeli bakatongawukila Mozesi a Aloni munkanda.

Ba Isilayeli bakati kuli mbabo ," kansi twakafwa biyo kujaanza lya Jehova kunyika ya Ijipiti nitwali kkede munsi lyampoto zyanyama akulya chibunge chakukkuta. Nkambo watugwisya watunjizya munkanda eyi kuti luundu lwesu loonse lujayingwe anzala."

Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi," Ndiyoomuwisizya chibunge ansi kuzwa kujulu. Bantu bayoyinka bakakubunganizye chipanzi chabuzuba bumwi abumwi kuchitila kuti ndibasunke ndibone na pepe bayoyenda kumulawu wangu.
Kuyosika mubuzuba bwamusanu alimwi, awo mpubayobunganizya tukkwana tubili mukuvula mbuli zyalikubunganizigwa buzuba abuzuba,akujika nzibeeta."
Mpawo Mozesi a Aloni bakati kubantu boonse ba Isilayeli, " Igoko muyoziba kuti nguJehova wakamugwisya nywebo kuzwa munyika ya Ijipiti.
Chifumo muyobona bulemu bwa Jehova, kambo ulamvwa kutongooka kwanu atala anguwe. Ndiswe bani mbumunga mulatongawukila?"

Alubo Mozesi wakati, "Muyoziba echi Jehova nayomupa nyama goko achibunge chifumofumo chakumukkutya- kambo wakamvwa matongawuko ngimwakambula atala anguwe. Nguni Aloni andime? Matongawuko anu tali atala andiswe; alatala aJehova."
Mozesi wakati kuli Aloni, "Ambila luundu loonse lwabantu ba Isilayeli, 'Amuze afwifwi kuli Jehova, nkambo wamvwa matongawuko anu.'''
Nichakaba mbubonya, Aloni wakambula kuluundu loonse lwabantu ba Isilayeli, mpawo bakalanga kunembo lyankanda, alimwi, amubone bulemu bwaJehova mbubyakaboneka mujoba.
Mpawo Jehova wakambula kuli Mosesi wati,
Ndamvwa matongawuko abantu baIsilayeli. Bambile kuti, ''Igoko muyolya nyama, achifumo muyokkuta chibunge. Mpawo muyoziba kuti ndime Jehova Leza wanu.
Nilyakaba goko, basiakancele bakasika akuzuzya busena mpubakakkede. Chifumo lume lwakaboneka kaluzyungulukide busena.
Lume nilwakasansamuka, oko atala lwankanda kwakali tuntu tunini tulimbuli gweenda twakali anyika.
Bantu ba Isilayeli nibakachibona, bakati kuli umwi awumwi, ''Ninzi echi?" Tebakazi pe kuti chakaliinzi. Mosesi wakati kulimbabo, "'Chibunge Jehova nchamupa kuti mulye.

Oyu ngumulayizyo Jehova ngwamupa: Mwelede kubunganisya umwi awumwi akati kanu nchayanda kulya, i oma ya umwi kalizulila mweelwe wabantu bakwe mbubobu mbumuyobunganisya: Mubunganisye zyiingi zyakulya zyamuntu woonse ukkala mudumba lyanu. "'
Bantu ba Isilayeli bakachita obo. Bamwi bakabungania zyiingi, bamwi bakabungania ziche.
Nibakayelesya achelesyo cha oma, abo bakabungania zyiingi takwe nchibakali acho chichede, ababo bakabungania ziche takwe nichakacheya. Muntu umwi wakabungania zyiingi zimuzulila kwakuyanda kwakwe.
Mpawo Mozesi wakati kulimbabo, "Takwe umwi welede kusiya nikuba chimwi kusikila kuseni.
Nikuba boobo, tebakaswilila Mozesi. Bamwi babo bakasiya tumwi mane chifumo, pesi twakazyala nkonye alimwi twabola.   Mpawo Mozesi wakanyema atala ambabo.
Bakabungika chifumofumo. Umwi awumwi muntu wakabungika chizulila kulya buzuba obo. Izuba nilyakawumpa, kwakayaya.
Nichakati mubuzuba bwamusanu  abumwi bakabungika chibunge chindulwidwe, ma oma abili amuntu. Bazulwidi boonse baluundu bakasika akwamba eechi kuli Mozesi.

Wakati kulimbabo,"Nchechi Jehova nchaamba: Junza mbobuzuba bwakulyokezya, sabata isalala mubulemeko bwa Jehova. Muyoke kufumbwa nchimuyanda kuyoka akujika kufumbwa chomuyanda kujika choonse chiyochala amuchibambe kusika chifumo."'
Aboobo bakachilika ambali kusika chifumo, mbuli Mozesi mbakabalayilila. Techakabola, na kuba ankonye mukati.
Mozesi wakati, "Ngamulye chakulya echo sunu, nkambo sunu mbuzuba bubambidwe mbuli Sabata kuti tulemeke Jehova. Sunu takwe nimuyochijana mumyuunda.
Muyobungika mumazuba musanu abumwi, pesi buzuba bwamusanu aabili niSabata. MuSabata munoli takukwe mana."
Nichakaba mubuzuba Bwamusanu aabili bamwi bantu bakeenda anze kuyobungika mana, pesi takwe nchibakajana.
Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, "'Uyosika lili kukaka milayizyo amilawu yangu?

Bona, Jehova wamupa Sabata. Lino mubuzuba bwamusanu abumwi ulamupa chibunge chamazuba abili. umwi wanu weelede kukkala kubusena bwakwe; takwe welede kuzwa anze abusena bwakwe mubuzuba bwamusanu abili."
Lino bantu bakalyookezya mubuzuba bwamusanu abili.
Bantu ba Isilayeli bakawuzika chakulya kuti "mana." Chakalikutuba mbuli mwana wanseke ya kkoliyanda, munse wacho wakali mbuli wafaasi achitidwe abuchi.

Mozesi wakati, "Nchechi Jehova nchakamulalayilila: Amuchite oma lilondolwe mukwinda muzyalane lyabantu banu kuchitila kuti lunyungu lwanu luzobone chibunge nchindakamusanizya munkanda, kuchindi nchindakamugwisya munyika ya Ijipiti".
Mozesi wakati kuli Aloni, "Bweza mpoto mpawo ubike oma lya mana mukati. Chilondolwe kunembo lya Jehova kuti chikabambwe mukwinda mumazyalane abantu.
Mbuli Jehova mbwakalayilide Mozesi, Aloni wakachilondola kumbali lya Akki lyamulawu wachizuminano.
Bantu ba Isilayeli bakalya mana myaaka makkumi aane lumwi basika kunyika njibakakkala. Bakalya kusika kumugaano wanyika ya Kkenani.
Lino oma chipanzi chakkumicha Efa.
Loonse luundu lwa Isilayeli lwakeenda kuzwa munkanda yazibi, bakutobelezegwa malayilile a Jehova. Bakalala ku Lefidimu, pesi tekwakali maanzi pe kuti bantu banywe.
Nkinkako bantu bakanyoontokela Mozesi nkambo kabwiime bwabo kabati, ''Kotupa manzi akunywa.'' Mozesi wakaamba wati, Nkambonzi nimundikalalila ?''
Bantu bakali anyota mpati, mpawo bakang'ung'una atala a Mozesi. Bakati, ''Nkamboonzi niwakatugwisya mu Ijiputi? Kuzotujazya inyota iswebo abana besu azivuubwa zyesu?''
Aboobo Mozesi wakalayilia Yawe , ''Ino ndichite byeni abantu aaba? Baamba kulibambila kunditulula amabwe.''
Yawe wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Yinka kunembo lyabantu, alimwi weende aabo bamwi basilutwe baba Izilayeli. Kobweza musako nguwakawumya mulonga, weende.
Ndiyoyimikila kunembo lyako mpawo awo abbwe lya Holebbu, alimwi uyowuma ibbwe. Manzi ayoozwa mulindilyo kuti bantu bakanywe.'' Mpawo Mozesi wakachita echi mumeso abasilutwe baba Izilayeli.
Obo busena wakabwita kuti Masahi a Mulibba nkambo kakung'ung'una kwaba Izilayeli alimwi nkambo kakuti bakasunka Mwami kabaamba kuti, ''Saa Yawe uli akkati kesu nakuti pepe?''
Mpawo basilumamba babantu baba Ameleki bakeza balwanisya Izilayeli ku Lefidimu.
Aboobo Mozesi wakaamba wati kuli Joshuwa, ''Saluuzya baalumi muzwe anze mwende mubalwanisye ba Ameleki. Junza ndizoyimikila atala a kulundu a musuku wa Leza mujanza lyangu.
Aboobo Joshuwa wakalwana aba Ameleki mbuli Mozesi mbwakalayilila, awo Mozesi, Aaloni, a Huli bakaya atala a kukalundu.
Awo Mozesi wakanyampwide maboko akwe mujulu, Izilayeli wakalikuzunda; awo naakali kuselusya maboko akwe kulyokezya, Amaleki wakalikusanguna kuzunda.

Aawo maboko a Mozesi nakanoonga walemenwa maboko kunyampula, Aaloni a Huli bakaanyampula maboko akwe, muntu umwi kubbazu lyakwe limwi, awumwi kuli limbi ibbazu. Aboobo maboko aa Mozesi akali lulamikidwe kusikila kubbila kwezuba.
Aboobo Joshuwa wakazunda ba Ameleki a panga.
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Lemba ezi mubbuku ubale Joshuwa kamvwide, nkambo ndiyozimania kuyeeyegwa kwaba Ameleki kuzwa kunsi lyamajulu.''
Mpawo Mozesi wakayaka chipayililo akuchaamba kuti  ''Yawe nintobo yangu.''
Wakati, ''Nkambo kuboko kwangu kwakanyampulwa kuchuno cha Yawe - ikuti Yawe akatangune inkondo a Ameleki kuzwa kuzyalane akuzyalane.''
Jetulo mujpayizi waku Midia, syayinazyala wa Mozesi ,wakamvwa zyoonse ezyo Leza nzyakachitila Mozesi abantu ba Isilayeli. Wakamvwa kuti Jehova wakagwisya Isilayeli kuzwa mu Igipiti.
Jetulo syayinazyala wa Mozesi wakatolelezya Zipola, mwanakazi wa Mozesi, naakamaninsya kumujosya kumuunzi,
abana bakwe balombe babili,
izina lyawumwi mwana mulombe ngu Geshomu, nkaambo Mozesi wakamba kuti, '' Leza wabasikale  bangu wakandigwasya wakandivuna kuzwa kupanga lya Falo.
Jetulo, syayinazyala wa Mozesi, wakaza abo bana balombe ba Mozesi amwanakazi wakwe wabeeta kulinguwe Mozesi munkanda oomo mwakaliyakide muchilundu cha Leza.
Wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Imebo ndisyanyokozyala Jetulo, ndiliikuboola kuli nduwe  amwanakazi wako abana boko balombe babili.
Mozesi wakazwa waya kukuyoswanana asyanyinazyala, wakakotama aansi akumumyonta. Bakajuzyania mpawo banjila amwi mumusasa
Mozesi wakaambila syanyinazyala zyoonse Yahweh nzyaakachita kuli Falo akuba Ijipiti nkaambo kaba Izilayeli, atala aboonse buyumuyumu mbubakaswanana abo kabali munzila, a Yahweh mbwakabavuna.
Jetulo wakakondelelwa atala aboonse bubotu Yahweh mbwakachitila ba Isilayeli, bwakuti wakabavuna kuzwa mumaboko aba Ijipiti.
Jetulo wakati, ''Yahweh ngalumbayizigwe, nkaambo wamuvuna kuzwa muma boko aba Ijipiti akuzwa kuluboko lwa Falo, wabavuna bantu kuzwa mukuboko kwaba Ijipiti.
Lino ndaziba kuti mupati kwiinda kwiinda ba Leza boonse, nkaambo awo ba Ijipiti nibakapenzya ba Isilayeli chaluuni, Leza wakabafutula bantu bakwe.''
Jetulo syayinazyala wa Mozesi, wakeeta chipo chakutenta aachipayizyo kuli Leza. Aloni abapati ba Izilayeli boonse bakaza kuzo susulaaamwi kunembo lya Leza aantomwe asyayinazyala wa Mozesi.
Mubuzuba butobela Mozesi wakakkala ansi kukubeteka bantu. Bantu bakayimikila nkabamuzyunguukide izuba lyoonse kuzwa kusenikoosika goko.

Syanyinazyala a Mozesi nakabona nzyakachitila abantu, wakati, ''Niinzi eechi nchulikuchita kubantu? Nkaambonzi nukkala aansi awuikke  mpawo bantu boonse balimvwi akukuzyunguluka kuzwa kuseni kusikila goko?''
Mozesi wakati kuli syanyinazyala, ''Bantu baza kulindime kuzobuzya malayilile aa Leza.
Chiindi nibaba atwambo, balaza kuli ndime. Ndilalisalila akati kamuntu kuzwa kuli uumwi, mpawo ndilabayiisya imbeta  amilawu ya Leza.''
Syanyinazyala a Mozesi nakamba kuti kuli nguwe, ''Ncholiikuchita tachili kabotu pe.
Masimpe muyowizuuka, iwe abantu bali aanduwe. Ooyu mukuli mulemu kapati kulinduwe. Tuukonzyipe kuuchita iwebo akulike.
Ndiswiilizye. Ndilakupa nchenjezyo, alimwi Leza uyooba aamnduwe, nkaambo ulimwimikilili wabantu kuli Leza, mpawo ulayeta twaambo twabo kulinguwe.
Weelede kubayiisya imbeta amilawu yakwe. Welede kubatondeezya nzila njibeelede kwenda ayoamulimu ngubelede kuchita.

Atala azeezi, weelede kusaluzya balumi basimilimu kuzwa kubantu boonse, balumi balemeka Leza, balumi bakasimpe basula mpindu iizwa mulweno. Welede kubabika kubantu kuti babe bazulwidi bazyuulu, myaanda , makkumimusanu, abakkumi.
Bayoobeteka twaambo tonse twabantu tubuka,pesi twambo tuyumu bayotweta kulinduwe. Lino twaambo tunini toonse, balabeteka bonya  beni. Muleeyo inzila kuyowuba kulinduwe, alimwi bayokunyampuzya mukuli.
Na wachichita eechi, alimwi naa kuti Leza wakulayilila kuti uchite oobo, alimwi uyokonzya kukukakatila, alimwi bantu boonse bayoobweda mumiinzi yabo kabakutikene.
Aboobo Mozesi wakaswilizya majwi asyayinazyala  alimwi wakachita zyoonse nzyaakamba.
Mozesi wakasala bakozu kuzwa kuli ba Izilayeli boonse akubachita kuti babe basilutwe babantu, basilutwe bazyuulu, myaanda, makumi musanu abakumi.
Bakababeteka bantu mbuli mbukwelede. Twaambo tuyumu bakatweta kuli Mozesi, pesi lwabo beni bakabeteka twaambo toonse tunini.
Mpawo Mozesi wakachita kuti syanyinazyala ayende, alimwi Jetulo wakajokela munyika yakulimbabo.
Mumweezi wachitatu kuzwa bantu ba Izilayeli nkabali beenda kuzwa muchisi cha Ijipiti, mubuzuba bomwe, bakaza kunkanda ya sinayi.
Kuzwa akusiya Lefidimu alimwi bakaza kunkanda ya Sinayi, bakakkala munkanda kunembo lyachilundu.
Mozesi wakaya kuli Leza . Jehova wakiita kuli nguwe kuzwa kuchilundu alimwi wati,''weelede kwambila nganda ya Jakkobbu, bantu ba Izilayeli:
wakabona nzindakachita kuma Ijipiti, mbuuli mbindakakubweza mumababa egumbe akukweeta kuli ndime.
Lino eelyo, kuti watobelezya loko  akuswilizya jwi lyangu akulondola chizuminano changu, eelyo uyoba chipo changu chiyandisi akati kabantu boonse, nkaambo yoonse nyika njiyangu .
Uyooba dolopo lyaba payizi alunyungu  lusalala kuli ndime. Aaya ngimajwi ngoyelede kwambuula kubantu ba Izilayeli.''
Mpawo mozesi wakasika akuyiisya baapati babantu. wakabika kunembo lyabo woonse majwi ayo Jehova ngakamulayilila.
Boonse bantu bakasandula aantomwe akuti,''Tuyochita zyoonse ezyo Jehova nzyawamba. ''Eelyo Mozesi wakaboola kuzowamba majwi abantu kuli Jehova.
Yahweh wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Ndiyooza kuli nduwe mujoba jumu kuchitila kuti bantu bamvwe nindanoowambula anduwe akusyoma kwalyoonse.'' Eelyo Mozesi wakaamba majwi abantu kuli Jehova.
Yahweh wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Yinka kubantu. Sunu ukababike kule andime, akubachita ba wache zyakuzwaata zyabo.
Kuli  bambilila buzuba bwatatu,nkaambo muzuba lya tatu Jehova uyoosika aansi kukalundu ka sinayi.
Mweelede kuyobika migaanu  koonse kuzyunguluka chilundu kubantu. Utedi kuli mbabo, Amuchenjele loko kuti tamwiinki kuchilundu nikuba kujata migaanu. Kufumbwa uujata chilundu kasimpe uyoojayigwa.
Takwe jaanza lyawumi litakajate muntu ooyu. nikyba boobo  uyotululwa na kudubulwa. Nikuba chikabe chinyamankala na muntu, uyojayigwa. Eelyo mweembo wakumvwikka kulila, uyooza kundyato lyachilundu.''
Eelyo Mozesi wakaseluka kuzwa kuchilundu waya kubantu. Wakabika kulekule bantu kuli Jehova alimwi bakawacha zyakuzwaata zyabo.
Wakati kubantu amulibambile muzuba lya tatumutayinki afwifwi  abanakazi benu.''
Muzuba bwatatu, eelyo nikwakachili kuseeni, kwakali guwo atulabi ajoba jumu muchilundu, amuzumo wamwembo. Boonse bantu bakabungene bakayoowa.
Mozesi wakeeta bantu kuzwa nkubakabungene kuti baswaanane a Leza, alimwi bakayima kundyato ya chilundu.
kalundu ka sinayikakali kazulila busi nkaamboJehova wakaselukila mulinkako mumulilo abusi. Busi bwakaya kujulu mbuuli busi bwe ziba, alimwi chonse chilundu chakateketa changuzu.
Eelyo muzuzumo wamweembo niwakalila mujulu a mujulu, Mozesi wakaambula, alimwi Leza wakamusandula mujwi.
Jehova waseluka muchilundu cha sinayi ajulu lyachilundu, alimwi wakayiisya Mozesi aajulu eelyo Mozesi wakayinka.
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi,'' Inka aansi ukalabike bantu, chimwichiindi balamwayuula kuli Jehova kuti alange alimwi biingi babo bayonyonyoka.
Leka bapayizi kabiyo baza afwifwi andime balikkazike lwabo beni kulale- kabalibambilila lwabo kukuboola kwangu-kuchitila kuti nditakanyonyooni kwiminana ambabo.''
Mozesi wakati kuli Jehova,''bantu tabakoozape kuchilundu cha Sinayi, mbuuli mbuwatulayilila: kukubika migaano izyungulukide chilundu akukkala kulaale kuli Jehova.''
Jehova wakati kulinguwe,'' inka aansi ukeete Aloni ayebo, pesi mutachiti kuti bapayizi abantu bamwaye kuzwa akuza kuli Jehova, nikuba ulamwaya kwiminana abo.''
Eelyo Mozesi wakaya aansi kubantu akuyowambuulabo.
Leza wakamba majwi aya:
''Ndime Jehova Leza wenu, wakamugwisya kuzwa munyika yaku Ijiputi, kuzwa mung'anda yabuzike.
Mutabi abamwi ba Leza kunembo lyangu.
Mutakalichitili chikozyanio chibezedwe chili mbuli chili kujulu, nikuba chili aansi ano, nikuba chili kunsi amanzi.

Mutakazifugamini kuli nzizyo nikuba kuzikomba nkambo ndime Jehova, Leza wenu, ndime Leza sibuzuba. Ndipa chisubulo kububi bwaba sinsiku akweta chisubulo kulunyungu, kumazyalane atatu alyane kuli babo batandiyandi me.
Pesi ndiyotondezya luyando kuzyuulu kulabo bandiyanda alimwi akubamba milawu yangu.
Muatakabwezi zina lya Jehova Leza wenu chabuyo, nkambo nsikoyomujata oyo utakwe mulandu ubweza zina lyangu chabiyo.
Yeya buzuba butegwa sababta, mukabusalazye kuli ndime.
Muyobeleka akuchita milimu yenu kwamazuba alimusanu abumwi.
Pesi buzuba bwamusanu aabili mbuzuba butegwa sabata bwa Jehova Leza wenu. Muli mbubo mutakachiti nikuba mulimu, iwebo, nikuba mwanako mulombe, nikuba mweenzu wako ukkede amulyango.
Mumazuba alimusanu abumwi Jehova wakalenga ijulu anyika, ilwizi, azyonse zili mumo, alimwi wakalyokezya muzuba lyamusanu abili. Nkiinkako Jehova wakalongezya izuba litegwa sabata akulilongezya.
Lemeka wuso abanyoko, kuchitila kuti upone chiindi chilamfu munyika Jehova Leza wako njanokupa.
Utajayi nikuba umwi.
Utachiti bwamu.
Utakabbidi umwi.
Utakaambi chakubeja kumwenzinyokwe.
Utakeemuzyi ng'anda yasimabambanwa wako, utakeemuzyi mwanakazi wasimabambanwa wako, mulanda wakwe mwalumi, mulanda wakwe mwanakazi, musune wakwe, indonki yakwe, nikuba chintu chasimabambanwa wako.''
Bantu bonse bakabona mabbalubalu atulabi, alimwi bakamvwa ijwi lyamweembo, akubona chilundu kachizwa busi. Bantu nibakachibona bakateketa akwimikila kule.
Bakati kuli Mozesi, ''Aambula andiswe alimwi tuyokuswilizya; pesi utazumizyi Leza ambule andiswe, amwi tulafwa.''
Mozesi wakati kubantu, ''Mutayowi, Leza waza kuzomusunka kuchitila kuti bulemu bwakwe bube mulindinywe, kuchitila kuti mutakabisyi.
Aboobo bantu bakiima kule, alimwi Mozesi wakinkila mudima usiya awo Leza mpakabede.
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Eezi nzizyo nzoyelede kubuzya bana ba Izilayeli:  'Nywebo lwanu mwabona kuti ndakambula andinwe kuzwa kujulu.
Tamukoyolichitila lwenu ba Leza bambi kunze kwangu, baleza bansiliva nikuba baleza bangolida.

Mukandichitile chipayililo chabulongo changu, akapayilile alinchicho chipayizyo chakuumppa, azipayizyo zyakuswanana, Imbelele zyenu chita zina lyangu kuti lilemekwe, ndiyobola kulindinwe akumulongezya.
Kuti mwandichitila chipayililo chabbwe, mutakachiyakili amabwe apandwidwe, nkambo kuti wabelesya zibelesyo zyako alinchicho, unoli wachisofwazya.
Toyelede kwinka kuchipayililo changu kumatambiliko, kuchitila kuti chinswe chako chitakaboneki antanganana.''
Lino aaya ngemalayilile ngoyelede kuti ubike kunembo lyabo:
Na wawula mulanda mu Hebbulu, uleelede kukubelekela kwaminyaka iili musanu awumwi, alimwi mumunyaka wamusanu ayibili uyoyenda kaangunukide katakwe kuliya chintu pe.
Na wakaza aalike, uleelede kwiinka kaangunukide; na ulikkwete, eelyo banakwe baleelede kwaangunuka kwiinka aantomwe amulumi.
Na simalelo wakwe wakamupa mwanakazi akuzyala bana balombe na basimbi, mwanakazi abana bakwe bayooba basimalelo aakwe, alimwi mwaalumi uleelede kweenda kaangunukide alike.
Pesi kuti mulanda waamba biyo wati, ''Ndilayandisya simalelo wangu, banangu, alimwi abana bangu; nsikonzyi kuzwa chakwaangunuka,''

eelyo simalelo wakwe uleelede kumutola kuli Leza. Simalelo wakwe uleelede kumweeta kumulyango na kumunsende, alimwi simalelo wakwe amudonkole kutwi kwakwe ansunda. Eelyo mulanda uyoomubelekela kwabuumi bwakwe boonse.
Na muntu wawuzya mwana wakwe musimbi mbuli mulanda, tayelede pe kwaangunuka mbuli balanda baalumi.
Na tamubotezyi simalelo wakwe, ooyo wakamuyandide mwini, eelyo uleelede kumuleka awulwe abweede. Takwe cheelelo kumusambala kubazwakule. Takwe cheelelo eecho, nkaambo wamuchitila chalweeno.
Na simalelo wakwe wayanda kumukkwatya kumwana wakwe mulombe, beelede kumuchitila mbubo mbuli mwana wakwe musimbi.
Na walikkwatila uumbi mwanakazi tayelede kuchesya chakulya chakwe, zyakuzwaata, nikuba zyeelelo zyamakkwatano.
Pesi kuti taamupa eezi zintu zyotatwe, eelyo uyoyenda katakwe kuliya mali pe.
Kufumbwa uwuma muntu chakumujaya, nchobeni ooyo muntu uleelede kujayigwa.
Na muntu takwe naachita achaali, pesi anukuti chakutalibambila eelyo njoomulangwiida kwakuchijila.
Na mumntu wajaya mwenzinyina achaali mukwiindila mumizeezo yalweeno, eelyo amumugwisye nikuba kuti ulaachipayililo cha Leza, kuchitila kuti alakwe afwe.
Kufumbwa muntu uwuma wisi nikuba banyina ninchobeni uleelede kujayigwa.
Kufumbwa muntu uubba muntunyina - nikuba kuti sikubba wamuuzya, na muntu ooyo wajanika mumaboko aakwe - ooyo sikubba bantu uleelede ajayigwe.
Kufumbwa muntu uutukila wisi nikuba banyina nchobeni uleelede kujayigwa.
Na bantu balwana alimwi umwi wuuma mweenzinyina abbwe niba mfayindi, alimwi ooyo muntu taafwa pe, pesi wachiswa biyo;
mpawo kuti wapona akukonzya kweenda amufunko, sikumuuma uleelede kuliya chiindi nchaakamusowela; alimwi uleelede kuliya kumusilisya kabotu. Pesi ooyo muntu takwe mulandu wakujaya pe.
Na muntu wawuma muzike wakwe mwaalumi na mwanakazi amufunko, alimwi na muzike wafwa nkaambo kaluuma, eelyo ooyo muntu nchobeni uleelede kupegwa chisubulo.
Nikubaboobo, na mulanda wapona kwalimwi na aabili mazuba, simalelo wakwe tayelede kupegwa chisubulo pe nkaambo unoli wasweekelwa mulanda.

Na baalumi balwana akuumikizya mwanakazi uleeda alimwi wasowa katakwe amwi mpaachisigwa , eelyo sikuuma nchobeni uleelede kuliya mbuli mbwawamba mulumi wamwanakazi, alimwi uleelede kuliya mbuli mbubakabeteka babetesi.
Pesi kuti wachisigwa kapati eelyo uleelede kuliya buumi kubuumi,
liso kuliso, lino kulino, jaanza kujaanza, chituta kuchituta,
kupya kukupya, chilonda kuchilonda, na mubunda kumubunda.
Na muntu wawuma linso lyamulanda wakwe mwaalumi naba mwanakazi akulinyonyona, eelyouleelede kwaangununa muzike mbuli luliyo nkaambo kalinso lyakwe.
Na wakulumbula lino lyamulanda wakwe mwaalumi naba mulanda mwanakazi uleelede kwaangununa muzike mbuli luliyo lwalino lyakwe.
Na musune wayasa mwaalumi naba mwanakazi nkabela wafwa, musune ooyo uleelede kutululwa mabwe, alimwi inyama yawo tiyeelede pe kulyigwa; pesi mwani musune tayeelede kupegwa mulandu pe.

Pesi na kuti musune uli aachimbo kale chakuyasa, alimwi munaawo wakachenjezegwa nikubaboobo taakubamba alimwi wajaya mwaalumi naba mwanakazi, ooyo musune uleelede kutululwa alakwe,  alakwe munaawo uleelede kujayigwa.
Na luliyo lwayandikana nkaambo kabuumi bwakwe, ulelede kuliya kufumbwa nchiwambilwa kuti aliye.
Na musune wayasa mwana mulombe naba musimbi, muni musune uleelede kuchita mbubo mbuli mulawu ngumwaambilwa kuti achite.
Na musune wayasa muzike mwaalumi naba mwanakazi, munimusune uleelede kuliya masyekeli aansiliva aali makkumi otatwe, awulawo musune uleelede kujayigwa amabwe.
Na muntu wajula mulindi, nikuba wasya mulindi akutawuvumba, alimwi musune niiba mbongolo yawida mukati kawo,
muni mulindi uleelede kuliya. Uleelede kupa mali kuli mwani munyama, alimwi mutunta wamunyama ulaba wakwe.
Na musune wamuntu wayasa musune wamweenzinyina nkabela wafwa, eelyo baleenda kusambala musune uuchipona akwaabana mali, alimwi akwaandwidana musune uufwide.
Pesi na chakalizibikene kuti ooyo musune wakli aachimbo chakuyasa kale alimwi munaawo tawubambide pe, uleelede nchobeni kuliya musune kumusune, alimwi iifwide ilaba yakwe.
Na muntu wabba musune niiba mbelele akwiijaya nikuba kwisambala, eelyo uleelede kuliya basune balimusamu aachimanga chamusune woomwe ambelele zyomwe achimanga chambelele.
Na mubbi wajanwa kalokudonkola, alimwi wawumwa chakufwa, mukaambo kaliboobo takwe muntu upegwa mulandu wakujaya pe akaambo kakuchita kwakwe.
Pesi kuti izuba lyamuzwida katanadonkola, mulandu wakujaya ulapegwa kumuntu wamujaya. Mubbi uleelede kuliya. Na katakwe nchalaacho, mpawo uleelede kusambalwa nkambo kakubba kwakwe.
Na munyama wabbigwa wajanwa kalimuumbulu mujanza lyakwe, nekuba kuti musune, imbongolo, niiba mbelele, uleelede kuliya zyiindililde.
Na muntu wachezya lubono lwakwe mumuunda na mumasansa akulekela lubono lwakwe, alimwi lwakulyida mumunda wamwenzinyina, uleelede kuliya bubotu bwamuunda wakwe abubotu bwamasansa akwe.
Na mulilo wabuka akutenta lubaya lwamamvwa kuchitila kuti zilyo zilimumalwi, azilyo zyimvwi, nuuba muunda wapya, sikutenta uleelede nchobeni kuliya.
Na muntu wapa mali neluba lubono kumwenzinyina kuti alulondole kabotu, alimwi kuti lwabbigwa kung'anda yasikulondola, na kuti mubbi wajanwa. Oyo sikubba uleelede kuliya zyiindulwidwe.
Pesi kuti sikubba taajanwa, mpawo mwani ng'anda uleelede kuza kubabetesi kuti kukabonwe kuti ateni wakabika jaanza lyakwe kulubono lwamweenzinyina.

Kukukatazyania koonse atala achimwi chintu, naba musune, imbongolo, imbelele, zyakuzwata, akufumwa chiswekede nchawamba kuti, ''Echi chichangu ,'' lukazyanio lwabo bobile luyeledwe kweetwa kubabetesi. Oyo babetesi ngubayojana mulandu uleelede kuliya zyiindulwidwe kulisimayakilanwe wakwe.
Na muntu wapa mwenzinyina lubono, musune, imbelele, nekuba kuumbwa munyama wakuvuba, alimwi kuti wafwa nanka kulumwa nanka kubwezegwa kakutakwe nekuba woomwe wakamubona,

chikonke kuli Jehova cheelede kuchitwa abaaba bobile, kuti takwe naba womwe akati kabo wakabikka jaanza lyakwe alubono lwasimamayakilane. Munaalo welede kuzitambula eezi, alimwi mwenzinyina tokoyoliya pe.
Pesi kuti lwaka bbigwa kuzwa kulinguwe, umwi uleelede kuliya kuli mwani lubono.
Na munyama wazapawulwa, muleke umwi ayete munyama mbuli chitondezyo. Takoliya echo chazapawulwa pe.
Pesi na muntu wakumbila munyama kulisimayakilane alimwi munyama wachiswa na wafwa katali kuli mwanaawo, umwi wakwe uleelede nchobeni kuliya.
Pesi kuti walikuli mwanawo, mwenzinyina tayelede kuliya pe; na munyama walikubeleka chakufolola, uyoliyigwa amali yamufolo wayo.
Na mwaalumi weneena nakalindu utana kukwatwa, alimwi walalawe, uleelede nchobeni kumuchita banakwe akuliya lubono ndwayitilwa.
Na wisi wakakilila kumupa , uleelede kuliya mali ayelene alubono lwabanakalindu.
Mutazumizyi musondi kuti apone.
Kufumbwa muntu uulala amunyama welede kufwa.
Kufumbwa muntu upayila kuli leza umbi utali Jehova ullelede kujayigwa.
Tamweelede kubisizya mweenzu nekuba kumudyamizya, nkambo mwakali beenzu munyika ya Ijipiti.
Mutapenzyi naba omwe mukamufu naa muchaala.
Naa kuti mwabapenzya, alimwi bakkwila kulindime, nchobeni ndiyomvwa kulila kwabo.
Bukkali bwangu buyobuka, alimwi ndiyomujaya apanga; banakazi bene bayoba bamukabafu, abana benu bayoba bamuchala.
Na wakweletya mali kufumbwa kuli umwi wabantu bangu bachete akati kanu, toyelede kumubeda mbuli sikukweletya nekuba kumuliyisya mpindu.
Na watola chibaki chamwenzinyokwe chakusyomezya, uleelede kuchibweedezya izuba kalitana bbila,
nkambo nchicho luzutu chakuvumba chakwe; nchechicho chibaki chamubili wakwe. Nchiili chimbi nchanga ulalivumba aacho? Elyo nayoyita kulindime, ndiyo mumvwa nkambo ndilimubombe moyo.
Toyelede kusampawula ndime, Leza, nanka kutukila mweendelezi wabantu bako.
Toyelede kuyooleka kupayizya zyabutebuzi bwako na zikandilo zya wayini yako. Uyelede kundipa mwana mutaanzi wabana bako balombe.
Uleelede alimwi kuchita mbubo kubasune bako ambelele  zyako. Kwamazuba musanu aabili zileeledwe kuba antomwe amanyina, pesi mubuzuba bwamusanu aatatu uleelede kuzipa kuli ndime.
Muyoba bantu basalala kuli ndime. Nkenkaako tamweelede kulya nyama yakalumwa abanyama mumunda pe. Asi, kuti muleelede kwiisowela babwa .
Tamwelede kwamba zyakubeja atala awumwi.
Utagwasyanyi awumwi muntu sizibi kuti uwambe bukamboni bwakubeja. Mutatobeli bbunga kukuchita  bubi, kana kupa bukamboni bwakubeja kuti utobele banji kukukusandula bululami.
Tamwelede kutondezya kuvuninina muntu muchete mukukkachilwa kwakwe.
Na mwaswana musune kana mbongolo yasinkondonyokwe nkili yasweka, mwelede kwibozya umupe.
Na mwabona mbongolo yamuntu ngotayandi yawida amutolo, tamwelede kusiya muntu oyo. Kasimpe mwelede kumugwasya ambongolo yakwe.
Mutasoweli kumbali bululami bwamuchete mukuya kwakwe.
Mutaswanani abamwi mukutamikizya bwakubeja, alimwi utajayi utakwe mulandu na mululami, nkambo nsikyoleka kubabeteka bataluleme.
Mutabwezi masinkamulomo, nkambo masinka mulomo alofwazya abo babona, alimwi alasandulwa majwi abantu baluleme.
Muta dyamizyi mwenzu, nkambo mulibwizi buumi bwamwenzu, nkambo inywe mwakali beenzu munyika ya Ijipita.
Kwamyaka musanu awumwi muyobyala imbuto munyika yenu alimwi akubungika butebuzi.
Pesi mumunyaka wamusanu ayibili muyoyisiya nkitalimidwe, kuti bachete balakkati kabantu benu bakalye. Ezyo nzibasiya, banyama bamusokwe bakalye. Muyochita mbubo mumyanda yamasansa amyunda yama olifa.

Mumazuba musanu alimwi muyochita milimo yanu, pesi mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili mwelede kulyokezya.  Muchite eechi kuti musune wanu ambongolo yanu zilyokezye, alimwi kuti mwana mulombe wamuzike wako mwanakazi akufwambana mwenzu ngaula lyokezya akubukuluka.
Swilila zyoonse nzindaamba kulinduwe. Utadomboli mazina abaleza, kana kuti mazina abo amvwigwe mumulomo wako.
Mwelede kweenda kuti muka ndichitile ipobwe tutatu amunyaka.

Mwelede kubamba ipobwe lyachinkwa chitawe buswezyo. Mbuli mbundaka mulayilila, muyolya chinkwa chitakwe buswezyo kwamazuba musanu aabili. Kuleecho chindi, muyolibonia kunembo lyangu mumwezi utegwa Abbibbi, chibambilidwe makkanze aya. Kwakali mumwezi oyo ngumwakazwa aawo mu Ijiputi. Pesi tamwelede kulibonia kunembo lyangu chinkwamanza

Mwelede kubamba ipobwe lyakutyola, kabalwebalwe kamilimo yenu nimwakabyala mumyunda yenu. Alubo mwelede kubamba pobwe lyakubika aamwi kumamanino amunyaka, mpumubweza nzyomwatebula kuzwa mumyunda yenu.
Baalumi benu boonse belede kulibonia kunembo lya Mwami Jehova tutatu mumunyaka umwi awumwi.
Tamwelede kupeda bulowa kuzwa kuzipayizyo nzimweta kulindime chibunge chilabuswezyo. Mafuta kuzwa kuchipayizyo kupobwe tayelede kusyala mansiku woonse kusikila kuseni.
Mwelede kweeta michelo mitaanzi miyandisi kunyika yako mung'anda yangu, ing'anda ya Jehova Leza wako. Toyelede kubilisya kana kempongo mumalili abanyina.
Ndiyotuma mungelo kunembo lyako kukukwabilila munzila yako, alimwi akakwete kubusena mbwekubambilide.
Mumuswilizye alimwi mumulemeke mutamunyemyi, nkambo takoyolekelela insotoko zyanu. Izina lyangu lilanguwe.
Na chamasimpe mwamuswilila ijwi lyakwe  akuchita zyonse ezyo nzendamwambila, Elyo ndiyoba sinkondonyina abasinkondonyokwe alimwi ndiyoba sikulwanisya kuli basikukulwanisya.
Angelo wangu uyobakunembo lyanu akuyomweta kuliba Amoli, Hiti, Pelizi, Kkenani, Hivi, alimwi akuba Jebbusi. Ndiyobanyonyona.
Tamwelede kukkotamina ba Leza babo, kubakkomba, kana kuchita mbuli mbubachita. Pesi, mwelede kubanyonyona akubazapawula minseme yamabwe.
Mwelede kukkomba Jehova Leza wenu alimwi uyolongezya chinkwa amanzi anu. Ndiyogwisya zilwazi kuzwa akkati kenu.
Takwe mwanakazi uyobula kuzyala na kusowa mwana wakwe muminyaka yenu. Ndiyomupa buumi bulamfu.
Ndiyotuma kuyoosya kulaabo bamunyika nkomuyobuya. Ndiyojaya bantu boonse mbimutakaswane. Ndiyochita kuti boonse basinkondonyokwebaka mufutatile chakuyoowa.
Ndiyotuma zyuuka zijaya kunembo lyanu ezyo zitakatande ba Hivi, ba Kkenani aba Hiti kuzwa kunembo lyanu.
Nsikoyo batanda kunembo lyenu mumwaka omwe, kuti nyika itakabi tongo, alimwi banyama bamusokwe bayomuvulila loko.
Pesi, ndiyobatanda bunini bunini kuzwa kuli ndinywe ado mukazyalisye akuvuba nyika.

Ndiyobika migano kuzwa kulwizi lwamatente kuyosika kulwizi lwaba Filisitiya, akuzwa kunkanda kuyosika kumulonga wa Lifutelete. Ndiyomupa luzundo kubantu bakkala munyika, muyobatanda kuzwa kulindinywe.
Mutakachiti chikkonke ambabo na abaleza babo.
Batakakkali munyika yenu, na kumuchita kuti mundibisizye. Na mwakukomba ba Leza babo, nchobeni chiyomubeda chilebyo.''
Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''kweza kulindime - iwebo, Aaloni, Nada, Abbihu, abali makkumi musanu aabili abapati ba Izilayeli, alimwi mukandikkombe kulale.
Mozesi alikke nguyelede kuswena afwifwi andime. Aba bamwi tabelede kuza afwifwi, nikuba kuti bantu baswene baze awe.''
Mozesi wakiinka akwambila bantu majwi a Jehova ambeta zyakwe. Bantu boonse bakasandula ajwi lyomwe akwamba kuti, ''Tuyochita majwi oonse Jehova ngawamba.''

Mpawo Mozesi wakalemba aansi majwi oonse a Jehova'Chifumo, Mozesi wakayaka chipayililo munsi lyesimpilo lyachilundu akubamba musumpululu yamabwe alikkumi aabili, kuti mabwe ayiminine mikowa ilikkumi ayibili, kuti mabwe ayiminine mikowa ilikkumi ayibili yaba Izilayeli ilikkumi ayibili ya Izilayili.
Wakatuma ba Izilayeli bakubusi abachalumi kukuyopeda zituuzyo zyakutenta alimwi azituuzyo zyabulyidilano zyabasune kuli Jehova.
Mozesi wakabweza chisela chabulowa mpwao wabika mumitiba, akusansila chimwi chisela achipayililo.
Wakabweza ibbuku lyechizuminano alimwi wakalibalila mujulu kubantu. Bakati, ''Tulochita zyoonse Jehova nzyawamba. Tuyoswilila.''
Mpawo Mozesi wakabweza bulowa akusansila abantu wakati, ''Oobu mbulowa bwachizuminano obo Jehova mbwachitila ndinywe akumupa chisyomezyo amajwi aya woonse.''
Mpawo Mozesi a Aaloni, Nadabbu, Abbihu, abali makumi musanu aabili bapati ba Izilayeli bakiinka muchilundu.
Bakabona Leza wa Izilayeli. Kunsi amawulu akwe kwakabonwa mbuli chibuye chamabwe chakachitidwe asafili nkakubalangala mbuli ijulu lwalyo.
Leza takabika  kuboko kubapati baba Izilayeli. Bakabona Leza, alimwi bakalya akunywa.
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Kweza kulindime muchilundu alimwi ukakkale nkuko. Ndiyokupa zilembelo zyamabwe amulawu amilazyo njendilembede, kuti ukabayiisye.''
Eelyo Mozesi wakinka asikumugwasya Joshuwa alimwi bakatanta muchilundu cha Leza.
Mozesi wakati kubapati, ''Amukkale alimwi mutulinde ado tubole kulindinywe. Aaloni a Huli balandinywe. Kuti nkakuli ujisi makani, ayinke kulimbabo.''
Eelyo Mozesi wakayinka muchilundu, mpawo joba lyakachivumba chilundu.
Bulemu bwa Jehova bwakali achilundu cha Sinayi, ajoba lyakachivumba kwamazuba ali musanu alimwi. Mubuzuba bwamusanu abumwi wakiita kuli Mozesi kuzwa mujoba.
Kulibonia kwabulemu bwa Jehova bwakali mbuli mulilo uyakisya atala achilundu kumenso aba Izilayeli.
Mozesi wakanjila mujoba akutanta muchilundu wakkala atala lyachilundu kwamazuba makkumi oone amansiku makkumi aane.
Jehova wakaambuula kuli Mozesi,

''Ambila bana ba Izilayeli kuti batole zipo zyangu kuzwa kumuntu woonse uusungwazigwa amoyo uuzumina. Amutambule zipo zyangu kubantu boonse bazumina mumyobo yabo. Uleelede kutambula eezi zipo zyangu .
Nzeezi zipo nzimweelede kutambula kuli mbabo: ngolide, nsiliva, amukuba;
masani aasikkaka, masani aamusinza wanyangu, amasana aasalala pyu amasani aatuba, aboya bwampongo;
zikumba zyabagutu zisalazidwe; azisamu zyamuunga;
mafuta aamalampi  amubusena busalala bwakukombela; misamu yamafuta aakunana, atununkilizyo twakutenta,
mabwe aa onikisi aambi mabwe ayebeka ayelede kubikwa muchikombelo chakupayizi amukatobo kachaamba.
Amubaleke bandichitile chikombelo kwiitila kuti ndikkale aakati kabo.
Muleelede kuchita mbubonya mbuli mbondiyoomutondeezya mumizeezo chikombelo azibelesyo zyacho zyoonse.
Baleelede kuti bachite ibbokesi lyazisamu zyamuunga. Bulamfu bwalyo bube tukkokola tobile achisela, abwaamba bwalyo kakkokola komwe achisela, abwiime bwalyo kakkokola komwe achisela.
Uleelede kuzilulula mukati aanze angolida iisalala, aatala aacho alimwi ulibikile mukkome wangolida chakuzyunguluka bulamfu bwalyo.
