Uleelede ufule inchoko zyone zyangolide, akuzibika ajulu aamawulu one aabbokesi, inchoko zyobile kulubazu lumwi anchoko zyobile kuli lumwi lubazu.
Uleelede ubeze miziyo yamuunga akwiiziluluzya ingolida.
Uleelede uchite miziyo wiisyomeke munchoko zyakumabazu, kuti mukonzye kubweza bbokesi.
Miziyo iileelede kusyaala munchoko zyabbokesi;  tazyeelede kugwisigwa pe kulindilyo.
Uleelede ubike mubbokesi milawu yachizuminano.
Uleelede kuchita chijazyo changolide chaluswaanizyo. Bulamfu bwacho bube tukkokola tobilwe achisela, abwaamba bwacho kakkokola komwe achisela.
Uleelede kuchita bobilwe bakkelubi bangolinda iipwayidwe kumpela zyobile zyachijazyo chachuuno chaluswaanizyo.
Chita Kkelubi umwi wamagozezyo aamwi aachuuno chaluzyalo, awumwi Kkelebi wamamanino wagozezyo limbi. Zyeelede zichitwe mbuli chipanzi chachuuno chaluzyalo.
Bakkelubbi balatandabika mababa aabo akuvumbilila chuuno chaluzyalo, amasyu aabo aalangene, masyu abakkelubbi alange chuuno chaluzyalo.
Mweelede kubika chuuno chaluzyalo aatala lyabbokesi, alimwi mukati kabbokesi mweelede kubika milawu njendikukupa.

Nkukonya kubbokesi nkutuyooswaninana andinywe. Ndiyoowambula anduwe kuzwa kujulu lyachuuno chaluzyalo aakatikati kabakkelubbi bobile bali aabbokesi lyachizuminano ooko nkwesiyookwaambile milawu yoonse njowelede kulayilila bana ba Izilayeli.

Uleelede kuchita tafula lyamuunga. Bulamfu bwalyo bube tukkokolaa tubili, abwaamba bwalyo kakkokola komwe, abwiime bwalyo kakkokola komwe achisela. Uyiziluluzye ingolida iisalala akwiichita mukkome uyizyungulukide wamgolida.
Uchite mubalo uyizyungulukide uli aabwaamba bwajanza, awooyo mubalo ube aamoongola wangolida koonse koonse.
Weeledei uchite nchoko zine zyangolida akubika nchoko kuzyooko zyone zyakumawulu aayo.
Aafwifwi kumubalo kuyooba inchoko zitakajate miziyo yakunyampuzya tafula.
Weeledde kuchita miziyo kuzwa kumusamu wa akkasiya alimwi ukuuvumbe angolida kuti tafula likanyampuzigwe aanzizyo.
Uleelede kuchita mitiba, amyuungo, azilongo amfulu zyakupayizya, zyoonse uzichite aangolide iisalala.
Uleelede kubika zibunge zyamabonwabonwa aatafula kubusyu bwangu chiindi choonse.
Uleelede kuchita chiimikilo chalampi changolida iisalala kunsi lyacho amubili walo abe achifulamubisi. Nkomeki zyacho atunkuli twacho, amalubaluba aacho zyoonse ziyoojatilila mulinchicho.
Nkabela mumabazu aacho muyoozwa mitabi iili musanu awumwi - mitabi yotatwe kulubazu lumwi, alimwi mitatbi yotatwe kulubazu alumwi lwachiimikililo chalampi.
Mutabi umwi awumwi uubezedwe ankomeki zyotatwe zili mbuli michelo wa alumondi zili atunkuli amalubaluba mitabi yoonse ilimusanu awumwi iizwa kuchiimikililo ibe mbubonya oobo.
Awo achimikililo chini abezwe inkomeki zyone zilimbuli michelo ya alumondi zili atunkuli amalubaluba.

Kuleelede kuba chikkazikilo chamatu kunsi aantabi zyobile zyakutanguna - zichitidwe mbuli chintu chomwe anchicho, alimwi aachikkazikilo chamatu munsi lyantabi zyobile - alubo chichitidwe mbuli chintu chomwe anchicho. Munzila njiyeeyo kweelede kube chikkazikilo chamatu munsi lyantabi zyobile zyatatu, zichitidwe mbuli chintu chomwe anchicho. Kweelede kube mbubo kuntabi zili musanu ayimwi zyiindilila kuzwa kuchikkalilo chalampi.
Zikkazikilo zyazyo zyamatu antabi zyeelede kuba chintu chomwe anchicho, chomwe chipanzi chamulimu wabufule bwangolide iisalala.
Weelede kuchita chikkazikilo chalampi amalampi aacho ali musanu aabili, akubamba malampi aacho kuti ape mumuni kukuzwa kulinchico.
Mamano ankayi zyawo zyoonse zibe zyangolide iisalala.
Belesya talenta lyoomwe lyangolida iisalala kukuchita chikkazikilo chelampi azibelesyo zyacho.
Bona kuti wazichita mbubonya mbuli muchikozya nchiwakatondeezegwa achilundu.
Uyake idumba lyakukombela lili amakketeni aabambidwe amulembo mubotu alimwi awuulu yamuteme, yantumbula, iiswankukide kinengulwidwe mbuli Kkelubbimu. Ooyu uyooba mulimo wasikubeza munkutwe abusongo.
Ibulamfu bwalimwi alimwi kketeni bwelede kuba makumi obile amusanu awatatu makkiyubbiti, ibusasa bube aane kweelana bupati.
Imakketeni musanu ayelede kujatanisigwa kulimwi alimwi, alimwi amwi aali musanu lubo ayelede kujatanisigwa kuli limwi alimwi.

Welede kupanga myoondo yamubala wamuteme kutobelezya aanze lyamunkome wamamanino aakketani lyenkama yomwe.  Munzila njiyo ikozyenie, uyelede kuchita mbubo kotobelezya aanze amunkume wakketeni lyamamanino munkama yabili.
Welede kupanga myondo makumi musanu kukketeni lyakusanguna, alimwi upange myoondo makumi musanu kukketeni lyamamanino kunkama yabili. Uchite eezi kuchitila kuti imyondo isandikane umwi awumwi.
Welede kuchita zikobela zyangolida zili makumi musanu alimwi uswanizye makketeni antoomwe azikobekelo kuchitila kuti dumba lyakukkombela lijatane.
Welede kuchita makketeni aaboya bwampongo akuchita bbakasa litavumbe idumba.  Welede  kuchita makketeni aya abe kkumi alimwi.
Ibulamfu bwakketeni lyomwe bube  makkiyubbiti makumi otatwe, alimwi busasa bwakketeni lyomwe bube makkiyubbiti oone. Limwi alimwi lyamakketeni alikkumi alimwi lyelede kukozyania kukomena aamwi.
Welede kuswanizya makketeni musanu kuli limwi alimwi amwi makketeni aali musanu alimwi aswanizigwe kuli limwi alimwi. Welede kwaavunga tubili ikketeni lyamusanu alimwi kunembo lyabbakasa.
Welede kuswanizya myondo makumi musanu kumukkome wakketeni lyamamanino lyankomo ntanzi, alimwi mondo makumi musanu kumukome wakketeni lyamamanino eelyo liswanana ankama yabili.
Welede kuchita zikobekelo makumi musanu zyamubala wabbulonzi alimwi uzibike mumyondo. Mpawo uswanizye bbakasa antomwe Kuchitila kuti chibe chintu chomwe.
Ichisela chakketeni chisyaala, eelyo bbazu lichaala kalilengelede kuzwa kumakketeni abbakasa, ayelede kulengelela kusule lya dumba.
Kwelede kuba kkiyubbiti yomwe yakketeni kuti limbi bbazu - eelyo lyachala kubulamfu bwakketeni lyabbakasa lyalede kulengelela kumabbazu aadumba. Kubbazu lyomwe akuli limbi bbazu, kuti lichivumbe.
Welede kuchitla dumba ichivumbyo chachikkumba chembelele chakayanikwa kachisalala, alimwi achimwi chivumbyo chachikkumba chisukidwe kuti chiinde aatala aachechiya.
Welede kuchita busanza bwiimvwi njii bwa dumba kuzwa kumasamu aa akasiya.
Bulamfu bwayimwi ayimwi impanda bwelede kuba ikkumi lyamakkiyubbiti, alimwi ibusasa bwelyo bwelede kuba kkiyubbiti yomwe achisela.
Kwelede kuba inkanka zyobile zyachisamu muchisansa chomwe izyakuswanizya zisanza kuli chimwi achimwi. Welede kuchita zyonse zisanza zyadumba muli njiyeyi inzila.
Iwachita zisanza izyadumba, welede kuchita zisanza makumi obile aabbazu lyakunsi.
Welede kuchita mazeteko aansiliva aali makumi oone atayinke kunsi lyamasanza aali makumi obile. Kwelede kube mazeteko obile munsi lyasanza tanzi kuti zibe zilyatililo zyazyo zyobile.
Kubbazu lyabili lya dumba kubbazu lyakumbo, welede kuchita masanza makumi obile
amazeteko azyo aansiliva makumi oone. Kwelede kuba mazeteko obile munzi lyamasanza itanzi, mazeteko obile kuchisanza chitobela, kaziyobiya mbuboobo.
Kubbazu lyakusule edumba kubbazu lyakububbila, welede kuchita zisanza musanu achimwi.
Welede kuchita zisanza zyobile zyamakkona akusule lyadumba.
Eezi zisanza zyelede kwaanzana kunsi, pesi kaziswenene ajulu kulubalo lomwe.

Kwelede kuba mbubobu kuli woonse obile makkona akusule. Kwelede kuba zisanza musanu azitatu, antomwe amazeteko azyo ansiliva. Kwelede kuba mazeteko aali kkumi amusanu alimwi mubwingi, mazeteko obile munsi lyasanza litobela, alimwi kaziyabuya mbubobu.
Welede kuchita zisamu zyamu akkasiya zyiingene - zili musanu nzyazisanza zyalimwi ibbazu lyedumba.
Zili musanu zisamu zyingene nzyakuli limbi bbazu lya dumba, alimwi zisamu zyiingene zili musanu nzyabbazu lyakusule adumba kububbila.
Izisamu zyiingene zili aakkati kazisanza, nkokuti; akkati aakkati kukuya mujulu, zyelede kusika kumagolelo akumagolelo.
Welede kuvumba zisanza angolida. Welede kuchita bwaanzo bwazyangolide, kuchitila kuti zibeleke mbuli zijatizyo zyazisamu zyiingeene, alimwi welede kuvumba zisamu zyiingeene angolide.
Welede kwimikizya idumba munzila itobela njiwakatondezegwa aachilundu.
Welede kuchita kketeni lyamubala wamuteme, muntumbula awuulu iyebeka, alimwi amulembo uumaninide, uli abweengo bwakkelubbimu, imulimu wasimulimu uuli aaluzibo.
Welede kuzyaanzika aazisanza zyoonse zyamusamu wa zisanza zyelede kuba azikobekelo zyangolida zibikidwe amazeteko angolide oone,
Welede kwanzika makketeni munsi lyazikobekelo, alimwi welede kweeta mukati ibwaato bwabukamboni. Ikketeni ndyakwanzanisya busena busalala kubusena busalalisya.
Welede kubika chivunisyo chabulemu abwaato bwabukamboni, ichili mubusena busalalisya. Welede kubika tafula aanze aakketeni.
Welede kubika chikkalilo chelampi kachileyene atafula kubbazu lyakuunsi aanyika kwadumba itafula lyelede kuba kubbazu lyakujulu.
Welede kuchita mulengalenga kumulyango wabbakasa. Welede kuuchita amubala wamuteme, wamuntumbula, azibelesyo zyeebeka, amulembo uumaninide uuvungidwe, mulimu wasikuluka.
Ikwa mulengalenga, welede kuchita mbandama musanu zyamu akkasiya alimwi uzivumbe angolida. Izikobekelo zyazyo zibe zyengolide, alimwi welede kusala mazeteko aazyo aabbulonzi aali musanu.
Uyelede kuyaka chipayililo chamusamu wamu-akasiya, tukokola tuli musanu kutandabala atukokola tuli musanu bwaanda. Chipayililo chelede kuba aamabbazu ayelene atukokola tutatu kuya kujulu.
Uyelede kuyingizigwa zyooko zyacho amusune. Imeja ayolundwa mbuli chimwi chibeela achipayililo, alimwi uyelede kuwavumba amukuba.
Uyelede kulunda zibelesyo zyaachipayililo: mpoto zyamulota alubo amafocholo, ndido, fologwe yanyama, ampani zyamulilo. Uyelede kulunda zibelesyo ezi uzilunde kobelesya mukuba.
Uyelede kuchita munkombe wachipayililo, anjatanisyo yamukuba. Lunda mubalo wamukuba aliwumwi awumwi mukome wazyoko zyone.
Uyelede kubika mukombe munsi aalumpimpito lwachipayililo, aakati akati kuyansi.
Chita minkulu yachipayililo, ibe yamu-akasiya, mpawo uyivumbe amukuba.
Iminkulu eyi ibikwe mumibalo, alimwi minkulu eyi iyelede kuba kumabbazu achipayililo obile, kuti ichibweze.
Uyelede kulunda chipayililo chikwankwamuke amapulanga. Uyelede kuchilunda munzila njwakatondezegwa ajulu achilundu.
Uyelede kuyakila dumba lyakukombela. Kuyelede kuba zilengelela kumusansa kwalubaya, zilengelela zyamasani matete awosedwe aalitukokola tuli mwanda bulamfu.
Zilengelela zyelede kuba misumpululu makumi abili, zila zikazikilo zyamukuba zilimakumi abili. Kwelede lubo kuti kube zikobelo zijisilidi amisumpululu antomwe akabulo kasiliva.
Munzila ikozyania, kubbazu lyakujwe, kwelede kuba zilengelela tukokola tuli mwaanda bulamfu bulamisumpululu  makumi aabili azikazikilo, zikobelo zijisilidi kumisumpululu akabulo kasiliva.
Kutobezya lubaya kuumbo kwelede kuba mulembu ulatukokola tuli makumi masanu kulampa. Kwelede kuba musumpululu  ilikuumi aazikazikilo zili kuumi.
Lubaya lwelede kuba tukokola tuli makumi musanu kubuzwazuba.
Zilengelela zyalimwi bbazu lyamulyango lyelede kubatukokola tulikuumi amusanu. Zyelede kubamisumpululu itatu ilazikazikilo zyotatwe.
Eli limwi bbazu lyelede kuba azilengela kuumi amusanu bulamfu. Zyelede kuba misumpululu itatu ilazikazikilo zyotatwe.

Mulyango walubaya welede kuba mulembu ulatukokola makumi obile bulamfu. Mulembo welede kulundwa amubala wamuteeme, muntumbula, azibelesyo zisalalisya amasani matetete awosedwe, mulimu wasikupanga lwebo. Lyelede kuba amisumpululu yone azibikilo zyoone.
Yoonse misumpululu yalubaya iyelede kuba atuubulo twasiliva, zikobekelo zyasiliva azikazikilo zyamukuba.

Bulamfu bwalubaya bwelede kuba tukokola tuli mwaanda , ibbazu lyalo libe tukokola tuli mwaanda, Ibbazu lyalo libe tukokola makumi masanu aamasani mebesi awosedwe ilengelede bwanda boonse, azibikilo zyamukuba.
Zyoonse zibelesyo zyelede kubelesegwa mubbakasa lyakukkombela , antomwe aampeki zyatente lyabbakasa alubaya zyelede kulundwa amukuba.
Welede kulayilila ibantu baIzilayeli kuti bete mafuta amu-oliva, isalala asinidwe aamalampi kuchitila kuti ayake chindi choonse.

Mutente lyakuswananinwa, anze amulembo ulikunembo lyadumba lyakukombela libambide bbokesi lyabukamboni, Aaloni abana bakwe balombe belede kubambala malampi kuyaka kunembo lyaJehova kuzwa goko kuyosika kuseni. Eechi chiyandikana kuba mulawu utamani kumazyalani abantu ba Izilayeli.
Lyiitile Aloni mukulana wako abana bakwe balombe - Nadabu, Abbihu, Eliyaza, a Itamala - kuzwa akati kabana baIsilayeli kuchitila kuti bandibelekele mbuli bapayizi.
Welede kuchitila Aloni, mukulana wako, zisamo zisalidwe kulindime. Ezi zisamo zinoli zyabulemu bwakwe abweebesi.
Welede kwaambula kubantu boonse balaabusongo mumoyo, abo mbindakazuzya amuya wabusongo, kuchitila kuti nga bala chitila Aloni zisano zitamuchite kuba kubbazu kubelekela ndime mbuli mupayizi wangu.

Zisamo ezyo nzibelede kuchita nzyakukaango, efodi, logwe, jansi lyabbulukwe, aluchinda , amwinga nkwa. Belede kuchita zisamo ezi zisalidwe kulindime. Zinoli zyamukulana wako Aloni abana bakwe kuti nga bandibelekele mbuli bapayizi.
Basikuluka belelde kubelesya sila bbotu nkookuti yangolide, muteme, musinzanyangu, azisalalisya.
Belede kuchita efodi yangolide, yasyamuteme, musinaanyangu, alyamasila antwayini. Welede kuba mulimu wamuntu upedwe kukozya.
Yelede kuba aazipanzi zibili zyamakwiko zijananizidwe kumoombe ibili yatala.
Mukumba ukuzwidwe kabotu welede kuba mbuli efodi; chelede kuchitwa achintu chomwe a efodi, lichitidwe asila lyangolida, syamuteme, musinzanyangu, achisalalisya.
Welede kubweza mabwe aabili aa kisi akwaalemba alingawo mazina abana  ba Isilayeli.
Mazina aabo alimusanu alimwi ayelede kuba aabbwe lyomwe, amazina alimusanu alimwi ayelede kuba alilimbi bbwe, mukutobelana akuzyalwa kwabana.
Amulimu wasikulemba mubbwe, mbulimukulembwa kuli achitondezyo, welede kulemba mabwe aabili ali amazina abana ba Isilayeli. Welede kwiilika mabwe muzikkalilo zyagolide.

Welede kubika mabwe aabili azipanzi zyamakwibo a Efodi, kuti abe mabwe akuyeeya bana baJehova aatala abana ba Isilayeli. Aloni uyobweza mazina aabo kunembo lyaJehova amakwibo akwe abili mbuli chiyeezyo kulinguwe.
Welede kupanga zikkalilo zyagolide
amacheni aabili aalukene angolide ngingini mbuli lusungo, alimwi welede kujatanizya macheni kuzikkalilo.
Welede kuchita chakukaango chakupangisya mizeezo, mulimu wasimulimu ukonzesya, ubambidwe mbuli efodi. Ichitwe agolide, syamuteme, musinzaaanyangu abulowa busalisya, abwasila bbotu.
Cheelede kwelana mabazu oonse one. Welede kuvunga chakukaango twiindulwidwe. chelede kuba chaampa chomwe busasa.
Welede kubika mulinchicho milongo yone yamabwe mayandisi. Mulongo mutaanzi ube a lubbi, a topazi, a ganeti.
Mulongo wabili welede kuba a emalaludi, safile, a dayamondi.
Mulongo watatu welede kuba a jasinti, a geti, a ametisiti.
Mulongo wane welede kuba a bbeleleli, a onikisi ajasipa. Mwelede kwayilika muzikkalilo zyangolide.
Mabwe ayelede kubambwa mbuli mazina abana baIsilayeli. Ayelede kuba mbuli malembelo ali anwenwe yachitondezyo, izina alimwi kalyiimikilila mikowa ili kkumi ayibili.
Welede kuchita alichakukaango macheni mbuli lusungo, mulimu ulukidwe wangolida nginingini.
Welede kuchita nwenwe zibili zyangolide zya chakukaango alimwi welede kuzijatanisya kumyombe iibili ya chakukaango.
Welede kujatanisya macheni angolida kumabazu amyombe ya chakukaango.
Welede kujatanisya imwi mitwe yamacheni alukibwe  kuzikkalilo zyobile. Mpawo welede kujatanizya eezyo kuzipanzi zyamakwibo a efodi nkwili kunembo.
Welede kupanga nwenwe zyobile zyagolide, alimwi welede kuzibika kumabbazu abili aachakukaango, kumupendelo kuswena kumoombe wamukati.
Welede kupanga alubo zimbi nwenwe zibili zyangolide alubo welede kuzijatanizya ansi kwazipanzi zibili zyamakwiko zyakunembo lya efodi munsi amombe atala lyamukumba ubambidwe kabotu waefodi.

Belede kwaanga chakukaango anwenwe yacho kunwenwe ya efodi zilalusungo lyasyamuteme kuchitila kuti nga chilajatikizya kwinda biyo lukumba lwa efodi lulukidwe. Echi chiliboobu chichitilwa kuti chakukaango chitabi chitajatene kuzwa ku efodi.
Elyo Aloni nanjila mubusena busalala, welede kubweza mazina abana baIsilayeli atala lyamoyo wakwe muchipanzi chakukaango chakupanga mizeezi, mbuli chiyeezyo cheendelela kunembo lyaJehova.

Welede kubika Yulimu aTumimu muchipanzi chakukaango chakupanga mizeezo, kuti bakabe atala lyamoyo wa Aloni elyo naya kunembo lya Jehova. Nkokuti Aloni unoli kabweza lyonse zyakubamba mizezo yabantu ba Isilayeli atala amoyo kunembo lya Jehova.
Uyopanga logwe lya efodi lyonse lyaluchinda lyasyamuteme.
lyeelede kuba abbanga lyasyamuteme akati. Ibbanga lyelede kuba aalupeto luzyunguluka kuchitila kuti litadeluki. Oyu welede kuba mulimu wasikuluka.
Ansi aalupeto mwelede kupanga mapomegilaneti asyamuteme, musinzanyangu , abuyale busalalisya kabuzyungulukide . Milangu yangolide yelede kuba akati kazyoonse zizyungulukide.
Kwelede kube  mulangu wangolide a pomegilaneti, mulangu wangolide a pemogilaneti - alubo kaziya buya - kuzyunguluka lupeto lwalogogwe.
Ilogwe lyelede libe ali Aloni elyo nabeleke , kuchitila kuti kulila kwayo imwike  elyo nanjila mubusena busalala kunembo lyaJehova  alubo elyo nazwa. Ezi ziliboobo kuti atafwi.
Welede kuchita ndido yangolide nginingini akulemba alinjiyo, mbuli  bulembo buli achitondezyo, ''Kusalala kuli Jehova.''
Welede kujatanisya ndido eyi zyaalusungo yasyamuteme kunembo lyachibikilo.

Chelede kuba ankumu ya Aloni; Welede kunyampuka lyoonse kufumbwa bubi bunga bulajanwa kuzipayizyo zyazipo zisalala ezyo bana Isilayeli nzibakabika kulubazu lwa Jehova . Chibikilo chelede kuti lyoonse chibe kunkumu  yakwe kuti Jehova nga ulatambula zipo zyabo.
Welede kuchita jansi asila bbotu, akubamba chikalilo cha sila bbotu. Welede kuchita alubo sila lyamwinga nkwa, mulimu wasikusuma.
Zyabana baAloni, welede kupanga majansi, mwingankwa, amincinda yakumutwe zyabulemu bwabo abwebesi.
Welede kusamika Aloni mukulana wako, abana bakwe kabali anguwe. Welede kubananika, ubakombele, akubabika kulubazu lwangu, kuchitila kuti bakandibelekele mbuli bapayizi.
Welede kubachitila zyakusama zyakunsi zyamasila kuvumba nyama zyabo zyazintanda, ezyo ziyobavumba kuzwa muchibuno kusika muzibelo.

Aloni abana bakwe belede kusama zisamo ezi elyo nibanjila mutente  lyakubunganina naa elyo nibasika achipayililo kukubeleka mubusena busalala. Belede kuchita eezi kuti kuti batakabi abubi nkambo inga balafwa. Oyu ngumulawo walyoonse wa Aloni  abasilunyungu lwakwe musule lyakwe.

Lino eezzi nzinzyo                                                                                             nzyotakachite kukubasalazya kuchitila kuti bandimanine milimu mbuli mupayizi. Bweeza musune momwe muniini a mbelele zyobile kakutakwe katongauka,
chinkwa chitakwe buseezyo, azibunge zitakwe busezyo zyavwelanisigwa amafuta. Aboobo mubweze zibunge zitakwe busweezyo zinanikidwe mafuta. Muchite zibunge kubelesya busu bunante bwewiti.
Mukazibikke muchizuma chomwe, mukazyeete muchizuma alimwi mukazitondezye amusune wangombe alimwi amigutu yobile yambelele.
Mwelede kutondeezya Aloni abana bakwe balombe kumulyango watente lyakubunganina. Mwelede kosanzya Aloni abana bakwe balombe mumaanzi.
Mwelede kubweza zizwaato akuzwatika Aloni ejansi, chikole cha efodi, efodi, achipanzi chakukango mwaange chitete- chikumba chalukkumba lwamuchikungu cha efodi kachimuzungulukide.
Ukabikke tebbeni amutwe wakwe akubikka musini usalala aajulu engwani.
Eelyo bweza mafuta aakunanika alimwi uwatile ejulu lyamutwe wakwe, alimwi muleyi nzila uwananike.
Welede kweeta bana bakwe balombe akubazwatika  majansi aali mboobo. Welede kuzwatika Aloni abana bakwe balombe alutambo akubazwatika zikobela amunene mumutwe yabo.
Milimu yabupayizi iyoba yabokwamilayo myinimyini. Muleyi nzila welede  kulangisisya Aloniabana bakwe balombe kuli mbaabo kuti bakandimanine milimu.
Mwelede kuyeta basunu boonse kunembo lya tente lyakubunganina, alimwi Aloni abana bakwe balombe belede kubbikka  maanzi aabo ajulu amitwe  yazyo.
Mwelede kujaya basune kunembo lyaJehova amulyang watente lyakuswangano.
Mwelede kubweza limwi gaze lyabasune akulibika ameja  akuchipayililo aminwe gaze, alimwi mwelede kuyotila limwi gaze alubuwa lwachipayililo.
Mwelede kubweza oonse mafuta avumbidwe zipanzi zyamukati, alimwi mubweze kabiyo chivumbyo chachini ensa zyobile amafuta aali azninzyo, mukazitente zyoonse achipayililo.
Pesi mbuli nyama yabasune, kabiyo azikkumba zyabo amasya , mwelede kozitente aanze alubuwa lwakuswanana. Chiyoba chipo chabubi.
Mwelede kubweza kabiyo mugutu wa mbelele womwe, Aloni abana bakwe balombe beleede kubika maboko aabo amitwe yazyo.
Mwelede koojaya kagutu kambelele eelyo mukabweze mgazi lyazyoakwisansila kuli oonse mabazu achipayililo.
Mwelede konenga kagutu wambelele muzipanzi zipanzi akusanzya zyamukati amawulu awo aachipayililo.
Eelyomukatente yoonse mbelele. Chiyoba chipayizyo chitentendwe kuli Jehova, bwema bobotu, chipayizyo chichitidwe kuli Jehova aamulilo.
Mwelede kabiyo kuyobweza umwi mugutu wambelele, alimwi Aloni abana bakwe balombe beleede kuyobikka maanza aabo amutwe wacho.

Eelyo welede kuyojaya mugutu wambelele akobweeza alimwi ngaze lyawo. Mukabikke kumpela lyakutwi lwa Aloni lwakuchilisyi. Alimwi akumpela lyamatwi akuchilisyo abana bakwe balombe, aazyala zyako zyamaboko achilisyo, akutunwe twabo tupati twakumaulu  akuchilisyo. Eelyo mwelede kosansila gaze kamwimina achipayilo kumabazu oonse.

Mwelede kobweza alimwi gaze eelyo liiliachipayililo aamwi mafuta akunanika, alimwi mukamusansuile oonse Alonoi azisamo zyakwe, alimwiaboobo kubana bakwe balombe akuzisamo zyabo. Aloni uyosalazigwa eelyo kulindime, nkikaakoezisamo zyabo, abana bako balombe anguwe.

Mwelede koobweza mafuta amugutu wambeleele , emuchila unenede , amafuta aayo avumbide zyamukaati, chivumbyo chaachini, insa zyobilezyakuchilisyo- chamugutu wanbeleleoyu chamupayizikukunanikwa kwakwe kulindime.
Bweza chinkwa chomwe, chibunge chachinkwa chchitwa aamafuta aamafuta achitwa achibunge chomwe kuzwa muchizuma chachinkwa chitakwe busweesyo eecho chili kunembo lya Jehova.
Mwelede kubika eezi mumaboko a Aloni amumaboko abana bakwe balombe akuzinyampula kunembo lyangu kuchipo chinyampwidwe kunembo lyaJehova.
Mulelede eelyo kuyobweza chakulya chizwa mumaboko aabo akuchitenta kuchipayililo achipo chitentendwe  chiyogwisya bwema bubotu kulindime, chiyooba chipayizyochichitimdwe kulindime amulilo.
Mwelede kobweza mpongo kuchisamo chakaango. Aloni kakupedekezegwa kwakwe akunyampuka kujulu kuchipo chinyampwidwe kunembo lya Jehova , alimwi chiyoba chipanzi chako.

Mwelede kondisalazya nkolo zyakunyampulwa kwazipo eezyo zinyampwidwe, achibelo eecho chakalikugwisigwa kumu payizi_ zyobile nkolo eezyo zyakanyampwidwe, achibelo eecho chaka gisisigwe  Aloni abana bakwe balombe.
Eechi chiyayinkilila anembo chipo cha Aloni abana bakwe balombe. Kuyoba kubunganisya kwazipo kuzwa kuma Izilayili kukupeda kuli Jehova kuzipanzi zyazipo zyabo.
Zisamo zisalala zya Aloni ziyolondolwa kabiyo mulunyungu lwakwe musule lyakwe. Bayonanikwa muli mbabo amulimu mupati kulindime muli mbaabo.
Mupayizi umuzwidilizya kuzwa akati kabana bakwe, ooyo uza mutenti lyamuswangano kukuzondimanina mulimu aabusena busalala, uyozwata nzizyeezyo zisamo kwamazuba musanuaabili.
Mwelede koobweza mugutu wambelele kulindime kukupegwa busena bwaba payizikulindime alimwi mukajike nyama  yawo mubusena busalalisya.
Aloni abana bakwe balombe welede kulya nyama yamugutu wambelele achinkwa eecho chilimuchi zuma chili amulyango watenti lyamuswangano.

Belede kulya nyama achinkwa eecho chakapedwe kukubbadala kuli mbaabo akubananika, kuti basalazigwe kuli ndime. Taakwe naba oomwe uyolya chakulya eecho nkaambo bayochibweza mbuli chisalazigilwe kuli ndime, chilondendwe kulindime.
Kuti  imwi nyama  yachipo chabunanike, nikuba chimwi chachinkwa, chisyaala buseni butobela, eelyo mwelede kochitenta. Tachelede kolyiigwa nkaambo chiindi chasalazigwa kulindime.
Muli eeyi nzila, kukutobela zyoonse eezyo nzindamulayilila kuti muchite, mwelede kobweza Aloni abana bakwe balombe. Kwamazuba musanun aabili mwelede kobabambila.

Woonse mazuba mwelede kpeda musune mbuli chipo chisofwede chakubweda lulana. M welede kusalazya chipayililo akuchichita lubwedululano kulinchincho, alimwi mwelede kuchinanika kuchitila kuti chisalazigwe kulindime.
Kwamazuma musanu aabili mwelede mwelede kubweda kuchipayililo akuchisalazya kuli Jehova. Eelyo chipayilo chiyosalazigwa bumaninide kulindime. Nikuba chijata chipayililo chiyosalala kuli Jehova.
Mweledekuyindulula kupa achipayililo buzuba abuzuba  mbelele zyobile zilaminyaka womwe wakuzyalwa.
Mbelele yomwe mwelede kwipeda kuseni alimwi imwi mbelele mwelede kwipeda nilyabbila zuba.
Embelele ntaanzi, pa chakkumi cha efa chabusu bunante buvwelanisigwe achipanzi chane  che hini yamafuta kuzwa kumafuta a Oliva adinidwe , alimwi achipanzi chachinechahini ya wayini

Mwelede kupeda mbelele  yabili kumabbililo azuba. Mwelede kupeda chipo kuzilyo zikonzyania mbuli chilyo chakuseni, achipo chakunwa chikonzyania. Eezi ziyoyeta bweema bununkilila kulindime, chiyoba chipayizyochachitwa kulindime amulilo.
Eezi  ziyoba zipayizyo zitentwa kwindilundwi kuzwa kumazyalane eenu, kumulyango watente lyamuswangano kunrmbo lya Jehova, oko nkutakaswanane andime kukuyowambula anywebo nkuko.
Ooku nkuko nkwitakaswanane abana ba Izilayili, itenti iyosalazigwa kulindime mubulemu.
Ndiyosalazya tenti lyamuswanganoachipayililo kuli eezi kuti zikabe zyangu  andikke. Aboobo ndiyosalazya Aloni abana bakwe balombe kuti bakandimanine milimu mbuli bapayizi.
Ndiyopona aakati kabana ba Izilayili akuyoba Leza wabo.
Bayoziba kuti ndime Jehova Leza wabo wakabagwisya kuzwa kunyika ya Ijipiti kuchitila kuti ndikapone aakati kaabo. Ndime Jehova, Leza wabo.
Ukachite chipayililo chakutentela tunkilizyo. Ukachichite azisamu zyamuuna.
Bulamfu  bwacho bukabe tukokola tobile. Meja acho ayelede kuchitwa chimpanzi chimwi anchicho.
Uyelede kuvumba chipayililo chatununkilizyo angolida isalala - ajulu lyacho, mabazu acho, ameja acho. Ukachite chizyunguluko chamuganu wenolide yacho.
Ukachite nwenwe zyobile zyengolide kuti zikajatane kunsi lyamugano kumabazu acho alangene. Inwenwe zikabe zijatizyo zyazisamu kukubwezesya chipayililo.
Ukachite masamu azisamu zyamuunga, ukazivumbe angolide.

Ukabike chipayililo chatununkilizyo kunembo lyamulembo eelyo lili kubbokesi lyabukamboni. Chinoli kunembo amulyango wakubwedululana oyo unoli ajulu achibbokesi  yabukamboni, oko nkwesika swanane anduwe.
Aaloni welede kutenta tununkilizyo tulaabwema bununikilila mukucheda chifumo. Welede kutenta elyo nayasya lampi,
Aaloni uyasya lampi alimwi golezya kuti tununkilizyo tupye mulinchicho lyoonse kunembo lya Yahweh kuzwa mumazyalane enu.
Pesi tuyelede kupayilila tununkilizyo tumbi achipayililo chatununkilizyo, nikuba chomwe chitentwa chipayizyo nikuba chipayililo chazilyo. Toyelede kutila chipayizyo chakunywa alinchicho.
Aaloni welede kumana milandu kumeja alyo kamwi amunyaka. Aganzi lyachipayizyo lyachibi uyomana milandu kamwi amunyaka kwinda mumazyalane enu. Chili maninide kusalazigwa kuli Jehova.''
Lino Yahweh wakambula kuli Mozesi, wakati,
''Niwayobala bantu bakwa Izilayeli, mpawo umwi awumwi, uyopa chipo chakuvunia bwakwe kuli Jehova.  Muyochita echi nimwakuzwa akubabala, kuchitila kuti kutakabi ntenda pe akati kabo nimwayobabala.

Wonse muntu ubalidwe kukabalwebalwe uyobbadala chimpanzi chasekeli lyansiliva, kwindila mubulemu bwasyekeli lyachikombelo ( Sekeli lilakozyania mbuli makumi obile amagelasi ). Echi chibela chasekeli chiyoba makumi chipayizyo kuli Yahuwe.
Wonse muntu ubalidwe, kuzwa kuminyaka makumi obile akuzyaligwa nkaziya kunembo, welede kupa chipayizyo kulindime.
Elyo bantu nibayoopa chipo echi kulindime kuchitila kumaninsya milandu yabuumi bwabo, bavubi tabelede kupa kwinda achibeela chasekeli, alimwi bafwaba tabeelede kupa ziche.

Welede kutambula mali eyi yakumaninsya milandu kuzwa kuba Izilayeli alimwi muyoyibika kumilimo yatente lyakubunanina. Chelede kuba chibalusyo kuba Izilayeli kunembo lyangu, kumania milandu yabuumi bwabo.''
Mpawo Jehova wakambula kuli Mozesi, wakati,
''Welede kuchita ibbede ipati lyamukuba kalila chikkazikilo chamukuba, ibbede lyakusambila. Uyolibika aakati katente lyakubunanina achipayililo, alimwi welede kubika maanzi mulindilyo.
Aaloni abana bakwe boonse belede kusamba maboko abo amawulu abo amanzi alii mulindilyo.
Eelyo nibayoyinka mutente lyakubunanina nikuba nibayoswena afwifwi achipayililo kukundimanina milimu akuumpa chipayizyo, belede kusamba amanzi kuti batakafwi.
Belede kusamba maboko abo amawulu abo kuchitila kuti batafwi. Eechi chelede kuba mulawu kwalyoonse wa Aaloni alunyungu lwakwe kuzwa kumazyalane abantu babo.''
Mpawo Yahweh wakambula kuli Mozesi wakati,
''Bweza obu butwizyo bunante : myanda ilimusanu yasekeli ya muula ukunka, 250 masekeli alabweema bununkilila sinamoni, 250 masekeli alabwema bunkilila bwamisale,
miyanda ilimusanu yamasekeli ya kkasiya, kiyeledwe abulemu bwa sekeli abusena bwakulisalazya, antomwe akankuli kamwi kamafuta a olifa.
Welede kuchita mafuta akunanika asalala avwelanisizigwe obu, imulimu wasikupanga muunde. Ayoba mafuta akunanika asalala, abambilidwe ndime.
Welede kunanika itente lyakubunganina amafuta aya, nkabela kulelede abbokesi lyabukamboni,
itebuli antomwe azyonse zibelesyo zyalyo, chikkazikilo chelampi azibelesyo zyacho, tununkilizyo twachipayizyo,
chipayililo chakutentela zipo azyonse zibelesyo zyacho, ibbede achikkazikilo chalyo.
Uyelede kuzipambwida ndime zibe zisalali kuli ndime. Kufumbwa echo chitakazigume achilacho chiyosalala.
Welede kumunanika Aaloni abana bakwe balombe akuba pambwida kulindime kuchitila kuti baka ndimanine milimu mbuli bapayizi.
Welede kwambila bana ba Izilayeli, ''Aya ayelede kuba mafuta akunanika apambwidwe kabikilidwe mbali kuli Yahweh kwinda mumazyalane abantu boonse.
Tayelede kunanikwa achikanda chamuntu, nikuba kuchita amwi mafuta alimbuli aya munzila ikozyenie, nkambo aya apambididwe Yahuwe. Welede kuzichita mbuleyi inzila.
Kufumbwa uuchita muunde ukozyenie anawo, nikuba ubika umwi wawo alumwi, oyo muntu uyelede kugwisiwa kuzwa kubantu bakwe.''
Yahuwe wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Bweza butwizyo - amasitekisi, ama onika, alimwi a galubbanumu - abutwizyo bunona antomwe atununkilizyo tunambene, ayimwi myeelwe iyelene.
Mukayichite muchiimo chatununkilizyo, avwenganisigwe amuntu uchita muunde, alunidwe amwinyo, unambene upambwidwe.
Muyowuziya ukabe muvwelevwele  munante mukawubike kumbali abbokesi lyakubukamboni, elyo lilimutente lyakubunganina, oko nkutakaswanane andinywe. Muyochitola mbuli chintu chisalalisya kulindime.
Atwalo otu tununkilizyo ntoyochita, toyelede kuchita tumwi tununkilizyo twenu anzila ikozyenie. Twelede kuba katusalalisya kuli ndinywe.
Kufumbwa uuchita chimwi chikozyania acho kubelesya mbuli muunde uyogwisigwa kuzwa kubantu bakwe.''
Lino Yawe wakambula kuli Mozesi, wakati,
''Bona, ndamwita ezina Bbezalili mwana mulombe wa Uli kali mwana mulombe wa Hee, wakumukowa wa Juda.
Ndazuzya Bbezaleli a Muuya wangu, kumupa busongo, kumvwisisisya, alimwi aluzibo, lwakukonzya kuchita milimu isiyenesiyene,
kubamba, akuchita milimo yamaboko chabuchenjezu abusongo, alimwi akubelesya ngolida, nsiliva abutale;
alimwi kutema akubamba mabwe akubeza zisamu- kuchita milimu yoonse yaluzibo amaboko.

Mukuyungizya kuli nguwe, ndasala Oholiyabbu mwana mulombe wa Ahisamaki, wamukowa wa Deni. Ndabika kukonzya kwabuchenjezu mumyoyo yabaabo  boonse basongo, kuchitila kuti bachite zyoonse nzindakakulayilila ezi zijatikizya
iteente lyakuswanana abbokesi lyabukamboni, chivunisyo chalulekelelo chilabbokesi azilongo zyoonse zyamutente
itafula azibelesyo zyalyo, achizikitizyo chiini chalambi azibelesyo zyacho zyoonse, chitentelo atununkilizyo,
achitentelo chazipo zyakuumpilizya azibelesyo zyacho zyoonse, amutiba mupati achikkazikilo chawo.
Eezi zijatikizya zikobela zinantisigwe kulukwa, zikobela zisalala zya Aloni mupayizi azeziya zyabana bakwe balombe, babambilidwe ndime kuti bazoobeleke mbuli bapayizi.
Eezi azilazyo zijatikizya mafuta abunanike atununkilizyo tunono twabusena busalala. Aaba bazibi bamilimu yabuchenjezu kumaboko bayelede kuchita zintu zyoonse ezi mbubonya mbunda kulayilila.''
Lino Yawe wakati kuli Mozesi,

''Kowambila bana ba Izilayeli: ''Nchobeni mwelede kubamba buzuba bwa sabata ya Yawe. nkambo ezi chiyooba chitondezyo aakati kakwe andinywe kwinda mumazyalani aabantu kuchitila kuti mukazibe kuti ngu Yawe ulipambwida ndinywe.

Aboobo amubambe masabata nkambo kulijata mbuli basalali, libambilidwe nguwe. Wonseni imuntu ulinyongania nchobeni welede kujayigwa. Kufumbwa uubeleka musabata, Ooyo muntu nchobeni welede kudyunkulwa kuzwa  kubantu bakwe.

Mulimu uyochiwa mumazuba musanu abumwi pele izuba lyamusanu aabili lyelede kuba Sabata lyakulyokezya kuzwide, lisalala kunembo lya Yawe. Kufumbwa uuyochita mulimu nuuba ulibyeni munsabata nchobeni welede kujayigwa.
Aboobo bana ba Izilayeli bayelede kubamba Sabata. Bayelede kwibamba mumazyalani aabantu baabo mbuli chizuminano chikkalilila.
Isabata lyoonse iyoba chitondezyo aakati ka Yawe abana ba Izilayeli, nkambo mumazuba musanu alimwi Yawe wakachita ijulu anyika, alimwi mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili wakalyokezya alimwi wakakkatalukwa.''
Leza nakamana kwambula a Mozesi achilundu cha Sinayi, wakamupa mapapali obile amabwe akalembedwe chizuminano, akalembedwe aluboko lwakwe mwini.

Bantu nibakabona kuti Mozesi wanonoka kuseluka kuzwa muchilundu, bakabunganina Aaloni akumwambila kuti, ''koboola, tuchitile chikozyanio kuti chikeende kunembo lyesu. Nkambo kaboobu Mozesi, mwalumi wakatugwisya kuzwa munyika ya Ijiputi , tatuzi pe kuti niinzi chakachitika kulinguwe.
Aboobo Aaloni wakati kulimbabo, ''Amugwisye malangulangu angolida woonse ali kumatwi abanakazi benu akumatwi abana benu balombe abasimbi mwayete kulindime.''
Boonse bantu bakagwisya malangulangu angolida oonse ngibakalisamikide kumatwi abo akwayeta kuli Aaloni.
Wakatambula ingolida kuzwa mumaboko abo wabumba - bumba achibelesyo wachita chikozyanisyo chakanamani. Eelyo wakati, ''aba mbaleza benu, Izilayeli, bakamugwasya munyika ya Ijipita.''
Aaloni nakabona eechi, wakayaka chipayililo kunembo akanamani mpawo waambilizya: wakati, ''Ijunza kunolipobwe lyakulemeka Jehova.''
Bantu bakafuma kubuka buzuba butobela bapa chipayizyo chakutenta mpawo beeta zyakulya zyakulyida amwi. Eelyo bakakkala aansi kuti balye akunywa, mpawo bakanyampuka akusobana.
Mpawo Jehova wakambila Mozesi kuti, ''Koya chakufwambana, nkambo bantu bako, mbwakagwisya munyika ya Ijipita balinyongania.
Bafwambana basiya inzila eeyo njindakabalayilila. Babumba chikozyanio muchiimo chakanamani bakaamba kuti, ''Aaba mbaaleza benu, Izilayeli, aabo bakamugwisya munyika ya Ijipita.''
Eely Yawe wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Ndabona bantu aaba. Langa, mbayumu mikosi.
Elyo lino, uteezyi kundimikizya bukali bwangu buyoba buyobawumpa, Eyo ndiyobazimania. Mpawo ndiyochita chisi chipati kuzwa kulinduwe.''
Pesi Mozesi wakeezya kutontoozya Yawe Leza wakwe. Wakati, ''Yawe, nkamboonzi lunyemo lwako nilwayaka atala abantu bako, aabo mbiwakagwisya kuzwa munyika ya Ijipita anguzu mpati akuboko kulenguzu?

Nkamboonzi ba Izilayeli nibamba kuti, wakabazulwida amoyo mubi kuti akabajaye muzilundu akubazimania kuzwa kubusyu bwanika? Kochengunuka kuzwa kubukali bwako buumpa akuzwa kuchizuminano chachisubulo chili abantu bako.

Koyeya Abbulahamu a Ayizeki  a Izilayeli, balanda bako, aabo mbiwakakonkezya kulinduwe omwini akwamba kulimbabo, ''Ndiyovuzya lunyungu lwenu mbuli inyenyezi zili mumajulu, mpawo ndiyopa lunyungu lwenu loonse inyika eeyi njindakaamba. Bayoyikona  kwalyoonse.''
Mpawo Yawe wakalekelela bantu bakwe kuchisubulo nchakali wayanda kubapa.
Eelyo Mozesi wakachengunuka akuseluka kuzwa kuchilundu, kajisi mabwe aabili mapapali amilawu yechizuminano mujanza lyakwe. Aayo mabwe akali lembedwe kumabazu oonse, kunembo akusule.
Mabwe akulimulimu wakwe Leza, abulembo bwakali bulembo bwakwe bwa Leza, bwakali lembedwe amabwe.
Joshuwa nakamvwa kuyowela kwabantu nibakali koompolola, wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Kuli kuyowela kwenkondo mumusasa.
Pesi Mozesi wakati, ''Tekompolola kwasikuzunda pe, alimwi tekuyowela kwabantu bazunda pe, pesi nkuyowela kwakwimba nkwendilokumvwa.''
Mozesi nakasika kumusasa wakabona kanamani, abantu kabali kuzyana. Wakanyema loko. Wakawala ansi mabwe mapapali kuzwa mumaboko akwe akwapanduula munsi lyachilundu.
Wakabweza kanamani ako wakawumpa, wakakuuya bwaba busu, mpawo wabubika mumanzi. Mpawo wakachita kuti bantu ba Izilayeli banywe.
Aboobo Mozesi wakati kuli Aaloni, ''Ino niinzi bantu aaba nchibachita kulinduwe, chachita kuti weete chibi chipati chiliboobu kulimbabo?''
Aaloni wakati, ''Utaleki bukali bwako kuti buumpe, simalelo wangu. Ulibezi bantu aaba, mbubazibide kuchita bubi.
Bakati kulindime, tuchitile leza utende kunembo lyesu. Nkambo ooyu Mozesi, mwalumi wakatugwisya munyika ya Ijipita tatuzipe kuti ninzi chakachitika kulinguwe.
Eelyo ndakamba kuti kulimbabo, ''Wonse ujisi kufumbwa ngolida, ngayizunune.'' Bakandipa ingolida mpawo ndakayiwalila mumulilo, kuzwawo kwakazwa kanamani.''
Mozesi nakabona kuti bantu banyongana ( nkambo Aaloni wakabachita kuti bakake kwendelezegwa,zyakachita kuti basinkondonyina babaniake )
Eelyo Mozesi wakayimikila kumulyango wamusasa akwamba kuti, ''Woonse ulikubbazu lya Yawe, ngaboole kulindime.'' Boonse ba Levi bakabungana kulinguwe.

Wakati kulimbabo, Yawe, Leza waba Izilayeli, wamba eechi: 'Mwalumi umwi awumwi aange ipanga lyakwe kubbazu lyakwe abwede musule akuya kunembo kuzwa kumulyango akumulyango wamusasa woonse, ajaye mwana wakwabo, mwenzinyina, a simayakilane wakwe.''
Ba Levi bakachita muli Mozesi mbwakabalayilila. Mubuzuba oobo bantu bakasisike kuzyulu zitatu zyabakafwide.
Mozesi wakati kuli Levi, sunu, nkambo umwi awumwi wenu wabweza ntamo atala amwana wakwe amwana wabanyina, kuti Yawe amupe choolwe sunu.''
Mubuzuba butobela Mozesi wakati kubantu, ''Mwakachita chibi chipati loko. Lino ndilatanta kuli Jehova. Antena inga ndlachita kuti mulekelelwe chibi chenu.''
Mozesi wakabweda kuli Yawe wamba kuti, ''Maawe, aaba bantu bakachita chibi chipati alimwi balibumbila chileza changolida. Pesi lino, weenche balekelele chibi chabo;
Pesi kuti tewachita mbubobo, kondizima mubbuku ndiwakalemba.''
Yawe wakati kuli Mozesi, kufumbwa wakandibisizya, ooyo muntu ndiyomuzima kuzwa mubbuku lyangu.
Aboobo lino koya uzulwide bantu kuya kubusena nkundakakwambila. Bona mungelo wangu uyoyenda kunembo lyako. Pesi mubuzuba mbundiyobasubula, ndiyobasubula nkambo kachibi chabo.''
Yawe wakatuma chisubulo kubantu nkambo bakabumba kanamani, aako Aaloni nkakababumbila.

Mpawo Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi, ''Yinka kuzwa aano, webo abantu aabo mbuwakagwisya kuzwa muchisi cha Ijipiti. Yinka kunyika eeyo njindakakonkezya kuli Abbulahamu, kuli Ayizeki, akuli Jakkobo, eelyo nindakati, 'Ndiyoyipa kulunyungu lwako.'
Ndiyotuma mutumwa kunembo lyako, alimwi ndiyowanda baKkanana, abaAmoli, abaHiti, abaPelizi, abaHivi, abaJebusi.
Kamuya kunyika eeyo ikunka malili abuchi, pesi nsikoyooyinka andinywe, nkaambo mulibantu bayumu myoyo. Ulabona ndaakumujaya.''
Eelyo bantu nibakamvwa majwi aaya aamakatazyo, bakalila, alimwi takwe naba omwe wakasama bulungu.

Jehova mbakaambila Mozesi, ''Ambila bana ba Izilayeli, 'Muli bantu bayumu myoyo. Na ndeenda aakati kenu nikuba muchiindi chinini, ndilakonzya kumujaya. Ikwalino amuzwatunune bulungu bwanu kuchitila kuti nkaliyeeyele kuti njoochitaayi andinywe.'''
Akaako ba Izilayeli nibakasama bulungu bwabo kuzwa kuchilundu cha Holebbu akuya kunembo.

Mozesi wakabweza tente akulikankamina aanze amusasa, kulekule kuzwa kumusasa. Wakati nditente lyakubunganina. Woonse uukumbila kuli Jehova kufumbwa nchayanda ayinke kutente lyambunganino, aanze amusasa.
Eelyo Mozesi nakalikuzwa kuya kutente, bantu boonse bakalikwiimikila amilyango yamatente aabo akulanga Mozesi kusikila akanjile mukati.
Chiindi choonse Mozesi nakali kunjila mutente, musumpuululu wajoba wakali kusika aansi akwiimikila kumulyango watente, alimwi Jehova wqkqlikwaambula kuli Mozesi.
Chiindi choonse bantu boonse nibakali kubona musumpuulula wa joba kuyimvwi amulyango watente, bakali kubuka akukomba, awumwi muntu kumulyango watente lyakwe.

Jehova wakanoonga waambula aMozesi kubusyu-akubusyu, mbuli muntu mbawambula kumweenzinyina. Mpawo Mozesi wakanoonga wabweda kumusasa, pesi mulanda wakwe Josyuwa mwana wa Nuni, mwaalumi muniini, wakali kusyaala mutente.

Mozesi wakatik uli Jehova, ''Langa, wakalikwaamba kuli ndime, 'Bweza bantu aaba mulweendo lwabo,' pesi tewandizibya pe kuti ooyo ngotakanditume aawe ngwani. waamba wati, 'Ndilikwizi we azina, alimwi webo wajana choolwe kumenso aangu.'
Lino na ndajana choolwe kumenso aako, nditondeezye nzila zyako kuchitila kuti ndikuzibe akwiinkila kunembo kukujana choolwe kumenso aako. Koyeya kuti eeyi nyika mbantu bako.''
Jehova wakasandula, ''Buliwo bwangu ndemwini buyooyinka anywebo, alimwi ndiyomupa kulyookezya.''
Mozesi wakati kulinguwe, ''Na kuti buliwo bwako tebweenda andiswe, utatubwezi pe kuzwa aano.
Nkaambo muliimwi nzila ndiyooziba biyeni kuti ndajana choolwe kumenso aako, mebo abantu bako? Takunoli kuti na wayinka andiswe mebo abantu bako tuyoosiyana abamwi bali aatala aanyika?''
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Ndiyokuchitila eecho chintu nchuwakumbila, nkaambo wajana choolwe kumenso aangu, alimwi ndikwizi webo azina.''
Mozesi wakati, ''Ikaka nditondeezye bulemu bwako.''

Jehova wakati, ''Ndiyoochita boonse bubotu bwangu bukayinde kunembo lyako, alimwi ndiyolyaamba azina lyangu 'Jehova' kunembo lyako. Ndiyooba aaluzyalo kufumbwa ngunchiyoobeda aaluzyalo alimwi akutondeezya aaluse kufumbwa ngunchiyoobeda aaluse.''
Pesi Jehova wakati, ''Tukoyoobona busyu bwangu nkaambo takwe ubona busyu bwangu akupona.''
Jehova wakati, ''Bona, kulibusena aafwifwi andime; uyooyimikila abbwe eeli.
Kayindi bulemu bwangu nibuyooyinda aawa, ndiyokubika mulwaanzi luniini lwabbwe akukuvumba ajanza lyangu kusikila nkayinde.
Mpawo ndiyoogwisya kuboko kwangu alimwi uyoobona isule lyangu, pesi busyu bwangu tabukoyoobonwa pe.''
Yawe wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Bweza mabwe apapalete aabili mbuli akutanguna. Ndilalemba amabwe apapalete aya majwi akali amabwe akumatangunino, mabwe ngiwakapwachuula.
Koli walibambila kuseni alimwi, usike ejulu achilundu cha Sinayi, alimwi ukalitondezye kunembo lyangu ejulu lyachilundu.
Kutabi umbi uuza anduwe. Uutazumizyi naba aani kuti aboneke naaba ali achilundu. Kutabi imbelele nanka ng'ombe zichela kunembo lyachilundu.''
Eelyo Mozesi wakabeeza mabwe apapalete abili mbuli matanzi, wakabuka kuseni alimwi wakatanta achilundu chaSinayi, mbuli Jehova mbwakamulayilide. Mozesi wakabweza mabwe apapalete mujanza lyakwe.
Yawe wakaseluka aansi mujoba alimwi wakayimikila a Mozesi nkukoko alimwi wakamba izina ''lya Jehova.''
Jehova, Leza sibuya alimwi ngusiluzyalo, uutafwambani kunyema, alimwi ngusiluyando akusyomeka kuyinkilila kakufwasuka.

Ubamba luyando luteeli kuzyuulu, ulekelela bubi, ndubizyo, alimwi azibi. Nekubabobo takwe nayolekelela basizibi, uyoyeta chisubulo nkambo kachibi chabamawisi kubana babo alimwi kubazukulu, mane kuzyalane lyatatu alyaane.''
Mozesi wakafwambana kukotama alimwi wasikukomba.
Mpawo wasikuti, ''Na lino ndajana choolwe kumenso ako, Mwami wangu ikaka yenda akati kesu nkambo bantu aba mbasimutwe muyumu. Lekelela milandu yesu azibi zyesu, alimwi utubweze mbuli lukono lwako.''

Yawe wakati, ''Bona, ndaamba kuchita chizuminano kunembo lyabanrtu bako boonse, Ndilachita malele atana kuchitwa munyika yoonse nikuba muchisi nichiba ichili. Bantu boonse mbokkede abo bazobona milimu yangu, nkambo nchintu chiyoosya nchindokuchita andinywe.
Amuchite nchindimulayilila sunu. Ndamba kugwisya kunembo lyanu ma Amoli, baKkenani, ba Hiti, ba Pelizi, ba Hiviti alimwi aba Jebbusiti.
Uchenjele utakachiti chizuminano ababo bakkala munyika oko nkoyobuya, inga bayoba kakole akati kenu.
Pele mwelede kuyomwaya zipayililo zyabo, mukolomone minsi yamabwe, alimwi mutemene aansi ziyako zyabo zya Ashela.
Nkambo tamwelede pe kukomba bambi baleza, nkambo Jehova izina lyakwe ngusibuzuba,' ngu Leza sibuzuba.
Aboobo muchenjele mutachiti chizuminano abakkede munyika eyo, nkambo balaamuka abaleza babo alimwi balapayilila kuli baleza babo. Mpawo umwi wabo uyomutamba alimwi muyolya zimwi zyachipayizyo chakwe,
Kuzwa awo muyosika abakubweza bana basimbi bakwe kubapa bana banu balombe, alimwi bana basimbi bakwe bayowamuka abaleza babo, alimwi bayochita kuti bana benu balombe bakaamuke abaleza babo.
Mutalichitli baleza babumbidwe alotwe.

Mwelede kubamba pobwe lyechinkwa chitakwe busweezyo. Mbuli mbundakamulayilila, mwelede kulya chinkwa chitakwe buswezyo kwamazuba musanu aabili muchiindi chibikidwe mumwezi wa Abbibbi, nkambo kwakali mumwezi wa Abbibbi nimwakazwa mu Ijipiti.
Boonse bana batanzi mbibangu, nikuba woonse mweenze wakutanguna wazivuubwa zyako, nikuba kuzwa kung'ombe na kumbelele.

Ulelede kunununa mwana mutanzi wadonki a mwana wembelele, na wakachilwa kumuula lubo ulelede kumutyola nsingo. Ulelede kunununa boonse bana balombe batanzi. Takwe naba omwe uyelede kusika kulindime kali chinkwa-maanza.
Ulakonzya kubeleka kwamazuba musanu alimwi, pele muzuba lyamusanu aabili ulelede kulyokezya. Nikuba muchiindi chakufolola alimwi akutyola ulelede kulyookezya.
Uyelede kuyeya pobwe lyamviiki abutebuzi butanzi bwawiiti, alimwi uyelede kuyeeya a pobwe lyakubungania kwakumana kwamunyika.
Zyiindi zitatu mumunyaka balumi benu boonse belede kulibonia kunembo lya Mwami Jehova Leza wa Izilayeli.

Nkambo ndiyowanda zisi kunembo lyako alimwi ndiyoyungizya migaano yako. Takwe naba omwe uyolombozya kubweza nyika yako kuti ibe yabo kuti watanta kukuyolibonia kubusyu bwa Jehova Leza wako zyiindi zitatu mumunyaka.
Toyelede kupa bulowa bwachipayizyo changu abuswezyo, nikuba kufumbwa nyama yazwa kuchipayizyo chepobwe lya Pasika tiyelede kuchaala kusika kuseni.
Uyelede kweta kabalwebalwe kebesi kamumuunda wako kung'anda yangu. Toyelede kujika mwana wempongo mumalili abanyina.''
Yawe wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Lemba aansi majwi aya, nkambo mukwendelana amajwi aya ndilachita chizuminano anduwe alimwi a Izilayeli.''
Mozesi wakakkala oko a Jehova kwamazuba makkumi aane amansiku, takwe nakalya chakulya nikuba kunywa manzi. Wakalemba amabwe majwi achizuminano, milazyo ilikkumi.
Lino Mozesi nakaseluka aansi kuzwa kuchilundu cha Sinayi amabwe aabili achizuminano mujanza lyakwe, teensi wakalizi kuti chikumba chabusyu bwakwe chakali chamweka chiindi nakali kwambuula a Leza.
Lino Aaloni abama Izilayeli nibakabona Mozesi, chikumba chabusyu bwakwe chakali kumweka alimwi bakayoowa kuswena afwifwi kulinguwe.
Pele Mozesi wakabayita, alimwi Aaloni abazuluzi boonse bembungano bakasika kulinguwe. Mpawo Mozesi wakambuula ambabo.
Nichakayinda eechi, bantu boonse ba Izilayeli bakasika kuli Mozesi, alimwi wakabambila milayizyo yoonse Jehova njakamupa kuchilundu cha Sinayi.
Lino Mozesi nakamana kwaambula ambaabo, wakalivumba lembo kubusyu bwakwe.
Elyo lyoonse Mozesi nakalikwinka kunembo lya Yawe kukwambula aawe, walikugwisya lembo, manedo azwe aanze. Nakali kuzwa aanze, walikubambila bana ba Izilayeli ezyo nzyakalayililwa kuti azyambe.
Lino bana ba Izilayeli nibalikubona busyu bwa Mozesi kabumweka walikulivumba lubo lembo kubusyu bwakwe manedo abwede kuyowambula a Jehova.
Mozesi wakeendelezya choonse chisi chabana ba Izilayeli akwamba kuti kulimbabo ,''Eezi nzezintu ezyo Jehova nzyakamulayilila kuti muchite .

Mumazuba ali musanu alimwi mulimu unoli wachitwa, pesi kuli ndinywe, izuba lyamusanu aabili lyelede kuba zuba lisala, buzuba butegwa sabata bumaninide bwakulyokezya, busalala kuli Jehova, Nikuba boobo kuli nikuba mulimu na mubuzuba butola kulufu.
Tamwelede kuyasya mulimo nikuba mulimwi ng'anda yenu mubuzuba butegwa sabata.''
Mozesi wakambula aaluundu loonse lwaIsilayeli,wakati, '''Echi nchichitu Jehova chakalayilila.
Amubweze chipo cha Jehova,kuli boonse bala moyo uzumina.Amwete zipayizyo kuli Jehova-ingolida, ansiliva,amukuba,
simakaka,musinza wanyangu,abukkotani busalala alimwi amilembo mibotu;aboya bwa mpongo;
4 zikumba zyabagutu zichitidwe busalala azikumba zyebeka;azisamu zyamu akkasiya;
amafuta amumalampi,atununkilizyo twamafuta akunanika alimwi abwema bununkilila,
amabwe abulungusene aamwi mabwe ayebeka kukwabika ku efodi alimwi azipanzi zyakukango.
Boonse balumi balaluzibo akati kanu baleelede kusika akuchita zyoonse ezyo Jehova nzakalayilila-
kudumba lyakukombela atente lyalyo,achilivumbyo chalyo,misemo yazyo, azikunguzyo, amisemu,alimwi azikkalilo;
abbokesi amayako alyo,achivumbyo chakumana milandu, amulembo wakujazya.
Baketa tafula azisamu zyacho, azyoonse zibelesyo, alimwi achibunge chabuliwo,
achikkalilo chalampi lyamumuni; azibelesyo zyalyo, amalampi, alimwi amafuta amalampi;
atununkilizyo twachipayililo amisemo yacho, amafuta akunanika alimwi abwema bununkilila; awanzikwa amulyango wadumba lyakukombela;
chipayililo chazipayizyo zitentedwe kazilaa mukuba yacho alimwi amisemo azibelesyo;alimwi abbede pati lilachibikilo.
Bakeeta zilengelezyo kulubuwa amisemo alimwi azikkalilo, alimwi amulembo kumulyango walubuwa ;
alimwi amapegi atente zyadumba lyakukombela akulubuwa, kubikka aamwi amakole.
Bakeeta zisamo zyeebeka loko kukuzobelekela abusena busalala, zyakusama zisalala zya Aloni mupayizi abana bakwe balombe, kuti bakabeleke mbuli bapayizi.''
Mpawo boonse baluzubo lwaIsilayeli  lwakanyampuka akwenda  akuzwa kubuliwo bwa Mozesi.

Kuliwoonse uwakala moyo uumunyangania ayooyo ulamuuya achiyandisyo chakuza alimwi akweta chipayizyo kuli Jehova chakuyasya dumba lyakukombela, akuli zyonse zibelesyo zyamilimu yamukati, alimwi azyamalembo asalala.

Bakasika, boonse balumi abanakazi,boonse bakalamyoyo izumina. Bakeeta zisita, amalangulangu, anwenwe, azyakusama zyakulibotezya, ayoonse misyobo yakusama yangolida. Boonse bakapedekezya zipayizyo zyangolida mbuli chipayizyo kuli Jehova.
Boonse bakala simakaka, amusinza wanyangu, kana kuti boya busalala, amulembo uyebeka,aboya bwampongo, azikumba zyabagutu zisalala, na kuti zikumba zyeebeka bakazyeta.
Woonse muntu wakachita chipayizyo cha nsiliva nakuti chamukuba bakazyeeta mbuli zipayizyo kuli Jehova, alimwi woonseni wakala chisamu chamu akkasiya chakali kulangika kumulimu chakeetwa.
Woonse mwanakazi wakalaluzibo wakachita  bukkotani amaboko akwe alimwi bakeeta ezyo nzibakachita-zyasimakaka, azyamusinza wanyangu,azyaboya busalala, nakuti mulembo uyebeka.
Boonse banakazi bakala myooyo yakabakopa  alimwi bakalaa abusongo bakachita boya bwampongo.
Balu baketa mabwe abezedwe alimwi amabwe mebesi akabikwa mu efodi achibela  chakaango;
bakeeta butwido amafuta amumalampi, kali mafuta akunanika, akutununkilizyo tununkilila.

BaIsilayeli bakeeta chipayizyo chakulimvwida kuli Jehova; kuzwa kumwalumi akusika kumwanakazi bakala myoyo yakulimvwida bakeeta zyakubelesya zyoonse kumulimu wa Jehova ngwakabalayidide kwinda muli Mozesi kuti ukachitwe.
30 Mozesi wakati  kuli baIsilayeli,'' Amubone, Jehova wakita azina kuli Bbezaleli mwana mulombe  wa Uli amwana mulombe wa Huli, kuzwa kuluzubo lwa Juda.
Wakazuzya Bbezaleli amuuya, kukumupa busongo,akumvwisisya, amaanu, kuliwoonse mulimu wamaboko,
kukubumba zyebeka akubeleka mungolido, amunsiliva, alimwi amuli  zyamukuba;
akugonka akubikka mabwe akubeza zisamu-kuchita yoonse misyobo yazyeebeka azyababezi.
34 Wakazikka mumoyo wakwe kuti ayisye, boonse we aHoliyabu  mwana mulombe wa Ahisamaki, kuzwa kuluzubo lwa Dani.

Wakabazuzya boonse aluzibo kukuchita yoonse misyobo yamilimu ,kukubeleka mbuli basimilimu yamaboko, mbuli basikubeza masamu, ambuli basikuyala malembo yabasimakaka,ayamuzinza anyangu,ayaboya busalala azisamo zyeebeka, alimwi mbuli basikuluka.Kuli babezi kuli yoonse milimu, alimwi kuli babumba zyebeeka.

Lino Bbezaleli a Ohaliyabbu abantu boonse bala luzibo ndubapedwe a Jehova kukuziba kuchita kufumbwa mulimu mukuyaka busena busalala bayelede kuchita milimu kwindila mulizyonse ezyo Jehova nzyakabalayilila.''
Mozesi wakiita Bbezaleli, Ohaliyabbu, awonse muntu wakala luzibo ndwakapedwe  mumiyeyo, a Jehova, alimwi ababo balamyoyo yakali kupyida kuchita milimu.
Bakatambula kuzwa kuli Mozesi  zyoonse zipo nzibakali betela kuyasya busena busalala. Bantu bakachili kweta zipo zyakulimvwida chifumo achifumo kuli Mozesi.
Lino woonse muntu wakali aluzibo wakali kubeleka mubusena busalala kabazwa kumilimu eyo njibakali kuchita.
Bantu bachita milimu yamaboko bakabuzya  Mozesi, ''Bantu balikweta zyiingi zyindilide kwinda zyiingi kuchitila mulimu wa Jehova eeyo njakatulayilila swebo kuti tuchite.''
Lino  Mozesi wakalayililwa kuti takwe umwi mubusena ucheeta zimwi zipo zyakuyasyanbusena busalala. Mpawo bantu bakaleka kweta ezyo zipo.
Bakali baba azyakubelesya zyindilide kuvula kumilimu.

Aboobo woonse muntu wakali kuchita milimu yamaboko akati kabo boonse bakayaka idumba lyakukombela amalembo alimakumi akachitidwe kuzwa kumulembo wamusyobo wasimakaka, musinza wenyangu, aboya busalala kalabwanze bwa Kkelibbimu. Oyo wakala luzibo lwamilimu yamaboko.
Bulamfu bwalimwi alimwi lembo bwakali makumi obile alamusanu aatutatu tukokola, busasa bwatukokola toone. Woonse malembo akalelene.
Bbezaleli wakaswanizya malembo alimusanu kulilimwi alimwi, alimwi amwi malembo alimusanu wakaswanizya limwi kuli limwi.
Wakachita tukole twamusyobo wasimakaka kabatobelezya kumpela kumamanino alembo muchbaka chomwe, alimwi wakachita zikozyania kwindilila kumpela kwamamanino alembo muchibaka chabili.
Wakachita tukole tuli makumi musanu kulembo tanzi atuli makumi alimusanu tukole kumpela lyamamanino alembo kumundando wabili. Abobo tukole otu twakali langene kuli kamwi akamwi.
Wakachita zijatilizyo zyengolide zili kkumi amusanu akuswanizya malembo amwi angawo kuchitila kuti idumba lyakukombela lijatane.
Bbezaleli wakachita malembo abooya abooya bwempongo kuti libe tente ajulu edumba lyakukombela; wakachita kkumi alimwi ayaya malembo.
Bulamfu bwalimwi lembo bwakali tukokola tulimakumi atatu, abusasa bwalimwi bwakali tukokola tone. Limwi alimwi lyamalembo alikkumi alimwi lyakalelene.
Wakaswanizya malembo alimusanu kuli limwi alimwi aambi alimusanu alimwi kuli limwi alimwi,
Wakachita tukole tuli makumi alimusanu kumamanino ampela lyalembo kuchibela chitanzi, atukole tulimakumi alimusanu kumamanino ampela alembo eelyo liswanizya chibeela chabili.
Bbezaleli wakachita zijatizyo zyamukuba zili makumi alimusanu kuswanizya tende antomwe kuchitila kuti libe chintu chomwe.
Wakachitla dumba lyakukombela chilivumbyo chazikumba chamugutu wambelele ipentedwe busalala, chimbi chilivumbyo chachikumba chebeka kuti chiinke ajulu achecho.
Bbezaleli wakachita zisamu zyimvwi kaziya kujulu kuza kuzisamu zyamuunga zyadumba lyakukombela.
Bulamfu bwachimwi chikunguzyo bwakali tukokola tuli kkumi, abusasa bwachimwi chikunguzyo bwakali kakokola komwe achisela.
Chimwi achimwi chikunguzyo chakala nkanka zyazisamu zibili kukuswanizya zikunguzyo zikunguzyo amwi. Wakachita eezi kuli zyonse zikunguzyo zyadumba lyakukombela.
Wakachita zikunguzyo zyadumba lyakukombela muleyi inzila: Makumi abili azikunguzyo kubbazu lyakumusansa.

Bbezaleli wakachita zikkazyo zyansiliva zili makkumi one kazyiinka munsi azikunguzyo zili makumi abili. Kwakali zikkazyo zibili munsi kwachikunguzyo chomwe kuti ziswanizyenzikunguzyo amwi, alimwi zikkazyo zibili munsi achimwi zikunguzyo kuswanizya zikunguzyo amwi.
Kubbazu lyabili lyedumba  lyakukombela, kubbazu lyakunyika, wakachita zikunguzyo zilimakumi abili
azikunguzyo zyansiliva zili makumi ane zyezyo. Kwakali zikkazyo izibili munsi kwachikunguzyio chitanzi, izibili zikazyo munsi lyachikunguzyo chitobela, alimwi kaziyobuya.
Kusule lyadumba lyakukombela nkulili kumbo, Bbezaleli wakachita zikunguzyo zili musanu achimwi.
Wakachita zikunguzyo zibili kumabbazu akusule adumba lyakukombela.
Eezi zikunguzyo zyakalaanzene munsi lyezyo pesi kaziswenene ajulu munwenwe yomwe. Wakachita izibili zyazyo muliyeyi inzila kuzyooko izibili.

Kwakali izikunguzyo zili musanu azitatu, amwi azikkazyo zyazyo zilimakumi musanu akamwi kuli zyoonse, zikkazyo zibili munsi lyechikkunguzyo chitanzi, izibili zikkazyo munsi lyachikkunguzyo chitobela, alimwi kaziyobiya.
Bbezaleli wakachita minkulu yezisamu zyamuunga misanu yezikunguzyo yabbazu lyomwe lyedumba lyakukombela,
Minkulu ilimusanu kuzikunguzyo zyalimbi ibbazu lyadumba lyakukombela, aminkulu ilimusanu kuzikungzyo kumabazu lyakusule adumba lyakukombela lyakuumbo.
Wakachita minkulu akati kazikunguzyo, ili, akati kajulu, kusikila kumamanino akumasimpilo.
Wakavumba zikunguzyo angolide. Wakazichita nwenwe zyengolide, kulinzyo kuti zibe zijatyo zyaminkulu, alimwi wakavumba minkulu angolide.
Bbezaleli wakachita malembo amusyobo wasimakaka, amusinza wenyangu,azyaboya busalala, alimwi amulembo uyebeka, kuli muchimo chamakkelebbimu, milimu yabantu balaluzibo.
Wakachita mulembo misemo iine yamusamu wamuunga, alimwi wakivumba angolide. Abobo wakachita ngobyobyo zyangolide kumisemo, wakaziyungizya zikkazyo zyansiliva zyone zyazyo.
Wakachita chilengelezyo kumulyango watente. Chakachitidwe mumusyobo wasimakaka, musinzanyangu, aboya bwembelele, kabelesya mulembo uyebeka, mulimu wabasiyala malembo.
Abobo wakachita zilengelezyo zyamisemo zilimusanu kazila ngobyobyo. Wakavumba ajulu azyo aziponda zyalyo zyangolida. Zikkazyo zyalyo zili musanu zyakali chitidwe kuzwa kumukaba.
Bbezalelu wakachita bbokesi lyazisamu zyamuunga .Bulamfu bwacho bwakali tukokola tubili achisela,busasa bwalyo bwakali kakokola komwe achisela; abulamfu bwalyo bwakali kakokola komwe achiseela.
Wakachivumba mukati aanze angolide iili njiyo akulichitila mugaanu wangolide uuzyungulukide ajulu alyo.
Wakalibumbila mbalo zyone zyengolide zyantamo zyalyo zyone, ambalo zibili kuli limwi bbazu.
Wakachita zisamu azisamu zyamuunga akuvumbya ngolide.
Wakabika zisamu mulubalo kubbazu lyabbokesi, kuchitila kuti babwezwe bbokesi.
Wakachita chijazyo chakumana milandu changolide iili njiyo.Bulamfu bwacho bwakkali tukokola tubili achiseela, abusasa bwacho bwakali kakokola achiseela.
Bbezalelu wakachita makkelebbimu aabili awumwidwe angolide kachili kumpela lyamamanino achijazyo chakumana milandu,
Kkelebbimu limwi lyakumamanino achuijazyo chakumana milandu, alimwi kkelebbu lyakalilya lyalilyalimwi bbazu. Lyakachitidwe mbuli chimpanzi chachijazyo chakumana milandu.
Kkelebbimu chakajula mababa aacho akuvumba chijazyo chakumana milandu angawo. Kkelebbimu lyakatangana alyeenzina akulanga kunembo lyakati akuchijazyo chachuno chaluzyalo.
Bbezelelu wakachita tafula lyamusamu wamuunga.Bulamfu bwalyo bwakali tukokola tubili, busasa bwalyo bwakali kakokola komwe, abulamfu bwalyo bwakali kakokola komwe achisela.
Wakakavumba angolide ilinjiyyo akubika mugaanu wengolide iilinjiyonkakazyungulukide julu.
Wakakachita kaluli keelanisisigwe kuboko komwe busasa, kali aamuganu uuzyungulukide wangolide wachikunguzyo.
Wakakayakila imbalo zyone zyangolide akujatanisya mbalo muzyoke  zyone, oko kwakali kujinka ntamo zine.
Imbalo zyakali gumide kukaluli kukupa busena kumayako, kuchitila kuti babweze tafula.
Wakachita  ziyako kuzwa kumasamu akkasiya akuvumbya angolide, kuchitila kuti babweze tafula.
Wakachita zibelesyo ezyo zitakabe aajulu atafula- mabede, bachoncho,tubede, anongo zibelesegwa kukutulidila zipayizyo. Wakazichita kuzwa kungolide inambene.

Wakachita chikalilo chalampi changolide iipwayidwe inambene. Wakachita chikalilo chalampi   ezeteko lyacho aluuti. Inkomeki yacho, izeteko lyacho lilimbuli matu, alimwi malubaluba acho akabumbwa kkajisini kachili chimwi.
Mitabi iili musanu awumwi yakayungizigwa kuzwa kumabbazu aacho- mitabi yobile yakayungizigwa kuzwa bbazu, amitabi iitatu yachikalilo chalampi yakayungizigwa kuzwa kuli limwi bbazu.

Mutabi mutaanzi wakaleenkomesi zyotatwe zichitidwe mbuuli malubaluba, ankomesi zyotatwe zichitidwe mbuuli malubaluba a alimondi kuluumwi mutabi, azeteko lyamatu alubaluba. Yakali kozyeniyembuuli yoonse mitabiili  iili musanu awumwi iyungizizigwe kuzwa kuchikalilo chalampi.
Achikalilo chalampi lwacho, luuti lulakati lwakali nkomesi zyone zyakalundidwe mbuli malubaluba a alimondi amazeteko alyoalimbulitu.

Kwakali zeteko lilaabime bwatu ansi achipanzi chamutabi- chichitidwe mbuuli chimpanzi chomwe chalyo, lilimuchiimo chatu ansi amutabi wabili- abobo wakachitidwe chimwi chimpanzi mbuli nchicho. zyakali kozyeniye biyo zyoonse kumitabi ilimusanu awumwi kuziyungizwa kuzwa kuchikazikilo chalampi.
Mazeteko abo alimuchimo chatu woonse akali chibeela chomwe chumidwe chamulimuyangolide inini.
Bbezaleli wakachita chikalilo chalampi amalampi achoalimusanu aabili, amimano azibikilo zyazyozyangolide inini.
wakachita chikalilo chalampi azibelesyo zyachoatalenta yomwe yangolide inini.

Bbezalelu wakachita chipayililo chatununkilizyo. Wakachichita amusamu amu akkasiya. Bulamfu bwacho bwakali kakokola komwe., abusasa bwacho kakakola komwe. Chakalelene woonse mabazukalane, abulamfu bwacho bwakali tukokola tobile. Meja acho akapangidwe mbuuli chimwi chibeela anchoncho.
Wakavumbila chipayililo chatununkilizyo angolide nini- ajulu lyacho, mabbazu aacho, ameja acho.

Wakachita alubo mugaanu uuzyungulukide wengolide kulinchicho. Wakachita nwenwe zyobile zyengolide kuti zijatikizigwe kuli nchicho munsi amugano kumazuba aacho abili aalangene. Inwenwe zyakali zijatizyo zyazisamu kukubweza chipayililo.
Wakachita zisamu ezyo amusamu wamu akkasiya, akwaavumbila angolida.
Wakachita mafuta asalala akunanika bweema bununkilila bwatununkilizyo, kuli mulimu waba simuunde.
Bbezaleli wakachita chipayililo chazipayilo zitentwa zyamusamu mu akkasiya. Chakali makkiyubbiti musanu ibulamfu amakkiyubbiti musanu ibusasa - chiswi. bwelene - alimwi makkiyubbiti otatwe mubwiime.
Wakayungizya kuzyooko zyecho zyone izyiimo zili mbuli meja amunkabe. Imeja akachitidwe achipanza chomwe achipayililo alimwi wakachijala abbulonzi.
Wakachita zyoonse zibelesyo zyachipayililo - mpoto zyedota, mafocholo, mabbavu, tusumu twanyama, ankangilo zyamulilo. Wakachita zibelesyo zyonse eezi abbulonzi.
Wakachita jazyo lubuwa lya chipayililo, anjatano mulimu (netiweki) yabbulonzi itakabikwe munsi lya leegi, muchisela bwiime kuya aansi kumakkalilo.
Wakabumba mibalo yone yazyooko zyone zyajazyo lyabbulonzi, kuti zibe zijatizyo zyamayako.
Bbezaleli wakachita mayako amusamu mu akkasiya alimwi walamba aabbulonzi.
Wakabikka mayako mumbalo kumabazu aachipayililo, kuti iwajate. Wakachita kuti chipayililo chibe pako, kabelesya mapulanga.
Bbezaleli wakachita ibbavu lya abbulonzi ipati achikkalilo chalyo chabbulonzi, wakachita bbavu kabelesya ziboniboni zyabanakazi ibakali kubeleka kumulyango wabbakasa lyamumbunganino.
Alimwi wakenga lubuwa lwabusena. Izyakalengelezegwa kubbazu lyakunsi aanyika kwalubuwa zyakali zyamulembo umaninide, imwanda wamakkiyubbiti kukulampa.
Zilengelezegwa zyakajimpikwa ndengelezyo zili makumi obile, zili amakkalilo aabbulonzi aali makumi obile. Kwakali zikobekelo zyakabikidwe kundengelezyo, alimwi atubulo twansiliva.

Munzila yomwe anjiyeyo, kubbazu lyakujwe, kwakali zyakalengelezegwa zili mwaanda omwe wamakkiyubbiti kulampa izili andengelezyo makumi obile, makumi obile makalilo aabbulonzi, zikobekelo kazibikidwe kundengelezyo, akutubulo twansiliva.
Izilengelezegwa kubbazu lyakububbila zyakali makumi musanu aamakkiyubbiti kulampa, kazili andengelezyo amakkalilo aalikkumi. Izikobekelo atubulo twandengelezyo zyakali zyansiliva.
Alimwi ilubuwa lwakali makkiyubbiti makumi musanu kulampa kubbazu lyakubuzwezuba.
Izilengelezegwa kubbazu lyomwe lyamulyango zyakali makkiyubbiti kkumi amusanu kalampa. Zyakali andengelezyo zyotatwe amakalili otatwe.
Kuli limwi bbazu lyamulyango walubuwa kwakali zilengelede alimwi zili makkiyubbiti kkumi amusanu kulampa, zili andengelezyo zyotatwe azikalilo zyotatwe.
Zyonse zyakalengelede kuzyunguluka lubuwa zyakachitidwe amilembo imanide.
Izikkalilo zyandengelezyo zyakachitidwe abbulonzi. Izikobekelo atubulo twandengelezyo zyakachitidwe ansiliva, achivumbyo chaatala aandengelezyo chakachitidwe a nsiliva.

Ichisitilizyo chakumulyango walubuwa lyakali makkiyubbiti makumi obile kulampa. Ikketeni lyakachitidwe amibala yamuteme, muntumbula, amalembo abekema, milembo ilukikene, alimwi yakali makkiyubbiti makumi obile kulampa. Yakali makkiyubbiti makumi obile kulampa amakkiyubbiti musanu ibwiime, mbuli makketeni aalubuwa.
Lyakali amakalilo aabbulonzi one azikobekelo zya nsiliva. Izivumbyo zyaatala aazyo atubulo twacho twakachitidwe ansiliva.
Zyonse nkaanka zyabbakasa lyachikombelo alubuwa zyakachitidwe aabbulonzi.

Eechi nchechiimo chamabambe aachikombelo, ichikombelo chachizuminano, mbuli mbuchakabwezwa kakutobelezegwa malayilile aa Mozesi. Wakali mulimo waba Levi munsi lyabwendelezi bwa Itama mwana wa Aloni mupayizi.
Bbezaleli mwana wa Uli waku Heli, kuzwa kumukowa wa Juda, wakachita zyoonse Yawe nzyakali walayilila Mozesi.

Oholiyabbu mwana wa Ahisamaki, kuzwa kumukowa wa Deni, wakabeleka a Bbezaleli mbuli simawumbwe, mbuli simulimo musongo, alimwi mbuli mubambisi mumibala yamuteme, muntumbula, awuulu ibekema, amumilembo imaninide.

Yoonse ingolide yakabelesegwa aamulimo, mumilimo yonse yendelana abusena busalala ingolide izwa kujwe lyazipo - yakali matalenta makumi obile amusanu atune amashekeli myanda makumi musanu awabili amakumi otatwe, yakeelwa achimo chamashekeli aasankichwali.
Insiliva yakazwa kuluundu yakali kulema mwanda wamatalenta achuulu chili amyanda makumi musanu amakumi obile ili amakumi musanu aabili amusanu, mukwendelana amashekeli asankinchuwali,

nakuti ibbeka lyomwe kumuntu amuntu, chendelana achisela chasyekeli, yakeelwa ashekeli lyamasankinchuwali. Oyu mweelwe wkajanki mubwingi bwabantu bakabalwa mubwingi bwabo mubusena, aabo bali amiyanda makumi obile akwiinda - (603,550) mbantu mubwingi bwabo.
Mwanda omwe wamatalenta ansiliva akabambwa lyaba chikkalilo chabusena busalala alimwi azikalilo zyazisitilizyo - zikalilo mwanda omwe, talenta lyomwe lyachikalilo chomwe.
Kuli zyakachala (1,775) mashekeli ansiliva, Bbezaleli wakachita zikobela zyandengelezezyo, wajala aatala andengelezezyo, alimwi wakachita tubulo twezyo.
Ibbulonzi yakazwa kujuwe lyazipo yakali kulema matalenta makumi musanu aabili, a (2,400) mashekeli.
Ezi wakazibelesya kuchita makkalilo akumulyango wakubbakasa lyambunganino, chipayililo cha abbulonzi, ikkoma lyacho lyebbulonzi, zyoonse zibelesyo zyachipayililo.
makalilo alubaya lwalubuwa, makalilo amulyango walubuwa, zyonse nkaanka zyebbakasa lya chikombelo, azyonse nkaanka zyebbakasa lyalubuwa.

Bakabelesya yamubala wamuteme amuntumbula, amubala usalala, bakachita zisamo zilukikene zyakubelesya mubusena busalala. Bakachita zisamo zya Aaloni zyabusena busalala, mbuli Yawe mbwakali walayilila Mozesi.
Bbezaleli wakapanga efodi yaangolide, yamuteme, muntumbula, ayamubala usalala wewuulu, alimwi amulembo ulukikene.
Bakapwaya mazenge angolide akwanengulula kwachita tubulo, kuti batubelesye mumibalo yamuteme, mintumbula, amubala usalala wawuulu, amumilembo ilukinkene, kumilimu yamubelesi munkutwe.
Bakachita zimpanzi zyamakkuko a efodi,  bajatanisya zyooko zyajulu zyobile kuli nchicho.
Ilukumba lwacho lwamuchibuno lulukinkene lwakali mbuli chiimo; chakachitidwe aamulembo ulukinkene wangolide, muteme, muntumbula amubala usalala, biyo mbuli Yawe mbwakali walayilila Mozesi.
Bakabeza ibbwe lya Onikisi, livumbikizigwe aanzila zyamabambe angolide, zibambidwe abulumatizi mbuli abukozyenie amazina abana ba Izilayeli balombe.
Bbezaleli wakazibika azimpanzi zyamakuko ac efodi kuti abe mabwe akwibalukwa bana ba Izilayeli balombe, mbuli Yawe mbakali walayilila Mozesi.
Wakachita chimpanzi chakukango, mulimo wamubelesi munkutwe, lweebo lupya mbuli efodi. Wakachichita angolide, amuteme, muntumbula, alimwi amubala wawuulu, amulembo umaninide.
Chakali chamweelwe uyelene. Bakavunga tubili chimpanzi chaakango. Chakali abwanza bumwi mubusasa.
Bakabamba milongo yone yamabwe mebesi muli nchicho. Mulongo mutanzi wakali aalubbi a topazi, alimwi alimwi a ganeti.
Mumulongo wabili mwakali lya emalaludi, a safile, alimwi lya dayamondi.
Mumulongo watatu mwakali aa jasinsi, a ageti alimwi a ametiyisiti.
Mulongo wane wakali aa bbelilu, a onikkisi, alimwi lya jasipa. Mabwe akabambidwe muchiimo changolida.
Kwakali mabwe ikkumi aane, alimwi kalyimvwilidi izina lyabana ba Izilayeli balombe, alimwi kalijisini azina lyaumwi wamikowa ilikkumi ayibili.
Achimpanzi chakango bakachita inketani mbuli tukole, ulukidwe mbuli ingolide loko.
Bakapanga nchoko zyangolide zyobile anwenwe zyangolide zyobile, alimwi bakajatanisya nwenwe zyobile kuzyooko zyobile zyachimpanzi chankolo.
Bakabikka zisitilizyo zyengolida zyobile zilukidwe munwenwe zibili kuzyooko zyachimpanzi chakukango.
Bakajatanisya zimwi impela zyobile zibambidwe. Bakazijatanisya ezimpanzi zyekkuko lya efodi kunembo lyayo.
Bakapanga inwenwe zyobile angolide akuzibika kulizimwi izyooko zyobile zyachimpanzi chakukango, kumbali afwifwi amugaano wamukati.
Bakapanga zimbi inwenwe zyangolide zyobile akuzijatanisya akunsi lyezimpanzi zyekkuko zyobile zyakunembo lya efodi, afwifwi amukkome wayo ataala lyaluvumba lwamuchibuno cha efodi.

Bakapanga chimpanzi chakukango chenwenwe zyecho kunwenwe zyaku efodi akukkole lyamuteme, kuchitila kuti likonzye kujatanisigwa biyo ataala lyalukumba lwa efodi lwamuchibuno lulukinkene. Eezi zyaklikuchitilwa kuti chimpanzi chakukango chikachilwe kujatanisigwa kuzwa ku efodi. Eezi zyakachitwa mbuli Yawe mbakali walayilila Mozesi.
Bbezaleli wakachita igubo lya efodi lyonse amulembo wamuteme biyo, mulimo wasikuluka.
Lyakali aabbanga lyamutwe aakkati. Ibbanga lyakali amunkome ulukidwe kuzyunguluka bwanzo kuchitila kuti utadeluki.
Kumupeto wakunsi, bakachita ma pomegilaneti amuteme, muntumbula amubala usalala alimwi lyamulembo umaninide.
Bakapanga milangu yengolide loko, alimwi bakabika milangu akati kama pomegilaneti kuzyunguluka mukkome wakunsi lyegubo, aakati a pomegilaneti imulangu a pomegilaneti,
imulangu alimwi a pomegilaneti - kumukkome wegubo kuti Aaloni abeleke kasamide. Eezi zyakali mbuli Yawe mbwakali walayilila Mozesi.
Bakapanga amajansi amulembo umaninide a Aaloni abana bakwe.
Bakapanga itabbeni amulembo umaninide, i owoneti kkwalibba lyakumutwe lyamulembo umaninide, zisamo zyamukati zyamulembo umaninide,
alimwi a sashi lyamulembo umaninide wamuteme, muntumbula, abbalabala yani, imulimo wasikuluka. Eezi zyakali mbuli Yawe mbwakali walayilila Mozesi.
bakachita indyido yamusini usalala wangolide; akulemba alinjiyo, mbubonya mbuli mbokulembwa anwenwe, ''Busali kuli Yawe.''
Bakajatanisya ku mukkome lukole lwamusyobo wamuteme kujulu lyamukkome. Eezi zyakachitwa mbuli Yawe mbwakalayilide Mozesi.
Nkokuti imulimo wachikombelo, ibbakasa lyamiswangano, wakamaninina. Bantu baku Izilayeli bakachita zyoonse, bakatobelezya woonse malayilile aayo Yawe ngaakali wapa kuli Mozesi.
Bakeeta chikombelo kuli Mozesi - ibbakasa azyonse zibelesyo zyelyo, injatanisyo zyelyo, mayasyo;
zivumbyo zyezikumba zya lamu zyakachindululwa amubala usalala, ivumbyo lyechikumba chimaninide, alimwi akketani lyakusitikizya
ibwato bwabukamboni, alimwi amayako alimwi avunisyo champwido.
Bakeeta itebuli, zyonse zilongo zyelyo, achinkwa chezipo;
chikazikilo chalayiti chengolide loko azimunisyo zyecho kazili mulongo, atulongolongo twelyo amafuta azimunisyo;
ichipayililo changolide, mafuta aamananike, atununikilizyo; indengelezyo yamulyango wachikombelo;
chipayililo chabbulonzi ajazyo lyecho lyabbulonzi amayako aalyo azilongo abbavu pati akkazikilo lyelyo.

Bakeeta zilengelezegwa zyalubuwa a ndengelezyo zyazyo azikkazikilo, alimwi achisitilizyo chamulyango walubuwa; tukole twalyo ankaanka zyebbakasa; azyoonse zibelesyo zyamulimo wachikombelo, ibbakasa lyambunganino.
Bakeeta zisamo zyakalukidwe kumaninina zyakubelesya mubusena busalala, zisamo zisalala zya Aaloni mupayizi abana bakwe, kuti babeleke mbuli bapayizi.
Mbombubo bantu baku Izilayeli mbubakachita woonse mulimo mbuli Yawe mbwakali walayilila Mozesi.
Mozesi wakalangisisya woonse mubeleko, alimwi, amulange, bakali bawuchita. Mbuli Yawe mbwakali walayilila, bakawuchita mbubo loko. Mpawo Mozesi wakabalongezya.
Mpawo Yawe wakambula a Mozesi, wakati,
''Mubuzuba butanzi bwamwezi mutanzi wamunyaka mupya welede kwimika chikombelo, ibbakasa lyambunganino.
Weelede kubika ibbokesi lyabukamboni muli ndilyo, alimwi weelede kusitikizya bbokesi achisitilizyo.
Weelede kweeta tafula mukati akubamba kabotu eezyo zintu zyalyo. Mpawo weelede kweeta mukati chikkazikilo chazimunisyo akubamba zimunisyo.
Weelede kubika chipayililo chatununkilizyo chamubala wengolida kunembo lyabbokesi lyabukamboni, alimwi weelede kubika chisitilizyo kumulyango wachikombelo.
Weelede kubika chipayililo chakuumpa zipayizyo kunembo lyamulyango wachikombelo, ibbakasa lyamuswangano.
Weelede kubika bbavu pati akati kebbakasa lyambunganino achipayililo alimwi welede kubika maanzi mukati.
Welede kuyakila lubuwa luchizyungulukide, alimwi welede kwaanzika chisitilizyo kumulyango walubuwa.
Welede kubweza mafuta akunanika unanike chikombelo azyonse zilimukati.

Welede kuchibika bwanzeene azyoonse zyalweebo lwacho kuli ndime; mpawo chiyoba chisalali. Welede kunanika chipayililo chazipayizyo zyuumpwa azyonse zilongo zyacho. Welede kuchibamba kumbali chipayililo kuli ndime alimwi chiyoba chisalali loko kuli ndime.
Welede kunanika ichisambilo chaabbulonzi achikkalilo chalyo alimwi uchibambile kubbazu kulindime.
Weelede kuyooyeta Aaloni abana bakwe balombe kumulyango wabbakasa lyambunganino alimwi ukabasanzye amanzi.
Welede kuyozwatika Aaloni zisamo zibambilidwe kubbazu kuli ndime, ukamunanike akumubika kubbazu kuchitila kuti akabeleke mbuli mupayizi wangu.
Weelede kuyoyeeta bana bakwe ukabazwatike majansi.
Welede kuyobananika mbuli mbuwakananika wisi kuchitila kuti bakandibelekele mbuli bapayizi. Kunanikwa kwabo kuyobachitya bupayizi bwalyoonse kwinda mubuzyalwe bwabantu babo.''
Eezi nzyakachita Mozesi; wakatobelezya zyonse nzyakamulayilide Yawe. Wakazichita zyoonse eezi.
Nkokuti chikombelo chakayakwa mubuzuba butanzi bwamweezi mutanzi mumunyaka wabili.
Mozesi wakayaka chikombelo, wakabika chikkalilo chacho mpucheelede, wakiimikizya busanza bwacho, waswanizya atubulo twacho, alimwi wakiimikizya mbandama andengelezyo zyacho.
Wakayabika chivumbyo aatala lyachikombelo akubika bbakasa ataala lyacho, mbuli mbaakali wamulayilila Yawe.
Wakabweza zilembelo zyechizuminano akuzibika mubwaato alimwi wakabika chivunisyo champwido aali nchicho.
Wakeeta bbokesi muchikombelo. Wakayimikizya chisitilizyo kuti lisitikizye bbokesi lyabukamboni, mbuli mbakali wamulayilila Yawe.
Wakabika tafula mubbakasa lyakubunganina,kubbazu lyakujwe lyachikombelo,kunze lyachisitilizyo.
Wakabika chinkwa atafula mbuli mbukwelede kunembo lya Yawe, alimwi mbuli Yawe mbwakali walayilila.
Wakabika chikkazikilo chazimunisyo mubbakasa lyakubunganina, mukwiinga kuzwa kutafula, kubbazu lyakunsi lyachikombelo.
Wakayasya zimunisyo kunembo lya Yawe, mbuli mbaakali wamulayilila Yawe.
Wakabika chipayililo chatununkilizyo chamubala wangolide mubbakasa lyachibunganino kunembo lyachisitilizyo.
Wakatenta kanunkilizyo kanunkilila muli nchicho, mbuli mbwakamulayilide Yawe.
Wakaanzika chisitilizyo kumulyango wachikombelo.
Wakabika chipayililo chazipo ziteentwa kumulyango kuchikombelo, ibbakasa lyakubunganina muswangano. Wakapa kuli nchicho ichipo chakutenta alimwi achipo chamuseke wazilyo, mbuli mbwakamulayilila Yawe.
Wakabikka ichisambilo akati kabbakasa lyambunganino achipayililo, alimwi wakabika maanzi akusamba muli ndilyo.
Mozesi, Aaloni abana bakwe balombe bakasamba maboko amawulu aabo mubbavu.
Kufumbwa chiindi nibakali kunjila mubbakasa lyakubunganina lyamuswangano alyonse nibakali kuya mujulu kuchipayililo. Bakalisanzya, mbuli Yawe mbwakalayilide Mozesi.
Mozesi wakayakila lubuwa kazyunguluka chikombelo achipayililo. Wakabika chisitilizyo kumulyango walubuwa. Muli eeyi inzila, Mozesi wakamaninsya mulimo.
Mpawo ijoba lyakajala ibbakasa lyachibunganino chamiswangano, alimwi bupati bwa Yawe bwakazuzya chikombelo.
Mozesi takwepe nakakonzya kunjila mubbakasa lyachibunganino nkambo ijoba lyakali lyakali lyakkala alinchicho, akuti bupati bwa Yawe bwakali bwazuzya chikombelo.
Kufumbwa chindi ijoba nilyakali kuvumbulwa achikombelo, bantu bakwa Izilayeli bakali kutalika kweenda mulwendo lwabo.
Pesi ikuti ijoba telyanyampuka aachikombelo aawo bantu tebakali kweenda pe. Bakali kukkala manedo mubuzuba mbulyayonyampulwa.
Nkambo ijoba lya Yawe lyakali atala lyachikombelo abuzuba,alimwi mulilo wakwe wakali aatala lyaacho mansiku, aantanganana kunembo kumaboneno aabantu boonse bakwa Izilayeli mulwendo lwabo loonse.
Mumunyaka wakkumi, mumwezi waane, alimwi mubuzuba bwamusanu mumwezi, kwakabakuti nindakakkede akkati kabazike kumulonga wa Kkebba. Majulu akajulika, alimwi ndakabona zilengano zya Leza.
Mubuzuba bwasanu mulooyo mwezi-wakali munyaka wasanu wabuzike bwamwami Jehoyiyakkimu -- wakali munyaka wasanu wabuzike bwamwami Jehoyiyakkimu --
Ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli Ezekkiyeli mwana wa Bbuzi mupayizi, munyika yama Chaludiya kumulonga wa Kkebba, ajanza lya Jehova lyakali alinguwe nkukooko.
Mpawo ndakalanga, alimwi kwakali guwo lyemvula lyakayobuza kuzwa kunyika; ijoba pati lyakali amulilo umweka mukkati kalyo akubalama kwakazyungulukide mukkati kelyo, amulilo usalala mukati kejoba.
Akkati kwakali mbuli zinyama zyoone zipona mbobu mbuzyali kulangika: zyakali kubaanga muntu,
pesi zyakali amasyu oone achimwi, alimwi chinyama chakali amababa oone.
Mawulu azyo akaliluleme, pele kundyatyo zyamawulu azyo akali mbuli insumba zyakang'ombe zyakali kubalama mbuli kazikwizingidwe mbuli bbulonzi mumabazu woonse one.
Mulizine zyoonse, kumenso amababa akali oobu:
mababa akali kuguma mababa achinyama chimwi, alimwi takwepe nizyakali kunyona nkaziyobwenda; anukuti, achimwi chakaluleme kunembo mukwenda kwazyo.

Bwime bwakumenso azyo kwakali mbuli kumenso amuntu. Mubune bwazyo zyakali akumenso amulavu kubbazu lyakuchilisyo, alimwi mubune bwazyo zyakali akumenso kwamusune kulubazu lwakochimwensi. Mubune bwazyo zyakali akumenso kwensika.
Kumenso azyo kwakali mbuboobo, mababa akali julikide ajulu, aboobo achimwi chinyama chakali amababa akajisini amababa achimwi chinyama, aboobo chakali amababa akavumbide mibili yazyo.
Achimwi chakaluleme kunembo, aboobo kuti kufumbwa muuya nkuwaka zilulamika nkonkuko nkuzyakaya, zyakiinka nkatakwe kunyona.
Mbuli mukukozyania kwazinyama zipona, zyalikulangikanga mbuli makkala amulilo ayaka, mbuli zimunisyo, mulilo umunikisya alimwi wakali kwenda akkati kazinyama, alimwi kwakali kumweka kwakalabi.
Zinyama zipona zyakali kwenda kufwambana musule akunembo, alimwi zyakali kulangika mbuli kalabi!
Mpawo ndakalanga kuzinyama zipona; alimwi ndakabona vili lyomwe anyika kumbali achimwi chinyama chipona amasyu azyo oone.
Mbobu mbuzyakalikulangika abwiime bwamavili: alimwi vili lyakali mbuli Bbelulo, kulangika kwazyo abwiime bwakali mbuli vili linjilene alimwi vili.
Mbuli mbwakali kweenda, akali kwenda kufumbwa kumabazu oone, katanyoni pe.
Nakayobwenda mbuli mitendelele yawo, akali malamfu akuyoosya, mitendelele yakazwide menso nkaazyungulukide.
Kufumbwa zinyama zipona zyeenda, mavili alikwenda kumbali lyazyo. Elyo zinyama zyuumi zyali kunyampuka kuzwa ansi anyika, mavili awalawo akalikunyampuuka.
Kufumbwa muuya nkuwakali kuya, zyakalikwinka, nkambo muya wazinyama zipona wakali mumavili.

Kufumbwa zinyama nkuzyakiinka, amavili nkonkuko nkwakaya; alimwi elyo zinyama nizyaakima, amavili akalikwima, elyo zinyama nizyaka nyampuka kuzwa aansi enyika, amavili akanyampuuka awalawo kumbali azyo, nkambo muuya wazinyama zipona wakali mumavili.
Ajulu amitwe yezinyamankala zipona kwakali mukozyanisyo wachilivumbyo; chakali kulangika mbulimabwe mayandisi akayalidwe ajulu amitwe yazyo.

Kunsi achivumbilizyo, achimwi chinyama mababa akali tandabede akujata mababa achimwi chinyama. Achimwi chinyama chipona chakali amababa akulivumbya; achimwi nkachijisi akulivumba mubili wacho lwacho chini.

Mpawo ndakamvwa muzuzumo wamababa azyo. Mbuli muzuzumo wamanzi miingi. Mbuli ijwi lyasimajulu kufumbwa nizyakali kweenda. Mbuli muzuzumo wemvula yeguwo. Mbuli muzuzumo wabasilumamba. Kufumbwa nizyakiimikila, zyalikuselezya mababa azyo.
Ijwi lyakazwa atala achilivumbyo chaajulu amitwe kufumbwa nizyakali kwimikila akuselezya maba azyo.
Ajulu achilivumbyo chamitwe yazyo kwakali mbuli chuuno chabwami: kwakali mbuli ibbwe lya Sofilo, alimwi awo kwali mbuli chunochabwami kwakali kubonekanga muntu.
Ndakabona chintu chilimbuli nsimbi ilikutentwa mumulilo kuli nchicho kuzwa mumabolo kaziya kujulu, ndakabona kuuzwa mukulanga kwamuchikungu kuuza ansi kulangika kwamulilo akumweka kuzyungulukide.
