Mbuli bulangika fulichoongwe mumayoba muzuba lyemvula kwalai kuboneka mbuli mumuni uumwekesya uchizyungulukide kwakali kuboneka mbuli bulemu bwa Jehova. Nindakabubona, ndakavundama , alimwi ndakamvwa ijwi lyaambula.
Lino wakandambila kuti, ''Mwana mungu, yimikila amawulu ako; mpawo ndiyowambuula ayebo.''
Mpawawo nakali andime, muuya wakanjila muli ndime akundiimikizya amawulu angu, alimwi ndakamvwa ndakabona nkalokwambuula andime.
Wakati kuli ndime, ''Omwana wamuntu, ndikukutuma kubantu ba Izilayeli, kuluzubo lukatazya bandipapila mubo- lwabo abamawisi babo boonse mane kusikila kubuzuba obuno!,
Lunyungu lwabo lujisi masyu atatambuliki amyoyo miyumu. Mebo ndikukutuma kuli mbabo, uyobambila kuti, ''Mbuboobu mbwaamba Mwami Jehova.'
Nikuba kuti bayoswilila kana kuti pe. Nkambo mbana baluzubo lupapide, pele bayoziba kuti kwaba musinsimi akkati kabo.

Iwebo, yomwana amuntu, utakabayoowi nekuba majwi abo utakayoowi, nikuba kuti waba buyumuyumu amachise alimbuli amaamvwa nekuba kuti wakkala atubaze. Utayoowi majwi abo nikuba kukankama akambo kamasyu aabo, nkambo nduzubo lupapide.
Pesi uyobaambila majwiangu, nikuba kuti bayoswilila nanka kuti pe, nkambo nduzubo lupapide loko.
Pele webo, O mwana amuntu, swilila nzendokukwabila. Utandipapili mbuli aluzubo lupapide. Jula mulomo wako ulye echo nchendaamba kukupa!''
Elyo ndakalanga, alimwi ijanza lyakatandabalide kuli ndime; mujanza omo mwakali bbuku lilembedwe.
Wakalivungununa kunembo lyangu; lyakali lembedwe majwi akulila, amajwi akoomoka, amajwi amawuse.
Wakandambila kuti, ''Mwana muntu, echo nchuwajana, kolya eli bbuku, elto koya ukambile luzubo lwa Izilayeli.''
Mpawo ndakajula mulomo wangu, alimwi wakandilisya elyo bbuku.
Wakandambila kuti, ''Mwana muntu, lisya ida lyako akuzuzya bula bwako aleli bbuku ndendapa nduwe!'' Mpawo ndakalilya, alimwi lyakali kunona mbuli buchi mukanwa lyangu.
Elyo wakandambila, ''Mwana muntu, koya kuluzubo lwaIzilayeli ukabambile majwi angu.
Nkaambo teensi watumwa kubantu bamusyobo umbi nekuba mulaka muyumu, pesi kuluzubo lwaIzilayeli-
teensi kubantu biingi bamusyobo umbi nekuba mulaka muyumu, wamajwi ngotakonzyi kumvwisisisya. Nchobeni nendalikutumide kuli mbabo, balikunokuswilizya.
Pesi luzubo lwa Izilayeli talukoyoyanda pe kuyokuswilila, nkaambo tabayandi pe kundiswilila. Lino loonse luzubo lwa Izilayeli lula nkumu njumu amoyo muyumu.
Bona! ndayumya busyu bwako mbubo mbuli masyu aaboaankumu yako kuyuma mbuli nkumu zyabo.
Ndachita kuti nkumu ibe mbuli bbweluma, iyume kwiinda indomba! utayoowi nekuba kukankama nkaambo kamasyu aabo, nekuba kuti nduzubo lukatazya .''
Eelyo wwakandaambila kuti, ''Mwana muntu, majwi woonse aayo ngendaambakulinduwe- abikke mumoyo wako akwaswiilila amatwi aako!
Koyinka kubazike, kubantu bako, akuyobaambila. Kobaambila kuti,' Muboobu mbwaamba Mwaami Jehova,' na  bayoswiilila kana pe.''
Eelyo muuya wakandinyampula alimwi kusule lyangu ndakamvwa jwi lyamuzuzumina mupati wanyika: ''Bulemekwe bulemu bwa Jehova kubusena bwakwe!
''Lyakali jwi lyaamababa azinyama zyuumi limwi alimwi nkaliguma jenzinyina, amuzuzumina wamavili akali kumbali lyazyo,amuzuzumina mupati wenyika.
Muuya wakandinyampula akunditola, aboobo ndakiinka akunyema mumuya wangu, nkaambo ijanza lya Jehova lyakali andime changuzu!
Aboobo ndakiinka kubazike bakali ku Teli Abbibbi bakali kukkala kumulonga wa Kkebbala, alimwi ndakakkala nkukoko kwamazuba aali musanu aabili, akuzula kugamba.
Mpawo nakamana mazuba musanu aabili ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime, kalyamba kuti,
''Mwana muntu, ndakuchita mulindizi waluzuba lwa Izilayeli, lino koswiilila kujwi lizwa kumulomo wangu, akubapa nchenjezyo yangu.

Nindaambila sikubisya kuti, 'Uyoofwa nchobeni' aboobo twamuchenjezya nekuba kukwaamba nchenjezyo kuli sizibi aatala anchito zyakwe imbi kuti amwi walikuleka-ooyo sizibi uyoochifwida chibi chakwe, pesi bulowa bwakwe ndobuyanduula kuzwa kujaanza lyako.
Pesi kuti wamuchenjezya ooyo sizibi, aboobo tasanduka kuzibi zyakwe nekuba kuzwa kunchito zyakwe mbi, eelyo uyochifwida chibi chakwe, pesi unooli wafutula buumi bwako omwini.

Na muntu ululeme waleka bululami bwakwe akuchita kutalulama, aboobo ndabikka chilebyo kunembo lyakwe, uyoofwa. Nkaambo kakuti twamuchenjezya, uyoofwa muchibi chakwe, aboobo nsikoyibulukwa inchito ziluleme nzyalikuchita, pesi ndiyoyanduula bulowa bwakwe kuzwa kujaanza lyako.
Pesi na wamuchenjezya oyo mululami kuti aleke kubisya kuti atakabisyi limbi, inchobeni uyoopona nkaambo wakachenjezegwa; alimwi unoli wavuna buumi bwako omwini.''
Lino jaanza lya Jehova lyakali aalindime nkukoko, alimwi wakandaambila kuti, ''Nyampuka! uyinke kugundu, nkabela ndiyokwaambila nkukoko!
''Ndakanyampuka akwiinka mugundu, nkabela bulemu bwa Jehova bwakalimvwi nkuko, mbuli bulemu mbundakabwene kumbali lyamulonga Kkebbala: mpawo ndakavundama.
Muuya wakasika kulindime akundimikizya amawulu aangu; akwaambuula aandime, akundaambila kuti, koya ukalijalile munganda yako,
kwalino, omwana muntu, bayobikka ntambo alinduwe akukwanzya anzizyo eelyo tokoyoyendenda pe akati kabo
Ndiyochita kuti lulimi lwako lukanamatile kubwasa bwako, kuti ukabe syataambi akutakonzya kubakkalila, nkaambo nduzubo lukatazya.

Pesi ndanowambula ayebo, ndiyomamuna mulomo wako eelyo uyoti kulimbabo, 'Mbuboobu mbawamba Mwaami Jehova.' Ooyo uyanda kumvwa uyoomvwa; ooyo utayandi kuswiilila takoyo swiilila pe, nkaambo nduzubo lukatazya!''
''Pesi webo, mwana mulombe wamuntu, libwezele chitina lwako alimwi ukachibike kunembo lyako. Mpawo ukanengulule chisi cha Jelusalemu alinchicho.
Mpawo uyale lubaya lulangene anjiyo, alimwi uyake malambo alinjiyo. Mukanyampule chisubwido chilangeene anjiyo alimwi mukabambe tubunga twiizyungulukide.

Mpawo webo kuzwaawo kolibwezela kkwalibba lyabutale alimwi ulibelesye mbuli bulambo akkati kako adolopo mpawo ukalanzike busyu bwako nkuko, nkambo liyoba munsi lyakusinkilizigwa. Eechi chiyooba chitondezyo kung'anda ya Izilayeli.
Mpawo, webo ulale ebbazu lyakochimweensi alimwi ukabikke chibi chang'anda ya Izilayeli alinchicho; uyobweza zibi zyabo kwamazuba ayo ngoyolala aansi kolangene ng'anda ya Izilayeli.
Imebo lwangu ndizotumina buzuba bomwe butakiminine umwi wamunyaka yakusubulwa kwabo: mazuba ali 390! Munzila eyi, uyobweza chibi chang'anda ya Izilayeli.
Muchiindi noyomaninsya mazuba aya, mpawo ukalale aansi lwabili kubbazu lyachilisyo, nkambo uyobweza chibi chang'anda ya Juda kwamazuba makkumi aane. Ndakupa lwako izuba lyomwe kumunyaka womwe.
Lanzika busyu bwako ku Jelusalemu eyo ilimunsi lyakusinkilizigwa, alimwi akuboko kwako kusamununwe chisinsimi aatala anjiyo.
Nkambo bona! Ndilabika zyakukumanikizya kuti utasandukili kuzwa kuli limwi bbazu kuti ulange kulilimbi mane do ukamaninsizye mazuba akusinkilizigwa kwako.

Ukalibwezela lwakpo wiiti, bbaali, nyangu, anyeemu, amabede amayila; ukazibike muchibikilo alimwi mukabike muchibikilo choomwe alimwi mukapange chibunge chanu kazyendelana amweelwe wamazuba ayo ngotalale aansi kolimbide limwi bbazu. Kwamazuba 390 uyoyilya.
Chakulya nchoyolya chinoli abulemu, makkumi aabili amasyekeli abuzuba, alimwi uyochilya muzyiindi zibikidwe zuba ezuba.
Alimwi uyoonywa manzi, anopimidwe kucheleko chankomeki, alimwi uyowanywa kuzyiindi zitalidwe.
Uyochiilya mbuli chibunge chabbaali, pesi uyochijika achijikilo aatala amazyu aabantu kunembo lyabo kabakubwene!''
Nkaambo Jehova wati, ''Echi chaamba kuti chinkwa eecho bantu bakwa Izilayeli nchibayoolya chinosofweede, oko akati kabamaasi nkwebatandilide beni.''

Pesi mebo ndakati, ''Alasi, Mwami Jehova! Takwepe nindakali ndasofwaala! Takwepe nindakali ndalya nikuba chintu echo chakali chafwa nikuba chintu chakajiigwa abanyamankala, kuzwa kubunini bwangu kusikila linobu, niiba ntundulu takwepe niyakanjide mukkanwa lyangu!''
Eelyo wakati kuli ndime, ''Langa! Ndakupa webo bufumba bwa ng'ombe kwinda mazyu abantu kuchitila kuti ukajike obotu chinkwa chako ajulu alinchicho.''
Alimwi wakati kuli ndime, ''Mwana muntu! Langa! Ndiyokwamuna chiinkwa mu Jelusalemu, alimwi bayoolya chinkwa kabapima pima mumakatazyo alimwi akuyoonywa maanzi chakwapima mukuteketa.
Nkambo bayobula chinkwa amanzi, muntu woonse uyogambilwa kumukulana wakwe alimwi banoya bukotela nkambo kabubi bwabo.''

''Mpawo webo, mwana mulombe wamuntu, bweza ipanga libosya mbuli mbeli yasikugela ulibwezele, alimwi uyinzye mbeli aajulu lyamutwe wako antomwe akuzilezu, mpawo ukabweze cheelesyo kuti ukapime bulemu, alimwi ukapambuule susu lyako.

Ukateente chimpanzi chatatu mumulilo akkati kadolopo kuchiindi mazuba akusinkilizigwa akumana, eelyo ukabweze chimpanzi chatatu chamasusu alimwi ukachuumye ipanga chonseni chakunzeemuka dolopo. Mpawo ukamwaye chimpanzi chatatu chamasusu kumuuwo, alimwi ndiyogwisya aanze ipanga kuti nkatandanie bantu.
Pesi ubweze kampanzi kanini kuzwa kumasusu alimwi ukalyaange mumoombe wachizwato chako.
Mpawo uyungizye limbi lyamasusu alimwi uliwale akkati kamulilo; alimwi ulitente mumulilo; kuzwawo mulilo uyoozwa kuya kung'anda yonseni ya Izilayeli.''
Mwami Jehova nguwamboobu, ''Eeyi ni Jelusalemu akkati kabamaasi, oko nkondakamubikka, alimwi oko nkundakabazyunguluka azimwi zisi.

Pesi mukukachilwa kwakwe wakakaka imbeta zyangu kwinda bamaasi mbubakachita, alimwi amalayilile aangu kwinda manyika abazyungulukide. Bantu bakakaka imbeta zyangu alimwi tebakeenda mumalayilile angu pe.''

Nkiinkako Mwami Jehova waamba oobu, ''Nkaambo muli basikupilingania kwinda zisi ezyo zimuzyungulukide alimwi temwakeenda mumalayilile aangu nikuba kuchita mbuli mbeta zyangu mbuzyaamba pe, nikuba kuchita mbuli zichito zyazisi zimuzyungulukide lwanu,''
nkinkaako Mwami Jehova wamba obu, ''Langa! Imebo lwangu njokulwiisya. Ndiyomujaya ambeta akkati kanu kuchitila kuti zimwi zisi zibone.
Ndiyochita kuli ndinywe ezyo nzyesina kuchita alimwi azezyo nzyesikabule kuchita lubo pe, akambo kazichito zyenu nzyensulide.
Nkiinkako mawisi bayolya bana akati kanu, alimwi abana bayolya bamawisi, mbokunga ndiyobika lubeta alindinywe alimwi akuyo mumwayisya kuya kumabbazu woonse nywebo monseni nimucheede.

Nekubaboobo, mbuli mbwempona--aya ngimajwi akaambwa a Mwami Jehova--kuli mbubo loko nkaambo mwakasofwaazya busena bwangu azintu zyenu zyonseni zindinyemya antomwe anchito zyenu zindisesemya, zyakuti mebo ndiyomuchesya kumweelwe; linso lyangu talikoyomufwida nsoni pe, alimwi tandikoyo muleka pe.

Chimpanzi chomwe chamweelwe wenu chatatu chiyofwa amalwazi, alimwi bayomenwa abbalangwe lyanzala akati kanu. Chibeela chanu chatatu chiyoowa akafulo aako kamuzyungulukide. Mpawo njomwayisya bamwi kumabbazu asiyene siyene wonseni, alimwi njogwisya ipanga kuti ndika baandile alimwi.

Mpawo bukali bwangu buyomana, alimwi njochita kuti bukali bwangu bukamanine alimbaabo. Njokkutisikana, alimwi bayochiziba eechi kuti Mebo, nde Jehova, ndakaambula mubukali bwangu awo nindakamaninsya bukali bwangu alimbabo.
Ndiyomuchita kuti mukawuumbale alimwi mukawuse kumisyobo yoonse eyo imuzyungulukide mumenso aboonse abo banakwenda.

Elyo Jelusalemu iyooba chimwi chintu kubantu bamwi kuti biisole alimwi biniake, ninchenjezyo alimwi zilayoosya kuli bamaasi bamuzyungulukide. Ndiyobika lubeta alinduwe mubukali amukunyema, alimwi ankalalilo inkali -- Lwangu mebo, nde Jehova ndime ndazyamba ezi!
Njotuma miivwi mikkali yabbalangwe lyanzala aatala lyenu alimwi akuyomwayula bulilu bwenu bwachinkwa.

Ndiyotumina bbalangwe lyenzala antenda aatala lyanu zyakuti muyosyaala kamutachikwe bana pe. Intenda zyamalwazi abulowa ziyomuwida, alimwi njoyeta ipanga aatala lyanu -- Lwangu, ndime Jehova, ndazyamba ezi.''
Ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime, kaliti,
''Mwana amuntu, tambya menso aako kuzilundu zya Izilayeli usinsime aanzizyo.

Waamba kuti, 'Muzilundu zya Izilayeli, amuswilile majwi aaMwami Jehova! Mwami Jehova mbwawambila zilundu atulundulundu, majeenga, amakkuti: Nchobeni! njomwetela majwi aatala andime, alimwi njoonynyoona zipayililo zyenu.
Zipayililo zyeni ziyonyonyoonwa, zikozyanisyo zyanu ziyopwachulwa alimwi ndiyosowela aansi zifwide kubusyu bwamizimu yenu.
Ndiyoolazika mitunta yamibili yabo ifwide yabana ba Izilayeli kubusyu bwamizimu yenu, azifuwa zyenu njoozimwaya chakuzyunguluka
Koonse konse nkumukkede, myuunzi yenu iyooba matongo akubula bantu, zikozyanio zyenu ziyopwayigwa akuloba, tukombelo twenu tumwayigwe, amilimo yenu izimigwe.
Aabo bafwide bayoowa aansi baliyasidwe akkati kenu aboobo muyoziba kuti ndime Jehova.
Pele njomuswanizya bamwi baloboka kuzwa kupanga lyabamasi chiindi echo nimuyomwayikila akati kazisi.

Aabo balobokede bayoyibalukwa ndime akkati kazisi nkubatoledwe mubuzike, nkambo njotyola myoyo yabo yabwamu iindisulide amenso aabo aabwamu aalanga zikozyanio zyabo, lino bayoba chisesmyo mumenso abo beni nkambo kabubi bwabo mbubachita akambo kazisesemyo zyabo boonse.
Nkabela bayoziba kuti ndime Jehova. Alimwi mapenzi aya woonse ngendaamba kubeetela teensi abuyo pe.

Mwami Jehova mbuboobu mbwaawamba: Kawamba amanza aako lyata achituta chako! Akwamba kuti, 'Mwaawe.'' nkambo kazisesemyo zibi zyoonse zyang'anda ya Izilayeli! nkambo bayojayigwa ipanga apamba amalwazi.
Ooyu uulikule uyoofwa kubulwazi, ayooyo uuli kufwifwi uyojayigwa ipanga, ayooyo usyeede uvunidwe uyofwa inzala. Aboobo njozuzikizya bukali bwangu kulimbabo.

Muyiziba kuti ndime Jehova, chiindi echo bajayidwe babo nibanozolede akkati kazikozyano zyabo chakuzyunguluka yoonse yamalundu, muchenzule chaminsamu yoonse miteete, kunsi lyamabanga woonse iivunzene, mumasena woonse nkubakali kuchitila mizimu yabo tusamu twatununkilizyo.
Njotandabika ijanza lyangu kukubalwisya, njochita kuti nyika ikabe matongo akubula bantu, mumasena woonse nkubakkede kuti ndime Jehova.''
Lino ijwi lya Jehova lyakandisikila, kalyamba kuti,
''Iwebo, mwana muntu- mbubobu Mwami Jehova mbwawamba kunyika ya Izilayeli.''  'Asika mamanino! Asika mamanino kumabbazu aanyika woonse aane.

Yino magolelo amusikila, lino ndaamba kutumina bukali bwangu kuli ndinywe, njomubwedezya bulumbu bwanu mbubonya mbuli inzila zyanu, milimu   yenu isesemya nichili akkati kenu, lino muyoziba kuti ndime Jehova.

Nkambo menso aangu takoyomufwida insoni, alimwi nsikoyomuleka pe. Anukuti, njomubwedezya bulumbu bwenu alindinywe, alimwi azisesemyo zyenu ziyoba akkati kenu, kuchitila kuti mukazibe kuti ndime Jehova Leza wenu.
Mwami Jehova mbuboobu mbwawamba: Mapenzi ! Mapenzi alasika aatala lyamapenzinyina! nchobeni alasika.
Magolelo nchobeni asika. Mamanino asika amubukila kuli ndinywe. Amujatisye, mamanino asika!
Malweza asika kuli ndinywe nemukkede munyika. Chiindi chasika; buzuba bwakumwayula bwaba afwifwi, alimwi zilundu tazikoyobotelwa limbi.
Kabe kayindi ndaamba kumutilila bukali bwangu akuzuzikizizya lunyemo lwangu kulindinywe eelyo njomubeteka mbubonya mbuli inzila zyako akukubwedezezya bulumbu bwamilimu yako isesemya.

Nkambo menso aangu takoyomufwida insoni, alimwi nsikoyomufwida luzyalo pe. Mbuli ndinwe ndamaninsya, ndiyochita kulindinywe; milimu yenu isesemya nichili akkati kenu lino muyoziba kuti ndime Jehova, ulikumupenzya.
Langa, izuba! Kolanga, lizobuza! Malweza ayinka kule! Musako wasyuuka, bukali mukulisumpula bwafulula!
Inkondo yakomenesya loko kuba musako wabulewusi-takwe naba umwi wabo, alimwi takwe naba omwe mubwingi bwabo, naba wamuvubi bwabo, alimwi takwepe naba omwe wamubupati bwabo uyowangola!
Chiindi chasika; buzuba bwasika afwifwi loko. Mutachiti kuti sikuula atasekeleli, alakwe sikuuzya atalili, nkambo bukali bwasikila boonse biyo.

Sikuuzya takoyoboola kunyika yakwe uyowuzya kwachindi chilamfu. Nikuba kuti boonse bachili bawumi nkambo nchilengano chilamba amakamu abo boonse; nkambo kazibi zyabo nkabela takuyooba naba umwi uliyumya!
Balizya mweembo akubamba zintu zyoonse, nekuba boobo takwe uuyinka kuyolwisya; nkambo bukali bwangu bwasikila makamu aabo woonse.
Ipanga lyaboneka aanze, malweza anzala zyaboneka mukati kang'anda. Ooyo ulimumaanda uyojayigwa ipanga, nzala amalwazi nzeziyomujaya mumunzi.
Pesi nkubali bamwi akati bachija, bayooba atala amalundu. Bayoba mbuli inziba zyamukkuti, balavuluvuta umwi-- awumwi nkambo kamilandu yakwe.
Maanza woonse akompama mazwi woonse ateeta mbuli maanzi,
alimwi bazwata zisamo zyamasaka, kuyoowa kwabavumba; bweeme bulaboneka kubusyu bwabo boonse, alubala mpoluli amitwe yabo yoonse.

Bayosowa insiliva zyabo mumigwagwa aboobo ingolida zyabo ziyooba mbuli chintu chisofweede. Ingolida zyabo ansiliva zyabo zyoonse zilakachilwa kubavuna mubuzuba bwabukkali bwa Jehova. Mawumi aabo takatambulika pe, tebakakkutisikana nikuba kuzuzya mala aabo, nkambo nzenzizyo zyaba chilebyo chakubawisya muzibi.
Bakali kulitondezya bwebesi bwazyo, bakali kuzichitya zikozyanio zibi zisesemya, aboobo ndachita kuti zibabede mbulikuti nchintu chisofweede.
Njozipa mumaanza abazwakule kuti bazisale, abalabo basizibi benyika bayozitola, nkabela bayozisofwazya.
Ndiyofutatika busyu bwangu kuzwa kuli mbabo nkabela bayosofwazya chiyobwedo changu; bafumpi bayonjila muli nchicho bayochisofwazya.
Inyika ilizwide milandu yabulowa, amuunzi uzwide inkondo.
Lino njoyeeta basizibi babamasi kuti bakavube maanda abo, njomaninsya kulisumpula kwabayumu, amasena aabo aasalalisya ayosofwaazigwa!
Kuyoowa kuzosika! Balayandula luumuno, pele tabakoyolujana pe.
Malweza alasika aatala lyamalwezanyina, makani ayoosya alamvwigwa chakutobela makaninyina. Bayoyanduula chilengano kumusinsimi, pele mulawu uyoloba kubapayizi alulayo luyoloba kubanene.

Mwami ulalila basilitwe balasama chibaki chansoni, maanza aabantu bachisi alakankama. Njoobachitila mbubonya mbuli inzila zyabo! njobabeteka mbubonya mbubabeteka bamwi nkabela bayoziba kuti ndime Jehova.''

Lino mumunyaka wamusanu awumwi, amumwezi wamusanu awumwi, amubuzuba bwamusanu abumwi bwamumwezi, nindakakkede mung'anda yangu abalabo bapati bamu Juda nibakakkede kunembo lyangu, ijanza lyaMwami Jehova lyakandijata alimwi nkukoko.

Alimwi ndakalanga, alimwi ndakabona, akulangisisya, ndakabona chiimo chamuntu. Chilibonia mbuli mulilo muchikungu chakwe. Alimwi kuzwa muchikungu chakwe kuyakujulu wakali kumweka, mbuli insiliva ivweledwe angolide.

Mpawo wakatandabika eecho chakali kulibonia anga ndijaanza akubweza masusu amutwe wangu; muuya wakanditola kujulu akkati kanyika ajulu, alimwi amuzilengano zya Leza, wakandisisya ku Jelusalemu, wakanditola dokumanjililo amulyango wamukkati, ooko chitombe chabuzuba echo chipa kubamunyono nkuchakimvwi.
Mpawo amulange, bulemu bwa Leza wa Izilayeli bwakaliwo, mbuli chilengano nchindakabona ajulu lyantandabale.
Mpawo wakati kuli ndime, ''Omwanamuntu, kowala menso aako kunyika.'' Aboobo ndakawala menso angu kunyika, alimwi kunyika kwamilyango wakuchipayililo, kwakali chikozyanisyo chabuzuba kumanjililo.

Aboobo wakandaambila kuti, ''Omwana amuntu, wazibonana nzibalo kuchita? Eezi nzisesemyo zipati loko ezyo mung'anda ya Izilayeli nzilokuchita aano kuchita kuti mebo njekule amubusena bwangu. Pesi ulabona alimwi akubonesesya zimbi zisesemyo.''
Mpawo wakandeeta kumanjililo alubuwa, alimwi ndakalanga, kwakali chipulo mubwaanda,.''
Wakandaambila kuti, ''Omwana muntu, donkola chipulo mubwanda.'' Aboobo ndakadonkola chipulo mubwanda, alimwi ndakabona manjililo.
Mpawo wakandambila kuti, ''Koya alimwi ukabone zintu zibi zisesemya nzibachita okuno.''
Aboobo ndakanjila mukati alimwi ndakalanga akubona, ndakabona zikozyanio zyamisyobo yoonse yazilenge zikkala aansi azyabanyama, alimwi amituni yoonse isesemya yamung'anda ya Izilayeli.

Makkumi musanu aabili abapati bamung'anda yaba Izilayeli bakaliko, alimwi a Jazaniya mwana mulombe wa Safani wakalimvwi akkati kabo. Bayimvwi kunembo lyazitombe, alimwi umwi awumwi wakajisi chakuumpila tununkilizyo mujanza lyakwe kuchitila kuti mweemw wajoba lyamununkilizyo liye kujulu.

Wakandambila kuti, ''Omwanamuntu, wakubona nakuti bapati bang'anda ya Izilayeli balikuchita zyamumudima? Umwi awumwi mutwaanda twamituni yakwe moyibikkidwe, nkambo baamba kuti, 'Jehova tatubwene pe! Jehova wachisiya chisi.'''
Mpawo wakandambila kuti, ''Langa lubo alimwi ulabona zimbi zipati zisesemyanzibalokuchita.''
Aboobo wakandatola kumanjililo amulyango wang'anda ya Jehova yakali kubbazu kunyika, alimwi akubona! Elyo banakazi bakalikkede akulila chileza chitegwa Tamuzi.
Aboobo wakandaambila kuti, ''Wachibona na eechi, omwana muntu? Chengunuka lubo alimwi ulabona zimbi zisesemya kwiinda eezi.''

Aboobo wakanditola kulubuwa lwamukati lwang'anda ya Jehova, alimwi langa! kumanjililo antempele ya Jehova aakati kakkoche achipayililo, kwakali balumi basika kumakkumi aabili amusanu bakafutatilide ntempele lya Jehova alimwi masyu abo kaalangide kujwe, alimwi kavundamina zuba.

Wakandambila kuti, ''Wachibona na echi, omwana muntu? Naa nchintu chinini na kuti mung'anda ya Juda kabachita zisesemyo eezi nzibalokuchita aawa? Bazuzya chisi ankondo alimwi akuzumanana kundinyemya, kubikka mutabi kumpemo zyabo.
Aboobo ndilachita chabula aakati kabo; linso lyangu taliko beetelela pe, alimwi tandikoyo bafwida insoni lubo pe. Nikuba kuti bakwile kumatwi aangu chakompolola, nsikoyobamvwa pe.''
Mpawo wakakwila chakongolola kumatwi angu, alimwi ndakati, ''Kobiita aabo batisubule muunzi, umwi awumwi mujanza lyakwe kajisi chilwanisyo chakwe chakubelesya kukunyonyoona.''

Mpawo langa! baalumi balimusanu awumwi bazwa kubbazu lyamulyango waajulu uulangide kunyika, umwi awumwi kajisi chilwanisyo chakwe chakujazya mujanza lyakwe. Kwakali mwalumi umwi akati kabo iwakazweete chisani chuba wuba kajisi nkomo yazilembyo yamulembi muchikungu. Aboobo bakanjila mukkati alimwi bakiima kumbali achipayililo chamukkuba.

Eelyo nulemu bwa Leza wa Izilayeli bwakaya kujulu kuzwa awo mpobwakabede ajulu akkelebbimu akuya kumanjililo aang'anda. Wakiita mwalumi wakazweete chisani chuuba wuba, ooyo wakajisi chibikilo chazilembyo zyamulembi muchibuno chakwe.
Jehova wakamwaambila kuti, ''Koyinda mumunzi -- mu Jelusalemu -- ubikke chitondezyo ankumu zyabantu ibakwiila akutongela akambo kazintu zyoonse zisesemya zichitika mumunzi.''
Mpawo wakambila bamwi nkandimvwide amatwi aangu kuti, ''Mwiinde mumunzi mumutobele akujaya. Menso eenu ateetezegwi pe, alimwi mutabafwidi lubomba pe

naba muneene, naba mulombe nakalindu, naba mwana mucheche naa mwanakazi. Mubajaye boonse!  Pesi mutasiki afwifwi amuntu ulachitondezyo ankumu yakwe. Bakatalika kubapati aabo bakali kunembo lyang'anda.
Wakabambila kuti, ''Amwisofwazye ing'anda, alimwi mwizuzye mabuwa abantu bajiidwe. Kamuya!'' Aboobo bakiinka akujaya bantu mumunzi.

Nebakali kubajaya, ndakasyaala biyo andilikke alimwi ndakagodamika busyu bwangu mpawo akukwilila kuti, ''Ikaaka, Mwami Jehova, aate ulabanyonyoona ma Izilayeli basyeede boonse chindi notila bukali bwako mu Jelusalemu?''
Wakandaambila kuti, ''Chinyonyoono chamung'anda ya Izilayeli amaJuda nchipati loko. Nchisi chizwide bumpelenge lwabo bwini, nkambo bakati, 'Jehova wakachiluba chisi,' alimwi Jehova taboni pe!'
Nikuba bbobo, linso lyangu taliko betelela pe, alimwi nsikoyobafwida lubombo pe. Ndilabapa bulumbu bwanzila yabo amitwe yabo beeni.''
Langa! Mwaalumi uuzwete chisani chuuba-uba iwakajisi chinyumpwido chazilembyo muchikungu chakwe wakaboola musule. Wakaamba kuti, ''Ndachita mbubo mbuli mbwandilayilila.''
Nindakali kulangila ajulu achibimbili chakali aamitwe yama Kkelubbimu; ndakabona chimwi chintu chakali kulibonia anga ndibbwe lya Safile.

Mpawo Jehova waakambula kumwaalumi wakazwete zituba alimwi wakati, ''Yinka aakati kamavili aansi a Kkelubbimu, uzuzye maanza aako obile amakala alamulilo kuzwa aakati ka Kkelubbimu alimwi uwawale amuunzi.'' Mpawo mwaalumi wakanjila kandilangide.
Bakkelubbimu bakalimvwi kululyo lwanganda eelyo mwaalumwi nakanjilamukati, alimwi joba lyakanjila mulubuwa lwamukati.
Bulemu bwa Jehova bwakanyampuka kuzwa mu Kkelubbimu alimwi bwakaya kumanjililo anganda. Bwakazuzya nganda ajoba, alimwi lubuwa lwakazwide mumuni wamulemu bwaJehova.
Kuvuuma kwamababa amaKkelubbimu kwakali kulimvwisya aanze kwalubuwa, mbuli jwi lya Leza singuzu zyoonse mbulilimvwisya eelyo nawambuula.

Yakasika mbuli, eelyo Leza nakalayilila mwaalumi wakazweete ngubo zituba alimwi wakamwaambila kuti, '''Bweza mulilo kuzwa akati kamavili aali akati ka Kkelubbimu, ''mwaalumi wakanjila mukati alimwi wakiimikila avili.

Mukkelubbi wakatandamika jaanza lyakwe aakati kama Kkelubbimu kuyosika kumulilo wakali akati kama Kkelubbimu, alimwi wakayokolola akubikka mumaaanza aakwe mwaalumi wakazwete ngubo zituba. Ooyo mwaalumi wakawutambula alimwi wakazwa aanze.
Ndakabona ma Kkelubbimu kabali achimwi chintu chilimbuli jaanza lyamuntu munsi amababa aabo.
Aboobo nindakalanga, alimwi ndakabona! mavili aane kumbali ama Kkelubbimu- alimwi vili kumbali awumwi mukkelubbimu- alimwi kulibonia kwamavili kwakali kulibonia kwakali kubanga nkumwemweka kwabbwe.
Kulibonia kwawo woonse one kwakali kukozyania, akali kubanga ndivili lili muvili nyina kayingene.
Eelyo nakali kweenda, akali kwiinka mumabbazu aane aabo, kakutakwe kubweeda musule pe nakali kwiinka; pesi kufumbwa bbazu mutwe nkuwalanga, akali kutobela kakutabwe kubweda musule pe.
Mibili yabo yoonse- kubikkilizya amasule aabo,maanza aabo,alimwi amababa aabo zyakazwide meso, alimwi meso akazwide mavili koonse koonse one.
Nindakaswiilizya, ndakamvwa jwi lyakoompolola kumavili kuti, ''Amweende .''
Awumwi awumwi wakali amasyu aane; busy butanzi bwakali busyu bwa Kkelubbi, busyu bwachibili bwakali busyu bwamuntu, busyu bwachitatu bwakali bwamulavu, alimwi busyu bwane bwakali bwapolo.
Mpawo ma Kkelubbimu- eezi nzezilengezyuumi nzindakabona kumulonga Kkebba.
Eelyo ma Kkelubbimu nibakali kweenda, mavili alawo akali kweenda, eelyo ma Kkelubbimu nibakanyampula mababa aabo kuti awuluke kuzwa aanyika, mavili takabweda musule pe. Akali kumbali aabo.
Eelyo ma kkelubbimu nibakali kwiima mavili akali kwiima alawo, alimwi elyo nibanyampuka kujulu, mavili ngawuluka ambabo alawo, muuya wakali kweendelezya zyuumi wakali mumavili.
Mpawo bulemu bwa Jehova bwakazwa ajulu amanjililo amulyango wanganda alimwi wakwiima aajulu aba kkelubbimu.

Makkelubbimu bakavupula mababa aabo akuluka kuzwa anyika kandilangide eelyo nibakali kuzwa alimwi mavili akachita mbubo mumbali kwabo. Bakiima kumanjililo amulyango wakujwe wakunganda ya Jehova, alimwi bulemu bwaLeza wa Izilayeli bwakabasikila ajulu kwabo.
Eezi nzezilenge zyuumi nzindakabona kunsi a Leza wa Izilayeli kumulonga wa Kkebba Kkanali, aboobo ndakabona kuti bakali ma kkelubbimu!
Boonse bane bakajisi masyu aane,
alimwi achimwi chintu chakali kulibonia mbuli zilenge nzindabwene ku Kkebba Kkanali, alimwi awumwi wabo wakiinka kalangide kunembo luzutu.

Lino Muuya wakandisumpula wandisisya kumulyango wakubuzwezuba wang'anda ya Jehova, uulangide kubuzwezuba nkabela kumanjililo kwakali baalumi bakali makkumi obile amusanu. Ndakabona Jazaniya mwana mulombe wa Azuli, a Pelatiya mwana mulombe wa Bbenaya, bazululi ba bantu, aakati kabantu.
Leza wakati kulindime, ''Mwana wamuntu, aaba mbibaalumi babumba bubi, alimwi  bapa lulayo lubi mumuunzi uno.
''Bali kwaamba kuti, 'Lino teensi chiindi chakuyaka maanda pe; muunzi ooyu nimpoto, mpawo swe tuli nyama.'
Akaako sinsima chakubapa mulandu. Sinsima, mwana wamuntu.''
Lino Muuya wa Jehova wakandiselukila wati ndaambe kuti: Oobu mbubo mbwaamba Jehova, ''Oobu mbubo mbolikwaamba, bg'anda ya Izilayeli; nkaambo ndilizi zilikuchitika mumiyeeyo yanu.
Mwavuzya bantu mbimwakajaya mumunzi ooyu alimwi mwazuzya migwagwa yawo ambabo.

Nkinkaako, Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Bantu mbimwakajaya, aabo mbimulazikide mibili yabo mukati ka Jelusalemu, mbembabo nyama, alimwi muunzi ooyu ni mpoto. Pesi muyoogwisigwa kuzwa mukati kachisi eechi.
Mwayoowa panga, aboobo ndileeta panga aatala lyanu - ooku nkokwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova.
Ndiyoomugwisya kuzwa aakati lya muunzi alimwi ndikamubike mumaanza a bazwakule, nkaambo ndiyooyeta lubeta aalindinywe.
Muyoojiigwa aapanga. Ndiyoomubeteka mumigaano ya Izilayeli nkabela muyooziba kuti ndime Jehova.
Ooyu muunzi tukoyooba mpoto yakujikila pe, nikuba nywebo kuyooba nyama aakati kawo. Ndiyoomubeteka mumigaano ya Izilayeli.
Lino muyooziba kuti ndime Jehova ooyo uuli aambeta nzimwakatatobelezya pe alimwi ooy uuli aamilawu njimwakatachita pe. Pesi mwakachita milawu ya zisi zimuzyungulukide.''

Zyakachitika kuti nindakalikusinsima, Pelatiya mwana mulombe wa Bbenayiya, wakafewa. Aboobo ndakavundama ndalila ajwi pati ndati, ''Akaka, Mwami Jehova, sena muyoolobya boonse bakasyeede ba Izilayeli?''
Ijwi ly Jeova lyakandisikila lyakati,

''Mwana wa muntu, bana bakwenu! Bana bakwenu! Baalumi bamukowa wako aboonse bang'anda ya Izilayeli! Boonse mbimbabo baambwa abaabo bakkala mu Jelusalemu kuti, 'Bali kulekuzwa kuli Jehova! Eeyi nyika twakayipegwa kuti twiivube.'

Aboobo amba kuti, 'MwamiJehova waamba eechi: Nikuba kuti ndabatandila kule aakati kamanyika alimwi nikuba ndabamwaya mumasena, pesi ndakabede chikombelo chabo kwachiindi chiniini mumasena ooko nkubaya.'
Nkinkaako amba kuti, 'MwamiJehova waamba eechi: Ndiyomubungania kuzwa kuli bamasi akumuyobolola kuzwa kuzisi nkumwakamwayikilide, alimwi ndiyoomupa nyika ya Izilayeli.'
Mpawo bayooyinka nkuko akuyoogwisya choonse chintu chisesemya azyoonse zilweza mubusena oobo.
Ndiyoobapa moyo womwe, alimwi ndiyoobika muuya mupya mulimbabo. Ndiyoogwisya moyo wabbwe kuzwa kunyama yabo akubapa moyo wanyama,
kuti bakeende mumbeta zyangu, bakabweze milawu yangu akuyooyichita. Mpawo bayooba bantu bangu andime ndiyooba Leza wabo.
Pesi kuli baabo beende aziyandisyo zyabo kuzisesemyo a malweza aabo, ndiyooyeta nchito zyabo aamitwe yabo - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova.''
Ba Kkelubbimu bakatandabika mababa aabo antoomwe amavili aakali kumbali lyabo, alimwi bulemu bwa Leza wa Izilayeli bwakali aajulu ambabo.
Mpawo bulemu bwa Jehova bwakayinka kuzwa aakati kamuunzi akwiimikila aachilundu kujwe lya muunzi.
Muuya wakandibweza akundeeta mu Chaludiya, kubantu bakachija kuzwa kunyika zyabo, mu chilengano kuzwa ku Muuya wa Leza, alimwi chilengano nchindakali ndabona chakazwa aalindime.
Mpawo ndakaambila bantu aaba zyoonse zintu zya Jehova nzindakabona.
Ijwi lya Jehova lyakaza kulindime, kaliti,
''Mwana wa muntu, ukkala aakati kang'anda iipapide ooko nkubaliaamenso akubona pesi taabonipe; ooko nkubali aamatwi aakumvwa pesi tabaswiilizyi pe, nkaambo ning'anda iipapide.

Nkinkaako akaambo kako, mwana wa muntu, bambila zintu zyako kuya mubuzike akutalisya kuya aanze sikati kumenso aabo, nkaambo ndiyookuchita muzike kumenso aabo kuzwa kubusena bwako kuya kuli biumwi busena. Amwi bayootalisya kubona nikuba kiili ng'anda iipapide.
Uyoogwisya zintu zyako kuya mu buzike sikati kumenso aabo; zwa aanze golezya kumenso aabo munzila eeyo kufumbwa umwi njayinka aayo mu buzike.
Sya bulyango kwiinda mubulambo kumenso aabo ukazwe aanze kwwindila mulimbabo.

Kumenso aabo, nyampula zintu zyako aakkuko lyako alimwi ukazyeete aanze mumudima. Vumba kumenso kwako akaambo kakuti towelede kubona nyika pe, mbukunga ndakubika mbuli chitondeezyo kung'anda ya Izilayeli.''

Aboobo ndakachita eechi mbuli mbundakalayililwa. Ndakagwisya aanze zintu zyangu zya buzike kalibala, alimwi golezya ndakasya bulyango akuboko bwakadonkola bulambo. Ndakagwisya aanze zintu zyangu mumudima, alimwi ndakazinyampula aakuko lyangu kumenso aabo.
Mpawo jwi lya Jehovalyakaza kulindime chifumo kaliti,
''Mwana wa muntu, iilya ng'anda ya Izilayeli iipapide teyabuzya na kuti, 'Ulikuchitaanzi?'

Aboobo ukatedi kulimbabo, 'MwamiJehova waamba eechi: eechi chichitiko cha chisinsimi chilangene aatala a mwana mulombe wa Mwami mu Jelusalemu, a ng'anda yoonse ya Izilayeli oomo mubabede aakati kabo.'
Amba kuti, 'Ndili chitondeezyo kulindinywe.' Mbuli mbundakachita, mbubo mbukuyoochitwa kulimbabo; bayooya mubuzike a mubwaange.

Mwana mulombe wa Mwami uyoonyampula zintu zyakwe aakkuko lyakwe mumudima, alimwi uyoozwa aanze kwiindila mubulambo. Bayoosya akudonkola bulambo akugwisya zintu zyabo. Uyolivumba busyu bwakwe kuti atakaboni nyika amenso aakwe.
Ndiyootalamuna kazamba kangu aatala lyakwe alimwi uyoochigwa mukakkole kangu; mpawo ndiyoomweeta ku Bbabbiloni, nyika ya ba Chaludiya, pesi takoyooyibona pe. Uyoofwa nkuko.
Alimwi ndiyoomwayuula kumabbazu woonse boonse bamuzyungulukide beelede kumugwasya a lumamba lwakwe loonse. Ndiyootuma panga litakabatobele.
Mpawo bayooziba kuti ndime Jehova aawo ndaakubasansaania mumanyika akubamwayula aakati kamasena.
Pesi ndiyoosiya baalumi bache aakati kabo kuzwa kupanga, kunzala, a kuzitondeezyo zya malwazi kuti bakakonzye kulemba malweza aabo mumasena mundabatola kukuziba kuti ndime Jehova.''
Ijwi ly Jehova lyakaza kulindime kaliti,
''Mwana wa muntu lya chinkwa chako chakuyoowa, alimwi nywa maanzi aako chakukankama akulikataazya.

Mpawo uteedi kubantu benyika, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi aatala abantu bakkala mu Jelusalemu, anyika ya Iziayeli, ''Bayoolya chinkwa chabo chakuyoowa akunywa maanzi aabo chakukankama mbokunga nyika iyoobisigwa mubuzwide bwayo akaambo ka lupyopyongano lwabaabo bakkala nkuko.
Aboobo myuunzi yakakkedwe iyooba matongo, alimwi nyika iyooba yabuyo; aboobo muyooziba kuti ndime Jehova.'''''
Alubo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,
''Mwana wa muntu, nkaakali kasimpi aaka nkimulaako munyika ya Izilayeli kati, 'Mazuba alampisigwa, alimwi choonse chilengano chakachilwa?'

Nkinkaako amba kuti kulimbanbo, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Ndiyoogozya kasimpi aaka, alimwi bantuba Izilayeli tabachiyokabelesyi lubo pe.' Amba kuti kulimbabo, 'Mazuba afwiinsigwa aawo chilengano choonse mpuchiyoozuzikizigwa.
Nkaambo takuchiyoobi limbi zilengano zyakubeja na busondi butakabakonde mukati kang'anda ya Izilayeli.

Nkaambo ndime Jehova! Ndilaambuuka akuchita majwi ngewambuula. Kaambo takachiyoochelezegwi pe nkaambo ndiyoowambuula majwi aaya mumazuba aanu, nong'anda iipapide, alimwi ndikaazuzikizye! - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova.'''
Alubo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,
''Mwana wamuntu! Langa ng'anda ya Izilayeli yaamba kuti, 'Chilengano nchabona nchamazuba miingi kuzwa lino, alimwi usinsima zyiindi zilikule.'
Nkinkaako amba kuti kulimbabo, 'MwamiJehova waamba eechi: Majwi aangu taachiyoochelezegwi limbi pe, pesi jwi ndindaambuula liyoochitwa - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova.'''
Alubo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,
''Mwana wamuntu, sinsima aatala abasinsimi balikusinsima mu Izilayeli, alimwi waambe kulibaabo balikusinsima zizwa mumiyeeyo yabo, 'Muswiilile kujwi lya Jehova.
Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Maawe kubasinsimi bafubafuba batobelela myuuya yabo, pesi batakwe nchibakabona!
Izilayeli, basinsimi bako bakaba mbuli bamwaaba bali munyika zitachikwe lugwasyo pe.
Tamunaakwiinka pe kung'anzi zyabulambo buzyungulukide Izilayeli kuti mukabubambulule kuti bukakonzye kwiimikila munkondo mubuzuba bwa Jehova.

Bantu babona zilengano zyakubeja akwaamba zizazitalinzizyo, aabo baamba kuti, ''Eechi acheechi nkwaamba kwa Jehova.'' Jehova tabatumide pe, pesinikuba boobo bakachita bantu kuti babe aabulangilizi kuti milumbe yabo iyoozuzikizigwa.
Sa tamunaabona zyakubeja a kwaamba zyakubeja ziza imywe nimwaamba kuti, ''Eechi acheechi nkwaamba kwa Jehova'' aawo mebo mpesyaambwiide pe?'
Nkinkaako Mwami Jehova waamba boobu, 'Akaambo kakuti mwakali aazilengano zyakubeja alimwi mwakaamba mabejo - nkinkaako nkoku kwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova aatala anduwe:

Kuboko kwangu kuyoolwisya  basinsimi bali aazilengano zyakubeja alimwi baamba zitali nzizyo ziza. Tabakoyooba mumbungano yabantu bangu, na kulembwa mumalembe aang'anda ya Izilayeli; tabeelede pe kwiinka kunyika ya Izilayeli. Muyooziba kuti ndime Mwami Jehova!
Akaambo kacheechi akuti bakazulwida bantu bangu chakubasowa akwaamba kuti, ''Luumuno!'' aawo aatakwe luumuno, balikuyaka bulambo mbubatazoozile ampende iituba ibuuluka.'
Baambile aabo balikuzila bulambo ampende iituba ibuuluka kuti, 'Buyookolomoka; kuyoowa mvula mpati alimwi ndiyootumina chivula mabwe kuti bukawide aansi, aguwo pati kuti likawuwisizye aansi.
Bona, bulambo buyoowida aansi. Bamwi tebakakwaambila na kuti, ''Ilikuli mpende iituba ibuuluka njimwakabikide aalimbubo?''

Nkinkaako Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Ndiyoyeta guwo pati mukubijilwa kwangu kupati, alimwi kuyooba mazambangulwe aamvula mukunyema kwangu kupati! Chivula mabwe mukubijilwa kwangu kupati chiyoobanyonyoona.

Nkaambo ndiyookwamwida aansi bulambo mbumwazila ampende iituba ibuuluka, alimwi ndiyoowudilisizya aansi akumwaya ntalisyo yawo. Aboobo uyoowa alimwi muyoonyonyoonwa aakati kabo. Mpawo muyooziba kuti ndime Jehova.
Mukubijilwa kwangu kupati ndiyoonyonyoona bulambo antoomwe abaabo bakabuzila mpende iituba ibuuluka. Ndiyooti kulindinywe, ''Bulambo tabuchiwo pe, nikuba aabo bakabuzila ampende iituba ibuuluka -
basinsimi ba Izilayeli aabo bakasinsima aatala a Jelusalemu alimwi bakali aazilengano zya luumuno aatala anjiyo. Pesi takwe luumuno pe! - ooku nkwaambuula kwa Jehova.'''
Aboobo we mwana wamuntu, bika busyu bwako aatala abana basimbi babantu bako basinsimi zizwa mumiyeeyo yabo, alimwi ukasinsimi aatala ambabo.

Amba kuti, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Maawe ku banakazi aabo basuna zimpanganiko kuli chimwi achimwi chimpanzi chakuboko kwabo akulichitila zidabba zyamitwe yabo zyamyeelwe yoonse, zibelesegwa kukuvwimya bantu. Sena mulavwima bantu bangu pesi kamukwabilila mawumi eenu?

Mwandisampawula aakati kabantu bangu akaambo ka bbali uuzwide jaanza, abufwefwelenga bwachinkwa, kujaya bantu bateelede kufwa, akubamba mawumi aabaabo bateelede kupona, akaambo kamabejo aanu kubantu bakamumvwa.

Nkinkaako Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Ndilikulwanisya zimpanganiko nzimwakabelesya kukucha mawumi aabantu mbuli kuti ntuyuni. Nchobeni ndiyoobadeluula kuzwa mumaanza aanu; ndiyoowangununa aabo mbimwakacha mbuli tuyuni.
Ndiyoodeluula ziddaba zyanu zyakumitwe alimwi nkavune bantu bangu kuzwa kujaanza lyanu. Tabachiyoobi kabachedwe limbi mu maboko aanu. Muyooziba kuti ndime Jehova.

Akaambo kakuti mulatyompa moyo wa musalali amabejo, nikuba tendalikuyanda kutyompwa kwakwe, akuti mulasungwaazya nchito zyamuntu uutaluleme kuti atakonzyi kuzwa munzila yakwe kuti afutule buumi bwakwe -
nkinkaako tochiyoobi aazilengano zyakubeja limbi pe na kwiinkilila nkowamba lyejunza, nkaambo ndiyoovuna bantu bangu kuzwa kujaanza lyako. Muyooziba kuti ndime Jehova.
Bamwi ba baalu ba Izilayeli bakasika kulindime, bakkala kunembo lyangu.
Mpawo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,
''Mwana wamuntu, aaba baalumi nakabweza zitoombe zyabo mumyoyo yabo akubika chilebyo chazibi zyabo kunembo lya busyu bwabo. Kujana ndabuzigwa na aambabo?

Nkinkaako baambile eechi alimwi waambe kuti, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Woonse mwaalumi wa mung'anda ya Izilayeli uubika zitoombe mumoyo wakwe, na uubika chilebyo chazibi kunembo lyabusyu bwakwe, akuza ku musinsimi - imende Jehova, bweelene amweelo wazitoombe zyakwe.
Ndiyoochita boobu kuchitila kuti ndikaboozye ng'anda ya Izilayeli mumyooyo eeyo yakaba kule kuzwa kulindime akaambo kazitoombe zyabo.'
Nkinkaako wambila ng'anda ya Izilayeli kuti, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Musanduke akuzwa kuzitoombe zyaanu! Mugwisye masyu anu kuzwa ku zisesemyo zyanu zyoonse.

Nkaambo woonse wamung'anda ya Izilayeli a woonse muzwakule uukkala mu Izilayeli uunditantamuka, uubika zitoombe zyakwe mumoyo wakwe alimwi uubika chilebyo chachibi chakwe kunembo lya busyu bwakwe, mpawo waza ku musinsimi kuzoondiyanduula - ime nde Jehova ndiyoomusandula lwangu ndemwini.
Aboobo ndiyoobika busyubwangu kukumulwisya akumuchita chitondeezyo akasimpi nkaambo ndiyomugwisya aakati kabantu bangu, mpawomuyooziba kuti ndime Jehova.
Na musinsimi weenwa alimwi waamba mulumbe, mpawo me, nde Jehova, ndiyoyena musinsimi ooyo; ndiyotandabika kuboko kwangu kukumulwisya akumunyonyoona kuzwa aakati kabantu bangu ba Izilayeli.
Bayoobweza milandu yabo; milandu yabasinsimi iyookozyania amilandu ya sikubuzya kuzwa kulinguwe.

Akaambokacheechi, ing'anda ya Izilayeli tiikoyoozungaana limbi kuzwa kulindime mukunditobela nikuba kuyoolisofwaazya limbi kwiindila  mumilandu yabo. Bayooba bantu bangu alimwi ndiyooba Leza wabo - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova.'''
Mpawo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,

''Mwana wamuntu, na nyika yandibisizya akuchita chibi chichita kuti nditandabike kuboko kwangu aatala anchicho akusinka ooko nkuchijana kulya, akutumina bbalangwe aatala anchicho akujaya bantu abanyama munyika;
mpawo nikuba aaba baalumi botatwe - Nowa, Daniyele, a Jobbu - nkakuli kuti bali aakati kanu, balikuyoovuna mawumi aabo luzutu akaambo ka bululami bwabo - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova.
Na ndatuma zinyama zibi munyika akwiichita kuti ibule michelo kuchitila kuti ibe nyika iitakwe chintu bantu nkubatakonzyi kutimbula akaambo kazinyama,

mpawo nikuba aaba baalumi botatwe bakali mulinjiyo - mbuli mbepona, mbwaamba Jehova - tebakali kuyookonzya pe nikuba kuvuna bana babo balombe  na basimbi; luzutu mawumi aabo ngaali kuyoovunwa, pesi nyika yali kuyooba iitakwe lugwasyo.
Nikuba na ndayeta panga aatala anyika eeyo akwaamba kuti, 'Panga, koya munyika alimwi ujaye bantu abanyama,'
mpawo nikuba aaba baalumi botatwe bakali munyika - mbuli mbepona, mbwaamba Jehova - tebakali kuyookonzya pe nikuba kuvuna bana babo balombe  na basimbi; luzutu mawumi aabo ngaali kuyoovunwa.
Nikuba na ndatuma chisubulo aatala anyika eeyi akutila bukali bwangu kwiindila mukutika kwa bulowa, kuti ndijaye bantu abanyama,
mpawo nikuba Nowa, Daniyele, a Jobbu bakali munyika eeyo - tebakali kuyookonzya pe nikuba kuvuna bana babo balombe  na basimbi; luzutu mawumi aabo ngaali kuyoovunwa akaambo kabululami bwabo.

Nkaambo Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Ndiyoyindilizya kubijisya zintu akutuma zisubulo zyangu zine - bbalangwe, panga, banyama bamusokwe, a malwazi - aatala a Jelusalemu kukujaya bantu abanyama kuzwa kulinjiyo.

Pesi, langa! Bafutuke bayoochaala mulinjiyo, baponi batakayinke aanze abana balombe abana basimbi. Langa! Bayooza kulinduwe, alimwi uyoobona nzila anchito zyabo alimwi uyowumbulizigwa aatala achisubulo nchindatuma ku Jelusalemu, azyoonse nzindatuma aatala anyika.
Bapona bayokuumbulizya waakubona nzila anchito zyabo, aboobo muyooziba  zyoonse zintu nzindakachita aatala anjiyo kuti tendakazichita chabuyo! - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova.
Mpawo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,
''Mwana wamuntu, mubotu biyeni musaansa kwiinda umwi musamu uuli aantabi ooyo uuli aakati kalusaka?
Bantu balabweza na chisamu kuzwa ku musaansa bachite chimwi chintu? Na kuchita mumano kuti balengelezye chimwi chintu?
Bona! Na wasowelwa mumulilo mbuli chiyasilizyo, alimwi na mulilo watenta zyoonse mpela zyacho aakati, chinoli chichibotelede chimwi chintu na?
Bona! Aawo nichakachizwide, techali kuchita chimwi chintu; alimwi aawo nichatentwa tachikoyoochita chimwi chintu kale pe chibeleseka.
Nkinkaako Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Mbuli kutali misamu iili mulusaka, ndapa musaansa mbuli chiyasilizyo chamililo; ndiyoochita munzila iyeelene kunembo lyabantu bakkala mu Jelusalemu.

Nkaambo ndiyoonyampula busyuu bwangu akwiiminana aabo. Nikuba bakazwe mumulilo, pesi mulilo uyoobatenta akubalotya; aboobo muyooziba kuti ndime Jehova, aawo ndaakunyampula busyu bwangu akwiiminana aabo.
Mpawo ndiyoochita nyika kuti ikabe iisowedwe iitakwe lugwasyo nkaambo bakachita chibi - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova.''
Mpawo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,
''Mwana wamuntu, zibya Jelusalemu aatala azisesemyo zyakwe,
alimwi waambe, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi kuli Jelusalemu: Matalikilo aako abuzyalwe bwako bwakachitikila mubusena bwanyika ya Kkenani; wuso wakali mu Amoli, abanyoko bakali mu Hiti.
Mubuzuba bwakuzyalwa kwako, banyoko teensi bakalunenga pe lukombokombo lwako, nikuba kukusalazya mumaanzi na kukukkumba amunyo, na kukupopelezya achidabba.
Takwe linso lyakakufwida luzyalo kuti likuchitile chimwi chazeezi, kukufwida luzyalo kunembo lyako. Mubuzuba niwakazyalwa, akusulwa kwabuumi bwako, wakasowelwa aanze mumuunda uujulikide.
Pesi ndakayinda kumbali lyako, alimwi ndakakubona koli kubumbuluka mubulowa bwako; aboobo ndakati kulinduwe mubulowa bwako, ''Pona!'' Ndakati kulinduwe mubulowa bwako, ''Pona!''
Ndakakuchita kuti ukomene mbuli musamu uuli mumuunda. Wakavula alimwi wakaba mupati, mpawo wakaba nchoko yenchoko. Nkolo zyako zyakayuma alimwi susu lyako lyakakomena nikuba wakalimaya kotazweete.

Ndakakwiinda lubo, alimwi ndakakubona. Bona! Chiindi cha luyando chakakusikila, aboobo ndakabika mulembo wangu aalinduwe kuvumba maya yako. Mpawo ndakakonkezya kulinduwe alimwi ndakweeta mu chizuminano - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova - mpawo wakaba wangu.
Aboobo ndakakusanzya amaanzi alimwi ndakagwisya bulowa kuzwa kulinduwe, mpawo ndakakunanika amafuta.
Ndakakuzwaatika zizwaato zibotu ansangu mbotu zyachikumba kumawulu aako. Ndakakuzambilila amulembo mubotu wa telelina akukuvumba aboya.
Chitobela ndakakubotya anchoko mumaanza aako, abulungu buzyunguluka mukosi wako.
Ndakakubika chisita mupemo yako a malangulangu mumatwi anu, amusini mubotu amutwe wako.
Aboobo wakabotesegwa a ngolide ansiliva, alimwi wakasamikidwe amulembo mubotu, boya azizwaato zibotu; wakalya busu bunante, buchi, a mafuta. Wakali mubotu alimwi wakaba mbuli mwami wachanakazi.
Mpuwo yako yakeendelela aakati kazisi nkaambo kabubotu bwako, nkaambo chakali kweebeka mubulemu mbundakakupede - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova.
Pesi webo wakasyoma bubotu bwako, alimwi wakachita mbuli sibwaamu akaambo kampuwo yako; wakatila nchito zyako zya bwaamu kuli woonse wakiinda kumbali lyako kuti bubotu bwako bube bwako.

Mpawo wakabweza zibaki zyako alimwi anzizyo wakalibotesezya busena bwako bwaajulu amibala iisiyene, alimwi ooko wakachita mbuli sibwaamiu. Eechi techakeelede kuchitika pe. Nikuba kuti chintu chili boobu chipone.
wakabweza nchoko mbotu zya ngolide ansiliva eezyo nzindakakupa mpawo wakalichitila zitoombe zyaalumi. Wakachita anzizyo mbuli sibwaamu mbakonzya kuchita.
Wakabweza zizwaato zyako zibotu wazivumba, alimwi wakabika mafuta aangu ansende zyangu kunembo lyazyo.
Ndakakupa chibunge changu - chichitidwe aabusu bunante, mafuta, a buchi - wakazibika kunembo lyazyo kuti zipe bweema bununkilila, nkaambo eezi nzizyo zyakachitika - ooku nkwaamba kwa Jehova.
Mpawo wakabweza bana bako balombe abasimbi mbiwakandizyalila akubapedekezya ku zitoombe kuti bakalyigwe mbuli chakulya. Nchito zyako zyabwaamu nchintu chiniini na?
Mwakajaya bana bangu kuzitoombe akubachita kuti biinde mumulilo.
Kuzisesemyo zyako zyoonse akunchito zyabwaamu bwako takwe niwakayeeya mazuba aabwanike bwako pe, aawo niwakali maya kotazweete niwakali kutapata mbublowa bwako.
Mawe! Mawe kulinduwe! - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova - nkinkaako, kukuyungizya kububi oobu boonse,
wakaliyakila chilikwabililo akulichitila ntumba ndamfu mumasena woonse.
Wakayaka busena buli aatala lyamigwagwa yoonse akuchita bubotu bwako buusu. Wakajula mawulu aako kuli kufumbwa wakiinda kumbali lyako mpawo wakavuzya nchito zyako zyabwaamu.
Wakachita mbuli sibwaamu a ba Ijipiti, basimayakilanwe bako basikweemuzya, alimwi wakachita nchito nyingi zyabwaamu, kundichita kuti ndinyeme.
langa! Ndiyokuuma ajanza lyangu alimwi nkagozye kulya kwako. Ndiyoopedekezya buumi bwako kuli basinkondonyokwe, bana basimbi baba Filisitiya, aabo bakaba aabweeme amaponeno aako mabi.
Wakapona mbuli sibwaamu aatoomwe a ma Asiliya nkaambo tewalikukkutisikana pe. Wakachita mbuli sibwaamu alimwi tewakakkutisikana pe.
Wakachita nchito nyingi zyabwaamu munyika ya zyabuuzya baku Chaludiya nikuba eezi tezyakakukkutisya pe.
Moyo wako uchiswa biyeni - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova - kuti ulakonzya kuchita eezi zyoonse zintu, nchito zyasibwaamu uutakwe nsoni?
Mwakaliyakila zyakulikwabilila aajulu aanzala akulichitila ntumba zili aajulu mumasena woonse. Pesi tewakali mbuli sibwaamu pe nkaambo mwakasampawula kubweza mbadalo.
Yomwanakazi simamambe, iwe nuutambula batuba kwiinda mulumi wako.
Bantu balaliya kuli sbwaamu woonse, pesi upa mufolo ku bayandwi bako akubeeneena kuti baze kulinduwe kuzwa kumazuba aanchito zyabwaamu bwako.
Aboobo kuli musiyane aakati kako abamwi banakazi. Takwe naba womwe uukuliya kuti uchite mbuli sibwaamu. Nduwe uupesene. Wakabapa mbandalo alimwi takwe yapegwa kulinduwe pe.
Nkinkaako webo sibwaamu, swiilila jwi lya Jehova.

Mwami Jehova waamaba eechi: Akaambo kakuti wakatila aansi nkosya yako alimwi akutavumba maya yako kwiindila munchito zyako zyabwaamu abayandwi bako azileza zyako zisesemya, alimwi kuti wakabapa bulowa bwabana bako,

nkinkaako, langa, ndiyoobungania bayandwi bako boonse mbuwakaswaanana aabo, boonse mbiwakayanda alimwi abaabo mbiwakasula, ndiyobabungania kukubukila nduwe kumabazu woonse. Ndiyoovumbula maya yako kulimbabo kuti bakabone yoonse maya yako.
Nkaambo ndiyokupa chisubulo akaambo kabwaamu akutila bulowa, alimwi ndiyoyeta kutika kwabulowa kwabukali aluzyalo lwangu.
Ndiyomupeda mumaanza aabo kuti bakakonzye kuwaalila aansi maanda anu akunyonyoona masena aalikujulu, alimwi bayoomukulula anchoko zyabo zyoonse zyeebeka  Bayookusiya koli maya kotazweete.
Mpawo bayokuletela nkamu yakukulwisya akukutulula mabwe, alimwi bayookunenguula amapanga aabo.
Bayootenta maanda aako akuchita nchito zyachisubulo aatala lyako kunembo lyabanakazi biingi. Nkinkaako ndiyokulesya bubwaamu bwako, alimwi tochiyoobabbadali limbi bayandwi bako.
Mpawo ndiyowumuzya bukali bwangu kulinduwe; bukali bwangu buyookusiya nkaambo ndinoli ndakkutisikana, nsichiyoonyemi limbi.

Akaambo kakuti tewakandiita kukuyeeya mazuba aabwanike bwako alimwi wakandichita kuti ndizungaane akaambo kazintu zyoonse eezi, nkinkaako , langa! Ndiyoyeta aatala aamutwe wako chisubulo chanziwakachita - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova. Tewakayungizya bwaamu na aali zyoonse zisesemyo zyako?
Langa! Woonse muntu waambuula tusimpi aatala anduwe uyowowamba kuti, ''Mbuli banyina mbubabede, aboobo amwana wabo musimbi mbabede.''
Uli mwana musimbi wabanyoko, wakasampawula mulumi wabo abana bakwe, alimwi ulimuchizi wabachizi bako bakassampawula balumi babo abana babo. Banyoko wakali mu Hiti, wuso wakali mu Amoli.
Muchizi wako mupati wakali Samaliya alimwi bana bakwe basimbi mbabo bakali kukkala kunyika, eelyo muchizi wako muniini nguwe wakali kukkala ku musanza kwako, kwaamba kuti, Sodomu abana bakwe basimbi.
Teensi kuti wakeenda luzutu munzila zyabo akutobelezya mayeeyelo anchito zyabo, pesi munzila zyako zyoonse wayindilila kuli mbubakabede.
Mbuli mbechipona - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova - muchizi wako Sodomu abana bakwe basimbi, tebachita bubi bwiingi mbuli nduwe abana bako basimbi mbubakachita.

Langa! Eechi chakali chibi cha muchizi wako Sodomu nchaakachita mukuti wakali kulisumpula mukulyiiba kwakwe, katakwe bubanzi akutalikataazya aatala achintu chomwe. Takali kuyumya maanza aabantu bachete ababula.
Wakali kulisumpula alimwi wakali kuchita nchito mbi kunembo lyangu, aboobo ndakabatanda mbuli mbuwakabona.

Naba Samaliya taakachitide nichiba chisela chazibi zyakwe; anikuti webo wakachita zyiingi zisesemyo kwiinda nzibakachita, alimwi wakatondeezya kuti bachizi bako bakali mbubo kwiinda nduwe akaambo kazintu zisesemya nzyochita!

Ikapati we, tondeezya bweeme bwako; muli eeyi nzila unoli watondeezya kuti bachizi bako bakalimbubo kwiinda nduwe akaambo kazibi nziwakachita muli eezyo zyoonse nzila zisesemya. Bachizi bako lino baboneka kabali mbubo kwiinda nduwe. Ikapati we, tondeezya bweeme bwako, muli eeyi nzila unoli watondeezya kuti bachizi bako bakalimbubo kwiinda nduwe.
Ndiyooboozya zyoolwe zyabo - zyoolwe zya Sodomu abana bakwe basimbi, a zyoolwe zya Samaliya abana bakwe basimbi; pesi zyoolwe zyako zinooli aakati kabo.
Mukulangisisya zintu eezi uyootondeezya bweeme bwako; uyoobijilwa loko akaambo kazyoonse nziwakachita, munzila eeyi uyooba chuumbulizyo kuli mbabo.

Aboobo muchizi wako Sodomu abana bakwe basimbi bayoobwedezegwa muchiimo nchibakabede lutaanzi, alimwi Samaliya abana bakwe basimbi bayoobwedezegwa kunyika yabo. Mpawo we abana bako basimbi muyooboozegwa kuchiimo chanu chalutaanzi.
Sodomu muchizi wako takwe nakambidwe amulomo wako mumazuba aakulisumpula kwako,
bubi bwako kabutanaayubununwa. Pesi lino waba chisampawuzyo kubana basimbi ba Idomu akuli boonse bana basimbi baba Filisitiya bamuzyungulukide. Bantu boonse bali kukusampawula.
Uyootondeezya bweeme bwako anchito zyako zisesemya! - ooku nkwaamba kwa Jehova!
Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Ndiyoomaninsyania aayebo mbuli mbukweelede, inywe nimwakasampawula chikonke chanu akutyola mulawu.
Pesi me ndiyooyeeya chizuminano changu nchindakachita mumazuba aabukubusi bwako, alimwi ndiyooyimika chizuminano changu anduwe kwa lyoonse.
Mpawo we uyooyeeya nzila zyako alimwi uyooba aansoni aawo waakutambula bachizi bako bapati a baniini. Ndiyoobapa kulinduwe mbuli bana basimbi, pesi peepe achizuminano chako.
Me lwangu ndiyooyimika chizuminano changu anduwe, alimwi uyoziba kuti ndime Jehova.

Akaambo kazintu eezi, uyooyeeya zyoonse alimwi uyooba aabweeme aboobo tokoyoojula mulomo wako kukwaambuula akaambo kabweeme bwako kuchiindi nenjookulekelela kuli zyoonse nziwakachita - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehiva.'''
Ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaiti,
''Mwana wamuntu, amba kalabiko alimwi waambe lwaano lwachikozyano kung'anda ya Izilayeli.
Utedi, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Nkwaze mpati iili aamaba mapati malamfu, iizwide milimba, alimwi yakali aamabalala yakayinka ku Lebbanoni alimwi yakajatilila aajulu lyamusamu wa kkeda.
Yakatyola mpela zyantabi  akwiinka aazyo kunyika ya Kkenani; wakiizikila mumuunzi wa basambali.
Alimwi wakabweza mbuto yanyika akwiibyala mumuseele uuli aambolezi. Wakiibika kumbali lyamanzi mbuli musamu ukunkumuka matu.
Mpawo wakasyuuka alimwi watandabala afwiifwi anyika. Mitabi yawo yakaboolela kulinguwo, amitabi yawo yakakomena munsi lyawo. Aboobo yakaba chisiko chakachita ntabi akuchita mpakatwa.

Pesi kwakali nkwazi mpati yakali aamababa mapati a milimba myiingi. Langa! Chisiko eechi chakachengunusya miyanda yacho kukulanga ku nkwazi, aimwi chakatandabika ntabi zyacho ku nkwazi kuzwa kubusena nkuchakabyalilidwe kuti chikonzye kutiliilwa.
Chakabyalidwe mumuseele mubotu kumbali lyamaanzi miingi kuti ikonzye kuchita ntabi akusyuusya michelo, kuti ube musaansa mupati weebeka.'

Amba kuti kubantu, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Uyoozwidilila na? Tukoyoonyukulwa na akukuluulwa  bana bawo kuchitila kuti ukapusame, alimwi zyoonse zisyuukilwa zyawo kuti zikayume? Takwe kuboko kuli aanguzu na bantu biingi bayooyandikana kuti bakuunyukule amiyanda yawo.
Aboobo langa! Kawuli wabyalwa, uyoolampa na? Tukoyoopusama na aawo waakugumwa aaluwo lwakujwe? Uyoopusama lyoonse muchilili oomo muwakasyuukila.'''
Mpawo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,

''Ambuula kung'anda iipapide, 'Tamuzi na kuti zintu eezi zyaambaanzi? Langa! Mwami wa Bbabbiloni wakaza ku Jelusalemu alimwi wakabweza mwami wakwe mwanakazi a bana basimbi ba mwami akubeeta kulinguwe mu Bbabbiloni.
Mpawo wakabweza umwi wabalunyungu lchakwe wa bwami, wachita chizuminano anguwe kachili chikonke. Wakagwisya bantu banyika bali anguzu,
kuti bwami bubweedele aansi akutakonzya kulinyampula. Mukubamba chizuminano nyika iyoopona.

Pesi mwami wa ku Jelusalemu wakamupapila akutuma basingambela bakwe ku Ijipiti kuyookumbila mabbiza a mpi. Uyoozwidilila na? Muntu uulikuchita zintu eezi uyoonzwenga na? Na watyola chizuminano, uyoonzwenga na?

Mbuli mbechipona! - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova - nchobeni uyoofwa munyika yamwami wakamuchita mwami, mwami ooyo ngwakanyansizya chikonke chakwe, alimwi ooyo chizuminano chakwe nchiwakatyola. Uyoofwa aakati ka Bbabbioni.
Falo ampi yakwe iili aanguzu ankamu mpati ya baalumi tabakoyoomugwasya pe mu nkondo, aawo madunduulu amalambo aakusyanikizizya naayoyakwa kukujaya mawumi miingi.
Nkaambo mwami wanyansya chikonke chakwe mukutyola chizuminano. Langa, wakatandabika kuboko kwakwe mukuchita chisyomezyo pesi nikuba boob wakachita zyoonse zintu eezi. Takoyoonzwenga pe.
Nkinkaako Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Mbuli mbepona, teensi chikonke changu na nchaakasampawula alimwi chizuminano changu nchaakatyola? Aboobo ndiyyeta chisubulo chakwe aamutwe wakwe!
Ndiyootandabika kazamba kangu aajulu lyakwe, alimwi uyoochigwa mukazamba kangu kakuvwimya. Mpawo ndiyoomweeta ku Bbabbiloni akupa lubeta aalinguwe akaambo kakuuzya nyika nkwakachita aawo nakanduuzya!
Boonse basikuchija nkondo bali mumpi yakwe bayoojiigwa apanga, alimwi bayosyaala bayomwayisigwa kumabbazu woonse. Mpawo uyooziba kuti ndime Jehova; ndaamba kuti eechi chiyoochitika.''
Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: 'Aboobo, ime lwangu ndiyoogwisya mpela ya mu kkeda alimwi ndiyoyizikila kuzwa kuntabi ntete. Ndiyoyityola alimwi ndiyoyizikila aachilundu chilamfu.

Ndiyoyizikila aazilundu zya Izilayeli kuti ikabe entabi zitakazyale michelo. Uyooba mu kkeda mupati kuchitila kuti koonse kayuni kali aamababa kakakkale munsi lyawo. Tuyooyaka zizumbo mumweenzule wantabi zyawo.

Mpawo misamu yoonse yamulusaka iyooziba kuti ndime Jehova. Ndiyoowisya misamu milamfu alimwi ndikanyampule misamu mifwiifwi. Ndiyopusamisya misamu iitiliilwa alimwi nkachite misamu miyumu kuti ikasyuuke. ndime Jehova; ndaamba kuti eechi chiyoochitika; alimwi ndachichita.'''
Alubo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,
''Mwambaanzi nywebo nimubelesya kasimpi aatala anyika ya Izilayeli akuti, 'Ba mataata balya masaansa aapanyuka, alimwi meno aabana asibisigwa?'
Mbuli mbepona - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova - takuchiyooba limbi aawo mpumuyookonzya kubelesya kasimpi aaka mu Izilayeli.
Langa! Boonse buumi buzwa kuindime - buumi bwa wisi a bwa mwana mulombe, buzwa kulindime! Muntu uubisya nguwe uyoofwa!
Niinzi chinga chilaambwa aatala amuntu uululeme alimwi uubamba busalali a bululami -

na taalyida aajulu aachilundu na kunyampula menso aakwe kuzitoombe zya ng'anda ya Izilayeli, alimwi taasofwazya mwanakazi wa simayakilane wakwe, nikuba kwiinkila mwanakazi kuchiindi nali kumweezi, mwaalumi uululeme na?

Niinzi zinga zilaambwa aatala a mwaalumi utadyamizyi muntu nikuba umwi alimwi wabweedezya kuli basizikkwelete eezyo zyakabikidwe mbuli chijatisyo kumali yakucheneka? Alimwi tabbi pesi upa chakulya chakwe kuli basinzala aimwi ulavumba maya azizwaato, mwaalumi uululeme na?

Niinzi zinga zilaambwa aatala a mwaalumi uutayinzilizyi mbadalo kumali yakucheneka, aimwi uutajani mpindu yiindilide kuli zeezyo nzyawuzya? Zyaambidwe kuti uchita mbukweelede alimwi usimpika kusyomeka aakati kabantu.
Na mwaalumi ooyo weenda mumbeta zyangu akubamba malayilile aangu mukusyomeka, mpawo chisyomezyo cha mwaalumi ooyu ncheechi: Nchobeni uyoopona! - ooku nkwaamba kwa Jehova.
Pesi tutedi uli aamwana sinkondo ooyo uutila bulowa akuchita chimwi chazeezi zintu zyaambwa,
(nikuba wisi taakachita nichiba chimwi chazeezi). Ulyida aajulu aachilundu alimwi ulasofwaazya mwanakazi wa simayakilane wakwe, nchiinzi chakwaamba aatala anguwe?
Ooyu mwaalumi udyamizya bafwaba a babula, tanyanzyi alimwi ulabba, tabweedezyi chikkwelete, alimwi unyampula menso aakwe kuzitoombe akuchita zisesemyo,

alimwi ulacheneka mali yachimbazo, alimwi uchita mpindu mpati loko kuli zeezyo nzyasambala, mwaalumi ooyo weelede kupona na? Nchobeni takoyoopona pe! Nchobeni uyoofwa aimwi bulowa bwakwe bunoli aalinguwe nkaambo kakuti wakachita zyoonse zintu eezi zisesemya.
Pesi langa! Tutedi kuli mwaalumi wakazyaa mwana mulombe, aimwi mwana wakwe mulombe wabona  zibi zyoonse zyakachitwa awisi, alimwi nikuba wazibona tazichiti pe zintu eezyo.
Mwana mulombe ooyu talyidi aajulu aachilundu, alimwi tanyampuli menso aakwe kuzitoombe zya ng'anda ya Izilayeli alimwi tasofwaazyi mwanakazi wa simayakilane wakwe, nchiinzi chwakwaamba aatala anguwe?
Ooyo mwana mulombe tadyamizyi naba womwe, na kunyanzya chisyomezyo chachipo na kubweza zintu zyakubba, pesi anikuti ulapa chakulya chakwe kuli basinzala alimwi ulavumba bali maya azizwaato.

Mwana mulombe ooyu tadyaamizyi naba womwe nikuba kubweza  mali nyingi na kujana mpindu mpati kumali yakucheneka, pesi ubweza mbeta zyangu akweenda mumalayilie aangu; ooyomwana mulombe takoyoofwida chibi chawisi: Uyoopona chakasimpe!
Wisi wakwe, mbuli kuti wakadyaamizya bamwi akubajata changuzu akubbida mukulana wakwe, akuchita chibotu aakati kabantu - langa, uyoofwa muzibi zyakwe.
Pesi waamba kuti, 'Nkaamboonzi mwana mulombe natafwidi milandu yawisi?' Nkaambo mwana mulombe uchita bululami abusaali alimwi ulabamba mbeta zyangu zyoonse; ulazichita. Nchobeni uyoopona!

Ooyo uubisya nguwe uutakafwe. Mwana mulombe tokoyoofwida milandu yawisi pe, alimwi wisi takoyoofwida milandu ya mwana wakwe mulombe pe. Bululami bwawoyo uuchita ziluleme bunooli aalinguwe, alimwi bubi bwa mubisyi bunooli aalinguwe.
Pesi na mubisyi wasanduka kuzwa kuzibi zyakwe zyoonse nzyakachita , alimwi wabamba mbeta zyangu zyoonse alimwi wachita bululami abusalai, nchibeni uyoopona takoyoofwa pe.
Milandu yakwe yoonse njanooli wakachita tichiyooyeeyegwi limbi aalinguwe. Uyoopona abusalali mbwanoli wachita.
Kujana ndabotelwa kapati na aatala alufu lwa sizibi - ooku nkwaamba kwa Jehova - kutali kukuzwa kwakwe kunzila yakwe kuchitila kuti apone?

Pesi na mululami wazwa kubululami bwakwe alimwi wachita chibi akuchita zitondwa zichitwa aasizibi, uyoopona na? Boonse bululami mbwakachita tabuchiyooyeeyegwi limbi aawo nayonduuzya. Aboobo uyoofwa muzibi nzyatanooli wachita.
Pesi waamba kuti, 'Nzila ya Mwami tiili kabotu pe!' Swiilila, ng'anda ya Izilayeli! Nzila zyangu tazili kabotu na? Teensi nzila zyanu na zitali kabotu?
Musalali nazwa kubusalali bwakwe, alimwi wachita zibi akufwa  akaambo kanzizyo, mpawo uyoofwa muzibi nzyaachita.
Pesi na mwaalumi sizibi wasanduka kuzwa kuzibi zyakwe eezyo nzyakachita aimwi wachita zili kabotu a buluami, unooli wabamba buumi bwakwe.
Nkaambo unoli wabona akusanduka kuzwa kuzibi zyakwe nzyaakachita. Nchobeni uyoopona, alimwi takoyoofwa pe.
Pesi na ng'anda ya Izilayeli yaamba kuti, 'Nzila ya Mwami tiilikabotu pe!' Inzila yangu tiilikabotu biyeni, ng'anda ya Izilayeli? Ninzila zyenu zitalikabotu.

Nkinkaako ndiyoobeteka umwi awumwi mwaalumi aakati kanu kwiindila munzila zyakwe, ng'anda ya Izilayeli! - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova. Musanduke alimwi muzwe kuzibi zyanu zyoonse kuchitila kuti zitakabi zilebyo zyazibi aatala andinywe.
Kuzwa kulindinywe, mukasowe yoonse milandu yanu njimwakachita; mukalichitile moyo mupya a muuya mupya. Nkaambonzi nowelede kufwa, ng'anda ya Izilayeli?
Nkaambo nsikwe kubotelwa mulufu lwawoyo uufwa - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova - aboobo sanduka upone!''
''Lino iwe, bweza lila aatala abazululi ba Izilayeli
alimwi utedi, 'Ngwani wakali banyoko? Mulavu muzyazi, wakapona antoomwe amwana wamulavu mweeze; aakati kabalavu baniini, wakakomezya bana bakwe.
Nguwe wakakomezya umwi wabana bakwe kuti abe mulavu muniini, mulavu wakiiya kudelula nzyavwima, alimwi wakalya bantu.
Mpawo manyika akamvwa aatala anguwe. Wakachigwa mukakole kabo, alimwi bakamweeta angobyoobyo kunyika ya Ijipiti.
Mpawo wakabona kuti nikuba wakali walindila kuboola kwakwe, lino bulangilizi bwakwe bwakali bwiinka. Aboobo wakabweza umwi wabana bakwe akumukomezya kuti abe mulavu muniini.
Ooyu mulavu muniini wakali kweendeenda aakati kabalavu. Wakali mulavu muniini alimwi wakayiya kudelula nzyavwima; wakalya bantu.
Wakabweza bamukabafu babo akumwaya myuunzi. Nyika abuzule bwayo yakasiigwa akaambo kamuzuzumo wakulila kwakwe.
Pesi zisi zyakasika kuzoomulwisya kuzwa kuzilikiti zimuzyungulukide; bakayala tunsabwe twabo aatala anguwe. Wakachigwa mukakole kabo.
Angobyoobyo bakamubika muchizumbo alimwi bakamweeta ku Mwami wa Bbabbiloni. Bakamweeta kuzichijilo kuchitila kuti ijwi lyakwe litakamvwigwi limbi aachilundu cha Izilayeli.
Banyoko bakali mbulu musaansa uubyalidwe mubulowa bwako kumbali lya maanzi. wakali kuzyala alimwi wakali aantabi nyingi nkaambo kakuvula kwamaanzi.
Wakali aantabi zisimide eezyo zyakali kubelesegwa kuchita nkoli ya mweendelezi, alimwi bupati bwawo bwakalisumpwidwe aajulu aantabi, bulamfu bwawo bwakabonwa abupati bwamatu aawo.
Pesi musaansa wakanyukulwa mukunyema alimwi wakawaalilwa aanyika, alimwi luuwo lwa kujwe lwakayumya michelo yawo. Mitabi yawo iisimide yakatyokooka, yapusama alimwi mulilo wakayitenta.
Aboobo lino ubyalidwe munkanda, munyika yabbaangwe anyota.
Nkaambo mulilo wakazwa kuzwa kumitabi mipati alimwi wakatenta michelo yawo. Taachikwe mutabi uusimide pe aalinguwo, taachikwe nkoli yakweendelezya.' Ooku nkulila alimwi kunooyimbwa mbuli kulila.''
Zyakachitika mumunyaka wamusanu ayibili, mubuzuba bwakkumi mumweezi wasanu, kuti bapati ba Izilayeli bakaza kuzoobuzya kuli Jehova akukkala kunembo lyangu.
Mpawo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,

''Mwana wamuntu, amba kubapati ba Izilayeli alimwi utedi kulimbabo, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Mwaza kuzoobuzya na kuindime? Mbuli mbechipona, nsikoyoobuzigwa andinywe pe! - ooku nkwaamba kwa Jehova.'
Uyoobabeteka na? Mwana wamuntu, uyoobeteka na? Kabazibye aatala azisesemyo zyamawisi.

Katedi kulimbabo, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Mubuzuba oobuya mbundakasala Izilayeli akunyampula luboko lwangu kukukonka chizuminano kulunyungu lwa ng'anda ya Jakkobu ndakalizibya kulimbabo munyika ya Ijipiti, aawo nindakanyampula luboko lwangu kukukonka chizuminano kulimbabo. Ndakati, ''Ndime Jehova Leza wanu'' -

mubuzuba oobo ndakanyampula luboko lwangu kukukonka chizuminano kulimbabo kuti ndiyoobagwisya kuzwa munyika ya Ijipiti kuya munyika eeyo njindakabasalila chakuchenjela. Yakali kukunka malili abucha; yakali zilulwidwe kabotu loko aakati kanyika zyoonse.
Ndakati kulimbabo, ''Umwi awumwi muntu ngasowe zintu zisesemya kuzwa kubusyu bwakwe azitoombe zya Ijipiti. Mutalisofwaazyi; ndime Jehova Leza wanu.''

Pesi bakandipapila aimwi tebakali kuyanda pe kuliswiilila. Takwe muntu pe wakasowa zintu zisesemya kuzwa kumenso aakwe nikuba wakaleka zitoombe zya Ijipiti, aboobo ndayeeya kutila bukali bwangu aalimbabo kuti ndikkutye lunyemo lwangu aakati kabo aakati kanyika ya Ijipiti.
Ndakachichita akaambo kazina lyangu kuti litasampawulwi kumenso aazisi ooko nkubakali kukkala. Ndalizibya kulimbabo, kumenso aabo, akubagwisya kuzwa munyika ya Ijipiti.
Aboobo ndakabagwisya kuzwa munyika ya Ijipiti akubeeta munkanda.
Mpawo ndakabapa milayizyo yangu akuchita mbeta zyangu kuti zizibinkane kulimbabo, muli nzizyo muntu mwayooponena na wazilemeka.
Alimwi ndakabapa ma Sabata aangu mbuli chitondeezyo aakati kangu ambabo, kukuziba kuti ndime Jehova uubachita kuti basalale.

Pesi ng'anda ya Izilayeli yakandipapila munkanda. Tebakeenda mumilayizyo yangu pe; pesi bakakaka mbeta zyangu eeyo muntu mwayooponena na wayilemeka. Bakasampawula loko ma Sabata angu, aboobo ndakati ndiyootila kunyema kwangu alimbabo munkanda kuchitila kubamaninsya.
Pesi ndakachichita kuti zina lyangu litasampawulwi kumenso aazisi, kunembo lyabo ooko nkundakabagwisya kuzwa ku Ijipiti.

Aboobo mebo lubo lwangu ndakanyampula luboko lwangu kukukonka chizuminano kulimbabo munkanda kuti nsikoyoobatola munyika eeyo njindakali kuyoobapa, nyika iikunka malili abuchi, eeyo iizilulwidwe kabotu loko aakati kamanyika woonse.
Ndakakonka eechi nkaambo bakakaka milayizyo yangu akusampawula ma Sabata angu, mbukunga myoyo yabo yakali kutobela zitoombe zyabo.
Pesi linso lyangu lyakabakwabilila kuzwa ku lunyinyooko lwabo alimwi tendakabanyonyoona pe munkanda.
Munkanda ndakaambila bana babo, ''Muteendi mumilayizyo yabamawuso, nikuba kubamba milawu yabo, na kuisofwaazya azitoombe zyabo.
Ndime Jehova Leza wanu, mweende mumilayizyo yangu; mubambe mbeta zyangu akuziswiilizya.
Mubambe ma Sabata angu asalale kuti akabe chitondeezyo aakati kangu andinywe, mukuyooziba kuti ndime Jehova Leza wanu.''

Pesi bana babobaombe abasimbi bakandipapila. Tebakeenda mumilayizyo yangu pe nikuba kubamba mbeta zyangu, oomo muntu mwakonzya kuponena na wazilemeka. Bakasofwaazya ma Sabata angu aboobo ndakayeeya kutila bukali bwangu alimbabo kuti nkutisye lunyemo lwangu aatala ambabo munkanda.
Pesi ndakakasya luboko lwangu kukuchitila zina lyangu kuti litasampawulwi kumenso aazisi ooko nkundakagwisya  ba Izilayeli.
Mebo lwangu ndakanyampula luboko lwangu kukukonka kulimbabo munkanda kuti ndiyoobasansaania aakati kabamaasi akubamwayisya mumanyika.
Ndakayeeya kuchita eechi mbulu kuti tebakalemeka mbeta zyangu pe, akuti bakakaka milayizyo yabngu akusampawula ma Sabata angu. Menso aabo akalikupeekezya kuzitoombe zyabamawisi aabo.
Mpawo mebo lubo ndakapa milayizyo eeyo yakatali mibotu ambeta nzibatakonzyi kuponena.
Ndakabaamba kuti balisofweede kwiindila muzipo zyabo - bakachita zipayizyo zyabana babo bataanzi beda akubachita kuti biinde mumulilo - kuti ndikabazuzye achiyoosyo mukuyooziba kuti ndime Jehova!'
Nkinkaako, mwana mulombe wamuntu, ambuula kung'anda ya Izilayeli alimwi utedi kuimbabo, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Muli cheechi alubo bamawuso bakandisampawula aawo nibakatasyomeka kulindime.

Aawo nindakabanjizya munyika njindakakonkezya kubapa, eelyo mpawo kufumbwa nibakalikubona kalundu kulamfu amusamu uuli aamatu, bakali kupa zipayizyo zyabo, bakali kundinyemya azipo zyabo. Ooko alubo bakatenta tufwefwelenga twatununkilizyo akutila zipo zyakunywa.
Mpawo ndakati kulimbabo, ''Mbuubuli busena oobu nkumweeta zipo nkuko?'' Aboobo zina litegwa Bbama kusikila buzuba oobuno.'
Nkinkaako ambila ng'anda ya Izilayeli kuti, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Nkaamboonzi nimulisofwaazya anzila zyamawuso? Aboobo nkaamboonzi nimuchita mbuli ba sibwaamu, mukuyanduula zintu zisesemya?

Aawo nimupa zipo zyanu - nimuchita bana banu balombe kuti biinde mumulilo - kusikila sunu muchilisofwaazya azitoombe zyanu zyoonse. Aboobo nkaamboonzi nensikamuleke kuti mundiyanduule, yo ng'anda ya Izilayeli? Mbuli mbechipona - ooku nkwaamba kwa Jehova - nsikoyoomulekela kuti mukandiyanduule.
Muzeezo ooyo uulikubumbwa muboongo bwanu tukoyoochitika pe. Mulaamba kuti, ''Ngatube mbuli zimwi zisi, mbuli imwi mikowa iili muli zimwi nyika aabo bakomba chisamu abbwe.''
Mbuli mbechipona - ooku nkwaamba kwa Jehova - ndiyoomweendelezya ajanza lili aanguzu, kuboko kunyampwidwe, alunyemo luyootililwa alindinywe.
Ndiyomugwisya kuzwa kuli bamwi bantu akumuyobolola kuzwa kumanyika nkumwakamwayikilide. Ndiyoochita eechi ajanza lyangu lili anguzu alunyemo lutilidwe.
Mpawo ndiyoomweeta munkanda yabantu, alimwi nkukooko ndiyomubeteka kumenso akumenso.
Mbuli mbundakabeteka bamawuso munkanda yanyika ya Ijipiti, aboobo ndiyomubeteka anywebo - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova.
Ndiyomuchita kuti mukayinde aansi amufunko wangu, alimwi ndiyomuchita kuti mukalemeka ziyandwa achizuminano.
Ndiyoosansamuna kuzwa aakati kanu bandipapila abasichinguni. Ndiyoobagwisya kuzwa munyika eeyo njibakkede mbuli bazwakule, pesi tabakoyoonjila nyika ya Izilayeli. Mpawo muyooziba kuti ndime Jehova.

Aboobo kulindinywe, ng'anda ya Izilayeli, Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Umwi awumwi wanu weelede kwiinka kuzitoombe zyakwe. Mukazikombe na mwakaka kuswiilila kulindime, pesi tamweelede limbi kusofwaazya zina lyangu lisalala azipo azitoombe zyanu.

Nkaambo aachilundu changu chisalala, aansonge yachilundu cha Izilayeli - ooku nkwaamba kwa Jehova - boonse beng'anda ya Izilayeli bayondikomba munyika eeyo. Ndiyoobotelwa kuyanda zipo zyanu nkukooko, alimwi amichelo mitaanzi yanu antoomwe azintu zyanu zisalala.

Ndiyomutambula mbuli tufwefwelenga twatununkilizyo aawo ndaakumugwisya kuzwa kubantu akumuyobola kuzwa kumanyika nkumwakamwayikilide. Ndiyolitondeezya lwangu mbuli uusalala aakati kanu kuti manyika akabone.
Mpawo eelyo nindiyoomugwisya munyika ya Izilayeli, kunyika eeyo njindakanyampwida luboko lwangu kukukonka kwiipa kuli bamawuso, muyooziba kuti ndime Jehova.
Ooko muyoyeeya nzila zyanu anchito zyanu nzimwakasofwaazya lwanu, alimwi muyolisola lwanu mumenso anu akaambo kanchinto zyanu mbi nzimwakachita.

Aboobo muyooziba kuti ndime Jehova eelyo ndaakuchita eezi akaambo kazina lyangu, peepe kumilimu yanu mibi alimwi peepe kunchito zyanu zitaluleme, yo ng'anda ya Izilayeli - ooku nkwaamba kwa Jehova.'''
Mpawo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,
''Mwana mulombe wamuntu, lanzya busyu bwako kunyika zya kumusanza, alimwi waambuule aatala amusanza; sinsima aatala alusaka lwa ku Negevi.

Ambila lusaka lwa Negevi, 'Ooku nkwaamba kwa Jehova - Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Bona, ndiyoobika mulilo aakati kanu. Uyootenta musamu mutete amusamu muyumu aakati kanu. Mangalaba aatenta takoyoozimika pe; masyu woonse kuzwa kumusanza kusikila kunyika ayootentwa.
Mpawo nyama yoonse iyoobona kuti ndime Jehova aawo ndaakuyasya mulilo, alimwi tukoyoozimika pe.'''
Mpawo ndakati, ''Ala! Mwami Jehova, balikuti aatala andime, Tali sikwaamba zikozyano biyo na ooyu?'''
Mpawo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,
''Mwana wamuntu, lyanzya busyu bwako ku Jelusalemu alimwi wambuule aatala amasena aasalala; sinsima aatala anyika ya Izilayeli.

Ambila nyika ya Izilayeli kuti, 'Jehova waamba eechi: Langa! Ndime sinkondo anywebo! Ndiyoogwisya panga lyangu kuzwa muchikkwama chalyo alimwi ndiyoogonka boonse bantu baluleme abataluleme kuzwa kulindinywe!
Kuti nkagoke boonse baluleme abataluleme kuzwa kulindinywe, panga lyangu liyoozwa muchikkwama chalyo kailwana boonse bantu kuzwa kumusanza kusika kunyika.
Mpawo nyama yoonse iyooziba kuti me, Jehova, ndasomona panga lyangu kuzwa muchikkwama chalyo. Talikoyoobweeda musule pe!'
Mbuli nduwe, mwana mulombe wamuntu, mimila aawo nyama zyako nizidunsuuka! Mukubijilwa mimila kunembo lyamenso aabo!

Mpawo ziyoochitika kuti bayookubuzya, 'Nkaambonzi nomimila?' Mpawo uyowamba kuti, 'Nkaambo kamakani aalikuza, nkaambo myoyo yoonse iyoowizuuka, alimwi amaboko woonse ayookompama! Myuuya yoonse iyoowizuuka, amazwi woonse ayoyenda mbuli meenda. Langa! Chiyoobuza aimwi chiyooba mbuboobo! - ooku nkwaamba kwa Jehova.'''
Mpawo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,
''Mwana muombe wamuntu, sinsima alimwi waambe kuti, 'Mwami waamba eechi: ''Tedi: Ipanga! Ipanga! Liyoonona akubukuswa!
Liyoononwa kuti likakonzye kujaya kupati! Liyoopukutwa mukuti likabe mbuli kalabi! Tukabotelwe na mumusako wamwana wangu mulombe? Ipanga liyobuza lilasula woonse musako uuliboobu!
Aboobo panga liyoopegwa kuli lipukutidwe, mpawo likajatisigwe aluboko! Panga lyanonwa alimwi lyapukutwa akupegwa kumanza awooyo ujaya!'''''

Mwiitilile lugwasyo alimwi mulile, mwana mulombe wamuntu! Nkaambo panga eelyo lyazida kulwisya bantu bangu! Lilikulwisya bazululi ba Izilayeli boonse. Bawalwa kukulwisyania aapanga bantu bangu. Nkinkaako, wuma chibelo chako!
Nkaambo kuli kweezegwa , pesi kuyooba buti na musako wakachilwa? - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova.

Lino webo, mwana muombe wamuntu, sinsima alimwi wuume maboko aako obile nkaambo panga liyoolwisya  nikuba lwatatu! Ipanga lyabaabo batakajayigwe! Ndipanga lyabiingi batakajayigwe, litakabayase koonsekoonse!
Kuti tuyeemune myooyo yabo akuvuzya bawide babo, ndabika panga lyakujaya kumilyango yabo. Ma! Lyachitwa mbuli kalabi, libwezelegdwe kujaya.
Iwe, panga! Wuma kululyo! Wuma kuchimweensi! Inka kufumbwa busyu bwako nkubulangide.
Nkaambo njoowuma maboko angu obile antoomwe, alimwi njowokezya bukali bwangu! Mebo, Jehova, mbundaamba!''
Ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,

''Lino we, mwanamulombe wamuntu, sala migwagwa yobile ipanga lya mwami wa Bbabbiloni ndilikonzya kubweza. Migwagwa yobile iyootangunina munyika yomwe, alimwi chikkwaankwani chiyootondeezya umwi wayo mbuli uuya kumunzi.
Bika umwi mugwagwa kuti ube wampi ya Bbabbiloni kuti iye ku Labba, muunzi wa ba Amoni. Bika umwi kutola mpi kuli Juda akumuunzi wa Jelusalemu, ooyo uukwabililidwe.
Nkaambo mwami wa Bbabbiloni uyoyima kumaswaananino aamigwagwa kuti akachite busondi. Uyoozungania mivwi alimwi akabuzye meendelo kuzitoombe akuyoolingulula chini.

Mukuboko kwakwe kwalulyo kunooli chitondeezyo aatala a Jelusalemu, kubika bagutu bwakupwayuula aatala anjiyo, kujula mulomo wakwe kulujayo, kulizya jwi lyankondo, kubika bagutu bapwayawula milyango, kuyaka dunduulu, akuyaka zisinkinizizyo zyambandami.
Chiyooba mbui chitondeezyo chabuyo kumenso abaabo bamu Jelusalemu, aabo bakakonkezya chizuminano kubantu ba Bbabbiloni! Pesi mwami uyoobapa mulanda wakutyola chizuminano kuti akabaange kabotu!

Nkinkaako Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Akaambo kakuti mwachita bubi bwanu kuti buyeeyegwe, kuchita nsotoko zyanu kuti ziyubununwe kuchitila kuti munchito zyanu zyoonse zibi zyanu zikabonwe - nkaambo mwachita eechi muyoozundwa.
Mbuli nduwe nomuzululi mubi wa Izilayeli uusampawula, ooyo uuli aazuba lyachisubulo lyasika, alimwi uuli achiindi chabubi chagola,
Mwami Jehova waamba eechi kulinduwe: Gwisya chitambala alimwi uzwaatunune musini! Zintu tazichiyoofanani pe! Sumpula bali aansi alimwi ufwiinsye basumpukide!
Tong! Tongo! Ndiyooyichita tongo! Tikoyoobukulusigwa pe kusikila wasika ooyo wakasalwa kuzooyibeteka.

Aboobo we, mwana mulombe wamuntu, sinsima alimwi waambe kuti, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi kubantu ba Amoni aatala akuusa kwabo kuyobuza: Panga, panga lyasomonwa! Lyanonwa kukujaya kuti ilye, aboobo liyooba mbui kaabi!

Muchiindi basinsimi nibabona zilengano zyabuyo aatala andinywe, muchiindi nibachita zyamizimu kuti bakajane mabejo aataa andinywe, eeli panga liyoolala mumikosi yabaabo baamba kujayigwa, aabo buzuba bwabo bwachisubulo bwasika alimwi aabo chiindi chabo chazibi chaamba kugola.
Bweedezya panga muchikkwana chalyo. Mubusena bwakulengwa kwako, munyika nkozyalwa, ndiyookubeteka!
Ndiyootila bukali bwangu alinduwe! Njoofulidila mulilo walunyemo lwangu alinduwe akukubika mumaanza abaalumi bakali, basikubamba lunyonyooko!
Uyooba mungwimba wamulilo! Bulowa bwako buyooba aakati kanyika. Tokoyooyeyegwa limbi, nkaambo mebo, Jehova ndaamba eechi!'''
Mpawo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,
''Lino we, mwana mulombe wamuntu, ulabeteka na? Ulabeteka na dolopo lya bulowa? Muchite azibe zisesemyo zyakwe zyoonse.
Weelede kwaamba kuti, 'Mwami Jehiva waamba eechi: Ooyu muunzi uutila bulowa aakati kakwe kuti kuchitila kuti chiindi chakwe chisike; muunzi uuchita zitoombe kuti usofwaale.

Waba simuandu abuowa oobo mbuwakatila, aimwi wasofwaazigwa azitoombe eezyo nziwakachita. Wafwiinsya mazuba aako alimwi mamanino aaminyaka yako asika. Nkinkaako ndiyokuchita chisampuzi kuzisi  a chisesyo kunyika zyoonse.
Boonse bali afwiifwi a bali kule anduwe bayookuninda - we nodolopo lisofweede - ampuwo koonse yakuba uuzwide lunyongano.
Langa! Bazululi ba Izilayeli, umwi awumwi amanguzu aakwe, baza kulinduwe kuzootila bulowa.
Balasampawula mawisi amanyina mulinduwe, alimwi bakasyanikizya bazwakule aakati kanu. Bakajata bubi bamuchaala a bamukabafu aakati kanu.
Mwakanyansya zintu zyangu zisalala alimwi mwakasofwaazya ma Sabata angu.
Baalumi balengela bamwi twaambo basika mulinduwe kuzootila bulowa, alimwi balyida aazilundu. Bachita bubi aakati kanu.
Mulinduwe baalumi bavumbula maya ya wisi. Mulinduwe balanyonyongania banakazi basofweede muchiindi chabo chakumweezi.

Baalumi bachita zisesemyo abanakazi babasimayakilane aabo, alimwi baalumi basofwaazya bamukamwana babo chamawuse; baalumi bajata bubi bachizi babo - bana basimbi bamawisi aabo - zyoonse eezi zilachitwa mulinduwe.

Aaba baalumi babweza nsinkamulomo mulinduwe kuti batile bulowa alimwi wakazibotelwa akujana mpindu mpati loko, alimwi mbimuyakilene aabo kwiinda mukudyaamizya, alimwi mwakandiluba - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova.
Bona! Akuboko kwangu ndawuma zijanwa chakutasyomeka nchiwakachita, akutika kwa bulowa aakati kako.
Uyooyima na moyo wako, ayoosima na maboko aako mumazuba ngendiyoolangana anduwe? Ime, Jehova, ndikwaamba eechi, alimwi ndiyoochichita.
Aboobo ndiyomumwayisya aakati kamasi akumusansaania mumanyika. Muli yeeyi nzila njoogwisya busofwaazi bwanu kuzwa kulindinywe.
Aboobo uyooba uusofweede kumenso aamanyika. Mpawo uyooziba kuti ndime Jehova.'''
Mpawo jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,

''Mwana mulombe wamuntu, ng'anda ya Izilayeli yaba sifwisifwi kulindime. Boonse baba zyakulya zyasyaala zya mukuba a tiini, butale a liidi mulinduwe. Bayooba mbuli sifwisifwi lya nsiliva mumvuto yanu.
Nkinkaako Mwami Jehova waamba eechi, 'Akaambo kakuti moonse mwaba mbuli sifwisifwi, nkinkaako, langa! Ndaamba kumubungania aakati ka Jelusalemu.

Mbuli muntu mbabungania nsiliva, mukuba, butale, liidi, tiini akubika mumvuto kuti ayiyeemune, alimwi balafulida mulilo aalinjiyo kuti iiyeemune, aboobo ndiyoomubungania mubukali amubunyeme bwangu, aimwi ndiyoomubika oomo akumuyeemune.
Ndiyoomubungania alimwi nkafulide mulilo wabukali bwangu alindinywe, alimwi muyoyeemunwa aakati kayo.
Mbuli nsiliva mbiiyeemunwa mumvuto, muyoyeemunwe mulinjiyo, alimwi muyooziba kuti ime, Jehova, ndatila bukali bwangu alindinywe!'''
Ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime kaliti,
''Mwana mulombe wamuntu, mwaambile kuti, 'Ulinyika iitanasalazigwa pe. Takwe mvula mubuzuba bwabukali!
