Basinsimi bajatana mububi aakati kakwe, mbuli mulavu uuvuluma kaikukwamuna nchaajata. Balalya buumi akutola buvubi bweebeka; bachita bamukabafu biingi aakati kakwe!

Bapayizi bakwe bachita lupyopyongano kumulawu wangu, alimwi balasofwaazya zintu zyangu zisalala. Tabasiyanisyi zintu zisalala azintu xzisofweede alimwi tabayisyi kusiyana kuliwo aakati kakutasalala akusalala. Balasisa menso aabo kuzwa ku ma Sabata angu kuchitila kuti ndisofwaazigwe aakati kabo.
Bana balombe babami bali anguwe bali mbuli bawumpe bazavuula nzibajata. Balatila bulowa akunyonyoona buumi kuti bachite mpindu chakutasyomeka.
Basinsimi bakwe babazila ampende iituba iikumbuuka; babona zilengano zyakubeja akubaambila zichiza zyakubeja. Balati, ''Mwami Jehova waamba eechi'' aawo Jehova mpataambwiide pe.
Bantu bamunyika baladyaamizya chakubba a kunyanzya mbono, alimwi bajata bubi bafwaba a babula, baladyaamizya muzwakule kakutakwe kaambo.
Aboobo ndakalanguula muntu aakati kabo utayake bulambo alimwi uutayimikile kunembo lyangu kayiminina nyika kuti nditayinyonyooni, pesi takwe ngundakajana pe.
Aboobo ndiyootila bukai bwangu alimbabo. Ndiyobamana amulilo wabukali bwangu akuchita nzila yabo aamitwe yabo beni - ooku nkwaamba kwa Mwami Jehova.
Ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli ndime, kalyaamba kuti,
'''Mwana wamuntu, omulombe, kwakali banakazi bobile, bana basimbi bazyalwa awumwi nyina.
Bakachita mbuli basibwamu mu Ijiputi muchiindi chabucheche bwabo. Bakachita mbuli basibwamu nkukooko. Inkolo zyabo zyakapwayigwa alimwi bunakalindu bwatunyonkelo twazyo twakaponywa nkukooko.

Mazina abo akali Owola - mukulana mupati a Owolibba - mwanike wakwe. Mpawo bakaba bangu alimwi bakazyala bana balombe abasimbi. Mazina aabo awamba eechi: Owola chaamba Samaliya, alimwi Owolibba chaamba Jelusalemu.
Pesi Owola wakachita mbuli sibwaamu nikuba kuti wakali waba wangu; wakali kwemuzya mbakali kuyandana aabo, kwaba Asiliya bakavulide kwiindila,
Imuleli wachilikiti wakali kusama zyamusyobo wamuteme, azyabasilutwe bakwe, bakasimide alimwi kabali babotu, boonse baalumi bakagede mbongolo.
Aboobo wakali pedekezya mbuli sibwaamu kuli mbabo, kuli boonse baalumi baku Asiliya babotu loko, alimwi wakali sofwazya - alimwi azyoonse zileza chikozyanisyo zyabo.
Nkambo takali wasiya pe kup[ona kwasibwamu bwakwe ku Ijiputi, aawo nibakoona anguwe nakachili kasimbi kanini, awo nibakakumbulula bunakalindu bwansalamo yakwe akutuntamuna kwemuzya kwabo aalinguwe.
Nkinkaako ndakamupedekezya mumaanza aabantu mbayandana aabo, mumaanza ama Asiliya mbaakali kweemuzya.
Bakavumbula chinkuna chakwe, babweza bana bakwe balombe abasimbi, bakamujaya apanga, alimwi wakaba sikondongania loko mukati kabamwi banakazi, aboobo bakamubeteka.
Mwanike wakwe Owolibba wakachibona eechi, pesi nikuba boobo wakeemuzya chamoyo uupya loko akuchita mbuli sibwamu kwinda mukulana wakwe.
Wakeemuzya ma Asiliya abasilutwe bakavulide kwindilila bakasamide zyebeka, bakali baalumi bakagede mabbiza. Boonse bakali simide, baalumi babotu.
Ndakabona kuti wakali walisofwazya. Chakali chimwinya kubasimbi babili.
Mpawo wakayungizya bwaamu bwakwe chakwindilila. Wakali kubona baalumi babezedwe abulambo, zyiimo zyama Kkalidyeni zilambidwe busalala,

bazweete mabbanti muzikungu zyabo, bali atusensa tweenda aamitwe yabo. Boonse bakali achiimo chabasilutwe benkalaki zyalumamba, ibukozyenie abwabana balombe ba Bbabbiloniya, bali anyika yakulimbabo iKkaludiya.
Kuzwa menso akwe nakababona, wakabeemuzya, aboobo wakatuma bantu kuli mbabo mu Kkaludiya.
Aawo ma Bbabbilonia bakaza kulinguwe akubulo bwakwe bwakwemuuzya, alimwi bakamusofwazya alulalano kuli nzyakali wachita wakati wasofwazigwa, aboobo wakabafutatila chakubijilwa.
Nakatondezya nchito zyakwe zyabwamu akuvumbula chinkuna chakwe, ndakachengunuka kuzwa kuli nguwe, mbuli mbundakali ndachengunuka chakubijilwa kuzwa kumukulana wakwe.
Mpawo wakayungizya bwaamu bwakwe aawo nakayeeya mazuba abucheeche bwakwe, nakali sibwamu munyika ya Ijiputi.
Aboobo wakeemuzya mbwakali kuyandana aabo, ibakali ansiswa - chinkuna zyakali mbuli zyamadonki, alimwi bakali kuzwa nzyalamuntu yakali mbuli yamabbiza.
Mbuboobu mbwakachita inchito zyamawuse abucheeche bwako, aawo ibaku Ijiputi nibakaponya tunyonkelo twako akutyanka nkolo zyako zyabusimbi.
Nkinkaako, Owolibba, i Mwami Jehova waamba boobo, ''Boona! Ndiyochita kuti mboyandaabo bakakusule. Aabo mbwakachengunukila kuzwa kulimbabo,  ndiyobeeta kuzokulwana kuzwa kumabbazu woonse:

Baku Bbabbilonia aboonse maKkalidiya, Pekkodi, Syoya, aba Kkoya, alimwi aboonse baku Asiliya bakali ambabo, basimide, baalumi babotu, baleli bachilikiti, abasilutwe balumamba, boonse mbabelesi abalumi baleempuwo, boonse kabagede mabbiza.

Bayooza chakusula azilwisyo, alimwi kabali ankalaki amyaango, alimwi kabali aabbunga lyabantu pati. Bayobamba intibi mpati, ntibi niini, angowani baka kuzyunguluke chakukulwana. Ndiyobapa mweenya wakukupa chisubulo, alimwi bayokupa chisubulo munchito zyabo.

Nkaambo ndiyobikka bukali bwangu aalinduwe, alimwi bayobambilana anduwe kabanyemede. Bayonenga akugwisya mpemo yako amatwi, alimwi balyako bafutuka bayoowa achipanga. Bayobweza bana bako balombe abasimbi, alimwi balyako bafutuka bayoligwa amulilo.
Bayokuzwatununa ngubo alimwi bakabweze zyoonse nchoko zyako zyalweebo.

Aboobo ndiyogwisya kulinduwe inchito zyako zifwisya bweeme anchito zyako zyabwamu munyika ya Ijiputi. Tokoyokonzya pe kunyampula menso aako kubalanga chakupeekezya, alimwi tochikayeeyi Ijiputi lubo pe.'
Nkaambo Mwami Jehova waamba boobu, 'Bona! Ndiyokupedekezya mujaanza lyabaabo mbosulide, kobweda mujanza lyabaabo mbwakafutatila.
Bayobambilana anduwe chalusulano; bayobweza zyoonsenzyovubide bakakusiye chinkuna antanganana, alimwi chinkuna chako chinovumbwidwe mbuli nchiwakali kuchita imfunkununo zyalulalano abwaamu.
Eezi zintu ziyochitwa alimwikulinduwe mukuchita kwako mubli sibwaamu, kweemuzya zisi ooko kuyokusofwazya azikozyanisyo zyabo zyabaleza.
Wakeenda munzila yamukulana wako, aboobo ndiyobikka nkomesi yakwe yachisubulo mujanza lyako.'
Mwami Jehova waamba boobu, Úyoonywa nkomesi yamukulana wako eeyi inikide alimi nimpati. Uyoba nsesya alimwi ukabe chintu chabuyo - eyi nkomesi ijisi mweelo mupati,.
Uyozula ankolwi akuusa, inkomesi yaziyoosyo alunyonyoona; inkomesi yamukulana wako Samaliya.
Uyoyinywa akuyiswimpa kumaninsya; mpawo uyoyipwaya akunenguula nkolo zyako muzimpanzi zyayo! Nkambo ndazyambilizya--eechi nchaambilizyo cha Mwami Jehova.'
Nkinkaako, Mwami Jehova waamba boobu, 'Nkaambo wandiluba akundiwaala kule musule lyako, aboobo alubo uyolangana antentuuko zyetelezegwa aanchito zyako zifwisya bweeme anchito zyalulalano lwabwamu.'''
Jehova wakati kuli ndime, ''Yomulombe mwana wamuntu, uyomubeteka na Owola a Owolibba? Aboobo batondezye inchito zyabo zisesemya,

kuzwa nibakachita zyabumambi, akuzwa nikwakaba geze mumaanza aabo. Bakachita zyabumambi azikozyanisyo zyabo, alimwi bachita kuti bana babo balombe bayinde mumulilo, mbuli chakulya chazikozyanisyo zyabo.
Mpawo binkilila anembo akuchita boobu kulindime: Basofwazya busena bwangu busalala, alimwi mubuzuba mbuboobo basofwazya buzuba butegwa nsabata yangu.
Nkambo aawo mbakajaya banababo kuchitila zikozyanisyo zyabo, mpawo bakaza kubusena bwangu busalala ndilyo zuba akubusofwazya. Aboobo bona! Nzenzizyo nzibachita akati keng'anda yangu.
Wakalayizizya bantu bakazwa kule, kuli aabo bakaza, aabo mbwakasambila, wabalambila menso aako, alimwi walibotyabotya anchoko zyalweebo.
Awo wakakkala abulo bubotu akutafula lyakabambidwe kunembo lyabo awo mpowakabika tununkilizyo twangu amafuta.

Aboobo kumvwikka kwamuyoliyoli walubunga wakali muzyungulukide; kuswanizya yoonse misuobo yabantu, nikuba ma Sabbiyeni bakeetwa kuzwa munkanda, alimwi bakabikwa zikobela kumaboko aabo angowani mbotu kumitwe yabo.
Mpawo ndakati atala anguwe wakali wazakala abumambi, 'Lino bayooba alulalano anguwe, alakwe ambabo.'
Bakanjila kuli nguwe, mbuli baalumi mbubanjila kulinguwe, muli yeeyi nzila bakanjila muli Owola a Owolibba, banakazi baamu.
Pesi baalumi basalali bayochita lubeteko akubapa chisubulo mbuli basilumamba, alimwi bayobapa chisubulo amulandu wabaabo bakatila gaze, nkaambo mbasibwamu alimwi gaze lilimumaanza aabo.
Aboobo Mwmai Jehova waamba boobu: Ndiyobusya nkamu yalumamba itakazyanie aabo akubaaba kuti bakondonganisigwe akumwayigwa.
Mpawo eeyo inkamu yalumamba iyobatulula amabwe akubagonkoola azipanga zyabo. Bayojana bana balombe abasimbi akutenta maanda aabo.
Nkaambo ndiyogwisya inchito zyamawuse kuzwa kunyika akuzyotolola boonse banakazi kuchitila kuti tabachiti mbuli basibwaamu lubo.
Aboobo bayochita nchito zyako zyamawuse zikakusandukile. Uyolangana amilandu yazibi zyako azikozyanisyo zyako, alimwi muli yeeyi nzila uyoziba kuti ndime Mwami Jehova.''
Ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli ndime mumunyaka wamusanu ayine, mumwezi wakkumi, amuzuba bwakkumi bwamwezi, nkalyaamba kuti,
''Mwana munut, lilembele lwako izina lyazuba eeli, elizuba ndilyo, aboobo muli ndilyo elizuba mwami wa Bbabbiloni wazyunguluka kukulwanisya Jelusalemu.
Aboobo wamba kasimpi atala aluzubo lupapide, mambilambali. Wamba kulimbabo, 'Mwami Jehova wamba boobu:
Bikka mpoto yakujikila. Ibike akutulida manzi mulinjiyo. Bungika zituli zyachakulya mulinjiyo, kufumbwa zituli zibotu, chibotu - chibelo abbandabuko - alimwi wizuzye zifuwa zibotu.
Bweza chibotu mubutanga akulundika mafuwa munsi ayo. Wiyeete ibike akupeka mafuwa mulinjiyo..
Nkinkaako Mwami Jehova waamba obu: Maawe kumunzi wabulowa, mpoto yakujikila eyo yakaba abulala mulinjiyo. Bweza chituli achituli kuzwa mulinjiyo, pesi utayuminini nkakata.
Nkaambo bulowa bwakwe buli akati mulinguwe. Wabubika amwala ubungusene; takabutilila ansi anyika kuti abuvwikile asuko,
aboobo chileta bukali bwaku bwedezezya kwelede ubungusene kuti butakavwikkilwi.
Nkiinkako, Mwami Jehova waamba oobu: Maawe kumunzi wabulowa. Alubo ndiyokomezya idwi lyankuni. Bamba nkuni akuzibika mulilo.
Jika nyama kabotu akuvwelengania atunonia musinza akuleka zifuwa zipye zibensizi.
Elyo bikka mpoto amakkala nkitakwe chintu pe, kuti itentwe akusanduula mubala wayo wamukuba, aboobo kulasalala kuli mukati kayo kuyoyeemuka, ibulala bulyigwe bukamane.
Wakatala kambo kakubeleka loko, pesi bulala tabuzwide kulinguwe amulilo.
Buuse bwabube bwako buli mubusofwazi. Nkaambo ndakeezya kukusalazya pesi tewakasalala kuzwa mubusofwazi bwako, tokoyosalazigwa limbi ado ndikakkutisike bukali bwangu atala anduwe.
Imebo nde Jehova, mbundamba, alimwi ndiyochichita. Nsikoyoleka na kulyokezya kuzwa kulinchicho. Mbuli nzilazyako mbuzyakabede, ambuli nchito zyako, bayomubeteka.''
Elyo ijwi lya Jehova lyakaza kuli ndime, lyaamba kuti,
''Mwana muntu! Langa, Ndikubweza kuyanda kwamenso aako kuzwa kulinduwe achuumyo pesi toyelede koomoka na kukwila, alimwi misozi yako tiyelede kukkunka.

Welede kukwila chibiizi. Toyelede kwendelezya dilwe lyabafwide. Wanga ngowani yako akuzwata nsangu kumawulu ako, pesi utavumbi masusu akumenso na kulya chinkwa chabaalumi nkambo kakusweekelwa banakazi bako.''
Aboobo ndakambila bantu boonseni, alimwi mwanakazi wangu wafwa magolezya, kuseni ndakachita nzindakali ndalayililwa kuchita.
Bantu bakandibuzya, ''Tokoyotubuzya na kuti ezizintu zyambaanzi, zintu nzyolikuchita?'''
Aboobo ndakati kuli mbabo, ''Ijwi lya Jehova lyakaza kuli ndime, nkaliti,

'Wambila ng'anda ya Izilayeli, Mwami Jehova waamba oobu: Langa! Njowubula chikkombelo changu -- mantukwe anguzu zyanu, kubotelwa kwamenso eenu, chiyandisyo chamoyo wanu, alimwi bana banu balombe abana banu basimbi mbibakasiya musule bayojigwa apanga.
Elyo muyochita mbubonya mbundakachita: tamukoyovumbula masusu akumenso, nakulya chinkwa chababa baalumi bakwiila!
Anukuti, ngowani zyanu zinoli amitwe yanu, ansangu zyanu kumawulu anu; tamukoyowomoka nakukwiila, nkambo muyoyemuka muzibi zyanu, alimwi awumwi mwalumi uyosintimukila mukalana wakwe.
Aboobo Ezekkiyeli uyoba chitondezyo kuli ndinywe, mbuli zintu zyonse nzyachita muyochita chakumusikila. Elyo muyoziba kuti Ndime Mwami Jehova.'''
''Pesi iwebo, mwana wamuntu, mubuzuba obo ndakutola ng'anda yakubunganina, ililukondo lwabo, mantukwe aabo, anzibabona akuyandisya - alimwi ayo ndakubweza bana babo balombe, abana basimbi -
mulelyo zuba, ulobokede uyoza kuli nduwe kukupa milumbe!
Mulelyo zuba mulomo wako uyowasamina sikuloboka alimwi uyowambuula -- tochiyowumuni. Kuchitila kutondezya kulimbabo elyo bayoziba kuti Ndime Jehova.''
Mpawo Ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime, nkaliti,

Omwana muntu, bika busyu bwako kubantu ba Amoni, akusinsima chakubapa mulandu.

Nkikaako, langa, ndakupa kubantu bakujwe mbuli buvubi bwabo. Baloyimika musasa alinduwe alimwi akwimika matente abo akati kako. Bayolya michelo yako akunwa malili ako.
Ndiyochita Labba ankamela abantu ba Amoni muunda wabutanga. Mpawo uyoziba kuti ndime Jehova.
Aboobo Mwami Jehova wamba echi:  wakamba maboko ako akulyata ndyato zyako, akusekelela chakunyansya mulinduwe konyansya nyika yaIzilayeli.
Nkikaako, Langa! Ndiyokuma akuboko kwangu alimwi ndiyokupa mbuli chisalo kuzisi. Ndiyokugwisya kuzwa kubantu akukuchita kuti unyonyoke akati kamasi! Ndiyokunyonyona alimwi uyoziba kuti ndime Jehova.'
Mwami Jehova wamba echi; nkambo Mowabbu aSeyi bakati langa! Ing'anda yaJuda yaba mbuli woonse masi."
Nkikaako, langa! Ndiyojula tulonga twa Mowabbu, kutalikila kuziisi zyakwe amugano - bubotu bwaBbeti Jesimoti, Bali Miyoni, aKiliyatamu -

kubantu bakujwe abo bakalikwimpana abantu baAmoni. Ndiyobapedekezya mbuli muntu wabo aboobo kuchitila bantu ba Amoni. Ndiyobapedekezya mbuli muntu wabo aboobo kuchitila bantu ba Amoni tabakoyoyeyegwa akati kazisi.
Aboobo ndiyochita mbeteko kuba Mowabbu, alimwi bayoziba kuti ndime Jehova.'
Mwami Jehova nguwakamba echi, ' Edomu wakaliya nkoto kung'anda yaJuda alimwi wakachita bubi mukuchita mbubobu.
Nkikaako, Mwami Jehova wakamba echi: Ndiyowuma Edomu aluboko lwangu akunyonyona bantu boonse abanyama nkukoko. Ndiyobachita tongo, masena atakatidwe, kuzwa kutemani kosika kuDedani. Bayowa apanga.
Ndiyoliya Nkoto atala lya Edomu aluboko lwabntu bangu baIzilayeli, alimwi bayochitila Edomu mbuli kunyema abukali bwangu, alimwi bayoziba kuliya nkoto kwangu - aya ngamalayilile aMwami Jehova.'
Mwami Jehova ngwamba echi, 'BaFilisitiya bayoliya nkoto abubi alimwi akuzwa akati kabo bezya kunyonyona Juda chiindi achiindi.
Aboobo echi nchenchicho Mwami Jehova nchawamba: langa! Ndiyowuma aluboko lwangu kubaFilisitiya, alimwi ndiyo gwisya baKelati akubanyonyona bakayoboka abo batobezezye kumbali lyaLwizi.
Lino ndiyo liya nkoto mpaati kulimbabo chanchito zyabukali chakuba subula, aboobo bayoziba kuti ndendimeJehova, elyo nenjoliyankoto zyangu kulimbabo."
Aboobo mwakali mumwaaka wakkumi aawumwi, mubuzuba butaanzi bwamweezi, aawo ijwi lya- Jehova lyakasika kuli ndime, kaliti,
''Mwana wamuntu, nkaambo Taya wakaamba chakukazyana a- Jelusalemu, 'Maa! Millyango yabantu yapazuulwa! Wajokela kuli ndime;  Ndiyozuzigwa kujulu nkaambo wakanyoonganwa.'
Nkiikaako Mwami Jehovawaamba eechi, 'Amulange! Ndakazyana anduwe, Taya, alimwi ndiyobusya maanji manyika akazyana anduwe mbuli lwizi lubusya mayuwe.
Bayoonyonyoona milambo ya- Taya akupwayila aansi angazi zyakulangila kwaabo. Ndiyoyiila lusuko lwakwe akumuchita mbuli bbwe litakwe chintu.
Uyakuba busena bwakubikkila nsabwe kuti ziyume aakati kalwizi, mbuli mbundaamba- Ooku nkuukwaamba kwa- Mwami Jehova- alimwi uyooba sikunyonyoona kumanyika.
Bana bakwe basimbi bali mumyuunda bayojayigwa asumu, alimwi bayooziba kuti ndime Jehova.'
Nkaambo ncheechi Jehova nchaati: Amulange, kuzwa kujwe ndeeta Nebbukkadineza mwami wa- Bbabbiloni, mwami wa- Baami, kukazyana a- Taya, amabbiza ankalaki, abeenzyi bamabbiza abiingi.
Uyakujaya bana basimbi bako mumuunda. Uyakubusya bulambo bwakukulwisya akuyaka zitantaala zisazyana abulambo akunyampula zikwabilizyo zikazyana anduwe.
Uyakubikka mincina yakwe ikazyana abulambo bwako, alimwi zibelesyo ziyakuzapawulwa aansi milambo.

Mabbiza aako ayakuvula kuti lusuko lwako luyakukuvumba. Bulambo buyakuzungaana amuzuzumino wamabbiza, amawagoni, ankalaki. Kuchiindi nayonjila mumilyango yanu, uyakunjila mbuli bantu basika mumuunzi ooyu bulambo mubwakawunsigilwa aansi.
Nsumba zyamabbiza ayookulyatawula yoonse migwagwa yanu. Uyakujaya bantu bako apanga anguzu zyanu zyamubulambo bwamabwe buyowida aansi.
Bayakuupwayulala buvubi akubweza nzimusambala zitali mumulawu. Baya kukukolomweda aansi bulambo alimwi akunyonyona bubotu bwaminzi.
Ndiyakuumuzya mizuzimino yanyimbo zyangu. Mizuzimino yatuntimbwa twanu tikooyoomvwigwa limbi.
Ndiyokuchita mabwe atakwe chintu, uyooba busena aawo nsabwe mpuziyobikwa kuti ziyume. Tukoyookoonzya kubuyaka lubo, nkaambo Ime, Mwaami Jehova ndaambula- mbwaamba Mwaami Jehova.
Mwaami Jehova waamba eezi ku Taya, 'Sa tusuwa twalwizi tatukoozungana amumuzumo wakuwa kwako, anibayootongela machise achitanga wafwa kuti kujayigwa kwaba akati kanu?

Mpawo boonse baami balwizi bayooseluka kuzwa kuzyuunu zyabo alimwi akugwisya zyakusama zyabo akusamununa zisamo zyabo zyaboofu. Bayosa zyakusama zyamanyengwe manyengwe, bayokala mumabuwa azyakusama zyamanyengwe manyengwe chiindi chifwifwi, alimwi bayoayoowa kaambo kanduwe.

Bayoolilisya akwaamba kuli nduwe, Mbuti nywebo nimwakali bantu bakakkede abasimaato, mwnyonyoonwa. Chisi chilampuwo chakala nguzu- Lino zyeenda kuzwa kuli. Bamwi bakkala omuno bakatondeezya kuyoowa beni aatala aboonse bakali kukkala munsi aambabo.
Lino tusuwo tulayoowa mubuzuba bwakuwa kwanu. Tusuwa tulimulwizi tulazungaana, nkaambo tamuchili mubusena bwanu.'
Nkaambo Mwami Jehova waamba eezi: Nindiyookuchita muumi uutachikwe chintu, mbuli iimwi myuunzi itakkede bantu, nindiyobusya bunike bwamaanzi aanu, alimwi kuchiindi maanzi aalanguzunayoomuvumba,

mpawo ndiyokubwedsya aansi basikale banu mbuli bamwi bakeenda aansi mumalindi; nkaambo ndiyookuchita kuti ukkale mumasena aalansi anyika mbuli mumatongo abasikale. Nkaambo kacheechi tukooyoobweda lubo akwiimikila munyika yabapona.
Ndiyakuleta mapenzi alinduwe, alimwi tukooyoobawo chalyoonse. Mpawo uyoozichita, pesi tukooyooboneka limbi- Mbwamba Mwami Jehova.''
Alimwi ijwi lya Jehova lyakaza kuli ndime, nkaliti,
''Omwana wamuntu, talika kulya Taya,
alimwi utedi kuli Taya, ngwani ukkala mukati kamilyango ya Lwizi, Bantu bawuzya kutusuwa twiingi, Mwami Jehova waamba ezi kuli nduwe: Taya, wakamba kuti, 'Ndiluleme mububotu.'
Migaano yako ilimumyoyo yalwizi; basikuyaka bako balulamika bubotu bwako.
Bakachita mapulanga ako woonse amusipulasi kuzwa ku Sina; bakabweza seda kuzwa kuli Lebbanoni kukuchita kasamu kabwato kako.
Bakachita nsoke yako kuzwa kumu okkisi wa Bbasyani; bakachita ntafula yako muzisamu zyamusipulasi kuzwa ku Sayipulasi kuzwa ku Sayipulasi, alimwi bakalimbania ameja anzovu.

Malembo akwenzya ako akachitidwe kuzwa kunchinda imwekesya kuzwa ku Ijiputi oyo wakali kubela mbuli ndembela; musyobo wasimakaka awantumbula kuzwa kuzitobela zya Elayisya zibelesegwa kukuvumbya abwato bwako.
Abo bakali kukkala mu Sidoni a Avadi bakali basikuyamba bako; bachenjede baku Taya bakali mulinduwe; bakali basikukwenzya.
Basikubeza bakonzya loko bazwa ku Babbilosi bakazuzya basikwenzya babo akati kako bakanyampwide zyakuyowuzya zyako.
Peziya, Lidiya, a Libbiya bakali mulumamba lwako, baalumi bako benkondo, bakagwabikide ntobo azikwabilizyo zyamumutwe mulinduwe; bakatondezya bubotu bwako.
Balumi baku Avadi a Helekki mulumamba lwako bakali abulambo bwako kabakuzyungulukide! Bakamaninsya bubotu bwako.
Tasyisyi wakali sikusambala nyokwe nkambo kabuvubi bwako bwiingi bwazintu zyakuzya: Nsiliva, nsimbi, kagabba amusyobo wensimbi. Bakuula akuzya zintu zyabo!
Javani, Tubbalu, a Mesyeki -- bakali kuuzya bazike azintu zyakachitidwe amukuba. Bakabweza zyuzigwa zyako.
Bbeti Togama wakapa mabbiza , mabbiza ankondo ambongolo mbuli zyuzigwa zyako.
Balumi baku Lodi bakali basikukuzizya zyakali mumaboko ako zyingi zyuzigwa zyakali mumaboko ako; bakabwedezya meja, meja anzovu, azisamu zyakuuzya!
Alamu wakali sikuuzya zintu zyako zyiingi; bakapa ma emaladi, bwantumbula, zigogo zimweka, milembo lyabulukwe bunini, pelusi, amalubbizi mbuli zyakuuzya zyako.
Juda anyika ya Izilayeli bakali kuzizyania anduwe. Bakapa wiiti kuzwa kuminiti, zibunge, buchi, mafuta, a bbalusamu mbuli zyakuuzya zyako.
Damasikkosi wakali kuuzya zintu zyako zyoonse, boonse buvubi bwako bwiingi, abwawayini ya Helobbolani abuluba bwa Zaha.
Dani a Javani  baku Izali bakakupa zyakuuzya zyabutale bufulidwe, sinamoni akkalamusi. Eezi zyakaba zyakuuzya kulinduwe.
Dedani wakali sikuuzya wako mandumba mabotu.
Alabbiya boonse baami bakkeda bakali basikusambazyanyokwe, bakapa tubelele, bagutu, aa mpongo.
Basikuzya ba Syebba a Lama bakaza kuzokuuzizya zibotu zyabuztwizyo boonse amumisyobo yamabwe mabotu; bakeeta ngolide kukuzowula zinrtu zyako.
Halani, Kkane, a Edeni bakali basikuuzya nyokwe, antomwe a Syebba, Asa, a Kkilinadi.
Aba bakali basikuuzya bako muzisamo zyeebeka zyamisyobo injilene, mumandumba amisyobo myingi, alukidwe, zisamo zyakasumwa obotu abusena bwako bwakuuzizya.
Maato aku Tasyisyi  akali zinyampuzyo zyazyuuzyo zyako! Aboobo wakalizwide, akalilemedwe zintu mumoyo walwizi!
Basikuyamba bako bakakweta mulwizi lupati; guuwo lyakujwe lyakakutyola akati kabo.

Buvubi bwako, nzyowuzya, azintu zyakuuzya, basimaato bako basikubeenzya, abasikuyamba bwato; basikuula zintu zyako aboonse baalumi bankondo bakali mulinduwe, aboonse basikubeleka -- bayondyondyomena mulwizi lubbila mubuzuba bwalunyonyooko lwako.
Zisi kulwizi ziyotekezta kumuzumo wakulila kwaba sikwenzya bako;
Boonse abo bajata nsoke balaza ansi kuzwa mumaato abo; basinkasia boonse basikwenzya mulwizi bayoyima anyika.
Elyo bayokuchita uswilile kujwi lyabo alimiw bayolila chakuchisya moyo; bayolitila lusuko ajulu amitwe yabo. Bayobumbuluka mudyota.
Bayogela mitwe yabo chinkulu kulinduwe akulyangilila amasaka, alimwi bayolila chakuchisya moyo alimwi bayolilisya.
Bayolila ajulu maliyo kabalilila nduwe, akwimba nyimbo zyakuyeeya kulinduwe, ngwani ulimbuli Taya, oyo lino weetwa kuluumuno akati kalwizi?
Awo basikuuzya bako nibakayinda ankomwe yalwizi, bantu biingi bakakkutisika anzizyo; wonetesya Baami bamunyika abuvubi bwako bubotu anzowuzya!
Pele nimwaka mwayusigwa alwizi, amanzi abbide, zyoonse nzyowuzya ababeleka bako bakabbila!
Bonse bakkala kumbali alwizi bakagamba alinduwe, alimwi Baami babo bakakankama chakuyoowa!
Masyu abo akateketa! Bantu bawuzya bakakungwakung'ung'una; wakabachisya, alimwi tochiyobiwo limbi kwalyoonse.''
Mpawo ijwi lya Jehova lyakaza kulindime, nkaliti,

''Omwana muntu, wambila mwendelezi wa Taya, 'Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Mowowako ulalisumpula! Wamba, ''Ndime Leza! Ndiyokkala achuuno chabaleza mumoyo walwizi!'' Nikuba kuti ndimuntu alimwi nsili Leza, moyo wako mbuli moyo waleza;
uyeya kuti ulimusongo kwinda Daniyele, alimwi takwe nsiswa ikugambya!
Wakalichitila nomwini buvubi abusongo aluzibo, akujana ngolida a nsiliva muzibikilo zyako!
Mubusongo bupati alimwi akukuzya kwako, wakayungizya buvubi bwako, aboobo moyo wako ulalisumpula nkambo kabuvubi bwako.
Nkinkaako, Mwami Jehova wamba eezi:  Nkambo wachita moyowako mbuli waleza,
Ndiyoyeta bazwakule bazokulwisye, baalumi bayoosya bazwa kulaamwi maasi. Bayoyeta mapanga aabo akulwisya bubotu bwabusongo bwako; alimwi bayosofwazya bubotu bwako.
Bayokuwalila aansi mudindi, alimwi uyoofwa lufu lwabaabo bafwa mumyoyo yalwizi.
Uyowamba kasimpe na, ''Ndime Leza'' kubusyu ayoyo ukujaya lwako? Ulimuntu alimwi teensi nduwe Leza pe, alimwi uyoba mumanza ayoyo ukuyasa.
Uyofwa lufu lwabaabo batapalwidwe pe akuboko kwabazwa kule, nkambo ndakazyamba - echi Mwami Jehova nchawamba.'''
Ijwi lya Jehova lyakaza lubo kulindime,
''Omwana wamuntu, pwaya mubila kumwami wa Taya alimwi uteedi kulinguwe,  'Mwami Jehova wamba echi: wakali chikozyanio chabululami, chizwide busongo alimwi chibotu kwalyoonse.

Wakali mu Edeni, mumuunda wa Leza. Lyoonse bbwe ibbotu lyakali kuzyungulukide: Lubbi, topazi, emelaludi, kkilisoliti, onikisi, jasipa, safiya, takwisi, a bbali. Kubamba kwenu akubika kwenu zyakachitwa kuzwa kungolide. Lyakali muzuba ndwakalengwa ezyo nizyakabambwa.
Ndakakubika achilundu chisalala cha Leza mbuli kkelubbi Ndakakunanika kuti ulange misyobo yabantu. Wakali akkati kamabwe alamulilo oko nkwakali kwendeenda.
Wakali syomekede munzila zyako kuzwa mubuzuba bwakulesegwa kosikila kutalulama nikwakatajanika mulinduwe.

Mukwindila kuzya kwako kupati wakazwide bulwani, alimwi wakabisya. Aboobo ndakakusowela aanze kuzwa kuchilundu cha Leza, mbuli  oyo wakasofwazigwa, alimwi ndakakunyonyoona, ulindiide kkelubbi, alimwi wakakugwisya kuzwa akati kamabwe apya.
Moyo wako wakali kulisumpula abubotu bwako; wabisya busongo bwako nkambo kabubotu bwako. Ndakakutuma aansi enyika. Ndakakubikka kunembo lya Baami nkokuti bakubone.
Nkambo kazibi zyako zyiingi akuzya kwako kutasyomekana, wakasofwazya masena aako asalala aboobo Ndachita mulilo kuzwa kulinduwe; uyokusyukuta. Ndiyokuchita dyota kumenso abaabo bakulanga.
Boonse abo bakwizi akati kabantu bayokuletela; bayoyoowa alimwi tachiyobi limbi kwalyoonse.'''
Mpawo ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime, nkaliti,
''Omwana wamuntu, langisisya busyu bwako atala a Sidoni alimwi sinsima zimulwania.
Mwambilobu, 'Mwami Jehova wamba echi; lemekwa akati kenu aboobo bantu bayoziba kuti Ndime Jehova nenjobeteka chabululami akati kabo. Ndiyotondezya kuti ndasalala mulinduwe.
Ndiyotumizya bulwazi mulinduwe abulowa mumigwagwa yako alimwi abo bakajiidwe bayowa akati kanu.

Elyo panga lyayosika kukulwisya kuzwa kumabbazu woonse, mpawo muyoziba zinchenya ziyasa amamvwa achisa kung'anda ya Izilayeli kuzwa kuli koonse bamwengelede abo banyansya bantu bakwe, aboobo bayoziba kuti Ndime Mwami Jehova!

Mwami Jehhova wamba echi, 'Kuti ndabungania ng'anda ya Izilayeli kuzwa kubantu abo bakasanseene, alimwi ndayopambulwa akati kabo, aboobo zisi ziyobona, mpawo bayochita myunzi yabo munyika njentakape mulanda wangu Jakobu.

Mpawo bayopona chakutayowa mulinguwe akuyaka maanda, akubyala masansa, akupona chakutayowa elyo ndayobeteka chabululami kulibaabo bonse balangilila ansi kuzwa kulibaabo babengelede; aboobo bayoziba kuti Ndime Jehova Leza wabo!'''
Mumwaaka wakkumi, mumwezi wakkumi mubuzuba bwakkumi atubili bwamumweezi, ijwi lyaJehova lyakeza kuli ndime, lyaamba kuti,
''Mwana muntu, kolwisya Falo, mwami waku Ijiputi,

Kokanana kulinguwe akwaamba boobu: Bona! ndime sinkondonyokwe, Falo; mwami waIjiputi. Iwebo, achinyama chipati chamulwizi chiyubide aakati kamulonga, nchiwaamba kuti, ''Mulonga wangu nguwangu. Ndakupanga nkelichitila lwangu.''

Aboobo ndiyobika tulobyo mumulomo wako, alimwi baswi bamumulonga wenu Nayili bayojatilila kumakwa aako; ndiyokunyampula kuzwa aakati kamulonga wako antomwe abaswi boonse bamumulonga bajalilidwe kumakwa aako.

Ndiyokusowela aansi munkanda, webo antoomwe abaswi bamumulonga wako. Uyoowida mumuunda ujulikide; takwepe noyobungikwa nikuba kubusigwa. Ndiyookwaba mbuli chakulya kuzinyaama zipona zyaanyika alimwi akubayuni bakujulu.
Mpawo boonse aabo bakkala muIjiputi bayoziba kuti ndime Jehova, nkaambo bakali kkuba lyatete kung'anda yaIzilayeli.
Muchiindi nibakabweza amanza aabo, wakatyola akudeluula makkuko aabo; alimwi wakachitya mawulu aabo kuti atayimi kabotu.
Aboobo Mwami Jehova waamba boobu: Bona! Ndiyokweetela ipanga liyookulwisya. Ndiyogonka baalumi antomwe abanyama kulinduwe.
Aboobo nyika yaIjiputi iyoosigwa akuba tongo. Eelyo bayooziba kuti ndime Jehova, nkaambo munyama wamulwizi wati, ''Mulonga nguwangu, nkaambo ndakawuchita.''

Nkinkaako, langa! Ndiyolwisyania anduwe akuyolwisya mulonga wako aboobo ndiyoopa nyika yaIjiputi kubatongo akutakaanika, alimwi iyooba tongo lyaanyika kuzwa kuMigidolo kusika kuSayini akumigaano yakuKkusyi.
Taakwe kuulu kwamwaalumi kuyooyinka mukati, alimwi taakwe kuulu kwamunyama kuyoyinka mukati. Takukoyokkalwa kwamyaaka ilimakkumi aane.
Eelyo ndiyochita nyika yaku Ijiputi kusiigwa aakati kanyika zitakkedwe, amadolopo ayosiigwa kwamyaaka makumi aane; eelyo ndiyomwaya Ijiputi akati kamaasi, alimwi ndiyoyisansaania kumanyika woonse.
Eelyo Mwami Jehova waamba boobu: kumamanino amyaaka iilimakumi aane ndiyobungania Ijiputi kuzwa kubantu akati kabaabo bakamwayikide.
Ndiyoboozya buzike bwaIjiputi akubwedezya kubusena bwaPetulosi, kunyika nkubazwa. Eelyo kuyooba bwami bulaansi ooko.
Buyooba buniini loko kumaami amwi, alimwi tabukoyobusigwa limbi akati kazisi zimwi. Ndiyobafwiinsya kwakuti tabachiyoyendelezyi limbi zimbi zisi.

BaIjiputi tabachiyoobi chitamizyo kuchaamba chang'anda yaIzilayeli. Anukuti, bayoba chiyeezyo chabubi oobo Izilayeli mbwakachita muchiindi nakalanga kuli Ijiputi kuti bajane lugwasyo. Eelyo bayoziba kuti lwangu ndendime Mwami Jehova.'''
Eelyo kwakaba kuti mumwaka wamakkumi aabili alamusanu atubili mubuzuba butaanzi bwamweezi, kuti ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime, kaliti,

''Mwana wamuntu, Nebbugadineza mwami waku Bbabbiloni wakakkazika impi yakwe kukuchita mulimo mupati kukulwisya Taya. Mitwe yoonse wakachikinisigwa manedo yabamabbuwa, alimwi makkuko woonse akachubbuuka. Kakuli kuti lwakwe abasilumamba takwe nibakatambula mufolo kuzwa kuTaya nkambo kamulimo muyumu ooyo ngwakachita kukwilwisya.

Nkinkaako iMwami Jehova waamba boobu, ''Langa! Ndiyopeda nyika yaIjiputi kuli Nebbugadineza mwami waBbabbiloni, alimwi uyotola buvubi bwayo, akuyola zyonse nzyajisi, akuyokukulula zyoonse nzyayojana nkuko; eezyo nzeziyooba mufolo wabasilumamba bakwe.
Ndamupa nyika yaIjiputi mbuli impindu nkambo kamulimo ngubakachita kulindime, oyu Mwami Jehova nguwamba oobu.
Mubuzuba oobo ndiyomezeka lwija kung'anda yaIzilayeli, alimwi njokuchita kuti webo ukaambuula akati kabo, kuchitila kuti bakazibe kuti ndime Jehova.'''
Ijwi lyaJehova lyakaza kuli ndime, kalyaamba kuti,
''Mwana wamuntu, sinsima akwamba kuti, 'Mwami Jehova uwamba eechi: kwiila; ''Maawe kuzuba litobela.''
Izuba lilaafwifwi. Izuba lyaJehova lilaafwifwi. Liyooba zuba lyamayooba, chiindi chakunyonyooka kwazisi.
Mpawo ip[anga liyoosika aatala aIjipita, alimwi kuyooba kupengeleka muKkusyi eelyo bantu bajiidwe nibayoowa muIjiputi, eelyo nibayotola buvubi bwakwe, alimwi intalisyo zyakwe niziyooba matongo.
Kkusyi aPuti, Lidiya alimwi aboonse baAlabbiya, aLibbiya, antoomwe abantu balimuchizuminano, bayoowa boonse apanga.

Jehova uwamba eechi: Aboobo aabo bagwasya Ijiputi bayoowa, alimwi kulisumpula kwanguzu zyakwe kuyooya aansi. Kuzwida kuMigidoli kuyosikila kuSyene basilumamba babo bayowisigwa apanga, aaya ngemalayilile amwambila Jehova.
Bayooyosegwa mukati kanyika zicheede, alimwi muunzi wabo uyooba akati kamyuunzi yoonse yakaba matongo.
Eelyo bayoziba kuti ndime Jehova, elyo ndayobikka mulilo muIjiputi, alimwi boonse basikumugwasya nibayomwayisigwa.
Mubuzuba oobo batumwa bayozwa aanze kuzwa kunembo lyangu mumaato kuti bayoosye Kkusyi ukwabilidwe, alimwi kuyooba mapenzi akati kabo kubuzuba oobo bwakumwayisigwa kwaIjiputi. Nkaambo bona! Chiyobuza.
Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: njoochita mamanino kumakamu makamu aIjiputi kwiinda kujanza lyaNebbugadineza, mwami waBbabbiloni.
Lwakwe abasilumamba bakwe kabalaamwi, nchiyoosyo chazisi, ziyoyetwa kuti zimwaye nyika: bayogwisya mapanga aabo aatala aIjiputi akuzuzya nyika abaabo bakajigwa.
Ndiyochita milonga kuti ikabe nyika injumu alimwi ndiyowuzya nyika mumaanza aabalumi basizibi. Ndiyochita nyika azili mulinjiyo kuti likabe tongo ajanza lyabazwakule, lwangu ndeJehova, ndakaambuula.

Mwami Jehova, waamba eechi: ndiyomwaya zikozyanio, akuyoboozya kumagolelo zikozyanio zyabuyo zyaMeempisi. Takwe nikuyooba mwana wamwaami mulombe pe munyika yaIjiputi, alimwi njotila chiyoosyo munyika yaIjiputi.
Mpawo ndiyochita Patilosi chiyosezyo akubika mulilo muZoyani, njojaya inchito zyalubeta aaliTebbesi.
Nkaambo njotila kunyema kwangu aali Pelusiyamu, singuzu waIjiputi, akugonka bwiingi bwaTebbesi.
Mpawo njobika mulilo muIjiputi, Pelusiyamu uyoba mumapenzi mapati, Tebbesi uyootyololwa, alimwi Memfisyi uyolangana abasinkondonyina mazuba woonse.
Balombe bachikula muHeliyopolisyi akuBbubbasyitisyi bayowisigwa apanga, alimwi madolopo aabo ayobikwa mubuzike.

MuTapanesi, izuba liyokachilwa kupa mumuni walyo elyo nentakatyole ijokwe lyaIjiputi ooko, alimwi kulisumpula kwanguzu zyakwe kuyomana. Kuyooba joba linomuvumbide abana bakwe basimbi bayoyenda mubuzike.
Ndiyojaya inchito yakubeteka muIjiputi, aboobo bayoziba kuti ndime Jehova.'''
mpawo nikwakaba mumunyaka wakkumi awuumwi, mumwezi wakutanguna, mubuzuba bwamusanu atubili bwamwezi, jwi lyaJehova lyakasika kulindime, kalyamba kuyti,
''Mwana wamuntu, ndakatyola Ijiputi. Langa! Taakwe nikwakali kwaangwa pe,nanka kuchitwa kuti kusilikwe achaanzyo, kuchitila kuti kukasime loko kuti kukonzye kujata panga.
Aboobo Mwami Jehova uwaamba eechi, 'Langa, ndayimikizyania aFalo, mwami waIjiputi. Nkaambo njotyola kuboko kwakwe, antomwe akusimide akutyokede, akuchita kuti ipanga likawe kuzwa mujanza lyakwe.
Mpawo njomwaya Ijiputi akati kazisi akubasansaania akati kanyika.
Njoyumya maboko amwaami waBbabbiloni akubikka panga lyangu mujanza lyakwe kuchitila kuti nkakonzye kumwaya maanza aFalo. Uyotongooka kunembo lyamwami waBbabbiloni antongawuko yamuntu wambakufwa.

Nkaambo njosimya maboko amwaami waBbabbiloni, muchiindi eecho maboko aFalo ayoowa. Mpawo bayoziba kuti ndime Jehova, eelyo ndayobika panga mujanza lyamwami waBbabbiloni: nkaambo uyoolwisya nyika yaIjiputi andilyo.
Aboobo njowanzaania Ijiputi akati kazisi akubasansaania kwiinda munyika. Mpawo bayoziba kuti ndime Jehova.'''
Mpawo chakachitia mumwaka wakkumi awumwi, mumwezi watatu, mubuzuba butaanzi bwamwezi, kuti  ijwi lya Jehova lyakaza kuli ndime,  kaliti,
''Mwanamuntu, amba kuli Falo, mwami waIjipiti, alimwi akumabunga mabunga akwe amuzyungulukide, Mubupati bwako, ulimbulini?
Laanga! Asiliya wakali musida waLebbanoni ulamitabi mibotu, uupa mwenzule kulusaka alimwi uulindilide kukulampa, alimwi mitabi yakachita mpela yawo.
Maanzi miingi akawuchita kuti ube mulamfu; maanzi aanikide akamuchita kuti ubemupati. Milonga yakeeta koonse mubusena bwawo, nkaambo tulongalonga twawo twakali kusikila kumisamu yoonse yamumunda.
Bulamfu bwawo bupati bwakali kwiinda bwayimwi  yoonse misamu mumuunda, alimwi mitabi yawo yakavula loko; mitabi yawo yakalampa akaambo kamanzi miingi niyakalikuyookomena.

Woonse muyuni wamumajulu wakayaka mumitabi yawo, alimwi zyoonse zintu zipona zyamumuunda zyakazyala bana bazyo munsi lyamatu aawo aasansamukide. Zyoonse zisi zyiingi zyakakkala munsi lyacheenzule chawo.
Nkaambo wakali mubotu mubupati bwawo alimwi kulampa kwamitabi yawo, nkaambo miyanda yawo yakali mumanzi miingi.

Misida muhilili chaLeza teyakalikweelana pe anguwo. Takwe aakati kamisamu misipulasi yakeelene amitabi yawo, alimwi misamu biyo teyalikweelana amitabi yawo. Takwe nikwali uumbi musamu muchilili chaLeza wakali mbuli nguwo mukubota kwawo.
Ndakuuchita kutiubote antabi zyawo nyingi alimwi yoonse misamu yaEdeni yakali muchilili chaLeza yakuusula.
Aboobo Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Nkaambo wakali mulamfu kuyakujulu, alimwi wakabika mpela yawo aakati kamitabi yawo, wakanyampula moyo wawo nkaambo kabulamfu bwawo.
Ndawupeda mujanza lyamupati wazisi, kuti akalangane aawo mbuli bubi bwawo mbubuyanda. Ndkusowela anze.

Bazwakule bakali chiyoosyo chazisi zyoonse bakawugonka alimwi bakuusiya kuti ufwe. Mitabi yawo yakawida aazilundu alimwi amumisena yoonse, alimwi matabi aawo akalala butyokede mumajenga aanyika.  Mpawo zisi zyoonse aansi zyakazwa munsi lyacheenzule chawo alimwi zyakeenda kuzwa kulinguwo.
Boonse bayuni bamujulu bakalyookezya aachisiko chamusamu uuwide, alimwi munyama woonse wamumuunda wakaza kumitabi yawo.

Eechi chakachitika kuti kutabi iimbi misamu iikomena kumbali lyamanzi iloonyampula matu aayo kubulamfu bwamisamu milamfu loko, alimwi kuti kutabi iimbi misamu iikomena kumbali lyamanzi iloosikila kubulamfu oobo. Yoonse yakabambilwa kufa, kunyika iilikunsi, aakati kabana babantu, ambabo biinka kudindi.

Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Mubuzuba musida niwakiinka kukabanda ndakeeta kulila kunyika. Ndakavumba maanzi aanikide aatala lyayo, alimwi ndakaboozya maanzi aalwizi. Ndakasisia maanzi mapati, alimwi ndakeeta kulilila nguwe Lebbanoni. Aboobo yoonse misamu yamumuunda yakalila akaambo kawo.

Ndakeeta kuteketa kuzisi kumuzuzumo wakuwa kwawo, aawo nindakuuwaalila aansi kukabanda aantomwe abaabo bakiinka mudindi. Aboobo ndakuumbulizya yoonse misamu yaEdeni mumasena aaselukide loko aanyika. Eeyi njemisamu yakasalidwe mibotu yaLebbanoni; misamu yakanywa maanzi.
Nkaambo abalabo bakiinka aansi anguwo kukabanda, kuli baabo bakali bajayigwa apanga. Eezi zyakali kuboko kwawo kusimide, eezyo zisi zyakali zyapona munsi lyacheenzule chawo.

Nguuli wamisamu muEdeni wakeelene aawo mubulemu amubupati? Nkaambo uyoboozegwa aansi amisamu yaEdeni kusika kumasena aaselukide loko aanyika aakati kabatapalwidwe; uyopona abaabo bakajayigwa aapanga.' Ooyu nguFalo amukamu aakwe - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Elyo zyakachitika mumwezi wakkumi ayibili wamunyaka wakkumi ayibili, mubuzuba butaanzi bwamwezi, elyo ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulindime, kaliiti,

''Omwana muntu, wompololesya aatala aFalo mwami wa Ijiputi; wamba kuti kulinguwe, 'Waba mbuli mwana wamulavu akati kazisi, pesi waba mbuli chiyoosyo mulwizi; wakakkuvunga manzi, wakopengania maanzi amawulu aako akwavwindania maanzi aabo.
Mwami Jehova waamba boobu: Aboobo ndiyoyala kazamba kangu alinduwe mumbungano yabantu biingi; alimwi bayokunyampula mukazamba kangu.
Ndiyokusiya chakukutakata munyika, Ndiyokusowela mumuunda akuchita kuti bayuni bamajulu bakakkale alinduwe; inzala yabanyama boonse bapona anyika iyokkutisigwa anduwe.
Nkenkaako ndiyobikka nyama yako aazilundu, alimwi ndiyozuzya  mimpata amutunta wako uuzwide mvwinyu.
Mpawo njotila bulowa bwako atala azilundu, alimwi tulonga tuyozuzigwa abulowa bwako.
Mpawo eelyo ndayokuzima, ndiyovumba akusizya nyenyeezi zyawo; Ndiyovumba zuba amayoba, alimwi mweezi tukoyomunika pe mumuni wawo.
Yoonse mimuni imunika kumajulu njoyisizya alinduwe, akuyosizya nyika yako -- aya ngemalayilile a Mwami Jehova.
Aboobo njoyoosya moyo wabantu biingi mumanyika aayo ngotazi, nendayoyeta kuwa kwako akati kazisi, akati kamanyika ngwakayitanaziba.

Ndiyoyoosya bantu biingi atala anduwe; baami babo bayokankama akuyoowa akambo kako nendayovukuzya panga lyangu kunembo lyabo. Kufumbwa chindi awumwi uyokankama nkambo kako, mubuzuba bwakuyowisigwa kwako.
Nkaambo Mwami Jehova waamba ezi: Ipanga lyamwami wa Bbabbiloni liyooza alinduwe.
Ndiyochita kuti makamu ako akawisigwe amapanga abasilumamba - awumwi silumamba nchiyoosyo chazisi. Aaba basilumamba bayoselezya kulisumpula kwa Ijiputi akunyonyoona makamu ayo woonse.
Nkenkaako ndiyonyonyoona zyonse ng'ombe kuzwa kumbali lyamanzi; kuulu kwamuntu takukono chikompenganyi manzi pe, neziba insumba zyang'ombe zikakope.
Mpawo ndiyowumuzya maanzi abo akuyochita milonga yabo kuti ikafwilime mbuli mafuta - aya ngemalayilile a Mwaami Jehova.
Nendayochita nyika ya Ijiputi kuti ikabe busena butakatidwe, eelyo nyika yayosyala nkitachikwe zyakizuzizye, nendayolwisya boonse bakkala mulinjiyo, bayoziba kuti ndime Jehova.
Kuyooba kulila; bana basimbi bazisi bayolila atala anjiiyo; bayokwila atala a Ijiputi, atala amakamu akwe bayolila -- aya ngimalayilile a Mwami Jehova.'''
Mpawo zyakachitika mumunyaka wakkumi ayibili; mubuzuba bwakkumi amusanu bwamweezi, awo ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli ndime, kalyamba kuti,
''Mwana muntu, kolilila makamu a Ijiputi akubaselezya - lwakwe abana basimbi bazisi zisumpukide - kuyosika anyika ilansi antomwe abaabo bakiinka aansi kudindi.
'Mulikabotu loko na kwiinda namwi? Amwinke aansi mukale aansi abatapalwiidwe.'
Bayowida akkati kabaabo bakajayigwa epanga. Ipanga lyakagwisigwa! Wakapedekezegwa kupanga; bayomujata amakamu aakwe.
Basilumamba balenguzu bamukabanda bayolayilila atala a Ijiputi abenzinyina, 'Bakaza ansi okuno! Bayolala antomwe abatapalwidwe, antomwe abaabo bakajayigwa epanga.'
Asiliya mpali ambungano yakwe yoonse. Tubanda twakwe twamuzyunguluka; boonse bakajayigwa epanga.
Aabo balatubanda tupangilidwe mumalindi mpbali, ambungano yakwe yoonse. Tubanda twakwe tulizyungulukide boonse aabo ibakajayigwa, ibakawisigwa epanga, aabo bakeeta kuyosya anyika yabawumi.

Elamu mpali amakamu akwe oonse. Tubanda twakwe tuli muzyungulukide; boonse bakajayigwa. Aabo bakawisigwa epanga, bakaya ansi bakatapalwidwe kuya kubusena bulikunsi anyika, ibakeeta kuyoosya anyika yabawumi alimwi bakabweza bweeme bwabo, antomwe abaabo bakayinka ansi kudindi.

Bakabamba bulo bupetedwe bwa Elamu amakamu akwe woonse ali akkati kabusena bwakujayilwa; tubanda twakwe twamuzyunguluka. Boonse tabapalwidwe pe, bakayaswa amapanga, nkambo bakeeta ziyoosyo zyabo anyika yabapona. Aboobo balibwezede bweeme bwabo, antomwe abaabo baya mudindi akkati kabaabo bakajiigwa, aabo bayaaansi mudindi. Elamu ulakkati kabaabo bakajayigwa.
Masyekki, Tubbalu, awoonse makamu aabo mpobali! Tubanda twabo twabazyunguluka. Boonse tabapalwidwe pe, bakajayigwa epanga, nkambo bakeeta ziyoosyo zyabo anyika yabawumi.
Tabalali antomwe abasilumamba bakaya ku Tubanda antomwe azilwanio zyabo zyoonse zyankondo, alimwi amapanga aabo kawabikidwe munsi lyamitwe yabo azibi zyabo atala lyamafuwa aabo.
Aboobo iwebo, Ijiputi, uyotyolola akkati kabatapalwidwe! Uyolala kotobezya aabo bakayaswa a panga.
Idomu mpali abaami bakwe, abazululi bakwe boonse. Bakabikidwe munguzu zyabo abaabo bakajayigwa epanga. Bakalala antomwe abatapalwidwe, antomwe abaabo bakaya aansi mudindi.

Mupayizyi uyobweza bulowa bumwi bwachipayizyo chazibi akububika aminsende yang'anda akumabazu aane kusika kulubuwa lwamukkati.
Eezi muyozichita mumwezi wamusanu ayibili nkaambo kazibi zyamuntu umwi awumwi uubisya chakutaziba naa chakubula maanu; munzila eyii muyomania milandu akusalazya chikombelo.
Mumweezi mutanzi mubuzuba bwakkumi atune, kuyooba pobwe lyako, ibuzuba bwamusanu atubili bwamapobwe. Uyoolya chinkwa chitakwe busweezyo.
Mubuzuba oobo, mwana wachalumi wamwami uyolibambila lwakwe abantu boonse bamunyika imusune mbuli chipayizyo chazibi.

Alimwi kumazuba musanu aabili amapobwe, mwana mwalumi wamwami uyoobamba chituuzyo chazyumpilizyo zya Jehova: Basune bali musanu ababili abagutu batakwe pe chibi bali musanu ababili, a mupule wempongo mubuzuba bumwi abumwi mbuli chipayizyo chazibi.
Elyo mwana mwalumi wamwami uyochita chipayizyo chakulya chisuwo kumusune umwi awumwi anongo kumbelele imwi ayimwi aantomwe a hini lyamafuta kuli chimwi achimwi chisuwo.

Mumwezi wamusanu ayibili mubuzuba bwakkumi amusanu bwamwezi, kumapobwe, mwana mwalumi wamwami uyochita zipayiizyo kumazuba aaya alimusanu aabili: zipayizyo zyazibi, zipayizyo zyakutentela, zipayizyo zyazilyo, antomwe azipayizyo zyamafuta.

Mwami Jehova waamba echi: Muluyango walubuwa lwamukati, ulangide kujwe, uyojalwa kwamazuba musanu alimwi akubeleka, pesi mubuzuba bwakulyokezya unoli kuujulidwe, amubuzuba bwamwezi mupya unoli kujulidwe, amubuzuba bwamwezi mupya unoli kujulidwe.

Silutwe uyonjila lubuwa lwaanze aanzila yamulyango amulukoche lwawo kuzwida aanze, mpawo uyoyimikila kunembo lyaminsende lyamulyango wamulyango wamukati eelyo bapayizi nibayoobamba chituuzyo chakwe chakuumpa achituuzyo chakumuzya. Eelyo uyokomba kuchikunguzyo chamulyango wamukati akuzwa aanze, pesi mulyango tukonoli kujalidwe kusika lumwi kumabbililo.
Bantu benyika abalabo bayokomba kunembo lya Jehova kumanjililo amulyango ooyu musabata amwezi mupya.
Chipayizyo chakuumpa eecho silutwe nchayoyeta kuli Jehova mubuzuba bwasabata zinoli tubelele tuli musanu akamwi tutakwe chibi amugutu uutake chibi.
Chipayizyo chazilyo chila mugutu chiyobuchiyoba chisuwo, achipayizyo chilatubelele chiyooba echo nchayanda kupa, anongo yamafuta achisuwo chimwi achimwi chazilyo.
Mubuzuba bwamwezi mupya welede kutula sipule wang'ombe uutakwe chibi kuzwa kubutanga, tubelele tuli musanu akamwi mpawo amugutu uutakwe chibi.
Welede kuchita chipayizyo chazilyo zyalusuwo icha mupule wang'ombe alusuwo lwamugutu, akufumbwa nchayanda kupa kutubelele anongo yamafuta yachisuwo chazilyo zyoonse.
Elyo silutwe nanjila anzila yakumulyango amulukoche lwawo, welede kuzwida munzila mwanjilila.

Pesi nabantu bamunyika basika kunembo lya Jehova kuzyindi zyamapobwe asalidwe, kufumbwa umwi unjila kayinda mumulyango wakunyika kuyokomba welede kuzwida kumulyango wakumusanza; alubo kufumbwa unjilila kumulyango wakumusanza welede kuzwida kumulyango wakunyika. Takwe umwi uzwida kumulyango nkwanjilila, welede kweenda kalangide kunembo.
Silutwe welede kuba akati kabo; nibanjila mukati, welede kunjila mukati, anibayoozwa, welede kuzwa.
Kumapobwe, chipayizyo chazilyo chelede kuba chazisuwo chazilyo chasipule wang'ombe achisuwo chamugutu, alimwi kufumbwa nchayanda kupa kutubelele anongo yamafuta achisuwo choonse.

Silutwe na wapa chipo chamoyo, nikuba chipayizyo chakuumpa na chituuzyo chalumuno kuli Jehova, uyojulilwa mulyango oyo ulangide kujwe. Uyotula chituuzyo chakuumpa na chituuzyo chaluumuno mbuli uyelede kuzwa aanze, alimwi nanoli wazwa aanze amulyango uyojalwa.
Mukuyungizya, uyoopa kabelele katakwe chibi kamwaka omwe mbuli chipayizyo chakuumpa kuli Jehova mazuba woonse; uyochita oobu chifumo achifumo.

Uyoopa chituuzyo chazilyo anchicho chifumo achifumo, chimpanzi chamusanu achimwi chachisuwo mpawo achimpanzi chatatu chanongo yamafuta kuti chikatetye busu bwachituuzyo chazilyo cha Jehova, mukwinda mumulawu utamani.
Bayobamba kabelele, chituzyo chazilyo, amafuta chifumo achifumo, chituuzyo chakuumpa chitamani.
Mwami Jehova wamba obu: Na silutwe wapa chipo kuli umwi wabana bakwe balombe, ndukono lwakwe. Alimwi chazyalane lyakwe ndubono lwabo lwakukona.

Pesi na wapa chipo kuzwa kulukono lwakwe kuli umwi wabalanda bakwe, eelyo chiyoba chamulanda ooyo kusikila kumwaka walwangunuko, alimwi elyo chiyobweda kuli silutwe. Lukono lwakwe masimpe luyoba lwabana bakwe balombe.
Silutwe takabwezi lukono lwabantu kuzwa kulubono lwabo; welede kupa kubana bakwe balombe kuzwa kulubono lwakwe kuchitila kuti bantu batakusansaani, awumwi muntu kuzwa kulubono lwakwe.'''
Chitobela muntu wakeeta kulindime mukwinda kumanjililo amulyango wakutwanda tusalala twabapayizi, tulangide kunyika alimwi amubone! Kwakali busena kukuya kumbo.

Wakamba kuti kulindime, ''Obu mbubusena bapayizi nkubelede kubizya chituzyo chamulandu achituzyo chachibi alimwi nkubelede kujikila chituzyo chazilyo. Tabeelde kweeta zituuzyo mukati kalubuwa lwaanze, nkikaako bantu bayosalazigwa.''
Eelyo wakandeta kulubuwa lwaanze mpawo wakanditola wandinzya kuzyooko zine zyalubuwa oolo, mpawo ndakabona kuti kuchooko achimwi chalubuwa kwakali lumwi lubuwa.
Muzyooko zine zyalubuwa lwanze mwakali mbuwa zinini zine, tukokola tuli makumi aane mubulamfu amubusasa buli makumi aatatu. Mbuwa zine zyakeelene.
Kwakali munchali uchitidwe abbwe kuzyunguluka woonse aane, azijikilo aansi lyamunchali wabbwe.
Muntu wakaamba kuti kulindime, ''Ayaange masena , balanda bang'anda ya Leza nkubizya zipayizyo zyabantu.''

Mpawo mwalumi wakanditola kusule kumanjililo ang'anda ya Leza iisalala, alimwi kwakali maanzi ayenda kuzwa kunsi achikunguzyo chang'anda ya Leza kaalangide kujwe - Nkambo kunembo lyang'anda ya Leza iisalala lyakalangide kujwe - amanzi akalikukunka kaselukila aansi kubbazu lyakumusanza lyang'anda ya Leza isalala, kululyo lwachipayililo.
Eelyo wakandeta aanze kwinda kumulyango wakunyika akundizulwida kazyunguluka kumulyango ulangide kujwe, alimwi ooko akali kukunka kuzwa ooyu mulyango kubbazu lyawo lyakumusanza.
Mbuli kuti mwalumi wakali kuya kujwe, kwakali cheelesyo mujanza lyakwe; wakeeleka tukokola tulichuulu chomwe akundeeta kwinda awo maanzi mpayiila mungo.
Mpawo wakeeleka tukokola tuli chuulu chomwe alimwi akundeeta kwinda manzi mwayiilwa mungo; alimwi wakeeleka lubo tukokola tuli chuulu akundeeta manzi nkwayiila mungo.
Chakatobela wakeeleka alimwi chuulu chatukokola, pesi wakali mulonga ooyo nguntakonzyi kuzubuka pe nkambo maanzi akatanta aboobo akelela kuyamba mulingawo - wakali mulonga utakonzeki pe kuuzubuka.
Mwalumi wakandaambila kuti, '''Mwana muntu, ulichibwene na eechi?'''alimwi wakandeeta aanze antomwe twakabweeda katutobezya ankomwe yakumulonga.
Aboobo nindakabweeda musule, awo nkomwe yamulonga yakali aminsamu myiingi kuli eeli bbazu akuli imwi bbazu.
Mwalumi wakandikumbila kuti, ''Aaya maanzi ayabuya aanze kubusena bwakujwe aansi ku Alabba; Manzi aaya alakunka kaaya mulwizi lwa Munyo akwachita kuti abote.

Kuyoba kuti zyoonse zilengwa eezyo zyeenda amwi ziyokkala ooko manzi nkwaaya; kuyooba inswi nyingi, nkambo manzi nkwakunkila ooko. Ayochita kuti manzi alamunyo abote. Zyonse ziyokkala kufumbwa mulonga nkuuya.

Mpawo kuyoba kuti basikuzuba baku Eni Egilayimu kumbali amanzi, alimwi ooko kuyoba busena bwakuyanikila nsabwe ku Eni Egilayimu. Kuyoba misyobo myiingi yabaswi mu Lwizi lwa Munyo, mbuli baswi bamu Lwizi Lupati nkambo mbiingi.
Pesi masena azilambwa zilamatope zyaku Lwizi lwaMunyo tazikoyobotesegwa pe; ziyooba zyakupa munyo.

Kusiya atala ankomwe yamulonga waatala lyamabazu aabili, misyobo yoonse yamisamu iyokkala akuzyala kuulya. Matu aayo takoyokunkumuka pe aliwi michelo tikoyokachilwa pe kukula. Amwezi amwezi iyozyala michelo, nkambo maanzi azwa kubusena busalala alakunkila kulinjiyo. Michelo yayo iyooba chilyo, amatu aayo ayoba akusilisya.
Mwami Jehova waamba eechi: Eeyi iyoba nzila njimuyopambukania nyika kulunyungu lulikkumi ayibili ya Izilayeli: Jozefu uyooba azimpanzi zyobile.
Mweelede kwabania bwelene eecho nchindakasumpwida janza lyangu akukonka kuti ndipe kuli bamawuso banu. Eelyo nyika iyooza kulindindinywe mbuli lukono.
Eechi chiyoba ngumugaano wanyika kubbazu yakunyika kuzwa kuLwizi Lupati kunzila yaku Hetiloni, aku Zedadi akwalo.
Mpawo muugano uloyinka ku Bbelota, kuSibbulayimu, eeyo ikati ka Damasikkasi aku Hamati, alimwi aku Hazi Hatikoni aku Hamati, alimwi aku Haza hatikoni akwalo, eeyo ilikumbati lyamugano wa Hawulani.
Aboobo mugano uyoyinka kuzwa aku Haza Enani kumazubukilo antomwe a Damasikkasi a Hamati akusika kunyika. Eli liloba bbazu lyakunyika.

Aatala lyakubbazu lyakujwe mugano uyoyinka akati ku Hawulani aku Damasikkasi, kutobelezya mulonga wa Jodani aakati ka Giliyadi anyika ya Izilayeli. Muyoyeleka Giliyadi anyika ya Izilayeli kujwe lyaLwizi. Ayo ayoba mazubukilo akujwe.

Mpawo kubbazu kumusanza lyamugaano uyoyinka kuzwa kuzwa kuku Tama akuule akumanzi aku Melibba Kadesyi, mpawo akutobezya kasensa kaku Ijipiti doku Lwizi Lupati. Ooyu uyoba mugaano aatala lyakubbazu lyakumusanza.
Nkabela muugano wakubbazu uyoba ku Lwizi Lupati kulangene a Lebbo Hamati. Ooku kuyooba bbazu lyakumbo.
Amunzila eeyi muyowabonia nyika eeyi lwanu, kumikowa ya Izilayeli.
Muzyooko zyoonse alubuwa kwakali mbuwa niini zyoone, tukokola makumi aane mubulamfu alimwi makumi aatatu mubusasa. Mbuwa zyoone zyakeelene.
Mpawo kuyoba kuti muzwakule uyooba antoomwe amukowa ngwakkalaawo. Mulelede kumupa lukono - aaya ngemalayilile aa Mwami Jehova.''

Aya ngemazina anzubo. Luzubo lwa Dani luyotambula chisela chomwe chanyika; mugaano wayo uyotobelezya kumugano wakumusanza wa Izilayeli anzila ya Hetiloni a Lebbo Hamati. Mugano wayo uyoyinda kuyosika ku Haza Enani alimwi kuyosika kumbali lyamugaano wa Damasikkosi kusika kumusanza alimwi  akuyosika ku Hamati.
Kujatanisya amugaano wa Dani, uyoyinda kuzwa kujwe kuzwa kunzila yoonse ku Lwizi Lupati.
Kujatikizya amugano wa Asa kuzwa kubbazu lyakujwe kuyosika kunyika, Nafutali uyoba achibela chomwe.
Kujatanisya mugano wa Nafutali kuzwa kubbazu lyakujwe kuyosika kunyika, Manase uyooba achisela chomwe.
Kujatanisya mugano wa Manase kuzwida kubbazu lyakujwe,
Kujatanisya mugano kubbazu lyamugano wa Efulemu kuzwa kubbazu lyakujwe kuyosika kunyika, Lubbeni uyoba achisela chomwe.
Kujatanisya mugano wa Lubbeni kuzwa kujwe kuyosika kubbazu lyakunyika, Juda uyoba achisela chomwe.

Chipo chanyika echo nchotabachite chinotobezezye mugaano waJuda alimwi kukwankwamuka kuzwa kubbazu lyakujwe kuyosika kubbazu lyakunyika; chinoli makumi aabili amusanu azyuulu zyatukokola mubusasa. Bulamfu bunokozyenie kkumi lyazyuulu zyatukokola mubusasa kubbazu lyakunyika alimwi makkumi obile amusanu azyulu zyatukokola kubbazu lyakumusanza, alimwi chikombelo chinoli akkati kanjiiyo.
Eyi inyika njimuyopa kuli Jehova inoli tukokola tuli makkumi obile amusanu wazyuulu amubulamfu alimwi kkumi lyazyulu zyatukokola mubusasa.

Ezi ziyooba zyakuchita kuli echi chisela cha Jehova chisalala chanyika: Bapayizi bayopegwa nyika ilamweelwe ujisi tukokola makkumi obile amusanu wazyuulu mubulamfu kuzwa kubbazu lyakumusanza; tukokola kkumi lyachuulu mubusasa kubbazu lyakumbo; Abusena busalala bwa Jehova akkati lyanchicho.
Ezi zibaya zyakuli salazya kwabapayizi kubana ba Zadokki, oyo wakandilekela chakusyomeka awakatapambuka elyo bantu ba Izilayeli nibaka pambuka, mbuli kwakachita ba Levayiti.
Zipayililo zyabo ziyoba chimpanzi chanyika isalalisya, kuyungizizya kuya kumugaano wa Levayiti.

Inyika yaba Levayiti itobezezye mugaano wenyika yabapayizi  obo busena bunoli tukokola tuli makkumi obile amusanu wazyuulu mubulamfu kula tukokola tulikkumi lyazyuulu kubusasa. Bulamfu boonse bwampaa zyenyika bunoli tukokola tuli makkumi obile azyuulu amusanu kukulampa alimwi tukokola tuli makkumi obile azyulu mubusasa.
Tabelede kwiwuzya nanka kuchinchaana; takwe zyamichelo mitanzi zyankiya ya Izilayeli tazyelede kwanzaana kwalyoonse kuzwa kuleezi mpaa, nkambo zyonse zilasalala kuli Jehova.
Inyika isyeede, musanu wazyuulu zyatukokola mubusasa makkumi obile amusanu azyulu mutukokola bulamfu, inoli yakubelesya mudolopo, imaanda, alimwi amachezezyo; idolopo liyoba akkati kazyo.

Ezi zinoli zipimyo; bbazu lyakunyika linoli 4,500 tukokola mubulamfu; ibbazu lyakumusanza linoli 4,500 tukokola mubulamfu; ibbazu lyakujwe linoli 4,500 mutukokola mubulamfu; alimwi bbazu lyakujwe linoli 4,500 mutukokola mubulamfu.
Kunoli machezezyo aadolopo kuya kubbazu lyakunyika, 250 mutukokola kukunika; kuyosika kumbo kuya kujwe, 250 mutukokola kukunika, alimwi kuya kumboo 250 tukokola kunika.

Ibusena bucheede bwazipo zisalala buyotantamuka kwakkumi lyachuulu mutukokola kuyosika kujwe alimwi ikkumi lyachuulu mutukokola kuyosika kunyika. Chiyosika uyolampa kuutobezya kumugaano wazipayizyo zisalala, alimwi zigwisya ziyoba zyakulya kulibaabo babeleka mudolopo.
Bantu babeleka mudolopo, kuzwa kunzubo zyonse zya Izilayeli, bayolima nyika eyo.
Zyonse zipayizyo zyenyika ziyopimwa makkumi obile azyuulu mutukokola amakkumi obile amusanu azyuulu zyatukokola. Muleyi nzila muyochita zipayizyo zisalala zyanyika, antoomwe anyika yamudolopo.

Nyika yoonse kuzwa kumabbazu woonse azipayizyo zisalala alimwi busena bwadolopo buyoba bwamwana mulombe wa Mwami. Nyika yamwana a wamwami mulombe iyosika kujwe buyoyungizigwa amakkumi obile amusanu azyulu mutukokola kuzwa kumugano wakujwe - mpaa yakwe kuya kunyika iyoyungizigwa kwama kkumi obile amusanu azyulu mutukokola kuyosika kumugano wakumbo. Akkati kunoli chipayizyo chisalala, aabusena busalala bwachikombelo bunoli akkati kacho.

Inyika iyungizizigwe kuzwa kubuvubi bwaba Levayiti alimwi busena bwadolopo akkati kabo buyoba bwamwana wamwami, ziyoba akkati kamugaano wa Juda aamugano wa Bbenjamini - eyi nyika inoli yamwana mulombe wamwami.
Kuleezyo nzubo zitakachaale, impanzi zyabo azilazyo zinoozwa kumbo kuyosika kubbazu lyakunyika. Bbenjamini uyotambula chimpanzi chomwe.
Kujatanizya mugano wa Bbenjamini kuzwa kujwe kuyosika kubbazu lyakunyika Simiyoni uyobweza chimpanzi chomwe.
Kujatanisya mugaano wa Simiyoni kuzwa kubbazu lyakujwe, Izakka uyobweza chimpanzi chomwe.
Kujatanisya mugaano wa Izakka kuzwa kubbazu lyakujwe kuyosika kumbo, Izakka uyooba achisela chomwe.
Kuyosika kumusanza kwamugaano wa Zebbuluni, kokunuka kuzwa kujwe kuyosika kubbazu lyakunyika, iyoba nyika ya Gadi - chimpanzi chomwe.
Mugaano wakulubazu lwakumusanza wa Gadi uyoyungizigwa kuzwa ku Tama kuyosika kumanzi a Melibba Kkadesi, akukwinda kalonga ka Ijiputi alimwi  aku Lwizi Lupati.
Eyi nyika njimutakawale nkakata; luyoba lukono lwanzubo zya Izilayeli. Ezi ziyoba zimpanzi zyabo. Aya malayilile a Jehova.
Eyi inoli milyango yamazwido kuya kudolopo: kubbazu lyakunyika, chiyopima tukokola 4,500 mubulamfu,
iyoba amilyango itaatu, kiwuzikidwe mazina amikowa yaJuda: umwi mulyango nguwa Lubbeni, umwi mulyango nguwa Juda, alimwi umwi mulyango nguwa Levi.
Kubbazu lyakujwe, eecho chitakapimwe 4,500 mutukokola mubulamfu, kunoli milyango yotatwe; omwe nguwa Jozefu, omwe mulyango wa Bbenjamini, alimwi umwi wa Dani.
Kubbazu lyakumbo, eecho chinoli 4,500 tukokola mubulamfu, kunoli milyango yotatwe; mulyango womwe wa Simiyoni omwe wa Zebbuluni.
Kubbazu lyakumbo, echo nchimpanzi chiyopima 4,500tukokola linoli amilyango yotatwe; omwe mulyango wa Gadi, omwe mulyango wa Asa, alimwi omwe mulyango wa Nafutali.
Musinzo utobezya dolopo unoli kkumi amusanu azyuulu; kuzwa obobuzuba kaziya kunembo, izina lyedolopo linoli "Jehova mpaali."

Mumwaka wakusanguna wa Sayilasi mwaami wa Peziya , mwaami Leza wakazuzikizya majwi akwe akwambula kuzwa mumulomo wa Jelemiya mpawo akakopakopa muya wa Sayilasi. Ijwi lya Sayilasi lyakasika kubusena boonse bwabuleli bwakwe ino nzeezi zyakalembedwe akwaambulwa:
''Sayilasi, mwaami wa Peziya, wati: Jehova, Leza wakujulu, wandipa boonse bwami bwaansi, alimwi wakandisala kuti ndimuyakile ng'anda yakwe mu Jelusalema muchisi cha Judiya.
Kufumbwa uzwa kubantu bakwe (akube kuti Leza wakwe abanguwe) ulakonzya kutansya kuuya ku Jelusalema ili muchisi cha Juda, akuyakila Jehova Leza wa Izilayeli, Leza ujanika mu Jelusalema.
Bantu bali mumasena aayo mukkede aabo aasyede ba mwaami Leza beelede kubapa nsiliva angolida, zintu zibotu azivubwa, alimwi mbuli zipo zyakuliyandila zyang'anda ya Leza ilimu Jelusalema.''
Eelyo bapati bamikowa yakale ya Juda aya Bbenjamini, bapayizi aba Levi abaabo boonse Leza mbakakopakopa mumyoyo kuti bayinke kuyoyaka ng'anda ya mwaami Leza ku Jelusalema bakanyampuka.
Basimayakilane bakabagwasizya mukubapa zintu ezi: nsiliva, ngolida, zintu zibotu, zivuubwa azimwi ziyandisi, azipo zyakuliyandila.
Sayilasi mwaami wa Peziya alakwe wakababoozya zibelesyo zyamung'nda ya mwaami Leza, eezyo Nebbukkadineza nzyaaketede kuzwa ku Jelusalema akuzibikka mung'anda yamizimu yakwe.
Sayilasi mwaami wa Peziya wakazipa mumanza a Mitiledati mulondozi wachiyobwedo, wakazibalila Sheshibbaza, mwendelezi wa Judiya.
Oyu nguwakali mweelwe wazyo: makumi aatatu amitiba, chuulu chomwe chamitiba yansiliva, makumi abili amusanu amitiba yone,
makkumi atatu amitiba yangolide, 410 mitiba minini yansiliva, alimwi echuulu chomwe chazimwi zintu zyakayungizigwa.
Kwakali 5,400 zilongo zya ngolida azyansiliva mubwingi bwazyo zyonse. Sesibbaza wakazyeeta zyoonse eelyo bakali munyika zyabantu nibakazwa mu Bbabbiloni kuyaku Jelusalema.
Aaba mbibantu bakaboola kuzwa kubwaange bwa Mwaami Nebbukkadineza, oyo wakabatolede ku kubuzike ku Bbabbiloni, bantu bakaboola umwi awumwi kumyuunzi yabo mu Jelusalema muchisi cha Juda.
Bantu aba bakeza a Zelubbabbelu, Joshuwa, Nehemiya, Selayiya, Lilayiya, Modekkayi, Bbilushani, Misipa, Bbigivayi, Lehumu, antomwe a Bbana. Oyu ngomundando wamalembe a baalumi ba bantu ba Izilayeli..

Baalumi bamu Bbetelu a Ayi: 223.

Bayimbi bamuntempele, balunyungu lwa Asafa: 128.

Kkelosi, Syaha, Padoni,
