Mumwelwe wabo bakali 392 balunyungu lwababo bakasalilidwe kuti babelekele muntempele antomwe abalunyungu lwabalanda ba Solomoni.
Abo bakasyede Telu Mela, Telu Hasha, Kkelubbu, Adoni, alimwi a Imaa- pesi tebakali kukonzya pe kutondezya kuti mbasikale baba Izilayeli -
babikilizya 652 balunyungu lwa Delayiya, Tobbiya, antomwe a Nekkoda.

Alimwi, kuzwa kulunyungu lwaba payizi: balunyungu lwa Habbayiya, Hakkozi, a Bbazilayi (oyo wakabweza mwanakazi wakwe kuzwa kubana basimbi ba Bbazilayi waku Giliyadi alimwi wakali kwitwa azina lyakwe).
Bakalangula langula mumabbuku amikowa, pesi takwepe nibakabajana, nchenchicho nchibakatabikilizigwa mubupayizi nkambo bakategwa balisofweede.
Aboobo mwendelezi wakabambila kuti batakalyi nichiba chimwi chazipayizyo zisalala manedo mupayizi ula Ulimu a Tumimu akabazumizye.
Mbungano yabo yoonse yakali mweelwe usika ku 42,360,
kutabikilizya abalanda babo bachalumi antomwe abablanda babo bachanakazi ( bakali kusika ku 7,337) baalumi babo abanakazi babo basikwimba muntempele bakali ( miyanda ibili).
Mabbiza abo ngibakalawo: 736. Bana bamadonki abo: 245.
Nkamela zyabo: 435. Madonki abo: 6,720.
Eelyo nibakasika kung'anda ya Jehova ku Jelusalema, bamwi basololi babasikale bakapeda zipo zyakuyanda kwabo kukuyakwa kwa ng'anda.
Bakapa mbubakali kukonzya kumulimo: makumi musanu akkumi lyomwe akamwi kazyulu zyangolida,  zyulu musanu zyamilwi yansiliva, alimwi a mwanda womwe wazisani zyabapayizi.

Aboobo bapayizi aba Levi, ibantu, abasikwimba mung'anda ya Leza antomwe abalindizi bamilyango, antomwe ababo bakasalilidwe kubelekela mung'anda ya Leza bakali kukkala mumyunzi yabo. Bonse bantu bamu Izilayeli bakali mumyuunzi yabo.
Kwakali mumweezi wamusanu ayibili ba Izilayeli nkabali baboola kumyunzi yabo, eelyo bantu boonse nibakabungana mu Jelusalema mbuli muntu womwe.

Josyuwa mwana mulombe wa Jozadakki ababunyina bapayizi  a Zelubbabbelu mwana mulombe wa Syelitiyeli ababunyina bakanyampuka bakuyaka chipayililo cha Leza wa Izilayelu kuti bape zipayizyo zyakutenta mbuli mbokulembedwe mumulawo wa Mozesi muntu wa Leza.
Eelyo bakayaka chipayililo azikkalilo, nikuba kuti bakali kuyoowa akambo kabantu bachisi. Bakapa zipayizyo zyakutenta ku mwaami Leza zyachifumofumo akumagolezya.
Alubo bakachita pobwe lyakutebuzi akupa zipo zyakutentela zili mumulawo akuchita zyeelede kuchitwa mubuzuba bumwi abumwi.
Mbuli mbukubede, kwakali zipo zyakutenta zyalubbe, zipo zyakukkala kwamweezi mupya alimwi ezipo zyakuliyandila zyakapegwa aboonse bakazipa kuli Jehova, kubikilizya azipo zyakuli yandila.
Nikuba kuti tebakalina talika kuyakulula ng'anda ya Leza, pesi bakakonzya kupa zipayizyo zyakutenta ku mwaami Leza mubuzuba butanzi bwamweezi wamusanu ayibili.

Aboobo bakapa nsiliva kubabezi bamabwe abafuzi mpawo bakapa zyakulya, zyakuumpa amafuta aa olifa kubantu baku Sidoni a Taya kutegwa abalabo babeetele masamu amusidoli kuzwa ku Lebbanoni aayo ngibakayinzya mulwizi mane kuzowasisya ku Jopa, mbubonya mbuli mbwakambide Sayilasi, mwaami waku Peziya.

Nkaako mumwezi wabili mumwaka mupati wabili bantu kabasikide kale mung'anda ya Leza mu Jelusalema, Zelubbabbeli mwana wa Syeyalitiyeli, Jeshuwa mwana mulombe wa Zodakki, abamwi boonse bapayizi, ba Levi, ababo boonse bakaboola ku Jelusalema kuzwa mubwaange, bakatalika mulimu. Bakapa ba Levi bakali amyaka makumi obilwe naa kwinda kuti balange zyakuyakwa kwa ng'anda ya Jehova.

Jeshuwa abana bakwe abana bakwabo a Kkadimiyeli abana bakwe, abana bakwe uli ngwalunyungu lwa Hodaviya), abana ba Henadadi antomwe abana babo abana babunyina mbabo bakayaka ng'anda, boonse aba bakali ba Levi bakajatana mukulanga abo bakali kuchita mulimu wang'anda ya Leza.

Bayaki bakabamba intalisyo yang'anda ya Jehova. Eezi zyakachita kuti bapayizi bayime muzisamo zyabo amyeembo aba Levi bana ba Asafu, kulumbayizya Jehova ansaka mbuli Devidi mwaami waku Izilayeli mbwakali walayilila.

Bakayimba chakulumbayizya akulumba kuli Jehova kabati, mwaami Leza mubotu. Kusyomeka kwakwe kwachizuminano kuchisi cha Izilayeli takumani.'' Bantu boonse bakatembawula Jehova chakoompolola mulukondo nkambo kakuti ntalisyo yang'anda ya Jehova yakayaligwa.

Pesi bunji bwaba payizi, ba Levi, aantomwe abapati babasikale babo bakali bakomena, bakali babona n'anda ntanzi, eelyo nibakabona ntalisyo zya n'anda kazili kubambwa bakakwiila kapati. Pesi bantu biingi bakali koompolola chakukondwa chalumwemwe alimwi aloompololo lwakubotelwa.
Kumasimpilo, bantu tibakali kukonzya kusiyanisya majwi abantu balikubotelwa abali kukwiila nkambo bakali kukkwilisya aluuza lwabo kalusika kule.
Lino bamwi basinkondonyina babantu ba Juda aba Bbenjamini nibakamvwa kuti aabo bakalibangwa batolwa kumbi bakali batalika kuyaka ng'anda ya Jehova Leza wa Izilayeli.

Eelyo abo bakaboola kuli Zelubbabbelu abasilutwe babasikale bamikowa yabo. 'Bakati kulimbabo, ''Ngatuyake antomwe andinywe,  nkambo aswebo mbubonya mbuli ndinywe, tuyandula  kukomba Leza wenu, aswebo twali kupayizya kulinguwe kumazuba Esahadodi mwaami waku Asiliya, wakatweta kubusena okuno.''

Pesi Zelubbabbeli, Jesyuwa abamwi boonse bakasyeede basilutwe babasikale bamikowa bakasandula bakati, ''Nywebo teensi zyenu pe pesi nzizyesu swebonitwelede kuyaka ing'anda ya Leza wesu nkambo ndiswe nitwelede kuyakila Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, mbuli mbakalayilila Mwaami Sayilasi waku Pesiya.''
Aboobo bantu bakalimugundu bakasoleka kutyompya bantu ba Juda akubakonga kutegwa bayowe kuyaka ng'anda.
Bakapa balupati babulelo sinkamulomo kabayanda kuchelezya mabambe aabo. Bakali kuchita oobo mumazuba a Sayilasi mane mubulelo bwa Daliyasi mwaami wa Peziya.
Alimwi kumatalikilo abulelo bwa Zekisesi (oyu wakazibinkene lubo alyakuti Kkekesi) bakalemba chakupa mulandu bantu ba Juda aku Jelusalema.

Kwakali mumazuba a Atakizesi awo Bbishilamu, Mitiledati, Tabbilu, antomwe abenzinyina bakalemba lugwalo kuli Atakizesi ku mwaami waku Peziya. Lugwalo oolu lwakalembeledwe mumusyobo wachi Alamayikki alimwi akutolekelwa.
Lehumu musololi a Syimusyayi mulembi bakalemba muleyi nzila kuli Atakizesi atala a Jelusalema.

Mpawo Lehumu, Syimusyayi, abenzinyina, bakali babetesi abalupati-pati muli fulumende, bamu Peziya, bantu baku Eleki aku Bbabbiloni, alimwi abantu bazwa ku Susa (kwamba kuti, ba Elamayitisi)- bakalemba lugwalo-
alimwi bakajatana abamwi bantu bakali bakkazikwa mu Samaliya changuzu, antomwe abamwi abo bakali muchilikiti Chamutala a Mulonga.
Obu mbobwindulule bwalugwalo olo lwakatuminwa kuli Atakizasi: ''Tobalanda bako, baalumi bamuchilikiti Chamutala lya Mulonga, balemba obu:

Akube kuti mwaami azizibe kuti bama Juda bakazwa kuli nduwe bakabola kuzotulwisya okuno ku Jelusalema bayanda kuyakulula dolopo ibbi lipapila. Bakamaninsya kuyakulula bulambo alimwi balikuyakulula intalisyo.
Lino mwaami olemekwa nchoyelede kuziba nchakuti kuti naa munzi oyu uyakululwe abwanda bwawo bubambululwe tabachiyopi limbi mutelo, chamba kuti ezi chiyojaya chiyobwedo chabaami.
Lino swebo mukuti nduwe nutulanga tatuyandi kubona kuti muleli wasampawulwa, nchenchicho nchitwakalembela zyamakani aya kuti uzibe kutegwa makani aya alangwe-langwe mumalembe abaami bakakusangunina
mumalembe aya uyojana kuti munzi oyu ngwabantu bazangi. Alimwi nchenchicho chakapa kuti munzi ooyu umwayigwe.
Tulikukuzibya mwaami kuti na munzi oyu wayakululwa bulambo bwabambululwa chamba kuti kunoli takwepe chako muchilikiti Chamutala a Mulonga.''
Aboobo mwaami wakatumina nsandulo kuli Lehumu a Syimusyayi antomwe akubenzinyina bakali mu Samaliya antomwe akulibamwi bakali mukati mu Dolopo Mutala lya Mulonga: ''Lumuno ngalube kulindinywe.
Ilugwalo ndumwakatumina kulindime lwakazopandululwa alimwi lwakabalwa kulindime.
Aboobo ndakabambila kuti balangulisye alimwi bakajana kuti bantu bamuunzi oyu mumazuba akiinda bakali bachita bubi alimwi bapapila baami.
Baami basintaanze mbibakali kwendelezya mu Jelusalema, kabajisi nguzu atala azintu zyoonse zyakali Muchilikiti Chamutala lya Mulonga. Tusangesange amutelo zyakali kuliyigwa ambabo.
Nkinkako lino, bikka malayilile akuti baleke alimwi batayakululi dolopo manedo nkalayilile kuti batalike.
Mulangisisye kabotu mutaleki kuchitobu. Nkambonzi nikutazumizigwe echi chiyoosyo kuti chikomene alimwi cheetelezye kubisizya ziyandwa bami?
Eelyo malayilile a Mwaami Atakizasi  nakabaligwa kunembo lya Lehumu, Syimusyayi, abenzinyina, bakazwa chakufwambana kuya ku Jelusalema alimwi akuyowangila bama Juda kuti baleke kuyaka.
Mpawo mulimu weng'anda ya Leza mu Jelusalema wakimikila manedo mumunyaka wabili wakulela kwa Daliyasi mwaami waku Peziya.
Mpawo Hagayi musinsimi a Zekkaliya musinsimi, walunyungu wa Ido, wakasima muzina lya Leza wa Izilayeli kuba Juda akuli bamu Jelusalemu.
Zelubbabbelu mwana mulombe wa Syeyilutielu a Jeshuwa mulombe wa Jozadaki bakanyampuka kuya kukuyoyakulula ng'anda ya Leza mu Jelusalemu antomwe abasinsimi abo bakabagwasizya.
Mpawo Tatenayi mwendelezi wachisi chili Kusule a Mulonga, Syeta-Bbozenayi, antomwe abenzinyina bakasika akubambila kuti, ''Ngwani wakamuzumizya kuti muyakulule ng'anda  akumaninsizya bulambo?''
Alimwi bakati, ''Mbani mazina abo balumi balikuyaka mayake aya?''
Pele linso lya Leza lyakali abapati pati baba Juda kwakuti basinkondonyina tebakabayimikizya pe. Bakali kulindila lugwalo kuti lutuminwe kumwami alimwi amalayilile kuti akabozegwe alangene azezi.
Echi nchinduluzyo chalugwalo lwa Tatenayi, muzuluzi wa Chisi chili Kusule lya Mulonga, a Syeta-Bbozenayi antomwe abenzinyina mukati ka Chisi Kusule lya Mulonga, olo ndubakatuma kuli Daliyasi mwami.
Bakatuma mulumbe, kabalemba ezi ku Mwami Daliyasi, ''Lumuno loonse lube kulinduwe.

Mwami tuyanda kuti uzibe kuti twakasika kuchisi cha Juda mung'anda ya Leza mupati. Ilokuyakwa amabwe mapati alimwi amasamu abikidwe mubulambo.  Mulimo oyu ulokuchitwa mbuli mbokwelede alimwi ulokwendelela kunembo kabotu mumanza abo.
Twakabuzya kubapati, ''Ngwani wakamupa malayilile akuyakulula ng'anda eyi antomwe abulambo obu?'
Alimwi twakababuzya mazina abo kuchitila kuti iwebo uzibe mazina awumwi awumwi sikubazulwida.

Bakasandula akwamba kuti, 'Swetuli babelesi bayoyo ulingo Leza wama julu anyika, alimwi tulokuyakulila eyi ng'anda eyo yakayakidwe minyaka myingi yakayinda chindi elyo mwami mupati wa Izilayeli naka iyakide akwimana.

Nekubaboobo, muchindi basikale besu nibakapapila Leza wakujulu, wakabaaba mumanza a Nebbugadineza mwami wa Bbabbiloni, ba Chaludiya, abo bakamwayuula eyi ng'anda  alimwi akutola bantu mubuzike ku Bbabbiloni.
Kakuli boobo, mumwaka mutanzi muchindi nakaba mwami wa Bbabbiloni, Sayilosi wakalayilila kuti ng'anda ya Leza iyakululwe.

Mwami Sayilosi alakwe wakabwedezya zibelesyo zyangolida azya nsiliva ku ng'anda ya Leza ezyo Nebbugadineza nzyaketede kuzwa muntempele mu Jelusalemu kuzyeta kuntempele mu Bbabbiloni. Wakaziboozya kuli Syesibbaza, oyo ngwakachitide mwendelezi.
Wakati kuli nguwe, ''Bweza zibelesyo ezi. Koya ukazibike muntempele mu Jelusalemu. Chita kuti ng'anda ya Leza iyakululwe.''
Mpawo oyu Syesibbaza wakasika alimwi wakayala ntalisyo yang'anda ya Leza mu Jelusalemu; alimwiilokuyakwa, pesi tinakumaninina pe.'

Kwalino kuti kachibotelezya mwami, ino kulibiyeni kuti chalangwa langwa mung'anda yansiswa mu Bbabbiloni kubona kuti muleli mupati Sayilosi wakalayilila zyanchobeni kuti ng'anda ya Leza iyakululwe mu Jelusalemu. Eelyo akube kuti mwami atumizye mizezo yakwe kuli ndiswe.
Elyo muleli mupati Daliyasi wakalayilila kuti balangelange lugwalo mumabbuku akali muchiyobwedo mu Bbabbiloni.
Mubusena buyakilidwe bwachisi cha Esibbatana mu Midiya malembe akajanika; obu mbubwakali bulembo;

''Mumwaka wakwe wakutanguna muleli mupati Sayilasi, Sayilasi wakapa malayilile atala ang'anda ya Leza mu Jelusalemu: 'Akube kuti ng'anda iyakululwe mbuli busena bwakupayilila, akube kuti ntalisyo italikwe, abwime bwayo abube tukokola tuli makumi musanualimwi, alimwi busasa bube tukokola makumi musanu alimwi,
amindano itaatu yamabwe mapati alimwi amundando wamasamu mapya, alimwi kube kuti muulo ubbadalwe abeng'anda yamwami.

Lino amuboozye zibelesyo zyangolida azya nsiliva ezyo zyelede mung'anda ya Leza, ezyo Nebbugadineza nzyaketa ku Bbabbiloni kuzwa muntempele ku Jelusalemu alimwi ubatume lubo kuntempele ku Jelusalemu. Ulelede kuyozibika mung'anda ya Leza.'
Lino Tatenayi, mwendelezi mupati wa Chisi chili Kusule lya Mulonga, Syeta-Bbozenayi, antomwe abenzinyina abo bali Muchisi Kusule lya Mulonga, bikka kule!
Siya mubeleko wang'anda ya Leza awulike. Mwendelezi alimwi mu Juda mupati uyoyaka eyi ng'anda ya Leza abusena obiya.

Ndikumulayilila nchimwelede kuchita kubapati baba Juda abo bakayaka ng'anda ya Leza: Mali yakuyasya ng'anda eyi yelede kuzwa muchiyobwedo chabwami aayo aliyiigwa abantu bakuumbo lya Mulonga iyobelesegwa kukuliya aba balumi kuchitila kuti mulimu utiimikili.

Kufumbwa chiyandika - bapule banini, bagutu, nikuba bana bambelele bazipo zyuumpwa kuli Leza wakujulu, mbuto, mwinyo, wayini, naba mafuta mbuli mbokubede kumulawo wabapayizi mu Jelusalemu - upe zintu ezi kulimbabo mazuba woonse kaatakwe kutalukila.
Konochitobu kuchitila kuti bakeete zipo kuli Leza wakujulu alimwi akukomba kuli ndime, mwami, antomwe amwana wangu mulombe.

Ndikumulayilila echo kuti na umwi watyola malayilile, musemo wang'anda welede kusomonwa yakwe alimwi welede kulengelezegwa alinjiyo. Ing'anda yakwe iyelede kutentwa kuti ikabe mulwi wazibi akambo kanzizeezi.

Akube kuti Leza ulazina likombelwa kooko akanyonyoone baami nibaba bantu boonse abo basoleka kuvolozya majwi aya nikuba kunyoonyona ng'anda ya Leza mu Jelusalemu. Imebo lwangu Daliyasi ndime ndalayilila boobu. Mulimu ooyu uuchitwe chamanguzu!''

Mpawo linobu akambo kamalayilile aayo muleli mupati Daliyasi ngakatumizya, Tatenayi, muzuluzi wa Chisi Kusule lya Mulonga, antomwe a Syeta-Bbozenayi antomwe abenzinyina, bakachita zyonse ezyo zyaka layililidwe a Mwami Daliyasi.

Eelyo bapati baba Juda bakayaka alimwi bakazwidilila munsi lyanjiisyo ya Hagayi musinsimi  antomwe a Zekkaliya, walunyungu lwa Ido. Bakamaninsya mayake abo kazyendelana amalayilile a Leza waba Izilayeli alimwi kwinda mumalayilile a Sayilasi, Daliyasi, antomwe a Atakizasi mwami waku Peziya.
Ing'anda yakamaninsigwa mubuzuba bwatatu bwamweezi wa Ada, mumunyaka wamusanu awumwi wabwendelezi bwa Mwami Daliyasi.
Bantu ba Izilayeli, bapayizi, ba Levi, antomwe  abamwi boonse bazike bakakondwa kukulipeda kwang'anda eyi ya Leza chalumwemwe.

Bakapeda mwanda omwe wabasipule, mwanda womwe wabagutu, alimwi myanda yone yabana bambele njibakapeda kung'anda ya Leza. Akkumi lyatupongo tupule atulato twakapedwa mbuli chipo chazibi chaba Izilayeli, omwe kayiminina mukowa wa Izilayeli.
Alimwi bakapa ba payizi aba Levi kuti babeleke muzibeela kumulimo wa Leza mu Jelusalemu, mbuli mbukulembedwe mubbuku lya Mozesi.
Alimwi abo bonse bakali mubuzike bakakondelelwa pobwe lya Pasika mubuzuba bwakkumi aane mubuzuba butanzi bwamwezi mutanzi.
Bapayizi aba Levi boonse bakalisalazya lwabo alimwi bakajaya zipayizyo zya Pasika lyaboonse abo bakali mubuzike, kubikilizya ambabo beni.

Bantu ba Izilayeli abo bakalya antomwe nyama ya  Pasika bakali abo bakali baboola kuzwa mubuzike alimwi bakali balipambula lwabo kuzwa kuzisofweede zyabantu bamunyika alimwi bakayandula Jehova, Leza waba Izilayeli.

Chakukondwa bakasekelela Pobwe lya Zibunge zitakwe bumena kwamazuba musanu zzbili, nkambo Jehova wakali wababozezya lukondo alimwi akubabozezya moyo wamwami wa Asiliya kukusimya maanza abo kumulimo wang'anda yakwe, ing'anda ya Leza waba Izilayeli.
Lino kuzwa mubwami bwa Atakizasi mwami wa Peziya, Ezila wakazwa ku Bbabbiloni. Balunyungu lwa Ezila bakali Selayiya, Azaliya, Hilukkiya,
Syalumu, Zadokku, Ahitubbu,
Amaliya, Azaliya, Melayoti,
Zelahiya, Uzi, Bbukki,
Abbishuwa, Finiyasi, Eliyeza, oyo wakali mwana mulombe wa Aaloni mupayizi.

Ezila wakasika kuzwa ku Bbabbiloni alimwi wakali mulembi uchenjede kumulawu wa Mozesi oyo Yahuwe, Leza wa Izilayeli, ngwakapede. Nkabela mwami wakamupa zyoonse nzyakakumbila nkambo nkamo mbokunga janza lya Jehova lyakali anguwe.

Bamwi balunyungu lwa Izilayeli abapayizi, ba Levi aba sikwimba bamuchikombelo, alimwi abaabo bakali basikubamba milyango, abalabo bakasalilidwe kugwasizya muchikombelo bakinka ku Jelusalemu mumunyaka wamusanu ayibili ya Mwami Atakizasi
Wakasika mu Jelusalemu mumwezi wasanu, nguwakali munyaka wasanu ayibili wa mwami.
Wakasiya Bbabbiloni muzuba taanzi lyamwezi mutanzi. Mwakali muzuba itanzi lyamwezi mutanzi wasanu kasikide mu Jelusalemu, awo janza bbotu lya Leza kalili anguwe.
Ezila wakapeda moyo wakwe kukwiiya mulawu wa Jehova akuuchita akuyisya zyambwa ambeta amalayilile ayo amulawu wa Yahuwe.
Olu ndulwakali lugwalo mwami Atakizasi ndwakapa Ezila mupayizi kali mulembi wamulawu wa Jehova alimwi ambeta nzyakabikkila ba Izilayeli.
''Mwami wabaami Atakizasi, kumupayizi Ezila, kali mulembi wamulawu wa Leza wakujulu:
Ndikulayilila kuti kufumbwa uzwa mu Izilayeli mubwami bwangu kazyendelana abapayizi babo antomwe aba Levi abo bayanda kwinka ku Jelusalemu, bakonzya kwinka ayebo.
Imebo, ndemwami, alimwi abasinkuta bangu bali musanu ababili, ndamutuma moonse kuyobaguntania ba Juda antomwe a Jelusalemu bwendelana amulawu wa Leza, oyo uli mujanza lyanu.
Mulelede kweta nsiliva angolida eyo njimwakapegwa katakwe muulo kuli Leza wa Izilayeli, oyo ulabukkalo buli mu Jelusalemu.
Mupe chakwangunuka zyonse nsiliva angolide njimujana muchilikiti cha Bbabbiloni antomwe azipo zyakwangunuka ezyo bantu abapayizi nzyobakapa kabayandide kung'anda ya Leza mu Jelusalemu.
Aboobo mubelesye mali eyi kukuula basune, bagutu abana bembelele, alimwi azipo zyamayila azyakunywa. Mukazipe achipayililo chili mung'anda ya Leza wenu mu Jelusalemu.
Mubelesye nsiliva angolide itakasyale kufumbwa nchimubona kachili chibotu kuli ndinwe abana bakwenu, kuti mubotezye Leza wenu.
Mubikke zibelesyo nzimwakapegwa chakwangunuka kunembo lyakwe zyakubelesya mung'anda ya Leza mu Jelusalemu.
Kufumbwa  echo nchimuyoyanda chang'anda ya Leza echo chiyandikana, amubweze muulo wacho muchiyobwedo changu.

Imebo, nde Mwami Atakizasi, ndalayilila boonse basikulondola bali mutala mulonga, echo kufumbwa Ezila mupayizi, kali mulembi wamulawu wa Leza wakujulu, nzyakumbila kuli ndinywe uyelede kupegwa chizwide,
kuyosika ku mwanda womwe wamatalenta ansiliva, mwanda womwe wanseke zya wiiti, mwanda wanongo zyawayini, alimwi amwanda womwe wanongo zyamafuta, alimwi amwinyo mwiingi loko.
Kufumbwa chizwa kumalayilile a Leza wakujulu, amuchichite achabusungu kujatikizya ng'anda yakwe. Nkambonzi bukkali butasikili munyika yamwami alimwi abana babo bachaalumi?

Tulokubalayilila kuti tachizumizidwe kubweza zipo na mutelo nikuba umwi wabapayizi, ba Levi, bayimbi, balindizi bamilyango na kubantu bakalayililwa kumbungano yantempele alimwi ababelesi bamung'anda ya Leza.

Ezila, kwindila mubusongo obo Leza mbwakakupede lwako, uyelede kuyosala babetesi abasilutwe benkuta kuti babeteke bonseni bantu ba Muchisi Chakusule lya Mulonga, akuyobelekela boonse abo bakazi mulawu wa Leza wenu.

Akusubula kufumbwa oyo utatobelezyi mukuzuzikizya mulawu wa Leza nikuba mulawu wa mwami, zikonzya kuchitwa akumujaya, nikuba kumutanda, nakutio wabbadalisigwa imbono zyakwe, nakuti wabikwa muntolongo.
Ngatembawulwe Jehova, Leza wabasikale besu, oyo wakabikka zyonse ezi mumoyo wamwami kuti alumbayizye ng'anda ya Jehova mu Jelusalemu,

alimwi wakayungizya chizuminano chakusyomekana kuli ndime kunembo lya mwami, bendelezi bakwe, alimwi abasilutwe bakwe balamanguzu. Ndakasimisigwa ajanza lya Jehova Leza wangu, alimwi ndakabunganisya bazuluzi kuzwa mu Izilayeli kuti binke ambebo.
Aba mbibayiminini babasikale yampuli zyabo, alimwi amulongo wabaabo bakasyala ku Bbabbiloni andime muchindi chabulelo chamwami Atakizasi.
Balunyungu lwa Finiyasi, Gesyomu. Balunyungu lwa Itama, Daniyele. Balunyungu lwa Devidi, Hutisyi.
Balunyungu lwa Syekkaniya, oyo wakali walunyungu lwa Paosyi, Zekkaliya, antomwe anguwe wakali a 150 bachalumi balembedwe mubbuku lyamulongo wamazyalane.
Balunyungu lwa Pahati-Mowabbu, Eliyehonayi mwana mulombe wa Zekkaliya antomwe ambakali abo bakali myanda ibili bachalumi.
Balunyungu lwa Zatu, Bbeni Jahaziyeli ababo mbakali abo bakali myanda iitatu bachalumi.
Balunyungu lwa Adini, Ebbedi mwana mulombe wa Jonatani antomwe ababo mbakali abo bakali lembedwe kabali makumi musanu bachalumi.
Balunyungu lwa Elamu, Jesyayiya mwana mulombe wa Ataliya antomwe ababo mbakali abo balembedwe bakali makumi musanu amakkumi abili bachalumi.
Balunyungu lwa Syepatiya, Zebbadiya mwana mulombe wa Mikkayeli antomwe ababo mbakali abo balembedwe bakali musanu abatatu bachalumi.
Balunyungu lwa Jowabbu, Obbadiya mwana mulombe wa Jehiyelu antomwe ababo mbakali abo balembedwe 218 bachalumi.
Balunyungu lwa Bbani, Syelomiti mwana mulombe wa Josipiya antomwe ababo mbakali abo bakali 160 bachalumi.
Balunyungu lwa Bbebbayi, Zekkaliya mwana mulombe wa Bbebbayi antomwe ababo mbakali ambabo balembedwe bakali makkumi abili alamusanu abatatu bachalumi.
Balunyungu lwa Azigadi, Johanani mwana mulombe wa Hakkatani antomwe ababo mbakali abo balembedwe kabali 110 bachalumi.
Aba bakali balunyungu lwa Adonikkamu bakazida musule. Aya ngakali mazina abo: Elipeleti, Jewuyelu, a Syemayiya antomwe ababo bakasika kabali makumi musanu alimwi bachalumi.
Balunyungu lwa Bbigivayi, Utayi a Zakkuwa antomwe ambakalabo balilembedwe kabali makumi musanu aabili bachalumi.
Ndakabunganisya banakwenda kukalonga ako kaya ku Ahava, alimwi twakakkala ooko mazuba atatu. Nindaka balingula bantu abapayizi, tendakajana mu Levi pe naba omwe.

Elyo ndakatuma bantu kukuyoyita Eliyeza, Aliyelu, Syemayiya, Elunatani, Jalibbu, a Elunatani antomwe a Natani, Zekkaliya, a Mesyulamu - abo bakali bazuluzi - alimwi kuli Joyalibbu a Elunatani - bakali bayiisyi.

Lyakatobela ndakatumina kuli Ayido, muzuluzi mu Kkasipiya. Ndakabambila kuti nzezilinzibayowamba kuli Ayido antomwe anzubo zyakwe, balanda bamuntempele bakali kukkala mu Kkasipiya, nkokuti, kuti batumine kuli ndiswe balanda bang'anda ya Leza.

Elyo bakatutumina swebo ajanza lya Leza bbotu mwalumi mubotu utegwa ngu Syelebbiya, mwalumi musongo. Wakali walunyungu lwa Mahili mwana mulombe wa Levi mwana mulombe wa Izilayeli. Wakaza abana balombe bali kkumi amusanu abatatu antomwe abakkulana bakwe.
Alimwi wakaza a Hasyabbiya. Alimwi kwakali anguwe Jesyayiya, umwi wabalunyungu lwa Melali, antomwe abakkulana bakwe kubikilizya abana babo bachalumi, balumi makkumi abili kukubabikkamwi.
Abo bakasalilidwe kuti babeleke muntempele, abo Devidi abasilutwe bakwe mbakapede kuti babelekele ba Levayiti: 220, umwi awumwi kapedwe ezina lyakwe.
Mpawo ndakambilizya kuti kube kulyiimya chakulya mu Ahava Kkanalu kuti tulibombye kunembo lya Leza, kuti tuyandule inzila iluleme yesu izwa kulinguwe, bacheche besu, antomwe ambono zyesu zyoonse.

Ndakawusa loko kuti ndikumbile kumwami kuti andipe basilumamba nakuti basikutanta mabbiza kuti batukwabilile kuli ba sinkondoma mukati kenzila yesu, mbokunga twakali twamba kumwami, 'Ijanza lya Leza wesu lilajulu aboonse abo bamuyandida bubotu, pesi janza lyakwe pati abukali bwakwe buli kuli bonse abo bamuluba lwakwe.'
Elyo twakalyimya mpawo twakayandula Leza atala azeezi, alimwi twakakomba kuli nguwe.
Zyakatobela ndakasala kkumi ababili bachalumi kuzwa kulibasilutwe bapayizi: Syelebbiya, Hasyabbiya, antomwe akkumi lyakkulana babo.
Ndakabapimina nsiliva, ngolide, azibelesyo antomwe azipo zyamung'anda ya Leza eyo mwami, abasilutwe bakwe abendelezi, antomwe a Izilayeli wonse ngwakapedelede chakwangunuka.
Aboobo ndakapima mujanza lyabo matalenta ansiliva ali myanda alimusanu awumwi amakkumi alimusanu, mwanda umwi wamatalenta ansiliva azibelesyo, mwanda umwi wamatalenta angolida,
makkumi abili azigabba zyangolide amwi abulemu bwampondo zili chuulu, alimwi azibelesyo zyobile zyamukuba ufulidwe zibotu mbuli ngolide.
Mpawo ndakabambila kuti, ''Inywebo mulasalala kuli Jehova, alimwi azilazyo zibelesyo, antomwe ansiliva angolide nzipo ziya kuli Jehova, Leza wabasikale benu.
Amuchenjele alimwi muzibambe kabotu mane mukazipime bulemu kunembo lyabapayizi bapati, ba Levi, alimwi abapati banzubo zya Izilayeli mu Jelusalemu mumaanda amung'anda ya Leza.''
Bapayizi aba Levayiti bakatambula nsiliva, ngolide, alimwi azibelesyo kuchitila kuti bazitole ku Jelusalemu, kung'anda ya Leza wesu.

Twakanyampuka kuzwa ku Ahava Kkanalu muzuba lyakkumi aabili atanguna mumwezi kuya ku Jelusalemu. Janza lya Leza wesu lyakali alindiswe; wakatukwabilila kujanza lyabasinkondoma alimwi ababo bakali kulindila munzila.
Aboobo twakasika ku Jelusalemu alimwi twakakkala nkuko mazuba aatatu.

Lino mubuzuba bwane insiliva, ngolide, alimwi azibelesyo zyakapimwa mung'anda ya Leza wesu, mujanza lya Melemoti mwana wa Uliya mupayizi. Wakali antomwe a Eliyeza mwana mulombe wa Finiyasi, Jozabbadi mwana mulombe wa Jesyuwa, antmwe a Nowadiya mwana mulombe wa Bbnuyi mu Levayiti.
Mwelwe antomwe abulemu bwazyonse bwakapimwa. Bonse bulemu bwakalembwa ansi muchindecho.

Aabo bakaboola kuzwa mubuzike, ibantu bamubuzike, bakapa zipayizyo kuli Leza wa Izilayeli: kkumi abasipule babili kuba Izilayeli, makumi musanu amakumi aane alamusanu abagutu boone, makumi musanu aabili alamusanu abana bambelele bobile, antomwe akkumi atubili tupule twampongo mbuli chipayilo chazibi. Zyonse zyakali zipo zyakutenta kuli Jehova.
Mpawo bakapa malayilile amwami kuli basilutwe ba mwami antomwe akubendelezi mu Zilikiti Kusule lya Mulonga, alimwi bakagwasizya bantu antomwe ang'anda ya Leza.

Elyo ezi zintu nizyakamana, bapati bakalulama kuli ndime alimwi bakati, ''Bantu bamu Izilayeli, bapayizi, alimwi aba Levayiti tabana kwanzana pe lwabo kuzwa kubantu benzinyika alimwi: Kkenayiti, Hititisi, Peliziti, Jebbusayiti, Amonayiti, Mowabbayiti, ba Ijiputi, antomwe aba Amoni.
Nkambo bakali babweza bamwi bana babo basimbi abachilombe alimwi bakabaswanizya abantu basalala bali abantu bamanyika, alimwi abazulwidi abo bakali mbibatanzi kukusyomekana oku.''
Muchindi nindakamvwa ezi, ndakadelula zigogo zyangu alimwi achibaki changu ndanonkola masusu angu mumutwe akuchilezu, ndakakkala ansi, akugamba.
Boonse bakali kuyowa majwi a Leza wa Izilayeli aatala alusyomo lwabazike bakabungana kuli ndime nindakakkede kundichigamba mane kusikila chachipayizyo chamansiku.
Pesi kuchindi chachipayizyo chamansiku ndakabuka kuzwa kubbazu lyamapenzi angu, eelyo nindakamana kudelula zyakuzwata zyangu alimwi akutandabika maanza angu kuli Jehova Leza wangu.
Ndakati, ''Leza wangu, ndaba ansoni kuli nduwe, nkambo milandu yesu yavula kumitwe yesu, alimwi amilandu yesu yakomena kusikila kujulu.

Kuzwa kumazuba abamatata besu, kusikila yino tli mumulandu mupati. Mumilandu yesu njitulayo, baami besu, abapayizi besu twakapegwa mujanza lyabaami besu bamunyika eeyi, akujazigwa ipanga abuzike, alimwi akusalwa akufwa insoni kumenso, mbuli mbotubede sunu obu.

twafwidwa luzyalo kuli Jehova Leza wesu kuti tusyalilwe bamwi baloboka akupegwa izina mubusena bwakwe busalalisya. Ezi zyakali zya Leza wesu kuti amunike menso esu alimwi akutuponia bunini mubuzike bwesu.

Nkambo tuli bazike, pesi Leza wesu tatulubide pe pesi wakayungizya chizuminano chalusyomo kuli ndiswe. Wakachita eechi mumenso amwami wa Peziya kuchitila kuti atupe kusima kupya, aboobo tuyelede kuyakulula ng'anda ya Leza wesu alimwi amatongo ayo. Wachita echi kuchitila kuti atupe bulambo kuti tukkale obotu mu Juda amu Jelusalemu.
Pesi kwalino, Leza wesu, tulaambanzi kuzwa echi? Twaluba milawu yako,

milawu njiwakalayilila balanda bako abasinsimi, wakati, ''Nyika eeyi njimuyobunjila kuti mwivube ilisofwede. Izwide bantu bamunyika azisesemyo zyabo. Bakizuzya busofwazi bwabo kuzwa kumagolelo kusikila kumagolelo ayo.

Aboobo kwalino, mutanochipi bana benu bachisimbi kubana babo balombe; mutakabwezi bana babo bachisimbi mupe bana benu balombe, alimwi mutakayanduli kubeetela luumuno azyoolwe, kuchitila kuti mube amanguzu alimwi mulye zibotu zyanyika, abobo akuvubya bana benu choonse chindi.''

Lino kusule kwazyonse zyakasika kuli ndiswe nkambo kamilimu yesu mibi alimwi amilandu yesu mibi - mbuli nduwe, Leza wesu, mbowakatubwedezya milandu yesu bunini biyo kwinda mbukwelede alimwi akutupa lufutuko -

nsaa nchibotu na kusotoka milawu yako lubo alimwi atuvwelanie mulukwatano abantu aba bachita zisesemyo? Tamukoyotunyemena na alimwi akutatukalalila mane lumwi watujayilila akutatusiila, naba omwe utakaloboke?
Jehova, Leza waba Izilayeli, ulasalala, nkambo twasyaala tulivunidwe kuzuba eli. Langa! Tuliwo kunembo lyako mumilandu yesu, nkambo takwe uunga ulayima kunembo lyako nkambo kayaaya.

Elyo Ezila nakakomba alimwi wakalyamba zibi zyakwe, wakakwila alimwi wakali walila ansi kunembo lyang'anda ya Leza. Imbungano mpati loko ya Izilayeli yabalumi, banakazi, abana bakabungana antomwe, nkambo bantu bakali kukwila kapati loko.

Syekkaniya mwana mulombe wa Jehiyelu walunyungu lwa Elamu wakati kuli Ezila, ''Tetwakasyomekana pe kuli Leza alimwi twakakwata banakazi bazwakule kuzwa kubantu bakuli zimwi inyika. Pesi nikuba kakuli boobu, mpobuchili bulangizi ku Izilayeli.

Aboobo kwaino atube achizuminano cha Leza wesu tutume banakazi boonse abana mbuli malayilile a Leza mbwalayilila alimwi amalayilile ababo bayoowa kumilawu ya Leza wesu, alimwi echi ngachichitwe kazyendelana amulawu.
Amubuke, nkambo echi chintu nchichenu kuti muchendelezye, alimwi tunoli anywebo. Amulisimye alimwi muchichite echi.''
Aboobo Ezila wakabuka, wakasungilizya bapati, bapayizi, ba Levi, aba Izilayeli boonse basyomezya kuchita mbubo munzila eyi, aboobo bonse bakasyomezya.

Mpawo Ezila wakabuka kuzwa kunembo lyang'anda ya Leza alimwi wakayinka kumaanda a Jehohanani mwana mulombe wa Eliyasibbu. Takalya nikuba chinkwa nakunywa manzi, nkambo wakali kuyeeya lusyomo lwababo ibakali mubuzike.
Aboobo bakatumizya ijwi mu Juda amu Jelusalemu kubantu boonse bakazwa mubuzike kuya kukubungana mu Jelusalemu.
Kufumbwa utaleke kusika mumazuba aatatu mbuli mumalayilile akazwa kubaami bapati-boonse buvubi bwakwe uyonyanzigwa, alimwi lwakwe uyogusigwa mumbungano yabantu bakaboola kuzwa mubuzike.

Aboobo balumi bamu Juda aba Mu Bbenjamini bakabungana mu Jelusalemu mumazuba atatu. Wakali mwezi wasanu ayine alimwi amazuba alikkumi aabili amwezi. Boonse bantu bakkala mumugwagwa wang'anda kunembo lyang'anda ya Leza, balakankama nkambo kamakani aya alimwi akambo kamvula.
Ezila mupayizi wakabuka alimwi wakati, ''Inywe lwenu mwabisya. Mwakakkala abanakazi bazwakule mukuyungizya kubisya kwa Izilayeli.
Pesi kwalino mulyambe zibi zyenu kuli Jehova, Leeza waba mawuso, alimwi muchite luyando lwakwe. Mupambuke kuzwa kubantu benyika alimwi akubanakazi benzu.''
Yonse imbungano yakasandula mujwi pati, ''Tulachita mbubonya mbuli mbuwaamba.

Nikubabobo, kuli bantu biingi, alimwi chaba chiindi chakuwa kwamvula. Tatukwepe inguzu kuti twimikile anze, alimwi oyu tensi mulimo wazuba lyomwe kana abili pe, mbukunga twakabisya kapati mubwingi kutwambo otu.

Aboobo banyampule basilutwe besu bimikilila imbungano yoonse. Eelyo boonse bamumyunzi yesu bakwelete beenzu banakazi basike kuchindi chibikidwe babe abapati bamunzi ababetesi bawo mane buleke bukali bwa Leza wesu bwinke kule andiswe.''
Johanani mwana mulombe wa Asahelu antomwe a Jazeyiya mwana mulombe wa Tikkiva wakazikaka ezi, antomwe a Mesyulamu a Syabbetayi mu Levayiti wakaba kumwi ambabo.
Aboobo bantu bakazwa mubuzike bakachita eezi. Ezila mupayizi wakasala balumi, bapati banzubo - boonse balembedwe mazina aabo, alimwi bakanzanisigwa muzuba tanzi lyamwezi wakkumi.
Elyo muzuba tanzi lyamwezi wakutanguna bakamana kulanga balumi abo bakali kukkala abanakazi beenzu.

Akkati kabalunyungu lwaba payizi kwakaliko abo bakali kukkala abanakazi bazwakule. Akati kalunyungu lwa Jeshuwa mwana mulombe wa Jozadaki antomwe abakulana bakwe kwakali Maseyiya, Eliyeza, Jalibbu, a Gedaliya.
Aboobo bakabamba kulekana abanakazi babo. Nkambo mpubakali amulandu, bakapayila imbelele kuzwa mubutanga kuti imane milandu yabo.
Akkati kalunyungu lwa Imma: Hanani a Zebbadiya.
Akkati kalunyungu lwa Halimu: Maseyiya, Elija, Syemayiya, Jehiyelu, a Uziya.
Akkati kalunyungu lwa Pasyuwa: Eliyonayi, Maseyiya, Isyumayelu, Nataniyelu, Jozabbadi, a Elasa.
Akkati kaba Levayiti: Jozabbadi, Syimeyi, Kkelayiya - chamba kuti, Kkelita, Petahiya, Juda, a Eliyeza.
Akkati kabayimbi: Eliyasyibbu. Akkati kabasikulinda mulyango: Syalumu, Telemu, antomwe a Uli.
Akkati kabamwi boonse ba Izilayeli - akati kalunyungu lwa Palosyi: Lamiya, Iziya, Malukkija, Mijamini, Eliyeza, Malukkija, a Bbenayiya.
Akkati kalunyungu lwa Elamu: Mataniya, Zekkaliya, Jehiyelu, Abbidi, Jelemoti, a Elija.
Akkati kalunyungu lwa Zatu: Eliyonelu, Eliyasyibbu, Mataniya, Jelemoti, Zabbadi, antomwe a Aziza.
Akkati kalunyungu lwa Bbebbayi: Jehohanani, Hananiya, Zabbayi, a Atilayi.
Akkati kalunyungu lwa Bbani: Mesyulamu, Malukku, Adaniya, Jasyubbu, a Syiyalu Jelemoti.
Akkati kalunyungu lwa Pahati-Mowabbu: Adina, Kkelalu, Bbenayiya, Maseyiya, Mataniya, Bbezalelu, Bbinuyi, a Manase.
Akkati kalunyungu lwa Halimu: Eliyeza, Isyija, Malukija, Syemayiya, Syimiyoni,
Bbenjamini, Malukku, antomwe a Syemaliya.
Akkati kalunyungu lwa Hasyumu: Matenayi, Matata, Zabbadi, Elifeleti, Jelemayi, Manase, antomwe a Syimeyi.
Akkati kalunyungu lwa Bbani: Madayi, Amulamu, Uwelu,
Bbenayiya, Bbedeyiya, Kkeluhi,
Vaniya, Melemoti, Eliyasyibbu,
Mataniya, Matenayi, a Jaasu.
Akkati kalunyungu lwa Bbinuyi: Syimeyi,
Syelemiya, Natani, Adayiya,
Makkinadebbayi, Syasayi, Syalayi,
Azalelu, Syelemiya, Syemaliya,
Syalumu, Amaliya, a Jozefu.
Akkati kalunyungu lwa Nebbo: Jeyiyelu, Matitiya, Zabbadi, Zebbina, Jadayi, Lowelu, a Bbenayiya.
Aba boonse bakali kwatilide banakazi bazwakule alimwi bakali abana abamwi babo.
Pawulu, mutumwa - uutali mutumwa uzwa kubantu naanka kwiinda mumilimo yabantu, pesi kwiindilila muli Jesu Kkilisito mpawo a Leza Taata, oyo wakamubusya kuzwa kubafu -
mpawo aboonse balombe bali andime, muzibunga zyaku Galantiya:
Luzyalo kulindinywe mpawo aluumuno luzwa kuli Leza taatesu mpawo a Mwami Jesu Kkilisito,
Wakalipeda lwakwe kuzibi zyesu kuchitilakuti atwaangunune kuzwa kububi bwalino, kwiinda mukuyanda kwa Leza wesu mpwao a Taata,
Kulinguwe akube bulemu kwalyoonse alyoonse.
Ndagamba kuti mulikubweeda achakufwambana kuzwa kulinguwe wakamwiita muluzyalo lwa Kkilisito. Ndagamba kuti wasandukila kumakani asiyene,
teensi kuti kulaambi makani, Pesi kulibamwi bantu bayanda kumuchitila mapenzi a Kkilisito
Pesi nikubakuti swe naa mungelo uuzwa kujulu walikukambawuka kulinduwe makani aatali mbuli aya ngitwakali kukambawuka kulindinywe, ngabe mutuke.
Mbuli mbutwamba kumatalikilo, mpawo lino ndaamba lubo,''naa umwi wakambawuka kulindinywe makani aatali mbuli ngimwakatambula, ayo ngabe mutuke.''
Sa lino ndikulanguula buuya bwamuntu nanka bwa Leza? Saa ndikulangula kuboteezya muntuma? kuti nkecheezya kubotezya muntu, nsichili mulanda waKkilisito.
Mbuli  mbiyanda kuti muzibe, nobakwesu, kuti makani ngindakambawuka teensi aamuntu.
Teensi ndakatambula kuzwa kumuntu naba oomwe naanka kuyiisigwa. Nikuba boobo, kwakalikwinda muchiyubunuzyo cha Jesu Kkilisito kulindime.
Mwakamvwa ataata akupona kwangu mutunsiyansiya twaba Juda, mbuli mbundakapenzya mbungano zya Leza kuzwa mubwelede mpawo ndalikwezya kuzimwaya.
Ndakakkomena muchanza chamuJuda bwindilide kubiingi oboo bakali beselalyangu, kuzwa kubantu bangu. Obu mbubo bwindilide bwechiyandisyo nchindakali aacho kuchaanza chabamataata.
Pesi elyo nakandibikka kumbali kuzwa muda lyabaama, mpawo ooyo wakandiita kwiinda muluzyalo lwakwe,
wakabotelwa akutondezya mwanakwe mulindime, kuchitila kuti ndikakkambawuke akati kabamaasi, Teenda kabukakubuzya aamubili abulowa.
Teensi ndakayinka ku Jelusalema kuli baabo bakali batumwa kunembo lyangu. Kwinda kuchita oobu, ndakayinka ku Alabbiya mpawo ndaboola ku Damasikkasi.
Alimwi nikwakiinda minyaka yotaatwe ndakayinka ku Jelusalema kuti nkazibe Sifasi mpawo ndakakukkala anguwe mazuba aalikkumi amusanu.
Pesi takwe mutumwa ngwindakabona kunze kwa Jemusi, mwanike wa Mwami.
Kulizezi nzindalemba kulindinywe, ndasyomezya kunembo lya Leza kuti nsilikubeja pe.
Mpawo ndakayinka kuchisi cha Siliya aku Silisiya.
Teensi ndakalizibidwe kumenso akumambungano aku Judaya ali muli Kkilisito.
Bakazimvwa biyo kazilikwambwa, ''mwalumi wakali kutupenzya lino ngulikukambawuka makkani mabotu aa lusyomo ndwakali kwezya kumwaya.''
Mpawo bakalemeka Leza nkambo kangu.
Nikwakinda myaka kkumi ayiine ndakabweda ku Jelusalema a Bbanabbasi, ndakabweza Tito alakwe.
Ndakinka nkambo kachiyubunuzyo akubapandulwida makani ngindakali kukambawuka akati kabamaasi. Ndakambula kunsiswa abalemekeka, kuti ndibe akanzambwenene kuti kuchijana -  teendakachijana- chabuyo.
Asi nekuba kuti Tito wakali andime awakali mu Giliki,bakasungilizya kupalulwa.
Bakwesu babeji bakaza munsiswa kuzolingula lwangunuko ndutulalo muli Kkilisito Jesu. Bakali kuyanda kutuchita bazike.
Pesi tetwaka zumina kulibombya kulimbabo muchiindi chinini, kuchitila kuti simpe lyamakani mabotu likkalilile mulindinywe.
Asikulabo balikulangila kulemekwa ( kufumbwa mbubakabede takwe nichamba chintu kulindime, Leza talangilili chiimo) -abo, ndati, abo bakalikulangika nkabalemekeka tabayungizizye chintu kulindime.
Musiyano, bakazobona kuti ndakapegwa makani mabotu kulabo batapalwidwe, mbokunga Pita wakapegwa makani mabotu kulaabo bapalwidwe.
Nkambo Leza, wakabeleka kuli Pita kubutumwa kulibabo bapalwidwe, wakabeleka kulindime kulibamaasi.
Awo Jemusi, Kkefasi a Joni,abo bakali minsemu,bakabona luzyalo ndundakapegwa,bakamuzuminina Bbanabbasi ambebo. Bakatuzuminina kuti twiinke kuli bamaasi ambabo bayekulabo bapallwidwe.
Bakakumbila kutituyeeye bachete, nchintu nchindakalibambilide kuchita.
Asi Kafasi nakasika ku Antiyoki, ndakamukazya kumeso akwe nkambo wakalijana kalamulandu.
Nkabatanasika balumi bakazwide kuli Jemusi, Kkefasi wakali abamaasi. Pesi nibakasika balumi , wakaleka wakalisosolosya kulibamaasi. Wakayoowa abobakali kuyandisisya bupalule.
Abobo boonse bamaJuda bakanjilana awe mukuwupawupa. Nikuba Bbanabbasi wakapambuka abo mukuwupawupa kwabo.

Pesi nindakababona kuti kuchita kwabo takuli kwakutobela simpe lyamakani mabotu pe, Ndakati kuli Kkefasi kunembo lyabo boonse, ''Kuti nkoli mu Juda nkoli kupona mbuli muJuda, ulalangila biyeni bamaasi kuti bapone mbuli bama Juda ?''
Iswetubeni tuli maJuda mukuzyalwa pepe bamaasi basizibi,

Eno tulizi kuti takwe muntu ululamikwa amilimu yamulawu pesi kulusyomo muli Kkilisito Jesu.Iswe twakasyoma muli Kkilisito Jesu ikuti tululamikwe a lusyomo muli Kkilisito kutali kwamilimo yamulawu.Kumilimo yamulawu takwe nyama iyolulamikwa.
Pesikuti twayanda kululamikwa muli Kkilisito, iswebo tuyojanwa nkatuli basizibi, lino Kkilisito mubelesi wabasizibi ?
Kuti nkelikuyakulula zintu nzindaka mwayide, ndili tondezya kuti ndichili sikutyola mulawu.
Kambo kwinda kumulawo ndakafwa kumulawo, kuti ndiponene Leza

Ndakabambulwa antomwe a Kkilisito,Takucheensi ndime upona,asikuti Kkilisito ngupona mulindime. Ibuumi lino mbwendipona munyama ndapona mulusyomo mumwana a Leza, Oyo wakandiyanda wakapelida kambo kangu.
Nsibikide kumbali luzyalo lwa Leza, ikuti bululami bwalikujanwa kwinda mumuulo,unoli Kkilisito wakafwida chabuyo !
Nibana Galatiya nobafubafuba! Ngwani wakamulowa? Kunembo lyamenso enu Jesu Kkilisitu wakatondeezegwa mbuli mbakabambuulwa.
Echi nchicho chintu chimwi nchindiyanda kwiiya kuzwa kulindinywe: Mwakatambula Muya na kuzwa kumilimu yamulawu na kuzwa kukusyoma nzimwakamvwa?
Mulibafubafuba oobu? Kamunoli mwatanguna aMuya, muyomaninsya munyama na?
Mwakafwaba na muzintu zyiingi chabuyo - na mwakachita chabuyo?
Ooyo uupa Muya kulindinywe akuchita maleele akati kenu ulazichita kwiinda mumulawu na kana mukumvwa chalusyomo?
Mbuli Abbulahamu ''mbakasyoma Leza alimwi zyakayesyanisigwa mbuli musalali kulinguwe,''
munzila njiyo eyi, mumvwisisisye, lino, kuti mbalusyomo aabo biitwa kuti mbana baAbbulahamu.
Malembe mbuli mbaalangililidwe kuti Leza uyolulamika baMasi alusyomo, wakakambawuka kale makani mabotu kuli Abbulahamu, kati, ''Mulinduwe masi woonse ayolongezegwa.''
Nkinkaako, aabo balusyomo balalongezegwa aantomwe aAbbulahamu, muntu walusyomo.
Aabo boonse baponena kumilimu yamulawu balitukidwe; alubo kuli lembedwe, ''Ulitukidwe ooyo woonse uutatobelezyi zyoonse zilembedwe mubbuku lyamulawu, akuzichita.''
Lino zili aantanganana kuti takukwe muntu uululamikwa kunembo lyaLeza amulawu, nkambo baluleme bayoopona chalusyomo.
Pele mulawu teensi walusyomo, pesi, ''Muntu uuchita milimu yamulawu weelede kuponena njiyo.''
Kkilisito wakatuunununa kuzwa kulutuko lwamulawu mukuba lutuko lwesu - nkambo kulilembedwe, ''Ulitukidwe woonse uulengelela mumusamu'' -
kuti chilongezyo chaAbbulahamu kusikile baMasi muliKkilisito Jesu, kuchitila kuti alusyomo tukonzye kutambula chisyomezyo chaMuya.
Bakwesu, muleke ndaambe mubuntu. Muchizuminano chabambwa abantu, tawope muntu unga ulachibika kumbali na kuyungizizya kulinchicho, na chayimikwa amulawo.
Lino zisyomezyo zyakaambwa kuli Abbulahamu akulunyungu lwakwe. Tachaambi kuti, ''ku lunyungu'' kwaamba biingi, pesi kuliwumwi biyo, ''alimwi kulunyungu lwakwe,'' kali Kkilisito.
Lino nchewamba ncheechi: Mulawu, wakasika kakuli kwiinda myaaka ili myanda iine ili a makkumi aatatu, tiibiki kunze pe chizuminano chakabambwa aLeza.
Nkaambo na lukono kaluza akambo kamulawu, nkokuti taluchizi achisyomezyo. Pele Leza wakachipa Abbulahamu chalusyomo.

Ninzi mpo, ugwasya nyamayi mulawu? Wakayungizigwa akambo kazibi, kusikila lunyungu lwaAbbulahamu lwasika kuliwooyo wakapegwa chisyomezyo. Mulawu wakabikwa mukubeleka kwiinda mubangelo mumanza aasimwaama aakati.
Lino simwima aakati zyaamba zyiinda muntu womwe, pele Leza ngumwi.
Akaako mulawu ulakazyanya na azisyomezyo zyaLeza? Chanchobeni pe! Na mulawu wakali wapegwa  kuti upe bumi, akaako bululami chanchoonzyo ninga bwakasika a mulawu.
Pele malembe akabika zyoonse zyachibi muntolongo. Leza wakazichita ezi kuti chisyomezyo chakutufutula muli Jesu Kkilisito chikakonzye kupegwa kulibaabo basyoma.
Lino kalutanasika lusyomo, twakalijiswi mubwange bwamulawu, katwaangidwe kusikila lusyomo lyayubununwa.
Aboobo mulawu wakatubeda mwiiminini kusikila Kkilisito wasika, kuchitila kuti tukonzye kululamikwa mulusyomo.
Pele lino mukuti lusyomo lyakasika, tatuchili mumaboko a mwiiminini.
Nkaambo nywebo moonse muli bana baLeza kwiinda mulusyomo muli Kkilisito Jesu.
Nkaambo mbuli biingi benu mbubakabbabbatisigwa muli Kkilisito, mwakatambula Kkilisito.
Takukwe muJuda na muGiliki, takukwe muzike na waangunukide, takukwe  mwalumi na mwanakazi, nkaambo mulibamwi muli Kkilisito Jesu.
Alimwi na kamuli baKkilisito, zyaamba kuti muli lunyungu lwa Abbulahamu, abasikukona mbuli muchisyomezyo.
Ndaamba aya kuli sikulyalukono, kuciindi nowakacilimwana, takwe kusiyana amuzike, asikoli mwanibusena boonse.
Pele kali munsi abuzuluzi abwendelezi kusikila kuciindi cakabikwa a wisi.
Mbubonya nitwakachili bana, twakali mubuzike kumalengelo, akumulawu wayeyi nyika.
Asi ciindi nichakasika, Leza wakatuma mwana wakwe, wakazyalwa kumwanakazi, wazyalwa aansi amulawu.
Wakachita oobo kukunununa aabo balikuunsi amulawu, kuti tukatambulwe mbuli bana.
Nkambo kakuti muli bana, Leza wakatuma mumyoyo yesu muuya wamwana wakwe, ngutwiita kuti, ''Abba, Taata.''
Aboobo tochili  muzike, asi mwana, alimwi mbuli mboli mwana,waba sikulyalukono lwa Leza.
Asi kuciindi echo, nchiwakatalina kuziba Leza, wakali mubuzike bwayooyo, utajisi bu Leza bwinibwini.
Pesi bwalino mwakaziba Leza, nkambonzi mwabweda kuzichito zitete zitagwasyi zyamalengelo amulawu? Muchiyanda kuba mubuzike lubo na?
Mulalangisisya mazuba amyeezi mipya azyiindi aminyaka !
Ndamuyowela kuti amwi milimo yangu njindaka mubelekela yaba yabuyo.
Ndamukumbila, bakwesu, amube mbulindime, nkambo ambebo ndaba mbuli ndinywe. Takwe nimwa ndibisizya.
Aboobo mulizi kuti kambo kabulwazi bwanyama nkindakamukambawukila ijwi chiindi chitaanzi.
Nekuba kuti nyama yangu yamunjizya mumisunko, takwe nimwa ndiwabasya na kundikaka. Pele mwakanditambula mbali angelo wa Leza.
Lulikuli lulongezyo lwanu?Mbuli mbundi lungulula kulindinywe kuti, ansinga zyalikukonzeeka, kamunonkoola meso anu kamwapa ndime.
Nekubobo inga ndaba sinkondonyokwe nkabo kakumwambila kasimpe?
Balisungwete kuyanda kukona, Asi katakwe mpindu mbotu,. Bayanda kumumuuzya akuti musungwalile mbabo.
Nchibotu lyoonse kusungwalila bubotu bulampindu, kutaamba neli anywe kupelape.
Na twana twangu, lubo ndabamumachise akutumbuka ado Kkilisito abumbwe mulindinywe.
Ndilombozya kuba akati kanu lino akuchincha mambwido angu, nkamo mwandigambya.
Amundambile inywe nimuyanda kuba aansi amulawo, temwakumvwa mulawu?
Nkambo kulilembedwe kuti Abbulahamu kajisi bana balombe bobile, omwe kali mwana wamusimbi muzike awomwe kali mwana wamwanakazi uwakangunukide.
Omwe wakazyalwa kumusimbi muzike nkambo kanyama, asi umwi wakazyalwa kumwanakazi uwakangunukide kwinda muchisyomezyo.
Ezi zilapandulula kaaano kachiindi kuti banakazi aba bobile bayiminina zizuminano zyobile. Omwe wabo wakali kuzwa kuchilundu cha Sinayi abobo wakazyala bana mubuzike. Oyu ngu Hagayi.
Lino Hagayi uyiminina chilundu cha Sinayi mu Alabbiya; aboobo uyiminina bubebwa Jelusalema,  nkali mubuzike abana bakwe.
Pele Jelusalemu uulikujulu ulangunukide, nkambo ngonguwe baama.

Nkambo kulilembedwe kuti, ''Amusekelele, nywebo nongoomwa nimuyazyali; kkwila akutambwiizya kwalukondo, wenotali koomba amachise abutumbu; nkambo bana bayooyo utakwetwe mbiingi kwinda bamwanakazi ula mulumi.''
Asi nywebo, bakwesu, mbuli Izaka, mulibana bachisyomezyo.
Kuchiindi echo ooyo wakazyalwa kunyama wakapenzyaoyo wakazyalwa kumuuya. Mbukubede alino.
Pele malembe atyeni? ''Taanda musimbi muzike amwana wakwe. Nkambo mwana wamusimbi muzike takonzyi kwabana lukono amwana wamwanakazi walwangunuko,''
Aboobo, bakwesu, tatuli bana bamusimbi muzike pe, tulibana bamwanakazi walwangunuko.
Mulwaangunuko Kkilisito wakatwaangununa. Amwiime nji, alimwi, mutakabikwi limbi mubweendelezi bwa moyo wabuzike.
Amubone, me, ndePawulo, ndamwaambila kuti na muntu wazuminina kuti apalulwe, Kkilisito takwe mbayomupa mpindu nikuba kutyeni.
Ndipa bukamboni lubo kumwaalumi woonse uuzuminina kupalulwa kuti unoli weeela kutobelezya mulawu woonse.
Wagwisigwa kuli Kkilisito, iwebo notazosalazigwe a mulawu; tokojana limbi luzyalo.
Nkaambo kwiinda muMuya, chalusyomo, tulalindila chalusinizyo bulangilizi bwabululami.
Muli Kkilisito Jesu uupalwide naba utapalwide takwe nchaamba pe, pesi biyo lusyomo lubeleka muluyando.
Mwakali kweenda kabotu. Ngwani wakamukachizya kutobela kasimpe?
Olu lweeno taluzwi kuli wooyo wakamwiita!
Busweezyo buche bulaluzya nongo yoonse.
Ndili abusichichaamba muMwami kuti tamukoyoyeeya zimbi zisiyene. Ooyo uli kumupenzya uyoofwaba mulubeta, nikuba kuti ngwani.
Bakwesu, na kandichaambula aazyabupalulwe, nkaambonzi nenchiyobupenzegwa?Mukuba oobo chilebyo chachiingano chagwisigwa.
Kuli kulibaabo balikumupenzya, ndipeekezya kuti balizibe lwabo!
Nkaambo mwakayitwa kulwaangunuko, bakwesu. Pele mutabelesyi lwaangunuko lwenu mbuli mweenya wazyanyama; anikuti kwiinda muluyando amugwasyanye awumwi awumwi.
Nkaambo mulawu woonse ulizuzikizigilwe mumulawo womwe; mukuti ''Weelde kuyanda simayakilanwi wako mbuli mbuliyanda webo nomwini.''
Pele na mwalumana akulyana, amuchenjele kuti mutakamanani.
Pele ndati, amweenda chaMuya alimwi tamukoyozuzikizya ziyandisyo zyenyama.
Nkaambo ziyandisyo zyenyama zilalwana aMuya, alimwi ziyandisyo zyaMuya zilalwana anyama. Nkaambo ezi zilalwana chimwi achimwi, kuti mutachiti chintu nchimuyanda.
Pele na mwazulwidwa aMuya tamuli munsi lyamulawu pe.
Lino milimu yenyama ilalitondezya: busofwazi muli zyamalalani, busofwazi, inkosya,
kukomba mituni, busondi, kanyetunyetu, inkondo, ibbivwe, kufwambana kubijilwa, inkazi, inkazyanyo, kwaanzana,
kubijilwa, bukolwi, mapobwe akukolwa, azimwi ziliboobu. Ndamuchenjezya, mbuli mbundakamuchenjezezye kale lutanzi, kuti aabo bachita zintu ezi tabakoyookonzya  kunjila mubwami bwaLeza.
Pele michelo yaMuya nduyando, lukondo, lumuno, bulindizi, buuya, bubotu, lusyomo,
bubombe, alimwi akulijata; aatala azezi zintu tuuwo pe mulawu.
Aabo bali muli Kkilisito Jesu bakagankamina nyama aantomwe ampeekezyo alimwi aziyandisyo zyayo.
Na katupona mu Muya, ngatweende muMuya.
Tatunolifunkayizyi, kunyesesyanya, akweemuzyanya.
Nobakwesu, naumwi wenu wajanika ulimukubisya, inywe nimuli amuuya mwelede kumuboozya amuuya muboombe. Amulikatazye lwenu nubeeni, ikuti inywebo mutasunkwi.
Mubwezelane mukuli, mpawo muzuzikizye mulawu waKkilisito.
Na umwi uyeeya kuti ulimbwabede wekatakwe mbwabede pe, ulikuyeeya lwakwe mwini.
Awumwi alingule mulimo wakwe, mpawo kulikankayizya kwakwe kunoli mulinguwe kakutali kulumwi pe.
Kambo umwi awumwi uyonyampula mukuli wakwe.
Ooyo uyiisigwa ijwi welede kwabilaana zintu zibotu awoyo uyiisya.
Muteeenwi pe. Leza tasekwi, kufumbwa muntu nchabyala, nchenchiicho nchayotebula.
Nkambo oyo ubyala imbuto munyama yakwe, kuzwa kunyama uyotebula lunyonyko. Kuli ooyo ubyala imbuto kumuuya kuzwa kumuuya uyotebula buumi ibutamani.
Tutakatali mukuchita kabotu, nkambo kuchindi cheelede tuyotebula, kuti tetwakalengwana.
Alimwi, nituchili amweenya, ngatuchitile bantu boonse bubotu, kwindilila abo bang'anda yalusyomo.
Mulange kukomena kwamagwalo ngimulembela amaboko aangu.
Abo bayanda kubotesya izyanyama balikweezya kumwangila ikuti mupalulwe. Balikuchita obo biyo kuti batapenzegwi nkambo kachiingano chaKkilisito.
Nikuba kulaabo bakalipalula takwe nibakabamba mulawu, Pesi bayanda kuti mupalulwe ikuti bakali kankayizye nkambo kamibili yanu.
Pesi nsyelede kulikankayizya pe kunze kwakulikankayizizya chiingano cha Mwami wesu Jesu Kkilisito, mukwiinda mulinchicho inyika yakakankaminwa alindime, andime kunyika.
Nikuba kupalulwa na kutapalulwa takwambi chintu pe, pesi chibaligwa biyo mbulenge bupya.
Kuli boonse benda munzila eeyi, lumuuno aluzyalo alube alimbabo nikuba kulabo bana ba Izilayili wa Leza.
Kuzwa lino kutabi uchindikazya pe, nkambo amubili wangu ndibwezede impa zya Jesu.
Luzyalo lwaMwami Jesu Kkilisito alube amyuuya yanu, nobakwesu, Amen.
Kumatalikilo, Leza wakalenga majulu anyika.
Inyika teyakalikwe chiimo akubula chintu. Mudima wakali atala maanzi malamfu. Muuya wa Leza wakali kweenda ataala amanzi.
Leza wakati, ''Akube mumuni,'' alimwi mumuni wakaba.
Leza wakubona mumuni, kuti mubotu. Wakanzania mumuni kuzwa mumudima.
Leza wakawuzika mumuni ''sikati,'' alimwi mudima wakuyita ''mansiku'' ''Awo kwakaba goko achifumo, izuba lyakutanguna.
Leza wakati, ''Akube mulengalenga akati kamanzi, alimwi uwanzanie manzi kuzwa kumanzi.
Leza wakalenga mulengalenga akwanzania manzi akali munsi amulengalenga wamaanzi akali ajulu amulengalenga. Kwakaba mbubo.
Leza wakayita mulengalenga ''Ijulu'' kwakaba igoko akuseni izuba lyabili.
Leza wakati, ''Akube kuti manzi alimunsi amulengalenga ayoboloke aamwi kubusena bomwe, akuti ntundubwi iboneke.'' Kwakaba mbubo.
Leza wakawuzika intundubwi kuti ''Inyika,'' alimwi maanzi akayobolokede amwi wakawuzika kuti ''ndwizi.'' wakabona kuti nchibotu.
Leza wakati, ''Inyika isyusye mweemvwe: azisyu zizyala mbuto, amisamu ilambuto ilimumichelo, umwi awumwi mbuli mumusyobo wawo.'' Kwakaba mbubo.
Inyika yakazyala mweemvwe, michelo yakazyala imbuto yayo ayimwi mbuli mumisyobo yayo, aalimwi minsamu yakazyala michelo ilambuto ilimulinguwo, kwinda mumusyobo wayo.
Kwakaba goko achifumo, izuba lyatatu.
Leza wakati, ''Akube mimuuni kwanzania isikati kuzwa kumansiku aalimwi azibe mbuli zitondezyo, zyazyiindi, zyamazuba amyaka.
Azibe mumuuni kumulengalenga kuti zipe mumuuni anyika.'' Kwakaba mbubo.
Leza wakachita mimuuni mipati ibili, mumuuni mupati wakwendelezya buzuba, amumuni munini wakweendelezya mansiku. Wakalenga inyenyeezi alimwi.
Leza wakazibika mumulengalenga kuti zipe mumuni aanyika,
Kuti zyeendelezye buzuba aamansiku, akwanzania mumuuni kuzwa kumudima. Leza wakabona kuti nchibotu.
Awo kwakaba igoko achifumo, izuba lyane.
Leza wakati, ''Maanzi azuzigwe amwelwe mupati wazilenge, alimwi abayuni bawuluke atala anyika mumulengalenga wajulu.''

Leza wakalenga zilenge zipati, alimwi, mbuli zilenge zipati, zipona kuzwa kumisyobo yazyo, zilenge ezyo zyeenda azezyo zizwide mumaanzi busena boonse, aboonse bayuni balamababa kwinda mumisyobo yabo. Leza wakabona kuti nzibotu.
Leza wakabalongezya, kaamba kuti, ''Muzyalisye akuvula, akuzula mumaanzi amulwizi. Bayuni abavule anyika.
Kwakaba goko akuseni, izuba lyamusanu.
Leza wakati, ''Nyika izyale zilenge zipona, achiimo mbuli musyobo wacho, zivubwa, zintu ziyavula abanyima banyika, achimwi mbuli musyobo wacho.'' Kwakaba mbubo.
Leza wakalenga zinyama zyamunyika kwinda mumisyobo wazyo, zivuubwa mbuli mumisyobo wazyo azyonse ziyavula aanyika kwinda mumusyobo wazyo. Wakabona kuti nchibotu.

Leza wakati, ''Atupange muntu muchikozya chesu, mbuli mubube bwesu. Aababe abwendelezi aatala abaswi bamulwizi, aatala abayuni bakujulu, aatala zivubwa, aatala anyika yoonse aatala alizyonse zinyama ziyavula anyika.''
Leza wakalenga muntu muchinkozya chakwe. Muchikozyanio chakwe wakamulenga. Baalumi abanakazi wakabalenga.

Leza wakabalongezya alimwi wakati kuli mbabo, ''Amuzyalane, akuvula, muzuzye nyika, akwiibombya. Mube abweendelezi aatala lyabaswi bamulwizi, aatala lyabayuni bakujulu, alimwi aatala azintu zyoonse zyeenda aatala anyika.
Leza wakati, ''Amubone, ndamupa zyoonse zizyala imbuto eeyo ili aatala anyika yoonse, ayonse minsamu ilamuchelo ooyo ulembuto mukati kayo. Ziyoba zilyo kulindinywe.
Kuli woonse munyama wanyika, kuli boonse bayuni bamajulu alimwi kuli choonse eecho chiyavula anyika, alimwi kuli choonse chilengwa chiyoya ndapa yoonse minsamu kuti chibe chakulya.'' Kwakaba mbubo.
Leza wakabona zyoonse nzyakachita. Amubone, chakabotesya. Kwakaba goko achifumo, izuba lyamusanu alimwi.
Mpawo majulu anyika zyakamana, alimwi azyoonse zintu zyakazuzizye nzizyo.
Mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili Leza wakasika kumagolelo a mulimu wakwe ngwakachita, alimwi aboobo wakalyookezya mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili kuzwa kumulimu wakwe.
Leza wakalongezya izuba lyamusanu aabili akulisalazya, nkambo mulindilyo wakalyokezya kuzwa kumulimu wakwe ngwakachita mukulenga kwakwe.
Eezi nzizyakachitika aatala amajulu alimwi anyika, eelyo nizyakalengwa, mubuzuba oobo Jehova Leza mbwakalenga nyika amajulu.
Takwe mateyo akali aba pe munyika, alimwi kakutakwe musamu pe wakali wamena, nkaambo Jehova Leza takalinaachita mvula kuti iwe aatala anyika, alimwi tekwakali muntu pe sikupanda nyika.
Pesi sikunkwe wakanyampuka kuzwa aansi alimwi wakatiliila nyika yoonse.
Jehova Leza wakabumba muntu kuzwa kulusuko lwenyika, alimwi wakayoyela mumpemo zyakwe muuya wabuumi, alimwi muntu wakaba chintu chipona.
Jehova Leza wakabyala chilili kubuzwezuba, mu Edeni, alimwi oko wakabika muntu ngwakapanga.

Kuzwa kunyika Jehova Leza wakachita misamu yoonse kuti ikomene eyo iyeebeka kumenso alimwi kili mibotu kukulya. Eezi zyakali kubikilizya musamu wabuumi wakali aakati kachilili, alimwi musamu waluzibo lwabubotu a bubi.
Mulonga wakali kuzwa ku Edeni kutilila chilili. Kuzwa waawo wakaanzana akuba milonga yone.
Izina lyawakutanguna ngu Pisyoni. Nguwo ukunkila munyika yoonse ya  Havila, oko kuli ngolida.
Ingolida yayeyo inyika nimbotu. Alimwi kwakaliko mundalila alimwi abbwe lya onikisi.
Izina lyamulonga wabili ngu Gihoni. Ooyu ukunkila kunyika yoonse ya Kkusyi.
Izina lyamulonga watatu ngu Tigilisi, alimwi ukunkila kubuzwezuba bwa Asiha. Mulonga wane ngu Yufuletisi.
Jehova  Leza wakabweza muntu akumubika muchilili cha Edeni kuti achibeleke alimwi akuchibamba.
Jehova Leza wakalayilila muntu, kati, ''Kuzwa kumisamu yoonse ilimuchilili ulaangunukide kukwiilya.
Pesi kuzwa kumusamu waluzibo lwabubotu alimwi a bubi utakalyi, nkaambo mubuzuba notakalye kuzwa kulinguwo, nchobeni uyoofwa.''
Mpawo Jehova Leza wakati, ''Tachili chibotu pe kuti  muntu abe alike. Ndiyomupangila mugwasyi umweelede.''

Kuzwa kunyika Jehova Leza wakalenga banyama boonse bamumuunda abayuni boonse bamumulengalenga. Mpawo wakabeeta kumuntu kuti abone akubawuzika mazina. Kufumbwa muntu mbakawuzika chimwi chilengwa, ndilyakaba izina lyacho.
Muntu wakawuzika mazina kuzivubwa zyoonse, kubayuni boonse, alimwi kuli woonse munyama wamumuunda. Pesi kumuntu lwakwe tekwakajanika mugwasyi umweelede pe.
Jehova Leza wakachita n'onzi mpati ziwide muntu, aboobo muntu wakoona. Jehova Leza wakagwisya kamwi katumpango alimwi wakajala nyama aawo mpakagwisya kampango.
Akampango ako Jehova Leza nkakagwisya kuzwa kumuntu, wakalenga mwanakazi akumweta kumuntu.
Muntu wakamba kuti, ''Echino chiindi, ooyu ndifuwa lyamafuwa aangu, anyama yenyama yangu. Uyoyitwa ''mukayintu,' nkambo wakagwisigwa kuzwa kumuntu.''
Nkenkako mwalumi uyosiya wisi abanyina, uyojatana amukayintu wakwe, alimwi bayoba nyama yomwe.
Boonse bakalimaya, mwaalumi a mwanakazi wakwe, pesi tibakali abweeme pe.
Lino inzoka yakalijisi maanu kwinda bamwi  boonse banyama bamumuunda oyo Jehova Leza ngwakalenga. Wakati kumwanakazi, ''Mbaakamba na nchoonzyo Leza, 'Tamwelede kulya kuzwa kumunsamu wamuchilili'?''
Mwanakazi wakati kunzoka, ''Ngatulalya michelo kuzwa kuminsamu yamuchilili,
pesi aatala amuchelo wamunsamu uli aakati kachilili, Leza wakati, ''Tamwelede kuulya pe, nikuba kuuguma, na kuti uyofwa.'''
Inzoka yakati kumwanakazi, ''Nchobeni tokoyofwa pe.
Nkaambo Leza ulizi kuti mubuzuba mbomuyowulya menso aako ayojulika, alimwi uyooba mbuli Leza, kuziba chibotu achibi.''

Eelyo mwanakazi nakabona kuti munsamu wakali mubotu kuchilyo, alimwi wakali kubotezya kumenso, alimwi munsamu ulayandika kuti umwi abe musongo, wakabweza umwi wamichelo yawo akwiilya.  Mpawo wakapa lubo imwi michelo kumulumi wakwe ngwakali aawe, alimwi wakiilya.
Menso abo boonse kabali babili akajulika, alimwi bakaziba kuti bali maya. Bakasuma matu amukuyu akulichitila zilivumbyo.
Bakamvwa musoso wa Jehova Leza kayobweenda muchilili muchiindi chakubomba kwezuba, elyo mwaalumi a mwanakazi wakwe bakayuba kuzwa kubuliwo bwa Jehova Leza aakati kaminsamu yamuchilili.
Jehova Leza wakayita mwaalumi akwaamba kuti, ''Uli kuli?''
Mwaalumi wakati, ''Ndakumvwa muchilili, alimwi ndayowa, nkaambo ndali maya. Aboobo ndalisisa.''
Leza wakati, ''Ngwani wakwaambila kuti wali maya? Sa walya kuzwa kumunsamu ooyo ngundakakulayilila kuti utakawulyi?''
Mwaalumi wakati, ''Mwanakazi nguwakandipa kuti ndibe anguwe, wandipa muchelo uzwa kumunsamu, alimwi ndawulya.''
Jehova Leza wakati kumwanakazi, ''Ninzi eechi nchuwachita?'' Mwanakazi wakati, ''Inzoka yandeena, alimwi ndawulya.''

Jehova Leza wakati kunzoka, nkaambo kakuti wachita eechi, watukwa webo olike aakati kazivuubwa zyoonse alimwi abanyama boonse bamumuunda. Uyoyenda abula bwako, alimwi mbulongo mboyoolya mumazuba woonse abuumi bwako.
Ndiyobika inkondo aakati kako amwanakazi, alimwi aakati kambuto yako ambuto yakwe. Uyowuma mutwe wako, alimwi uyoluma kasiindi kakwe.''
Ku mwanakazi wakati,
Kuli Adamu wakati,
Iyokuzyalila maamvwa a mitubetube, alimwi uyoolya izisyu zyamumuunda.
Amitukuta yakubusyu uyoolya chibunge, kusikila ukabweede kunyika, nkaambo kuzwa kuli njiiyo nkuwakazwa. Nkaambo uli bulongo, alimwi kubulongo uyobweeda.''
Muntu wakawuzika mwanakazi wakwe izina lyakuti Eva nkaambo wakali banyina bazipona.
Jehova Leza wakachitila Adamu amwanakazi wakwe zisamo zyechikuumbaalimwi wabasamika.
Jehova Leza wakati, ''Lino muntu waba mbuli ndiswe, kuziba chibotu achibi. Aboobo lino tayelede kuzumizigwa kuti asikile aluboko lwakwe, abweze kuzwa kumunsamu wabuumi, awulye, apone kwalyoonse.''
Nkiinkako Jehova Leza wakamutandila aanze kwachilili cha Edeni, kuti apande nyika ooko nkwakabikwa.

Aboobo Leza wakatanda muntu kuzwa muchilili, alimwi wakabika kkelubbimu kubuzwezuba bwachilili cha Edeni, alimwi afulo limweka lyakali kuzyunguluka koonse koonse, kuti likalinde kunzila yamunsamu wabuumi.
Mwalumi wakaziba banakwe Eva bakaminta akuzyala Kkayini. Wakati, ''Ndazyala mwalumi alugwasyo lwa Jehova.''
Mpawo wakazyala mwanikakwe Abbelo. Lino Abbelo wakaba mwembeli, pesi Kkayini wakalima nyika.
Nikwakaba chiindi Kkayini wakayeta imwi michelo yenyika mbuli chipo kuli Jehova.
Pesi Abbelo, wakeeta bamwi babana batanzi babutanga bwakwe amafuta. Jehova wakatambula Abbelo achipo chakwe,
Pesi Kkayini achipo chakwe takwe nakamutambula pe. Awo Kkayini wakanyema loko, wakasyulungana.
Jehova wakati kuli Kkayini, ''Nkambonzi niwanyema alubo nkambonzi niwasyulungana?
Na wachita chitaluleme, chibi chilakuyubilila amulyango akuyanda kukwendelezya, pesi uyelede kuzizunda.''
Kkayini wakambula kuli Abbelo mwanike wakwe. Kwakaba nibakali mumyuunda, Kkayini wakabukila mwanike wakwe akumujaya.
Mpawo Yahuwe wakatikuli Kkayini, ''Ulikuli Abbelo mwanike wako? ''Wakati, ''Nsiizi pe. Ndime na nindibamba mwanike wangu?''
Jehova wakati, ''wachitanzi?
''Lino watukwa webo kuzwa kubulongo, ibwakajula mulomo wabo akutambula bulowa bwamwanike wako kuzwa kujanza lyako.
Wakulima inyika, kuzwa, kuzwa lino ali njiyo tichikakutebwidi nguzu zyayo uyoba sikwempeta akuba simutuntuli anyika.''
Kkayini wakati kuli Jehova, ''Chisubulo changu nchipati kwindilila mpunkonzya.
Nchobeni, wandigwisya buzuba obuno kuzwa kunyika eeyi, alimwi ndiyosiswa kubusyu bwako. Ndooba sikwempeta asimutuntuli munyika, alimwi kufumbwa undijana uyondijaya.''
Jehova wakati kuli nguwe, ''Kufumbwa ujeya Kkayini, uyopegwa mulandu zyiindi zyindulwidwe musanu azibili.'' Mpawo Jehova wakabikka kufumbwa umujana, oyo muntu muntu atamulwanisyi.
Awo Kkayini wakazwa kubusyu bwa Jehova akuyokkala munyika ya Nodi, kubuzwezuba Edeni.
Kkayini wakaziba mukakwe wakaminta. Wakazyala Inokki. Wakayaka chisi wachipa zina ndyakapede mwanakwe Inokki.
Kuli Inokki kwakazyalwa Iladi. Iladi wakaba wisi wa Mehiyayeli. Mehiyayeli wakaba wisi wa Metusela. Metusela wakaba wisi wa Lameki.
Lameki wakalikwatila banakazi bobile. Izina lyawumwi kali Ada, azina lyawumwi kali Zila.
Ada wakazyala Jabbali wakali wisi wababo bakali kukkala mumatente ibakali azivubwa.
Izina lyamukulana wakwe kali Jubbali. Wakaliwisi wababo bakalizya tuntimbwaanyeele.
Pesi Zila, wakazyala Tubala - Kkayini, mufuzi wazibulo zyamukuba azyabutale. Muchizi wa Tubali - Kkayini wakali Naama.
Lameki wakati kubanakazi bakwe, ''Ada a Zila, amuswilizye kujwi lyangu; Inywe nubanakazi ba Lameki, Amuswilizye nzingamba. Nkambo ndakajeya mwalumi wakandichisa, mulombwana wakandichudula.
Na Kkayini wapegwa mulandu zyiindi musanu azibili, lino Lameki uyopegwa mulandu zyiindi zili makumi musanu abili amusanu atubili.''
Adamu wakoona amwanakazi wakwe lubo, elyo wakazyala alimwi mwana mulombe. Wakamupa izina lyakuti Seti mpawo wakati,'' Leza wandipa uumbi mwana muchibaka cha Abbelo, nkambo Kkayini wakamujaya.''
Mwana mulombe wakazyalwa kuli Seti wakamupa izina lyakuti Inoshi. Kuli cheecho chiindi bantu bakatalika kwiita zina lya Jehova.
Ayaa ngimakani amazyalane a Adamu. Mubuzuba Leza nakalenga bantu, wakabachita baba muchikozyanio chakwe.
Wakalenga mwalumi amwanakazi. Wakabalongezya akubapa izina lyakuti mbantu nibakalengwa.
Eelyo Adamu nakapona myaka mwanda  amakkumi ataatu, wakaba wisi wamwana mulombe umukozezye, muchikozyanio chakwe, elyo wakamwita zina lya Seti.
Adamu nkali waba wisi wa Seti. Wakapona myaaka myaanda musanu ayitatu. Wakaba wisi wabana biingi balombe abasimbi.
Adamu wakapona minyaka, (930) myanda musanu ayine amakumi otatwe, mpawo wakafwa.
Eelyo Seti nakapona minyaka mwanda amusanu, wakaba wisi wa Enosi.
Nkali waba wisi wa Enosi, wakapona minyaka myanda musanu ayibili (807) mpawo wakaba wisi wabana balombe abasimbi bingi loko.
Seti wakapona minyaka (912) myanda musanu ayine akkumi ayibili, elyo wakafwa.
Awo Enosi nkali wapona minyaka myanda musanu ayine, wakaba wisi wa Kkenani.
Nkali waba wisi wa Kkenani, Enosi wakapona (815) minyaka myanda musanu ayitatu a kkumi amusanu. Wakaba wisi wabana biingi balombe abasimbi.
Enosi wakapona (905) minyaka myanda musanu ayine amyaka musanu, awo mpawo wakafwa.
Eelyo Kkenani nakapona minyaka iili makkumi musanu aabili, wakaba wisi wa Mahalaleli.
Nkali waba wisi wa Mahalaleli, Kkenani wakapona minyaka myanda musanu ayitatu amakkumi oone (840). Wakaba wisi wabana balombe abasimbi biingi.
Kkenani wakapona (910) minyaka myaanda musanu aine ilekkumi elyo wakafwa.
Elyo Mahalaleli wakali wapona minyaka makkumi musanu alimwi amusanu, wakaba wisi wa Jaledi,
Nkali waba wisi wa Jaledi, Mahalaleli wakapona minyaka myanda musanu ayitatu amakkumi atatu. Wakaba wisi wabambi bana balombe abasimbi.
Mahalaleli wakapona minyaka (895) myanda musanu ayitatu amakkumi musanu ayine aminyaka musanu, elyo wakafwa.
Eelyo Jaledi wakapona minyaka (162) mwanda amakkumi musanu amyaka yobile, Wakaba wisi wa Inokki.
Nkali waba wisi wa Inokki, Jaledi wakapona minyaka myanda musanu ayitatu. Wakaba wisi wabana biingi balombe abasimbi.
Jaledi wakapona minyaka (962) myanda musanu ayine amakkumi musanu alimwi aminyaka yobile mpawo wakafwa.
Eelyo Inokki nkali wapona minyaka makkumi musanu alimwi amyaka musanu, wakaba wisi wa Metusela.
Inokki wakeenda a Leza minyaka myanda yotatwe nkali waba wisi wabana balombe abasimbi biingi.
Inokki wakapona (365) minyaka myanda yotatwe amakkumi musanu alimwi aminyaka musanu.
Inokki wakeenda a Leza, mpawo wakiinka, nkambo Leza wakamubweza.
Eelyo Metusela wakali wapona minyaka mwanda amakkumi musanu atatu aminyaka musanu ayibili, wakaba wisi wa Lameki,
Nkali waba wisi wa Lameki, Metusela wakapona (782) minyaka myanda musanu ayibili amakkumi musanu aatatu aminyaka yobile.Wakaba wisi wabana balombe abasimbi biingi.
Metusela wakapona minyaka (969) myanda musanu ayine amakkumi musanu alimwi aminyaka musanu ayine. Mpawo wakafwa.
Elyo Lameki nkali wapona minyaka mwanda amakkumi musanu aatatu amyaka yobile, wakaba wisi wamwana mulombe.
Wakamuzika izina lya Nowa, nkati, ''Oyu ulatupa kulyokezya kuzwa kumilimu yesu akumilimu ichisa yamanza esu, njitwelede kuchita nkambo kanyika Jehova njaka tuka.''
Lameki akapona myaka myanda musanu ayine amusanu nkali waba wisi wa Nowa. Wakaba wisi wabambi bana balombe abasimbi.
Lameki wakapona minyaka (777) myanda musanu ayibili aminyaka musanu ayibili. Mpawo wakafwa.
Nkali Nowa wapona myaka myanda musanu, wakaba wisi wa Shemu, Hamu, a Jafeti
Zyakachitika awo nibakatalika kuvuzyania anyika alimwi bana basimbi bakazyalwa kuli mbabo,
ikuti bana ba Leza balombe bakabona kuti bana babantu basimbi bakali kwebeka. Bakalijanina bakayintu, kufumbwa ooyo ngubakasala.
Yahuwe wakati, ''Imuuya wangu tawukoyokkalilila mubantu kwalyoonse nkambo mbantu benyama. Bayopona kwamyaka (120) ili mwana amakkumi obile.''

Kwakali bantu mampumbwa munyika mazuba aayo, amazuba atobela alimwi. Eechi chakachitika aawo bana ba Leza balombe nibaka kwatana abana babantu basimbi, akuba bana ambabo. Aaba bakali balumi basinguzu bachiindi, baluumi bempuwo.
Jehova wakabona kuti kubisya kwabantu kwindilila munyika, alimwi kuti bunangatizi bwamizezo yamumyoyo yabo bwakali kwinkilila anembo akubisya.
Jehova wakalibeteka mukuti wakali walenga bantu aanyika, alimwi zyakamuchisa mumoyo wakwe.
Nkenkaako Jehova wakati, ''Ndiyolobya bantu mbindakalenga kuzwa kuntandabale yenyika - ibantu abanyama, ezinyamankata ziyavula abayuni bamujulu, nkambo ndili amawuse akuti ndakabalenga.''
Pesi Nowa wakajana luzyalo kumenso a Jehova.
Ezi nzezintu zyakali kuchitika kazilangena a Nowa. Nowa wakali mwalumi uululeme, alimwi katakwe kampenda mubantu bamazuba akwe. Nowa wakeenda a Leza.
Nowa wakaba wisi wabana balombe botatwe: Shemu, Hamu, a Jafeti.
Inyika yakali abubbinginizi kunembo lya Leza, alimwi yakazwide lupyopyongano.
Leza wakabona nyika; amubone, yakali abusofwazi, nkambo boonse benyama bakali babbinginizya munzila zyabo anyika.
Leza wakati kuli Nowa, ''Ndili bwene kuti chaba chiindi chakulobya akugozya zyonse zipona, nkambo inyika yazula lupyopyongano kwinda muli mbabo. Nchoonzyo, ndiyolobya nyika.
Liyakile bwato bwamusamu wa Sayipulesi. Upange twaanda mubwato, alimwi ubujale ansakizi mukati ampobuli anze.
Mboobu mbotazichite: ibulamfu bwabwaato bweelede kuba myanda yotatwe yamakkiyubbiti; ibusasa bwabo bube makumi musanu bwamakkiyubbiti, alimwi bulamfu bwabo bwato bube makumi otatwe amakkiyubbiti.
Upange kaluli kabwaato, alimwi ukamaninsye kakali akkiyubbiti kuzwa aatala - ansonge yabbazu lyabo. Ubikke ikkoma kubbazu lyabwato alimwi uchite selelelo lyaansi, alyabili, alimwi aselelelo lyatatu.
Swilila, ndamba kweeta izambangulwe lyamanzi enyika, kuti kufwe choonse chenyama chili amuuya wabuumi kuzwa munsi lyakujulu. Choonse ichili anyika chizofwa.
Pesi ndiyotalika chizuminano changu anduwe. Uyonjila mubwato, iwebo, abana bako, abakayintu bako, abamuka bana bako uyoba aabo.
Kuzinyama zyoonse zipona zyamisyobo yonse uyobweza zibili kumisyobo yonse ukazibike mubwato, kuti zikapone anduwe, zyoonse ibeenze abazyazi.

Kubayuni kuzwa kumisyobo yabo boonse, alimwi akubanyama kuzwa kumisyobo yabo, akuli choonse chintu chiyavula aanyika chamusyobo wacho, izibili kumisyobo yoonse ziyoza kuli nduwe kuti ukazilele kazipona.
Libunganisizye yoonse misyobo yachakulya ilyigwa uyilondole, kuchitila kuti chikabe chakulya chako ambabo.''
Alimwi Nowa wakazichita eezyo Leza nzyakamulayilila, alino wakazichita.
Jehova wakati kuli Nowa, ''Kweza iwebo ampuli yako, munjile mubwato, nkambo ndabona kuti muzyalane eeli ulasalala kunembo lyangu.
Kubanyama boonse basalala uyoyeta bali  musanu ababili beenze alimwi musanu ababili bazyazi. Kuzwa kubanyama basofwede, kuli mbabo ukabweze babili, mwenze amuzyazi wakwe.
Alimwi kubayuni bamumulengalenga, ukabweze musanu ababili beenze abazyazi bali musanu ababili, kuti kulondolwe buzyalane bwabo kubuyanza bwanyika yoonse.
Nkaambo mumazuba alimusanu aabili ndiyochita kuti imvula ikawe aanyika kwamazuba aali makumi oone amansiku aali makkumi aane. Ndiyolobya kuzwa abuyale bwenyika choonse chipona nchindakalenga.''
Nowa wakachita zyoonse Jehova nzyakamulayilila.
Nowa wakali amyaka ili myanda musanu awumwi yakuzyalwa awo izambangulwe nilyakeza anyika.
Nowa, bana bakwe balombe, mukayintu wakwe, abamukabana bakwe bakanjila mubwaato boonse akambo kamanzi aazambangulwe.
Ibanyama ibasalala abanyama basofwede, bayuni, azyonse ziyavula aanyika,
zibili zibili, mwenze amuzyazi, zyakeza kuli Nowa akunjila mubwato, mbubonya mbuli Leza mbwakalayilila Nowa.
Zyakachitika kuti musule amazuba musanu aabili imanzi azambangulwe akazula enyiika.

Mumwaka wakuzuzya myaka myanda musanu awumwi yabuumi bwa Nowa, mumwezi wabili, wabuzuba bwakkumi amusanu amazuba obile mumwezi ooyo, muzuba ndilyo elyo, imibanzo yoonse yabunike bupati bwakaanduka bwajulika, alimwi impulunguzyo zyajulu zyakajulika.
Imvula yakatalika alimwi yakawa aanyika kwamazuba makkumi aane amansiku aali makkumi aane.
Mubuzuba mbubobo Nowa abana bakwe balombe, Shemu, Hamu, a Jafeti, amukaintu wa Nowa, abakayintu babana bakwe botatwe kabali antoomwe, bakanjila mubwaato.

Bakanjila boonse antomwe awumwi munyama mbuli mumisyobo yabo, alimwi awumwi musyobo wazivuubwa mbuli musyobo wazyo, alimwi achimwi chintu chiyavula chakali kuyavula anyika mbuli musyobo wazyo,awumwi musyobo wazyuuka chili amabaaba.
Izibili kulizyoonse zyenyama izyakali zyamuuya wabuumi zyakaza kuli Nowa alimwi zyakanjila mubwato.
Ibanyama bakanjila bakali beenze abazyazi bamisyobo yoonse; zyakanjila mbuli Leza mbwakali wamulayilila. Mpawo Jehova wakajala ikkoma musule lyabo.
Mpawo izambangulwe lyakasika anyika kwamazuba makumi oone, alimwi maanzi akavula alimwi akanyampula bwaato akubutola ajulu anyika.
Imaanzi akasinsinkania kuvumba nyika, alimwi bwaato bwakayibuka aatala lyamuyaba wamaanzi.
Imaanzi akatanta kuvulisya anyika chakuti zyoonse zilundu zilamfu zyakali munsi lyamulengalenga zyakavumbwa.
Maanzi akatanta kwamakkiyubbiti kkumi amusanu aatala lyansonge yazilundu.
Zyoonse zintu zipona ezyo zyakali kweenda aanyika zyakafwa - bayuni, zivuubwa, banyama bamulusaka, zyoonse zinyamankala zipona izyakali kupona mubwiingi bwamweelo wanyika, aboonse bantu.
Boonse banyamankala bapona ibakali kupona anyika, aabo bakayoya muuya wabuumi, kuzwa mumpemo zyabo, bakafwa.

Nkokwamba kuti choonse chintu chipona ichakali aatala anyika chakakukululwa chaloba, bantu abanyama ezintu ziyavula abayuni bamumulengalenga. Zyoonse zyakaloba kuzwa aanyika. Nowa biyo abaabo mbakali aabo mubwaato mbibakachaala.
Imaanzi akakkala aanyika kwamazuba mwaanda amakkumi musanu

Aaba bami balimusanu bakatobela musule bakaswaanana antomwe musena lya Sidimu (alubo lyiitwa kuti lwizi lwamunyo).
Kkumi ayibili myaaka bakakukutawukila Kkedolema, pesi mumwaaka wakkumi ayitatu bakapapa.
Mpawo mumwaaka wakkumi ayine,  Kkedolema abaami aabo bakali aanguwe bakasika alimwi bakalwisya Lifeyimu mu Asyitaloti Kkanayimu, mu Zuzayiti mu Hamu, ba Emiti mu Syevi Kkiliyatayimu,
mpawo ba Holiti munyika yabo yachilundu cha Seyili, kulaale mbuli Elu Palani, ili afwifwi akunkanda.
Mpawo bakapiluka akusika ku Eni Misipati (alubo yitwa kuti Kkadesi), akuzunda zyoonse zisi zyaba Amaleki, alimwi aba Amoli bakakkede mu Hazazoni Tama.
Mpawo mwami wa Sodomu, mwami wa Gomola, mwami wa Adima, mwami wa Zebbayimu, amwami wa Bbela (alubo wiitwa kuti Zowa) bakazwa akuyoobambila nkondo mumusena wa Sidimu
kwiiminana aa Kkedolilayoma, mwami wa Elamu, Tidalu, mwami wa Goyimu, Amulafelu, mwami wa Sina, Aliyokki, mwami wa Elasa; baami bane aatala abali musanu.
Lino musena wa Sidimu wakazwide malindi aataala, alimwi mbuli baami ba Sodomu a Gomola mbubakachija, bakawida mumoomo. Aabo bakasyaala bakachijIla kuzilindi.
Elyo mwami wakabweza zyoonse zintu zya Sodomu a Gomola azyoonse zyakuligwasya, akwenda mUnzila yabo.
Nibakayinka bakabweza alubo Loti, mwana wamukulana wa Abbulamu wachaalumi, wakali kukkala mu Sodomu, azintu zyakwe zyoonse.
Umwi wakali waloboka wakasika wabuzya Abbulamu mu Hibbulu. Wakali kukkala mumisamu eeyo yakali ya Mamule, mu Amoli ooyo wakali mukulana wa Esikkolu a  Ana, aabo boonse bakali babunyina ba Abbulamu.

Lino Abbulamu nakamvwa kuti basinkondonyina bakajata nzubo zyakwe, wakatuma bakwe bali myaanda itatu akkumi amusanu abatatu bayiidwe baluumi aabo bakazyedwe mung'anda yakwe, wakabatobela kusikila ku Dani.
Wakabapambula baluumi bakwe kwiminana aambabo mansiku akubalwisya, alimwi wakabatobela kusikila ku Hobba, eeyo ili kulubazu lwakunyika ya Damasikkasi.
Elyo wakaboozya lubo boonse buvubi, alimwi wakaboozya munyina wakwe Loti azilongo zyakwe, antoomwe abanakazi abamwi bantu .
Kuzwa Abbulamu nakaboola kuzwa kukuzunda Kkedalema abaami aabo bakali aanguwe, mwami wa Sodomu wakayinka kukuyooswanana aanguwe kumusena wa Syave ( alubo wiitwa kuti musena wa mwami).
Melukkizedekki mwami wa Salemu, wakeeta chibbubbu awayini. Wakati mupayizi wa Leza wamajulu.
Wakamulongezya wati, "Alongezegwe Abbulamu kuzwa kuli Leza wamajulu, mulengi wajulu anyika.
Alongezegwe Leza wamajulu, wakaaba basinkondo nyokwe mujaanza lyako.''
Mwami wa Sodomu wakati kuli Abbulamu, "Ndipe bantu alimwi ubweze zilongo zibe zyako.''
Abbulamu wakati kumwami wa Sodomu, "Ndinyampwide kuboko kwangu kuli Jehova, Leza wamajulu mulengi wajulu anyika,
kuti nsikoyoobweza luchinda, chaanzyo, chansangu, nakuti chimwi chako, kuchitila kuti utakaambi kuti, 'Ndakachita Abbulamu muvubi."
Taakwe nchintakabweze kunze kwamukubusi nzyakalya alimwi achaabilo chabaalumi eecho chakayinka andime. Muleke Ana, Asikkolu, a Mamule babweze zipanzi zyabpo.
Nikwakamana eezi zintu jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli Abbulamu muchilengano kaliti, "Utayoowi Abbulamu! Ndime ntobo yako abulumbu bwako bupati."
Abbulamu wakati, "Mwami Jehova, uyoondipaanzi, mbukunga nsijisi mwana, asimulya zina lyang'anda yangu ngooyu Eliyeza waku Damasikko?"
Abbulamu wakati, "Lino mbotandipede lunyungu, bona, simuzyalwa aalikke mung'anda yangu nguyoondilida zina."
Lino amubone, jwi lya Jehova lyakasika kulinguwe, lyakati, "Ooyu mwaalumi takoyoolya zina lyako pe; pesi oomwe uyoozwa kumubili wako nguyoolya zina lyako."
Lino wakamutola aanze, alimwi wakati, "Langa kujulu, ubale nyenyeezi, na ulakonzya kuzibala." Mpawo wakati kuli nguwe , "Alimwi mbuluyooba lunyungu lwako."
Wakasyoma Jehova, mpawo wakamubala mbuli mululami.
Wakati kulinguwe, "Ndime Jehova, wakakugwisya kuzwa ku Uli wamuchisi chaba Kkaludi, akukupa eeyi nyika kuti uyoyikone."
Wakati, Mwami Jehova, mbobuli mbunkonzya kuziba kuti njoyikona?"
Elyo wakati kulinguwe, "Undiletele ng'ombe nzyazi yamwaaka itatu, ampwizi yampongo ili amyaaka itatu, ambelele zyamyaaka itatu, anziba, amwana wankwilimba."
Wakamuletela eezi zyoonse, wazyaandula aakati, mpawo wakabika chipanzi chimwi achimwi kuchipanzinyina, pesi takaandula bayuni pe.
Lino bayuni nibakaseluka kuzoolya nyama, Abbulamu wakabatanda
Lino zuba nilyakabbila, Abbulamu wakoona ng'onzi mpati alimwi, bona, mudima mupati usiya mbii uyoosya wakamuwida.
Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Abbulamu, "koziba chalusinizyo kuti basilunyungu bako bayooba banasinakooma munyika itali yabo, ooko bayooba bazike akupenzegwa kwamyaaka ili myaanda yone.
Ndiyoochibeteka chisi eecho nchibayoobelekela, lino kusule lyacheechi bayoozwa ambono zyiingi.
Pesi muyoyinka kuli bamawuso muluumuno, alimwi muyozikkwa muziimo zibotu.
Mumukowa wane bayooboola ookuno, nkaambo milandu yaba Amoli tina kuzula."
Zuba nilyakabbila mpawo kwakasiya mbii, amubone, chilongo chamulilo chisuka busi abbalabala lyalampi zyakayinda aakati kazipanzi.
Muleelyo zuba Jehova wakatanguna chizuminano a Abbulamu, wakati, "Kulunyungu lwako ndiliwo kumupa eeyi nyika, kuzwa kumulonga wa Ijiputi kuya kumulonga mupati, mulonga Yufuleti.
Ba Kkeni, ba Kkenizi, ba kkadimoni,
ba Hiti, ba Pelizi, ba Lifayiti,
ba Amoli, ba Kkenani, Gegasiti, aba Jebbusi."
Lino Salayi, mwanakazi wa Abbulamu, taakwe nakazyede nikuba mwana kulinguwe, pesi wakali aamulanda wachanakazi, mu Ijiputi, zina lyakwe kali Haga.
Lino Salayi wakati kuli Abbulamu, "Langa, Jehova  wandikasya kuba aabana. Koya ukalale amulanda wangu. Ziyoochitika eezyo kuti ndiyooba abana anguwe." Abbulamu wakaswilizya jwi lya Salayi.
Kwakali kwayinda myaaka ili kkumi Abbulamu kapona munyika eeyo ya Kkenani ooyo Salayi, mwanakazi wa Abbulamu, wakapa Haga, mulanda wakwe mu Ijiputi kumulumi wakwe mbuli mwanakazi wakwe.
Aboobo wakaba abulidilano a Haga, alimwi wakaminta. Eelyo nakabona kuti waminta, wakabalangila kali aakunyansya simalelo wakwe.

Elyo Salayi wakati kuli Abbulamu, "Ooku kubisya kuli aalindime nkaambo kako. Ndakupa mulanda wangu mwanakazi umukumbate amaboko, alimwi mpakabona kuti watumbuka ndakanyansigwa kumeso aakwe. Alubo Jehova wakatonga aakati kangu anduwe."

Pesi Abbulamu wakati kuli Salayi, "Langa aawa mulanda mulanda wako mwanakazi ulimunguzu zyako, chita kulinguwe nchoyanda anga nchiboto . Aboobo Salayi wakamujata bubi, anguwe, mpawo wakachija kuzwa kulinguwe.
Mungelo wa Jehova wakamujana kumbali aakasensa kamaanzi munkanda, kasensa kakali kunzila yaku Suli.
Wakati, "Haga mulanda wa Salayi, wazwa kuli alimwi uyakuli?" Elyo wakati, "Ndikuchija kuli simalelo wangu Salayi."
Alimwi mungelo wa Jehova wakati kulinguwe, "Bweeda kulusimalelo wako, alimwi ukalifwiinsye kubweendelezi bwakwe."
Elyo mungelo wa Jehova wakati kuli nguwe, "Ndiyookomezya kapati lunyungu lwako, mpawo luyoochita kuti mweelwe walo utakabaliki."
Mungelo wa Jehova alubo wakati kulinguwe, "Langa, uli aada alimwi uyoozyala mwana mulombe, mpawo uyoomulika zina lya Isyumayeli, nkaambo Jehova wamvwa mafwabi aako.
Uyooba ndonki yamulusaka yamuntu. Uyooba mukali kumuntu woonse alimwi muntu woonse unooli mukali kulinguwe, mpawo uyoopona kaanzene kubananyina."
E;yo wakapa zina eeli kuli Jehova wakambawide aawe, "Nduwe undibona," nkaambo wakati, "Ndichikonzya kuya kunembo kandibona loko na, nikuba wazwa aakundibona?"
Nkikaako chikala chakali kutegwa Bbiyeli Lahayi Loyi; langa, kali aakati a Kkadesi Bbeledi.
Haga wakazyalila Abbulamu mwana mulombe, alimwi Abbulamu wakamulika zina mwana mulombe ooyo Haga ngwakazyala, Isyumayeli.
Abbulamu wakali amyaaka ili makumi musanu aatatu amusanu awumwi. Aawo Haga nakazyala Isyumayeli kuli Abbulamu.

Lino Abbulamu naakaba aaminyaka ili makkumi musanu aane aali aaminyaka misanu ayine, Jehova wakalibonya kuli Abbulamu alimwi wakaamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Ndime Leza Singuzu zyoonse. Enda kunembo lyangu, alimwi ukabule kampenda.
Mpawo ndiyoosimya chizuminano changu aakati kangu anduwe, alimwi ndiyokuvuzya chakwiindilila.
Abbulamu wakakkotamika busyu bwakwe aansi alimwi Leza wakaambula anguwe, wakati,
''Mbuli lwangu, kolanga, chizuminano changu chilaanduwe. Uyooba wisi wamanyika miingi.
Tachikwe pe zina lyako nilichiyooba Abbulamu, pesi izina lyako liyooba Abbulahamu - nkaambo ndakusala kuti ube wisi wamakkamu mukkamu aamanyika miingi.
Ndiyookuchita kuti ukazyalisye, alimwi ndiyoochita zisi zyiingi zyako, alimwi baami bayoozwa kulinduwe.
