Ndiyoosimwa chizuminano changu aakati kandime anduwe alunyungu lwako musule lyako, kwiinda mumazyalane aabo woonse kuchizuminano chitamani, kubaLeza wako akulunyungu lwako musule lyako.
Ndiyoopa kulinduwe, akulunyungu lwako musule lyako, inyika oomo mumwakali kukkala, nyika yoonse yaKkenani, kuti ikabe buvubi butamani, alimwi ndiyooba Leza wabo.''
Lino Leza wakati kuli Abbulahamu, ''Mbuli lwako, weelede kubamba chizuminano changu, webo alunyungu lwako musule lyako kwiinda mumazyalane aabo woonse.
Eechi nchizuminano changu, nchimweelede kubamba, aakati kandime a nduwe abalunyungu lwako musule lyako: Woonse mwaalumi aakati kenu weelede kupalulwe.
Mweelede kupalulwa munyama yalukanda lwe ndomo zyanu, aboobo eechi chiyooba chitondeezyo chachizuminano changu aakati kandime a nduwe.

Woonse mwana mulombe uli aamazuba aakutumbukwa ali musanu aatatu weelede kupalulwa, kumazyalane abantu bako woonse. Eechi chibikilizya muntu woonse uuzyalya mu'anda yako awooyo wakawulwa kuzwa ku muzwakule uutali umwi wabalunyungu lwako.
Ooyo uuzyalwa mu'anda yako alimwi awooyo woonse wuulwa amali yako uleelede kupalulwa. Akaako chizuminano changu chiyooba munyama yako kuchizuminano chitamani.
Kufumbwa mwaalumi utapalwidwe pe nyama yalulomo lwakwe uyoowandanisigwa kuzwa kubantu bakulimbabo. Watyola chizuminano changu.''
Leza wakati kuli Abbulahamu, ''Mbuli Salayi mukkazi wako, utazomwiiti kuti Salayi limbi. Pesi, izina lyakwe liyooba Sala.
Ndiyoomulongezya, alimwi ndiyokupa mwana mulombe kwiinda kulinguwe. Ndiyoomulongezya, alimwi uyooba banyina bazisi. Baami ba bantu bayoozwa kulinguwe.''

Mpawo Abbulahamu wakakkotamika busyu bwakwe aansi, alimwi wakaseka, alimwi wati mumoyo wakwe, ''Kujana mwana wazyalwa na amwaalumi uli aaminyaka ili mwaanda? Alimwi kujana Sala, uli aaminyaka makkumi musanu aane azyale mwana mulombe?
Abbulahamu wakati kuli Leza, ''Oo kuti Isyumayeli apone kunembo lyako!''

Leza wakati, ''Pe, pesi Sala mukayintu wako uyookuzyalila mwana mulombe, alimwi weelede kuyoomuzika kuti Ayizekki. Ndiyosimya chizuminano changu anguwe mbuli chizuminano chitamani alunyungu lwakwe luchiza musule lyakwe.

Mbuli Isyumayeli, ndakumvwa. Langa, ndiyoomulongezya alimwi ndiyomuchita kuti akazyalisye alimwi ndiyomuvuzya chakwiindilila. Uyooba wisi wa baami bali ikkumi ababili alimwi ndiyomuchita kuti akabe chisi chipati.
Pesi chizuminano changu ndiyochiimika a Ayizekki, ooyo Sala ngwatakazyale kulinduwe kuchiindi eechino kumunyaka uuza.''
Lino nakamaninsya kwaambula anguwe, Leza wakazwa kuli Abbulahamu.

Mpawo Abbulahamu wakabweza Isyumayeli mwana wakwe mulombe, aboonse aabo bakazyalilwa mu'anda yakwe, abaabo boonse bakawulwa amali yakwe, woonse mwaalumi aakati kabaalumi ban'anda ya Abbulahamu, alimwi bakapalula inyama yalulomo lwabo buunsi mbubo oobo, mbuli Leza mbaakamwaambilide.
Abbulahamu wakali aaminyaka iili makkumi musanu aane aali aminyaka ili musanu ayine nakapalulwa munyama yalulomo lwakwe.
Alimwi Isyumayeli mwana wakwe mulombe wakali aaminyaka iili kkumi ayitatu aawo nakapalulwa munyama yalulomo lwakwe.
Mubuzuba mbubonya oobo Abbulahamu a Isyumayeli mwana wakwe mulombe boonse bakapalulwe.
Boonse baalumi been'anda yakwe bakapalulwa aantomwe anguwe, kubikilizya abaabo bakazyalilwa mugunzi alimwi abaabo bakawulwa kubazwakule.
Yawe waklibonya kuli Abbulahamu aakati kamasamu aa Mamule, nakakkede amulyango watente sikati  mukupya kwe zuba.
Wakalanga kujulu alimwi, langa, wakabona baalumi batatu kabiimvwi kuzwa kulinguwe. Eelyo nakabona, wakachijaana kuyobatambula kuzwa kumulyango watente alimwi  wavundama aansi aanyika.
Wakati, ''Mwaami, na ndajana luzyalo mumenso aako, utayindi mbali akusiya mulanda wako.
Muleke kweetwe twaanzi, musambe ndyato, alimwi mulyookezye munsi lyamunsamu.
Amuleke ndilete chakulya chiche, kuchitila kuti mulibukulusye lwanu. Kuzwa aawo mulayinka anzila yenu, mbukunga mwaza kumuzike wenu.'' Limwi bakati, ''Chita mbuli mbuwamba.''
Mpawo akufwambana Abbulahamu wakanjila mutente kuli Sala, akuti, ''Fwambana, bweza zyeelesyo zitatu zyabusu bunante bwa fulawa, kkopa, upange chibunge.''
Mpawo Abbulahamu wakachijanina kubutanga, alimwi wabweza chana cha n'ombe chiteteete chibotu, akupa mubelesi, ooyo wakafwambana kuchibamba.
Wakabweza masase, amalili, alimwi amwana wen'ombe wakali wabambwa, a kubika kulya kunembo lyabo, alimwi wakiima kumbali lyabo munsi lyamusamu bo kabali kulya.
Bakati kulinguwe, ''Ulikuli Sala mukayintu wako?'' Wakasandula, ''Omiya, mutente.''

Wakati, ''Nchobeni ndiyooboola chakutaleka kulindinywe muchiindi chakulwaaka, alimwi bona, Sala mukkazi wako uyooba amwana mulombe.'' Sala wakalikuswiilizya kali aamulyango watente, lyakali musule lyakwe.
Lino Abbulahamu a Sala bakali bachembaala, bakali biindilila loko kuminyaka yakuzyala, alimwi Sala wakali wiinda minyaka yamwanakazi njakkonzya kuzyala bana.Nkinkaako
Sala wakaliseka, akulyaambila kuti, ''Kandili ndazakala oobu a simalelo wangu wakkomena, kujana lino ndakujana na kubotelwa ooku?''
Yawe wakati kuli Abbulahamu, ''Nkaambonzi Sala naseka akwaamba kuti, 'Ndiyomuzyala na nchobeni mwana, kendi ndachembaala'?
Sena kuli chintu chiyumu kuli Jehova? Kuchiindi nchindaamba, kulwaaka, ndiyoboola kulinduwe. Kuchiindi chakasibe mbuli cheechi mumunyaka uza Sala uyooba a mwana mulombe.''
Mpawo Sala wakazikaka alimwi wati, ''Tendaseka pe,'' nkaambo wakali wayowa. Wakasandula wati, ''Pe, waseka.''
Mpawo baalumi bakanyampuka akweenda kabakunuka kabalangide Sodomu. Abbulahamu wakiinka aambabo kubabona munzila yabo.
Pesi Jehova wakati, ''Ndisise na kuli Abbulahamu kuti niinzi ncheyanda kuti ndichite,
mbuli kuti Abbulahamu chanchobeni uyooba chisi chipati alimwi chili aanguzu, alimwi zisi zyoonse zyenyika ziyoolongezegwa mulinguwe?

Nkaambo ndakamusala kuchitila kuti alayilile bana bakwe aben'anda yakwe kuti bakalondole inzila ya Jehova, akuchita bululami a bubotu, kuchitila kuti Jehova nga ulaleta aatala a Abbulahamu eezyo nzyakaamba kulinguwe.''
Mpawo Jehova wakati, ''Akaambo kakulila aatala a Sodomu a Gomola kupati, alimwi akaambo chibi chabo chipati loko,
ndiyooyinka aansi aawo a kubona kulila kuli aatala anguwe ooko kwakasika kulindime, na kuti bakazichita nchobeni. Na pe, ndiyoziba.''
Nkaako baalumi bakachengunuka kuzwa ooko, alimwi biinka kabalangide Sodomu, pesi Abbulahamu wakachaala kayimvwi kunembo lya Jehova.
Mpawo Abbulahamu wamusikila wati, ''Uyoonyonyoona na baluleme a basizibi aantomwe?
Amwi kuli makkumi musanu baluleme mudolopo. Uyoolinyonyoona na akutalondola busena akaambo ka bali kkumi baluleme balimo oomo?
Akukabe kule kuzwa kulinduwe kuyoochita chintu chili boobo, kujaya baluleme a babi, kuti baluleme bajatwe bweelene ababi. Akukabe kule anduwe! Sena sikubeteka wanyika yoonse takoyoochita chibotu?''
Jehova wakati, ''Kuti na ndajana mu Sodomu  baalumi bali makkumi aali musanu baluleme mukati ke dolopo, mpawo ndiyoyokola busena boonse akaaambo kambabo.''
Abbulahamu wakasandula alimwi wati, ''Langa, ndalipeda kwaaambula ku Mwaami wangu nikuba kuti ndilibiyo lusuko adota!
Ani kuti kwalela musamu ku makkumi musanu baluleme? Uyoonynyoona na dolopo lyoonse akubulila kwa musanu?'' Alimwi wakati, ''Tandikoolinyonyoona pe, na ndajana nkuko makkumi aane amusanu.''
Wakaambula kulinguwe alubo, a kuti, ''Ani kuti kakuli makkumi aane aajanika nkuko?'' Wakasandula, ''Tandikwe kuyoochichita pe akaambo kamakkumi aane.''
Wakati, ''Inche kaka utanyemi pe, Mwaami, kuti ndaambule. Amwi makkumi atatu balajanika nkukooko.'' Wakasandula, ''Tandikwe kuyoochichita na ndajana makkumi atatu nkuko.''
Wakati, ''Langa, ndalipeda kwaambula ku Mwaami wangu! Amwi makkumi aabili balakujanika nkuko.'' Wakasandula, ''Tandikoyoochinyonyona pe akaambo ka makkumi abili.''
Wakati, ''Inche kaka utanyemi, Mwaami, alimwi ndiyowambuula aaka kamamanino. Amwi kkumi liyojanika nkuko.'' Mpawo wakati, ''Tandikoyooyinyonyoona pe akaambo ka bali kkumi.''
Jehova wakeenda anzila yakwe mpawawo nakamana kwaambula a Abbulahamu, alimwi Abbulahamu wakabweda kumunzi.
Bangelo babili bakasika ku Sodomu goko, Loti naka kkede amulyango wamunzi. Loti wakababona, wakanyampuka kuti aswaanane aabo, mpawo wakavundama abusyu bwakwe ansi.

Wakati, ''Akaka nobasimalelo bangu, ndamukumbila kuti munyonele kun'anda yamuzike wanu, mukkale  mansiku aano, akusamba ndyato zyenu. Mpawo muyobuka chifumo akutola lweendo lwanu.'' Alimwi bakati, ''Pe, tuyobuchesya mansiku katuli mubbuwa lyadolopo.''
Pesi wakabakombelezya loko, mpawo bakayinka anguwe, alimwi bakanjila mun'anda yakwe. Wakabamba chakulya alimwi wabajikila chibunge chitakwe busweezyo, alimwi bakalya.
Pesi kabatana wona, baalumi bamuchisi, baalumi ba Sodomu, bakazyunguluka n'anda, baniini a bapati, bantu boonse bakayoboloka kuzwa kumabbazu woonse achisi.
Bakayita Loti, alimwi bakati kulinguwe, ''Balikuli baalumi baza kulinduwe goko? Beete kulindiswe, kuti tubazibe.''
Akaako Loti wakazwa alimwi wajala kkoma wayinka kuli mbabo.
Wakati, ''Ndamukumbila nobakkulana bangu, mutachiti bubi.

Amubone, ndilijisi basimbi babili batanaziba nikuba mwaalumi. Amuleke, ndamukkumbila, ndibape kulindinywe, alimwi mukachite kulimbabo kufumbwa chibotu kumenso eenu. Biyo mutachiti chintu kuli baaba bantu, nkaambo baza mucheenzule chakaluli kangu.''

Bakati, ''Bweedela musule!'' Bakati alubo, ''Ooyo wakaza kuzokkala mbuli muzwakule, alimwi lino wakaba mubetesi wesu! Lino tuyochita bubi bwiindilide alinduwe kwiinda alimbabo.'' Bakamulwisya kapati mwaalumi, kulwisyanya a Loti, alimwi bakali baamba kutyola kkoma.
Pesi baalumi bakatalamuna maboko aabo alimwi bakwela Loti mun'anda akujala kkoma.
Mpawo beenzu ba Loti bakoofwazya bantu boonse bakali aanze en'anda, boonse baniini a bapati, kuchitila kuti bakawuumpulike baakuyandawula mulyango.
Mpawo baalumi bakati kuli Loti, ''Ulaawumwi na uumbi omuno? Uli aabakwansa na, bana bako balombe a bana bako basimbi, a kufumbwa ngoli aawe muchisi, bagwisye omuno.
Nkaambo twaamba kunyonyoona busena obuno, nkaambo bubi bwabo kuli Jehova bwavulisya nchaatutuma kuzoochinyonyoona.''

Loti wakiinka aanze alimwi wakaambula abakwansa bakwe, baalumi bakasyomezezye kukkwata bana bakwe basimbi, alimwi wakati, ''Chakufwambana, amuzwe aabusena oobu, nkaambo Jehova uyanda kunyonyoona chisi.'' Pesi bakwaansa bakwe bakabonaanga mudanta.
Nikwakaba kubuchedo, bangelo bakasungilizya Loti, kabati, ''Kamuya, bweza mukkazi wako a bana bako basimbi bali aano, kuti utasukutizyi muchisubulo chachisi.''

Pesi wakakkala. Aboobo mwaalumi wakajata jaanza lyakwe, a jaanza lya mukkazi wakwe, a maanza a bana bakwe basimbi babili, nkaambo Jehova wakamufwida luzyalo. Bakabagwisya aanze, alimwi babakkazika aanze kwachisi.
Nibakabagwisya aanze, umwi wa baalumi wakati, ''Amuchije abuumi bwanu! Mutachebuki musule, nikuba kukkala mubbuwa. Mukalobokele kuchilundu kuti mutakanyonyooki.''
Loti wakati kulimbabo, ''Pe, kaka, nobasimalelo bangu!
Mulanda wanu wajana luzyalo kumenso aanu, alimwi mwanditondeezya buuya bupati akufutula buumi bwangu, pesi nsikkonzyi kulobokela kuzilundu, nkaambo lunyonyooko luyoondeezya, alimwi ndiyoofwa.
Langa, echiya chisi chiboneka okuya chili aafwifwi kukuchijila kuli nchicho, alimwi nchiniini. Akaka, muleke ndobokele nkuko (tachili chiniini na?), alimwi buumi bwangu buyoofutulwa.''
Wakatim kulinguwe, ''Nchibotu, ndiyookupa chikumbizyo eechi alimwi, kuti nsikoyoonyonyoona chisi  nchuwaamba.
Fwambaana! Lobokela nkuko, nkaambo nsikkonzyi kuchita chintu kusikila usike nkuko.'' Nkinkaako chisi chakali kutegwa Zowali.
Izuba lyakali lyazwa aawo Loti nakasika ku Zowali.
Mpawo Jehova wakawisya aatala a Sodomu a Gomola salifa a mulilo uuzwa kuli Jehova kuzwa mu mulenga-lenga.
Wakanyonyoona zisi eezyo, amabbuwa woonse, abantu boonse bamuzisi, amisamu yoonse iimena aanyika.
Pesi mukkazi wa Loti, wakali musule lyakwe, wakachebuka musule, mpawo wakaba chuulu chamwinyo.
Abbulahamu wakabuka chifumo loko alimwi wayinka kubusena nkwakayimvwi kunembo lya Jehova.
Wakalanga aansi ku Sodomu a Gomola akunyika yoonse yamabbuwa. Wakalanga alimwi wakabona, busi bwakali kuunta kuzwa aanyika mbuli busi bwabbila lyamulilo.
Aboobo Leza wakanyonyoona zisi zya mabbuwa, Leza wakayita Abbulahamu kumizeezo. Wakatuma Loti kuzwa aakati kalunyonyooko aawo nakanyonyoona zisi oomo Loti mwakali kukkala.
Pesi Loti wakatanta kuzwa ku Zowali kuyookkala muzilundu abana bakwe basimbi babili, nkaambo wakayowa kukkala mu Zowali. Aboobo wakakkala munkomwe, we abana bakwe basimbi babili.
Mutaanzi kukuzyalwa wakati kumuniini, ''Taata wesu wachembaala, alimwi tatukwe mwaalumi ngutukonzya koona aawe pe mbuli kuchiyanza chanyika yoonse.
Koza, ngatuchite taata wesu anywe wayini, alimwi tuyowona aanguwe, kuchitila kuti tukakkomezye luzubo lwa taata.''
Aboobo bakachita wisi kuti anywe wayini mansiku aayo. Mwana mutaanzi wakanjila alimwi wawoona awisi wakwe; wisi takaziba pe kuti mwana wakalala chiindi nzi, nikuba kuti wakabuka chiindi nzi.

Buzuba butobela mwana mutaanzi wakati kumwanike wakwe, ''Swiilila, mansiku ayinda ndakoona a taata. Atumuchite kuti anywe lubo wayini mansiku aano, alimwi weelede kunjila akoona aawe, kuchitila kuti tukomezye luzubo lwa taata.
Aboobo bakamuchita wisi wabo kuti anywe lubo mansiku aayo, alimwi wakanjila akoona aawe. Wisi taakaziba pe kuti mwana wakalala chiindi nzi, nikuba kuti wakabuka chiindi nzi.
Aboobo bana basimbi boonse ba Loti bakamitisigwa  a wisi wabo.
Mwana mutaanzi wakazyala mwana mulombe, alimwi wakamuuzika kuti Mowabbu. Wakaba wisi wabaMowabbu basunu.
Kumwana musimbi muniini, alakwe wakazyala mwana mulombe, alimwi wakamuuzika kuti Bbeni Ami. Nguwe wakaba wisi wabantu ba Amoni basunu.
Abbulahamu wakeenda kuzwa ooko kaya kunyika yaNegevi, alimwi wakakkala aakati ka Kkadesyi  a Suli. Wakali muzwakule wakali kukkala mu Gela.
Abbulahamu wakaamba aatala aSala banakwe, ''Muchizi wangu.'' Aboobo Abbimeleki mwaami wa Gela wakatumwa alimwi wakamubweza Sala.
Pesi Leza wakaza kuli Abbimeleki mansiku muchiloto, alimwi wakati kulinguwe, ''Bona, ulimwaalumi uufwide nkaambo kamwanakazi nguwatola nkaambo mbana muntu.''
Lino Abbimeleki taakalinaasika pe aafwifwi anguwe alimwi wakati, ''Mwaami, kujana wajaya na nyika iiluleme?
Taakamba na lwake mwini kulindime, 'Muchizi wangu?' Nikuba we lwakwe wakaamba, 'Munyaandumi wangu.' Ndakazichita eezi mubuntu bwamoyo amukubula mulandu kumaanza aangu.''
Mpawo Leza wakati kulinguwe muchiloto, ''Iyii, ndalizi kuti mubuntu bwamoyo wako wakachita eechi, alimwi ndakakukasya kuti undibisizye. Nkinkaako tendakakuzumizya pe kuti umugume.
Nkinkaako, bwedezya mukayintu wamuntu, nkaambo musinsimi. Uyookukombela, alimwi uyoopona. Pesi ikuti tewamubwedezya, ziba kuti iwe abako boonse nchobeni muyoofwa.''
Abbimeleki wakabuka chifumo loko alimwi wakayita balanda bakwe boonse kulinguwe. Wakabaambila zyoonse zintu eezi, alimwi bantu bakayowesya loko.

Mpawo Abbimeleki wakayita Abbulahamu  akwaamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Niinzi nchimwachita kulindiswe? Ndakubisizya biyeni, kuti weete alindime alimwi akubwaami bwangu chibi chipati? Wachita eezyo ziteelede kuchitwa kulindime.''
Abbimeleki wakati kuli Abbulahamu, ''Niinzi chakuchitya kuti uchite chintu eechi?''
Abbulahamu wakati, ''Nkaambo ndakayeya, 'Nchobeni takwe kuyowa Leza pe abusena oobu, alimwi balandijaya nkaambo kamukayintu wangu.'
Nikuba boobo, nchoonzyo muchizi wangu, mwana musimbi wa taata, pesi uutali mwana musimbi wa baama; alimwi wakaba mukayintu wangu.

Aawo Lea naakandichita kuti ndisiye n'anda ya taata alimwi nkenjobweendenda kubusena abusena, ndakati kulinguwe, 'Weelede kunditondezya busyomesi oobu mbuli mukayintu wangu: Kufumbwa kubusena ooko nkutwaya, wamba aatala andime, ''Munyandumi wangu.''''
Mpawo Abbimeleki wakabweza mbelele a basune, alimwi bazike baalumi a banakazi, akubapa kuli Abbulahamu. Mpawo wakabwedezya Sala, mukayintu wa Abbulahamu, kulinguwe.
Abbimeleki wakati, ''Langa, inyika yangu ilikunembo lyako. Kkala kufumbwa akubotezya.''

Kuli Sala wakati, ''Langa, ndapa munyandumi wako chuulu cha nsiliva. Njakusitizya kufumbwa mulandu aatala anduwe kumenso aabaabo bali aanduwe, alimwi akuli boonse bali aanduwe, alimwi kunembo lyaboonse, mwachitilwa kabotu chakumaninina.''
Mpawo Abbulahamu wakakomba kuli Leza, alimwi Leza wakasilika Abbimeleki, banakwe, a bazike bakwe bechanakazi kuchitila kuti bakonzye kuba aabana.
Nkaambo Jehova wakali wachitila banakazi boonse ben'anda ya Abbimeleki kuti batakazyali pe kwalyoonse, nkaambo ka Sala, mukayintu wa Abbulahamu.
Yawe wakaswiilila Sala mbuli mbaakaamba kuti uyoochita, alimwi Jehova wakachitila Sala mbuli mbakali wasyomezya.
Sala wakamita alimwi wazyalila Abbulahamu mwana mulombe kubuchembele bwakwe, kuchiindi chili mbuli eecho chakabambidwe Leza nchaakali waamba kulinguwe.
Abbulahamu wakawuzika mwana wakwe mulombe, ooyo umwi ngwaakazyalilwa, ooyo Sala ngwaakazyala, Ayizekki.
Abbulahamu wakapalula mwana wakwe Ayizekki naakali waba aamazuba musanu aatatu, mbuli Leza mbaakamulayilila.
Abbulahamu wakali aaminyaka iili mwaanda yakuzyalwa nakazyalilwa Ayizekki.
Sala wakati, ''Leza wandichita kuti ndiseke; woonse uumvwa uyooseka aantomwe andime.''
Alubo wakati, ''Ngwani wakali kuyoowamba kuli Abbulahamu kuti Sala uyoolela bana, alimwi ndamuzyalila mwana mulombe ku buchembele bwakwe!''
Mwana wakakkomena akulesegwa, alimwi Abbulahamu wakabamba ipobwe pati mubuzuba Ayizekki nakalesegwa.
Sala wakabona mwana wa Hagayi mu Egepita, ngwakazyalila Abbulahamu, kamuseka.
Akaako wakati kuli Abbulahamu, ''Mutande mwanakazi muzike amwana wakwe, nkaambo mwana ooyu wa mwanakazi muzike takabi sikulya lukkono amwana wangu, Ayizekki.''
Eechi chintu chakamuchisa kapati Abbulahamu akaambo kamwana wakwe mulombe.

Pesi Leza wakati kuli Abbulahamu, ''Utalili akaamboka ka mwana mulombe,  alimwi akaambo ka mwanakazi muzike. Swiilila majwi aakwe woonse ngaawamba kuli nduwe aatala akaka kaambo, nkaambo kwiinda muli Ayizekki izyalane lyako muliyoovuzigwa.
Ndiyoochita alubo mwana mulombe wa mwanakazi muzike kuba chisi, nkaambo ndizyalane lyako.''
Abbulahamu wakabuka chifumofumo, wabweza chibunge, achinkuli cha maanzi, alimwi wapa Haga, wabika aakkuko lyakwe. Wamupa mulombe akumwaanda. Wakeenda akuzelengana mulusaka lwa Bbeyasebba.
Aawo maanzi akali mu chinkuli nakamana, wakasiya biyo mwana munsi lyachimwi chiteyo.

Mpawo wakayinka, alimwi waakaukkala aansi kulekule anguwe, wakasibe mbuli wakuwaala kavwi, nkaambo wakati, ''Nditalangi aatala alufu lwa mwana.''Mbuli nakakkede kuzwa kulinguwe, wakanyampula ijwi lyakwe alimwi walila.
Leza wakamvwa ijwi lya mwana mulombe, alimwi angelo wa Leza wakayita Haga kuzwa kujulu, alimwi wakati kulinguwe, ''Niinzi chikukataazya Haga? Utayowi, nkaambo Leza wamvwa ijwi lya mulombe nkwabede.
Nyampuka, busya mwana mulombe, alimwi musungwaazye, nkaambo ndiyoomuchita kuba chisi chipati.''
Mpawo Leza wakajula menso aakwe, alimwi wakabona chikala chamaanzi. Wakayinka alimwi wazuzya maanzi muchinkuli, alimwi wapa mulombe aakunywa.
Leza wakali aamulombe, alimwi wakakkomena. Wakakkala munkanda  akuba sikavwi.
Wakali kukkala munkanda ya Palani, alimwi banyina bakamujanina mukayintu kuzwa kunyika ya Egepita.
Kwakasika kuchiindi eecho Abbimeleki a Pikkolu muzuluzi wabasilumamba bakwe nibakaambula kuli Abbulahamu, bakati, ''Leza uli aanduwe kulizyoonse nzyochita.

Lino akaako konkezya aLeza aano kulindime kuti tokoyooyendelezya chakubeja kulindime, nikuba kubana bangu, nikuba kulunyungu lwangu. Tondeenzya kulindime alimwi akunyika njiwakakkede kusyomeka kuchizuminano nchindakatondeezya kulinduwe.''
Abbulahamu wakati, ''Ndilakonka.''
Abbulahamu alubo wakanyontawukila Abbimeleki aatala achikkala chamaanzi babelesi ba Abbimeleki nchibakabweza kuzwa kulinguwe.
Abbimeleki wakati, ''Tandimwizi pe wakachita chintu eechi. Tewakandaambila pe lutaanzi kusikila lino; takwe nchindalinaamvwa pe do sunu.''
Akaako Abbulahamu wakabweza imbelele alimwi abasune akuzipa kuli Abbimeleki, alimwi bantu babili bakabumba chizuminano.
Mpawo Abbulahamu wakabamba bana bambelele bazyazi bali musanu ababili abaliike kuzwa mubutanga.
Abbimeleki wakati kuli Abbulahamu, ''Mbupanduluzi buli buti oobu bwabana bembelele bali musanu ababili mbuwabika aabalike?''
Wakasandula, ''Aaba bana bembelele bazyazi bali kusanu ababili mbuyootambula kuzwa ku luboko kwangu, kuti chikabe bukamboni bwangu, kuti ndakasya  chikkala eechi.''
Akaako wakuuzika busena oobo Bbeyasebba, nkaambo ooko kabali babili bakakonka chikonke.
Bakabumba chizuminano ku Bbeyasebba, alimwi mpawo Abbimeleki a Pikkolu, muzuluzi wabasilumamba bakwe, bakabweeda kunyika ya baFilisitiya.
Abbulahamu wakabyala musamu wa Tamalisiki mu Bbeyasebba. Ooko wakakomba Jehova, Leza walyoonse.
Abbulahamu wakakkala kali mweenzu munyika ya baFilisitiya mazuba miingi.
Kwakaba kuti nikwakayinda zintu eezi Leza wakasunka Abbulahamu. Wakaamba kutikulinguwe, ''Abbulahamu!'' Abbulahamu wakati, ''Ndili aano.''

Mpawo Leza wakati, ''Bweza mwana wako mulombe, mwana wako mulombe uumwi biyo, ooyo ngoyanda, Ayizekki, alimwi uyinke kunyika ya Moliya. Ukamupede nkuko ooko mbuli chipayizyo chakutenta aatala aachimwi chazilundu ooko, nchindiyookwaambila.''

Akaako Abbulahamu wakabuka chifumofumo, waanga mbon'olo yakwe, alimwi wakabweza babili balanda bakwe baalumi bachiniini, aantomwe a Ayizekki mwana mulombe wakwe. Wakatema inkuni zya chipayizyo chatununkilizyo, mpawo wanjila mulweendo lwakwe kaya kubusena oobo Leza mbwakali wamwaambila aatala.
Mubuzuba bwatatu Abbulahamu wakatambya menso aakwe alimwi wabona busena kabuchili kule.
Abbulahamu wakati kubaalumi bachiniini bakwe, ''Muchaale aawa ambon'olo, alimwi ime a mulombe tuyooyinka kunembo ookuya. Tuyookomba alimwi tukaboole lubo kulindinywe.''
Mpawo Abbulahamu wakabweza inkuni zyachipayizyo wazibika aali Ayizekki mwana wakwe mulombe. Wakabweza mumaboko aakwe mulilo a chipanga; alimwi bakiinka aatomwe kabali babili.

Ayizekki wakaambuula kuli wisi wakwe Abbuahamu alimwi wati, ''Taata wangu,'' alimwi wakati, ''Mpaano, mpundili mwana wangu mulombe.'' Wakati, ''Bona, ngoyu mulilo a nkuni, pesi ani ilikuli imbelele yachipayizyo chakutenta?''
Abbulahamu wakati, ''Leza lwakwe mwini uyoopa imbelele yachipayizyo chakutenta, mwana wangu.''Aboobo bakayinkilila kunembo, aantomwe kabali babili.

Nibakasika kubusena ooko Leza nkwaakamwaambila azyankuko, Abbulahamu wakayaka chipayililo nkuko ooko alimwi wakabika inkuni aali nchicho. Mpawo wakaanga Ayizekki mwana wakwe mulombe, wamulazika aachipayililo, aatala aankuni.
Abbulahamu wakatandabika luboko lwakwe wabweza ipanga kuti ajaye mwana wakwe mulombe.
Mpawo angelo wa Jehova wakamwiita kuzwa kujulu wati, ''Abbulahamu, Abbulahamu!'' alimwi wakati, ''Ndili aano.''

Wakati, ''Utabiki jaanza lyako aatala a mulombe, nikuba kuchita chimwi chintu chimuchisa, nkaambo lino ndaziba kuti ulamuyoowa Leza, nkaambo takwe niwakakila amwana wako mulombe, mwana wako mulombe uumwi biyo, kulindime.''

Abbulahamu wakatambya menso aakwe kujulu alimwi wakabona, musule lyakwe kmwakali mugutu wambelele wakapatide meja aakwe mumasamu. Abbulahamu wakayinka wabweza mugutu wamupeda mbuli chipayizyo chakutenta aabusena bwa mwana wakwe mulombe.
Aboobo Abbulahamu wakiita busena oobo kuti, ''Jehova uyoopa,'' alimwi mbubwaambwa ambuli sunu, ''Aachilundu cha Jehova kuyoopegwa.''
Angelo wa Jehova wakayita Abbulahamu lwabili kuzwa kujulu
alimwi wati - mbubo oobu mbwaamba Jehova, ''Alwangu ndakonkezya kuti nkaambo kakuti wachita eechi chintu, akuti tewakaka amwana wako mulombe, mwana wako mulombe uumwi biyo,
nchobeni ndiyookulongezya alimwi ndiyoovuzya izyalane lyako mbuli nyenyeezi zyakujulu, alimwi mbuli museele uuli kunkomwe yalwizi; alimwi balunyungu lwako bayoovuba milyango yabasinkondonyina.
Kwiindila mubana bako zisi zyoonse zyaansi zyoolongezegwa, nkaambo waswiilizya ijwi lyangu.''
Akooko Abbulahamu wakabweeda kubaalumi bakwe baniini, alimwi bakanyampuka aantomwe baya ku Bbeyasebba, alimwi wakaakukkala ku Bbeyasebba.
Kwakaba kuti musule lyazeezi Abbulahamu wakalwiidwa kuti, ''Alakwe Milika wazyalila mwana wakwanu Naholi bana.''
Bakali Uzi mwana wakwe mutaanzi, Bbuzi mukulana wakwe, Kemuyeli wisi wa Alamu,
Kkesedi, Hazo, Pilidasyi, Jidilafu, a Bbetuyeli.
Bbetuyeli wakaba wisi wa Lebeka. Aaba mbana bali musanu abatatu Milika mbaakazyalila Naholi, mukulana wa Abbulahamu.
Simamambe wakwe, ooyo izina lyakwe lyakalikutegwa Lewuma, alakwe wakazyala Tebba, Gahamu, Tahasyi, aantomwe a Maaka.
Sala wakapona minyaka iili mwaanda amakumi obile amusanu ayibili. Eeyi njeminyaka  yabuumi bwa Sala.
Sala wakafwida mu Kiliyati Abba, nkokuti, mu Hebbuloni, muchisi cha Kkenani. Abbulahamu wakoomoka akulila Sala.
Mpawo Abbulahamu wakabuka alimwi wakazwa kumutunta wamukakwe, mpawo wakambula abana baHiti, wakati,
''Ndili muzwakule aakati kanu. Ikaka amundizumuzizye kuti nchite mavwikilo akati kanu, ikuti nkazike mufu wangu.''
Bana ba Heti bakasandula Abbulahamu, bakati,

''Swiilila ndiswe, simalelo wangu. Uli mwana wa mwaami wa Leza uli aakati kesu. Zika mufu wako kufumbwa nkosala kumavwikilo eesu mabotu. Takwe naba omwe aakati kesu uukonzya kukukasya mavwikilo aakwe, kuchitila kuti uvwike mufu wako.''
Abbulahamu wakabuka wakkotamina bantu banyika, kubana ba Heti.
Wakaambula ambabo, wakati, ''Na kamuzumina oobo kuti ndizike mufu wangu, mpawo amundiswiilile mpawo mundikumbilile kuli Efuloni mwana mulombe wa Zohali.
Mumukumbile kuti anduuzizye pako lyamumabwe aa Makkapela, ndyajisi, lili kumagolelo aamunda wakwe. Amuulo uuzwide nganduuzizye aantanganana nkabuli busena bwamavwikilo.''
Lino Efuloni wakalikkede aakati kabana balombe ba Heti, alimwi Efuloni mu Hiti wakavwiila Abbulahamu mukumvwa bana balombe ba Heti, aabo boonse bakanjila kumulyango wa dolopo, wakati,
''Pe, simalelo wangu , ndiswiilila. Ndakupa muunda, alimwi a pako lyamumabwe lili mukati. Ndawupa kulinduwe kumenso aabana balombe ba bantu bangu. Ndawupa kulinduwe kuti uzike bafu bako.''
Mpawo Abbulahamu wakakkotama lwakwe kunembo lyabantu banyika.
Wakaambula kuli Efuloni mumatwi abantu banyika, wakati, ''Pesi kuti kozumina, ikaka ndiswiilila. Ndiyowubbadalila muunda. Bweza mali kuzwa kulindime, alimwi ndiyoovwika mufu wangu ooko.''
Efuloni wakaavwiila Abbulahamu, wakati,
''Ikaka, simalelo wangu, swiilila kulindime. Chimpanzi chanyika hichita myaanda yone yama syekeli aa nsiliva, niinzi eecho aakati kangu anduwe? Zika mufu wako!''
Abbulahamu wakaswiilila Efuloni alimwi Abbulahamu wakeela imali ansiliva yakaambwa mumatwi aabana ba Heti, myaanda yone yama syekeli ansiliva mbuli mbubakali kweela basambazi.
Aboobo muunda wa Efuloni, wakali mu Makkepela, wakali aafwifwi a Mamule, nkokuti, muunda, apako mumabwe lyakali mukati, alimwi amisamu yoonse yakali mumuunda anyika yoonse iili mumugaano, yakapegwa
kuli Abbulahamu akuula aakati kabana ba Heti, kunembo lyabaabo boonse bakanjila kumulyango wedolopo lyakwe.
Musule lyacheechi, Abbulahamu wakazika Sala mukakwe mupako lyamabwe lyakali mumuunda wa Makkapela, iwakali aafwifwi ku Mamule, nkokuti, Hebbuloni, munyika ya Kkenani.
Aboobo muunda apako lyamabwe lyakali mukati lyakapegwa kuli Abbulahamu kuti alivube kuti bube busena bwamavwika bwazwa kubana balombe ba Heti.
Lino Abbulahamu wakali wachembaala loko alimwi Jehova wakali mulongezezye muzintu zyoonse.
Abbulahamu wakati kumulanda wakwe, ooyo wakali mupati kuli basin'anda bakwe alimwi wakali mubambi wazezyo nzyakali aazyo, ''Bika kuboko kwako kunsi achibelo changu
alimwi ndiyokuchita kuti ukakonke kuli Jehova, ooyo Leza wamajulu alimwi ooyo Leza wenyika, tokoyojani mwanakazi wa mwana wangu mulombe kuzwa kubana basimbi ba baKkenani, mbeyakide munzi aakati kabo.
Pesi iwe weelede kwiinka kunyika yakulindiswe, alimwi kunzubo zyangu, alimwi ukajanine mwanakazi mwana wangu mulombe Izaka.''
Mulanda wakati kulinguwe, ''Anikuti mwanakazi kaya kunditobelakunyika eyi? Ani ndikabweze na mwana wako ndikabwede awe kuzwa kunyika nkuwazwa?
Abbulahamu wakati kulinguwe, "Ba akasimpe kuti utakabwezi mwanaangu kuti ubwede awe okuya.

Jehova leza wakujulu,  oyo wakandigwisya kuzwa kunganda yandende alimwi kuzwa kunyika yanzubo zyangu, alimwi oyo wakandisyomezya chinkonke chinichini wakati, 'Ku lunyungu lwako ndiyokupa nyika eyi,' uyotuma angelo wakwe kunembo musulaako, alimwi uyojanina mwanaangu mulombe mwanakazi kuzwa ooko.
Pesi na mwanakazi katayandi kukutobela, mpawo iwe uyowangunuka ku chikonke changu. Luzutu iwe toyelede kubwedezya mwana wangu okuya.''
Aboobo mulanda wakabika kuboko kwakwe kunsi lyachibelo cha Abbulahamu simalelo wakwe, alimwi wakakonkezya kulinguwe aatala amajwi aaya.

Mulanda wakabweza kkumi lyambon'olo zya simalelo wakwe alimwi wakanyampuka. Wakabweza lubo anguwe zipo zyamisyobo yoonse kuzwa kuli simalelo wakwe. Wakanyampuka alimwi wakaya kubusena bwa Alam Nahaleyimi, kuchisi cha Neha.
Wakachita kuti mbongolo zyakwe zifugame aansi kunze lya chisi kumbali esawu lya manzi. Lyakali golezya, chiindi bakayintu nibaya kuyoteka manzi.
Mpawo wakati, ''Jehova, Leza wa simalelo wangu Abbulahamu, ndipe kuzwidilila sunu alimwi tondeezya chizuminano chisyomekede kuli simalelo wangu Abbulahamu.
Langa, aawa mpundiimvwi akasensa kamanzi, alimwi bana basimbi ba baalumi bachisi balasika kuzoteka manzi.

Leka zichitike oobu. Eelyo nindati kumwanakazi muniini, 'Ikaka tula nongo yako kuti nkanywe,' alimwi akatedi kulindime, 'Nywa, alimwi ndiyonywisya ankamela zyakoazilazyo, elyo abe nguwe oyo nguwe tondekela mulanda wako Izaka. Azezi ndiyo ziba kuti watondezya chizuminano chisyomekedekuli Simalelo wangu.
Kwaba kuti nikuba naka manisya kwambula, amulange, Lebekka wakaza anongo yakwe yamanzi amakkuko akwe. Lebekka wakazyalwa kuliBbetuweli mwana mulombe waMikka, mwanakazi waNaho, mukulana wa Abbulahama.
Mwanakazi munini wakali mubotu loko alimwi nkali nakalindu. Takazi mwalumi. Wakiinka ansi kukasensa, wazuzya nongo yakwe alimwi wakazwa.
Aboobo mulanda wakachijana kuyomuswanizya alimwi wati, " Ikaka ndipe nywe bunini manzi kuzwa munongo yako,"
wakati, "Nywa simalelo wangu," alimwi wakafwambana kutula nongo mumaboko akwe, alimwi wakamupa wanywa.
Elyo nakamana kumupa akunywa, wakati "Ndiyotekela ankamela zyako manzi azilazyo kusikila zikamane kunywa."
Elyo wakafwambana alimwi wapimpa nongo mumutiba , aboobo wakachijana lubo kusawu kukuteka manzi, alimwi wakatekela inkamela zyakwe zyoonse manzi.
Mwalumi wakamwebela chumunizi kuti abone kana Jehova wazwidilizya lwendo kana pe.
Mankamela nakamanisya kunywa, mwalumi wakagwisya chisila changolida chakala bulemu bwechisela chaShekkeli, alimwi anchoko zyangolida zyobile zyakumaboko zilabulemu buli maShekkeli makumi,
alimwi wakabuzya, "Uli mwana musimbi wani? Ndambile kaka, kulibusena na kunganda yawuso kuti swebo tukoone kwabusiku?"
Wakati kulinguwe, "Ndimwana musimbi wa Bbetuweli mwana mulombe waMikka, oyo ngwakazyala kuliNaho."
Wakati lubo kunguwe, "Tulabwingi bwizu alimwi azyakulya, alimwi abusena bwakoona kuti ukamanisye  busiku."
Elyo mwalumi wakakkotama aansi alimwi wakakkomba Jehova.

Wakati, " Ngalumbwe Jehova, Leza wasimalelo wangu Abbulahamu, wakatasiya chizuminano chakwe chakusyomeka alimwi kusyomekesya kuli simalelo wangu. Mbuli kuli ndime, Jehova wandizulwida wandilulamika kunganda yaLuzubo lwasimalelo wangu.
Elyo mwanakazi munini wakachijana alimwi wakabuzya basinganda yabanyina atala azintu ezi zyoonse.
Lino Lebekka wakali amunyandumi, alimwi izina lyakwe wakali Labbani. Labbani wakachijana kumwalumi wakali aanze kumugwagwa wakukasensa.

Elyo nakabona chisita alimwi anchoko kumaboko amuchizi, alimwi elyo nakamvwa mabala aLebekka muchizi wakwe, " Ezi nzizyo oyu mwalumi nzyawamba kulindime," wakinka kumwalumi alimwi akumubona, wakalimvwi kumbali ankamela zyakwe kukasensa.
Elyo Labbani wakati, "boola iwe nolongezedwe waJehova. Kaambonzi noyimvwi aanze? Ndakubambila nganda, alimwi abusena bwenkamela."
Aboobo mwalumi wakaza kunganda alimwi akwangununa nkamela. Nkamela zyakapegwa bwizu alimwi azyakulya, oyu mwalumi wakapegwa manzi akusamba mawulu akwe amawulu ababo mbakalabo.
Bakabika chakulya kunembo lyakwe kuti alye, asi wakati, " Nsikoyolya kusikila ndambe ezyo nzyeyelede kwamba." Aboobo Labbani wakati, "Ambula."
Wakati, "Ndilimulanda wa Abbulahamu.
Jehova  ulimulongezezye simalelo wangu alimwi waba mupati. Wakamupa mbelele angombe, ansiliva angolide, balanda balumi abanakazi, ankamela amadonki.
Sala, mwanakazzi wasimalelo wangu, wakazyala mwana mulombe kulisimalelo wangu mubuchembele bwakwe, alimwi wiisi wakamupa zyonse zyakwe.
Simalelo wangu wakandichita kuti ndikonke, kwamba kuti, 'Iwe toyelede kutolela mwanangu mwanakazi kubana babaKanana basimbi, munyika mundakayaka munzi.
Pesi kuti, welede kwiinka kumpuli yandende, alimwi kunzubo zyangu, alimwi ukajanine mwana wangu mwanakazi.'
Ndakati kuliSimalelo wangu, ' Amwi mwanakazi takoyonditobela.'
Asi wakati kulindime, Jehova, oyo ngwetobela uyotuma mungelo anduwe alimwi uyozwidilizya nzila yako, aboobo uyotolela mwanangu mwanakazi kuzwa kuluzubo lwangu alimwi kuzwa kumpuli yaluzubo lwandende.
Asi uyowangununwa muchikonke changu kuti wakuza kuluzubo lwangu alimwi batakukupa nguwe. Elyo uyowangununwa kucikkonke changu.'
Aboobo ndasika sunu kutusensa, alimwi ndati, 'O Jehova, Leza wasimalelo wangu Abbulahamu ikaka, kuti nkochita mukwambisya nkopanga lwendo lwangu luzwidilile -
Ano mpwebede ndimvwi kumbali akasensa kamanzi - leka oyo mwanakazi uza kukuteka manzi, ngundiyowambila kuti, " Ikaka ndipe twanzi tuche munongo ndinwe,"
Mwanakazi uyoti kulindime "Nywa, alimwi ndiyotekela ankamela zyako maanzi " - abe nguwe nguwasalila mwana wasimalelo wangu.'
Nkesena manisya kwambula mumoyo wangu, Lebekka wakaza anongo yakwe amakukko alimwi wakaya ansi kukasensa alimwi wakakuteka manzi. Aboobo ndakati kulinguwe, 'Ikaka ndinywisye.
'Wakafwambana kuseluzya nongo yakwe kuzwa amakkuko alimwi wakati, 'Nywa, alimwi ndiyopa nkamela zyako manzi azilazyo.' Aboobo ndakanywa , alimwi wakanywisya nkamela azilazyo.
Ndakamubuzya alimwi ndati, ulimwanani webo? Wakati  ndilimwana musimbi waBbetuweli, mwana mulombe waNaho ngwakazyalilwa aMikka.' Elyo ndamubika chisita mumpemo alimwi anchoko kumaboko akwe.

Elyo ndakavundama ansi alimwi ndakakomba Jehova, alimwi ndalongezya Jehova, Leza wasimalelo wangu Abbulahamu, oyo wakandenzya munzila mbotu kuti ndijane musimbi wamwana wasimalelo wangu kunzubo zyakwe.

Nkikaako, kuti kamulibambilide kunditondezya luyando luteli alimwi akusyomeka kuli simalelo wangu, mundambile, pesi kuti pe mundambile lubo, kwitila kuti ndizibe kuti ndelede kulanga kululyo kana kuchimwensi."
Elyo Labbani aBbetuweli bakasandula alimwi bati, "Chintu chazwa kuli Jehova, tatukonzyi kwambula ayebo zibi na zibotu.
Langa, Lebekka ezi zilikulinduwe. Mubweze alimwi wende, aboobo, antela walikuyoba mwanakazi wasimalelo wako, mbuli Jehova mbakamba."
Elyo mulanda waAbbulahamu nakamvwa majwi abo, wakakotama ansi enyika kunembo lyaJehova.
Mulanda waketa zilongo zyansiliva azilongo zyangolida, azikobela akuzipa Lebekka. Wakapa lubo zipo ziyandisi kumunyandumi wakwe akuli banyina.
Elyo we abalumi mbakalabo bakalya akunywa. Bakakkala nkukoko busiku boonse, nibakabuka kuseni, wakati, "Amunditume ndiye kulisimalelo wangu."
Munyandumi wakwe abanyina bakati, "Leka mwanakazi munini akale andiswe kwamazuba mache, ambweni alikkumi. Musule aaya ulenda."
Pesi wakati kulimbabo, " Mutandijalili, Kambo Jehova wandizwidilizya munzila yangu. Amunditume munzila yangu kuti ndiye kuli simalelo wangu."
Bakati, " Tulita mwanakazi munini alimwi tubuzye."
Aboobo bakamwita Lebekka alimwi bamubuzya, "Ulinka na amwalumi oyo? " Wakasandula, " Ndilinka."
Aboobo bakazumizya muchizi wabo Lebekka, antomwe amulanda wakwe mwanakazi, mulwendo lwamulanda waAbbulahamu abalumi bakwe.
Bakalongezya Lebekka, alimwi bakati kulinguwe, " Muchizi wesu, ukabe banyina bezyulu zilikkumi zyazyulu, alimwi lunyungu lwako lukavube milyango yababo batakuyandi."
Elyo Lebekka wakanyampuka alimwi we abalanda bakwe basimbi bakatanta nkamela, alimwi bakatobela mwalumi. Aboobo mulanda wakabweza Lebekka alimwi winka munzila yakwe.
Lino Izaka wakali kukala kuNegevi alimwi wakali wakali wabola kuzwa kuBbiya Lahayi Loyi.
Izaka wakinka anze kukuyesesya mulukuba golezya. Elyo nakalanga kunembo, wakabona nkamela kaziyobuza!
Lebekka nakalanga alimwi elyo wakabona Izaka wakasotokela ansi kuzwa enkamela.
Wakati kumulanda, ngwani oyu mwalumi uyobwenda mumunda kuti aswanizye ndiswe?" Mulanda wakati, " Ngusimalelo wangu." Wakabweza veyili, alimwi walivumba.
Mulanda wakapandulwida Izaka zyonse zintu nzyakachita.
Elyo Izaka wakamweta mutente lyabanyina Sala, alimwi wakabweza Lebekka, alimwi wakaba mwanakazi wakwe, alimwi wakamuyanda. Aboobo, Izaka wakumbulizigwa musule akufwa kwabanyina.
Abbulahamu naakabweza uumbi mwanakazi; izina lyakwe wakali Kketula.
Wakamuzyalila Zimulani, Jokoshani, Medani,Midiyani, Ishibbeki, a Shuwa.
Jokoshani wakaba wisi a Shebba a Dedani bakali bantuma a Siliyeni, Letushi, alimwi abantuma Lewumi.
Bana balombe ba Midiyeni bakali ba Efaha,  Efa, Hanoku, Abbida, a Eludaha. Boonse aba bakali babuzyalane bwa Ketula.
Abbulahamu wakapa zyoonse nzyakavubide kuli Aizekki. Nikuba boobo, awo nakachilikupona, wakapa zipo
kubana balombe babamwi banakazi akubatandila kunyika yakubuzyezuba, kule a Ayizekki, mwana wakwe.
Aaya akali mazuba amyaka yabuumi bwa Abbulahamu njaakapona, imwaanda amakkumi musanu ama kkumi obile aali aminyaka musanu.
Abbulahamu wakayoya chakwelelezya alimwi wafwa mumwelwe mubotu wachiimo chakukomena, imwalumi mupati uuli abuumi buzwide alimwi wakali bungikene kubantu bakwe.
Ayizekki a  Ishumayeli, bana bakwe balombe bakaamuvwika munkumbwi  ya Makkipelaha, mumuunda wa Efoloni. Mwana mulombe  wa Zohola mu Hitayiti, uuli afwifwi a mamule.
Ooyu muunda Abbulahamu wakali wuula kuzwa kubana balombe ba Hitayiti. Abbulahamu wakavwikkwa nkukooko  amwanakazi wakwe sala.
Musule alufu lwa Bbulahamu, Leza wakalongezya Ayizekki mwana wakwe mulombe, alimwi Ayizekki wakakkede afwifwi a BiyaLahayi Loyi.
Lino aba bakali babuzyalane bwa Isyumayeli, mwana mulombe wa Abbulahamu, Hagali muna Ijipiti, mubelesi wa sala, ngwakazyala kuli Abbulahamu.
Aya akali mazina abana balombe ba Isyumayeli, mbuuli mukutobelana kwabo mukuzyalwa: Nebbayiyoti mutaanzi kuzyalwa kuli Isyumayeli, Keda, Adibbela, Mibbisamu,
Mishima, Duma, Masa,
Hadadi, Tema, Jeta, Napishi, a kkedema.
Aaba bakali bana balombe ba Isyumayeli, aya akali mazina abo, kumyunzi yabo, amumayakalane aabo; ikkumi ababaili bana balombe babwaami mbuuli mumisyobo yabo
Eeyi yakali minyaka yabuumi bwa Ishumayeli, mwanda amakkumi otatwe  amuasanu aminyaka yobile. Wakayoya kwamwelelezyo akwe mpawo wafwa ,alimwi kulibunga kubantu bakwe.
Bakapona kuzwa ku Havila kusika ku Ashawu, oko kufwifwi aku Ijipiti, kuti umwi kayenda kalangilide ku Asiliya. Bakapona mukusulana kuli umwi awumwi.
Eezi nzizyakachitika kazilangene a Ayizekki, mwana mulombe wa Abbulahamu.  Abbulahamu wakaba wisi wa Ayizekki.
Ayizekki wakali aminyaka yakuzyalwa ili makkumi one awo nakabweza Libbekka mbuuli mwanakazi wakwe, mwana musimbi wa Bbetuwelu  imu Alamini waku Padani Alamu, muchizi wa Labbani imu Alamiyeni.
Ayizekki wakakomba kuli Jehova kuchitila mwanakazi wakwe, alimwi Jehova wakasandula nkombyo yakwe, alimwi Libbekka mwanakazi wakwe wakaba abula.
Ibana bakaputuuka antomwe mulinguwe, alimwi wakati,'' nkaambonzi ezi nizilikuchitika kulindime?'' wakayinka kukubuzya Jehova atala achechi.
Jehova wakati kulinguwe,'' izisi zyobile zili mubula  wako , alimwi bantu bobile bayowanzanisigwa kuzwa mulinduwe. Muntu omwe uyoba anguzu kwiinda umwi, alimwi mupati uyogwasya munini.''
Nichakaba chiindi chakuti atumbuke, amubone, mwakali mabile mubula bwakwe.
Mwana mutaanzi wakazwa aanze kasalala koonse mbuuli chisamo chilaaboya. bakamwiita zina lyakwe kuti ngu Isawu.

Musule aboobo, mwanike wakwe wakazwa aanze. Kuboko kwakwe kwakajisilidi kasindi ka Isawu. Wakayitwa kuti Jakkobbu. Ayizekki wakali aminyaka yakuzyalwa ili makkumi musanu alimwi nakabatumbuka mwanakazi wakwe.
Bakakkomena balombe, alimwi Isawu wakaba muvwimi uuli aluzibo, mwaluumi wamuuda, pesi Jakkobbu wakali mwaalumi uuwumwine, wakali kumana chiindi chakwe muzibbakasa.
Lino Ayizekki wakali kuyanda Isawu nkaambo wakali kulya banyama mbakali kuvwima, pesi Libbekka wakali kuyanda Jakkobbu.
Jakkobbu wakajika musinza. Isawu wakasika kuzwa kumulimu, alimwi wakali demukide mumafuwa.
Isawu wakati kuli Jakkobbu, '' ndisanine amusinza oyu usalala. Inche, ndakatala!'' Nkinkaako izina lyakwe  lyakayitwa kuti Edomu.
Jakkobbu wakati,'' saansina nduuzizye chelelo chako chakuzyalwa.''
Isawu wakati,'' Bona,ndaamba kufwa. mbubotuunzi chelelo chakuzyalwa kulindime ?''
Jakkobbu wakati,''talika ukonkezye kulindime,'' aboobo Isawu wakakonkezya chikonke alimwi muli eeyonzila wakawuzya cheelelo chakwe chakuzyalwa kuli Jakkobbu.
Jakkobbu wakapa Isawu chibunge amusinza wa Lentulusi. Wakalya akunywa, wanyampuka akweenda munzila yakwe. Mukuchita boobu Isawu wakanyansya cheelelo chakwe chakuzyalwa.
Lino inzila yakaba munyika, kutali inzila ntaanzi yakaliwo mumazuba a Abbulahamu. Ayizekki wakiinka kuli Abbimeleki, mwami wamu Filisitiya ku Gela.
Lino Jehova wakalibonia kuli nguwe akuti,'' utayinki ku Ijipita,'' pona munyika eyo njindakakubuzya kuti upone mulinjiyo.

Kkala munyika njiyeeyi, alimwi ndiyooba anduwe alimwi ndiyookulongezya, mbuuli kuli nduwe alimwi akuzyalane lyako, ndiyookupa nyika eezi zyoonse  alimwi ndiyokuzizikizya chikonke echo nchindakakukonkezya kuli Abbulahamu wuso.
Ndiyovuzya zyalane lyako mbuuli nyenyezi zyakujulu, alimwi ndiyoopa kuzyalane lyako nyika eezi. Kwiinda muzyalane lyako zisi zyoonse zyanyika ziyoolongezegwa.
Ndiyochita echi nkaambo Abbulahamu wakalemeka jwi lyangu alimwi wakabamba malayilile angu.''
Aboobo Ayizekki wakakkala mu Gela.

Elyo mwaalumi wabusena naakamubuzya aatala amwanakazi wakwe, wakati,'' muchizi wangu.'' wakwaamba kuti mwanakazi wangu,'' nkaambo wakayeeya kuti,'' mwaalumi wabusena oobu ulandijaya kuti abweze Libbekka, nkaambo mubotu loko.''
Kali Ayizekki waba oko kwachiindi chilamfu Abbimelekki, mwaami wama  Filisitiya zyakachitika kalangide anze aampulumguzyo wakalanga, wabona, Ayizekki kaliikubukusa Libbekka, mwanakazi wakwe.

Abbimelekki wakayita Ayizekki kuli nguwe alimwi wakati,'' Langa,nchobeni mwanakazi wako. Nkaambonzi niwati, 'muchizi wangu ?' '' Ayizekki wakati kuli nguwe,'' Nkaambo ndayeeya kuti umwi ulabona wandijaya kuti amubweze.''
Abbimelekki wakati,'' Niinzi eechi nchuwatuchitila ? umwi wabantu ulabona chamuubila koona amwanakazi wako, alimwi wayinoyeta mulandu alindiswe.''
Aboobo Abbimelekki wakachenjezya bantu boonse alimwi wakati,'' kufumbwa uujata mwaalumi ooyu nikuba mwanakazi wakwe kasimpe uyoobikkwa kulufu.''
Ayizekki wakabyala zilyo munyika eyo alimwi wakatebula muli nguwo munyaka mwaanda ayindulwidwe, Jehova wakamulongezya.
Mwaalumi wakabaabwami, alimwi wakakkomena akukkomena alimwi zyingi kusika kusikila waba mulemu.
Wakali aambele zyiingi angombe, ampuli, mpati. Mafilisitiya bakabaabbivwe kulinguwe.
Lino zikkala zyoonse zyakasyidwe abalanda bawisi mumazuba Abbulahamu wisi, Ma Filisitiya
bakazyiimikizya akuzizuzya muse. Abbimelekki wakati kuli Ayizekki,'' zwa awa kulindiswe, mbuuli kuti ulaanguzu kwiinda ndiswe.''
Aboobo Ayizekki wakeenda kuzwa awo alimwi wakaakukkala mumumpata  wa Gela,alimwi wakapona nkukoko.

Alubo Ayizekki wakafukulula lubo zikkala zyamanzi, nzibakasyide mumazuba Abbulahamu wisi. Mafilisitiya bakali bazimikizya kuzwa naakafwa  Abbulahamu . Ayizekki wakayita zikkala amazina omwe ayo wisi ngakakali kuzyita.
Chiindi balanda ba Ayizekki nibakasya mumampata, bakajana  nkukooko chikkala chizwa maanzi ayenda.
Bembeli ba Gela bakalikukkazyania abeembeli ba Ayizekki, alimwi bakati,'' Aya maanzi ngeesu.'' A boobo Ayizekki wakayita chikkala eecho kuti Isekki,'' nkambo bakakkazyania anguwe.
Mpawo bakasya chimbi chikkala, alimwi bakakkazyania anchicho, lubo , aboobo wakachipa zina lya ''Silna.''
Wakazwa oko alimwi wakasya lubo chimbi chikkala, pesi tebakakazyania atala anchicho. Aboobo wakachuuzika kuti Liwoboti, alimwi awakati,''Lino Jehova watupa mweenya alimwi tuyozwidilila munyika.''
Mpawo Ayizekki wakeenda kuzwa awo kusika ku Bbiyeshebba.

Jehova wakalibonia kulinguwe mansiku ngayayo alimwi wakati,'' Ndime Leza wa Abbulahamu wuso. Utayoowi, ndilaanduwe alimwi ndiyokulongezya alimwi ndiyo vuzya izyalane, nkaambo kamulanda wangu Abbulahamu.
Ayizekki wakayaka chipayililo nkukooko alimwi wayita kuzina lya Jehova. Oko wakasyidila tente lyakwe, alimwi balanda bakwe bakasya chikkala.
Mpawo Abbimelekki wakeenda kulinguwe kuzwa ku Gela, kali a Ahuzati, mwenzinyina, a Fikkolu, mupati waba silumamba bakwe.
Ayizekki wakati kuli mbabo,'Nkaambonzi nimuza kulindime, mbuunga ulandizonda alimwi wanditandila kule kuzwa kulinduwe?''
Mpawo bakati,'' Twabona chaantanganana kuti Jehova walaanduwe. Aboobo twayeeya kuti kwede kube chikonke akati kesu, iyi, akati kesu anduwe. Aboobo atuchite chizuminanao anduwe,
Kuti taakwe, nikuyo tuchisa, mbuuli mbutwakatakuchisa, alimwi mbuuli mbutwakakaujata obotu alimwi twakakweenzya mulumuno. Nchobeni, alimwi ulilongezezegwe a Jehova.''
Áboobo Ayizekki wakachita pobwe kuli mbabo alimwi bakalya akunywa.
Bakabuka chifumofumo, alimwi bakakonka chikonke kuli umwi awumwi. Mpawo Ayizekki wakati ngababweede, alimwi bakamusiya muluumuno.
Ndilyonya ndilelyo zuba balanda ba Ayizekki bakaza alimwi bakamubuzya atala achikkala nchibakali basya. Bakati,'' twaajana maanzi.''
Wakayita chikkala kuti Shibba, aboobo izina lya muunzi oyo litegwa Biyeshebba kusika sunu.
Eelyo Isawu naakaba aminyaka ili makkumi aane, wakakkwata mwanakazi Juditi mwana musimbi waBiiyeli mu Hitayiti, alubo Basemati mwana musimbi wa Eleni mu Hitayiti.
Bakeeta nsoni kuli Ayizeki a Lebeka.
Lino Ayizekki wakali wachembaala ameso akwe akali agubi kuti takachili kubonape, wakayita Isawu, mwana mupati, akwamaba kuti kuli nguwe,'' Mwanaangu.'' Isawu wakati kuli nguwe,'' Ndilaano.''
alimwi Ayizekki wakati,''bona awa, Ndachembaala, Tandizi buzuba bwakufwa kwangu.
Nkinkaako bweza zivwimyo zyako, inkomo yako abuta bwako, akuya mulusaka akuyondivwimina munyama.
Undichitile chakulya chinono, mbubonya mbuli mbiyandisya, akwileta kulindime kuti ndilye akukulongezya nkitanaafwa.''
Lino Libbekka wakamvwa chiindi Ayizekki nakali kwambula a Isawu mwanaakwe. Isawu wakaya mulusaka kukuyovwima munyama akumweta.
Libbekka wakaambila Jakkobbu mwanaakwe akwamba kuti,'' bona awa, Ndamvwa wuso kawambuulaa a Isawu mukulana wako. wakati,
'undetele nyama yamulusaka akundichitila chakulya  chinono, kuti ndilye mpawo ndikulongezye kunembo lya Jehova kanditanaafwa.'
Lino nkinkaako, mwanaangu, swilila jwi lyangu mbuuli mbikulayilila.
Koya kubutanga akundiletela mpongo zibili zyebeka; alimwi ndiyokuchitila chakulya chinonokuzwa kuli mbabo kuzwa kuli wuso, mbuuli mbayanda.
Ukamutolele wuso,  kuti akiilye, kuti akulongezye kalutana sika kufu lwakwe.''
Jakkobbu wakati kuli Libekka banyina,''Bona, Isawu mukkulana wangungusimavwele, mpawo ime ndibulungusene.
Alimwi ndeende akandigume, alimwi ndiyoba mbuuli silweno. Ndiyoleta lutuko aalindime akutalongezegwa.''
Banyina bakati kulinguwe,'' Mwanaangu, leka lutuko lube alindime. swiilila jwi lyangu , alimwi akwiinka, ubeete kulindime.''
Elyo Jakkobbu wayinka akubweza tupongo akututola kuli banyina, alimwi banyina bakachita kulya kunono, mbuuli wisi mbwakali kuyanda.
Libbekka wakabweza zyakusama zibotu zya Isawu, mwana wakwe mupati, nzyaakalazyo munganda,akusamika Jakkobbu, mwana wakwe munini.
Wakamuzambilila zikkumba zyabana bampongo mumaboko akwe amunsingo yakwe.
Wakabika kulya kunono ansima eeyonjakabambide mumaboko amwana wakwe Jakkobbu.
Jakkobbu wakaya kuli wisi mpawo wakuti,'' Ndeende wangu.'' Wisi wakati,'' Ndili ano; nduweni, mwanaangu?''
Jakkobbu wakati kuli wisi, ''Ndime Isawu mwana wako mutaanzi. Ndachita mbuuli mbuwamba kuli ndime. Lino kkala akulya imwi nyama yamusokwe, kuti undilongezye.''
Ayizekki wakati kumwanaakwe,''wafwambaana biyeni kwijana, mwanaangu?'' wakati,'' Nkaambo Jehova Leza wako wandiletela.''
Ayizekki wakati kuli jakkobbu,'' kweza afwifwi andime, kuti ndikugume, mwanaangu, akwiiya kuti ulimwana wanguna choonzyo Isawu na pe.''
Jakkobbu wakaya kuli Ayizekki wisi wakwe; alimwi Ayizekki wakamuguma akwaamba,'' ijwindijwi lya Jakkobbu, pesi maboko maboko a Isawu,.''
Ayizekki tewakamuziba pe, nkaambo maboko akwe akali amavwele, mbuuli maboko amukkulana wakwe Isawu, aboobo Ayizekki wakamulongezya.
Wakati,'''Nduwena mwanaangu Isawu?'' wakasandula,'' Ndime.''

Ayizekki wakati, eta kulya kuli ndime, mpawo ndilye nyama yako yamusokwe, kuti ndika kulongezye.'' Jakkobbu wakaleta kulya kuli nguwe. Ayizekki wakalya alimwi Jakkobbu wakaleta wayini, mpawo wakanywa.
Mpawo wisi Ayizekkiwakati kulinguwe, kuza afwifwi lino mpawo undimyonte, mwanaangu.''
Jakkobbu wakaza afwifwi akumumyonta, mpawo wakamununkizya bweema bwazisamo zyakwe mpawo wakamulongezya. Wakati ,'' Bona, ibwema bwa mwanaangu buli mbuli bwema bwamuunda oyu Jehova ngwakalongezya.
Nichabota Leza akupe chimpanzi chamuume wakujulu, chimpanzichamafuta amunyika, azilyo zyiingi awayini mupya.
Chilabota bantu bakubelekele amasi bakuvundamine. Ukabe mwami akkati kabakkulana bako, Alimwi nichabota bana babanyoko bakakukkkotamine, awoonse ukutuka akatukwe, alongezegwe woonse ukulongezya.''
Mbaakakmana biyo Ayizekki kulongezya Jakkobbu, alimwi Jakkobbu wakanywebuka kuzwa munsi lya wisi Ayizekki, Isawu mukulana wakwe wakaboola kuzwa kukuvwima.
Alimwi wakajika kulya kunono akutola kuli wisi. Wakati kuli wisi,'' Ndeende, buka ulye imwi nyama yamusokwe, kuti ukandilongezye.''
Ayizekki wisi wakwe wakati kuli nguwe,'' Nduweni?'' wakati, Ndime mwana wako, mutaanzi, Isawu.''
Ayizekki wakakankamaloko akwamba kuti,'' Nngwani wakavwima nyama yamusokwe akwileta kulindime?'' Ndakiilya lyoonse kotanakusika, mpawo ndamulongezya. Nchobeni, uyoolongezegwa.''
Elyo Isawu nakaamvwa majwi awisi, wakalila akulilila kupati, alimwi wakati kuli wisi,'' Ndilongezye, mebo alimwi,ndeende.?
Ayizekki wakati,'' Mukkulana wako waza ano achalweno akubweza zilongezyo zyako.''
Isawu wakati,'' sa tewawuzikwa Jakkobbu?''Nkaambo wandeena tubili. Wandibwezela bupati bwangu, alimwi, bona, lino wabweza chilongezyo changu.'' Mpawo wakati, ''Tewandibambila zilongezyo zyangu na?''

Ayizekki wakasandula akwaamba kuli Isawu, ''Langa, ndamuchita simalelo wako, alimwi ndamupeda banike bakwe boonse mbuuli bazike bawe, akumupa zilyo awayini. Ndikuchitilenzi chimbi, mwanaangu mulombe?''
Isawu wakati kuli wisi,'' tokwe chimbi na chilongezyo changu,ndeende,Ndilongezye, andime,ndeende.? Isawu wakalila chakoompolola
Ayizekki wisi wakwe wakasandula  akwamba kuti kulinguwe,'' Langa, busena mbuyokkala buyoba kule kuzwa kubuvubi bwanyika, kuzwa kule amume atala lyanyika.
Uyopona apanga, alimwi uyobelekela mwanikaako. Pesi eelyo wakumubukila, uyozungania mukkuli wakwe kuzwa kunsingo yako.''
Isawu wakasula Jakkobu nkaambo kachilongezyo eecho wisi nchakamupa. Isawu wakati mumoyo wakwe,'' Mazuba aakulila ndeende abafwifwi; akwinda ndiyo jaya mwanike wangu Jakkobbu.''
Majwi a Isawu mwana wakwe mupati akambila Libbekka. Lino wakatuma akwiita Jakkobbu mwana wakwe munini akwamba kuli nguwe,'' Bona, mukulana wako Isawu ulakanza atala anduwe akubamba kukujaya
Lino nkinkaako, mwanaangu, ndiswiilile akuchijila kuli Labbani, kumunyaandumi wangu mu Halani
ukkale anguwe kayindi kanini, kusikila aleke kunyema kwakwe.
Kusikila kunyema kwamukkulana wako kumane kuli nduwe, akuluba ezyo nziwakamuchitila. Mpawo ndiyotuma akukuboozya kuzwa ooko.  Nhaambonzi nintamuswekelwe moonse kamulibabili mubuzuba bomwe?

Libbekka wakati kuli Ayizekki.'' bwandikataazya buumi nkambo kabana basimbi ba Heti. Na Jakkobbu wabweza umwi wabana ba basimbi ba Heti mbuuli mwanakazi, mbuuli banakazi aba, bamwi bana basimbi bamunyika, mbubotuunzi buyoba mubuumi kuli ndime.?''
Izekki wakayita Jakkobbu, akumulongezya akumulayilila ,  ''  toyelede kukwata mwanakazi pe kuzwa kubanakazi  baku Kkenani.
Buka, koya ku  Padamu Alamu, kunganda ya Bbetuweli wisi wabanyoko akukwata mwanakazi uuzwa oko, umwi wabana ba Labbeni, munyaandumi wabanyoko.
Nechakonzeka Leza simanguzu akulongezye, akuzyazye akukuvuzya, kuchitila kuti mukabe makamu aabantu .
Nechakonzeka amupe choolwe cha Abbulahamu kulinduwe, alimwi kulunyungu lwakwe muluse lwako, ikuti mukakone nyika eeyo nkomwakali kukkala, eeyo Leza njaaka mupa Abbulahamu.''
Aboobo Izeyikki wakatuma Jakkobu.Jakkobu wakaya ku Padamu Alamu, kuli Labbani mwana wa Bbetuweli mu Alamu, munyaandumi wa Libbeka, banyina Jakkobbu a Isawu.

Lino Isawu wakabona kuti Isakki wakalongezya Jakkobbu akumutuma ku Padani  Alamu, koya kwata nkukooko. Wakabona alimwi kuti Izekki wakamulongezya akumupa malayilile, kuti,'' Toyelede kukwata mwanakazi uuzw ku Kkenani.''
Isawu wakabona alubo kuti Jakkobbu wakaswilila wisi abanyina, alimwi wakiinka ku Paddani Alamu.
Isawu wakabona kuti banakazi baku Kkenani  tabamubotezyi pe Ayizekki wisi.
Aboobo wakiinka kuli Isyumayeli,akukkwata, kunze kwabanakazi aabo mbakalabo, Mahalati mwana musimbi wa  Isyumayeli, mwana mulombe wa Abbulahamu muchizi wa Nebbayoti, kuti abe mukakwe.
Jakkobbu wakazwa ku  Bbalisebba akweenda kuya ku Halani.
wasika aali bumwi busena  alimwi wakakkala aawo mansiku woonse, nkambo izuba lyakali lyabbila, Wakabweza lyamabbwe aakulobo busena,  wakalisegela,akulala aansi kulobo busena kuti awone.
Wakabona akulota muntambiliko uuzwa aansi, impela yawo yakasika kujulu abangelo ba Leza bakali kutanta aali nguwo.
Boona, Jehova wakaliimvwi aajulu aawo akwaamba kuti,'' Ndime Jehova, Leza wa Abbulahamu wuso, alimwi Leza wa  Ayizekki. Busena aawo mpolede, Ndiyoopa kulinduwe akulunyungu lwako.

Lunyungu lwako luyooba mbuuli lusuko lwanyika, alimwi muyoosaalila koosika kububbila, kuya kubuzwezuba, kuya kunyika, akumusanza kwiindila muli nduwe akwiindila kulunyungu lwako impuli zyoonse zyanyika ziyo lingezegwa
.Boona, ndinoli aayebo  alimwi ndiyokubamba kufumbwa nkotakaye. Ndiyokuboozya lubo kuliino nyika; akaako nsikoyokusiya pe. Ndiyokuchitila zyoonse eezyo nzindakakusyomezya.''
Jakkobbu wakasinsimuka kuzwa kungonzi, mpawo wakatii,''  Nchobeni Jehova mwali mubusena oobuno, alimwi teendazi pe.''
Wakayoowa akwamba kuti,'' Buyoosya biyeni busena oobu ! Nchobeni eyi ninganda ya Leza. oyu mulyango wakujulu.''
Jakkobbu wakabuka achifumo akubweza bbwe elyo ndyakasegede. Wakalyiimikizya mbuuli musemu akulitila  mafuta ajulu aalyo.
Wakabuuzika busena oobo kuti Bbeteli, pesi zina lyaboobo busena lyakazibinkene kuti Luzi.
Jakkobbu wakakkonkezya chikonke, wamba,'' Naa Leza wabaandime akuyondibamba munzila eyi njendiyobwenda, akundipa nsima kuti ndilye, akundipa zizwaato kuti ndizwaate,
kuchitila kuti ndikabweede kabotu kunganda yandeende,mpawo Jehova uyoba  Leza wangu.
Mpawo eeli bbwe ndindachita musemu liyoba liyoba bbwe lisalala. Kuzwa kuli zyoonse nzyondipa nchobeni ndiyogwisya chakkumi akubwedezya kulinduwe.''
Mpawo Jakkobbu wakeenda mulwendo lwakwe akusika kunyika yabantu bakujwe.

Naakalanga, wakabona chikkala mumuunda, alimwi, bona, matanga aatatu ambelele akali lede ambali lyacho. Nkaambo kuzwa kuchikkala echo bakali kunywisya matanga, abbwe lijalide mulomo wachikkala echolyakali pati.
Elyo matanga nalikubungana nkuko ,beembeli bakakungulusya bbwe kuzwa kumulomo wachikkala akunywisya mbelele, akubika ibbwe alubo atala amulomo wachikkala, kubwedezya abusena bwalyo.
Jakkobbu wakati, kulimbabo,'' Nobakwesu muzwa kuli? Bakasandula,'' Tuzwa kuli Halani.''
Wakati kuli mbabo,'' mulimuzina  Labbani mwana wa  Naho?'' Bakati'' Tulimuzi.''
Wakati kulimbabo,'' ulikabotu na?'' Bakati'' ulikabotu,  alubo, Langa okiya, Lakkeli mwanaakwe musimbi uleza ambelele.''
Jakkobbu wakati,'' mubone, mpaakati kabuzuba. Tachili chiindi chamatanga kuti abunganisigwe antomwe. Mwelede kunywisya mbelele akwenda mpawo muzileke zikachele.''
Bakati,'' Tatukonzyi kuzinywisya kusikila matanga woonse abunganisigwe antomwe. Baalumi mbibayakulungisya ibbwe kuzwa kumulomo wachikkala,mpawo tuyonywisya mbelele.''
Jakkobbu nakachili kwambula ambabo, Lakkeli wakaza ambelele zyawisi, nkaambo wakali kuzyembela.

Eelyo Jakkobbu nakabona Lakkeli, mwana musimbi wa Labbani, munyaandumi wabanyina, ambelele zya Labbani, munyaandumi wabanyina, Jakkobbu wakeza kunembo, wakulungusya bbwe kuzwa kumulomo wachikkala akunywisya tanga lya Labbani, munyaandumi wabanyina.
Jakkobbu wakamyonta Lakkeli akulilisya.
Jakkobbu wakambila Lakkeli kuti wakali luzubo lwawisi, akuti wakali mwana wa Libbekka. Mpawo wakachijaana akuyobuzya wisi.
Elyo Jakkobbu nakamvwa makani atala amwana wamuchizi wakwe, wakachijaana kuyomuswaana, wamukumbata, wamumyonta, akumuleta kunganda yakwe. Jakkobbu wakambila Labbani zyoonse zintu ezi.
Labbani wakati kulinguwe,'' ulifuwa lyangu anyamaa yangu loko.'' mpawo Jakkobbu wakakkala anguwe kwakachibe mwezi omwe.
Mpawo Labbani wakati kuli Jakkobbu,'' uyondibelekela biyo na nkambo kakuti ulilizubo? Ndaambile, niyi chiyoba mufolo wako?
Lino Labbani wakali abana basimbi bali babili. Zina lyamupati wakali Liya, azina lyamuniini wakali Lakkeli.
Meso a Liya akali abulilila, pesi Lackeli wakali mubotu muchiimo amukubonwa.
Jakkobbu wakayanda Lakkeli, mpo wakati,'' Ndilabelekela Lakkeli kwaminyaka ili musanu ayibili, mwanaako musimbi munini.''
Labbani wakati,'' chalimbubo kuti ndikupe nguwe, kwinda kuti ndimupe uumbi mwalumi. Kkala andime.''
Nkokuti Jakkobbu wakabelekela Lakkeli kwaminyaka ilimusanu ayibili ;alubo chakaboneka kuli nguwe kali amazuba mache biyo, akambo kaluyando ndwakalalo kuli nguwe.
Mpawo Jakkobbu wakati kuli Labbani,'' Ndipe mwanakazi wangu, nkaambo mazuba angu azulila kuchitila kuti ndimukkwate!''
mpawo Labbani wakabungaania antomwe boonse baalumi bachilawu akuchita pobwe.
Mumansiku, Labbani wakabweza mwanaakwe  musimbi Liya akumuleta kuli Jakkobbu, oyo wakoonawe.
Labbani wakapa mubelesi wakwe wachanakazi zilipa mumwanaakwe Liya, kuti abe mubelesi wakwe.
Kuseni, bona, wakali Liya! Jakkobbu wakati kuli Labbani, '' Niinzi eechi nchiwachita kulindime? Tendakabelelkela Lakkeli na kuli nduwe? nkaambo nzi mpo niwandichengela?''
Labbani wakati,'' Tachili chiyanza chesu kupa mwana musimbi munini kutali kuti mutaanzi kukuzyalwa.
Maninsya mviki yabwiinga yamwana musimbi oyu , alubo tuyokupa uumbi lubo mukuyondibeekela imbi minyaka ili musanu ayibili.''
Jakkobbu wakachita obo, akumaninsya mviki ya Liya. Mpawo Labbani wakamupa Lakkeli mwanaakwe musimbi mbuuli mmwanakazi wakwe alakwe.
Labbani alubo wakati bbila kumwanaakwe musimbi Lakkeli, kuti abe mubelesi wakwe.
Mpawo  Jakkobbu wakoonawe awe Lakkeli, alakwe, pesi wakali kuyanda Lakkeli kwiinda Liya. Mpawo Jakkobbu wakabelekela Labbani minyaka ili musanu ayibili imbi.
Jehova wakabona kuli Liya wakatali kuyandwa, mpawo wakamujula zyalilo lyake, pesi Lakkeli takali abana.
Liya wakaminta akuzyala mwana mulombe, akumwita zina lya Lubbeni. Nkaambo wakati,'' Akambo kakuti Jehova walanga atala amakataazyo angu; nchobeni lino mulumi wangu uyakundiyanda.''
Mpawo wakaminta alubo akuzyala mwana mulombe. Wakati'' Akambo kakuti Jehova wazimvwa kuti tandiyandwi, nkinkaako wanddipa alubo oyu mwana mulombe,'' akumwita zina lya Simiyoni.
Mpawo wakaminta lubo akuzyala mwana mulombe. Wakati'' Lino mulumi wangu chiindi echino ulakunamatila kulindime, nkaambo ndamuzyalila bana balombe batatu.'' Nkinkako zina lyakwe wakategwa ngu Levi.
Wakaminta alubo akuzyala mwana mulombe wakati,'' Chiindi echino ndiyo tembawula Jehova.'' Nkinkaako wakamuti zina lyakwe ngu Juda; mpawo wakayimakuba abana.
Eelyo Lakkeli nakabona kuti tazyalilide Jakkobbu mwana, Lakkeli wakaba eebbivwe amukulana wakwe. Wakati kuli Jakkobbu, ''Ndipe bana, kana ndifwe.''
Lunyemo lwa Jakkobbu lwakapyida Lakkeli. Wakati, ''Ndili aabusena bwa Leza na, ooyo wakukasya kuti ube abana?''
Wakati, ''Langa, kuli mulanda wangu Bbila. Konjila kulinguwe, ambweni walikutumbuka bana kumazwi angu, alimwi ndiyooba aabana anguwe.''
Aboobo wakamupa mulanda Bbila mbuli mukayintu, alimwi Jakkobbu wakanjila kulinguwe.
Bbila wakaminta alimwi wazyalila Jakkobbu mwana mulombe.
Mpawo Lakkeli wakati, ''Leza wanjilila alimwi wamvwa ijwi lyangu akundipa mwana mulombe.'' Akaambo kacheechi wakamuuzika izina lya Dani.
Bbila, mulanda wa Lakkeli wakaminta lubo alimwi wakazyalila Jakkobbu mwana mulombe wabili.
Lakkeli wakati, ''Akulwisyania kupati ndakalwisyania amukulana wangu alimwi ndazunda.'' Wakamuuzika zina lyakwe kuti Nafutali.
Eelyo Liya nakabona kuti wiimikila kuba abana, wakabweza Zilupa, mulanda wakwe, alimwi wamupa Jakkobbu mbuli mukayintu.
Zilupa mulanda wa Liya wakazyalila Jakkobbu mwana mulombe.
Liya wakati, ''Eechi nchoolwe!'' aboobo wakamuuzika zina lyakuti Gaadi.
Mpawo Zilupa, mulanda wa Liya wakazyalila Jakkobbu mwana mulombe wabili.
Liya wakati, ''Ndabotelwa! Nkaambo bana basimbi bayondiita kuti kubotelwa.'' Aboobo wakamuuzika zina lya Asya.
Lubbeni wakanjila muchiindi chakutebula witi alimwi wakajana michelo mumuunda. Wakiiyeta kulibanyina Liya. Mpawo Lakkeli wakati kuli Liya, ''Ndipe iimwi michelo yamwana wako mulombe.''

Liya wakati kulinguwe, ''Ninkani niini na kulinduwe, kuti wakanditolela mulumi wangu?'' Lino uyanda kutola michelo yamwana wangu mulombe na, ayilayo?'' Lakkeli wakati, ''Mpawo uyoowona aandunwe mansiku aasunu, mukuchinchana amichelo yamwana wako mulombe.

Jakkobbu wakaza kuzwa kumuunda igolezya. Liya wakazwa aanze kuyoomuswanizya  alimwi wakati, ''Weelede kusika kulindime, nkaambo ndakuula amichelo ya mwana wangu.'' Aboobo Jakkobbu wakawona a Liya mansiku ngaayo.
Leza  wakaswiilizya kuli Liya, alimwi wakaminta akuzyalila Jakkobbu mwana mulombe wasanu.
Liya wakati, ''Leza wandipa mbadalo yangu nkaambo ndapa mulanda wangu wachanakazi kumulumi wangu.'' Wakamuuzika zina lyakuti Isakka.
Liya wakaminta alubo alimwi wakazyalila Jakkobbu mwana mulombe wamusanu awumwi.
Liya wakati, ''Leza wandipa chipo chibotu. Lino mulumi wangu uyoondilemeka, nkaambo ndamuzyalila bana balombe bali musanu awumwi. Wakamuuzika zina lyakuti Zebbuloni.
Kuzwa aawo wakamuzyalila mwana musimbi alimwi wakamuuzika zina lya Dayina.
Leza wakayita Lakkeli wamuyeya alimwi wakamuswiilizya. Wakamuchita kuti abe eeda.
Wakaminta alimwi wakazyala mwana. Wakati, ''Leza wagwisya buuse bwangu.''
Wakamuuzika zina lyakuti Jozefu, wakati, ''Jehova wandiyungizizya umbi mwana mulombe.''
Musule Lakkeli nkali wazyala Jozefu, Jakkobbu wakati kuli Labbani, ''Nditume, kuchitila kuti ndikonzye kwiinka kumunzi wangu ndemwini alimwi kuchisi changu.
Ndipe banakazi bangu alimwi abana bangu aabo mbindakakubelekela, alimwi ndiinke, mbuli mbozi mulimu ngundakakupa.''
Labbani wakati kulinguwe, ''Na ndajana choolwe kubusyu bwako, imikila, nkaambo ndakayiya mukubelesya nguzu eezyo Jehova nzyakandilongezya kuchitila nduwe.''
Mpawo wakati, ''Amba mbadalo yako, alimwi ndiyoobbadala.''
Jakkobbu wakati kulinguwe, ''Ulizi mbundakakubelekela, alimwi mbuli zivubwa zyakombuzyakeenda andime.
Nkaambo wakali aaziche nkesinaasika, alimwi zyayungizigwa mubwiingi. Jehova  wakulongezya kufumbwa nkundakabeleka. Lino ndiilili nensikape kuli ben'anda yangu ndemwini alubo?''
Aboobo Labbani wakati, ''Ndikubbadale anzi?'' Jakkobbu wakati, ''Tokoyoondipa chintu pe. Na ulachita chintu eechi akaambo kangu, alubo ndiyoosanina butanga bwako alimwi ndikabubambe.

Ndileke ndiinde mulutanga lwako sunu, kendikugwisya kuzwa kulimbubo imbelele zyoonse zili abusansiile alimwi, zili  amabatamabata mbelele, alimwi iisiya aakati kambelele, alimwi ili amabatabata na busansile aakati kempongo. Eezi zinoli nimbadalo yangu.

Kuzikatila kwangu kuyondipeda bukamboni mumazuba aatobela, wazooboola kuzoolingula mbadalo zyangu. Zyoonse eezyo zitakwe busansiike alimwi zili aamabatamabata aakati kempongo, alimwi azisiya aakati kembelele, na kwajanikana iimwi aantomwe anzizyo, zinoli zyabalwa kuti zyakabbigwa.''
Labbani wakati, ''Zyazuminika. Akukabe mbuli kumajwi aako.''

Mubuzuba oobo Labbani wakagwisya bapule bempongo bakali amweengo amabatamabata, alimwi zyoonse mpwizi zyakali abusansile a mabatamabata, zyoonse zyakali zyakali amubala uutuba mulinzizyo, alimwi azyoonse zisiya aakati kambelele, alimwi wakazipa mumaboko abana bakwe balombe.
Labbani alubo wakabika lweendo lwamazuba otatwe aakati kakwe a Jakkobbu. Aboobo wakiinkilila kunembo kayembela butanga bwa Labbani bwakasyede.

Jakkobbu wakabweza ntabi ntete zyamwiingili, azyamu alumondi alimwi azyamuse, alimwi wapapula mibala iituba mulinzizyo, alimwi wachita kutuba kwamukati kwachisamu kuti kuboneke.ooko kwakali mukaponda.
Mpawo wakabika tuponda ntwakali wapapula kunembo lya mutiba wamanzi awo mpuzinywida. Zyakaminta eelyo nizyakalikuza kuzoonywa.
Lutanga lwakali kutantana kunembo lyaponda; alimwi zyakazyala zili amyeengo, zili abusansile, alimwi zili amabatamabata nini.

Jakkobbu wakagwisya mbelele eezi, pesi wakachita zyoonse kuti zilange banyama bali amyeengo alimwi zyoonse mbelele zisiya zyakali mubutanga bwa Labbani. Mpawo wakaligwisizya butanga bwakwe alike mwini alimwi takazibika aantomwe amatanga a Labbani.
Kufumbwa lyoonse imbelele zisimide nizyakali kutantana, mpawo Jakkobbu wakali kubika tuponda kumenso aambelele muzinywido, kuchitila kuti ziminte aakati katuponda.
Pesi kufumbwa eelyo tudandala twabanyama mubutanga nitwali kusika, takali kubika tuponda pe kunembo lyato. Aboobo tudandala twabanyama twakali twa Labbani, alimwi zisimide zyakali zya Jakkobbu.
Mwaalumi wakazwidilila kapati. Wakali amatanga mapati, balanda banakazi alimwi abalanda baalumi, alimwi nkamela a madonki.
Lino Jakobbu wakamvwa majwi aabana ba Labbani, akuti bakati, ''Jakobbu wabweza zyoonse eezyo zyakali zyandeende, alimwi ndubono lwandende lwamupa buvubi.''
Jakobbu wakabona ndangilo kumenso kwa Labbani. Wakabona kuti mizezo yakwe kuli nguwe yakali yasiyana.
Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Jakobbu, ''Bweda kunyika yamawuso akunzubo zyako, alimwi ndinoli aanduwe.''
Jakobbu wakatuma akwita Rashelu a Leya kumuunda kumbelele zyakwe
akubambila kuti, ''Ndabona kuti mizezo yawuso kli ndime yasiyana, pesi Leza wandeende wali andime.
Mulizi kuti ninguzu zyangu zyoonse zyapa kuti ndigwasye wuso.
Wuuso wandena alimwi wasandula bulumbu bwangu mumweelwe wakkumi, pesi Leza taana muzumizya pe kuti andichise.

Aanoli wamba kuti, ''Banyama balamabbata bayooba mufolo wako; mpawo lyoonse tanga liyoozyala bana bali amabbata. Aanoli wamba kuti, ''Izilamyengo ziyoba ngomufolo wako; mpawo langa lyonse tanga liyozyala bana bali amyeengo.
Muli eyi inzila Leza wabweza lubono lwawuso akulupa ndime.
Lomwe muchiindi chakuzyalana, ndakabona mumaloto basipule bampongo ibakali achembela atanga lyampongo,Bapule bakali aamyengo-myengo, bakali amabbata, abali abusenseele, abali amawubimawubi.
Mungelo wa Leza wakati  kuli ndime mumaloto, ''Jakobbu.'ndakati, ''Ndili aano.''
Wakati nyampula menso aako ubone boonse basipule bampongo ibali kuzyazya itanga. Bali amyengo myengo, zilamabbata mabbata azili amawubi mawubi, nkambo ndazibona zyoonseni Labbani nzyali kukuchitila.
Ndime Leza wa Bbeteli, ooko nkowakachita chizuminano kuli ndime. Lino nyampuka uzwe aanyika eeyi ubwede kunyika nkuwakazyalilwa.''
Lakkeli a Liya bakasandula kabati kuli nguwe, ''kuli chimpanzi na kana lukono lwesu mung'anda yandeende.
Tali kutuchita mbuli bazwakule na ? Nkambo watuuzya alimwi walya walobya imali yesu.
Nkambo boonse buvubi Leza mbwabweza kuzwa kuli ndende bwaba bwesu lino abana besu. Nkiinkako linobu, kufumbwa nzyakwaambila Leza, uzichite.''
Mpawo Jakobbu wakanyampuka alimwi wabikka bana bakwe balombe abanakazi bakwe amankamelo.
Wakabinga zyoonse zivubwa zyakwe kunembo lyakwe, antomwe alubono lwakwe loonse, kuswanizya azivubwa nzyakali wajana mu Padani Alamu. Mpawo wakatalika kweenda kuya kuli wisi Ayizeki kuyika ya Kkenani.
Awo Labbani nakaya kukugela imbelele zyakwe, Lakkeli wakabba boonse baleza bang'anda yawisi.
Alimwi Jakobbu wakena Labbani imu Alamiyeni, akutamwambila kuti wakali kuyanda kweenda.
Aboobo wakachija azintu zyoonse nzyakali azyo akutozya kuchilundu chenyika ya Giliyadi.
Mubuzuba bwatatu Labbani wakabuzigwa kuti Jakobbu wakachija.
Aboobo wakabweza inzubo zyakwe wamutobela ikwalweendo lwamazuba musanu aabili. Wakamwiinda muchilundu chenyika ya Giliyadi.
Lino Leza wakeza kuli Labbani mu Alameyani muchiloto mansiku akumwambila kuti, ''Ubone kuti towambuli a Jakobbu nikuba mububotu kana mububi.''
Labbani wakamwinda Jakobbu. Lino Jakobbu wakali wayaka chibbakasa chakwe munyika yamuchilundu. Alimwi Labbani wakakkala enzubo zyakwe muchilundu chenyika ya Giliyadi.
Labbani wakati kuti Jakobbu, ''Wachitanzi, kuti wakandena alimwi wachijisya bana bangu basimbi mbuli bazike benkondo?
Nkaambonzi niwakenda chakusisikizya akundiyuba kotandambili pe? Ndakali kunokugwisya chakubotelwa anyimbo, mweembo katulizya miimbo.
Tewakandizumizya kumyoonta bazukulu bangu balombe abana bangu banakazi lwanzano lubotu. Lino wakacita bufubafuba.
Chilimunguzu zyangu kuti ndikunyonyone, pesi Leza wawuso ijilo mansiku wakandaambila kuti, ''Ubone kuti towambuli a Jakobbu izibotu kana izibi.''
Lino wachija nkambo wazimba kubweda kung'anda yawuso. Pesi nkambonzi niwabba baleza bangu?''
Jakobbu wakasandula Labbani wakati, ''Nkambo ndakayowa akuyeeya kuti ulandinyanga bana basimbi nchindakenda chakusisikizya.
Kufumbwa wabba baleza bako takoyoyinkilila anembo akupona. Kaziliwo inzubo zyesu, saluula kuli nzindaazyo kufumbwa ichako ubweze.'' Nkambo Jakobbu takazi pe kuti Lakkeli  wakali wabba baleza.
Labbani wakanjila mubbakasa lya Jakobbu wakunjila mubbakasa lya Liya, amucibbakasa chabanakazi bobile babelesi, pesi takwe pe nakabajana. Wakazwa mubbakasa lya Liya akunjila mubbakasa lya Lakkeli.
Lino Lakkeli wakali wabweza baleza bempuli, wababika muchibbula chankamela, akukkala etala ambaabo. Labbani wakafunuka kuyandula mubbakasa lyoonse, pesi tabajene.
Wakati kuli wisi, ''Utanyemi, simalelo wangu, mukuti tendayimikila kunembo lyako, nkukuti ndili muchiindi changu chakusofwaala.'' Aboobo wakayandula pesi takabajana pe baleza bempuli yakwe.
Jakobbu wakanyema alimwi wakakazyania a Labbani. Wakamwambila kuti, ''Nguuli mulandu wangu? Ncheechi chibi changu, eecho nchiwanditobelela abukkali?
Nkambo wavwima mulizyonse nzendazyo. Niinzi nchiwajana kuli zyoonse zintu zyako? Zitondezye aawa kunembo lyenzubo zyesu, kuchitila kuti babone mubi akati kesu tobabili.
Ndakali anduwe kwaminyaka makumi obile. Imbelele zyako mpwizi ampongo zyako mpwizi takwepe nizyakasowa, aboobo taakwe nindakalya inyama yambelele kuzwa kutanga lyako lyambelele.
Tendakakwetela chakayawulwa amunyama. Anukuti, kubulika kwacho lyakaba penzi lyangu. Wakali kundibbadalisya woonse munyama wasweka, nikuba kuti wabbigwa sikati kana wabbigwa mansiku.
Aawo mpundakabede; isikati kupya kwakandinyeela, alimwi impeyo mansiku; alimwi taakwe nindakoona.

Minyaka makumi obile ndali mumpuli yako. Ndakakubelekela minyaka ikkumi ayine nkelanga bana bako basimbi bobile, alimwi iminyaka musanu awumwi nkekulangila imbelele zyako. Wakasandula mufolo wangu myeelwe ikkumi.

Adokuti Leza wandeende, Leza wa Abbulahamu, ayooyo Ayizeki ngwayowa, bali andime. Nkasimpe kuti lino wali kunditanda chinkwamanza. Leza wabona kudyamizigwa kwangu akuti ndakabeleka chenguzu, alimwi wakakukaka ijilo mansiku.''

Labbani wakasandula akubuzya Jakobbu kuti, ''Ibana basimbi mbana bangu, ibazukulu mbazukulu bangu, alimwi iitanga lyambelele nimbelele zyangu. Zyoonse nzyobwene nimbelele zyangu. Pesi ninzi nzenkonzya kuchita sunu kubana babo mbibakazyala?
Nkokuti lino, atuchite chizuminano, alimwi chibe chabukamboni aakati kako andime.''
Nkinkaako Jakobbu wakabweza ibbwe akulijimpa mbuli imbandama.
Jakobbu wakati kunzubo zyakwe, ''Amubunganie mabwe.'' Aboobo bakabwezelela mabwe bachita mulwi. Mpawo bakalya mpawawo amulwi wamabwe.
Labbani wakalyuzika kuti Jega Saha Duta, pesi Jakobbu wakalyiita kuti Giliyadi.
Labbani wakati, ''Eeli idwi mbukamboni aakati kangu anduwe sunu.'' Nkiinkako izina lyalyo lyakateegwa Galiidi.
Alubo lyiitwa kuti Mizipa, nkambo Labbani wakati, ''Jehova abone aakati kangu anduwe, aawo nitutachiboneki kuli umwi awumwi.
Kuti tewakubajata kabotu bana bangu basimbi, kana kuti ukabweze bamwi banakazi batali bana bangu, nikuba kuti taakwe uumbi muntu ngutuli awe, boona, Leza ngukamboni aakati kako andime.''
Labbani wakati kuli Jakobbu, ''Bona idwii eeli, alimwi boona imbandama, eyo njindajimpa aakati kako andime.
Eeli idwi ngukamboni, alimwi eeyi mbandama ngukamboni, ikuti nsikoyoyinda imulwi oyu kuza kulinduwe, alimwi kuti tokoyoyinda imbandama eeyi kuza kulindime, kukuyochita lunyonyono.
Akube kuti Leza wa Abbulahamu, a Leza wa Naholi, baleza bawisi, batutonge.'' Jakobbu wakakonka akuyowa wisi Ayizeki.
Jakobbu wakachita chipayililo aachilundu alimwi wakayita inzubo zyakwe kuti balye chilyo. Bakalya alimwi bakabuchesya mpawawo achilundu.
Ichifumo nibwakacha Labbani wakabuka, wamyonta bazukulu bakwe balombe abana bakwe basimbi akubalongezya. Mpawo Labbani wakeenda kabweeda kumunzi wakwe.
Jakkobbu alakwe wakaya kunzila yakwe, mpawo baangelo ba Leza bakamuswaana.
Jakkobbu nakababona, wakati, "Ooyu musasa wa Leza," mpawo wakawulika busena oobo kuti Mahanayimu.
Jakkobbu wakatuma batumwa kunembo lyakwe kuya kumwana wakwabo Isawu munyika ya Seyili muchilawo  cha Idomu.
Wakabalayilila kuti, "Ncheechi nchomuyoowamba kuli simalelo wangu: 'Mboobu muzike wako Jakkobbu mbwaamba: 'Ndakali kukkala a Labbani, mpawo wakachelezya kubweeda kwangu kusikila lino.
Ndili aa ng'ombe, madonki, amatanga, babelesi bachaalumi, ababelesi bachanakazi. Ndatuma makani aaya kuli simalelo wangu, kuchitila kuti ndijane luzyalo mumeso aako.
Batumwa bakajokela kuli Jakkobbu akwaamba kuti, "Twakiinka kumwana wakwanu Isawu. Uliikuza kuti azooswanane anduwe, amyaanda yone yabaalumi mbalaabo."
Mpawo Jakkobbu wakayoowa loko akutakkalinkana. Mpawo wakapambukania bantu mbakali aabo mumisasa ibili, amatanga aambelele, abutanga bwang'ombe, ankamela.
Wakati, Na Isawu wasika kumusasa umwi  akuulwisya, mpawo musasa usyaala uyoochija."
Jakkobbu wakati, "Leza wataata Abbulahamu, a Leza wataata Ayizekki, Jehova, ooyo wakati kulindime, "Bweeda kunyika  yako akumukowa wako alimwi ndiyokusumpula,'

tandeeleli kunchito zyako zyoonse zyazizuminano zyakusyomeka azyoonse zyakukkazikila moyo nzwakandichitila ndimuzike wako. Nkaambo amusako wangu biyo ndakazubuka Jodani ooyu, mpawo lino ndajoka amisasa ibili.
Inche ndivune kuzwa kujanza lyamwana wakwesu, kuzwa kujaanza lya Isawu, nkaambo ndilamuyoowa, kuti ulikuza akuzoondilwisya amamama ali abana.
Pesi wakati, 'Ndiyookusumpula chakutaleka. Ndiyoochita lunyungu lwako mbuli museele wakulwizi, utakonzeki kubalwa nkaambo kamweelwe walo.'''
Jakkobbu wakakkala aawo kwabusiku oobo. Wakabweza zimwi nzyakalaazyo wazichita zipo zya Isawu, mwana wakwabo:
myaanda ibili yampongo mpwizi abapule bali makumi aabili, myaanda ibili yambelele nzyazi abapule bali makumi aabili,
makumi aatatu aa nkamela zinyonsya abana bazyo, makumi oone aa ng'ombe nzyazi abapule bali kkumi, makumi aabili aa madonki mazyazi abapule bali kkumi.
Eezi wakazipa mujaanza lyabazike bakwe, tanga limwi alimwi kuli lyalo. Wakati kubazike bakwe, "Amwiinde kunembo lyangu mpawo musiye mweenya kubutanga bumwi abumwi."
Wakalayilila muzike mutaanzi,  akwaamba kuti, "Na Isawu mukulana wangu wakuswana akukubuzya, kuti, 'Ino muli bakulini? Muya kuli? Mbibani banyama aaba bali kunembo lyanu?'
Mpawo ukaambe kuti, 'Mbibamulanda wako Jakkobbu. Nchipo chatumwa kuli simalelo Isawu. Alimwi boona, uliikuza musule lyesu.'''
Jakkobbu alubo wakalayilila kabunga kachibili, katatu, akubaalumi boonse bakali kutobela matanga. Wakati, "Muyoowamba chintu chimwi kuli Isawo  mwakumuswana.

Muleede kwaamba lubo, 'Mulanda wako Jakkobbu uliikuza musule lyesu."' Nkaambo wakayeeya kuti, "Ndiyoomutontozya aazipo nzindili kutuma kunembo lyangu. Elyo mukayindi, na ndaakumubona, ampweni uyoonditambula."
Mpawo zipo zyakiinka kunembo lyakwe. Lwakwe mwini wakakkala busiku oobo mumusasa.
Jakkobbu wakabuka muchiindi chamansiku, akubweza banakazi bakwe babili, bazike bakwe banakazi babili, abana bakwe balombe bali kkumi awumwi. Wakabatola mutala lya Jabbokku.
Munzila eeyi wakabatola mutala lyakalonga alubono lwakwe loonse.
Jakkobbu wakasyaala aliikke, mpawo muntu wakapulaana aawe kusikila kubuchedo.
Muntu nakabona kuti takonzyi kumuzunda, wakawuma nsonyo ya Jakkobbu. Nsonyo ya Jakkobbu yakakwiduka nakali kupulaana aawe.
Muntu wakati, "Ndileke ndiinke, nkaambo kucha kwasika." Jakkobbu wakati, "Tandikuleki ado undilongezye."
Muntu wakati kuli nguwe, "Nduweni zina lyako?" Jakkobbu wakati, "Jakkobbu."
Muntu wakati, "Zina lyako talichiyoowambwi limbi kuti Jakkobbu, pesi Izilayili. Nkaambo walwisyana aa Leza abantu alimwi wazunda."
Jakkobbu wakamubuzya kuti, "Inche ndaambile zina lyako." Wakati, "Nkamboonzi nubuzya zina lyangu?" Mpawo ndilyonya wakamulongezya.
Jakkobbu wakawulika busena zina lyakuti Peniyelu nkaambo wakati, "Ndabona Leza kumeso kumeso, alimwi buumi bwangu bwangunuka."
Zuba lyakazya Jakkobbu nakali kwiinda Peniyelu. Wakali kusunkuta nkaambo kansonyo yakwe.
Nchincheecho sunu bantu ba Isilayili nchibatalyi milambi yansonyo ili kumaswananinano ansonyo, nkaambo muntu wakachisa milambi muchiindi chakukwidula nsonyo ya Jakkobbu.
Jakkobbu wakalanga kunembo mpawo, laanga, Isawu wakali kuyobuza, mpawo wakala baalumi bakali miyanada iine. Jakkobbu wakkanzaniya akati Liya, Lakkelu mpawo abalanda banakazi babili.
Eelyo wakabika balanda banakazi abana babo kunembo, katobelwa a Liya abana bakwe, mpawo katobelwa a Lakkelu mpawo a Josefu wakumamaninsizyo kuli boonse.
Welwakwe wakiinka kunembo lyabo. Wakafugama musanu atubili kunembo aabuwa, Mane kosika afwifwi amukkulana wakwe.
Isawu wakachijaana kaya kukumutambula, wakambundila, wabika maboko aakwe, mpawo wamumyonta. Mpawo wakalila.
Eelyo Isawu nakalanga kunembo, wakabona mwanakazi abana. Wakati,'' Mbana aba Leza mbakapa chaluzyalo kumulanda wako.''
Mpawo balanda banakazi  bakaza kunembo abana, mpawo bafugama aansi.
Katobela Liya alubo abana bakwe bakaza kunembo bafugama aansi. Kumamaninsizyo Jozefu a Lakkelubakaza kunembo bafugama aansi.
Isawu wakati,'' Uliikwambanzi atubunga ootu ntundaswaana?'' Jakkobbu wakati,'' kujana choolwe kuzwa kuli simalelo wangu.''
Isawu wakati,'' ndaazyo kale, mukulana. Libambile nzolaazyo.

''Jakkobbu wakati,'' Inee, ikaka, Naandajana choolwe kunembo lyako, mpawo tambula chipo changu chizwa mumaboko aangu, nkaambo nchoonzyo, ndabubona busyu bwako, mpawo kuli mbuuli kubona Leza, mpawo wanditambula.
Ikaka tambula chipo chakeetelwa nduwe, nkaambo Leza wakandibamba chaluzyalo, mpawo nkaambo ndaazyo ndaazyo zikkwene,'' Ngu Jakkobbu kulikumusungilizya, mpawo Isawu wakiitambula.
Mpawo Isawu wakati,'' Tube munzila yesu. Ndeenda kunembo lyako.''
Jakkobbu wakati kulinguwe,''simalelo wangu ulizi kuti bana mbanini, mpawo imbelele angombe zilokunyonsya twana tunini. Kuti zyabingwa changuzu bunsi bumwi boonse banyamankala balafwa.
Ikaka leka simalelo abe kunembo lyamulanda wakwe. Ndileenda bunini, amunyansu wabanyamankala kunembo lyangu,amunyansu wabana, mane nkasike kuli simalelelo wangu ku Siye.''
Isawu wakati,'' leka ndikusiile bamwi babaalumi mbindaabo.'' pesi Jakkobbu wakati,'' Nkaambo nzimwa chita eezi?  Leka ndijane choolwe kunembo amwami wangu.''
Aboobo Isawu elyo zuba wakatalika kubweeda ku Siye.
Jakkobbu wakiinka ku Sakkoti, wakali yakila nganda, mpawo wakachita mwenzule wazivuubwa. Nkinkaako zina lyabusena lyakali kutegwa Sakkoti.
Awo Jakkobuu nakazwa ku Padani Alamu, wakasika obotu kumuunzi waku Shekkemu, Oyo wakali munyika ya Kkenani. Wakakkala afwifwi amuunzi.
Mpawo wakawula chimpanzi chanyika oko nkwakabikide matente kuzwa kumwana wa Hama, Wisi Shekkemu,amwaanda wa siliva.
Oko wakabika chipayililo mpawo wachiita kuti Eli Elohe Izilayeli.
Lino Dayina mwana musimbi wa Liya ooyo ngwakazyala kuli Jakkobbu, wakazwa waya kuyooswanana abanakazi bachinini bamunyika oomo.
Siekkemu mwana mulombe wa Hamoli mu Hivayiti, mwana wamwami wanyika, wakamubona. Wakamubweza wawona aanguwe, aboobo wakamufwisya bweeme.
Wakayobolwa kuli Dayina, mwana musimbi wa Jakkobbu. Wakalikumuyanda mwanakazi wachinini ooyo alimwi wakali kumwambuuzya buteete.
Siekkemu wakambuula awisi Hamoli, wati, "Mundijanine mwanakazi wachinini ooyu kuti abe mwanakazi wangu."
Lino Jakkobbu wakamvwa kuti wakasofwaazya Dayina mwana wakwe musimbi. Bana bakwe balombe bakali aa zivuubwa zyakwe kumuunda, aboobo Jakkobbu wakajata moyo wakwe kusikila baboola.
Hamoli wisi wa Siekkemu wakazwa waya kuli Jakkobbu kuyowambuula anguwe.
