Bana balombe bakwe Jakkobbu bakaboola banjila kabazwa kumuunda nibakamvwa kaambo aaka. Baalumi aaba bakasokwa. Bakalibilide kapati nkaambo wakasampawula Isilayili kwiinda mukoona amwana musimbi wa Jakkobbu, nkaambo eechi nchintu chitakayelede kuchitwa pe.
Hamoli wakambuula aabo, kaamba kuti, "Mwana wangu mulombe Siekkemu ulamuyanda mwana wanu musimbi. Inche ngamumupe kuti abe mwanakazi wakwe.
Amunjilane andiswe mumakwatanizi, anywebo mubweze bana besubasimbi kuba banu.
Muyookkala andiswe, alimwi nyika inoowangunukide kuli ndinywe kuti mukkale akuchita makwebo mulinjiyo, akuba alubono,"
Siekkemu wakati kuli wisi akubakulana bakwe, "Ngandijane luse mumeso aanu, alimwi kufumbwa nchimutandaambile ndiyoopa nchicho.
Ngamundaambile kufumbwa luselo lwanabwiinga azipo zyoonse mbuli mbumuyanda, alimwi ndiyoopa nchimwaamba kuli ndime pesi amundipe mwana wanu musimbi kuti abe mwanakazi wangu."
Bana ba Jakkobbu bakasandula Siekkemu a Hamoli wisi chalweeno, nkaambo Siekkemu wakasofwaazya Dayina muchizi wabo.
Bakati kuli mbabo, "Tatukwe nitunga tulachita chintu eechi pe, kupa muchizi wesu kuli kufumbwa utapalwidwe; nkaambo aaya masampu kuli ndiswe.
Nkuuli boobu biyo bwiime nkutunga tulazuminana andinywe: kuti na mwapalulwa mbuli mbutubede, kuti na mwalumi woonse uli akati kenu wapalulwa.
Elyo tuyoomupa bana besu basimbi, alimwi tuyoobweza bana benu basimbi kuti babebkulindiswe, alimwi tuyookkala aamwi akuba bantu bamwi.
Pesi na kuti temwatuswiilizya akuba bapalwidwe, aboobo tuyoobweza muchizi wesu mpawo tuyoozwa.
M ajwi aabo akabotezya Hamoli a mwana wakwe Siekkemu.
Mwalumi muniini ooyo tewakachedwa pe kuchita eecho nchibakaamba, nkaambo kakuti wakakondelwa kumwana musimbi wa Jakkobbu, alimwi nkaambo kakuti wakali muntu wakali kulemekwa kapati mung'anda yawisi
Hamoli a Siekkemu mwana wakwe bakaya kmulyango wa Dolopo alimwi bakwambuula abaalumi bamu Dolopo, bati,

Aaba bablumi bali aluumuno andiswe, nkikaako ngabakkale munyika akuchita makwebo mulinjiyo nkaambo, masimpe, nyika nimpati alimwi ilibazulide. Ngatubweze bana babo basimbi kuba banakazi besu, aswebo tubape bana besu basimbi.

Boonse baalumi bamu Dolopo bakaswilila Hamoli a Siekkemu, mwana wakwe. Woonse mwaalumi wakapalulwa.

Mubuzuba bwatatu aawo nibakachili mumachiswe, bana babili bamwi babana ba Jakkobbu (Simiyoni a Levi, bakulana ba Dayina), umwi awumwi wakabweza panga lyakwe alimwi babukila dolopo lyakakwabilidwe, alimwi bakajaya baalumi boonse.
Bakajaya Hamoli amwana wakwe milombe Syekkemu a panga. Bakabweza Dayina kuzwa kun'anda ya Syekkemu alimwi bazwa beenda.
Bamwi bana ba Jakkobbu bakaboola kumitunta akuduntuula Dolopo, nkaambo bantu bakasofwaazya muchizi wabo.
Bakabweza zivuubwa zyabo, matanga aa ngo'mbe zyabo, mbong'olo zyabo, azyoonse zyakali mu Dolopo azyakali mumyuunda yakali zyungulukide dolopo
buvubi bwabo boonse. Boonse bana babo abanakazi babo, bakababweza. Bakabweza nikuba zyoonse zyakali mumaanda.

Jakkobbub wakati kuli Simiyoni a Levi, "Mwandeetela penzi, kundichita kuti ndinunke kuli bamuna nyika, ba Kkenani aba Pelizi. ndilimuche kumweelwe. Kuti na balibungania antoomwe akundilwanya, aboobo ndiyoonyonyonwa, mebo abang'anda yangu."
Pesi Simiyoni a Levi bakati, "Sena Siekkemu wakali kunoochita muchizi wesu mbuli kuti uli asimamambbe?"
Leza wakati kuli Jakkobbu,'' buka, uye ku Bbeteli, ukakkale nkuko. Uyake chipayililo cha Leza nkuko, iwakali binia kuli nduwe niwakachija kuli Isawu mukkulana wako.''
Mpawo Jakkobbu wakati kuli basingand yakwe akuli boonse mbakali aabo, ''Amusowe ba leza beenzu bali akati kenu, amulisalazye nobeni, akusama zisamo zimbi.
Mpawo tunyampuke tuye ku Bbeteli. Ndiyoyaka chipayililo oko cha Leza, oyo wakandivwiila kubuzuba bwamafwabi, alimwi wakali aandime koonse nkundakali kuya.''
Aboobo bakapa Jakkobbu baleza beenzu bakali mumaboko aabo, amalangulangu akali mumatwi aabo. Jakkobbu wakazivwikila munsi amu Okku afwifwi a Shekemu.
Elyo nibakeenda, Leza waka batumina buyoofu bwakawida mumadolipo akabengelede, Lino bantu aba tebaka nibandila bana wa Jakkobbu.
Lino Jakkobbu wakasika  ku Luzi, (nkokuti, Beteli), uli munyika zya Kkenani,we boonse bantu bakali abo.
Wakayaka chipayililo oko akuzika busena kuti Eli-Bbeteli, nkaambo oko Leza wakalibonia lwakwe mwani kulinguwe, nakali kuya buchija mukkulana wakwe.
Dibbola, muleli wa Libbekka, wakafwa. Wakazikwa ku Bbeteli oko munsi lyamusamu mu Okku elyo musamu wakawuzikwa kuti Aloni Bbakkuti.
Lino Jakkobbu nakazwa ku Padani Alamu, Leza wakalibonyi lubo kuli nguwe alimwi waka mulongezya.
Leza wakati kulinguwe,'' izina lyako nduwe Jakkobbu, pele zina lyako talichitwi kuti Jakkobbu. Izina lyako lizowambwa kuti Izilayeli.''Aboobo Leza wakayita zina lyakwe Izilayeli.
Leza wakati kuli nguwe,'' ndime Leza singuzu zyoonse. Zyalisya akuvula. Musyobo ankamu zya misyobo iyozwa mulinduwe , abaami bayoba akati kamukowa wako.
Inyika eeyo njindakapa Abbulahamu a Ayizekki, ndayipa nduwe. Amukkowa wako uuchiza awalo ndawupa nyika eeyo.''
Leza wazwa kulinguwe kubuse nkwakali kwaambulawe.
Jakkobbu wakayimika munsemu abusena awo mpakambulisyania anguwe , mensemu wabbwe. Wakatila chipayizyo chakunywa alinguwo alimwi wakatila mafuta atala.
Jakkobbu wakayita zina lyabusena oko Leza nkwakambulisyania aangwe, Bbeteli.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Bbeteli. Nikwakachisyede kainzo kuya ku Ifulati, Lashelu wakamyonga. Wakaba abuyumu mukumyonga kwakwe.
Nikwakayindila kumyonga, sikutumbusya wakati utayoowi, ikwalino uyoba awumbi mwana mulombe.''
Naakamba kufwa, akuyoya kwakwe kwakufwa wakamulika zina lya Bbenoni.
Lashelu wakafwa nkabela wakazikwa muzila zyaku Efulati(nkokuti  Bbetelehema).
Jakkobbu wakayimikizya musemu atala lyakabanda. Nchitondeezyo chakabanda ka Lashelu sunu.
Izailayeli wakalonga wakuyaka tente lyakwe kunembo lyangazi ndamfu lyakulingula mbelele.
Nkabela Izilayeli nakachili kukkala munyika eeyo, Lubbeni wakoona Bbeliha simamambe wawisi, nkabela Izilayeli wakamvwa acheechi. Lino Jakkobbu wakali abana balombe bakali kkumi ababili.
Bana bakwe kuli Leya mbaaba. Lubbeni, mwana mutaanzi wa Jakkobbu, a Simiyoni, Levi, Juda, Izakka, a Zebbuloni.
Bana bakwe kuli Lakkeli mba Jozefu a Bbenjamini.
Bana bakwe kuli Bbiliha, mulanda wachanakazi wa Lashelu, mbaaba Dani a Nafitali.
Bana ba Zilufa, mulanda mwanakazi wa Leya, mba Gadi a Asha.Aba boonse mbana ba Jakkobbu mbakazyalilwa a Padani Alamu.
Jakkobbu wakasika kuli Izakka , ndeende wakwe, mu mamule mu kkiliyati Abba (nkokuti Hibbuloni), oko Abbulahamu a Ayizekkinkubakali kukkala.
Ayizekki wakapona minyaka ili mwanda amakkumi aali musanu aatatu.
Ayizekki wakayoya kwamamaninsizyo mpawo wafwa, eelyo wakayobolwa kuli basikale bakwe, munene uuzwide mazuba. Isawu a Jakkobbu, bana bakwe, bakamuvwika.
Aaya ngemazyalane a Eswau (alubo kayitwa kuti Idomu).
Esawu wakabweza banakazi bakwe kuzwa kuba Kkenani. Aaba mbibanakazi bakwe: Ada mwana musimbi wa Elomi mu Hiti; Olibbama mwana musimbi wa Ana, muzukulumusimbi wa Zebbiyoni mu Hivi;
alimwi Bbasemati, mwana musimbi wa Isyumayeli, muchizi wa  Nebbayoti.
Ada wakazyala Elifazi kuli Esawu, alimwi a Bbasemati wakazyala Lewulu.
Oholibbama wakazyala Jewusyi, Jalamu a Kkola. Aaba mbibana ba Esawu mbaakazyalilwa munyika ya Kkenani.

Esawu wakabweza banakazi bakwe, bana bakwe balombe, bana bakwe basimbi, aboonse ba sin'anda yakwe, azivuubwa zyakwe - boonse bamwi banyama bakwe, alimwi abuvubi bwakwe boonse mbwakabunganisizye munyika ya Kkenani, akwiinka kunyika  ilikule kuzwa ku mukulana wakwe Jakkobbu.
Wakachita eechi nkaambo buvubi bwabo bwakali bwiingi loko kuti bakale aantomwe. Inyika njibakakkede teyakachilikubazulila pe akaambo kambono zyabo.
Aboobo Esawu, alibo uuzibinkene kuti Idomu, wakakkala munyika yachilundu cha Siyelie.
Aba ndolunyungu lwa Esawu, sinsiku wama Idomu munyika yachilundu cha Siyeli.
Aaya ngaakali mazina aabana balombe ba Esawu: Elifazi mwana mulombe wa Ada, mwanakazi wa Esawu; Lewulu mwana mulombe wa Bbasemati, mwanakzi wa Esawu.
Bana balombe ba Elifazi bakali Temani, Oma, Zefo, Gatamu a Kkenazi.
Timuna, simamambe wa Elifazi, mwana mulombe wa Esawu, wakazyala Amaleki. Aaba bakali bazukulu balombe ba Ada, mwanakazi wa Esawu.
Aaba mbibakali bana balombe ba Lewulu: Nahati, Zela,Syama, a Miza. Aaba mbibakali bazukulu balombe ba Bbasemati, mwanakazi wa Esawu.
Aaba mbibakali bana balombe ba Oholibbama, mwanakazi wa Esawu, kali mwana musimbi wa Ana alimwi muzukulu musimbi wa Zibbiyoni. Wakazyalila Esawu  Jewusyi, Jalamu a Kkola.
Eeyi njemikowa aakati kalunyungu lwa Esawu: lunyungu lwa Elifazi, mwana mutaanzi wa Esawu: Temani, Omali, Zefo, Kkenazi,
Kkola, Gatamu, a Amaleki. Eeyi njiyakali mikowa yakazwa kuli Elifazi munyika ya Idomu. Bakali bazukulu balombe ba Ada.

Eeyi njemikowa kuzwa kuli Lewulu mwana mulombe wa Esawu: Nahati, Zela, Syama, Miza. Eeyi njiyakali mikowa yakazwa kuli Lewulu munyika ya Idomu. Bakali bazukulu balombe ba Bbasemati, mwanakazi wa Esawu.
Eeyi yakali mikowa ya Oholibbama, mwanakazi wa Esawu: Jewusyi, Jalamu, Kkola. Eeyi njiyakali mikowa yakazwa kuli Oholibbama mwanakazi wa Esawu, mwana musimbi wa Ana.
Aaba mbibakali bana balombe ba Esawu (wakazibinkene kali Idomu) alimwi aaba bakali baami babo.
Aaba bakali bana balombe ba Siyeli mu Holiti, bakkali banyika: Lotani, Syobbalu,Zibbuyoni, Ana,
Disyoni, Eza, a Disyani. Eyinjimikkowa ya ba Holiti bakali baseyili munyika ya Idomu.
Bana balombe ba Lotani bakali Holi, a Hemeni, Timuna kali muchizi wa Lotani.
Aba bakali bana balombe ba Syobbalu: Aluvani, Manahali, Ebbala, Seepo a Onamu.
Aba bakali bana balombe ba Zibbiyoni:Ayiya a Ana. oyu ngu Ana wakajana tusawu tubila mulusaka, kali kwembela madonki a Zebbiyoni wisi.
Aba bakali bana balombe ba Ana: Disyoni a Holibbama, mwana musimbi wa Ana.
Aba mbakali ban balombe ba Disyoni: Hemadamu, Eshibbani, Itilani, a Kelani.
Aba mbakali bana balombe ba Eza :Bilihani, Zavani, a Akkani.
Aba mbakali bana balombe ba Disyani: Uzi a Alani.
Eyi njiyakali mikkowa yamaHolaiti:Loti.Shobalu, Zibbiyoni, a Ana,
Disyoni, Eza, Disyani: Eyi njiimikkowa yaba Holayiti, mukwiinda mumikkowa yabo ilembedwe munyika ya Seyeli.
Aba bakali bami bakendelezya munyika ya Edomu awo kakutanaba mwami,wakali kweendelezya akati kabana ba Izilayeli:
Bbela mwana mulombe wa  Bbiya, wakeendelezya mu Edomu, lino izina lya dolopo lyake lyakali Dinabba.
Bbela nakafwa, mpawo Jakkobbu mwana mulombe wa Zela wa Bbozila, wakeendelezya mubusena bwakwe.
Jakkobbu wakafwa , Hushumu wakali wanyika yaba Temunayili, wakeendelezya mubusena bwakwe.
Husyumu nakafwa, Hadadi mwana mulombe  wa Bbedadi wakazunda ba Midiyanayili munyika ya Mowabbu, wakeenelezya mubusena bwakwe.Izina lye dolopo lyakwe lyakali Aviti.
Hadadi naakafwa, mpawo Samula wamasileka wakeendelezya busena  bwakwe.
Eelyo Samula nakafwa, mpawo Syawulu wa Lihobboti uuli ambali lyamulonga wakeendelezya busena bwakwe.
Eelyo Syawulu naakafwa, mpawo Bbalu-Hanani mwana  mulombe wa Kkido wakeendelezya busena bwakwe.
Eelyo Bbalu -Hanani wakeendelezya mubusena bwakwe. Izina lyadolopo lyakwe ngu Paayu. Izina lyana lyamwanakazi wakwe wakali Mehetabbelu, mwna musimbi wa Matiledi, muzikulu musimbi wa Mi Zahabbu.
Aaya ngakali mazina abasilutwe bamikowa kuzwa kuzyalane lya Isawu,mukwindila mumikowa yabo amumasena aabo amuma zina aabo: Timuna, Aluva,Jeteti,
Oholibana, Ela,Pinoni,
Kenazi, Temani, Mibbiza,
Magidiyeli, akamu. Eeyi njimikkowa yabasilutwe ya Idomu, mukwiinda mukukkala kwabo munyika njjibakabwezya. Oyu ngu Isawu, wisi waba Idomu.
Jakkobbu wakalikukkala munyika oomo wisi mwakali kukkala, munyika ya Kkenani.

Eezi zyakali zichitiko aatala aJakkobbu. Josefa, ooyo wakali mulombe ulaminyaka ilikkumi amusanu ayibili, wakalikwembela butanga abakkulana bakwe. Wakali abana balombe ba Biliha abana balombe ba Zilupa, banakazi bawisi. Josefa wakeeta makani mabi atala ambabo kuliwisi.
Lino Izilayeli wakayandisya Josefa kwinda bana bakwe balombe boonse nkambo wakalimwana wabuchembele bwakwe. Wakamuchitila jansi bbotu.
Bakulana bakabona kuti wisi wakamuyandisya kwinda bakulana bakwe boonse. Bakamusula alimwi tebakachili kwambula kabotu pe anguwe.
Josefa wakalota alimwi wakambila bakulana bakwe  aatala anchicho. Bakayindilila kumusula.
Wakati kulimbabo, "Aakaka amuswilizye chiloto nchindakalota.
Amubone, twalikwaanga misunta yamayila mumuunda, musunta wangu wakabuka wayima nji, alimwi amubone, misunta yanu yakazyunguluka akukotamina musunta wangu."
Bakulana bakwe bakati kulinguwe, "Nchobeni uyootwendelezya na? Ndisimpe na kuti uyotwendelezya? Bakayindilila kumusula loko nkaambo kaziloto amajwi aakwe.
Wakalota alimwi ichimbi chiloto waambila bakulana bakwe. Wakati, "Mubone, ndalota chimbi chiloto: Izuba amwezi anyenyezi zili kkumi ayimwi zyandikotamina."

Wakachambila wisi mbuli mbakabuzya bakulana bakwe mpawo wisi wakamukalalila. "Nchichili chiloto eecho nchiwalota? Nkasimpe na kuti banyoko, ime abakulana bako nchobeni tuzosika tuzokuvundame aansi kuli nduwe?"
Bakulana bakwe bakaba abbivwe anguwe, pesi wisi wakamba kaambo mumizeezo yakwe.
Bakulana bakwe bakayinka kuya kukwembela mbelele zyawisi kuSyekkemu.
Izilayeli wakati kuli Josefa, "Ani bakulana bako tabalokwembela mbelele zyawuso na kuSyekkemu? Boola alimwi nkutume kuli mbabo." Josefa wakati, "Ndilibambilide."

Wakati kulinguwe, "Yinka lino ukakubone kuti kulikabotu na abakulana bako alubo kuti bulikabotu na butanga, mpawo undizide aajwi."Aboobo Jakkobbu wakamutuma kuzwa kumusena waHebbuloni, alimwi Josefa wakaya kuSyekkemu.
Umwi mwalumi wakajana Josefa. Boona, Josefa wakali kuyabwenda mumuunda. Ooyu mwalumi wakamubuzya, "Ulangulaanzi?''
Josefa wakati, ''Ndookuyandula bakulana bangu. Ndambile inche ooko nkubalo kweembelela imbelele."
Mwalumi wakati, bazwa aabusena oobu, ndabamvwa nkabalokuti , ''Atuye kuDotaani."' Josefa wakatobela bakulana bakwe alimwi akuyobajana kuDotaani.
Bakamubona kachili kule ambabo , alimwi katanasika afwifwi ambabo bakayandula nzila yakuti balamuchita byeni.
Bakulana bakwe bakati kuli umwi awumwi, "Mulange ooyo sizilito uzabuza.
Mubole lino, aboobo, atumujaye akumuwaala muli limwi lyamalindi. Tulowamba kuti, 'munyama wamusokwe wamulya. Tuzozibona kuti ziloto zyakwe."
Lubbeni wakamvwa alimwi wakamuvuna kumaanza aabo. Wakati, "Atutatoli buumi bwakwe."
Lubbeni wakati kulimbabo, "Mutatili ganzi. Mumuwalile mudindi lilimunkanda, pesi muleke kubikka janza alinguwe" - kuchitila kuti amuvune kuzwa kujaanza lyabo kuti amwete lubo kuli wisi.
Nikwakasika awo Josefa nakasika kubakulana bakwe, bakamusamununa chikobela chakwe chibotu.
Bakamubweza akumuwalila mudindi . Idindi telyakaala chintu pe mukati.

Bakakkala aansi kuti balye insima. Bakatambya meso abo alimwi balanga, alimwi, amubone, mulongo waba Isyumayeli wakalikuzwa ku Giliyadi, ankamela zyabo kabanyampwide zilisyo amusamu atununkilizyo. Bakalikuya bweenda kabanyapwide kabaya kuIgipiti.
Juda wakati kubakulana bakwe, ''Chitupa mpinduunzi kuti twajaya mwanike wesu akuvwikkila ganzi lyakwe?
Mubole, alimwi tumuuzizye ma Isyumayeli alimwi tatubiki maanza esu pe alinguwe. Nkambo mwanike wesu, ninyama yesu. Bakulana bakwe bakamuswilizya.
Basambazi baba Midiyona bakayinda mpawo, bakulana bakwe bakagwisya Josefa kuzwa mudindi. Bakawuzya Josefa ku ma Isyumayeli a makumi aabili ansiliva. Ba Isyumayeli bakayinka awe ku Ijipiti.
Lubbeni wakabweda kudindi, amubone, Josefa taakachilimo pe mudindi. Wakadelula zisamo zyakwe.
Wakabweeda kubakulana bakwe akwamba kuti, "'Mulombe tachiko pe! Alimwi ime njinke kuli?''
Bakafunda mpongo mpawo bakabweza chigogo cha Josefa akuchinika muganzi.
Mpawo bakacheta kuli wisi akwamba kuti, "Twajana eechi. inche langa amwi nchicho chigogo chamwanaako naakuti pe."
Jakkobbu wakachilangisisya akwamba kuti , Nchigogo chamwana wangu. Munyama wamusokwe wamulya. Josefa nchobeni wazavulwa.
Jakkobo wakadelula zigogo zyakwe akubika saka muchikungu. Wakalila mwanakwe kwamazuba miingi.
Boonse bana bakwe balombe abasimbi bakabuka kuti bamumbulizye, pesi wakakaka kumbulizigwa. Wakati, ''Inchobeni ndoyinka aansi mukabanda nkindobulila mwanaangu." Wisi wakamulilila.
Ba Midiyeni bakamuzya kuIjipiti kuli Potifa , umwi silutwe waFalo, mupati wabasikamulinda.
Zyakachitika muleecho chiindi kuti Juda wakasiya bana bakwabo akuyokkala awumwi mu Adulamayiti, izina lyakwe kateegwa ngu Hila.
Ooko wakaswana mwana wechanakazi wamwalumi waku Kkenani zina lyakwe kateegwa Shuwa. Wakamukwata akuyowonawe.
Wakaminta akuzyala mwana mulombe. Wakamuuzika izina lyakuti Elu.
Wakaminta lubo akutumbuka mwana mulombe. Oyo ngwakawuzika izina lyakuti Onani.
Wakaminta lubo alimwi wakazyala mwana mulombe ngwakawuzika izina lyakuti Shila. Kwakali ku Chezibbu oko nkwakamuzyalila.
Juda wakajanina Elu mwana wakwe mulombe wabubele mwanakazi. Izina lyakwe walikuteegwa Tama.
Elu, mwana mutanzi wa Juda, wakali mubi mumenso aa Jehova. Jehova wakamujaya.
Juda wakati kuli Onani, ''Koya unjile kumwanakazi wamukulana wako. Uchite mulimo welede malinyina kulinguwe, kuti uzyalile mukulana wako mwana.''
Onani wakaziba kuti mwana takozoba wakwe pe. Kufumbwa mpakali kunjiila kumwanakazi wamukulana, wakali kusubila aansi bwalumi bwakwe kuti atazyalili mukulana mwana.
Nzyakachita zyakali zibi mumenso aa Yahweh. Yahweh wakamujaya alakwe.

Aboobo Juda wakati kuli Tama, mukamwana wakwe, ''Kakkale mung'anda yawuso mbuli mukamufu kusikila mane Shila, mwana wangu mulombe akkomene.'' Nkambo wakayowa, ''Kuti amwi alakwe afwe, mbuli bakkulana bakwe.''  Tama wakeenda wakukkala kung'anda yawisi.
Musule echindi chilamfu, mwana wa Shuwa, mwanakazi wa Juda,wakafwa. Juda wakuumbulizigwa alimwi wakaya kuli bageli bembelele zyakwe ku Timuna, we amwenzinyina Hila mu Adulamayiti.
Tama wakambilwa kuti, ''Langa, wusozyala uyobuya ku Timuna kuyogela mbelele zyakwe.''

Wakazwatununa zisamo zyakwe zyabumukamufu akulivumba anselelemba yakwe akulivulingilizya. Wakakkala kumanjililo a Enaimu, afwifwi amugwagwa uuya ku Timuna. Nkambo wakabona kuti Shila wakomena pele takomupegwa kuli nguwe kuti abe mwanakazi wakwe.
Eelyo Juda nakamubona wakayeya kuti mahule nkambo wakalivumbide busyu bwakwe.
Wakaya kuli nguwe kumbali amugwagwa, akwamba kuti ''Koboola kaka, ndizumizye ndiwone ayebo''- nkambo takwe nakaziba kuti ngumukamwana wakwe elyo we wakati, ''Ulandipaanzi kuti uwoone andime?''
Wakati, ''Ndiyokutambikizya kapongo kanini kuzwa mubutanga.'' wewakati, ''Ulandipa mbejiinzi yachijatizyo kotana kukatumizya kapongo?''  Wakati, ''Ino inga ndilakupa mbejiinzi?''
Wakavwiila, ''Chisimyo chako akakole alimwi amufunko uuli mukuboko kwako.'' Wakamupa nzizyo elyo wakanjila woonawe, mpawo wakaminta nkambo kakwe.
Wakabuka wiinka. Wakazwatununa selelemba yakwe wazwata zizwato zyabumukamufu bwakwe.
Juda wakatumizya kapongo kanini amwenzinyina mu Adulamayiti kuchitila kuti aboozezegwe imbeji yakwe kuzwa kujanza lyamwanakazi,  pele tamujene pe.
Elyo mu Adulamayiti wakabuzya baalumi bamubusena oobo, ''Ino ulikuli muhule wakali ku Enaimu kumbali amugwagwa?'' Bakati, ''Takwe pe nikwakali muhuule pe okuno.''
Wakabweda kuli Juda akuyowamba kuti, ''Nsiyomujene. Alimwi balumi bamubusena oobo baamba kuti, ''Takwepe nikwakali muhuule pe okuno.''
Juda wakati, ''Ngaalondole biyo izintu eezyo kuti tutawusigwi. Nchobeni, ndatumizya kapongo aaka kanini, pele toyomujene pe.''
Zyakachitika kuti kusule amyeezi yotatwe Juda wakambilwa kuti, Tama mukamwana wako wakahuula alimwi masimpe ulaada lyabuhule.''  Juda wakati, ''Amumweete okuno azoteentwe.''
Eelyo naketwa aanze, we wakatumizya ijwi kuli wisizyala, ''Ayooyo mwalumi uulezintu ezi ndimintide.'' Wakati mulangisisye kuti ezi zintu nzizyani, chisimyo atukole alimwi amufunko.''
Juda wakaziziba mpawo wakati, ''Walo uliluleme   kwinda ndime,  nkambo tendakamupa kuli Shila mwana wangu kuti abe mwanakazi wakwe..'' Taakwe nakonawe lubo pe.
Chakachitika kuti echindi chakutumbuka amubone mwida lyakwe mwakali mambile.
Nakali kusoonoka zyakachitika kuti umwi mwana wakagwisya kuboko, awosikutumbusya wakatola busumyo busalala waanga kukuboko alimwi wakati, ''Ooyu nguwazwa kusanguna.''
Kwakaba kuti mpakabwedezya kuboko kwakwe mukati, alimwi amubone munyina wakazwa kusanguna. Sikutumbusya wakati, ''Ino mbuwazopulumuka.'' Aboobo wakawuzikwa izina lyakuti Pelezi.
Lino alakwe wakalabusumyo busalala kukuboko kwakwe, alimwi wakawuzikwa zina lyakuti Zela.
Jozefu waketwa ku Ijipiti. Potifa imubelesi wa Falo iwakali mupati wabasikulinda alimwi kali muna Ijipiti, wakamweta kuzwa kuba Isyumayili, ibakali bamweta kunsi ooko.
Jehova wakali a Jozefu alimwi wakaba mwalumi uzwiidilila. Wakali  kukkala mung'anda yasimalelo wakwe muna Ijipita.
Simalelo wakwe wakabona kuti Jehova uli anguwe akuti Jehova wakachita kuti zyoonse nzyakali kuchita zizwidilile.
Jozefu wakajana insoni kukubona kwakwe. Wakamubelekela Potifa. Potifa wakamuchita mwendelezi wang'anda yakwe Jozefu azyonse nzyakali aazyo, wakazibika mumabambe aakwe.

Zyakachitika kuzwa kuchindi nakamuchita mwendelezi wang'anda yakwe awezintu zyoonse nzyakali ezyo, kuti Jehova wakalongezya ng'anda ya muna Ijipiti akaambo ka Jozefu. Ikulongezyakwa Jehova kwakali azintu zyoonse nzyakali aazyo Potifa mung'anda yakwe amumuunda.
Potifa wakabika zintu zyoonse nzyakali azyo mubulondozi bwa Jozefu. Takachilikwe kuyeeyanzi pe ado chakulya nchakali kulya. Lino Jozefu wakali mubotu akwebeka.
Zyakachitika musule acheechi nkuti bakazi basimalelo wakwe bakawaala menso aabo kuli Jozefu akwamba kuti, ''Laala andime.''
Pesi wakakkaka akwambila bana simalelo wakwe kuti, ''Boona, simalelo wangu talangisisyi pe kuli nzindichita mung'anda, alimwi wakabikka zyoonse nzyalazyo kubulondozi bwangu.

Takwe mupati kwinda mbebede pe mung'anda oomu. Takweepe nchasiside  kuli ndime pesi kuli nduwe, nkambo uli mwanakazi wakwe. Mboobuli lino mbundinga ndilachita bubi bupati oobu alimwi ndibisye kuli Leza?''
Wakali kwambila Jozefu buzuba abuzuba, pesi wakamukkakila kulala anguwe nakuti kuba anguwe.
Zyakachitika biyo limwi zuba kuti wakanjiila mung'anda kukuchita mulimu wakwe. Takwe muntu wang'anda wakalimo mung'anda omo.
Wakamujata azisamo akwamba kuti, ''Laala andime.'' Wakasiya zisamo zyakwe mujanza lyakwe, wachija, alimwi wayinka aanze.
Zyakachitika awo, nakabona kuti wamusila zisamo zyakwe mumaboko aakwe alimwi wachijila aanze,
ikuti wakayita bantu bang'anda yakwe akubaambila, ''Amubone Potifa wakeeta oyu mu Hibbulu kuti azotuseke swebo. Wanjila akuza kuli ndime kuti azolale andime, alimwi ndakwiila.
Zyachitika nkuti aawo nandimvwa kukwiila, wachija kasiya zisamo zyakwe kuli ndime, wachija, akuya aanze.''
Wakabikka zizwaato zyakwe afwiifwi anguwe mane simalelo wakwe waboola kumunzi.
Wakamwambila oobu bupanduluzi, ''Imubelesi mu Hibbulu nguwakatwetela, walinjide kuzondiseka.
Izyachitika nkuti nindakwiila wandisiila zizwato zyakwe wachija wayaanze.''
Zyakachitika obo kuti, awo simalelo wakwe nakamvwa bupanduluzi mbwakamwambila mwanakazi akwe, ''Eezi nzyandichitila mubelesi wako,'' wakanyema loko.
Simalelo wa Jozefu wakamubweza wamubika muntolongo, ibusena mwakali kujalilwa baange ba Mwami. Wakalimo muntolongo.
Pesi Jehova wakali a Jozefu kamutondezya kusyomeka muchizuminano. Wakamupa insoni kumenso aamupati wantolongo.
Imupati wentolongo wakapa baange boonse ibakali muntolongo mujaanza lya Jozefu. Kufumbwa nzibachita ooko, zyakali kwendelezegwa a Jozefu.
Mupati wentolongo takwe nakapengaana pe achintu  kufumbwa chakali mujaanza lyakwe, nkambo Jehova wakali anguwe. Kufumbwa nchakachita, Jehova wakachizwidilizya.
Nikwakainda chiindi, Sikwaba zyakunywa wamwami waku Ijipita a sikujika chinkwa wamwami bakabisizya simalelo wabo, mwami waku Ijipita.
Falo wakabanyemena basimulimo aba babili, silutwe wabasikwaba zyakunywa asilutwe wabasikujika chinkwa.
Wakabajalila mung'anda silutwe wabasikulinda muntolongo omo Jozefu mwakajalilidwe.
Silutwe wabasikulinda wakababikka mumaanza a Jozefu, alimwi Jozefu wakabakutawukila. Bakakkala muntolongo kwakayindi.

Bobile aba bakalota ziloto - sikwaba zyakunywa asikujika chinkwa wa mwami waku Ijipita bakalijalilidwe muntolongo - awumwi wakalota chakwe mansiku omwe, alimwi chimwi chiloto kachijisi bupanduluzi bwacho.
Jozefu wakaza kulimbabo kuseni alimwi wakababona. Ababone bakaliwuside.
Wakababuzya basimilimo ba Falo mbakajalilidwe aabo mung'anda yasimalelo wakwe, wati, ''Nkambonzi mulangika kamusulwidwe sunu?'' Bakamwambila,
Antomwe, ''twalota chiloto alimwi takwe unga wachipandulula.'' Jozefu wakabaambila, ''Íno bupanduluzi tebwa Leza ? Kamundaambila, ndakomba.''
Mupati wabasikwaba zyakunywa wakambila Jozefu chiloto chakwe. Wakamwambila wati,  ''Muchiloto changu ndabona, chisiko chamusansa chali anembo lyangu.
''Achisiko kwalimitabi iitatu, mbiyasyuuka, yafulula alimwi chikkata chamasansa chabizwa
''Nkomesi ya Falo yalimujanza lyangu. Ndabweza masansa alimwi ndaadinina munkomesi ya Falo, mpawo ndipedekezya Falo mujanza lyakwe.''
Jozefu wakamwambila wati, ''Bupanduluzi bwacho mboobu. Mitabi iitatu mazuba aatatu.
Mumazuba aatatu Falo uyokusumpula akukubwedezya kumulimu wako. Uyobikka nkomesi mujanza lya Falo, mbuli niwakali sikwaba zyakunywa wakwe.
Pele ukandiyeeye zyakukwendela kabotu ndakomba, ukandichitile buuya. Ukandambwide kuli Falo andigwisye muntolongo omu.
Nkambo zyanchonzyo ndakajomonwa kunyika yama Hebbulayo. Akokuno takwe chibi nchindakachita chindiwazya mudindi eli.''
Mupati wabasikujika chinkwa nakabona bupanduluzi bwabota, wakati kuli Jozefu, ''Ambe ndakalota, Alimwi, mulange zisuwo zitatu zyachinkwa zyakali amutwe wangu.
Chisuwo chakali ajulu chakali amisyobo yoonse yakulya kujikilwa Falo, pele tuyuni twakalya kulya muchisuwo kachilamutwe wangu.''
Jozefu wakamwambila wati, ''Bupanduluzi mboobu, zisuwo zitatu mazuba aatatu.
Mumazuba atatu Falo uyokudyunkula mutwe wako akukulengelezya amusamu tuyuni tuzolya mutunta wako.''

Kwakaba kuti mubuzuba bwatatu bwakali mbobuzuba bwakuzyalwa kwa Falo. Wakachita pobwe lyababelesi bakwe boonse - wasumpula mutwe wamupati wabasikwaaba zyakunywa alimwi amutwe wamupati wabasikujika chinkwa akati kababelesi alimwi.
Wakabwedezya mupati wabasikwaaba zyakunywa kumulimo wakwe alimwi wakabikka nkomesi mujanza lya Falo alubo.
Pele mupati wabasikujika chinkwa wakamwangilila, mbuli Jozefu mbwakamupandulwida.
Pele mupati wabasikwaaba zyakunywa takwe nakamuyeeya pe Jozefu, pele wakaluba atala anguwe.
Kwakasika aakauti kumamanino aminyaka iibili iizwide eelyo Falo wakalota. Bona, wakaliimvwi kumbali a Nayile.
Bona, in'ombe zili musanu azibili zyakasika kazizwa muli Nayile, zyeebeka alimwi kazineneede, alimwi zyakali kuchela mumatete.
Bona, izimbi n'ombe zili musanu azibili zyakasika kazitobela eezi kuzwa muli Nayile, kaziteebeki alimwi kazikotede. Zyakayimikila kumbali lyazimwi n'ombe kunkomwe ya mulonga.
Mpawo in'ombe ziteebeki kazikotede zyakalya in'ombe zili musanu azibili zyeebeka kazineneede. Mpawo Falo wakabuka.
Mpawo wakalala alimwi wakalota lwabili. Bona, mitwe yanseke ili musanu ayibili yakasika aasiko lyomwe, kiineneede alimwi kili mibotu.
Bona, mitwe iili musanu ayibili, iikotede akutentwa aluwo lwa kujwe, yakasyuuka musule lyayo.
Mitwe iikotede yakamena iili musanu ayibili iineneede alimwi kayizwide. Falo wakabuka, alimwi, bona, te ndiloto.

Kwakasika aakuti ikuseni muuya wakwe wakakatazikana. Wakatuma akwiita basondi boonse abasyabusongo bamu Ijipiti. Falo wakabaambila maloto aakwe, pesi takukwe naba omwe wakakonzya kwaapandulula kuli Falo.
Mpawo silutwe wabasikubweza nkomeki wakati kuli Falo, ''Sunu ndokuyeya aatala amilandu yangu.
Falo wakanyemena balanda bakwe, alimwi wakandibika muchitokesi mun'anda yamupati wabalindizi, silutwe wabapeka chinkwa andime.
Twakalota iloto mansiku omwe, we andime. Twakalota umwi awumwi muntu kakweendelana mbuli mubupanduluzi bwaloto lyakwe.
Kwakaliwo wakali aandiswe ooko mwaalumi waba Hibbulu, mulanda wamupati wabalindizi. Twakamwaambila alimwi wakatupandulwida maloto eesu. Wakapandulwida umwi awumwi wesu mbuli kulota kwakwe.
Kwakasika akuba mbuli mbaakatupandulwidide, kwakaba mbubo. Falo wakandibweedezya amulimu wangu pesi umwi wangu wakamwaanzika mulukole.''
Mpawo Falo wakatuma akwiita Jozefu. Bakamugwisya akufwambaana mumulindi uusiya zwi. Wakalinyoola, wazwata zimbi zizwato, alimwi wakasika wanjila kuli Falo.
Falo wakati kuli Jozefu, ''Ndakalota, pesi takwe sikupandulula iloto. Pesi ndamvwa aatala anduwe, kuti eelyo niwamvwa iloto ulakonzya kulipandulula.''
Jozefu wakasandula Falo, wakati, ''Tachili mulindime pe. Leza ulasandula Falo achoolwe.''
Falo wakaambula kuli Jozefu, ''Mumaloto angu, bona, kandiimvwi kunkomwe ya Nayile.
Bona, in'ombe zili musanu azibili zyakasika kuzwa muli Nayile, zineneede kazyeebeka, alimwi zyakali kuchela mumatete.
Bona, izimbi n'ombe zili musanu azibili zyakasika musule lyazo, zitakwe nguzu, kaziteebeki, alimwi kazikotede. Takwe mpundakali ndabona munyika yoonse ya Ijipiti kuteebeka kuli mbuli kwazyo.
In'ombe zikoteede kaziteebeki zyakalya in'ombe ntanzi zili musanu azibili zineneede.
Eelyo nizyakazilya tekwakali kuzibikana kuti zyazilya, nkaambo zyakachili kutayebeka mbuli mbuzyakabede lutanzi. Mpawo ndakabuka.
Ndakalanga muloto lyangu, alimwi, bona, mitwe misanu ayibili yakasika aatala aasiko lyomwe, iizwide kili mibotu.
Bona, imbi mitwe ili musanu ayibili - kinyanide, kiikotede, alimwi kiitentedwe aluwo lwa kujwe - yasyuuka musule lyayo.
Imitwe iikotede yakamena imitwe ili musanu ayibili mibotu. Ndakaambila basondi maloto aaya, pesi takwe naba omwe walikukonzya kundipandulwida pe.''
Jozefu wakati kuli Falo, ''Imaloto a Falo ngamwi. Ezyo Leza nzyayanda kuchita wazyaamba kuli Falo.
In'ombe mbotu zili musanu azibili minyaka iili musanu ayibili, alimwi imitwe mibotu iili musanu ayibili minyaka iili musanu ayibili. Maloto ngamwi.

In'ombe zikotede kaziteebeki zili musanu azibili zyakasika kazitobela eezi minyaka ili musanu ayibili, alimwi lubo mitwe iikotede yakatentwa aluwo lwa kujwe ili musanu ayibili inoli minyaka iili musanu ayibili yenzala.
Nchicho chintu eecho nchindakaamba kuli Falo. Eecho Leza nchayanda kuchita wachiyubununa kuli Falo.
Langa, minyaka iili musanu ayibili yakooloka kupati iyoosika munyika yoonse ye Ijipiti.
Minyaka iili musanu ayibili yenzala iyootobela musule, alimwi ikooloka koonse kuyoolubikana munyika ya Ijipiti, alimwi inzala iyoonyonyoona inyika.
Igoloka linoli kalitachiyeyegwi pe munyika akaambo kanzala izotobela nkaambo inoli nkali loko.
Ikuti iloto lyiindululwe kuli Falo nkukuti kaambo kakatangunwa aLeza, alimwi Leza lino-lino ulakachita.
Lino Falo ngayanduule mwaalumi uuchenjede alimwi uli abusongo, alimwi amubike abe mweendelezi wanyika yoonse ya Ijipiti.
Amuleke Falo asale basilutwe munyika, alimwi abazumizye bakabweze chasanu muzilyo  zya Ijipiti muminyaka iili musanu ayibili yakooloka.
Amuleke babunganye kulya koonse kwaminyaka eeyi mibotu iyobuza alimwi babambe kulya aansi abweendelezi bwa Falo, ikuti kulya kuzoobelesegwe mumadolopo. Bayelede kukubamba.
Ikulya kunoli kwanyika yoonse kwaminyaka iili musanu ayibili yanzala eeyo inoli munyika ya Ijipiti. Muleeyi nzila inyika tikoyoojayigwa anzala pe.''
Oku kuchenjezya kwakali kubotu kumenso aFalo akumenso kwabalanda bakwe.
Falo wakati kubalanda bakwe, ''Nga tulajana na mwaalumi uli mbuli oyu, mulinguwe muli Muuya waLeza?''
Aboobo Falo wakati kuli Jozefu, ''Mbulu kuti Leza wakautondeezya zyoonse, takwe umbi uchenjede kali abusongo mbuli nduwe.
Uloyendelezya n'anda yangu, alimwi mbuli kumajwi aako ibantu bangu boonse bayooyendelezegwa. Luzutu kuchuuno chabwaami nkwesinoli mupati kwiinda nduwe.''
Falo wakati kuli Jozefu, ''Langa, ndakubika mweendelezi munyika yoonse ya Ijipiti.''
Falo wakagwisya inweenwe yabwaami kuzwa kuluboko lwakwe alimwi wazwatika luboko lwa Jozefu. Wakamuzwatika zizwato ziteteete zya bwaami, alimwi wabika incheni yangolida munsingo yakwe.
Wakamuti ayende munkalaki yabili eeyo njaakalayo. Baalumi bakoompolola kunembo lyakwe, ''Tyola izwi.'' Falo wakamubika waba mweendelezi wanyika yoonse ya Ijipiti.
Falo wakati kuli Jozefu, ''Ndime Falo, alimwi kunze kwako, takwe mwaalumi uyonyampula kuboko kwakwe na kuulu kwakwe munyika yoonse ya Ijipiti.''
Falo wakawuzika Jozefu izina, ''Zafenati Paniya.'' Wakamupa Asenati, mwana musimbi wa Potifa mupayizi wa Oni, mbuli mwanakazi wakwe. Jozefu wakeendelezya nyika ya Ijipiti.
Jozefu wakali aminyaka iili makkumi aatatu eelyo  nakiima kunembo lya Falo, Mwaami wa Ijipiti. Jozefu wakazwa kunembo lya Falo, alimwi wakiinka munyika yoonse ya Ijipiti.
Muminyaka iili musanu ayibili yakooloka inyika yakaba abutebuzi bwiingi.
Wakabunganya kulya koonse kwaminyaka ili musanu ayibili kwakali munyika ya Ijipiti alimwi wabika kulya mumadolopo. Wakabika muli limwi alimwi dolopo ikulya kwakali kuzwa mumyuunda yakalizyungulukide.
Jozefu wakabunganya ikulya mbuli musele wamulwizi mubwiingi bwakuti wakaleka kubala, nkaambo tekwakachili kubalika pe.
Jozefu wakaba aabana balombe babili minyaka yenzala kiitanaasika pe, aabo Asenati, mwana musimbi wa Potifa mupayizi wa Oni, mbaakamuzyalila.
Jozefu wakawuzika mwana wakwe mutanzi izina litegwa manase, nkaambo wakati, ''Leza wachita ndaluba mafwabi aangu ampuli ya taata.''
Wakawuzika izina lyamwana mulombe wabili Ifulemu, nkaambo wakati, ''Leza wandichita ndaba aamichelo munyika yamafwabi aangu.''
Iminyaka iili musanu ayibili yazyiingi eeyo yakali munyika ya Ijipiti yakasika kumamanino.
Iminyaka ili musanu ayibili yanzala yakasanguna, mbuli mbaakamba Jozefu. Kwakaba nzala munyika yoonse, pesi munyika yoonse ye Ijipiti mwakali kulya.
Eelyo nyika yoonse ya Ijipiti niyakaba anzala, bantu bakakkwiilila Falo akaambo kachakulya. Falo wakati kubantu boonse ba Ijipiti, ''Amwiinke kuli Jozefu alimwi muchite eezyo nzyawamba.''
Inzala yakazulila busyu boonse bwa nyika yoonse. Jozefu wakajula zimumbwa zyoonse alimwi wawuzizya bamu Ijipiti. Inzala yakakomena munyika ya Ijipiti.
Inyika yoonse yakali kusika ku Ijipiti kuzowula chakulya kuli Jozefu, akaambo kenzala yakali yaba nkali loko munyika yoonse.
Lino Jakkobo wakaziba kuti kwakali kulya ku Ijipiti, wakati kubana bakwe balombe, ''Nkaambonzi nimulikulangana?''
Wakati, ''Mulange aawa, ndamvwa kuti kuli zilyo ku Ijipiti. Muselukile nkuko ooko alimwi mukatuulile kuzwa nkuko aboobo twalikupona a kutafwa.''
Bakulana ba Jozefu bakaselukila nkuko kuyoowula zilyo ku Ijipiti.
Pesi Jakkobo taakatuma Bbenjamini pe, mwanike wa Jozefu, aamwi abakulana bakwe, nkaambo wakati, ''Ndiyowa kuti amwi ibubi bukasike kulinguwe.''
Ibana balombe ba Izilayeli bakasika kuzoowula aakati kabaabo bakasikide, nkaambo inzala yakali munyika ya Kkenani.
Lino Jozefu wakali mweendelezi mupati aatala anyika. Nguwe wakali kuuzizya bantu boonse banyika. Bakulana ba Jozefu bakasika akukotamina aansi kulinguwe amasyu aabo kaalangide nyika.

Jozefu wakabona bakulana bakwe alimwi wakabaziba, pesi wakalisisa we lwakwe mwini kuli mbabo alimwi wakaambula chabukali ambabo, alimwi wakati kulimbabo, ''Nkuukuli nkumwazwa?'' Bakati, ''Kuzwa kunyika yeKkenani kuzowula kulya.''
Jozefu wakaziba bakulana bakwe, pesi bo tebakamuziba pe.
Mpawo Jozefu wakayeya maloto ngakali walota aatala ambabo, alimwi wakati kulimbabo, ''Muli bawuzyi! Mwaza kuzoobona busena butakwabililidwe bwa nyika yesu.''
Bakati kulinguwe, ''Pe, simalelo wangu. Balanda bako baza kuzowula kulya.
Tuli bana balombe ba mwaalumi umwi toonse. Tuli baalumi basyomekede. Balanda bako tensi bawuzyi pe.''
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Pe, mwaza kuzobona busena butakwabililidwe bwanyika.''
Bakati, ''Iswe tobalanda bako tuli balombe ikkumi ababili, bana balombe bamwaalumi uumwi wanyika ya Kkenani. Langa, imunini loko buunsi bwasunu uli ataata, alimwi umwi wesu tachiponi pe.''
Jozefu wakati kuli mbabo, ''Nzizyo nzindaamba kulindinywe; muli bawuzyi.
Azezi muloosunkwa. Abuumi bwa Falo, tamuloozwa pe aano, ado kuti mwanike wanu muniini loko asike aano.
Mutume umwi wanu alimwi akeete mwanike wanu. Munoli muntolongo, ikuti majwi anu akasunkwe, ikuti muli simpe na mulindinywe. Na amwi, abuumi bwa Falo, simpe loko muli bawuzyi.''
Wakababika boonse muchitookesi kwamazuba aatatu.
Jozefu wakati kulimbabo mubuzuba bwatatu, ''Muchite eechi alimwi mupone, nkaambo ndiyowa Leza.
Na kamuli baalumi basyomekede, muchite umwi wanu asyaale oomu muntolongo, pesi mwiinke, mubweze kulya nkaambo kanzala yaba en'anda zyanu.
Mweete mwanike wanu muniini loko kuli ndime ikuti majwi aanu akatambulike alimwi tamuzofwi pe.'' Aboobo bakachita mbubo.

Bakati kuli umwi awumwi, ''Isimpe ndiswe basimulandu aatala amwanama mukuti twakabona mulinguwe koomba kwa muuya wakwe aawo nakali kutukombelezya alimwi takwe nitwakaswiilila. Nkinkaako koomba ookum nchikwasika aatala andiswe.''
Lubbeni wakabasandula, '''Tendakamwaambila na, 'Mutabisizyi mulombe,' pesi temwakali kuswiilila pe? Lino, mulange, igazi lyakwe lyayandwa alindiswe.''
Tebakaziba pe kuti Jozefu wakali bamvwide, nkaambo kwakali mupanduluzi aakati kabo.
Wakazwa aakati kabo waakulila. Wakaboola kuimbabo alimwi wakaambula kulimbabo. WakabwezaSimiyoni kuzwa aakati kabo alimwi wamwaanga kunembo lyamenso aabo.
Mpawo Jozefu wakalayilila balanda bakwe kuti bazuzye masaka aabakulana bakwe azilyo, alimwi babike mali yawumwi awumwi musaka lyakwe, alimwi babape bulilu bwamulweendo. Zyakachitilwa mbabo.
Bakulana bakabika zilyo zyabo aamadonki alimwi bakanyampuka kuzwa aawo.
Mbuli umwi wabo nakajula isaka lyakwe kuti asanine idonki lyakwe nibakali kulyookezya, wakabona imali yakwe. Bona, yakali aamulyango wasaka lyakwe.

Wakati kubakulana bakwe, ''Imali yangu yabweedezegwa. Mwiibone; ili musaka lyangu.'' Imyoyo yabo yakayaaya alimwi bakalanganakabakankama kuli umwi awumwi, kabati, ''Niinzi eechi eecho Leza nchaatuchitila?''
Bakaya kuli Jakkobo, wisi wabo munyika ya Kkenani alimwi bakamwaambila zyoonse zyakachitika kuli mbabo. Bakati,
''Imwaalumi, mwaami wanyika, wakaambula chabukali kulindiswe alimwi wakayeya kuti tuli bawuzyi munyika.
Twakati kulinguwe, 'Tuli baalumi basyomekede. Tatweensi bawuzyi pe.
Tuli balombe bali kkumi ababili, bana bataata wesu. Umwi tachiponi pe, alimwi muniini loko buunsi oobuno uli aataata wesu munyika ya Kkenani.'

Imwaalumi, mwaami wanyika, wakati kulindiswe, 'Acheechi ndiyoziba kuti muli baalumi basyomekede. Musiye umwi wanu andime, mubweze kulya mutolele  bali munzala kun'anda zyanu, alimwi munjile nzila yanu.

Mukeete mwanike wanu muniini loko kulindime. Mpawo ndiyooziba kuti tamweensi bawuzyi pe, pesi kuti muli baalumi basyomekede. Mpawo ndiyowangununa mukulana wanu ndikamupe, alimwi munoosunza munyika.'''
Kwakasika aakuti nibakalikugwisya zilyo mumasaka aabo, ikuti, bona, umwi awumwi chikkwama cha nsiliva chakali musaka lyakwe. Eelyo bo a wisi wabo nibakabona zikkwama zyabo zye nsiliva, bakayowa.
Jakkobo wisi wabo wakati kulimbabo, '''Mwandimvwisya machise nkaambo kabana bangu. Jozefu tachiponi pe, Simiyoni wiinka, alimwi mulabweza Bbenjamini ayinke. Zyoonse zintu eezi tazizuminani andime.''
Lubbeni wakaambula a wisi, kati, ''Ulakonzya biyo kujaya bana bangu balombe babili ikuti ndataakuboozya Bbenjamini kulinduwe.''

Jakkobo wakati, ''Mwana wangu mulombe takooseluka ayinke andinywe pe. Nkaambo imukulana wakwe wakafwa alimwi nguwe alike uusyeede. Ikuti ibubi bwasika alinguwe munzila njimwiinda, mpawo muyovwikka imvwi zyangu mumafwabi ku Syiyoli.''
Lino nzala yakakomenesya munyika.
Lino kwakaba nibakamaninsya kulya zilyo nzibakagwisizye mu Ijipiti, wisi wabo wakati kulimbabo, ''Amwiinke lubo; mukatuulile zilyo.''
Juda wakamwaammbila, ''Ulya muntu nchibeni wakatuchenjezya, 'Tamukoyoobona busyu bwangu limbi anze kwakuti mwanike wanu kali aandinywe.'
Na mwatutuma aamwi amwanike wesu tulaseluka alimwi tukamuulile chakulya.
Pesi na temwamutuma, tatukooyinka. Nkaambo uulya mwaalumi wakati kulindiswe, 'Tamukoyoobona busyu bwangu limbi anze kwakuti mwanike wanu kali aandinywe.'''
Izilayeli wakati, ''Nkaambonzi nimwandijata bubi akwaambila mwaalumi uulya kuti muli amwanike uumbi?''

Bakati, ''Mwaalumi wakabuzya mubunike aatala andiwe alimwi ampuli yesu. Wakaamba kuti, 'Wuso wanu uchipona na? Muchili awumbi na mwanike?' Twakamusandula mbuli kumibuzyo eeyi. Twali kuyooziba biyeni kuti uyoowamba kuti, 'Mukeete mwanike wanu?'''
Juda wakaambila Izilayeli wisi, ''Tuma mulombe ayinke andime. Tuyoonyampuka akwiinka kuchitila kuti tupone akutafwa, aamwi iswe, iwe, alimwi abana besu.
Mebo ndiyooba chisyomezyo chakwe. Uyondibweza kandili mwiiminini. Na kuti tendaakumuboozya kulinduwe alimwi akumubika kunembo lyako, mpawo mebo andikabweze kusolwa kwalyoonse.
Nkaambo na tetwakanonokede, simpe kwalino nikuli twaboola aano lwabili.''

Wisi wabo Izilayeli wakabaambila kuti, ''Na kuti kakuli boobo, lino muchite eechi. Amubweze zimwi zibotu loko zyamichelo yanyika muzikkwama zyanu. Mutolele muntu chipo - atumwi tumabbona alimwi abuchi, tununkilizyo abutwizyo, amandongo ama alumondi.
Mubweze mali iyindulwidwe tubili mumaboko anu. Kumali eeyo yakabwedezegelwe kukujula masaka anu, mwiibweze alubo mumaanza anu. Ambweni kwakaba kulubizya.
Alubo mubweze mwanike wanu. Amunyampuke alimwi mwiinke lubo ku mwaalumi.
Leza Singuzuzyoonse amupe luzyalo kunembo lya muntu, kuchitila kuti amwaangunwide umwi wanu a Bbenjamini. Na mebo ndafwidwa bana bangu, mebo ndafwidwa.
Baalumi bakabweza chipo eechi alimwi mumaboko aabo bakalibwezede imali iyindulwidwe tubili, kabali aBbenjamini. Bakanyampuka alimwi baselukila kuIjipiti akwiima kunembo lya Jozefu.
Eelyo Jozefu nakabona Bbenjamini antomwe ambabo, wakaambila mubanzi waan'anda yakwe, ''Mundeetele baalumi mun'anda, jaya munyama utujikile, nkaambo baalumi bayoolya andime sikati.''
Mubanzi wakachita mbuli Jozefu mbakaamba. Wakeeta baalumi mun'anda ya Jozefu.

Baalumi bakaliyowede nkaambo bakeetwa kun'anda ya Jozefu. Bakati, ''Eechi nkaambo kemali njitwakabwedezegwa mumasaka eesu kuchiindi chitanzi nitwakazide kale, kuti ayandule mwenya aatala andiswe. Ulakonzya kutwaanga kutubweza mbuli bazike akutola madonki eesu.''
Bakayinkila mubanzi wamun'anda ya Jozefu, akwaambula aawe amulyango we n'anda yakwe,
akuti, ''Simalelo wesu, twakalizide lutanzi kuzowula zilyo.

Ichakachitika ncheechi, nitwakasika kubusena nkotukkala, nitwakajula masaka esu, alimwi nitwakalanga, woonse muntu wakajana mali yakwe mukujula saka lyakwe, imali myesu yakalikkwene mubulemu bwayo. Twazaayo lubo mumaanza esu.
Imwi mali twazaayo alubo mumaanza esu kuzowula zilyo. Tatuzi pe kuti ngwani wakabika mali yesu mumasaka esu.''

Sikubanza wakati, ''Luumuno ngalube kulindinywe, mutayowi. Leza wanu a Leza wawuso wanu nguwenya wakabika mali yanu mumasaka enu. Ndakatambula mali zyanu.'' Sikubanza mpawo wakagwisya Simiyoni anze kuli mbabo.
Sikubanza wakabanjizya baalumi mun'anda ya Jozefu. Wakabapa manzi alimwi bakasanzya mawulu aabo. Wakapa kulya ku madonki aabo.
Bakabambilila zipo zyakuboola kwa Jozefu sikati nkaambo bakali bamvwa kuti bayoolya nkuko.
Eelyo Jozefu nakasika kumunzi, bakeeta zipo zyakali mumaboko aabo mun'anda, akufugama aansi kunembo lyakwe.
Wakababuzya aatala abuponi bwabo alimwi wakati, ''Wuso wanu ulikabotu na, munene ngumwakalikwaamba? Uchipona na?''
Bakati, ''Mulanda wako taata wesu ulikabotu. Uchipona.'' Alimwi bakafugama akumupa bulemu.

Eelyo nakanyampula menso akwe wakabona Bbenjamini mwanike wakwe, mwana mulombe wabanyina, alimwi wakati, ''Oyu ngomwanike wanu muniini na ngumwakandaambila?'' Mpawo wakati, '''Leza abe aluzyalo kulinduwe, mwanaangu.''
Jozefu wakafwambaana kuzwa mun'anda, nkaambo wakajatikana kapati aatala amwanike wakwe. Wakayanduula busena bwakuyoolilila. Wakaya kuliimwi n'anda yakwe akuyoolila nkuko.
Wakasanzya busyu bwakwe akuzwa anze. Wakalijata lwakwe mwini, wakati, ''Mwaabe kulya.''

Balanda bakaabila Jozefu alike alimwi bakulana kabali abalike. Ba Ijipita awo bakalya anguwe kabali abalike nkaambo kakuti ba Ijipita tebakali kulya chinkwa aantomwe ama Hibbulu, eechi chakali kutondwa kuma Ijipita.
Bakulana bakwe bakalikkede kunembo lyakwe, mutanzi kwiindila mubuzyalwe bwabo, abaniini kwindila mubukubusi bwabo. Baalumi bakaligambide aantomwe.

Jozefu wakatumina zibeela kulimbabo kuzwa muchikkafu chakali kunembo lyakwe. Pesi chibeela cha Bbenjamini chakiindulwidwe musanu kwiinda nichiba chawumwi wabakulana bakwe. Bakanywa alimwi bakabotelwa.
Jozefu wakalayilila mulindi wanganda yakwe wati, " Zuzya abantu azilyo, mubwingi mbubakonzya kunyampula, alimwi bika mali aamuntu awumwi mumulomo wesaka lyakwe .
Bika yangu nkomeki yasiliva  mumulomo wesaka lyamunini, alimwi antomwe emali yakwe ya zilyo." Mulindi wanganda wakachita mbubonya Jozefu mbwaka mwambila.
Chindi chamafumina, elyo bantu bakategwa beende lwabo amadonki abo.
Nibakazwa kunze achisi pesi tebakali na bbilisya pe, Jozefu wakati kumupati wanganda yakwe, "Nyampuka tobela bantu aba, alimwi nuwakubezya ukabambile kuti, ' Nkambonzi nimubwedezya chibi kuchibotu?
Eyi tesi ninkomeki eyo mwami wangu njanywida alimwi njabelesya kukusondya? Mwachita chibi, eechi chintu nchimwachita."'
Mulindi wanganda yakwe wakababweza akwamba majwi aya kulimbabo.
Bakati kulinguwe, " Nkambonzi mwami wesu naamba majwi aya alibobu? Kuzwa kubalanda bako chilatondwa kuchita chintu chilobu.
Langa, mali njitwajana mumulomo yamasaka, twayibozya lubo kuli nduwe kuzwa kunyika yaKkenani. Mbubuli lino mbutunga tulabba munganda yamwami wako isiliva na ingolida?
Na kulumwi wabalanda utajanwe ayo, ngakafwe, alimwi aswebo tuyoba bazike bamwami."
Mulindi wanganda wakati " Lino aboobo akube mbubonya mbulimajwi enu. Oyo uyojanwa enkomeki uyoba muzike wangu, alimwi nobamwi munoli tamujisi mulandu."
Mpawo awumwi muntu wakafwambana kweta saka lyakwe akulitula ansi, alimwi awumwi wakajula saka lyakwe.
Mulindi wanganda wakalangula.  Wakatalikila kumupati akuyosyalizya kumunini, alimwi inkomeki yakajanwa musaka lyaBbenjamini.
Lino bakadelula zyakusama zyabo. Awumwi muntu wakanga donki lyakwe akubweda kudolopo.
Juda abakulana bakwe bakaza kuliJozefu kunganda. Wakachiliwo alimwi bakavundama kunembo lyakwe ansi.
Jozefu wakati kulimbabo, nchinzi eechi nchimwachita? Sa tamuzi kuti muntu ulimbuli ndime ulachita zyakusonda?"
Juda wakati, " Tulambanzi kumwami wesu? Tulambulanzi? Nanka tulalipandulula byeni lwesu tubeni? Leza wajana buubi abalanda bako. Langa tulibazike bamwami, toonse ayooyo wajanwa ankomesi."
Jozefu wakati, " Azibe kule ambebo, kulatondwa  kuchita obo. Mwalumi oyu uli amaboko ajanwa ankomeki, oyo muntu uyoba muzike wangu pesi nywebo nobamwi amwinke mulumuno kuliwuso."
Mpawo Juda wakaza afwifwi kulinguwe wakati," Mwami wangu, ince leka mulanda wako awambule ijwi mumatwi aMwami wangu, alimwi utalekeli bukali bwako amulanda wako, nkaambo uli mbuli Falo.
Mwami wangu wakabuzya balanda bakwe, wati mulawuso na naanka mukulana?'
Twakati kumwami wesu, ' Tuli ataata munene amwana wabunene bwakwe, munini loko. Pesi mukulana wakafwa, alimwi we lwakwe nguwe wasyala abanyina, awisi ulamuyandisya.'
Mpawo wakati kubalanda , 'Mumwete kulindime kuti ndimubone.'
Musule lyaya, twakati kumwami, 'Mulombe takonzyi kusiya wisi. Nkaambo ayosiya wisi oyo wisi uyofwa.'
Mpawo wakatu kubalanda bako, ' Kuti temwaza amwanike wanu mulombe tamukozobona  busyu bwangu limbi.'
Mpawo chakasika chindi nchitwakabweda kumulandako ndendesu, twakamwambila majwi amwami.
Taatesu wakati,  "Amubwede lubo mukawule chakulya."
Mpawo twakati, "Tatuko bweda pe. Kuti mwanike wesu nkaali aswe, alimwi tulinka, swebo tatukuyonkonzya kubona busyu muntu oyu ado kuti mwanike wesu twiinke awe.'
Mulanda wako taatesu wakati kulindiswe, "Mulizi kuti mwanakazi wangu wakandizyalila bana balombe bobile.
Omwe wabo wakenda kuzwa kulindime alimwi ndakati, " Nchobeni ndakati ulikwamwidwe mutumpanzimpanzi, alimwi tandichimubwene kuzwa lili."
Lino na mwandibwezela oyu kuzwa kulindime, alimwi kuchisa kwasikila nguwe muyoselezya imvwi zyangu kuzwa mukabanda.'
Lino na, ndakusika kumulanda wako taatesu alimwi mulombe katutakwawe pe, kuzwa buumi bwakwe ulabutula kubumi bwamulombe,
ziyochitika nzyakuti, nayobona mulombe taliaswebo uyofwa. Balanda bako bayoselezya imvwi zyamulanda wako taatesu mukabanda.'
Nkaambo mulanda wako waba musimyi nkaambo kamulombe kulitaatesu alimwi wakati, " Ikuti tendamweta kulinduwe, njoba amulandu kulitaatesu lyoonse.'
Lino na, ince mundileke nsyale ndemulanda wako achibbaka chamulombe muzike kumwami wangu, alimwi alekwe mulombe ayinke abakulanabakwe.
Nkambo nsikonzyi kwinka kuli taatesu na mulomb katutali awe. Ndayowa kubona bubi obo buyosika kuli taatesu."
Lino Jozefu wakakachilwa kulizyotolola kwakwe mwini kunembo lyabo boonse balanda bakimvwi anguwe.

Wakambula chakompolola wati, "Woonse muntu uyelede andisiye." Aboobo takwe mulanda  wakachimvwi awe elyo Jozefu nakachilikuliziby lwakwe kubakulana bakwe. Wakalila akompolola ma-Ijipiti akamumvwa, benganda yaFalo bakamvwa.
Jozefu wakati kubakulana bakwe, "Ndime Jozefu. Uchipoona na taata? " Bakulana bakwe takwe nibakamusandula nkaambo bakaliku kankama nkaambo kakuba kwakwe.
Elyo Jozefu wakati kubakulana bakwe muze, " Muze  afwifwi kulindime ikaka. Wakati, "Ndime Jozefu mwanike wanu, ngumwaka wuzizya kuIjipiti.
Mutapengi, na kulinyemena lwanu kuti mwakanduzya me okuno, nkaambo Leza wakandituma kunembo lyanu kuti nkamubambile kupona.
Kwaminyaka eyi yobile kulya kwabulika munyika, alimwi kuchili imbi ilimusanu iyobuza kutabulike kulima na kutebula.
Leza wakandituma kunembo lyanu kuti mubambile mube bafutuki munyika, kuti mube baponede alwangunuko lupati.
Aboobo teensi ndinwe mwakandituma okuno pesi nguLeza, alimwi wakandichita kuti ndibe wisi waFalo, mwami wanganda yakwe yoonse, amweendelezi wenyika yoose yaIjipiti.
Mufwambane alimwi mwinke kulitaata  akuyomwambila kuti, 'Ezi nzenzizyo nzyawamba mwana wako Jozefu, " Leza wandichita mwami wabaIjipiti boonse. Boola ansi kuli ndime, utanonoki.
Uyokkala muchisi chaGosheni, alimwi unoli afwifwi andime, Iwe abana bako, ambelele zyako, angombe zyako, azyoonse nzoli azyo.
Njokupa nkuko kaambo kuchili myaaka misanu yabbalangwe, aboobo tokoza kukufwaba, iwe empuli yako azyonse nzyoli azyo.'"
Langa, menso ako abone, ameso amwanike wangu Bbenjamini, kuti mulomo wangu nguwambula kuli nduwe.
Uyomwambila taata atal abulemu bwangu muIjipiti azyoonse nzimwabona. Mukafwambane akundetela taata okuno."
Wakakumbata mwanike Bbenjamini munsingo akulila, alakwe Bbenjamini wakalila ansingo yakwe.
Wakaba myonta boonse bakulana bakwe akulila alimbabo. Kuzwa awo bakambula awe.
Impuwo yatwambo yakakwambulwa munganda yaFalo:   '''Bakulana baJozefu basika." Zyakabotezya Falo abalanda bakwe kapati.
Falo wakati kuli Jozefu , ''baambile bakkulana bako, Amuchite eechi amwange banyama banu mwinke ku kkenani.
Mubweze uso wanu ampuli zyanu mpawo musike kulindime. Ndiyomupa bubotu bwanyika.
Lino mwalayililwa, kuti muchite boobu, amubweze zikkochikala kuzwa munyika ya Ijipiti zibe zyabana abanakazi banu. Mubweze wuso wanu akuza.
Mutalikataazyi anzimulaazyo, nkaambo bubotu boonse bwenyika ya Ijipiti mbubwenu.''
Bana ba Izilayeli bakachita mbuboobu. Jozefu wakabapa zikkochikala, nkwindililaa mumalayilile a Falo, aali aamwi wabapa abulilu bwamu lweendo.
Kuli boonse kuli boonse wakabapa chizwaato chakucchincha, pesi Bbenjamini wakamupa myaanda yotatweyamaali yansiliva amusanu wazizwaato zyakuchincha.
Kuli wisi wakatumizya  ezi: madonki aali kumi kaabwezede zintu zibotu zyamu Ijipiti amadonki aalikkumi mazyazi kabwezede zilyo, chibunge, aamwi kaabwezelede wisi zyamulweendo.
Aboobo wakabatuma bakulana bakiinka. Wakabaambila kuti, ''Mubone tamukakalazyani mulweend.''

Bakeenda kuzwa mu Ijipiti akusika munyika yamu Kkenani, kuli Jakkobbu wisi wabo. Bakamwaambila kuti '' Jozefu uchipona, alimwi nguwe mwendelezi wachisi choonse cha Ijipiti.'' Moyo wakwe wakagamba, nkaambo takali kuzumina anzibakamwaambila.

Bakamwaambila woonse majwi aa Jozefu ngakambila. Eelyo Jakkobbu nakabona zikkochikala eezyo Jozefu nzyakatumizya kuti zikamu bweze, imuuya wa Jakkobbu wisi wakamutambula. Izilayeli wakati,'' kwazulila. Jozefu mwana wangu uchipona. Ndilayinka akuyomubona nketanaafwa.
Bakamwambila majwi oonse Jozefu ngakali wabambila. Jekkobbu nakabona nkalaki zyakali zyatumwa aJozef kuti zizomubweze, muuya waJekkobbu ndendabo wakabukulusigwa.
Izilayeli wakati," Kwazulila. Jozefu mwanangu uchipona. Ndilinka ndikamubone nkesena fwa pe."
Izilayeli wakasanguna lwendo lwakwe azyonse nzyakalazyo akuya ku Bbelisyeba. Oko wakakupa zipayizyo kuli Leza wa wisi Ayizeki.
Leza wakaambula a Izilayeli muchiyubunuzyo mansiku, wakati, ''Jakobo , Jakobo.'' Wakati, ''Ndiliwaano.''
Wakati ''Ndime Leza wawuso. Utayowi kuya ku Ijipiti, nkambo njokuchita chisi chipati nkuko.
Njoyenda ayebo kuyaku Ijipita, aboobo njokuboozya alimwi mpawo Jozefu uyokuvumba meso ako amaboko akwe mwini.''
Jakobo wakabuka kuzwa ku Bbelisyeba. Bana ba Izilayeli bakamubweza Jakobo wisi wabo, bana babo, abamakayintu babo, muzikochikala ezyo Falo nzyakatumide kuzomubweza.
Bakabweza zivuubwa ambono nzibakali babungika munyika yaKkenani.
Bakasika mu Ijipita abana bakwe balumi, abana bakwe babana bakwe basimbi, aboonse balunyungu lwakwe.
Aya ngemazina abana baalumi ba Izilayeli bakaza mu Ijiputi. Jakobo azyalane lyakwe, Lubbeni, mwana mutanzi wa Jakobo;
bana ba Lubbeni, Hanoki, Palu, Heziloni, a Kkalimi;
ibana ba Simiyoni, Jemuyeli, Jamini, Ohadi, Jakkini, Zowali, a Shawulu, ibana bamwanakazi mu Kkenani;
abana bamu Levi, Geshomu, Kkohati, a Melali.
Ibana balombe ba Juda kwakali Elu, Onani, Shela, Pelezi, a Zela, ( pesi Elu a Onani bakali bafwa munyika ya Kkenani) Bana ba Pelezi kwakali Heziloni a Hamulu.
Ibana ba Izakka kwakali Tola, Puwa, Lobbu, a Shimuloni;
Ibana balombe ba Zebbuluni kwakali Seledi, Eloni, a  Jaleli
Aba bakali bana balombe ba Liya mbakazyala kuli Jakobo mu Padani Alamu, antomwe amwana wakwe musimbi Dina. Bana bakwe balombe antomwe abasimbi bakali mukkumi atatu - abatatu
Ibana balombe ba Gadi kwakali Zefoni, Hagi, Shuni, Ezibboni, Eli, Alodi, a Aleli.
Ibana balombe ba Asha kwakali Imuna, Ishiva, Ishivi, a Bbeliya; alimwi Sela wakali muchizi wabo. Ibana balombe ba Bbeliya kwakali Hebba a Malikiyeli
Aba bakali bana balombe ba Zilipa, abo Labbani mbakapa mbakazyala kuli Jakobe - kkumi amusanu awumwi kubabika antoomwe.
Ibana balombe ba mukayintu wa Jakobo mbakazyalilwa a Lakkeli kwakali Jozefu a Bbenjamini.
Mu Ijipita Manase a Efulemu mbakazyala  Jozefu kuli Esinati, imwana musimbi wa Potifela mupayizi wa Oni.
Ibana balombe ba Bbenjamini kwakali Bbela, Bbeka, Ashibbelu, Gela, Namani, Ehi, Loshi, Mupimu, Hupimu, a Alidi.
Aba mbebana balombe ba Lakkeli bakazyalwa kuli Jakobo - kkumi abane kubabikaantomwe.
Mwana mulombe wa Dani wakali Hushimu.
Bana balombe ba Nafutali kwakali Jaziyeli Guni, Jeza, a Shilemu
Aba mbebana balombe Jakobo mbakazyala kuli Bbiluna abo Labbani mbakapa Lakkeli mwanakwe musimbi - musanu ababili antomwe.
Abo boonse bakayinka ku Ijipita a Jakobo bakali bazyalani lyakwe, kutabala bana balombe babakayintu ba Jakobo, bakali makumi musanu awumwi.
Antomwe abana ba Jozefu bakazyalilwa mu Ijipiti, mweelwe wempuli yakwe  bakaya ku Ijiputi bakali makumi musanu aabili.
Jakobo wakatuma Juda kunembo lyakwe kuli Jozefu kuti atondezye nzila kunembo lyakwe iyaku Gosheni, aboobo bakasika kunyika ya Gosheni.
Jozefu wakabambila nkalaki yakwe akuyo swanizya Izilayeli wisi mu Gosheni. Wakamubona, wamukumbata mukosi, akulila munsingo yakwe kwachiindi chilamfu.
Izilayeli wakati  wakati kuli Jozefu , ''Lino leka mfwe, nkambo ndabona busyu kuti uchipona.''
Jozefu wakati kubananyina akung' anda yawisi, ''Ndilayinka akuyowambila Falo kuti, 'Bakwesu abang' anda yataata, bakali munyika ya Kkenani, baza kuli ndime.
Balumi mbembezi, nkambo bakali babambi bazivuubwa. Bazabutanga bwabo, ang' ombe zyabo azyonse nzibakali azyo.'
Ziyochitika nayomwita Falo akubuzya, 'Muchita mulimoyi?''

Mukatedi, ''Tubalanda bako tuvuba lubono kuzwa kubu kubusi bwesu kuyosika sunu, iswebo abasikale besu.'' Muchite ezi kuti mukkale munyika ya Gosheni, nkambo wonse mweeembeli nchisesemyo kubantu bamu Ijipiti.''
Mpawo Josefa wakayinka akuyowambila Falo, "Taata abakwesu, ambelele zyabo, angombe zyabo azyoonse nzebalaazyo basika kuzwa kunyika yaKkenani. Bona, balimunyika yaGosheni."
Wakabweza bakwabo bali musanu akuyo bazibya kuli Falo.
Falo wakati kubana nyina, "Muchita mulimu nzi?" Bakati kuli Falo, "Ibalanda bako mbembezi, mbuli basikale besu.''

Mpawo bakati kuli Falo, "Tuzide biyo kuzokkala muchindi chifwiifwi munyika. Tachikwe machezezyo aambono zyabazike bako nkambo nzala yakkomena muchisi cha Kkenani. Elyo lino ikaka leka bazike bako bakkale munyika yaGosheni."
Mpawo Falo wakambula kuli Josefa , kati, "Wuso abana nyokwe baza kulinduwe.
Inyika ya Ijipiti ilikunembo lyako. Kkazika wuso abana nyokwe mubusena bubotu, munyika yaGosheni. Na kozi baalumi bakonzya akati kabo, babike babambe zivubwa zyangu."
Mpawo Josefa waketa Jakkobo wisi akumwimika kunembo lya Falo. Jakkobo wakalongezya Falo.
Falo wakati kuli Jakkobo, ''Wapona kwachiindi chilamfu byeni?
Jakkobo wakati kuli Falo, "Minyaka yanyendo zyangu ilimwaanda amakumi atatu. Minyaka yabumi bwangu miche alimwi nkichisa. Tensi yaba milamfu mbuli yabasikale bangu pe.
Mpawo Jakkobo wakalongezya Falo akuzwa kubusyu bwakwe.
Mpawo Josefa wakakazika wisi abananyina. Wakabapa busena munyika ya Ijipiti, busena bubotu kwiindilila, muchisi chaLamesesi, mbuli Falo mbakalayilila.
Josefa wakapa kulya kuli wisi, bananyina antomwe aboonse banganda yawisi mbuli kuvula kwabo aasuwa.
Lino tekwakachili kulya pe munyika yoonse; nkambo nzala yakali yakomena. Inyika ya Ijipiti anyika ya Kkanani yakali yoomba nkambo kanzala.
Josefa wakabungania mali yoonse yakali munyika ya Ijipiti anyika ya Kkenani akuwuzya zilyo kubantu bakala munyika ezi. Mpawo Josefa waketa mali eyi kunganda ya Falo.
Elyo mali yonse yamunyika ya Ijipiti a Kkenani niyaka mana, boonse bantu bakasika kuli Josefa bati, "Tupe kulya! Nkamboyi nchetutafwe kunembo lyako kambo kakuti imali yesu yamana?"
Josefa wakati, "Naakuti imali yanu yamana mwete mbono zyenu kuti mupe kulya kuli zicheede.
Abobo baketa mbono zyabo kuli Josefa. Josefa wakabapa kulya akuchinchana ambongolo, mbelele, ngombe amadonki. Wakabasanina achinkwa kalo kuchinchaana azivubwa munyaka oyo.

Nwakamana oyo munyaka, bakaboola kuli nguwe munyaka wakatobela bamba kuti kili nguwe, "'Tatukosisa kuli simalelo wesu kuti mali zyesu zyamana , ingombe zyesu zyoonse zyaba zyasimalelo wesu. Takwe zyasyala pe kumeso asimalelo , ado mibili yesu.
Tufwideeyi kunembo lyameso iwebo anyika yesu? Tuule iswe anyika akuchincha akulya alimwi iswe anyika yesu tulaba bazike ba Falo. Tupe imbuto kuti tupone, kuti tutafwi , nyika itanyonyoki."
Aboobo Josefa wakawula nyika ya Ijipiti nkawulila Falo. Aboobo woonse muna Ijipiti wakawuzya muunda nkambo nzala yakali yakomena. Muli yeyi nzila, inyika yakaba yaFalo.
Ibantu wakabachita bazike kuzwa kumagolelo aamugaano kuyosikila kulilimwi bbazu lyamamanino.
Kwakacheede biyo nyika yabapayizi eyo Josefa njakatawula, nkambo bapayizi bakalikupegwa chaabilo. Bakalikulya chaabilo Falo nchakali kubapa. Abobo tensi bakawuzya pe nyika yabo.
Josefa wakambila bantu kuti, "Amubone, sunu inywebo anyika zyanu ndamuulila Falo. Lino njeyi mbuto yanu, yakuti mukabyale myunda.
Kuchindi chakutebula mwelede kupa chipanzi chasanu kuli Falo alimwi zipanzi zine ziyoba zyanu, nzyambuto yamyunba yanu alimwi nzyakulya mumpuli zyanu alimwi nzyabana banu."
Bakati, '''Wafutula mawumi esu. Katujane luzyalo kumeso aako. Tuyoba balanda ba Falo.''
Aboobo Josefa wakachita waba mulawu ubeleka munyika ya Ijipiti kusikila sunu, kuti chipanzi chomwe muli zili musanu nchicha Falo. Kusiya biya nyika yabapayiza njiyakataba ya Falo.
Aboobo Isilayeli wakakkala munyika ya  Ijipiti mubusena bwa Gosheni. Bantu bakwe bakajana buvubi  oko. Bakazyalisya akuvula loko.
Jakkobo wakapona munyika ya Ijipiti minyaka ili kkumi amusanu ayibili, aboobo minyaka yabuumi bwakwe Jakkobe yakali mwanda amakkumi one alaminyaka musanu ayibili.

Nichakaswena afwiifwi chiindi chakufwa kwa Isilayeli, wakita mwanakwe Josefa akumwambila kuti, "Naakuti ndajana luzyalo kumeso ako, bika kuboko kwako munsi achibelo changu, akunditondezya chaluzyalo achakusyomeka. Ikaka mutakandivwiki mu Ijipiti.
Nindayo wona abamataata, uyondibweza kuzwa mu Ijipiti uyondivwika kubusena bwazyuumbwe zyabamataata."
Isilayeli wakati, "Konka kulindime ," awo Josefa wakakonka kulinguwe. Mpawo Isilayeli wakakotama ansi kumutwe wabulo bwakwe.
Chakasika aatala lyazintu eezi, kuti umwi wakaambila Jozefu kuti, ''Langa, wuso ulichisidwe.'' Aboobo wakabweza bana bakwe balombe bobile, Manase a Ifulemu.
Eelyo Jakkobbu nakaambilwa, ''Langa, mwana wako mulombe Jozefu wasika kuzokubona,'' Izilayeli wakaliyumya-yumya alimwi wakkala abulo.
Jakkobbu wakati kuli Jozefu, ''Leza Singuzuzyoonse wakalibonia kulindime ku Luzi munyika ya Kkenani. Wakandilongezya
alimwi wakati kulindime, 'Bona, ndiyokuchita kuti ukabe amichelo, alimwi ndiyokuvuzya. Ndiyochita kuzwa mulindime imbungano yamanyika. Ndiyoopa nyika eeyi kulunyungu lwako mbuli buvubi bwalyoonse.'

Lino bana bako balombe babili, aabo bakatumbukwa kulinduwe munyika ya Ijipiti nkesinaasika kulinduwe munyika ya Ijipiti, mbibangu. Ifulemu a Manase bayooba bangu, mbuli Lubbeni a Simiyoni mbubali bangu.
Bana mbolaabo musule lyabo bayooba bako; bayoolembwa munsi lyamazina abakulana babo bachaalumi mulukono lwabo.
Pesi lwangu, eelyo nindakazwa ku Padeni, kukuusa kwangu Lakkeli wakafwa munyika ya Kkenani munzila, nkakuchili musinzo kuya ku Efulati. Ndakamuzika nkuko munzila yaku Efulati'' (njenjiyo Betelehemu).
Eelyo Izilayeli nakabona bana balombe ba Jozefu, wakati, ''Mbaani aaba?''
Jozefu wakaambila wisi, '''Mbana bangu balombe, abo Leza mbakandipa okuno.'' Izilayeli wakati, "Beete kulindime, ikuti ndibalongezye.''
Lino menso a Izilayeli akali aagubilizi akaambo kaminyaka yakwe, aboobo takachilikubona pe. Aboobo Jozefu wakabeeta afwifwi kulinguwe, alimwi wakabamyonta akubakumbata.
Izilayeli wakati kuli Jozefu, ''Tendakalikuyeeyela kubona busyu bwako pe limbi, pesi Leza wandizumizya kuti ndibone bana bako.''
Jozefu wakabeeta kuzwa aakati kamazwi a Izilayeli, alimwi wakavundama a busyu bwakwe kunyika.

Jozefu wakabatola boonse babili, Ifulemu muluboko lwakwe lwachilisyo kunembo lya luboko lwa Izilayeli lwachimweensi, alimwi Manase muluboko lwakwe lwachimweensi kunembo lya luboko lwa Izilayeli lwa chilisyo, alimwi wakabeeta afwifwi kulinguwe.

Izilayeli wakasikila luboko lwakwe lwachilisyo alimwi walutandabika aatala lyamutwe wa Ifulemu, wakali muniini, alimi luboko lwakwe lwachimweensi aatala lyamutwe wa Manase. Wakapiyania maboko aakwe, nkaambo Manase mwana mutanzi.
Izilayeli wakalongezya Jozefu, nkali kuti, ''Leza ooyo nkubakeenda kunembo lyakwe bamataata Abbulahamu a Ayizekki, Leza ooyo uchindibambide ambuli sunu,
mungelo wakandivuna kulizyoonse zichisa, ngalongezye balombe aaba. Izina lyangu ngalikawuzikwe alimbabo, alimwi azina lyamataata aangu Abbulahamu a Ayizekki. Ngabakomene akuba nkamu enyika.''
Eelyo Jozefu nakabona wisi kabikide luboko lwakwe aatala amutwe wa Ifelemu, tezyakamubotezya pe. Wakaweza luboko lwawisi lwachilisyo kuzwa ku mutwe wa Ifulemu kuya kumutwe wa Manase.
Jozefu wakaambila wisi, ''Tensi mbubo, taata wangu; nkaambo ooyu ngonguwe mwana mutanzi. Bika luboko lwako lwachilisyo aatala amutwe wakwe.''

Wisi wakakkaka alimwi wakati, ''Ndilizi, mwana wangu mulombe, ndilizi. Alakwe uyooba muntu, alimwi alubo uyooba mupati. Pesi mwanike wakwe uyooba mupati kwiinda nguwe, alimwi lunyungu lwakwe luyooba makkamu amanyika.''

Izilayeli wakabalongezya buzuba oobo amajwi aaya, ''Bantu ba Izilayeli bayowamba zilongezyo kwiinda mumazina aako nkabati, 'Leza akuchite kuti ube mbubonya mbuli Ifulemu a mbuli Manase.''' Muli yeeyi nzila, Izilayeli wakabika Ifulemu kunembo lya Manase.
Izilayeli wakati kuli Jozefu, ''Bona, ndaamba kufwa, pesi Leza uyooba andinywe, alimwi uyomuboozya kunyika yabamawuso.
Kulinduwe, mbuli ooyo uli aatala lyabakulana bakwe, ndilakupa chilundu chinkuneme nchindakabweza kuzwa kuma Amoliti apanga lyangu a kanta kangu.''
Mpawo Jakobo wakayita bana bakwe balombe alimwi wakati,: ''Amulibunge nywebo antomwe, kuti ndimwambile nywebo echo chiyochitika kulindinywe mubuzuba buza.
Amubungane lwenu akuswilila, inywe nobana ba Jakobo. Amuswilile kuli Izilayeli, wuso wanu.
Lubbeni, ulimwana wangu mutanzi, inguzu zyangu, amatalikilo akusima kwangu, uyimvwi mubulemu, amunguzu.
Utayimikiziki mbuli manzi alokwenda, tokoyoba abupati pe, nkambo winka atala lya buulo bwa wuso. Aboobo wusofwazya; winka ataala lyamukaintu wangu.
Simiyoni a Levi mbanyina. Zilwisyo zyalumamba zyaabo ngemapanga aabo.
Omuuya wangu, utanjili mumvwiyo zyabo; Utaswanani mumibunga yabo, nkambo moyo wangu uli abulemu kulizezyo. Amunyemo zyabo bakajaya bantu. Amukunyema kwabo bakatyola musune.
Alunyemo lwabo lutukwe, abobo lwakali kuyoosya - alimwi akunyema kwabo kwabo kwakali kuyumu. Ndiyoba pambula muli Jakobo aa kubamwayusya muli Izilayeli.
Juda, ibakkulana bako bayokutembawula. Ikuboko kwako kuyoba atala ansingo zyaba sinkondonyokwe. Ibana bawuso bayokukkotamina kunembo lyako.
Juda mwana wa mulavu. Mwanangu mulombe wazunda kuli basinkondonyokwe.Wakakotama aansi, wenda mbuli mulavu, mbuli mulavu muzyazi. Ngwani unga uyomubusya ?
Inkoli tikoyomana kuzwa kuli Juda, Nuuba mufunko wabwami waakati kazituta zyakwe, mane Shilo akasike. Ngonguwe manyika ngatakaswilile.
Uulanga mbongolo yakwe kumisansa, Amwana wembongolo yakwe inzyazi nimbotu, wasanzya zyakusama zyakwe muwayini, aa chikobela chakwe mumusinza wamasansa.
Menso akwe ayoosalala pyu mbuli wayini, mpawo ameno akwe ayotuba buu mbuli malili.
Zebbuloni uyookala kunkomwe yawisi. Uyoba inkomwe yamaato, achisi chakwe. Chiosika aku Sidoni.
Izakkala nimbongolo isimide, iilala akati kazimpati zyambelele.
Wakabona nchilyokezezyo chibotu aayalo nyika ibotezya. Uyogogomeka ikkuko lyakwe kukuyumuna mpawo waba muzike kumulimo.
Dani uyobeteka bantu bakwe mbuli umwi wamisyobo ya Izilayeli.
Dani uyoba inzoka kumbali lya mugwagwa, Inzoka ilabuyoka munzila eeyo iluma mbizi kunsumba, kuti sikutanta weyo awide musule.
Ndalindila lufutuko lwako, Jehova.
Gadi - basikutanta bayokufumpa, pesi takwe uyofumpa tusimbi twabo.
Asha zilyo zyakwe ziyonenesya, mpawo uyoopa zinono zya Mwami.
Nafutali ninsya iyangunukide; mpawo uyoopa zinono zyamwami.
Jozefu ngomutabi uuzyalisya michelo, mutabi uzyalisya afwifwi a kasensa, mitabi yakwe ilatandabala abulambo.
Basitunta bayomufumpa mpawo akumudubula akumupenzya.
Pesi buta bwakwe kabuchilimvwi njii, mpawo maboko ayoba enguzu wa Jakobo, nkambo kazina lya mwembeli, imwaala wa Izilayeli.
Leza wabamawuso uyokugwasya aa Leza singuzu uyokulongezya azilongezyo zyaku julu, azilongezyo zyimikide zyaansi anyika, aa zilongezyo zyankolo aa-zya zyalilo.
Izilongezyo zyawuuso nzipati kwiinda zilongezyo zyachiindi zyazilundu nanka zintu ziyandisi tulundu twachindi. Zibe amutwe wa-Jozefu, zibe atala lyamusinsimi wamutwe wabana bababunyina.
Bbenjamini nguumpe ulanzala. Chifumo ulalya indume, alimwi igoko ulandania inyama.''
Eyii njemisyobo ilikkumi ayibili yaba Izilayeli. Eechi nchenchicho nchibakambilwa kuliba mawisi nakabalongezya. Awumwi-awumwi wakalongezegwa achilongezyo chmwelede.
Nkinkako wakabalayilila mpawo wabambila, ''Ndamba kwiinka kubantu bangu. Mukandizike kuli bamataata musempo lili mumuunda wa Efuloni mu Hititi,
Musempo eelyo lilimumunda wa Machipela, lili kufwifwi aku Mamule munyika yaKkenani, muunda oyo Abbulahamu ngwakawulide kuti ube mawumbwe kuzwa ku Efuloni mu Hitite.
Nkuko nkuba vwikila Abbulahamu  a Sla mukakwe; nkuko nkubakavwikila Ayizeki a Lebeka mukakwe; mpawo nkuko ndavwikila Liiya.
Muunda aa musempo lilimunguwo lyakawulidwe kuzwa kubantu ba Heti.''
Lino Jakobo nakamaninsya kulayilila banabakwe, wakaboozya zituta zyakwe abulo wafwa, wayinka kulibasinsiku bakwe.
Mpawo Jozefu wakayoowa zyakachitika kuti awida abusyu bwa wisi, alimwi walila aali nguwe wamumyonta.
Josefu wakalayilila balanda bakwe basilisi kuti bayanike mutunta wa wisi. Aboobo basilisi bakayanika mutunta wa Izilayeli.
Bakabweza mazuba aali makkumi one, ngumweelwe wamazuba akuyanika mutunta. Ba Ijipiti bakamulila mazuba aali makkumi aali makkumi  aali musanu aabili.
Eelyo mazuba aakulila naakayinda, Jozefu wakaambila basinganda ba Falo, kuti,'' Lino ndajana choolwe mumeenso aanu , ikaka amwaambile Falo, kuyi,
Tata wakandikonkezya, wakati, boona, ndamba kufwa. Mukandizikke kukabanda kangu nkindakalisyida munyika  ya kanani.Nkoko nkotakandizike.'' Lino njinke nkazikke Taata, mpawo njooboola.''
Falo wakasandula ,'' koya ukazike wuso, mbuuli mbwakakukonkezya.''
Jozefu wakiinka kukuzika wisi. Aboonse balanda ba Falo bakayinka awe abapati basinganda yakwe, Bonse bapati ba Ijipiti,
Antomwe aboonse babe nganda ya Jozefuaba bunyiina, abutanga bwabo, mpawo angombe zyabo zyakasyaalamunyika ya Gosheni.
Inkalaki alimwi abasimabbiza abalabo bakiinka anguwe .Yakali nkamu mpati loko yabantu.
Lino nibakasika ku Bbuwa lya chipolelo cha Atadi kulubazu lumwi lwa Jodani, bakalila kupati kuyoosya loko. Nkukonya Jozefu wakachita mazuba musanu aabili nkaaliikulila wisi.

Nkinkaako bantu banyika, ba kanana, nibakabona kulila mubbuwa lya Atadi, bakati,'' oku kulila kwaba Igipita kulayoosya loko,'' Eechi nchenchicho busena nchibwaka wuzikwa kuti Abel Mizilayimu, ilimutala lya Jodani.
Aboobo bana bakwe bakamuchitila mbubonya mbwakabalayilila.
Bana bakwe bakamubweza akumutola kunyika ya Kanana mpawo bamuzika musempo lili mumyunda yamayumbwe. Oyo ngwakawulide kuzwa kuli Ifuloni mu Hitayiti.
Amane kuzika wisi, Jozefu wakabweeda mu Ijipita, we, ababunyiina mpawo aboonse abo baka musindikide kukuzikka wisi.
Lino babunyiina ba Jozefu nibakabona kutiwisi wabo wafwa, bakati, ''Ambweni Jozefu uyootusula akutuboozezya bubi boonse mbutwakamuchitila?''
Aboobo bakatumina Jozefu, mulaazyo wakuti,'' wisi naakatalina kufwa, wakalayilila kuti,

''mbuboobo mbubobo mbumwelede kwambila Jozefu,'' Ikaka ulekelele bubi bwaba kkulana bako mpawo azibi zyabo nebakakuchitila bubi.'' Lino ikaka lekelela balanda ba Leza ba wuso.'' Jozefu wakalila lino nibakamwaambila.
Ibakkulana bakwe abalabo bakayinka akuvundama abusyu kunembo lyakwe. Bakati,''Bona, tulibalanda bako.''
pesi Jozefu wakabasandula,'' Muta yoowi  saamebo ndimuchibaka cha Leza?
Inywe, mwakayeeya kundichitila bubi, pesi Leza wakabusandula akubuchita bubotu, kuti alondole , mawumi abantu banji, mbuuli mbumubwene sunu.
Nkinkaako lino mutayoowi. Njoomulela nywebo abana banu.'' Mbwakabawumbulizya akubakkazika myoyo yabo.
Jozefu wakakkala mu Ijipiti, antomwe ampuli yawisi . wakakapona kwamyaaka iili mwaanda akkumi.
Jozefu wakabona bana ba Ifulemu bamuzukulu watatu. Alubo wakabona bana ba Makiya bana balombe balombe ba Manase, abo waka bekidwe amazwi a Jozefu.

Jozefu wakambila bakkulana bakwe,'' mebo ndaamba kufwa; pesi Leza nchobeni unoomuswaya akumu zulwida munyika ino kuti muye kunyika eyo njaka konzezya kupa Abbulahamu, kusika kuli Isaka, akuli Jakkobbu.''
Mpawo Jozefu makachita bana balombe ba Isilayeli kukonka chikonke. Wakati,  ''Leza nchobeni unoomuswaya. kuchiindi echo mulelede ku bweza zifuwa zyangu kuzwa  okuno.''
Aboobo Jozefu wakafwa, kali amyaka iili mwaanda akkumi lyomwe. Bakayani mutunta wakwe akumubika muchilondwedo mu Ijipiti.
Imukuli ooyo Habbakkukku musinsimi ngwakabona.
''Jehova kuyosikila lili kandililila lugwasyo, alimwi kotayoomvwa? Ndalilila nduwe, 'Bukali!' pesi taakwe nuyofutulwa.
Nkamboonzi nundichita kuti ndibone bubi alimwi wachitya ndalanga ndalanga aatala kuchita bubi?  Lunyonyoono akukali zili kunembo lyangu; kuli lukazyaniyo ampyopyongano zyayima nji.
Nkinkaako mulawo wamaninsigwa nguzu, lululamo taluchikali nikuba chiindi chili. Nkambo ibubi bwazyunguluka balulami; ndululamo ipilingene yazwida aanze.'' Jehova wasandula kuli Habbakkukku.
''Langa langa kuzisi alimwi uzilangisisye; gamba alimwi ukankabale! Nkaambo nkasimpe ndamba kuchita chimwi chiintu mumazuba aako eecho nchutakayosyoma elyo noyoochibuzigwa.
Nkambo langa! Ndaamba kubsya baChaladiya - bayobweenda nyika yoonse kuti bakamaninsye myuunzi yakatali yabo.
Balagambya akuyoosya; bubeteki abweebesi bwabo buzwa kuli mbabo.

Mabbiza aabo aalawao alaaluno kwiinda basiluwe, kaafwambaana kwiinda bawumpe bagolezya. Aboobo mabbiza aabo alalimvwa, alimwi basimabbiza babo bazwa kumusinzo mulamfu - baluuluka mbuli chuungwe uufwambanina kulya.
Boonse bazida bukali; buvule bwaabo buleenda mbuli luuwo lwamunkanda, alimwi bulabunganiya baande mbuli muse.
Aboobo balaseka baami, alimwi beendelezi mzisesyo biyo kuli mbabo. Balaseka mayubila abo moonse, nkambo balalundika amwi nyika alimwi akwiimaninsya.
Mpawo iluuwo luyayinda aatala; lulayenda kalwiinda - baalumi bali amilandu, abo basinguzu zyabo nguleza wabo.'' Habbakkukku ubuzya Jehova uumbi mubuzyo.
''Teensi uzwa kuchiindi chachiindi loko, Jehova Mwaami wangu, Usalala wangu? Tatuloofwa pe. Leza wabamanikila lubeta, anduwe, Bbwe, wababusizya nzotololo.

Meso aako alasalalisya kukulanga aatala abubi, alimwi tikonzyi pe akuchita kubi kuli alweetelelo; Nkamboonzi mpawo nwaalanga chalweetelelo kulibaabo bawuzyi? Nkamboonzi nuwumwide kakuli bataluleme balanyonyoona abo basalali kwiinda mbubabede.
Ulachita bantu mbuli baswi mulwizi, mbuli zintu ziyavula kazitakwe mweendelezi alinzizyo.
Ulayobolola aantomwe mbuli kalobyo; ulakwela baalumi kule mukanyandi kakwe; ulabunganiya aamwi mukanyandi kakakwela; aboobo ulakondwa alimwi uliboteledwe.
Nkinkaako ulapayilila kanyandi kakwe alimwi akutenta tununkilizyo kukanyandi kakukwela, nkaambo akanyandi kakwe upona ,ukubotelwa, alimwi kulya kwakwe nkwaatala.
Nkinkaako nga ulayinkilila kagwisya kanyandi kakwe, alimwi nga ulayinkilila kagwisya kanyandi kakwe, alimwi nga nga ulayinkilila kajeya zisi kaatakwe luzyalo.
Ndiyooyimikila aachilangilo changu alimwi nkikakkale aangazi, alimwi ndiyokkala chakulangisisya kuti ndibone eezyo kulindime ambunga ndiloozya kukuliluuka kwangu.
Jehova wakandisandula kati, ''Lemba chilenganio eechi,  aboobo ulembe ziboneka aachilembelo kuti ooyo uubala kayoochijana.
Nkambo chilengano chilipedwe chindi chacho alimwi chiyopa bukamboni alimwi kachitakachili. Nikuba chinonoke, chilindile, nkaambo kwaambisya alimwi tachitoleki.
Langa! Oyo siziyandisyo zitaluleme mukati kakwe ulitukidwe. Pesi uululeme uloopona alusyomo lwakwe.

Nchoonzyo, mbuli wayini mbiikola, nikuba boobo mwaalumi sintaza takonzyi kukala kumuunzi. Wakachita gulyukumena lyakwe lyakwazamuka mbuli kabanda; alimwi mbuli lufu, taakwe nakuta pe. Wakabumganiya aamwi zisi zyoonse, wakalibunganinya bantu boonse kulinguwe.

Zyoonse eezi tazilobweza kasimpi alimwi chisesyo, maambila mbali aatala anguwe, kati, 'Mawe kuli ooyo uyungizya kuli zezyo zitali zyakwe! Nkambo kuyosika lili kuyungizya bulemu bwazisyomezyo nzwaakabweza?
Tazikonyampula aabo baluma kulinduwe akufwaambana, alimwi aabo bakuyoosya babusigwe na? Uyooba sikunyonyoonwa kulimbabo.
Nkaambo wakanyonyona bantu biingi, boonse bantu basyeede balokunyonyoona. Nkambo wakatila gaze lyabantu alimwi wakachita bukkali aatala anyika, madolopo, alimwi boonse bakkalamuli ngawo.
Mawe kuliyooyo ujanina mpindu iitaluleme kung'anda yakwe, aboobo kuti akabikke chiteendele ajulu kuti akalinunule kuzwa kuluboko lwabubi.'
Wakayeta mawuse kung'anda yakoakugonka bantu biingi, alimwi wakabisizya buumi bwako.
Nkambo mabwe ayolila kuzwa kubulambo, alimwi minkulu yampanda iyoobavwiila,
'Mawe kuli ooyo ayaka dolopo kali aagazi, alimwi uubusya dolopo mububi,'
Tazizwi kuli Jehova waNkondo kuti bantu babelekele mulilo, alimwi zisi zilikatazizya zyabuyo?
Asi inyika iyozuzigwa aaluzibo lwabulemu bwaJehova mbuli maanzi mbwaajalide lwizi.
Mawe kuliyooyo uwangila ngwakkede aawe kuti anywe - utondezya kunyema kwako alimwi ubachite kuti bakkolwe kuchitila kuti ulange imeya zyabo.'

Ulozula mawuse kwiinda kuba aabulemu. Lino chaba chiindi chako! Nywa, alimwi uyootondezya kutapalulwa kwakakumba kabwaalumi! Inkomesi muluboko bwaJehova lwakuchilisyo lulooselukila nduwe, alimwi mawuse ayoojala bulemu bwako.

Bukkali bwakachitilwaLebbanoni buyozulila anduwe alimwi kunyonyonwa kwabanyama kulo kuyoosya. Nkaambo wakatila gazi lyabantu alimwi wakachita chabukali aatala aanyika, madolopo aboonse bapona muli ngawo.

Niinzi nzichikugwasya chituni chibezedwe? Nkaambo ooyo wakachibeza, naa ooyo uulemba chituni ansimbi iitentedwe, muyiisi wakubeja; nkambo usyoma mulimu wamaboko aakwe eelyo nnachita zintu eezi zyabuyo. Mawe ooyo uti kuchisamu, Buka! naa kubbwe lyuumwide. Konyampuka!' Zikonzya kuyiisya na zintu eezi? Langa, chiliyalilidwe angolide ansiliva, pesi buumi abuniini kulinchicho. Pesi Jehova ulimung'anda yakwe iisalala! Muumune kunembo lyakwe, nyika yoonse.
Inkombyo yaHabbakkukku musinsimi.
Jehova, ndavwa mulumbe wako, alimwi ndayoowa. Jehova, bukulusya mulimu wako muzyiindi eezi; aakati kaminyaka chita izibwe; yeya kuba aaluzyalo mubukali bako.
Leza wakasika kuzwa kuTemani, alimwi ooyo uusalala kuzwa kuchilundu cha Palani. Sela Bulemu bwakwe bwakavumba majulu, alimwi anyika yakazwide aakumutembawula.
Akumweka mbuli mumuni, mitungazubaiimweka kuzwa kuluboko lwakwe; alimwi ooko wakasisa manguzu aakwe.
Bulwazi bujaya bwakeenda kunembo lyakwe, alimwi chisubulo chakeenda kumbele lyakwe.
Wakiimikila alimwi wakeela nyika, wakalanga alimwi wasansa zisi. Nikuba zilundu zyalyoonse zyakamwayika, alimwi zilundu zyakutamani zyakafugamina aansi. Izila yakwe njakutamani.

Ndakabona matente aKkusyani kaali mumafwabi, alimwi milembo yamatente aakwe kaali munyika yamaMidia kukankama.Ai Jehova wakanyemenede mulonga naa? Bukkali bwako bwakali aamilonga, nikuba kunyema kwako aatala aalwizi, eelyo nwaakagada mabbiza aako alimwi ankalaki zyabuzundi?
Weeta idaantambwa lyako litakwe chijazyo; ubika kaanta adaantambwa lyako! Wakaanzaniya nyika amilonga.
Zilundu zyakakubona akumonywa mumachise. Kutika kwamaanzi kwakiinsila atala anzizyo; Lwizi lubbila lwakoompololo. Lwakanyampula mayuwe aalo.
Izuba amweezi zyakayima nji mubusena bazyo bwaatala kukumweka kwatunta twako nitwali kuuluka, kukalabi kasumu lyako limweka. Walyatuuka aatala lyanyika abukkali bwako. Mukunyema wakalyata zisi.
Wakazwida aanze nkaambo kalufutuko lwabantu bako, nkaambo kulufutuko lwabananike bako. Upwaya mutwe wang'anda yababi kuti ilale maya kuzwa kunsi kusikila munsingo.
Wakasa mutwe wabalwani bakwe amasumu aakwe mbukunga bakaza mbuli kambizi kuzotumweya; bulamgazi bwabo bwakali mbuli ooyo unyonyoona bafwaba bali mubusena bwakuyubila.
Walyatuuka aatala aalwizi amabbiza aako, akubanyanga aamwi maanzi miingi.

Ndakamvwa, alimwi zizo zyagu zyamukati zyakakankama! milomo yangu yakabwibwima kumuzuzumo. Kubola kwasika mumafuwa aangu, alimwi kunsi kwangi kwakankama kandilokulindila chiwumunizi buzuba bwamapenzi kuti busike aataala lyabantu aabo batunjilila.

Nikuba mukuyu kutasyuuki katakwe michelo mudabala; alimwi nikuba michelo wamusamu wamu oliva itabotzyi aamunda kitakwe chikkafu; alimwi nikuba imbelele zijeegwe mubbondo alimwi kaakwe ng'ombe muzyaata, eechi nchicho nchitakuche.
Nikubaboobo, nditokondwa muliJehova. Ndiyoba aakukondwa nkaambo kaLeza walufutuko lwangu.
Mwaami Jehova ninguzu zyangu alimwi ulachita mawulu aangu mbuli nsya. Undichita ndiye kunemboaabusena bwangu bwaatala. - Kumuzululiwakwiimba, azilizyo zyatukole.

Mumwaka wabili wamwami Daliyasi, mumwezi wamusanu akamwi, muzuba lyakutanguna lyamwezi, ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika muluboko lwa Hagayi musinsimi kumwendelezi wa Juda, Zelubbabbeli mwana mulombe wa Syelutila, akumupayizi Josyuwa mwana mulombe wa Jehozadakki, kati,
'' Jehova wamakamu waamba oobu: Aaba bantu bati,' Teensi nchiindi chesu kuti tuuze nakuti tuuzi tuzoyake ng'anda ya Jehova'''.
Eelyo ijwi lya Jehova lyakeeza kwiinda muluboko lwa Haggayi musinsimi, kaliti,
''Eechi nchechindi chanu na kukkala mumanda amanide,nekuba ng'anda eeyi ichimwayikide?
Lino Jehova wamakamu ngwawamba eezi: kamuyeya nzila zyaanu!

Wakabyala mbuto nyiingi, pesi mwaketa butebuzi mbuche; ulalya pesi tokwe zyiingi pe; ulanywa pesi tokolwi pe. Ulazwata zizwato pesi tamulikasazyi lwenu pe, alimwi ayoyo ufola mali luzutu ulabikamuchikwama chizwide mabanga!
Jehova wamakamu waamba oobu: ''Kamuyeya nzila zyaanu!
Amwinke atala lyachilundu, mukete ziyako, akuzoyaka ng'anda yangu; mpawo ndiyokondelelwa mulinjiyo, alimwi ndiyolumbayizigwa!-mbaamba Jehova.''

''Mwakalangilila bwiingi, pesi amubone! mwaketa tuche kumunzi, nkaambo ndakatusowela kule! Nkaambonzi?'' mbawamba Jehova wamakamu. ''Nkaambo ng'anda yangu lyakaba tongo, nkakuli awumwi awumwi wenu ulokubeleka kungánda yakwe mwini.
Nkaambo kaboobu imajulu nchakasizya lume kuza kulindinywe ayilayo nyika yakasya kugwisya michelo yayo.
Ndatumina bbalangwe kunyika akuzilundu, atala lyamayila awayini mupya amafuta atala anyika zigwisya kabotu, atala lyabantu aatala lyabanyama, akumilimo yoonse yamaboko eenu!''
