Mpawo Zelubbabbeli mwana mulombe wa Siyeteli, amupayizi mupati Josuwa mwana mulombe wa Jehozadaki, abantu boonse basyede, bakalemeka ijwi lya Jehova Leza wabo alimwi amajwi aHagayi musinsimi, nkaambo Jehova wabo wakamutuma alimwi bantu bakayowa busyu bwaJehova.
Mpawo Hagayi, mutumwa waJehova, wakamba milumbe ya Jehova kubantu wakati, '' Ndaanywebo!- aaya ngimalayilile aJehova!''

Aboobo Jehova wakabusya muuya wamwendelezyi wa Juda, Zelubbabbeli mwana mulombe wa Setiyeli, amuuya wamupayizyi mupati Josuwa mwana mulombe wa Jehozadaki, alimwi amuuya wabantu boonse bakasyede, kuchitila kuti binke akubeleka kung'anda ya Jehova wamakamu, Leza wabo.
Mubuzuba bwamakumi aabili aane zuba lyamwezi wamusanu awumwi, mumwaka wabili wamwami Daliyasi.
Mumweezi wamusanu ayibili mubuzuba bwa makkumi aabili abumwi bwamweezi, ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kwindila kuli Hagayi musinsimi, kaliti,
''Wambula kumweendelezi waJuda, Zelubbabbelu mwana mulombe Syeluteyi, akupayizi mupati Joshuwa mwana mulombe wa Jehozadakki, akubantu boonse basyeede. Wamba obu,
'Ngwani uusyede akkati kenu wakabona ng'anda eyi mubulemu bwayo butaanzi? Mwibona biyeni lino? Tayiboneki kili mbuli chintu chabuyo mumenso anu?
Kwalino, kamuyuma, Zelubbabbelu!--aya ngimalayilile a Jehova--amubeleke nkambo ndilanywebo!--echi nchizuminano cha Jehova.
Echi nchisyomezyo nchindabumba andinywe nimwakazwa mu Ijiputi, amuuya wangu uyimikilila akkati kanu. Mutayoowi!
Mbuli Jehova wamakamu wamba kuti: mubunini loko elyo njozungaanya ijulu anyika, ilwizi anyika injumu!
Ndiyozunganya zisi zyoonse, azisi zyonse ziyoyeta zintu ziyandisi kuli ndime, alimwi njozuzya ing' anda yoonse ibulemu, mbwaamba Jehova wamakkamu.
Insiliva angolida nzizyangu!--mbubobu mbwaamba Jehova wamakkamu.
Ibulemu bwang' anda eyi buyoba bupati loko kunembo kwinda kumatalikilo, mbwamba Jehova wamakkam, alimwi njoopa lumuno mubusena obo!--echi nchizuminano cha Jehova wamakkamu.''
Mubuzuba bwamakkumi aabili aane muzuba lyamwezi wamusanu ayine, mumwaka wabili wa Daliyasi, ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli Hagayi musinsimi, kaliti,
''Jehova wamakkamu mbwamba obu: Amubuzye mupayizi zyendelene amulawu, mwambe kuti,

'Na muntu wabweza inyama ipedwe kuli Jehova mulupeto lwachikobela amulupeto lwaguma lupeto na musina, wayini namafuta, nakufumbwa musyobo wachakulya, ngachasalala na?''' Mupayizi wakasandula akuti, ''Takuli mbubo pe.''
Elyo Hagayi wakati, ''Nakuti umwi usofwede nkambo kalufu waguma kufumbwa zintu eezi, ngakwasofwala na?'' Mupayizi wakasandula akwamba kuti, ''Iyi ngawasofwaala.''
Lino Hagayi wakasandula akwamba kuti, ''Ezi zilikubantu akuchisi kunembo lyangu!-- eechi nchizuminano chaJehova--alimwi chili mumilimo yamaboko aabo. Eecho choonse nchibapa chilisofwede!
Aboobo lino, amuyeeye mumizeezo yanu azyakinda akusikila buzuba bwasunu. Kuchindi nikwatalina kubikwa ibbwe aatala lyabbwe kung' anda ya Jehova,
Kwakali buti mpawo? Nimwakasika achilwi chamakkumi aabili amwelwe wakali biyo alikkumi; animwakasika kudindi lyawayini kuti, ateke nongo zilmakkumi musanu zyamweelwe, kwakali biyo makumi aabili.
Ndakamupenzya amilimo yamaboko aaanu woonse andyomba achivulamabwe, pesi takwepe nimwakaboola kulindime pe -- aaya ngemalayililo a Jehova.
Koyeeya kuzwa buzuba oobouno kuyakunembo, kuzwa mazuba mazuba makkumi aabili--aane muzuba lyamwezi wamusanu ayine, kuzwa buzuba intalisyo ya Jehova nichakatalikwa.
Amuyeeye mbubobu! Kuli nikuchili mbuto na muchimumbwa?  Nikuba musansa, mukuyu, apomegilanayiti, ama olifa atazyede! Pesi kuzwa sunu ndikulongezye na!''
Mpawo ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika lwabili kuli Hagayi mubuzuba bwamakkumi aabili aane amwezi akwamba kuti,
''Wambuula kumuzuluzi waJuda, Zelubbabbelu, akuti, njozunganya ijulu anyika.
Nkambo njosowa chuuno kubwami bwazisi akumwaya inguzu zyabwami bwazisi njolobya inkalaki abasikugada nzizyo;  mabbiza abasikugada njobawisizya aansi, umwi awumwi nkambo kapanga lyamwenzinyina.

Mubuzuba oobo--aya ngimalayilile a Jehova wamakkamu---njomubweza, Zelubbabbelu mwana mulombe wa Syelutayelu mbuli mulanda wangu--aya ngimalayilile a Jehova wamakkamu. Njokuchita kuti ukabe mbuli inwenwe, nkambo ndakakusala!--aya ngimalayilile a Jehova wamakamu!'''
Chiindi chakale Leza wakaambula kuli basikale besu kwiinda muba sinsimi muzyiindi zyiingi alimwi amunzila zyiingi.
Pesi muli aaya mazuba aamamanino wakaambula kulindiswe kwiinda mumwana mulombe, ooyo ngwaakayimikizya kuti akabesikulya lukonowezintu zyoonse. Nkwiindila mulinguwe alubo Leza wakachita bwaanze.

We ngusikubalangala kwabulemu bwa Leza. Bwiiminizi bulimbubo bwabwiime bwakwe. Aboobo ulajata zinti zyoonse amwii ajwi lyamanguzu aakwe. Naakamana kusanzya zibi, wakakkala aansi kululyo lwabupati kujulu.
Wakaba  ulanguzu kubangelo mbuli zina ndyakakona liluleme kwiinda aabo mazina.
Nkaambo nkuli uuli wabangelo Leza ngwakatgi "Uli mwana wangu, sunu ndaba wuso"? Nakuti nguuli wabangelo Leza ngwakati, "Ndiyoba wisi kulinguwe alimwi we uyoba mwana kulindime"?
Pesi lubo aawo Leza nayeta mwana mutaanzi munyika, we utii, "Boonse bangelo mba Leza beelede kumukomba."
Aatala abangelo utii, "Nguwe uuchita bangelo bakwe babe myuuya, mpawo balanda bakwe babe malabi amulilo
Pesi aatala amwana utuu, "Chuuno chakwe, Leza, chikkala mane kukabe kutamani. Lubeteko lwabwami  bwako ndubeteko lwabululami.
Wakayanda bulumi mpawo wasula kutabaamba mulawu. Nkunkaako webo Leza wako wakunanika amafuta aalukondo kwiinda beenzinyokwe."

Kumatalikilo, Mwami wakayala matalisyo aanyika. Majulu milimo yamaboko aako.

(58) @HEB 1:12	<p-n>@Ba Hibbulu 1:12</p-n>	Uyobavunga mbuli chizwaato mpawo bayosandulwa mbuli chimpanzi chasila. Pesi webo tosanduki, amyaaka yako tiimani.
Mpesi kuli ooyo bangelo ba Leza bakati amulichili chiikndi, "Kkala kululyo lwangu mane ndikachite basinkondonyokwe bakabe chilyatilizyo chamawulu aako."?
Teensi bangelo boonse myuuya iibeleka na, abaabo bakatumwa kutabilila aabo bayokona lufutuko?
Aboobo tweelede kuswilisisya kuleezyo nzitwakamvwa kuti tutaka sosoloki kulinzizyo.
Nkaambo naa makani akaambwa kubangelo akaboneka kuti ngakusinizya, akuti zibi zyoonse akutaswiilila zipegw chisubulo.
Nga tulachija biyeni kuti twawuzya kulufutuko luli boobu? Olu ndulufutuko lwakatalika kwaambilizigwa a Mwami akuzuminwa kulindiswe abaabo bakalumvwa.
Muchiindi nchicheecho Leza wapa bukamboni, azitondeezyo azigambyo, amaleele asiyene siyen, akwaabila zipo akwaabila zipo zya Muuya Uusalala mbuli kuyanda kwakwe
Nkaambo teensi nkubangelo Leza nkwaka bombya nyika kuti isike, atala anzitwaambula.
Pesi umwi wakaba kamboni kumwi, kaamba kuti, "Niinzi chitegwa muntu ooyo ngumuyeeya aatala anguwe? Na mwana wamuntu ooyo ngumulikatazya aawe?
Wakachita kuti muntu abe ansi kubangelo, wakamusamika bulemu akulemekwa. amwi malembe mapati achiindi achi Giliki alayungizya, alimwi wakamubika aatala yamilimu yamaanza aakwe.
Wakabika zykooknse mukuzibombya munsi lyazituta zyakwe." Nkaambo nguwe Leza ngwakabikka qkuzintu zykoonse eezi. Pesi lino tatunazibona pe zyoonse nzyakabikilwa
Pesi tulikumubona ooyo wakabikidwe kunsi kubangelo, muchiindi chiniini Jesu, wakasamikwa bulemu akulemekwa nkaambo kamapenzi aalufu lwakwe kuti muluzyalo lwa Leza akalabizye lufu lwabantu boonse.

Nkaambo chaleelede kuti Leza, nkaambo zyoonse ziponena nguwe kwiinda mulinguwe, kuti alete myuuya yoonse kubulemu. Chakeelela kulinguwe kuti abe ntalisyo yalufutuko kiizwide kwiindila mukupenzegwa kwakwe.
Nkaambo ooyo uusalazya abasalizigwa boonse bazwa kumwi. Nkikaako tawuusi pe kubiita kuti banabakwabo.
Waamba kuti, "Ndiyolungulula zina lyako kubana bakwesu, ndiyoyimba atala anduwe mukati mumbungano."
Alubo, "Ndiyoosyoma mulinguwe," alubo "Amulange, mpaano mpebede abana mbaakandipa Leza."
Aboobo, mbulikuti bana ba Leza banyama abulowa bomwe, Jesu alakwe wakali umwi kuzintu zyiingi ambabo, kuchitila kuti mulufu akakonzye kuzunda ooyo wakali aamanguzu alufu, ooyo, kudyabbulosi.
Chakaba oobo kuti akaangunune boonse abao bakaba akuyoowa lufu balkapona buumi bwabo boonse mubuzike.
Nkaambo nchoonzyo tanyongani nkaambo kabangelo pe; pesi; ulanyongana loko kumbuto ya Abbulahamu.

Aboobo chakaleelede kuti akabe mbuli bana bakwabo munzila zyoonse, kuchitila kuti akabe mupayizi uusyomekede alimwi uulaluzyalo mubulyidilano azintu zya Leza, akuti akakonzye kweeta lulekelelo kuzibi zyapbantu.
Nkaambo Jesu lwakwe wakapenzegwa mumasunko, ulakonzya kugwasiya aabo balikusunkwa.
Aboobo, nobakwesu basalala, anywebo muli aalukono mulwiito lwakujulu. Amuyeeye Jesu, mutumwa alimwi kali mupayizi mupati waluzumino lwesu.
Wakalisyomekede kuli Leza, wakamusala, mbuli mbaakasyomekede alakwe Mozesi mung'anda ya Leza.
Nkaambo Jesu wakajanika kali musalali abulemu bupati kwiinda bwa Mozesi, nkaambo ooyo uuyaka ng'anda ujana bulemu kwiinda ng'anda lwayo.
Nkaambo ang'anda ang'anda ilamuntu uyiyaka, pesi wakayaka zyoonse ngu Leza.
Kulilimbi bbazu, Mozesi wakali zyomekede mung'anda ya Leza yoonse. Walkali kaamboni aatala azintu zyalikuzowambulwa mulilya juunza.
Pesi Kkilisito mwana mweendelezi wang'anda ya Leza . Tuli ng'anda yakwe, na twajatisya kubusichaamba bwesu akubotelwa mukusima kwesu.
Aboobo, zilimbuli mbawamba Muuya Uusalala uti: "Sunu na mwalimvwa jwi lyakwe
mutayumyi myoyo yanu mbuli mulupapi, muchiindi chakusunkwa munkanda.
Awa mpawo bamawuso nibaknodikpapila akundisunka lubo, alubo, mumyaaka makumi one bakabona nchito zyangu.
Aboobo zyalane eelyo telyakandibotezya pe. Ndakati, 'Bakkede kabasweeka mumyoyo yabo. Tabana kuziba nzila zyangu.'
Kulibiyo mbuli mbundakakonka mukunyema kwangu: 'Tabakoyonjila pe mukulykookezya kwangu.'"
Amuchenjele, nobakwesu, kuchitila kuti akati kenu takubi naba omwe uyooba amoyo mubi wakutasyoma, moyo uuchija kuzwa kuli Leza uupona.
Pesi, amusungwaazyanie abuzuba, biyo kalitegwa ngu "sunu," kuchitila kuti kutakabi akati kenu uyoyuma moyo nkaambo ka lweeno lwachibi.
Nkaambo twakaba balyidilani aKkilisito, tulijisi busichaamba busimide mulinguwe kuzwa kumatalikilo kuyosika kumamanino.
Aatala azeezi zyakaambwa kuti, "Sunu, na mwamvwa jwi lyakwe, mutayumyi moyo yenu, mbuli mulupapi."
Ngwani wakamvwa Leza mpawo wapapa? Teensi mbaabo boonse na bakazwa mu Ijipiti kabagwisigwa a Mozesi?
Ngwani ngwaakanyemenede kwamyaaka makumi one? Teensi mbaabo bakabisya na, aabo nbalamitunta yakawida musokwe?
Nkulini nkwaakakonka kuti tabakoyonjila mukulyookezya kwakwe, na kakutali kuli aabo bakatamulemeka?
Alimwi tuli kubwene kuti tebakakonzya pe kunjila mukulyookezya kwakwe nkaambo kakutasyoma.
Aboobo atuchenjele kuchitila kuti kutabi umwi aakati kenu uyoboneka kakachilwa kuzuzikizya chisyomezyo nchimwaka siilwa chakunjila mukulyookezya kwa Leza.
Nkaambo twakabuzigwa majwi mabotu mbuli mbaabede. Pesi aayo majwi taakabagwasya pe aabo bakatajatana mulusyomo abaabo bakalemeka.

Nkaambo swebo nitwakasyoma ndiswe tutakanjile mukulyookezya, mbuli mbakaamba kuti, "Mbuli mbundakakonka mubunyeme bwangu, tabakaoyonjila pe mukulyookezya kwangu." Nikuba boobo, milimo yoonse njaakalenga yakamaninsigwa kumalengelo aanyika.
Nkaambo wakati muli bumwi busena aataka abuzuba bwamusanu atubili, "Leza wakalyookezya mubuzuba bwamusanu atubili kuzwa kumilimu yakwe yoonse,"
Alubo pwakati, "Tabakoyonjila mukulyookezya kwangu."
Aboobo, mbulikuti kuchili mweenya wabamwi biyo kuti bakanjile mukulyookezya kwakwe, akuti nkaambo kakuti bana Izilayili biingi taakwe nibakakunjila nkaambo kakuleya milawu,
Leza watala alubo limbi zuba litegwa, "Sunu." Musule lyamazuba miingi, wakaambuula kwiinda muli Devidi kuti, mbuli mbuzyakaambidwe kusanguna, "Sunu na mwalimvwa jwi lyakwe, tamuyumyi myoyo yenu."
Nkaambo kansinga Joshuwa wakabapa kulyookezya, Leza wakalikunowaambuula aatala alimbi zuba.
Aboobo mpukuchili kulyookezya kwa Sabata kubambilidwe bantu ba Leza.
Nkaambo awumwi uunjila mukulyookezya kwa Leza, alakwe mwini unoli walyookezya kumilimu yakwe, mbuli Leza mbalyokezya kuli yakwe.
Aboobo, atuyandisye kunjila mukulyookezya ooko, kuchitila kuti kutabo uyoonjila mukutaswilila mbuli mbubakachita.

Nkaambo jwi lya Leza lilapona alimwi lilabosya kwiinda panga linenga mabazu aabili. Lilayasa nikuba kuyowanzaania muuya wamuntu amuuya wa Leza, antoomwe akwaanzaania moolyo aawo mpuuswaanana. Lilakonzya kuziba ziyandwa aziyeyegwa aamoyo.
Taakwe chakalengwa chisisidwe kunembo lya Leza. Pesi zyoonse zili salede alimwi zili aantanganana kumenso aakwe ngutweelede kulemeka
Aboobo, mbukunga tuli amupayizi mupati loko wakayinda mumajulu, Jesu mwana wa Leza, wakapa kuti tujatisye kulusyomo lwesu.
Nkaambo tatuke mupayizi muati uutakonzyi kutufwida nsoni mubutela bwesu. Pesi, tuli aawe wakanjila munzila zyoonse zyamasunko mbulindiswe, kusiya biyo kuti we takwe chibi pe.
Atwiinke aboobo abusichaamba kuchuuno chakwe chaluzyalo, kuchitila kuti tukatambule nsoni akujana luzyalo lwakugwasya muchiindi chapenzi.
Nkaambo awumwi mupayizi mupati, wakasalwa kuzwa mubantu, usalilwa kwiiminina bantu muzintu zya Leza, kuchitila kuti apede zipo azipayizyo zyazibi.
Ulakonzya kubeleka kabotu abatazi abaabo bapapide nkaambo we alakwe ulaabo butela.
Nkaambo kazeezi we alakwe kwelede kuti ape zipayizyo zyazibi zyakwe, mbuli mbachita kuzibi zyabantu.
Alimwi tachili chakwe pe kuti umwi abweze bulemu bwakwe. Uliitwa a Leza, mbuli Aaloni mbakabede.
Munzila njiyeeyo, alakwe Kkilisito taakwe naakalisumpula mukulichita mupayizi, Pesi, ooyo wakalikwaambuula aawe wakalikuti, "Ulimwana wangu; sunu ndaba Wuso."
Kulimbuli mbukwaambidwe kulibumwi busena kutgi, "Uli mupayizi walyoonse mbuli Melukkizedeki."
Muchiindi chakwe chakuba munyama, Kkilisito wakapeda nkambyo azikumbizyo ajwi pati lyakulila misozi kuli Leza, ooyo walikukonzya kumufutula kuzwa kulufu. Wakamvigwa nkaambo kakulila kwakwe.
Nikuba kuti wakali mwana, wakayiya kuteelela kuzintou nzyakapenzegwa kulinzizyo.
Wakachitwa mululami mpawo, kubantu boonse bamulemeka, wakabapa lufutuko lutaman.
Wakasalwa a Leza mbuli mupayizi mupati mbuli Melukkizedeki.
Tuli aazyiikngi zyakwaambula aatala aJesu, pesi kwayuma kupandulula nkaambo mwayuma kumizeezo yenu akukumvwa.
Nikuba muli eehi chiindi mwelede kuba bayiisyi, mucheelede kuba aamuntu umuyiisya ziiyandikana zya Leza amajwi aakwe. Muyanda malili peepe chakulya chisimide.
Nkaambo awumi unywa malili tanakomena pe mumajwi aabululami nkaambo uchili mwana mutete.
Pesi chakulya chisimide nchabantu baati. Aba mbaabo banga nkaamo kakukomena kwabo balalwiiyo mukumvwisisisya kwabo akwaanzaania chibi kuzwa kuchibpotu
Mpawo elyo atusimye matalikilo aamkani aaaJesu mpawo tuye kunembo akukomena. Tutayali lubo matalikilo azya kusanduka kuzwa kumilimu ifwide azyalusyomo muli Leza.
Olo matalikilo aanjisyo yazyalubbabbatizyo, buyale bwamaboko, bubuke bwabafu, alubeta lutamani.
Tuyochita lubo aswe echi naLeza wachizumizya.
Nkaambo nchiyumu kuli aabo ibakali bamunikilwa, ibalakalabila zipo zyakujulu, abo bakali basikwaaba baMuuya Uusalala,
mpawo akulabila ijwi bbotu lyaLeza amanguzu achiindi chiza,
pesi abo ibakawa - nkuyumu kubaboozya lubo kukusanduka. Kuloobu akaambo kakuti balikuligankamina lubo Mwana waLeza, mpawo akumusya lubo chaantanganana.
Nkambo inyiika inywa kumvula iyiwida aachiindi, akumezeka ziliimwa zilamulimu kuli abo nyika mbiyakaliminwa - eyi ninyika itambula zilongezyo zizwa kuli Leza.
Pesi ikuti yazyala maamvwa,amanchenya, tayigwasyi pe elyoo ili afwifwi alutuko. Mamanino ayo alimukutentwa.
Pesi twakakomenenwa kuzintu zili mbubombubo aatala anduwe, nobayandwa, zintu zilangene alufutuko, nikuba kuto twaamba oobu.
Nkaambo Leza takwe lubazu. Takoyoluba mulimu wako aluyamdo nduwakatondeezya kuzina lyakwe, nkaambo wakagwasya basalali bakwe, a lino uchibagwasya.
Tuli achiyandisyo kapati kuti awumwi akati kanu akatondezye bukozu bukozyene kumamanino, kuti bulangizi bwanu bube bwanchonzyo.
Eechi nkokuti mutakabi bakandu , pesi batobelezyi babaabo kwindila mulusyomo abulindizi bakone zisyomezyo.
Nkaambo Leza naakachita chisyomezyo kuli Abbulamu, wakalikonkezya mwini, mukuti taali kanookonkezya kuli umwi mupati kampatila.
Wakati " Chonzyo ndiyokulongezya a kukomezya myeelwe yako."
Munzila eeyi, Abbulamu wakachijana echo nchakasyomezegwa musule abulindizi buzulide.
NKaambo bantu balakonkezya kuli umwi mupati kwinda lwabo beni. Kumamanino a twaambo twabo, achizuminano chiyoba mbuli chizuzikizyo.
Elyo Leza nakasala kutondeezya chilaantanganana kuli basimulya lukono lwazisyomezyo kutasanduka kwabube bwakwe, wakachibikila chizuminano.

Wakachita obu kuti kuzintu zibili zitasandululwi - kuli eecho chitakonzeki kuti Leza abeje - iswe, nitwakachijila kumayubilo, tuyooba akusungwazigwa kupati mukujatisya changuzu bulangizi bubikidwe kunembo lyesu.
Tulabulangizi obu mbuli chikwabilizyo chesu a chisimyo chitazunganisigwi chamuuya, bulangizi obo mubusena bwamukatikati kusule a chisitikizyo, oko
Jesu, wakeendakunembo lyesu, nkwakanjilila mubusena obo akambo kesu. Elyo wakaba mupayizi mupati kwakutamani musule amalayilile aMelikizedeki.
Wakali ooyu Melekizedeki mwami wakuSalemu, mupayizi waLeza usumpukide wakaswanana  aAbbulamu kaboola kuzwa kwakali kufundwa baami mpawo wakamulongezya.
Nkulinguwe oko Abbulamu nkwakapa chibeela chaachakummi chazyonse. Lutanzi kupandulwa kwazina lyakwe chaamba kuuti "mwaami wabululami," alimwi utegwa "mwami wakuSalemu," chamba kuti "mwami walumuno."
Takwe wisi, takwe banyina, takwe basikale, katakwe nikuba kutalika kwamazuba anikuba kwabuumi.  Nikuba oobo, uyiminide mwana waLeza, nkambo unolimupayizi kwalyonse.
Bona bupati kuloyu mwalumi wachiindi Abbulamu ngwakapa chipanzi chakkumi kuzintu nzyakatola munkondo.
Izyalane lya Levi eelyo litambula mulimu wabupayizi balamalayilile kwinda mumulawu kuti batole zyachakkumi, kubantu nkuukuti chizwa kuli babunyina nikuba kuti ambabo nizyalane lizwa kuliAbbulamu.
Pesi Melekizedeki, ulazyalane elyo lyakatali lyabo lyakatambula chakkumi kuzwa kuli mbabo, wakatambula zyakkumi kuzwa kuli Abbulamu akumulongezya, oyo wakali azisyomezyo.
Takwe zikazyana akuti muntu munini ulongezegwa amupati.
Mulaya makkani muntu wanyama ulatambula chakkumi, pesi mumakani aya kulibukamboni bwakuti unochipona.
Mpawo, kwinda munzila yakwambula, muLevi ooyo wakali kutambula chakkumi, alakwe wakali kugwisya chakkumi kwinda kuli Abbulamu,
nkaambo Levi wakali mumubili wazyalane awo Melekizedeki nakaswanana aAbbulamu.

Lino anoli bululami bwakali konzekene kwindila mubupayizi bwabu Levi (aawo muunsi azezi bantu bakatambula mulawo), ninzi eecho chakali kuyandikana kunembo eecho chinoli chakalelede kubawo kuti kube umbi mupayizi kuti abewo kunembo mubube bwa Melekizedeki, mpawo kitatolegwi kuti ibe kunembo kuliAaloni?
Mpawo kuti bupayizyo bwasandulwa, mulawo awulawo uyelede kuti wasandulwa.
Ooyo umwi wambwa azeezi zintu ngwawumbi musyobo, utakwe umwi wakali wabelekela achipayililo.
Lino zilantanganana kuti eezi zizwa kuli Juda oko Mwami nkwakazyalilwa, musyobo Mozesi ngwakwakatamba atala abupayizi.
Ezyo nzitwamba zimvwikka loko zyakuti anoli umwi mupayizi wabuka muchikozya chaMelekizedeki.
Tewakalanagene loko pe aziyandikana amulawu wanyama kukuba muapayizi, pesi wo wali atala amanguzu abuumi butamani.
Nkambo magwalo ababukamboni anguwe: "Ulimupayizi kwalyoonse kwinda mumabmbe aMelikizedeki."
Tazyambi kuti ayo malayilile achindi akabikwa kumbi kumbali akaambo alikumpeme akubula mulimu.
Nkaambo mulawo takwe nchwakachita chiluleme - pesi alubo bulangizi balimbubo bwakazibisigwa kwinda nituswena kuliLeza.
Chamba kuti tezyakali achikonke pe ! Bamwi bakaba bapayizi kabatakwe chikonke pe.
Pesi wakaba mupayizi kwinda muchikonke nchaakatola kulumwi ooyo wakati kulinguwe, "Mwaami wakakonka alubo taakwe nazosanduka pe muzezo wakwe : Ulimupayizi kwalyoonse."
Alubo kuli eechiJesu wakapa chisinizyo chachizuminano chilimbubo.
Bapayizi bataanzi bakali biingi mumweelwe, mbulu kuti lufu lwakabakachizya kuti bayimkilile nkabali munganda yamulimu.
Pesi akambo kakuti Jesu ulapona kwalyonse, ulabupayizi bwalyoonse.
Mpawo ulakonzya lubo kufutula chakumanina basikila Leza kwinda mulinguwe nkaambo choonse chiindi uponena kubakombela.
Nkaambo nochoonzyo chaakelela kuti tuube amupayizi mupati, ooyo usalala, utakwe chiibi, uwanzanisigilwe kuzya kuli basizibi akusumpulwa ataala lyamajulu.
Ooyo utayandi, uatali mbuli bapayizi balaajula, kuti ape zipayizyo zyabuzu abuza, kutaangu chazibi zyakwe, mpawo zyazibi zyabantu. Nakachita eechi lumwi kuli boonse nakalipeda.
Nkambo mulawu upa bapayizi kumuntu ulabukompami. Pesi ijwi lyachi chikonke, eelyo lyakaza kunembo amulawu, lyakapa mwana, ooyo wakasalazigwa kwalyoonse.
Lino kaambo nkitulikwaamba: Tulijisi mupayizi mupati wakkala aansi kuluboko lwachilisyo lwachuuno chabulemu cha Singuzu zsyoonse mumajulu.
Mubeleki mubusena busalala, idyuumba lya choonzyo, elyo Mwami pepe muntu, ndyakayala.
Woonse mupayizi ulasalwa kuti ape zipo antjkoomwe azituuzyo. Lino kulayandikana kuba achimwi chakupa.
Lino koonzinga Jesu uli aanyika, tewalikunoba mupayizi kale pe, mbulikuthi kuli aabo bapa zipo kwiinda mumu lawu.

Babeleka kabatobelezya alimwi munzinzimwa wazintu zyakujulu. Kuli biyo mbuli Mozesi mbaka chenjezegwa a Leza naakali waamba kuyaka dyumba: Leza wakaamba kuti, "Langa kuti uchite zyoonse mbuli mumabambe aayo ngwaakatondezegwa aatala lyachilundu."
Pesi lino Jesu watambulwa mumbungano ilimbubo, mbuli mbali simwiima akati kachizuminano chilimbubo eecho chichita zisyomezyo zilimbubo.
Kuti eechiya chizuminano chakutanguna teechakali abubi, taakwe nikwalikuno chitwa chimbi chizuminano.
Elyo Leza nkalikunoonga wajana bubi abantu, wakalikwaamba kuthi, "Amubone mazuba ayobuza, mbwaamba Mwami - elyo nindiyo chita chizuminano chipya ang'anda ya Izilayeli alimwi ang'anda ya Juda.

Takukwe nikuyoba mbuli chizuminano nchindakachitide abasikale benu mubuzuba mbundakabajata akuboko kubagwisya mu Ijipiti. Nkaambno tebakeenda muchizuminano changu, alimwi ndakabatakata - mbawamba Mwami.

Nkaambo eechi nche chizuminano nchindiyochita ang'anda ya Izilayeli musule lyamazuba ayo - mbawamba Mwami. Ndiyobikka milawu yangu mumizeezo yabo, alimwi ndiyoyi lemba mumykoyo yabo. Ndiyoba Leza wabo alimwi bayoba bantu bangu
Tabakoykooyiisya basimabambanwa babo na bana bakwaabo kabati, 'Ziba Mwami.' Nkaambo boonse bayondiziba], kuzwa kumuniini kuyoosika kumupati wabo.
Nkaambo ndiyooba aluzyalo kuchito zyabo zyakutalulama, alimwi nsikoyoziyeeya lubo pe zibi zyabo."
Mukwiita chizuminano echi kuti, "chipya," wakachita chizuminano chakusanguna chibe chikulukulu. Alimwi eecho chaba chachiindi alimwi kachili chi kulukulu chaba afwiifwi kuti chiinde.
Lino nikuba chizuminano chitanzi chakalijisi milawo atala akukukomba abusena bwachiyubilo chaansi.
Nkaambo dumba lyakukombela mwakalichibikilo  chalambe atebuli, achinkwa chabuliwo bwakwe, bwakali kuyitwa kuti busena busalala.
Musule adembo lyachibili kwakali limbi dumba lyakukombela, buitwa kuti busena busalalisya.

Lyakali angolide yachipayililo yatununkilizyo. Alimwi ilabhokesi bwachizuminano, yakazililwidwe angolide koonse, koonse. Mukati mwakali nkomesi yangolide yakajisi chitegwa maana, musako waAloni wakalinonga wasyukila aya mabbwe akalembedwe majwi achizuminano.
Atala abhokesi lyachizuminano, bangelo  bajisi bulemu bakavumbide chivunisyo, echo chitutakonzyi kwambula atala anchicho mubunike.
Nizyakamana kubambwa ezi zintu bapayizi choonse chiindi bakalikunjilila mung'andu yakunze ya dumba lyakukombela kuti bakachite milimu yabo.
Pesi mupayizi mupati luzutu wakanonga wanjila mung'anda yakunze ya dumba lyakukombela kuti bakachite milimu yabo.
Muuya usalalala wakatondezya kuti na dumba taanzi kalichimvwi mukati kanzila yabusena busalalisya butaboneki.
Echi chakulitondezya muchindi echo zyonse ziipo azipayililo ezyo lino zilikupegwa tazichiti kusalazya bakombi amamvwido.
Balalangilila kupela chakulya akunywa azyakutula zisiyene - siyene zyakusamba, malayilile amibili kusiika chiindi chabubambululwe bupya.
Kilisito nakasika mbuli muapayizi mupati wazintu zibotu zyaksika wakeenda mukati kadumba lyakukombela pati lisalalisya litesi lyakabumbwa amaanza abantu chimwi kachitali chanyika eyi yakalengwa.
Tekwakali kwabulowa bwampongo abwang'ombe, pesi abulowa bwakwe obo bwakanjilila mubusena busalalisya kamwi kwalyoonse akujana akukwabilila kwaununuko lwenu lutamani.
Kansinga bulowa bwampongo abaasune, akusansayilwa kwadyota kulibabo bakalisofwazya zyakaba salazya kukusanzigwa kwamibili yabo,

buyoba byeni bulowa bwaKkilisito, ngwani mukwiinda mumuya uusalala utamani wakalipeda lwakwe mwiini kutakwe kampenda  kuli Leza, kuto asalazye kubisya kwesu kuzwa kumilimu ifwide kuti babelekele Leza upona?

Akambo kabobu ngusikwima akati wachizuminano chipya. Ezi zilimbulikuti kuzwa kuchindi lufu nilwakabweza busena mulwangunuko kulibabo bali ansi achizuminano chitanzi kuzwa kuzibi zyabo, abo bayitwa kuti  bayojana chisyomezyo chitamani chalukono.
Awo ali chiyandisyo, lufu lwamuntu wakuluchita uyoluzuzikizya.
Nkaambo kuyanda kubabiyo nakwakaba lufu, nkaambo takwe lukakatizya kuliyoyo wakalubumba uchipona.
Pesi alacho chizuminano chitanzi chakabambwa kachitakwe bulowa.

Kufumbwa Mozesi wakalikupa lulayililo luli mumulawu kubantu kubantu boonse, wakabweza bulowa bwabana bang'ombe ampongo, ameenda, buluba busalala, amichelo yahisopi akubusansila zyoonse ibhuku abantu boonse.
Wakati, "  Obu mbulowa bwachizuminano echo Leza nchakamulayilila."
Alubo wakasansila bulowa mu dumba lyachikombelo azyoonse zibikilo zyakalikubelesya mumilimu.
Mbuli kumulawo zyoonse zyakasalazigwa abulowa kakutali kutika kwabulowa takwe lulekelelo.
Nkinkakako nchikwakalikabotu kuti, zikozyanyo zyazintu zyakujulu kuti zisalazigwe azipayizyo zyabanyama aba. Aboobo, zintu zyakujulu lwazyo zyakalelede kusalazigwa azipayizyo zilikabotu.
Nkaambo Kkilisito takanjila mubusena busalalisya bwakachitwa amaboko, kachili chikozyano chawumwi wakasimpe. Pesi wakanjilwa kujulu lini kuti alibonye mubuliwo bwaLeza mulindiswe.
Takayinka oko kuti akalipe mwini muzintu zyiingi, mbuli mbuwakachita mupayizi mupati, unjila mubusena busalalisaya bwamunyaka amunyaka abulowa bwawumwi.
Nikuli ako nkikaambo, mpawo ulelede kufwaba muzintu zyiingo kuzwa kuntalisyo yanyika. Pesi lino wasika chantanganana kumamanino azyiindi kuzogwisya kulibali azibi kulipayizya kwakwe mwini.
Mbuli muntu bwakasalwa kuti afwe kamwi, alimwi kuzwawo kuyosika lubeta.
Alubo,Kkilisito wakapedwa lumwi kuti agwisye zibi zyabiingi, alimwi uzoboneka lwabili, kuti atazobi abwendelezi azibi, pesi lufutuko kulibabo bamulindilide.

Nkaambo mulawu mwenzwide bikupayilwayo wazikntu zibotu zichiza, kawutali chiimo loko pe chazintu eezi. Aabo baza kuli Leza tabakonzyi pe kululamikwa anzizyo zipayizyo nzibaswini kabapayila munyaka amunyaka.
Mulikumwi kwaamba konzo zipayizyo tezyaka yimikizigwa? Na kakuli boobo, na kazili zyasalazigwa zyamanina aatu, basykomi teensi balikunoba kabaziba zibi pe.
Pesi muzipayizyo eezi kuli kuyeezegwa kwazibi amunyaka amunyaka.
Nkaambo tazichiti pe kuti bulowa bwaba pule bang'ombe ampongo bumane milandu.
Lino Kkilisito naakasika munyika, wakati, "Zipayizyho azipo tenzizyo nzwakayandisisya pe. Pesi, wakali mubili ngumwakandibambila.
Kazitali muzipayizyho zitentedwe na zipayizyo zyazibi nzimwakabotelwa kulinzizyo.
Mpawo ndakati, 'Langa, ndasika, mbuli mukulembedwe atala andime mumalembe, chita kuyanda kwako.'"
Kakutanguna wakati, "Teensi zipayizyo pe, na zipo, niziba zyoonse zipayizyo zyakuumpa, mna zipayizyo zyazibi nzimwakalikuyanda. Na kubotelwa mulinzizyo." Eezi nzezipayizyo zipegwa kwiinda mumulawu.
Mpawo wakati, "Langa mpawa ndili wano kuti ndichite lkuyanda kwenu." Wakagwisya mabelekelo mataanzi kuti asangune mabelekelo aabili.
Munzila eeyi, twakasalazigwa kwiinda mukupayilwa kwamubili wa Jesu Kkilisitu mpawo kwamanina aatu.
Kulilimwi bbazu, buzuba abuzuba, awumwi mupayizi ulayimikila kubelekela Leza. Ukkede kapayila zipayizyo nzizyo nzizyo, nikuba tazikwe nizisalazya zibi pe.
Kúli limwi bbazu, Kkilisito wakapayila chipayizyo chomwe kwa lyoonse, wakakkala ansi kululyo lwa Leza.
Ulilindide mane basinkondonyina bakachitwe chilyatilizyo chamawulu aakwe.
Nkaambo achipayizyo chomwe wakalulamika aabo balikusalazigwa.
Alimwi Muuya Uusalala ulatwaambilila kulindiswe. Nkaambno usanguna kati,

Eechi nchechizuminano nchesikachite aabo musule lyawayo mazuba ayo, mbawamba Mwami. Ndiyobikka milawu yangu mumyoyo akwilemba mumizeezo yabo
(58) @HEB 10:17	<p-n>@Ba Hibbulu 10:17</p-n>	Taakwe nesikaziyeeye lubo pe zibi zyabo.
Lino aawo ali kulekelelwa kwabaaba, taachikwe nikucheelede zipayizyo zyazibi pe.
Aboobo, bana bakwesu, twaba achaamba chakunjila mubusena busalalisya nkaambo kabulowa bwa Jesu.
Njenzila mpya yakupomna njatujulila kwiinda mudyembo nkukwaambo kuti mubili wakwe.
Nkaambo tujis mupayizi mupati kampatila wang'anda ya Leza,
atunjile amyooyo yachoonzyo amulusyomo luzwide, moyo yesu kiisaledekuzwa kumizeezo amibili yesu kisanzizigwe amaanzi aaslala.
Alukbo ngatujatisye katutazungani kubulangizi mbutulingulula, nkaambo ooyo wakasyomezya ulisyomekede.
Tuyeesesye mbutunga tulasungwaazyania umwi awumi mumilimu yaluyando.
Tutanoleki kuswaanana, mbuli mbubakaleka bamwi. Pesoi agtusungwaazyanie umwi awumwi mukuvula akwiinkila kunembo mbuli mbumukubwene kuti buzuba bwaba afwiifwi.
Kuti na twachita chibi achaali musule akutambula busongo akasimpe, chipayizyo chazibi tachichiwo pe.
Pele kwasyaala biyo kubetekwa kuyoosya, abukali bwamulilo buyotenta basinkondonyina ba Leza.
Kufumbwa uukaka mulawu wa Mozesi ulafwa katausilwi pe kakuli bakamboni babili na nbatatu.

Muyeeya kuti nga chilatana aali chisubulo chipegwa ooyo wakaba kunsi lyamawulu aMwana wa Leza, oyo wakabweza bulowa bwachizuminano mbuli butasalede, - bulowa bulimbubo bwakamululamika  - mpawo wakatukila Muuya waluzyalo?
Nkaambo tulimuzi wakati, "Kukolotya nkukwangu; ndiyobbadala." Alubo, Mwami uyobeteka bantu bakwe."
Nchintu chiyoosya kuwida mumaboko a Leza uupona.
Pesi aukayeeye mazuba akusanguna nimwakajana mumuni, kuti mwakasima biyeni mukulwana amukoomba.
Mwakaba akusampawoulwa aluundu akupenzegwa, alimwi mwakali kwaabilana abaabo bamwi bakiinda mubusampawuzi amapenzi aya.
Nkaambo mwakali aluse kuli aabo bakangidwe alimwi mwakali kutambula amoyo omwe kunyanzigwa zintu zyenu. Mwakalizi lwanu kuti mwakalizi kuti mulijis lubono lutamani.
Aboobo tamusowi chaamba chenu, chijyoomweetela mpindu mpati.

(58) @HEB 10:38	<p-n>@Ba Hibbulu 10:38</p-n>	Mululami wangu uyoopona alusyomo. Naayoowa, nsikoyoomubotelwa pe.
Pesi tatuli babaabo bawa pe kababweeda kukunyonyoonwa. Pesi, tuli bamwi babaabo bajisi lusyomo lwakubamba myuuya yesu.
Lino lusyomo nkuba akasimpe kazintu zilangilidwe alimwi abwini bwazintu zitaboneko.
Aboobo nkaambo kacheechi basikale bakatambulika nkaambo kalusyomo lwabo.
Kwiinda mulusyomo tumvwisisya kuti nyika yakalengwa akulayilila kwaLeza , kutondezya kuti iziboneka tezyakalengwa kuzwa kuzintu zyakali kuboneka.

Nkaambo kalusyomo Abbelu  wakapa Leza chipayizyo chibotu kwiinda cha Keyini, nkakasunkwa aacho kukuba mululami alimwi Leza wakambula kabotu aatala anguwe nkaambo kazipayizyo zyakwe, alimwi kwiinda mulusyomo Abbelu  uchambuula nikuba kuti ulifwide.
Nkaambo kalusyomo Inoki wakatolwa biyo kujulu  katabwene lufu. "Taakajanika nkaambo Leza wakamubweza." Awo katana tolwa , kwakaba bukmaboni bwakuti wakali wabotezya Leza.
Lino uti kakutakwe lusyomo tazikonzeki pe kumubotezya. Nkaambo chileelede kuti kufumbwa uuza kuliLeza welede kusyoma kuti mpali alimwi mulumbuli wababo bamuyandula.

Ndusyomo lwakachita kuti Nowa, nakali wapegwa mulumbe wakujulu aatala azintu zikatalina boneka mukuba abulemu buli abunaLeza wakayaka bwaato ktui afutule mpuli yakwe.Mukuchita oobu wakiipa mulandu nyika eelyo wakaba simulyazina wabululami buza alusyomo.
Ndusyomo lwakachita kuti Abbulamu, nakiitwa wakateelela wiinka kubusena, oobo mbwakelede kutambula mbuuli lukono. Wakazwa wiinka, katanzi nkwaali kuya.
Ndusyomo lwakachita kuti akale munyika  yechisyomezyo mbuli muzwa kule. Wakakala mumatente antoomwe aAyizeki aJekkobbu, basimulyazinanyina kuchisyomezyo chomwe biyo.
Nkaambo wakali kulangilila kugunzi lilaantalisyo mubambi amuyaki wazyo kali nguLeza.

Mulusyomo - alimwi Sala lwakwe wakali ngomwa wakatambula kukonzya kumita mwana mubuchembele  bwakwe, mukubona kasyomekede oyo wakapa chisyomezyo. Kulimubuzyo wakutii  lwakali lusyomo lwaAbbulahamu na kana lwaSala lwakali kuboneka awa.  Mulusyomo Sala, nikuba kuti wakali wachembala, wakatambula  nguzu zyakuzyala mwana, nkaambo wakabona kasyomekede oyo wakapa chisyomezyo.
Aboobo kuzwa kumwalumi oyu omwe alimwiwakali wamba kufwa - kwakazyalwa bana bingi mbuuli nyenyeezi zya julu alimwi batabaliki mbuuli luseese lwakumbali alwizi.
Chakali mulusyomo kuti boons aaba bakafwa kabatatambwide zisyomezyo. Muchiindi eecho, nibaka ibona akuzi juzya kazili kule, bakazumina kuti bakali banasinakooma munyika.
Kuli aabo baamba zintu ziliboobu babika antaanganana kuti bayandula nyika yakukala.
Nikwali kuti bakali kuyeeya nyika njibakazwa kulinjiyo bali kunoowujana mweenya wakubweeda.
Pesi mbuuli mbuzibede bayndula nyika mbotu kwiinda, nkokuti, yakujulu. Aboobo Leza takwe nsoni akwambwa kuti nguLeza wabo, mbuli kuti wakaba bambila muunzi.
Nguwakali mwana wakwe omwe biyo ngwakapedekezya , ooyo wakatambula zisyomezyo.
Ezi  zyakambilwa Abbulahamu, "mazyalane aako ayowuzikwa kwindila muli Ayizeki"
Abbulahamu wakayeeya kuti Leza wakalikukonzya kumubusya Ayizeki kuzwa kubafu, alimwi kwaambisya mumaboneno aakwe wakamutambulalubo kuzwa kulimbabo.
Ayizeki wakalongezya Jekkobbu aIsawu kwindilila mulusyomo aatala azintu zyakachiyobuza.
Kwindila mulusyomo Jakkobbu naakaba afwiifwi akufwa wakalongezya banabaJOzefu balombe umwi awumwi. Jekkobbu wakakomba, kakoteme aamufunko wakwe.
Kwindila mulusyomo Jozefu , mamanino aakwe naakab aafwifwi, wakambuula atala akulonga kwabana ba - Isilayeli kuzwa ku - Igipite alimwi wakabalayilila aatala amafuwa akwe.
Kwakalikwindila mulusymo, Mozesi naakazyala, wakasiswa kwamyeezi yotatwe abazyali bakwe nkaambo bakabona kuti mwana mubotu. Tabayowede kulayilila kwamwami.
Kwakkali kwiindila mulusyomo kuti Mozesi, naakakomena wakakkaka kwambwa kuti mwana waFalo.
Wakasala kupenzegwa antoomwe abantu baLeza kwiinda kulibotzya abunone bwachibi chindi chinini.
Wakayeya kuti kusampulwa kwakutobela Kkilisito bwakali buvubi bupati kwiinda buvubi bwaIgipita. Nkaambo menso aakwe wakaabikide kubulumbu bwakwe.
Mulusyomo Mozesi wakazwa Igipita. Takwe nakayoowa bukkali bwaMwaam. Takwe nakayowa bukkali bwaMwaam, nkaambo wakakalatila aanga wakali mubwene ooyo uutabonwi.
Alusyomo wakabamba Pasika akusansilwa kwabulowa, kuchitila kuti sikujaya bana bataanzi atagumi bana babana-Izilayeli balombe batanzi.
Alusyomo bakiinda mu;wizi lwamatete mbuli kwiinda aanyika njumu. Awobana-Igipita  nibakayanda kuchita oobo bakamenwa.
Alusyomo bulambo bwakuJelikko bwakakkolomoka musule akuzyungulukwa kwamazuba alimusanu abili.
Zyakachitika mulusyomo kuti sibwaamu taakafwa pe antoomwe abasikutaswilila, nkaambo wakatambula basikutwela muluumuno.
Ninzi chimwi nchekonzya kwaamba? Ichiindi nsikoba aacho kuti ngambuule zyaGidiyoni, Bbalakki, Samisoni, Jefutati, Devidi, Samiyeli alimwi atala abasinsimi.
Kwakali kwindila mulusyomo kuti bakazunda zisi, bendelezya, bululami, alimwi bakatambula zisyomezyo. Bakajala milomo yabalavu,
akuzima nguzu zyamililo, bakaloboka kuyaswa asumu, bakaponesegwa kumalwazi bakaba basinguzu munkondo, akuzunda basilumamba bamazwa kule.
Banakazi bakatambula bafu babo abubuke. Bamwi bakoomba akufwabisigwa, kabatatambuli kwangununwa kuchitila kuti bajane bubuke bubotu kwiinda.
Bamwi bakatambula kunyansigwa  aunabbwa, alimwi amaketaniakubikwa muntolongo.
Bakatululwa mabbwe. Bakkandulwa aakati. Bakajigwa asumu. Bakapwenta kabazwete zikumba zyambelele azyempongo. Bakali mubuchete, akudyamizigwa, kabtajatwi oobotu.
Nyika teyakabapa bulemu Lyoonse bakali bakalikupwenta munkanda amuzilundu amumapako munyika.
Nikuba kuti boonse bantu aaba bakalitambwidwe aLeza nkaambo kalusyomo lwabo, taakwe nibakachitambula chisyomezyo.
Leza wakatubambila chimwi chintu chibotu kwiinda, kuchitila kuti kuboneke  aanoli tetwaliwo tebali kunoomaninizigwa pe.
Mbukuliboobo, mbulikuti yuzyungulukdwe joba paiti lyabakamboni, atubikke kumbali kulemenwa koonse antoomwe aibi zyoonse. Atube amoyo mulamfu mukuchijaana mujiizyanio ooyu wambikkwa kunembo lyesu.

Atuswiilile Jesu, we ngomutaliko amumaninizyi walusyomo. Nkaambo lukondo lwakabikkwa kunembo lyakwe, wakalipeda kuchiingano , nikuba chakalikupa mawuse, mpawo wakakukkala kululyo lwachuuno chabulemu cha Leza.
Aboobo amumuyeye, ooyo wakatola chiimo chili boobo kuli basizibi chiteendelani aguwe, kuchihtila kuti tamubi abutela mumyoyo yanu.
Taakwe nimwalina lwana achibi kuyosika kubulowa.
Alimwi mwakaluba kusungwaazigwa kumwaambila kuti inywe mbuli bana balombe: "Mwanangu, utayeeyi kuti milawu ya Mwami myuuba, na kuba abutela awo nowambilwa atala akuchita chibi anguwe.
Nkaambo Mwami ulapa malayilile kuli woonse muntu ngwayanda alimwi ulasubula mwana woonse ngwatambula.
Sima mukuenzegwa akulayigwa. Leza ubeleka andinywe mbuli bana. Ulabanzi ooyo mwana uula wisi utamu layi?
Pesi kuti kotakwe buntu, obo bantu boonse mbubaabana, ulimwana uutatambuliki alimwi toyelede pe kuba mwana wakwe.
Kuyakukunembo, twakalijisi bama taata bamunyama mbuli basikiutulayilila, alimwi twakabalemeka. Tatweelede na aboobo kuti tulemeke Wisi wa myuuya kuti tupone?

Nkaambo kulilimwi bbazu, bama taata besu bakatulayilila kwamazuba mache mbuli mbubakalikubona kazyeelede kulimbabo. Pesi kulilimwi bbazu leza uchita oobo kuti zitubotele kuchitila kuti tukaabaane aawe mubusalali.
Taakwe kulayililwa kuboneka kakubotela muntu muli eecho chiindi pesi kulachisa. Pesi muchiindi chiboola kuleta muchelo waluumuno mubululami kuli aabo bakalayililwa.
Aboobo simya maboko aako aayo asiminina aansi mazwi aako.
Panga nzila ziluleme zyamawulu aako, kuchitila kuti eezyo zilemene tazikoyookachilwa pesi ziyoponesegwa.
Amuyanduule luumuno abamwi boonse, antoomwe abusalali nkaambo iuutakwe busalali taakwe nayoomubona Mwami.
Amuchenjele kuti kuti takubi ubula luzyalo lwa Leza, alimwi takubi nuuba muyanda wakunyema uunga ulayeta kutamvwanana, kuchitila kuti biingi tababi kababisigwa ankuko.
Amuchenjele kuti takubi zyakunjila munobo zitaluleme na kuba muntu utaluleme mbuli Isawu, ooyo wakawuzya bupati bwakwe nkaambo kakulya.
Nkaambo mulizi kuti musule lyazezyo, naakazoyanda kutola chilongezyo, taakatambulika pe, nkaambo wakabula mweenya wakusanduka, nikunba kuti waka chiyanduula amisozi.
Nkaambo teensi mwaza kuchilundu chikonzeka kugumwa, chilundu chaulilo uuyaka, mudima, kutaboneka a guwo pati.
Teensi mwaza kuzolizya nyeele, na kujwi lyaambula majwi basikumvwa kabatamwi niliba limbi jwi lyaambuulwa kulimbabo.
Nkaambo tabakonzyi kuzikalilila eezyo nzibalayililwa: "Namnsya nuuba munyama waguma chilundu welede kutululwa mabwe."
Chakalikuyoosya loko echi chakabonwa a Mozesi awo naakati, "Ndilikuyoowa alimwi ndilikukankama."
Pesi mwasika kuchilundu cha Zayoni akudolopo lya Leza upona, Jelusalemu lyakujulu, akumakumi azyuulu zyabangelo zili kupobola.
Mwasika kumbungano yamwana wabubele, ooyo wakalembwa kujulu. Mwasika kuli Leza, Mubetesi waboomnse, akumyuuya yabaluleme bakalulamikwa.
Alimwi mwasika kuli Jesu, simwiima aakati wachizuminano chipya, akubulowa bwakasamnsiilwa bwaambula zilimbubo kwiinda bulowa bwa Abela.
Amubone kuti tamumukasyi ooyo uulikwaambula. Nkaambo kaansinga tebakafutuka nibakachija ooyo wakabalayilila aanyika, nkuche kuti tufuke na twachija ooyo ulikutulayilila kuzwa kujulu.
Mulichimwi chiindi, jwi lyakwe lyakateketesya nyika. Pesi lino wasyomezya wati, "Ilubo, nsikozoteketya nyika ayilike pe, pesi amajulu woonse."
Aya majwi, "Chimbi lubo chiindi," kwaamba kugwisya eezyo zintu zikonzya kuteketesegwa, kwaamba kuti, zintu zyakalengwa, kuchitila kuti zintu zitakonzeki kuteketesegwa zichaale.
Aboobo, kutambula bwami butakonzyi kuteketesegwa, atulumbe, amuleyi nzila tumukombe Leza mubulemu bupati akuyoowa.
Nkaambo Leza wesu mulilo uyaka akutenta.
Aamulekke Luyando lwabunyina lwinkilile anembo.
Mutalubi kujata akabotu beenzu. Mukwindila kulechi, bamwi bakajata kabotu ibangelo kabatazi pe.
Kamuyeya ibangidwe mbuli kuthi mwangidwe aamwi ambabo. Kamubayeya aaba batajiswi kabotu muli mulimubili omwe.
Aamuleke makwatano alemekwe kuliboonse, alimwi buulo bwamakwatano abusalale, nkambo leza uyobeteka abo ibayanda malalano abasimamambe.
Machitilo anu atabi akuyanda mali. Amukutisikane kuzinini nzimulazyo. Nkambo Leza lwakwe wakamba kuti,"Sikoyomuleka pe, nanka kumusiya."
Atukutisikane  tukabe abusichamba mukwamba, "Mwami ngomugwasyi wangu; nsikoyoyowa pe. Ino muntu ulandichitanzi?
Kamuyeeya bazuluzi ibanu, kulabo bakamba aabo bakamwambila jwi lyaLeza, Alimwi kamwibalukwa impindu zyabweende bwabo. Kamutobelzye lusyomo lwabo.
Jesu Kkilisito nguwe wajilo, sunu mane kukabe kutamani.
Mutenwi anjisyo nzimutazi zyamusyobomusyobo. Nkambo nchibotu kuti Moyo usisimisigwe aluzyalo pe- pe azyakulya.eezyo zitagwasyi aabo benda anzizyo.
Tulijisi chipayililo chizwa kulabo ibabeleka muDumba lyakukkombela eelyo tabakwe cheelelo chakulya.
Nkambo bulowa bwabwanyama bwakafwida zibi bwaketwa abapayizi ibapati mukati kenganda isalala, muchindi echo mibili yabo yakatentwa anze mpubakakede.
Eelyo Jesu alakwe wakapenzegwa anze amulyango wamunzi, mukambo kakuti basalazye ibantu mukwindila mubulowa bwakwe.
Nkinkaako atwiinke kulinguwe kumbali amunzi, atubweze mawuse akwe.
Kambo tatukwe munzi wakukalilila pe ano, Pesi tuchiyandula munzi umbi uchiza.
Kwiinda mulinguwe, aboobo, tweelede chindi choonse tupede chipayizyo chakutembawula Leza, lumbayizya michelo yamilomo akuzumina muzina lyakwe.
Elyoo tutalubi nituluba mukuchita bubotu akwabilana, nkaambo mukwindila muchipayizyo chilobu Leza ulachibotelwa.

Kuswilila akulibombya kubazululi banu, eelyo mbembabo balanga myuya yanu mbuli abo bamupeda bukamboni bwaabo beni, Mulemeke kuchitila kuti bazuluzi banu bakachite echi chakubotelwa akutangunguna, pesi chakatali kumugwasya inywe.
Kamutukombela aswebo, nkambo twakombelezegwa munjisyoimbotu akuti twayandisya kukala muzintu zyoonse.
Ndilikumusungwazya nikuba nanka mukwindila mukuchita obu nkambo ndobozegwa kuli ndinywe mukufwambana.
Lino Leza waluumuno oyo wakabozya kuzwa kulufu mweembeli mupati wembelele, Mwami wesu Jesu, akubulowa bwachizuminano chitamani.
Kupa zyonse zibelesyo mukukusimya kuzintu zyoonse, mukubeleka mulindiswe kulecho chimubotezya, mukwindila muliJesu Kkilisito, kulinguwe akube bulemu kwalyoonse alyoonse. Ameni.
Lino ndamusungwazya, nobakwesu, ikuti mubweze ijwi eeli lyakumusungwazya ndindamulembela mubufwifwi.
Muzibe mukwesu Timoti wangununwa, ooyo ngwesizawe kuzomubona kuti afwambana kusika.
Mujuzye bazuluzi banu boonse antomwe abasalali abantu boonse baLeza. Abo bazwa kuItali balokumujuzya.
Luzyalo alube anywebo moonseni.

Eeli ndijwi lya Jehova eelyo lyakasika kuli Hosiya mwana wa Bbiyali mumazuba a Uziya, Jotamu, Ahazi a Hezekkiya, baami ba Juda, alimwi mumazuba a Jelobbowamu mwana mulombe wa Jowasyi, mwami wa Izilayeli.

Aawo Jehova nakambuula kumatalikilo kwindila muli Hosiya, nakamwambila kuti, ''Koya,  ukalibwezele mwanakazi mwaamu. Uyooba aabana kuzwa kubwaamu bwakwe. Nkaambo inyika ilikuchita bwamu bupati mukutatobela Jehova.''
Nkiinkako Hosiya wakinka wakukwaata Goma mwana musimbi wa Dibbilayimu, alimwi wakaminta akumuzyalila mwana mulombe.

Jehova wakati kuli Hosiya, ''Umwiite izina lya Jezililu. Nkambo muchindi chinini ndiyopa chisubulo kung'anda ya Jewu akambo kakutila bulowa ku Jezililu, alimwi ndiyo yimikizya bwami bwa ng'anda ya Izilayeli.
Ziyochitika mubuzuba mbindiyotyola mudaantambwa wa Izilayeli Mumusena wa Jezililu.''
Goma wakaminta lubo akuzyala mwana umbi musimbi. Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Hosiya, ''Umwiite izina lya Lo - Luhama, nkambo nsichiyoobi ansoni pe kung'anda ya Izilayeli, kuti ndibalekelele alili.
Kakuli kuti ndiyooba ansoni ang'anda ya Juda, alimwi ndiyobavuna alwangu, Jehova Leza wabo. Nsikoyobawuma amudaantambwa, ifulo, nkondo, mabbiza, na abasimabbiza.''
Lino musule akuti Goma walesya Lo-Luhama,  wakaminta akutumbuka uumbi mwana mulombe.
Mpawo Jehova wakati, ''Umwiite izina lyakuti Lo-Ami, mukuti tamuli bantu bangu pe, alimwi nsili Leza wenu pe.

Nkakuli kuti mweelwe wabantu baku Izilayeli uyooba mbuli musele wakumbali alwizi, ooyo utakonzyi kweelwa na kubalwa. Kuyoba oobo ooko nkubakambiilwa kuti, ''Tamuli bantu bangu pe, muyowambwa oobo kuli mbabo, 'Muli bantu ba Leza uupona.'
Bantu bakwa Juda abantu baku Izilayeli bayobungana antoomwe, alimwi bayolisalila uumwi muzuluzi, alimwi bayooya kujulu kuzwa anyika, mukuti izuba lya Jezileli liyooba pati.
Ambila bakulana bako, 'Bantu bangu!' alimwi akubachizi bako, 'Mwatondeezegwa luzyalo.''''

Uyete kambo mukazyanie abanyoko, yeta lukazyanio, nkambo tali mwanakazi wangu, alimwi mbuli mbwensili mulumi wakwe. Muleke asowe bwamu bbwakwe kuzwa kunembo lyakwe, anchito zyakwe zyabwaamu kuzwa aakati kankolo zyakwe.
Kuti tekwaba oobo, ndiyo mugwisya zisamo kukaboneke chintanda chakwe mbuli mubuzuba mbwakazyalwa. Ndiyomuchita mbuli nkanda, mbuli nyika ibbuwa, alimwi ndiyomuchita kuti akafwe anyota.
Nsikoyo bafwida insoni pe bana bakwe, nkaambo mbana babwaamu.

Nkaambo banyina bakali baamu, alimwi ooyo wakabaminta wakachita zifwisya bweeme. Wakati, ''Ndiyotobela bayandwa bangu, nkambo bandipa chibunge changu amanzi, buluba bwangu achilivumbyo, mafuta angu azintu zyakunywa.''
Nkiinkako ndiyoyaka lubaya lwakujalila nzila yakwe amaamvwa. Ndiyoyaka bulambo bwakumusitika kuti ataboni inzila yakwe.

Uyo bayanduula bayandwa bakwe, pesi takoyobayinda pe. Uyobayanduula pesi takoyobajana pe. Mpawo uyowamba kuti, ''Ndiyobweda kumulumi wangu mutaanzi, nkambo kwakali mbubo mbubo kuli ndime elyo kwinda mbukubede lino.''
Nkambo takaazi pe kuti ndime ndakali ndamupa zilyo, iwayini impya amafuta, alimwi wakavukula insiliva angolida yakwe, eyo njibakabelesya mpawo ku Bbaalu.
Nkiinkako ndiyo bweedezya zilyo zyakwechiindi chagoloka, awayini yangu impya muchindi chayo. Ndiyobwedezya buluba achilivumbyo ezyo zyakabelesegwa kukuvumba chinkuna chakwe.
Mpawo ndiyo muzwatununa chinkuna kunembo lyabayandwa bakwe, alimwi takwepe muntu utakamuvune kuzwa mujanza lyangu.
Ndiyoyimikizya koonse kubotelwa kwakwe - mapobwe aakwe, ansekelelo zyakwe zyamweezi mupya, masabata aakwe, amabambe aakwe azyiindi zyakusekelela.
''Ndiyomwayula michelo amikuyu yakwe, eeyo njakali wati, 'Eyi njemifolo njibakandipa bayandwa bangu.' Ndiyoyichita lukabe lusaka, alimwi banyama bamumuunda bayoyilya.

Ndiyomupa chisubulo chamazuba aapobwe lya Bbaalu, aawo nakatenta kanunkilizyo kuli mbabo, aawo nakalibotya a nweenwe zyakwe anchoko, alimwi nayenda kutobela bayandwa bakwe akundiluba - eechi nchaambilizyo cha Jehova.''
Nkiinkako ndiyomuyunga lubo. Ndiyomweeta munkanda alimwi ndikaambuule aawe kabotu kabotu.
Ndiyo mubweedezya myuunda yakwe, akkuti lya eKkaa mbuli mulyango wabulangizi. Uyondisandula nkukooko mbuli mbali kuchita mumazuba akwe ngaakazwa munyika ya Ijiputi.
Chiyoba muli eelyo izuba -- eechi nchaambilizyo cha Jehova -- kuti muyondiita, mulumi wangu.' alimwi tachikandiiti kuti, 'Bbbaalu wangu.'
Nkambo ndiyogwisya mazina aba Bbaalu kuzwa mumulomo wakwe; mazina aabo tachikayeyegwi limbi.''

''Muli eelyo izuba ndiyochita chizuminano chabo abanyama mumyuunda, abayuni mujulu, alimwi azintu ziyavula aanyika. Ndiyotanda mudaantambwa, ifulo, ankondo kuzwa aanyika, alimwi ndiyochita kuti mulale aansi chakukwabilika.
Ndiyosyomezya kuba mulumi wako walyoonse. Ndiyosyomezya kuba mulumi wako mubusalali, mubwini, kusyomeka kuchizuminano, ansoni.
Ndiyolipeda kuli nduwe mukusyomekana, alimwi uyomuziba Jehova.
Muli eelyo izuba, ndiyo sandula- eechi nchaambilizyo cha Jehova -- ndiyo vwiila majulu, alimwi ayovwiila inyika.
Inyika iyovwila imbuto, iwayini impya amafuta, alimwi ziyovwiila Jezelilu.
Ndiyo mubyalila lwangu munyika, alimwi ndiyoba ansoni aali Lo--Luhama. Ndiyowambila Lo--Ami, 'Muli bantu bangu; alimwi bayondaambila kuti, 'Nduwe Leza wangu.''

Jehova wakati kuli ndime, ''Yinka lubo, ukayande mwanakazi, uyandwa amulumi wakwe, pesi kali sibwamu. Umuyande mbuli ndime, Jehova, mbundiyanda bantu ba Izilayeli, nikuba kuti bachengunukila kuli bamwi ba leza, akuyanda tubunge twazibi.''
Nkiinkako ndakamuulila lwangu atusyapu twa nsiliva tuli kkumi amusanu amugomo agabba lya bbali ( mpuunga)
Ndakati kuli nguwe, weelede kukkala andime kwamazuba miingi. Tokooba sibwaamu pe nikuba kuba wa umwi mwalumi. Mulinjiyeyo inzila, ndiyoba aanduwe.''
Aboobo bantu ba Izilayeli bayopona kwamazuba miingi kabatakwe mwami, mwana wa mwami, chipayilo, imbandama yamabwe, chizwato chamupayizi nikuba zileza kubumba zyampuli.
Musule aaboobo bantu ba Izilayeli bayoobola akuyanduula Jehova Leza wabo a Daviti mwami wabo, alimwi mumazuba amelelezyo, bayoza butuntuma kunembo lya Jehova abubotu bwakwe.

Amumvwe ijwi lya Yahuwe, nywebo nobantu ba Izilayeli. Yahuwe ula mulawu ulangene abantu bakkala munyika eyo, nkambo takukwe kasimpe nikuba kusyomekana kuchizuminano, nikuba luzibo lwa Leza mukati kanyika.
Kuli kutukwa, kweenena, bujayi, kubba akwamuka. Bantu bakatyolola woonse kulatondwa, alimwi akutikiika kwaganzi kuloku tobelana.
Nkiinkako nyika yayuma, alimwi muntu wonse ukkala mukati ulimukunyonyooka; banyama mumyuunda antomwe abayuni bakujulu, niziba enswi zyamumilonga, azyalo zilimuku nyonyoonwa.
Pesi mutazumizyi naba omwe kuti ayete mulawu ; tamulekeli umwi muntu kuti aape umwi mulandu. Nkambo ndendinywe, ba payizi, abo mbindi mukupa mulandu.
Inywebo nobapayizi muyodadalika isikati; basinsimi abalabo bayodadalika andinywe kuchindi chamansiku, alimwi ndiyonyoonyona banyoko.

Bantu bangu bali muku jayigwa nkambo kakubula luzibo. Nkambo nywebo nobapayizi mwatakata luzibo. Ambebo ndiyomutakata kuti muli bapayizi kuli ndime. Nkambo mwaluba mulawu wangu, nikuba kuti ndime Leza wenu, ambebo ndiyoluba bana benu.
Mukuvula nkubayovula bapayizi nkubayo bubisya kuli ndime. Bakasanduzya bulemu bwabo abuuse.
Balya chibi chabantu bangu; batangala kukujana bwiingi bwaziyandisyo zyabo.
Chiyokozyania kuli zyabantu ambuli zyaba payizi: Ndiyoba subula boonse nkambo kazichito zyabo; Ndiyo babbadalisya nkambo kazichito zyabo.
Bayolya pesi tabakoyojana zikkwene pe; bayochita bwamu pesi tabakoyovula, nkambo bakaya kule kuzwa kuli Yahuwe.
Bayanda busofwazi bwalulalano, wayini, antomwe awayini mupya, oyo wakatola kumvwisisisya kwabo.

Bantu bangu bayandula kumvwisisisya kuzibezwa zyabo, alimwi amifunko yabo ibapa chisinsimi. Nkambo muzezo wabusofwazi wabasowesya, alimwi bachita mbuli basibwamu awo mpubelede kusyomeka kuli Leza wabo.

Bachita zipayilo ataala azilundu akutenta tununkilizyo azilundu, munsi lyamibanga, misikili a mikamba nkambo myenzule yayo mibotu. Nkinkako bana benu basimbi balachita chisesemyo chakulalana, alimwi abamukabana benu balachita bumambi.

Imebo nsikoyo bapa chisubulo bana benu basimbi muchindi nibali salila kuchita malalane abo, nibaba bamukamwana benu kuchindi nibachita mamambe. Nkinkako aba bantu tabamvwisisisyi bayosowelwa ansi. Nkambo abalabo balumi babo balalipeda kuli basibwamu. Eelyo aba bantu bataswilili bayosowelwa ansi
.inchekaka Juda atabi amulandu pe. Utayinki pe ku Giligali, nobantu; mutakayinki ku Bbeti Aveni, alimwi mutakakonki, kamwamba kuti, ''Mbuli Yahuwe mbwapona.''
Nkambo Izilayeli walibamba chabumpelenge, mbuli ng'ombe inzyazi impelenge. Mbobuli Yahuwe mbatazyeete kukuzochela mbuli imbelele mumusena ulalume?
Efulemu walijatanisya lwakwe abaleza bakufula; mumusiye alikke.
Nikuba nikamumanina kanywido kakwe kajisi nguzu, balinkilila anembo akuchita bumambi; batongi bakwe bayiyanda loko mfwisya bweeme yabo.
Iluwo luyomuzambilila mumababa aalo; alimwi bayoba aansoni akambo kazipayilo zyabo.

''Amumvwe eezi, bapayizi! Muswilile loko, n'anda ya Izilayeli! Swilila, nong'anda yamwami! Nkambo lubeta luzobuza lulangene anywebo moonseni. Mwali kakole ku Mizipa alimwi akazamba kayalidwe aa Tabbo.
Ibakasaluukana bayimvwi chakunika muchijayilo, pesi ndiyobapa chisubulo boonse.
Ndili mwizi Efulemu, alimwi Izilayeli tasisidwe pe kuli ndime. Efulemu, lino waba mbuli sibwamu; Izilayeli yazimvwa.
Inchito zyabo tazikoyobazumizya pe kuti baboole kuli Leza, nkambo muzezo wabwamu uli muli mbabo, alimwi tabamwizi pe Yahuwe.
Ikuliyanda kwa Izilayeli kulambilizya atala anguwe; nkinkako Izilayeli a Efulemu bayoyenda mububi bwabo: alimwi Juda alakwe uyoyenda ambabo.
Bayoyinka atulundu lwabo amatanga ambono zyabo kukuyandula Yahuwe, pesi tabakoyo mujana pe, nkambo waligwisya kuli mbabo.
Tebakali kusyomeka kuli Yahuwe, nkambo bazyala bana batali mumulawu pe. Lino ipobwe lya mweezi mupya liyo balya amyuunda yabo.
Musiibe nyeele mu Gibbiya, antomwe amweembo mu Laama. Musibe kalizyo kankondo ku Bbeti Aveni: 'Tuyo mutobela nywebo, Bbenjamini!'
Efulemu uyoba mumbala mubuzuba bwachisubulo. Akati kamisyobo yoonse ya Izilayeli ndakambilizya eezyo zili nzizyo zitakachitike.
Bazuluzi ba Juda bali mbuli aabo basosolosya ibbwe lyamugaano. Ndiyotila bukkali bwangu aali mbabo mbuli maanzi.
Efulemu wakadyamizigwa; wamanikila mulubeta, nkambo wakaliyandila kwendela baleza zibumbe.
Elyo ndiyoba mbuli inkubi kuli Efulemu, alimwi mbuli chimbozya kung'anda ya Juda.

Muchindi Efulemu nakabona kuchiswa kwakwe, alimwi Juda wakabona chilonda chakwe, mpawo Efulemu wakaya ku Asiliya, alimwi Juda wakatuma basinyeenda kumwami mupati. Pesi takakonzya pe kumusilika nywebo nobantu nikuba zionda zyenu.

Nkiinkako ndiyoba mbuli mulavu kuli Efulemu, alimwi mbuli kalavu kanini kung'anda ya Juda. Imebo, nikuba lwangu, ndiyopanuna bakaanzane alimwi ndikazwe; Imebo ndiyo bagwisya, alimwi takukoyoba naba omwe sikuyobavuna lwabo.
Ndiyoyenda alimwi ndikabweede kubusena bwangu, kusikila bakazibe bubi bwabo akuyoyanduula chinso changu, kusikila bakandiyanduule chanchoonzyo mukuusa kwabo.''
''Amubole, atupiluke kuli Jehova. Ngonguwe wakatukwamuna chakutwanzaania, pesi uyotuponia; wakatuchisa, pesi uyowanga zilonda zyesu.
Aamana mazuba obile uyotubukulusya; uyotubusya mubuzuba bwatatu, alimwi tuyopona kubusyu bwakwe.
Atumuzibe Jehova; atwinkilile kunembo chakusinizya mbuli mvula ntaanzi ibombya nyika.''
Efulemu, nkakuchite biyeni? Juda nkakuchite biyeni? Luyando lwenu lulimbuli ijoba lyachifumofumo, mbuli lume lufwambana kumana.
Nkaambo kaako njobagonkola kwinda kubasinsimi; Ndabajaya amajwi amulomo wangu. Imbeta zyangu zili mbuli mumuni umunika aanze.
Elyo ndakondelelwa muchizuminano chisyomekede pepe chipayizyo, aluzibo lwa Leza kwinda zituuzyo.
Mbuli Adamu mbwakachityola chizuminano, tebakasyomekape kuli ndime.
Giliyadi nchisi chaababo bachita bubi, beendela zyabulowa.
Mbuli nkamu yabafumpi balindila muntu, abalabo bapayizi balajanika kubujayi munzila ya Sechemu; balajanika kubujayi munzila ya Sechemu; balachita milandu iwusisya nsoni.
Mung'anda ya Izilayeli ndakabona chintu  chiyosya; Efulemu bwamu bwakwe mpobuli,  alimwi Izilayeli wakasofwaala.
Ayeebo, Juda, wabikilwa kutebula, eelyo ndiyobwedezya buzike bwabantu bangu.
Kufumbwa nindayanda kuponia Izilayeli, mulandu wa Efulemu ulalibonia, alimwi mbuli zibi zyazichito zya Samaliya, nkambo bachita zyalweeno; muubbi ulanjila, abafump balafumpa mumigwagwa.

Tabayeeyi pe mumiyeeyo yabo kuti ndayibulukwa inchito zyabo zyoonse imbi. Lino inchito zyabo zyabazyunguluka; zyalibonia kumenso aangu. Abubi bwabo bulabazyunguluka lwabo; akubeja kwabo kuli kunembo lyabusyu bwangu.
Amichito yabo isofwede balabotelezya mwami, antomwe amabejo abo balabotezya basilutwe.
Boonse mbasimamambe, mbuli chijikilo chakutentwa amujiki, oyo waleka kusosela mulilo kuzwa kukukanda zinkwa mane zikafutufumuke.
Mubuzuba bwa Mwami wesu basilutwe balalichisya chisya akukolwa wayini. Wakatandabika ijanza lyakwe kuli baabo bakali kusampawuwula.
Nkambo amyoyo yabo ilimbuli chijikilo, balapanga mizezo yabo yalweeno. Bukali bwabo buloola mansiku woonse; chifumo bulayaka mbuli mulilo wamabanga banga.
Boonse balapya mbuli chijikilo, akulya abo babazulwida. Baami babo boonse bawa; takwepe naba omwe wabo undikwilila.
Efulemu wali vwelengania akati kabantu. Efulemu nchinkwa chipapalete chitasandwidwe pe.
Beenzu bazimaninsya inguzu zyakwe, pesi tazizi pe. Imvwi zyatalika alinguwe, pesi lwakwe taziizi pe.
Kulisumpula kwaba Izilayeli kupa bukamboni bwaku mupandukila; nekuba boobo, tabana piluka pe kuli Jehova Leza wabo, nekuba kumuyandula, takwe nchebakayanda kuli zeezi.
Efulemu ulimbuli inziba, imfubafuba alimwi zitakwe pe boongo, zyiitila ku Ijiputi akuulukila ku Asiliya.
Elyo nibayoyinka, njoyala lunsabwe lwangu alimbabo; njobaselusya aansi mbubonya mbuli bayuni bakujulu. Njobasubula mbubonya mbuli mukwenda kwabo.
Maawe kuli mbabo! nkambo bapambuka kuli ndime. Lunyonyooko luyobuza kuli mbabo! Bandipapila! Niinga ndalikuno bavuna, pesi bakamba chakubeja atala andime.
Takwepe nibaka ndikkwilila amoyo wabo woonse, pesi balakwila amalo abo. Balabungania biyo mayila awayini mupya, alimwi balandifutatila.
Nekuba ndakabayiisya akusimya maboko aabo, balandibambila bubi.

Balaboola, pesi tababooli kuli ndime pe, ndime Sijulu lya Majulu. Bali mbuli buuta butasimide. Basilutwe babo bayowinsigwa epanga nkambo kakasampusampu kandimi zyabo. Echi chiyoba chisesyo chabo munyika ya Ijiputi.
''Kobikka mweembo amulomo wako! Insika iyobuza kung'anda ya Jehova nkambo bantu batyola chizuminano changu akupapila mulawu wangu.
Balandikwilila, ''Leza wangu, iswebo mu Izilayeli tulikwizi.'
Pesi Izilayeli wakaka chintu chibotu, alimwi sinkondonyina uyomutandania.

Balalibikila bami, pesi kutali kwindila mulindime pe. Balipangila basilutwe, pesi mbensizi pe. Mukwindila mungolida ansiliva zyabo bakapanga chileza chabo beni. Pesi nekuba bobo balelede kunyonyoonwa.''
''Ching'ombe chako chakakwa, Samaliya. Bukali bwangu bwababukila aba bantu. Kuyoba lili kabataleki kubisya?
Nkambo eechi chileza chakazwa ku Izilayeli; mufuzi ngwakachifula, tachili leza pe! Nching'ombe chaba Samaliya chiyotyololwa.
Nkambo bantu babyala luuwo alimwi bayotebula kambizi. Mayila ayimvwi katakwe pe masonso; taachiti zilyo pe. Nekuba kuti abizwa, bazwa masi bayozimana.
Ba Izilayeli bamenenwa; sunu baba akkati kabamasi mbuli chilongo chitabeleki.
Nkambo bakaya ku Asiliya mbuli mbongolo yamusokwe lwabo abalikke. Efulemu walyulila basimamambe mwini.
Nekuba kuti balyulila basimamambe akkati kamikowa, lino njobayobolola antomwe. Bayotalika kuleka nkambo kamikuli yabami abasilutwe.
Nkambo Efulemu wavuzya zipayililo zyakupayilila zibi, pesi zyakaba zipayililo zyakuchita zibi.
Ndalikuba lembela milawu yangu zyindi zili myaanda ilikkumi, pesi balikwilanga mbuli chintu cheenzu kuli mbabo.
Kuzituzyo zyazipayizyo zyangu, balatuula nyama akwiilya, pesi imebo,  nde Jehova nsizitambuli pe. Lino ndiyoyeeya atala akubisya kwabo akuyopa chisubulo kuzibi zyabo. Bayobweda ku Ijiputi.
Izilayeli wakandiluba, nde Mulengi wakwe, alimwi wakayaka maanda abami. Juda wakayakila myuunzi myiingi chakwizyunguluka, pesi njotuma mulilo kumyunzi yakwe, uyotenta bwami bwakwe.
Utabotelwi, Izilayeli, alukondo ndubabotelwa bamwi bantu. Nkambo tewakasyomeka, akuluba Leza wako. Wayanda kubbadalwa mufolo wasibwamu ngwayanda muzipolelo zyoonse zyamiila.
Pesi zipolelo azisinino zyawayini tazikoyo basanina; wayini mupya uyobakachilwa.
Tabakoyoyinkilila kunembo akupona munyika ya Jehova; anukuti; Efulemu uyobweda ku Ijipita, alimwi limwi zuba uyolya zilyo zisofweede mu Asiliya.

Tabachiyotili wayini wachituulo kuli Jehova, nikuba kuyomubotezya. Zituuzyo zyabo ziyobaanga nkulya kwabasikulila kulimbabo: boonse basikulya bayosofwaala nkambo kulya kwabo kunoli kwabo abalikke; takukonochiza mukati kang'anda ya Jehova.
Muyochita biyeni mubuzuba bwepobwe libambidwe, muzuba lyepobwe lya Jehova?
Nkambo, bona, kuti bachija kulunyonyooko, Ijipita uyobabungania, alimwi Mempisi uyobavwikkila. Mbuli zintu zyabo ziyandisi zyansiliva zimpobwa zibosya zyabajana amamvwa ayoba mumadumba abo.

Mazuba akusubulwa ayobuza: mazuba akubwedezegwa bubi ayobuza. Izilayeli woonse azibe zintu eezi. Musinsimi mufubafuba, mwalumi uyoyeledwe ulipengede, nkambvo kakuvula kwabubi bwanu andutiluti zyanu zyakomena.
Musinsimi nguyiminina Leza wangu kukulanga Efulemu pele inzila zyakwe zyoonse ziliteyedwe akusulwa ulakujana mung'anda ya Leza.
Balisofwazya chakwindilila mbuli mumabuza a Gibbiya. Leza uyoyeeya busofwazi bwabo, alimwi ubasubula nkambo kazibi zyabo.

Jehova wati, ''Nindakajana Izilayeli, kwakabaanga nkujana munsansa munkanda, mbuli muchelo mutaanzi wamukkuyu mbundakajana bamawuso. Pele bakiinka kuli Bbaali Peyo, akulipeda kuchileza chifwisya mawuse. Bakaba mbuli chileza nchibayanda kukusofwaala.
Kwamba mbuli Efulemu, bulemu bwabo bwinke buyomwayuka akuuluka mbuli bayuni. Takukoyooba kuzyala, takwe ida akuminta.
Nikuba bakakkomezya bana, bayofwidwa boonse, maawe kuli mbabo ndakabafutula!
Ndakamubona Efulemu, mbuli Taya, ubyalidwe muluume, pesi Efulemu uyogwisya bana bakwe kulumwi oyo uyobajaya.''
Kobapa, Jehova - nchinzi nchoyobapa? Kobapa biyo ida litaminti pe alimwi ankolo zitagwisyi malili pe.
''Nkambo kabubi bwabo boonse ku Giligali, oko nkonkuko nkundakatalikila kubasula, nkambo kamilimo yabo mibi, njobagwisya mung'anda yangu. Nsichiyobayandi limbi; boonse basilutwe mbapanduki.
Efulemu wababulwazi, amiyanda yabo yayuuma; tabachizyali michelo. Nikuba kabali abana, ndiyobika bayandwi bamada abo kulufu.''
Leza wangu uyobakkaka nkambo tebakamuswilizya. Bayoba basimutuntuli akkati kamikowa yonse.
Izilayeli musamu muyandwi uuzyala michelo yakwe. Mbuli mbuyakavula michelo yakwe, wakayaka zipayililo zyiingi. Mbuli nyika mbiyakazyalisya, wakabotya misumpululu.
Myoyo yabo njalweeno; lino bayopegwa milandu yabo. Jehova uyodilisya zipayililo zyabo; uyomwayuula misumpululu yabo.
Nkambo alimwi bayowamba kuti, ''Tatukwe mwami, nkambo tetwakayoowa Jehova, amwami- wali kutuchitilayi?''
Baambula majwi atakwe chintu akuchita zizuminana akukonkezya chakubeja. Aboobo bululami bulasotoka mbuli masokwe alamusamu uujaya mubulimo bwamumuunda.
Bakkala mu Samaliya bayoyowa nkambo kamanamani aku Bbeti Aveni. Bantu babo bakabomokela, mbuli mbubachita abapayizi basikukomba mituni abo bakabotelwa akuzwidilila kwabo, pele tabachiwo pe.
Bayotolwa ku Asiliya mbuli chilumbyo chamwami mupati. Efulemu uyotyompwa alimwi Izilayeli uyoba amawuse achileza chakwe.
Mwami waku Samaliya uyonyonyoonwa, mbuli chisamu chigonkedwe atala manzi.

Masena asumpukide anusofwazi ayonyonyoonwa. Eechi nchibi cha Izilayeli! Maamvwa azyobankonono ayomena atala zipayililo zyabo. Bnatu bayoti kudundu ''Ndivwikke!''' alimwi akukalundu, ''Wida alindiswe!''
''Izilayeli, wakabisya kuzwa mumazuba aku Gibbiya; oko wakasyaala. Inkondo tikoyobweza bana babubi mu Gibiiya?
Eelyo ndayanda, ndiyobalaya. Bantu bayolibunga kukubalwisya nkambo kabubi bwindulwidwe.
Efulemu nimpwizi yakayisigwa iyanda kupola mayila, elyo njobikka jokwe ansingo yakwe mbotu. Ndabikka jokwe ali Efulemu; Juda uyolima, Jakobo uyolikwelela ihala lwakwe mwini.
Mulibyalile bululami lwanu, akuli tebwida michelo yachizuminano mubululami. Lipandile nyika itanalimwa, nkambo nchiindi chakuyandula Jehova, ado asike akutila bululami alinduwe.
Wakalima busofwazi; watebula kutalulama. Wakalya michelo yalweeno nkambo wasyoma mabambe ako akuli basilumamba bako bingi.

Eelyo lupyopyongano lwenkondo luyobuka akkati kabantu bako, amadolopo anu ayakilidwe ayonyonyoonwa. Kuyoba mbuli Shalimani mbwakanyonyoona Bbeti Abbeli mubuzuba bwenkondo, awo banakazi mpubaka sabulwa abana babo.
Aboobo ziyochitika kuli ndinywe, Bbeteli, nkambo kabubi bwako bupati. Kubuchedo mwami wa Izilayeli unoli wamana.''
Eelyo Izilayeli nakali mulombe ndakamuyanda, alimwi ndakamwiita mwana mulombe kuzwa mu Ijipita.
Nkuchiyobumwiita twingi, nakasosoloka loko kuzwa kuli ndime. Bakatula zituuzyo kuli Bbaali akutenta tununkilizyo kuzileza.
Anukuti ndime ndakayiisya Efulemu kwenda. Ndime ndakabanyampula amaboko abo, pele tebakaziba pe kuti ndime ndabasilika.
Ndabeenzya azyenzyo zyabuuya, alutambo lwaluyando. Ndakababeda mbuli muntu utebununa ijokwe mumyeebo yabo, ndakakotama aansi kuli mbabo akubasanina.
Tabakoyobweda kunyika ya Ijipita? Asiliya takoyobendelezya pe na nkambo bakkaka kupiluka kulindime?
Ipanga liyowida mumyunzi yabo akumwayula mankolo amilyango yabo; liyobamwayula nkambo kamaanu abo beni.
Bantu bangu balibambilidwe kundifutatila nikuba bayita kuli usumpukide, takwepe utakabagwasye.

Ndafutatila biyeni, Efulemu? Ndika kwaabe biyeni, Izilayeli? Nkujana ndikakuchite mbuli mbundakachita Adima na? Nkujana ndikakuchite mbuli Zebboyimu? Moyowangu wasanduka muli ndime; luzyalo lwangu lwabukuluka.
Nsikoyo maninsizya bukali bwangu buyoosya; nsichiyo munyonyooni limbi Efulemu nkambo ndime Leza alimwi nsili muntu; Ndime Uusalala omwe akati kanju, alimwi nsiciyoboli mubukali.
Bayotebula Jehova; alimwi uyovuluma mbuli mulavu. Eelyo navuluma, bana bakwe bayoza buteketa kuzwa kumbo.
Bayoza buteketa mbuli kayuni kuzwa ku Ijipita, mbuli inziba kuzwa kunyika yaku Asiliya. Ndiyobachita kuti bakkale mumyuunzi yabo-mbwaamba Jehova.
Efulemu ulandizyunguluka akubeja, ang'anda ya Izilayeli alweno.Pele Juda ucheenda a Leza alimwi uli syomekede kuli Uusalala Omwe.''
Efulemu ulisanina aguuwo alimwi ulatobela luuwo lwakujwe winkilila kunembo kukuvuzya mabejo enkondo. Bachita chizuminano a Asiliya akubweza mafuta ama Olifa kuya ku Ijipita.
Jehova ulijisi makani alatala a Juda alimwi uyosubula Jakobe kulezyo nzyakachita; uyo mubbadala kumilimo yakwe.
Nkachili mwida wakajata kasindi kamukulana wakwe, alimwi mubwalumi bwakwe wakazundana a Leza.
Wakazundana amungelo wazwidilila. Wakakwila akukkumbila luzyalo. Wakaswanana a Leza ku Bbeteli; oko Leza wakaambula anguwe.
Oyu ngu Jehova, Leza wamakamu; ''Jehova'' ndyezina lyakwe ndyati kayitwe.
Aboobo pilukila kuli Leza wako. Kobamba chizuminano chakusyomeka abululami, alimwi kolinda Leza chakutaleka.
Zyelesyo zyasimakwebo nzyalweeno zili mumaanza akwe, balayanda kubeja.
Efulemu wakati, ''Nchobeni ndavuba, ndalijanina buvubi mumilimu yangu tabakoyojana bubi, achintu chiyoba chibi.''
''Ndime Jehova Leza wako kuzwa munyika ya Ijipita. Njokukkazika alimwi mumadumba mbuli mumazuba apobwe libambidwe.
Ndakaambula kubasinsimi, alimwi ndakabapa zilengano zyiingi zyenu. Kumana abasinsimi ndakabapa zikozyanyo.''
Kuti nkakuli bubi ku Giliyadi, nkasimpe bantu banoli mbabuyo. Ku Giliyadi bakatuuzya basune; zipayililo zyabo ziyoba mbuli malwi amabwe mubulimo bwamulukkuba.
Jakobe wakachijila kunyika ya Alamu; Izilayeli wakabeleka kuti ajane mwanakazi; akwembela butanga bwembelele kuti ajane mwanakazi.
Jehova wakagwisya Izilayeli mu Ijipita amusinsimi, alimwi kwindila mumusinsimi wakababamba.
Efulemu wakanyemya Jehova chabukkali. Nikuba boobo Mwami wakwe uyosiya bulowa bwakwe alinguwe akumubozezya insoni zyakwe.
''Muchindi Efulemu nakambula, kwakaba kukankama. Wakalisumpula lwakwe mu Izilayeli, pesi wakaba simulandu nkambo wakakomba Bbaalu, alimwi wakafwa.

Kwalino bachibisya alimwi akwi dlila. Balachita zikozyano zyakufula kuzwa kunsiliva, zikozyanisyo zibezwa chabunamanu mbuli mbubakonzya, yoonseyi kayili milimo yasikubeza. Bantu balamba atala ambabo, ''Aba balumi bapayila zipayizyo zyalumyonto lwabanamani.'
Mukuti bayoba mbuli mayoba achifumo, mbuli luume lufwambana kumwayika, mbulibuungu bupepuka kuchipolelo, ambuli busibuzwida achipulo.
Pele ndime Jehova Leza wako uzwa kuchisi cha Ijipita. Tamwelede kulumbayizya umbi Leza kunze kwangu; mulelede kuchilumbaizya echi kunze kwangu, takwepe umbi Muvuni.
Ndakali mwizi lwanu munkanda, munyika ilabuyumu bupati bwachimpayuma.
Muchindi nimwakajana zilyo, elyo mwakakkuta; alimwi elyo nimwakakkuta, myoyo yanu yakalimvwa kusumpulwa. Akambo kazeezi mwakandiluba.
Ndiyoba mbuli mulavu kuli mbabo; mbuli siluwe ndiyobalangilizya munzila.
Njabalwana mbuli chinyama chabbidwa bana becho. Njodeluula lulyang'anga lwakaango kabo, alimwi awo njobakwamuna mbuli mulavu, mbuli syuumbwa mbwanga ulabakwamuna muzimpanzi mpanzi.
Ndiyokunyonyoona webo, Izilayeli; ngwani uyokonzya kukugwasizya lwako?
Ulikuli kwalino mwami wako, kuti akuvune muzisi zyako zyoonse? Balikuli bazuluzi bako, abo mbmwakambide kli ndime, 'Kamunfipa mebo wami amwami wachanakazi'?
Ndakamupa mwamk mukunyema kwangu, alimwi ndakamutola kule abukali bwangu.
Milandu ya Efulemu ili bikilidwe; zibi zyakwe zililondwedwe.
Wakasikilwa kuchiswa kwakutumbuka, pele ngomwana mufubafuba, nkambo tayimikili muzyalilo kuchindi cheelede, tazwidi anze pe muzyalilo.
Sa nkabavune kujanza lyachuumbwe? Sa nkabanunune kujanza lyachuumbe? Sa nkabanunune kulufu? Ikuli, lufu, ngemapenzi anu? Ikuli, Shiyoli, ndolunyonyooko lwanu?  Luzyalo lulisisidwe kubusyu bwangu.''

Nikuba kuti Efulemu azwidilile akati kabakulana bakwe, iguuwo lyakujwe liyoza; iguwo lya Jehova liyowunga mukati kankanda. Kasensa ka Efulemu kayoyuminina, alimwi chikala chakwe chiyosyala kachitachikwe manzi. Alimwi sinkondonyina uyoyola zyonse zintu zyebesi mung'anda yakulondweda zyonse zintu zyibotu.
Samaliya uyopegwa mulandu, nkambo kakuti wakasampawula Leza wakwe. Bayojazigwa apanga; bana babo banini bayozapawulwa mutumpanzi mpanzi, alimwi banakazi babo baminsi bayoyanduulwa.
Izilayeli, koboola kuli Jehova Leza wako, nkambo wakawa nkambo kakubisya kwako.

Amubweze tufulo twanu alimwi muboole kuli Jehova. Mwamboobu kuli nguwe, ''Kobweza boonse bubi bwesu alimwi utambule bubotu, kuchitila kuti tukapede kuli nduwe michelo yamilomo yesu. (munchali wakuti elyo tukabike kuli nduwe michelo yamilomo uyiminina bupanduluzi bwaamwi malembe abupanduluzi bwensiku bwaminchali yachi Hebbelu. Bwindulule bwabensiku bwachi Hebbelu bulijisi kuchitila kuti tukapede basipule, bamilomo yesu. Bumwi bupanduluzi bwamazuba ano bupandulula obu, kuchitila kuti tukapede kuli nduwe basipule, abombitwakasyomezya kuchitoobo).
Asiliya taonzyi kuyotuvuna, tatukoyo gada amabbiza ankondo. Alimwi tatukoyowamba limbi kumilimu yamaanza esu, 'Nduwe leza wesu,' nkambo mulinduwe bamuchaala mubajana luzyalo.''
''Njoponia kuluba kwabo; Ndiyobayanda chakwangunuka, nkambo kunyema kwangu kunol kwazwa kulimbabo.
Ndiyoba mbuli luume kuli Izilayeli; alimwi uyopasula mbuli malubaluba alimwi uyobka miyanda mbuli zisamu zyamusiida mu Lebbanoni.
Mitabi yakwe iyoyendelela; bubotu bwakwe buyoba mbuli musamu wamu Olifa, alimwi abweema bwakwe buyoba mbuli masiida amu Lebbanoni.
Bantu bakkala mucheenzule chakwe bayojoka; bayobukulusigwa mbuli mayila asonsa alimwi akuyopasula mbuli masansa. Mabelekelo akwe ayoba mbuli wayini waku Lebbanoni.
Efulemu, ngandilaba azyakuchitanzi a zikozyanisyo? Ndiyo musandula akumubbasopa kabotu. Mebo ndimbuli mu Sayipule oyo ujisi matu akkala kalimatete; kuzwa kuli ndimwe momuzwa michelo yako.''

'Ngwani musongo zyakuti uyoswilila makani aya? Ngwani umvwisisisya ezi zintu kuchitila kuti akazizibe? Nkambo inzila zya Jehova zililuleme, alimwi abo baluleme baleenda mulinzizyo, pesi bapapila balalebwa muli nzizyo.
Chilengano cha Isaya mwana mulombe wa Amozi, makani ngaakabona a Juda a Jelusalemu, mumazuba a Uziya, Jotamu, Ahazi, a Hezekkiya, baami ba Juda.
Koswilila, majulu akupa kutwi, nyika; nkambo Jehova waamba: ''Ndakalela bana akubakuzya, pele bakandipapila akulwisya ndime.
Musune ulizi simalelo wakwe, ambongolo ilizi chilyido nchiipedwa kumwami wayo, pele ba Izilayeli tabeezi, Izilayeli takamvwisisisya pe.''
Maawe! Nyika, basizibi, bantu balemenedwe milandu, lunyungu lwabachita bubi, bana basikubisya! Baleka Jehova, basampawula Uusalala omwe wa Izilayeli, bakabola abalikke kuli nguwe.
Ino nkamboonzi numuchiyanda kuumwa? Ino nkamboonzi nochiyabupapila bwindilide? Mutwe woonse ulachiswa, moyo woonse ulalenguuka.
Kuzwa kumalyatilo azituta mane kusikila mumutwe takwe buponi mulimbabo; zilonda kupela, amibunda azilonda zipya ziyulikide; tabana kwaangwa, kusalazigwa, kusilikwa nikuba kubombekwa amafuta.
Chisi chenu nitongo; myuunzi yenu ilipyide amulilo; myumnda yenu--abuliwo bwanu, bazwakule biinyonyoona--yasyala lyaba tongo, kumwayigwa abeenzu.
Mwana musimbi wa Ziyoni wasyala mbubonya mbuli kaanda mumuunda, mbuli mwenzule muchilili chamakkowa, mbuli muunzi usinkilidwe basilumamba.
Jehova wamakamu wakatusiila bache loko basyede, nitwakakozyania a Sodomu akuba mbubonya mbuli Gomola.
Amuswilile majwi a Jehova, nobeendelezi ba Sodoma; amutelele mulawo wa Leza wesu, nobantu ba Gomola;
''Zipayizyo zyenu nzyingi zili amilimoonzi kuli ndime?'' mbwawamba Jehova. ''Ndazyiingi zituuzyo zyabagutu, amafuta abanyama baneneede; amubulowa bwabapule; bwatubelele na bwampongo tabunditondezyi.
Chiindi nimusika kukulibonia kuli ndime, ino ngwani wamulayilila, kuti mulyatuuke abo lubanza lwangu?
Mutayeeyi limbi kundetela zipayizyo zyabuyo; tununkilizyo tulandisesemya; mweezi mupya ambungano zya Sabata nzimubunganina -- Nsibotelwi ambungano zyabubi.
Ndisula myeezi yanu mipya amapobwe; nkaambo nchibi kulindime; ndakatala ndachimwa kulemenwa angawo.
Naa mwatandabika maanza enu mukukomba, njosisa menso angu kulindinywe; nekuba kuti mwakomba nkombyo nyiingi, nsikoyoswilila, maanza enu azwide bulowa.
Amusambe, mulisalazye amulikke; amugwisye bubi bwamilimo yenu kubusyu bwangu; amuleke kuchita bubi;
amwiiye kuchita kabotu; amulanguule mbeta ziluleme, muyanduule bululami, mululamike budyaamizi, bamuchaala, mukwabilile bamukabafu.''
''Amuboole lino, tubuzyanie makani aamwi,'' mbwaamba Jehova; ''nekuba zibi zyenu zyasalala pyu, ziyotuba buu mbuli nyengeenge, nekuba kuti zibi zili mbuli zisani zisalalisya, ziyoba mbuli buluba.
Naa mwazumina akuswilizya, muyoolya bubotu bwanyika,
pesi na mwakaka akupapila, muyoligwa panga, ipanga liyomulya chakumunyonyoona,'' nkambo mbuboobu mbwiwamba milomo ya Jehova.
Wabotesya byeni muunzi musyomesi niwasanduka kuba simamambe! Kuuzwide imbeta -- bululami bwakalikkede mulinguwo, pesi lino mwakazula bujayi.
Insiliva yako yasanduka yabija, wayini wako ulivwelene amaanzi.
Basilutwe bako mbapanduki alimwi mbeenzinyina aababbi; boonse bayanda masinkamulomo akuchijanina kuliyigwa. Tababeteki makani abamuchaala, naa makani aba mukabafu taamvwigwi kulimbabo.
Nkaambo kamakaniaya mbuboobu mbwaamba Mwami Jehova wamakamu, mupati wa Izilayeli: ''Maawe kuli mbabo! Nzolibwedezezya kuli abo bandikatazya, akuliya nkoto kulibasinkondoma;
Njobozya janza lyangu kuli nduwe, kuti nsalalzye mankwisilili aako akuwisya mundalila.
Elyo njobaamba babetesi bako bakabe mbuli batanzi, abalabo basinkuta bako mbubonya mbuli kumatalikilo; kusule lyayaaya uyowambwa munzi wabululami, chisi chisyomekede.''
Ziyoni uyonununwa abululami, abasanduki babo.
Basimilandu abasizibi bayonyonyoonwa antomwe, abaabo baleka Jehova bayomaninsigwa ambabo.
''Nkaambo bayoofwa nsoni kumabanga aminsamu njimwakayandisya, muyoowusa nsoni kumyunda njimwakasala.
Nkambo muyooba mbuli mubanga ufwida matu aawo, ambuli chilili chibula maanzi.
Mwalumi usimide uyooba mbuli butonge, amilimo yabo iyooba mbuli nsasi; boonse bayopya antomwe, takwepe naba umwi uyobazima.''
Zintu eezyo Isaya mwana wa Amozi nzyakabona muchilengano, aatala a Juda aa Jelusalemu.

Kuyoba kuti kumamanino aamazuba awo chilundu chang'anda ya Jehova chiyoyimikwa mbuli chilundu chilamfu chazilundu, alimwi chiyoyimikizigwa aatala lyatulundu, alimwi maasi woonse anoyobukkunka kulinjiyo.

Baantu banji bayosika aakwamba kuti, ''Amuze, tulayinka aatala lyachilundu cha Jehova, kung'anda ya Leza wa Jakobo, aboobo uyotwisya zimwi zyanzila zyakwe, alimwi tuyoyenda munzila zyakwe.'' nkambo mu Ziyoni muyozwa mulawu, aajwi lya Jehova kuzwa mu Jelusalemu.
Uyobeteka akati kamaasi alimwi akukosola makani kubantu banji; lino bayofula mapanga aabo aabe maamba akulimya; chisi tachikoyobweza panga lyakulwisya chiisinyina, nikuba kwiila nkondo limbi pe.'
O ng'anda ya Jakobo, amuboole, aatwende mumumuni wa Jehova.
Nkambo wabaleka bantu bako, ng'anda kakuti bazula ziyanza zyakujwe alimwi bachita busondi mbuli ba Filisitiya, aakujuzyania abana babazwakule.
Nyika yabo ilizwideansiliva angolide, alimwi buvubi bwabo tabubaliki; anyika yabo lubo ilizwide mabbiza, azilazyo nkalaki zyabo tazibaliki.
Nyika yabo ayilayo ilizwide zitombe; balakomba milimo yamaboko aabo beni, zintu eeyo minwe yabo nziyakapanga.
Bantu balavundama aansi, nkiinkaako mutababusyi.
Njila mukati mumasena aamabwe alimwi akuyuba mukati kasuko kuzwa kukuyoweegwa kwa Jehova aakuzwa kubulemu bwabapati bwakwe.
Kulilemeteka kwamuntu kuyowusigwa, alimwi kulisumpula kwabantu kuyoselusigwa aansi, alimwi Jehova alike nguyosumpulwa muzuba eelyo.
Nkambo kuyooba izuba lya Jehova wamakamu kuli woonse oyo ulikankayisya aakulisumpula akuli woonse oyo sichisapi --
alimwi uyoselusigwa aansi -- alimwi akuliyoonse minsamu yamukkedali yamu Lebbanoni milamfu iisumpulwa, amibanga yaku - Bbasani.
Eelyo zuba lya Jehova wamakamu liyooba kuzilundu zyoonse zilamfu, aatulundu toonse tusumpulwa,
aamaanda malamfu woonse, amalambo woonse aabikkilwa zilwisyo,
amaato woonse aku Tasyisyi, akuli yoonse mitiba yakuzubusya myeebesi.
Mwalumi woonse ulisumpula uyoselusigwa alimwi kulilemeka lwabantu balya mayila kuyolwisigwa aansi, Jehova alikke nguyosumpulwa muzuba eelyo.
Zikozyanio zyamituni ziyomaninina.
Bantu bayonjila mumampangala kukuyoowa nulemu bwa Jehova, alimwi kuzwa kubulemu bwabupati bwakwe, eelyo buzobuka kuzoyoosya nyika.
Mubuzuba oobo bantu bayosowa zikozyanio zyabo zyansiliva azya ngolida ezyo nzibakalilundila beeni kukuzikomba - bayozisowa basimalukwe abasimudima.
Bantu bayonjila mumalindi amumabwe, kukuzwa kukuyoosya kwa Jehova abulemu bwabupati, bwakwe nazobuka kukuyoosya nyika.
Amuleke kusyoma muntu, uulabuumi buli mumansyono aakwe, ulagwasyaanzi?
Amubone, Mwami Jehova wamakamu waamba kugwisya kuzwa ku Jelusalemu akuzwa ku Juda lugwasyo abulelo: koonse kupa chibunge akoonse kupa manzi,
muntu singuzu asikalumamba,mubetesi amusinsimi, ayooyo ulichita anga ngu Leza amupati,
silutwe wabali makumi musanu amuntu ulemekeeka ukkala muchisi, amwendelezi, ayooyo uchenjede mulizyakufula ayooyo ulaluzibo azyakulowa.
''Ndabikka bachikula banini mbuli beendelezi babaabo, aboobo banini bayobendelezya.
Bantu bayopenzegwa, boonse kuli umwi akuli umwi, aboonse umwi kuli simayakilane wakwe; mwana uyofutukila mupati, alimwi balibombya bayozunda ulemekeka.
Mwaalumi uyojata mukulana wakwe mung'anda yawisi akwaamba kuti, 'Ulachikobela; katubeda mwendelezi, abaaba bacheede ubeleke babe mumaanza ako.'
Mulilelyo zuba uyowoompolola akuti, nsikoyooba musilisi pe; nsikwe zibunge pe nichiba chisamo. Tamukoyondichita muzuluzi wabantu pe.'''
Nkambo Jelusalemu wazingana, a Juda waawa, nkambo kwaambula kwabo anchito zyabo zilwisya Jehova, balakaka antangaanana kumenso akwe akubulemu bwakwe.
Kubalangala kumenso abo ngukamboni atala ambaabo; alimwi balaamba zibi zyabo mbuli Sodomu; tabachisisipe. Maawe kulimbabo! Nkambo balimaninsizya mulunyonyooko lupati lwabobeni.
Ngamwambile muntu ululeme kuti kuyobota, nkambo bayoolya michelo yanchito zyabo.
Maawe kuli basizibi! Nkambo kuyomubijila, nkambo mpindu yamaanza akwe iyochitwa kuli nguwe.
Bantu bangu - bapenzegwa abana, alimwi bendelezegwa abanakazi. Bantu bangu, aabo bamutondezya nzila balamweenzya chakumusweesya akumusweesya nzila yanu.
Jehova wanyampuka nkambo kakukazyania; ulinyampukide kuti ape bantu mulandu.
Jehova ulaza alubeta akulwanisya bapati babantu bakwe abeendelezi babo: ''mwakabisya muunda wamasansa; nzimwakanyanzya achanguzu bachete zili mumaanda aanu.
Nkaambonzi nimupwaya bantu bangu akuziya masyu abachete?'''  Mbuboobu mbwawamba Jehova wamakamu.

Jehova waamba obu nkambo bana basimbi ba Ziyoni balisumpula, baleenda nsingo zyabo kazyiimvwi, amenso azwide luyando, baleenda antaamo niini nibaya bwinka, kabaya buchita tuzumo twanchooko mungo zyabo.
Aboobo Mwami uyobawumya zilonda mumitwe yabana basimbi ba Ziyoni, alimwi Jehova uyobavumvula meya zyabo.
Kuli elyo zuba Mwami uyogwisya bubotu bwanchoko zyakungo zyabo, atuntambo ntubalyaanga kumitwe, tukozyanio twamweezi twakulibotya munsingo,
malangulangu amumatwi, nchoko, akaputi;
misini, amacheni anchoko, amafuta akulyetela zyoolwe.
Uyogwisya nweenwe achisita chamumpemo;
zikobela zibotezya, chisamo, kaputi, atukwama twamujanza;
ziboniboni zyamujanza, malembo mabotu, zipandeeka, azyakulivumbya.

Eelyo muchibaka chamyunde inunka kabotu kuyoba bubozi; amuchibaka chalukumba, kuyooba ntambo, muchibaka chamasusu abambidwe kabotu muyoba kankulu, achinowe; alimwi muchibaka chazisamo, bayolivumba masaka; muchibaka chabubotu bayoopya mbuli chisisi chamulilo.
Baalumi bako bayowisigwa apanga, abaalumi balanguzu balowa munkondo.
Milyango ya Jelusalemu iyolila akoomoka; alimwi uyoba alikke akukkala atala lyanyika.
