Mubuzuba oobo banakazi bali musanu ababili bayojata mwalumi omwe akwamba kuti, ''Tuyoolya kulya kwesu, tuyozwata zizwaato zyesu. Pesi tuyoyitwa muzina lyako kuti tutasampawuki.''
Mubuzuba oobo mutabi wa Jehova uyoyebeka abulemu, amichelo yaanyika iyolyikka akwebeka kuli aabo balobokede ku Izilayeli.
Kuyooba kuti ooyo usyeede mu Ziyoni ayooyo uchikkede mu Jelusalemu bayotegwa usalala, boonse  alembedwe aansi mbuli bakkala mu Jelusalemu.
Eezi ziyochitika kuchindi Mwami nayosanzya tombe lyabana basimbi bamu Ziyoni, alimwi uyosalazya madosi abulowa kuzwa akkati ka Jelusalemu, akwinda mumuuya wakubeteka amumuya wamabangabanga amulilo.

Eelyo aatala lyazikkalilo zyoonse zyaaChilundu cha-Ziyoni aatala lyabusena bwakubunganina, Jehova uyolongezya mayoba abusi sikati akubekabeka kwamabangabanga amulilo mansiku; kuyooba tente lyakuvumbya aatala abulemu boonse.
Kuyoba cheenzule chachiyusilo chiindi chasikati kuzwa kunkasaalo, alimwi achiyubilo achivumbyo kuzwa kuguwo akumvula.
Akube kuti njimbile muyandwi wangu uuyandika loko, lwiimbo lwamuyandwi wangu aatala achilili chakwe. Muyandwi wangu uuyandika loko wakali aachilili aatala lyakalundu kali aanyika iivundide.

Wakaliminina liminina, wagwisya mabwe, alimwi wakagaka amusyobo wamuchelo mubotu loko. Wakayaka ingaze akati kachilili, alimwi wakayaka chisiminini chawayini. Wakalindila kuti uzyale muchelo, pesi wakazyala muchelo wamusokwe.
Aboobo lino, bantu bamuJelusalema abantu boonse baJuda, mubeteke aakati kangu achilili changu.
Niinzi chiindilide chakelede kuchitilwa chilili changu, eecho ncendakatachita? Eelyo ndakalandilila kuti chizyale michelo, nkamboonzi niyakazyala michelo yamusokwe?
Lino ndakubuzya eechi ncindoochitila chilili changu: ndoogwisya lubeya lwacho, njoowusandula ukabe muchelo, njomwaya bulambo bwacho, alimwi chiyolwatwiidwa aansi.
Njochilazika kachisowedwe, alimwi tachikoyookookwedwa pe. Muchibaka chamasaansa kuyomena maamvwa. Njolayilila mayoba kuti atawisyi mvula.

Nkambo mumunda waJehova wamakamu ninganda yaIsilayeli, akubantu baJuda mbubotu bwamisamu yakwe: wakalindila bululami, pesi, muchibaka eecho kwakaba kujeya; nkambo bululami, pesi, anikuti, kwakaba moongololowalugwasyo.
Mawe kuli baabo basyanizya kungánda akungánda , aabo baswanizya muundsa kusikila kakutachikwe busena buchaala akuti iwe awulike uchaale munyika!
Jehova wamakamu wakandibuzya Maandaangu miingi ayochaala katakwe chintu, nikuba mpati alimwi azikondezya kaatachikwe naba omwe.
Nkambo mumunda uulimwa abasune bali kkumi uyotyolwa chisuwo chimwi kupela, alimwi mweelwe wambuto yamuunzi uyoozyala cheelesyo chomwe luzutu.
Mawe kulibaabo bafuma kuseni kuti bajane bukande bululisya, aabo bakkala chakusyaalila mansiku kusikila mane wayini wabakkola.
Balaakagoma anyeele, anamaala, kantimbwa awayini kumapobwe aabo, pesi tabalemeki pe eezyo jehova nzyaachita naakalemeka mulimu wamaanza aakwe.
Nkinkaako bantu bangu bayinka mubuzike akaambo kakutaswilizya; bazuluzi baabo balemekezya beenda aanzala, alimwi bantu baabo bazibinkene tabakwe chakunywa pe.
Nkinkaako chikkalilo chabafu chalichita kuti chikomezye kapati akwasamusya lokomulomo wacho; buvubi, abaabo basekelelaaabo babotedwe akati kabo, baselukila mulinchicho chikkalilochabafu.
Bantu bayowangilwa kukotama aansi, alimwi bantu boonse bayoofwiinsigwa; meso abasikulisumpula ayosowelwa aansi.
Jehova wamakamu uyoosumpulwa mubululami bwakwe, alimwi Leaza uusalala uyoliboniya kusalala kwakwe kwiindila mubululami bwakwe.
Mpawo mbelele ziyochela mbuli mumachezezyo aazyo, alimwi mumatongo aamwayikide, twana twambelele tuyoochela mbuli bazwakule.
Mawe kuli baabo bakwelana azibi antombo zyabuyo alimwi aababo bakkwela alubo mbuuli kuti zyakali antombo yangolo.

Mawe kuli baabo baamba kuti, ''Anoli Leza wafwambaana , anooli wachita kufwambaana, kuchitila kuti tubone kakulokuchitika; alimwi akubekuti mabambe awusalala waIzilayeli asike, kuchitila kuti tukonzye kwaaziba.''
Mawe kulibaabo bayita chibi kuti nchibotu, alimwi bubotu kububi; bayiminina mumudima mbuli mumuni, amumuni mbuli mudima; aabo bayiminina chilula mbul chinono, achinono mbuli chilula!
Mawe kulibaabo basongo mumeso aabo beni! abachenjede mukumvwisisisya kwabo beni.
Maawe kulibaabo balaanguzu kwiindilila kukunywa wayini, alimwi bachenjede kukuvweelaniya zinywigwa zikkola;
abaabo balulamika basizibi kuti babbadale akukasya batakwe milandu zyeelelo zyabo!

Nkinkaako mbuli mabangabanga aamulilo mbuumwaya zisiko, alimwi mbuli sokwe lyakayuma niliwida aansi mumabangabanga, aboobo muyanda wawo uyoobola, amalubaluba aawo ayoomwayuka mbuli lusuko. Eechi chiyochitika nkaambo bakakaka mulawo waJehova  wamakamu, alimwi nkaambo bakanyansya ijwi lya Uusalala waIzilayeli.

Nkinkaako, bukali bwaJehova bwabuka aakati kabantu bakwe. Wasisya jaanza lyakwe aalimbabo akubasubula. Zilundu zyakankama, alimwi amitunta yabo yaba mbuli zintu zyabiyo zisowedwe mumigwagwa. Muzintu zyoonse eezi, lunyemo lwakwe talumani pe; muchindeecho, ijaanza lyakwe lichitandabikidwe.
Uyoosumpula chitondeezyo chandembela kumanyika alikule akusibila aabo balikumamanino aanyika. Langa, bayooza achakundijana akufwambaana.
Takwe uukatala nikuba uubaleba akati kabo; takwe pe uuguna naa koona. Nikuba nkumba zyabo kuti zitendele naakuti intambo zyansangu zyabo kudunsuka.
Mivwi yabo ilabosya amata aabo woonse alipetedwe; insumba zyamabbiza aabo zilimbuli bbwe, amavili aankalaki yabo mbuli kambizi.
Kuvuluma kwabo kunooli mbuli kamulavu; bayoovuluma mbuli twana twamulavu. Bayoolila akujaya banyamaakubatola kule, kaatakwe sikubavuna.
Mubuzuba oobo bayoovuluma aatala aabanyama mbuli lwizi lwizi mbuluvuluma. Naa umwi walanga aajulu lyanyika, uyoobona mudima akufwaba, nikuba mumuni uyochitwa kuba mudima amayoba.
Mumunyaka ulya mwami Uziya nakafwa, Ndakabona Mwami ulikkede achuuno chabwami; wakali sumpukide loko, alimwi malogwe akwe akazuzya ng'anda yakukombela.
Ajulu lyakwe kwakali baselafimu; umwi kali amababa alimusanu alimwi; abili kali akulivumba kumenso, alimwi abili kali akulivumba kumawulu akwe, alimwi abili wakawulusya.
Awumwi wakiita mwenzinyina akuti, ''Uusalala, usalala, usalala, ngu Jehova wamakamu! Inyika yoonse yazula bulemu bwakwe.''
Intalisyo yazikunguzyo yazungana amajwi abaabo bakali kukkwila, alimwi ing'anda yakazula aabusi.
Elyo ndakati, ''Maawe kulindime!  Ndanyonyooka nkambo ndimwalumi usofweede kumilomo, alimwi ndikkala akkati kabantu basofwede kumilomo, nkambo menso angu abona Mwami, Jehova, Jehova wamakamu!''
Elyo umwi wabasalafimu wakandulukila; wakajisi ikkala lyamulilo mujanza lyakwe, elyo ndyakabwezede alumano kuzwa kuchipayililo.
Wakaligumya amulomo wangu akundambola kuti, ''Bona, echichaguma milomo yako; milandu yako yagwisigwa azibi zyalekelelwa.''
Ndakamvwa ijwi lya Mwami kaliti, ''Ngwani ngwensatumde; ngwani utatwinkile?'' Elyo ndakati, ''Mpendi mebo, ndituma.''
Wakati, ''Yinka ukambila bantu aba, 'Muswilile, pele tamuswililisyi; mubona, pesi tamubonenesyi.'

Chita myoyo yabantu aba itamvwisisiki, amatwi abo aleme, akofwazigwa kwamenso abo. Ambweni balikunobona amenso abo, kumvwa amatwi aabo, akumvwisisisya amyoyo yabo, akusanduka, akupona.'' Elyo ndakati, ''Mwami, kukabe lili?'' Wakasandula,
alimwi kusikila Jehova akatume bantu kuule, anyika yoonse inoli yazulila kusiyigwa.
Nikuba kulichimpanzi vhakkumi chabantu chasyala mulinjiyo, chiyomwayisigwa lubo; mbuli mubanga nanka muzwamalowa niwatemwa achisiko chawo mbuchisyala, ambuto isalala ilimuchisiko.

Mumazuba aa Ahazi mwana mulombe wa Jonatamu mwana mulombe wa Uziya, mwami wamu Juda, Lezini mwami waba Alamu, a Pekka mwana mulombe wa Lemaliya, mwami wa Izilayeli, wakaya ku Jelusalemu kunkondo kukulwana anjiyo, pesi bakakachilwa kwizunda lwayo.
Kwakaambwa kung'anda ya Davida kuti Alamu ulitangeene a Efulemu. Myooyo yabo yakakankama, amyoyo yabantu bakwe, mbuli minsamu yamu lusaka mbwiteketa aluuwo.
Eelyo Jehova wakati kuli Isaya, ''Yinka aanze amwana wako mulombe Siyeya-Jasyubbu mukaswanane a Ata a Aahazi kumamanino amufolo wa Dambwa, mumugwagwa wamuunda waba Sikusanzya.

Umubuzye kuti, ''Uchenjele loko, kokkede kowumwide, utayoowi naakuti utayoosegwi nkambo kazeezi zifumpu zyobile zyazisisi zisunta. Ikunyema kwabukali bwa Lezini aa Alamu, abwa Pekka mwana mulombe wa Lemaliya.
Alamu, Ifulemu, amwana mulombe wa Lemaliya balakubambila buubi aatala anduwe; mbubaamba.
''Atulwisye Juda akumuyoosya, akwipwayula mukati kayo akubikka mwami wesu muumo, imwana mulombe wa Tabbelu.''
Mwami Jehova ulokuti, ''Takukoyochitika mubusena pe; tazikozochitika pe,
nkambo mupati wa Alamu ni Damasikkasi, alimwi muzululi wa Damasikkasi ni Lezini. Muminyaka ilimakkumi musanu awumwi, Ifulemu inoli yamwayisigwa takunochili muntu pe.
Imuzululi wa Ifulemu ni Samaliya, amuzululi wa Samaliya mulombe wa Lemaliya. Kuti kotimvwi chakasimpe mulusyomo, nkasimpe tamukoyoyimisigwa pe.''''''
Eelyo Jehova wakambula lubo kuli Ahazi,
''Kumbila chitondezyo cha Jehova Leza wako; kumbila nzizyo mubunike naakuti mukulwiluka kwayo.''
Pesi Ahazi wakati, ''Nsikokumbila pe. naakuti kunka Jehova.''
Elyo Isaya wakasandula, ''Koswilila, ng'anda ya Davida. Tekwazulila na kuli ndinywe lubo na kukusunka kumuuna kwabantu? Tamwelede lubo na kusunka kuumuna kwa Leza wangu?
Aboobo mwami lwakwe uyomupa bantu chitondezyo: Amubone, Imwanakazi muniini uyominta, akuzyala mwana mulombe, alimwi uyoyitwa zina lyakuti Imanuwele.
Uyolya zyakuselulwa abuchi alimwi uyoziba kukaka chibi akusala chibotu.
Eelyo mwana katanaziba kukaka chibi akusala bubotu, inyika yabaami bobilwe iyosalwa.
Jehova uyoyeta nduwe, kubantu, bako, amung'anda yawuso kumazuba kutali mbuli nikwakatanguna Ifulemu wakandanisigwa a Juda -- uyomweetela mwami wa Asiliya.''
Kuchiindi echo Jehova uyosiba kukuusya kuzwa kumagolelo atulonga twa Ijiputi, alimwi anzuki kuzwa kunyika ya Asiliya.
Bayosika boonse akukkala ansi muliwoonse majenga, angazi zyamabwe, aatala mulusaka lwamamvwa, alimwi amumachezezyo woonse.
Kuchiindi echo mwami uyopala ambeli eeyo yakakumbidwe kunembo amulonga wa Yupilati -- imwami wa Asiliya --mutwe aboya bwamumawulu; achalo chilezu iyochimana.
Kubuzuba oobo, Muntu uyovuba ng'ombe mpwizi ambelele zibili,
alimwi nkaambo kakuvuula kwamalili ngibapa, uyolya zyakuselula kukli eezyo boonse nzibasiya munyika uyolya zyakuselula abuchi.
Kuchiindi echo, ooko kwakali masansa alichuulu awulwa nsiliva nchuulu chamasyekeli, chiyooba chintu biyo pesi mitubetube amamvwa.
Baalumi bayoyinka ooko kukuvwima atunta, nkambo yoonse nyika yazula mitubetube amamvwa.
Bayokkala kule kuzwa kuzilundu zyoonse eezyo zyakasakwidwa ajamba, nkambo bunoli busena ng'ombe ambelele nkozichelela.
Jehova wakati kuli ndime, ''Bweza bbwe pati alimwi ulembee aalindilyo, 'Mahe-Syalalu-Hasyi-Bbazi.'
Ndiyoyita bakamboni basyomekede kuti bakandeezezye, Uliya mupayizi, aZekkaliya mwana mulombe waJebbelekkiya.''
Ndakaya kumusinsimi mwanakazi, alimwi wakaba atumbu alimwi wakatumbuka mwana mulombe. Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli ndime, ''Mupe zina lyakwe kuti Maha-Syali-Hasyi-Bbazi.
Nkambo mwana katanaziba kulila, ''Ndeendangu.'antomwe, Ábaama bangu,'buvubi bwa Damasikkasi antomwe azyakabwezegwa mu Samaliya ziyotolwa amwami wa Asiliya.''
Jehova wakambula kuli ndime alimwi,
''Nkambo bantu bakkaka manzi mabotu a Syilowa, alimwi baliboteledwe aatala abana balombe ba Levi a Lemaliya,
nkinkaako mwami waamba kweeta alimbabo manzi aMulonga, miingi kalanguzu, Mwami wa Asiliya abulemu bwakwe boonse. Uyoza kuzwide inzila zyawo zyoonse akufwasuka kunkomwe zyawo.
Mulonga uyokukula kuya kunembo kuunjila mu Juda, kufwasuuka akwinda, mane akasike munsingo yako. Kutandabala kwamababa aawo ayozuzya nyika yako, Imanuwele.''
Nywebo nobantu muyotyololwa kuba tumpanzi. Muswilizye, monse nozisi zyakule; mubweze zilwanisyo mubambilile nkondo alimwi mutyololwe kuba tumpanzi; mubweze zilwanisyo alimwi mutyolwe mutumpanzi.
Muchite mabambe, pesi takoyochitwa pe, nkambo Lezauli aswebo.
Jehova wakaambula kulindime, akuboko kwakwe kulanguzu alindime, alimwi wakandichenjezya kuti nkintakwendi munzila yabantu aaba.
Uutaambi kuti twaabwa kufumbwa eecho bantu aba nchibati nkwaabwa, tokoloyoowa nzibayoowa, alimwi utakazwi moyo pe.
Ngu Jehova wamakamu oyo nguyolemeka mbuli musalali; nguwe nguyelede kuyoma, alimwi nguwe nguyelede kukankaama.
Uyooba chiyubilo; pesi uyobabbwe lyakutuluzya, amwaala wachilebyo kuli zyoonse ng'anda zya Izilayeli, alimwi uyoba kakole a diba kubanttu baku Jelusalemu.
Biingi bayolebwa andilyo bakawe alimwi bakatyoke, bayoteyegwa akuchegwa.
Waanga bukamboni bwangu, namatizya makani azumizigilwe upe basikwiiya bangu.
Ndiyoyimina Jehova, usisa busyu bwakwe kung'anda ya Jakkobbu; Ndiyosyoma kulinguwe.
Langa, Imebo abana balombe aabo Jehova mbakaandipa mbazitondezyo azigambyo mu Izilayeli kuzwa kuli Jehova wamakamu, ukkala ku Chilundu cha Ziyoni.
Bayowamba kuti kuli ndime, ''Buzya kuli baabo baambuula abafwide amyuuya,'' aba bawala nkakata mukusonda. Pesi bantu tabayelede kubuzya Leza wabo na? Bayelede kubuzya bafwide na kukugwasya bawumi?
Kumulawo akubukamboni! Kuti kabataambi zintu ziliboobo, nkambo kakuti tabakwe mumuuni wakubuchedo.
Bayoyinda munyika kabakatede loko kabalanzala. Elyo nibayofwa anzala, bayonyema alimwi batukile Mwami wabo a Leza wabo, kabalanga kujulu.
Bayolanga kunyika alimwi bayobona kukatala, mudima, abudyamizi. Bayotolwa munyika yamudima.

Mudima uyoogwisigwa kuzwa kuli ooyo mwanakazi wakali kupengaana kapati. Muchiindi chakumatalikilo wakasampawula inyika yaZebbuloni anyika yaNafutali, pesi muchiindi chakumamanino uyoyichita kuti ikabe aabulemu, inzila iya kulwizi, mutala aJodani Galili wazisi.
Ibantu aabo bakeenda mumudima bakabona mumuni mupati; aabo bakapona munyika yacheenzule chalufu, mumuni wabamunikila.
Wakavuzya nyika; wakavuzya lukondo lwabo. Balakondwa kunembo lyako mbuli lukondo kuchiindi chakutyola, mbuli baalumi mbubakondwa nibaabana zyakusaala.
Akabmbo kejokwe lyamukuli wakwe, mungwamba aakati kamakuko aakwe, inkoli yasikumudyaamizya wayipwaya mbuli kubuzuba bwaMidiyeni.
Nkaambo zyoonse insangu zyiinda kaziyobuvuuma azikobela zivungidwe mubulowa ziyowumpwa zikabe inkuni zyamulilo.
Nkaambo kulindiswe mwana unoli wazyalwa, kulindiswe mwana mulombe wapegwa; alimwi bweendelezi bunoli kumwana wamwami waluumuno.

Kuvuzigwa kwabweendelezi bwakwe akwaluumuno taakuyoomana pe, mbuli mbwanoyendelezya achuuno chabwami bwaDeviti aajulu abwami bwakwe, kukukkazika akukwiimika chaluumuno alimwi abusalali kuzwa kuchiindi chakwe kuya kunembo alyoonse. Inguzu mpati zyaJehova wamakamu ziyoochita eezi.
Mwami wakatumizya ijwi aatalaaaJakkobbu, alimwi lyakawida aali Izilayeli.
Bantu boonse bayooziba, nikuba Ifulemu abaabo bakkede muSamaliya, aabo baamba mukulisumpula alimwi kabali aamoyo wankondo,
''Zitina zyawa, pesi tuloyakulila amabwe aabezedwe; mikuyu yagonkelwaansi, pesi tuyobika misamu yasidali aabusena bwayo.''
Nkikaako Jehova uyobukilana aatala anguwe Lezini, Sinkondonyina, akutyoloola basinkondonyina,
baAlamu kubuzwezuba abaFilisitiya kububbila. Bayoojaya Izilayeli amulomo uuwasamukide. Muzintu zyoonse eezi, bukkali bwakwe tabukoyomana pe; aboobo ijanza lyakwe zichinootandabikidwe.
Nikuba oobo tabakoyoosandukila kuli ooyo sikubawuma pe, na kuyanduula Jehova wamakamu.
Nkinkaako Jehova uyogonkela Izilayeli mutwe amuchila, ntabi zyatukunka amatete, muzuba lyoomwe.
Muzululi amwaalumi mupati mbaasilutwe; alimwi musinsimi ooyo uyisya mabejo  muchila.
Aabo bazulwida bantu aaba babazulwida chakubasowa, aabo bazulwidwa abalabo bayoomenwa.

Nkinkaako mwami takoyookondelelwa aatala abakubusi baalumi na kuyofwida luzyalo bamuchaala abamukabafu, mbuli kuti woonse takwe uli aaleza pe akuba basizibi, alimwi woonse mulomo wambuula zintu zyabufubafuba. Muzintu zyoonse eezi, kunyema kwakwe takukoyomana pe; aboobo janza lyakwe lichinotandabikidwe.
Bubi bulayaka mbuli mulilo uutenta myuunga amaamvwa; ulawumpa nikuba saka pati eelyo libuka musumpuuluu mupati wabusi.
Kwindila mubukali bwaJehova wamakamu inyika ilasizigwa alimwi bantu baba mbuli nkuni zyamulilo. Takwe pe naba uumwi uugwasya mweenzinyina.
Bayojata kulya akuboko kwakuchilisyo pesi bachinooli anzala; bayoolya chilyo akulya kwakuchimweensi pesi tabakoyookkuta pe. Umwi awumwi uyoolya nyama yakuboko kwakwe mwini.
Manase uyoopenzegwa aIfulemu, alimwi Ifulemu, Manase; alimwi aantomwe bayolwisya Juda. Mulizyoonse zintu eezi bukali bwakwe tabukoyoleka pe; nikuba oobo ijanza lyakwe lichinootandabikidwe.
Maawe kulibaabo babikka twambo tutali mumulawu akulemba zitaluleme zyakupenzya.
Balanyanzya bubotu bwabatengwaana, akubbida bachete bantu bangu zyelelo zyabo, akunyanzya bamukabafu, akuchita bamuchaala banyangwe imbono zyabo!
Muyochita biyeni buzuba bwalubeta bwakupyopyongania kwakusika kuzwa kule? Nkulini nkumuyojana lugwasyo, alimwi nkukuli nkumuyosiya buvubi bwanu?
Takwepe chiyosyaala, alimwi muyokotama munsi lyabajatwa na kuwa munsi lyabajayigwa. Muli zyoonse zintu eezi, Bukali bwakwe tabuna kumana pe: aboobo, ijanza lyakwe lichitandabete.
Maawe Asuliya, inkoli yabukali bwangu, musako oyo ngobwezede ndolunyemo lwangu!
Ndamutuma kukulwisya chisi chitalemeki akukulwisya bantu aabo bachitakuti njindilile kukunyema. Ndabalayilila kuti basale lusalo, akubanyanzya mbono, akuzilyatawuka mbuli matope amumigwagwa.
Pesi eezi tensinzyayeeya, natayeyi muli yeeyinzila. Zilimumoyo wakwe nkunyonyoona akugwisya zisi zyiingi loko.
Nkambo ulamba kuti, ''Tabeensi baami basilutwe bangu boonse na?
Tensi kwalinoli mbuli Kkasyemisyi? Takwensi Hamati ulimbuli Apadi? Tensikuti Samaliya ulimbuli Damasiko?
Mbuli jaanza lyangu lyazunda kubwami bwamituni, bwakajisi zikozyanio zyiinda Jelusalemu a Samaliya,
mbuli mbwindakachita ku Samaliya azikozyanio zyayo, sa nsikoyochita mbubo aku Jelusalemu akuzikozyanio zyawo?
Elyo mwami nakamaninsya mulimo wakwe muchilundu cha Ziyoni amu Jelusalemu, Njosubula twambo twamyoyo italemeki twabaami ba Asyiliyaakulisumpula kwabo.

Nkambo wamba kuti, ''Kwinda kunguzu zyangu akwinda kubusongo bwangu ndakachichita. Ndakamvwisisisya alimwi ndakagwisya migaano kubantu. Ndabatolela mbono zyabo, alimwi mbuli singuzu ndafwinsya basibwaami ansi.

Ijanza lyangu lilabuvubi, mbuli buzwa kuchitendele, buvubi bwazisi, alimwi mbuli umwi mbwabungania mayi asiidwe, Ndabungania nyika yoonse. Kaatakwe bakaputusya maboko aabo naa bakasamuna milomo yabo nanka kulila.''

Ikaleba kalalikankayizya na ilwako kuliyooyo ukabelesya? Neliba isaha lilalisumpula lwalyo kwiinda yoyo uligonsya? Zilimbuli kuti inkoli ilanyampula abo bayinyampwide, nanka mbuli musako ulanyampula muntu.
Nkambo kako Mwami Jehova wamakamu ulatuma bulwazi akkati kababo baneneede basinkondo bakwe; alimwi kunsi abulemu bwakwe kuyooba kuyaka mbuli kwamulilo.
Imumuni wa Izilayeli uyooba mulilo, alimwi Bakwe ba Salali muyoba mabangabanga; ziyoyaka akutenta mamvwa aakwe akuzimana mubuzuba boomwe.
Jehova uyosyukuta bulemu bwalusuko lwakwe amichelo yanyika yakwe, zyoonse muuya amubili; ziyooba mbuli buumi bwamuntu uchiswa wasowelwa kule.
Busena busyeede minsamu yamulusaka lwakwe isyede iyoba michelo, aboobo mwana muniini ukonzya kwibala.
Mubuzuba oobo, basyeede ba Izilayeli, luzubo lwa Jakkobo abo balobokede, tabakoyosyoma limbi kuliyooyo wakabazunda, pesi kwalyoonse bayojatilila kuli Jehova, Uusalala wa Izilayeli.
Basyede ba Jakobo balapiluka kulisinguzu Leza..
Nkambo abo bantu bakwa Izilayeli, bali mbuli musele wakunkomwe yalwizi, abo luzutu basyede mbibayobweda. Lunyonyooko lwalayililwa, mbuli mbukwazulila kuyanduula bululami.
Nkambo Mwami Jehova wamakamu, uyanda kubweza lunyonyooko ndwakabikila nyika yoonse.
Akambo kaako Mwami Jehova wamakamu wati, ''Bnatu bangu bakkala mu Ziyoni, mutayoowi mu Asiliya. Uyokuuma musako akunyampwida musako, kukulwana anduwe, mbuli mbubakachita ba Ijiputi.
Mutamuyoowi, nkambo muchiindi chifwifwi bukkali bwangu buyobamana, alunyemo lwangu luyonditola kukunyonyoona.''
Elyo Jehova wamakamu uyobusya mitatuuka, akati kabo, mbuli mbaakazunda ma Midiyani kumbo lya Olebbu. Uyonyampula musako wakwe atala lyalwizi akwiyimika mbuli mbwakachita mu Ijiputi.
Mubuzuba oobo, mukuli wakwe wagwisigwa kuzwa kumakuko eenu ajokwe lyakwe kuzwa kunsingo zyanu, alimwi ijokwe liyonyonyooka nkaambo kakuneneeya.
Sinkondoma wasika ku Ayiti akwiinda mu Migiloni; ku Mikkimasi walondola bulilu bwakwe.
Bazubuka achito akoona ku Geebba. Lama ulakankama a Gibbiya wa Sawulo wachija.
Wongolola, mwana musimbi wa Galimu! Swilizya, Layisya! WWebo nomu Anatoti ufwaba!
Madimena waloboka, abantu bakkede mu Gebbimu bachija akulibamba.
Elizuba ndilyonya ulayimikila ku Nabbi akuzunganyia janza lyachilundu musimbi wa Ziyoni, chilundu cha Jelusalemu.
Amubone, Mwami Jehova wamakamu uyogonka mitabi chakuyoosya; minsamu milamfu iyogonkwa alimwi milamfu iyofwinsigwa.
Uyogonka zisaka zyamulusaka akaleba, alimwi Lebbano ulawa mbulimbwawa singuzu.
Mulasyuuka chibbuukwa kuzwa kuchisiko cha Jese, alimwi mutabi uzwa anze kuzwa kumiyanda uyozyala muchelo.
Muuya wa Jehova uyolyokezya aalinguwe, lulayo anguzu, a Muuya wakuziba awakuyoowa Jehova.
Kubotelwa kwakwe kuyooba kuyoowa Mwami; takoyobeteka amenso akwe nzyabona pe, nikuba kukosola makani akwe nzyamvwa pe.
Nikuba kuti, bafwaba chakululama akuyeeya kuuluzi kulibaabo balibombya banyika. Uyowuma nyika amfunko wamulomo wakwe., akuyoya kwamulomo uyojazya basizibi.
Bululami luyoba lukumba lwamuchibuno chakwe, akusyomeka lukumba luzyunguluka chikungu chakwe.
Wumpe uyokkala antomwe amwana wambelele, alimwi siluwe uyolala ansi antomwe akana kampongo; akana kang'ombe, amwana wamulavu,  alimwi mwana wang'ombe uneneede  awamulavu bayolala antomwe.
Ng'ombe abbule ziyochela amwi, alimwi bana bazyo bayolala antomwe aansi. Awalo mulavu uyochela mbuli moongo wang'ombe.
Awalo mwana uyolisenia atala lyamulyungu wanzoka, amwana uchinyonka uyobikka kuboko kwakwe atala lyamulyungu wabachipile.
Tazikoyobachisa pe nikuba kunyonyoona atala lyachilundu changu chisalala choonse; nkambo nyika iyozula kuziba Jehova, mbuli maanzi mbwavumba lwizi.
Kuli eelyozuba, muyanda wa Jese uyoyimikila mbuli chikwankwani kubantu. Zisi ziyomulanguula, alimwi busena bwakwe bwakulyokezezya buyolemekwa.
Kuli eelyozuba, Mwami uyotandabika bantu basyeede bakachaala mu Asiliya, Ijiputi, Patulosi, Kkusyi Elamu, Syina, Hamati, a mutusuwa twakulwizi
Uyozibikila ndembela yazisi akubungania batandidwe ba Izilayeli abamwayikide ba Juda kuzwa kuzyooko zyoone zyaanyika.
Uyosandula bbivwe lya Efulemu, abusinkondo bwa Juda buyodunsulwa. Efulemu takoyomubeda abbivwe limbi pe Juda, awalo Juda tachiyobi limbi sinkondonyina kuli Efulemu pe.
Nikuba kuti bayosala minkuni yaba Filisitiya kujwe, alimwi bayobanyanzya bantu bakujwe. Balolwisya ba Edomu aba Mowabbu, abantu ba Amoni bayobalemeka.
Jehova uyomaninizya kunyonyoona inkomwe yalwizi lwa Ijiputi. Apuumina lipya uyovukuzya janza lyakwe atala lya Mulonga Efulata alimwi uhyopambukania mutulonga tuli kumawulu.
Kuyoba mugwagwa mupati wabantu bacheede babalobokede kuzwa ku Asiliya, mbubonya mbuli mugwagwa waba Izilayeli ngubakajana mubuzuba oobo nibakapola kuzwa kuchisi cha Ijiputi.
Mubuzuba oobo uyoowamba kuti, ''Ndiyoopa kulumba kulinduwe, Jehova. Nikuba wakalindinyemenede, bukali bwako bwazwa kulindime, alimwi wanduumbulizya.
Bona, Leza ndufutuko lwangu; ndiyoosyoma alimwi nsikoyooyowa pe, nkaambo Jehova, iyi, Jehova manguzu alwiimbo lwangu. Waba lufutuko lwangu.''
Chalukondo muyooteka maanzi kuzwa mumasawu aalufutuko.
Mubuzuba oobo muyoowamba kuti, ''Mupe kulumba kuliJehova akwiita zina lyakwe; mwaambe milimu yakwe aakati kabantu, mwaambe kuti zina lyakwe lisumpulwe.
Mwiimbe kuliJehova, nkaambo wachita zintu zilemekeka; mukachite kuti eezi zikazibinkane munyika yoonse.
Mukakwiile akoompolola chakukondwa, nywebo nimukkala muZiyoni, nkaambo mupati Uusalala waIzilayeli aakati keni.''
Makani alatala a Bbabbiloni, ayo Isaya mwana mulombe wa Amozi ngakatambula.
Achilundu chitakwe chintu mubike ndembela yachitondezyo, wompolweda mujulu kulimbabo, nyampula kuboko kwako biinke kumilyango yabavubide.
''Ndalayilila basale bangu, ndaambila basinguzu kuti banjile bukkali bwangu--abo basekelela mukuzunda.
Muzuzumo wamakamumakamu muzilundu, mbuli bantu biingi! Muzuzumo wampyopyongano wamaami mbuli zisi zibungene antomwe! Jehova wamakamu ulikubungania impi yenkondo.
Bazwa kumanyika akule, kumagolelo ajulu kule, Ngu Jehova azibelesyo zyakwe zyalubeta, kukunyonyoona nyika yoonse.
Amompoolole, nkambo buzuba bwa Jehova bwabafwifwi, buza alunyonyooko luzwa ku Mupati kampatila.
Aboobo maboko woonse alengelela chakubula manguzu, amyoyo yayaaya.
Bayoyoowa; kuchisa azisinto ziyobasikila, mbuli mwanakazi kuchindi chakutumbuka. Bayolanga akugamba umwi awumwi; masyu aabo ayoyaka mbuli mulimo.
Langa, izuba lya Jehova liza abukali bubi alunyemo lukunka, kuti nyika libetongo akunyonyoona basizibi kuzwa kulinjiyo.
Nyeenyezi zyakujulu abandakutema tabachiyoopi mumuni wazyo. Izuba liyosizigwa nikuba kubuchedo, alimwi mweezi tukoyo munika.
Ndiyoopa chisubulo kunyika nkambo kachibi chayo abubi nkambo kabusofwazi bwayo. Ndiyomaninsya kulisumpula kwabaliyanda akuseluzya kulisumpula kwababo balikankayizya.
Ndiyochita kuti baalumi bacheye kwinda ngolide isalala abantu nkatachijaniki mbuli ngolida yaku ofili.
Aboobo Ndiyochita kuti majulu akankame, alimwi nyika iyoteketesegwa kuzwa kubusena bwayo, abukkali bwa Jehova wamakamu, alimwi mubuzuba bwabukkali bwakwe buyoosya.
Mbuli njelele yavwimwa kana mbuli mbelele yabula mweembeli, umwi awumwi uyopilukila kubantu bakwe akuchijila kunyika yakwe mwini.
Umwi awumwi utakajanike uyojayigwa, alimwi umwi awumwi utakajatwe uyojiigwa apanga.
Atwana twabo tuyopwachuulwa kunembo lyamenso aabo. Maanda aabo ayodilisigwa abanakazi babo bayojatwa chibbalo.
Langa, ndaamba kubusya Medisi kuti abalwisye, tabakoyoyeeya nsiliva, na kubotelwa angolida.
Buta bwabo boyoyasa balombe, tabakoyofwida luzyalo bana batete alimwi tabakoyolanga aluzyalo kubana baniini.
Elyo Bbabbiloni, bwami bweebesi, bubotu bwakulisumpula kwa Chaludiyeni, uyozundwa a Leza mbuli Sodoma a Gomola.
Tikoyokkalwa nikuba kuyakwa kuzwa kumazyalani atobela. Ba Alabbi tabachiyoyaki zilawo nkuko, nikuba basikweembela tabakoyoyusisya butanga bwabo nkuko.
Pele banyama bamusokwe bamunkanda bayolala nkuko. Maanda aabo ayozula zipolo; alimwi mpawo ansya zinoyosotoka nkukooko.
Basuntwe bayokwiilila maanda abwaami, alimwi bamwaba mumaanda mebesi. Chiindi chakwe chaba afwiifwi, amazuba aakwe takoyononoka pe.

Jehova uyofwida Jakkobbu luzyalo; alimwi uyosala Izilayeli akubaboozya munyika yabo beni. Beenzu bayoliswanizya antomwe ambabo akuyolijatanisya antomwe ambabo akuyobajatanisya beni kung'anda ya Jakkobbu.
Manyika ayoobeeta kunyika yabo beni. Elyo ng'anda ya Izilayeli iyobatola, munyika ya Jehova mbuli baluumi abanakazi bazike. Bayobaanga abo bakabangide, akuyoyendelezya basikubapenzya.
Mubuzuba oobo Jehova mbwayomupa kulyokezya kuzwa kubuusu amapenzi, akuzwa kumilimo miyumu njiwakali kubelesegwa,
uyoyiimba lwiimbo lwakusampula kumwami wa Bbabbiloni, ''Mbubonya mbuli sikupenzya mbwasika kumamanino, kunyema kwakulisumpula mbukwamana!
Jehova watyola musako wasizibi, inkoli yabaabo beendelezi,
aabo bakawuma bantu zyuumo zyalyoonse, aabo bakendelezya manyika mukunyema, alukono lutakasigwi.
Inyika yoonse yaba mukulyokezya akuumuna; batalika kubotelwa akwiimba.
Ayilayo minsamu yaku Sipulesi yasekelela atala anduwe antomwe amakkedali aa lebbano; ilaamba kuti, 'Mbulikuti walazikwa aansi, takwe chigonsyo chazisamu chituzida kuzotugonka.''
Chikkalilo chabafu chakunsi chilikkede kukutambula eelyo nozoyinka nkuko. Chilakubusizya bafwide, boonse baami banyika, akubachita kuti baami bamaasi boonse.
Bayowambuula boonse akwamba kuti kulinduwe, Áyeebo wakompama mbuli ndiswe waaba mbuli ndiswe.
Kulisumpula kwako kwaseluzigwa kuchikkalilo chabafu achikwala chatuntimbwa twako. Imvwinyu zilisalidwe munsi lyako, azilazyo ziyokaansi zilazula alinduwe.'
Waawa buti kuzwa mujulu, ntanda yangu o mwana wangu mulombe wakubuchedo! Wagonkwa biyeni kuyaansi, iwebo niwakazunda maasi!
Wakaamba mumoyo wako kuti, 'Ndiyotanta kujulu, Ndiyonyampula chuuno changu chabwaami aajulu lyanyenyeezi zya Leza, mumabazu aakunyika.
Ndiyotanta aajulu loko kwiinda mayoba; Ndiyolichita nkakozyanie a Leza Mupati Kampatila.'
Nekuba boobo waselusigwa kuchikkalilo chabfu, kumagolelo amulindi.
Aabo bakubona bayokweebela akuyoswilila kulinduwe. Bayowaamba kuti, 'Sa nguyoyu muntu wakazungaania nyika, iwakateketya bwaami,
iwakachita nyika yoonse kuti ibe mbuli nkanda, iwakavwinyuuna myunzi yayo akukasya baange bakwe kuti biinke kumaanda?
'Baami boonse bamaasi bonse balooma mubulemu, umwi awumwi mukabanda kakwe mwini.
Pesi ulisowedwe kuzwa kukabanda kako mbuli mutabi uusowedwe. Bafwude balikuvumbide mbuli chisamo, aabo ibakayaswa apanga, ibayinka aansi kumabwe amumulindi.
Tokoyoswanizigwa pe ambabo mukuvwikkwa, nkambo wakanyonyoona nyika yako akujaya bantu bako. Ibana babsimuchita zibi tabakoyoyitwa limbi.''
Amulibambile bujayi bwabana bakwe, nkaambo kazibi zyabamawisi, aboobo tabakoyobuka pe kukuvuba nyika akyozuzya nyika yoonse amyuunzi.
''Ndiyobuka akubalwiisya''-- aya ngemalayilile a Jehova.''Ndiyogonka kuzwa kuzina lya Bbabbiloni, lunyungu, azyalani - aya ngemalayilile a Jehova.
''Njowuchita kuti ukavube zipalo, akuba maziba amaanzi, alimwi njomukukula achikukuzyo chalunyonyooko'' -- aya ngemalayilile a Jehova wamakamu.
Jehova wamakamu wakakonkezya kuti, ''Nchobeni, mbuli mbundayeyede, chiyoba mbubonya; alimwi mbuli mbundakazibambide, ziyoba mbuboobo:
Njopwaya ma Asuli munyika yanu, aajulu azilundu zyangu njomulyatawuka. Elyo ijokwe lyakwe liyogwisigwa kuzwa kulinguwe amikuli wakwe uyoozwa akkuko lyabo.''
Aya ngimabambe abambilidwe nyika yoonse, alimwi eli ndijaanza litandabikilidwe kukulwisya maasi woonse.
Nkambo Jehova wamakamu nguwazibamba eezi; ngwani uutamwimikizye? Ijanza lyakwe lyatandabikwa, alimwi ngwani utalibwedezye musule?
Mumunyaka oyo mwami Ahazi nakafwa aya makani akasika:
Mutabotelwi pe, inywebo moonse noba Filisitiya, nkambo kakuti yakamumya yakatyoka. Nkambo kuzwa kumuyanda wenzoka kulazwa chipile, nkabela michelo yakwe iyooba nzoka nkali iwuluka.
Bana bataanzi bakafwaba bayochezya mbelel zyabo mumachezezyo aangu, abachete bayolala chakutayoowa. Ndiyojaya miyanda yabo enzala elyo itakajaye bantu bako boonse ibakasyeede.
Kolila, omulyango; koomoka, o munzi; moonse muyoyaaya, nobaFilisitiya.
Kuzwa kunyika kuyozwa musumpululu wabusi, nkabela takwepe uyozwidilila muchiindi nchabikilidwe. Bayobavwiila biyeni batumwa bayeyonyika?''
Kwambuula atala a Mowabbu. Ikaaka, mansiku amwi Ala wa Mowabbu waabwa akunyonyoonwa; ikaka, mumansiku ngaawo Kkili wa Mowabbu wabwa akunyonyoonwa.
Bayinka kuntempele, mbantu ba Dibboni bayinka kujulu kukulila; Mowabbu walilila Nebba a Medebba. Yoonse mitwe yabo yakululwa chinkulu azilezu zyoonse zilinyoledwe.
Mumigwagwa yabo balizweete masaka; aatala atululi twabo azisamablilo zyabo boonse balalila, akuumbulizika misozi.
Hesyibboni a Elile bakwilila lugwasyo; muzuzumo wabo wamvwikka kule kusikila ku Jahazi. Aboobo basilumamba baba Mowabbu balalilila lugwasyo; balakankama lwabo beni.

Moyo wangu ulalilila Mowabbu; basilutwe bakwe bachijila ku Zowali aku Egilati Syelisyiya. Balobutanta akwinka ku Luhiti akuya bukwiila; mumugwagwa waku Hlonayimu balawompolola achilizyo chalunyonyooko lwabo.
Maanzi a Nimulimu ayuminina, masokwe apusama; zisyu zyapya; takuchikwe mweemvwe abuniini.
Bwiingi bwabutebuzi mbubatebula babubweza akutaaluka kalonga kapopulasi.
Kulila kwazulila akuzyunguluka koonse munyika ya Mowabbu; kuwuula kwamvwigwa kule mbuli ku Egilayimu a Bbele Elimu.
Nkambo manzi Dimoni azwide abulowa; pesi njoyeeta miingi atala Dimoni. Balavu bayojata abo balobokede kuzwa ku Mowabbu abaabo basyeede munyika.
Tumizya tubelele kumwendelezyi wenyika kuzwa kusela munkanda, kuchilundu chamwana musimbi wa Ziyoni.
Mbuli bayuni batuntulika, mbuli chizumbo chimwaywidwe, aboobo banakazi ba Mowabbu bali azito zya Mulonga wa Alinoni.
''Pa malayilile, beteka chabululami; chita mwenzule mbuli mansiku isikati; kosisa batandidwe utabawuzyi batandidwe.
Kobaleka bakkale akkati kanu, bayobuchija kuzwa ku Mowabbu; bachiyubilo chabo kuzwa kulisikubajaya.'' Nkambo budyamizi buyomana, alunyonyooko luyomana, abobalyatawuka bayochija kuzwa munyika.
Chuuno chabwami chiyoyimikila muchizuminano chisyomekede; alimwi umwi kuzwa kuchilawo cha Davida uyokkala chakusyomeka nkukooko, uyobeteka nkachiyabuyandula bululami akuchita bululami.
Twamvwa akuliyanda kwa Mowabbi, kulikankayizya, kulitunta, abukali bwakwe. Pesi kulitunta kwakwe takwe nchikwamba.
Aboobo Mowabbu uyolila Mowabbunyina -- boonse bayolila! Momooka, inywebo nimwanyonyooka chakumaninina, nkambo zinkwa zitakwe buswezyo zya Kkili Halesyeti.

Myunda ya Hesyibboni zyayuma azisiko zyamisansa zya Sibbima azilazyo. Bendelezi bazisi balyatawuka zisiko zyamisansa ezyo zyalikusika ku Jazeli akutandabala kusika kunkanda. Zisyukila zyatandabalila mutala; zyaya mutala alwizi.
Kasimpe ndiyolila antomwe a Jazeli nkambo kachilili cha Sibbima. Ndiyokutilila amisozi, Hesyibboni, a Eleyale. Nkambo munkuba zyamichelo yako yamiinza akutyola ndamaninsya mompololo walukondo.
Kubotelwa alukondo lwagwisigwa kuzwa kumichelo yamunsamu; alimwi tachikwe kwimba kana kompolola muzilili. Takwe ulyatuuka wayini muzisinino, nkambo ndakonzya mompololo wayoyo ulyatawuka.
Nkambo moyo wangu ulalila mbuli kantimbwa nkulilila Mowabbu, amukati mulindime nkambo ka Kkili Haleseti.
Elyo Mowabbu nalikatazya abusena bulajulu akunjila muntempele kukuyokomba, nkombyo zyakwe tazikoyoba ampindu pe.
Eli ndijwi ndyakamba Jehova atala a Mowabbu kale.
Alimwi Jehova ulaambula, mukati kaminyaka yotatwe, bulemu bwa Mowabbu bulamana; nikuba ulabantu biingi, batakasyale banooli bacheloko akutayeyegwa.
Makani akambulwa atala a Damasikkasi.
Myunzi ya Alowe iyokakwa. Ayooba masena akulalila butanga aansi, alimwi takwe naba omwe utakabuyowesye.
Myuunzi yakuyubila iyomwayika kuzwa kuli Efulemu, bwami kuzwa ku Damasikkasi, aabwendelezi bwaba Izilayeli -- oku nkwaambula kwabantu ba Izilayeli -- oku nkwaambula kwa Jehova wamakamu.
Kuyosika atala abuzuba obo elyo bulemu bwa Jakobo buyokotela, alimwi amafuta anyama yakwe iyokotela.
Kuyoba mbuli elyo mutebuli nabungania mayila ayimvwi, alimwi kuboko kwakwe nikutebula mitwe yamayila. Kuyoba mbuli kuchiindi muntu navuulula mitwe yamayila Mukkuti lya Lefayimu.

Kuvuulula kuyolekwa, nekubaboobo, mbuli kuchiindi munsamu wamu Olifa nutikinisigwa: obile na otatwe ma Olifa akujulu alasyala, oone naa musanu kumpela lyantabi yamisamu yamichelo - oku nkwambula kwa Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli.
Mubuzuba obo bantu bayolanga kunembo lya Mubumbi wabo, alimwi menso abo ayolanga ku Musalali wa Izilayeli.
Tabakoyolanga kuzipayililo, kumilimo yamaboko aabo, nekuba kulanga kuli eezyo minwe yabo nziyakabumba, zyamunsamu nanka zikozyanio zyazuba.
Mubuzuba oobo myuunzi yabo isimide iyoba mbuli chisaka chinkuneme kukalundu kasamiti, ako kakasowegwa nkambo kabantu ba Izilayeli, alimwi bayoba matongo.
Nkaambo mwaluba Leza walufutuko lwanu, alimwi mwakaka bbwe lyanguzu zyanu. Aboobo mwazikkila minsamu mibotu, alimwi mwazikkila intabi nzimwatambula kuzwa kubazwa masi,
nekuba boobo mubuzuba nimwazikila mwazyungulusya, alimwi nekuba kuchifumo imbotu zyanu zilakkomena, butebuzi buyokachilwa mubuzuba bwamapenzi abwabuusu bugambya.
Maawe! kumakamu abantu biingi, abo bavuluma mbuli kuvuluma kwalwizi, aakwendesya kwazisi, abo bandesya mbuli kwendesya kwamanzi alanguzu!

Zisi ziyovuluma mbjuli kwendesya kwamanzi miingi, pesi uyobakkalalila alimwi bayochija kuyakule, bayowandwa kunembo lyaluuwo mbuli buungu atala lyazilundu, aambuli lusuko lulundumuka nilyungisya iguwo.
Chiindi chamangolezya,kulaboneka, makani aayoosya! Lino kabutana kucha tabakono chiliwo! Eechi nchenchicho chaabilo chabaabo batusaala, banji babaabo batunyanzya mbono zyesu.
Maawe kunyika yakusokonya kwamababa, iilikutala lyamilonga ya Kkusyi;

eyo ituma batumwa alwiizi, mumaato amapapulasi atala lyamanzi. Kamuya, nubatumwa basiluno, kuchisi chilamfu batetete, kubantu bakali kuyoosya kule aafwifwi, chisi chisimide akulyatawida ansi, nyika yabo yakaandulwa amilonga.
Moonse nywebo nobantu baanyika aanywebo nimukkala anyika, eelyo chitondezyo chiyosumpulwa aatala lyazilundu, langa; alimwi mweembo nuyosibwa, mukaswilile.
Kaambo mbuboobu Jehovambwandambila, ''Nkawumune akulangisisya kuzwa kumunzi wangu, mbuli mumuni wazuba mbekabeka, mbuli ijoba lyamune mukati kankaasaalo yakutebula.
Kabatana kutebula, malubaluba naamana, alimwi michelo yamusansa niitalika kubizwa kuba michelo, uyoogonka tumintentenga azizibyo, alimwi uyogonkelaansi akwiisowa mitabi itabete.
Iyoosiilwa bayuni antoomwe ataala lyazilundu aakubanyama baanyika. Bayuni bayosanizigwa chiindi chachilimo, alimwi abanyama boonse baanyika bayosanizigwa njiiyo chiindi champeyo.''

Kuchindi eecho Jehova wamakamu uyoyetelwa mutelo kuzwa kubantu balamfu banjenjeema, kuzwa kubantu bakali kuyoosya kule aafwifwi, chisi chisimide akulyatwiidwansi, abo nyika yabo yakaanzanisigwa amilonga, kubusena bwazina lya Jehova wamakamu, kuchilundu cha Ziyoni.
Ngaaya makani alatala a Ijiputi. Langa, Jehova ulaza katantide ajoba alimwi uzabuza ku Ijiputi; zikozyanio zya Ijiputi ziyokankama munsi lyakwe, alimwi myooyo yaba Ijiputi iloyaaya mulimbabo.
''Njobusya ba Ijipita aatala aba Ijipita: mwalumi uyolwana amukulana wakwe, alimwi mwalumi atala a simayakilane akwe; chisi aatala achisinyina, alimwi bwami aatala abwaaminyina.
Muuya wa Ijipita uyobula manguzu kuzwamukati. Njonyonyoona luchenjezyo lwakwe nikuba kuti bayanduula luchenjezyo lwazikozyanio, myuuya yabaalumi bafwide basondi, alimwi abalozi.
Ndiyowaba ba Ijiputi mujanza lyasimalelo mukali, alimwi mwami uusimide uyoyendelezya aalimbabo - aaya ngimalayilile a Jehova wamakamu.''
Maanzi amulwizi ayoyuminina, alimwi mulonga uyoyuminina akubula nchuulacho.
Milonga iyonunka; tulonga twa Ijipita tuyoyuminina; matete ankubbu ziyoyuma.
Matete kunkomwe ya Nayili, kudomolomo lya Nayili, alimwi muunda woonse uugankidwe kumbali a Nayili uyoyumisigwa, uyotolwa, alimwi tukoyoba limbi pe.
Baalumi bazubi bayowompolola akukwiila, alimwi boonse aabo bawala tulobyo muli Nayili bayokwiila, abaabo bayanzala tunsabwe amanza bayopengeleka.
Babeleki batonje abaabo basuma masani aatuba bayosanduka akuusa.
Babeleki bazizwato bayopwayulwa; boonse aabo babeleka chakubbadalwa balowusigwa nsoni mulimbabo.

Baana balombe babaami baku Zowani mbafubafuba chakumanina. Luchenjezyo lwaba sikuchenjezya balabusongo ba Falo baaba basikuchita zitamvwisisiki. Sa ngaulawamba kuti kuli Falo, ''Ndimwana mulombe wamwalumi mupampu, mwana mulombe wabaami basikale?''
Balikuli lino aabo baalumi basongo? Akube kuti bakwambile alimwi akukuzibya eezyo Jehova wamakamu nzyababimbide aatala aba Ijipita.
Bana balombe babaami baku Zowani bakaba zifubafuba, bana balombe babaami ba Mefisi bayenwa; bachitya kuti Ijipita ayeende asweka, aabo balimbabo chooko chamisyobo yakwe.
Jehova wavwelengania muuya walweeno aakati kakwe, alimwi balesya Ijipita akumusowa mulizyonse nzyakachita, mbuli mukolwi udadalika mumalusi aakwe.
Tachikwe uumwi nchaanga ulakonzya kuchitila Ijipita, naa mutwe nanka muchila, intabi yakakunka nanka itete.
Muzuba elyo, ba Ijipita bayooba mbuli banakazi. Bayokankama akuyoowa nkambo kwakusumpulisigwa kwajanza lya Jehova wamakamu ndyakabusya aalimbabo.
Inyika ya Juda iyooba makkazikilo akutatalika kwa Ijipita, choonse chiindi umwi nayobayeezya aanguwe, bayoyoowa, nkambo kamabambe a Jehova, aayo ngalokubamba aatala ambabo.
Mubuzuba oobo kuyooba zisi zili musanu munyika ya Ijipita aambuula mulaka waKkenani alimwi ukonka muzina lya Jehova wamakamu. Chimwi chazeezi Nkuti Chisi Chazuba.
Muzuba elyo kuyooba chipayililo cha Jehova aakati kanyika ya Ijipita, alimwi amunsende wamabwe kumugaano wa Jehova.
Uyooba mbuli chitondezyo abukamboni kuli Jehova wamakamu munyika ya Ijipita. Ndibayoowa kuli Jehova wamakamu nkambo kaba sikudyamizya, uyobatumina mufutuli asikubatabilila, alimwi uyobavuna.
Jehova uyozibinkana ku Ijipita alimwi ba Ijipita bayotambula Jehova kubuzuba oobo. Bayomukomba azipayizyo alimwi azipo, akuchita zikonke kuli Jehova uyopenzya Ijipita, kubapenzya akubasilika.
Balobweda kuli Jehova; uyomvwa chikombyo chaabo alimwi uyobasilika.
Muzuba elyo kuyooba migwagwa mipati izwa ku Ijipita kiiya ku Asiliya, alimwi ba Asiliya bayooza ku Ijipita, aaba Ijipita ku Asiliya, alimwi ba Ijipita bayokomba aba Asiliya.
Mubuzuba oobo, Izilayili uyooba watatu a Ijipita a Asiliya, chilongezyo akkati kanyika.
Jehova wamakamu uyobalongezya akwaamba kuti; ''Aalongezegwe Ijipita, bantu bangu, Asiliya, mulimu wamaboko aangu; a Izilayeli, lukono lwangu.''
Mumunyaka ooyo Tatani ngwakasika ku Asyidodi, eelyo Syagoni mwami wa Asyuli naakamutuma, wakalwana aatala a Asyidodi alimwi aakutola.

Kuli echo chiindi Jehova wakaambula kuli Isaya mwaana mulombe wa Amozi akwaamba kuti; ''Koya ukagwisye masaka kuzwa muchibuno chako alimwi akugwisya insangu kuzwa kumawulu aako.'' Wakachita oobo, kayabweenda chinswe katazwete insangu pe.
Jehova wakati, ''Mbuli mulanda wangu Isaya mbwakeenda chinswe akutazwaata insangu kwaminyaka yotatwe, nchitondezyo chigambya aatala a Ijiputi aatala a Kkusyi--
muuli eyinzila mwami wa Asiliya uyozulwida aanze baangwe ba Ijipita aabazwa kule ku Kkusyi, banini abapati; balichinswe abatazwete nsangu aabala matako atavumbidwe, kuti ba Ijipita bawuse insoni.
Bayo dyamizigwa alimwi akuusa, nkambo ka Kkusyi  elyo chilangililo chabo achabulemu bwa Ijiputi.

Bakkala muli ezi nkomwe bayowomba muuli elyozuba, 'Nchobeni, echi nchichakali chilangililo chesu, ooko nkutwakachijila kuti tukajane lugwasyo lwakuvunwa kumwaami wa Asyuliya, aalimwi lino, nkubona twachijila kuli?'''
Ndamwambila atala ankanda yalwizi. Mbuli tumbizi mbotunga twiinda mu Negevu akusika chakwiinda kuzwa munkanda, akuzwa munyika iyoosya.
Ndayubunwida zilengaano zimvwisya machise: Baalumi bawuzyi babamba ziyoosya, alimwi abajayi balokujaya. Taanta ajulu alimwi ukabalwisye, Elamu; kobasinkilizya, Midiya; Ndiyoyimikizya kulila kwabo.
Aboobo mabbazu angu azwide machise; machise alimbuli machise akumyongwa kwamwanakazi andijata loko; Ndafugama aansi kuli nzendakamvwa; Ndakachelezeka azezyo nzendakabona.
Moyowangu ulawuma; Ndakankama chakuyoowa.
Bakandibambila ntafule, balabika zivumbyo alimwi balalya akunywa; amubuke, nobana bamwami, amunanike ntobo zyanu amafuta.
Nkambo mbubobu Mwami mbwandaambila, ''Koya ukabikke mulindizi; uleelede kwamba nchaabona.
Kuchindi nchaabona nkalaki, abasimabbiza bobile, abagade madonki, alimwi abagade nkamela, elyo uleleede kuswililisya loko alimwi alibambile.''
Mulindizi ngawompolole mbuli mulavu, akwamba kuti, ''O Mwami, Ndilimvwi achilangilo changu buzuba boonse, amazuba woonse, alimwi achilindililo changu ndilimvwi busiku boonse.''
Lino bona nkalaki zilaza abaluumi alimwi balibobile amabbiza. Wakompolola, ''Waawa, waawa, Bbabbiloni azikozyanioa zibezedwe zyabaleza zyapwachukila ansi.''
Bantu bapoledwe alimwi kabapalwidwe, mbana balubuwa lwangu! Eecho nchindakamvwa kuzwa kuli Jehova wamakamu, Leza wa Izilayeli, ndamwambila nchichonya.
Ndamwambila aatala a Duma. Kuli muntu uchiita kuzwa ku Seyili, ''Omulindizi, kwambwaanzi aano mansiku?
Omulindizi wakamba wati, ''Mafumina alasika alimwi amansiku. Kuti koyanda kubuzya, elyo buzya; alimwi ukaboole lubo.''
Ndamwambila aatala amakani a Alabbiya. Munkanda ya Alabbiya mumuyomaninsya busiku, nywebo nobasilweendo ba Dedani.
Amwetele balanyota meenda; bakkala munyika ya Tema, amuswanizye basikuchija achinkwa.
Nkaambo bakachija kuzwa kupanga, kuzwa kupanga lisomwedwe, akuzwa kubuta, alimwi kuzwa kunkondo ndemu.
Nkaambo mbuboobu Mwami mbwakandambila, ''Mukati kanyika, mbuli mubelesi wakapegwa mulimu nkambo kamunyaka uumwi uyobona kuti, boonse bylemu bwa Kkedali buyomana.
Kucheede basimata bache, abasilumamba babana baKkedali mbayoochaala,'' nkambo Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli mbwazyambide.
Imakani akaambwa atala a Kkuti lya Chilengano: Niinzi chapa kuti moonse mutante atululi twamaanda?
Tamulindinywe na nimumvwa dolopo lizwide kusabilwa, dolopo lyalupyopyongano? Inchito zyaanu tezyakajayigwa na apanga, alimwi tebakafwa pe kunkondo.
Boonse bazululi banu bakachija antomwe, pesi bakaangwa kabatabelesezye kaanta pe; Boonse bakaangwa antomwe, nikuba bakachija kule.
Aboobo, ndati, ''Mutalangi kulindime, Njolila loko; Mutezyi kunduumbulizya pe atala akulunyonyooko lwamwana musimbi wabantu bangu.''

Nkaambo buzuba bwamapenzi, abwakulyatawuka aansi, abwalupyopyongano bwazwa ku Mwami Jehova wamakamu, mukati ka Kkuti lya Chilengano, ikumwayisigwa kwamalambo aansi, abantu balakwila chakompolola muzilundu.
Elamu balabweza inkomo yamivwi ankamu yabantu batantide mabbiza, a Kkeli bakayubununa intobo antanganana.
Chilasika chiindi chamakkuti azwide inkalaki alimwi basimabbiza bayoyima mumindando yamilyango.
Wakabweza kukwabililwa kwa Juda; Nzyakalangide mubuzuba oobo mwakali kulangila ing'anda yazilwisyo zyamulusaka.
Wakabona muunzi wadolopo lya Davida, ikuti bakali biingi, alimwi bakatola maanzi kudambwa lyakunsi.
Mwakabala ing'anda zya Jelusalemu, alimwi mwakamwayisya maanda ansi kuti mumamike malambo.
Mwakapanga ikkala akati kamalambo obile aziba lyamanzi. Pesi temwakalanga aabo basikupanga dolopo, ooyo wakazichita kale lyensiku.
Jehova Leza wamakamu mubuzuba oobo wakayita bantu kuti bakwile, nkambo kakomooka akulinyoola mumitwe, akuzwata zisamo zyamasaka.
Pesi boona, kwiinda kuti, bakondwe akusekelela, bajaye ing'ombe akufunda mbelele, balye nyama, akunywa wayini; atulye akunywa, eelyo junza, tulafwa.
Eechi chakayubununwa kumatwi aangu a Jehova wamakamu: Nkasimpe zibi eezi tazikoyolekelelwa pe, nikuba mwafwa,'' Mbwaamba Mwami Jehova wamakamu.
Mwami Jehova wamakamu, waamba oobu, ''Yinka kumwendelezi wamali, kuSyebbina, mupati wang'anda akwamba kuti,
'Niinzi nchochita aawa alimwi ngwani wakakupa mvumo kuti ulitemene kabanda lwako, ulalisyida kabaanda lwako mubulamfu akulifukila busena bwakulyooezya mubbwe?'''
Boona, Jehova waamba kukusowa webo, singuuzu, waamba kukusowela aansi; uyokuvuna chakuvungisya.
Nkasimpe uyokuzyungulusya akukuzyungulusya akukuwala mbuli ibbola munyika impati. Ooko uyofwa, ooko azyalo nkalaki zyabulemu nkuzibede; uyowusisya ng'anda yasimalelo wako insoni!
''Njokusyoma kuzwa kumabelekelo aako akukugwisya mubusena bwako. Njokutontela aansi.
Liyosika izuba eelyo ndenjoyita mwanangu Eliyakkimu mwana mulombe wa Hilukkiya.
Njomuzwatika chikobela chako akumuyumya alutambo lwako, alimwi bwami bwako njobwaaba mumaanza aakwe. Uyoba wisi wabantu bakkede mu Jelusalemu akung'anda ya Juda.
Njobikka chijaluzyo ang'anda ya Davida akkuko lyakwe; uyojula alimwi takwepe uyojula; unoli wajala, alimwi takwepe nikuba omwe uyojula.
Njomukankamina, mbuli nkaanka mubusena mbwiigankamina, alimwi uyooba chikkalilo chachuuno chabulemu chang'anda ya Taata.
Bayowanzika alinguwe boonse bulemu bwang'anda ya Taata, abana bazyedwe alunyungu lwakwe, azibelesyo zyoonse zinini kuzwa kunkomeki mpati zyoonse.

Mubuzuba oobo -- Eechi chambilizyo kuli Jehova wamakamu -- inkaanka iyakagankamidwe mubusena mbwingangemene iyozungaana, iyogonkwa akuwa, awalo mukuli wakabikkidwe alinjiyo uyotemwa -- oobo Jehova mbwawaamba.
Ndamwambila aatala achisi chaku Tayile: Maawe, nywebo nomazubo akuchisi chaku Talisi; nkambo nikuba taakwe muunzi naakuti manjililo; kuzwa kunyika yachisi cha Sipulasi ngibaka yubunwidwa.
Amumuune, nobantu nimukkala munkomwe yaLwizi, nywebo kubasambazi baku Sidoni, aabo bayinda kutala lyaLwizi, bakamuzuzya.
Aatala amanzi manji kwakali mbuto ya Siwoli, butebuzi bwa Nayile bwakali buvubi bwakwe; alimwi wakaba chisambalilo chamaasi.

Kofwa insoni, Sidoni, nkaambo lwizi lwaambuula, inguzu zyalwizi zyaamba. Lwaamba kuti, ''Mebo nsina kumvwa chimyoonzi naa kutumbuka, nakubusya balombe bachili baniini nikuba kukomezya basimbi baniini.''
Kuchiindi niyosika impuwo kuchisi chaku Ijiputi , bayonyema loko aatala a Tayile.
Amuzubuke kuya ku Tasyisyi; amulile, nywebo nobantu bakkede kunkomwe yalwizi.
Saa ezi zyakali zyachitika kuli ndinywe, muunzi wabusekelezi, ulinguwo loko kuzwa kumazuba achiindi, sa ngwakali amawulu akwendeenda kule loko akuyokkala kunyikanyenzu?
Ngwani wakabamba makani aaya akulwisya chisi chaku Tayile, uupa misini, ulabasambazi bana balombe babaami, abasikuuzya bawo mbalemekeka munyika?
Jehova wamakamu nguwakabamba makani akufwiinsya bulemu boonse bwaanyika.
Kolima nyika yako, mbuli umwi mbwalima mulonga Nayile, O mwana musimbi waku Tasyisyi. Takuchikwe limbi busena bwakusambalila kuchisi chaku Tayila.
Jehova watandabika janza lyakwe aatala alwizi, alimwi wazunganisya bwaami; wapa malayilile aatala achisi cha Fayonesiya, kukuchilwisya malambo mayumu.
Waamba wati, ''Tokoyobotelwa alimbi, O mwana musimbi usyanikidwe wa Sidoni; Buka, ukazubukile ku Sipulasi; pesi nikuba kuti ooko tokoyojana chilyokezezyo.''

Amubone nhyika yaba Kkaludiya. Bantu aaba tababoneki limbi; Asyiliya bayichita kuti ibe nkanda yabanyama bamusokwe. Bakayaka maanda aabo malamfu; bakamwaya ng'anda zyabaami; bazichita kuba zilwi zyamatongo.
Kozubuka, yebo obwaato bwaku Tasyisyi, nkambo busena bwakuyubila bwadilisigwa.

Mubuzuba oobo, chisi chaku Tayile chiyolubwa kuzwa kumakumi musanu aabili amyaaka (70), mbuli kumazuba amwaami. Kusule akuumana kwamakumi musanu aabili amyaaka kuyochitika zimwi muchisi cha Tayile mbuli kulwiimbo lwa simamambe.
Bweza kantimbwa, koya bwendeenda mudolopo O simamambe ulubidwe; kowuma kabotu, koyimba nyimbo nyiingi, kuti ukayeyegwe.

Kuyosika nikutakabe kusule amyaaka ilimakumi musanu aabili, Jehova uyogwasya chisi chaTayile, alimwi uyotalika kuchita mamali lubo akuchita mulimo wabumambe, akuyopa mulimo wakwe mubwaami bwanyika yoonse.

Lino imbono zyoonse ziyobikwa kunembo lya Jehova. Tazikoyobambwa pe nikuba kubikkwa muchibambilo, nkambo imbono zyakwe ziyopegwa bakkala mubulemu bwa Jehova alimwi ziyobelesegwa kukwaaba chakuvuzya zilyo akulijanina zisamo zisimide.
Amubone, Jehova wamba kugwisya nyika azintu zyoonse, ulayisala, ulayisandamuna, alimwi ulamwaya bantu bakkede mulinjiyo.

Ziyochitika boobu, mbuli bantu, bayoba mbuli bapayizi; mbuli muzike, uyoba mbuli simalelo; mbuli sikuula, uyoba mbuli sikuuzya;  mbuli sizikoloto, uyoba mbuli sikukweletesya, mbuli sikupegwa mpindu, uyoba mbuli sikupa mpindu.
Nyika iyonyonyooka nchobeni akumaninsigwa; nkambo Jehova wakaamba ijwi eeli.
Nyika iyoyuminina akupusama, bantu balisumpula alimwi balanyana, bantu basumpukide balasowegwa.
Nyika yasofwazigwa abantu  bakkala mulinjiyo nkambo basotoka milawu, batyola mbeta, alimwi akutyola chizuminano chitamani.
Aboobo lutuko nchilwalyida nyika, alimwi bantu bakkala mulinjiyo bajanika balamilandu. Bantu bakkala munyika balatentwa, alimwi kwasyala bantu bache.
Wayini mpya yayuminina, misansa yapusama, boonse balamyooyo ikondedwe ilomimila.
Kuyobeka kwansaka kwamana, alimwi kupululuzya kwabaabo baboteledwe; kuyobeka kwatuntimbwa kwamana.
Tabachinywi wayini akwiimba, alimwi bukkande bulalula kuli baabo babunywa.
Chisi chalupyopyongano chamwayigwa; ng'anda zyoonse zyajalwa alimwi tamuchikwe zintu.
Kulikulila mumigwagwa nkaambo kawayini; lukondo loonse lwabbililwa zuba, busekelezi bwanyika bwamwayuka.
Kuchisi kwachaala lusalao, alimwi chitendele chatyoka lyabatongo.
Nkaambo eezi mbubo zitazobe munyika yoonse akkati kazisi, mbuli muchindi musamu wamu Olifa mbuzowumwa, mbuli kupalulwa kwamasansa eelyo nulikutebulwa.
Bayonyampula majwi aabo alimwi bakompolole bupati bwa Jehova, alimwi chalukondo bayowompolola kuzwa kulwizi.
Aboobo kujwe mupe Jehova bulemu, alimwi nimulikunkomwe yalwizi amupe bulemu kuzina lya Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli.

Kuzwa kubusena bwakule bwanyika twakali twamvwa nyiimbo, ''Bulemu ngabupegwe kuloyo ululeme!'' Pesi Ndakati, ''Ndakasowela kule, Ndakasowela kule, maawe kulindime! Busilweeno buleena chalweeno; mbombubo, basilweeno babambulula chalweeno.''
Lupyopyongano, mulindi, alimwi akakkole kalalinduwe, bantu bakkala munyika.
Ooyo uchija muzuzumo wenkondo uyowida mumulindi, alimwi oyo ubbuda mumulindi ulachigwa akakkole. Zipulunguzyo zyakujulu zinoyojulidwe, alimwi ntalisyo zyenyika zyazuungana.
Nyika iyomwayigwa chakumaninina, nyika iyopwayigwa; nyika iyozunganisigwa chakunyonyooka.
Nyika iyodadalika mbuli muntu ukkoledwe bukkande alimwi iyoyaamuka kusule akunembo mbuli ng'anda. Mulandu wayo uyoyilemena alimwi iyoowa alubo tikoyobuka alimbi.
Mubuzuba oobo Jehova uyosubula basumpukide bakujulu balikumajulu, alimwi abaami beenyika balanyika.
Bayobunganisigwa antomwe, baange balimumalindi, alimwi akujalilwa muntolongo; alimwi nazoyinda mazuba miingi bayopegwa chisubulo.
Alubo mwezi uyowusigwa nsoni, alimwi zuba liyo pilinganisigwa, nkambo Jehova wamakkamu uyoyendelezya atala achilundu cha Ziyoni aku Jelusalema, akunembo lyabapati bakwe chabulemu.
Jehova, nduwe Leza wangu; Ndiyokusumpula, ndalumbayizya izina lyako; nkambo wachita zintu zigambya, zintu zyakabambidwe kale kale, mukusyomeka kulondokede.
Nkambo wakachita munzi kuba chitantaala, myuunzi isimide, itongo, alimwi mayubilo abazwakule kutaba munzi.
Nkaambo kako bantu basimide balokulemeka; munzi wabatakwe luzyalo uyokuyoowa.

Nkambo mwakali masena akwabilidwe nkambo kamuchete, ang'anda kuloyo ubulide mumapenzi - ang'anda kuzwa kumvula ilaluuwo acheenzule kuzwa mukupya. Eelyo kuyoya kutakwe luzyalo kwakali mbuli imvula ilaaguwo kilwisya bulambo,
alimwi mbuli kupya munyika yachimpayuma, ulabombya chikwala chabazwakule, mbuli kupya mbuku bombesegwa acheenzule chajoba, aboobo lwiimbo lwaba fwidilidwe luzyalo lwasandulwa.
Atala achilundu cha Jehova wamakamu uyochitila bantu boonse pobwe lyazintu zilamafuta, mawayini aasalidwe, anyama ntete, apobwe mumandumba.
Uyonyonyona achilundu chivumbyo atala lyabantu boonse, amulilo wankuni atala lyazisi zyoonse.
Uyomena lufu lyoonse, alimwi Mwami Jehova uyosindulula misozi kuzwa kumasyu woonse; uyogwisya mapenzi abantu bakwe kuzwa kunyika yoonse, nkambo Jehova wachaamba.
Chiyowambwa abuzuba oobo, ''Langa, oyu ngu Leza wesu; wakamulindila, alimwi uyotufutula. Oyu ngu Jehova; twakamulindila, tuyokondwa akubotelwa mulufutuko lwakwe.''
Nkambo achilundu echi ijanza lya Jehova liyoolyokezya, alimwi Mowabbu uyolyatawidwa aansi mubusena bwakwe, nichiba chisinino chili lyatawidwe ansi mukkomba lizuzigilwe ambolezi.
Bayokkwazamuna maanza abo akkati kalyo, mbuli sikuyamba, mbwakwazamuna manza akwe kuti ayambe. Pesi Jehova uyoselusya kulisunzuula kwabo nikuba kukonzya kwamanza aabo.
Bulambo bwanu bulamfu buloseluzigwa ansi kuntundubwi, kulusuko.
Mulelyo zuba lwiimbo oolu luyoyimbwa munyika ya Juda. Tulamuunzi uusimide; Leza wachita lufutuko kuba bulambo bwawo achikwabilizyo.
Amujule zilyango, kuti misyobo iiluleme iisyomeka kuti injile.
Moyo upangidwe kulinduwe, uyomubamba muluumuno lwakasimpe, nkambo ulasyoma mulinduwe.
Kamusyoma muli Jehova kwalyonse; nkambo muli Jehova, mulibbwe litamani.
Nkaambo uyofwiinsya aabo bapona chakulisumpula; munzi usumpwidwe uyowuseluzya, uyowuyala ansi anyika; uyowelanisya alusuko.
Uyopwachwida aansi azituta zyabachete akulyatuuka kwabatengwana.
Inzila yabaluleme iitandabete, ililuleme; inzila yabaluleme ulichita ilulame.
Mbombubo, munzila yalubeta lwako, Jehova, tulakulindila; izina lyako ampuwo yako nzizyo nzituyanda.
Ndakuyanduula mansiku, chanchoonzyo, muuya wangu mulindime ulakuyanduula chakasimpe. Nkambo chiindi lubeta nilusika aanyika, bakkala munyika biiya aatala abululami.
Buuya ngabutondezegwe kumuntu sizibi, pesi takoyoyiiya bululami. Munyika yabululami ulachita busyofwazi alimwi taboni bulemu bwa Jehova.
Jehova, kuboko kwako kulisumpwidwe, pesi tabakuboni. Pesi bayobona busungu bwako kubantu alimwi bayofwisigwa nsoni, nkambo mulilo wabasinkondonyoko uyobaluma.
Jehova, uyoyeta luumuno kulindiswe; nkambo nchobeni, wamaninizya yoonse milimu yesu kichitilwa ndiswe.
Jehova Leza wesu, bamwi bapati kunze kwako bakatwendelezya, pesi tusumpula zina lyako alilike.
Balifwide, tabakoyopona; bakafwa, tabakoyobuka. Nchobeni, wakasika mulubeta alimwi wabanyonyoona, alimwi wajaya chiibalusyo chabo choonse.
Wavuzya bantu, Jehova, wavuzya bantu; ulalemekwa; wayungizya yoonse migaano yanyika.
Jehova, mumapenzi kuli nibakalanga kulinduwe; bakachita nkombyo ilulayo lwako nilwakali alimbabo.
Mbuli mwanakazi uminsi mbabafwifwi achindi chakutumbuka, elyo nali mumachise alimwi kakwila mumachise akutumbuka, mbombubo mbutubede kunembo lyako, Mwami.
Twaliminsi, twalimumachise akutumbuka, pesi kuli mbuli kuti twakatumbuka luuwo. Takwe nitwelede lufutuko kunyika, alimwi abantu bakkala munyika tabana kuwa.
Bako bafwide bayopona; mibili yabo iifwide iyobuka. Buka wiimbile kubotelwa, inywebo nimukkala mulusuko; nkambo luume lwanu ndume lwamumuni, alimwi nyika iyobusya bafwide bayo.
Mwiinke, nobantu bangu, munjile mumaanda aanu alimwi mujale makkoma kusule lyanu; muyube kwakayindi, mane do bukkali bukiinde.
Nkambo, amulange, Jehova waamba kuzwa mubusena bwakwe kuzosubula bantu bakkala munyika akambo kachibi chabo; inyika iyoyubununa bulowa mbuyakatila, alimwi tikoyosisa bajayidwe bayo.
Mubuzuba oobo, Jehova apanga lyakwe lisimide, pati liyoosya uyoosubula Leviyatani nzoka iiyalalika, Leviyatani nzoka iiyongosana, alimwi uyoojaya munyama mupati uuli mulwizi.
Mubuzuba oobo: Muunda wamasaansa, kowuyimba.
''Mebo, Jehova, ndime mukwabilili wayo; ndilawutiliila choonse chiindi. Ndilawubamba mansiku asikati aboobo tawo pe uutakuuchise.
Nsinyemede pe, O, kuti kwakali zimpobwa amaamvwa! Munkondo ndakali kubalwanisya; ndakali kubatenta antoomwe;
luzutu na bajana lukwabililo lwangu akuchita luumuno andime; ngabachite luumuno andime.
Mubuzuba buboola, Jekkobbu uyoosimpa muyanda; Izilayeli uyoosyuuka akuzwa maluba; alimwi bayoozuzya busy bwenyika amichelo.''
Sena Jehova wakalwanisya Jekkobbu aIzilayelu mbuli mbaakalwanisya manyika aayo aakabalwanisya? Sena Jekkobbu aIzilayeli bakajayigwa mbuli mukujayigwa kwamanyika aayo aakajayigwa angawo?
Mumweelwe uulinguwo walwanisya, kutanda Jekkobbu aIzilayeli; wakabatanda akuyoya kwakwe kuyoosya mubuzuba bwaluuwo lwakujwe.

Aboobo muliyeeyi nzila, mubi bwaJekkobbu buyoolekelelwa, akaambo kacheechi chibi chesu chiyoogwisigwa: aawo natakachita mabwe aakuchipayililo mbuli choko akuziilizigwa mubufwapula, alimwi takwe tuponda twaAsyela na zipyililo zyatununkilizyo ziyoosyaala kazyiimvwi.
Nkaambo muunzi uusalala lyaba tongo, chikkalilo chasiigwa akusowegwa mbuli chimpayuma. Ooko kanamani kalachela, alimwi ooko ulalala aansi akulya ntabi zyawo.

Aawo ntabi mpati niziyooyuma, ziyootyolo akugwisigwa. Banakazi bayoosika akubasa mulilo anzizyo, nkaambo aaba teensi mbantu bamvwisisisya. Nkinkaako Mubumbi wabo takoyooba aaluzyalo aalimbabo, alimwi ooyo wakabalenga takoyoobamvida luse pe.
Kuyoochitika mubuzuba oobo kuti Jehova uyoopola kuzwa kuMulonga Yufileyiti kusika kuWadi ya Ijipiti anduwe, bantu baIzilayeli, bayoobungana bumwi bumwi.
Mubuzuba oobo mweembo mupati uyoolila; alimwi aabo banyonyooka munyika yaAsiliya bayoosika, alimwi abateeleli munyika yaIjipiti. Bayookomba Jehova aachilundu chisalala muJelusalemu.

Maawe kumusini ulukidwe wakulisumpula ooyo uusamwa awumwi wabasikukolwa ba Efulemu, alimwi kudubaluba lipusama lyabulemu bwabo bweebesi, kulukwa ooko kukkede amutwe wambooleyamusena wabaabo bazundwa abukande!
Amubone, Mwami utumina umwi singuzu abukozu; mbuli guuwo lyachivulamabwe aguwo linyonyoona, mbuli mvula ikukula amanzi miingi apayisya; alimwi uyosowelwa aansi aaluuwa amusini ulukidwe umwi awumwi.
Chiluko chakulisumpula chabasikukolwa chaba Efulemu chiyolyatawidwa aansi aakulu.
Dubaluba lipusama lyabulemu bwakwe bweebesi, eelyo lilimumutwe wambole yamusena, liyooba mbuli nkuyu itanguna kubizwa mayinza naatana kusika, kuti, umwi uyibona, kayichili mujanza lyakwe, ulayilya.
Mubuzuba oobo Jehova wamakamu uyooba musini mweebesi angala njebesi kubantu bakwe bachisyeede,
muuya wakululamika wayooyo ukkede muubeteka anguzu zyabaabo bapilusya basinkondonyina kumilyango yabo.

Pesi nikuba aaba badadalika abukande mpawo kutatalika azyakunywa zikola. Mupayizi amusinsimi badadalika azyakunywa zikola, alimwi bukande bwakakomena. Balazeeleka azyakunywa zikola, kuzeeleka muchilengaano akudadalika mumizeezo.
Nkasimpe, matebuli woonse avumbwa amalusi, aboobo takuchikwe busena busalala.
Ngwani ngwayoyiisya luzibo, alimwi nkuulini nkwayopandululwa makani? Kulibaabo bakalesegwa kuzwa kumukupa na kulibaabo bachigwisigwa kuzwa kunkolo.
Nkambo mulawo aatala amulawo, mulao atala lyamulawo; bwendelezi atala abwendelezi, bwendelezi atala lyabwendelezi; ano bunini, akokuya bunini.
Nchonzyo amilomo iniaaka andimi zyenu uyowambila bantu aaba.
Mumazuba akaindi wakamba kuti kulimbabo, kamupa kulyokezya kuliyooyo ukkatede; alimwi ncheechi chikatalusyo,'' pesi takwe nibakaswilila pe.

Aboobo makani aa Jehova ayoba mulawo aatala amulawo, mulawo aatala lyamulawo, bwendelezi atala abwendelezi, bwendelezi aatala abwendelezi, aano bunini, akokiya bunini; aboobo kuti bakeende akuwa akaleente, mpawo bakapwayigwe, bakachigwe akujatwa.
Aboobo amuswilile kumakani a Jehova, nywebo nimuniaaka, nywebo nimwendelezya bantu aaba aabo bali mu Jelusalemu.

Eechi chiyochitika nkambo mwakaamba kuti, ''Twakatangaana chizuminano alufu, alimwi achikkalilo chabafu twasikila chizuminano. Aboobo myoondo yakukoma niyoyinda, tayikwe kuyotusikila pe. Nkambo twakachita kubeja kuba machijilo eesu, alimwi lweeno kuba mayubilo.''
Nkinkaako Mwami Jehova waamba kuti, ''Amubone, Ndiyobikka bbwe lyantalisyo mu Ziyoni, ibbwe lyakeezegwa bbwe liyandisi lyakuchiswi, intalisyo yanchonzyo. Ooyo uusyoma takwe kuyofwisigwa nsoni pe.
Ndiyochita kululamika kuba kasamu kakwendelesya, alimwi bululami bukkabe chipimyo. Chivulamabwe chiyokukulula machijilo azyakubeja, mpawo meenda miingi ayoobbizya busena bwakuyubila.
Chizuminano chenu chalufu chiyomwayika, alimwi lumvwanano lwenu aachikkalilo chabafu tachikwe kuyoyiima pe. Meenda makali nayoyinda, muyobbizigwa aangawo.
Kufumbwa naayinda, ayomubbizya, alimwi chifumo achifumo ayoyinda abuzuba amansiku ayosika. Makani namvwisisika, ayoyoosya.
Nkaambo bulo mbufwifwi loko kumuntu kutikuti alyolole, alimwi ndumba niniini loko kuli nguwe kuti alivumbe mukati.''
Jehova uyobuka mbuli aa Chilundu Pelazimu; uyolibusya mbuli Mumusena wa Gibbiyoni kuti abeleke mulimo akuuchita nchito yakwe nyenzu.
Nkinkaako linoobu mutaniaki pe, na zyaanzyo zyanu ziyojatisigwa. Ndakamvwa kuzwa ku Mwami Jehova wamakamu, makani akunyonyoona anyika.
Amuswilile akumvwa kujwi lyangu; amuchenjeke matwi akumvwa kumakani aangu.
Sena mulimi ulima buzuba boonse kuti abyale, ulima luuwa biyo? Sena ulendelela kupwayawulwa akukulula muunda?

Namana kubambila luwa, sena ngatamizi mbuto zyakwe ansi, kubyala nkuniini, kubika bulotwe mumifolo abbale mubusena bwelede, mpawo sipeluti kumagolelo aawo? (kuzibinkana kwatumwi tununkilizyo mukudoneekwa, aboobo nsandululo zisiyene ngazilaba abulembo busiyene bwatununkilizyo kwiinda awa. Mukuyungizya, nsandululo zimwi zyachiindi zipa bupanduluzi busiyene kukubika zyakasandululwa mu ULB mbuli muminchali amubusena bwelede, nkambo zibikwa eezi tazizibinkene pe, muchi Hebbelu).
Leza wakwe ulamululika ulamwiisya chabusongo.
Atalaazezyo, mbuto ya kkalawayi tayibbulwi achipozyo naba vwiili lyachingolo kukupwanda kkumini; pesi kkalawayi ipolwa amuvundo, alimwi kkumini amusako.
Nseke zilakwiilwa chinkwa pesi peepe kanantikana loko, alimwi nikuba mavwili achingolo chakwe amabbiza aakwe kazimwachuulwa, mabbiza aakwe tayipwayawuli pe.
Achilacho eechi chizwa kuli Jehova wamakamu, uugambya mululayo amubusongo bubotu.
Maawe kuli Aliyeli, Aliyeli, ooyo munzi Devidi ngwakakkede! Yungizya myaaka kumwaka, leka mapobwe abe afwifwi.
Pesi Ndiyopenzya, Aliyeli, alimwi uyolila akoomoka; mpawo kuli ndime uyoba mbuli Aliyeli.
Ndiyokkala akulangana anduwe kandikuzyungulukide akukusinkila alubaya, alimwi Ndiyobusya milimo yakukusinkila.

Uyobozegwa aansi akwambuula kuzwa mubulongo; ijwi lyako linooli ansi kuzwa mulusuko. Ijwi lyako liyomvwigwa mbuli muuya oyo wambuula kuzwa mubulongo, alimwi kuzwa mulusuko ijwi lyako liyovwiya - vwiya.
Mweelwe mupati wabasikukulwisya uyoba mbuli lusuko lunante mpawo makamu makamu abasiluuni ayoba mbuli buungu bupupuluka. Chiyochitika chakufwambana champawompawo.
Jehova wamakamu uyooza amuzuzumo, akuteketa kwanyika, kundindima kupati, atumbizi tupati, achivulamabwe, mpawo amabangabanga amulilo usyukuta.
Kuyooba mbuli chiloto, chilengano chamansiku: makamu makamu abantu boonse bayolwisya Aliyeli abasinguzu bakwe. Bayomulwisya aba sikumubayilila bamanikizigwe alinguwe.

Kuyoba mbuli muntu ulanzala naalota kuti ulikulya, pesi naasinsimuka, bula bwakwe tabukwe chintu. Kuyoba mbuli muntu ulanyota mbwalota kuti ulokunywa manzi asinsimuka ulikwizukide, anyota yakwe katagondedwe pe.Mbombubo, aboobo uyoba mweelwe mupati wazisi zyoonse ezyo zilwisya Chilundu cha Ziyoni.
Amuligambye lanu alimwi mugambilwe,; mulyofwaazye akofwaala! Amukolwe, pesi tensi mbote; mudadalike, pesi tensi kwabukande pe.
Nkambo Jehova watila muuya alindime wang'onzi zilubulula. Wajala menso anu, nobasinsimi alimwi wavumba mitwe yanu, nimubona.
Ziyubunuzyo zyoonse zyaba mbuli majwi abbuku eelyo linamatikidwe, ndibanga bantu balipa kuli umwi uyiide, kabamba kuti, nkaambo, lilinamatizigilwe.''
Naa bbuku lyapegwa umwi utabali, akwaamba kuti, ''Bala eechi, ulaamba kuti, ''Tandikonzyi kubala.''
Mwami wakamba kuti, ''Aba bantu baza afwifwi kulindime amilomo yabo akundilemya amulomo, pesi myoyo yabo ilikule andime. Lulemeko lwabo lwandime ndwamulayizyo biyo wabantu ooyo ngubakayiisigwa.

Nkaambo kaako, boona, Ndiyoyinkilila anembo kuchita chintu chibotu akati kabantu aaba, chigambyo kwayinda chigambyo. Busongo bwabantu babo bachenjezu buyoloba, mpawo akumvwisisisya kwabantu babo bachenjede buyoyangabila.
Maawe kuli baabo beezya kusisa makanze aabo anikide kuzwa kuli Jehova, alimwi milimo yabo ilimumudima. ''Balaamba kuti ngwani utubwene, mpawo ngwani uutuzi?''

Musandamuna zintu nkuzyali kujulu zyalanga aansi! Nkubona mubumbi ulabalwa mbuli bulongo, kuti chintu eecho chakapangwa chilaamba atala ayooyo wakachipanga, ''Tewakandipanga pe mebo,'''na chintu chibumbidwe chilakonzya kwamba atala ayooyo wakachibumba kuti, ''Tewakandibumba, takonzyi kuchimvwisisisya'''?
Mukati chiindi chinini, Lebbanoni uyosandulwa kuba muunda, mpawo muunda uyoba lusaka.
Mubuzuba oobo basinkematwi bayoomvwa majwi abbuku, alimwi menso a boofu bayobona kuzwa mumudima usiya mbii.
Bakadyamizizigwe bayokondwa lubo muli Jehova mpawo bachete bali akkati kabantu bayokondwa muli Uusalala wa Izilayeli.
Nkaambo siluuni wafwinsigwa, alimwi musampawuzi uyomana. Kuli aabo boonse bayandisya kuchita bubi bayogwisigwa,
Ooyo upa kuti muntu abe sikubisya aajwi. Balateya kakole kuli oyo uyandawula kululama kumulyango akukwendezya basalali ansi amanwa abuyo.
Nkaambo kaako mbubo mbwawamba Jehova aatala ang'anda ya Jakkobu - Jehova, wakavuna Abbulamu, ''Jekkobbu takoyofwa limbi bweeme, nobuba busyu bwakwe kuti buuse.
Pesi nabona bana bakwe, mulimo wamaanza angu, bayosaalizya zina lyangu. Bayosalazya izina lya Uusalala wa Jakkobbu akwiima mukuyoowa Leza wa Izilayeli.
Aabo baleya mumuuya bayojana kumvwisya, mpawo balengawuka bayoyiiya luzibo.''
''Maawe kubana bapapila,'' Oku nkwambuula kwa Jehova. ''Balachita mabambe, pesi taazwi kuli ndime; balatangaana buzolwani azisi, pesi tebakazulwidwa amuuya wangu, aboobo balayungizya chibi kuchibi.
Balalibambila kwiinka ansi mu Ijiputi, pesi tebabuzya kuzulwida kwangu pe. Balayandawula lukwabililo kuzwa kuli Falo akujana machijilo muchenzule cha Ijiputi.
Akambo kaako lukwabililo lwa Falo ayooba mawuse anu, amayubilo muchenzule cha Ijiputi, mawuse eenu,
nekuba kuti bwami bwabo buli ku Zoyani, aabatumwa basika ku Hanisi.
Boonse bayowusigwa nkambo kabantu abo batakakonzya kubagwasizya, pesi mawuse, aa naba kubula choolwe.''

Kwambula atala abanyama ba Negevi: kwiinda munyika yamakatazyo aalantenda, abana babalavu abalavu, bachipile anzoka zyuuluka ziyoosya, balabweza buvubi bwabo kumisana yambongolo, aabuvubi antunda yankamela, kubantu abo batabagwasyi.
Nkambo lugwasyo lwa Ijiputi talugwasyi; nkinkaako ndamuulika Lahabbu, oyo ukkala chakutazuungan.
Lino koya, lemba mubuliwo bwabo eebbwe, alimwi ukazilembe azilembelo, kuchitila kuti zikalondwedwe chiindi chichiza mbuli bumboni.
Nkambo aba mbantu bapapila, mbana babeja, mbana batakabule kumvwa malayilile a Jehova.
Balambila basimabibo, ''Mutaboni;'' aakuba sinsimi,'' Mutasinsimi kasimpe kulindiswe; wambuule mabala mabotu kuli ndiswe, ukasinsime ziboneka.
Pambuka kuzwa munzila, yeenda aanze aanzila; chita basalali ba Izilayeli bawumune kwaambula kunembo lyabusyu bwesu.''
Nkiinkako basalali ba Izilayeli balaamba, ''Nkambo mwakaka ijwi eeli alimwi mwasyoma mukusinikizigwa a mulweeno akuseyama alimbubo,
aboobo echi nchibi chiyoba kulinduwe mbuli chibeela chityokede chaamba kuwa, mbuli chitombe chili mubulambo bulamfu kuwa kwacho kulachitika champaawo mpawo, chakufwambaana.''
Uyochipwayula mbuli chilongo chamubumbi mbochipwayuulwa, aboobo tachikoyo janwi akkati kazibeela chimpanzi chaku zimya mulilo kuzwa kunsi achikko, nanka kutesya maanzi kuzwa munongo.
Ncheenchicho eecho Mwami Jehova, Musalali wa Izilayeli mbwaamba, ''Mukupiluka aa kulyokeezya kwenu kuyonunulwa; Mubuumuzi aa mukusyoma ziyoba nguzu zyanu. Pesi temwakayanda.
Wakati, pepe, nkambo tuyochija amabbiza,'Aboobo muyochija; alimwi tuyotanta amabbiza alaluno, áboobo abo bamutobela bayooba aaluno.
Chuulu chomwe chiyochija kukuyosya kwawumwi; kukuyosya kwabali musanu bayochija kusikila chimikizizyo chikabe mbuli kasamu kandembela atala lyachilundu, nanka mbuli ndembela atala lyakalundu.''
Lino Jehova ulikulindila kuba aluzyalo kuli ndime, nkiinkako ulilibambilide kumutondezya buuya. Aboobo Jehova ngu Leza wabululami; balilongezedwe boonse abo bamulindila.
Nkambo bantu bayokkala mu Ziyoni, mu Jelusalemu, alimwi tamukoyolila limbi. Zyanchonzyo uyoba aluzyalo kuli nduwe mukumvwika kwakulila kwanu. Eelyo nayomvwa, uyomusandula.
Nekubaboobo Jehova wamupa chinkwa chitakondelezyi amanzi amachise, nekuba kuti, muyisi wanu tayomuyuba limbi, pesi muyomubona mwiiyi wanu amenso anu nobeni.
Matwi anu ayomvwa ijwi kusule lyanu nkaliti, ''Eeyi njenzila, yakweenda mulinjiyo,'' Eelyo nimunyonena kululyo nanka elyo nimunyonena kuchimwensi.
Muyosofwazigwa zikozyanio zibezedwe chizilulwidwe ansiliva azikozyanio zifulidwe zyangolide. Muyozisowa kule mbuli zintu zisofwede. Muyozyambila, ''Kamuzwa aawa.''
Uyoopa mvula kumbuto zyanu eelyo nimuyobyala nyika, achinkwa mubwiingi kuzwa kunyika, alimwi zilyo ziyovula. Mubuzuba oobo ng'ombe zyanu ziyochela mumachelelo mapati.
Basune ambongolo, eezyo zifolola nyika, ziyoolya zilyo zyamwaka ezyo zyapupululwa afocholo achijikuuzyo.
Azilundu zyoonse zilamfu atulundu toonse tulamfu, kuyooba tusensa tukunka atulonga twamanzi, mubuzuba bupati bwakujaya eelyo maanda malamfu naawa.

Mumuni wamwezi uyoba mbuli mumuni wazuba, amumuuni wazuba uyomunikisya musanu atubili kwindilila, mbuli mumuni wazuba wamazuba musanu aabili. Jehova uyowanga kutyoka kwabantu bakwe alimwi akusilika kusensa kwazilonda zyabo.
Langa, izina lya Jehova lizwa kumasena alikule, ayaka alunyemo lwakwe abusi busiya mbii. Milomo yakwe izwide alunyemo,aalulimi lwakwe lulimbuli mulilo utentesya.
Kuyoya kwakwe kulimbuli kukkunka kwakalonga kazulisya ako katanwa munsingo, kamwaya zisi alunyonyooko lupati. Kuyooya kwakwe kuli mbuli luningo mumyeebo yabantu kuchita kuti bakabe basimutuntuli.
Uyoba alwiimbo mbuli mansiku eelyo ipobwe lisalala nililangisisigwa, aachakukondwa mumyoyo, mbuli elyo umwi nayinka amuteteele kuchilundu cha Jehova, ku Bbwe lya iIzilayeli.
Jehova uyochita bubotu bwajwi lyakwe likamvwikke akutondezya kweenda kwajanza mumuzuzumina walunyemo amabangabanga amulilo, ndiguwo pati, ndiguwo lyamvula, aachivulamabwe.
Nkambo kujwi lya Jehova, Asiliya iyojaligwa; uyobawuma amusako.
Yonse ngumyo itondekwa amusako oyo Jehova uyotandabikwa alimbabo akusindikilwa akukwila kwensaka atuntimbwa mbuli mbalwisya akulwana ambabo.

Nkambo busena bwakutentela bwakabambwa kaale amulilo aankuni nyiingi. Kuyoya kwa Jehova, mbuli kalonga kasalufa, iyokkazikwa amulilo.chiindi. I=Zyanchoonzyo, kuli bambilidwe baami, aa Leza wakabuchita kuti bunike aakukomena kwabusasa. Bbibi lilibambidwe kale

Maawe kulibaabo bayinka ku Ijiputi kuti bagwasigwe akuyaama kumabbiza, akusyoma kunkalaki (nkambo mbiingi) akuli basimabbiza (nkambo tababaliki pe). Pesi tabakwe makani pe atala awusalala wa Izilayeli, nekuba kuyandawula Jehova!
Lwakwe kalimusongo, alimwi uyoleta mapenzi akayotobelezya majwi aakwe. Uyobuka atala amaanda abasizibi abaabo bagwasya kuchita chibi.
Ijiputi talimuntu pe, mabbiza aabo ninyama buyo tuli muuya pe. Lino Jehova nayotandabika ijanza lyakwe, boonse aabo bagwasya bayoowa, ayooyo wakagwasigwa uyoowa; boonse bayoomana antomwe.

Mbuboobu mbwawamba Jehova kulindime, ''Mbuli mulavu, naba mwana wamulavu, mbwali kusule akudelula kwachakulya chakwe, nikuba inkamu yabeembeli yayitwa kukuzomulwisya, pele takankami kumajwi aabo, nikuba kuzwa kumajwi aabo akuyubilila; ngu Jehova muleli uyoselukila kuzolwana achilundu cha Ziyoni, aatala akalundu aako.
Mbuli bayuni bawuluka, Jehova wamakamu uyokwabilila Jelusalemu; uyokwabilila akuvuna nayoyinda atala acho akuchikwabilila.
Amupiluke kulinguwe kuli oyo ngumwakachija chakunika kule nobantu ba Izilayeli.
Nkambo mubuzuba oobo umwi awumwi uyogwisya baleza bakwe bansiliva abaleza bakwe bangolida ezyo maanza akwe mabi nzyakapanga.
Asiliya uyowinsigwa apanga; ipanga lyakatachitwa amuntu lyakamulya. Uyochija kuzwa kupanga, abalombe bakwe bayotola muchibbalo chiyumu.

Bayoswekelwa busichaamba nkambo kabuyoofu, amwana wamwami wakwe mulombe uyoyoowa kubusya kwankondo andembela zya Jehova -- mbuboobu mbwawamba Jehova -- ngonguwe uujisi mulilo mu Ziyoni achikko chakwe chili mu Jelusalema.''
Langa, mwami uyoyendelezya mubululami, amwana musimbi wamwami uyoyendelezya muluumuno.
Umwi awumwi uyooba mbuli mwenzuule kuzwa kuluuwo amayubilo kuzwa kuguwo, mbuli tulonga twamanzi mumasena ayuminide ayuminide, ambuli cheenzule champangala pati munyika yakakatazyo.
Eelyo amenso abaabo babona takoyosofwazigwa, amatwi, aababo bamvwa ayoswilizisya loko.
Mufubafuba uyoyenzya chamaanu achakumvwisisisya, asichibebeebe uyowambuula kabotu akuubilwa.
Mufubafuba tachikaambwi kuti mulemu, asikweena takoyowambwa kuti uliluleme.
Nkambo mufubafuba ulaambula zyabufubafuba, amoyo wakwe ulabamba chibi anchito zitakwe Leza, alimwi uwambula bubi aatala a Jehova. Uchita basinzala bamaninwe, abafwanyota babule chakunywa.
Inzila zyasilweeno nimbi. Ulayeezya makanze  abi kuti anyonyoone bachete amabejo, nikuba kuti muchete waamba ziluleme.
Pele muntu mulemu ulachita makanze aluleme; akaambo kamakanze malemu ulayima.
Amubuke, inywebo nobanakazi batalipenzyi akuswilila kujwi lyangu; nobasimbi batalipenzyi, amuswilile ndime.
Nkambo muchindi chifwifwi biyo kwiinda mwaka busichaamba bwenu buyomana, inywebo nobanakazi batalipenzyi, nkaambo kutyolwa kwamasansa kuyokachila, kubungika takukoyoosika.
Amukankame nobanakazi nimulyiibide; amulipenzye, inywebo nobasichaamba; amugwisye zikobela zyanu zibotu muchite chinswe; amusame zisamo zyamasaka muzibuno zyanu.
Muyowomoka kumyuunda iliwo, akambo kakuvula kwamasansa.
Anyika zyabantu bangu iyomena maamvwa amitubetube, nimuba moonse mumaanda akukondelwa mumuunzi wabusekelezi.
Nkambo ing'anda yamwami iyotakatwa, munzi abantu bayingi uyoba matongo; chilundu ang'anda zyakulangilila ziyooba malyango kwalyoonse, lukondo lwambongolo zyamusokwe, amachelelo abutanga;
mane muuya ukatilwe alindiswe kuzwa kujulu, elyo inkanda ikabe muunda uzyalisya, alimwi munda uzyalisya uyoyeeyegwa kuti ndusaka.
Lino lubeta lubotu luyokkala munkanda; abululami buyokkalailila mumuunda uzyalisya.
Milimo yabululami iyooba luumuno; ampindu yabululami, buumuzi abusichaamba kukabe kutamani.
Bantu bangu bayokkala muchikkalilo chaluumuno, mumyuunzi ikwabililidwe, amumasena awumwide akulinzinza akulyokezezya.
Nikuba chivula mabwe chatanda lusaka elyo chisi chiyofwinsigwa chakumaninina,
muyooba achoolwe nimuyobyala imbuto zyenu kumbali atulonga amuleke mawulu abasune amawulu ambongolo zilyendelele.
Maawe kulinduwe, sikunyonyoona wakatanyonyonwa! Maawe kuli sikwaaba nutana kwaabwa! Notakaleka kunyonyoona uyonyonyonwa ! Notakaleke kwaabwa, bayokwaaba lwako.
Jehova, tufwide luzyalo, bakuboko kwesu chifumo fumo; lufutuko lwesu muchiindi chakupengana.
Muzuzumo waatala bantu balachija, noyobuka, nyika zilimwayikide.
Zipambanikide zilabunganisigwa mbuli nsozi mbuzibungana, insozi mbuzisotooka, bantu mbubasotokela alinchicho.
Jehova ulisumpwidwe ukkala kubusena bwakujulu uyozuzya Ziyoni abululami abusalali.
Uyokkalila muzyiindi zyako, lufutuko lwiingi, busongo, alimwi aluzibo; kuyoowa Jehova mbuvubi bwakwe.
Laanga, batumwa balakwila munzila, basimaanu balangilila luumuno balakwiila chakuusa.

Nzila mpati bazisiya, tachikwe basikweenda. Zizuminano zyabo bazityola, basikamboni bakasampawulwa, alimwi bantu tabalemekwi pe. (zimwi nsandululo zyachiindi zyamapepa achi Hebbulu kuli bbala lyamyunzi, pesi echi chkabonwa abasikuyiya biingi kuti kunyongaana kwingi kwabbala lya Hibbulu kutegwa basikamboni, nkusandulula kwa ULB).

Nyika yomoka akupusama; Lebbanoni wawusa akupusama; Ibbala lyamba koomoka lilakonzya kubalwa kuti kuyuma lubo mabala abili a Hibbulu abalwa bukozyenie. Isaya 24:4 ulikozyenie, alimwi kalyamba kuyuma. Shaloni ulimbuli chilundu chatandabete, alimwi Bbasyani a Kkamelu batikinia maatu aabo.
''Kwalino ngandiyobuka na,'' mbwaamba Jehova; ''kwalino Ndiyosumpulwa kujulu; lino ndiyotansikwa.
Waminta buungu akuzyala makkuba, kuyoya kwanu kulimbuli mulilo utakamusyukute.
Bantu bayotentwa kusikila bakabe mbuli mulota, mbuli myumvwa mbwitemwa akutentwa.
Nywebo nimuli kule, muswilile nchindachita, alimwi, nywebo nimuli afwifwi, amuzibwe nguzu zyangu.''
Basizibi mu Ziyoni baliyowede, kukankama kwabajata bamwi batakwe leza. Ngwani akati kesu ukonzya kweenda amulilo uyaka lyoonse?

Ooyo uyeenda chakululama akwambula chakasimpe; oyo ukaka ujana mpindu yakudyamizigwa, oyo uzungania maboko akwe akukaka kutambula sinkamulomo, ukasya matwi aakwe kuzwa kukuswilila atala abasikujaya, alimwi ujala menso kuzwa kukubona bubi --
oyu ngomuntu uyokkala aatala, busena bwakwe kuyoba lubaya akkati atulundu, chakulya chakwe uyochipegwa, alimwi meenda aakwe takamani pe.
Menso anu ayobona Mwami mubwebesi bwakwe; bayobona nyika kulaale.
Myoyo yanu iyoyeeya chiyoosyo; ulikuli mulembi ulikuli wakeleka mali? Ulikuli ubala maanda malamfu?
Tochikaboni limbi bantu batukila, bantu bamwaambo mwenzu ooyo ngomutakonzyi kumvwa.

Mulange ku Ziyoni, muunzi wamapobwe eesu, menso aanu ayobona Jelusalemu mbuli bukkalo buumwide, tente eelyo litakabule kuyogwisigwa, aabo bali atusamu tutabi tutakabule kuyononkolwa nikuba kufumbwa lyakkole lyawo talikoyo dunsulwa.
Aboobo, Jehova mubupati uyoba andiswe, mubusena bwamilongo ikwezeme atunkubila. Takwe bwaato alimwi maato mapati ayozubuka.
Nkambo Jehova ngomubetesi wesu, ngosikupa mulawo, Jehova ngo Mwami wesu; uyotufutula.
Inkole zyenu zyakalitebede, tazikonzyi kujata kasamu mubusena; tazikonzyi kusanzabika dyembo; elyo zinyongeene zipati zyapambukana, nikuba zilema ziyokwela zipambanikide.
Bakkali tabakoyowamba kuti pe, ''Imebo ndachiswa;'' bantu abo bakkala nkuko bayolekelelwa nkambo kazibi zyabo.
Kamuboola afwifwi , nywe nomasi, akuswilila; amuswilile, inywe nobantu! Inyika azyoonse zizuzizye zyelede kuswilila, inyika azyoonse zizwa mulinjiyo.
Nkaambo Jehova wanyemena masi woonse, akubusya bukali atala lyabasinkondonyina; wakamana kubanyonyona, wakabaaba kukujayigwa .
Mitunta yabantu babo bafwide iyosowelwa aanze. Ibweema bwamitunta yabo buyoosalila koonse koonse; alimwi zilundu ziyozula bulowa bwabo.
Inyenyezi zyakujulu zyoonse ziyozima, ajulu liyopetwapetwa mbuli bbuku; anyenyezi zyabo ziyozima, mbuli matu mbaakunkumuka kuzwa kumusansa, alimwi mbuli nkuyu zyakabizya kwindila mbuziwa mumukuyu.
Eelyo ipanga lyangu nilyayonywa muchizuzikizyo chalyo kujulu; amulange liyoobola ansi aliIdomu, aatla lyabantu mbendabambila  lunyonyoko.

Ipanga lyaJehova lilokulokaloka bulowa alimwi lilivumbidwe amafuta, lilalikaloka bulowa bwambelele abwampongo lilivumbidwe amafuta aansa zyabagutu.Akako Jehova ulachipayizyo mu Bbozila akujaya kupati munyika yaIdomu.
Basune bamulusaka bayowisigwa antomwe ambabo, abapule banini antomwe abapati.Inyika yabo iyozula abulowa, alimwi lusuko lwabo luyonenesegwa amafuta.
Nkaambo liyoba zuba lyakuliya nkoto lyaJehova alimwi kuli munyaka nayobabwedezezya nkaambo kwakuchita kwaZiyoni.
