Tulonga twaIdomu tuyoochitwa mbuwa, lusuko lwakwe luyoba sulufa, alimwi nyika yakwe iyoba lubuwa luyaka.
Luyoyaka mansiku asikati; busi bwayo buyonyampuka kwalyoonse; kuzwa kuzyalani akuzyalani iyooba nyika itachikwe chintu; takwe pe utakayiinde mulinjiyo mane kukabe kutamani.
Pesi bayuni bamulusaka abanyama bayokkala nkuko; chipolo achikwangala ziyooyaka zintente mulinjiyo. Uyotandabika alinjiyo lutambo lwakweelesya tongo acheelesyo chalunyonyoko.
Bantu bakwe balemekeka tabakoyoochala achintu pe chiyoosyala chabwami, abana babaami balombe bayooba bantu biyo.
Maamvwa ayomena mumaanda aabo aabwami, minsamu yalusaka iyomena mumasena aabo ayakilidwe. Buyooba busena bwakukkala bamwaaba, busena bwampoo.
Banyama bamusokwe abasuntwe bayooswanana nkukoko, alimwi mpongo zyamusokwe ziyoolila imwi kunyenziina. Banyama beenda mansiku bayokkala nkukoko akulijanina busena   bwakulyookezezya.
Zipolo ziyooyaka ziteente, kunia akukonkola mayi aazyo, kukonkola akukwabilila bana bazyo. Iyi, oko bagumbe bayobungana, umwi amwenzinyina.
Amukalingulule mubbuku lyaJehova; takwe nechiba chomwe chazeezi chiyoobulika.Takwe chitakabule mwenzinyina pe; nkaambo mulomo wakwe wachilayilila, alimwi muuya wakwe  wazibungika.
Wakawumina nkakata masena aabo, alimwi janza lyakwe lyakiyeleka kuzwa kuli mbabo alutambo. Bayoyokona kwalyoonse; kuzwa kuzyalani akuzyalani bayokkala nkukoko.
Inkanda antomwe a Alabba ziyokondwa; alimwi inkanda iyosekelela iyosekelela akusyuuka.
Mbuli malubaluba, iyosyuuka mubwingi akusekelela chakubotelwa akwiimba; bulemu bwa Lebbano buyopegwa njiiyo, bwebesi bwa Nkemala a Syaloni; buyobona bulema bwa Jehova, bwebesi bwa Leza wesu.
Simya maboko matete, alimwi kosimya mazwi akankama.
Aamba kuli aabo bali amyoyo iyoowa, ''Muuyume, mutayoowi! Amubone, Leza wanu ulaza ankoto, abulumbu bwa Leza. Uyooza akumuvuna.''
Mpawo menso aboofu ayobona, amatwi abasinke ayoosinkuka.
Mpawo chilema chiyosotoka mbuli insya, asyataambi uyoyimba, nkambo maanzi ayowanzaana mu Alabba, akukunka munkanda.
Muse upya uyoba kaziba, alimwi inyika injumu iyokunka manzi; muzikkalilo zyabamwaba, oko nkubakalikulala, kuyoba masokwe ali amatete amalala.
Mugwagwa oyo Uyotegwa Ninzila Isalala. Basofwede tabakoyoyenda mulinjiyo. Pesi bayooba bakwe abo beenda mulinjiyo. Takwe bafubafuba beenda mulinjiyo.
Taakwe mulavu unoliwo, taakwe banyama bayoosya batanoli alinjiyo; tabakoyojanwa ooko, pesi banunwidwe mbibayoyenda ooko.
Banunwidwe ba Jehova bayoobola akuzabwiimba ku Ziyoni, alukondo lutamani luyooba amitwe yabo; kubotelwa akukondwa kuyobendelezya; buusu amapenzi ziyobatantamuka.
Mumwaka wakkumi ayine yamwami Hezekkiya, Senakkelebbu, mwami wa Asiliya, wakalwisya yoonse myuunzi ibayilidwe ya Juda akubajata.

Mpawo mwami wa Asiliya wakatuma silutwe waba silumamba mupati kuzwa ku Lachisi kusika ku Jelusalema kumwami Hezekkiya kali ampi mpati. Wakasika ambali kuziba lyakutala, munzila mpati iiya kusapilwa zizwaato, alimwi wakiima ambali lyalyo.

Basimilimo bapati ba Izilayeli bakazwa kunze kwamuunzi kuyowambuula ambabo bakali mwana wa Hilikkiya Eliyakkimu, mwendelezi wang'anda yamwami, Syebbina mulembi wamwami, alimwi amwana mulombe wa Asafu Jowa, oyo wakalembaansi mizezo yafulumende.
Silutwe mupati wampi wakati kulimbabo, ''Mwambile Hezekkiya kuti mwami mupati, mwami wa Asiliya, wamba kuti, ''Buzwa kuli busichaamba bwaanu?
Mwaambula biyo majwi atakwe mulimo, kamuti kuli lulayo anguzu zyankondo. Lino muli bani momusyoma? Oyo wamupa bukozu bwakundipapila?

Langa, mulasyomena mu Ijiputi, eecho chitete chabulembo nchimubelesya mbuli mufunko wakweenzya, pesi naa muntu wayaama alinchicho chiyonamatila mujanza lyakwe akuchiyasa. Mbombubo Falo mwami wa Ijiputi mbwabede kuli oyo usyoma mulinguwe.

Pesi naa wamba kuli ndime, ''Tulasyoma muliJehova Leza wesu,'' tenguwe na ulamasena abulemu azipayililo Hezekkiya nzyakabweza, alimwi wakamba kuti kuli Juda akuli Jelusalema, ''Mwelede kukomba kunembo lyachipayililo eechi mu Jelusalemu''?
Lino nkiinkaako, ndiyanda kumuchita mube chipayilo chibotu kuli simalelo wangu mwami wa Asiliya. Ndiyomupa zyuulu zibili zyambongolo, naa mulakonzya kujana basikuzitanta.
Mwali kukonzya biyeni kukazya nikuba omwe wabasilutwe muniini wabalanda basimalelo wangu? Mwabika lusyomo lwanu ku Ijiputi kunkalaki abasimbongolo!
Mpawo linoobu, tendaza aano na kanditakwe Jehova kuzolwisya nyika eyi akwinyonyoona? Jehova wakaamba kuti kulindime, ''Lwisya nyika eyi akwinyonyoona.''''

Mpawo Eliyakkimu mwana mulombe wa Hilikkiya, alimwi Syebbina, antomwe a Jowa bakaamba kuti kuli silutwe mupati, ''Ndakomba wambuula kubalanda bako mumulaka wachi Alamiya chi Alamayikki, nkambo tulachimvwa. Utaambuuli andiswe mumulaka wachi Juda mumatwi abantu bali aabulambo.''

Pesi silutwe mupati wakamba kuti, ''Sena simalelo wangu wandituma kuli simalelo wanu akulindinywe akwaamba majwi aya? Tewandituma kubaalumi bakkala abulambo, aabo bayolya mazyu aabo akunywa minsyu yabo andinywe?''
Mpawo silutwe mupati wakayima akoompoolola ajwi pati mumulaka wachi Juda, kawamba kuti, ''Amuswilile kumajwi amwami mupati, mwami wa Asiliya.
Mwami waamba kuti, 'Mutalekeli Hezekkiya amweene, nkambo takoyokonzya kumuvuna pe.
Mutakalekeli Hezekkiya amuchite kuti musyome muli Jehova, kawamba kuti, ''Jehova zyanchoonzyo uyotuvuna; muunzi uuno tukoyowabwa mujanza lyamwami wa Asiliya pe.''''

Mutakaswilili kuli Hezekkiya, nkambo nzeezi mwami wa Asiliya nzyaawamba: Mpawo luumuno ambebo akuza kulindime. Mpawo woonse wanu uyolya kumusiko wakwe mwini akuzwa kumukuyu wakwe mwini, alimwi kunywa akuzwa kumaanzi amukkala wakwe.
Muyochita echi kusikila ndikaze akumutola kunyika iilimbuli yanu nobeni, nyika yazilyo awayini mupya, nyika yachinkwa amyuunda yamichelo.
Mutalekeli Hezekkiya amusowe, kawamba kuti, Jehova ulatuvuna.' Kulumwi na wabaleza babantu wakabavunide kuzwa kujanza lya mwami wa Asiliya?
Balikuli baleza ba Sefalivayimu? Bakamuvuna na Samaliya kuzwa kunguzu zyangu?
Akkati kabaleza banyika eezi, kuli baleza na bakavuna nyika yakwe kuzwa kunguzu zyangu, mbuli Jehova mbwanga walikufutula Jelusalemu kuzwa kunguzu zyamgu?'''
Pesi bantu bakachaala kabawumwide akutasandula pe, nkambo mulayilo wamwami wakali kuti, ''Mutamusanduli.''

Mpawo Eliyakkimu mwana mulombe wa Hilikkiya, wakali mwendelezi wang'anda, Syebbina mulembi, antomwe a Jowa mwana mulombe wa Asafu, sikubweza makani, bakeeza kuli Hezekkiya azizwaato zyabo kazidelukide, alimwi bakasuma kuli nguwe majwi amwendelezi wabasilumamba mupati.
Kwakaba kuti eelyo Mwaami Hezekkiya naakamvwa mchaambyo chabo, wakadelula zisamo zyakwe, wakalivumba aazisamo zyamasaka, alimwi wakanjila wakanjila munganda yaJehova.
Wakatuma Eliyakkimu, wakali aatala aabasinganda, alimwi aSebbina mulembi, abapati baba payizi, boonse bakavumbidwe aazisamo zyamasaka, kuli Ayizaya mwana mulombe waAmozi, musinsimi.

Bakati kulinguwe, ''Hezekkiya ulaamba, 'Oobu buzuba mbuzuba bwakuusa, kukkalala, alimwi akufwisigwa nsoni, mbuli eelyo mwana mbwanga weelela kuzyalwa, pesi nyina nkatakwe nguzu zyakutumbuka mwana wakwe.

Kulaba kuti Jehova Leza wakouyoomvwa majwi aasilutwewabasinkondo, ooyo Mwaami waAsiliya simalelo wakwe ngwaatuma kusampawula Leza uupona, alimwi uyokkalalila majwi Jehova Leza wakwe ngaakamvwa. Lino nyampula nkombyo yako kuziche zicheede zichililwa.'''
Eelyo balanda baMwaani Hezekkiya bakaza kuli Ayizaya,
alimwi Ayizaya wakati kulimbabo, ''Kamwaamba kulisimalelo wanu: 'Jehova ulaamba, ''Utayoowi majwi ngwaamvwa, angawo balanda baMwaami waAsiliya ngibanditukila.
Langa, ndiyoobika muuya mulinguwe, alimwi uyoomvwa umwi mulumbe alimwi akubweeda kunyika yakwe. Ndiyomuchita kuti akawe apanga munyika yakwe.''''
Mpawo silutwe wabasinkondo wakaboola alimwi wakajana mwaami wa Isiliya nkalikulwanaaLibbina, nkambo wakali wamvwa kuti Mwaami wakali wiinka kuzwa kuLachisi.
Mpawo Senakkilibbu nakamvwa kuti Tinakka Mwaami wa Kkosi aIjiputi wakali wabambilila kulwana aanguwe, nkinkaako wakatuma batumwa lubo kuli Hezekkiya amulumbe:
''Mwaambe kuli Hezekkiya, mwaami waJuda, 'Utaleki Leza mulinguwe mosyoma akweene, akwaamba kuti, ''Jelusalema tikoyopegwa mujaanza lyamwaami wa Asiliya.''
Bona, wamvwa eezyo baami BaAsiliya mbubachita kunyika zoonse akuzimwaya kumaninide. Nkinkaako uyyovunwa na?
Baleza bamanyika babavuna na, manyika bamataata bangu ngibakamwaya: Gozani, Lezefu, alimwi abantu ba Edeni mu Teli Asa?
Ulikuli mwaami waHamati, mwaami waApadi, mwaami wamyuunzi yaSefavayimu, yaHena, alimwi Iva?
Hezekkiya wakalutambula lugwalo kuzwa mumaanza abatumwa alimwi wakalubala. Mpawo wakiinka kunganda yaJehova alimwi wakaluyala kunembo lyakwe.
Hezekkiya wakakomba kuli Jehova:
''Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, iwe nookkala aatala lyaChelubbimu, nduwe Leza olike aatala lya maani oonse anyika. WAakachita majulu alimwi anyika.
Chengunusya kutwi kwako, Jehova, alimwi uswiilile,. Jula meso aako, Jehova, alimwi ubone alimwi komvwa majwi aaSenakkalibbu, ngaakatuma kukuseka Leza uupona.
Ndisimpe, Jehova, baami ba Asiliya bamwayula zisi zyoonse alimwi amanyika aabo.
Babika baleza babo mumulilo, nkaambo teebali baleza pesi milimo yamaboko aabantu, biyo chisamu aabwe. Nkinkaako bama Asiliya bakabamwaya.
Kwalino, Jehova Leza wesu, tuvune kuzwa kunguzu zyakwe, nkokuti woonse maami aanyika akazibe kuti nduwe Jehova olike.''
Mpawo Ayizaya mwana mulombe waAmozi wakatuma mulumbe kuli Hezekkiya, kati, ''Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli ulaamba, 'Nkaambo wakomba kulindime aatala aSenakkalibbu mwaami waIzilayeli,
eelyo ndilyo jwi Jehova ndyawamba aatala anguwe: ''Nakalindu mwana musimbi waZiyoni ukulangila aansi alimwi ulakuseka kukunyemya; mwana musimbi waJelusalema ulateketya mutwe wakwe kulinduwe.
Ngwani wakabisya alimwi akutukila? Aatala yani nkwakanyampula ijwi lyako akunyampula meso aako mukulisumpula? Aatala lya Uusalala wa Isilayeli.

Abazike bako wabisizya Mwaami alimwi wati, 'Amakamu aankalaki zyamabbiza ndiinka kujulu kubulamfu bwazilundu, kubusena busumpukide loko bwaLebbanoni. Ndiyogonka misida yawo milamfu alimwi misamu misipulesi nkukooko, alimwi ndilonjila munyika zyabo zilikule zisumpukide, lusaka lwawo lulaamichelo.
Ndasya masawu alimwi ndanywa maanzi; Ndayuminizya yoonse milonga ya Ijipiti munsi lyazituta zyamawulu aangu.'
Teewakamvwa na mbundakachisugwaalila chiindi alimwi akuchibelekela muzyiindi zyakale? Lino ndikuchiinzilizya. Ulaano kuchita myuunzi iitanjiliki kuti ibe malwi aamatongo.
Bakkala mulinjiyo, balamanguzu mache, balizapwiidwe akuba aanson. Kuli misamu mumuunda, mweemvwe wamasokwe, masokwe ali akaluli naa mumuunda, kunembo lyaluuwo lwakujwe.
Pesi ndilizi kukkala kwako aansi, kwiinka kwako aanze, kuboola kwako mukati, alimwi akukalala kwako kulindime.
Nkaambo kakukalala kwako kulindime, alimwi nkaambo kanchiki zyako zyasika kumatwi aangu, ndiyobika kalobyo mumpemo yako, alimwi alubulo lwangu mukanwa lyako; njookubweedezya mbuli mbwaakaza.''

Eechi chiyooba chitondeezyo kuli nduwe: Muwaaka ooyu uyoolya chikomena mulusaka, alimwi mumunyaka wabili zikomena mumoomo. Pesi mumwaaka watatu  weelede kubyala akutebula, misaansa yamisamu alimwi ukalye michelo yayo.
Kampanzi kachede kanganda yaJuda kachipona kalooba aamwaanda alimwi kayozyala muchelo.
Nkaambo kuzwa kuJelusalema kampanzi kachipona kayoozwa aanze; kuzwa kuchilundu chaZion bakafutuka bayooza. Chiyandisyo chaJehova wamakamu chiyoochichita eechi.''''
Nkinkaako Jehova waamba eechi aatala amwaami wa  Asiliya: ''Takoyooza mumuunzi ooyu alimwi takoyowaala lunta . Takoyooza kunembo lyachi antibi naa kuyaka chitantilo kulinguwo.
Inzila njaza anjiyo inoli njiyo njaloyenda; takoyonjila mumunzi ooyu - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Nkaambo njovuna muunzi ooyu akuunununa, nkaambo kachiyandisyo changu achiyandisyo chaDevidi mulanda wangu.
Mpawo mungelo waJehova wakiinka aanze alimwi walwisya nkamba yaba Asiliya, nkajaya 185,000 basilumamba. Eelyo baalumi nibakabuka chifumofumo, mitunta yakalilede koonse koonse.
Mpawo Senakkalibbu mwaami wa Asiliya wakazwa muIsilayeli alimwi wakaya kumuunzi alimwi wakakukkala muNinive.

Kuzwawaawo, naakachili kukomba munganda yaNisilokku leza wakwe, bana bakwe balombe Adilameleki aSaleza bakamujaya apanga. Mpawo bakachijila munyika yaAlalati. Mpawo Esahadoni mwana wakwe mulombe wakeendelezya mubusena bwakwe.

Kumazuba ayo Hezekkiya wakachiswa akusika muchibela chakufwa. Aboobo Isaya mwana mulombe waAmosi , musinsimi, wakeza kuli nguwe, alimwi wakaamba kuli nguwe kuti, ''Jehova waamba kuti, 'Bamba ng'anda yako kabotu; nkaambo ulafwa, tukoopona pe.'''
Mpawo Hezekkiya wakachengulusya busyu bwakwe kubulambo akukomba kuli Jehova.

Wakaamba kuti, Ndakombelela, Jehova, yeeya mbundakeenda chakusyomeka kunembo lyako chamoyo wangu woonse, Kuli nduwe amoyo wangu woonse alimwi mbuli mbundakachita chakali chibotu kumeso ako. Mpawo Hezekkiya wakalila kapati.
Mpawo ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli Isaya kalyaamba kuti, ''

Koya ukaambe kuli Hezekkiya , silutwe wabantu  bangu. Eechi nchicho Jehova , Leza waDevidi sikale wanu nchawamba, wamba kuti : Ndayimvwa inkombyo yako , alimwi ndayibona misozi yako, Bona, ndaamba kuyungizya myaaka ili kkumi amusanu kubuumi bwako.
Mpawo ndiyovuna munzi oyu kuzwa mujanza lya mwami wa Asiliya, alimwi ndiyowukwabilila munzi oyu.
Eechi chiyooba chitondezyo kuli nduwe kuzwa kuli Jehova, kuti ndiyochita eezyo nzendakasyomezya.
Laanga, ndiyochita chenzule chachipimyo cha Ahazi kukubweda musule intamo zili kkumi''' Aboobo chenzule chakabweda musule antamo zili kkumi mpuchakali chasika.
Eyiyakali nkombyo yakalembedwe ya Hezekkiya mwami wa Juda, kuzwa mpaakali kuchiswa akuzoyumya:
''Ndakaamba boobu muchibaka kwiinda mubuumi bwangu Ndiyoyinda mumilyango yatbanda; Ndakatumwa nkuko kwamyaaka yangu yoonse.

Ndaamba kuti nsikoyomubona limbi Jehova, Jehova munyika yawumi; Nsichiyolanguuli muntu naa bakkali bamunyika. (balachakwambula amazyalane amunyika; Bapanduluzi bamazuba, basikale baba Hebbulu amalembe alamazyalane azilawo zitachizibinkene, nankakuti zizibinkene).

Buumi bwangu bwagwisigwa akutolwa kule kuzwa kulinduwe mbuli tente lyamweembeli; Ndakalambilila mebo buumi bwangu mbuli sikuluka; ulokundigonkoola kuzwa kubuumi bwangu; akkati kabuzuba amansiku ulikumansinsizya buumi bwangu.
Ndakalila kapati (ba Hebbulu bakachibikka boobu: 'ndakalila kapati; nanka ndakalyuumuzya lwangu) mane kusikila chifumofumo; mbuli mulavu natyolola mafuwa aangu woonse.
Mbuli kampembelezya kajwiila; Ndakavuta mbuli nziba; menso aangu akasika mpaakatala akulanga mujulu. Mwami, ndadyamizigwa; ndigwasye.
Ino njowaambanzi? Lwakwe wakambawula kuli ndime, tubili alimwi wakazichita; Njoyeenda mubuchebuche myaka yangu yoonse nkambo masukusyo, ngotumizya.
Mwami, masukusyo ngotumizya mabotu kuli ndime; wakabukulusya buumi bwangu akupona kabotu.
Chakali chakundijania mpindu kuti njiinde mumasukusyo aali boobu. Wakandivuna kuzwa mudindi lyalunyonyoko; nkaambo waksowa zyoonse zibi zyangu kusule lyako.
Nkaambo kabanda takwe pe nikayokulumba, lufu talukulumbayizyi pe; abo baselukila mudindi tabakwe bulangizi pe mukusyomeka kwako.
Muntu uupona, muntu uupona, nguukupa kulumba mbuli mbundachita buzuba oobu, ndeende ulazibya bana bakwe kusyomeka kwako.
Jehova waamba kundifutula, alimwi tuyopobola amayimbo kumazuba abuumi bwesu mungánda ya Jehova.''
Lino Isaya wakali waamba kuti, ''Mubaleke babweze chilwi chankuyu akuzibya, alimwi uyoponesegwa.''
Alakwe Hezekkiya wakali waamba kuti, ''Chitondezyaanzi chiyooba chakuti ndeende kweenda kuya ku ng'anda ya Jehova?''
Kuchiindi eche Maduku- Bbaladani  mwana mulombe wa Bbaladani, mwami waBbabbiloni, wakatuma mwagwalo achipo kuli Hezekiya; wakali wachiswa akupona.

Hezekiya wakakondezegwa azintu ezi; wakatondezya batumwa mung'anda yakwe yakulondweda zintu ziyandisi- insiliva, ingolida, tununkilizyo amafuta mabotu, ng'anda yakulondweda zilwanisyo zyakwe, azimwi zyoonse zyakali kujanika mumaanda akwe akulondweda. nekuba mubwami bwakwe, eecho Hezekiya nchatakwe wakabatondezya pe.

Mpawo Isaya musinsimi wakeza kumwami  Hezekiya aakumubuzya kuti, ''Niinzi balumi aaba nzibaamba kuli nduwe? Bazwida kuli? '' Hezekiya wakamba kuti, Bakeza kuli ndime kuzwa kunyika ilikule yaBbabbiloni.
Isaya wakabuzya kuti, ino ninzi nchibabona mung'anda yako?'' Hezekkiya wakasandula kuti, ''Babona zyoonse zilimung'anda yangu. Takwe pe akati kazintu zyangu ziyandisi ezyo nzindaba tondezya pe.
Mpawo Isaya wakaamba kuti kuli Hezekkiya, ''Swilila kujwi lya Jehova wamakamu;
Laanga, mazuba aamba kusika azyoonse mung'anda yako yamwami, zintu ezyo  zyabasikale nzibakalondola kusikila buzuba obuno, bayotolwa kuBbabbiloni. Taakwe chiyoosyala pe., mbwaamba Jehova.
Byoobweza bamwi balunyungu lwako, mbuyoyendelezya, alimwi bayooba beendelezi mung'anda yabwami bwamwami waBbabbiloni. '''
Mpawo Hezekkiya wakaamba kuti kuli Isaya, ''Ijwi lya Jehova ndwakaamba ndibbotu. ''Nkaambo wakayeya, ''kuyoba luumuno akuli kkalila mumazuba angu.''
''Wumbulizya, wumbulizya bantu bangu,'''mbwawamba Leza.
''Mwambuula kumoyo wa Jelusalemu; akwitilizya kuli nguwe kuti inkondo yakwe yamana, kuti bubi bwakwe bwajatilwa, kuti watambula tupetedwe kuzwa kujanza lya Jehova nkambo kazibi zyakwe zyonse.''

Ijwi lilawompolola, ''Mubambe nzila ya Jehova munkanda; muchite kululama mu Alabba nzila mpati ya Leza wesu.'' (zimwi nsandululo zyachiindi zyachikkiwa zilajwi liti wompolola munkanda litobela matayo 3:3)
Masena woonse ayosumpulwa, mpawo zilundu zyonse atulundu ziyofwinsigwa; alimwi nyika ipilingene iyochitwa kiluleme, mpawo masena alamagudugudu akabe ntandabale;
alimwi bulemu bwa Jehova buyoyubununwa, kuzwawo bantu boonse bayobubona kabali antomwe; nkambo Jehova wachaamba amulomo wakwe.
Ijwi lya Jehova lyamba kuti, ''Kwiila.'' Umwi asandule, ''Ndikwililenzi?'' ''Nyama yoonse mbwizu, achizuminano chabo chabusyomesi choonse chilimbuli dubaluba lyamumunda.
Bwizu bulanyana adubaluba lilapusama aluyoyo lwa Jehova niluunga alingawo; nkasimpe bantu mbwizu.
Bwizu bulanyana dubaluba lilapusama, pesi ijwi lya Leza wesu liyoyima kwalyoonse.''

Tanta atala achilundu chilamfu, Ziyoni, sikweeta makani mabotu. Kutalikwamba kuti kuya atala achilundu chilamfu, Ziyoni, sikweeta makani mabotu, (nsandululo zyasunu zijisi aya Webo noyeta makani mabotu ku Ziyoni, tanta atala lyachilundu chilamfu. Wompolola changuzu, Jelusalemu, wompolola makani mabotu. zimwi nsandululo zyasunu zijisi sikompolola makani mabotu ku Jelusalemu). Wamba kuti kumyunzi ya Juda, ''Ngoyu Leza wanu!''
Bona, Mwami Jehova ulaboola mbuli silumamba muzundi, alimwi janza lyakwe lilanguzu lilamwendelezya. Langa, bulumbu bwakwe bulanguwe, alimwi aabo, mbakanununa baleenda musule lyakwe.
Uyosanina butanga bwakwe mbuli mweembeli, uyobungika bana bambelele mujanza lyakwe, akubanyampula munsi lyachaamba chakwe, mpawo mbelele zinyonsya bana bazyo ziyo yembelwa obotu.
Ngwani wakeeleka manzi munkankamanza yajanza lyakwe, wakajata lusuko lwanyika lulimunsangwe, wakeeleka zilundu muchipimyo, naa tulundulundu muchipimyo?
Ngwani umvwisisisya miyeeyo ya Jehova, na kumulayilila mbuli sikulaya.
Nkulini nkwakatambula malayilile? Ngwani wakamusisya inzila ilikabotu yakuchita eezi, mpawo kumuyiisya luzibo, naa kumutondezya inzila yakumvwisisisya?
Boona, zisi zili mbuli intosi lilimugabba, mpawo libwezedwe mbuli lusuko luli achipimyo; langa, ulapima kasuwa mbuli kasyapu.
Lebbanoni takwe mafuta azulide, naaba banyama bayo bamusokwe tabazulide kuba chipayizyo chakuumpa.
Zisi zyoonse tazizulide kunembo lyakwe; zibezedwe mbuli takwe chiliwo.
Nkuliini nkonga ulezyanisya a Leza? Kuchikozyanisyonzi nchonga ulamwezyanisya?
Chikozyanisyo! Nchabeza mubezi: Mubambi wangolida wachizilulula ngolida akwifulila nketani yansiliva.
Kuchita chipayizyo umwi ulasala inkuni zitaboli; ulayanduula mubezi ujisi luzibo mukuchita chikozyanisyo eecho chitakabule kuwa.
Takukwe niwakaziba na? Takukwe niwakamvwa na? Takwe nwakabuzizigwe na kuzwa kumatangunino? Temwakamvwa na kuzwa kumatalikilo anyika.
Ngonguwe ukkede atala alubaya lwanyika; alimwi basikukkala kunembo lyakwe balimbuli insozi. Ulatambika majulu mbuli chisitikizyo. Ulayanika mbuli tente lyakukkala mumo.
Ulachesya beendelezi kuba biyo akuchita bendelezi baanyika batakwe makani.
Bakazikwa antanganana akubyalwa antanganana, chisiko chayo tachikwe nichinikide miyanda munyika, eelyo naa wawunga alimbabo mpawo balapusama, alimwi muuwo wabapupulula mbuli buungu.
Elyo nkulini nkonga ulandelanisya andime, ngwani ngwendikozyania awe? Mbwawamba Umwi Uusalala.
Mulange mumulengalenga! Ngwani wakalenga nyenyeezi zyoonse ezi? Ulasolweda basilumamba akubayita boonse amazina. Abupati bwanguzu zyakwe amunina wanguzu zyakwe, takukwe nikuba umwi uswekede.
Nkamboonzi nwamba, Jakobbo, mpawo nkamboonzi noluula, Izilayeli, kuti, ''Inzila yangu ilisisikene kuzwa kuli Jehova, alimwi Leza wangu takwe nchakwiila atala alubeta lwangu?''
Tewakaziba na? Tewakamvwa na? Leza uutamani, Jehova, mulengi amagolelo aanyika, takatali tawizuuki; takwe majinkilo mukumvwisya.
Ulapa nguzu kubakatede; akubakompeeme ulapa nguzu zikubukulusidwe.
Nibaba bakubusi balakatala akwizuuka, abakubusi baalumi balalebwa akuwa:
pesi kuli baabo balindila Jehova bayobukuluka kunguzu zyabo; bayowuluka amababa mbuli nkwazi; bayochijaana mpawo tabakoyokkatala pe; bayoyenda akutakkatala.
''Ngamumune kunembo lyabusyu bwangu, inywebo nozisi zyakunkomwe yalwizi; misyobo yabantu ibukulusye nguzu zyabo; mubaleke baswene kufwafwi akwambuula, atuswene afwifwi toonse kukubeteka makani.

Ngwani ubusya uumwi uzwa kujwe, kumwiita kubululami kumulimo wakwe?  Ulaaba minyaka mumaanza aakwe alimwi ulamugwasya kuti abe mwendelezi wabaami. Ulabaabila ipanga lyakwe mbuli lusuko, mbuli buungu kunembo lyabuta bwakwe.
Ulaya bubotelwa alimwi uliinda kabotu, anzila itanza yindwa njatola mawulu akwe.
Ngwani wakabeleka akuchita milimo iliboobu? Ngwani wakayita mazyalani oonse kuzwa kumatalikilo? Ndime, Jehova, mutanzi, akumamanino, Ndime ngonguwe.
Inyika zyakunkomwe zyalwizi zyakabona akuyoowa; Magolelo aanyika akakankama; Bakaswena afwaafwi akusika.
Umwi awumwi wakagwasyania abenzinyina, alimwi umwi mubezi wakambila mwenzinyina kuti, ''Koyuma.'
Aboobo mubezi wakayumya mufuzi, alimwi oyo ubilingania ansando wakagwasizya sikuuma achifulo, wakamba akufula kuti, ''Nchibotu.' Bakachikankamina amanembe kuti chitasunzuluki.
Pesi iwebo, Izilayeli, mulanda wangu, Jakkobbo ngwendisalide, lunyungu lwa-Abbulahamu muzolwani wangu, ,
Imebo ngundakajata kuzwa kumagolelo anyika angundakayita kuzwa kuzyooko zyayo, kukwambila kuti, nsikukakide oe.
Utayoowi, nkambo ndilayebo. Utakankami, nkambo ndime Leza wako. Njokuyumya, alimwi njokugwasya, alubo njokutabilila ajanza lyangu lyalulyo lyabululami bwangu.
Boona, boonse bayowusigwa insoni abweeme, aboboonse bakakubikilila; Boonse bayooba chintu biyo alimwi bayonyonyoonwa, aabo bakazyania anduwe.
Uyobayanduula akutabajana aabo basikwambana anduwe; Abo bakubusizya inkondo bayooba chintu biyo, nchobeni nchintu biyo.
Nkambo Imebo, Jehova Leza wako, Njokwambilila kuti, 'Utayoowi; Ndime sikukugwasya.'
Utayoowi,  Jakobo webo nochiyokaansi, alimwi anywebo nobantu ba Izilayeli; Ndiyokugwasya -- mbwawamba Jehova, Mumuni wako, Uusalala wa Izilayeli.
Bona, Imebo ndakubikka kuti ubembuli chipoozyo chipya chijisi meno, chipya amamanino aabili; uyopola zilundu akuzipyachuula; uyochita tulundulundu mbuli buungu.
Uyoziseba, alimwi muuwo uyozitola; kambizi kayozimwayisya. Uyosekelela muli-Jehova, kutembawula Uusalala wa Izilayeli.

Batengwana abachete ba layanduula maanzi, pesi takwepe, alimwi indimi zyabo zyayuminina nkambo kanyota; Mebo, lwangu ndi Jehova, ndiyobavwiila kunkombyo zyabo; Mebo, ndi-Leza wa-Izilayeli nsikoyo balekelezya.
Ndiyotuntumusya milonga aatala lyazilundu zikukwidwe muuwo, amwalo mumakkuti; Ndiyosandula inkanda kuba iziba lyamanzi, alimwi nyika injumu iyooba tusensa twamanzi.
Mukati kenkanda ndiyomeneka minsamu ya Sida, ayamuunga, ayamisowe ayamafuta. Ndiyomeneka minsamu yaku Sayipulesi mukati kankanda, amisikili amizimbwa yoonse antomwe.
Ndiyochita eechi kuti bantu babona, akuziba, akubikka myoyo yabo kumakani, kuti janza lya-Jehova ndilyachita oobo, kuti Uusalala wa-Izilayeli nguwakazilenga.
''Ngamweete makani aanu,'' mbwawamba Jehova, ''Amulete bukamboni bwamituni,'' mbwawamba Jehova wa-Jakkobbo.

Baleke beete makani atulwiida kuti ziyoboneka; mube aabo kunembo lyanu akwaamba kuli nduwe zintu zitachitike, kuti toonse tuzibe zintu eezi kabotu. Batwambile tulangilila kwachiindi anzibakaamba, kuti tuyibaluke kulingawo akuziba mbwatakazuzikizye.
Ngamutulwiide makani achiza, kuti tuzibe kuti muliba-Leza; Amuchite makani naaba mabotu naaba mabi, kuti twabone akugamba.
Bona, nywebo nozikozyanio muli zintu biyo amilimo yenu tiikwe chintu; oyo umusala ulasesemya.
Ndabusya umwi uzwa kunyika, alimwi wasika; kuzwa kujwe ulalemeka izina lyangu, alimwi uyolyatawula basilutwe mbjuli butope, mbuli mubumbi mbwakkanda bulongo.
Ngwani wakalungulula makani kuzwa kumatalikilo, kuti twazibe? Musule acheechi chiindi, kuti twaambe, ''Ulikabotu''?Nchobeni takwe ulungulula, iyi, taakwe uuswilila majwi aanu,
Ndakatanguna kwambila Ziyoni kuti, ''Bona awa mpaabede,'' Ndime ndakatuma sikuleta makani ku-Jelusalemu.
Kuti ndalanga, takwe muntu pe, taakwe sikulanga akkati kabo ukkonzya kupa makanimabotu, ngwani, kuti ndabuzya, ulakonzya kusandula ijwi.
Bona, boonse mbabuyo, alimwi milimo yabo tiikwe makani; zikozyano zyabo zifulidwe nzyamuuwo biyo alubo tazikwe chintu.
Amubone, mulanda wangu, oyo ngwendisalide; musale wangu, mulinguwe ndilakondwa. Ndabikka Muuya wangu aalinguwe; uyoyeta kululamikwa kuzisi.
Takoyolila chakoompolola, nikuba ijwi lyakwe kumvwikka munzila.
Itete litifukide takoyolityola, akamuni kasuka takoyokazima: Uyosyomezya kweta bululami.
Takoyokomena loko pe nikuba kulangilwa ansi kusikila akeete bululami munyika; azilazyo nyika zyakunkomwe zyalwizi ziyolindila milawo yakwe.
Mbuboobu mbwawamba Leza Jehova - ooyo wakalenga majulu akwakomezya, ooyo wakalenga nyika azyonse nzyugusya, oyo upa kuyoya kubantu alinjiyo alimwi a buumi kuli baabo bakkala mulinjiyo.
''Imebo, nde Jehova, ndakamwitila mubusalali alimwi njojatilila kuboko kwenu. Ndiyomubamba akubikka mbuli chizuminano chabantu, mbuli mumuni wabamasi,
kujula menso aboofu, kwangununa baangidwe kuzwa muntolongo ilikunsi aanyika, alimwi kuzwa mukujalilwa mung' anda kwabaabo bakkede mumudima.
Ndime Jehova, ndendilyo izina lyangu; alimwi bulemu bwangu nsikoyo bwabana awumbi nikuba kutembawula kwangu azikozyanio zibezedwe.
Bona, zintu zyachiindi zyamba kwiinda, lino ndaamba kwaamba zichitiko zipya. Kabatana kukkala ndiyokwambila atala ambabo.''
Mwimbile Jehova alwimbo lupya, alimwi kutembawulwa kwakwe kuzwa kumagolelo anyika; webo nonyika aansi kulwizi, alimwi azyonse ezyo zili mulindulo, nyika zyakunkomwe, mpawo ezyo zikkala mukati.
Muleke nkanda amyunzi zilyite, magunzi Kkeda nkwakkala, moompolole chakubotelwa. Muleke bakkali baku Sela biimbe; muleke boompolole kuzwa ajulu azilundu.
Muleke bape bulemu kuli Jehova alimwi baambe ntembwuzyo zyakwe munyika zyanu mukati kankomwe.
Jehova uyoyinka aanze mbuli silumamba; mbuli mwalumi wankondo, uyobusya busungu bwakwe. Uyowompolola, iiyi, uyovulumina kulila kwankondo yakwe; uyotondezya basinkonyina inguzu zyakwe.
Ndakawumuna lwachiindi; Ndakachiliwo alimwi akuli simyasimya lwangu; lino ndiyolila mbuli mwanakazi utumbuka; Ndiyoya akufwambana.
Ndiyobikka zilundu zitakwe lugwasyo pe atulundu akuyumya lusaka lwabo loonse; alimwi ndiyolanzya milonga mutusuwa akuyuma masensa.

Ndiyoyeta boofu anzila ezyo nzibatezi pe; munzila ezyo nzibatazi kuti ndiyobazulwida. Ndiyosandula mudima kuba mumuni kunembo lyabo, mpawo akululamika masena ataluleme akalulame. Ezi zintu ndiyozichita alimwi nsikoyozileka pe.
Bayolanzigwa musule, aboobo bayofwisigwa bweeme, abo basyomasyoma zikozyanio zibezedwe, abo kuti kuzikozyanio zyalubulo zifulidwe, ''Ndinywe baleza besu.
Amuswilile, nobasinkematwi; alimwi mulange, nywebo noboofu, kuchitila kuti mubone. Ngwani utaboni pesi kali mulanda wangu? Nanka musinkematwi mbuli mutumwa wangu ngwendituma?
Ngwani moofu ulimbuli mwenzuma wachizuminano, naba moofu mbuli mulanda wa Jehova?
Ubona zintu zyiingi, pesi tozimvwisisyi; matwi alijulikide pesi takwe uswilila.
Zyakabotezya Jehova kuti ngatembawulwe bululami bwakwe akuchita mulawu wakwe kuti ube abulemu.
Pesi aba mbibantu bakabba alimwi akusala; boonse balichedwe mumalindi, balibikidwe mubuzike muntolongo; bakaaba zisale zitakwe ubavuna pe, alimwi takwe uumwi uwamba kuti, 'Mubabozye baboole!''
Ngani akkati kanu uyoswilila eechi? Akuswilila akumvwa muchiindi chiza.

Ngwani wakaaba Jakkobbu kubafumpi, alimwi ngwani wakaaba ba Izilayeli kuli babasikubuta? Sena takali Jehova, zilwisyania ayooyo ngutwakabisizya, ulanzila azibaka bakaka kwendela, alimwi ulamilawu njibakakaka kusyoma?
Nkinkaako wakatila bukali bwakwe buyoosya alimbabo abukali bwankondo, mabangabanga aabo akabazyunguluka, pesi tebakamvwisisya pe; wakabuuma, tebakazibikkila moyo pe.
Pesi lino echi nchicho Jehova nchawamba, oyo wakakulenga, Jakobu, alimwi oyo wakakubumba, Izilayeli: ''Utakankami, nkaambo ndakakunununa ndakakwita azina lyako, uliwangu.
Notakayinde akkati kamanzi, ndinoli anduwe, alimwi akkati kamilonga, tokoyozundwa pe. Notakeende akkati kamulilo tokoyo wumpwa pe, alimwi mabbalabala takoyokunyonyoona pe.
Nkambo ndime JehovaLeza wako, Uusalala wa Izilayeli, mufutuli wako. Ndakapa Ijipiti mbuli chinunuzyo chako, Kkusyi a Syebba muchibaka changu.
Mbuli kuti ulimwebesi abubotu mumenso angu, Ndilakuyanda, nkinkaako ndiyopa bantu muchibaka chako, alimwi bamwi bantu muchibaka chabuumi bwako.
Utakayoowi, nkambo ndilayeebo, ndiyoyeta lunyungu lwako kuzwa kujwe, alimwi ndiyomubungania kumbo.

Ndiyowamba kuti kunyika, bapede mumaanza abambi;'  alimwi akumbo, 'Utakabwedezyi naba umwi;' Ndiyowamba kuti kunyika, ''Bapede mumaanza abaambi, akumbo, utakabwedezyi nikuba.'' Mweete bana bangu balombe kuzwa kule, alimwi bana bangu basimbi kuzwa kuzilikiti zyanyika,
woonse oyo uyitwa azina lyangu, oyo ngundakalenga nkambo kabulemu bwangu, oyo ngundakabumba, iyi, oyo ngundakapanga.
Mweete bantu boofu, nikuba abali amenso, abasinkematwi, nikuba bali amatwi.

Zyonse zisi zilabungana antomwe alimwi bantu balabungana. Ngwani akati wakamba echi akwambilizya kulindiswe zintu zyakachitika lutanzi? Abalete bakamboni babo kuti balitondezye amubaleke baswilile akuzumina, 'kuti nkasimpe.'

Mulibakamboni bangu, ''Mbwamba Jehova.'' alimwi mulanda wangu oyo ngundakasala, kuchitila kuti mukazibe akusyoma mulindime akumvwisisisya kuti Ndime.  Kunembo lyangu tekwakalikwe baleza babumbe alimwi takukoyoba naba umbi kusule lyangu.
Mebo, Ndime Jehova, alimwi takwe umbi muvuni pesi lwangu.
Ndakamba, ndafutula, alimwi ndakaluula, alimwi takwe umbi Leza akati kanu. Nywebo mulibakamboni bangu,'' Mbwawamba Jehova, '''Ndime Leza.
Kuzwa kubuzuba oobo ndendime, alimwi takwe uyovuna naba umwi kuzwa mujanza lyangu. Ndilachita, alimwi ngwani uyochijosya musule?''

Echi nchicho nchawamba Jehova, Mununuli wanu, Musalali wa Izilayeli: ''Nkambo kandinywe Ndilatuma ku Bbabbiloni akubazulwida boonse ansi mbuli zintu biyo, kubwedezya ba Bbabbiloni kubupanduluzi bwakubotelwa kunyimbo zyakulila.
Ndime Jehova, Uusalala wanu, Mulengi wa Izilayeli, Mwami wanu.''
Echi nchicho Jehova nchawamba (wakajula nzila akati kalwizi anzila akati kamanzi agambya
wakazulwida nkalaki amabbiza, impi abasilumba bakawa ansi antomwe tabayobuki limbi; bakayaka mbuli mulilo wabubi.)
''Utakayeyi atala azintu zyachindi ezi, na kuyeya zintu zyachindi loko.
Langa, ndamba kuchita zintu zipya; lino ziyotalika kuchitika; tuzibwene na? Ndiyochita mugwagwa muchilundu amanzi miingi muchimpayuma.
Banyama bamusokwe bamunyunda bayondilemeka, bamwaba aa mpoo, nkambo ndipa manzi mucimpayuma, amilonga munkanda, kuti basale banywe,
bantu aba mbindakalilengela, kuti bakabale lubo kulumbayizya kwangu.
Pesi temwandita pe, Jakobo, wakakatala akambo kangu, Izilayeli.
Tewandetela pe kufumbwa mbelele zyako mbuli zipayizyo zyakutenta, nakundileka azipazyo zyako. Tendakakupa mukuli wazipayizyo zyazilyo na kundikatazya akuyanda tununkilizyo.
Twakandetela bwema- bubotu amali, nikuba kunditila mafuta azipayizyo, pesi wakandipa mukuli azibi zyanu, wandipenzya azibi zyako.
Imebo, iiyi, Imebo, ndime oyo umana milandu yanu; alimwi tandikoyomwita kuti ndikayeye milandu yanu.
Mukandibalusye kuli zyakachitika. Tukakazyanie toonse, mukambe mbuzibede, kuchitila kuti mukaboneke kuti tamukwe chibi.
Wuuso mutanzi wakabisya, alimwi bayiminizi benu bakandibisizya.
Nkikako ndiyosofwazya basimilimu basalali; ndiyopedekezya Jakobo kuti akajayigwe alimwi Izilayeli akajatwe chamawuse.''
Kwalino swilila, Jakkobo omubelesi wangu, a Izilayeli, ngundasala:
Mbuboobu Jehova mbawamba, nguwe wakakuchita akukubumba mwida alimwi ngutakakugwasye: ''Utayoowi, Jakkobo omubelesi wangu; ayebo Jesuluni, ngundasala.
Nkambo Ndiyotila maanzi aanyika ilanyota, atulonga tukunka anyika njumu; Ndiyotila muuya wangu kubana bako azilongezyo zyangu kuzyalane lyako.
Bayonyampuka mukati kamasokwe, mbuli misamu imena kumbali lyatulonga twamanzi.
Umwi ulamba kuti, 'Ndili wa Jehova,' alimwi umwi ulyita zina lya Jakobo, alimwi umwi ulalemba mujanza lyakwe 'Kuba wa Jehova,' alimwi alyuzike muzina lya Izilayeli.''
Mbuboobu Jehova mbwawamba--Mwami wa Izilayeli amufutuli wakwe, Jehova muleli: ''Ndime mutanzi, alimwi Ndendime mamanino; alimwi takwe umbi Leza pesi mebo.
Ngwani ulimbuli ndime? Ngaachambilizye apandulule kuli ndime mabambe akachitika kuzwa nindakalenga bantu bangu bensiku, alimwi mubaleke baambilizye mabambe ayobuza.
Utayoweli na kuyoowa. Tendakazyamba na kulindinywe chindi loko, akuchaamba? Nduwe kamboni wangu: Kuli Leza na kunze kwangu? Takwe limbi bbwe; Takwe ngwendizi pe.''
Zyonse zibumbwa zyankombyo nzyabuyo; zintu muzibotelelwa tazikwe muulo; bakamboni babo tababoni kana kuziba chintu, alimwi bayobikwa mumawuse.
Ngwani uunga wabumba Leza nanka kweeta chibumbwa leza chitakwe muulo?
Boona, boonse mbalyidilana aabo bayobikkwa mumawuse; Babezi mbaalumi biyo. Mubaleke babweze busena bwabo antoomwe; Bayoba zyoombe alimwi bakabikwe mumawuse.

Mufuzi ubeleka azibelesyo zyakwe, kuchibumba, kubeleka kwiinda na makala. Ulachibumbuzizya ansando akuchibeleka akuboko kwakwe kusimine. Uli anzala, alimwi nguzu zyakwe zilongelwa; tanywi manzi alimwi ulazilika.

Mubezi weela chisamu chakwe akakole, alimwi uchibika impa acheengo. Uchipa chiimo azibelesyo zyakwe akuchibikwampa antondeka-mweelo. Uchipa chiimo chamuntu, mbuli muntu weebeka, kuchitila kuti chikonzye kukkala mung'anda.
Utema kawisya minsamu, na kusala muzwaganzi kana mukusu. Ulalibwezela misamu mulusaka. Ubyala musamu mukulambila alimwi imvula ilukomezya.
Mpawo muntu wuubelesya kukunka mulilo akulikasazya. Mbombubo, uyasya mulilo akujisya chibunge. Mpawo wachita leza kuzwa kulinchicho akuchifugamina; uchita chileza bubumbe akuchikotamina mubulemu.
Utenta chimwi chimpanzi chachisamu kakunka mulilo, kayoka nyama yakwe aalinguwo. Ulalya akakkuta. Ulalikasazya akwaamba kuti, ''Aah, Imebo ndakasalilwa, Ndalibonena mulilo.''
Zimwi zisamu wakazibelesya kuchita leza, chikozyanisyo chakwe chakubeza; wachikotamina akuchipa bulemu, akukomba kuli nchicho kawamba kuti, ''Ndivune, nkambo nduwe leza wangu.''
Tabazi pe, nikuba kumvwisisya, nkambo menso aabo mawofu alimwi takonzyi kubona pe, alimwi myoyo yabo nikuba kujatana tayiyeyeli.

Takwe uyeeya nikuba kujatana akwamba kuti, ''Ndatenta chimwi chimpanzi chazisamu mumulilo; iiyi, alimwi ndajika chibunge amakala aazyo. Ndayoka nyama amakala ndalya. Lino chimwi chimpanzi chazisamu ndichite chimwi na chisesemya kukukomba? Ndikotamine ansi kuchitanda chachisamu?''
Kubanga mbuli wali kulya dyota; moyo wakwe weenedwe ulamusowesya. Takonzyi pe kulivuna, nikuba kwamba kuti, ''Eechi nchintu chili mujanza lyangu lyachilisyo nguleza wakubeja.''
Yeeya zintu ezi, Jakobo, a Izilayeli, nkambo ulimubelesi wangu: Izilayeli, nsikoyokuluba pe.
Ndasitika, mbuli jobademu, inchito zyako zyabutaka, alimwi mbulijoba, zibi zyako; boola kuli ndime, nkambo nddakufutula webo.

Yiimba, iwebo nomajulu, nkambo Jehova wachita oobu; tambwizya, iwebo nobunike bwaanyika. Mumwayikizyanie mukwimba, inywe nomalundu, iwe nolusaka luli amisamu yoonse; nakmbo Jehova wafutula Jakobu alimwi uyotondezya busalali bwakwe mu Izilayeli.
Mbuubo bu mbawamba Jehova, mufutuli wako, ooyo wakakubumba kuzwa mwida: ''Ndime Jehova, wakachita zyoonse, wakatandabika imajulu aalike, wakebesya nyika.
Imebo nesukusya businsimi bwababeji abawusya aabo baboola businsimi; Imebo nenzunda busongo bwabasongo akufubazika nchenjezyo yabo.

Imebo, nde Jehova, wakasinizya majwi amubelesi wakwe alimwi kagozya inzumbuuzyo zyabatumwa bakwe, uwamba zya Jelusalemu, nkwayokkala, ázyamadolopo aaku Juda, Áyoyakwa lubo, alimwi Ndiyobusya matongo aabo';
uwamba kubunike bwalwizi kuti, 'Yuminina, alimwi Ndiyoyumya bulongalonga bwako.'
Jehova nguwamba zya Sayilasi, 'Ngomwembeli wangu, uyochita yoonse mpeekezyo yangu; uyozibisya aatala a Jelusalemu, uyoyakululwa, 'alimwi aatala achikombelo, 'Muleke ntalisyo yayo iyakwe.'''

Ncheechi nchaamba Jehova kumunanike wakwe, kuliSayilasi, ooyo ngundijisi jaanza lyalulyo, kuchitila kuti tukabweze zisi kunembo lyakwe, kunyanga nguuzu baami, alimwi ukajule makoma kunembo lyakwe, kuti milyango ikachaale kijulikide:
''Ndiyoyiinda kunembo lyako akumwaya zilundu; ndiyotyoloola makoma amukuba muzipanzi akugonkoola masimbi aazyo,
alimwi ndiyomupa zintu ziyandisi zyakumudima abuvubi busisidwe, kuti ukazibe kuti ndime, Jehova, ooyo ukwiita azina lyako, imebo, Leza waIzilayeli,
Akaambo kaJakkobo mulanda wangu, alimwi Izilayeli musale wangu, ndakakwiita azina lyako, kandikupa chuuno chabulemu, nekuba teewakalina kundiziba.
Ndime Jehova, alimwi takukwe uumbi; takukwe Leza pesi mebo. Ndiyokuyumya kunkondo, nekuba kuti tewalindizi;
kuti bantu ngabalandiziba kuzwa kukuzwa kwazuba, alimwi kuzwa kumbo, kuti takukwe Leza pesi mebo: Ndime Jehova, alimwi takukwe uumbi.
Ndilachita mumuni akulenga mudima; ndilaleta luumuno akuchita lunyonyooko; ndime Jehova, uuchita zintu zyoonse eezi.

Nywebo nomajulu, amuwisye mvula kuzwa kujulu! Muleke mulengalenga uwisye bululami. Muleke nyika ibuswimpe kuti lufutuko lusyuuke, alimwi bululami busyuuke aantomwe andulo. Mebo ndeJehova nindakabalenga boonse.

Maawe kuli ooyo uukazyania ayooyo wakamupanga, kuli ooyo ulimbuli chimwi chilongo chabulongo aakati kazilongo zili munyika! Bulongo bulaamba na kulisikubumba, 'Niinzi nchuliikupanga?' naa 'Mulimu wako tuujisi mikoba aalinchicho?
Mawe kuli ooyo wamba kuti kuliwisi, 'Niinzi nchweendelezya?' naa kumwanakazi, ''Niinzi nchulizyalila?'
Ncheechi Jehova ncaamba, Uusalala waIzilayeli, Mulengi wakwe: 'Nkamboonzi ulabuzya mibuzyo aatala  anchiyoochitila bana bangu? Ulandambila na chakuchita cheendelana amulimu wamaanza aangu?'
'Ndakapanga nyika akulenga muntu aalinjiyo. Akali maanza aangu akakomezya majulu, alimwi ndakalayilila nyenyezi zyoonse kuti ziboneke.

Ndakasukutizya Sayilasi mubululami, alimwi ndiyobamba kabotu nzila zyakwe zyoonse. Uyooyaka munzi wangu; uyooleka bantu bangu balimubuzike bakaye kumuunzi, alimwi kwakutali kwamuulonaa masinkamulomo,''' mbwaamba Jehova wamakamu.

Ncheechi Jehova nchaamba, ''Mifolo yaIjipita amakwebo aaKkusyi abaSabbi, baalumi balamfu mubwiime bayoletwa kulinduwe. Bayooba bako. Bayotobela musule lyako, kabeza kabaangidwe aanketani. Bayovundama kulinduwe akwaambuzyania aandinywe nkabaamba kuti, nchobeni Leza ulaandinywe alimwi takukwe uumbi kunze kwanguwe.'''
Nchobeni uliLeza uulisisa lwakwe, Leza waIsilyeli, Mufutuli.
Bayowusa nsoni boonse akubula luzyalo antoomwe; aabo babeza mituni bayoyenda mubweeme.
Pesi Izilayeli uyofutulwa aJehova alufutuko lutamani; takukwe lubo nuyoowusigwa nsoni akuba aabweme.

Ncheechio Jehova nchaamba, ooyo wakalenga majulu, Leza wamasimpe ooyo wakalenga nyika akwiipanga, ooyo wakayiimika. Wakayilenga, pepe mbuli chitakwe mulimu, pesi kiibambidwe kuti ikkalike: ''Ndime Jehova,  alimwi takukwe uumbi.
Tendakambwiida mukavwindi pe, mubusena bumwi busisidwe; tendakaamba pe kulungu lwaJakkobo, 'Mundiyanduule chabuyo! ndime Jehova, wambuula chaluzyalo; Ndaamba zintu ziluleme.
Amuyobololane akuza! Amubungane aantomwe, inywebo nomuyubide nkondo kuzwa akati kazisi! Tabakwe luzibo aabo banyampula zikozyanio zyakubeza akukomba kulibaleza batafutuli.

Swena aafwiifwi uwambe kulindime, leta bukamboni! Amuleke nzyaambe antoomwe. Ngwani wakatondezezye eechi nsiku? Ngwani wakachambilizya? Teewakilindime na, Jehova? Takukwe Leza kunze kwandime, Leza uubeteka kabotu amufutuli; takukwe uumbi kutali ndime.
Amuchengulukile kulindime akufutulwa, nyoonse nomagolelo aanyika; nkambo ndime Leza, alimwi takwe uumbi.
Alwangu mwaini ndilakonka, kwaamba kwakubeteka kabotu, alimwi takuyosanduka: 'Kulindime izwi lyoonse liyoovundama, lulimi loonse luyookonka.
Balowamba azyandime, ''MuliJehova alike mulilufutuko anguzu.''''' Bayooba abweeme boonse banyemede kulinguwe.
MuliJehova lunyungu loonse lwaIzilayili luyoolulamikwa; bayoba akulisumpula mulinguwe.
Bbeli wakotamina ansi, Nebo waliselesya aansi. Zikozyanio zyabo zyaselesya banyama bzinyampula, alimwi mulemya ng'ombe zyanu abuyumuyumu bwakujulu nkaambo kabanyama boongedwe.
Antomwe ngazyadyamanina aansi, kufugama aansi; tazikonzyi kunununa bwime, alimwi lwabo beni bazwa baya mubuzike.
Amundiswilile, nonganda yaJakkobo, aboonse bacheede munganda yaIzilayeli, bakabwezedwe andime kuzwa kamutana zyalwa, nkamunyampwide mubula.
Na kumachembalilo ako ndinoli ndime, alimwi kusikila masusu ako akabemvwi ndiyokubweza. Ndakakuchita alimwi nsiyokulubi; ndiyokubweza alimwi ndiyokunununa.
Ime uyondezyanisya ani? Ngwani ngoyeyela kuti ndikozyenie awe, kuchitila kuti twezyanisigwe?
Bantu batila ngolida kuzwa musaka alimwi bamvwa bulemu bwa nsiliva achikkelo. Bapa mulimu kuli basikufula, wayichita yaba leza; bayokotama akuchikomba.

Bakanyampula babikka amakuko abo alimwi bakachinyampula; bakachibikka abusena oobo mpucheelede, alimwi chiyoyimikila abusena bwacho alimwi tachiyogwisigwi pe alimbabo. Bayoolila kuli nchicho, pesi tachiyosandula na kufutula naba omwi kuzwa mumasukuzyo.
Amuyeye atala azintu eezi, mutawunduzyi, nobapanduki!
Amuyeye atala azintu zyakusanguna; zyachindi zyakale, nkaambo Ndime Leza, alimwi takwe umbi, Ndime Leza, alimwi takwe ukozyenie andime
Ndamwambila mamanino kuzwa kumatalikilo, alimwi zilimumanza eezyo zitana chitika, Ndati, ''Mabambe angu ayochitika, alimwindiyochita mbuli  mbepekezya.
''Njoyita muyuni mukali kuzwa kujwe, mwalumi ngwensalide uzwa kuchisi chilikule; iyi,ndaamba kale; alubo ndiyochizuzikizya; ndazizwidilizya, alimwi ndiyozichita.
Amundiswilile, bachuungutwi, balikule akuchita zintu eezyo ziluleme
.Ndiyoyeta busalali bwangu afwifwi; tabuli kule loko pe, alimwi lufutuko lwangu talwimikili pe; alimwi ndiyoopa lufutuko kuli Ziyoni alimwi abulemu bwangu kuli Izilayeli.
Seluka akukkala mulusuko, nakalindu mwana musimbi waBbabbiloni; nkala anyika atakwe chuno, mwana musimbi waba Kkaludiya.Tukolemekwa limbi akuba mutete.
Bweza ziyo akuziya busu; gwisya chisitilizyo chako, zwatununa malogwe ako alengelela,vumbula mawulu ako, uzubuke tulonga.
Chiswe chako chiyovumbulwa, iyi bweme bwako buyoboneka: Ndiyobwedezya bubi akutafwida muntu   luzyalo.
Mununuli wesu, Jehova wamakamu ndizina lyakwe,  umwi Uusalala wa Izilayeli.
Kokkali chakumuna akuya mumudima mwana musimbi waba Kkaludiya; nkaambo tukoyitwa limbi kuti mwana musimbi wa Mwami.
Ndakanyemena bantu bangu; Ndakasofwazya lukono lwangu akulupeda mujanza lyako, pesi tewakatondezya luzyalo; wakaanzika mukuli ulema kubantu bachiindi.
Wakaamba kuti, ''Uyoyendelezya mbuli mwana musimbi wa Mwami.'' Takwe niwakazilondola zintu ezi mumoyo, nikuba kuziba kuti ngaziyoba buti.

Aboobo kwaino komvwa eechi; inywebo nimuyanda kulibotezya akukkala chakulyiiba; webo nowamba mumoyo wako, 'Mondili alimwi taakwe uumbi ulimbuli ndime: Nsikoyokkala mbuli mukamufu, nekuba kutaswekelwa bana.''
Pesi zintu ezizyobile ziyokusikila mukayindi kaniini muzuba limwi kufwidwa bana akuba mukamufu munguzu zyoonse bayoza kulinduwe nekuba zisonzyo zyako ansengo zyako zyiingi azidanda.

Wakasyoma mububi; wakaamba kuti, ''Taakwe uumwi undilwene.'' Busongo bwako aluzibo lwako zitola kukusweeka, pesi wamba kuti mumoyo wako; ''Ndichipona, alimwi taakwe umbi uulimbuli ndime. I ntenda iyokuzunda tokoyozikonzya kuzitanda ansengo zyako.
Lunyonyooko luyokuwida; taakwe notakakonzye pe kulikwabilila. Lunyonyooko luyokusikila chakufwambaana, kotana kuziba.
Kochikakatila mukuwaala inkakata zyako azisondyo zyako zyiingi eezyo nziwakalemezegwa chakusyomeka kuzwa kubwanike bwako; ambweni uyozwidilila, ambweni uyoyoosya ntenda.
Wakatala alulayo lwako lwiingi, Leka bantu bayime akukutawukila - aabo bambuula azyamujulu akulanga kunyenyeezi, aabo baamba myeezi mipya - leka bakukutawukile kuzwa kuleezyo ziyochitika kulinduwe.
Bona, bayooba mbuli buungu. Mulilo uyobatenta. Tabakoyo likutawukila lwabo beni kuzwa kujanza lyamabangabanga. Taakwe makala akubakasazya, akutakwe mulilo wakubatakkalilile alinguwe!
Mbombubobu mbubatabe kulinduwe- aabo bali ayooyo nguwakabelekela, alimwi wakawuzya akuzya ambabokuzwa kubukubusi - takwe umbi unga ulakuvuna.''

Swiilila eezi, ngánd yaJakobo, biitwa aazina lya Izilayeli,  alimwi bakazwa kubwaalumi bwaJakobo; iwe nookonka aazina lyaJehova alimwi kwaamba zina lyaLeza waIsilayeli, pesi chitali chalusinizyo naa kwabululami.
Nkaambo balyita kuti mbatu bachisi chisalala akusyoma kuliLeza wa Isilayeli. Jehova wamakamu ndizina lyakwe.
''Ndakaambilizya kuzwa chiindi zyakazwa kumulomo wangu, alimwi akubazibisya;  mpawo champawo ndakazichita, alimwi zyakiinda.
Nkaambo ndakali kuti ulimuunyu, nsingo yako ilamilambi mbuli butala alimwi nkumu yako ilimbuli mukuba,

akambo kaako nchindaambilizya eechi chintu mumaanza aako; nkazitanachitika ndakakubuzya, aboobo toyelede kuti, ''Chikozyano changu chazichita kulimbabo,'naa Çhiimo changu chakubezaachabutale chazinanika nguzuzintu eezi.'

Wakamvwa aatala azeezi zintu; langa eezi zyoonse zintu zijatika; alimwi iwe, tokoyozumina na kuti nzindaamba zililuleme? Kuzwa lino akuya kunembo, ndilikukutondezya zintu zipya, zintu zisisidwe nzwaatakezi.
Lino akutali kwamusule, zyakaba zintu, alimwi kuzwa musule takwe niwakazimvwa, aboobo tokoyokonzya  kwaamba kuti, Iyii, ndakalizi aatala anzizyo.
Taakwe nowakamvwa; taakwe niwakazi; eezi zintu teezyakamvwika kumatwi aabo. Nkaambo ndakalizi kuti mwakeenana, alimwi wakali sikupapa kuzwa kukuzyalwa.
Nkambo kazina lyangu nchindalekela bukkali, alimwi nkaambo kakulemekwa kwangu ndiyooleka kukunyonyoona.
Bona, ndakakusalazya, pesi peepe mbuli nsiliva; ndakakusalazya mubbila lyamulilo wamafwabi.
Nkaambo kangu ndemwini ndiyochita; ndiyozumizya buti izina lyangu kuti lisampawulwe? Nsikoyoopa bulemu bwangu kuluumwi muntu pe.
Swiilila kulindime, Jakobo, aIzilayeli, ngundakiita; ndime nguwe; ndimasangunino, amamanino.
Iyii, kuboko kwangu kwakabumba ntalisyo yanyika, alimwi kuboko kwangu kwalulyo kwakayala majulu; eelyo niyita kulimbabo, bayoyima aantomwe.
Amulibunganiye, moonse, alimwi muswiilile! Ngwani aakati kenu wakaambilizya eezi zintu? Jehova ulayandisisya kuzuzikizya mabambe aatala aBbabbiloni. Uyoochita chiyandisyo chaJehova aatala aKkaladiya.
Ime, ndaambuula, iyii, ndakamwiita, ndakamweeta, alimwi uyoozwidilila.
Kweza aafwiifwi andime, swiilila eechi; Kuzwa kamatalikilo takwe nindakaambula zyansiswa pe; eelyo nizyachitika mpeli,'' Lino Mwaami Jehova wandituma, alimwi muuya wakwe.
Eezi nzizyo Jehova, mufutuli wako, ooyo Uusalala waIsilayeli nkati, ''Ndime Jehova Leza wako, umuyiisya mbumweelede kuzwidilila, ooyo umuzulwida kuzwa munzila nzimweelede kweenda aazyo.
Nsinga wakaswilizya milawo yangu! Mpawo luumuno lwako akuzwidilila kwako nikuli lwakeeta mbuli mulonga, alimwi lufutuko lwako mbuli mayuwe aalwizi.
Lunyungu lwako lwakelede kuvulla mbuli muse; alimwi abana kuzwa kutumbu lyakombiingi mbuli muse wamumulonga; izina lyako telwalinogwisigwa nekuba kunyonyoka kubusyu bwangu.

Bbuda kuzwa kuBbabbiloni! Chija kuzwa kulibaKkaladiya! amuzumo wakukkwiila wakwaambilizya nzizyo! chita eezi zizibinkane; chichite chizwe aanze kuya kumamanino aanyika! Amba , Jehova wakafutula mulanda wakwe Jakobo.
Tabalooba aanyyota pe naakabazulwida munkanda; wakachita maanzi kuti azwe mubbwe kuti banywe; wakabbalula ibbwe, alimwi maanzi akazwa.
Taakwe luumuno pe kuli basizibi - mbwawamba Jehova.''
Amundiswilile, inywebo nonyika zyamunkomwe! Lino ngamundiswilizye, inywe nobantu balikulaale. Jehova wakandiita azina kuzwa kukuzyalwa, eelyo baama nibaka ndeeta munyika.
Wakachita mulomo wangu wabosya mbuli panga; wakandisisa mumwenzule wajaanza lyakwe; wakandichita ndaba kanta kang'ayima; wakandisisa munkomo yakwe.
Wakati kuli ndime, ''Ulimulanda wangu, Izilayeli, kwinda muli nguwer ndatondezya bulemu bwangu.''
Pesi ndakavuwa, ''Nikuba ndayeyesya anga ndakabeleka chabuyo, Ndakabelesya nguzu zyangu aatakwe, ano lwangunuko lwangu luli a Jehova, alubo impindu yangu ili a Leza.''

Lino wakambula - oyo wakandibumba kukuzyalwa kwangu kuti ndibe mulanda wakwe, kuboozya Jakobo alimwi kuli nguwe, nkokuya Izilayeli abungane kuli nguwe, nkinkaako ndalemekwa mumenso a Jehova, alimwi Leza wabanguzu zyangu --
alimwi ulaamba, ''Nchintu chinini loko kuli nduwe o mulanda wangu kubusiluzya mukowa wa Jakobo, alimwi akuboozya bakachaala ba Izilayeli. Ndiyokuchita ukabe mumuni ku Bazwakule.''

Ezi nzenzizyo Jehova Leza nzyawamba, Mununuli wa Izilayeli, Uusalala Alikke, kulooyo buumi bwakwe bulangililwa ansi, usulidwe amanyika, alimwi muzike wabendelezi, ''Baami bayokubona akukubukila, alimwi bana babaami bayokubona akukukotamina ansi, nkambo ka Jehova usyomekene, naba oyo Uusalala Umwi wa Izilayeli, oyo iwakakusala webo.''

'Mbuboobu mbwawamba Jehova, ''Muchiindi nchindayeeya Ndiyokutondezya luyando lwangu Ndiyokusandula, alimwi mubuzuba bwalufutuko lwangu Ndiyokugwasya, Ndiyo kukwabilila, alimwi Ndiyokupa mbuli chizuminano chabantu, kuyakulula nyika, kuchitulula tongo kulukono.

Uyowamba kubaangidwe, 'Muzwe aanze; kulibaabo bali mung'anda zisiya zyabaangidwe, 'Mulitondezye lwanu.'Bayochela kumbali lyamigwagwa, alimwi nyika zyonse zikuneme zitakwe zintu ziyooba machezezyo aabo.
Tabukoyooba anzala nikuba nyota, nanka kupya naa izuba talikoyobawumpa, nkinkaako oyo ulaluzyalo uyobazulwida; uyobeembela kusika kumasawu amanzi.
Eelyo Ndiyochita malundu aangu wonse kuba migwagwa, alimwi Ndiyochita migwagwa mipati bweelene.''
Langa, ezi ziyosika kuzwa kule loko, zimwi kuzwa kunyika akumusanza; azimwi kuzwa kunyika ya Sinimu.
Yiimba, amajulu, alimwi ubotelwe, anyika; njila mukwiimba lwako azilundu! Mbubo Jehova ulawumbulizya bantu bakwe, alimwi uyobabeda luzyalo bapenzedwe bakwe.
Pesi Ziyoni waamba, ''Jehova wanditakata, alimwi Mwami wandiluba.''
Ngankubona mwanakazi ulaluba muvwanda wakwe, unyonka kunkolo zyakwe, elyo unoli takwe luzyalo pe amwana mulombe  ngwakatumbuka?  Iyii, balakonzya kuluba, pesi Nsikonzyi kuluba.
Langa, Ndalemba izina lyako amanza aangu; bulambo bwako buli kunembo lyangu mbobiya.
Bana bako balachijanina musule, nikuba aaba bakakumwaya bayobuzwa.
Kolanga mumbali ubone, boonse balikubungana akuza kulinduwe. Masimpe mbuli mbwempona --aaya malayilile a Jehova - nchobeni uyobazwata mbuli chilisakatizyo, alimwi uyobasama mbuli nabwinga.
Nikuba tewakalikwe lugwasyo wakali tongo, inyika yakali matongo, kwalino uyocheya loko kulibatakakkale mumo, abaabo bakakulya bayoba kule loko.
Bana bakazyalwa muchindi nwakafwide bayowamba komvwide, 'Busena mbuniini loko kuli ndiswe, tuchitile ng'anda, kuti tukkale aano.'

Nkabela uyolibuzya omwini, 'Ngwani wanditumbukila bana aaba? Ndakali fwide alimwi ndakali ngomwa, muzike alimwi ndakali lekedwe. Ngwani wakakomezya bana aaba? Langa, Ndakali syede endikke; nkokuli nkubakazwa aaba ?''''
Mbuboobu mbwawamba Mwami Jehova, ''Langa, Ndiyo nyampla kuboko kwangu kumanyika; Ndiyonyampula ndembela yachitondezyo kubantu. Bayoyeta bana bako basimbi amakkuko aabo.

Baami bayoba mataata balela bana, alimwi abanakazi babaami bayooba basimulela bana bak; bayokukotamina masyu aabo anyika akumyankuta suko lyaku mawulu aako, alimwi uyoziba kuti Ndime Jehova; aabo bandilindila tabakoyofwa bweeme pe.''
Nkubona nzibalekede zilatolwa kuzwa kuli silumamba na bazike balavunwa kuzwa kuli bayoosya?
Pesi mbuboobu mbwawamba Jehova, ''Iyii, bazike bayotolwa kuzwa kuli silumamba, alimwi azibolede ziyovunwa; eelyo Ndiyokazyania aba sinkondonyokwe akuvuna bana bako.

Ndiyosanina badyamizyi bako anyama yabo beni; alimwi bayokolwa abulowa bwabo, mbuli mbotatedi niwayini. Nkabela yoonse misyobo yabantu iyoziba kuti Imebo, nde Jehova, ndili mufutuli wako alimwi ndendime Mununuli, Mupati Kampatila wa Jakkobbu.''

Mbuboobu mbawamba Jehova, ''Lulikuli lugwalo lwakulekana ndundakaleka aabo banyoko? Kuli bali basizikwelelte bangu mbindakakuuzizya? Bona, wakawuzigwa akaambo kazibi zyako, alimwi akaambo kabupapi bwako, baamako bakatandigwa.

Nkaambonzi nindakasika pesi tekwakali naba womwe ooko? Nkaambonzi nindakayita pesi takwe naba womwe wakandisandula? Sa kuboko kwangu kwakali kufwifwi loko kuliya mali yachinunuzyo? Sa temwakali nguzu mulindime zyakukuvuna? Langa, kukukasya kwangu lwizi lwayuma; ndachita milonga kuti ibe nkanda; inswi zyayo zilafwa akaambo kakubula manzi alimwi zilabola.
Ndazwaatika julu amudima; ndalivumba amasaka.''

Mwami Jehova wakandipa lulimi mbuli lwawumwi wabaabo bakayiisigwa kuchitila kuti ndaambe akukkalilila kwajwi kulibabo bakompeme; ulandibusya chifumo achifumo; ubusya kwitwi kwangu kuti kumvwe mbuli aabo bayiisigwa.
Mwami Jehova wajula matwi angu, alimwi tendakaba mupapi pe, naakuti tendakabweedela musule.
Ndakafutatila aabo bakanduuma, alimwi zikowe zyangu kuli baabo bakadunsula bulungu bwangu; Tendakasisa busyu bwangu kumilimo iigambya akubusya nkondo.
Nkaambo Mwami Jehova uyondigwasya; akaambo kaako tandibulide choolwe pe; aboobo ndachita busyu bwangu mbuli chibikilo, nkaambo ndilizi kuti tandikoyoobikwa mumawuse.
Ooyo uyondilulamika uli afwifwi. Ngwani uyondikazya? Atwiime akulangana umwi awumwi. Ngwani sikunditamikizya? Mumuleke asike afwifwi andime.
Bona, Mwami Jehova uyondigwasya. Ngwani uyondaamba kuti ndime simulandu? Bona, boonse bayozakala mbuli chizwaato; busibiibi buyomulya.
Ngwani aakati kanu uyowa Jehova? Ngwani ulemeka ijwi lyamulanda wakwe? Ngwani weenda mumudima uusiya mbi katakwe lampi? Weelede kusyoma zina lyaJehova akugaminina kuli Leza wakwe.

Mulange, moonse nimumunika mulilo, nimulibambila lwenu beni azimunisyo: mweende mumumuni wamulilo wanu amumabangabanga aawo ngimwayasya. Eechi nchenchicho nchimwakatambula kulindume: Uzolala ansi mubusena bwamapenzi.
Amuswiilile kulindime nyebo nimuyandisya bululani, inywebo nimuyandawula Jehoa: Amulange kubbwe ooko nkomwakabezululwa akulubwebwele ooko nkumwakazubulwa.
Amulange kuliAbbulamu, wuso, akuli Sala, wakamuzyala; nkaambo kuchiindi nchakachili aalike mwaini, ndakamwiita. Ndakamulongezya akumuchita kuti avule.

Iyii, Jehova uyoowumbulizya Ziyoni; uyoowumbulizya masena woonse aaswekede; chimpayuma chakwe wakachichita mbuli Edeni, alimwi munkanda iikwazeme kumbali lyamumpata wamulonga waJodani mbuli muunda waJehova; lukondo abusekelezi buyoojanwa mulinguwe, chilumbo ajwi lyakwiimba.
''Amundiswilizye loko, nobantu bangu; alimwi muswilile ndime, nobantu bangu! Nkaambo ndiyoopa mulawu, alimwi ndiyochita lubeta lwangu kuti lukabe mumuni wazisi.
Bululami bwangu bulaafwiifwi, lutuko lwangu luyoboneka aanze, alimwi jaanza lyangu liyoobeteka zisi; nyika zyakunkombwe yalwizi  ziyondilindila; nkaambo bayolindila kuboko kwangu.

Amulansye meso aanu kujulu, alimwi mulange nyika yaansi, nkaambo majulu ayomwayika mbui busi, nyika iyoosama chikkobela, alimwi bakkede mulinjiyo bayoofwa mbuli nzi. Pesi lufutuko lwangu ndwalyoonse, alimwi bululami bwangu tabukoyooleka kubeleka.
Amundiswiilile, nywebo nomuzi bululami, bantu bajisi mulawu wangu mumyoyo yabo: Utayoowi chisapi chamuntu, nekuba kudyamizigwa akubisya kwabo.

Nkaambo mapempe ayoobalya mbuli chikobela mbuchilyigwa, alimwi amvwinyu ziyoobalya mbuli kulyigwa kwaboya bwambelele; pesi bululami bwangu buyooba bwalyoonse, alimwi lufutuko lwangu kuzyalani lyoonse.''
Buka, buka, ulisamike inguzu, ajaanza lyaJehova. Buka mbuli kumazuba aakamana, mumazyalani abasikale, Teensi nduwe wakapwachuula Lahabbu, akuyasa munyama uyoosya?
Teensi nduwe wakayuminizya lwizi, maanzi mapati aanikide, alimwi wakachita nzila aakati kalwizi kuti banunwidwe bakiinde?
Chibbadazyo chaJehova chiyooboola akusika kuZiyoni chakulila akukondwa akusekelela kwalyoonse aatala amitwe yabo; alimwi kusekekelela alukondo luyoobazulwida, alimwi bbusu akulila kuyobasiya.
Ime, ime, ndime ikuumbulizya. Nkamboonzi nimuyowa bantu, abo bafwa, bana balombe bamisyobo yoonse, bakachitwa mbuli bwizu?

Nkamboonzi niwaluba Jehova mulengi wako, wakatanbabika majulu wabika ntalisyo yanyika? Ulimukuyoowa kupati buzuba boonse nkaambo kakunyema kwamudyaamizi eelyo nayeya kumujeya. Kulaali kunyema kwamudyaamizi?
Ooyo uukoteme, Jehova uyoofwambaana; takoyoofwa akutanjila mugodi, nekuba kubula chibunge.
Nkaambo ndime Jehova Leza wako, uubusya lwizi kuti mayuuwe avuume - Jehova wamakamu ndezina lyakwe.
Ndabika majwi aangu mumulomo wako, alimwi alimwi ndamuvumba amweenzule waluboko lwangu, kuti nkabyale majulu, ndikayale ntalisyo yanyika, alimwi wambila Ziyoni kuti, ''Muli bantu bangu,'''
Buka, buka, yimikilaJelusalema, webo nowakanywida muluboko lwaJehova kuzwa kuchinywido chabukkali bwakwe; iwebo nowakanywida muchinywido kuzwa kunkomesi iidadalisya.
Takwe naba oomwe akati kaboonse bana balombe bakazyalwa kuti bamuchenjezye; takwe naba omwe aakati kaboonse bana balombe mbaakabusya kuti bamujate luboko.
Mapenzi aaya obile achitika kulinduwe - nguuni utikuumbulizye? - mpawo kumatongo aakanyonyoka, alimwi bbalangwe apanga nguni uyookumbulizya?
Bana bako balombe bayomana nguzu; baloona boonse kwamigwagwa yamuzyooko, mbuli lweengu mukazamba; Bazuzigwa bukkali bwaJehova, alutapatilo lwaLeza wanu.
Pesi lino amumvwe ezi, nywebo nimudyamizigilwe animukoledwe, kutaamba kukolwa kwawayini:

Jehova Mwaani wanu, Leza wanu, uubeteka makani aabantu bakwe, mbuboobu mbwaamba, ''Boona, ndakubwezela nkomeki yakudadalika kuzwa kujaanza lyako - achibikilo, eeyi ninkomeki yabukkali bwangu - kuchitila kuti utakanywi lubo.
Njoyibika mujaanza lyabasikukpenzya, aabo bakaamba kuti kulinduwe, 'Wona aansi, kuti tukeende aatala lyako;  wakachita sule lyako mbuli nyikaalimwi mbuli tugwagwa ntubeendela.''
Buka,buka,zwata nguzu zyako, Ziyoni; zwata magubo aako mabotu, Jelusalema dolopo lisalala: nkaambo takwe nibachiyokunjila lubo pe batapalwidwe abasofwede.
Lizakamune kuzwa kulusuko; buka ukkale, Jelusalema; gwisya nketani munsingo yako, yomusungwa, mwana musimbi waZiyoni.
Nkaambo mbuboobo mbawamba Jehova, ''Takwe muulo ngomwakawuzigwa awo pe, alimwi muyofutulwa kakutakwe mali,''
Nkaambo mbuboobo mwami Jehova mbwaamba, ''Kumatalikilo bantu bangu bakiinka aansi kuti bakajanane bukkala mu Ijipiti; alimwi Asiliya wabadyamizya kakutakwa kaambo kabotu pe.

Lino niinzi nchindilaacho ano -echi nchaambilizyo chaJehova- mukubona kuti bantu bangu bakabwezegwa biyo ? Aabo babatonga balikubaseka- eechi nchaambilizyo chaJehova- alimwi zina lyangu lilikupwapwa kwalyoonse buzuba boonse.
Nkinkaako bantu bangu bayooziba zina lyang; bayooziba muleelyo zuba kuti Ndime ndaamba, ''Iyi, Ndime!''
Mabotu biyeni mano aazilundu abatumwa beeta makani mabotu, bambilizya luumuno, bajisi busanambi bubotu baambilizya lufutuko, baamba kuli Ziyoni, ''Leza wako ulikukwendelezya!''
Swilila, basikulinda bako batola mujulu majwi abo, antomwe bawompolweda kubotelwa , nkaambo bayoobona , alimwi aya meso aabo, kuboola kwaJehova kuZiyoni.
Amumanikizyanie antomwe mukwiinda kukubotelwa, nomatongo aaJelusalema; nkaambo Jehova wawumbulizya bantu bakwe; wafutula Jelusalema.
Jehova wabikka jaanza lyakwe lisalala kunembo lyazisi zyoonse; nyika yoonse iyoobona lufutuko lwaLeza wesu.
Enda,enda , koya aawo, utagumi chitu chisofwede; bbuda mukati kakwe; lisalazye, iwe nobweza zibelesyo  zyaJehova.
Nkaambo tokoyoozwa anze chakuchijana pe, nekuba kuyozwa chakudoneka; nkaambo Jehova uyozwa kunembo lyako; alimwi Leza waIzilayeli uyoba mulindizi wakumbali lyako.
Bona, mubelesi wangu uyochita chabusongo; uyolampa akusumpulwa, alimwi uyosumpulwa.
Mbuli biingi mbubakayowa kuli nduwe- bube bwakwe tebwakazibinkana kwinda echo chamutu ulibiyeni,  alimwi chimo chakwe techachili kulangika mbuli muntu pe.
Nikuba boobo, mubelesi wangu uyosansila zisi zyiingi abami bayojala milomo nkaambo kakwe.Nkaambo echo nchibakatabuzigwa, bayochibona, alimwi echo nchibakatanamvwa, boyochimvwisisya.
Ngwani wasyoma nzibakamvwa kuzwa kulindiswe, alimwi ngwani wayubunwida jaanza lya Jehova?
Nkambo wakakomenena kunembo lya Jehova mbuli ntengatenga, ambuli muyanda uzwa munyika njumu; takalikwe chiwa cheebeka na chibotu; elyo nitumwebela, katakwe bwebesi buchita kuti tumuyande.
Wakasampawulwa akukakigwa kubantu; muntu wamapenzi, alimwi kazibinkene amachise. Mbuli oyo uzwa kubantu ngibasisa masyu abo, wakasampawulwa; alimwi tetwakamubweza mbuli ulemekeka.
Pesi musimpe wakazyedwe amachise esu akubweza mapenzi eesu; lino twakayeya kuti wakapegwa chisubulo aLeza, wakandulwa aLeza, akunyonyonwa.
Pesi wakayasya nkaambo kanchito zyesu zibi; wakavwinyunwa nkaambo kazibi zyesu. Chisubulo chaluumuno lwesu chakalaalinguwe, alimwi kuzilonda zyakwe twaponesegwa.
Swebo toonse tuli mbuli mbelele ziswekede; umwi awumwi wakeenda enzila yakwe, alimwi Jehova wakabikka alinguwe milandu yesu yoonse.
Wakadyamizigwa; lino eelyo wakalibombya mwini, takajula mulomo wakwe pe; mbuli mbelele ikwelelwa kukujayigwa, alimwi mbuli mbelele iwumwide kunembo lyasikugela, eelyo takajula mulomo wakwe.
Mukukasigwa alubeta wakabwezegwa. Mbuli kulunyungu lwakwe, oyo wakabonaanga wagonkwa kuzwa kunyika yabawumi, na kuti wakapenzegwa kumilandu yabantu bangu?
Bakabikka kabanda kakwe aantomwe abajayi, aantomwe amwalumi muvubi mulufu lwakwe, nikuba  kuti takwe nakachita nichiba chibi, na kuti nikuba zibi mumulomo wakwe.

Lino kwakali kuyanda kawJehova kukumuvwinyuna akumuchisya. Mpawo wakachita buumi bwakwe chipayizyo chazibi, uyobona bana bakwe, uyolampya mazuba aakwe, aamakanze aJehova ziyoozuzukizigwa  kwindila muli  nguwe.
Kuzwa kukupenzegwa kwabuumi bwakwe, uyobona mumuni akukkutisikana kuluzibo lwakwe. Mubelesi wangu uululeme uyoopandulula zyiingi; uyobweza milandu yabo.

''Yiimba, webo yomwanakazi ngomwa, webo nutakwe nwakazyalide; njila mukwiimba kwalukondo akulilisya, webo nutakwe nwakali njide mukumyongwa kwakuzyala. Nkambo bana bamutakale mbaanji kwiinda bana bamwanakazi ukwetwe,'' mbwaamba Jehova.
''Panga tente lyako likomene akusasabula masila atente lyako aanze, chakutalichesya; lampya nsungo zyako akuyumya nkaanka zyako.
Nkambo uyosasabula kujanza lyachilisyo akuchimweensi, alimwi lunyungu lwako luyoozunda zisi akubambulula myunzi itakatidwe.
Utayoowi nkambo takwe pe noyofwisigwa bweeme, naaba kutyompozegwa nkambo tokoyobula choolwe; uyoluba bweeme bwabukubusi bwako akubula choolwe chakutakatwa kwako.
Nkambo mulengi wako ngomulumi wako; Jehova wamakamu ndezina lyakwe. Uusalala wa Izilayeli nguuMwaami wako; wiitwa kuti Leza wanyika yoonse.
Nkambo Jehova wakamwiita mbuli mukayintu utakatidwe akuchiswa mumuuya, mbuli mukayintu wakakwatwa bunini akutakatwa,'' mbwawamba Jehova.
''Nkambo kwachiindi chinini ndakamusowa, pesi aluse lupati ndiyomubungania nywebo.
Mukufwasuka kwakunyema ndakasisa busyu bwangu kuzwa kulinduwe chakukuluba; pesi achizuminano chiteeli chakusyomeka ndiyoba aluse alinduwe - mbwawamba Jehova, oyo uukuvuna.
Nkaambo echi chilimbuli maanzi a Nowa kuli ndime: mbuli mbundakakonka kuti manzi a Nowa takoyoyinda aatala anyika alimbi pe, aboobo ndakonka kuti tandikoyo munyemena pe nanka kumukalalila.
Nikuba malundu nga alawa atulundu zikazuzume, lo luyando lwangu lutedi talukwe niluyoozwa kuli ndinywe, naaba chizuminano changu chaluumuno kuti chikazuungane - mbwawamba Jehova, ulaluse alinduwe.
Upenzedwe, uwumidwe ampeyo awutawumbulizizgwe, langa, ndiyobika mumabwe amisyobo misyobo, alimwi kubika intalisyo zyako abbwe liyandisi.
Ndiyopanga nsonge zyako abbwe lyalubbi amilyango yako yamabwe aamweka, alimwi bulambo bwako bwakunze bwamabwe meebesi.
Mpawo bana bako boonse bayoyisigwa a Jehova; alimwi luumuno lwabana bako luyooba lupati.
Mubululami muyoyimikwa, alimwi munoli kule kuzwa kukudyamizigwa, nkambo tamukoyoyoowa; alimwi kuzwa kuchiyoosyo, nkambo taakwe nichiyoswena afwifwi anduwe.
Langa, na umwi wabusya lupyopyongano, talukwe niluyozwa kuli ndime pe; kufumbwa uubusya lupyopyongano andinywe uyozundwa.
Bona, ndakalenga mufuzi, bachita imvutyo kumakala ayaka akupanga zilwanio mbuli mulimo wakwe, alimwi ndakalenga sikunyonyoona kuti anyonyoone.

Takukwe chilwanio chibambilidwe nduwe chiyozwidilila; alimwi uyoopa mulandu boonse bakupa mulandu, olu ndolukono lwabalanda ba Jehova, alimwi kululamikwa kwabo kuzwa kulindime - oku nkokwamba kwa Jehova.''
Muze, moonse nimuli aanyota, muze kumanzi, andinywe nimutakwe mali, muze, muule alimwi mulye! Muze, muule wayini amalili zitayandi mali alimwi zitakwe muulo.
Nkaambonzi nimweelesya nsiliva kutali chibunge, alimwi nkaambonzi nimubeleka eezyo zitakutisyi pe? Muswiilile chaluchenjezyo kulindime akulya zibotu, alimwi ulibotezye mukuneneya.
Muchenjekezye matwii enu kulindime! Muswiilile, kuti mupone! Ndiyoochita chizuminano chitamani anduwe - luyando lwangu luli kabotu, lusyomekede ndundakasyomezya Deviti.
Langa, ndamubika mbuli bukamboni kuzisi, mbuli muzululi asilutwe wabantu.
Langa, uyoyita zisi nzotazi pe; alimwi zisi zitakwizi ziyokuchijaanina nkaambo kaJehova Leza wanu, Uusalala waIzilayeli, wakakulumbayizya.''
Muyanduule Jehova nachijanika; amumwiite nachili afwifwi.
Sizibi ngaleke nzila yakwe, amuntu wachibi mizeezo yakwe. Leka abweede kuli Jehova, alimwi uyomufwida luzyalo, akuli Leza wesu uulekelela mubuvule.
''Nkaambo miyeyo yangu tensi miyeyo yanu pe, nikuba nzila zyako tensi zyangu - ooko nkwaamba kwaJehova -
nkaambo majulu malamfu kwiinda nyika, aboobo nzila zyangu nindamfu kwiinda kwiinda nzila zyako, amiyeyo yangu kwiinda yako.
Nkaambo mbuli mvula achaanda mbuziwa kuzwa kujulu alimwi tazibweedi do mane zyasaalila aanyika akwiichita kuti izyale akusyuuka alimwi akupa mbuto kumulimi uubyala, achinkwa kulisikulya,
mbubo ijwi lyangu linoli eelyo lizwa kumulomo wangu - talikoyoboola kulindime chinkwamaanza, pesi liyozuzikizya makanze anzindalitumina.
Nkaambo uyoyinka mukubotelwa akuzulwidwa chaluumuno; zilundu atulundu ziyokwamuka mulukondo kunembo lyako, alimwi misamu yamumyuunda iyobotelwa akufwefwema.

Kutali zisamu zyamyuumvwa, misepulasi iyookomena; alimwi kwiinda ziwawa, mimiyutuli iyokomena, alimwi zinoli zyaJehova, kuchitila zina lyakwe. Mbuli chitondeezyo chalyoonse chitakabule kugwisigwa pe.''
Mbuboobu mbwaamba Jehova, ''amutobelezye eezyo ziluleme, muchite zyeelede; lufutuko lwangu luli afwifwi, alimwi bululami bwangu bwamba kuyubununwa.
Uli achoolwe muntu uchita eezi, alimwi uchijatisisya achamanguzu.Ulabamba Sabata, tayisofwazyi pe, ulakasya janza lyakwe kukuchita zibi.''
Kutabi mweenzu wab mutobeli waJehova uuwamba kuti, ''Jehova ulandaania kuzwa kubantu bakwe.'' Muzibe tayeelede kuti, ''Laanga, ndimunsamu muyumu.''
Mbuboobu mbwamba Jehova, ''Kumuzibe ubamba sabata yangu akusala ezyo zibotezya ndime, alimwi ujatisya chizuminano changu,
Kuli mbabo nzoyimika mukati kanganda yangu amukati kamalambo aangu chibalusyo echo nchibotu kwiinda kubaa bana balombe abana basimbi. Njoobapa chiibalusyo chalyoonse eech chitakoyoomwayigwa.
Alimwi beenzu baliswanizya kuli Jehova- kumubelekela, alimwi balayanda izina lyaJehova, kumukomba, kufumbwa ubamba sabata alimwi kayayisofwazyi, alimwi ulajatisya chizuminano changu-

Njobaleta kuchilindu changu chisalala akuchita lukondo mung'ánda yangu yakukombela; zipayizyo zyabo zyakutenta azipayizyo zyabo ziyotambulika achipayililo changu. Nkaambo ng'ánda yangu iyoyitwa kuti ning'anda yakukombela zisi zyoonse.
Oku nkukwamba kwaMwami Jehova, ubungania batandidwe baIzilayeli- ndichinoya bubungania abambi kuyungizya alimbabo.''
Moonse nubanyama bamulusaka, amuboole mulye, moonse nobanyama bamuzisaka!
Basikulindila bako boonse mboofu, tabamvwisisisyi. Boonse mbankala bawumwide tabakonyi kukuwa. Balalota, alimwi balalala ansi bayandisya koona.
Babwa aba balachiyandisyo chipati chakulya; tabakkuti pe; mbembeli batamvwisisisyi; boonse bapambuka batola umwi awumwi nzila yakwe, umwi awumwi wapilukila kuli zitaluleme.
Boola, ''baamba'' atunywe wayini azikola. Junza lilaba mbuli sunu''.
Baluleme banyonyooka, pesi takwepe uchilangisisya, alimwi bantu bachizuminano chisyomekede bamwayisigwa, pesi takwepe umvwisisisya, kuti baluleme bamwayisigwa kuzwa kuchibi.
Wanjila muluumuno; balyokezya mumalo, aabo, beenda mubululami bwabo.
Pesi boola okuno, nywebo bana babanakazi basondi, mwana wasimamambe amwanakazi wakalyamusya lwakwe.
Ngwani ngosampawula? Ngwani ngwaasamina mulomo akulepuula mulomo akulengelezya lulimi? Sena tamuli bana basikupapila, bana balweeno.
Mulalikasazya lwanu akulala antomwe munsi amunsamu, munsi lyaminsamu yoonse ilamatu, nywe nimujeya bana banu munkomwe zyamulonga njumu, munsi lyamabwe mulabalazika.

Akkati kazintu zibungusene zyamumulonga nzezintu nzimwakatuminwa nywebo. Nzezikozyanio nzimukomba. Mulatila chipayizyo chakunywa kulinzizyo akunyampula chipayizyo chamayila. Muzintu ezi sena ndakeendelwa mulinzizyo?
Mulabamba malo aanu atala lyazilundu zilamfu, alimwi mwakatanta loko akuyoopa chipayililo.

Kusule aakkoma akuminsende yamilyango ulabikka chitondezyo; mulandisiya, mwalichita meeya, akwinka; wakwazamuna nulo. Wachita chizuminano ambabo; wayanda malo aabo; wabona zimpanzi zyamibili yabo zisisikene.
Mwakayinka kuli Molekki amafuta akuvuzya myunde yanu. Mwakatuma bangambela kule; mwakainka ansi kukabanda.
Wakakatala kuzwa kulwendo lwako lulamfu, pesi takwepe nwakaamba kuti, ''Tachikwe chilangililo.'' Wakajana buumi mujanza lyako; nkinkaako tewakakatala pe.

Nguni ngulibilikila ? Ngwani ngoyoowa ngoyowesya loko chakuchitya kuti nchite chalweeno, chakwindilila kuti utandibaluuki na kundiyeeya? Nkaambo ndakawumuna kuchiindi chilamfu, takwe tamuchindiyowa pe.
Njoluula nchito zyabululami bwako koonse akwaamba eezyo nziwakachita; pesi tazikoyokugwasya.

Muchindi nokwila anze, leka zikozyanio zibunganisigwe zikuvune. Anukuti luuwo lulazitola zyoonse, kuyoya kulazitola zyoonse. Pesi ooyo ujana mayubilo mulindime ulakkona nyika akutola mbono zyamuchilundu changu chisalala.
Uyowaamba kuti, 'Muyake, muyake! Mukukule nzila! Mugwisye zilebyo zyonse kuzwa kunzila yabantu bangu!'''

Nkambo echinchicho ulatala awusumpwidwe nzyaawamba, upona lyonse, ulazina lisalala, ''Ndakkala musumpukide amubusena busalala, aamwi anguwqe ooyo utyokede amuuya ulibombya, kubukulusya muuya ulibombya, mpawo akubukulusya myoyo yabawuside.
Nkambo nsikoyomupa mulandu limbi pe, nikuba kunyema lyonse, nkambo muuya wamuntu uyowizuka kunembo lyangu, mawumi aayo ngindakachita.
Nkambo kabukali bwachindi champindu yakwe, ndakali nyemede, mpawo ndakamusubula; ndakayubika busyu bwangu mpawo ndakanyema, pesi wakabwedelela chibunda munzila zyamoyo wakwe.
Ndabona inzila zyakwe, pesi ndiyomusilika. Ndamuzulwida akumuumbulizya alimwi ndawumuzya aabo boomoka nkambo kanguwe,
alimwi njolenga michelo yamilomo. Luumuno, Lumuuno, kuli baabo balikule abaabo bali afwifwi - mbwaamba Jehova -- Ndiyo basilika.
Pesi basizibi bali mbuli kuvwandawuka kwalwizi, lutalyookezyi pe, achibikilo chamanzi tachibikkiki mpawo mbutope.
Taakwe luumuno pe kuli basizibi -- mbwawamba Leza.''
''Kwilisya loko; utabwedezyi musule. Yitisya ajwi lyaako mbuuli mweembo. Yiminana abantu alupapo lwabo, alimwi ing'anda ya Jakkobbo azibi zyabo.

Nikuba kuti balandiyanduula buzuba abuzuba akubotelwa muluzibo lwaanzila zyangu, mbuli nyika eeyo yakeezya kuchita busalali alimwi akutaleka mulawu wa Leza wabo. Bandibuzya bubetesi bwabusalali; balabotelwa mukuyeeya kwa Leza kwakuza afwiifwi.

''Nkaamboonzi nitwakalyiimya; baamba kuti, 'Pesi tamuziboni pe? Nkamboonzi nitwalifwiinsya lwesu, pesi tamuziboni pe?'Bona, mubuzuba bwakubotelwa kwanu mujana kubotelwa kwanu nobeni alimwi akudyamizya boonse babelesi baanu.
Bona, mulyimisizya kuti mukazyanie akulwana, akuma amfayindi yabusizibi; Toyelede pe kulyiimya sunu kuchitila ijwi lyako limvwigwe ajulu.

Nguwo na nchobeni musyobo wakulyiimya ooyo ngunoli ngunjanda; izuba lyawumwi kuti alibombye lwakwe, kuti akotame ansi mutwe wakwe mbuli tete, aalimwi kuti ayale masaka adyota munsi lyakwe? Mukwamba kuti nchobeni nkulyiimya, izuba eelyo libotezya Jehova?
Tenkuko na kulyiimya nkundakasala: kuti ndekezye kwangununa zyanzyo zyabubi, kusungula tukole twajokwe, kwangununa batyokede kuti balyendelele, akudunsuula majokwe woonse?

Sa takwensi kwabana chinkwa abalanzala aalimwi akuboozya bachete abaabo batakwe muunzi mung'anda yako? Elyo mwabona umwi uli chinswe, mwelede kumusamika; alimwi tamwelede pe kulisisa lwanu kuzwa kunzubo zyanu.
Mpawo mumuni wanu uyojuka akumunika mbuli kubbuda kwazuba, alimwi kusilikwa kwanu akufwambana kuyolibonia ajulu; bululami bwanu buyoyinka kunembo lyanu, alimwi bulemu bwa Jehova buyokusindikila.
Mpawo uyoyiita alimwi Jehova uyosandula; uyolila lugwasya, alimwi ulowamba kuti, ''Mpawa ndabawo.'' nNa wagwisya akkati kanu jokwe, kanwe kapedwe mulandu, alimwi amakani aabasizibi,
na inywebo lwanu mwagwasya basinzala akukkutya bachete babasikupenzegwa; mpawo mumuni wanu uyomunika mumudima, alimwi mudima wanu uyooba mbuli sikati.
Mpawo Jehova uyomuzulwida kwalyoonse alimwi akumukkutya nywebo mumasena aanu ooko kutakwe maanzi, akusimya mafuwa aanu. Munoli mbuli kasensa kamaanzi, aako kaalamanzi atamani.
Bamwi banu bayoyakulula matongo achiindi; muyobusilizya matongo amazyalani miingi; muyoyitwa kuti, ''Bayakululi babulambo,'' babukulusyi bamigwagwa kuti ipone.''

Atwambe kuti mwabwedezya musule mawulu aanu kuzwa kukwenda mubuzuba butegwa nsabata kuti lukondo, alimwi akwiita makani a Jehova usalala akulemekwa. Atwambe kuti mwaalemeka sabata kwinda mukuyisya milimu yanu nobeni, alimwi akwinda mukutajana zimukondezya alimwi mukwinda mukutambula makani aanu nubeni.
''Mpawo muyojana kukondwa muuli Jehova; aalimwi njomuchita mukeende aajulu aanyika; njomusanina kuzwa kulukono lwa Jakkobbo wuso waanu - Nkambo mbuwamba mulomo wa Jehova.''
Boona, janza lya Jehova talinakufwinsigwa pe kuti talikozyi kufutula; nekuba kutwi takunalema kuti kutaswilili.
Inchito zyanu zyabubi, nekuba boobo, nzezyamwanzania kuzwa kuli leLeza wanu, alimwi zibi zyanu nzyamuchita kuti asise busyu bwakwe kuzwa kulindinywe alimwi kuti atamuswilili.
Nkaambo maanza anu asofwazigwa abulowa aminwe yanu yazula bubi. Milomo yanu ilaamba bubeji, alimwi ndimi zyanu zilambala matusi.
Takwe omwe uyita bululami, alimwi takwe unjila mukubetekwa chakasimpe. Balasyoma kumajwi apilingene, akwaamba zyakubeja; balaminta miyeyo mibi akuzyala chibi.
Balakumba mayi anzoka ijaya akuluka lubiilili lwagubi. Kufumbwa uulya mayi aabo ulafwa, alimwi na iji lyakonkoka, lilakonkola inzoka ijaya.
Luubilili lwabo talubelesegwi kumalembo, nekuba kubavumba kumilimu yabo. Imilimu yabo milimu yabubi, anchito zyankondo zili mumanza aabo.
Mawulu aabo alachijanina bubi , alimwi balachijanina kukutila bulowa bwabatakwe mulandu.Imiyeyo yabo miyeyo yazibi; inkondo alunyonyoko nzinzila zyabo.
Inzila yaluumuno tabayizi p, alimwi tamukwe kuneteka kabotu munzila zyabo. Balichitila nzila zipilingene munzila zyabo; kufumbwa uyenda munzila ezi taluzi luumuno.
Aboobo kubetekwa kuli kule kuzwa kulindiswe, nekuba busalali tabusikili. Tulindila mumuni, pesi tubona mudima; tuyandula bbalabala, pesi twenda mumudima.
Tulaampampa bulambo mbuli boofu, mbuli aabo bataboni. Tulakachilwa masikati mbuli kuti nkulundindiwana; akati kabasinguzu tubaanga mbuli bantu bafwide.
Tulavuluuma mbuli babbule akupululuzya mbuli nziba; Tulalindila lubeta, pesi taluwo; kuti tumvwe, pesi lulikule andiswe.
Nkaambo milandu yesu myiingi ilikunembo lyako, alimwi zibi zyesu zilaambula andiswe; nkaambo milandu yesu ilaswebo, alimwi tulizizi zibi zyesu.
Twakakupapila, akukaka Jehova akupiluka kuzwa kukutobela Leza wesu. Twakambula makani mabi aakupambuka, katuminside kungunguna kuzwa mumyoyo amajwi akubeja.
Lubeta lwatubolela musule, alimwi bululami bwayimikilila kule lok; kasimpe katukachizya antanganana, alimwi bululami tabokoosika.
Lusyomo lwinilwini lweendela kule, alimwi kufumbwa upiluka kuzwa kuzwa kububi walichita simulandu mwini. Jehova nakazibona eezi alimwi kwakabija eelyo tekwakaba lubeta.
Wakabona kuti takwe muntu , alimwi wakagamba kuti takwe naba omwe wakanjilila mumakani. Aboobo ijanza lyakwe lyakeeta lufutuko kuli nguwe, abululami bwakwe bwakamutabilila.
Wakabikka bululami bwakwe mbuli chikwabilizyo akaango anguwani yalufutuko atala amutwe. Wakalisamika mwini achizwato chankoto akuli vungilila mbuli chikobela
chabusungu.Wakabwedezya kuli mbabo nzibakachitide, bukali bwalubeta kuli basinkondonyina, ankoto kuli basinkondonyina, anyika zyakunkomwe yalwizi ulazibwedezya mpindu yachisubulo chazyo.
Elyo bayoyoowa izina lya Jehova kuzwa kumbo, abulemu bwakwe kuzwa kukubala kwazuba; nkambo uyooza mbuli kalonga kawalama, kakalokwenzegwa aluyoyo lwa Jehova.
''Munununi uyoosika mu Ziyoni akuli baabo bapiluka kuzwa kunchito zyakupapila Jakkobbo - Oku nkwaamba kwa Jehova.

Mbuli ndime, eechi nchizuminano changu ambabo - mbwaamba Jehova - muuya wangu ulatala alindinywe, alimwi majwi angu ngindakabikka mumulomo wako, takoyozwa amulomo wako, nikuba kuzwa kumilomo yalunyungu lwako - mbwawamba kuchiindi echino akutamani.''
Nyampuka, umunike; nkambo lampi lyako lyasika, alimwi bulemu bwa - Jehova bwasika alinduwe.
Nekuba mudima wavumba anyika, alubo amudima usiya mbii mumanyika; Jehova uyoboneka aalinduwe, alimwi bulemu bwakwe buyotumwa kulindime.
Manyika ayoosika kumumuni wako, alimwi baami bayoosika kumumuni ulokumwinika.
Langa koonse kuzyungulukide akubona. Boonse babungana antomwe beni akusika kuli nduwe. Bana bako balombe bayosika kuzwa kule, alimwi bana bako basimbi bayobwezegelwa amakkuko abo.
Mpawo uyolanga akukasalilwa, alimwi moyo wako uyokondwa chakwindilila, nkambo bwiingi bwalwizi buyotilwa kulinduwe, buvubi bwazisi buyosika kulinduwe.
Nkalaki zyankamela ziyomuvumba, amyoota zya Midiyani a Efa; zyoonse ziyoozida ku-Syebba; bayoyeta ngolide atununkilizyo, alimwi ndiyolumbayizya Jehova.
Zyonse mbelele zya-Kkeda ziyobunganisigwa antomwe kuli nduwe, mugutu wa-Nebboyoti uyomufutula ezyo nzyubula; kuyooba zipo zitambulika ku-chipayililo; alimwi ndiyokulumbayizya bulemu bwang'anda yangu.
Mbaani aba bawuluka mbuli joba, alimwi mbuli nziba kuzisaba zyabo?

Inkomwe zyamilonga zilayanduula, alimwi maato a Tasyisyi atunga kunembo, kuyoyeta bana balombe benu kuzwa kule, nsiliva zyabo angolide balazyo, nkaambo kazina lya-Jehova Leza wako, alimwi akambo ka Uusalala wa-Izilayeli, nkaambo wakulemeka.
Bana balombe bazwa kule bayoyakulula bulambo bwanu, alimwi baami babo bayomufutula; nekuba kuti mubukali bwangu ndakakupeda chisubulo, aboobo mukuyanda kwangu ndiyooba aluse kuli nduwe.
Milyango yako ayilayo iyokkala kiijulidwe chakuyoowa, tikoyojalwa kuti bivubi bwamanyika bukayetwe, abaami babo kabazulwida.
Nchobeni, zisi a bwaami obo butakabule kukubelekela bayonyonyoonwa; zisi eezyo ziyo nyonyonwa chakutasiya chintu.

Bulemu bwa Lebbanoni buyosika kulinduwe, musamu utegwa sipulesi, amufeya, antomwe achibikkilo chamu sipulesi kazijisini antomwe, kukubotezya busena busalala; alimwi ndiyolumbayizya nusena bwamawulu angu.
Bayosika kuli nduwe akukukotamina, bana balombe balafwifwi; bayofugama kumawulu aako; bayookwamba kuti dolopo lya-Jehova, Ziyoni Usalala wa Izilayeli.
Kutali kuti mukkalilile kutakatwa akutayandwa, kakutakwe naba oomwe wiinda akkati kanu, ndiya kukumuchita chintu chakumulumbayizya kwalyoonse, lukondo kuzwa kuzyalane kusika kuzyalane.
Alimwi muyonywa makupa azisi, alimwi muyonyonka kunkolo zyabaami; muyoziba kuti ndime Mufutuli alimwi ndimu Futuli a munununi wanu, Singuzu Oyo umwi wa Jakkobbo.

Kunze kwamundalila ndiyakweeta ngolide, kunze kwabutale ndiyakweeta nsiliva; kunze kwachisamu, mundalila, alimwi kunze kwamabwe, lubulo. Ndiyakusala luumuno kuba mwendelezyi wanu, alimwi kululamika kwabazuluzibanu.

Nkondo tikoyomvwikka lubo pe munyika yenu, naa kupyayuulwa nikuba kubukilana kumigaano yanyika; pesi muyakwamba bulambo bwanu kuti lufutuko; pesi muyakwamba bulambo bwanu kuti lufutuko, alimwi milyango yanu iyolumbayizigwa.
