Izuba talikoyooba mumuni wabuunsi, naakuti kumwinikisya kwamweezi bwamunika alinduwe; pesi Jehova uyooba mumuni wako kwalyonse; alimwi Leza mbulemu bwanu.
Izuba lyanu talikoyobbila, naakuti mweezi wenu tokoyozwa akubulika; nkambo Jehova uyooba mumuni wako kwalyoonse, alimwi mazuba akulila kwako ayomana.
Boonse bantu banu bayosalala; bayobweza buvubi bwanyika kwachindi kwalyoonse, mitabi yachilimwa changu, mulimu wamaanza aangu, kuti nditembawulwe.
Bachebayoba mwaanda alimwi munini kuba nyika isimide; Lwangu mebo, nde Jehova, ndiyofwambana kuzuzikizya zintu eezi chasika chiindi.

Muuya wa Mwami Jehova ubaali ndime, nkambo Jehova wakandinanika kuti nkambawuke makani mabotu kuli bapengede mumyoyo. Wakandituma kuti ndiponie batyokede myoyo, kuti nkambawuke lwangunuko kuli baabo baangidwe.
Wakandituma kuti nkambawuke munyaka wa Jehova waluzyalo, ibuzuba bwakubwedezya kwa Leza wesu, alimwi kuti ngumbulizye boonse balila.

Wakandituma -- kuti ndipe aabo balila mu Ziyoni - kuti ndibape ingala muchibaka chadyota, mafuta alukondo muchibaka chakulila, chikobela chakulumbayizya mubusena bwamuuya wabufubafuba, kubayita kumibanga yabululami, kubyala kwa Jehova, kuti alemekwe.
Bayoyakulula matongo; matongo akalekale; bayobwedezya matongo achiindi. Bayobwedezya matongo aamyunzi, imatongo kuzwa kumazyalane miingi aachindi.
Bazwakule bayoyima akusanina batanga bwako alimwi bana balombe babazwakule bayobeleka mumyunda yako ayamasansa.
Muyoyitwa kuti mulibapayizi ba Jehova; bayomwiita kuti mulibalanda ba Leza wesu. Muyolya buvubi bwamaasi, alimwi muyolidunda mubuvubi bwabo.
Muchibaka chakufwabeeme uyooba azyindulwidwe; alimwi muchibaka chakunyansigwa bayobotelwa ajulu azyabilo zyabo. Aboobo zimpanzi zyanyika zyaba ziyoyindululwa; kukondwa kutamani kuyooba kwabo.
Nkambo Mebo, Jehova, ndiyanda kwelanisya, alimwi ndasula bubbi ankondo zyabubi.

Ndiyobabwedezya chakusyomeka, alimwi ndiyochita chizuminano chitamani ambabo. Imikowa yabo iyozibinkana akati kabamasi, alimwi abana babo aakati kabantu. Boonse bayobabona bayo bazumina, kuli mbabo bantu Jehova mboo kalongezya.

Ndiyosekelela kapati muli Jehova; muli Leza wangu ndiyobotelwa loko. Nkaambo wandizwatika jansi lyalufutuko; wakandizwatika amukumba wabusalali, mbuli nabwiinga mbwalibotya lwakwe achikobela, alimwi mbuli nabwiinga mbwalibotya azilisakatizyo.
Nkambo mbuuli nyika mbwimezeka zilyo, alimwi mbuli muunda chita zilyo zyawo kuti zikule mbubo mwami Jehova mbwayochita bululami akulumbayizya kumena kunembo lyabamasi woonse.
Nkambo ka Ziyoni nsikoyowumuna, alimwi akambo ka Jelusalemu nsikoyowumuna, kusikila bululami bwakwe bubonekembuli mumuuni, alimwi lufutuko mbuli chimunisyo chuumpa.
Bamasi bayobona bululami bwako, mpawo baami boonse mbulemu bwako. Uyoyitwa azina pya eelyo Jehova ndyayosala.
Alimwi uyoba musini wabwebesi mujanza lya Jehova, alimwi kuba ingala yabwami mujanza lya Leza wako.

Tokoyowambwa limbi anduwe, ''Ulekeledwe,'' nokuba nyika yako tiikowambwa limbi, ''Matongo.'' Nchobeni, uyoyitwa kuti ''Muyandwi wangu alimwi nyika yako,'' alimwi nyika ''Ukwetwe,'' nkambo Jehova ulakuyandisya , mpawo nyika yako iyokwatwa
Nchobeni, mbuli mwalumi munini mbwakwata mwanakazi munini, aboobo bana bako balombe bayokukwata, alimwi mbuli nabwiinga mbwakondwa kubwinga bwakwe. Mpawo Leza wako uyokondelwa anduwe.
Ndabikka sikulinda malambo, Jelusalemu; tabawumwide sikati naa mansiku. Inywebo nimwibalusya Jehova, mutawumuni pe.
mutamuzumizyi kulyokezya kusikila akasimpikizye Jelusalemu akwichita kuti utembawulwe aanyika.
Jehova wakonkezya ajanza lyakwe lyalulyo akuboko kwanguzu zyakwe, ''Nchobeni nsikoyopa limbi zilyo zyako mbuli chilyo chabasinkondonyokwe. Beenzu tabakoyoonywa wayini wako mupya ooyo ngwakabelekela!
Nkambo aaba batebula zilyo bayolya nzizyo akulumbayizya Jehova alimwi aabo bachelo masansa bayoonywa wayini muchibetekelo changu chachiyubilo chisalala.''
Mwiinde, mwiinde mumilyango! mubambile nzila yabantu muchiyake muyake mugwagwa! mubungike mabwe! musumpwide bamasi indembela!
Langa, Jehova waambilizya kusikila kumamanino anyika, ''Uwambe kumwana musimbi wa Ziyoni; Langa, Mufutuli wako wasika! bona bulumbu bulanguwe, alimwi ankambilizyo yakwe mpiili kunembo lyakwe.''
Bayomwamba kuti, ''Mbantu basalala; banunuke ba Jehova,'' Mpawo uyowambwa kuti ulisalidwe; munzi utasiiidwe.''
Ngwani ooyu uzwa ku Edomi, uzweete majansi asalala kuli Bbozila? Ngwani oyu, usamide zisamo zyabo zyebesi, zyendelana mumanguzu aakwe? ''Ndendime, ningwambula mubululami, mupati ugwasya.''
Nkambonzi zisamo zyako nizisalala, alimwi nkamboonzi nalangika mbuli chikandilo chamisansa?

''Ndakalyatuuka misansa achikkandilo chayo achilikke, alimwi takwepe naba umwi wamuzisi wakaba andime. Ndakabalyata changuzu mukunyema kwangu akweenda mulinchicho amukunyema loko. Mabata-mabata abulowa bwabo akazula azisamo zyangu akudyabila kwakazula azisamo zyangu zyoonse.
Elyo ndakalangilila lyakunembo kuzuba lyakubwedezya, akumunyaka wakunununwa wakasika.
Ndakalanga, alimwi takwe naba omwe wakandigwasya. Ndakagamba kuti takwepe umbi sikundigwasya, pesi kuboko kwangu kwaketa lufutuko kulindime, bukali bwangu bwakanditola kunembo.
Ndakalyatawuka bantu ansi mukunyema kwangu akubachita kuti bakolwe mubukali bwangu, alimwi ndakatila bulowa bwabo anyika.'''

Njomwambila nchito zya Jehova achizuminano chakusyomekana, amilimo ya Jehova itembawulika. Njomwambila zyoonse Jehova nzyakatuchitila, bululami abubotu kung'anda ya Izilayeli. Buuya bwakwe wakabutondezya kulindiswe nkambo kaluzyalo lwakwe, anchito nyiingi kuchizuminano chakusyomekana.
Nkambo wakati, ''Nchobeni mbantu bangu, bana balibombya.'' Wakaba mufutuli wabo.

Mumapenzi aabo woonse, wakapengana alakwe, abangelo kuzwa mubuliwo bwakwe wakabafutula. Muluyando lwakwe amuluzyalo wakabafutula, akubasumpula akubabweza lwabo wakababweza muzyindi zyabo boonse zyakale.
Pesi bakapapila akunyemya muuya Uusalala. Elyo wakaba sinkondonyina akubalwisya mwini.

Bantu bakwe bakayeeya aatala azyindi zyakale zya Mozesi. Bakaamba kuti, ''Ulikuli Leza, ooyo wakababoozya kuzwa kulwizi beembeli abutanga? Ulikuli Leza, oyo wakabikka muuya wakwe Uusalala mukati kabo?
Ulikuli Leza, oyop wakanza bulemu bwakwe busalalisya wakeenda akuboko kwalulyo lwa Mozesi, akwandania maanzi kuli mbabo, akuchita kufumbwa chitamani muzina lyakwe?
Ulikuli Leza, oyo wakabazulwida akati kamaanzi malamfu? Mbuli bbiza lichijana anyika kutakwe chintu, alimwi tibakali gubbula pe.
Mbubhonya mbuli ng'ombe ziya mukkuti, muuya wa Jehova wakabapa kulyokezya. Mbuboobo mbwakazulwida bantu bako, kuti ulichitile zina lilumbayizigwa.
Langa ansi akujulu ulangisisye kuzwa kubusena bwako busalala abulemu. Buli kuli busungu bwako anguzu zyako mpati? Mapenzi anu aluzyalo anchito zilibambidwe kulindiswe.
Nkambo nduwe taata wesu, mbunga Abbulahamu tatuzi pe, a Izilayeli tatuyeyi pe, iwe, Jehova, nduwe taata wesu. 'Mumuni wesu'nizina lyako kuzyindi zyakale.
Jehova, nkambonzi notulesya kuzwa munzila zyako akuyumya myoyo yesu, kuti tatukulemeki? Boola nkambo kabalalanda bako, kuzogwasya misyobo yabavubidwe.
Bantu bako bakavuba busena busalala mukayindi kanini, pesi basinkondonyina bakabalyatawuka.
Twaba mbuli abo batana kwendelezegwa, mbuli aabo batana bunsi bitwa muzina lyako.''
''Akaka, anoli wakanzaania ajulu majulu akuseluka aansi! Izilundu zyalikuno zungana kubuliwo bwako?
mbuli mulilo uutenta buyokoyoko, naa mulilo uchita maanzi abile. Akaka, kuti izina lyako lizibwe kuli basinkondonyokwe, kuti zisi zizungaane kubuliwo bwako!
Muchindi chakayinda, eelyo nimwakali kuchita zigambya ezyo nzitwakali kulangilila, wakasika aansi, alimwi zilundu zyakateketa kubuliwo bwako.
Kuzwa zyiindi zyansiku taakwe naba uumwi Leza uutensi nduwe, ulichitila zintu akumulindila.
Uuza kuzogwasya aabo babotelwa mukuchita zibotu, aabo bayeeya nzila zyabo akuzilemeka, wakanyema nitwakabisya. Munzila zyako tuyovunwa lyoonse.
Nkambo toonse twalitwaba mbuli utasalede, alimwi zyoonse zichito zyesu ziluleme zili mbuli matu; milandu yesu, mbuli guuwo, lyatusowela kule.
Taakwe bayita muzina lyako, ubweza intamo kulinduwe. Nkaambo wakasisa busyu bwako alimwi watuchita zibi zyasowegwa mumaboko amilandu yesu.
Nikuba, Jehova, webo nduwe taatesu; Nduwe mubumbi wesu; alimwi tuli milimo yamaboko aako.
Utanyemesyi pe, Jehova, nikuba kotuyeeya kwiminana azibi zyesu. Inchekaka langa kuli ndiswe toonse, tobantu bako.
Zisi zyako zisalala zyaba chimpayuma; Ziyoni yaba chimpayuma, Jelusalemu lyabatongo.
Ntempele yesu isalala iyebeka, oko bamatatesu nkubakakulumbayizigwa, yakalobesegwa amulilo, aboonse benzinyina bakeendelezya.
Mbubuli mbokonzya kuli kasya, Jehova? Mbubuli mbokonzya kuumuna alimwi akwinkilila aanembo akunotupenzya?''

Ndakali bambilide mukuyanduulwa abaabo batakwe nibakali kubuzya pe; Ndakali bambilide mukujanwa abaabo bakata ndiyanduula. Ndakamba kuti, 'Mebo Ndilaano!'Mebo Ndilaano!' kuchisi echo chakatitide zina lyangu.
Ndakayala maanza angu zuba lyoonse kubantu batamvwide pe, abo bendela munzila eyo italikabotu pe, aabo bakeenda kuzwa mumiyeeyo amabambe aabo!
Bolwabo mbantu bakkala kabandibisizya, bapeda zipayizyo muzilili, alimwi akutenta tununkilizyo atala lyazitina.
Bakkala akati katubanda kabalinda busiku boonse, alimwi akulya nyama yangulube antomwe anyama isofwede mumbede zyabo.
Baamba kut, 'Mwinkilile oko, mutasiki afwifwi kuli ndime, nkambo ndilasalalisya kwinda ndinywe.'zintu ezi mbusi mumpemo zyangu, mulilo uuyaka zuba lyonse.
Langa, kulilembedwe kunembo lyangu: Nsikoyowumuna pe, nkambo Ndiyobaliya; ndiyobaliya lubo kunembo lyabo,

akambo kezibi zyabo azibi zyabamawisi babo antomwe, ''Mbwawamba Jehova. Njobaliya nkambo kakutentela tununkilizyo aatala amalundu akundinyansya atulundu. Ndiyoyela zichito zyabo zyakale kunembo lyabo.''

Obu mbombubo mbwawamba Jehova, ''Mbuli kuti muswnswi wajanika munkanyina yamasansa, umwi nawamba kuti, 'Utachinyonyooni, nkambo muli chibotu mukati kecho,'eechi nchicho nchindiyochitila balanda bangu: Nsikoyo banyonyoona boonse.
Njoyeta lunyungu luzwa kuli Jakobo, alimwi akuzwa muli Juda abo bayovuba zilundu zyangu. Nobasale bangu muyovuba nyika, alimwi balanda bangu bayokkala mumo.
Syeloni uyoba machezezyo amatanga, alimwi musena wako mbusena bwakulyokezezya kwabutanga, nkambo kabantu bangu bandiyanduula.
Pesi webo nukaka Jehova, waluba chilundu changu chisalala, oyo ubambilila ntafula yachoolwe, alimwi uzuzya nkomeki yawayini uswanizigilwe awayini ya Bukkalo.

Ndiyokubikkila panga, alimwi moonse muyokotamina sikujaya, nkambo nindakayita, tewakandisandula pe; nindakaambula, tewakaswilila pe. Pesi wakachita chibi kunembo lyangu akusala kwiita echo chisesemya ndime.''
Mbuboobu Mwami Jehova mbwawamba, ''Langa, balanda bangu bayolya, pesi muyoba enzala; langa balanda bangu bayonywa, pesi muyoba anyota; langa, balanda bangu bayokondwa, pesi muyobikwa mumawuse.
Langa, balanda bangu bayowompolola chaluyando nkambo kabubotu bwamoyo, pesi muyolila nkambo kamachise amoyo, alimwi bayowongelwa nkambo kakuuma kwamuya.
Uyosiya musule izina lyako mbuli lutuko kubasale bangu kukwambula; Mebo, mwami Jehova, uyokujaya; Njobayita balanda bangu azina limbi.

Kufumbwa uyowambilizya zilongezyo aano anyika uyolongezegwa andime, Leza wanchoonzyo. Kufumbwa uyobweza chikonke ansi ano uyosamikwa andime, Leza wakasimpe, nkambo mapenzi akiinda ayolubigwa, nkambo zinosisidwe kumenso aangu.
Nkambo ngamubone, Mebo ndamba kulenga julu pya anyika mpya; azintu zyachiindi taziyoyeyegwi limbi nanak kuzibikila mumizezo.
Pesi muyokondwa akubotelwa kwalyonse kulizezyo nzindiyakuyolenga, Bona, Ndaamba kuyolenga Jelusalemu mbuli lukondo, alimwi bantu bakwe mbuli kuyoyelwa.
Ndiyokondelwa ku Jelusalemu akubotelwa akubantu bangu; kowoomoka akukwila kwakutakkalinkana takukoyomvwika limbi kulinguwe.

Takukoyoba alimbi mwana muniini uyopona mazuba mache, naaba mwalumi mupati uyofwa chindi chakwe kachitanasika. Umwi ufwida kumyaanda yamyaaka uyolumbulwa amwana muniini. Kufumbwa umwi utakabule kuyosisya myaaka ili mwanda yakupona ngunoli wambwa kuti ulitukidwe.
Bayoyaka manda akukkala mulingawo, alimwi bayobyala minsamu yamasansa akwilya michelo yayo.
Takuchikwe limbi nibachiyoyaka maanda akuyokkala mulingawo, tabachiyobyali, alimwi akuyolya limbi, mbuli kumazuba aminsamu ayoba mazuba abantu bangu. Basale bangu bayoponena kumilimu yamanza aabo.
Tabakoyobeleka chabuyo, naa kuyochita chabuyo. Nkaambo mbana babaabo balongezezegwe a Jehova, alimwi alunyungu kabalaamwi.
Kabatanayita, Njobavwiila, alimwi kayindi kaniini kabachaambuula; Ndiyomvwa.

Mwaaba amwana wambeele ziyochela aamwi, alimwi mulavu uyolya sokwe mbuli musune; pesi lusuko ndoluyoba chakulya chanzoka. Takuyobi limbi chichisa nanka kumwayisigwa atala achilundu chisalala,'' mbwaamba Jehova.
Mbuboobu mbwawamba Jehova, ''Ijulu nchikkalilo changu, alimwi inyika nchikkalilo chamawulu angu. Mpaali lino mpumuyondiyakila ng' anda? Bulikuli busena oko nkundinga ndilalyokezezya?

Ijanza lyangu lyakapanga zintu zyoonse eezi; mbombubo obu zintu zyoonse ezi mbuzyakeza - oku nkokwaamba kwa Jehova. Oyu nguumwalumi ngundikondelwa, utyokede akulikatazya mumuuya, alimwi oyo ukankama kujwi lyangu.

Oyo  ugonka musune alimwi ulajaya muntu; oyo utuula kabelele alimwi ulatyola nsingo yamubwa; oyo waaba chaabilo chabilo chazilyo ulaaba bulowa bwangulube; oyo waaba tununkilizyo twachiyeezyo alimwi ulalongezya bubi. Bakasala nzila zyabo beni, alimwi balakondelwa mukumunama kwabo.

Munzila njiyonya eyo ndiyosala chisyubulo chabo beni; ndiyoyeta alimbabo nchibayoowa, nkambo nindakiita, taakwe wakasandula; nindaakambula takwe omwe wakaswilila. Bakachita zyakali zibi kumenso aangu alimwi bakasala kuchita ezyo zindinyongania.''

Amumvwe ijwi lya Jehova, nywebo nimukankama kujwi lyakwe, ''Bananyokwe bamusule akumupambula akambo kazina lyangu bakaamba kuti, 'Jehova ngalemekwe, mpawo tuyobona lukondo lwanu,' pesi balakuusisigwa insoni.
Muzuzumo wankondo uzwakumunzi, muzuzumo kuzwa kuchikombelo, muzuzumo wa Jehova ujosezya basinkondonyina.
Katana kunjila mukumyongwa; ulatumbuka machise kaatana kusika alinguwe, wakatuma mwana mulombe.

Ngwani wakamvwide chintu chili boobu? Ngwani wakabwene ziliboobu? Nyika nga ilazyalwa na mubuzuba bomwe? Chisi chilakonzya na kwiimikwa muchindi chomwe? Kakuli kuti webo Ziyoni nonjila mukumyongwa, ulatumbuka bana bako.
Sa ndilalela mwana kumulyango wakuzyalilwa akutazumizya mwana kuti azyalwe?-- ulabuzya Jehova. Naakuti ndilaleta mwana kuchiindi chakuzyalwa mpawo ndamujosya?--ulabuzya Jehova.''
Amukondwe a Jehova akubotelwa anguwe, nywebo moonseni nimumuyanda, mukondelwe anguwe, nywebo moonseni nimwakamulila!
Nkaambo muyuwongwa akukkutisika; ankolo zyakwe mujisi kumbulizigwa; nkambo muyoonywa buzwide akusekelela mukuvula kwabulemu bwakwe.

Mboobu Jehova mbwawamba, ''Ndaamba kutila buvubi alinguwe mbuli mulonga, alimwi buvubi bwazisi mbuli kufusuuka kwakalonga. Muyolelwa kubbazu lyakwe, akubwezwa mumanza aakwe, alimwi mukalelwe kumazwi aakwe.
Mbuli mwanakazi mbubawumbulizya mwana wabo mbuboobo mbundiyomumbulizya, alimwi muyovumbilizigwa mu Jelusalemu.''
Muyozibona eezi, alimwi moyowanu uyokondwa, alimwi mafuwa aanu ayoosyuka mbuli sokwetete. Janza lya Jehova liyozibisigwa kubalanda bakwe, pesi uyotondeezya kunyema kwakwe kuli basinkondonyina.
Nkambo amulange, Jehova uleza amulilo, alimwi inkalaki zyakwe zilaza mbuli luuwo lwamvula kuleta kuumpa kwakunyema kwakwe amabangabanga amulilo.
Nkambo Jehova ulapa lubeta kubantu bamisyobo amulilo apanga lyakwe. Bayovula abo bayojayigwa a Jehova.

Balalisalazya lwabo beni akulichita baluleme beni, kuti banjile muzilili, kutobela abo bali akkati kabaabo balyanyama yangulube azimwi zisesemya mbuli mbeba (kasandwida kumazuba aano apa bupanduluzi bwiingi kumuncali oyu muyumu) ''Bayoosika kumagolelo - oku nkwaamba kwa Jehova.
Nkambo ndilizi nchito zyabo amiyeeyo yabo. Chiindi chileza nindiyobungania zisi zyoonse amilaka. Bayosika akubona bulemu bwangu. (kusandwida kwamazubaano kupa bupanduluzi bunji kumunchali oyu muyumu)

Ndiyobikka chitondezyo akkati kabo. Mpawo ndiyotuma bakafutuka kuzwa kulimbabo kuya kuzisi: ku Tasyisyi, Puti, aku Ludi, abo bakafusa mivwi, kuTubbalu, Javani, alimwi akumanyika akunkomwe alikule oko nkubatana kumvwa aatala andime nikuba kubona bulemu bwangu. Balakwamba bulemu bwangu akati kazisi.

Bayoobozya boonse bananyina kuzwa kuzisi zyoone, mbuli zituuzyo kuli Jehova. Balokuza atala zyambong'olo, alimwi amunkalaki, mungolo abana bambongolo, alimwi ankamela,kusika kuchilundu changu chisalala Jelusalemu- mbwaamba Jehova. Nkaambo bantu baIzilayeli bayoleta chituzyo chazilyo mumutiba usambide kunjila mung'anda yaJehova.
Bamwi babaanzi ndiyobasala mbuli bapayizi abaLevi- mbaamba Jehova.
Nkaambo mbuli majulu mapya anyika mpya ezyo nzintakapange ziyookkala kunembo lyangu -  oku nkwaamba kwaJehova- aboobo lunyungu lwako luyoosyala, alimwi izina lyako liyoosyala.
Kuzwa kumwezi umwi kusika kulutobela,alimwi kuzwa kusabata kusika kuli litobela, bantu boonse bayooza kukuvundama kuli ndime- mbaamba Jehova.
Bayooyinka anze akubona mitunta ifwide yabantu bakandipapila, nkaambo nkonye abalya takoyoofwa,alimwi mulilo ubalya tukwe kuyozima, alimwi kuyooba kufwaba kunyika yoonse.
Jemusi, mubelesi waLeza aMwami Jesu Kkilisito, kumisyobo yabantu ilikkumi ayibili iisanseene munyika: Mwajuzigwa!.
Muzibweze mbuli lukondo loonse, nobakwesu, aawo nimuswaanana amakataazyo asiyenesiyene.
Mulizi kuti kusunkwa kwalusyomo lwenu kuzyala banangatizi.
Amulekele bunangatizi, bumaninsye mulimu wabo kuchitila kuti mukonzye kukomena akumaninina, kamutachibuli chintu pe.
Pesi na umwi wenu kayanda busongo, ngabukumbile kuliLeza, ooyo uupa mubwiingi alimwi katakalalili pe kuli baabo bakumbila, mpawo uyoomupa.
Pesi ngakumbile mukusyoma, kakutakwe kudoneeka. Nkaambo kufumbwa muntu uudoneeka ulimbuli juwe mulwizi litontwa aluuwo alimwi kaliyumbwa kumabazu woonse.
Ooyo muntu atayeeyi kuti uyootambula chimwi chintu kuzwa kuMwami pe.
Muntu uli boobo ulaamizeezo iibili, takkalinkene pe munzila zyakwe zyoonse.
Ngapakale mukwesu muchete muchuuno chakwe chaajulu,
pesi muvubi muchuuno chakwe chilaansi, nkaambo uzooyinda mbuli dubaluba lyalusaka musokwe.
Nkaambo zuba lizwa akupya akutenta alimwi akuyumya masokwe mpawo dubaluba lilaloka, alimwi bubotu bwalyo ngabwamana. Muli njiyeyi nzila, muntu muvubi uyooyangala aakati kalweendo lwakwe.
Ulilongezezegwe ooyo unangatila muchiindi chamasunko,  nkaambo aazunda masunko uyootambula musini wabuumi, eelyo lyakasyomezegwa aabo bayanda Leza.
Kutakabi muntu utakaambe kuti aakusunkwa, ''Ndasunkwa aaLeza.'' nkaambo Leza tasunkwi achibi pe, alimwi we lwakwe takwe ngwasunka pe.
Pesi umwi awumwi muntu usunkwa akupeekezya kwakwe, ikumukwelela kule akumweneena.
Impeekezyo niyamita ilatumbuka chibi mpawo nichakomena, chazyala lufu.
Tamweneenwi, nobakwesu bayandwa.
Choonse chipo chibotu achoonse chipo chimaninide chizwa kujulu. Chizwa kujulu kuli Wisi wamimuni. Leza tasanduki pe mbuli zilenge, zilimbuli mweenzule, mbuzisanduka.
Leza wakasala kuti tuzyalwe ajwi lyakasimpe, kuchitila kuti tube musyobo wamichelo mitaanzi kuzintu zyoonse nzyakalenga, eezyo zikonzya kupegwa luzutu aJesu.
Mulichizi eechi, nobakwesu bayandwa: amuchite kuti muntu woonse afwambaane kumvwa, atafwambaani kukwambuula, nikuba kunyema.
Nkaambo kunyema kwamuntu takuzuzikizyi bululami bwaLeza pe.
Nkikaako amugwisye woonse mawunda mawunda aabulewusi busesemya bwazibi. Mukulifwiinsya amutambule ijwi lyakabyalwa, eelyo likonzya kuvuna myuuya yenu.
Amube bachiti bejwi peepe basikuswilizya biyo, kamuliikulyeena.
Nkaambo na muntu kamvwa biyo ijwi pesi katalichiti, ulimbuli muntu uuleyeba busyu bwakwe mbububumbidwe muchiboniboni.
Ulalyeeba, pesi  aazwa biyo waliluuba mbabede.
Pesi muntu uulanga kabotu mumulawu walwaangunuko, alimwi kayinkilila kunembo akuchita boobo, katali sikumvwa biyo uuluba, ooyu muntu ulalongezegwa munchito zyakwe.
Na umwi muntu kaliyeeya kuti ngwabuna Leza, pesi katazyotololi lulimi lwakwe, weena moyo wakwe, alimwi nzyasyoma nzyabuyo.
Lusyomo lusalala lutakwe kampenda kunembo lyaLeza aaTaata ndyakuti: kugwasya bamuchaala abamukabafu kulizibachisa, akuliyobola lwabo beni chakutaba akampenda nikaba komwe kamunyika.
Nobakwesu, mutajatilili kulusyomo muMwami wesu Jesu Kkilisito, Mwami wabulemu, chakusaluula bamwi bantu.
Atwaambe kuti umwi muntu wanjila mumuswaangano wako kasamide inwenwe zyangolide azisamo zibotu, mpawo kwazoonjila umwi muchete uusamide zileetombe.
Na walanga muntu uusamide zibotu akwaamba kuti, ''Webo kkala aawa abusena bubotu,'' pesi kuli yooyu muchete wasikuti, ''Webo kiminookiya,'' na kuti, ''Kkalaansi aawa,''
munooli tamuliikubetekeana na mukati kanu? Tewmwaba babetesi bajisi mizeezo mibi na?
Amuswilizye nobakwesu bayandika, Leza taakasala bachete munyika kuti babe bavubi mulusyomo na alimwi kuti bazookone Bwami oobo mbwaakasyomezya kulibaabo bamuyanda ?
Pesi teemwabalemeka pe bachete! Tabeensi bavubi na bamudyamizya ? Teensi mbabo na bamukwelela kunkuta?
Tabali mbabo na batukila zina bbotu eelyo ndimwakayitwa aalyo?
Zyanchonzyo, na mwazuzikizya mulawo waMwami, wabubanakukalya, mbuli mumalembe aati, ''Mukayande basimayakilane benu mbuli mbomuliyanda lwenu,'' munooli mwachita kabotu.
Pesi na kamusaluula mbimuyanda muliikuchita chibi, alimwi muliikupegwa mulandu amulawo wakutyola mulawu.
Nkaambo kufumbwa muntu uulemeka mulawu woonse, pesi kalebwa muli uli aamulandu wakukutyola mulawu woonse.
Akaambo kakuti ooyo wakati, ''Utachiti bumambi,'' nguwe lubo wakati, ''utajayi.'' Na kotachiti bumambi, pesi wajaya, unooli waba simutyola mulawu.
Nkinkaako ambula akuchita mbuli baabo batazoobetekwe anzila yamulawu walwaangunuko.
Nkaambo lubeta luza kalutakwe lweetelo kulibaabo batatondeezyi lweetelelo. Lweetelelo lulaluzunda lubeta.
Mbubotuunzi, nobakwesu, kuti umwi muntu wati ulijisi lusyomo, pesi katakwe milimu? Oolo lusyomo lulakonzya kumuvuna na?
Tuteedi umwi mukwesu na muchizi tasamide zisamo zilikabotu pe alimwi takwe kulya kwabuzuba oobo.
Twaambe kuti umwi wenu wabaambila kuti, ''Kamuya muluumuno, mukkale mukasalilwe alimwi mukute", pesi taabapa zintu zyeelede mubili, kuli mpinduunzi?
Munzila yomwe njiyeeyo lusyomo alulike, na kalutakwe milimu, lulifwide.
Pesi umwi ukonzya kwaamba kuti, ''Uli aalusyomo, alimwi imebo ndili amilimu.'' Nditondezye lusyomo lwako kakutakwe milimu, alimwi ndilakutondeezya lusyomo lwangu kwinda mumilimu yangu.
Ulasyoma na kuti kuli Leza omwe; uliikuchita kabotu. Pesi ayilayo myuuya mibi ilazisyoma eezyo, mpawo iteketa chakuyoowa.
Mulayanda na kuziba,  nobaalumi bafubafuba, kuti lusyomo lutakwe milimu ndwabuyo?
Abbulahamu taata wesu taakalulamikwa amilimu na aawo naakaba mwana wakwe Ayizeki kuchipayilo?
Mwabona kuti lusyomo lwakabeleka antoomwe amilimu yakwe, alimwi kwiinda kumilimu yakwe lusyomo lwakwe lwakamaninina.
Akazuzikizigwa malembe aawamba kuti, ''Abbulahamu wakasyoma Leza, alimwi zyakamwaambya kuti uli aabululami,'' akwaambwa kuti mweenzinyina waLeza.
Mwabona kuti muntu waambwiidwa aamilimu yakwe, peepe alusyomo biyo.
Munzila ikozyania, Lahabbu sibumambi teembaakalulamikwa na amilimu aawo mpaakatambula basikutumwa akubalayila kuti bayende aayimbi nzila?
Nkaambo mbuli mubili mbuuwanzeene amuuya ulifwide, mbombubo alulalo lusyomo lwaanzeene amilimu lulifwide.
Bayingi benu tababi bayiisyi pe, nobakwesu, nkaambo mulizi kuti swebo nituyiisya tuyoobetekwa zikkalikali.
Nkaambo toonse tulalebwa munzila nyingi. Na umwi muntu katalebwi kumajwi, ooyo muntu uliluleme chakumaninina, ulakonzya kuzyotolola mubili wakwe woonse.
Lino na katubika nkabyo mumulomo wamabbiza kuti atutobelezye, nga twakonzya kuzyotolola mibili yawo.
Amuzibe alimwi kuti maato, nikuba kuti mapati biyeni alimwi ayenzegwa aluuwo, alayambwa ansoke niini loko kuyoosika kufumbwa nkwayanda sikwayenzya.
Munzila yomwe, lulimi nchizo chiniini loko, pesi lulalikankayizya muzintu zipati. Amubone alimwi kalilo kaniini mbukatentezya lusaka loonse.
Lulimi alulalo nkalilo, nyika yazibi ibikidwe aakati kazizo zyamibili yesu. Lulimi luninaania mubili woonse, luumpa buumi boonse, nkabela kuninaanakwalo kuzwa kugehhena.
Nkaambo woonse musyobo wamunyama wamusokwe, bayuni, ziyalalika, azyuuka zyamulwizi ziliikuvubwa alimwi zilazyotololwa abantu.
Pesi tawo pe muntu uukonzya Kuzyotolola lulimi. Mbubi butalyookezyi pe, musamu uujaya.
Andulo tulalumbayizya Mwami aTaata, alimwi andulo tulatuka bantu bakalengwa muchikozyanio aLeza.
Kuzwa mumulomo nguwo omwe kuzwa zilongezyo akutuka, Nobakwesu, eezi zintu tazyeelede kunoochitika pe.
Kasawu komwe kalazwa na maanzi manono amaanzi aalweela?
Mukuyu ulazya na nsikili nobakwesu? Na kuti musansa, uzyale nkuyu? Aboobo tachikonzeki pe kuti kasawu kazwa maanzi aalweela kazwe maanzi mabotu.
Ngwani musongo umvwisisisya aakati kenu? Mumuleke muntu ooyo atondeezye buumi bwakwe bubotu kwiinda kumilimu yakwe yakulibombya.
Pesi na kojisi bbivwe ndulwe mumoyo wako, utalikankayizyi pe akubejela kasimpe.
Oobu teensi mbombubo pe busongo buzwa kujulu. Anukutu mbwaansi, mbwenyama, buzwa kumyuuya mibi.
Nkaambo aawo aalibbivwe abusyaamuvule mwangu, kuli lupyopyongano anchito mbi.
Pesi busongo buzwa kujulu, lutaanzi bulasalala, alimwi mbwalumuuno, mbwabuuya, mbwamiyeeyo mibotu, buzwide lweetelelo amichelo mibotu, talusali pe alimwi ndwabwini.
Muchelo wabululami ulabyalwa muluumuno mukati kabaabo bachita chaluumuno.
Kuzwa kuli kupopotezyania ampyopyongano aakati kenu? Tazizwidi muziyandisyo zyenu na eezyo zilwana akati kenu nobeni?
Mulapeekezya, pesi tamukwe pe. Mulajaya akuba aabbivwe, pesi tamukonzyi kujana. Mulalwana akupopotezyania. Taakwe anchimuli aacho pe nkaambo tamukumbili.
Mulakumbila pesi tamujani pe nkaambo mukumbila aamoyo uutaluleme pe, kamuyanda kuti muzuzikizye ziyandisyo zyenu.
Nywebo nobasimamambe! Tamuzi na kuti buzolwani enyika nkulwana aaLeza? Nkokwaamba kuti kufumbwa ulisalila kuba mweenzinyina wanyika ulichita sinkondonyina aLeza.
Na muyeeya kuti malembe awamba zyabuyo aati, ''Muuya ngwaakachita kuti apone mulindiswe uli aabbivwe loko''?
Pesi Leza uupa luzyalo lwiingi, aboobo malembe awamba kuti, ''Leza ulabakazya balisumpula, pesi upa luzyalo kuli balibombya.''
Nkokuti amulifwiinsye kuliLeza. Mumukake satani, alimwi ulamuchija.
Amuswene afwiifwi aLeza, alimwi uleza afwiifwi andinywe, Amusalazye maboko eenu, nywebo nobasizibi, alimwi musalazye myoyo yenu, nywebo nobasimyoyo iibili.
Mumvwe machise, mupwaye mibila, akulila ! Muchite kuti kuseka kwenu kube mawuse alimwi lukondo lwenu lube kuungumana.
Amulibombye kunembo lyaMwami, alimwi uyoomunyampula.

Tamunoowambuuli chakutamikizyania, nobakwesu. Muntu waambuula bubi aatala amuzyalwanyina na kumubeteka muzyalwanyina ukazyania amulawu, alimwi ubeteka mulawu. Na wabeteka mulawu, toli simuchita mulawu pe, pesi ulimubetesi.
Ngumwi biyo sikupa mulawu amubetesi. Nguwe uukonzya kufutula akujaya. Nduweni, webo noobeteka simayakilanenyokwe?
Muswilizye lino, nywebo nimwaamba kuti, ''sunu na juunza tuyoonjila muchisi eechi, tukakkale munyaka nkukooko, tukasambale, alimwi tukajane mpindu.''
Ngwani uuzi zitakachitike juunza, alimwi buumi bwako niinzi? Nkaambo nduwe sikunkwe uuboneka kwachiindi chiniini mpawo wamwayika.
Anukuti, mweelede kwaamba kuti, ''Na Mwami kayanda, tulapona alimwi tuchite eechi na eechiya.''
Pesi lino mulalikankayizya aatala amabambe eenu. Kulikankayizya kuli boobu koonse nkubi.
Nkinkaako kuli woonse uuzi kuchita kabotu pesi katazichiti, kulinguwe nchoono.
Amuze lino, nywebo nimuvubide, mulile mulyeeme akaambo kamasukuusyo aatamusikile.
Buvubi bwenu bwabola, alimwi zisamo zyenu zyavunda ankubi.
Ingolide ansiliva zyenu zyabbulubana alimwi bulala bwazyo bulaba bukamboni butakamukone. Buyoolya nyama yenu mbuli mulilo. Mwalondola buvubi bwenu kuchitila mazuba aakumamamnino.
Amubone, mifolo njimuliikwiima basimilimu benu aabo baliikumukwiilila. Kukwiila kwabasikutebula kwasika kumatwi aaMwami wamakamu.
Mwapona chakukkalinkana aanyika akulibotezya mulizyoonse. Myoyo yenu mwayineneesezya buzuba bwakujayigwa.
Mwapa mulandu alimwi akujaya muntu mululami. Taakwe naamulwana pe.
Nkikaako amube amoyo mulamfu nobakwesu, mane akaboole Mwami. Mubone mulimi mbalindila muchelo mubotu kuzwa munyika alimwi uli aamoyo mulamfu kukuulindila, mane do kuwa kwemvula ntaanzi ayamelelezyo.
Anywebo amukkazike myoyo yenu. Amusimye myoyo yenu nkaambo kuboola kwaMwami kwaba aafwiifwi.
Tamutongawuki, nobakwesu, chenuchenu, nkokuti tamukabetekwi. Amubone, mubetesi uliimvwi aamulyango.
Amujane chitondeezyo nobakwesu, kuzwa kukoomba akulansya myoyo kwabasinsimi, aabo bakaambuula muzina lyaMwami.
Mubone, twaamba kuti aabo bakawunduuzya machise balilongezezegwe. Mwakamvwa Joobbu mbakapengaana, alimwi mulizi machitilo aaMwami, mbayetelela akutondeezya luse.

Aatala aazyoonse nobakwesu, mutakonki, nikuba kwaana ejulu na nyika, na nikuba achili zwecho chikonke. Anukuti, ''Iyii'' wenu ngabe ''Iyii'' alimwi ''Peepe'' wenu abe ''Peepe,'' kuchitila kuti tamukanjili mukubetekwa.
Kuli umwi na aakati kenu uulimubuyumuyumu? Ngakombe. Kuli uli aalumwemwe na? Ngayimbe ntembawuzyo.
Kuli umwi uchisidwe na akati kenu? Ngayite baalu bembungano, alimwi ngabamukombele. Abamunanike mafuta muzina lyaMwami.
Nkombyo yalusyomo ilamuponia muntu uuchiswa, alimwi Mwami ulamubusya. Kuti kali wakachita zibi, Leza ulamulekelela.
Nkikaako muzumine zibi zyenu kuli umwi awumwi, alimwi mukombelane, kuchitila kuti mupone. Inkombyo yamuntu mululami ili aanguzu loko kumabelekelo aayo.
Elayija wakali mwaalumi mbuli ndiswe, wakakomba chamoyo woonse kuti imvula itawi, alimwi teeyakawa pe kubusena oobo kwaminyaka yotatwe amyeezi musanu awumwi.
Mpawo Elayija wakakomba lubo. Majulu akapa mvula, alimwi inyika yakazyala michelo yaayo.
Nobakwesu, na umwi aakati kenu wasweeka wazwa kukasimpe, alimwi umwi wamuboozya,
ooyo muntu weelede kuziba kuti kufumbwa muntu uboozya sizibi kuzwa kubulewusi bwanzila yakwe uyoomuvuna kuzwa kulufu, alimwi uyoovumba mweelwe mupati wazibi.
Musule alufu lwa Josyuwa, bantu ba Izilayeli bakabuzya Jehova, kabaamba kuti, ''Nguni utakasangune kutwiinkila kuba Kkanani, kukuyolwana ambabo?''
Jehova wakamba kuti, ''Juda uyoyinka. Langa, ndabapa inguzu zyanyika eeyi.''

Baalumi ba Juda bakaamba kuti kubaalumi ba Simiyoni, bakkulana babo, ''Atweende aamwi andiswe muchaabilo chesu echo chakapegwa kulindiswe muchaabilo chesu eecho chakapegwa kulindiswe kuti antoomwe tukalwane aba Kkanani. Andiswe tuzoyinke aandinywe kuchaabilo eecho chakapegwa kulindinywe.'' Aboobo mukowa wa Simiyoni wakiinka aambabo.
Baalumi ba Juda bakiinka, alimwi Jehova wakabapa luzundo aatala aba Kkanani aba Pelizi. Bakajaya bamwi babo bali zyuulu zili kkumi ku Bbezekki.
Bakajana Adoni-Bbezekki ku Bbezekki, alimwi bakamulwisya akuzunda ba Kkanani aba Pelezi.
Pesi Adoni-Bbezekki wakachija, mpawo bakamwandilila akumujata, alimwi bakamudunswida zyaala zyakwe zyakumawulu zipati.

Adoni-Bbezekki wakaamba kuti, ''Baami bali makkumi musanu aabili, aabo bakadunswiidwe zyaala azyaala zyakumawulu, bakabungika chakulya chabo kuzwa munsi aatebuli lyangu. Mbuli mbundakachita, mbubonya Leza mbwachita kulindime.'' Bakamuleta ku Jelusalema, alimwi wakafwa nkuko.
Baalumi ba Juda bakalwana aamunzi wa Jelusalema akuubweza. Bakawusikila apanga libosya akuumpa munzi.
Kumana kwaboobo, baalumi ba Juda bakaseluka kuyolwisya ba Kkanani aabo bakali kukkala munyika yazilundu, mu Negevi, amunyika zikunukide.
Ba Juda bakalwisya ba Kkanani aabo bakali kukkala mu Hebbuloni ( ichindi zina lya Hebbuloni lyakali Kkiliyati Alibba) alimwi bakazunda Syesyayi, Ahimani, a Talumayi.
Kuzwa oko baalumi ba Juda bakiinka kuyolwana abakkali baku Debbili ( chiindi zina lya Debbili lyakali Kkiliyati Sefa).
Kkalebbu wakaamba kuti, ''Kufumbwa ulwanisya Kkiliyati Sefa akuubweza, ndiyomupa, Akkisa, mwana wangu musimbi, kuti abe mwanakazi wakwe.''
Otiniyeli, mwana mulombe wa Kkenazi ( mwanike wa Kkalebbu) wakazunda Debbili, aboobo Kkalebbu wakamupa Akkisa, mwana wakwe musimbi, kuti abe mwanakazi wakwe.
Akkisa asike biyo kuli Otiniyeli, mpawo wakamusungwazya kuti akumbile wisi kuti amupe muunda. Mbubonya mbwakaseluka ambongolo Kkalebbu wakamubuzya kuti, ''Nchiinzi nchendinga ndilakuchitila?''
Wakaamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Kondipa chilongezyo. Mbwiinga wandipa nyika ya Negevi, alubo kondipa atusensa twameenda.'' Aboobo Kkalebbu wakamupa tusensa twaatala atwamunselelo.
Lunyungu lwa Syanyinazyalaa Mozesi mu Kkenayiti wakatanta kuzwa kumuunzi wa Tukunka abantu ba Juda, iili mu Negevi, kukuyokkala abantu ba Juda afwifwi a Aladi.
Baalumi ba Juda bakiinka abaalumi ba Simiyoni abakulana babo akuyolwanisya ba Kkanani bakakkede mu Zefati mpawo bakawunyonyoona chakumaninina. Zina lyamuunzi lyakali Homa.
Aliwi bantu ba Juda bakazunda Gaza anyika zizyungulukide, Asyikkeloni anyika iyizyungulukide, alimwi Ekkiloni anyika iyizyungulukide.
Jehova wakali abantu ba Juda mpawo bakabweza lukono lwanyika yazilundu, pesi tebakakonzya kutanda bakkali bamuntandabale nkambo bakali aankalaki zyalubulo.
Kkalebbu wakapegwa Hebbuloni ( mbuli Mozesi mbwakaambide), alimwi wakatanda kuzwa ooko bana balombe batatu ba Anakki.
Pesi bantu ba Bbenjamini tebakabatanda pe ba Jebbusi bakakkede mu Jelusalemu. Aboobo ba Jebbusi bakachikkede abantu ba Bbenjamini mu Jelusalemu kusikila sunu.
Bang'anda ya Jozefu bakalibambila kukuyolwisya Bbeteli, alimwi Jehova wakali aambabo.
Bakatuma baalumi kukutweela aali Bbeteli ?( muunzi ooyo walikwambwa kuti Luzi Lutanzi).
Basikutweela bakabona muntu kazwa mumuunzi, alimwi bakaamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Weenche, tutondezye, mbotunga tulanjila mumuunzi, alimwi tuyokufwida luzyalo.''
Wakabatondeezya nzila injila mumuunzi, alimwi bakalwisya muunzi apanga libosya, pesi bakalekela muntu kwiinka ampuli yakwe yoonse.
Eelyo muntu wakaya kunyika yaba Hiti mpawo wakakuyaka munzi akuulika kuti Luzi, ndendlyo zina lyawo ambulisunu.

Bantu ba Manase tebakatanda bantu pe bakakkede mumyunzi ya Bbeti-Syani amagunzi aawo, na Tanakki amagunzi aawo, naa abo bakakkede mu Doli amagunzi aawo, na abo bakakkede mu Ibbuliyamu amagunzi aawo, aabo bakakkede mu Megido amagunzi angawo, nkaambo ba Kkanani bakakakatila kukukkala munyika eeyo.
Ba Izilayili nibakabangunzu, bakamanikizya ba Kkanani kubabelekela mulimu muyumu, pesi tebakabatanda pe chkumaninina.
Efulemu tewakabatanda pe ba Kkenani aabo bakakkede mu Gezeli, aboobo ba Kkanani bakendelela kukkala mu Gezeli akkati kabo.

Zebbuluni tewakabatanda pe bantu bakakkede mu Kkitiloni, na bantu bakakkede mu Nahalolu, aboobo ba Kkanani bakeendelela kukukkala akati kabo, pesi Zebbuluni wakamanikizya ba Kkanani kukubabelekela mulimu muyumu.
Asyeli takabatanda pe bantu bakakkede mu Akko, na bantu bakakkede mu Sidoni, naa aabo bakakkede mu Ahibbu, Akkizibbu, Helubba, Afekki na Lehobbu.
Aboobo mukowa wa Asyeli wakalikkede akkati kaba Kkanani. (aabo bakakkede munyika ), nkambo tekabatanda pe.

Mukowa wa Nafutali tewakabatanda pe abo bakakkede ku Bbeti Syemesyi a Bbeti Anati bakabamanikizigwa mulimo muyumu nkambo ka Nafutali. Nkinkaako bamukowa wa Nafutali bakakkala akati kaba Kkanani ( bantu bakakkede munyika eyo). Nekubaboobo, bakkali bamu Bbeti Syemesyi aba Bbeti Anati bakamanikizigwa mumilimu miyumu ya Nafutali.
Ba Amoli bakamanikizya mukowa wa Dani kukkala munyika yazilundu, tebakazumizya pe kuselukila kuntandabale.
Aboobo ba Amoli bakakkala ku Chilundu cha Helesi, mu Ayijaloni, alimwi mu Syalubbimu, pesi basilumamba basinguzu beng'anda ya Jozefu bakabazunda alimwi bakamanikizigwa kukubabelekela amulimu muyumu.
Mugano waba Amoni wakali kuzwa kuchilundu cha Akkilabbimu ku Sela kuunjila munyika yazilundu.

Angelo wa Jehova wakazwa ku Giligalu wakasika ku Bbokkimu, alimwi wakaamba kuti, ''Ndakamugwisya mu Ijiputi, mpawo ndakamugwisya kunyika njindakakonkezya kupa kuli bamawuso. Ndakaamba kuti, ''Nsikoyotyola chizuminano changu andinywe.
Tamwelede kuchita chizuminano abaabo bakkala munyika eeyi. Mwelede kumwaya zipayililo zyabo.' Pesi taakwe nimwakaswiilila jwi lyangu. Niinzi eechi nchimwachita?
Aboobo lino ndaamba kuti, 'Nsikoyobatanda ba Kkanani kunembo lyenu pesi bayooba mamvwa mumabazu aanu, alimwi baleza babo bayomubeda tukkole.'''
Angelo wa Jehova nakaambula majwi aaya kubantu boonse ba Izilayeli, bantu bakoompolola akukwila.
Bakawulika busena obo kuti Bbokkimu. Nkukonya bakapayila kuli Jehova.
Lino Josyuwa nakamaninsya bantu anzila yabo, bantu ba Izilayeli umwi awumwi wakinka kubusena mbwakabilwa, kuyovuba nyika yabo.
Bantu bakalekela Jehova chiindi choonse Josyuwa nchakapona achabapati aabo bakachili kupona kaliwafwa, aabo bakabona milimo mipati yoonse ya Jehova njakachitila ba Izilayeli.
Josyuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni mulanda wa Jehova, wakafwa kali waba aamyaka iili 110.
Bakamuzikka kumugaano wanyika njakabilidwe mu Timunati Helesi, munyika yatulundu twa Efulemu, kunyika ya Chilundu Gasyi. Izyalane eelyo lyoonse alyalo lyakabungana kuli bamawisi.
Zyalane alimwi lyakabuka usule lyabo elyo lyaatakwe lyakalizi Jehova naa echo nchakachitila ba Izilayeli.
Bantu ba Izilayili bakachita bubi mumenso aa Jehova akubelekela ba Bbaalu.

Bakali sosolosya kuzwa kuli Jehova, Leza wabamawisi, wakabagwisya kunyika ya Ijiputi. Bakatobela baleza baambi, baleza babantu aabo bakabazyungulukide, alimwi bakabakotamina. Bakakalazya Jehova mukunyema nkambo
bakasosoloka kuli Jehova akukomba Bbaalu aba Asyitoleti.

Bukali bwa Jehova bwakabukila ba Izilayeli, alimwi wakabapeda kabasali bakababbida lukono lwabo kuzwa kulimbabo. Wakabasambala mbuli bazike aabo bakalijiswi anguzu zyabasinkondonyina baka bazyungulukide, aboobo tebakachili kukonzya kuli kwabilila aatala abasinkondonyina.
Konse nkubakali kwinka ba Izilayili kuyolwana, kuboko kwa Jehova kwakali atala ambabo kukubazunda, mbubonya mbuli mbwakakonkezya kuli mbabo  mpawo bakali mumafwabi mayumu.
Eelyo Jehova wakabusya babetesi, aabo bakafutulwa kuzwa kujanza lyabaabo bakali kubabbida lukono lwabo. Nikubaboobo tebakaswilila pe kubabetesi babo.

Tebakasyomeka pe kuli Jehova mpawo bakalipeda mbuli bavuule kuli baleza bambi akubakomba. Bakafwambana kupambuka kuzwa kunzila bamawisi njibakaponena - aabo bakaswilila milazyo ya Jehova - pesi lwabo tebakachita oobo pe.

Jehova nakababusizya babetesi, Jehova wakagwasya babetesi akubavuna kuzwa kujanza lyaba sinkondonyina mazuba woonse mubetesi ngakapona. Jehova wakababeda aluse mbuli mbubakali kutongela nkambo kabaabo bakali kubapenzya akubafwabya.

Pesi mubetesi nakafwa, bakapambuka akuchita zintu ezyo zyakali zibi loko kwinda nzibakachita bamawisi. Bakali k utobela baleza bambi kukubabelekela akubakomba. Bakakaka kuleka kufumbwa yansotoko yabo yabubi naa inzila zyabo zyabusichinguni.

Bukali bwa Jehova bwakabukila ba Izilayili; wakaamba kuti, ''Nkaambo chisi eechi chatyola milawo yachizuminano changu echo nchindakabambila kubusena bwa bamawisi - nkambo tebakaswilila pe kujwi lyangu -
Kuzwa lino kaziya kunembo, nsikoyotanda limbi pe kunembo lyabo kufumbwa wamaasi aayo Josyuwa ngakasiya nakafwa.
Ndiyochita eechi kuchitila kuti ndikasunke ba Izilayeli, nikuba na pe bayolondola inzila ya Jehova akweenda mulinjiiyo, mbuli bamawisi mbubakilondola.''
Nchiicheecho Jehova nchakaleka maasi aayo akubatanda chakufwambana akubapeda mujanza lya Josyuwa.
Lino Jehova wakasiya eyi misyobo yabantu kuti basunke ba Izilayeli, kwaambisya umwi awumwi uli mu Izilayeli utakwakalaluzibo kufumbwa nkondo zyakalwanwa mu Kkenani.
(Wakachita echi kukuyiisya zyankondo kuzyalani lichikomena kubana ba Izilayeli bakatalizi).

Njeeyi misyobo yabo: baami bali musanu bazwa kuba Filisitiya, ba Kkenani boonse, aba Sidoni, alimwi aba Hivi balikukkala muzilundu zya Lebbanoni, kuzwa kuchilundu cha Bbaali Helimoni kuyosika ku Hamati Pasi.
Eezi zisi zyakasiilwa kuti Jehova akasunke Izilayeli, kuyobonesya bana balatobelezya malayililo ngakaapa basikale babo kwiinda kuli Mozesi.
Aboobo bantu ba Izilayeli aba Hiti, aba Amoli, aba Pelizi, aba Hivi, alimwi aba Jebbusi.
Bana babo basimbi bakababweza kuti bana babo balombe babe banakazi babo, alimwi bana babo basimbi bakabapa kubanababo balombe, alimwi bakabelekela baleza babo.
Bantu  ba Izilayeli bakachita bubi kumenso aa Jehova akuluba Jehova Leza wabo. Bakakomba ba Bbaala aba Asela.

Nkinkaako, lunyemo lwa Jehova lwakaba mulilo kubukila Izilayeli, alimwi wakabawuzya mujanza lya Kkusyani-Lisyatayimu mwami wa Alamu Nahalayimu. Bantu ba Izilayeli bakabelekela Kkusyani-Lisyatayimu kwaminyaka musanu ayitatu.
Elyo bantu ba Izilayeli nibakiita kuli Jehova, Jehova wakabusya umwi walikuyogwasya bantu ba Izilayeli, alimwi walikuyofutula: Otiniyeli mwana mulombe wa Kkenazi (mwanike wa Kkalebbu).
Muuya wa Jehova wakamuzuzya nguzu, alimwi wakabeteka Izilayeli akuya kunkondo. Jehova wakamupa kuzunda aliba Kkusyani-Lisyatayimu.
Nyika yakaba a lumuno kwamyaaka makumi oone. Mpawo Otiniyelu mwana mulombe wa Kkenazi wakafwa.
Kwiinda echo, ba Izilayeli bakachita bubi lubo kubusyu bwa Jehova, alimwi Jehova wakapa nguzu kuli Egiloni mwami wa Mowabbu kuyozunda ba Izilayeli.
Egiloni wakanjilaana aba Amoni aba Ameleki alimwi bakiinka akuyozunda Izilayeli, alimwi bakabweza nzibakalezyo mumunzi watukunka.
Bantu baba Izilayeli bakabelekela Egiloni myaaka ilikkumi amusanu ayitatu.

Bantu ba Izilayeli nibakiita Jehova, Jehova wakabusya umwi sikubagwasya, Ewudi mwana mulombe wa Geela, mu Bbenjamini, mwalumi sichimweensi. Bantu ba Izilayeli bakamutuma, azilumbyo, kuli Eiloni mwami wa Mowabbu.
Ewudi wakalipangila ipanga mwini lyakali ampimpito zibili, bulamfu bwalyo bwakali kakokola; wakalibika aansi azisamo zyakunsi kuchibelo chakululyo.
Wakapa chilumbyo kuli Egiloni mwami wa Mowabbu. (Lino Egiloni wakali mwalumi wakaneneede loko.)
Kuzwa Ehudi nakapeda chilumbo, wakasyala ababaya bakachitola mukati.

Kuzwawo Ehudi lwakwe mwini, nikuba obo, nakasika kubusena oko kwakali zibezwa zyakapangilwa kufwafwi a Giligali, wakanzyoonoka akubweda musule, alimwi wakati, ''Ndilansiswa yamulumbo wako, mwami wangu, ''Egiloni wakaamba kuti, ''Umuna!''  Aboobo boonse bakali kumubelekela bakazwa mung'anda.
Ewudi wakeeza akulinguwe. Mwami wakali kkede alike mwini, kali alike mung'anda yamujulu itontolela. Ewudi wakati, ''Ndijisi ijwi lyako lyazwa kuli Leza.'' Mwami wakanyampuka kuzwa achuuno chakwe.
Ewudi wakasisya kuboko kwakwe kwachimweensi akusomona panga kuzwa kuchikobela chakululyo lwakwe, alimwi wakayasa mumubili wamwaami.
Mukwa wapanga awulawo wakanyomena mukati kutobela museke. Nembo yapanga yakadonkola kusule lyakwe mpawo mafuta akalisinka, nkambo Ewudi takwakalisomona pe panga kuzwa mwida.
Lino Ewudi wakazwa aanze mulukonkono akujala milyango yang'anda yamujulu musule lyakwe akwakwida.
Kuzwa Ewudi kaliwinka, balanda bamwami bakasika; bakabona kuti makoma ang'anda yamujulu akali kwididwe aboobo bakayeeya kuti, ''Nchobeni ulilyokezezye mwini mutontolela mung'anda yamujulu.'''

Bakalikatazya kusikila bakasika akulimvwa kuti tabachilikuchita mulimo wabo mwami nate wakajula milyango yang'anda yamujulu. Aboobo bakabweza chijuzyo akujula, alimwi chawaalya ngulya ulilede simalelo wabo, kawidilide aansi, kafwide.
Muchiindi balanda nibakachili kulindila, akuamba kuti ngabala chita zili, Ewudi wakaloboka akwiinda kunembo kubusena oko kwakali zibezwa zyamizimu alimwi wakachijila ku Seyila.
Elyo nakasika, wakalizya mweembo munyika yakalundu ya Efulemu. Mpawo bantu ba Izilayeli bakaseluka anguwe kuzwa mutulundu, alimwi kali kuba zulwida.

Wakaamba kuti kulimbabo, ''Munditobela, nkambo Jehova wamba kuyozunda basinkondonyokwe, ba Mowabbu.'' Bakamutobela akuyojata zito zya Jolodani kuzubuka kuzwa kuli ba Mowabbu, alimwi taakwe nibakazumizya nikuba omwe kuzubuka mulonga.
Muchiindi echo bakajaya baalumi baba Mowabbu bakasibe zyuulu zilikkumi, alimwi boonse bakali basinguzu akukonzya. Taakwe nikuba omwe wakaloboka.
Aboobo zuba elyo Mowabbu wakazundwa kunguzu zya Izilayeli, alimwi nyika yakaba akulyookezya kwamyaaka ili musanu ayitatu.
Kuzwa kwa Ewudi kwakaba Syamuga mwana mulombe wa Anati oyo wakajaya 600 balumi baku Filisitiya akaponda nkakali kubelesya kubinzya basune. Awalo wakavuna Izilayeli kuzwa kuntenda.
Musule akufwa kwa Ewudi, bantu ba Izilayeli bakabisya lubo kubusyu bwa Jehova.
Jehova wakabawuzya kujanza lya Jabbini mwami wa Kkenani wakeendelezya mu Haza. Silutwe wampi yakwe wakali kutegwa Sisela, alimwi walikukkala mu Halosyeti Hagoyimu.
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakitilila lugwasyo kuli Jehova, nkambo Sisela wakalijisi myaanda yosanwe ayine yankalaki zyalubulo alimwi wakadyamizya bantu ba Izilayeli changuzu kwamyaaka ilimakkumi obile.
Lino Dibbola, mwanakazi musinsimi (mwanakazi wa Lapidoti), nguwakali mubetesi mupati mu Izilayeli muchiindi eecho.
Wali kuyandisya kukkala aansi akakunka ka Dibbola akati ka Lama a Bbeteli mukalundu kamunyika ya Efulemu, alimwi bantu ba Izilayeli bakeza kuli nguwe kuzogwasiwa zyambo zyabo.

Wakatumina Bbalakki mwana mulombe wa Abbinoyamu kuzwa ku Kkedesyi mu Nafutali. Wakati kuli nguwe, ''Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, ulikukulayilila, 'Koya ku Chilundu Tabba, alimwi ubwezelezye baalumi balizyuulu zilikkumi kabazwa ku Nafitali aku Zebbulani.
Ndiyogwisya Sisela aanze, silutwe wampi ya Jabbini, kuyoswanana ayebo amulongo wa Kkisyoni, kali aankalaki zyakwe aampi yakwe, alimwi ndiyokupa kuzunda aalinguwe.'''
Bbalaki wakamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Naa weenda ambebo, ndiyoyenda, pesi naa tetweenda antomwe, tandikoyinka pe.''

Wakaamba kuti, ''Nchobeni ndiyoyinka ayebo.  Nekubaboobo, mugwagwa nguyoyendela tukwe kuyokutola kubulemu bwako pe, nkambo Jehova uyowuzya Sisela mujanza lya mwanakazi.'' Mpawo Dibbola wakanyampuka akwenda a Bbalakki kuKkedesyi.
Bbalakki wakiita baalumi bakuZebbuluni abaku Nafutali kuti baze antomwe ku Kkedesyi. Zyuulu zilikkumi zyabaalumi bakamutobela alimwi Dibbola wakeenda aamwi anguwe.

Lino Hebba (mu Kkenayiti) wakali pambula kuzwa kuba Kkenayiti- bakali balunyungu lwa Hobbabbu syanyinazyala wa Mozesi -  alimwi wakayaka tente lyakwe munsi lyamubanga muli Zaananimu afwifwi a Kkedesyi.
Nibaakambila Sisela kuti Bbalakki mwana mulombe wa Abbinoyamu wakali waya kuchilundu cha Tabba,
Sisela wakayita nkalaki zyakwe zyoonse, myaanda ilimusanu azine nkalaki zyalubulo, alimwi abasilumamba boonse mbaakalabo, kuzwa ku Halosyeti Hagoyimu kuyosika ku Mulona Kkisyoni.

Dibbola wakamba kuti kuli Bbalakki, ''Koya! Nkambo oobu mbuzuba Jehova mbwakupa kuzunda ali Sisela, sena Jehova tali kukuzulwida kale naa?''' Lino Bbalakki wakaseluka kuzwa muchilundu cha Tabba abaalumi balizyuulu zilikkumi bakali kumutobela.
Jehova wakazela Sisela ankalaki zyakwe zyoonse abasilumamba bakwe boonse abbemba lyapana. Alimwi Sisela wakaseluka kuzwa munkalaki yakwe akuchija amawulu.
Pesi Bbalakki wakali kwandilila ankalaki aba silumamba kuya ku Halosyeti Hagoyimu, alimwi impi yakwe yoonse ya Sisela bakajazigwa abbemba lyapanga, alimwi taakwe nikuba mwalumi wakafutuka.
Pesi Sisela wakachija amawulu kuya kutente lya Izilayeli, mukayintu wa Hebba mu Kenayiti, nkambo kwakali luumuno akati kaba Jabbini mwami wa Haza antomwe abalunyungu lwa Hebba mu Kkenayiti.

Jaweli wakazwa anze kuyotambula Sisela akwamba kuti, kuli nguwe, ''Leya ambali, simalelo wangu; leyela kulindime alimwi utayoowi pe.'' Aboobo wakaleyela kuli nguwe akunjila kutente lyakwe, alimwi wakamuvumba achilivumbyo.
Wakati kulinguwe, ''Weenche mundipe twaanzi twakunywa, nkambo ndaba anyota.''' Wakajula chibikilo chachikwiye chakali amalili alimwi wakamunywisya, eelyo wakamuvumba lubo.
Wakamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Yimikila kumulyango watente naa kuli umwi wasika kuzokubuzya, 'Kuti kuli umwi naa uliwaano? utedi 'Pepe'.''

Mpawo Jaweli (mwanakazi wa Hebba) wakabweza nkanka yatente, a nsando mujaanza lyakwe akunjila chuumunizi kuli nguwe, nkambo lwakwe wakali ang'onzi mpati, alimwi wakagankamina nkaanka yatente kulubazu lwamutwe mane do kubbila munyika, alimwi wakafwa.

Mbuli Bbalaki mbwali kwandilila Sisela, Jaweli wakazwa anze kukumutambula akwamba kuli nguwe kuti, ''Boola, nkutondeezye mwalumi nguulya Sisela ulilede kafwide, kali a nkaanka yatente kulubazu lwamutwe wakwe.
Aboobo mubuzuba obo Leza wakazunda Jabbini, mwami wa Kkenani, kunembo lyabantu ba Izilayeli.
Inguzu zyabantu ba Izilayeli zyakayungizigwa kusima akuvula kukulwisya Jabbini mwami wa Kkenani, mane do kumunyonyoona.
Mubuzuba obo mwami Dibbola a Bbalaki mwana mulombe wa Abbinoyamu bakiimba lwiimbo olu:
''Elyo basololi nibasolweda mu Izilayeli, bantu nibalipeda chakubotelwa kuya kunkondo-tulumbayizya Jehova!
Amuswilile, nywebo nobaami! Imebo, Ndiyoyimbila Jehova; Ndiyoyimba intembawuzyokuli Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli.
Jehova, muchindi niwakazwa ku ku Seyili, niwakeenda kuzwa ku Edomu, inyika yakateketa, alimwi mulengalenga awulawo wakandengenda; awalo mayoba akatila maanzi ansi.
Malundu akazuzuma kunembo lyabusyu bwa Jehova; nichiba chilundu cha Sinayi chakazuzuma kunembo lyabusyu bwa Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli. Mumazuba a Syamuga (mwana mulombe wa Anati),
mumazuba a Jayeli, migwagwa mipati yakalekwa, alimwi abo bakali kweenda bakabelesya biyo tuzila tuzyunguluka.
Kwakali bantu bache bamuluwa mu Izilayeli kusikila mebo, Dibbola, ndabuka-ndabuka mbuli baama mu Izilayeli!
Nibakasala baleza bapya, kwakaba kulwana kumilyango yamuunzi nikuba kwakaba kulwana kumilyango yamunzi nikuba tekwakali ntobo naa masumu akaboneka akati kazyuulu zili makkumi oone mu Izilayeli.
Moyo wangu ulaya kuli basilutwe ba Izilayeli, aamwi abantu bakalipeda chakukondwa-tulongezya Leza akaambo kabo!
Amuyeeye aatala acheechi-nywebo nimweenzya mbongolo zituba kamukkede mumazavuzavu mbuli zyuuno,  alimwi nywebo nimweenda kamutobela mugwagwa.

Amumvwe majwi abaabo biimba kumasena amanzi. Nkuko balamba alimwi inchito zyabululami bwa Jehova, alimwi anchito ziluleme zyaba silumamba bakwe mu Izilayeli. Mpawo bantu ba Jehova bakakunukila kumilyango yamuunzi.
Buka! Kobuka, Dibbola! buka, yimba lwiimbo! Nyampuka, Bbalakki, alimwi uwange basintolongo bako, webo yomwana mulombe wa Abbinowami.
Mpawo bakafutuka bakeza kubapati; bantu ba Jehova bakakunukila kuli ndime abasilumamba.
Bakeeza kuzwa ku Efulemu, ulamuyanda uli mu Amaleki; Bantu ba Bbenjamini bakakutobela. Kuzwa kubendelezi ba Makkili bakakunuka alimwi kuzwa ku Zebbuloni abo babweza musako wasimulimu mupati.

Bana babwaami bangu muli Izaka bakali a Dibbola; alimwi Izaka wakali a Bbalakki kabayobufwambana musule lyakwe kabaya mumusena munsi lyamalayilile akwe. Akkati kamikowa ya Lubbeni kwakali kulingulula kupati mumyoyo yabo.
Nkambonzi nimwakakkala akkati kamasuwa, kamuswilizya kubembeli kabalizya matanga aabo miteteele? Kwamikowa ya Lubbeni kwakali kulingululwa kupati kwamoyo.
Giliyadi wakali kukkala kuli limwi bbazu lya Jodani; alimwi Dani, nkamboonzi nakali kuzuungaana amaato? Asya wakakkalilila munkomwe akukkala afwifwi azito zyakwe.
Zebbuloni wakali mukowa wakali kunga walyaaba buumi bwawo kusikila kuchibeela chalufu, alimwi Nafutali, alakwe, ulimumbuwa zyankondo.
Baami bakeza, bakalwana; baami ba Kkenani bakalwana ku Tanakki kumbali lyamaanzi aku Megido. Pesi takwepe nibakabweza nsiliva mbuli chisaalo.
Kuzwa kujulu inyenyeezi zyakalwana, kuzwa kunzila yazyo kwinga majulu zyakalwana aa Sisela.
Imulonga Kkisyoni wakaba kukula, mulonga oyon wakale, mulonga Kkisyoni. Amufoole mumuuya wangu muyume!
Mpawo wakamvwika muzuzumo wansumba zyambongolo-kazizyatuuka, kuzyatuuka kwaba singuzu bakwe.
''Tukila Melozi'mbwawamba mungelo wa Jehova. 'Nchobeni tukila babo bakkala mumomo! - nkambo tebakaza kuzogwasya Jehova-kuti bazogwasye Jehova munkondo yakulwana abasikulwana basinguzu.'
Jayeli uli longezegelwe kwiinda banakazinyina boonse , Jayeli (mukayintu wa Hebba mu Kkeniti), ulilongezezegwe kapati kwiinda boonse banakazi bakkala mumisasa.
Mwaalumi wakalomba maanzi, alimwi wakamupa malili; wakamuletela choonde mumutiba weelela bana babaami.

Wakabika ijanza lyakwe kunkaanka yamusasa, alimwi janza lyakwe lyachilisyo kunsando yasimulimu; ansando wakagankamina Sisela, wakapwaya mutwe wakwe, wakapwachuula kanza kakwe mutumpanzi nakamuyasa kumbali lyamutwe wakwe.
Wakawida akkati kumbali kandyato zyakwe, wakawa akoona mpawawo. Wakawida akkati kamawulu akwe chakukachilwa. Abusena mpakawida mpempawo mpakajiilwa.

Kuzwa kumpulungwido wakalanga-banyina a Sisela wakayuna mukamani akutambwizya chakusululwa, 'Nkamboonzi niwatola chiindi mizuzumo yakulila kwansumba zyambongolo ezyo zikwela nkalaki zyakwe nizyachelezegwa?'
Bana bakwe basimbi babwaami basongo bakamusandula alimwi wakalipa nsandulo njiyoonya eyo:

Tebakajana naa akwabana chisaalo - izyalilo, mazyalilo abili kumwaalumi umwi awumwi; chisaalo chamasila azilulwidwe a Sisela, chisaalo chamasila azilulwidwe akulukwa, zimpanzi zyobile zyamasila azilulwidwe kaalukidwe aansingo zyabaabo basikukona?'
Aboobo basinkondonyokwe boonse ngabaabe mbuli zuba nilipasula munguzu zyalyo.'' Mpawo nyika yakaba aaluumuno kwamyaaka iili makkumi oone.
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakachita bubi mumenso a Jehova, alimwi wakabaaba mujanza lyaba Midiyani kwamyaaka iili musanu ayibili.
Nguzu zyaba Midiyani zyakadyamizya Izilayeli, akambo kaba Midiyani, bantu ba Izilayeli bakalipangila misasa kuzwa kumapako mutulundu, mumalyango abasinguzu.
Chakachitika nkuti kufumbwa chiindi ba Izilayeli mpubakali kuzikkila zilimwa zyabo, ba Midiyani aba Ameleki abantu bazwa kujwe bakali kulwiisya ba Izilayeli.
Balikubamba basilumamba babo anyika akunyonyoona zilimwa zyabo, nzila yoonse kusika ku Gaza. Tebalikusiya chakulya pe mu Izilayeli, nikuba mbelele niziba ng'ombe niziba mbongolo.
Kufumbwa ooko lwabo azivuubwa zyabo azilawu zyabo mpozibede, balikuza mbuli bbomu lyansozi, alimwi tekwakali kukonzeka kubala nikuba kuchitila kuti bayinyonyoone.
Midiyani wakazunda ba Izilayeli kapati kwakuti bantu ba Izilayeli bakoongolola kuli Jehova.
Bantu ba Izilayeli nibakoongolola kuli Jehova akambo kaba Midiyani,

Jehova wakatuma musinsimi kubantu ba Izilayeli. Musinsimi wakamba kuti kulimbabo, ''Ncheechi Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, nchawamba; 'Ndakamugwisya kuzwa mu Ijiputi; Ndakamugwisya kuzwa mung'anda yabuzike.
Ndakamuvuna kuzwa kujanza lyaba Ijiputi, alimwi kuzwa kujanza lyaboonse abo bali kumudyaamizya. Ndakabatanda kunembo lyanu, alimwi ndakamupa nyika yabo.
Ndakaamba kuti kuli ndinywwe, ''Ndime Jehova Leza wanu; Ndakamulayilila kutakomba baleza baba Amoli, balaanyika njimukkede.'' Pesi temwakaswilila ijwi lyangu.'''

Lino angelo wa Jehova wakeza akuzokkala ansi lyamunsamu wamubanga mu Ofila, wakali wa Jowasyi (mu Abbiyezi), eelyo Gidiyoni, mwana mulombe wa Jowasyi, wakali kuuma wiiti mung'anda, muzikandilo - kusisa ba Midiyani.
Mungelo wa Jehova wakaboneka kulinguwe akwaamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Jehova ulanduwe, silumamba mukozu!''

Gidiyoni wakaamba kuti kuli nguwe, ''Ikaaka, simalelo wangu, naa Jehova ulaswebo, nkamboonzi zyonseezi nizyachitika kuli ndiswe? Zilikuli nchito zigambya ezyo bamataatesu nzibaka tulwiida nzizyo, nibakali kuti, ''Tewakatugwisya na Jehova kuzwa mu Ijiputi?'Pesi lino Jehova watutakata akutwaaba mujanza lyaba Midiyani.''
Jehova wakamulanga akwaamba kuti, ''Koya munguzu nzolazyo kale. Kapozye Izilayeli kuzwa kujanza lyaba Midiyani. Sena nsikutumide?
Gidiyoni wakaamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Ndakomba, Mwami, ndilipozya biyeni Izilayeli? Bona, mukowa wangu muniini loko muli Manase, alimwi imebo tandikwepe nchindibede mung'anda yataata.'''
Jehova wakati kuli nguwe, ''Ndiyoba anduwe, alimwi uyozunda basilumamba boonse baba Midiya mbuli mwalumi omwe.''
Gidiyoni wakati kuli nguwe, ''Naa ulikondedwe andime, undipe chitondezyo kuti nduwe oyo ulikwaambula kuli ndime.
Weenche, utazwi aano, kusikila ndize kuli nduwe ndilete chipo changu akuchibika kunembo lyako.'' Jehova wakaamba kuti, ''Ndiyolindila kusikila ukaboole.''

Gidiyoni wakinka akubamba kapongo ankankamanza yabusu bunante achinkwa chitakwe bumena. Wakabika nyama muchizuma, alimwi wakabikka musinza mumpoto akuzileta kuli nguwe munsi lyamunsamu mubanga akuzipeda.
Mungelo wa Leza wakati kuli nguwe, ''Bweza nyama achinkwa chitakwe bumena akuzibika aabbwe eeli, alimwi utile musinza alinzizyo.'' Ezyo Gidiyoni nzyakachita.

Mpawo mungelo wa Jehova wakasompokela wakagumya kumamanino kwamusako wakali mujanza lyakwe. Anguwe wakaguma nyama achinkwa chitakwe bumena; mulilo wakazwa kuzwa mubbwe akulya nyama achinkwa chitakwe bumena. Mpawo mungelo wa Jehova wakeenda mpawo Gidiyoni takachili kumubona lubo pe.
Gidiyoni wakaziba kuti oyu wali mungelo wa Jehova. Gidiyoni wakati, ''Akaaka, mwami Jehova! Nkambo ndabona mungelo wa Jehova kubusyu akubusyu!''
Jehova wakati kulinguwe, ''Lumuno kulinduwe! Utayoowi, tokoofwa pe.''
Aboobo Gidiyoni wakayaka chipayililo awo kuli Jehova. Wakachuulika kuti, ''Jehova ngu Luumuno.'' Kusikila asunu chichiimvwiku Ofula kumukowa wa Abbiyeza.

Mubusiku obo Jehova wakaamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Bweza sipule wang'ombe wawuso, alimwi asipule wabili ulamyaaka ilimusanu ayibili, alimwi wandula chipayililo cha Bbaala chawuso, akugonka Asyela ulikumbali lyacho.

Uyake chipayililo kuli Jehova Leza wako aatala abusena obuno bwakuyubila, alimwi uchiyake munzila ilinjenjiyo. Payila sipule wang'ombe wabili mbuli chipayililo chakutenta, kubelesya nkuni zizwa kuli Asyela ngwagonkweeda ansi.'''
Aboobo Gidiyoni wakabweza kkumi lyabalanda bakwe akuchita mbubonya Jehova mbwakamwambila. Pesi akambo kakuyoowa kapati bang'anda yawisi abaalumi bamudolopo kuti azichite sikati, wakazichita mansiku.

Chifumo baalumi bamudolopo nibakabuka, chipayililo chaBbaala chakali mwaywiidwe ansi, alimwi Asyela wakali kumbali lyacho wakali wagonkelwa aansi, alimwi sipule wang'ombe wabili wakali wapayililwa achipayililo echo chakali chayakwa.
Baalumi bamumuunzi bakati kuli umwi awumwi, ''Ngwani wachita eechi?'' Nibakaambuula abamwi akuyanduula nsandulo, bakamba kuti, ''Gidiyoni mwana mulombe wa Jowasyi nguwachita echi chintu.''
Mpawo ibaalumi bamudolopo bakati kuli Jowasyi, ''Koyeta mwana wako mulombe kuti ajiigwe, nkambo wamwaya chipayililo cha Bbaala, alimwi akambo kakuti wagonkweda ansi Asyela wali kumbali lyacho.''

Jowasyi wakati kuli baabo balikumukazya, ''Sena muyoyiminina mulandu wa Bbaala? Sena muyomubelekela? Kufumbwa uyoyiminina mulandu wakwe, mumuleke ajiigwe ndilyonya kakuchili chifumo. Naa Bbaala ngu Leza, mumuleke alyiminine umwi namwaya chipayililo chakwe.''
Nkinkaako mubuzuba obo bakawulika Gidiyoni ''Jelubbu Bbaala,'' nkambo wakati, ''Muleke Bbaala alyiminine kuli oyo umulwisya,'' nkambo Gidiyoni wakamwayila ansi chipayililo cha Bbaala.
Lino boonse ba Midiya, ba Ameleki, alimwi abantu bakujwe bakabungana antomwe. Bakazubuka Jolodani akukkala mumusena wa Jezili.
Pesi Muuya wa Jehova wakeza ali Gidiyoni. Gidiyoni wakasiba mweembo, kayita mukowa wa Abbiyezeli, kuti bamutobele.
Wakatumina batumwa kuli Manase yoonse, alimwi ambabo, bakiitwa kuti bamutobele. Wakatuma alimwi batumwa kuli Asya, Zebbuloni, antomwe a Nefutali, alimwi bakeenda kukuyomuchinga.
Gidiyoni wakamba kuti kuli Leza, ''Naa wayanda kubelesya ndime kukufutula Izilayeli, mbuli mbwakaamba --

Langa, ndabikka boya bwambeelele alubuwa lwakupolela. Naa kulaba muume biyo aboya bwambelele alimwi kakuyumide aanyika yoonse, elyo iyoziba kuti uyobelesya ndime kufutula Izilayeli, mbuli mbwawamba.''
'Ncheechi chakachitika -- Gidiyoni wakabuka chifumo chakatobela, wakavunga boya bwambelele antomwe, alimwiwakadina muume kuzwa kuboya bwambelele, lwalikuzuzya mumutiba amanzi.

Mpawo Gidiyoni wakati kuli Leza, ''Utakandinyemeni, ndiyowambuula alimwi lumwi. Weenche ndizumizye ndikakweezye lumwi aboya bwambelele. Kwalino kachite kuti boya bwambelele bukayume, alimwi ukaleke kukabe muume anyika yoonse ibuzyungulukide.''
Leza wakachita echo nchakalomba kubusiku oobo. Boya bwambelele bwakali buyumu, alimwi kwakali muume anyika yoonse ibuzyungulukide.

Mpawo Jelubbu Bbaalu (ngonguwe utegwa Gidiyoni), wakabuka chifumo abantu boonse mbaakalabo alimwi bakabungana kumbali akasensa ka Helodi. Chilawu chaba Midiya chakali kulubazu lwakunyika mumusena uuli afwifwi akalundu ka Mole.

Jehova wakaamba kuti kuli Gidiyoni, ''Kuli basilumamba biingi loko kulindime kuti ndikupe iluzundo aatala aba Midiya, kuti Izilayeli atalisumpuli aatala andime, kawamba kuti, ''Nguzu zyesu zyatufutula.''

Nkiinkako linobu, ambilizya mumatwi abantu akubabuzya kuti, ''Kufumbwa uyowa kufumbwa uteketa, amumuleke, abwede mpawo azwe kuchilundu cha Giliyadi.'''Aboobo bantu bali zyuulu zili makumi aabili azibili bakabweeda, alimwi bali zyuulu zilikkumi bakachaala.

Jehova wakamba kuti kuli Gidiyoni, ''Bantu bachili biingi loko. Batole kunsi mumanzi, alimwi ndiyochesya mweelwe wabo kuli nduwe nkukoko. Naa ndaamba kuti kuli nduwe, 'Oyu ulinka anduwe, uyoyinka anduwe; pesi na ndaamba kuti kuli nduwe, 'Oyu takoyinka anduwe; pesi na ndaamba kuti kuli nduwe, 'Oyu takoyinka anduwe; takoyinka.''
Aboobo Gidiyoni wakasisya bantu kumanzi, mpawo Jehova wakamba kuti kuli nguwe, ''Pambukanya woonse untwakiila manzi mbuli munkala mbwantwakila manzi, kuzwa kuli baabo banywa bufugeme.''
Bantu bali zyuulu zitatu bakantwakila. Bantu boonse bakachaala bakafugama kuti banywe manzi.
Jehova wakamba kuti kuli Gidiyoni, 'Bantu bali myaanda iitatu bakantwaakila, ndiyokuvuna akukupa luzundo aatala aba Midiya. Leka umwi muntu abweede kubusena bwakwe.''

Aboobo abo bakasalidwe bakabweza zyakacheede amyeembo yabo. Gidiyoni wakatuma bantu boonse baku Izilayeli, awumwi awumwi mwalumi kutente lyakwe, pesi wakabamba balumi bali myaanda iitatu. Lino chilawu chaba Midiya chakali aansi anguwe mumusena.
Mansiku ngawonya Jehova wakamba kuti kuli nguwe, ''Buka! Lwisya chilawu, nkambo ndiyokupa kuzunda atala anchicho.
Pesi na koyowa kukunuka, kunuka kuchilawu, a Pula mulanda wako,
alimwi swilila kuli nzibali kwamba, alimwi bukozu bwako buyosimisigwa kukulwanisya chilawu.'' ''Aboobo Gidiyoni wakinka kubusena bwakulindila chilawu.

Ba Midiya, ba Ameleki, antomwe abantu boonse bakujwe bakakkala kumusena, munini mbuli kayoba kansozi. Nkamela zyabo zyakali zyiingi zita baliki pe, bakali biingi mumweelwe kwinda nsanga zyamusele kunkomwe yalwiizi.

Eelyo Gidiyoni nakasika nkuko, muntu wakali kwamba maloto aakwe kubenzinyina. Muntu wakamba kuti, 'Amulange ndila chiloto, alimwi ndabona chinkwa chabbali chakunkulika kuyosika kwakali chilawu chaba Midiya. Chakasika kutente, mpawo chakalyuuma changuzu zyakuti lyakawida aansi akusandamuka lyalanga kujulu, kuti lyoone bukwezeme.
Umwi muntu wakamba kuti, ''Echi nchabuyo kwinda panga lya Gidiyoni mwana mulombe wa Jowasyi, muntu waku Izilayeli. Leza wamupa kuzunda ba Midiya aba silumamba bakwe boonse.''

Eelyo Gidiyoni nakamvwa kwindululwa kwakwaambwa kwachiloto abupanduluzi bwawo wakakotama mukukomba wakabweda kuchilawu chaba Izilayeli akwamba kuti, ''Mubuke Jehova wamupakuzunda atala abasilumamba ba Midiya.''
Wakapambukania bantu bali myanda iitatu mutubunga tutatu, alimwi wakabapa myeembo yoonse azinkuli zyakatalikwe zintu, zimunisyo mukati achinkuli chimwi achimwi.
Wakaamba kuti kuli mbabo, ''Amulange kuli ndime alimwi muchite nzindili kuchita. Amulangisisye nindabika kumamanino achilawu mulelede kuchita mbuli mbundachita.
Elyo nindalizya mwembo, mebo abamwi boonse balandime, eelyo mulizye mweembo yanu anywebo kumabazu woonse achilawu akoompolola, kuli Jehova alimwi akuli Gidiyoni!'''

Aboobo Gidiyoni abantu bali mwanda bakali anguwe bakasika kumamanino awawo mpubakali achilawo, kuzwa kumatalikilo akati akulindila. Mbuli ba Midiya mbubakali kusandula sikulinda, bakalizya mweembo akujaya zinkuli zyakulizya mweembo akujaya zinkuli zyakali mumaboko abo.
Inkamu zyotatwe zyakulizya mweembo akujaya zinkuli. Bakabweza zimunisyo mumaboko abo achimwensi amweembo kumaboko abo achilisyo kuti bazilizye. Bakoompolola, ''Panga lya Jehova alya Gidiyoni.''
Awumwi muntu wakimikila abusena bwakwe kabazyungulukide chilawu ampi yoonse yaba Midiya yakachijana. Bakompolola akuchija.

Nibakalizya mweembo ili myaanda iitatu, Jehova wakabikka panga lyamuntu woonse mu Midiya aatala abenzinyina mpawo aatala ampi yabo yoonse.Impi yakachijila kulaale mbuli kuyosika ku Bbeti Syita koya ku Zelela, kulale mbuli kumugaano wa Abbelu Mehola, afwifwi a Tabbati.
Balumi baku Izilayeli kuzwa ku Nafutali, Asya, alimwi abonse ba Manase bakalitidwe anze, alimwi bakatobela ba Midiya.

Gidiyoni wakatuma batumwa kukulizya nyika yoonse yatulundu twa Ifulemu akwaamba kuti, ''Mwiinke mukalwisye Midiya alimwi mukendelezye mulonga Jolodani, kulale kuyosika ku Bbeti Bbaala, kukuyobimikizya.'' Eelyo boonse baalumi ba Ifulemu bakabungaana antomwe akwendelezya manzi, kulale mbuli ku Bbeti Bbaala akuyosika ku mulonga Jolodani, Bakajata bana babami bobile baku Midiya, Olebbu aku Zibbu.

Bakajaya Olebbu kundomba yabbwe lyaku Olebbu, alimwi bakajaya Zibbu kuchisinino chawayini cha Zibbu. Bakatobelela ba Midiya, alimwi bakakweta mitwe yaba Olebbu a Zibbu kuli Gidiyoni, oyo wakali kuli limwi bbazu lyamulonga Jolodani.
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakati kuli Gidiyoni, ''Niinzi eechi nchiwachita kuli ndiswe? Tewakatwiita pe niwakaya kukulwana aba Midiya.'' Eelyo bakali akukazyania kupati anguwe.
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Niinzi iino nchindachita kutelanisya andinywe? Sena nzyakuvululwida masansa a Ifulemu talikabotu na kukwinda kutebula masansa abizidwe a Abbiyeza?
Leza wakapa kuzunda atala abana balombe bamwami wa Midiya - Olebbu a Zibbu! Ninzi nzindakamaninsya zinga zilendelana andinywe? Lunyemo lwabo kuli nguwe lwakafwa nakamba eezi.
Gidiyoni wakasika ku Jodani akuzubuka lwakwe abantu bali myanda yotatwe bakali anguwe . Bakali bakatala, pesi bakendelela anembo kubandilila.
Wakamba kuti kubantu ba Sakkoti, ''Inchekaka amupe zinkwa kubantu balokunditobela, nkambo bakatala, alimwi tulikwandilila Zibba a Zalumana, baami ba Midiya.''
Mpawo bapati bakaamba kuti, ''Sena kwalino maboko a Zibba a Zalumani alimuluboko lwako? Nkambonzi nitutape zinkwa kumpi yako?
Gidiyoni wakamba kuti, ''Jehova naatupa kuzunda atala a Zibba a Zalumani ndiyo delula mibili yanu amyumvwa yamunkanda azibulo.''
Kuzwawo wakatansya kuya ku Peniyelu akwaambula kubantu oko munzila njiyonya, pesi bantu baku Peniyelu bakamusandula mbuli bantu baku Sakkoti mbubakamusandula.
Wakambula lubo kubantu ba Peniyelu akwaamba kuti, ''Nenjosika lubo mulumuno ndiyowisya ng'anda eyi ndamfu.''

Lino Zibba a Zalumani bakali mu Kkakko antomwe ampii yabo, bakali bantu batikabe zyuulu zilikkumi amusunu zyabaalumi, boonse bakachaala kumpi yachiindi yabantu bakujwe, kwakawa bantu bali 120,000 baalumi bakasomona mapanga.
Gidiyoni wakaya kunzila njibakatola basimatente, kwinda Nobba a Jogubbeha. Wakazunda impi yabasinkondonyina, nkambo tebakali kulangilila kulwisigwa.
Zebba a Zalumani wakachija, alimwi  Gidiyoni mpakabatobelela, wakajata baami bobile ba Midiya-Zebba a Zalumani - alimwi akubikka impi yabo yoonse mukuyoowa.
Gidiyoni, mwana mulombe wa Jowasyi, wakajoka kuzwa kunkondo kayinda munzila ya Helesi.
Wakajata mukubusi waku Sakkoti akumubuzya mukubusi wakalemba aansi mazina aba ngambela bali makkumi alimusanu aabili abapati ba Sakkoti.

Gidiyoni wakasika kubantu ba Sakkoti akwaamba kuti, ''Mulange Zebba a Zalumana, abo mbimwakandinyakila akwamba kuti, 'Sena wamuzunda kale na Zebba a Zalumuna? Tatuzi kuti twelede kupa chinkwa kumpi zyako.'''
Gidiyoni wakabweza bapati bamunzi akubasubula bantu ba Sakkoti amaamvwa amunkanda achiwawa.
Mpawo wakawisya ng'anda ndamfu ya Peniyeli akujaya bantu bamuchisi echo.
Eelyo Gidiyoni wakaamba kuti kuli Zebba a Zalumuna, ''Musyobonzi wabantu mbwajaya ku Tabba?'' Bakasandula kuti, ''Mbuli mbubede, abalabo mbubakabede. Awumwi wakalanga mbuli mwana mulombe wamwami.''
Gidiyoni wakamba kuti, ''Bakali bakulana bangu bana balombe babaama. Mbuli Jehova mbwali muumi, nikuli temwakabajaya, tendali kumujaya pe.''
Wakamba kuti kuli Jeta (mwana wakwe mutanzi), ''Buka nyampuka alimwi ubajaye!'' Pesi mukubusi takagwisya panga lyakwe nkambo wakaliyobweda, nkambo wakachili mulombe munini.
Mpawo Zebba a Zalumuna bakaamba kuti, ''Buka lwako mwini utujaye! Mbuli muntu mbwabede.'' Gidiyoni wakabuka akujaya Zebba a Zalumuna. Alimwi wakabweza minkonde yakali munsingo yankalaki zyabo.
Eelyo bantu ba Izilayeli bakaamba kuti kuli Gidiyoni, ''Tuzulwide webo, mwana wako m ulombe, amuzukulu wako mulombe - nkambo wakatuvuna kujanza lyaba Midiya.''
Gidiyoni wakamba kuti kuli mbabo, ''Tandikoyo mwendelezya, naba mwana wangu mulombe takoyo mwendelezya pe.Jehova uyomwendelezya nywebo.''

Gidiyoni wakamba kuti kuli mbabo, ''Muleke ndichite chikumbizyo chaanu, kuti umwi awumwi andipe malangu-langu kuzwa kuchisalo chakwe.'' ( ba Midiya bakajisi malangu langu angolide nkambo bakali ba Isyumayeli.)
Bakasandula, ''Twakonda tulakupa.'' Bakayala zisani mpawo muntu awumwi wakawala malangu-langu kuzwa kuchisalo chakwe.

Kulema kwama langu-langu ayo angolida ngaakakumbila bwakali 1,700 masyekkeli angolida. Chisalo echi chakali chakuyungizya kumunkonde, zikobela zyamusinza wanyangu zyakakonwa abaami baku Midiya, alimwi kubikkilizya anketani ezyo zyakali zyungulukide munsingo yankamela.
Gidiyoni wakachita chibbabba kunze lya malangu-langu akuchibikka mumunzi wakwe mu Ofu alimwi ba Izilayeli boonse bakandisofwazya akuchikomba kakaba kakole kuli Gidiyoni abaabo bali mung'anda yakwe.
Aboobo ba Midiya bakali babikwa kumbali abantu ba Izilayeli  alimwi tebakabusya mitwe yabo lubo aboobo nyika yakaba aluumuno kwamyaaka ilimakkumi aane mumazuba a Gidiyoni.
Jelubbu Bbawu, mwana mulombe wa Jowasyi wakeenda akukkala mung'anda yakwe.
Gidiyoni wakali abana balombe bali makkumi musanu aabili bakali lunyungu lwakwe, nkambo wakali abanakazi biingi.
Asimamambe wakwe, oyo wakali mu Syekkemu wakamuzyalila alimwi mwana mulombe alimwi Gidiyoni wakamupa izina litegwa Abbimeleki.
Gidiyoni, mwana mulombe wa Jowasyi, wakafwa muchiimo cheelede alimwi wakazikwa mukabanda ka Jowasyi syanawisi, ku Ofula kuzyalane lya Abbiyeza.
Chakachitika nkuti, mbwakafwa biyo Gidiyoni, bantu ba Izilayeli bakabweeda lubo akulisofwazya mukukomba ba Bbaalu. Bakachita Balu-Bbeliti leza wabo.
Bantu ba Izilayeli tebakayeya kulemeka Jehova, Leza wabo wakabavuna kuzwa kulubono lwabasinkondonyina kumabazu woonse.
Tebakabamba chizuminano chabo kung'anda ya Jelubbu Bbalu (oyo utegwa, Gidiyoni), kukubwedezya zyoonse zibotu nzyakachita mu Izilayeli.
Abbimeleki mwana mulombe wa Jelubbu Bbaala wakaya kunzubo zyabanyina bamukowa wampuli yabanyina,

''Weenche uwambe oobu, kuti bazulwidi boonse bamu Syekkemu bamvwe, 'Ncheechi chibotu kuli ndinywe?'Kuti bana balombe boonse bali makkumi musanu aabili ba Jelubbu Bbaala bamwendelezye, naa kuti uumwi amwendelezye?' Amuyeeye kuti mebo ndili wafuwa lyanu anyama yanu.''
Basiminzyaabo bakamwimikilila mukwaambula abazulwidi ba Syekkemu, mpawo bakazumina kutobela Abbimeleki, nkambo mbubakaamba kuti, mukulana wesu.''
Bakamupa mali ansiliva alimakkumi musanu aabili kuzwa kung'anda ya Bbaala-Bbeliti, mpawo Abbimeleki wakabelesya nsiliva kukuliya bantu babuyo abatagwasyi bakeenda anguwe.

Abbimeleki wakaya kung'anda yawisi iliku Ofila, mpawo bbwe limwi ndyakajazya bakulana bakwe bali makkumi musanu aabili, bana balombe ba Jelubbu Bbaala. Kwakachaala Jotamu luzutu, munini wabana balombe ba Jelubbu Bbaala, nkambo wali yanika.
Bazulwidi boonse baku Syekkemu aba Bbeti Milo bakabungana antoomwe akuya kuyobikka Abbimeleki bwami, kumbali amusikili uli afwifwi amusemu ulimu Syekkemu.
Eelyo Jotamu nakambilwa aatala azeezi, wakatanta wakwiima atala achilundu cha Gelizimu. Wakoompolola akwaamba kuti kuli mbabo, ''Amundiswilile, nobazulwidi baSyekkemu, kuti Leza akamuswilizye.
Chimwi chiindi minsamu yakaya kuyolinanikila mwami, Nkambo bakaamba kuti kumusamu wamu Olifa, 'Twendelezye.'
Pesi musamu wamu Olifa wakamba kuti kuli mbabo, ''Ngandilasiya nzindilazyo, eezyo nzibalemya baleza abantu, kukwendelezya misamu iimwi?'
Misamu yakaamba kuti kumukuyu, 'Koza mpawo utwendelezye.
Pesi mukuyu wakamba kuti kuli njiyo, 'Ngandilapa bunone bwangu amuchelo wangu mubotu, kuti ndibwede akuyoyendelezya iimwi misamu?'
Misamu yakaamba kuti kumusansa, 'Koza utwendelezye.'
Musansa wakaamba kuti kuli njiyo ndileke wayini wangu mupya, oyo ubotezya baleza abantu, mpawo ubwede akuyoyendelezya misamu iimbi?'
Mpawo wakaamba kuti kumisamu yoonse kamumvwa, 'koza mpawo utwendelezye.'

Muumvwa wakaamba kuti kuminsamu, 'naa nkasimpe kuti uyanda kuti undinanike mbuli mwami wanu, eelyo koza akujana lukwabililo aansi amunzwide wangu. Na tembubo, eelyo lekela mulilo uzwe kumumvwa akuumpa musida wa Lebbanoni?
Nkinkaako lino, na mwakachita mukasimpe amubusyomesi, nimwakachita kabotu atala Jelibbu Bbaala ang'anda yakwe, alimwi naa mwakamusubula mbuli mbwelede--
alimwi akuyeeya kuti taata wakamulwanina, kupeda buumi bwakwe, mpawo wakamuvuna kuzwa mujanza lyaba Midiyani --

pesi sunu mwabukila ng'anda yataata akujaya bana bakwe balombe, bantu bali makumi alimusanu aabili, abbwe limwi. Mpawo mwachita Abbimeleki mwana mulombe wamulanda wakwe mwanakazi, mwami ataala abendelezi ba Syekkemu, nambo ngwaluzubo lwanu.
Naa mwakachita zyanchoonzyo abululami a Jelubbu Bbaala ang'anda yakwe, eelyo mwelede kukondwa muli Abbimeleki, alimwi amumuleke alakwe akondwe muli ndinywe.
Pesi na tembubo lekela mulilo uzwe kuli Abbimeleki akuumpa bantu baSyekkemu a Bbeti Milo. Leka mulilo uzwe kuzwa kubantu ba Syekkemu a Bbeti Milo, kuti wuumpe Abbimeleki.''
Jotamu wakaloboka wachija, waya ku Bbeli wakakkala nkuko nkambo kwakali kuule a Abbimeleki, mukulana wakwe.
Abbimeleki wakeendelezya Izilayeli kwamyaaka iitatu.
Leza wakatuma muuya mubi aakkati ka Abbimeleki abazulwidi ba Syekkemu. Bazulwidi ba Syekkemu bakakuuzya kusyomeka nkubakalako a Abbimeleki.

Leza wakachita eechi kuti lupyopyongano lwakachitwa kubana balombe bali makkumi alimusanu aabili ba Jelubbi Bbaala lubwedezegwe, alimwi Abbimeleki mukulana wabo apegwe mulandu wakubajaya abalumi ba Syekkemu babe amulandu nkambo bakamugwasizya kujaya bakulana bakwe.
Aboobo bendelezi ba Syekkemu bakamubikkila bantu mukulindila atala atulundu, kuti bamuyubilile, mpawo bakabbida boonse bakali kwinda munzila eeyo. Eechi chakambilizigwa kuli Abbimeleki.
Galu mwana mulombe wa Ebbedi wakaza anzubo zyakwe akwindilila ku Syekkemu. Bazulwidi ba Syekkemu bakali alusyomo muli nguwe.
Bakiinka mumunda kuyobungika bulotwe kuzwa kumunda wamasansa, alimwi bakalyatawula. Bakachita pobwe mung'anda yaleza wabo, ooko nkubakalya akunywa, alimwi bakatuka Abbimeleki.

Gaalu mwana mulombe wa Ebbedi, wakamba, ''Ngwani utegwa Abbimeleki, alimwi ngwani utegwa Syekkemu, zyakuti tukutawukile nguwe?  Sena talimwana mulombe wa Jelubbu Bbaala? Sena Zebbuli tali mungambela wakwe? Kutawukila bantu ba Hamali, wisi wa Syekkemu! Nkambonzi nituta kutawukile Abbimeleki?
Chalikundibotela kuti bantu bakwe babe munsi anguzu zyangu! Mpawo ndikagwisye Abbimeleki. Ndiyowamba kuti kuli Abbimeleki yita Impi yako yoonse.'''
Kuchiindi Zebbuli, mungambela wamuunzi, nakaamvwa majwi a Gaalu mwana mulombe wa Ebbedi lunyemo lwakabuka.
Wakatuma batumwa kuli Abbimeleki kuti bakeene, akwaamba kuti, ''Bona, Galu mwana mulombe wa Ebbedi anzubo zyakwe bazobuza ku Syekkemu, alimwi banokuyunga muunzi kuti bakulwisye.
Lino, buka mansiku abasilumamba mbolabo, ukabambie kuyuba mumyuunda.
Eelyo kuchifumo, kufumbwa kuti zuba lyaba mujulu, mubuke chifumo akunjilila munzi. Natamubukile abantu mbalabo, mukachite kufumbwa nchimukonzya kuli mbabo.''
Aboobo Abbimeleki wakabuka mansiku, lwakwe abantu boonse mbakalabo, alimwi bakayuba Syekkemu muzibunga zyoone.
Galu mwana mulombe wa Ebbedi wakazwa mumanjililo amulyango wamunzi. Abbimeleki abantu mbakali aabo bakazwa kubusena bwabo bakuyuba.
Eelyo Galu nakabona bantu, wakaamba kuti kuli Zebbuli, ''Bona, bantu bazobuza kabaseluka kuzwa mukalundu!'' Zebbuli wakaamba kuti kuli nguwe, ''Ulokubona minzinzimwa atulundu kibanga mbuli bantu.''
Galu wakaambula lubo akwaamba kuti, ''Langa, mbantu bayobuseluka akkati kanyika, alimwi chimwi chibunga chino kuza anzila yamusamu mu Okki wabasondi.''

Mpawo Zebbuli wakaamba kuti kuli nguwe, ''Alikuli majwi aako akulisumpula lino, lwako wakaamba kuti, ''Ngwani Abbimeleki ooyo ngotutakutawukile?'Sena aba tembibantu mbowakasampawula? Muzwe lino mpawo mukabamaninsye.''
Galu wakazwa mpawo wakali kuzulwida bantu ba Syekkemu, alimwi wakalwania Abbimeleki.
Abbimeleki wakamutanda, mpawo Galu wakachija. Banji bakaba azilonda ziyoosya kunembo lyamanjililo amulyango wamunzi.
Abbimeleki wakakkala mu Aluma. Zebbuli wakakatizya Galu anzubo zyakwe kuzwa muSyekkemu.
Mubuzuba butobela bantu baSyekkemu bakazwa mumunda, alimwi eechi chakazibisigwa kuli Abbimeleki.
Wakabweza bantu bakwe, wakabikka mubunga tutatu alimwi bakayuba mumyuda. Wakalanga akubona bantu kabazwa mumunzi akubalwisya mpawo wakabajaya.
Abbimeleki ankamu nzyakali aazyo bakalwisya akusinka manjililo kumulyango wamunzi. Zimwi nkamu zibili zyakalwisya boonse bakali mumuunda akubajaya.
Abbimeleki wakalwisya munzi abuzuba boonse obo. Wakuubweza muunzi, alimwi wakajaya bantu aabo bakali mulinguwo. Wakakolomweda aansi bulambo bwamunzi akumwaya munyo atala lyawo.
Bazulwidi boonse bakasanza ka Syekkemu nibakachimvwa bakanjilila basinguzu bang'anda ya Eli-Bbeliti.
Abbimeleki wakaambilwa kuti bazulwidi boonse babungana antoomwe kukasanza ka Syekkemu.

Abbimeleki wakatanta atala achilundu Zalumoni, webo abantu boonse ambakali aabo. Abbimeleki wakabweza kaleba mpawo watema mitabi. Wakazibikka akkuko lyakwe alimwi wakaambila bantu mbakali aabo kuti, 'Nzimwabona nkandichita mufwambane akuzichita mbuli mbundachita.''

Aboobo woonse wakatema mitabi akutobela Abbimeleki. Bakazibunganisya kubulambo bwa Kasanza, mpawo akuumpa amulilo, kuti bantu boonse bakasanza ka Syekkemu abalabo bafwe, baalumi batikabe chuulu abanakazi.
Eelyo Abbimeleki wakaya ku Tebbezi, mpawo wakazyunguluka atala a Tebbezi akwijata.
Pesi kwakali kasanza kasimide mumunzi, alimwi baalumi abanakazi abazulwidi boonse bamuunzi bakachijila kuli nkako akuyolijalila mukati. Eelyo bakatanta kukaluli kakasanza.
Abbimeleki wakaya kukasanza akuyokalwisya mpawo wakasika afwifwi amulyango wakasanza kuti akawumpe.
Pesi mwanakazi wakalosya mwana wankando waziyo amutwe wa Abbimeleki akupwaya kaama kakwe.

Mpawo wakafwambana kwiita mulombe iwakali kunyampula zilwanisyo, alimwi wakwaamba kuti kuli nguwe, ''Somona ipanga lyako mpawo undijaye, aboobo kutabi umwi uyowamba atala andime, 'Mwanakazi wakamujaya.'''Aboobo mukubusi wakwe wakamuyasa, alimwi wakafwa.
Bantu ba Izilayeli nibakabona kuti Abbimeleki wafwa, bakinka kumyunzi.
Aboobo Leza wakabwedezya bubi bwa Abbimeleki oobo mbwakachita kuli wisi akujaya bakulana bakwe bali makumi musanu aabili.
Leza wakachita bubi boonse bwabantu ba Syekkemu bubweede atala amitwe yabo mpawo alimbabo lutuko lwa Jotamu mwana mulombe wa Jelubbu Bbaala lwakabasikila.
Musule a Abbimeleki, Tola mwana mulombe wa Puwa kali mwana mulombe wa Dodo, mwalumi wakazwa kuli Izakka wakali kukkala mu Syamili, munyika yakalundu ya Efulemu, wakabuka kuyovuna ba Izilayeli.
Wakabeteka ba Izilayeli myaaka ili makkumi aabili ayitatu. Wakafwa akuzikwa mu Syamili.
Wakatobelwa a Jayili mu Giliyati. Wakabeteka ba Izilayili myaaka ilimakumi aabili ayibili.
Wakali abana balombe bali makumi aatatu bakatantide mbongolo zili makumi aatatu, alimwi bakali amyuunzi makumi aatatu yiitwa kuti Havoti Jayili asunu, alimunyika ya Giliyadi.
Jayili wakafwa alimwi wakavwikkwa mu Kkamoni.

Bantu bakayungizya kuchibi nchibakachitide kumenso a Jehova akukomba ba Bbaala, Asitoleti, abaleza ba Alamu, abaleza ba Sidoni, baleza ba Mowabbu, baleza babantu ba Amoni, mpawo abaleza baba Filisitiya. Bakaleka Jehova akutamukomba.
Jehova wakaba kalalila ba Izilayili, mpawo wakaba mujanza lyaba Filisiti amujaanza lyaba Amoni.
Bakaya akudyamizya bantu ba Izilayili mwaaka ooyo, akwamyaaka ilikkumi amusanu ayitatu bakadyamizya bantu ba Izilayili bakali mutala a Jodani munyika yaba Amoli, ili mu Giliyadi.
Mpawo ba Amoni bakazubukila mutala a Jodani kuyolwisya ba Juda, aba Bbenjamini akuyolwisya ng'anda ya Efulemu, kuti ba Izilayeli babe mumapenzi mapati loko.
Mpawo bantu ba Izilayeli bakayita kuli Jehova, akwaamba kuti, ''Twakubisizya, nkambo twaleka Leza wesu akukomba ba Bbaalu.''
Jehova wakamba kuti kubantu ba Izilayeli, ''Tendakamuvuna na kuzwa kuba Ijiputi, kuba Amoli, kuba Amoni, kuba Filisiti,
alubo kuzwa kuba Sidoni? Ba Ameleki aba Mawoni bakamudyamizya; mwakandiita, alimwi ndakamuvuna kuzwa kunguzu zyabo.
Kakuli mwakandileka lubo akukomba baleza baambi. Nkinkaako, tandiko kuyungizya zyiindi zyakumwangununa.
Kamuya mukayite kuli baleza aabo mbimwakali kukomba. Ngabamuvune nimusikilwa mapenzi.''
Bantu ba Izilayili bakaamba kuti kuli Jehova, ''Twakabisya. Chita kuli ndiswe kufumbwa chibaanga nchibotu kuli nduwe. Akaako weenche, tuvune buzuba obuno.''
Bakaleka baleza beenzu bakali akati kabo akukomba Jehova. Eelyo Jehova atakamvwi limbi mapenzi aba Izilayili.
