Mpawo ba Amoni bakabungana antoomwe akuyaka musasa mu Giliyadi. Ba Izilayeli bakaza antomwe akuyaka musasa ku Mizipa.
Bazulwidi babantu ba Giliyadi bakaamba kuti kuli umwi awumwi, ''Nguni muntu utakatangune kulwisya ba Amoni? Uyoba muzulwidi uli atala lyabo boonse bakkede mu Giliyadi.''
Lino Jefuta mu Giliyadi kali silumamba sintaanze, pesi kali mwana mulombe wamwanakazi simamambe. Giliyadi kali ngowisi.

Mwanakazi wa Giliyadi alakwe wakazyala mwana kulibamwi bana bakwe balombe kuchiindi bana bamukayintu nibakakomena, bakatanda Jefuta kuti asiye ng'anda alimwi bakati kulinguwe, ''Iwebo tokoyooba achaabilo pe chalukono mumpuli yataatesu. Uulimwana wamwanakazi uumbi.''
Aboobo Jefuta wakachija kuzwa kubakulana bakwe alimwi wakakukkala munyika ya Tobbu, mpawo baalumi babuyo bakabunganina Jefuta akuyobwenzyania anguwe.
Nikwakiinda mazuba, bantu ba-Amoni bakabusya inkondo aatala aba-Izilayeli.
Kuchindi bantu ba-Amoni bakiinka kuyogwisya ba-Izilayeli, bapati ba-Giliyadi bakiinka kuyogwisya Jefuta munyika ya-Tobbu.
Bakaambila Jefuta kuti, ''Kweza mpawo ube musololi wesu kuti tulwisye bantu ba-Amoni.
Jefuta wakambila basololi baku Giliyadi kuti, ''Wakandisula akundikakatizya kusiya ng'anda yataata. Nkamboonzi niwasika kulindime chiindi echino nolimupenzi?''
Bapati baku-Giliyadi bakaambila Jefuta kuti, ''Nkiinkako nchitwaabola kulinduwe lino; kuza andiswe mpawo tukalwisye bantu ba-Amoni, alimwi uyooba musololi waboonse bakkala mu-Giliyadi.''
Jefuta wakati kubapati ba-Giliyadi, ''Naa mwandiboozya lubo kumunzi kuyolwisya ba-Amoni abantu ba Amoni, mpawo na Jehova watupa kuzunda kulimbabo, ndiyoba musololi wanu.''
Bapati ba-Giliyadi bakati kuli Jfuta, ''Ndalomba Jehova abe kamboni aakati kesu kuti tetwalichita mbuli mbutwaamba!''
Aboobo Jefuta wakeenda  abapati ba-Giliyadi, mpawo bantu bakamuchita musololi alimwi amubetesi wabo. Chiindi naakali kunebo lya Jehova mu-Mizipa, Jefuta wakiindulula zyoonse zisyomezyo nzyakachitide.
Mpawo Jefuta wakatuma batumwa kumwami wabantu ba-Amoni, wakati, ''Njaanzi eeyi inkondo ilakkati kesu? Nkaambonzi niwasika changuzu kuzobweza nyika yesu?''

Mwami wabantu ba Amoni wakasandula batumwa ba-Jefuta, ''Nkambo chiindi Izilayeli niyakazwa munyika ya-Ijiputi, bakabweza nyika yesu kuzwa kuba Alinoni kusikila ku-Jabboki, kusika ku Jodano. Lino muziboozye nyika ezyo muluumuno.''
Alubo Jefuta wakatuma batumwa kumwami wabantu ba-Amoni,
alimwi wakaamba kuti, ''Mbuboobu mbwawamba Jefuta: Izilayeli tibwezede nyika ya Mohabbu anyikwa yabantu ba-Amoni,
pesi bakasika kuzwa ku Ijipita, mpawo Izilayeli yakiinda munkanda kumulonga walwizi lwamataata akuyosika ku-Kkadesyi.

Izilayeli niyakatuma batumwa kumwami wa-Edomu, bakati, 'Weenche atwiinde munyika yanu; mwami wa-Edomu takaswilizya pe. Bakatuma alubo batumwa kumwami wa-Mohabbu, pesi wakakaaka. Aboobo Izilayeli yakakkala mu Kkadesyi.

Eelyo bakiinda munkanda akuzwa munyika ya Edomu aanyika ya-Mohabbu, alimwi bakeenda kutobelezya kusika kubbazu lyakujwe lyanyika ya Mohabbu akuyaka zilawo zyabo kumbali lya-Alimoni. Pesi tebakanjila muchisi cha-Mohabbu, nkambo Alimoni ngomugaano wa Mohabbu.
Izilayeli yakatuma batumwa ku-Sihoni, mwami waba Amoni, ooyo wakeendelezya mu Hezibboni; Izilayeli wakati kulinguwe, 'Weenche, atwiinde akkati kanyika yenu kuyosika kunyika yesu.'
Pesi Sihoni teyakasyoma Izilayeli kuti iyinde akkati kachisi chabo. Aboobo Sihoni yakabungania basilumamba bakwe boonse aamwi alimwi bakeenda ku-Jahazi, mpawo ooko wakalwisyania aba-Izilayeli.
Mpawo Jehova, Leza wa-Izilayeli, wakapa Sihoni abantu bakwe boonse mumaanza aaba Izilayeli akubazunda.
Aboobo Izilayeli yakabweza yoonse inyika yaba Amoni bakakkede muchisi chaba-Amoni, kuzwa ku-Alinoni kusikila ku-Jodani.
Aboobo Jehova, Leza wa-Izilayeli, wakatanda ba-Amoni kubusyu bwabantu ba-Izilayeli, alimwi kwalino mukonzya kuvuba nyika yabo?
Sena tamukoyobweza nyika ya-Chemosyi, Leza wanu, njaamupa? Aboobo kufumbwa nyika Jehova Leza wesu njaakatupa, tuyoyibweza.
Sena lino inywebo mwabota loko kwinda Bbalakki mwana mulombe wa Zipoli, mwami wa-Mohabbu? Sena wakabusya nkazyano aaba-Izilayeli? Sena wakabalwisya?

Kakuli kuti ba Izilayeli nibakakkede kwamyaaka mwaanda yotatwe mu-Hezibboni alimwi amumagunzi, mpawo mu Aloyeli amagunzi aayo, alimwi yoonse myuunzi itobelezya nkomwe zyamilonga ya-Alinoni-nkamboonzi eelyo niwakatababweza kubajosya kuchiindi echo?
Tendakachita bubi kuli nduwe, pesi wandichitila bubi mebo akundilwisya. Jehova, mubetesi, wasaluuzya sunu aakati kabantu ba-Izilayeli abantu ba-Amoni.''
Pesi mwami wabantu ba-Amoni bakakkaka kuchenjezegwa Jefuta nkwakabatumina.
Mpawo muuya wa Jehova wakasika aali Jefuta, mpawo wakiinda akkati ka-Giliyadi a Manase, alimwi aakuzwa ku-Mizipa ku Giliyadi wakiinda akkati kabantu ba-Amoni.
Jefuta wakachita chikonke kuli Jehova alimwi wakati, ''Naa wandipa luzundo kubantu ba-Amoni,
eelyo kufumbwa chizwa aanze kumakkoma ang'anda yangu kuyondiswania chiindi nindijoka muluumuno kuzwa kubantu ba-Amoni bayooba ba-Jehova, mpawo ndiyoba mbuli chipayizyo chakuumpa.''
Aboobo Jefuta wakayinda akkati kusika kubantu ba-Amoni kuyobalwisya, alimwi Jehova wakamupa luzundo.
Wakabalwisya akuchitya kujaya kupati kuzwa ku-Aloli kusikila ku-Miniti, myuunzi ili makkumi obile-akuyosika ku-Abbelu Kkelani. Aboobo bantu ba-Amoni bakabikwa aansi abuzuluzi bwabantu ba-Aizlayeli.

Jefuta wakasika kumuunzi wakwe ku-Mizipa, mpawo ooko mwana musimbi wakwe wakasika waswanana anguwe kazaabuuma nsaka akuzyana. Wakali mwana wakwe musimbi uumwi biyo, mpawo kutaamba nguwe takalamwana mulombe pe naa musimbi.

Mbwakamubona biyo, wakadeluula zyakusama zyakwe akwaamba kuti, ''Maawe! Mwanangu musimbi! Wandeetela mapenzi, mpawo nduwe wakaba umwi wakachitya machise mulindime! Nkambo ndasamununa mulomo wangu kuli-Jehova, alimwi tandikonzyi kujosya musule zisyomezyo zyangu.''
Wakamwambila kuti, ''Taata wangu, wachita chikonke kuli Jehova, ndichitile zyoonse nziwakandisyomezya, nkambo Jehova waka kubwedezezya aatala abasinkondonyokwe, ba-Amoni.''
Wakaamba kuti kuli wisi, ''Lekela chisyomezyo eechi kuti undibambile. Ndisiye mebo andikke kwamyeezi yobile, kuti ndikeende akukunukila kutulundu akukwilila bunakalindu bwangu, Lwangu abenzuuma.''
Wakamwambila kuti, ''Koya.'' Wakamutuma kwamyeezi yobile. Wakamusiya, lwakwe abenzinyina, mpawo bakalilila bunakalindu bwakwe mutulundu.
Wakachita mbuli chisyomezyo chachikonke nchaakachita. Lino taakwe nakali waswanana amwalumi, mpawo chakaba chiyanza mu Izilayeli
kuti ibana basimbi ba-Izilayeli myaaka yoonse kwamazuba aane, bayoyibuluka lwaano lwamwana musimbi wa-Jefuta ku Giliyadi.

Mompololo wakaza kubantu ba Ifulemu; bakayinda mu Zafoni mpawo bamba kuti kuli Jefuta, ''Nkambonzi niwazubikila kuyolwania abantu ba Amoni mpawo tewakatwiita pe kuti twiinke anduwe? Tuyowuumpa ng'anda yako.''
Jefuta wakamba kuti kulimbabo, ''Mebo abantu bangu twakali munkondo mpati loko abantu ba Amoni. Nindakakwiita tewakandivuna kuzwa kuli mbabo.
Nindakabona kuti tewandivuna ndakabikka buumi bwangu mujaanza lyangu mpawo ndakayinda mubantu ba Amoni, alimwi Jehova wakandipa kuzunda. Nkamboonzi niwasika sunu kuzolwana andime sunu?''
Jefuta wakabunganisya aamwi bantu boonse ba Gliyadi akulwanisya Ifulemu nkambo bakaamba kuti, ''Nywebo nuba Giliyadi muli basikuchija mu Ifulemu-mu Ifulemu a Manase.''

Ba Giliyadi bakabwezya zito zya Jodani zitola ku Ifulemu. Kufumbwa wakafutuka wa Ifulemu wakaamba kuti, ''Mundileke ndizubuke mutala lyamulonga,'' bantu ba Giliyadi bayowamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Sena uli mu Ifulemu? 'Na wamba kuti pe,''

eelyo bayowamba kuti kulinguwe, amba kuti: ''Sibboleti'' ( nkambo takali kulyamba obotu ibbala), ba Giliyadi balikumujata akumujaya kuzito zya Jodani. Ba Ifulemu bai zyuulu zili makumi oone azibili bakajiigwa kuchiindi eecho.
Jefuta wakabeleka mwaaka musanu awumwi kuba Izilayeli mbuli mubetesi. Eelyo Jefuta mu Giliyadi wakafwa mpawo wakabambwa muli umwi yamyunzi ya Giliyadi.
Musule lyakwe, Ibbizani waku Bbetelehemu wakabeleka mbuli mubetesi atala a Izilayeli.

Wakali abana balombe bali makkumi aatatu. Wakapa bana basimbi mumakwatano bali makkumi atatu mpawo wakeetela bana bakwe balombe basimbi babamwi bantu bali makkumi aatatu. Wakabeteka ba Izilayeli kwamyaaka musanu ayibili.
Ibbizani wakafwa akuzikwa mu Bbetelehemu.
Musule lyakwe Eloni mu Zebbuloni wakabeleka mbuli mubetesi aatala lya Izilayeli. Wakabeteka ba Izilayeli kwamyaaka iilikkumi.
Eloni mu Zebbuloni wakazofwa akuzikwa mu Ayijaloni munyika ya Zebbuloni.
Musule lyakwe mwana mulombe wa Hileli mu Pilatoni wakabeleka mbuli mubetesi aatala aba Izilayeli.
Wakali abana balombe balimakkumi aane abazukulu balombe bali makkumi aatatu. Bakatanta mbongolo zilimakkumi musanu aabili alimwi wakabeteka ba Izilayeli kwamyaaka musanu ayitatu.
Abbidoni mwana mulombe wa Hileli mu Pilatoni wakafwa mpawo wakazikwa kunyika yachilundu chaba Amalekki.
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakachita zintu zibi kumenso aa-Jehova, mpawo wakabaaba mumaanza aaba-Filisitiya myaaka iili makumi oone.
Kakuli umwi mwalumi uuzwa ku-Zola, waluzubo lwaba-Dani, izina lyakwe kali Manowa. Mukayintu wakwe kali musundi alimwi katazyede pe.
Angelo wa-Jehova wakaboneka kumwanakazi akumwambila kuti, ''Bona lino, tona kuminta pe, mpawo tona kuzyala, pesi uyominta akuzyala mwana mulombe.
Lino chenjela utanywi wayini pe naa chintu chikola, mpawo utalyi chintu chimwi chisofweede.
Bona, uyominta akutumbuka mwana mulombe. Takoyonyoolwa abunini mumutwe wakwe, uyooba mu-Nazili wa-Leza mazuba kuzwa kuzyalilo lyakwe, mpawo ngonguwe uuti vune ba-Izilayeli mumaanza aaba-Filisitiya.''

Mpawo mwanakazi wakasika akwambila mulumi wakwe kuti, ''Kwandizida muntu wa-Leza, abwiime bwakwe bwakali mbuli bwiime bwaangelo wa-Leza, bwakayoosya loko. Teendakabuzya nkwakazwa pe, alimwi taakandambila izina lyakwe.

Wakandaambila kuti, 'Bona! Uyominta, akuyotumbuka mwana mulombe.  Aboobo atanywi wayini nichiba chimwi chisofweede, nkambo mulombe uyooba mu-Nazili wa-Leza kuzwa kubuzyale bwakwe kusikila kubuzuba bwalufu bwakwe.'''

Mpawo Manowa wakakomba kuli - Jehova akwaamba kuti, ''Aakaka, mwami, weenche lekela muntu wa-Leza nguwakatuma aboole kuli ndiswe alwabili kuti atuyiisye mbutweelede kuchita amwana amuntu uuti zyalwe.''
Leza wakaswilila ijwi lyakwe Manowa, mpawo angelo wa-Leza wakaboola lubo alimwi kumwanakazi wakakkede mumuunda. Pesi Manowa mulumaakwe takaliko pe.
ASboobo mwanakazi wakachijana chakufwambana akuyowambila mulumi wakwe, ''Bona! Kwaboneka ooyu muntu wakandizida buzuba obo!''
Manowa wakabuka akutobela mwanakazi wakwe. Eelyo naakasika nkwakabede ooyo wakaamba kuti, ''Sena nduwe muntu wakambuula amwanakazi wangu?'' Muntu wwakati, ''Ndime.''
Aboobo Manowa wakti, ''Lino makani aako aabe anchoonzyo. Njiili milawo yamwana, mpawo njiili milimu yakwe?''
Angelo wa-Jehova wakambila Manowa kuti, ''Welede kuchita chakuchenjela zyoonse nzindakamwambila.
Teelede kulya chintu chimwi chizwa kuwayini, mpawo teelede kulya chintu nichiba chimwi chisofweede. Uleelede kulemeka zyoonse nzindamulayilila kuti azichite.''
Manowa wakaambila angelo wa-Jehova kuti, ''Weenche kolindila kuti ndiswe bunini, kuti utupe chiindi tukujikile kapongo.''

Angelo wa-Jehova wakaambila Manowa kuti, ''Nikuba ndalindila, nsikoyoolya zyakulya zyako pe. Pesi na ulayanda kubamba chituuzyo chakuumpa, utule kuli Jehova.'' ( Manowa takalizi kuti ngu-Angelo wa-Jehova.)
Manowa wakaamba kuti kuli angelo wa-Jehova, ''Nduweni izina lyako, kuti tulemeke majwi aako naayoba nchobeni?''
Angelo wa-Jehova wakamwaambila kuti kulinguwe, ''Nkambonzi wandibuzya izina lyangu? Lilagambya!'''
Aboobo Manowa wakabweza kapongo azilyo zyachipayililo mpawo aatala andomba lyachipayililo cha-Jehova. Wakachita zyoonse zyeebeka aawo Manowa amukayintu wakwe kabalokulangilizya.
Kuchiindi mulilo wachipayililo niwakali kuya kujulu, angelo wa-Jehova wakaya kujulu mukati kamulilo wachipayililo. Manowa amukayintu wakwe nibabona eechi bakoona buvundeeme anyika.
Angelo wa-Jehova takazoboneka limbi kuli Manowa naa kukukakwe pe. Mpawo Manowa wakaziba kuti ngu-angelo wa-Jehova.
Manowa wakaambola mukakwe kuti, ''Nchobeni tulafwa, nkambo twabona Leza!''

Pesi mukaakwe wakamwambila kuti, ''Naa Jehova nakayanda kutujaya, takalikuno tambula chipayizyo chakutenta chazilyo nzitwakamupa alimwi takali kutubonia aya makani pe, naa chindi eechi talikunotulekela kumvwa zintu eezi pe.'''
Kumazuba akatobela mwanakazi wakatumbuka mwana mulombe, mpawo wakamuniika izina lyakuti Samisoni. Mwana mulombe wakakomena alimwi Jehova wakamulongezya.
Muuya wa-Jehova wakatalika kumubusya ku-Mahane Dani, aakati ka Zola a Esitawoli.
Samisoni wakakunukila ku Timuna, alimwi nkwakakubona mwanakazi nkuko uumwi wabana basimbi baba Filisiti.
Nakabweeda, wakambula wisi abanyina, ''Ndakabona mwanakazi ku Timuna, uumwi wabana basimbi baba Filisiti. Lino mukandiletele abe mwanakazi wangu.''

Wisi abanyina bakaamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Sena takwe mwanakazi na akkati kabana basimbi banzubo zyako, na akkati kabantu besu boonse? Ayobweza mwanakazi kuba Filisiti batapalwidwe na? Samisoni wakaamba kuti kuli wisi, ''Mundibwezele nkambo nendimulanga, ulandibotezya.''
Pesi wisi abanyina tebakalizi kuti eyi nkani yazwa kuli Jehova, nkambo wakali kuyandisya kubusya kulwisyania aba Filisitiya (nkambo k uchiindi echo ba Filisitiya bakali kwendelezya ba Izilayeli)
Eelyo Samisoni wakakunukila ku Timuna awisi abanyina, alimwi bakasika kumyuunda yamasansa a Timuna. Alimwi, langa, nguulya umwi mwana wabalavu wakasika elyo mpawo kalokuvuluma kulinguwe.

Muuya wa Jehova wakamusikila akufwambana, alimwi waka kwamuuna mulavu akkati mubutetete mbuli mukukwamuna kapongo kanini akkati, alimwi katakwe chintu mujanza lyakwe. Pesi tewambila wisi chanyina echo nchakali wachita.
Wakeenda alimwi waambula amwanakazi, mpawo nakamulanga, wakamubotezya Samusoni.
Kumazuba mache biyo kajokede kuyomukwata wakaleya kumbali kuyolanga mutunta wamulavu. Alimwi, nakalanga, kwakali mbooma lyanzuki abuchi mukati kazyakali cheede mumubili wamulavu.

Wakakwangula buchi mumaanza akwe mpawo akweenda, kaya bulya kayabwenda. Nakasika kuli wisi abanyina, wakabapa bumwi. Alimwi bakalya. Pesi takabambila kuti buchi wakabububweza kulezyo zizo zyamubili zyamulavu zyakacheede.
Wisa Samisoni wakakunukila ooko kwakali mwanakazi alimwi Samisoni wakachita pobwe nkuko,  nkako echi chakali chiyanza chabakubusi.
Bamubone biyo benzubo zyakwe, bakamuletela benzinyina bali makkumi aatatu kuti bazobe awe.

Samisoni wakati kulimbabo, ''Leka lino ndikwambile kalabiko naa umwi wanu wakonzya kukayanduula akundambila nsandulo mumazuba musanu aabili apobwe, ndiyomupa malembo atentema makumi aatatu azyakusama makumi atatu.
Pesi naa temwandaambila nsandulo, eelyo muyondipa malembo antenteema alimakumi aatatu azyakusama zili makumi atatu.'' Bakaamba kuti kuli nguwe, ''Twambile kalabiko kako kuti tukamvwe.''
Wakabaambila kuti, ''Kuzwa muli singuzu mwakali chimwi chinona. ''Pesi batandidwe kujana nsandulo mumazuba aatatu, tebakajana nsandulo mumazuba atatu.
Mubuzuba bwane bakamba kumwanakazi wa Samusoni, eneena mulumi wako kuti atwambile nsandulo kukalabiko, kuti tekwaboobo tuyokuumpa lwako ang'anda yawuso. Sena wakatutamba okuno kuzotuchita bachete?''

Mwanakazi wa Samisoni wakatalika kulila kunembo lyakwe, wakamba kuti, ''Zyoonse nzochita nkundisula! Tondiyandi pe, wakamba kalabiko kuli bamwi babantu bangu, pesi tonakundambila nsandulo.'' Samisoni wakamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Langa aano, naa tendakambila taata na baama bangu sena ngandilambila nduwe?''
Wakalila mumazuba musanu aabili akumana apobwe. Mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili wakamwambila nsandulo nkambo wakamukatazya loko. Wakambila nsandulo nzubo zyabantu bakwe.

Kalitana bbilazuba mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili bantu bamuunzi bakaamba kuti kuli nguwe, ''Niinzi chinona mbuli buchi? Niinzi chilanguzu kwinda mulavu?'' Samisoni wakaamba kuti kuli mbabo, ''Naa temwakalima ampwizi yang'ombe yangu teensi ngamulayijana nsandulo yakalabiko kangu.''

Eelyo muuya wa Jehova wakasika akufwambana ali Samisoni anguzu. Samisoni wakakunukila ku Asyikkeloni mpawo wajaya makumi aatatu abantu babo. Wakabweza zisalo, alimwi wakapa zisamo zyabo kulibaabo bakapandanuna kalabiko. Kanyemede loko, wakaya kung'anda yawisi.
Mwanakazi wa Samisoni wakapegwa kumwenzinyina ngwayandisya.

Nikwakayinda amwi mazuba, kuchiindi chakutebula witi, Samisoni wakabweza mwana wampongo mpawo waya kuyoswaya mwanakazi wakwe, ''Ndiyoyinka kung'anda yamwanakazi wangu.'' Pesi wisi amwanakazi takamuzumizizye kunjila mukkati.
Wisi wamwanakazi wakaamba kuti, ''Ndakali kuyeeya kuti ulimusulide, aboobo nchindamupa kumwenzinyokwe. Mwanike wakwe musimbi mubotu loko kwinda nguwe. Taliboobo na? Kwinda oyu bweza nguwe.''
Samisoni wakaamba kuti kulimbabo, ''Kuchiindi echino ndiyoba utakwe mulandu kuba Filisiti, naa ndabachisya.
Samisoni wakiinka akujata myaanda itatu yabamwaaba mpawo wasungilila misunge antomwe, kumichila akumuchila. Eelyo wakabweza zimwinisyo akusungilila akkati kamusunge wamuchila umwi awumwi.

Nakatomeka zimwinisyo amulilo, wakalekela bamwaaba banjila muzilyo zyakalimvwi zyaba Filisiti, mpawo bakatoomeka mulilo kuli zyoonse zyakali kubungidwe aamwi azyakiimvwi mumyuunda, kuya kumyuunda yamisansa amyuunda yama olifa.

Ba - Filisiti bakabuzya kuti, ''Ngwani wachita oobu?'' Bakaambilwa kuti, ''Ngu Samisoni mukwaansa waba Timuni wakabweza mwanakazi wakwe akumupa mwenzinyina.'' Eelyo ba Filisiti bakiinka bakakumuumpa awisi.
Samisoni wakamba kuti kuli mbabo, 'Naa mbombubobu mbumuchita, ndiyomubwedezya atala andinywe mpawo naa chachitika, ndiyoleka.
Eelyo wakaba goonkola akuba zidyunku zidyunku, kasolo amweendo, akuumwa chakuyaaya kupati loko. Elyo wakeenda akukkala kumpulungwido yandomba lya Etamu.
Elyo ba Filisiti bakasika akubamba nkondo muli Juda akubikka impi yabo muli Leni.
Bantu ba Juda bakaamba kuti, 'Nkambonzi nimweza kuzotulwisya?'' Bakaamba kuti, ''Tulokumulwisya kuti tujate Samisoni, alimwi tuchite kuli nguwe mbuli mbwachita kuli ndiswe.''

Eelyo zyuulu zitatu zyabantu ba Juda bakeenda kumpulungwido mundomba ya Etamu, mpawo bakamba kuti uli Samisoni, ''Sena tozi kuti ba Filisiti mbendelezi atala andiswe?'' Niinzi echi nchiwachita kulindiswe?'' Samisoni wakamba kuti kuli mbabo, ''Bakachita kulindime alimwi ndabachitila abalabo.''
Bakaamba kuti kuli Samisoni, ''Twaza kuzokwaanga akukupeda mumaboko aba Filisiti.'' Samisoni wakaamba kuti kuli mbabo, mukonke kuli ndime kuti tamukwe kuyondijaya nubeni.''
Bakamba kuti kuli nguwe, ''Pepe, tuyokwanga biyo amakkole akukupedekezya kuli mbabo. Tulasyomezya tatukoyokujaya .'' Eelyo bakamwaanga amakkole aabili mapya akumugwisya kuzwa mubbwe.

Nakasika ku Lehi, ba Filisiti bakeza bompoolola kabaswanana awe. Eelyo muuya wa Jehova wakasika alinguwe anguzu. Makole akali kumaboko aakwe akaba mbuli bulundi bwakompwa, mpawo akaloka mumaanza akwe.
Samisoni wakajana chifuwa chipya chamuyaaya wambongolo, alimwi wakachibweza akujaya bantu balichuulu anchicho.
Samisoni wakamba kuti, ''Achifuwa chakumuyaya wambongolo, matantaala atala amatantaala, achifuwa chambongolo ndajaya bantu bali chuulu.''
Samisoni nakamana kwambuula, wakasowa chifuwa chamuyaaya, mpawo wuzika busena obo kuti Lamati Lehi.
Samisoni wakaba anyota loko, mpawo wakiita Jehova akwamba kuti, ''Wapa kuzunda oku kupati kumulanda wako pesi linondifwe enyota na akuwida mumaanza abaabo batapalwidwe?''

Leza wakandula busena bulampako oobo buli ku Lehi alimwi manzi akazwa. Nakanywa, kusima kwakwe kwakabweda alimwi waka bukulusigwa. Aboobo wakuuzika busena oobo kuti Eni Hakkole, alimwi buli ku Lehi ambuli sunu.
Samisoni wakabeteka ba Izilayeli mumazuba aba Filisiti kwamyaaka ilimakkumi aabili.
Samisoni wakaya kuGaza alimwi wakabona mwanakazi simamambe, mpawo wakoona awe.

BaGaza bakaambilwa, ''Samisoni wasika ookuno.'' BaGaza bakabuzyunguluka busena oobo alimwi mukusisikizya bakamulindila busiku boonse kumanjililo aagunzi. Bakalyuumunizya busiku boonse. Bakali bati, ''Atulindile mane buche, mpawo tumujaye.''

Samisoni wakalilede aabulo do aakati kabo busiku. Aakati kabusiku wakabuka alimwi wakajata kkoma lyamanjililo aagunzi amasamu mupati obile mpulyakajisilidi. Wakaamojola kuzwa munyika woonse akkoma lyawo, wapikula aamakuko aakwe, waabweza waatola aajulu lyachilundu kunembo lyaHebbuloni.
Musule aazezi, Samisoni wakaza kulisangalizya amwanakazi wakali kukkala muMumpata waSoleki. Zina lyakwe kali Delila.

Beendelezi babaFilisitiya bakaza kulinguwe, bakati kulinguwe, ''Na mweeneene Samisoni ubone aalede nguzu zyakwe mpati, alimwi kuti inga tulamuzunda biyeni, kuti tumwaange tumufwisye bweeme. Zichite eezi alimwi umwi awumwi wesu ulakupa zibela zyansiliva zili chuulu amwaanda (1,100).''
Mpawo Delila wakati kuli Samisoni, ''Inche kaka ndaambile kuti nkaambonzi noli enguzu mpati zilibobu, alimwi muntu kubona wakwaanga biyeni kuti azyololoke?''
Samisoni wakati kulinguwe, ''Kuti bandaanga amakole matete aali musanu aabili aatana yanikwa mpawo ndilamana nguzu ndikozyanie abantu boonse.''
Mpawo beendelezi babaFilisitiya bakeeta kuli Delila  makole aali musanu aabili atanayuma, alimwi wakaanga Samisoni angawo.

Lino wakali aabaalumi bakayubide mukusisikizya, kabakkala mung'anda yamukati. Wakati kulinguwe, ''BaFilisitiya mbabo bakusikila Samisoni!'' Pesi wakadunsula makole mbuli busumyo bwaguma mulilo. Aboobo insiswa yenguzu zyakwe teyakabbutulwa pe.
Mpawo Delila wakati kuliSamisoni, ''Oobu mbuwandeena akundaambila zyakubeja. Ikaka nche ndaambile mbunga ulazundwa.''
Wakati kulinguwe, ''Kuti bandaanga amakole mapya aatana belesegwa aamulimu, ndilamana nguzu ndibe mbuli baalumi boonse.''

Aboobo Delila wakatola makole mapya akumwaanga angawo, alimwi wakati kulinguwe, ''BaFilisitiya mbabo bakusikila Samisoni!'' Baalumi bakayubide bakali mung'anda yamukati. Pesi Samisoni wakadunsula makole kuzwa kumaboko aakwe anooti akali chibeela chabusumyo.

Delila wakati kuli Samisoni, ''Kusikila lino ulikundeena akundaambila manwa. Ndaambile kuti inga ulazundwa biyeni.'' Samisoni wakati kulinguwe, ''Kuti waluka susu lyangu muzimpusa zili musanu azibili alimwi mpawo uzyaange aamwi zisime, ndilaba mbuli bantu boonse.''

Aawo nakali koona Samisoni, Delila wakaluka zimpusa musanu azibili zyasusu lyakwe akuzyaanga aamwi zyasima, eelyo wakati kulinguwe, ''''BaFilisitiya mbabo bakusikila Samisoni!'' Wakabuka kuzwa kung'onzi zyakwe mpawo wakaangununa zimpusa zyoonse.
Wakati kulinguwe, ''Ulaamba buti kuti, 'Ndakuyanda,' aawo kotaabilani ambebo insiswazyako? Kwaba tutatu kolikundichita chisesyo kotandaambili aawo nguzu zyako mpati mpuzilede.''
Buzuba abuzuba wakamoongelezya loko mane wakasika mpayeeya kuti chali kubota kafwa zwakwe.

Aboobo Samisoni wakamwaambila zyoonse, alimwi wakti kulinguwe, ''Nsina buunsi ninyoolwa susu mumutwe wangu, nkaambo chiindi choonse ndakali muNazali waLeza mbundakali kuzwa mwida lyabaama. Na mutwe wangu wanyoolwa mpawo nguzu zyangu zilandisiya, alimwi ndiyoobula nguzu mbuli bantu boonse.''

Aawo Delila naakabona kuti lino wamwaambila  masimpe aatala amakani woonse, wakatuma ijwi akwiita beendelezi babaFilisitiya, kati, ''Amuboole alimwi, nkaambo lino wandaambila zyoonse.'' Mpawo beendelezi babaFilisitiya bakiinka kulinguwe, kabaletelezya ansiliva mumaboko aabo.
Wakamulazika aazibelo zyakwe mane woona. Wakiita umwi mwaalumi kuti amunyoole zimpusa zyasusu lyakwe zili musanu azibili, mpawo wakamuzunda, nkaambo nguzu zyakwe zyakali zyamusiya.

Wakati, ''BaFilisitiya mbabo bakusikila Samisoni!'' Wakabuka kuzwa kung'onzi zyakwe wakati, ''Ndilazwa aanze mbuli mulizimwi zyiindi nkalizakamune chakwaangunuka.'' Pesi taakaziba kuti Jehova wakali wamusiya.
BaFilisitiya bakamujata akumunonkoola menso. Bakamweeta kuGaza akumwaanga anketani zyamundalila. Nguwakali kuziya kuziyo lyakuntolongo katonta bbwe lyakuziya aalyo.
Pesi susu lyamutwe wakwe lyakatalika kulampa alimwi musule aakunyoolwa.

Beendelezi babaFilisitiya bakabungana aantomwe kuti bape chipayizyo chabo chipati kuli Dagoni leza wabo aloimwi akusekelela. Bakati, ''leza wesu wazunda Samisoni, sinkondoma, akumubika mumaboko eesu.''
Eelyo bantu nibakamubona bakalumbayizya leza wabo nkaambo bakati, ''Leza wesu wazunda sinkondoma alimwi wamupa kulindiswe - munyonyooni wanyika yesu, wakajaya biingi besu.''
Eelyo nibakali kusekelela, bakati, ''Amumwiite Samisoni azotusesye.'' Bakamwiita Samisoni kuzwa kuntolongo alimwi wakabasesya. Bakamuchita kuti ayimikile aakati kamayako mapati.
Samisoni wakati kumulombe wakamujisi luboko, ''Ndizumizye kujata mayako aayo aajisi ng'anda, kuti ndiyaame kulingawo.''

Lino ng'anda yakalizwide baalumi abanakazi. Boonse beendeleze babaFilisitiya bakaliwo. Mung'anda yeejulu mwakali baalumi abanakazi bakali kukonzya kusika zyuulu zyotatwe bakali kweebela aawo Samisoni nakali kubasangalizya.
Samisoni wakiita kuli Jehova wati, ''Mwami Jehova, amundiyeeye! Inche kaka amukandisimwe aaka komwe biyo, Leza, kuti ndikkwichizye kubaFilisitiya akaambo kamenso angu obilwe ngibakabweza.''
Samisoni wakajata mayako obile aakati aakajisi ng'anda akwatonta, limwi jako kululyo lwakwe alimwi kuchimweensi.

Samisoni wakati, ''Andifwe abaFilisitiya!'' Wakatonta anguzu zyakwe  alimwi ng'anda yakawida beendelezi abantu boonse bakali mulinjiyo. Aboobo bafu mbakajaya aawo nakafwa bakali biingi kwiinda mbaakajaya kachipona.

Mpawo bakulana bakwe aboonse beeng'anda yawisi bakaselukila nkuko. Bakamutola, akumuboozya alimwi bakamuzika aakati kaZola aEsitawoli kumaanda aManowa, wisi wakwe. Samisoni wakabeteka Izilayelikwaminyaka makumi obile.
Kwakali mwalumi kuchilundu munyika ya Ifulemu, izina lyakwe ngu Mikka.

Wakati kuli banyina, ''Ichuulu amuyanda wazimpanzi zyangolida izyakatolwa kuli nduwe, atala akwaambula lutuko, azeezyo nzindakamvwa--Langa ookuno! Ndilijisi nsiliva andime. Ndakiibba.'' Banyina bakaamba kuti, ''Jehova akulongezye lwako, omwanangu mulombe!''

Wakabwedezya, 1,100 zimpanzi zyansiliva kuli banyina alimwi banyina bakati, ''Ndaibika kumbali eyinsiliva kuli Jehova, nkambo kamwanangu kuti tuchite chikozyanio chibezedwe achikozyanio chabutale. Kwalino, ndabwedezya kuli nduwe.''

Eelyo nakabwedezya mali kuli banyina, banyina, bakabweza babweza miyanda ibili yansiliva akwipa kumubelesi wabutale wakachita chikkazyo, chibezedwe achikkozyano chifulidwe, alimwi zyakabikkwa mung'anda muli Mikka.
Imwalumi Mikka wakali ang'anda yazikozyano alimwi wakachita mbandama asuwa lyazileza, alimwi wakabweza umwi mwanakwe kuti aabe mupayizi.
Kumazuba aayo tekwakali mupayizi pe mu Izilayeli, alimwi walikuchita kufumbwa nchaabona kuti nchibotu kumenso aakwe.
Eeno kwakali umwi mwalumi muniini mu Bbetelehemu mu Juda, wamukowa wa Juda, wakali mu Levi. Wakakkala nkuko kuti azuzikizye milimo yakwe.
Mwalumi wakasiya Bbetelehemu mu Juda kuti ayinke akuyoyandawula busena bwakukkala. Kachiyobwenda, wakasika ang'anda ya Mika kuchilundu munyika ya Efulemu.
Mikka wakati kuli nguwe, ''Uzwida kuli?'' Mwalumi wakati kulinguwe, ''Ndimu Levi waku Bbetelehemu mu Juda, njobweenda nkenjaanduula busena mpunga ndilakkala.''
Mikka wakati kuli nguwe, ''Kkala andime alimwi uube ndeende alimwi mupayizi. Njokupa zimpanzi zilikkumi zyansiliva amunyaka, azyakuzwata zisamo, alimwi achakulya.''
Mu Levi wakazumina kukkala aanguwe, alimwi mwana muniini wakaba mbuli umwi wabana bakwe balombe,
Mikka wakamukkazika mu Levi mumabelekelo akwe, alimwi mwalumi, wakaba mupayizi wakwe, alimwi wakali mung'anda muli Mika.
Eelyo Mikka wakati, ''Lino ndizi kuti Jehova ulandichitila zibotu mebo, nkambo ooyu mu Levi waba mupayizi wangu.''

Mumazubaayo tekwakali mwami pe mu Izilayeli. Imukowa walunyungu lwa Dani bakali kuyaanduula busena bwakukkala mukkati, mbuli kuzwa kuzuba elyo ndibakatatambula lukkono kuzwa kumukowa walunyungu lwa Izilayeli.

Ibantu ba Dani bakatuma baaluumi balimusanu kuzwa kuliboonse bamikowa, baaluumi bakasimide kukulwana, kuzwa ku Zola akuzwa ku Esitolu, kuti babone nyika amawulu, akulanga koonse. Bakati kuli mbabo, ''Mwiinke mukalange nyika koonse.'' Bakasika kuchilundu munyika ya Efulemu, kung'anda ya Mikka, alimwi bakabuchesya mansiku wonse nkuko.
Eelyo nibakasika aafwifwi ang'anda ya Mikka, bakamvwa ijwi lyamu Levi. Alimwi bakiimikila babuzya, ''Ngwani wakweeta okuno? Ulokuchitayi mubusena obuno? Nkamboonzi noliwaano?''
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Echi nchicho Mikka nchandichitila: Wandichita kuti ndibe mupayizi wakwe.''
Bakati kuli nguwe, ''Ikaka yandawula kuchenjezegwa kuli Leza, kuchitila kuti tuzibe kuti lweendo ndotuyabwenda lulinkiilila kunembo na.''
Mupayizi wakati kuli mbabo, ''Mwinke aluumunu. Jehova ulamweenzya munzila njimutiinde.''

Eelyo baalumi balimusanu bakeenda akusika ku Layisya, akubona kuti balikkede chakukwabililwa, ibwelene a Sidoni mbwikkede, kabatachelezegwi kaba kwabilidwe. Takwe naba womwe wakabazunda naa kubalangila aansi mulizimwi nzila munyika. Bakali kukkala kule kuzwa kuli ba Sidoni alimwi takwepe bulidilane mbubakalaabo amuntu.
Bakabweeda kumukowa wabo ku Zola a Esitolu. Inzubo zyabo zyakababuzya, ''Niinzi nchimwaamba?''
Bakati, ''Amusike! Atubalwane! twayibona nyika alimwi nimbotu loko. Kuli ncholikuchita naa? Utanonoki kubalwana akuzunda nyika.
Elyo mwiinka, muyosika kubantu bayeeyaanga bali kwabilidwe, alimwi nyika nimpati loko! Leza wayipa kuli nduwe -- busena butabulide chintu munyika.''
Bantu bali myaanda musanu awumwi bamukowa wa Dani, balazilwano zyankondo, bazwa kuzwa ku Zola aku Esitoli.
Beenda baya kukukkala ku Kkiliyati Jelimu, mu Juda. Eechi nchenchicho nchibayita busena oobu, kuti Muhane Dani kusikila asunu; Nkonkuko kububbila kunyika ya Kkiliyati Jelimu.
Bakeenda ooko kuzwa nkuko dokuchilundu chakulemu akusika kung'anda ya Mikka.

Eelyo baaluumi balimusanu bakiinka kuyolanga nyika ya Layisya bakati kunzubo zyao; Ulizi naakuti mumaanda aaya kuli chikobela a chikozyano? Chamizimo, achibezedwe, achikozyano chifulidwe? amuyeeye lino nchimutachite.''
Aboobo bakanyona mukkati akusika kung'anda yamu Levi, kung'anda ya Mikka, alimwi bakamujuzya.
Lino bali myaanda ilimusanu awumwi ba Daniti, ibakalibambilide azilwisyo zyankondo, bakaliimvwi kumanjililo aamunzi.

Bantu balimusanu bakalikuya bulanga nyika bakiinka ooko alimwi akugwisya chikozyano chibezedwe, achikobela chabupayizi, achikozyano chamizimu, achikozyano chifulidwe, mupayizi naakachimvwi kumanjililo amulyango abaaluumi balimyaanda musanu awumwi kabajisi zilwano zyankondo.
Elyo nibakanjila mung'anda muli Mikka akubweeza chikobela chabupayizi, azikozyano zyamizimu, achikozyano chifulidwe, alimwi mupayizi wakati kuli mbabo, ''Muchitaanzi?''

Bakati kuli nguwe, ''Wumuna! Bikka maboko aako amulomo wako akuza kuli ndiswe akuba ndeende wesu amupayizi wesu. Takuli mbubo kuti nchibotu ube mupayizi wesu wang'anda yamuntu womwe, naakuti ube mupayizi wamusyobo waluzubo lwa Izilayeli?''
Moyo wamu Payizi wakabotelwa. Wakabweza chikobela chabupayizi, achikozyano chamizimu achikozyano chibezedwe akwinka abantu.
Mpawo bakanyona alimwi bakeenda, akubikka bana baniini, lwabo abuvubi kunembo lyabo.
Nibakaba kuule ang'anda ya Mikka, ibantu bakali mumaanda akali afwifwi ang'anda ya Mikka bakiitwa antomwe, alimwi bakajatwa aamwi aba Daniti.
Bakaba sampawula ba Daniti, alimwi bakanyona bati kuli Mikka, nkambonzi watwita antoomwe?''
Wakati, ''Mwakabba zikozyano zibezedwe, mwatola mupayizi wangu mpawo mweenda. Niinzi chimbi nchiindacho chasyaala? Mulandibuzya buti mebo, niinzi chamukatazya nywebo?'''
Ibantu ba Dani bakati kuli nguwe, ''Tatwelede kumvwa nduwe kolokwaamba kufumbwa chintu, naakatu bamwi bantu banyemede balakujaya. Webo ampuli yako mulajiigwa.''
Elyo bantu ba Dani bakeenda munzila. Eelyo Mikka nakabona kuti basimide loko kulinguwe, wakanyona wabweeda kung'anda yakwe.
Ibantu ba Dani bakabweza Mikka nzyakachita, aamwi amupayizi wakwe, alimwi bakasika ku Layisya, kubantu bakatachelegwa akukkala alimwi bakajazya amapanga akutenta dolopo.

Takwepe naba womwe kubafutula nkambo kwali kwaba kuule kuzwa Sidoni, alimwi tebachikwe bujatane nikuba oomwe. Kakuli mumumpata uli afwifwi ku Bbeti Lehobbu. Ba Danitisi bakayakulula dolopo akukkala nkuko.
Bakawuzika dolopo kuti Dani, izina lya Dani ndilyasikale wabo, ooyo wakali umwi wabana ba Izilayeli. Pesi izina lya dolopo lyakali kutegwa Layisya.

Ibantu ba Dani bakabiikka chikozyano chibezedwe chabo. Jonasani mwana mulombe wa Gesyomu, mwana mulombe wa Mozesi, lwakwe abana bakwe balombe bakali bapayizi kumusyobo waba Danitisi mane kuyosika kuchiindi nyika niyakatolwa mubuzike.
Mpawo baka kkomba chikozyano cha Mikka chibezedwe eecho nchakapangide kufumbwa ng'anda ya Leza niyakachili mu Syiilo.

Kumazubayo, elyo nikwakatalikwe mwami mu Izilayeli, kwakaliwo mwalumi, mu Levayiti, wakali kukkalakkala kumyeenya iilikule yamuchisi chatulundulundu twa-Efulemu. Wakalibwezela mwanakazi, simamambe uzwa ku Bbetelehemu mu Juda.
Pesi simamambe wakwe takasyomekede kuli nguwe; wakamusiya alimwi wakabweeda kung'anda yawisi mu Bbetelehemu ya Juda. Wakakukkala nkuko kwamyeezi yoone.
Mpawo mulumakwe wakanyampuka aakumutobela kuyomukkombelezya kuti abwede. Mulanda wakwe wakali anguwe, alimwi ambongolo zyoobile. Wakamweeta mung'anda yawisi. Elyo musimbi wakamubona, wakabotelwa.
Syanyinazyala, wisi wamusimbi, wakamukombelezya kuti akkale, kwamazuba otatwe. Bakalya aakunywa, alimwi akoona nkuko.
Muzuba lyaane bakanyampuka chifumo aakubambilila kweenda, pesi wisamusimbi wakati kumukwaansa wakwe, ''Koliyumya akasima, mpawo mulakonzya kweenda.''
Aboobo mububili bwabo bakakkala aansi akulya akunywa antoomwe. Mpawo musimbi wakati, ''Ndakumbila uwone asunu akuba achiindi chibotu.''
Eelyo mulevayiti nanyampuka kweenda, wisi wamusimbi wakamukasya kuti ayende, aboobo wakasandula mabambe akwe alimwi wakoona nkuko alimwi.
Muzuba lyamusanu wakabuka chifumo kuti ayeende, pesi wisi wamusimbi wakati,  ''Kuliyumya, alimwi ulindile kusika masikati.'' Aboobo mububili bwabo bakasusula.

Eelyo mulevayiti aa simamambe wakwe antomwe amulanda wakwe bakanyampuka kuti beende, syanyinazyala, wisi wamusimbi wakati kulinguwe, ''Kobona, lino buzuba bwandakuba magolezya. Ikaka kokkala busiku bumbi, alimwi kuti ube achiindi chibotu. Uzokonzya kunyampuka chifumo juunza akubweeda kumunzi.''

Pesi mulevayiti takachili kulipeda koona. Wakanyampuka akweenda. Wakaya kulubazu lwa Jebbusi (eyoo njiiyo jelusalemu). Wakali ambongolo zyobile zyaangidwe alimwi simamambe wakwe bakali antoomwe anguwe.
Eelyo nibakaba afwifwi aku Jebbusi, izuba lyakali lyaamba kubbila, alimwi mulanda wakwe wakati kuli simalelo wakwe, ''Boola, tunjile mumuunzi oyu waba Jebbusi aakoona mumo.''
Simalelo wakwe wakati kuli nguwe, ''Tatukonzyi kunyona kumunzi wabazwamaasi batali ba Izilayeli. Atwiinke kunembo ku Gibbiya.''
Mulevayiti wakambila musankwa wakwe, ''Koboola, ngatwiinke kuli b umwi bwamasena, alimwi tukoone mu Gibbiya nanka mu Lama.''
Aboobo bakiinkilila kunembo, alimwi izuba lyakabbila nibakasika kufwafwi aku Gibbiya, muchisi cha Bbenjamini.
Bakanyona nkuko mu Gibbiya. Bakayinka akuyolala aansi akkati kachisi, pesi takwepe naba omwe wakakkonzya kubanjizya mung'anda yakwe ayomansiku.

Pesi mpawo munene wakali kuzwa kumulimo wakwe mumuunda oyo mumangolezya. Wakali kuzwa kunyika yatulundulundu twa Efulemu, alimwi wakali mweenzu mu Gibbiya. Pesi bantu bakali kukkala mubusena oobo bakali ba-Bbenjamayiti.
Wakatambya menso akwe alimwi wakabona silweendo akati kachisi. Munene wakati, ''Mulobuya kuli? Mwazwa kuli?''

Mu Levayiti wakamwambila kuti, ''Tulimulweendo lwesu lwakuzwa ku Bbetelehemu mu Juda kule kuchisi chatulundulundu cha Efulemu, nkonkuko nkwezwa. Ndakaya ku Bbetelehemu mu Juda, alimwi njobuya kung'anda ya Jehova, pesi takukwe naba omwe oyo unditola mung'anda yakwe.
Tulijisi makuba abulilu bwambongolo zyesu, aachibunge alimwi awayini wangu aamulanda wangu oyu abalanda bako. Takwe pe nchitubulide.''
Munene wakabajuzya, ''Lumuuno alube andinywe! Ndiyomukutawukila zyoonse nzemubulide. Luzutu mutakooni akkati kachisi.''
Aboobo mwalumi wakeeta mu Levayiti mung'anda yakwe alimwi wakapa chakulya kumbongolo. Bakasamba kundyato zyabo akulya alimwi akunywa.
Nkabachikkondwa mumyooyo yabo, bamwi bantu bamuchisi, basizibi, bakazyunguluka ng'anda, nkabalo kuuma chijazyo.
Mwalumi, simalelo wang'anda, wakabbuda winka aanze kuli mbabo akubambila kuti, ''Pepe, bakwesu, ikaka mutachiti bubi obu! Mbukunga mwalumi oyu mweenzu mung'anda yangu, mutachiti chintu chabubi!

Amubone, mwanangu musimbi nakalindu abasimamambe bakwe mpubali aano. Amuleke ndimugwisizye mbabo lino. Mubabisizye alimwi amuchite kufumbwa nchimuyanda kuli mbabo. Pesi mutachiti bubi buli boobu kumwalumi oyu!''
Pesi bantu aba tebakaswilila kuli nguwe, aboobo mwalumi wakajata simamambe alimwi akumweeta aanze kulimbabo. Bakamulala akumubisizya mansiku woonse, alimwi kumachedo bakamuleka kuti ayeende.
Kubuchedo mwanakazi wakasika alimwi wakawida aansi amulyango wang'anda yamwalumi oko simalelo wakwe nkwakabede, aakulala mpawawo kusikila kuzwakwazuba.
Simalelo wakwe wakabuka kuseni aakujula milyango yang'anda akuzwa aanze kuti atole lwendo lwakwe. Wakabona simambe wakwe ulilede mpawawo amulyango, amaboko akwe akali achikkunguzyo.
Mu Levayiti wakamwambila kuti, ''Buka! Atweende.'' Pesi tekwakaba nsandulo. Wakamubikka ambongolo, aa mwalumi wakanyampuka akuya kumuunzi wakwe.

Eelyo mu Levayiti nakasika kumunzii wakwe, wakabweza kafulo, alimwi wakajata simamammbe wakwe, aakumutendawula, zibbimfu azibbimfu, muzimpanzizili kkumi azibili, wakazitumina muzisi zyoonse zya-Izilayeli.

Boonse abo bakazibona eezi bakati, ''Chintu chiliboobu tachinakuba abunini kuzwa kumazuba abo bantu ba Izilayeli nibakazwa munyika ya Ijiputi akuyosikila sunu. Lino amuchiyeeyesye! Mutupe maanu! Mubuzye kuti tuchite biyeni!''

Mpawo bantu boonse ba Izilayeli bakazwida aanze mbuuli umwi muntu, kuzwida ku Dani kuyosikila ku Bbelisyebba, kubikkaamwi anyika ya Giliyadi ayilayo, alimwi bakabungana aamwi kunembo lya Jehova ku Mizipa.
Bazuluzi babantu boonse, misyobo yoonse yaba Izilayeli, bakatola masena mukubungana kwabantu ba Leza 400,000 baalumi zyuulu myaanda yone kabayobwenda amawulu, abo bakalibambilide kulwana apanga.
Lino ibantu ba Bbenjamini bakamvwa kuti bantu ba Izilayeli bakali biinka ajulu ku Mizipa. Bantu ba Izilayeli bakaamba kuti, ''Tubuzye kuti eechi chintu chibi chakachitika biyeni.''
Mu Levi, mulumi wamwanakazi, oyo wakali wajiigwa, wakasandula, ''Ndazwida ku Gibbiya mubusena oobo bwa Bbenjamini, mebo amwanakazi wangu simamambe, kuti mbuchesye anguwe mansiku woonse.
Kuchiindi chamansiku, bazuluzi baku Gibbiya bakandilwisya, kabazyungulukide ng'anda, kabayanda kuti bandijaye. Bakajata chibbalo mwanakazi wangu simamambe, alimwi wakafwa.
Ndakatola simamambe wangu akumudyunkuula muzimpanzi zimpanzi, akuzitumina kulibumwi abumwi busena bwalukono lwa Izilayeli, nkambo bachita chibi achitalikabotu pe mu Izilayeli.
Lino, moonse noba Izilayeli, amupe kuchenjezya alugwasyo aawa.''
Boonse bantu bakabuka aamwi mbuuli muntu uumwi, akwaamba kuti, ''Tawope umwi wesu utayinke kutente lyakwe alimwi tawope umwi wesu utabweede kung'anda yakwe!
Pesi kwalino ncheechi nchitwelede kuchita kuli Gibbiya; Tuyomulwisya mbuli biingi mbuba tulayilila.

Tuyotola baalumi kkumi mumyaanda kwinda kumikowa yoonse ya Izilayeli abali mwaanda umwi muchuulu achuulu chimwi muzyuulu zili kkumi, kuti kujanwe lugwasyo lwabantu aaba kuchitila kuti elyo bayosika ku Gibbiya mu Bbenjamini bayobasubula nkambo kazibi nzibakachita mu Izilayeli.''
Aboobo boonse baluumi ba Izilayeli bakabungana atala adolopo, mbuli muntu umwi.
Mukowa wa Izilayeli wakatuma baluumi kwinda kumikowa yoonse ya Bbenjamini, kabaamba kuti, ''Nchiichili echi chibi eecho chakachitwa akkati kanu?

Nkiinkaako amutupe aabo baluumi babi ba Gibbiya, kuchitila kuti tubabikke kulufu, alimwi tuyogwisya bubi oobu kuzwa mu Izilayeli.'' Pesi ba Bbenjamini taakwe pe nibakaswilizya kujwi lyabakulana baabo, ibantu ba Izilayeli.
Mpawo bana balombe ba Bbenjamini bakazaamwi kuzwa mumadolopo kuza ku Gibbiya kuti balibambile kulwana atala abana balombe ba Izilayeli.

Bantu ba Bbenjamini bakeeta aamwi kuzwa kumadolopo aabo kuti balwane mubuzuba oobo basilumamba bali zyuulu zili makkumi aabili aali amusanu achimwi aabo bakayilide kulwana amapanga. Mukuyungizya, kwakali bali myaanda iili musanu ayibili yabaalumi bakasalidwe kuzwa mumasena a Gibbiya.
Akkati kaboonse basilumamba kwakali bali myaanda musanu ayibili baalumi bakasalidwe aabo bakali kubelesya kuboko kwachimwensi. Uumwi wabo wakali kuwala ibbwe kukasulwe akutakafusa pe.
Bantu ba Izilayeli kakutabalwi mweelwe kuzwa kuli Bbenjamini, bakali zyuulu zili myaanda yoone yabaaluumi, aabo bakayilide kulwana amapanga. Aaba boonse bakali baaluumi benkondo.

Bantu boonse ba Izilayeli bakabuka biinka ku Bbeteli, akukubambilila kunchenjezyo kuzwa kuli Leza. Bakabuzya, ''Ngwani utakatangune kulwisya bantu ba Bbenjamini kuli ndiswe?'' Jehova wakati, ''Juda nguyobalwisya kukutanguuna.''
Ibana balombe ba Izilayeli bakanyampuka kuseeni akulonzya madumba aabo afwifwi a Gibbiya.
Baalumi ba Izilayeli bakiinka kuti bakalwane aatala a Bbenjamini. Bakabamba masena aabo aankondo aatala aambabo ku Gibbiya.
Bantu ba Bbenjamini bakazwa anze a Gibbiya, akujaya baalumi bali zyuulu makkumi aabili azibili kuzwa akkati kaba Izilayeli mubuzuba oobo.
Pesi baaluumi ba Izilayeli bakalisimya lwabo alimwi bakabaamba mindaando yankondo mubusena bukozyenie awo mpubakalibambilide kuzuba lyakutanguna.

Mpawo bantu ba Izilayeli bakiinka aajulu akukwiila kunembo lya Jehova kuyosika mansiku, alimwi bakabuzya nzila kuli Jehova. Bakati, ''Twiinke lubo na kuti tukalwane atala abakulana besu, bantu ba Bbenjamini?'' Jehova wakati, ''Amubalwisye!''
Aboobo bantu ba Izilayeli bakiinka akuyolwisyania abasilumamba ba Bbenjamini kuzuba lyabili.

Muzuba lyabili, Bbenjamini wakiinka aanze kuyolwisyania ambaabo kuzwa ku Gibbiya alimwi bakajaya baaluumi baali zyuulu zilikkumi amusanu azitatu kuzwa kubantu ba Izilayeli. Boonse bakali baalumi bakayilide kulwana amapanga.

Mpawo boonse bantu ba Izilayeli, boonse bantu, bakiinka ku Bbeteli akukwiila, alimwi ooko bakakkala kunembo lya Jehova alimwi bakalyiimya eelyo zuba kuyosika mansiku aakupa zipo zyuumpidwe aazipo zyaaluumuno kunembo lya Jehova.
Ibantu ba Izilayeli baakabuzya Jehova - nkaambo bbokesi lyachizuminano cha Leza lyakaliwo kumazuba aayo,

alimwi Finiyasi, mwana mulombe wa Eliyaza mwana mulombe wa Aaloni, wakali kubeleka kunembo lyabbokesi  mumazuba aayo - ''Twiinke lubo aabantu ba Bbenjamini, bakulana besu kaana kuti tuleke?'' Jehova wakati, ''Mulwisye, nkambo ijunza njomugwasya kubazunda.''
Aboobo Izilayeli wakababikka baaluumi mumasena asisikene ayengelede Gibbiya.
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakalwana aatala aabantu ba Bbenjamini kuzuba lyatatu, alimwi bakaba mumindano yakulwanina nkondo yabo aba Gibbiya mbuli mbubakachitide kukutaanguna.

Ibantu ba Bbenjamini bakiinka akuyolwana aatala aabantu, alimwi bakagwisigwa kuule kuzwa kudolopo. Bakatazika kujeya bamwi bantu. Kwakali baalumi bakali biingi bakasibe makkumi aatatu ba Izilayeli aabo bakafwa mumyuunda amuumigwagwa. Uumwi wamigwagwa wakali kwinka kuyosika ku Bbeteli, awumwi kuyinka ku Gibbiya.

Mpawo bantu ba Bbenjamini bakati, ''Bazundwa alimwi bachijila kule kuzwa kulindiswe, mbuuli lwakutanguna.'' Pesi bantu ba Izilayeli bakati, ''Ngatuchijaane tuye musule akuyobabwedezya kule kuzwa kudolopo kuyosikila kumigwagwa.''

Boonse baaluumi ba Izilayeli baakabuka kuzwa mumasena aabo aakulibaamba kuuba mumindando yankondo ku Bbaalu Taama. Mpawo bantu ba Izilayeli aabo bakayubide mumasena asisikene bakachijana kuzwa aanze kumasena aabo kabazwa ku Maale Gibbiya.

Ooko kwakazwa aanze basikulwisyania a Gibbiya zyuulu kkumi zyabaaluumi basalidwe aanze a Izilayeli yoonse, alimwi kulwana kwakali kuyosya, pesi ba Bbenjamini taakwe nibakaziba pe kuti lunyonyooko kwakali afwifwi ambaabo.

Jehova wakazunda Bbenjamini kunembo lya Izilayeli. Kuzuba eelyo, ibantu ba Izilayeli bakajaya bantu bali zyuulu zili makkumi aabili amusanu amuyanda uumwi waba Bbenjamini. Boonse aaba bakafwa bakali aabo bakayisigilwe kulwana amapanga.

Aboobo bantu ba Bbenjamini bakabona kuti bazundwa. Baaluumi ba Izilayeli baakali baapa lubuwa kuli Bbenjamini, nkambo bakali kuumbala kuubaalumi aabo mbibakabikkide mumasena musisikene aanze a Gibbiya.
Mpawo baaluumi bakayubide bakanyampuka akufwambanina ku Gibbiya, alimwi bakawuma dolopo lyoonse amulomo  wapanga.
Chitondezyo chakabambidwe aakkati kabaalumi ba Izilayeli aabaaluumi bakayubide mumasena aasisikene kuyooba kuti ijoba pati lyabusi liyonyampuka kuya aajulu aanze adolopo.

Elyo chitondezyo nichakatumizigwa baaluumi ba Izilayeli bakali kuboola kuzakunkondo. Lino Bbenjamini wakatalika kulwisya aakujaya baluumi bakasisike makkumi aatatu aba Izilayeli, alimwi bakati, ''Nkasimpe kuti bazundwa kunembo lyesu, mbuli munkondo yakutaanguna.''
Pesi elyo musumpuululu wabusi niwakatalika kubuka kuzwa mumadolopo, ba Bbenjamini bakacheba aakubona buusi kabulokunyampuka kuya kujulu kuzwa kudolopo lyoonse.
Mpawo baaluumi ba Izilayeli bakachebuka akulangana ambaabo. Baaluumi ba Bbenjamini bakayoowa loko, nkambo baakaboona kuti lunyonyooko lwakali lwabasikila.
Aboobo bakachijana kuule kuzwa kubaaluumi ba Izilayeli, kuchijila munzila yakuya munkanda. Pesi kulwana kwakabazunda. Baaluumi ba Izilayeli baakazwa aanze amadolopo akubajaya aawo mpubakayimvwi.
Bakazyunguluka ba Bbenjamini, babatanda akubayinsizya aansi ku Nohali, kunzila yoonse kuyosikila kujwe kubbazu lya Gibbiya.
Kuzwa kumukowa wa Bbenjamini, bantu baali zyuulu zilikkumi amusanu aazitatu bakafwa, boonse bakali baaluumi aabo bakasiyanisigilwe munkondo.

Bakabweeda akuchijila kuya kunkanda kubbwe lya Limoni. Ba Izilayeli bakajaya baali zyuulu zili musanu aa bali zyuulu zili musanu kutobelezya mbabo mumigwagwa. Bakinkiilila kunembo kabaya bubatobelela, kuyabutobela chaafwifwi inzila yoonse kuyosikila ku Gidomu, aalimwi ooko bakakujaya zyuulu zibili lubo.
Boonse basilumamba ba Bbenjamini aabo bakawa eelyo zuba bakali zyuulu zilimakkumi aabili amusanu - baaluumi aabo bakayisigilwe kulwaana amapanga; boonse bakali siyanisigilwe munkondo.
Pesi baaluumi baali myaanda musanu awumwi baakabweda akuchijila munkanda, kutobezya lyabbwe lya Limoni.

Baaluumi ba Izilayeli bakabwedela kuyolwisya luunyungu lwa Bbenjamini akubawumya mulomo wapanga, idolopo, kubikkaamwi abanyama azyoonse ezyo nzibakajana. Bakawumpa alimwi lyoonse Bbooma munzila zyabo.
Lino bantu ba Izilayeli bakakonkezya chisyomezyo ku Mizipa, ''Takwe pe wesu uyelede kupa mwanakwe musimbi kuti akwatwe kumusyobo waba Bbenjamini.''
Mpawo bantu bakiinka ku Bbeteli akuyokkala nkuko kunembo lya Leza kusikila kumabbililo, alimwi ajwi pati bakoomoka chakukwila.
Bakiita, ''Nkaamboonzi, Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, ezi nizyachitwa ku Izilayeli, kuti wamusyobo wesu wabulika sunu?''
Mubuzuba butobela bantu bakabuka chifumo akuya ku chipayililo nkuko alimwi bakatula zituuzyo zyakutenta azituuzyo zyakutontoozya.

Bantu ba Izilayeli bakati, ''Nguuli woonse musyobo wa Izilayeli watasika mumbungano ya Jehova?'' Nkambo bakachita chisyomezyo chipati akulangisisya naba omwe watasika kuli Jehova ku Mizipa. Bakati, ''Ulelede kujayigwa.''
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakatelela mukulana wabo Bbenjamini. Bakati, ''Sunu woomwe musyobo wapambulwa kuli Izilayeli.
Ngwani utakababambe bakazi abo basyaala, mbokunga twakachita chikumina kuli Jehova kuti tatukoyosiya naba omwe wabo kuti akakwate mwana musimbi wesu?''
Bakati, ''Njiili misyobo yaba Izilayeli yakatasika kuli Jehova ku Mizipa?'' Kwakajanika kuti takwepe naba omwe wakasika kumbungano kuzwa ku Jabbesi Giliyadi.
Nkambo elyo bantu bakajanika balibambidwe kabotu, bona takwe, bakkala mu Jabbesi Giliyadi naba omwe wakajanika.
Imbungano yakatuma bantu bakozu bali zyuulu zili kkumi azibili kabali amalayilile akuti biinke akuyojaya bakkala mu Jabbesi Giliyadi apanga, kubikilizya abanakazi abana.
''Muchite obu: Baluumi boonse abanakazi boonse abo bakazi mwalumi kwiinda kuswanana anguwe amubape kulunyonyooko.''
Bantu bakajanwa akkati kabaabo bakkala mu Jabbesi Giliyadi bali myaanda yoone yabanakazi bachili baniini batana kuswanana amwalumi, alimwi bakabatola kuchilawo ku Silo mu Kkenani.
Imbungano yoonse yakatuma mulumbe akwambila bantu ba Bbenjamini bakali kundomba ya Limoni kuti babatula chaluumuno.
Ba Bbenjamini bakabweeda kuchiindi nchicheecho alimwi bakalipedwe mwanakazi waku Jabbesi Giliyadi, pesi tebakazulila pe boonse.
Bantu baketelela Bbenjamini azyakachitika, nkambo Jehova wakachita kwanzania akkati misyobo ya Izilayeli.
Mpawo bazuluzi bambungano bakati, ''Mbubuli mbotunga tulabamba banakazi baba Bbenjamini abo basyeede, mbokunga banakazi baba Bbenjamini bakajayigwa.
Bakati, ''Balelede kujana lukono lwabaabo basyeede kuzwa ku Izilayeli.
Tatukoyobapa banakazi kuzwa kubana besu basimbi, nkambo bantu ba Izilayeli bakachita chisyomezyo, 'Lutuko kuli oyo naba omwe uupa mwanakazi kuba Bbenjamini.'''
Aboobo bakati, ''Mulizi kuti kuli pobwe lya Jehova amunyaka amunyaka ku Silo ( kunyika ya Bbeteli, kujwe lyamugwagwa oyo uyinka ajulu kuzwa ku Bbetelu kuyosika ku Syekkemu, akumusanza wa Lebbona).''
Bakalayilila bantu ba Bbenjamini, bakati, kamuya mukayube munsiswa akwiima mumuunda wamisansa.

Akulanga chiindi elyo basimbi baku Silo nibasika kukuzyana, mpawo mukachijane kuzwa mumyuunda yamisansa alimwi awumwi wenu akalijatile mwanakazi kuzwa kubasimbi baku Silo, mpawo mukabwede kunyika ya Bbenjamini

Eelyo bamawisi abo naa bakulana babo nibasika kuzotututongawukila, tuyowamba kuti kulimbabo, 'Mutulekelele! Mubasiye nkambo tetwakabweza banakazi bamwalumi naba omwe muchiindi chankondo. Tamukwe mulandu, mbokunga temwakapa bana benu basimbi kuli mbabo.'''

Bantu ba Bbenjamini bakachita oobo. Bakatola mwelwe wabanakazi aabo mbibakali kuyanda kuzwa kubasimbi bakali kuzyana akubabweza kuti babe banakazi babo. Bakiinka akubweeda kubusena bwachisi chabo. Bakayakulula myuunzi yabo akukkala mulinjiyo .
Mpawo bantu ba Izilayeli bakasiya busena obo akuya kumunzi, awumwi kumusyobo wakwe akuchiinga chakwe, awumwi kuchisi chakwe.
Mumazubayo tekwakalikwe mwami pe mu Izilayeli. Awumwi wakali kuchita zyakali kabotu mumenso akwe.
Aaya majwi aJelemiya mwana waHilikkiya, umwi wabapayizi baku Anatoti munyika ya Benjamini.
Ijwi lyaJehova lyakasika kuli nguwe mumazuba aaJosiya mwana wa Amoni, mwana waJuda, mumunyaka wakkumi ayitatuyabweendelezi bwakwe.

Lyakasika lubo mumazuba aaJehoyakkimumwana wa Josiya, mwaami waJuda, mane do mumweezi wamusanu mumunyaka wakkumi alimwi waZedekkiya mwana waJosiya, mwaami waJuda, eelyo bantu baku Jelusalema nebakatoledwe mbuli baange.
Ijwi lyaJehova lyakasika kulindime, kaliti,
''Nketana kukuchita mwida, ndakakusala; kotanazwa mwida, ndakakusalazya; ndakuchita kuti ube musinsimi kumasi.''
''Ah, Mwaami Jehova!'' Ndaamba kuti, ''Tandizi mbonjelede kwaambula, nkaambo ndimuniini loko.''
Pesi Jehova wakati kulindime, ''Utaambi kuti ndimuniini loko.' Uyelede kwiinka koonse nkwendakutuma, alimwi welede kwaamba kufumbwa nchendakulayilila!
Utayoowi, nkaambo ndili aanduwe kukuvuna - aaya malayilile aaJehova.''
Mpawo Lehova wakandisikila ajaanza lyakwe, wakaguma mulomo wangu, akwaamba kuti kulindime, ''Lino ndabika ijwi lyangu mumulomo wako.
Ndakusala atala amasi aatala amaami, kuyomwa akumwaya, kuyonyonyoonaakujayilizya, kuyoyaka akuzikkila.''
Ijwi lyaJehova lyakasika kulindime, kaliti, ''Ubweneenzi, Jelemiya?'' Ndati, ''Ndibwene mutabi wa alimondi.''
Jehova wakandaamdila kuti, ''Wabona kabotu, nkabela ndilokulangilizya aatala ejwi lyangu kutilibwezwe lyiinke.''
Ijwi lyaJehova lyakandisikila lwabili, kalyaamba kuti, ''Ubweneenzi?'' Ndakati, ''Ndibwene chilongo chitentedwe, chisuuneme, kachilokuvunuka kuzwa kubbazu lwakunyika.''
Jehova wakandaambila kuti, ''Lunyonyoono luyojulilwa kuzwa kubbazu lyakunyika aatala aboonse ibakkala muliino nyika.

Lino ndayita misyobo yoonse yamaami aakubbazu lyakunyika, mbwaalayilila Jehova. Ayooza, alimwi umwi awumwi uyobika chuunu chakwe chabwaami aamanjililo aamilyango wa Jelusalema kachilangene amalambo woonse aayo aazyungulukide azisi zyoonse zyaJuda.
Ndiyowamba chisubulo kulimbabo chabubi bwabo boonsemukunditama, mukutenta tununkilizyo kuzileza zimbi, amukukomba eezyo nzebakalipangila amaboko aabo beni.
Libambile iwe lyako! Nyampuka akwaamba kulimbabo kufumbwa nchendakulayila. Utakamaninwi nguzu kunembo lyabo; naa kuti ime nkakumaninsye nguzu kunembo lyabo!
Boona! Bona! Sunu ndakuchita chisi chilalubaya, munsende wabutale, amalamba aamundalila aazyungulukide nyika yoonse.
Bayookulwanisya, pesi tabayokuzunda pe, akaako ndinoli anduwe kukukuvuna - aaya ngemalayilile aaJehova.''
Ijwi lyaJehova lyakaza kulindime kaliti,

''Koya ukaambe mukuswiilila kwaJelusalemu. Ukatedi, ''Jehova waamba eechi: ndayeya muchibela chako chizuminano chabusyomesi chabukubusi bwako, luyando lwako kuchiindi nitwakajatanisigwa, niwakandiyanduula munkanda, nyika itakwe niyakabyedwe.
Izilayeli yakalisalilidwe Jehova, kabalwabalwe kabutebuzi bwakwe! Boonse bakalya kuzwa kukabalwebalwe bakali aamulandu; ntenda zyakabawida - aaya malayilile aJehova'''
Swiilila jwi lyaJehova yoong'anda yaJakkobbu, nywebo moonse nobamukowa yang'anda yaIzilayeli.

Jehova waamba eechi, ''Niinzi bamawuso ncjibakajana kachili chibu kulindime, chakabachita kuti beendele kule kzwa kukunditobela? Zyakuti bakatobela zikozyanio zitagwasyi alimwi abalabo bakaba batagwasyi beni?

Tebakaamba pe kuti, ''Ulikuli JEhova ooyo wakatugwisya kuzwa kunyika yaIjipiti? Ulikuli Jehova ooyo wakatuzulwidwa kuya mukanda, munyika yabaAlabba amalindi, munyika yachimpayuma amudima uusiya mbi, nyika iitakwe wiinda mumo alimwi iitakwe uukkala mumo?'
Pesi ndakamweeta kunyika yaKkamelu, kuyoolya muchelo wayo azimwi zintu zibotu! Eelyo aawonimwakaza mwakasofwazya nyika yangu, mwakachita lukono lwangu lwabachisesemyo!
Mupayizi tensi wakaamba kuti, 'Ulikuli Jehova?' abalabo basyabusongo basimilawu tebakaba aamakani andime pe! Beembeli bakandibisizya. Basinsimi bakasinsima Bbaalaakweendela zintu zitakwe mpindu.
Aboobo ndiyomupa mulandu - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - alimwi  ndiyopa mulandu kubana balombe babana benu balombe.
Mukazubukile mutala eeliya lyaKkitimu alimwi mukalange. Mukatume batumwa kuya kuKkeda akuyoyandulisisya akubona na kwakali kwaba chintu chili boobu mumazuba akiinda.
Sena chisi chakali kwiinzanisya baleza, nikuba kuti tebakali baleza? Pesi bantu bangu bakiinzanisya bulemu bwabo kuzintu zitabagwasyi. .
Mukankame, nomajulu, akaambo kacheechi! Amukatilimuke akuyowa aaya malayilile aaJehova.
Nkaambo bantu bangu bandibisizya zibi zibili: Bakasiya tusensa twamanzi abuumi alimwi bakalisyida mikala beni, mikala ifwide iitachikonzyi kubamba manzi.
Sena Izilayeli muzike? Wakazyalilwa mumunzi wasimalelo wakwe na? Aboobo nkamboonzi naaba chisaato?
Balavu baniini bakamuvulumina. Bakachita kuyowa kupati akuchita nyika yakwe yaba chiyoosyo. Myuunzi yakwe yakamwayigwa tatichikwe bayikkala pe.
Abalabo bantu baMemfisi abaTapanesi bayokulula kapapa kako.
Sena temwakalichitila oobo na nimwakasiya Jehova Leza wanu, nakali kumuzulwida mukati kanzila?
Akkako nkaambonzi nimutobelezya nzila iiya kuIjipiti akuyonywa manzi aaSyiholi? Nkaambonzi nimutobelezya nzila iiya kuAsiliya akuyonywa manzi aaMulonga Yufuletisi?

Bubi bwanu bulamukalalila, alimwi kutasyomeka kwanu kulamusubula. Aboobo amuyeeye aatala anchicho akumvwisisisya kuti nchibi  alimwi kulalula aawo nimusiya Jehova Leza wanu, alimwi akutandiyowa - ooku nkwaamba kwaMwami Jehova wamakamu.

Nkaambo ndakatyola jogwe lyako eelyo ndiwakali aalyo mazuba achiindi; ndakadunsula bwaange kuzwa kulinduwe. Wakaamba kuti, 'Nsikoyoobeleka!' mbukunga wakavundama mukalundu kalamfu aansi kamusamu woonse uli aamatu, webo simamambe.
Ndakakubyala mbuli muchelo musale, kuzwa kunseke iizulide mbotu. Mpawo walisandula buti kuba musaansa uunyongene uutakwe lugwasyo.
Nkaambo nikuba walisanzya lwako mwini mumulonga na kusamba ansipa nkali, bubi bwako ndibbata kunembo lyangu- ooku nkwaamba kwaMwami Jehova.
Kujana ulaamba biyeni kuti, 'Nsisofweede pe! Tendakatobela baBbaala pe'? Langanziwakachita mumimpata! Yeesesya nziwakachita - uli nkamela nzyazi iizyatuuka kuchijaanaoku akoku,
mbong'olo yamusokwe iizibide munkanda, mukusantuula kwayo kinunkizya muuwo! Ngwani uunga ulijalisya nkosya yayo? Takwe ng'enze zilimvwa kuyanda kwiitobela; kuchiindi chakusantuzya balayijana.
Mweelede kukakila ndyato zyanu kuyooba zitasami amagoyooyo aanu kuba aanyota! Pesi mwakaamba kuti, 'Tazikwe bulangilizi! Pe, ndilayanda bamazwakule akubatobela!'
Mbuli bweeme bwa mubbi naajanwa, aboobo ng'anda yaIzilayeli iyofwisigwa bweeme - nbo abaami babo, bana babo balombe baami, bapayizi babo abasinsimi!

Aaba mbimbabo baamba kuti kumusamu, 'Nduwe taata wangu,' akubbwe, 'Nduwe wakandizyala.' Nkaambo masule aabo ngaandilanga peepe masyu aabo. NIkubaboobo muchiindi chamapenzi balaamba kuti, 'Buka alimwi utuvune!'
Pesi balikuli baleza mbimwakalibumbila? Ngababuka na kabayanda kumufutula muchiindi chamapenzi, bkaambo zikozyanio zyanu zileelene amyuunzi yanu kuvula, Juda!
Aboobo nkaambonzi nimundipa mulandu wakuchita chitaluleme? Moonse mwandibisizya - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Ndakasubula bantu bako chabuyo. Tebali kutambula pe lulayo. Ipanga lyako lyakalya basinsimi bako mbuli mulavu unyonyoona!

Nywebo nobezyalane eeli! Amuswiilile kujwi lyangu, ijwi lyaJehova! Sena ndakali nkanda kuliIzilayeli? Na nyika yamudima uusiya mbi? Nkaambonzi bantu bangu ninga balaamba kuti, 'Tuleke tupimpile, tatukoyooza limbi kulinduwe'?
Sena nakalindu kujana waluba nchoko zyakwe, nabwiinga zizwaato zyakwe? Pesi bantu bangu bakandiluba kwamazuba aatabaliki!
Mulalomya  kubamba nzila zyanu kukuyanduula luyando. Mwakayisya nzila zyanu nikuba kubanakazi basizibi.
Bulowa bwakali buumi kubaluleme, bantu bachete bakajanika aazisamo zyanu. Bantu aaba tebakajanikana pe munchito zyabubbi.
Pesi waamba kuti, 'Tandikwe mulandu pe; nchobeni lunyemo lwakwe lwakazwa kulindime.' Pesi langa! Ndiyooselusizya lubeta aalinduwe nkaambo waamba kuti, 'Ntandibisizye pe.'
Nkaambonzi ulawubya kusanduka kwanzila zyako? Alubo uyonyemesegwa aIjipiti mbuli mbuwakanyemesegwa aAsiliya.
Alimwi uyoozwa ooko kowuside, kojisi kumutwe wako, nkaambo Jehova wabakaka aabo mbosyoma, aboobo tokoyoogwasigwa ambabo.''

''Na mwaalumi waleka mwanakazi wakwe mpawo wazwa kulinguwe akuba mwanakazi wawumbi mwaalumi, ulakonzya lubo na kubweeda kulinguwe? Tikonooli yasofwaala kapati nyika eeyo? Wapona mbuli sibwamu ooy uli aabayandwi biingi; alimwi uyoboola na kulindime? - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Nyampula menso aako kusika kule alimwi ulange! Nkubuli na busena ooko nkuwakatachita bumambe? Kumbali anzila mulalindila bayandwi banu, mbuli muAlabbu munkanda. Mubumambe amububi mwasofwaazya nyika.
Aboobo lunywaanywa lwamvula  alimwi amvula yamiinza teyaboola pe; pesi muli aankumu yasibwaamu; mulakaka kuwusigwa nsoni.
Lino tensi wiita kulindime na: 'Taata wangu! Mweenzuma waafwifwi kuzwa kubuniini bwangu!
Sena uyoonyema zyiindi zyoonse? Sena uyookkala kali aabukkali kuyosika kumamanino?' Langa! Eezi nzizyo nziwaamba, pesi ulachita bubi boonse mbokonzya!''

Mpawo Jehova wakandaambila kuti mumazuba aaJosaya mwami, ''Mwachibona na eecho chachitwa aIzilayeli utakwe lusyomo? Watanta tulundu toonse alimwi wayinka munsi lyamusamu woonse uli aamatu, ooko wachita mbuli simamambe.
Ndakati, 'Naamana kuchita zintu zyoonse eezi, ulaboola kulindime,' pesi takaboola pe. Mpawo muchizi wakwe Juda uutasyomi wakabona zintu eezi.

Aboobo ndakabona kuti munzila iikozyenie Izilayeli uutakwe lusyomo wachita bumambe alimwi ndamutanda akumupa lugwalo lwakulekana aatala anguwe, mwanike wakwe Juda taakayowa pe; wakazwa alakwe aanze waakuchita mbuli simamambe.
Bwaamu bwakwe bwakaba bwabuyo kulinguwe; wakasofwaazya nyika. Wakachita bumambe aamabwe amisamu.
Mpawo musule lyachechi, mwanike wakwe Juda uutasyomi wakaboola kulindime chamoyo uutamaninide pe, pesi amabejo - ooko nkwaamba kwaJehova.''
Mpawo Jehova wakaamba kuti kulindime, ''Izilayeli utakwe lusyomo wakaliluleme  loko kwiinda Juda utakwe lusyomo!

Koya ukakambawuke majwi aaya kulubazu lwanyika. Ukaambe kuti, 'Boola, Izlayeli utakwe lusyomo! - ooko nkwaamba kwaJehova - nsikoyokunyemena pe lyoonse. Mbukunga ndilisyomekede - ooko nkwaamba kwaJehova - nsikoyookkala nkenyemede pe lyoonse.
Zumina milandu yako, nkaambo wabisizya Jehova Leza wako; waabana nzila zyako abazwakule munsi lyamusamu umwi awumwi uli aamatu! Nkaambo tewakaswiilila jwi lyangu pe! - ooko nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Amuboole, nobantu batakwe lusyomo! - ooko nkwaamba kwaJehova - ndime mulumi wanu! Ndiyokubweza, womwe kuzwa kuchisi alimwi babili kuzwa kumpuli, ndiyomweeta kuZiyon!
Ndiyokupa beembeli bali aamoyo wangu, alimwi bayokweembela chaluzibo achakulangisisya.

Mpawo chiyoochitika kuti mukavule akuzyala michelo munyika mumazuba aayo - ooko nkwaamba kwaJehova - tabachiyowambai limbi kuti, ''Ibbokesi lyachizuminano chaJehova!'' Aaka kaambo takakoyosika limbi kumyoyo yabo na kuyeeyegwa limbi; tachikoyobulwa, alimwi takwe chimbi chiyochitwa.'

Muchiindi eecho bayowamba aatala aJelusalemu, 'Eechi nchuuno chabwaami chaJehova,' alimwi zyoonse zimwi zisi ziyobungana kuJelusalemu muzina lyaJehova. Tabachiyoyendi limbi mukuunduuzya kwamyoyo yabo yabubi.
Mumazuba aayo ng'anda yaJuda iyoyenda ang'anda yaIzilayeli. Bayoyoboloka aantomwe kuzwa kunyika yakulubazu lwakunyika kuyoosika kunyika eeyo njindakapa baIzilayeli mbuli lukono lwabo.

Mbuli ndime ndaamba kuti, 'Mbuli mbeyanda kumubweza mbuli mwana wangu mulombe akumupa nyika mbotu, lukono lubotu loko kwiinda oolo luli mulichimwi chisi!' Ninga ndaamba kuti, 'Uyondiita kuti ''taata wangu''.' Ninga ndaamba kuti tokoyopiluka kunditobela.
Pesi mbuli mukayintu utasyomi mulumi wakwe, wanduuzya, ng'anda yaIzilayeli - ooko nkwaamba kwaJehova.''
Ijwi lyamvwigwa kumisena, kulila akukombelezya kwabantu baIzilayeli! Nkaambo basandula nzila zyabo; baluba Jehova Leza wabo.
''Amuboole, bantu nimutakwe lusyomo! Ndiyomusilika mubuuzyi!'' ''Amubone! Tuyooza kulinduwe, nkaambo nduwe Jehova Leza wesu!
Nchobeni mabejo azwa kutulundu, muzuzumo uusowesya kuzilundu; nchobeni Jehova Leza wesu ndufutuko lwaIzilayeli.
Pesi zikozyanio zifwisya bweeme zyanyonyoona eezyo basikale besu nzibakabelekela - matanga eembono zyabo, bana babo balombe abana babo basimbi!

Atulale aansi mukuwusa. Ikaka kuusa kwesu kutuvumbe nkaambo twabisizya Jehova Leza wesu! Swebo tobeni abasikale besu kuzwa kuchiindi chabwanike bwesu kusikila kubuzuba bwasunu, tetwakaswiilila kujwi lyaJehova Leza wesu!''
''Na wabweeda, Izilayeli - ooko nkwaamba kwaJehova - zyeelede kuba kulindime kuti ubweede. Na wagwisya zintu zyako ziyoosya kuzwa kunembo lyangu akutayoozwa lubo  kulindime limbi,
weelede kuba akasimpe, uusalala alimwi uululeme eelyo nokonka, 'Mbuli Jehova mbwapona.' Mpawo zisi ziyolilongezya mulinguwe, alimwi mulinguwe bayopa bulemu.''
Nkaambo Jehova waamba eechi kuliwumwi awumwi muntu muJuda amuJelusalemu: 'Lima nyika yako nomwini alimwi utabyali pe aakati kamaamvwa.

Mukalipalule kuiJehova, alimwi mukagwisye ndomo zyamyoyo yanu, nobaalumi baJuda abakkede muJelusalemu, lumwi bukali bwangu bulabbaluuka mbuli mulilo alimwi kawutenta kakutakwe ukonzya kuuzima, nkaambo kabubi bwanchito zyanu.
Muzibye muJuda alimwi muchite kuti zimvwigwe muJelusalemu. Amwaamba kuti, ''Lizya mweembo munyika.'' Waambe, ''Mubungane. Atweende kumyuunzi iibayilidwe.''
Nyampula ndembela yachitondeezyo akuyitondeka kuZiyoni, alimwi chijila kumayubilo! Utakkali nkaambo ndiyobweeta lunyonyooko kuzwa kulubazu lwa Nyika, akuwa kupati.
Mulavu ulikuzwa musaka lyakwe alimwi umwi utakanyonyoone zisi ulikubambila. Ulikusiya busena bwakwe kukweeta nkondo munyika yako, kusandula myuunzi yanu akuba matongo, kakutakwe naba womwe uyofutuka.
Nkaambo kacheechi livumbe achivumbyo chesaka, ulile akweema. Nkaambo bukali bwanguzu zyaJehova tabubweeda musule pe kuzwa kulindiswe.
Mpawo ziyochitika muzuba eelyo - ooko nkwaamba kwaJehova - kuti myoyo yamwami abasilutwe bakwe iyoofwa. Bapayizi bayooyowa abasinsimi bayokankama.'''
Aboobo ndakati, ''Ikaka! Mwami Jehova inchobeni wakamaninsya kweena bwantu aaba aJelusalemu akwaamba kuti, 'Kuyooba luumuno lwako.' Kakuli panga lilikuuma akulwisya buumi bwabo.''
Muchiindi eechi zinowambuulwa aatala abantu aaba aJelusalemu, ''Luuwo lutenta kuzwa muntandabale zyankanda luyochita nzila yalo kumwana musimbi wabantu bangu. Tuukoyopupulula na kubasalazya.
Luuwo luli aanguzu mpati kwiinda oolu luyoosika kwiinda mukulayilila kwangu, alimwi ndiyoopa chisubulo aatala ambabo.
Bona, ulikulwana mbui mayoba, alimwi nkalaki zyakwe zili mbuli mvula yaguwo. Mbongolo zyakwe zili aaluno kwiinda nsika. Maawe kulindiswe nkaambo tuyonyonyonwa!
Salazya moyo wako kuzwa kububi, Jelusalemu, kuchitila kuti mukafutulwe. Kuyooba chiindi chilamfu buti kuti mizeezo yako ikabisye?
Nkaambo ijwi lilikuleta twaambo kuzwa kuli Dani, alimwi lunyonyooko luyobuza lulikumvwigwa kuzwa kuzilundu zyaIfulemu.
Chita zisi kuti ziyeeye aatala acheechi: Bona, ambilizya kuliJelusalemu kuti basikusinkilizya bayobuza kuzwa kunyikakunyika yakule kuzowompolola munkondo aatala amyuunzi yaJuda.
Bayooba mbuli mulindizi wamuunda wakalimwa uzyungulukide, kuzwa naakandipandukila - ooko nkwaamba kwaJehova -
mayeeyelo amilimo yako nzizyachita zintu eezi kulinduwe. Eechi nchisubulo chako. Kuyoobija biyeni! Chiyowuma moyo wako lwawo.
Moyo wangu! Moyo wangu! Ndili mumapenzi mumoyo wangu. Moyo wangu tuukkalinkene pe. Takwe niinga nduumuna pe nkaambo ndamvwa kulila kwanyeele, nchenjezyo yankondo.
Lunyonyooko lutobela lunyonyooko nkaambo nyika yoonse yaba matongo. Chakufwambaana matente angu amwayigwa, zisitikizyo zyangu mukayindi.
Kuyooba lili kuti nkabone bubotu? Sena ndiyoomvwa na kulila kwanyeele?
Nkaambo kabufubafuba bwababntu bangu - tabandizi pe. Nzizeenwa zyabantu alimwi tabakwe kumvwisisisya pe. Bali aaluzibo lwakuchita bubi, pesi tabazi pe kuchita bubotu.
Ndakabona nyika. Amubone! Teyakali kulangika alimwi kitakwe chintu pe. Nkaambo tekwakali mumuni pe wamajulu.
Ndakalanga kuzilundu. Amubone, bakali kukankama, alimwi toonse tulundu twakali kuteketa.
Ndakalanga. Amubone, takwe wakali wo pe, alimwi tuyuni twakujulu twakali twawuluka.
Ndakalanga. Amubone, myuunda yamichelo yakaba nkanda amyuunzi yoonse yakawisigilwa aansi kunembo lyaJehova, kunembo kwalunyemo lwakwe.''
Ncheechi nchaamba Jehova, ''Yoonse nyika iyooba matongo pesi nsikoyoyimwaya chakumaninina pe yoonse.
Akaambo kachizato eechi, nyika iyoolila, majulu aali aajulu ayosizigwa. Nkaambo ndaamba makanze angu; nsikoyobweeda musule pe; nsikoyooleka pe kuzichita.

Munzi umwi awumwi uyochija kuzwa kumuzuzumo wakupenzegwa akumpumba yabasilumamba abasitunta bali aatunta; bayochijila mulusaka. Munzi umwi awumwi uyotanta mumasena aali aamabwe. Myuunzi iyotakatwa nkaambo takwe uyoyikkala pe.

LIno koli wanyonyonwa oobu, uyochita biyeni? Nkaambo nikuba wazwaata chizwaato chamanyemanyenge, kulibotezya anchoko zyako zyangolide, akuchita menso aako kuti aboneke kali mapati amusila, mwaalumi wakali kumweemuzya uyokukaka. Ani kuti balikweezya kubweza buumi bwako.

Aboobo ndakamvwa musabilo wakulila, kubulikilwa mbuli kutubukwa kwamwana mutaanzi, musabilo wamwana musimbi waZiyoni. Ulikufwetuuka kuyoya. Ulakwazamuna maboko aakwe, 'Maawe kulindime! Ndilikuwizuuka akaambo kabajayi aaba.'''

''Fwambaana kwiinda mumigwagwa yaJelusalemu; yanduula kumababzu aachisi chakwe alubo. Mpawo ulange alimwi uyeeye aatala acheechi: Na wakonzya kujana mwaalumi naba womwe ulikulichita uululeme alimwi ulikuweezya kupona chakusyomeka, ndiyolekelela Jelusalemu.
Nekuba balaamba, 'Mbuli Jehova mbapona,' nikuba boobo balikukonka zyakubeja.''

Jehova, sa menso aako taalangi busyomesi na? Ulabawuma bantu pesi tabamvwi kuchisa pe. Wakabazunda kumaninide, pesi bachikaka kutambula lulayo. Bachita masyu aabo kuti ayume kwiinda bbwe, nkaambo balakaka kusanduka.
Aboobo ndakati, ''Nchobeni bantu aaba mbachete. Mbafubafuba, nkaambo tabazi nzila zyaJehova, nikuba mbeta zyaLeza wabo.

Ndiyoyinka kubantu bayandika akwaambilizya mulumbe kuzwa kuli Leza, nkaambo balizizi nzila zyaJehova, imbeta zyaLeza wabo.'' Pesi boonse bakatyola jogwe lyabo aantomwe; bakadunsula nketani zyakabaangide kuliLeza.

Aboobo mulavu wamulusaka uyobalwana. Wumpe uuzwa kuAlabbu uyobajaya. Siluwe uyonyoona chisi chabo. Ooyo uuzwa muchisi uyonyoonwa. Nkaambo milandu yabo yavula. Nchito zyabo zyakutasyomeka zyayindilila.
Nkaambonzi neyelede kulekelela bantu aaba? Bana babo balombe bakandisiya akukonka azitali baleza. Ndakabasanina bakuta pesi bakachita mamambe akweenda kabali biingi kuya kung'anda zyabasibwaamu.
Bakali mabhiza aasantukide. Bakali kweendeenda kabayanda cheembela. Umwi awumwi mwaalumi wakali kuswenenena mwanakazi wamweenzinyina.
Aboobo nsyeelede kubeempya na - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - alimwi nsyeelede kubweedezya na kuchisi chili boobu?
Koya aakati kamyeenya yamisaansa yakwe wiijaye. Pesi utakamaninsizyi pe kubajaya. Kkwezuula misaansa yabo mbukunga misaansa eeyo tiizwi kuliJehova pe.
Nkaambo ng'anda zyaIzilayeli aJuda zyakanduuzya  kumaninide - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Bakaamba zyakubeja aatala aJehova kabati, ''Takwe nchatakachite pe; takwe bubi butakaze kulindiswe alimwi tatukoyobona panga na nzala.
Basinsimi bayooba luuwo, ijwi talili mulimbabo pe,  aboobo leka nzibabamba zikachitike kulimbabo.''

Aboobo Jehova, Leza wamakamu waamba eechi, ''Akaambo kakuti mwaamba eechi, bona, ndaamba kubika ijwi lyangu mumulomo wako. Linoli mbuli mulilo, alimwi bantu aaba banoli mbuli chisamu! Nkaambo uyobalya.

Amubone! ndaamba kweeta chisi chizwa kule kuti chizomulwane, ng'anda yaIzilayeli - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - chisi chitamani, chisi chachiindi! Nchisi chili aamuaka ngotazi pe, nikuba kumvwisisisya nzibaamba.
Inkomo yatunta ilimbuli kabanda katajalidwe pe. Boonse mbaasilumamba.

Bayoolya butebuzi bwako, achikkafu chako. Bayonyonyoona bana banu balombe abasimbi. Bayoolya mbelele zyako abutanga bwako. Bayoolya misaansa amikuyu yako. Bayopasula madolopo aako aayakilidwe oomo mobikide lusyomo lwako.
Pesi nikuba muliwayo mazuba - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - nsikwe muzeezo wakukunyonyoona kumaninidepe.

Eelyo aawo webo Izilayeli aJuda nimuyowamba kuti, 'Nkaambonzi Jehova Leza wesu naakachita zyoonse zintu eezi kulindiswe?' mpawo iwe, Jelemiya uyowamba kuti kulimbabo, 'Mbuli mbumwakasiya Jehova alimwi mwabelekela baleza bazwakule munyika yanu, aboobo muleelede kubelekela bazwakule munyika iitensi yenu.'
Muzyaambe eezi kun'anda yaJakkobbu alimwi mukachizibye muJuda. Katedi,
'Mumvwe eechi, nobafubafuba, nimutakwe kumvwisisisya; nimuli aamenso pesi tamuboni pe, alimwi muli aamatwi pesi tamumvwi pe.

Tamundiyowi na - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - na kukankama kunembo lyabusyu bwangu? Ndakabika mugaano wamuse wanzaania lwizi, nimbeta yiinkilila nembo njitasotoki pe - nikuba lwizi lulazula akuunguluka, pesi talusotoki kale pe. Nikuba mayuwe aalo avuuma akoondomoka, taazubuki kale pe.
Pesi bantu aaba  ali aamoyo wabuchuundwe. Ulachengunuka mukupapa akutakata.
Nkaambo tabaambi mumyoyo yabo pe, ''Ngatuyowe Jehova Leza wesu, ooyo weeta mvula - mvula ntaanzi ayakumamanino - muchiindi cheelede, kutulondweda chiindi chakutebula cheelede.''
Zibi zyanu zyakakachizya zibotu kuti zisike kulindinywe.
Nkaambo balajanika abantu bangu. Baleebela mbuli muntu uubwatilila kujata tuyuni; balateya kakole alimwi bacha bantu.
Mbuli zongo lizwide tuyuni, ng'anda zyabo zizwide lweeno. Aboobo balakomena kapati alimwi baba banoti.

Bakaneneya; balang'ayimina muzyiimo zibotu. Bakazubuka kuzwa kubwaange bwazibi zyonse. Tabaswiilili zyaamba bantu, na chipa kuti ube muchaala. Balazwidilila nikuba tabapede bululami kuli baabo babula.
Nsyeelede kubapa chisubulo na akaambo kazintu eezi - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - alimwi nsikoyolibwedezezya na aanyika iili boobu?
Zintu zibi ziyoosya zyakachitika munyika.
Basinsimi balasinsima chalweeno, alimwi bapayizi batonga aanguzu zyabo beni. Bantu bangu baziyanda munzila eeyi, pesi niinzi chiyochitika kumamanino?'''

Mujane lukwabililo, nobantu baBbenjamini, kwiinda mukuzwa muJelusalemu. Musibe mweembo muTekkoya. Mumunyampwide chitondeezyo Beti Hakelemu chakumuzunda, mbokunga bubi bulikuboneka kuzwa kumbo; lunyonyooko lupati luyobuza.
Mwana musimbi waZiyoni, mwanakazi mubotuuutentusya uyojayigwa.
Basikweembela amatanga aambono zyabo bayoyinka kulimbabo; bayoyaka zibbakasa koonse koonse aakumuzundikizya; awumwi muntu uyoyembela akuboko kwakwe.
''Amulipede kulibaleza kunkondo. Nyampuka, atukalwane aakalangabwaaseme. Nchibi loko kuti mumuni wasikati nkuyobuvwindaana.
Pesi atukabalwane mansiku alimwi tujaye luwabililo lwakwe.''
Nkaambo Jehova wamakamu waamba eechi: Tema misamu yakwe, alimwi ulundike tombe mukulwana Jelusalemu. Eeli ndidolopo lyeelede kulwanwa, nkaambo lizwide budyaamizi.
Mbuli chikkala mbuchizwida maanzi mapya, mbubo dolopo eeli mbulikkala kalibumba bubi. Lupyopyongano akutabambika zilamvwigwa mulinguwe; malwazi azilonda zilikubusyu bwangu lyoonse.
Tambula lulayo, Jelusalemu, na ndikutantamune akukuchita tongo, busena butakkalwi muntu.'''
Jehova wamakamu waamba eechi, ''Nchobeni bayobabweza aabo basyeede muIzilayeli mbuli lubuwa lwamusaansa. Tambika lubo akuboko kwako kuti uchele masaansa kumisaansa.
Nkuliini nkunditaambilizye kuchitila kuti baswiilile? Langa! Matwim aabo tapalwidwe pe; tabachikonzyi pe kiswiilila! Langa! Ijwi lyaJehova lyasika kulimbabo kukubazyotolola, pesi tabaliyandi pe.''

Pesi ndizwide bukali bwaJehova. Ndakatala kubufundilizya. Wakati kulindime, ''Butilile aabana mumigwagwa amutubunga twabaalumi baniini. Nkaambo woonse mwaalumi uyogwisigwa amwanakazi wakwe; amuntu mupati woonse uulemedwe minyaka.
Maanda aabo ayopegwa bamwi, zyoonse myuunda yabo abanakazi babo. Nkaambo ndiyolwana bakkala munyika eeyo amaboko aangu - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Jehova waambilizya kuti kuzwa kubaniini kusika kubapati loko, boonse mbatangazi mukujana amukutasyomeka. Kuzwa kumusinsimi kusika kumupayizi, boonse bachita zyalweeno.
Bakaponia zilonda zyabantu bangu buniini kabati, 'Luumuno, Luumuno,' aawo kakutakwe luumuno pe.

Bakafwisigwa mawuse na aawo nibakali kuchita zisesemyo? Tebakaba aamawuse pe; tebakezi pe kulisyobasyoba! Aboobo bayoowa aakati kabawide; bayoselezegwa eelyo nibatanoopegwe chisubulo, mbwaamba Jehova.

Jehova waamba eechi, ''Kayime aayingana migwagwa ukalange; ukabuzye nzila zyechiindi. 'Ilikuli eeyi nzila mbotu?' Mpawo mukayende mulinjiyo akulijanina busena bwakulyookezya. Pesi bantu baamba kuti, 'Tatukoyinka pe.'
Ndakamusalila mulindizi kuti aswiilile mweembo. Pesi bakati, 'Tatukoswiilizya pe.'
Nkinkaako, nozisi, muswiilile! Mubone, nywebo nobakamboni, kuti niinzi chitakachitike kulimbabo.
Mvwa, yonyika! Bona, ndaamba kweeta ntenda kuli aaba bantu - muchelo wamizeezo yabo. Tebakaswiilila pe jwi lyangu na mulawu, pesi bakakaka biya.''

''Bwaambaanzi kulindime bununkilizyo oobu buya kujulu kuzwa kuli Syebba? Na ooyu mweema ulabotezya na kuzwa kubusena buli kule? Zipayizyo zyabo zyakutenta tazitambuliki pe kulindime, nikuba zipo zyako.
Aboobo Jehova waamba eechi, ''Bona, ndaamba kubika syajingajingatanda kukulwana bantu aaba. Bayolitaaluka - mataata abana balombe aantomwe. Bakkala mumo abaafwiifwi bayofwa abalabo.'
Jehova waamba eechi, 'Bona, bantu balikuza kuzwa kunyika yakumbo, chisi chipati chilikubambwa kuzwa kumasena aanyika zyakule loko.

Bayobweza tuvwi amasumu. Bali aalunya alimwi tabakwe buuya pe. Muyoliyoli wabo ulimbuli kuvuuma kwalwizi, alimwi bagede mabbiza, aabambikene mbuli baalumi baya kunkondo, kulwana nduwe nomwana musimbi waZiyoni.'''
Twakaamvwa makaniaatala ambabo, ,aboko esu alengelela mukwiizuuka kwakutyompwa. Kuyowa kwatujata mbuli mwanakazi uulikutumbuka.
Utayinki aanze kumyuunda, alimwi uteende mumigwagwa nkaambo mapanga aasinkondonyokwe akuyowa kupati kuli koonse koonse.
Mwana musimbi wabantu bangu zwaata zisamo zyamasaka alimwi ubumbuluke mudota; lila amisozi iichisa mbuli kwamwana womwe biyo, nkaambo sikujaya ulasika aalindiswe mpawaawa.
''Ndakakubumba, Jelemiya, umwi uusunka bantu bangu mbuli uusunka nsimbi, aboobo uyolangisisya akusunka nzila zyabo.
Boonse mbaasikuunduzya kupati, beenda kabaamba bubi aatala abamwi. Boonse mbayumu mbuli mundalila abutale, kabachita bubbiningizi.
Masimbi asalalila akutentwa aamulilo; bubulo bwalyigwa kuyaaya mumangalaba. Kubambululwa kwiinkilila kunembo aakati kabo, pesi tazigwasyi pe, nkaambo chibi techagwisigwa pe.
Bayotegwa ninsiliva yakakwa, nkaambo Jehova wabakaka.''
Ijwi lyakasika kuli Jelemiya kuzwa kuli Jehova kaliti,
''Imikila kumulyango weng'anda yaJehova akukambawuka eeli jwi! Utedi, 'Muswiilile jwi lyaJehova moonse nobaJuda, nywebo nimunjila mumilyango kukulumbayizya Jehova.
Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli waamba eechi: Nchita nzila zyako alimwi uchite zibotu, alimwi ndiyoyinkilila kunembo kuti upone munyika eeyi.
Utalisyomi nomwini kunajwi mabi akwaamba kuti, ''Tempele yaJehova! Tempele yaJehova! Tempele yaJehova!''
Nkaambo na mwachita nzila zyenu akuchita bubotu; na mwachita bululami bumaninide aakati kamwaalumi asimabambanwa wakwe -
na waleka kupenzya aabo bakkede munyika, bamuchaala, na mukamufu alimwi temwatila bulowa busalala aabusena oobu, akuteendela bamwi baleza kukulibisizya -
mpawo ndiyokkala munyika eeyi, munyika njindakapa kuli bamawuso benu kuzwa kuzyiindi zyachiindi abutamani.
Mubone! Mulikusyoma majwi aakubeja aayo atamugwasyi pe.
Mulabba na, mulajaya na, alimwi mulachita na mamambe? Mulakonka na chakweeneena akutenta tununkilizyo kuliBbaali akweendela bamwi baleza mbimutazi?
Mpawo mulaza na akwiimikila kunembo lyangu mung'anda yangu eeyo yiitwa muzina lyangu akwaamba kuti, ''Twafutulwa,'' aboobo ulakonzya kuchita zyoonse zisesemyo eezi?
Sa eeyi ng'anda eeyi, iibwezede zina lyangu, ndikkomba lyababbi mumenso enu? Pesi amulange, ndakazibona - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.

Aboobo koya kubusena bwangu bwakali muSyiyoli, ooko nkundazumizya zina lyzngu kuti likkale nkuko lutaanzi, alimwi langa kuli eezyo nzindakachita kulinchicho nkaambo kakubisya kwabantu bangu Izilayeli.
Mpawo lino mulachita zintu zyoonse - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - ndakambuula kulindinywe chiindi achiindi pesi temwakaswiilila pe. Ndakamwiita pesi temwakavwiila pe.
Nkinkaako, nzindakachita kuSyiyoli ndiyozichita lubo kung'anda eeyi eeyo yiitwa muzina lyangu, ng'anda njimwakasyoma, oobu busena mbundakapa kulindinywe abasikale banu.
Nkaambo ndiyomutuma kuzwa kunembo lyangu mbuli mbundakatuma boonse bakulana benu, boonse balunyungu lwaIfulemu.'
Mbuli kulinduwe, Jelemiya, utabakombeli pe bantu aaba, alimwi utabanyampwidi lukwiilo na kwaamba nkombyo yakubiiminina, alimwi utandikombeli ndemwini, nkaambo nsikoyokuswiilila pe.
Tozibwene na nzibalokuchita muJelusalemu muzisi zyaJuda amumigwagwa yaJelusalemu?

Bana balikubungania nkuni alimwi bamawisi balikuyasya mulilo! Banakazi balikufunka busu kuti bachite zinkwa zyamwanakazi mwami wamajulu akutila chipayizyo chakunywa kuli bamwi baleza kuti bakandisampawule.
Nkasimpe na kuti balikundiniaka? - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - tensi balikuliniaka na lwabo, kuti mawuse aayo ali aalimbabo?
Nkinkaako Mwami Jehova waamba eechi, 'Bona, kunyema kwangu abukali bwangu buyotilwa mubusena oobu, kuli boonse bantu abanyama, aamisamu iili mulusaka amichelo iili aanyika. Ziyoopya akutazimika.'
Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli wamba eechi, 'Yungizya chipo chako chakunywa kuchipayizyo chako alimwi enyama kuzwa kulimbabo.
Nkaambo aawo nindakagwisya basikale benu kuzwa munyika yaIjipiti, tendakakumbila nikuba chintu chomwe kuzwa kulimbabo. Tensi ndakabapa malayilile aatala azipo zyakutenta aazipayililo.

Ndakabapa biyo aaya malayilile, ''Muswiilile kujwi lyangu, alimwi ndiyooba Leza wanu, anywebo bantu bangu. Aboobo mweende muzila zyoonse eezyo nzindamulayilila, kuchitila kuti kukabe kabotu kulindinywe.''
Pesi takwe nibakaswiilila na kuchenjeka kutwi. Balapona kwiindilila mumiyeeyo yamyoyo yabo mibi, aboobo bakabweedela musule, peepe kunembo.
Kuzwa buzuba basikale banu nibakazwa munyika yaIjipiti kusikila oobuno buzuba, ndatuma boonse balanda bangu, basinsimi bangu, kulindinywe. Ndakasungwaala mukubatuma.
Pesi tebakandiswiilila pe. Tebakaswiilila pe. Pesi bakayumya nsingo zyabo. Bakali basizibi kwiinda basikale babo.'
Aboobo amba woonse majwi aaya kulimbabo, pesi tabakoyokuvwiila pe.
Amba kulimbabo kuti: Eechi nchisi chitaswiilili kujwi lyaJehova Leza wacho alimwi tachitambuli lulayo. Kasimpe kakalobesegwa akugonkwa kuzwa kumilomo yabo.
Mukagele masusu enu akulinyoola, mukasowe masusu enu. Mwiimbe lwiimbo lwedilwe aatala lyamasena aajulikide. Nkaambo Jehova wakaka alimwi waanda  zyalane eeli mubukali bwakwe.
