Nkaambo bana balombe baJuda bakachita zibi kunembo lyangu - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - bakabika zintu zyabo zibi mung'anda eeyo yiitwa muzina lyangu, mukuyanda kulisofwaazya.

Mpawo bakayaka busena buli aajulu bwaTofeti buli muMumpata waBbeni Hinoni. Bakachita eezi kukutenta bana babo balombe abasimbi mumulilo - chimwi chintu nchindakatabalayilila pe, nikuba kunjila mumiyeeyo yangu.

Aboob bona, mazuba ayobuza - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - eelyo nilitachinoyitwi limbi kuti Tofeti na Mumpata waBbeni Hinoni. Inoli yaba Mumpata Wakajayila; bayovwika mitunta muTofeti kusikila kakutachikwe busena busyeede.
Mitunta yabantu aaba iyooba chikkafu chabayuni bakujulu abanyama bamulusaka bamunyika, alimwi takwe naba womwe uutakabakonge.
Ndiyobika magozezyo azisi zyaJuda amigwagwa yaJelusalemu, musabilo walukondo amusabilo wakubotelwa, musabilo wamuyeni amusabilo wanabwiinga, nkaambo nyika iyooba matongo.''
''Muchiindi eecho - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - bayoyeta kuzwa mutubanda mafuwa abaami baJuda abasimilimo babo, mafuwa aabapayizi abasinsimi, alimwi amafuwa aabakkala muJelusalemu.

Mpawo bayowayanzaania mumumuni wazuba amwezi anyenyeezi zyamajulu; eezi nzintu zyakujulu nzibakatobela akubelekela, nzibakatobela akuziyanduula, alimwi nzibakakomba. Mafuwa takoyobungikwa na kutentwa lubo pe. Banoli mbuli mafumba aajulu anyika.
Kunyika yoonse iitakachaale ooko nkundakabagwisya , bayosala lufu kutali buumi bwabo beni, aabo boonse bachicheede kuzwa kuchibi chanyika - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova wamakamu.
Aboobo amba kuti kulimbabo, 'Jehova waamba eechi: Mpali na uuwa katabuki? Mpali na usweeka katayezyi kuboola?
Nkaambonzi aaba bantu, Jelusalemu bakabweeda chakumaninina mukubula lusyomo? Balakakatila mulweeno aalimwi balakaka kusanduka.

Ndakachenjeka matwi alimwi ndakaswiilila, pesi tebakambuula kabotu pe; takwe naba omwe wakakumbila lulekelelo bwazibi zyakwe. Takwe waamba kuti, ''Ndachitaanzi?'' Boonse balayinka nkubayanda, mbuli silumamba munkutwe kunkondo.
Nikuba bbunga kujulu lilizi chiindi chibotu; alimwi inziba, zibelesyo, antantizyo zileenda achiindi cheelede, pesi bantu bangu tabazi mbeta zyaJehova.
Kujana ulaamba buti kuti, ''Tuli basongo, nkaambo mulawu waJehova uli aandiswe''? Nchobeni, bona! Chilembyo chalweeneeno chabasikulemba chachita lweeno.
Baalumi basongo bayowusigwa nsoni. Bayoowa akuchigwa. Bona! Bakaka jwi lyaJehova, aboobo busongo bwabo bubelekaanzi?

Aboobo ndiyoopa banakazi babo kulibambi, amyuunda yabo kuli babo bayoyivuba, nkaambo kuzwa kumuniini kusika kumupati, boonse mbalyabi kumpindu yakutalemeka! Kuzwa kumusinsimi kusika kumupayizi, boonse bachita lweeno.
Bakaponia zilonda zyabantu bangu buniini kabati, 'Luumuno, Luumuno,' aawo kakutakwe luumuno pe.

Bakafwisigwa mawuse na aawo nibakali kuchita zisesemyo? Tebakaba aamawuse pe; tebakezi pe kulisyobasyoba! Aboobo bayoowa aakati kabawide; bayoselezegwa eelyo nibatanoopegwe chisubulo, mbwaamba Jehova.
Ndiyobagwisya chakumaninina - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - takukoyoba masaansa aaminsaana , nikuba nkuyu kumikkuyu. Nkaambo matu ayopusama, alimwi eezyo nzindakabapa ziyoyinda.

Nkaambonzi nitukkede aano? Tuze aantomwe; ngatwiinke kumadolopo aabayilidwe, alimwi tukafwe muchuumunizi nkukooko. Nkaambo Jehova Leza wesu uyotumuzya. Uyotuchita kuti tukanywe zijaya mukuti twakamubisizya.
Tulikulangilila luumuno, pesi takwe chinoli chibotu pe. Tulikulangilila chiindi chakuponisigwa, pesi bona, kuyooba nkondo.
Kulumbuzigwa kwamabbiza aabo kwamvwigwa kuzwa kuliDani. Nyika yoonse yazungaana amizuzumo yakuza kwamabbiza aasimide. Nkaambo bayosika akulya nyika abuvubi bwayo, madolopo abaabo bakkala mulingawo.
Nkaambo bona, ndiyotumina nzoka aakati kanu, bachipile mbimutakonzyi kweemuzya. Bayomuluma -- ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.'''
Kuusa kwangu takukwe mamanino pe, alimwi moyo wangu ulachiswa.

Bona! Koompolola kwajwi lyamwana musimbi wabantu bangu kuzwa kunyika iilikule! Jehova tali muZiyoni na? An mwami wakwe tachili ooko na? Nkaambonzi nibandituka kuti bandinyemye azikozyanio zyabo zyakubeza azibumbwa zyabo zitabeleki zyakule?
Butebuzi bwayinda, miinza amana. Pesi tetwafutulwa pe.
Zyandichisa akaambo kakuchiswa kwamwana musimbi wabantu bangu. Ndoomoka akaambo kazintu zyakachitika kulinguwe; ndawusa.
Takwe musamu wakusilika na kuGiledi? Takwe musilisi na ooko? Nkaambonzi kuponesegwa kwabana basimbi babantu bangu nikutalikuchitika?

Ansinga mutwe wangu ukonzya kuchita maanzi, alimwi menso aangu kaaba mubanzo wamisozi! Nkambo ndipeekezya kukwila mansiku esikati nkelilila aabo bali mumwi amwana musimbi wabantu bangu aabo bajayigwa.
Kansinga umwi kandipa busena biyo kuti beenda mulusaka bakkale, nkundali kuya kuti ndisiye bantu bangu. Kuti nkonzye kubasiya biyo, mbuli kuti boonse mbasibumambi, ibbunga lyabawuzya!

Jehova ulambilizya, ''Bavunga ndimi zyabo mbuli midantaambwa yabo kukubeja, alimwi tachichitilwi kusyomeka kwabo pe kuti basime aansi. Nkaambo bazwi muli chimwi chibi kabanjila muli chimbi. Tabandizi pe.''
Umwi wenu, amuchenjelele mbimuyakilene aabo alimwi utasyomi naba omwe mukulana wako nkambo woonse mukulana ngusikweneena, alimwi wonse ngoyakilene aawe weenda mulweno.
Awumwi muntu useka ngwayakilene anguwe alimwi tawambi kasimpe pe. Indimi zyabo ziyiisya zintu zyalweeno. Badekela mukuchitz chibi.
Kubawo kwenu kuli mukati kantiinti yalweeno; mukubisya kwabo balakaka kundiziba -- eechi nchaambilizyo cha Jehova.''
Jehova wamakamu waamba kuti, ''Amubone, ndaamba kubanantya akukusunka, nkambo niinzi chimbi nchenkonzya kuchita, akambo kanzibachita bantu bangu?
Indimi zyabo ntuvwi tunonedwe; bambuula zintu zitasyomeki. Amilomo yabo baambilizya luumuno ambibayakilene aabo, pesi amyoyo yabo balabeja mukubalindila.
Nsyelede kubapa chisubulo akambo kazintu eezi -- alimwi nsyelede kukwichizya nikuba kuchisi chiliboobu?

Ndilayimba lwiimbo lwakubukila akulyeema nkambo kamalundu, alimwi lwiimbo lwaadilwe luyoyimbilwa bafwide. Nkambo balazikwa chinatombe alimwi takwe muntu ukonzya kwinda muli mbabo, alimwi kuselezegwa kwang'ombe tekwamvwika pe. Bayuni bamajulu abanyama boonse bachija.
Nkiinkaako ndilasandula Jelusalemu ibe zilwi zyamatongo, chiyubilo chabawumpe. Ndilachita madolopo aa Juda abe matongo atakkali bantu.''

Ngwani muntu musongo kuzulila kukumvwisisisya eechi? Nkulini mulomo wa Jehova nkuwaambuula, alimwi ulachaambilizya? Nkaambonzi nyika nyiyamana alimwi yamwayigwa mbuli lusaka lutachikwe muntu ukonzya kwiinda mukkati?
Jehova waamba kuti, ''Nkuti bakasowa mulawu wangu ngundakabikka kunembo lyabo, nkambo tabaswilizyi ijwi lyangu nikuba kweenda andilyo.
Kuliboobo  nkaambo bakeenda amyoyo yabo mindundulundu alimwi batobela basatani mbuli mawisi mbubaka bayiisya kuti bachite.
Nkinkaako Jehova wamakamu, Leza wa Izilayeli, waamba boobu, 'Amubone, Ndaamba kuchita kuti bantu aaba balye musamu wabuungu akunywa manzi akkola.
Mpawo Ndiyobasansaania mumanyika ngibatanaziba, nikuba mbabo kana basikale babo, Ndiyotumizya panga musule lyabo kusikila Ndibamane boonse akubajaya.''
Jehova wamakamu waamba kuti, '' Amuyeeye eechi; Mubape kaambo biimbi bakumalilwe; mubaleke baze. Mubatumine muntu bakayintu bazimbandawuko; mubaleke baze.
Muleke bafwambane bazoyimbe lwimbo lwakubukila aatala andiswe, kuchitila kuti menso eesu akonzye kukunka misozi alimwi zikowe zyesu zikunke maanzi.
Nkaambo kawuulo kakulyeema nkayumu mu Ziyoni, 'Mbuli mbotumanide, tuli wuside kapati, nkambo twasowa nyika kuzwa nibakamwaya maanda eesu.'

Nkinkaako yobanakazi, amumvwe ijwi lya Jehova; muswilizye milumbe izwa mumulomo wakwe.  Mpawo muyiisye bana benu basimbi lwiimbo lwakulila, alimwi umwi awumwi mwanakazi ngoyakilene anguwe abe alwiimbo lwaadilwe.
Nkambo lufu lwazida muli bamukabafu; lulikunjila mumasena eesu. Lujaya bana bazwa kunze, abaalumi banini mutubbwalo twadolopo.
Wambilizya eechi, 'Echi nchaambilizyo cha Jehova -- mitunta yabantu iyoowa mbuli mafumba mumyuunda, alimwi takukoyooba muntu pe utakababunganisye.''''
Jehova waamba oobu, '' Tamuleki muntu musongo abe akuliyanda mubusongo bwakwe, nikuba silumamba mubupati bwakwe. Tamuleki muntu muvubi abe akuliyanda mubuvubi bwakwe.

Nkambo kuti muntu waba akuliyanda mulichimwi chintu, akube muli eechi, ngabe amaboneno alimwi andizibe. Nkambo Ndime Jehova, uubeleka akulemekwa kwazizuminano, bululami abusalali aanyika. Nkambo mulinzizeezi mundibotelelwa -- echi nchaambilizyo cha Jehova.''
''Ngamubone, mazuba asika--echi nchaambilizyo cha Jehova--aawo nensikape chisubulo boonse bapalwidwe baliboobo biyo mumibili yabo.

Ndiyoopa chisubulo ku Ijipita a Juda, Edomu, bantu baku Amoni, Mowabbu, abantu boonse bagela akufwimpya loko masusu aamitwe yabo. Nkambo zyoonse zisi eezi tazipalwidwe pe, ang'anda ya Izilayeli yoonse ijisi moyo utapalwidwe.''
''Mvwa jwi lyaJehova mbaambilizya kulindinywe, kung'anda yaIzilayeli.
Jehova waamba eechi, 'Mutayiyi nzila zyamanyika, mutayoosegwi azitondeezyo zyamajulu, nkaambo zisi zilayoosegwa kulizeezi.
Aboobo zyaanza zyababa bantu nzyabuyo; umwi ulagonkela aansi musamu mulusaka, asikubeza uyoyigwisya kabotu azibelesyo zyakwe.
Mpawo balachibotezya ansiliva angolide. Bakachisimya ansando alimwi bakachigankamina azipikili kuchitila kuti chitawi.

Niinzi eezyo nzibachita amaboko aabo zili mbuli chitoombe mukati kamuunda wamakowa, nkaambo abalabo takwe nchibakonzya kwaamba, alimwi baleelede kubwezwa nkaambo tabayendi. Mutabayowi, nkaambo tabakonzyi kweeta bubi, nikuba kukonzya kuchita chibotu.'''
Tawe ulimbuli nduwe, Jehova. Ulimupati, alimwi zina lyako ndipati munguzu.
Ngwani utayowi nduwe, mwami wazisi? Nkaambo eezi nzowelede kujana, nkaambo tawo pe aakati kabasongo ulimbuli nduwe mumanyika woonse nikuba mumaami abami.
Boonse balakozyania na, mbafubafuba manzinzili, basikwiiya bezitoombe zitaambi chintu pesi kuba zisamu biyo.

Baleeta nsiliva izwa kuTasyisyi, angolide kuzwa kuliUfazi yakachitwa abasikubumba, maanza amufuzi. Zisamo zyabo nzyamubala wamuteme azyamuntumbula. Baalumi babo basungu bakazibumba zyoonse zintu eezi.
Pesi Jehova nguLeza wamasimpe. NguLeza uupona Mwami walyoonse. Nyika ilaanduka kubukali bwakwe, alimwi manyika taakonzyi kukasya bukali bwakwe.
Uyowamba bobu kulimbabo, ''Baleza bakatalenga majulu anyika bayooloba kuzwa kunyika alimwi kuzwa munsi lyamajulu aaya.''
Pesi nguwe wakalenga nyika kunguzu zyakwe, alimwi wiimika nyika yoonse abusongo bwakwe, akumvwisisisya kwakwe wakayala julu.
Ijwi lyakwe lichita kuguluma kwamanzi kumajulu; akweeta sikunkwe kumajinkilo aanyika. Ulapanga tulabi twamvula akutuma guwo kuzwa kuzilondwedo zyakwe.
Baalumi boonse takwe nchibakazi pe, kubula luzibo. Bafuzi boonse bakawusigwa nsoni azitoombe zyabo. Nkaambo zyoonse zitombwe zyabo zibumbidwe nzyakubeja; takwe buumi mulinzizyo.
Tazigwasyi, milimo yabasikasampusampu; ziyoomana kuchiindi chakusubulwa kwabo.
Pesi Leza, chibela chaJakkobbu, tachili mbulu zeezi pe, nkaambo mubumbi wazintu zyoonse. Izilayeli mukowa walukono; Jehova wamakamu ndezina lyakwe.
Bungika mikuli yako alimwi uzwe munyika, nywebo nobantu nimwakali kupona munsi lyalukwabililo.
Nkaambo Jehova waamba eechi, ''Bona, ndaamba kusowa bantu bamomuno munyika. Ndiyobapenzya alimwi bayozibona mbuboobo.''
Maawe kulindime! Akaambo kamafuwa angu atyokede, chilonda changu chilatabukizigwa. Aboobo ndakati, ''Nchobeni eechi chilachisisya, pesi ndeelede kuchitambula.''

Itente lyangu lyamwayuuka, alimwi ntambo zyobile zyetente zyagonkwa. Bakabweza bana bangu kuzwa kulindime, aboobo tabachiponi pe. Takwe naba womwe ukonzya kugankamina tente lyangu na kunyampula zisitikizyo zyetente lyangu.
Nkaambo beembeli mbafubafubatabakonzyi kuyanduula Jehova; aboobo tebakazwidilila pe, abutanga bwabo boonse bwakasansaana.
Makani atwambo akasika, ''Bona! muzuzumo mupati uyobuza kuzwa kunyika yakuNyika kuchita myuunzi yaJuda matongo, ziyubilo zyabamwaaba.''
Ndilizi, Jehova kuti inzila yamuntu tiizwi kulinguwe pe mwini. Tawo pe muntu weenda uulilulamika meendelo aakwe.
Ndilaye, Jehova, abululami bwako, peepe peepe mukunyema kwako na kundinyonyoona.
Tila mukali bwako kumanyika aatakwizi akumpuli zitayiti zina lyako. Nkaambo bakalya Jakkobbu akumumena kuti bamunyonyoone chakumaninina akudilisya chikkalo chakwe.
Ijwi lyakasika kuliJelemiya kuzwa kuliJehova kaliti,
''Swiilila kumajwi aachizuminano eechi, alimwi awaambilizye kuliwumwi awumwi wabantu muJuda amubantu bakkala muJelusalemu.
Waambe kuti kulimbabo, 'Jehova, Leza waIzilayeli waamba eechi: Ulitukidwe ooyo utaswiilili majwi aachizuminano eechi.

Eechi nchizuminano nchindakalayilila basikale bako kuti babambe buzuba mbundakabagwisya kuzwa kunyika yaIjipiti, kuzwa kumulilo uusyukuta uyaazya lubulo. Ndakati, ''Swiilila kujwi lyangu akuchita zintu zyoonse mbuli mbundakakulayilila, nkaambo uyooba muntu wangu ambebo ndiyooba Leza wako.''

Kondilemeka kuchitila kuti ndikonzye kuzumina chikonke nchindakakonkezya kuli basikale bako, chikonke chakuti ndiyobapa nyika iikunka malili abuchi, mumukkede sunu.''' Mpawo mebo, Jelemiya, ndakasandula alimwi ndakati, ''Iyi, Jehova!''
Jehova wakati kulindime, ''Kaambe zintu zyoonse eezi mumyuunzi yaJuda amumigwagwa yaJelusalemu. Utedi, 'Swiilila kumajwi aaya aachizuminano alimwi waachite.

Nkaambo ndakali kupa chizwide milawu kuli basikale bako kuzwa mubuzuba nindakabagwisya kuzwa kunyika yaIjipiti kusika kuchiindi eechino, kukakatila kubachenjezya akwaamba kuti, ''Muswiilile kujwi lyangu.'''

Pesi tebakaswiilila na kuchenjeka matwi aabo. Umwi awumwi muntu wakalikweenda munchiki zyakwiizuuka kwamoyo wakwe. Aboobo ndeeta lutuko loonse kuchizuminano eechi oolo ndundakalayilila kuti luyobasikila , pesi bantu takwe nibakalemeka pe.''
Alimbi Jehova wakati kulindime, ''Insiswa yakabbutunuka aakati kabantu baJuda abaabo bakkala muJelusalemu.

Bakabweeda kuzobi zyabasikale babo, aabo bakakaka kuswiilila ijwi lyangu, aano bakatobela baleza bambi akukomba mbabo. Ng'anda yaIzilayeli ang'anda yaJuda bakatyola chizuminano eecho nchindakatangana abasikale babo.
Nkinkaako Jehova waamba eechi, 'Bona, mebo ndaamba kweeta lunyonyooko aalimbabo, lutuko ndubatakoyokonzya kuchija. Mpawo bayondiita pesi nsikoyoswiilila kulimbabo pe.
Myuunzi yaJuda abantu bakkala muJelusalemu bayoyinka akuyoyita baleza aaba mbibakapa zipo, pesi tabakoyokonzya kubavuna pe muchiindi chalunyonyooko lwabo.
Nkaambo webo Juda mweelwe wabaleza babo weelana amweelwe wamyuunzi yako. Wachita mweelwe wazipayililo zyabuusu muJelusalemu, zipayililo zyaBbaala, zyeelene aamigwagwa yakwe.
Aboobo iwe lwako, Jelemiya, towelede kubakombela bantu aaba. Towelede kukwiila na kukomba muchibaka chabo. Nkaambo nsikoyobaswiilizya pe bayondiita muchiindi chalunyonyooko lwabo.
Nkaambonzi muyandwi wangu, ooyo wakali aamizeezo mibi myiingi, nali mung'anda yangu? Nyama yazipayizyo zyanu tayikoyomugwasya pe. Mulasekelela akaambo kanchito zyanu mbi.

Muchiindi chiinda Jehova wakalikukwiita kuti mu olifi uli aamatu, mubotu amichelo iiyandika. Pesi uyoyasya mulilo aalinguwo uutakaachite musabilo ulimbuli wakudilima kwamvula mpati; ntabi zyawo ziyotyoloolwa.
Nkaambo Jehova wamakamu, ooyo wakakubyala, waamba lunyonyooko aatala anduwe akaambo kamilimu yako mibi eeyo ng'anda yaIzilayeli ang'anda yaJuda njibakachita - bakandinyemya akupa zipo zili Bbaala.'''
Jehova wakandichita kuti ndizibe zintu eezi, aboobo ndilizizi. Iwebo Jehova wakandichita kuti ndibone nchito zyabo.
Ndakali mbuli mbelele iyobutolwa kukujayigwa. Tendakazi kuti bachita muzeezo wakundilwisya, ''Atujaye musamu amichelo yawo! Atumugonke kuzwa kunyika yabapona kuti zina lyakwe litakayeeyegwi limbi.''
Nikubaboobo Jehova wamakamu mubetesi uululeme uulingulula moyo amizeezo. Ndiyoyebela kubweedezya kwako kulimbabo, nkaambo ndeeta kaambo kangu kulinduwe.
Akaako Jehova waamba eechi aatala abantu baAnatoti balikuyannduula buumi bwangu, ''Balati, 'Toyelede kusinsima muzina lyaJehova nkaambo tuyokujaya.'
Akaako Jehova wamakamu waamba eechi, 'Bona, ndaamba kubasubula. Baalumi babo baniini basinguzu bayoofwa apanga. Bana babo balombe abana babobasimbi bayoofwa anzala.
Tawo pe wabo uyosyaala, akaambo kakuti ndilikuleta lunyonyooko aatala lyabantu baAnatoti, munyaka wabo wachisubulo.'''
Ulasalala, Jehova, kufumbwa nindileta nkazyanio kulinduwe. Nchobeni ndeelede kukwaambila aatala akunyonyawuka kwangu: Nkaambonzi nzila zyabasizibi nizizwidilila? Boonse bantu batasyomi balazwidilila.
Wakababyala alimwi bakasimpa muyanda. Baliinkilila anembo akuzyala muchelo. Uli afwiifwi ambabo mumilomo yabo, pesi kule loko ambabo mumyoyo yabo.
Kakuli boobo, Jehova, ulindizi. Ulandibona alimwi aleezya moyo wangu kunembo lyako. Babweze mbuli mbelele ziya kukujayigwa, alimwi akuzibambila buzuba bwakujayigwa!

Kuyooba lili nyika kibikidwe chigamba abwizu kabupuseme mumuunda? Akaambo kakuti aabo bapona mulinjiyo mbaasizibi, banyama abayuni bakagwisigwa, nkaambo bantu bakati, ''Takoyobona chichitika kulindiswe.''

Jehova wakati, ''Nchobeni, na webo, Jelemiya, wachijaana abasilumamba bamawulu alimwi wakatala, uyozundana biyeni amabbiza? Na wawida aansi aalubuwa lukwabililidwe, uyochita biyeni muzisakasaka zitobelezezye Jodani?
Nikuba bakulana bako ampuli yawuso bakakuuzya alimwi bakakukaka chakoompolola. Utasyomi mulimbabo. nikuba kabaamba zintu zibotu kulinduwe.
Ndakatakata ng'anda yangu, ndakasiya lukono lwangu. Ndakapeda bayandwi bangu mujaanza lyabasinkondonyina.
Lukono lwangu lwakaba mbuli mulavu muchisakasaka; walibika kundilwana ajwi lyakwe mwini, aboobo ndimusulide.
Sena lukono lwangu lwandibeda muyunu mukali, aakuti bamwi bayuni balya bamwi bayuni bamubunganina? Koya akubungania banyama boonse bamusokwe akubaleta kuti bamulye.
Beembeli biingi banyonyoona muunda wangu wamasaansa. Balyatawula chaabilo changu chanyika; basandula chaabilo changu chibotu bachisala chaba nkanda, matongo.
Bakamuchita matongo. Ndilamulila; waba tongo. Nyika yoonse lyaba tongo, nkaambo takwe wiyeeya pe mumoyo wakwe.
Basikulmwaya balwisya masena aatakwe chintu munkanda, nkaambo ipanga lyaJehova lilamaninsya kuzwa kulubazu lumwi lwanyika kuyosika kulilimwi bbazu. Takwe lukwabililo munyika kuchintu chipona oomo.
Bakabyala bulotwe pesi bayotebula maamvwa. Bakatala kubeleka pesi kakutakwe nchibajana pe. Aboobo amube abweeme bwampindu yanu nkaambo kakunyema kwaJehova.''

Jehova waamba eechi aatala abasimabambanwa bangu boonse, babisyi aabo bawuma lukono oolo ndundakachita kuti bantu bangu baIzilayeli bavube, ''Bona, ndime ndaamba kubamojola kuzwa munyika yabo, alimwi ndiyokwela nyika yaJuda kuzwa aakati kabo.
Mpawo nkendindamojola masi aayo, kuyochitika kuti ndiyobafwida luzyalo akubaboozya; ndiyobaboozya - awumwi kulukono lwakwe akunyika yakwe.

Chiyosika chiindi chakuti na manyika aayo ayiya chakunanzelela nzila zyabantu bangu, kukukonka azina lyangu, 'Mbuli Jehova mbapona,' mbuli mbubakayisya bantu bangu kukonka aBbaala, mpawo bayoyakwa aakati kabantu bangu.
Pesi na umwi taaswiilila, mpawo ndiyoyimojola nyika eeyo. Iyomojolwa nchobeni akunyonyoonwa - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.''
Jehova wakaamba eechi kulindime, ''Koya ukawule mulembo wakunsi agubo ubike aatala uzwaate muchikungu chako, pesi utasanguni kuchibika mumanzi pe.''
Aboobo ndakawula mulembo wakunsi agubo mbuli Jehova mbakandilayilila, alimwi ndakawubika aajula kawuzyunguluka chikungu.
Mpawo jwi lyaJehova lyakasika kulindime lwabili kaliti,
''Bweza chisamo chakunsi eecho nchiwakawula chili muchikungu chako, nyampuka alimwi wiinke kuPelati. Uchisise nkukooko mumpako yebbwe.''
Aboobo ndakayinka alimwi ndaakuchisisa muPelati, mbuli Jehova mbakali wandilayilila.
Nikwakiinda mazuba miingi, Jehova wakati kulindime, ''Nyampuka ubweede kuPelati. Kabweze chisamo nchindakatedi uchisise.''
Aboobo ndakabweeda kuPelati alimwi daakusya akugwisya chisamo ooko nkundakachisiside, alimwi amubone, chakali chanyonyooka akubula mulimu lyoonse.
Mpawo jwi lyaJehova lyakasika kulindime, lyakati,
''Jehova waamba eechi: Munzila iikozyenie ndiyonyonyoona bufubafuba bwaJuda aJelusalemu.
Aaba bantu babi bakaka kuswiilila jwio lyangu, beenda kabatobela bamwi baleza kuyobakomba akuyobavundamina - bayooba mbuli chizwaato eechi chakunsi chibotu kachitakwe mulimu.

Mbuli ntako mbiijatilila kutusolo twamuntu, aboobo ndachita yoonse ng'anda yaIzilayeli ang'anda yaJuda kuti bajatilile kulindime - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - kuti bakabe bantu bangu, kuyondetela mpuwo, bulubu abulemu. Pesi tebakandiswiilila pe.

Aboob weelede kwaamnba ijwi eeli kulimbabo, 'Jehova, Leza waIzilayeli waamba eechi: Zyoonse nkomeki ziyozuzigwa wayini.' Bayowamba kuti kulinduwe, 'Sena tatuzi na nchobeni kuti zyoonse nkomeki ziyozuzigwa wayini?'
Aboobo tedi kulimbabo, 'Jehova waamba eechi: Ndaamba kubazuzya bukolwi boonse bakkala munyika eeyi, Bami bakkala aachuuno chaDeviti chabwami, bapayizi, basinsimi aboonse bakkala muJelusalemu.
Mpawo ndiyowumputisyania bantu wumwi kuli wumwi, mataata abana aantomwe - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - nsikoyobafwida luse na luzyalo, alimwi nsikoyobavuna kulunyonyooko.'''
Amuswiilile akuchenjeka matwi. Mutalisumpuli pe nkaambo Jehova wambuula.

Amupe bulemu kuliJehova Leza wanu nkatanayeta mudima, alimwi katanachita mawulu enu kuti alebwe aajulu lyazilundu nikuvwindaana. Nkaambo mulangilila mumuni, pesi uyowusandula akuchita cheenzule chilamfu amudima uusiya mbi, kuba joba lisiya.
Aboobo na temwaswiilila, ndiyolila andike akaambo kakulisumpulwa kwanu. Nchobeni menso angu ayolila alimwi misozi iyoyenda, nkaambo lutanga lwaJehova lwatolwa buzike.
''Amukatedi kumwami akuli banyina mwami, 'Amuseluke muze aansi kuzwa kuzyuuno zyanu zyabwami, nkaambo misini yenu yaloka kuzwa aamitwe yanu.'
Zisi muNegevi ziyojalwa, kakutakwe ukonzya kuzijula. Juda woonse uyotolwa mubuzike.
Nyampula menso ako akulanga aabo bayobuza kuzwa kuMusanza. Bulikuli butanga mbwakakupa, butanga bwakali bubotu loko kulinduwe?

Uyotyeni aawo noyojana kuti Leza wachita bantu mbuwakayisya kuba bayandwi bako, nkali wabachita kuti babe basilutwe bako? Sena aaya teematalikilo aamachise aakuzyala na aayokujata mbuli mukayintu uulikutumbuka mwana?
Mpawo ulakonzya kwaamba kuti mumoyo wako, 'Nkaambonzi zintu eezi nizilikuchitika kulindime?' Ziyooba zyabwiingi bwazibi zyako kuti zikketi zyao zyavumbulwa alimwi wasampawulwa.
Kujana bantu baKkusyi basanduka chikanda chabo na, na siluwe kusandula busaasa bwakwe? Na kakuli boobo, mpawo iwe ayebo, nikuba wakazibila bubi, mulakonzya kuchita bubotu.
Aboobo ndiyobamwayisya mbuli buungu buzimaana muluuwo lwamunkanda.
Eechi nchicho nchindakapa kulindinywe, chibela nchindakamubikila - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - akaambo kakuti  mwakandiluba alimwi mwakasyoma lweeno.
Aboobo andime ndiyokusamununa zisamo zyako, alimwi chinswe chako chiyobonwa.
Ndibwene mamambe aako abubi bwako, bubi bwabusangu bwako muzilundu amumyuunda, alimwi ndabona zisesemyo zyako! Maawe kulinduwe, Jelusalemu! Kuyooba chiindi chilamfu biyeni nkotanasalazigwa lubo?''
Eeli ndijwi lyaJehova lyakasika kuliJelemiya aatala amakani enzala,
''Muleke Juda alile; milyango yakwe isansaane. Balikulilila nyika; kulilila Jelusalemu kwabo kuyobwiinkilila anembo.
Basilutwe balatuma babelesi babo kuyoteka manzi. Eelyo nibayooya kutulonga tabakoyojana manzi pe. Bayoboola boonse kabatakwe pe; bayosisa mitwe yabo mumawuse aakutalemekwa.
Akaambo kacheechi nyika ilaandukide, nkaambo takwe mvula munyika. Basikulima bafwa nsoni alimwi balalivumba mitwe.
Nkaambo insya ilasiya kana kayo mumuunda akukasiila aato, nkaambo takwe masokwe.
Imbongolo zyamulusaka zilayimikila aantundubwi yantandabale akufwetuuka muluuwo mbuli bamwaaba. Menso aazyo taabeleki nkaambo takwe masokwe.''
Nikuba milandu yesu ipe bukamboni aatala andiswe, Jehova uyooba azina lyakwe. Nkaambo nchito zyesu zitakwe lusyomo zyavula; twakakubisizya.
Nduwe Bulangilii bwaIzilayeli, ooyo uumuvuma muchiindi chakutyompwa, nkaambonzi noyooba mbuli muzwakule munyika, mbuli mweenzu nalyeenda uutola busiku bomwe?
Nkaambonzi noli mbuli muntu uugambide, na mbuli silumamba utakwe manguzu aakufutula? Uli aakati kesu, Jehova, alimwi zina lyakwe lilayitwa aatala aswebo. Utatusiyi!
Jehova waamba echi kubantu aaba: ''Mbuli kuti bayanda kutuntulika, tabakasyi mawulu aabo kukuchita oobo.'' Jehova taboteledwe pe ambabo. Lino ulayibulukwa zibi zyabo. Alimwi wabapa chisubulo.
Jehova wakati kulindime, ''Utakombeli bubotu kwiimikilila bantu aaba.
Nkaambo nibayolyiimya kulya, nsikoyoswiilila kulila kwabo, alimwi na bapa zipo zyabo zyakutenta azyakulya, nsikoyobotelwa pe mulinzizyo. Nkaambo ndiyobamaninsya apanga, nzala amalwazi.''
Mpawo ndakati, ''O Mwami Jehova! Bona! Basinismi balikuti kubantu, 'Tamukoyolibona panga, takukoyoba nzala pe kulindinywe, nkaambo ndiyomupa lukwabililo lwini mubusena oobu.'''

Jehova wakati kulindime, ''Basinsimi basinsima mabejo muzina lyangu. Tendakabatuma pe, nikuba kubalayilila na kwambuula kulimbabo. Pesi zilengano zyakubeja zitagwasyi, kwaamba kwakubeja kuzwa mumayeeyelo aabo nzizyo nzibalikusinsima kulindinywe.''

Nkinkaako Jehova wati kulindime, ''Aatala abasinsimi balikusinsima muzina lyangu aabo mbindakatatuma pe - aabo baamba kuti takukoyooba panga pe na nzala mpati munyika iino: Basinsimi aaba bayojayigwa eepanga enzala mpati.

Mpawo kubantu mbibakasinsimila bayosowelwa mumigwagwa  yaJelusalemu akaambo kenzala mpati epanga, nkaambo takukoyooba naba womwe uutakabavwike - bo, makayintu aabo, bana babo balombe, na bana babo basimbi - nkaambo ndiyotila bubi bwabo aalimbabo.

Kaambe jwi eeli kulimbabo: 'Leka menso angu azwe misozi, mansiku asikati. Utakazumizyi kuti akaleke, nkaambo kuyooba kuwa kupati kwanakalindu mwana musimbi wabantu bangu - chilonda chipati chitasilikiki.
Na ndaya kumuunda, mbabo bakajayigwa epanga! Na ndaza kumyuunzi, nkukuli malwazi aachitwa eenzala. Boonse musinsimi amupayizi bayotuntuuka munyika, alimwi tabazizi pe.'''

Sena Juda wamukakila aato? Ulamusula naZiyoni? Nkaambonzi noyotupenzya eelyo aawo nkakutakwe kuponesegwa kwesu? Twakalangililide luumuno, pesi takwe chakali chibotu pe - alimwi chiindi chakuponesegwa, pesi bona, kuli kuyosegwa luzutu.
Tulazumina, Jehova, milandu yesu, kubisya kwabasikale besu, nkaambo twakubisizya.
Utatukaki! Kuchitila zina lyako, utachiti chuuno chako chabwaami chisesyo. Yeeya alimwi utatyoli chizuminano chako andiswe.
Sena zileza zitagwasyi zyamanyika zileeta mvula? Na majulu lwawo kujana awisya lunywaanywa na? Tensi nduwe na, Jehova Leza wesu? Tulindilide kulinduwe, nkaambo nduwe uuchita zyoonse zintu eezi.
Mpawo wakati kulindime, ''Nikuba kuti Mozesi na Samiyele waliimvwi kunembo lyangu, tendalikukonzya kale pe kubafwida luzyalo bantu aaba. Bagwisye kuzwa kunembo lyangu kuti beende.

Kuyochitika kuti bakaambe kuti kulinduwe, 'Tuye kuli?' Mpawo uleelede kubaambila kuti, 'Jehova waamba eechi: Aabo balufu beelede kuya kulufu; aabo bepanga beelede kuya kupanga. Aabo benzala mpati beelede kwiinka kunzala mpati; alimwi aabo babuzike beelede kuya kubuzike.'
Nkaambo ndiyobatuma munkamu zyone - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - panga kukujaya bamwi, bankala kukukwela bamwi, bayuni bakujulu abanyama bamusokwe banyika kukusyukuta akunyonyoona bamwi.
Ndiyobachita chintu chiyoosya kumaami woonse , aamunyika akaambo kanzyakachita Manase mwana mulombe waHezekkiya, Mwami waJuda, muJelusalemu.
Nkaambo ngwani utakakufwide luzyalo, Jelusalemu? Ngwani uyokweetelela?
Wandisiya - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - wabweeda kuzwa kulindime. Aboobo ndiyokuuma ajanza lyangu akukunyonyoona. Ndakatala kukufwida luse.
Aboobo ndiyobapupulula achipupuluzyo kumilyango yanyika. Ndiyobajaya. Ndiyonyonyoona bantu bangu mukuti tabapiluki kuzwa kunzila zyabo.

Njoochita bamukabafu babo kuti bakavule kwiinda muse wamunkomwe yalwizi. Sikati ndiyotuma bajayi kumakayintu aabaalumi baniini. Ndiyobatilimuna alimwi ndiyochita kuyoowa kuti kuti kukabawide chakufwambaana.

Mwanakazi uuzyede bana bali musanu ababili bayosowegwa. Uyowizuuka. Zuba lyakwe liyobbila kakuchili sikati. Uyowusa akufwisigwa nsoni, nkaambo ndiyoopa aabo basyaala kupanga kunembo lyabasinkondonyina - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.''
Maawe kulindime, baama bangu! Nkaambo mwakandizyala, mebo ndemuntu wakukachilana akukazyania munyika yoonse. Tendakacheneka, na kucheneka umwi muntu, pesi boonse balandituka.
Jehova wakati: ''Sena nsikoyokuvuna lyoonse? Nchobeni ndiyochita basinkondonyokwe kuti bakakumbile kugwasigwa muchiindi chamalwazi amapenzi.
Sena kujana umwi wakwamuna butale? Butale buyandisi buzwa kulubazu lwakunyika oobo buswaanizigilwe amukuba?
Buvubi ambono zyanu ndiyozipa basinkondonyokwe mbuli kusaala kutakwe muulo. Ndizoyizichita eezi akaambo kazibi zyanu zyoonse nzimwakachita kumigaano yanu yoonse.
Mpawo ndiyochita kuti mukabelekele basinkondonyokwe munyika eeyo njimutazi pe, nkaambo mulilo uyonamatila, ukakutulwe mubukali bwakuyoosya kwangu.''
Jehova, ulizi! Kondiyeeya akundigwasya. Ndibozezya mpindu aatala lyababo bandipenzya. Ulakakatila, pesi utabazumizyi pe kuti banditande; ziba kuti ndilapenzegwa akaambo kako.
Majwi aako ajanwa, alimwi ndakaalya. Majwi aako aba lukondo akubotezya moyo wangu, nkaambo ndabweza zina lyako, Jehova, Leza wamakamu.
Tendakakkala pe aakati kabaabo basekelela na kukondelelwa. Ndakalipambula akaambo kajaanza lyako lili aanguzu, nkaambo wakandizuzya bukali.
Nkaambonzi machise aangu ayinkilila aanembo achilonda changu tachisilikikipe, chilakaka kupona? Sena ulandibeda mbuli maanzi aalweeno, maanzi aayo aayuminina?

Nkinkaako Jehova wakaamba eechi, ''Na wasanduka, Jelemiya, mpawo ndiyokuchitulula, alimwi uyoyimikila kunembo lyangu akundibelekela. Nkaambo na wapambula zintu zyabufubafuba kuzwa kuzintu loko ziyandisi, uyooba mbuli mulomo wangu. Bantu bayoboola kulinduwe, pesi webo toyelede kubweeda kulimbabo pe.

Ndiyokuchita mbuli bulambo bwamundalila butanjiliki pe kubantu aaba, alimwi bayobusya nkondo aatala anduwe. Pesi tabakoyokuzunda pe, nkaambo ndili ayebo kukukuunununa akukuvuna - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova -
nkaambo ndiyokuvuna kuzwa kujaanza lyasizibi akukuunununa kuzwa kujaanza lyamudyaamizi.''
Mpawo ijwi lyaJehova lyakaza kulindime, kaliti,
''Utalibwezeli mukayintu alimwi utalibedi abana balombe na basimbi mubusena oobo.
Nkaambo Jehova waamba eechi kubana balombe abasimbi bazyalwa mubusena oobu, kumanyina babatumbika, alimwi kumawisi bakabachita kuti bazyalwe munyika eeyi,
Bayoofwa amfwida zyamalwazi. Tabakoyoolilwa na kuwikwa. Banoli mbuli mafumba aatala lyanyika.'

Nkaambo ijwi lyaJehova lyakaza kulindime, kaliti, 'Utanjili mmung'anda muli kulila. Utayinki kukulila na kukutondezya luzyalo kulimbabo, nkaambo ndakagwisya luumuno lwangu kuzwa kubantu aaba - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - alimwi luyando lwangu lwiimvwi nji alimwi abuuya.
Boonse bapati abaniini bayoofwa munyika eeyi, tabakoyoovwika alimwi takwe utakabalile pe nikuba kuligonka na kunyoola mitwe nkaambo kabo.
Takwe utakaabe nichiba chakulya mukulila kukubuumbulizya nkaambo kemfwida, alimwimtakwe utakape nkoemki yuumbuluzya kuliwisi na banyina kuti buumbulizigwe.
Utakiinki kung'anda yapobwe kukukkala ambabokuti ukalye na kunywa.'

Nkaambo Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi, 'Bona, kunembo lyamenso, mumazuba aako alimwi mubusena oobu, ndaamba kubika mamanino kumusindo wakubotelwa alimwi akumusindo wakusekelela, musindo wasibwiinga alimwi amusindo wanabwiinga.

Mpawo chiyochitika kutiuyowamba woonse mulumbe uuya kubantu aaba, alimwi balowamba kulinduwe, 'Nkaambonzi Jehova nalaya loonse oolu lunyonyooko lupati aatala lyesu? Niinzi mulandu achibi chesu nchitwakabisya kuli Jehova Leza wesu?'

Aboobo kowamba kulimbabo, 'Nkaambo basikale bako bakandisiya - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - alimwi bakatobela bamwi baLeza alimwi bakakomba bakotama aansi kulimbabo. Bakandisiya alimwi tababambide mulawu wangu.
Pesi inywe lwenu mwandeetela kutalulama kwiingi kwiinda basinsiku benu, nkaambo mubone, awumwi muntu uyobweenda anchiki zyamoyo wakwe uutaluleme; takwe uuswiilila kulindime.
Nkinkaako njomusowa kuzwa munyika eeyi njimwatakaziba, kutali ndinywe na basikale benu, alimwi muyokomba bamwi baleza nkukooko sikati amansiku, nkaambo nsikoyoopa nichiba choolwe kulindinywe.'
Aboobo, langa, mazuba ayobuza - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - chiindi nikutakabule kwaamba kuti, 'Mbuli Jehova mbapona, ooyo wakeeta bantu baIzilayeli kuzwa kunyika yaIjipiti.'
pesi, ''Mbuli Jehova mbapona, wakeeta bantu baIzilayeli kuzwa kunyika yakunyika alimwi kuzwa kumanyika nkwakabamwayide.' Nkaambo njoobaboozya kunyika njindakapa basinsiku babo.
Langa! Ndayita balobi biingi - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - kuti bakalobe bantu. Kuzwa kuli eechi njoyita bavwimi biingi kuti bakabavwimine aakati kazilundu atulundu twiingi, alimwi amumpako zyamabwe.
Nkaambo linso lyangu lili aatala anzila zyabo zyoonse; tabakonzyi kusiswa kuzwa kunembo lyangu. Milandu yabo tiikonzyi kusisigwa kuzwa kunembo lyamenso aangu.

Njotalika kubweedezya zyiindulwidwe tubili  nkaambo kamilandu yabo alimwi achibi nkaambo kakusofwaazya kwabo nyika yangu amitunta yazikozyanio zyabo zisesemya, alimwi akuzuzya lukono lwangu azikozyanio zyabo zisesemya.''

Jehova, ulimanguzu aangu alimwi mayubilo aangu, busena bwangu bwakuchijila mubuzuba bwakupenga. Manyika ayoyinka kulinduwe kuzwa kumagozyo aanyika alimwi balaamba, ''Simpe basinsiku besu bakakona lweeno. Takwe nchibalaacho pe; takwe mpindu mulimbabo.
Sena bantu balalichitila baleza? Pesi tabali baleza.''
Aboobo bona! Ndiyobachita kuti bazibe muli eechi chiindi, njobachita kuti bazibe kuboko kwangu alimwi amanguzu aangu, kuti bazibe kuti Jehova ndizina lyangu.
Chibi chaJuda chililembedwe achilembyo chabutale chili aandomo ya dayimondi. Chililembedwe aachilembelo chamyoyo yabo alimwi aameja aazipayililo zyabo.
Nikuba bana babo baliziyeede zipayililo zyabo amasamu aAsyela aakabikidwe kumbali lyamisamu yakali kukomena aajulu lyatulundu tulamfu.
Chilundu changu munyika iikwazeme, buvubi bwako azibikilo zyako zyoonse ndiyozipa mbuli chipo, aantomwe amasena aako malamfu, akaambo kachibi nchiwakachita kumasena woonse.
Uyosweekelwa lukono oolo ndundakakupa. Ndiyokwaaba kuli basinkondonyokwe kunyika eeyo njotazi pe, nkaambo wanamatizya mulilo mubukali bwangu, ooyo utakayake kwalyoonse.''
Jehova wati, '''Muntu uusyoma mubantu ulitukidwe, ulachita munguzu zyanyama yakwe pesi ulapilusya moyo wakwe kuzwa kuliJehova.
Nkaambo uyooba mbuli chiteyo chiniini chamuAlabba alimwi takoyobona chimwi chintu chibotu kachisika. Uyookkala mubusena bujisi mabwe munkanda, munyika iitazyali itakwe bantu bakkala mumo.
Pesi muntu uusyoma muliJehova ulilongezegelwe, nkaambo Jehova ngomutabilizi wakwe.

Nkaambo unoli mbuli musamu uubyalidwe kumbali lyamanzi, miyanda yawo iyotandabalila mukalonga. Tukoyoyowa kupya puumina niliyosika, nkaambo matu aawo alikamweemvwe lyoonse. Tukalikataazyi pe mumunyaka wachimpayuma, alimwi tuukoyoleka kuzyala muchelo.
Moyo ulijisi lweeno lupati kwiinda zintu zyoonse. Ulachiswa; ngwani uunga ulumvwisisisya?
Ndime Jehova ooyo uulingula kwiinda mumiyeeyo, uusunka moyo. Ndiyopa kuli wumwi awumwi muntu kwiindila munzila zyakwe, akwiindila munchito zyamichelo yakwe.

Kwale uukonkola majwi ngaakatania pe. Umwi ukonzya kuba muvubi mububi, pesi eelyo chibeela chachiindi  chamazuba aakwe chaakumana, oobo buvubi bwakwe buyomusiya, alimwi kumamanino uyooba chifubafuba.''
''Busena bwatempele yesu nchuuno chabulemu, chakasumpulwa kuzwa kumatalikilo.
Jehova mbulangilizi bwaIzilayeli. Boonse bakutakata ndiyobabika mubweeme; aabo bali munyika baboola kuzwa kulinduwe bayoolembwa munyika, nkaambo baleka Jehova, kasensa kamaanzi aabuumi.
Kondiponia, Jehovva, alimwi ndiyopon! Ndivune, alimwi ndiyovunwa. Nkaambo ulilwiimbo lwangu lwakutembawula.
Bona, balikuti kulindime, 'Lilikuli jwi lyaJehiva? Ngalize!'
Mbuli ndime, tensi ndakachija pe kuzwa kuba mweembeli uukutobela. Tensi ndakeemuzya buzuba bwalunyonyooko pe. Ulikwizi kwaamba kwangu kwakazwa mumulomo wangu. Kwakachitwa mubuliwo bwako.
Utandibedi chiyoosyo. Ulichiyubilo changu mubuzuba bwamapenzi.

Ikaka aabo basikundoongelezya ngabakawusigwe nsoni, pesi mebo nditawusigwi nsoni. Ngabayoosegwe, pesi mebo nditayowesegwi. Tumina buzuba bwantenda aata;la lyabo alimwi kobanyonyoona alunyonyooko lwiindulwidwe tubili.''
Jehova wakaamba eechi  kulindime: ''Koya alimwi ukiimikile kumulyango wabantu ooko baami baJuda nkubanjilila akuzwida, mpawo akumilyango yoonse yaJelusalemu.
Kabaambile kuti, 'Amumvwe jwi lyaJehova, nobaami baJuda alimwi moonse nimukkala muJelusalemu nimunjila kumilyango eeyi.
Jehova waamba eechi: ''Muchenjele nkaambo kabuumi bwanu alimwi mutakabwezi mukuli mubuzuba bwaSabata kukweeta kumilyango yaJelusalemu.
Mutakeeti mukuli kuzwa kung'anda mubuzuba bwaSabata. Mutachiti kufumbwa mulimu, pesi mukabambe izuba lyaSabata, mbuli mbundakalayilila basikale banu kuti bachite.'''
Tensi bandiswiilila na kundimvwa, pesi bayayumya mikosi yabo kuti batandimvwi na kuntambulalulayo lwangu.

Ziyochitika kuti na mwandiswiilila chakasimpe - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - akutayeta mukuli kumilyango yamunzi ooyu mubuzuba bwaSabata pesi anikuti mubambe buzuba bwaSabata kuliJehova akutachita mulimu mubuzuba oobo,

mpawo baami, bana babaami, alimwi abaabo bakkala aachuuno chabwaami bwaDeviti bayooza kumilyango yachisi munkalaki amabbiza, bo abazululi babo, baalumi baJuda abaabo bakkala muJelusalemu, alimwi muunzi ooyu uyokkalwa kwalyoonse.

Bayoosika kuzwa kuzisi zyaJuda alimwi akuzwa kuli zizyungulukide Jelusalemu, kuzwa kunyika yaBbenjamini amumakuti, kuzwa muzilundu amuNegevu, kabeeta zipo zyakutenta azipayizyo, zipo zyazilyo atununkilizyo, zipo zyakulumba kung'anda yaJehova.

Pesi kuti temwandiswiilizya - kukubamba zuba lyaSabata akutabweza mikuli milemu akutanjila milyango yaJelusalemu mubuzuba bwaSabata - mpawo ndiyoyasya mulilo mumilyango yawo, alimwi uyosyukuta zikwabilizyo zyaJelusalemu, alimwi tukoyozimwa pe.''
Ijwi lyakasika kuliJelemiya kuzwa kuliJehova, kaliti,
''Nyampuka uye kung'anda yamubumbi, nkaambo ndiyochita kuti ukamvwe jwi lyangu nkukooko.''
Aboobo ndakayinka kung'anda yamubumbi, alimwi bona! Mubumbi wakali kubeleka aavili lyamubumbi.
Pesi kalongo nkakali kubumba kuzwa kubulongo kakabija mujaanza lyamubumbi, aboobo wakabweedezya bulongo alimwi wabumba kambi kalongo, alimwi wakabumba kalongo aako kuba chintu cheebesi kumenso aakwe.
Mpawo ijwi lyaJehova lyakasika kulindime, kaliti,

''Nsikonzyi na kuti nchite mbuli ooyo mubumbi andinywe, nong'anda yaIzilayeli? - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova. Amubone! Mbuli bulongo mujaanza lyamubumbi, - mbubo mbumubede mujaanza lyangu, nong'anda yaIzilayeli.
Kuli chimwi chiindi ndilakonzya kwaamba chimwi aatala achisi na abwaami, kuti ndiyochigwisya aanze kuchizavuula, na kuchinyonyoona.
Pesi nan chisi eecho nchindakaambila makani aayo chasanduka kuzwa kububi bwacho, mpawo ndiyoyivuna kuzwa kuntenda nzindakabambide kweeta aatala anchicho.
Kuli chimwi chiindi ndakonzya kwaamba chintu aatala achisi na abwaami, kuti ndiyochiyaka na kuzikila.
Pesi na chachita bubi kumenso angu kwiinda mukutaswiilila jwi lyangu, mpawo ndiyoyimikizya bubotu oobo mbundakabambide kubachitla.

Aboobo lino, ambila bantu baJuda abaabo bakkede muJelusalemu alimwi waambe kuti, 'Jehova waamba eechi: Bona, ndaamba kubumba lunyonyooko aatala andinywe. Ndaamba kuchita mabambe aatalaandinywe. Amusanduke, awumwi kuzwa kunzila yakwe mbi, aboobo nzila zyako anchito zyako ziyokweetela bubotu.'
Pesi bayowaamba kuti, ' Eezi tazibeleki. Tuyochita mbuli mumabambe esu.Awumwi wesu uyochita eecho chiyandwa amoyo wakwe mubi, uutaswiilili nzyuuyanda.'
Nkinkaako Jehova waamba eechi, 'Buzya manyika kuti ngwani utanaamvwa chintu chili mbuli cheechi? Nakalindu waIzilayeli wakachita nchito iiyoosya.
Sa lume muLebbanoni luyosiya tulundu tamabwe kumabazu aato? Sena tulonga twamuzilundu tuzwa kule twakamwayigwa, ooto tulonga tutontola?
Nikuba boobo bantu bangu bandiluba. Bakapa zipo kuzitoombe zitagwasyi pe alimwi zyakachitwa kuba zilebyo munzila zyabo; bakasiya nzila zyabo zyachiindi beenda munzila niini.
Nyika yabo iyooba chiyoosyo, chintu chiyoosya kapati. Woonse muntu wiinda mulinjiyo uyotilimuka alimwi akateketesye mutwe wakwe.
Ndiyobamwaya kunembo lyabasinkondonyina mbuli luuwo lwaKujwe. Ndiyobafutatila, peepe busyu bwangu, mubuzuba bwalunyonyooko lwabo.'''

Aboobo bantu bakati, ''Muboole, atwambuule aatala aJelemiya, mbukunga mulawu tukoyofwidilila pe  kubapayizi nikuba luchenjezyo luzwa kubaalumi basongo naaba majwi kuzwa kuubasinsimi. Muboole, atumulwane amajwi eesu alimwi tatukaswiilili limbi kumajwi ngayowamba.''
Swiilila kulindime, Jehova, alimwi uswiilile kujwi lyabasinkondoma.

Sena lunyonyooko luzwa kulimbabo lukabe mpindu yangu na nchobeni yakuba mubotu kulimbabo? Nkaambo bakandisyida dindi. Koyeeya mbundakiima kunembo lyako nkewamba aatala abukkale bwabo, kuchita bukali bwako kuti buzwe kulimbabo.

Nkinkaako pa bana babo kunzala mpati, alimwi ukabape kujaanza lyabaabo babelesya panga.Aboobo leka banakazi babo bafwidwe babe bamukabafu, alimwi baalumi babo bajayigwe, baalumi babo baniini bakajayigwe apanga munkondo.

Muleke koompolola kwakupenzegwa kukamvwigwe kuzwa mumaanda aabo, mbuli mboyeta basikubajata chakufwambaana aatala ambabo. Nkaambo bakasya dindi lyakundijatya aandilyo alimwi basisa tukole twakujata mawulu angu.

Pesi webo, Jehova, ulaazi mabambe aabo woonse aatala andime aakundijaya. Utalekeleli milandu azibi zyabo. Utazimaazyi zibi zyabo kuzwa kukinduwe. Pesi, ngabakazundwe kunembo lyako. Balwane muchiindi chabukali bwako.
Jehova wakaamba eechi, ''Mwiinke alimwi mukawule zibikilo zyazilongo kumubumbi nkamuli aabazuluzi babantu abapayizi.
Mpawo mwiinke kuMumpata wa Bbeni Hinoni kuMulyango waZilongo Zifwide, mpawo ooko mukaambe majwi ngesikamwaambile.

Mukatedi, 'Mumvwe jwi lyaJeova, nobami baJuda animukkala muJelusalemu! Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli waamba eechi, ''Bona, ndaamba kweeta lunyonyooko aabusena oobu, alimwi matwi aaboonse bamvwa eechi ayooyowa.

Ndiyochita eechi nkaambo bakandikaka akubisizya busena oobu. Mubusena oobu balapayilila kulibaleza bambi mbibakatezi pe. Bo abasikale babo, alimwi abaami baJuda bazuzya busena oobu abulowa butakwe mulandu pe.
Bayaka masena mapati aaBbaala kuti bawumpe bana babo balombe mumulilo mbuli zipayizyo zyakutenta - eecho nchindakatabalayilila pe na kwaamba, nikuba kuyeeya mumizeezo yangu pe.
Nkinkaako, bona, mazuba ayobuza - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - eelyo busena oobu nibutakachiyoyitwi limbi kuti Tofeti, Mumpata waBbeni Hinoni, nkaambo unoli wafa Mumpata wakuJayila.

Mubusena oobu ndiyochita mabambe aJuda aJelusalemu aabuyo. Ndiyobachita kuti bakajayigwe apanga kunembo lyabasinkondonyina akuluboko lwabaabo bayanduula mawumi aabo. Mpawo ndiyopa mitunta yabo mbuli chakulya kutuyuni twamujulu abanyama bamusokwe baansi.
Mpawo ndiyochita muunzi ooyu tongo chintu chiyoosya, nkaambo woonse wiinda mpawo uyoyosegwa akumuyasa kazyeendelana abulwazi boonse.
Ndiyoachita kuti bakalye nyama zyabana babo balombe abasimbi; awumwi muntu uyoolya nyama yasimabambanwa wakwe mukuyowa amukulila kweetwa aalimbabo abasinkondonyina abaabo bayanduula mawumi aabo.'''
Mpawo uyopwaya chibikilo chachilongo kumenso aabaalumi bakeenda aanduwe.

Uyowamba kuti kulimbabo, 'Jehova wamakamu waamba eechi: Ndiyochita chintu eechi chikozyenie kubantu aaba akuchisi eechi - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - mbuli Jelemiya mbwakapyachula chibikilo chabulongo kuchitila kuti chitakabumbululwi lubo pe. Bantu bayovwika bantu bafwide muTofeti kusikila kukabulike busena busyeede bwakuvwikia bafu.
Eechi nchincho nchindiyochita kubusena oobu akulibaabo bakkala mulimbubo nindiyochita chisi eechi mbuli Tofeti - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova -

aboobo nga'nda zyaJelusalemu alimwi azyabaami baJuda ziyooba mbuli Tofeti - zyoonse nga'anda zili aatululi ooko basizibi nkubakombela nyenyeezi zyakujulu alimwi nkubatila zipo zyakunywa kulibamwi baleza.'''
Mpawo Jelemiya wakeenda kuzwa kuTofeti, ooko Jehova nkwakamutuma kuti akasinsime. Wakiimikila mulubuwa lwang'anda yaJehova alimwi wakati kubantu boonse,

''Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi, 'Bona, ndaamba kweeta lunyonyooko loonse ndundakaamba aatala achisi eechi amadolopo aawo woonse, mbuli kuti bakayumya nsingo zyabo alimwi tebakaswiilila kumajwi aangu pe.'''
Pasuli mwana mulombe waIma mupayizi - wakali muzululi mupati - wakamvwa Jelemiya kali kusinsima majwi aaya kunembo lyang'anda yaJehova.
Aboobo Pasuli wakawuma Jelemiya musinsimi alimwi wakamubika mung'anda zyachisubulo eezyo zyakali aaMulyango Waajulu waBbenjamini mung'anda yaJehova.
Zyakachitika muzuba litobela aawo Pasuli nakeeta Jelemiya kuzwa mung'anda zyachisubulo. Mpawo Jelemiya wakaamba kulinguwe wati, ''Jehova taayita zina lyako pe kuti Pasuli, pesi waba Mega Misabbibbi.

Nkaambo Jehova waamba eezi, 'Bona, ndiyokuchita kuti ukabe chintu chiyoogambya, iwe abayandwi bako boonse, nkaambo bayowisigwa epanga lyabasinkondonyina alimwi menso aanu ayozibona. Ndiyopedekezya Juda woonse mujaanza lyaMwami waBbabbiloni. Uyobachita bakabe bazike muBbabbiloni nikuba kubalwana epanga.

Ndiyomupa buvubi boonse bwachisi eechi abuvubi bwacho boonse, azintu zyacho zyoonse zibotu zyoonse abuvubi boonse bwabaami baJuda. Ndiyozibika zyoonse zintu eezi munjaanza lyabasinkondonyokwe, alimwi bayobamaninsya. Bayobatola akubeeta kuBbabbiloni.
Pesi webo, Pasuli, aboonse bakkala mung'anda yako muyooba mubuzike. Muzooya kuBbabbiloni akuyoofwa nkukooko. Iwe aboonse bayandwi bako aabo mbuwakasinsima zintu zyakubeja muyovwikwa nkukooko.'''
''Jehova, iwe wakandeena, alimwi ndakeenwa. Ulimusimu kwiinda ndime, alimwi wakandizunda. Ndakaba nsesya zuba lyoonse; woonse muntuwakandiniaka.
Nkaambo kufumbwa aawo mbundambuula, ndakayita alimwi ndakoompolola, 'Lupyopyongano alunyonyooko.' Mpawo jwi lyaJehova lyakandibeda chisesyo aluniako mazuba woonse.

Na ndaamba kuti, 'Nsikoyoyeeya limbi aatala aJehova. Nsikoyowambuula limbi muzina lyakwe.' Mpawo kunooli mbuli mulilo mumoyo wangu, uupatikidwe aakati kamafuwa aangu. Aboobo ngandeezya kulilondola pesi nsikonzyi pe.

Ndakamvwa ntwiintwi ziyoosya kuzwa kubantu biingi bazyungulukide. 'Mang'ala! Tweelede kwiimang'ala!' Aabo bali aafwiifwi andime balangilila kuti babone na ndilawa. 'Ateni uleeneke. Na kakuki boobo, tulakonzya kumuzunda alimwi tukamubweedezezye.'
Pesi Jehova uli mbuli silumamba wamanguzu, aboobo aabo bandilwana bayoddalika. Tabakoyondizunda pe. Bayowusa kapati, nkaambo tabakoyozwidilila pe. Bayooba akuwusa kutamani; tachikoyolubwa pe.
Pesi Jehova wamakamu ulalingulula baluleme akubona miyeeyo amoyo. Ngandibone kubweedezezya kwako aalimbabo nkaambo ndapedekezya zyakuchita kulinduwe.
Amwwimbile Jehova! Amutembawule Jehova! Nkaambo wavuna mawuumi aabaabo badyaamizigilwe kuzwa kujaanza lyabasimuchita zibi.
Amuleke zuba ndindakazyalwa litukwe. Mutaleki zuba eelyo baama nebakandizyala kuti lilongezegwe.
Amuleke mwaalumi ooyo wakazibisya taata atukwe, ooy wakaamba kuti, 'Mwana mulombw wazyalwa kulinduwe,' kweetelezya lukondo lupati.
Ooyo mwaalumi ngakabe mbuli myuunzi eeyo Jehova njaakasowa akutaaba aaluzyalo anjiyo. Ngamvwe kulila kwalugwasyo kubuchedo, kulila kwankondo aakalanga bwaaseme,
nkaambo takandijaya pe mwida, kuchita baama kuba kabanda kangu, ida lyakamitwa kwalyoonse.
Nkaambonzi nindakazwa mwida kuzoobona mapenzi amachise, kuzuzya mazuba aangu akuusa?''
Ijwi lyakasika kuliJelemiya kuzwa kuliJehova aawo mwami Zedekkiya nakatuma Pasuli ,wana mulombe waMalakija aZefaniya mwana mulombe waManase mupayizi kulinguwe, alimwim bakati,

''Kumbila kulayililwa kuzwa kuliJehova kayiminina ndiswe, nkaambo Nebbukkadineza mwami waBbabbiloni ulikuchita nkondo aali ndiswe.Amwi Jehova ulachita chigambyo kulindiswe, mbuli kuchiindi chayinda, akumuchita kuti atuleke.''
Aboobo Jelemiya wakati kulimbabo, ''Mboobu mbumweelede kumwaambila Zedekkiya,

'Jehova, Leza waIzilayeli waamba eechi: Bona, ndaamba kubweedezya zibelesyo zankondo zili mumaboko aako, eezyo nzolikulwanisya aazyo mwami waBbabbiloni abaKkaludiyeni balimkukujalila mukati kuzwa aanze kwamalambo! Nkaambo ndiyobabungania aakati kamuunzi ooyu.
Mpawo mebo lwangu ndiyokulwana akuboko kunyampwidwe achilwanio chili eenguzu, alimwi alujayo, bukali akunyema kupati.
Nkaambo ndiyolwana aabo bakkala mumuunzi ooyu, bantu abanyama. Bayoofwa mumalwazi malemu.

Musule lyazeezi - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - Zedekkiya mwami waJuda, balanda bakwe, akufumbwa uutakasyaale mumuunzi ooyumusule lyadwazi, panga, anzala mpati, ndiyobapedekezya boonse mujaanza lyaNebbukkadineza mwami wakuBbabbiloni, alimwi mujaanza lyabasinkondonyina, amujaanza lyabaabo bayanduula buumi bwabo. Mpawo uyoobajaya ebbazu lyepanga. Takoyobafwida nsonim pe, kubalekelela na kubafwida luzyalo.'
Mpawo kubantu aaba weelede kwaamba kuti, 'Jehova waamba eechi: Mubone, ndaamba kubika nzila yabuumi anzila yalufu kunembo lyanu.

Kufumbwa muntu uukkala mumuunzi ooyu uyoofwa apanga, anzala mpati, alimwi adwazi; pesi kufumbwa muntu uzwa aanze akuwa kafugama amazwi aakwe kunembo lyabaKkaludiyeni aabo bajalila mukati kumulwana uyoopona. Uyofutuka abuumi bwakwe.
Nkaambo ndabika busyu bwangu kukulwana muunzi ooyu kuchitila kuti ndeete lunyonyoono peepe kweeta bubotu - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.Chapegwa mujaanza lyamwami waBbabbiloni alimwi uyochitenta.
Aatala ang'anda yamwami wakuJuda, swiilila jwi lyaJehova.

Nong'anda yaDeviti,Jehova wati, 'Amweete kululama chifumofumo. Mukavune ooyo wakabbidwa akuboko kwamudyaamizi, kakutali boobo bukali bwangu buyoyinka mbuli mulilo akuyotenta, alimwi takwe muntu utakawuzime pe, nkaambo kanchito zyanu mbi.

Bona, nookkala mumumpata! Ndili kukulwana, nobbwe lyentandabale - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - ndilikulwana kufumbwa muntu waamba kuti, ''Ngwani uutaze aansi kuzotulwana?'' na ''Ngwani uutazonjile mumaanda eesu?''
Ndatuma muchelo wanchito zyanu kuti uzomulwane - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - alimwi ndiyoyasya mulilo muzisakasaka, alimwi uyoosyukuta zyoonse zyuuzyungulukide.''
Nzezi Jehova nzyaawamba, ''Kunukila kung'anda ya Mwaami wa Jucda akuyolwambilizya nkuko eeli ijwi.
Uteedi, ''Mwami  waJuda, iwe nookkede achuuno chaDeviti chabwaami, ababelesi bako abantu bako banjilila amilyango eeyi.

Nchechi chilikwaambwa aJehova, ''Amuchite chakweelanisya achabululami , alimwi uvune akwakali wanyangwa naa kwiimwa zimweelede kuzwa kuluboko lwamudyaamizi.Mutajati bubi kulila muzwakule,  muchaala naa mukamufu mugundu lyenu. Mutachiti lupyopyongano nikuba kutila bulowa butakwe mulandu mubusena oobu.
Nkambo naa mwachita chakusinizya eezi zintu, baami bakkala aachunu chaDevidi chabwaami banoonjila milyango yang'anda  eeyi kabagwdw nkalaki amabbiza, lwakwe mwaami, babelesi abant bakwe!
Pesi naa waleka kswilizya majwi aaya ngindaambilizya, nkaambo nchaambilizyo chaJehova, aboobo eeyi ng'anda yabwaami iyooba tongo.''

Nkambo nzeezi Jehova nzyaawamba aatala yangánda yamwaami waJuda, ''Ukozyeniye aaGiliyadi naa akatooma kachilundu chaLebbanoni kulindime. Nikuba boobo ndizokuchita chiimpayuma, uzooba myuunzi itakwe bakkala pe.
Nkambo ndakambila basikunyonyona kuti bakulwane. Baalumi bajisi zilwanisyo bazosuntula misamu yako yasidala ijisi bweebesei bwiindilide akuyiwaalila mumulilo.
Eelyo bantu bazoyinda kumbali amuunzi ooyu. Umiwi awumwi uzoti kuli umbi, ''Ani nkaambonzi Jehova naachita muliyesu nzila kumuunzi mupati ooyu?''
Eelyo umwi uzoosandula kati kati, ''Nkaambo  bakachija chizuminano chaJehova Leza wako akuyookotamina akukomba bambi baLeza.''
Utamulili naa kumulosezya misozi wafwa pesi lila loko ooyo wamba kubwezwa nkambo tachizobooli limbi pe naa kuzomubona lubo busena bwakulimbabo.'
Nkamo nzeezi nzyawamba Jehova aatala aJewawazi mwana waJosiya mwami waJuda, wakali waba mwaami mubesena bwawisi Josiya,' wena kuzwa mubusena oobono nkabela tachiyobooli limbi.
Uyoofwida kumbi nkubamutola, anyika iino tachizoyiboni limbi pe.'
Mawee kuliyooyo uutayaki ngánda yakwe mubululami, amaanda amujulu aakwe mukweelanisya, uubelesya simayakilane wakwe chabuyo nkabela nkatamufozyi;
waamba, kuti, 'ndiyooliyakila ng'anda mpati iijisi twaanda twaanda twamujulu tukwazamukide. Aboobo wiipangila mpulunguzyo mpati, akwiiyala aamatanda aamusidali mpawo wayizilulula amulende uusalala.
''Eezi nzizikuchita kuti ube mwaami ulikabotu na, kuliyandila matanda amusidali? Ani wuso taakali kulya akunywa na, ooku nkuchita chakweelanisya achabululami? Mpawo zintu zyakamwendela kabotu.
Wakabeteka kakwabilila bachete ababula. Kwakabota. Teensi nzizyaamba kundizida na? Ooku nkwaamba kwaJwhova.
Pesi taakwe chijanika pe mumeso amumoyo wako kunze kwakulikaataazya aatala akulijanina mpindu anzila zyabubbiningizi akutila bulowa bwabantu batakwe milandu kudyamizya akunyoonyona bamwi.

Aboobo mbuboobu mbwawamba Jehova aatala aJehhowakkimu mwana waJosiya mwaami waJuda; Tabakozomulila pe kabati 'Mawe munyaandumi!' naa 'Mawe muchizi!' Tabakozomulila pe kabati, Mawe, simalelo!'naa 'Mawe, noolemekwa!'
Uzosowegwa chadonki, kukuluntwa akuyoosowegwa kunze kwamiyango yaJelusalema.
Tanta zilundu zya Lebbanoni woompolole. Nyampula ijwi lyako mbuli Bbasyani. Wompolola kuzwida kuzilundu zyaAbalimu nkaambo boonse benzinyokwe bayonyonyoonwa.
Ndakaambula ayebo nkochikwabilidwe pesi wakati tokooswilizya pe. Nchechiimbo  chako kuzwida kubukubusi bwako, wakaka kuswilizya ijwi lyangu.
Luuwo luyoopupulula akubingila kule beendelezi , alimwi bayooyinka mubuzike. Eelyo uyoowusigwa nsoni chobeni akaambo kazichito zyako  zibi.
Inywe nimukkala 'muLebbanoni' nimuyakide zizumbo mumaanda ayakidwe amatanda amusidali, mbomutazoowumbuumbwe aawo machise aakutumbuka aamusikila machise aayelene aamwanakazi ulikutumbuka!''
''nkechipona - mbwawamba Jehova - nekuba kuti Johhachini, mwana Johhakkimu mwaami waJuda kali wali nweenwe kukuboko kwangu kwalulyo, ndalikuzookuzavula aakale.
Nkaambo ndakupedekezya kuluboko lwabaabo bavwima buumi bwako, mboyowa akuluboko lwaNebbukkadineza mwaami waBBabbiloni awabaKkaludiya.
Ndiyokuwaalila kuliimbi nyika aantoomwe abanyoko bakakutumbuka, kunyika nkuwatakazyalilwa pe. Nkuko nkotakafwide.
Taakwe nibachizoboola limbi kunyika njibapeekezya kzoboola kulinjiyo.
Eechi chaba chibikilo chalangilwaansi akupwachuulwa na? Ooyu mwaalumi Johhachini chaba chilongo chitachiyandikani nikuba kuliini na? Nkamboonzi nibamusowa alunyungu lwakwe kuya kunyika njibatazi pe?
Nyika, Nyika, Nyika! Komvwa ijwi lyaJehova!

Jehova waamba boobu, Lemba aatala ayooyo mwaalumi Johhachini: Bayomumanina bana. Takoyoozwidilila pe mumazuba aakwe nkabela taakwe pe walunyungu lwakwe utazozwidilile nikuba kuzokkala aachuuno chabwaami chaDevidi akweendelezya chisi chaJuda.'''
Maawe kubeembeli aabo banyonyoona akumwaya mbelele zyamachezezyo aangu - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.''

Nkinkaako Jehova, Leza waIzilayeli waamba eechi aatala abeembeli balikweembela bantu bakwe, ''Mwakamwaya butanga bwangu akububingila kule.Temwakabubamba pe. Aboobo ndaamba kumupa chisubulo akaambo kabubi mbumwakachita - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Mebo lwangu ndiyobungania zyakasyaala zyabutanga bwangu kuzwa kumanyika ooko nkundakazibingilide, alimwi ndiyoziboozya kumachelelo, nkuziyoozyala michelo akuvula.
Mpawo ndiyobusya beembeli aalinzizyo alimwi bayozyembela kuchitila kuti zitakayoosegwi limbi na kumwayisigwa. Takwe yazyo itakasweeke pe- ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Bona, mazuba alasika - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - aawo nensikabusizye Devit mutabi wabaluleme. Uyoyendelezya mbuli mwami; uyoochita chabusongo akuchita bululami abusalali munyika.
Mumazuba aakwe Juda uyoovunwa, alimwi Izilayeli uyoopona mulukwabililo. Mpawo eeli ndezina ndyayoyitwa: Jehova mbululami bwesu.
Nkinkaako bona, mazuba alasika - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - nibatakwe kuyowamba limbi kuti, 'Mbuli Jehova mbapona, ooyo wakagwisya bantu baIzilayeli kuzwa munyika yaIjipiti.'

Pesi bayowamba kuti, 'Mbuli Jehova mbapona, wakagwisya akuzulwida kubweeda kwalunyungu lwang'anda yaIzilayeli kuzwa kulubazu lwakuNyika zyoonse ooko nkubakabingilildwe.' Mpawo bayopona kunyika yabo abalike.''
Aatala abasinsimi, moyo wangu ulityokede mukati, alimwi mafuwa angu woonse alateketa. Ndaba mbuli muntu uukoledwe, muntu wakazundwa wayini, nkaambo kaJehova amajwi akwe aasalala.
Nkaambo nyika ilizwide abasimamambe. Akaambo kazeezi nyika yayuma. Myuunda yabwizu munkanda yayuma. Nzila zyabasinsimi aaba nzyabubi; nguzu zyabo tazili kubeesegwa munzila ilinjenjiyo pe.
Nkaambo boonse basinsimi abapayizi bakasofwazigwa. Ndakajana bubi bwako mung'anda yangu! - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova -
nkinkaako nzila yabo iyooba mbuli busena butyezemuka mumudima. Bayotontolwa aansi. Bayowida mulinjiyo. Nkaambo ndiyoleta ntenda aalimbabo mumunyaka wachisubulo chabo - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Nkaambo ndakabona basisnsimi muSamaliya nkabachita zitalomene pe: Bakali kusinsima aBbaala akuleesya bantu bangu baIzilayeli.

Aakati kabasinsimi muJelusalemu ndakabona zintu ziyoosya: Balachita mamambe alimwi baleenda mulweeno. Balayumya maanza aabasimuchita zibi; takwe naba womwe uzwa kukuchita zibi zyakwe. Boonse baba mbuli Sodomu kulindime alimwi aabo bakkala oomo mbuli Gomola!''

Nkinkaako Jehova wamakamu waamba eechi aatala abasinsimi, ''Langa, ndaamba kubachita kuti balye masenda akunywa maanzi aali aamusamu uujaya, nkaambo kusofwaala kweendelela kuzwa kubasinsimi baJelusalemu kusika kunyika yoonse.''
Jehova wamakamu waamba eechi, ''Mutaswiilili kumajwi aabasinsimi basinisima kulindinywe. Bakamweena! Balikwaambilizya zilengano zizwa mumiyeeyo yabo beni, peepe kuzwa kumulomo waJehova.
Balikwaamba lyoonse kulibaabo batandipi bulemu, 'Jehova waamba kuti kuyooba luumuno lwanu.' Nkaambo woonse uyobweenda mukunduuzya kwamoyo wakwe waamba kuti, 'Ntenda tikoyosika pe aalindinywe.'
Pesi wakiimvwi mumbungano yaJehova? Ngwani uubona alimwi uumvwa jwi lyakwe? Ngwani uuswiilila jwi lyakwe akulimvwa?
Bona, kuli mvula yaguwo iyobuzwa kuliJehova! Bukali bwakwe bulikuzwa, anchinsyamoyo ilikuungawunga. Ilikuungawunga aatala lyamitwe yabasizibi.
Kunyema kwaJehova takukyobweeda kusikila kukachite aluleta bube bwamakanze aamoyo wakwe. Mumazuba aamamanino, muyochimvwisisisya.
Tendakabatuma pe basinsimi aaba. Bakayubunuka biyo. Tendakaamba chintu kulimbabo, pesi bachiyobusinsima.
Nkaambo nsinga bakayima mumbungano yamuswangano wangu, balikunochita kuti bantu bangu bamvwe jwi lyangu; balikunochita kuti bantu bangu basanduke kuzwa kumajwi aabo mabi akunchito zyabo zinyongene.
Sena tensi ndime Leza na alike uuli afwiifwi - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - alimwi Leza uutali kule?
Sena umwi nga ulayuba mubusena busitikide bwakuti nsikonzyi pe kumubona? - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - alimwi tandizuzyi julu anyika na? - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Ndamvwa eecho nchibalikwaamba basinsimi, aabo bakalikusinsima lweeno muzina lyangu. Bakaamba kuti, 'Ndakalota! Ndakalota!'
Kuyoosika lili eezi kazilikuchitika, basinsimi basinsima mabejo kuzwa mumyoyo yabo?
Balikubamba kuti balubye bantu bangu izina lyangu amaloto aayo ngibalikwaamba, umwi awumwimkulisimabambanwa wakwe, mbubo bmuli basikale babo mbubakaluba zina lyangu mukuyandisya zina lyaBbaala.
Musinsimi uulota, ngaambe loto. Pesi ooyo ngundaambila chintu mumuleke abandike jwi lyangu chamasimpe. Ani busweezyo bulachitaanzi kuzilyo? - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova -
Sena jwi lyangu talili mbuli mulilo na? - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - alimwi mbuli nsando iipwaya bbwe kuba zimpanzi?
Aboobo bona, ndilakazyania abasinsimi - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - kufumbwa umwi uuba majwi kuzwa kuli umwi muntu akwaamba kuti azwa kulindime.
Bona, ndilalwisyania abasinsimi - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - babelesya ndimi zyabo kusinsima zyaambo.

Bona, ndilalwisyania abasinsimi balota zyalweeno - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - mpawo basikwawamba munzila eeyi iisowa bantu bangu alweeno akulidunda. Ndilalwisyania ambabo nkaambo tendakabatuma pe nikuba kubalayilila. Aboobo nchobeni takwe nibatakabagwasye pe bantu aaba - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Eelyo bantu aaba, na musinsimi, na mupayizi nayomubuzya kuti, 'Nguuli mukuli waJehova?' muyowamba kuti kulimbabo, 'Nduwe mukuli, alimwi ndiyokusowela aanze' - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Mbuli basinsimi, bapayizi abantu balikwaamba kuti, 'Ooyu mukuli waJehova' ndiyomupa chisubulo muntu ooyo ang'anda yakwe.
Mwiinkilila aanembo kwaamba, umwi awumwi muntu kuli simabambanwa wakwe alimwi umwi awumwi muntu kumukulana wakwe, 'Jehova wasandula kutyeni? alimwi 'Jehova walayililaanzi?'
Pesi tamweelede kwambuula limbi aatala a 'mukuli waJehova,' nkaambo mukuli ndijwi lyawumwi awumwi mwaalumi, alimwi mwakasandula majwi aaLeza muumi, Jehova wamakamu, Leza wesu.
Ncheechi nchutakaambe kumusinsimi, 'Ninsandulo nzi Jehova njaakupa?' na 'Watyeni Jehova?'

Pesi na mwaamba kuti, 'Mukuli waJehova,' eechi nchicho nchaamba chaJehova: 'Akaambo kakuti mwaamba majwi aaya, 'Mukuli waJehova,' eelyo nindakamutuma, kamuti, 'Tamukoyowamba kuti, ''Mukuli waJehova,'''
nkinkaako, amubone, ndaamba kubweza akukusowa kuzwa kulindime, aantomwe amuunzi ngundakakupa abasikale bako.
Mpawo ndiyobika bweeme butamani achitusi aalinduwe chitakwe nichiyoolubwa pe.'''

Jehova wakanditondeezya chimwi chintu. Bona, zizuma zyobile zyankuyu zyakabikwa kunembo lyang'anda yaJehova. (Chilengano eechi chakachitika musule lyaNebbukkadineza ,mwami waBbabbiloni, kali wabweza akutola mubuzike Jewoyakki mwana mulombe waJewoyakkimu, mwana mulombe waJuda, basilutwe baJuda, babezi abafuzi bazwa muJelusalemu akubaboozya muBbabbiloni.)
Nkuyu zyakali muchizuma chomwe zyakali mbotu loko, mbuli nkuyu ntaanzi kubizwa, pesi nkuyu zyalkali muchizuma chimwi zyakali mbi loko aboobo tezyakali kulyika pe.
Jehova wakati kulindime, ''Ulikubonaanzi, Jelemiya?'' Ndakati, ''Ninkuyu. Nkuyu mbotu loko ankuyu mbi loko tazyiliki pe.''
Mpawo jwi lyaJehova  lyakaza kulindime, kaliti,
''Jehova, Leza waIzilayeli waamba eechi: Njoolanga buzike bwaJuda nkaambo nimpindu yabo, mbubonya mbuli eezyo nkuyu mbotu, bazike aabo mbindakatuma kuzwa kubusena oobo kusika kunyika yaKkalidiyo.
Njoobika menso angu kuli mbabo nkaambo mbabotu akubalondola munyika eeyi. Ndiyobayaka akutabanyonyoona pe. Ndiyobabyala alimwi nsikoyobanonkola pe.
Mpawo ndiyobapa moyo wakuziba ndime, nkaambo ndime Jehova. Bayooba bantu bangu ambebo ndiyooba Leza wabo, aboobo bayoboola kulindime amyoyo yabo yoonse.

Pesi mbuli nkuyu mbi, eezyo mbi loko kukuzilya - eechi nchenchicho nchaamba Jehova - ndiyochita muli yeeyi nzila aZedekkiya, mwami waJuda, abasilutwe bakwe, aboonse bamuJelusalemu aabo bakasyaala munyika eeyi na bakayinka kuyokkala munyika yaIjipiti.
Ndiyobachita kuba chintu chiyoosya, lunyonyooko, kubusyu bwamaami woonse ali aanyika, kuusigwa akuba chiiyo chatusimpi, kusampawulwa akutukwa mumasena woonse nkwesikabatandile.
Ndiyotuma panga, nzala amalwazi aakati kabo, mane lumwi bakanyonyooke kuzwa kunyika eeyo njindakabapa abamawisi aabo.''

Eeli ndijwi lyakasika kuliJelemiya aatala abantu boonse baJuda. Lyakasika mumunyaka wane waJowakkimu mwana mulombe waJosaya, Mwami waJuda. Nguwakali munyaka mutaanzi waNebbukkadineza, Mwami waBbabbiloni.
Jelemiya musinsimi wakoompolola eezi kubantu bamuJuda aboonse bakkala muJelusalemu.

Wakati, ''Kwaminyaka iili makkumi obilwe ayitatu, kuzwa mumunyaka wakkumi ayitatu yaJosaya mwana mulombe waAmoni, Mwami waJuda, kuyosika buzuba obuno, jwi lyaJehova lyakali kusika kulindime alimwi ndakalyaamba twiingi kulinduwe, pesi tewakaswiilila pe.
Jehova wakatuma b oonse balanda bakwe basinsimi twiingi loko, pesi takwe niwakaswiilila pe na kuchenjeka kutwi kuti umvwe.

Basinsimi aaba bakati, 'Umwi awumwi mwaalumi ngasanduke kusiya nzila zyakwe zyabubi akukunyongana kwanchito zyakwe akubweeda kunyika Jehova njaakapa muzyiindi kuli basikale banu akulindinywe, mbuli chipo chalyoonse.
Aboobo mutatobeli bambi baleza akubakomba nikuba kubakotamina, alimwi mutamunyemyi amilimu yamaboko anu kuti atamunyonyooni.'
Pesi temwakandiswiilila pe - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - aboobo mwandimyemya amilimu yamaboko anu kukukunyonyoona.
Aboobo Jehova wamakamu waamba eechi, 'Akaambo kakuti temwakaswiilila majwi aangu,

amubone, ndaamba kutuma malayilile aakubungika bantu boonse bakuNyika - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - aNebbukkadineza mulanda wangu, Mwami waBbabbiloni, akubeeta kuti balwisye nyika eeyi abantu bakkala mulinjiyo, akubalwisyania azisi zyoonse zimuzyungulukide. Nkaambo ndiyobasala akubabika kumbali kuti bakanyonyoonwe. Ndiyobasandula bakabe chiyoosyo, kuba chintu chakukonkomoka akuba chisampawuzi chitamani.
Ndiyobika mamanino kumusabilo wakusekelela akubotelwa, musabilo wasikukwata asikukwatwa, kuvuuma kwamaziyo amumuni walampi.
Mpawo yoonse nyika eeyi oiyooba chisampawulo achiyoosyo alimwi aaya manyika ayobelekela Mwami waBbabbiloni kwaminyaka iii makkumi musanu aabili.

Mpawo kuyochitika musule lyaminyaka iili makkumi musanu aabili kuti ndiyosubula Mwami waBbabbiloni achisi eecho, nyika ya baKkaludiya - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - nkaambo kazibi zyabo akuchita matongo aatagoli.
Mpawo ndiyobweza woonse majwi aangu aalangene aambabo ngindakaamba , azyoonse zilembedwe mubbuku eeli zyakasinismwa aJelemiya aatala azisi zyoonse.
Nkaambo alubo manyika miingi miingi abaami biingi bayochita bazike kuzwa kumanyika aaya. Ndiyobabwedezezya akaambo kanchito zyabo amilimu yamaanza aabo.'''
Nkaambo Jehova, Leza waIzilayeli, wakaamba eechi kulindime, ''Bweza nkomeki yabukali yawayini kuzwa mujaanza lyangu akuchita manyika woonse ngenjokutuma kulingawo kuti akanywe.
Nkaambo bayoonywa alimwi bayodadalika akweema chakupenga kunembo lyapanga ndelikutuma aakati kabo.''
Aboobo ndakabweza nkomeki kuzwa mujaanza lyaJehova, alimwi ndakachita kuti manyika aayo Jehova ngakandituma kulingawo anywe:
Jelusalemu, madolopo aaJuda, baami abasilutwe - kwaachita kuti abe matongo akuba chintu chiyoosya, chisesemyo chakutuka, mbuli mbabede sunu obuno.
Zimwi zisi azilazyo zyakayinywa. Falo Mwami waIjipiti, bazike bakwe abasilutwe abantu bakwe;
boonse bantu bamikowa iivwelengene abaami boonse banyika yaUzi; boonse baami banyika yaFilisitiya - Asyikeloni, Gaza, Ekkiloni, abakasyaala baAsyidodi;
Idomu aMowabbu abantu baAmoni.
Baami baTaya aSidoni, baami bamunkomwe kuli lumwi lubazu lwalwizi,
Dedani, Tema, aBuzi aantomwe aboonse balinyoola masusu mumbali lyamitwe yabo, abalabo bakayinywa.
Boonse baami baAlabbiya abaami bamikowa iivweleene bakkala munkanda;
boonse baami baZimuli, Elamu, abaami boonse baMedisi;

boonse baami bakuNyika, bali afwiifwi abali kule - umwi awumwi amukulana wakwe akufumbwa bwaami boonse bwamunyika buli munsi aazuba, boonse bakiinywa nkomeki yakazwa mujaanza lyaJehova. Kumamanino, Mwami waBbabbiloni uyoonywa kuzwa kunkomeki eeyo.

Jehova wakati kulindime, ''Lino waambe kuti kulimbabo, 'Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi: Munywe mukolwe, mpawo muluke, muwide aansi, mutabuki kunembo lyapanga ndyendikutuma aakati kanu.'
Mpawo chiyochitika kuti bakakake kunywa kuzwa munkomeki iili mujaanza lyako, uyooti kulimbabo, 'Jehova wamakamu waamba echi: 'Nchobeni mweelede kunywa kuzwa kulinjiyo.

Nkaambo bona, ndaamba kweeta lunyonyooko aatala adolopo eelyo lyiitwa muzina lyangu, alimwi nywebo nobeni muyofutuka na kuchisubulo eecho? Tamukoyofutula, nkaambo ndikwiita panga lyakulwisya boonse bakkala munyika eeyi! - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova wamakamu.'

Weelede kusinsima zintu eezi aatala ambabo, akwaamba kut kulimbabo, 'Jehova uyovuluma kuzwa kumajulu alimwi uyowompolola ajwi lyakwe kuzwa kuchikalilo chakwe chisalala, uyovuluma changuzu aatala abakwe; alimwi uyowompolola, mbuli balyatuuka masaansa kuli boonse bapona aatala anyika.
Muzuzumo wankondo uyondondoma kumamanino aanyika, nkaambo Jehova wapa mulandu munyika, aboobo weeta lubeta aatala anyama yoonse, alimwi basizibi uyobabikila panga - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Jehova wamakamu waamba eechi, 'Bona, lunyonyooko luyobuzwa kuchisi kaluya kuchisi, alimwi muuwo mupati ulikutalika kumatalikilo aanyika.
Mpawo aabo nakajayigwa aaJehova muleelyo zuba bayovula kuzwa kumamanino aanyika kuyosika kumamanino aanyika; tabakoyolilwa pe, kubungikwa, na kuvwikwa. Bayooba mbuli mafumba aang'ombe aajulu aanyika.
Mulyeeme, nobeembeli, alimwi moompololole lugwasyo! Mubumbuluke mulusuko, inywe nobazululi babutanga, nkaambo mazuba akujayigwa kwanu asika; muyomwayisigwa aawo nimuyoowa mbuli kalongo kabotu.
Takwe kwakuyubila pe kubeembeli, takwe kwakufutukila pe kubazululi babutanga.
Mvwa kulila kwabeembeli akweema kwabazululi babutanga, nkaambo Jehova ulikunyonyoona machezezyo aabo.
Aboobo machezezyo aaluumuno ayonyonyooka akaambo kabukali bwaJehova buyoosya.
Mbuli mulavu muniini, wasiya busena bwakwe mpalala, nkaambo nyika yabo yaba chiyoosyo akaambo kakunyema kwamudyaamizi, kaambo kabukali bwakwe.'''
Kumatalikilo aabweendelezi bwaJehoyikkimu mwana mulombe waJosaya, eeli jwi lyakaza kuzwa kuliJehova, kaliti,

''Jehova waamba eechi: Ima mubbetekelo lyang'anda yangu akwambuula aatala amyuunzi yoonse yaJuda iiza kuzokomba mung'anda yangu. Ambilizya majwi woonse ngindakamulayilila nywebo kuti mwawambe kulimbabo. Mutafwiinsyi kufumbwa jwi!
Akubekuti bayoswiilizya, kuti awumwi muntu uyoswiilizya akusanduka kuzwa kunzila zyakwe mbi, aboobo ndiyosungwala aatala alunyonyooko ndwedikubamba kuyotola kulimbabo akaambo kanchito zyazibi zyabo.
Aboobo baambile kuti, 'Jehova waamba eechi: Na temwaswiilizya ndime kuti mweende mumulawu wangu ooy ngundakabika kunembo lyanu -
na temwaswiilizya majwi aabalanda babasinsimi bangunaabo mbendikutuma kulindinywe kwalyoonse - pesi temwakaswiilila pe! -
eelyo ndiyochita ng'anda eeyi mbuli Syilo; ndiyosandula muunzi ooyu kuba chituko kunembo lyamasi woonse aanyika.'''
Bapayizi, basinsimi, aboonse bantu bakamumvwa Jelemiya kaikwaambilizya majwi aayo mung'anda yaJehova.

Aboobo zyakachitika kuti eelyo Jelemiya nakamana kwaambilizya zyoonse eezyo Jehova nzyakali wamulayilila kuti aambile bantu boonse, bapayizi, basinsimi aboonse bantu bakamukwempa akwaamba kuti, ''Nchobeni uyoofwa!

Nkaambonzi nosinsima muzina lyaJehova akwaamba kuti eeyi ng'anda iyooba mbuli Syilo alimwi kuti iyooba tongo, itakwe bantu bakkala mulinjiyo?'' Nkaambo boonse bantu bakabungana kukulwisya Jelemiya mung'anda yaJehova.
Mpawo basilutwe baJuda bakamvwa majwi aaya alimwi bakayinka kuzwa kung'anda yaMwami kuya kung'anda yaJehova. Bakabika mulyango wakubbuda kuMulyango Mupya wang'anda yaJehova.
Bapayizi abasinsimi bakambuula kuli basilutwe akubantu boonse. Bakati, ''Kuliluzi kuti mwaalumi ooyu afwe, nkaambo wasinsima aatala amuunzi ooyu, mbuli mbuwamvwa amatwi aako nomwini!''
Aboobo Jelemiya wakambuula kuli basilutwe boonse akubantu boonse, wakati, ''Jehova wandituma kuti ndisinsime aatala eng'anda eeyi amuunzi ooyu, kwaamba majwi woonse ngimwamvwa.
Aboobo lino, mubotezye nzila zyanu anchito zyanu, alimwi mukaswiilile kujwi lyaJehova Leza wanu kuchitila kuti akatebunune lunyonyooko ndwawamba aatala andinywe.
Mebo ndemwini - langa kulindime! - ndili mujaanza lyako. Ndichitile chibotu alimwi chiluleme mumenso aako.

Pesi mweelede kuziba kuti nchobeni na mwandijaya, nkokwaamba kuti mulikweeta bulowa butakwe kampenda aalindinywe alimwi aamuunzi ooyu abantu bakkala mulinguwo, nkaambo Jehova chakasimpe wandituma kulinduwe kwaamba majwi woonse kumatwi aanu.''
Mpawo basilutwe abantu boonse bakati kubapayizi akubasinsimi, ''Tachiluzi kuti ooyu mwaalumi afwe, nkaambo waamba makani kulindiswe muzina lyaJehova Leza wesu.''
Mpawo baalumi kuzwa kubapati benyika bakanyampuka alimwi bambuula kumbungano yoonse yabantu.

Bakati, ''Mikka Mosyeti wakalikusinsima mumazuba aaHezekkiya Mwami waJuda. Wakambuula kubantu boonse bamuJuda akwaamba kuti, 'Jehova wamakamu waamba eechi: Ziyoni uyooba muunda ulimidwe, Jelusalemu uyooba dantaala lyazibi, alimwi chilundu chatempele chiyooba chisakasaka.'

Sena Hezekkiya Mwami waJuda aboonse bamuJuda bakamujaya? Sena takayowa Jehova akukombelezya busyu bwaJehova kuchitila kuti Jehova atebunune lunyonyooko aatala ndwakali waamba aatala ambabo? Aboobo tuyochita zibi zipati na aatala amawumi esu?''
Pesi kwakali umwi mwaalumi wakasinsima muzina lyaJehova - Uliya mwana mulombe waSyemayiya kuzwa kuKkiliyati Jelimu - alakwe wakasinsima aatala amuunzi ooyu anyika eeyi, kazuminana amajwi aJelemiya.
Pesi eelyo Mwami Jehoyikimu abasilumamba  abasilutwe nibakamvwa jwi lyakwe, mpawo mwami wakeezya kumujaya, pesi Uliya wakamwa alimwi wakayowa, aboobo wakachija waya kuIjipiti.
Mpawo Mwami Jehoyikimu wakatuma baalumi kuya kuIjipiti - Elinatani mwana mulombe wa Akibba abaalumi kuya muIjipiti kutobela Uliya.
Bakabweza Uliya kuzwa muIjipiti akumweeta kuliJehoyikimu, Mwami. Mpawo Jehoyikimu wakamujaya apanga akutumina chituni chakwe kumaanda aabantu biyo.
Pesi jaanza lyaAhikamu mwana mulombe waSyapani wakali aaJelemiya, aboobo taakapedekezegwa mujaanza lyabantu kuti ajayigwe.
Kumatangunino aabweendelezi bwaZedekkiya mwana mulombe waJosaya, Mwami waJuda, eeli jwi lyakasika kuliJelemiya kuzwa kuliJehova.
Nzezi Jehova nzyakaamba kulindime, ''Lichitile zikkeyi ajogwe. Kazizwaate munsingo yako.

Mpawo ukazitumizye kumwami waIdomu, mwami waMowabbu, mwami wabantu baAmoni, mwami waTaya, akumwami waSidoni. Kazitumizye aluboko lwabiiminizi babaami aabo baza kuJelusalemu kuliZedekkiya mwami waJuda.
Pa malyilile kulimbabo aabasimalelo babo alimwi utedi, ''Jehova wamakamu, Leza wesu, waamba eechi: Eezi nzizyo nzimweelede kwaamba kuli basimalelo banu,
Mebo ndemwini ndakapanga nyika anguzu zyangu aluboko lwangu lunyampwidwe. Alubo ndakapanga bantu abanyama aanyika, alimwi ndipa kuliwoyo weelede mumenso angu.
Aboobo lino, mebo lwangu ndikupa manyika aaya woonse mujaanza lyaNebbukkadineza, MwamiwaBbabbiloni, mulanda wangu. Alubo, ndikupa zyoonse zipona mumyuunda kulinguwe kuti zikamubelekele.
Nkaambo woonse manyika ayomubelekela, mwana wakwe mulombe, muzikulu wakwe wachaalumi kuyosika kukusika kwachiindi chanyika yakwe. Mpawo manyika miingi abaami bapati bayomuzunda.

Aboobo nyika abwaami butabelekeli Nebbukkadineza, Mwami waBbabbiloni, awoyo utayandi kubika mukosi wakwe munsi lyajogwe lyaMwami waBbabbiloni - ndiyosubula nyika eeyo apanga, nzala mpati, adwazi - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - kusikila ndayinyonyoona ajaanza lyangu.
Abobo mutaswiililzyi basinsimi banu, bang'anza banu, basimabibo banu, basikubonisigwa banu abasondi banu, aabo bakali kwaambula kulindinywe kabati, 'Mutabelekeli mwami waBbabbiloni.'
Nkaambo balikusinsimazyalweeno kulindinywe kuchitila kuti bamutandile kule anyika yanu, nkaambo ndiyomutanda, alimwi muyoofwa.

Pesi nyika iibika nsingo yayo munsi lyajogwe lyaMwami waBbabbiloni akumubelekela, ndiyoyilekela kuti ikalyokezye munyika yayo - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - limwi bayolima akuchita myuunzi mulinjiyo.'''''
Abobo ndakambuula kuli Zedekkiya Mwami waJuda akupa mulumbe ooyu, ''Mubike nsingo zyanu munsi lyejogwe lyaMwami waBbabbiloni akumubelekela abantu bakwe, alimwi muyopona.
Nkaambonzi nimutakafwe - nywebo abantu banu - apanga, anzala mpati, adwazi, mbuli mbundakaamba aatala amanyika aakaka kubelekela mwami waBbabbiloni?
Mutaswiilizyimajwi aabasinsimi bambuula kulinduwe kabati, 'Mutabelekeli mwami waBbabbiloni,' nkaambo balikusinsima mabejo kulindinywe.
'Nkaambo tendakabatuma pe - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - nkaambo balikusinsima lweeno muzina lyangu kuchitila kuti ndikamutande alimwi muyooloba, moonse nywebo abasinsimi balikusinsima kulindinywe.'''

Ndakazyaamba eezi kubapayizi akubantu boonse akwaamba kuti, ''Jehova waamba eechi: Mutaswiilili kumajwi aabasinsimi banu basinsima kulindinywe kabati, 'Amulange! Zilongo zyang'anda yaJehova zilikuboozegwa kuzwa kuBbabbiloni lino!' Balikusinsima mabejo kulindinywe.
Mutabaswiilizyi. Mweelede kubelekela Mwami waBbabbiloni alimwi mupone. Nkaambonzi muunzi ooyu nutakabetongo?

Na kabali basinsimi, alimwi kuti ijwi lyaJehova nchobeni lyakabasikila, ngabakombelezye Jehova wamakamu kuti atatumizyi kuBbabbiloni zibelesyo zyakasyaala mung'anda yakwe, mung'anda yaMwami waJuda aJelusalemu.
jehova wamakamu waamba eechi aatala aminsende, chibikilo chipati chizibinkene aakuti, ''Lwizi'' achikalilo chacho, azimwi zibelesyo zyoonse zyakasyaala mummunzi -

zibelesyo eezyo Nebbukkadineza Mwami waBbabbiloni nzyakatabweza pe aawo nakabweza Jehoyikini, Mwami waJuda, mwana mulombe waJehoyikimu, Mwami waJuda, kuya mubuzike kuzwa muJelusalemu kuya kuBbabbiloni aantomwe abalemekeka baJuda aJelusalemu.
Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi aatala azintu zisyaala mung'anda yaJehova, ng'anda yamwami waJuda, aJelusalemu,
'Bayoyetwa kuBbabbiloni, alimwi bayokkala nkukooko kusika kubuzuba mbwebambide kuti nkabazide - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - mpawo ndiyobeeta akubaboozezya kubusena oobu.'''

Zyakachitika mumuntaka uulya, kumatangunino aabweendelezi bwaZedekkiya Mwami waJuda, mumunyaka wane mumwezi wasanu, Hananiya mwana mulombe waAzuli musinsimi, wakali kuzwa kuliGibbiyoni, wakambuula andime mung'anda yaJehova kunembo lyabapayizi abantu boonse. Wakati,
''Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi: Ndatyola majogwe aakabikidwe amamwmi waBbabbiloni.
Mukati kaminyaka iibili ndiyoboozya kuli boobu busena zyoonse zibelesyo zyamung'anda yaJehova eeyo Nebbukkadineza Mwami waBbabbiloni njakabweza kuzwa kubusena oobu akwiitola kuBbabbiloni.

Mpawo ndiyoboozya kuli boobu busena Jehoyikini, mwana mulombe waJehoyikimu, mwami waJuda, alimwi boonse bazike baJuda bakatumidwe kuBbabbiloni - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - nkaambo ndiyotyola jogwe lyamwami waBbabbiloni.''
Aboobo Jelemiya musinsimi wakambiila Hananiya musinsimi kunembo lyabapayizi aabantu boonse bakiimvwi mung'anda yaJehova.

Jelemiya musinsimi wakati, ''Anoli Jehova wachita eechi! Anoli Jehova wazuzikizya majwi ngiwakasinsima akuboozya kuli boobu busena zibelesyo zyang'anda eeyi yaJehova abazike boonse kuzwa kuBbabbiloni.
Nikubaboobo, amuswiilile kujwi ndyendikwaambilizya kukumvwa kwanu akukumvwa kwabantu boonse.
Basinsimi bakaliwo kunembo lyangu anduwe kuzwa chiindi abalabo bakasinisma aatala amanyika miingi alimwi aatala amaami mapati, aatala ankondo, nzala mpati, adwazi.
Aboobo musinsimi uusinsima kuyooba luumuno - na jwi lyakwe lyazooba kasimpe, mpawo liyoozibinkana kuti nchoonzyo musinsimi wakatumwa aJehova.''
Pesi Hananiya musinsimi wakabweza jogwe kuzwa munsingo yaJelemiya musinsimi alimwi wakalityola.

Mpawo Hananiya wakambuula kunembo lyabantu alimwi wakati, ''Jehova waamba eechi: Mbuli mbuboobu, mukati kaminyaka iibili ndiyotyola kuzwa kunsingo yenyika ayimwi jogwe lyakabikwa aaNebbukkadineza mwami waBbabbiloni.'' Mpawo Jelemiya musinsimi wakayinkilila kunembo mulweendo.
Nkali Hananiya musinsimi watyola jogwe kuzwa munsingo yaJelemiya musinsimi, jwi lyaJehova lyakasika kuliJelemiya, kaliti,
''Koya ukaambile Hananiya alimwi ukatedi, 'Jehova waamba eechi: Wakatyola jogwe lyachisamu, pesi ndiyochita lyabutale.'

Nkaambo Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli waamba eechi: Ndabika jogwe lyabutale yenyika zyoonse kuti zibelekele Nebbukkadineza mwami waBbabbiloni, alimwi bayomubelekela. Alubo ndamupa banyama bamusokwe mumyuunda kuti abeendelezye.''
Zitobela Jelemiya musibsimi wakaambila Hananiya musinsimi kuti, ''Swiilila Hananiya! Jehova taakutuma pe, pesi webo lwako nduwe wachita bantu kuti basyome mumabejo.
Aboobo Jehova waamba eechi: Langa, ndaamba kukutanda kuzwa munyika. Uyoofwa mumunyaka uno, mbuli kuti wakaamba bupandusi aatala aJehova.''
Mumwezi wamusanu ayibili wamunyaka ooyo, Hananiya musinsimi wakafwa.

Aaya ngimakani aali mabbuku eelyo Jelemiya musinsimi ndyakatumizya kuzwa kuJelusalemu kubapati bakasyaala aakati kabaange akubapayizi, basinsimi, alimwi akubantu boonse aabo Nebbukkadineza mbaakagwisya kuzwa kuJelusalemu kusika kuBbabbiloni.
Eezi zyakachitika musule lyamwami Jehoyikini, baama mukamwami, abeendelezi basilutwe, bazululi baJuda aJelusalemu, alimwi ababezi kabali batandwa kuzwa muJelusalemu.
Wakatumizya bbuku eeli ajaanza lyaElasa mwana mulombe waSyapani aGemaliya mwana mulombe waHilikkiya ooyo Zedekkiya, mwami waJuda, ngwakali watuma kuliNebbukkadineza mwami waBbabbiloni.
Bbuku lyakati, ''Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi kubaange aabo mbindakachita kuti bagwisigwe kuzwa kuJelusalemu kuya kuBbabbiloni,
'Muyake maanda alimwi mukkale mulingawo. Mubyale zilili alimwi mulye michelo yazyo.

Mukwate banakazi muzyale bana balombe abana basimbi. Mpawo mukakwatile bana banu balombe banakazi, alimwi mukape bana banu basimbi kubaalumi. Mukabaleke bakazyale bana balombe abasimbi alimwi bakavule nkuko kuchitila kuti mutakabi bache loko.
Mukayanduule luumuno lwamuunzi ooyo nkwesikamuchijisizye, alimwi mukambuuzyanie andime kwiimikilila nguwo mbukunga kunooli luumuno lwanu na kawuli muluumuno.'
Nkaambo Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi, 'Mutalekeli basinsimi bali aakati kanu abasimabibo banu bamweene, alimwi mutakaswiilili maloto aayo anywebo ngimulaawo.
Nkaambo balikusinsima chalweeno kulindinywe muzina lyangu. Tendakabatuma pe - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.'
