Nkaambo Jehova waamba eechi, 'Eelyo Bbabbiloni aakumweendelezya kwaminyaka iili makkumi musanu aabili ndiyomugwasya akuchita jwi lyangu bbotu kuti likamuboozya mubusena oobu.
Nkaambo mebo lwangu ndilizi makanze ngendaawo andinywe - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - mabambe aaluumuno alimwi peepe aantenda, kukumupa lyajunza abulangilizi.
Mpawo muyoyita kulindime, alimwi muyoyinka akuyokomba, mpawo ndiyomuswiilila.
Nkaambo muyondiyanduula akundijana, mbukunga muyondiyanduula amoyo wanu woonse.

Mpawo ndiyojanwa andinywe - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - alimwi ndiyoboozya choolwe chako; Ndiyomubungania kuzwa kumanyika akumasena woonse ooko nkundakamutandilide - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - nkaambo ndiyomulela kubusena ooko nkumwakaangilidwe akubikwa mubuzike.'
Mbokunga waamba kuti Jehova watubusizya basinsimi muBbabbiloni,
Jehova waamba eechi kumwami uukkede kuchuuno chabwami bwaDeviti akubantu boonse bakkala mumuunzi ooyo, bananyokwe bakatiinka adinywe mubwaange -
Jehova wamakamu waamba eechi, 'Bona, ndaamba kutumina panga, nzala mpati, adwazi aalimbabo. Nkaambo ndiyobachita kuba mbuli nkuyu zibolede eezyo zinunka zitalyiki.

Mpawo ndiyobatandaania apanga, nzala mpati, amalwazi akubachita chintu chiyoosya kunembo lyamaami woonse aanyika - chiyoosyo, chintu chamatusi akuyobayoba, alimwi chintu chuusisya nsoni aakati kazisi zyoonse ooko nkundakamumwayilide.

Zili boobu nkaambo tebandiswiilila jwi lyangu pe - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - ndindakatuma kulimbabo kwiindila mubalanda bangu basinsimi. Ndakabatuma twiingi twiingi, pesi tebakandiswiilila pe - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.'
Aboobo nywebo lwanu muswiilile kujwi lyaJehova, moonse nimwakazwa mubuzike aabo mbaatuma kuzwa muJelusalemu kuya kuBbabbiloni,

'Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi aatala aAhabbu mwana mulombe waKkolayiya aZedekkiya mwamna mulombe waManase, ooyo uusinsima zyakubeja kulindinywe muzina lyangu: Bona, ndaamba kubabika mujaanza lyaNebbukkadineza mwami waBbabbiloni. Uyoobajaya kunembo lyamenso aako.

Mpawo lutuko luyowambwa aatala abantu aaba abaange boonse abaange boonse baJuda muBbabbiloni. Lutuko luyowamba kuti: Anoli Jehova wamuchita mbuli Zedekkiya aAhabbu, aabo mwami waBbabbiloni mbaakayoka mumulilo.

Eechi chiyoochitika akaambo kanchito ziwusisya nsoni nzibakachita muIzilayeli aawo nibakachita mamambe abanakazi babasimabambanwa alimwi akwaamba majwi aakubeja muzina lyangu, zintu eezyo nzindakatabaambila pe kuti bakaambe. Nkaambo ndime uuzi; ndime kamboni - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.'''
''Aatala aSyemayiya muNehelamu, wamba eechi:

'Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIZilayeli, waamba eechi: Akaambo kakuti wakatumina magwalo muzina lyako kubantu boonse muJelusalemu, kuli Zefaniya mwana mulombe waManaseyiya mupayizi, akubapayizi boonse, akwaamba kuti,

''Jehova wakuchita mupayizi kutali Jehoyiyada mupayizi, kuti ube weendelezya ng'anda yaJehova. Nduwe uuzyotolola bantu boonse aabo bambuula akulibika kuba basinsimi. Mweelede kubabika muzitookesi amumanketani.
Aboobo nkaambonzi niwakatakalalila Jelemiya waAnatoti, ooyo uulichita musinsimi kukulwisya ndinywe?
Nkaambo wakatumina ndiswe kuBbabbiloni akwaamba kuti, 'Chiyooba chiindi chilamfu. Muyake maanda mukkale mulingawo, alimwi mukabyale zilili akulya michelo yazyo.'''''
Zefaniya musinsimi wakabala lugwalo oolu mukumvwakwaJelemiya musinsimi.
Mpawo jwi lyaJehova lyakasika kuli Jelemiya, kaliti,

''Tumina jwi kulibakazwa mubwaange boonse akwaamba kuti, 'Jehova wamba eechi aatala aSyemayiya muNehelamu: Akaambo kakuti Syemayiya wasinsima kulinduwe aawo nkesimutumide pe, alimwi wakuchita kuti usyome,

nkinkaako Jehova waamba eechi: Langa, ndaamba kusubula Syemayiya muNehelamu alunyungu lawkwe. Takwe kuyooba muntu wakukkala aakati kabantu aaba. Takwe nayobona bubotu oobo mbundiyoochitila bantu bangu - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - nkaambo wakaamba kupapila Jehova.'''
Ijwi lyakasika kuliJelemiya kuzwa kuliJehova, kaliti,
''Eechi nchicho nchawamba Jehova, Leza waIzilayeli, kati, 'Lemba mumapepa woonse majwi aayo ngindakwaambila.

Nkaambo langa, mazuba ayobuza - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - aawo nindiyobweedezya buvubi bwabantu bangu, Izilayeli aJuda. Mebo ndeJehova mbundaamba. Nkaambo ndiyobaboozya kunyika njindakapa kuli basikale babo, alimwi bayoyivuba.'''
Aaya ngimajwi Jehova ngakaamba aatala aIzilayeli aJuda,
''Nkaambo Jehova waamba eechi, 'Twamvwa jwi likankama lyakuyowa alimwi litakwe luumuno.
Mubuzye alimwi mubone na muntu ulazyala mwana. Nkaambonzi nendikubona boonse baalumi baniini kabajisi muchikungu mbuli mwanakazi ulikutumbuka mwana? Nkaambonzi masyu aabo boonse nawuside?
Maawe! Nkaambo buzuba oobo bunooli bupati, kakutawke buli mbuli mbubo. Chinoli chiindi chakulikataazya kwa Jakkobbu, pesi uyovunwa kulimbubo.
Nkaambo kuyooba mbuboobo mubuzuba obo - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - kuti ndiyotyola jogwe kuzwa aamukosi wako, alimwi ndiyodunsula nketani, aboobo bazwakule tabachiyomubiki limbi mubuzike.
Pesi bayookomba Jehova Leza wabo akubelekela Deviti mwami wabo, ooyo ngwesikachita mwami aatala lyabo.

Aboobo webo, nomulanda wangu Jakkobbu, utayowi -- ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - alimwi utakatazikani, Izilayeli. Nkaambo bona, ndaamba kukuboozya kuzwa kule, alunyungu lwako kuzwa kunyika yabuzike. Jakkobbuuyoboola akuba aaluumuno; uyokwabililwa, alimwi takukoyooba kuyoowa limbi.

Nkaambo ndili anduwe - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - kukukuvuna. Mpawo ndiyoyeta mamanino aamaninide kumanyika woonse ooko nkundakamumwayilide. Pesi nchobeni nsikoyobika mamanino pe kulinduwe, nikuba ndiakusubula bululeme alimwi nsikoyokuleka kotapedwe chisubulo.'
Nkaambo Jehova waamba eechi, 'Kulichisa kwako takusilikiki pe; cholinda chako chatabukilwa.
Tawo pe naba womwe uukazyania amulandu wako; takwe lululamiko pe kuzilonda zyako kuti zisilikwe.
Boonse bayandwi bako bakuluba. Tabakoyokuyanduula pe, nkaambo ndakuchisa achilonda chasinkondonyokwe achisubulo chasimalelo utakwe luzyalo akaambo kansitoko zyanu azibi zyanu zitabaliki.
Nkaambonzi nimuyanduula lugwasyo kumachise anu? Kuchisa kwanu takusilikiki pe. Akaambo kansotoko zyanu zyiingi, zibi zyanu zitabaliki, ndachita zintu eezi kulindinywe.

Aboobo woonse aakusyukuta uyoosyukutwa alakwe, alimwi boonse basinkondonyokwe bayooya mubuzike. Nkaambo aabo bakamupwayuula bayooba bapwayuulwa, alimwi ndiyochita aabo boonse bapona kuba bafwide banu.

Nkaambo ndiyoyeta kusilikwa aalindinywe; ndiyomusilika kuzilonda zyanu - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - ndiyochita eechi akaambo kakuti bamwiita kuti: Basowedwe. Tawo pe naba womwe uunanza ayeyi Ziyoni.'''

Jehova waanba eechi, ''Bona, ndaamba kuboozya buvubi bwamatente aaJakkobbu akuba aaluzyalo amyuunzi yakwe. Mpawo muunzi uyoyakwa aajulu lyazinyonyweedwe, alimwi businguzu bwanu buyooba lubo mbuli mbubwakabede.
Mpawo lwiimbo lwakulumbayizya amuzuzumo wakubotelwa uyobulika aalimbabo, nkaambo ndiyobavuzya alimwi nsikoyobachesya pe; ndiyobalemeka kuchitila kuti batakafwiinsigwi.
Mpawo bantu babo bayooba mbuli chiindi, alimwi mbungano yabo iypyimikizigwa kunembo lyangu aawo nensikasubule boonse aabo balikubapenzya.
Muzululi wabo uyoozwa aakati kabo. Uyozwa aakati kabo aawo nendiyomweeta afwiifwi ayoswena kulindime. Na tendachita eechi, ngwani utakalikataazye kuswena afwiifwi andime? - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Mpawo muyooba bantu bangu, alimwi ndiyooba Leza wangu.
Bona, muuwo mupati waJehova, bukali bwakwe, bwalibonia. Muuwo mupati wuunga lyoonse. Uyowunga aajulu lyamwitwe  yabasizibi.
Bukali bwaJehova tabukoyoboola kusikila bukabweze akweeta mumyoyo yabo nzibayanda. Mumazuba aakumamanino muyochimvwisisisya eechi.''''
''Muchiindi eecho - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - ndiyooba Leza wamikowa yoonse yaIzilayeli alimwi bayooba bantu bangu.
Jehova waamba eechi, ''Bantu aabo bakafutuka kupanga bajana choolwe muchimpayuma; ndiyoyinka kuyoopa kulyookezya kuli Izilayeli.''
Jehova wakaboneka kulindime mazuba ayinda akundaambila kuti, ''Ndakakuyanda, Izilayeli, aluyando lutamani. Aboobo ndakweeta afwiifwi andime akusyomeka kwachizuminano.
Ndiyokuyakulula lubo kuti ukayakikane, nakalindu Izilayeli. Uyobweza lubo tuntimbwa twako alimwi uyoyinka koyobuzyana chakubotelwa.
Uyobyala lubo masaansa aazilundu zyaSamaliya; balimi bayobyala akuyobelesya kabotu michelo.
Nkaambo buzuba buyosika aawo balindizi bali muzilundu zyaIfulemu nibayowamba kuti, 'Amubuke, ngatweende kuliJehova Leza wesu.'

Nkaambo Jehova waamba eechi, ''Moompolole chakukondwa akaambo kaJakkobbu! Moompolole mukubotelwa akaambo kabasimwaami bamasi. Kutembawulwa ngakukamvwigwe. Tedi, 'Jehova wavuna bantu bakwe, bantu baIzilayeli bakasyaala.

Langa, ndaamba kubaboozya kuzwa kubbazu lyakuNyika. Ndiyobabungania kuzwa kumasena aanyika aali kule. Boofu azimuumu banoli aakati kabo. Banakazi mamitide abaabo baamba kutumbuka banoli aakati kabo. Mbunga mpati iyoboola ooko.

Bayooboola kabalila; ndiyobazulwida aawo nibachita nkombyo zyabo. Ndiyobachita kuti bakayinke kutulonga twamaanzi munzila iibulungusene. Tabakoyolebwa pe mulinjiyo, nkaambo ndiyooba wisi waIzilayeli, alimwi Ifulemu uyooba mwana wangu mutaanzi/.'
''Mumvwe jwi lyaJehova, nomanyika. Mukaambe munkomwe zilikule. Nomanyika mweelede kuti, 'Ooyo wakasansaania Izilayeli ulikumubungania akumubamba mbuli mweembeli ulikubungania mbelele zyakwe.'
Nkaambo Jehova wakavuna Jakkobbu alimwi wakamufutula kujaanza lyakajisi nguzu kwiinda zyakwe.

Mpawo bayosika akubotelwa aajulu lyaZiyoni. Masyu aabo ayomweka akaambo kabubotu bwaJehova, aatala lyazilyo awayini mupya, aatala lyamafuta abana babutangu amatanga. Nkaambo buumi bwabo buyooba mbuli muunda watiliilwa, alimwi tabakoyomvwa kunyema lubo pe.
Mpawo banakalindu bayokondwa akuzyana, alimwi baniini abapati banoli aantomwe. Nkaambo ndiyosandula kulila kwabo kuba kusekelela. Ndiyobafwida nsoni alimwi ndiyochita kuti bakabotelwe kwiinda kuusa.
Mpawo ndiyozuzya mawumi aabapayizi mubwiingi. Bantu bangu bayolizuzya abubotu bwangu - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.''
Jehova waamba eechi: ''Jwi lyamvwigwa muLama, kulila akubizuuka. Ngu Lakkelu uli kulila bana bakwe. Wakaka kuumbulizigwa aatala ambabo, nkaambo tabachiponi pe.''
Jehova waamba eechi, ''Jata jwi lyako kuzwa kukulila amenso aako kuzwa kumisozi; r
Muli bulangilizi kuli lyejunza lyako - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - lunyungu lwako luyoboola mumigaano yabo.''
''Nchobeni ndakamvwa Ifulemu kali kulila, 'Wakandipa chisubulo, alimwi ndakapegwa chisubulo mbuli kanamani katakwe luzibo. Ndiboozye alimwi ndiyoboozegwa, nkaambo nduwe Jehova Leza wangu.
Nkaambo nindakazwa kulinduwe ndakaba aabweeme; nkezwa kukuba aaluzibo, ndakawuma chibelo changu. Ndakaba aansoni akufwisigwa bweeme, nkaambo ndakabweza mulanda wabukubusi bwangu.'

Sena Ifulemu tensi mwana wangu na muyandisi? Tensi muyandisi wangu na, mwana wangu mulombe mubotu? Nkaambo nikufa ndaamba bubi aatala anguwe, nikubaboobo nchobeni ndichinomuyeeya. Munzila eeyi moyo wangu uchimuyanda. Nchobeni ndiyomufwida nsoni - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.''
Kalibikile zikkwaankwani zyamugwagwa. Libikile mpa zyakululamika. Bika mizeezo yako munzila iiluleme, nzila njoyelede kutobela. Boola, nakalindu waIzilayeli! Boola kumyuunzi yako eeyi.
Kukabe lili kolikuzungaana, mwana musimbi utakwe lusyomo? Nkaambo Jehova walenga chintu chpya aanyika - mwanakazi wazyunguluka mwaalumi singuzu.

Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi, ''Eelyo nindayokweeta bantu kunyika yabo, bayowamba eechi munyik yaJuda amyuunzi yawo, 'Anoli Jehova wakulongezya, nobusena busalala ooko nkwakkala, nocjilundu chisalala.'
Nkaambo Juda amyuunzi yakwe yoonse bayokkala aatomwe nkukooko, mbuli balimi abeembeli.
Nkaambo ndiyochita aabo bakatede kuti bakanywe, alimwi ndiyozuzya aabo bawizukide.''
Musule lyacheechi ndakabuka, alimwi ndakananzelela kuti ng'onzi zyangu zyakali kubukulusigwa.
''Langa, mazuba ayobuza - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - eelyo nindiyobyala ng'anda zyaIzilayeli aJuda ambuto yamuntu ambuto yabanyama.

Muchiindi chiinda, ndakali kubalanga kuchitila kuti nkabanobbole akuyobadelwiida aansi, kubazunda, kubanyonyoona, akuyoobeetela ntenda. Pesi mumazuba ayobuza, ndiyobabamba, kuchitila kuti nkabayake akubabyala - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
Mumazuba aayo takwe naba womwe uutakaambe limbi kuti, 'Mataata balya masaansa aapanyuka, pesi meno aabana akaba aabuye.'
Nkaambo awumwi muntu uyoofwa muzibi zyakwe; woonse uulya masaansa aapanyukide meno akwe ayooba aabuye.
Langa, mazuba ayobuza - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova -  eelyo nendjoyimika chizuminano chipya ang'anda yaIzilayeli ang'anda yaJuda.

Tachikoyooba mbuli chizuminano nchindakasimpa amataata aabo mumazuba aayo ngindakabagwisya aluboko lwabo kubagwisya kuzwa munyika yaIjipiti, nkaambo bakatyola chizuminano changu, nikuba ndakali mulumi kulimbabo - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.

Eechi nchechizuminano nchesikasimpe ang'anda yaIzilayeli musule lyamazuba aaya - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova. Ndiyobika mulawu wangu mulimbabo alimwi ndiyowulemba aamyoyo yabo, nkaambo ndiyooba Leza wabo, alimwi bayooba bantu bangu.

Mpawo awumwi muntu tachiyoyiisyi simabambanwa wakwe pe, na muntu kuyiisya mukulana wakwe kati, 'Ziba Jehova!' Nkaambo boonse bayondiziba, kuzwa kumuniini kusika kumupati loko - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - nkaambo ndiyobalekela zibi zyabo akutaziyeeya limbi.''

Jehova waamba eechi, nguwe uuchita zuba kuti libalame sikati alimwi ulachita kuti mwezi anyenyeezi zibalangale mansiku. Nguwe uuchita lwizi kuti lweende kuchitila kuti mayuwe aalo avuume - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.
''Luzutu kuti na zintu eezi zyamwayuuka kuzwa kumenso aangu - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - lunyungu lwaIzilayeli talukoyoyimikila lyoonse kuba nyika kunembo lyangu.''

Jehova waamba eechi, ''Luzutu na chakonzeka kweeleka bulamfu bwakujulu, alimwi luzutu na ntalisyo yanyika yajanika, ndiyokaka loonse lunyungu lwaIzilayeli akaambo kakuti kanzibakachita - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.''
''Langa, mazuba ayobuza - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - eelyo muunzi niwuyoyakulwidwa ndime, kuzwa kuNgaze yaHananelu kusika kuMulyango waChooko.
Mpawo ntambo yakweelesya inochiya kunembo, mane kusikila kuchilundu chaGaleti akuzyunguluka Gowa.

Mumpata woonse wamitunta adota, alimwi amyuunda yoonse iichitilidwe zyakutanta kuyosika kuMumpata waKkidiloni uulikule mbuli chooko chaMulyango waMabbiza waKujwe, iyosalilwa kuli Jehova. Muunzi tawukoyondandamwidwa kujulu na kuzundwa limbi, kwalyoonse.''
Eeli ndejwi lyakasika kuliJelemiya kuzwa kuliJehova mumunyaka wakkumi waZedekkiya mwami waJuda, mumunyaka wakkumi amusanu ayitatu waNebbukkadineza.
Kuli eecho chiindi, mpi yamwami waBbabbiloni yakali zyungulukilide Jelusalemu, alimwi Jelemiya musinsimi wakalaangidwe mulubuwa lwamulindizi kung'anda yamwami waJuda.

Zedekkiya mwami waJuda wakali wamubika muntolongo akakwaamba kuti, 'Nkaambonzi nosinnsima akwaamba kuti, 'Jehova waanab eechi: Langa, ndaamba kutaliza kupa chisi eechi mujaanza lyamwami waBbabbiloni, alimwi uyoyitola.

Zedekkiya mwami waJuda takoyoochija pe kuzwa kujaanza lya baKkasidi, nkaambo nchobeni uyoopegwa mumaanja aamwami waBbabbiloni. Mulomo wakwe uyowambuula kumulomo wamwami, alimwi menso aakwe ayoobona menso amwmai.
Uyootola Zedekkiya kuBbabbiloni, alimwi uyosyaala nkuko kusikila nkamaninsyanie aawe -ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova. Nikuba mwalwisyania abaKkaludi, tamukoyoozwidilila pe.'''
Jelemiya wakati, ''Ijwi lyaJehova lyakandisikila kalyaamba kuti,
'Langa, Hanamelu mwana mulombe waSyalumi wusolenzi uyobuza kuinduwe alimwi uyoti, ''Ula muunda wangu ooyo uli muAnatoti ube wako, nkaambo cheelelo chakuula chili kulinduwe.'''''

Mpawo, mbuli kwaamba kwaJehova, Hanamelu, mwana mulombe wataatalenzi wangu, wakaza kulindime mulubuwa lwamulindizi, alimwi wakati kulindime, ''Ula muunda uuli muAnatoti munyika yaBbenjamini, nkaambo cheelelo chalukono nchichako, alimwi cheelelo chakuula chili kulinduwe. Lyuulile.'' Mpawo ndakaziba kuti eeli ndijwi lyaJehova.
Aboobo ndakawula muunda muAnatoti kuzwa kuliHanamelu, mwana mulombe wataatalenzi wangu, alimwi ndakamweelela mweelo kulinguwe wansiliva, masyekeli kkumi amusanu aabili mubulemu bwawo.
Mpawo ndakalemba mubbuku alimwi ndalijala, alimwi lyakali aabakamboni balyo bakapa bukamboni. Mpawo ndakeela nsiliva aazipimyo.
Chitobela ndakabweza eezyo zyakali zyawulwa zyakajalidwe, nkenjobutobelezya malayilile amilawo, alubo kulizitajalidwe.

Ndakapeda bbuku lyakajalidwe kuliBbalukki mwana mulombe waNeliya mwana mulombe waMaseyi kunembo lyaHanamelu, mwana wataatalenzi wangu, alimwi abakamboni bakalemba mubbuku lijalidwe, akunembo lyabaJudi boonse bakakkede mubbetekelo lyalubuwa lwamulindizi.
Aboobo ndakaapa malayilile kuliBbalukki kunembo lyabo. Ndakati,

''Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi: Bweza malembe aaya, aantomwe alugwalo lwakuula lujalidwe aamwi magwalo aatajalidwe atondeezya kuuzizyania alimwi waabike muchimywido chabulongo kuchitila kuti akakkale kwachiindi chilamfu.
Nkaambo ''Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi: Maanda, myuunda, amyuunda yamasaansa ziyowulwa lubo munyika eeyi.''
Nindakapa Bbalukki mwana mulombe waNeliya lugwalo lwakuula, ndakakomba kuliJehova akuti,
''Maawe, Mwami Jehova! Langa! Webo olike wakalenga majulu anyika kwiinda munguzu zyako mpati akuboko kwako kusumpwidwe. Takwe nchowamba chikukachila pe kuchichita.
Ulatondeezya luyando lwako lutasanduki pe kuli bali zyuulu alimwi akutula bantu bali aamilandu muzibelo zyabana babo. Nduwe Leza mupati uli eenguzu; Jehova wamakamu ndizina lyako.
Ulimupati mubusongo alimwi ulimupati kampatila munchito, nkaambo menso aako alijulikide kunzila zyoonse zyabantu, kukupa muntu woonse kwiindila mumiyeeyo anchito zyakwe.
Wakachita zitondeezyo azigambyo munyika yaIjipiti. Kusika mubuzuba oobu oomu muIzilayeli alimwi aakati kamisyobo yoonse, wakachitya kuti izina lyako lizibikane.
Nkaambo wakagwisya bantu bako Izilayeli kuzwa munyika yaIjipiti azitondeezyo alimwi azigambyo, aluboko lileenguzu, jaanza lisumpwidwe, alimwi akuyoosya kupati.
Mpawo wakabapa nyika eeyi - eeyo njiwakakonkezya kuli basikale babo kuti uyoyipa kulimbabo - nyika ikunka malili abuchi.

Aboobo bakanjila akwiivuba. Pesi tebakaswiilizya pe ijwi lyako na kupona mukuswiilizya mulawu wako. Takwe pe nzibakachita kuli zeezyo nziwakabalayilila kuti baachite, aboobo wakeeta ntenda zyoonse eezi aalimbabo.

Langa! Lubaya luzyungulukide lwasikila aajulu lyanyika kuti bayijate. Nkaambo akaambo kapanga, nzala mpati, adwazi,muunzi waabwa mumaanza abaKkaludiyeni aabo balikuulwana. Nkambo eezyo nziwakaamba kuti zizochitika zilokuchitika, alimwi, bona, ulikweebela.
Mpawo webo lwako wakati kulindime, ''Lyuulile muunda ansiliva alimwi ube aabakamboni anguwo, nikuba oyu muunzi upedwe mumaanza aabaKkaludiyeni.''
Ijwi lyaJehova lyakasika kuliJelemiya, kaliti,
''Langa! Ndime Jehova, Leza wamisyobo yoonse. Mpuchili na chintu chiyumu nchiinga ndakachilwa kuchita?
Nknkaako Jehovawaambaeechi, 'Bona, ndamba kupa muunzi ooyu mujaanza lyabaKkaludiyeni aNebbukkadineza, Mwami waBbabbiloni. Uyochijata.
BaKkaludiyeni balikulwana muunzi ooyu bayooza akuwutenta muunzi ooyu, aantomwe amaanda aawo bantu ngibakali kukombela Bbaalu akutila zipo zyakunywakuli bamwi baleza kuchitila kuti bandinyemywe.

Nkaambo bantu baIzilayeli aJuda nchobeni mbantu bakali kuchita bubi kunembo lyamenso aangu kuzwida kubwanike bwabo. Bantu baIzilayeli nchobeni bakandibisizya anzibakachita amaanza aabo - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.

Jehova waamba kuti muunzi ooyu wakaba chinyemyo chabukali bwangu akunyema kuli aabukali kuzwida buzuba oobo nibakachiyaka. Chakali mbubo kusikila buzuba bwasunu. Aboobo ndiyochigwisya kuzwa kunembo lyabusyu bwangu
akaambo kabubi bwabantu baIziayeli aJuda, zintu nzibakachita kuti bandinyemye - lwabo, baami babo, bana balombe babaami, bapayizi, basinsimi, amuntu woonse muJuda abakkede muJelusalemu.
Bakanditondeezya masule aabo peepe masyu aabo, nikuba ndakali ndabayisya changuzu. Ndakeezya kubayisya, pesi takwe naba womwe wakaswiilizya kuti atambula kululamikwa.
Babika zileza zyabo zisesemya aajulu mung'anda eeyo yiitwa muzina lyangu, kukwiisofwaazya.

Bakayakila Bbaala masena malamfu muMumpata wa Bbeni Hinomu kuchitila kuti babike bana babo balombe abasimbi mumulilo kuchitila Molekki. Takwe nindakabalayilila pe. Takwe nichakaba mumizeezo yangu pe kuti bayelede kuchita chintu chisesemya oobu alimwi akuchita Juda kuti abisye.'
Aboobo lino nkinkaako, ime, Jehova, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi aataa amuunzi ooyu, muunzi ngolikwaamba kuti, 'Ulipedwe mujaanza lyamwami waBbabbiloni kwiinda mupanga, nzala mpati, adwazi.'
Bona, ndaamba kubabungania kuzwa kunyika zyoonse nkundakabatandilide mubukali bwangu, kubijilwa amukunyema kupati. Ndaamba kubaboozya kubusena oobu akubakonzezya kuti bakkale mulukkwabililo.
Mpawo bayooba bantu bangu, alimwi ndiyoba Leza wabo.
Ndiyobapa moyo uumwi anzila iimwi yakundilemeka mazuba woonse kuchitila kuti zikababotele alunyungu lwabo musule lyabo.
Mapwo ndiyopangana chizuminano chitamani ambabo, chakuti nsikoyooleka kuchita bubotu kulimbabo. Ndiyobika lulemyo mumyoyo yabo kuchitila kuti batakazwi kulindime.
Mpawo ndiyobotelwa kuchita bubotu kulimbabo. ndiyobabika chakusyomeka munyika eeyi amoyo wangu woonse abuumi bwangu boonse.
Nkaambo Jehova waamba eechi, 'Mbuli mbundeeta lunyonyooko lupati oolu aabantu aaba, aboobo ndiyoyeta aalimbabo zyoonse zintu zibotu eezyo nzindakaamba kuti ndiyobachitila.
Mpawo myuunda iyowulwa munyika eeyi, njimulikwaamba kuti, ''Eeli nditongo lyanyika, nyika itakwe muntu na munyama. Yakapegwa mumaanza aabaKkaludiyeni.''

Bayowula myuunda ansiliva alimwi bayoolemba mumabbuku aajalidwe. Bayobungania bakamboni munyika yaBbenjamini, iizyungulukide Jekusalemu amyuunzi yaJuda, mumyuunzi iili aatulundu amumasena aalimumisena, amumyuunzi yaNegevu. Nkaambo ndiyobaboozezya buvubi bwabo - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.'''
Mpawo jwi lyaJehova lyakasika kuliJelemiya lwabili, aawo nakachijalilidwe mulubuwa lwamulindizi, kaliti,
''Jehova mubumbi, waamba eechi - Jehova, uubumba kuti ayimike - Jehova ndizina lyakwe,
'Kondiita, alimwi ndiyokusandula. Ndiyochita zintu zipati kulinduwe, zipati nzyotamvwisisisyi pe.'
Nkaambo Jehova, Leza waIzilayeli waamba eechi aatala amaanda ali mumuunzi ooyu amaanda abaami baJuda aakawida aansi akaambo kamatantilo akwabililidwe apanga,
'BaKkaludiyeni bayobuza kuzolwana akuzozuzya mitunta yabantu oobo mbesikajaye mubukali bwangu amukubijilwa kwangu, eelyo nindayokusisa busyu bwangu kuzwa kumuunzi ooyu akaambo kazibi zyabo zyoonse.
Pesi bona, ndaamba kweeta kusilika akuponesegwa, nkaambo ndiyobaponesya akubetela kuvula, luumuno, akusyomeka.
Nkaambo ndiyoboozya buvubi bwaJuda aIzilayeli; ndiyobayaka mbuli kumatangunino.
Mpawo ndiyobasalazya muzwa kuli yoonse milandu njibakachita aatala andime. Ndiyobalekelela yoonse milandu yabo njibakachita aatala andime, alimwi anzila zyabo zyoonse zibakandipapila anzizyo.

Nkaambo muunzi ooyu uyooba chintu chalukonda, lwiimbo lwakulemeka akulemeka kumanyika woonse aansi atakamvwe zyoonse zintu zibotu nzyeyanda kuyowuchitila. Mpawo bayoyowa akuteketa akaambo kazintu zyoonse zibotu aluumuno ndwenjoowupa.'

Jehova waamba eechi chintu, 'Mubusena oobu mbolikwaamba kuti, ''Nditongo, busena butakwe muntu nikuba munyama,'' mumyuunzi yaJuda, amumigwagwa yaJelusalemu yakaba matongo, iitakwe muntu nikuba munyama, kuyoomvwigwa lubo

musabilo walukondo akubotelwa, musabilo wamukwaansa amusabilo wanabwiinga, musabilo wababo baambakuti, eelyo nibayoyeta zipo zyakulumba kuli Jehova, ''Mupe kulumba kuliJehova wamakamu, nkaambo Jehova mubotu, alimwi luyando lwakwe lutamani ndwalyoonse!'' Nkaambo ndiyoboozya buvubi bwanyika mbuli mbubwakabede chiindi,' mbwaamba Jehova.
Jehova wamakamu waamba eechi: 'Mutongo lyabusena oobu, ooko kutakwe muntu nikuba munyama - mumyuunzi yawo yoonse kuyooba bachezezyo lubo ooko beembeli nkubakonzya kuyochezezya mbono zyabo.
Mumyuunzi iili mutulundu, misena,  aNegevu, munyika yaBbenjamini akoonse kuzyunguluka Jelusalemu, amumyuunzi yaJuda, mbono ziyoyinda lubo mumaanza aababo bazibala,' mbwaamba Jehova.
'Langa! Mazuba ayobuza - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - eelyo nindiyochita eezyo nzindakasyomezya ng'anda yaIzilayeli akung'anda yaJuda.
Mumazuba aayo amuchiindi eecho ndiyochita chibunga chisalala kuti chikakomene kuliDeviti, alimwi uyochita bululami abusalali munyika.
Mumazuba aayo Juda uyofutulwa, alimwi Jelusalemu uyopona mulukwabililo, nkaambo eezi nzizyo nzyayowambwa, ''Jehova mbusalali bwesu.'''
Nkaambo Jehova waamba eechi: 'Muntu uuzwa mulusinga lwaDeviti takoyobulika pe kuti akkale echuuno chabwaami bwang'anda yaIzilayeli,
nikuba muntu kuzwa kubapayizi baLevi takoyobulika pe kunembo lyangu kuti akanyampule tununkilizyo twakutenta, kuti atente zipo zyakulya, alimwi kuti akachite zipo zyazilyo choonse chiindi.'''
Jwi lyaJehova lyakaza kuliJelemiya, kaliti,
''Jehova waamba eechi: 'Na mwakonzya kutyola chizuminano changu sikati amansiku kuchitila kuti kutabi limbi sikati amansiku kuzyiindi zyeelede,

mpawo muyokonzya kutyola chizuminano changu aDeviti mulanda wangu, kuchitila kuti takuchiyoobi limbi lunyungu lutakakkale aachuuno chakwe chabwaami, achizuminano changu abapayizi baLevi, balanda bangu.
Mbuli makamu makamu aakujulu mbaatabaliki, ambuli muse wakunkomwe yalwizi mbutakonzyi kweelwa, aboobo ndiyoyuvuzya lunyungu laDevit mulanda wangu alimwi abaLevi aabo bandibelekela.'''
Jwi lyaJelemiya lyakasika kuliJelemiya, kaliti,

''tensi wakalangisisya na eezyo nzibakaamba bantu aaba aawo nibakati, 'Mpuli zibili eezyo Jehova nzyaakasala, lino wazikaka'? Munzila eeyi balangila bantu bangu aansi, kabati tabachili nyika pe kumenso aabo.
Ime, Jehova, ndamba eechi, 'Na tendayimika chizuminano chasikati amansiku, akuti na tendalulamika milawu yakujulu aansi,

mpawo ndiyokaka lunyungu lwaJekkobbu aDeviti mulanda wangu, akuteeta muntu kuzwa kulimbabo kuti ayendelezye lunyungu lwaAbbulahamu, Ayizekki, aJakkobbu. Nkaambo ndiyoboozya buvubi bwabo akutondeezya luzyalo kulimbabo.'''

Ijwi lyakasika kuliJelemiya kuzwa kuliJehova, eelyo Nebbukkadineza mwami waBbabbiloni ampi yakwe yoonse, aantomwe amaami aanyika, bweendelezi boonse bwakali munsi lyamanguzu aakwe, abantu babo boonse bakabusya nkondo aatala aJelusalemu amyuunzi yakwe yoonse, kabati:

''Jehova, Leza waIzilayeli waamba eechi: Koya ukaambe kuliZedekkiya mwami  waJuda akwaamba kuti kulinguwe, 'Jehova waamba eechi; Langa, ndaamba kupedekezya muunzi ooyu mujaanza lyamwami waBbabbiloni. Uyowutenta.
Tamukoyoochija pe kuzwa kujaanza lyakwe, nchobeni muyojatwa akuyoopedekezegwa mujaanza lyakwe. Menso anu ayolanga menso amwami waBbabbiloni; uyowambuua kalangene andinywe mwazoyinka kuBbabbiloni.'
Swiilila kujwi lyaJehova, Zedekkiya mwami waJuda! Jehova waamba eechi aatala anduwe, 'Tokoyojayigwa epanga pe.
Uyofwa muluumuno. Mbuli mudilwe lyakupya kwabasikale bako, baami bakaliwo chiindi, bayotenta mubili wako. Bayooti, ''Maawe, simalelo!'' Bayokulila. Lino ndambuula - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.'''
Aboobo jelemiya musinsimi wakaamba kuliZedekkiya mwami waJuda woonse majwi aaya muJelusalemu.
Impi yamwami waBbabbiloni yakabusya nkondo nkondo aatala aJelusalemu abaabo boonse bakasyeede bamyuunzi yaJuda: Lachisi aAzekka. Eeyi myuunzi kiili myuunzi iikwabililidwe.
Ijwi lyakasika kuliJelemiya kuzwa kuliJehova musule lyaMwami Zedekkiya kali wapanga chizuminano abantu boonse ba muJelusalemu, kukwaamba lwaangunuko kulimbabo,
kuti umwi awumwiaangununo bazike bakwe baHebbulu, boonse baalumi abanakazi, aboobo umwi wakeelede kuchita muzike muJuda, ooyo wakali mukulana wakwe.

Aboobo boonse bazululi abantu boonse bakanjila muchizuminano chakuti umwi awumwi muntu weelede kwaangununa bazike bakwe baalumi abanakazi kutibatakabi bazike limbi. Bakaswiilila alimwi bakabaangununa.
Pesi musule lyazeezi bakasandula miyeeyo yabo. Bakababoozya aabo bazike mbibakali baangununa. Bakabaangila kuti babe bazike lubo.
Aboobo ijwi lyaJehova lyakasika kuliJelemiya, kaliti,

''Jehova, Leza waIzilayeli waamba eechi, ''Mebo lwangu ndakapanga chizuminano abasikale banu mubuzuba mbundakabagwisya kuzwa munyika yaIjipiti, kubagwisya kuzwa mung'anda yabuzike. Mpimpawo mpundakaamba kuti,

''Kumamanino aaminyaka yoonse iili musanu ayibili, awumwi muntu weelede kwaangununa mukulana wakwe, muHebbulunyina ooyo wakalisambala kulindinywe akubeleka minyaka iili musanu awumwi. Mukamutande mulwaangunuko.'' Pesi basikale banu tebakandiswiilila pe na kuchenjekezya matwi aabo kulindime.

Lino nywebo lwanu nobeni mwakasanduka akutalika kuchita ziluleme mumenso aangu. Mwakaambilizya lwaangunuko, umwi kulisimabambanwa wakwe, alimwi mwakapanga chizuminano kunembo lyangu mung'anda eeyo yiitwa azina lyangu.

Pesi mwakafutata akusofwaazya zina lyangu; mwakachita kuti awumwi muntu aboozye bazike bakwe baalumi abanakazi, aabo mbimwakalimwaangununa kuti biinke nkubayanda. Mwakabaangila kuti babe bazike banu lubo.'

Nkinkaako Jehova waanba eechi, 'Nywebolwanu temwakandiswiilila pe. Mwakeelede kwaambilizya lwaangunuko, moonse, kubakulana benu akubaIzilayeli nyokwe. Aboobo langa! Ndaamba kwaambilizya lwaangunuko kulindinywe - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - lwaangunuko lwapanga, dwazi, anzala mpati, nkaambo ndiyomuchita chintu chiyoosya mumenso aamaami woonse aali munyika.

Mpawo ndiyobelekana aabantu bakatyola chizuminano changu, aabo bakatabamba majwi aachizuminano nchibakatalika kunembo lyangu nibakaanzania mupule weng'ombe muzimpanzi zyobile akwiinda aakati kazipmpanzi zyawo,
mpawo bazululi baJuda aJelusalemu, bapalulwe abapayizi, abantu boonse banyika bakeenda aakati kazimpanzi zyamupule weng'ombe.
Ndiyobapedekezya mujaanza lyabasinkondonyina amujaanza lyabaabo bali kuyanduula mawumi aabo. Mibili yabo iyooba chilyo chabayuni bakujulu abanyama bamusokwe bali aanyika.

Aboobo ndiyoopedekezya Zedekkiya mwami waJuda abazululi bakwe mujaanza lyabasinkonyina amujaanza lyabaabo bayanduula buumi bwabo, amujaanza lyabasilumamba bamwami waBbabbiloni ooyo wabuka kukumulwaisya.

Bona, ndaamba kupa malayilile - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - akuyobaboozya kumuunzi ooyu kuzobusya nkondo aatala anguwo akubweza, akutenta. Nkaambo ndiyosandula myuunzi yaJuda kuba matongo oomo mutakabule basikuyookkala.'''
Ijwi lyakasika kuliJelemiya kuzwa kuliJehova mumazuba aaJehoyakkimu mwana mulombe waJosaya mwami waJuda, kaliti,
''Koya kumpuli yabaLekkabbu akwambuula ambabo. Mpawo ukabeete kung'anda yangu, muli imwi yamaanda ooko, alimwi ukabape wayini kuti bakanywe.''
Aboobo ndakabweza Jazaniya mwana mulombe waJelemiya mwana mulombe waHabbaziniya abakulana bakwe, boonse bana bakwe balombe, alimwi ampuli yoonse ya baLekkabayi.

Ndakababtola kung'anda yaJehova, mumaanda aabana balombe baHanani mwana mulombe waIgidaliya, muntu waLeza. Maanda aaya akali kumbali lyang'anda yaazululi, yakali aatala lyang'anda yaMaseyiya mwana mulombe waSyalumi, sikulinda kumulyango.
Mpawo ndakabika ndido ankomeki zyazwide wayini kunembo lyabaLekkabbayi alimwi ndakati kulimbabo, ''Munywe wayini.''
Pesi bakati, ''tatukoyoonywa pe kufumbwa wayini, nkaambo sikale wesu, Jonadabbu mwana mulombe waLekkabbu, wakatulayilila, 'Mutakanywi wayini, nywebo nikuba lunyungu lwanu, lyoonse.

Alubo, mutakayaki pe kufumbwa ng'anda, kubyala kufumbwa mbuto, na kubyala myuunda yamasaansa; eezi tensi zyenu pe. Nkaambo muleelede kukkala mumatente mazuba anu woonse, kuchitila kuti mukapone mazuba miingi munyika ooko nkumupona mbuli bazwakule.'

Twakalemeka jwi lyaJonadabbu mwana mulombe waLekkabbu, sikale wesu, mulizyoonse nzyakatulayilila, kuti tutanywi wayini mumazuba esu woonse, swebo, banakazi besu, bana besu balombe, abana besu basimbi.
tatukoyooyaka maanda aakukkala, alimwi tatukoyooba amyuunda yamasaansa, muunda, nikuba mbuto njitutanoli aayo.
Twakakkala mumatente alimwi twakalemeka akuchita zyoonse eezyo Jonadabbu sikale wesu nzyakatulayilila.

Pesi aawo Nebbukkadineza mwami waBbabbiloni  nakalwana nyika, twkati, 'Sika, tweelede kuya kuJelusalemu tukayube kuzwa kuli basilumamba babaKkaludiyeni abaAlameni.' Aboobo tulimukukkala muJelusalemu.''
Mpawo jwi lyaJehova lyakasika kuliJelemiya, kaliti,
''Jehova wamakamu, Lea waIzilayeli, waamba eechi, 'Koya ukaambe kubantu baJuda ababo bakkala muJelusalemu, ''Sena tamukoyotambula kululamikwa akuswiilila kumajwi angu? - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.

Majwi aJonadabbu mwana mulombe waLekkabbu aayo ngakapa kubana bakwe balombe mbuli mulayizyo, kuti batanywi pe kufumbwa wayini, wakabambwa kusikila mubuzuba oobu. Bakalemeka mulayizyo wasikale wabo. Pesi mbuli ndime, mebo lwangu ndakali kusungwaala kumwaambila, pesi tamundiswiilili pe.

Ndakamutumina balanda bangu boonse, basinsimi. Ndakasumgwaala mukubatuma kuti baambe, 'Amuleke umwi awumwi muntu asanduke kuwa kunzila yakwe yabubi akuchita milimu mibotu; kutakabi umwi uutakeende mukutobela baleza bambi akuyobakomba. Pesi, muboole kunyika njindakamupa abasikale banu.' Nikubaboobo temwakandiswiilila na kuchenjeka kulindime.
Nkaambo lunyungu lwaJonadabbu mwana mulombe waLekkabbu lwabamba malayilile aabasikale babo aayo ngakabapa, pesi bantu aaba bakaka kuswiilila kulindime.'''

Aboobo Jehova, Leza wamakamu alimwi Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi, 'Langa, aajulu lyaJuda azyoonse zipona muJelusalemu, ndiyoyeta lunyonyooko loonse ndundakaamba aatala ambabo nkaambo ndakambuula kulimbabo, pesi tebakandiswiilila pe; ndakabayita pesi tebakandiswiilila pe.'''

Jelemiya wakti kumpuli yabaLekkabbayi, ''Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi: Mwakaswiilila kumilayizyo yaJonadabbu sikale wanu aimwi mwakibamba yoonse - mwakatobelezya zyoonse nzyakamulayilila -
aboobo Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi, 'Kunoli umwi muntu lyoonse uyoozwa kulunyungu lwaJonadabbu mwana mulombe waLekkabbu uutakandibelekele.'
Lino zyakachitika mumunyaka wane waJehoyakkimu mwana mulombe waJosaya mwami waJuda, kuti eeli jwi lyakasika kuli Jelemiya kuzwa kuli Jehova, alimwi wakati,
''Libwezele bbuku alimwi ulembe majwi woonse ngindakakwaambila aatala aIzilayeli aJuda, anyika imwi ayimwi. Kochita eezi  kulizyoonse nzindakakwaambila kuzwa kumazuba aaJosiya kusika mubuzuba oobuno.
Amwi bantu baJuda balikuyoswiilila kulunyonyooko loonse ndwebambide kweeta aalimbabo. Amwi umwi awumwi walikuyosanduka kuzwa kunzila yakwe mbi, kuti nkabalekelele milandu yabo azibi zyabo.''
Mpawo Jelemiya wakayita Bbalukki mwana mulombe waNeliya, alimwi Bbalukki wakalemba mubbuku, mbuli kukwaamba kwaJelemiya, woonse majwi aaJehova aakambuulwa kulinguwe.
Chakatobela Jelemiya wakapa malayililo kuliBbalukki. Wakati, ''Ndilimuntolongo alimwi tandikonzyi kwiinka kung'anda yaJehova.

Aboobo weelede kwiinka akuyobala kuzwa kubbuku eelyo ndiwakalemba kuzwa kukwambuula kwangu. Mubuzuba bwakulyiimya kulya, weelede kubala majwi aJehova mukuswiilila kwabantu mung'anda yakwe, alimwi mukuswiilila kwaJuda woonse wakazwa kumyuunzi yabo. Kawaambe majwi aaya kulimbabo.
Amwi nkombelezyo zyabo zyaluse zilasika kunembo lyaJehova. Amwi wumwi awumwi muntu walikuyooleka nzila yakwe yabubi, mukuti bukali akunyema kwaJehova oobo mbwawamba aatala abantu aaba mbukali.''
Aboobo Bbalukki mwana mulombe waNeliya wakachita eezyo zyoonse Jelemiya musinsimi  nzyaakamulayilila kuti achite. Wakabala chakoompolola majwi aJehova mung'anda yaJehova.

Zyakachitika mumunyaka wasanu amwezi mamusanu ayine yaJehoyakkimu mwana mulombe waJosaya, mwami waJuda, kuti boonse bantu bamuJelusalemu abantu boonse bakaza muJelusalemu kuzwa kumyuunzi yaJuda bakaambilizya kulyiimya kulya kunembo lyaJehova.

Bbalukki wakabala cvhakoompolola majwi aJehova mung'anda yaJehova, kuzwa kung'anda yaGemaliya mwana mulombe waSyapani mulembi, kulubuwa lwabbetekelo lulikujulu, kumulyango wakunjila mung'anda yaJehova. Wakazichita eezi mukuswiilila kwabantu boonse.
Lino Mikkayiya mwana mulombe waSyapani wakamvwa majwi woonse aJehova mubbuku.

Wakiinka kung'anda yamwami, kung'anda yamulembi. Langa, boonse basilutwe bakalikkede nkuko: Elisyama mulembi, Delayiya mwana mulombe waSyemayiya, Elimnata mwana mulombe waAkibba, Gemaliya mwana mulombe waSyapani, aZedekkiya mwana mulombe waHananiya, abasilutwe boonse.
Mpawo Mikkayiya wakazyaamba kulimbabo majwi woonse ngakali wamvwa Bbalukki kalikwabala chakoompolola mukuswiilila kwabantu.

Aboobo basilutwe boonse bakatuma Jehudi mwana mulombe waNetaniya mwana mulombe waSyelemiya mwana mulombe waKkusyi, kuli Bbalukki. Jehudi wakati kuliBbalukki, ''Bweza bbuku mujaanza lyako, ibbuku ooko nkuwazwaakubala mukuswiilila kwabantu, alimwi koza.'' Aboobo Bbalukki mwana mulombe waNeliya wakabweza bbuku mujaanza lyakwe akuya kuli basilutwe.
Mpawo bakati kulinguwe, ''Kkala aansi ubale eechi mukuswiilila kwesu.'' Aboobo Bbalukki wakabala bbuku.
Zyakachitika kuti eelyo nibakamvwa majwi aaya, umwi awumwi muntu wakalanga wakali aafwiifwi anguwe mukuyowa alimwi bakati kuliBbalukki, ''Nchobeni tweelede kuyowamba majwi aaya woonse kumwami.''
Mpawo bakabuzya Bbalukki, ''Twaambile, wakalemba biyeni majwi aaya kuzwa kukwaambuula kwaJelemiya?''
Bbalukki wakati kulimbabo, ''Wakaambuula majwi aaya woonse kulindime, alimwi ndakalemba amulende mubbuku eeli.''
Mpawo basilutwe bakat kuliBbalukki, ''Koya, kalisise lwako, alimwo aJelemiya, alakwe. Kakutakabi utakazibe ooko nkumutanobede.''
Aboobo bakabikabbuku mung'anda yaElisyama mulembi, alimwi bakayinka kumwami mulubuwa lwabbetekelo akwaamba zyoonse mwami kamvwide.
mpaqwo mwami wakatuma Jehudi kuti akeete bbuku. Jehudi wakalibweza kuzwa kung'anda yaElisyama mulembi. Mpawo wakalibala mwami abasilutwe bakwe boonse bakayimvwi afwiifwi anguqwe kabamwide.
Lino mwami wakalikkedde mung'anda yempeyo mumwezi wamusanu ayine, alimwi munchina wakutentelezya wakali kuyaka kunembo lyakwe.
Zyakachitika kuti aawo Jehudi nkali wabala mindando iitatu na ine, mwami uyolidunsula akafulo akuliwaalila mumulilo mulichakutenteezya kusikila bbuku lyoonse lyamana.
Pesi na mwami nikuba umwi wabalanda bakwe bakamvwa majwi aaya woonse bakayoowa kapati, nikuba kudabula zisamo zyabo.
Elinata, Delayiya, aGemaliya bakali baambila mwami chakumusisimpizya kuti atatenti pe bbuku, pesi takwe nakabaswiilizya pe.

Mpawo mwami wakalayilila Jelahimelu waluzubo lwakwe, Selayiya mwana mulombe waAziliyeli, aSyelemiya mwana mulombe waAbbudiyeli kuti baange Bbalukki mulembi aJelemiya musinsimi, pesi Jehova wakali wabasisa.
Mpawo jwi lyaJehova lyakasika kuli Jelemiya kali mwami watenta bbuku amajwi Bbalukki ngakali walemba kukwaambuula kwaJelemiya, kati
''Bweeda, bweza limbi bbuku lyako, alimwi ukalembe mulindilyo woonse majwi akali mubbuku lyakutanguna, eelyo Jehoyakkimu mwami waJuda ndyakatenta.

Mpawo weelede kwaamba eechi kuli Jehoyakkimu mwami waJuda: 'Wakatenta bbuku eeliya kowamba kuti, ''Nkaambonzi niwakalemba mulindilyo, 'Mwami waBbabbiloni nchobeni uyosika akuyonyonyoona nyika eeyi, nkaambo uyonyonyoona boonse bantu abanyama kuzwa kulinjiyo'?'''''

Nkinkaako Jehova wakaamba eechi aatala anduwe, Jehoyakkimu mwami waJuda: ''Takwe walunyungu lwako uyookkala aachuuno chabwaami chaDeviti. Mbuli nduwe, mutunta wako uyosowelwa aantundubwi mukupya kwazuba amumpeyo yamansiku.

Nkaambo ndiyokusubula webo, lunyungu lwako, abalanda bako akaambo kamulandu wanu moonse. Ndiyoleta aalindinywe, aali boonse bakkala muJelusalemu, alimwi aamuntu woonse muJuda zyoonse ntenda nzindakamukonga anzizyo, pesi nzimwakatachenjekezezya kutwi pe kulinzizyo.''

Aboobo Jelemiya wakabweza limbi bbuku alimwi wakapa Bbalukki mwana mulombe waNeliya mulembi.  Bbalukki wakalemba kuzwa kumulomo waJelemiya woonse majwi akali mubbuku lyakatentwa aJehoyakkimu mwami waJuda. Lubo, majwi miingi aafanana akayungizigwa mubbuku eeli.

Lino Zedekkiya mwana mulombe waJosiya wakeendelezya mbuli mwami kwiinda Jehoyakkini mwana mulombe waJehoyakkimu. Nebbukkadinaeza mwami waBbabbiloni wakali wachita Zedekkiya mwami aatala anyika yaJuda.
Pesi Zedekkiya, balanda bakwe, abantu benyika tebakaswiilila pe jwi lyaJehova ndyakaambilizya akuboko kwaJelemiya musinsimi.
Aboobo mwami Zedekkiya, Jehukkalu mwana mulombe waSyelemiya, aZefaniya mwana mulombe waMaseyiya mupayizi wakatuma mulumbe kuliJelemiya musinsimi. Bakati, ''Tukombele kuli Jehova Leza wesu.''
Lino Jelemiya wakalikuza akweenda mukati kabantu, nkaambo takalinabikwa muntolongo pe.
Lumamba lwaFalo lwakazwa muIjipiti, alimwi baKkaludiyeni bakali kusinkilizya Jelusalemu bakamvwa makani aatala ambabo alimwi bakazwa muJelusalemu.
Mpawo jwi lyaJehova lyakasika kuliJelemiya musinsimi, kaliti,

''Jehova, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi: Mbobu mbotakaambe kumwami waJuda, nkaambo wakakutuma kuti uzoyanduule kulayililwa kulindime, 'Bona, lumamba lwaFalo, lwakaza kuzokugwasya, lwaamba kubweeda kuIjipiti, inyika yalo.
BKkaludiyeni balabweeda. Bayoolwana muunzi ooyu, kubweza akutenta.'
Jehova waamba eechi: Mutalyeeni akwaamba kuti, 'Nchobeni baKkaludiyeni balatuleka,' nkaambo tabakoyoyenda pe.
Nikuba kuti mwalimwazunda loonse lumamba lwabaKkaludiyeni bali kumulwana kuchitila kuti muzibbakasa kusyaale biyo baalumi balichiside, balakonzya kubuka akutenta muunzi ooyu.''
Aboobo mpimpawo aawo lumamba lwamaKkaludiyeni mpulwakali lwazwa muJelusalemu mbli lumamba lwaFalo nilwakali buza,
mpawo Jelemiya wakazwa munyika yaJelusalemu kaya kunyika yaBbenjamini. Wakali kuyanda kubweza kampolongondo kanyika nkukooko mukati kabantu  bakwe.
Aawo nakasika amuMulyango waBbenjamini, mulindizi mupati wakaliwo. Zina lyakwe wakali Elayija mwana mulombe waHananiya. Wakambungatila Jelemiya musinsimi akwaamba kuti, ''Ulukuzwa kubaKkaludiyeni.''
Pesi Jelemiya wakati, ''Tensi kasimpe pe. Nsilikuzwa pe kubaKkaludiyeni.'' Pesi Ilija takaswiilila pe. Wakabweza Jelemiya alimwi wamweeta kuli basilutwe.
Basilutwe bakanyemena Jelemiya. Bakamuuma akumubika muntolongo, yakali ng'anda yaJonatani mulembi, nkaambo bakali biichita ntolongo.
Aboobo Jelemiya wakali wabikwa muntolongo yaansi, oomo mwakakkala kwamazuba miingi.

Mpawo mwami Zedekkiya wakatuma umwi muntu wakakumweeta kung'anda yamwami. Mung'anda yakwe mwami, wakamubuzya chakusisikizya, ''Kuli jwi na lyazwa kuliJehova?'' Jelemiya wakasandula, ''Kuli jwi: Uyoopedekezegwa mujaanza lyamwami waBbabbiloni.''
Mpawo Jelemiya wakati kuMwami Zedekkiya, ''Ndakakubisizya buti, balanda bako, na bantu aaba kuti mundibike muntolongo?
Balikuli basinsimi bako, aabo bakakusinsimila akwaamba kuti mwami waBbabbiloni takoyokulwana na kulwana nyika eeyi?
Pesi swiilila lino, simalelo wangu mwami! Amuleke nkombelezyo zyangu zize kunebo lyangu. Utakandibweedezyi kung'anda yaJonatani sizibi, na kuti ndiyofwida nkuko.''

Abbobo Mwami Zedekkiya wakalayilila. Balanda bakwe bakazumina mulubuwa lyabbetekelo lwamulindizi. Wakali kupegwa chibunge chomwe buzuba abuzuba kuzwa kumugwagwa wabasikujika, kusikila chibunge choonse mumuunzi chamana. Aboobo Jelemiya wakakkala mulubuwa lwebbetekelo lwabasikulinda.

Syepatiya mwana mulombe wa Matani, Gedaliya mwana mulombe wa Pasya, Jeyukkali mwana muklombe wa Syelemiya, alimwi Pasya mwana  wakali mwana mulombe wa Malikkija wakamvwa majwi ayo Jelemiya ngakali kwamba kubantu boonse. Wakali kwaamba kuti,
''Jehova waamba eechi: Umwi awumwi ukkala muloyu muunzi uyojazigwa apanga, anzala, azipenzyo. Pesi umwi awumwi uyoozwa kuli ba Chaludiya uyofutuka, uyoloboka mubuumi bwakwe, akupona.
Jehova waamba echi: Oyu munzi uyopegwa mujanza lyampi yamwami wa Bbabbiloni alimwi uyowubweza.''

Abobo basilutwe bakamba kumwami kuti, ''Amumuleke mwaalumi oyu afwe, muliyeeyinzila ulikutyompya maanza abaalumi basintanze basyede muloyu munzi, alimwi amanza abantu boonse. Ulikuzuzikizya majwi aya, nkambo oyu mwalumi talikubeleka kukwabilila obotu pe bantu pesi dokunyonyoona.''
Aboobo mwami Zedekkiya wakamba kuti, ''Langa oyu ulimujanza lyako kusikila kakutakwe uumbi pe mwami unga ulakugwasizya.''

Mpawo bakabweza Jelemiya akumuwaala muchikala cha Malikkija, mwana mulombe wamwami. Oyu mukala wakali walubuwa lwamulindizi. Bakamulengelezya Jelemiya atukole. Temwakali manzi pe mumukala, pesi mwakali matope alimwi wakabbila mukati mumatope.
Lini Ebbedi-Melekki muKkusyiti wakali umwi wabazibe mung'anda yamwami. Wakaamvwa kuti Jelemiya bakamubika mumukala. Lino mwami wakalikkede amulyango wa Bbenjamini.
Aboobo Ebbedi-Meleki wakeenda kuzwa kung'anda yamwami akwambula amwami. Wakamba kuti,
''Simalelo wangu simwami, aaba balumi bachita bubi munzila njibakajata eyo musinsimi Jelemiya. Bakamuwalila mumukala mbuli kuti afwide mukati anzala, mbokunga tamuchikwe chakulya mumuunzi.''
Mpawo simwami wakapa malayilile kuli Ebbedi-Melekki mu Kkusyiti. Wakaamba kuti, ''Bweza malayilile abaalumi makumi otatwe kuzwa ano ubweze Jelemiya musinsimi azwe anze lyamukala katana kufwa.''

Aboobo Ebbedi-Melekki wakalayilila balumi abaya kwiinka kung'anda yamwami, kuya kung'anda yachilondwedo changubo ansi lyang'anda. Kuzwa awo wakabweza ziselusigwe atukole kuli Jelemiya mukati mumukala.
Ebbedi-Melekki mu Kkusyiti wakamba kuti kuli Jelemiya, ''Bika madeludelu azisamo zikulukulu munsi lyankwa aajulu lyatukole. ''Aboobo Jelemiya wakachita obo.
Mpawo bakamukwela Jelemiya atukole. Muleyinzila bakamugwisya anze kuzwa muchikala. Aboobo Jelemiya wakakkala mulubuwa lwamulindizi.
Mpawo mwami Zedekkiya wakalayizya jwi lyakumweta Jelemiya musinsimi kulinguwe, ''Ndiyanda kubuzya chimwi chintu. Mutabambi nsandulo iizwa kulindime.''
Jelemiya kuli Zedekkiya kuti, Naa ndakusandula, ino tokoyondijaya na?  Pesi na ndakupa mubono, tokonga ulandiswilila pe.''
Pesi Mwami Zedekkiya wakakonka kuli Jelemiya chansi ansi akwaamba kuti, ''Mbuli Jehova mbwapona, oyo wakapanga ndiswe. Nsikoyokujaya pe nikuba kukwaba mujanza lyabantu bayanduula buumi bwako.''

Aboobo Jelemiya wakamba kuli Zedekkiya kuti, ''Jehova Leza wabulemu, Leza wa Izilayeli, waamba kuti: naa ninchoonzyo mwaya kunze kuli basilutwe bamwami wa Bbabbiloni awo muyopona, alimwi oyu munzi tukoyotentwa pe. Webo ampuli yako uyopona.
Pesi naa tewayinka aanze kuli basilutwe bamwami wa Bbabbiloni, nkokuti oyu munzi uyopegwa mujanza lya Chaludiya. Bayowutenta, alimwi tuyoloboka pe kuzwa mujanza lyabo.''
Mwami Zedekkiya wakaamba kuli Jelemiya kuti, pesi ndiyoowa bantu ba Juda aabo bakali kuyandwa kuli ba Chaludiya, nkambo ndelede kupegwa mujanza lyabo, zyakuti ngabalandijata zitaluleme.''
Jelemiya wamba kuti, ''Tabakwe nibayokupeda kuli mbabo pe. Teelela mulumbe uzwa kuli Jehova echo nchindili kukwambila, aboobo zintu ziyokwendela kabotu, alimwi uzopona.
Pesi na wakaka kwinkaanze, echi nchinchicho Jehova nzyanditondezya.

Langa! Boonse banakazi bayosyala musule mung'anda yako, mwami wa Juda, ziyoyetwa anze kuli basilutwe bamwami wa Bbabbiloni. Aaba banakazi kuli nduwe bayowamba boobu, 'Mwakali mweenwa abenzinyokwe; bakamunyonyoona Mawulu lino akabbila mumatope, alimwi benzinyokwe banu bayomuchija.
Nkambo kaboonse banakazi benu abana muyoletwaanze kuli ba Chaludiya, alimwi webo lwako tokoyoloboka pe kuzwa kujanza lyabo. Muyojatwa ajanza lyamwami wa Bbabbiloni, alimwi oyu munzi uyotentwa.''
Mpawo Zedekkiya wakamba kuli Jelemiya kuti, ''Utaananizyi naba omwe aatala amajwi aya, ziyochita kuti tokonzyi pe kuyofwa.
Na basilutwe bamvwa kuti ndakambula andinywe, alimwi na basika akwamba kuli ndinywe, ''Mutwambile echo nchimwakaamba kumwami alimwi mutasisi zizwa kulindiswe, nakuti tulokujaya,''
mpawo mwelede kwamba kulimbabo, Ndakachita kukombelela kumenso amwami kuti tokonzyi kuyondijosya kung'anda ya Jonatani kuyofwida nkuko.''

Mpawo basilutwe boonse bakeza kuli Jelemiya akumubuzisisya, aboobo wakabasandula mbuli mwami mbwakamunanizizye. Mpawo bakayima kwambula anguwe, nkambo taakwe nibakali bamvwa pe menzeezyo akkati ka Jelemiya amwami.
Aboobo Jelemiya wakasyalila mulubuwa lwamulindizi mane do buzuba Jelusalemu niyakaangwa.
Mumunyaka wamusanu ayine mumwezi wakkumi waZedekkiya mwami waJuda, Nebbukkadineza mwami waBbabbiloni wakasika ampi yakwe yoonse kuzolwana Jelusalemu akumuzyunguluka.
Mumunyaka wakkumi awumwi mumwezi wane waZedekkiya, mubuzuba bwamusanu aane muunzi wakanjililwa.

Mpawo boonse basilutwe bamwami waBbabbiloni bakasika akukkala aamulyango waakati: Nebbo Sasekkimu, Samuga Nebbo, aSasekkimu, silutwe uulemekezegwa. Nebbo Sasekkimu wakali mupati wabasilutwe alimwi bamwi boonse bakali basilutwe bamwami waBbabbiloni.

Zyakachitika kuti eelyo Zedekkiya, mwami waJuda, abamwi baalumi bakwe boonse basikulwana nibakababona, bakachija. Bakazwa mansiku anzila yakuchilili chamwami, yiinda kumulyango waakati amalambo aabili. Mwami wakazwa kulubazu lwaAlabba.

Pesi mpi yabaKkaludiyeni yakabatobela akuyoobweza Zedekkiya muntandabale zyamasena aaMulongaJodani afwiifwi aJelikko. Mpawo bakamujata akumuleta kuliNebbukkadineza, mwami waBbabbiloni, kuLibbula munyika yaHamati, ooko Nebbukkadineza nkwakapa chisubulo kulinguwe.
Mwami waBbabbiloni wakajaya bana balombe baZedekkiya kunembo lyamenso aakwe kuLibbula. Alubo wakajaya baalumi boonse balemekezegwa baJuda.
Mpawo wakagwisya menso aaZedekkiya akumwaanga anketani zyamukkuba kuchitila kuti amwiinkisye kuBbabbiloni.
Mpawo baKkaludiyeni bakatenta ng'anda yamwami amaanda aabantu. Alubo bakakolomona malambo aaJelusalemu.
Nebbuzaladani, silutwe wabalindizi bamwami, wakanjizya mubuzike bantu boonse aabo bakasyeede mumuunzi. Eechi chakali kubikilizya bantu aabo bakali baya kubaKkaludiyeni aboonse bakasyeede mumuunzi.
Pesi Nebbuzaladani, silutwe wabalindizi bamwami wakazumizya bantu bachete bakatalikwe chintu pe chabo kuti basyaale munyika yaJuda. Wakabapa myuunda yamasaansa amyuunda mubuzuba oobo.
Nebbukkadineza mwami waBbabbiloni wakapede malayilile kuliNebbuzaladani silutwe wabalindizi bamwami aatala aJelemiya. Wakaamba kuti,
''Mubweze alimwi umubambe. Utamuchisi. Umuchutile kufumbwa nchakwaambila.''
Aboobo Nebbuzaladani silutwe wabalindizi bamwami, Nebbusyazibbani muzibe mupati, Negalu Syaleza silutwe uulemekezegwa, aboonse basilutwe balemekezegwa kapati bamwami waBbabbiloni bakatuma baalumi.
Baalumi babo bakabweza Jelemiya kuzwa kulubuwa wamulindizi akumubambisya kuliGedaliya mwana mulombe waAhikkamu mwana mu;ombe waSyapani, kuti amutole kumuunzi, aboob Jelemiya wakakkala aakati kabantu.
Lino jwi lyaJehova lyakasika kui Jelemiya nakali mubwaange mulubuwa lwamulindizi, kalyaamba kuti,

''Ambuula kuli Ebbedi-Meleki muKkusyi akwaamba kuti, 'Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayeli, waamba eechi: Bona, ndaamba kubusya majwi aangu aatala amuunzi ooyu kulunyonyooko peepe kububotu. Nkaambo woonse ayosinizigwa kunembo lyangu mubuzuba oobo.
Pesi ndiyokuvuna mubuzuba oobo - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - alimwi tokoyopedekezegwa mujaanza lyamuntu ooyo ngoyowa.
Nkaambo nchobeni ndiyokuvuna. Takwe noyowisigwa apanga pe. Uyonzwenga abuumi bwako, mukuti usyoma mulindime - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova.'''

Ijwi lyakasika kuliJelemiya kuzwa kuliJehova musule aakugwisigwa kwaNebbuzaladani silutwe wabalindizi bamwami kuLama. Wakakujana Jelemiya ulaangidwe amanketani aakati kaboonse baange bamuJelusalemu abaJuda bakatolwa mubuzike bwaBbabbiloni.
Silutwe mupati wabalindizi wakabweza Jelemiya akwaamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Jehova Leza wako nguwakaamba lunyonyooko oolu aatala abusena oobu.
Aboobo Jehova walweeta. Wachita mbuli mbaakambide, mbuli kuti nywebo mwakmubisizya chakumulwisya alimwi temwakaswiilila jwi lyakwe pe. Nchenchicho chintu eechi nchinchachitika kulindinywe nobantu.

Pesi lino langa! Ndakwaangununa sunu kuzwa kumanketani aakali kumaboko aako. Kuti kazili zibotu kumenso aako kwiinka anduwe kuBbabbiloni, kweza, alimwi ndiyokuvuba. Pesi kuti kazitali zibotu mumenso aako kwiinka andime kuBbabbiloni, mpawo utachiti oobo. Langa munyika yoonse iilikunembo lyako. Koya nkwiili mbotu akululama kunembo lyako kuti wiinke.''

Eelyo Jelemiya naakatasandula, Nebbuzaladani wakati, ''Koya kuGedaliya yomwana mulombe waAyikkamu mwana mulombe waSyapani, ooy mwami waBbabbiloni ngwakabika kukweendelezya myuunzi yaJuda. Kakkale anguwe aakati kabantu na koya kufumbwa kukubotela mumenso aako kwiinka.'' Silutwe mupati wabalindizi bamwami wakamupa chakulya achipo, alimwi mpawo wakamuleka wayinka.
Aboobo Jelemiya wakayinka kuGedaliya mwana mulombe waAhikkamu, kuMizipa. Wakakkala anguwe aakati kabantu oobo bakasyeede musule munyika.

Lino bamwi basilutwe bempi yabasilumamba babaJuda bakachili kumbali lyanyika - bo abantu aabo - bakamvwa kuti mwami waBbabbiloni wabika Gedaliya mwana mulombe waAhikkamu kuti ayendelezye nyika. Alubo bakamvwa kuti wamubika kuti ayendelezye baalumi, banakazi, abana bakali bachete kwiindilila munyika, aabo bakatatolwa kuBbabbiloni pe.

Aboobo bakayinka kuliGedaliya kuMizipa. Aaba baalumi bakali Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya; Johanani aJonatani, bana balombe baKkaliya; Selayiya mwana mulombe waTanumeti; bana balombe baIfayi muNetofatayi; aJazaniya mwana mulombe waMakatayiti - bo abaalumi babo.

Gedaliya mwan mulombe waAhikkamu mwana mulombe waSyapani wakapa chikonke kulimbabo akubaalumi babo alimwi wakati, ''Mutayowi kubelekela basilutwe babaKkaludiyeni. Amukkale munyika alimwi mubelekele mwami waBbabbiloni, alimwi ziyomweendela kabotu.
Langa, ndikukkala muMizipa kuswaanana aabaKkaludiyeni bakaza kulindiswe. Aboob mutebule wayini, amichelo yamayinza, amafuta alimwi mwaabambe muzilondwedo zyanu. Mukakkale mumyuunzi njimwakakkala.''

Mpawo boonse baJuda muMowabbu, aakati kabantu baAmoni, abali muIdomu, amunyika yoonse bakamvwa kuti mwami waBbabbiloni wazumizya aabo bakasyaala muJuda kuti bakkale, kuti wasala Gedaliya mwana mulombe waAhikkamu mwana mulombe waSyapani kuti abeendelezye.
Aboobo boonse baJuda bakaboola kuzwa kumasena woonse nkubakali bamwayilwa. Bakaboola kunyika yaJuda, kuli Gedaliya kuMizipa. Bakatebula wayini amichelo yamayina mubwiing loko.
Johanani mwan mulombe waKaliya aboonse basilutwe babasilumamba bakunyika iilikumbali bakaza kuliGedaliya kuMizipa.
Bakati kulinguwe, ''Ulizi na kuti Bbalisi mwami wabantu baAmoni wakatuma Isimalyeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya kuti azokujaye?'' Pesi Gedaliya mwana mulombe waAhikkamu taakabasyoma pe.

Aboobo johanani mwana mulombe waKkaliya wakambuula chakusisikizya kuligedaliya kuMizipa alimwi wakati, ''ndizumizye kuti ndiinke ndikajaye Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya. Tawo pe utakandiyeeyele. Nkaambonzi nayelede kukujaya? Nkaambonzi kuzumizya baJuda boonse aaba bakabunganisigwa kulinduwe kuti bamwayikizyanie abasyeede baJuda banyonyoonwe?''
Pesi Gedaliya mwana mulombe waAhikkamu wakati kuliJohanani mwana mulombe waKkaliya, ''Utachiti eechi chintu, nkaambo ulikwaamba mabejo aatala aIsimayeli.''

Pesi chakaba kuti mumwezi wamusanu ayibili Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya mwana mulombe waElisyama, kumpuli yabaami, abamwi beendelezi bamwaami, bakasika - baalumi kkumi anguwe - kuli Gedaliya mwana mulombe waAhikkamu, kuMizipa.

Pesi Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya, abaalumi bali kkumi mbaakali aabo bakanyampuka alumni bakalwisya Gedaliya mwana mulombe waAhikkamu mwana mulombe waSyafani, apanga. Isimayeli wakajaya Gedaliya, ooyo mwami waBbabbiloni ngwakabikide kweendelezya nyika.
Mpawo Isimayeli wakajaya baJuda boonse bakali aaGedaliya muMizipa abaalumi basikulwana baKkaludiyeni.
Mpawo lyakali zuba lyabili kabali bajayaGedaliya pesi takwe wakaziba pe.

Bamwi baalumi bakasika kuzwa kuSyekem, kuSyilo, akuzwa kuSamaliya- baalumi bakali musanu above bakali nyowedwe zilezu zyabo, bakadelula zisamo zyabo, akulinengula lwabo - azipo zyakulya atununkilizyo mumaanza aabo kuti bayinke kung'anda yaJehova.

Aboobo Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya wakazwa kuya kuMizipa kuyobaswaana nibakayobuya, kabayobweenda akulila. Mpawo nakabaswaana, wakabaambila kuti, ''Musike kuli Gedaliya mwana mulombe waAhikkamu!"
Kwakaba kuti nibakasika, Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya wakabajaya akubasowela mumulindi, wenya abaalumi mbaakali aabo.

Mudindi oomo Isimayeli mwaakasowela mitunta yoonse yabaabo mbaakajaya, lyakali dindi pati eelyo Mwami Asa ndyakasyide kuchita chikwabililo kukulwanisigwa kuMwami Baasya waIzilayel. Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya wakalizuzya mitunta.

Zyakazootobela Isimayeli wakajaya bantu boonse bakali kuMizipa, bana basimbi bamwaami aantomwe abantu boonse bakacheede kuMizipa aabo Nebbuzaladani silutwe wabalindizi mbaakaabide kuli Gedaliya mwana mulombe waAhikkamu. Aboobo Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya wakabajata alimwi wakazubukila mutala eeliya lyabantu baAmoni.
Pesi Johani mwana mulombe waKkeliya aantomwe abazululi babasilumamba mbaakali aabo bakamvwa zyoonse ntenda Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya nzyakachita.
Aboobo bakabweza baalumi babo boonse alimwi bakiinka kuyolwisya Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya. Bakamujana aachikala chipati chaGibbiyoni.
Aboobo bantu boonse mbaakajisi Isimayeli kuMizipa bakachebuka akuya kuliJohanani mwana mulombe waKkeliya.
Pesi Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya wakachija abaalumi bali musanu abane kuzwa kuliJohanani. Wakaya kubantu baAmoni.

Johanani mwana mulombe waKkeliya abasilutwe babeendelezi babasilumamba mbaakali aabo wakabweza bantu boonse kuzwa kuMizipa aabo bakavunwa kuzwa kuli Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya.  Eechi chakachitika Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya kali wajaya Gedaliya mwana mulombe waAhikkamu. Johanani abenzinyina wakabweza baalumi basinguzu, baalumi balwana, banakazi abana, abazibe bakavunwa kuGibbiyoni.
akaambo kabaKkaludiya. Bakali kubayowa mukuti Isimayeli mwana mulombe waNetaniya wakali wajaya Gedaliya mwana mulombe waAhikkamu, ooyo Mwami waBbabbiloni ngwakali wabika kuti ayendelezye nyika.
Mpawo basilutwe babeendelezi babasilumamba aJohanani mwana mulombe waKkeliya, Jezaniya mwana mulombe waHosyayiya abantu boonse kuzwa kumuniini kunyika kumupati bakiinka kuliJelemiya musinsimi.
Bakati kulinguwe, "Leka nkombelezyo zyesu zisike kulinduwe. Tukombele kuliJehova Leza wako akaambo kabantu aaba bakachaala mbuli kuti tulibache loko mumweelwe, mbuli mbobwene.
Buzya Jehova Leza wako kuti atwaambile nzila njitweelede kwiinka aanjiyo anzitweelede kuchita."
Aboobo Jelemiya musinsimi Makati kulimbabo, "Ndamumvwa. Bona, ndiyookomba kuliJehova Leza wako mbuli mbuwakumbila. Kufumbwa Jehova nzyatakasandule. ndiyoomwaambila. Takwe nchesikamusisile pe."
Bakati kuliJelemiya, "Ikaka Jehova ngakabe kamboni wanchoonzyo uusyomekede kulwanisya ndiswe, na tetwachita zyoonse eezyo Jehova Leza wako nzyaatwaambila kuti tuchite.
Nikuba nchibotu na nchibi, tuyolemeka jwi lyaJehova Leza wesu, ooko nkutuli kukutuma, kuchitila kuti zikatubotele eelyo nitutakalemeke jwi lyaJehova Leza wesu. "
Kukamanino aamazuba aalikkumi, ijwi lyaJehova lyakasika kuliJelemiya.
Aboobo Jelemiya wakiita kuli Johanani mwana mulombe waKkeliya abasilutwe boonse babeendelezi babasilumamba anguwe, akubantu boonse kuzwa kumuniini kusika kumupati.
Mpawo wakati kulimbabo, "Eechi nchicho Jehova, Leza waIzilayel - ooko nkumwakandituma kuti ndikasisye nkombelezyo zyanu kunembo lyakwe - wati
'Na mwabweeda akupona munyika eeyi, ndiyomuyaka alimwi nsikoyomudelwiida aansi pe; ndiyomubyala alimwi nsikoyomumojola pe, nkaambo ndiyobweedezya misuse lunyonyooko ndundakeeta aalindinywe.
Utayowi Mwami waBbabbiloni, ooyo ngolikuyowa. Utamuyowi - joke nkwaamba kwaJehova - mukuti chili aanduwe kukukuvuna akukuunununa kuzwa kujaanza lyakwe.
Nkaambo ndizokupa luzyalo. Ndiyokufwida nsoni, alimwi ndiyokubweedezya kunyika yako.
Pesi ngatutedi wati, "Tatukoyookkala munyika eeyi" - na temwaswiilila jwi lyangu, ijwi lyaJehova Leza wanu.
Pesi ngatutedi wati, "Peepe! Tuyoyinka kunyika yaIjipiti, ooko nkututakaleke kubona nkondo, ooko nkututakaleke kumvwa akulila kwamweembo, alimwi tatukoyoomvwa nzala yakulya pe. Tuyookala nkuko."
mpawo panga ndimuyowa liyomujana nkukooko munyika yaIjipiti. Bbalangwe eelyo ndimuyowa liyomujana nkukooko munyika yaIjipiti, alimwi muyoofwa nkukooko.
Aboobo ziyochitika kuti baalumi boonse bakabamba kuya kuIjipiti kuyokkala nkuko bayoofwa apanga, nzala mpati, na dwazi. Takwe uutakafutuke pe kulunyonyooko ndwesikeete aalimbabo.

Nkaambo Jehova wamakamu, Leza waIzilayel, waamba eechi: Mbuli kunyema kwangu abukali bwangu mbukwakatilwa aali baabo bakkala muJelusalemu, munzila iikozyenie bukali bwangu buyotilwa aalindinywe na mwaya kuIjipiti. Muyooba thirty chalutuko achiyoosyo, chintu chakwamba zituko, alimwi chintu chisesemya, alimwi tamukoyoobubona limbi busena oobu. '"
Mpawo Jelemiya wakati, "Jehova wambuula aatala andinywe - nobasyaale baJuda. Mutayinki kuIjipiti! Nchobeni mulizi kuti ndime kamboni aatala andinywe sunu.
Nkaambo ndamwaambila sunu, pesi temwakaswiilila kujwi lyaJehova Leza wanu na chimwi chazezyo nchaakanditumina kulinduwe.
Aboobo lino, mweelede kuziba nchobeni kuti muyoofwa apanga, nzala mpati, adwazi busena mbumwali kuyanda kwiinka akuyookkala."
Chakachitika oobo Jelemiya nakamana kwambila bantu boonse majwi wonse a Jehova Leza wabo ooyo Jehova Leza wabo ngakamwambila kuti awambe.

Azaliya mwana mulombe wa Hosyayiya, Johanani mwana mulombe wa Kkaleya, alimwi bantu boonse bakali, bakambila Jelemiya kuti, ''Ulokwamba zyakubeja.'Jehova Leza wesu takabatuma kuti, waambe kuti, 'Utayinki ku Ijiputi kuyokkala nkuko.'
Nkaambo Bbalukki mwana mulombe wa Neliya nguwakasungilizya atala andiswe kuti utwangunune mujanza lyaba Kkaludiya, nkambo kanduwe kukuchita lufu lwesu akupa kuti tube mubuzike mu Bbabbiloni.''
Aboob Johanani mwana mulombe wa Kkaleya, bana balombe boonse babaami babasilumamba, alimwi bantu boonse bakaka kuswilila ijwi lya Jehova kuti bakkale munyika ya Juda.
Johanani mwana mulombe wa Kkaleya abasilutwe boonse bampi bakabweza boonse bacheede kuba Juda bakabweda kuzwa kuzisi zyonse oko nkubakasanseene kuzokkala munyika ya Juda.

Bakabweza baalumi abanakazi, bana balombe abana basimbi bamwami, alimwi amuntu wonse oyo Nebbuzaladani, silutwe wabalindizi ba mwami, muleke bachaale a Gedaliya mwana mulombe wa Ahikkamu mwana mulombe wa Syafani. Alimwi bakabweza Jelemiya musinsimi a Bbalukki mwana mulombe wa Neliya.
Bakaya kunyika ya Ijiputi, ku Tahapanesi, nkambo tebakaswilila pe kujwi lya Jehova.
Aboobo, ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli Jelemiyamu Tahanepasi, kalyaamba kuti,
''Bweza mabwe mapati mujanza lyako, alimwi, mumenso abantu ba Juda, waasise mubulongo kukazila kali kumanjililo akung'anda ya Falo mu Tahanapesi.

Mpawo uwaambe kuti kulimbabo, ''Jehova wamakamu, Leza wa Izilayeli, waamba oobu, 'Bona, ndaamba kutuma batumwa kukubweza Nebbukadineza mwami wa Bbabbiloni mbuli mualnda wangu. Ndiyobikka chuno chakwe chabwaami atala amabwe ayo webo Jelemiya, ngwakavwikka. Nebbukkadineza uyoyala aatala alingawo.
Nkaambo uyoza akulwania nyika ya Ijiputi. Kufumbwa wabilwa lufu uyotolwa kulufu. Kufumbwa waabilwa kubuzike uyotolwa kubuzike. Kufumbwa wambilwa kupanga uyotolwa kupanga.

Mpawo ndiyokokutula mulilo mumaanda akombela baleza ba Ijiputi. Nebbukadineza uyobatenta na kubajata. Uyokukula nyika ya Ijiputi mbuli beembeli mbubasansamuna njina muzizwaato zyabo. Uyozwa kubusena oobo muluzundo. (kwinda kuti ndiyokutula mulilo, zimwi nsandululo zyachiindi azyalino zyamba kuti uyokutula mulilo).
Uyomwaya misemu yabbwe ku Heliyopolisi munyika ya Ijiputi. Uyotenta zikombelo zyabaleza ba Ijiputi.'''
Ijwi lyakasika kuli Jelemiya aatala layaba Juda boonse bakakkede munyika ya Ijiputi, aabo bakkala mu Migidola, Tapanesi, Mefusi, abakala mipilaatala Ijip[uti.

''Jehova wamakamu, Leza wa Izilayeli, waamba kuti, 'Iwebo lwako walibonena loonseni lunyonyooko ndendeetela Jelusalemu amadolopo woonse aaku Juda. Boona, aaba matongo sunu. Takwe muntu uyokkala mulingawo.
Chaba boobu akambo kazintu zibi nzibakachita kuti ndinyeme mukuyotenta tununkilizyo akukomba bamwi baleza. Aaba bakali baleza mbibakatazi pe bolwabo nikuba basikale babo.'
Nkinkaako ndakindulula kutuma boonse babelesi bangu kulimbabo. Ndakabatuma kukwaamba kuti, ''Muleke kuchita busofwazi oobu mbwensulide.''
Pesi tebakaswilila pe. Bakakkaka kuswilila akusiya bubi bwabo bwakutenta tununkilizyo kuli bambi baleza.
Nkinkaako bukkali bwangu alunya zyakatilwa akujata mulilo mumadolopo aa Juda amumigwagwa ya Jelusalemu. Aboobo akaba matongo akumwayuuka, ambulisunu oobuno.'

Nkinkaako linobu Jehova, Leza wamakamu a Leza wa Izilayeli, waamba kuti, 'nkaambonzi nolikuchita bubi bupati buloobu atala alwako? Nkamboonzi noli kulyetelezya kugwisigwa mukati kaba Juda -- baalumi abanakazi kuli ndinywe batakasyaale.

Abusofwazi bwako wandinyemya anchito zyamaboko aako, mukutenta tununkilizyo kuli bamwi baleza munyika ya Ijiputi, ooko nkuwakaya kukukkala. Wayinka ooko kuti ukanyonyoonwe, kuchitila kuti ukabe chituko achisesemyo mukati kamanyika woonse aali anyika.
Waluba naa zibi zyakachitwa abasikale bako azibi zyakachitwa abaami baku Juda abanakazi babo? Waluba na bubi mbumwakachita abanakazi benu munyika ya Juda amigwagwa ya Jelusalemu?
Ambuli sunu, tabana kulumba. Tabalemeki pe milawu yangu na zizuminano nzindakabika kunembo lyabo abasikale babo, nikuba kweenda mulinzizyo.'
Nkinkaako Jehova wamakamu, Leza wa Izilayeli, waamba kuti, 'Bona, ndaamba kulangaana aandinywe kuti ndeete lunyonyoono kulindinywe akumwaya Juda woonse.

Nkambo Ndiyobweza luundu lwa Juda loonse lwanyampuka kuya kukuyokkala kunyika ya Ijiputi. Ndiyochita oobo kuti boonse bakamane kufwa munyika ya Ijiputi. Bayoowa apanga anzala. Kuzwa kumuniini kusika kumupati loko bayomana apanga anzala. Bayoofwa alimwi bayooba chintu chakukonkezya, kubisya, kusesemya, achintu chiyoosya loko.
Nkaambo Ndiyopa chisubulo bantu bakkala munyika ya Ijiputi mbuli Mbundakachita Jelusalemu chisubulo chapanga, anzala, adwazi,

kuchitila kuti takubi womwe waluundu lwa Juda bakaya kukukkala kunyika ya Ijiputi utakayube na kufutuka na kubweeda kunyika ya Juda, ooko nkubapeekezya kubweeda kukuyokkala; alimwi takwe umwi wabo utakabweede adokuti bache bakachija nkukooko.'''

Mpawo boonse baalumi bakazi kuti banakazi babo batentela bamwi baleza tununkilizyo, abanakazi boonse bakali mulubunga lupati, abantu boonse bakali kukkala mukkuti aatala lya Ijiputi, bakasandula Jelemiya.
Bakati, ''Aatala aajwi eelyo ndiwatwaambila muzina lya Jehova - tatukokuswilila pe.

Nkambo nchoonzyo tuyochita zyoonse zintu nzitwakakati tuzochita -- kutenta tununkilizyo kuli nkwini (kumwanakazi wa mwami) wakujulu akutila zipo zyakunywa kuli nguwe mbuli mbutwakali basikale besu, baami besu, abazuluzi besu, mbubakachita mumadolopo aa Juda amigwagwa ya Jelusalemu. Mpawo tuyozula achakulya alimwi tuyozwidilila, kakutakwe kujana lunyonyoono.
Nitwakaleka kuchita zintu eezi, kupa tununkilizyo kuli nkwini wakujulu akutatila zipo zyakunywa kulinguwe, toonse twakali kufwaba buchete alimwi twakali kufwa apanga abbalangwe.''
Banakazi bakati, 'Kutila zipayizyo zyakunywa kuli nguwe, zyakali kukazyania abaalumi besu na twachita eezi zintu, kuchita zibunge muchikozyanio chakwe akutila zipayizyo zyakunywa kuli nguwe?'''
Mpawo Jelemiya wakati kubantu boonse kubaalumi abanakazi, abantu boonse bakamusandula -- wakoompolola wati,

''Takuli kuti Jehova wakayeeya na tununkilizyo ntumwakatenta mumagunzi aa Juda amigwagwa ya Jelusalemu - inywebo abasikale benu, baami benu abazuluzi, abantu bamunyika? Nkaambo Jehova ulazyeeta mumizezo; zilaza kumiyeeyo yakwe.

Mpawo takachili kukonzya kuti kazilangide akambo kanchito zyenu zisofweede, akambo kabusondi mbumwakachita. Mpawo nyika yenu yakaba dekende, chiyoosyo, alimwi chitusi aboobo tekwakachili ukkala mumo ambuli sunu oobuno.

Nkambo mwakatenta tununkilizyo akubisizya Jehova, nkambo kakuti temwakaswilila kujwi lyakwe, mulawu wakwe, zikozyanio zyakwe, nikuba zizuminano zyakwe, oolu lunyonyoono lwakumulwana lwachitika mbuli bwasunu oobuno.''
Mpawo Jelemiya wakati kubantu boonse abanakazi boonse, ''Amumvwe ijwi lya Jehova, boonse ba Juda balimunyika ya Ijiputi.

Jehova wamakamu, Leza wa Izilayeli, waamba boobu, 'Inywebo abanakazi benu moonse mwaamba amilomo yenu alimwi mwabweza amaboko eenu nzimwaamba, ''Nchoonzyo tuyochita zizuminano nzitwakachita kukomba Nkwiini wakujulu, kutila zipayizyo zyakunywa kuli nguwe.'' Lino muzuzikizye zizuminano zyenu; amuzichite.'

Nkinkaako linoobu, amumvwe jwi lya Jehova, moonse noba Juda bakkala munyika ya Ijiputi, amubone, ndakonka azina lyangu pati -- mbwawamba Jehova. Zina lyangu talichikayitwi pe amilomo yakufumbwa muntu waku Juda munyika yoonse ya Ijiputi, inywebo nimwamba kuti lino, ''Mbuli mwami Jehova mbwapona.''
Amubone, Ndilibalangide kulunyonyoono kutali kububotu pe. Wonse muntu waku Juda uulimunyika ya Ijiputi uyoofwa apanga anzala mane boonse bakamane.

Mpawo basikufutuka kupanga bayoboola kuzwa kunyika ya Ijiputi kuza kunyika ya Juda, kabali bache biyo. Nkinkaako loonse luundu lwa Juda aabo bakaya kunyika ya Ijiputi kukuyokkala nkuko bayooziba kuti ndijwi lyani liyoochala -- lyangu kana lyabo.
Eechi chiyooba chitondezyo kuli ndinywe -- eechi nchaambilizyo cha Jehova -- nzindili kubambilila kumulwana munyika eeyi, kuchitila kuti muzibe kuti zyanchoonzyo jwi lyangu liyomulwana alunyonyoono.'

Jehova waamba boobu, 'Boona, ndaamba kupa Falo Hopula mwami wa Ijiputi mujanza lyasinkondonyina amujanza lyabaabo bayanda kumujaya. Chikozyania anindakapa Zedekkiya mwami waku Juda mujanza lya Nebbukkadineza mwami waku Bbabbiloni, basinkondonyina bakapenzya buumi bwakwe.''''

Ngaaya majwi Jelemiya musinsimi ngakabuzya Bbalukki mwana mulombe waNeliya. Aaya akachitikana eelyo nakalemba mubbuku aya majwi akazwa kumulomo waJelemiya mumwaaka waJehoyakkimu mwana mulombe waJosiya, mwami waJuda, Wakaamba kuti,
''Jehova waIzilayeli, wamwaambila oobu Bbalukki:
Waamba kuti, 'Maawe mebo; nkaambo Jehova wayungizya machise aangu. Kutongawuka kwangu kwandikataazya mebo; nsijani kulyookeezya pe.'
Mbuboobu mboyelede kumwaambila: Jehova waamba kuti: Boona, eecho nchindakabumba, ndachipwachwiida aansi. Eecho nchindakabyala, ndachinonkoola lino, ndachita eechi kunyika yoonse.

Pesi webo ulachilangililo chazintu zipati lwako? Uutalangili oobo pe. Nkaambo langa, lunyonyooko lulasikila bantu boonse, aaya ngimalayilile aJehova, pesi ndakapa buumi mbuli bulumbu kufumbwa nkuyoyinka.'''
Eeli ndijwi lyakasika kuli Jelemiya musinsimi aatala amaasi.

Nkambo ka Ijiputi: ''Eechi chilatala aampi ya Falo Nekko, mwami wa Ijiputi oyo wakaliku Kkakkemisyi kumbali lya Mulonga Ufuletesi. Eeyi njiyakali mpi eyo Nebbukkadineza mwami wa Bbabbiloni njakazunda mumwaaka wa Josiya, mwami wa Juda:
Amubambe ntobo ziniini antobo mpati, mpawo mwiinke kunembo kuyolwana.
Amubikke maanisi amabbiza; mwawange amabbiza akwimikila angowani zyanu; musyobole masumu akusama zibaki zyankondo.
Niinzi nchendilikunbona aano? Bazuzigwa akuyoowa akuchija, nkaambo basilumamba babo bazundwa. Bachijila lwangunuko akutachebuka musule pe. Buyoofu nkobuli konse konse -- aya malayilile a Jehova --
basiluno tabakonzyi kuchija pe, alimwi basilumamba tabaloboki pe. Balalebwa mulubazu lwakunyika akuwida kumbali aa Mulonga Ufuletesi.
Ngwani oyo ubuka mbuli Nayile,  oyo ujisi maanzi ayumaana kujulu aansi mbuli milonga?
Ijiputi ulabuka mbuli Nayile, mbuli milonga yameenda aayo abuka akuwa, Ijiputi waamba kuti, 'Ndiyotonta akuvumba nyika. Ndiyomwaya myunzi ababo bakkede mumo.
Amutante kujulu, nomabbiza. Ngamunyeme, nonkalaki. Basilumamba ngabazwe, Kkusyi a Puti, baalumi bali aluzibo antobo, alimwi Ludimu, baalumi bali aluzibo kukugobesya tunta twabo.

Buzuba oobo buyoba buzuba bwa Mwami Jehova wamakamu, bwakuliya nkoto, alimwi uyoliyila basinkondonyina. Ipanga liyolya akukkuta. Liyonywa bulowa bwabo likazule. Nkambo kuyooba chipayizyo ku Mwami Jehova wamakamu kulubazu lwanyika yakunyika kumbali a Mulonga Ufuletesi.
Tanta ku Giliyadi mpawo ukabweze munsamu wakusilika, mwana musimbi nakalindu wa Ijiputi. Tavchigwasyi kuti ulibike munsamu wakusilika mabbona. Tokwe notaponesegwe pe.
Maasi akamvwa azyalusampawuko lwako. Nyika yazuzigwa akukwila kwako, nkambo silumamba walebwa atala aasilumamba; boonse bawida aamwi.''
Eeli ndijwi eelyo Jehova ndyakaambila Jelemiya musinsimi akulwisya nyika ya Ijiputi:
''Amuzibye mu Ijiputi, alimwi muchiluule mu Migidolu, Memfisi amu Tapanihesi. 'Amunyampuke akulibambila, nkambo ipanga liyolya aabo bamuzyungulukide.'
Nkamboonzi basinguzu bako nibatungumana aansi aanyika? Tabakwe kuyoyimikila, nkambo Imebo, nde Jehova ndakaba chindila aansi.

Wakayungizya mweelwe wabaabo balebwa. Umwi awumwi silumamba wakaamba aatala awumwi uutobela. Baamba kuti, 'Mubuke. Atweendekumunzi.'Atubwede kubantu besu, kunyika yabuzyalwe bwesu. Atusiye panga eeli lilikutuumina ansi.'
Bakazibya nkukooko, kuti, 'Falo mwami wa Ijiputi ngusikuyowela biyo, umwi oyo wakalekela chiindi chakwe kwiinda.'
Mbuli mbwendipona -- mbwawamba Mwami, uli azina lya Jehova wamakamu -- umwi uyosika mbuli Chilundu Tabba a Chilundu Kkamelu kumbali lyalwizi.
Amulibambile kunyampuka zintu zyamubuzike, nywebo nomukkede mu Ijiputi. Nkaambo Memfisi uyosowegwa, uyoba tongo akubula umwi uyokkala mumo.
Ijiputi ning'ombe mpwizi mbotu, pesi muzimbwa ulasika kuzwa kulubazu lwakunyika. Iyobuza.

Basilumamba babbadalwa mali mukkati kakwe bali mbuli mupule wang'ombe uneneesegwe, pesi alubo bayobweeda akuchija. Tabakwe nibayoyimikila aamwi pe, nkambo buzuba bwalunyonyooko lwabo bulasika atala ambabo, chindi chalusubulo lwabo.
Ijiputi wafoota mbuli nzoka akuyalalika, nkambo basinkondonyina bamusikila. Bamwiinkila mbuli basikutema zisamu atuleba.
Baypgonkelansi lusaka--aya malayilile a Jehova -- nikuba kuti lusinkide loko. Nkambo basinkondo bayooba biingi loko kwinda nsoozi, kabatabaliki pe.
Mwana musimbi wa Ijiputi uyofwinsigwabweeme. Uyopegwa mujanza lyabantu bazwa kulubazu lwakunyika.''
Jehova wamakamu, Leza wa Izilayeli waamba kuti, ''Bona, Mebo ndaamba kusubula Amoni waku Tebbesi, Falo, Ijiputi abaleza bakwe, baami bakwe a Falo abaabo basyoma mulimbabo.

Ndabapeda mujanza lyabamwi aabo balanguula buumi bwabo, mpawo mujanza lya Nebbukkadineza mwami wa Bbabbiloni abalanda bakwe. Mpawo kwiinda kwazeezi Ijiputi uyokkaligwa mbuli mumazuba akayinda -- aya malayilile aa Jehova.

Pesi webo, nomulanda wangu Jakkobbu, utayoowi pe. Utakankami, Izilayeli, nkambo boona, ndaamba kukubwedezya kuzwa kule, alimwi lunyungu lwako kuzwa kunyika zyabuzike bwabo. Eelyo Jakkobbu uyobweeda, alimwi uyojana lumuno mpawo uyokwabililwa, alimwi takukwe nikuyoba sikumuyosezya pe.

Webo, nomulanda wangu Jakkobbu, utayowi pe -- aaya malayilile a Jehova -- nkambo ndili ayebo, aboobo ndiyoyeta lunyonyooko luzulide aatala amasi woonse ooko nkundaka mumwayisizya pesi tandikwe nenjomunyonyoona chakumaninina pe. Pesi ndiyomupa chisubulo chakululama akutamusiya kamutasubwidwe pe.''
Ngaaya majwi akasika kuli Jelemiya musinsimi aatala abaFilisitiya. Jwi eeli lyakamusikila kunembo lyaFalo kukulwisya Gaza.

''Jehova waamba oobu: Bona, Zambangulwe lyamaanzi lilanyampuka kuzwa kulubazu lwakunyika. Aayooba mbuli mulonga uupawula! Mpawo ayotola nyika azyoonse zili mulinjiyo, madolopo aayo mpawo abakkede mulinjiyo! Lino umwi awumwi uyoyita akuyanda kugwasigwa, eelyo boonse bakkede munyika bayolila.
Imvwoigwe biyo mizuzumo yansumba zyamabbiza aabo, kukonkeezya kwankalaki zyabo amizumo yamavili aabo, bamawisi teyakabagwasya pe bana baabo nkaambo kakubula nguzu kwabo.

Nkaambo buzuba bulasika oobo buyonyonyoona boonse baFilisitiya, kubanunsuula kuzwa kuTayili akuSidoni woonse utakafutuke uyanda kubagwasya. Nkaambo Jehova ulokunyonyoona baFilistiya, aabo bachaala kuzwa kukasuwa kaChafuta.
Gaza uyooba alubala. Asyikkeloni, bantu bacheede mumusena bayowumuzigwa. Kukabe lili kochilinengawula mukulila kwako?
Maawe, yopanga lyaJehova! Chitakwe lukumba! Ukalyokeezye akumuna.
Sena inga lilalyokeezya buti kuti Jehova walilayilila, kuti walyambila kuti lilwisye Asyikkeloni ankomwe itobelezya lwizi?''
Kuli ba Mowabbu, Jehova wamakamu, Leza wa Izilayeli, waamba eechi, ''Maawe kuli Nebbo, nkambo yakamwayisigwa. Kkiliyatimu yakafwinsigwa akwaangwa. Lubaya lwakwe lwakamwayigwa akupwachuulwa.

Bulemu bwaba Mowabbu tabuwope. Basinkondonyina mu Hesyibboni bakabamba mapenzi alinguwe. Bakabamba kuti, Ámuze tumunyonyoone mbuli chisi. Batamvwi abalabo bayoba kabaloba -- apanga likutobelela kusule lyako.'
Swilila! Muzuzumo wakukwiila ulikuzwa ku Helanayimu, ooko kuli matongo alunyonyooko luapti.
Mowabbu wakanyonyoonwa. Bana bakwe bakachita kuti kukwiila kwabo kumvwike.
Balatanta kalundu ka Luhiti kabalila, nkambo munzila kukunukila ku Holonayimu, kukwiila kwamvwigwa akambo kalunyonyooko.
Amuchije! Mufutule mawumi aanu akuba mbuli lusaka lwa janipa munkanda.
Nkambo kalusyomo lwanu munchito zyanu amumbono zyanu, nywebo lwanu muyowangwa. Mpawo Kkemosyi uyoozwa akanjile mubwaange, antomwe abapayizi abasilutwe bakwe.
Nkambo munyonyooni uyooza kumunzi woonse; takwe munzi utakaloboke. Aboobo musena uyoloba antandabale iyomwayisigwa, mbuli Jehova mbwawamba.
Mupe mababa kuli Mowabbu, nkambo welede zyanchonzyo awuluke. Myuunzi yakwe iyooba nyika itakwe milimu, ooko kutakwe nikuyooba muntu omwe ukkala mulinjiyo.
Kufumbwa umwi mutolo mukuchita mulimu wa Jehova ngatukwe! Kufumbwa umwi ukasya panga lyakwe kukutila bulowa atukwe!

Mowabbu walimvwa kukwabililwa mbokunga wakali mukubusi. Ulimbuli wayini wakwe oyo utakwe nakawungwidwe kuzwa muchilongo kuya muchilongo. Takukwe nakanjila mubwaange. Nkiinkaako umvwikka kali munono mbuli kale; Munse wakwe ulimbuli mbuubeede.
Aboobo bona, mazuba alasika --oku nkwaamba kwa Jehova -- nindiyomutumina aabo bayomutaaluka akutila njikilo zyakwe akupwaya zinywido zyakwe.
Mpawo Mowabbu uyoba abweeme a Kkemosyi mbuli ng'anda ya Izilayeli mbiyakaba abweeme a Bbeteli, chikozyanio chalusyommo lwabo.
Ulamba buti, kuti, 'Tuli basilumamba, baalumi basikulwana balanguz'?
Mowabbu uyomwayigwa amyunzi yakwe kulwisigwa nkambo baalumi babotu bakubusi bakimikila ansi kubusena bwakujayil. Oku nkwaamba kwamwami! Jehova wamakamu ndyezina lyakwe.
Mapenzi antenda ya Mowabbu ilafwifwi kuti ichitike; kusulana kuli kuvula chakufwambaana.
Nywebo moonse nimuzyungulukide Mowabbu, momooke; alimwi amoonse nimuzi mpuwo yakwe, mompolole eechi, Maawe, kunkoli njumu, musako uulemekwa, watyolwa.'
Selukila ansi kuzwa kubusena bwako bwabulemu akukkala anyika njumu, webo nomwana musimbi ukkala mu Dibboni. Nkaambo oyo uyonyonyoona Mowabbu ulikukulwisya, oyo uyonyonyoona basinguzu bako.
Mwinkilile munzila akulangilizya, nywebo nobantu bakkala mu Alowa. Amubuzye aabo balikuchija akuloboka, Mwaambe kuti, ''Niinzi chachitika?'
Mowabbu wawusigwa bweeme, nkambo yakamwayigwa muwuule akweema; mompolwede lugwasyo. Amwambe kubantu ambali lya Mulonga Anoni kuti Mowabbu wamwachuulwa.
Lino chisubulo chasika kunyika yakalundu, ku Holoni, Jaza, alimwi Mefati,
ku Dibboni, Nebbo, alimwi Bbeti Dibbulatayimu,
Kkiliyatimu, Bbeti Gamalu, alimwi Bbeli Meyoni,
Ku Kkeliyoti a Bbozalal, alimwi kumyunzi yoonse munyika ya Mowabbu -- myunzi iili kule aafwifwi.
Lwija lwa Mowabbu lwanengwa, kuboko akulako kwatyoka - oku nkwaamba kwa Jehova.
Mumukozye, nkambo wachita chakulisumpula kukazyana a Jehova. Muleke Mowabbu alikande mumalusi aakwe, alimwi mumuleke abe chintu chakunyansya.
Nkambo kabi Izilayeli teyakaba chintu chansesya kuli ndinywe? Wakajanika akkati kababbi na, kwakuti mwalikutikinia mutwe wanu kulinguwe lyoonse nimwali kwambula atala anguwe?
Amusiye myunzi akuyaka misasa kumajenga, bakkala ku Mowabb Amube mbuli nziba ichita chisaba amulomo wampako mumabwe.
Twamvwa kulisumpula kwa Mowabbu - kulipa kwakwe, kulidundizya kwakwe, kulisumpula kwakwe, kulipa bulemu kwakwe alimwi akulisyoma mumoyo wakwe.
Oku nkwamba kwa Jehova -- Imebo lwangu ndilizi mwambo wakwe wabufubafuba, kutakwe nchikweeta, mbuli nchito zyakwe.
Aboobo ndiwuula kulila kwa Mowabbu, alimwi ndiyowompolola mukusuwa kwa Mowabbu yoonse. Ndiyolilila bantu ba Kkili Haleseti.

Ndiyoyemena ndinywe baninda mbundakachitila Jazali, Chisiko cha Sibbina. Mitabi yako yakataaluka lwizi lwamunyo akusikila kule mbuli ku Jazali. Basikunyonyoona bakalwisya michelo yako yamayinza awayini wako.

Aboobo kupobola akubotelwa kwakagwisigwa kuzwa kuminsamu yamichelo akunyika ya Mowabbu. Ndakayuminizya wayini kuzwa kuzikandilo zyayo. Takukwe nibatakeende chakukondwa. Kufumbwa koompoolola takukoyoba kwalukondo pe.
Kuzwa kukompolola ku Hesyibboni kuyosika ku Eleyaleyi, mumuzumo wabo ulamvwikka ku Jahazi, kuzwa ku Zowa kusika ku Holonayimu a Egilati Syelisyiya, mbukunga naaba maanzi a Nimulimu akayuminina.
Nkambo ndiyobika magozezyo kufumbwa kuliini mu Mowabbu uchita zipayizyo mumasena asumpukide akuumpa tununkilizyo twabaleza --oku nkokwaamba kwa Jehova.
Eelyo moyo wangu ulokukwilila Mowabbu mbuli muteteele, moyo Wangu ulokukwila mbuli muteteele nkambo kabantu ba Kkeli Halesyeti. Buvubi mbubakajene bwaloba.
Nkambo miytwe yonse yakaba mabbuwa alimwi bonse basizilezu bakalinyoola. Bayolinengula wonse maboko, alimwi bayolizambilila masaka muzikungu.
Kuyoba koomoka wonse masena, alululi loonse lutandabete lwa Mowabbu antomwe amuzikkalilo zya Mowabbu. Nkambo ndakamwayuula Mowabbu mbuli mpoto zitakwe uziyanda -- oku nkokwaambula kwa Jehova.
