Ooyo uli amilawu yangu akwiibamba nguwe undiyanda, alimwi ooyo undiyanda uyooyandwa aTaata wangu, alimwi ndiyomuyanda akulitondeezya kulinguwe.''
Judas (pe pe Sikkaliyoti) wakati kuli Jesu, ''Mwaami, nkaambonzi noyolitondezya kulindiswe notayolitondeezyi kunyika?''
Jesu wakasandaula alimwi wati kulinguwe, ''Na kuli uumwi undiyanda, uyoobamba majwi aangu. Taata ulamuyanda alimwi tuyosika kulinguwe alimwi tuyoyaka muunzi anguwe.
Ooyo utandiyandi mebo takwe nabamba majwi aangu. Ijwi ndimumvwa talizwi kulindime pesi kuli Taata wakandituma.
Ndaamba zintu eezi kulindinywe kuchiindi nkechipona andinywe.
Nekubaboobo, Mugwasyi - Muuya Uusalala ooyo Taata ngwayootuma kwiindila muzina lyangu - uyoomuyiisya zyoonse akumuyezya zyoonse nzindakamwaambila nywe.
Ndamusiila luumuno; ndamupa luumuno lwangu. Tendamupa pe mbuli nyika mbwiipa. Myoyo yanu itapengi, alimwi mutapengi.
Mwakamvwa eezyo nzindakaamba kulindinywe; Ndiyobweenda alimwi nzooboola lubo kulindinywe. 'Na mwalikundiyanda, mwalikubotelwa nkaambo ndiya kuli Taata, nkaambo Taata mupati kwiinda ndime.
Lino ndamwaambila kazitanaachitikana kuchitila kuti , nizyazochitika, muzosyoma.
Tandichizowambuli zyiingi andinywe, kuli muzululi wanyika uuchizobuza. Taakwe nguzu aatala andime,
pesi mbuli nyika mbiiyoziba kuti ndamuyanda Taata, ndichita mbuli Taata mbakandilayilila me. Atunyampuke alimwi tuzwe aawa.
Nsikoyoowambula twiingi andinywe, nkaambommweendelezi wanyika eeyi uyobuza. Takwe manguzu pe aatala andime,
pesi mukuti inyika izibe kuti ndilamuyanda Taata, ndilachita mbubo mbuli Taata mbaakandilayilila mebo. Ngatukanyampuke alimwi tukeende kuzwa aano.''
''Ndimusamu wakasimpwa Taata ngomuka mwini muunda?
Uyogwisya ntabi  zyoonse mulindime zitazyali michelo, akukwezuula ntabi  zitazyali michelo kuchitila kuti zikazyale michelo.
Ulasalala kale  nkambo kamilumbe njindakawambula kulinduwe.
Kkalilila mulindime, andime mulinduwe, mbuli mutabi, utakonzyi kuzyala michelo lwayo, kunze kwakuti wayima kuchisiko, kuti amwi ulakonzya kuzyala, kunze kwakukkalilila mulindime.
Ndichisiko chamusamu, inywe muli mutabi. Oyo ukkalilila muli ndime, ambebo mulinguwe, ulazyalisya michelo, kotakwe ndime takwe nchokonzya kuchita.
Ooyo  naba oomwe uutakkali mulindime, Uyosowegwa mbuli mutabi mpo uyoyuma, alubo iyobwezelelwa mitabi akuyowalilwa mumulilo, mpawo iyotentwa.
Kuti wakkalilila mulindime, akuti majwi angu akkala mulinduwe, kumbila kufumbwa nchoyanda, mpawo uyochitilwa mboyanda.
Taata ulalemekezegwa azeezi, kuti wazyalisya michelo akulitondezya kuti nduwe sikwiiya wangu.
Mbuli Taata mbandiyandisya mebo, Ndakuyanda ambebo; mukkalilile mulindime.
Kuti wabamba milawu yangu, unokkalilide muluyando lwangu, mbundaka bambamilawu ya Taata akukkalilila muluyando lwakwe.
Ndambuula ezi zintu kulindinywe nkuchitila kuti lukondo lube muli nduwe, akuchitila kuti lukondo lumaninine.
Ooyu ngomulwu wangu, kuti muyandane mbuli mbondakamuyanda.
Takwe naba omwe ulaluyando luli oobu-kuti umwi abambe buumi bwakwe mwenzinyina.
Muli benzuma kuti mwachita zintu nzindakamulayilila.
Nsichiyomwiti kuti babelesi, nkambo mubelesi tazi kuti simalelo akwe anzyachita. Ndamwita kuti benzuma, mbuli zyoonse nzindakamvwa kuli Taata, ndachita kuti zizibinkane kulindinywe.

Teensi mwakandisala mebo, pesi ndakamusala inywebo kumwimika nywe kuti mwelede kwenda akuzyala michelo, akuti michelo yanu ikkalilile. Eechi chamba kuti kufumbwa nchimuyokumbila kuli Taata kwinda muzina lyangu, uuyochipa kulindinywe.
Eezi zintu nzindamu layilila, kuti mukonzye kuyandana umwi awumwi.
Kuti nyika yakusula, ziiba kuti yakalindisulide nkitana kukusula webo.
Kuti wali muntu wenyika, inyika ilakuyanda lwayo. Pesi nkambo kakuti taliwanyika akambo kakuti ndakakusala kuzwa munyika, nkiinkako inyika iyokusula we.
Koyeeya ijwi ndindakakwambila we, Ímubelesi tali mupati kwinda simalelo.'Na bandipenzya mebo, bayomupenzya anywebo; Anukuti balondola majwi angu, bayowalondola amajwenu.
Bayochita zyoonsezi zintu kuli nduwe nkambo kezina lyangu, nkambo tabamwizi pe wakandituma.
Anoli tendakasika akwambuula kuli mbabo, teensi bayinobisya, pesi kwalino tabakwe nchebanga balatamizya kukubisya kwabo.
Ooyo wakkaka ndime ngonguwe wakkaka Taata.
Ikuti tendachita milimo takwe naaba oomwe ukazya akati kabo, takwe nibanola chibi pe, pesi lino bibona akusula ndime a Taata.
Pesi eezi zitondezya kuzuzikizya majwi alembedwe mumulawu, 'Bandisula nkenditakwe mulandu.'
Eelyo mugwasyi nayosika - ooyo ngwenjotuma kuli ndinywe kuzwa kuli Taata, nguwe ooyo Muuya wakasimpe, ooyo iwakazwa kuli Taata - Uyoopa bukamboni atala andime.
Uleelede ayebo kupa bukamboni, nkambo wakali andime kuzwa kumatalikilo.
''Ndamwambila ezi zintu kulindinywe kuchitala kuti mutalebwi.
Bayomusowela anze achikombelo pesi chiindi chiyosika echo woonse oyo utakamujaye uyochitanga wamanina Leza mulimo.
Bayochita ezi zintu nkaambo tabana kumuziba Taata nekuba ndime .
Ndamwambila ezi zintu kulindinywe kuchitila kuti chiindi chazyo chakusika ,muyoyeya kuti kakamwambila atala anzizyo .Tendakamwambila atala azezi zintu kumasangunino ,kambo ndakachili anywebo.
Pele lino ndayinka kuliyoyo iwakandituma ,takukwe akati kanu undibuzya kuti ,uyakuli?

'Pesi nkaambo ndamwambila ezi zintu kuli ndinywe ,kubijilwa kwazula mumyoyo yanu  7 Pesi ndamwambila kasimpe ,chibotu kulindinywe kuti ndiinke .Ukuti tendinka ,Mugwasyi takosika pe kulindinywe ,pesi kuti ndayinka ,ndiyomutumina nguwe kuli ndinywe.
Elyo asika ,Mugwasyi uyotondezya nyika kuti iibisizye atala aziibi ,atala abululami ,atala alubeteko ,
atala  aziibi ,nkaambo  tabandisyomi.
ataala abululami ,nkaambo ndilayinka kuli Taata ,aboobo tamukachindiboni limbi,
alubeteko nkaambo nkaambo mweendelezi wanyika eyi wabetekwa kale.
Ndazyingi zintu zyakumwambila ,pesi tamukomvwisisya   lino.
pesi walo muuya wakasimpe ,asika ,oyo umwenzya mukasimpe koonse, pesi takoyowamba izyakwe mwini. Pesi uyowamba ezyo zyatakamwvwe aboobo uyomwambila zintu izichiza .
Uzondilumbayizya ,nkaambo uzobweza zyali zyangu akuzyambila ndinywe.
Zyoonse zyajisi Taata nzizyangu.Nchechicho ,nchindamba kuti Muuya ulabweza zyali zyangu akuzyambila ndinywe.
chaba chiindi chifwifwi tamuchikandiboni limbi ,aboobo kwakuyinda chiindi chifwifwi muyondibona .''
Alimwi bamwi basikwiya bakwe kuli umwi aumwi ,''Chamba nzi echi nchatwambila swebo ,'chaba chindi chifwifwi tamukachindiboni limbi aboobo ,'Nkaambo ndayinka kuli Taata'?''
Nchechicho nchibakamba kuti ,Çhamba nzi echi chawamba ,'chaba chindi chifwifwi '?Tatuzi kuti uwambula atala anyamayi ''.

Jesu wakabona kuti bakali kuyanda kubuzya kulinguwe ,aboobo wakabambila kuti ,Ézi nzizyo na nzimwalikulibuzya lwanu,kuti ndiwamba nzi kandamba ,kuti muchindi chifwifwi tamuyokondibona limbi,aboobo muchindi chifwifwi muyondibona?
Nkasimpe ,nkasimpe ,ndamwambila muyokwila akoomoka ,pesi nyika iyokondwa . Alimwi muyozula kubijilwa ,pesi mapenzi anu ayosanduka akuba lukondo.
Mwanakazi chiindi nayanda kutumbuka ulabijilwa nkaambo chiindi chakwe chasika ,pesi chindi natumbuka mwana ,tachiyeyi limbi machise akwe nkaambo kakukondwa kuti muntu watumbukwa mukati kanyika.
Anywebo mwabijilwa lino ,pesi ndiyomubona lubo ,aboobo myoyo yanu iyo kondwa ,aboobo takwe naba omwe uyokonzya kumunyanga kukondwa kwanu.
Mubuzuba obo takukwe uyondibuzya chintu . Nkasimpe ,nkasimpe ,ndamwambila kuti ,na mwakumbila kufumbwa chintu kuli Taata muzina lyangu ,uyomupa nchicho .
Ambuleno tamunakukumbila chintu mu zina lyangu . Kumbila uyopegwa,kuchitila kuti kukondwa kwanu kuzuzikizigwe''
Ndamwambila ezi zintu kuli ndinywe mutulabiko ,pesi chiindi chilasika nchetachiyomwambili mutulabiko ,pesi anukuti ndiyomwambila antaanganana atala aTaata.
Mubuzuba obo muyokumbila muzina lyangu aboobo nsikoyomwambila kuti ndiyomukombela kuli Taata,
pesi Taata lwakwe ulamuyanda nkaambo mwakandiyanda andime aboobo nkaambo mwakasyoma kuti ndakazwa kuli Leza.
Ndakazwa kuli Taata ,aboobo ndakaza munyika .Lubo ndiyozwa munyika aboobo ndilayinka kuli Taata.''
Basikwiya bakwe bakati,' 'Bona, lino wambula antaanganana aboobo tolikubelesya tulabiko pe.
Lino twaziba kuti ulizi zintu zyoonse, aboobo toyandi naba omwe kuti akubuzye mibuzyo. Nkaambo kazezi, tulasyoma kuti wakazwa kuli Leza.''
Jesu wakabasandula,'' Mwasyoma na lino ?
Bona ,chiindi chilasika ,iyii,aboobo nchechicho echino chimuyowazana aumwi aumwi kumunzi wakwe , aboobo aboobo muyondisiya andikke . Nekuba boobo nsili andikke pe nkaambo Taata ula ndime .
Ndamwambila ezi zintu kuti mube alumuno  mulindime . Munyika mube mapakasyo ,pesi amube akujatilila ; Ndakizunda nyika.
Jesu nakamana kwamba zintu eezi, wakatambya meso akwe kumajulu akwamba kuti, ''Taata, chiindi chasika, mupe bulemu Mwanaako kuchitila kuti alakwe Mwana akupe bulemu -
mbuli mbwakamupa bwendelezi atala ailengwa zyoonse kuchitila kuti azope buumi butamani kuli woonse ooyo ngwakapa kuli nguwe.
Mbuli ibuumi butamani kuti bakuzibe, nduwe Leza wakasimpe, akuli nguwe ooyo ngwakatuma, Jesu Kkilisito.
Ndakakupa bulemu anyika. Ndakamaninsya mulimo oyo nguwakandipa kuti nguuchite.
Lino, Taata, kondilemya antomwe ayebo abulemu obo mbendali kujusi nkechili ayebo, inyika kitanaanzwa.
Ndakayubununa izina lyako kubantu aabo mbwakandipa kuzwa kunyika. Bakali bako, wakabapeda kuli ndime bakabamba ijwi lyako.
Lino bakaziba kuti zyoonse eezyo nzwakandipa zizwa kuli nduwe,
Nkambo ndakabapa woonse majwi ayo ngwakandipa. Bakaatambula mpawo akuziba bwini bwakuti ndakazwa kuli nduwe mpawo bakasyoma kuti wakandituma.
Ndabakombela. Nsikombeli banyika pe pesi aabo mbwakandipa nkambo mbibako.
Choonse eecho changu nchichaako mpawo chako nchichangu mpawo mpegwa bulemu mulimbabo.
Nsichili munyika, pesi aaba bantu balimunyika, mpawo ndikuza kuli nduwe. Taata Uusalala, babambe muzina lyako elyo nduwe wakandipa kuchitila kuti babe bamwi mbuli mbutuli bamwi.
Nindakachili ambabo, ndakabambide kabotu muzina lyako, eelyo ndwakandipa. Ndakaba kwabilila, mpawo takwe nikuba umwi wakanyonyoka, kusiya mwana wabajayi, kuchitila malembe kuti azuzikizigwe.
Lino ndaboola kulinduwe, pesi ndikwamba zintu eezi munyika kuchitila kuti lukondo lwangu luzozuzikizigwe muli mbabo.
Ndakabapa ijwi lyako, mpwao nyika yakabasula nkambo tabali benyika eeyi, mbuuli mbuntali wenyika.
Nsilokukumbila kuli nduwe kuti ubagwisye munyika, pesi kuti babambwe kabotu kulibaabo batalomene.
Tembanyika pe mbuli mbentali wenyika ambebo.
Mubaanzanisye kwinda kukasimpe. Ijwi lyako ndayakasimpe.
Mbuli mbowakandituma munyika ndabatuma ambebo munyika.
Akambo kambabo, ndalibamba lwangu kuchitila kuti abalabo babambwe mukasimpe.
Nsikombeli aaba luzutu pe, pesi abaabo batakasyome mulindime kwinda kujwi lyaako
Kuchitila kuti boonse bakabe umwi mbuli nduwe. Taata mbuli muli ndime, andime ndimuli nduwe. Aabalabo abaabe muli ndiswe kuchitila kuti inyika ikasyome kuti nduwe nuwakandituma.
Ibulemu oobo mbuwakandipa, ndakabupa kuli mbabo, kuchitila kuti babe uumwi, mbuli mbundi umwi.
Ime muli mbabo, mpawo iwe muli ndime - kuti mpobazulila mulukamantano, kuti inyika izibe kuti wakandituma akuti wakabayanda mbuli mbuwakayanda ndime.
Taata, njanda aabo mbwakandipa kuti baabe andime ooko nkuumbede, mpawo akubona bulemu mbwakandipa nkambo wakandiyanda intalisyo yenyika kitana kubambwa.
Taata ululeme, inyika teyaka kwizi pe, pesi mebo ndakali  kwizi, mpawo aaba balizi kuti wakandituma.
Ndakachita kuti izina lyako lizibinkane kuli mbabo, nkabela ndichiyolizibya kuchitila kuti luyando ndwakandiyanda aalo lukabe muli mbabo, mpawo nooli muli mbabo.''
Jesu nakamana kwambula majwi aaya, wakainka kuli aanze abasikwiiya bakwe kuli bumwi busena mumusena wa Kkidiloni, oko kwakali chilili mwakakunjila abasikwiya bakwe.
Lino Judasi ooyo wakali sikuyo mwaba, alakwe wakalibwizi busenobu nkambo Jesu wakali kuswanana absikwiya bakwe nkuko.
Mpawo Judasi wakazulwida inkamu yabasilumamba abamwi bendelezi bazwa kubapayizi bapati akubaFalisi, abasizyuno, bakayinka nkukoko amalampi, azimunisyo, azilwanisyo.
Mpawo Jesu, iwakazi zyoonse zintu ezyo zyakali kuyochitika kulinguwe, wakaya kunembo wababuzya kuti, ''Ngwani ngomulokuyanduula ?''
Bakamusandula, ''Jesu waku Nazaleta.'' Jesu wakati ndamwambila kuti, ''Ndime.'' Judasi ooyo wakamuzya wakaliimvwi abasiliumamba.
Nakaamba kuli mbabo kuti, ''Ndime,'' bakabwedela musule bawidaansi.
Wakababuzya lubo, ''Ngwani ngomulokuyanduula?'' Lubo bakindulula bati, ''Jesu waku Nazaleta.''
Jesu wakasandula, ''Ndamubuzya kuti ndime. Na kamulokuyandula ndime, amubaleke aaba beende.''
Ezi zyakachitika kuti ijwi ndyakaamba lizuzikizigwe: ''kuti kulibaabo mbwaakandipa takwe ngundakasowa pe.''
Alimwi Sayimoni Pita, wakali akafulo, wakakasomona wagonka mulanda wamupayizi mupati wamugonka kutwi kwakuchilisyo. Lino izina lyamulanda oyu wakali Malukkasi.
Jesu wakati kuli Pita, ''Bweedezya ikafulo munkomo. Nsyelede kunywa muchinywido eecho Taata nchaakandipa mebo ?''
Awo inkamu yabasilumamba amupati wabo, ababelesi babaJuda, bakajata Jesu akumwaanga.
Kutanguna bakamutola kuli Aanasi, nkambo wakali yisizyala wa Kkefasi, wakali mupayizi mupati munyokoyo.
Lino Kkefasi wakali nguwe wakapede lulayo kubaJuda kuti nichali chibotu kuti umwi muntu afwide bantu boonse.
Sayimoni Pita wakatobela Jesu, alimwi awumwi sikwiiya. Lino ooyu sikwiiya wakazibinkene kubapayizi bapati, aboobo wakanjila a Jesu munkuta yabapayizi bapati.
Pesi Pita wakaliimvwi amulyango kalaanze, mpawo umwi sikwiya, wakazibinkene kubapayizi bapati, wakazwa aanze kuyowambuula abalinda amulyango, mpawo wakanjizya Pita mukati.
Mpawo mulanda wachikayintu, wakalikubamba amulyango, wakabuzya Pita kuti, ''Tooli umwi wabaabo basikwiiya bayooyu mwalumi na, wakasikuti, ''teensi ndime pe.''
Lino balanda abasikubeleka muwofesi bakalimvwi awo, nkabela bakali bakutilizya mulilo nkambo kwakali kutontola, bakali kuyota. Pita ambabo kayimvwi kalikuyota alakwe.
Mupayizi mupati wakabuzya Jesu aatala abasikwiiya bakwe anjiisyo yakwe.
Jesu wakamusandula, ''Ndakambuula entanganana kunyika. Choonse chiindi ndakali kuyiisya muzitumba amuzikombelo akoko baJuda nkubakali kuswanana. Taakwe pe nchindakaamba mukusisikizya.
Nkambonzi nimundibuzya? Kabuzye kuli bakandimvwa ataala azezyo nzindakaamba. Boona, aaba bantu balizizi nzindakaamba.''
Jesu nakamana kwamba eezi, umwi wababelesi wakayimvwi wakawuma Jesu wati, ''Mbubo na mboyelede kusandula mupayizi mupati ?''
Jesu wakatikuli nguwe, ''kuti nkendi ndaambula bubi, paa bukamboni atala abubi, pesi kuti kakuli kabotu, unduuminayi?
Mpawo Aanasi wakamutola kaangidwe kuli Kkayifasi mupayizi mupati.
Lino Sayimoni Pita wakalimvwi kayoota mulilo. Bantu bakati kulinguwe, ''Sena tenduwe umwi wabasikwiiya bakwe na? Wakakaka akwamba kuti, ''Tensindime pe.''
Umwi wabalanda bamupayizi mupati, wakali munyina wamwalumi ulakutwi Pita nkwakagonkede, wakati, ''Tooli nduwe na ngundakabwene muchilili anguwe ?''
Mpawo Pita wakakaka lubo, mpawo mukuku wakakokolika.
Eelyo bakatola Jesu kuzwa kuli Kkayifasi kuya kukubetekwa. Kwakachili kuseni loko, nkabela tebakanjila pe mubbetekelo kuchitila kuti tabasofwazigwi pe pesi bakakonzye kulya pasika.
Awo Pilato wakazwa aanze waya kuli mbaboo wasikuti, ''Nguuli mulandu ngumweeta ayoyu mwalumi ?''
Bakasandula kabati kulinguwe, ''Aanoli ooyu mwalumi tesimuchita zibi, Tetwayinomweeta kuli nduwe pe.''
Mpawawo Pilato wakati kulimbabo, ''mumutole ndinywe, akuyomubeteka kwinda mumulawu wanu.'' MaJuda bakati kulinguwe, ''Tachili mumulawu pe kulindiswe kubikka kufumbwa umwi muntu kulufu.''
Bakaamba ezi kuchitila kuti ijwi lya Jesu lizuzikizigwe eelyo ndyakaamba kutoondezya atala amusyobo walufu ndwayizofwa.
Mpawo Pilato wakanjila mungánda yakubetekela lubo wayita Jesu wamubuzya kuti, ''Nduwe Mwami waba Juda na?''
Jesu wakasandula, ''Ulokulyambwida na, nakuti kuli bamwi bakambula atala andime kuli nduwe?''
Pilato wakasandula, ''Nsili muJuda pe me, ndinguwe na? Bantu bako abapayizi bapati bakupeda kuli ndime. Niinzi nchiwachita?''

Jesu wakasndula, ''Bwami bwangu tabuli bweenyika eeyi pe. Aanoli bwami bwangu bwali bwachimwi chipanzi chenyika eeyi, balanda bangu bayinokulwana kuchitila kuti nkindeka kwabwa kuba Juda. Pesi lino bwami bwangu tabuzwidi aano pe.

Pilato wakati kulinguwe, ''Uli mwami na?'' Jesu wakamusandula , ''wamba kuti ndimwami. Kuuli aya makanze ndakazyaligwa, akuli aya makanze ndakasika munyika, kuti ngaambe bukamboni mukasimpe. Woonse ooyo uuli mukasimpe ulaswilizya kujwi lyaangu.''
Pilato wakati kulinguwe, ''niinzi kasimpe?'' Ndakazwa kwaamba eezi, wakayinka kumaJuda wamba kuli mbabo, Takwe mulandu pe ngundajana mumwalumi ooyu.
Pesi mulachiyanza chakuti ndiwangunune umwi muntu kuli ndinywe apasika. Aabobo mulayandana kuti ndimulekezezye mwami waba Juda ?''
Mpawo bakoompolola lubo akwamba kuti, pepe oyu mwalumi, pesi Bbalabbasi.'' Lino oyu Bbalabbasi wakaali mubbi.
Mpawo Pilato wakatola Jesu akuyomunabba.
Basilumamba bakalunda ingowani yamamvwa. Bakayibikka amutwe waJesu bamuzwatika asila lyamusyobo wantuumbula.
Bakasika kulinguwe basikuti, wabonwa,  ''Mwami waba Juda!'' mpawo basikumuma.
Pilato wakabbuda aanze lubo wasikuti kulimbabo, ''Mubone, ndikumweeta anze kulindinywe kuchitila kuti muzibe kuti nsijene mulandu pe aalinguwe.''
Awo Jesu wakabbuda aanze, kazweete musini wamamvwa asiila lyachikobela chamusyobo wantumbula. Pilato wakati kulimbabo, ''Mubone ngooyu mwalumi!''

Mpawo awo bapayizi bapati ababelesi nibakabona Jesu, bakoompololesya bati, ''Aababmbulwe, abambulwe!'' Pilato wakati kuli mbabo, ''Mumutole ndinywe mukamubambule nkambo nsijene mulandu pe kulinguwe.''
Ba Juda bakamusandula, ''Tulijisi mulawu,  alubo kwinda mumulawu oyoo, welede kufwa nkambo wakali kulyaamba kuti Mwana waLeza.''
Aawo Pilato nakamvwa nkani eeyi, wakayoweesya loko.
Wakanjila mungánda yakubetekela lubo wati kuli Jesu, ''Uuzwa kuli? Pesi Jesu takwakasandula pe.
Mpawo Pilato wakati kulinguwe, ''Towambuli na kulindime?'' Toozi na kuti ndilenguzu zyakukwangununa aanguzu zyakukubambula?
Jesu wakamusandula, ''Tojisi pe kupanguzu alindime kusiya eecho nchiwakapegwa kuzwa kujulu, nikuba oobo, ooyo wandipedya kuli nduwe ulaachibi chipati.''
Kunsandulo eeyi, Pilato wakeezya kumwangununa pesi bama Juda bakawompoolola kabati, ''kuti wangununa mwalumi ooyu, ''Tooli muzolwani wa Siza. Woonse ulichita mwami uuwambula ataala a Siza.
Pilato nakamvwa makani aaya wakeeta Jesu aanze wakkala aachuno chakubetekela mubusena bwiitwa kuti ''Ibbuwa lyamabwe,'' pesi mumulaka wachi Hibbulu, ni ''Gabbata.''
Lino lyakali izuba lyakubambililwa kwapasika, chiindi chamahola aali musanu alimwi. Pilato wakati kuba Juda, ''Mulange ngoyu mwami wenu!''
Bakawompolola, ''Kuule anguwe, kule anguwe,'''Abambulwe!'' Pilato wakati kuli mbabo, ''Mubambule na mwami wenu?'' Bapayizi bapati bakasandula, ''Tatukwe mwami pe, pesi Siiza.''
Mpawo Pilato wakapedekezya Jesu kuli mbabo kuti abambuulwe.
Mpawo bakatola Jesu, bayinka aanze, kalibwezelede chiingano, kubusena butegwa ''Kaanza,'' chiitwa kuti ''Gologota.'' mumulaka wachi Giliki.
Bakamubambula Jesu nkuko, antomwe abamwi baalumi babili umwi kuli eeli bbazu, umwi kuli eeli, Jesu kali akati.
Pilato wakalemba chitondezyo wachibika achiingano. Chakalembedwe obu: JESU, MWAMI WABA JUDA.
BaJuda biingi bakalikuchibala chitondezyo eechi nkambo busena Jesu nkwakabambwidwe bwakali afwifwi adolopo. Chitondezyo chakalembedwe mumilaka eyi, chi Hibbulu, Latini, antomwe amuchi Giliki.
Eelyo bapayizi bapati babaJuda bakati kuli Pilato, ''Utalembi kuti, ''Mwami wabaJuda, pesi utedi, ''Ooyu uulyamba kuti , ''Ndimwami wabamaJuda.''''
Pilato wakasandula kuti nzindalemba, ndalemba.''
Basilumamba nibakabambula Jesu, bakatola zisamo zyakwe, bazyabana akati kabo muzibeela zyoone, kuti baabane umwi awumwi, achilacho chibaki. Lino chibaki chakali abusumyo buumwi kuzwida ajulu.

Mpawo bakati kuli umwi awumwi, ''Tatuchideluli pe, pesi aatusonde kuchitila kuti chilyaambe kuti chilaaba chani. Eechi chakachitika kuchitila kuti malembe azuzikizigwe awamba kuti, ''Bakaabana zikobela zyangu akati kaabo akusonda zisamo zyangu. Eezi nzibakachita basilumamba.''
Lino ibakayimvwi afwifwi achiingano cha Jesu, kwakali banyina Jesu, kwakali mukulana wabanyina, Meli muka Kkilopasi, a Meli Magadalina. Aaba bamakayintu bakalimvwi afwifwi achiingano cha Jesu.
Jesu nakabona banyina asikwiiya ooyo ngwakali kuyandisya kabimvwi afwifwi, wakati kuli banyina, ''Yomwanakazi, ''Langa, mwanako!''
Mpawo wakati kuli sikwiiya, ''Langa banyoko.'' Kuzwa kuchiindi echo sikwiya wakabatola banyina kungánda yakwe.
Nikwakayinda ezi Jesu, nkambo wakaziba kuti zyonse lino zyakali zyamana, akuchitila kuti malembe ayelede kuzuzikizigwa, Jesu wakati, ''Ndaaba enyota''
Chibikilo chakazwide wayini upanyuka chakaliwo, mpawo bakabika akasamu kakaangidwe chisana chakazwide wayini upanyuka bamutambikizya amulomo wakwe.
Jesu nakanywa wayini upanyuka wakati ''Kwamana.'' wakalanzya mutwe aansi akupedya muuya wakwe.

Mpawo baJuda, akambo kakuti lyakali izuba lyakulibambila, akuti mibili teyakali kuchaala aachingano kuchindi chasabata ( elyo Sabata yakali mpati loko), bakakumbila Pilato kuti atyole mawulu aabo akubagwisya.
Mpawo basilumamba bakasika akutyola mawulu amwalumi wakutanguna awabili wabo bakabambwidwe a Jesu.
Nibakasika kuli Jesu, bakabona kuti wakali wafwa kale, aboobo tebakamutyola pe mawulu akwe.
Nikuba obo, umwi wabasilumamba wakamuyasa limwi bbazu esumu, mpawo kwakazwa iganzi amaanzi.
Ooyo wakabona eechi wakaamba bukamboni, abukamboni bwakwe mbwakasimpe. Ulizi kuti nzyawamba ninchobeni kuchitila kuti anduwe usyome.
Nkambo eezi zintu zyakachitika kuchitila kuzuzikizya malembe, ''Takwe nikuba limwi fuwa lyakwe litakatyolwe.''
Alubo, aamwi malembe aamba kuti, ''Bayolanga kulinguwe ooyo ngubakayasa.''

Nikwakamana ezi zintu, Josefa waku Alimatiya mbuli kuti wakali sikwiiya ( pesi mukusisikizya akuyoowa baJuda) wakakukumbila kuli Pilato kuti atoole mubili waJesu, Pilato wakamuzumizya. Aboobo Josefa wakaboola akuutola mubili waJesu.
Nikkodimasi alakwe wakasika, nguwe wakazide kutangna kuli Jesu mansiku. Wakeeta tununkilizyo tuvwelene twamuula atwatyati, mweelwe wamuyanda umwi wampondo.
Mpawo bakatola mubili wa Jesu bawuvungilizya zisani zituba atununkilizyo mbuli muchaanza chaba maJuda kukuvwikka mubili.
Lino mubusena mwakabambwidwe kwakali chilili, omu muchilili mwakali kabanda kakatalina kulazikwa muntu naba umwi pe.
Nkambo kakuti lyakali izuba lyakuli bambilila lyabama Juda alimwi akambo kakuti kabanda kakali afwifwi, bakamulazika mumo Jesu.
Lino chifumo mubuzuba butaanzi bwamviki, nkakuchisiya, Meli Magadalina wakaza kuchuumbwe alimwi wakabona ibbwe kalikkunkulisigilwe kuzwa kuchuumbwe.
Akaako wakachijaana alimwi wasika kuli Sayimoni Pita a kuli bamwi basikwiiya aabo Jesu mbakali kuyanda, alimwi wabaambila wati, ''Bamubweza Mwaami kuzwa muchuumbwe, alimwi tatuzi nkubamulazika.''
Mpawo Pita abamwi basikwiiya bakazwa, alimwi bakaya kuchuumbwe.
Aantomwe bakachijaana, alimwi umwi sikwiiya wakachijaanisya kwiinda Pita akusika kuchuumbwe lutaanzi.
Lino wakalangisisya aansi, wakabona mulembo wazizwaato zyakwe kazilede aawo, pesi takanjila pe mukati.
Sayimoni Pita lino wakasika kunembo lyakwe alimwi wanjila muchuumbwe. Wakabona chilembo chachizwato  kachiyalidwe awo,
achilembo chakali aatala amuutwe wakwe. Techakayalidwe aamwi azilembo zimwi pesi chakalivungidwe mubusena bwacho achilike.
Lino umwi sikwiiya, ooyo wakatanguna kusika kuchuumbwe, alakwe wakasika wanjila muchuumbwe, alimwi wakabona aalimwi wasyoma.
Nkaambo kusikila kuchiindi eecho tebakalinaaziba malembe aamba kuti uzobuka kuzwa kubafu.
Akaako basikwiiya bakabweeda kumunzi lubo.
Pesi Meli wakaliimvwi aanze aachuumbwe. Nkachilila, wakalangisisya aansi muchuumbwe.
Wakabona bobilwe bangelo muzituba balikkede, umwi kumutwe, alimwi umwi kumawulu aawo mubili wa Jesu mpuwakalede.
Bakati kulinguwe, ''Yo mwanakazi, ulilaanzi?'' Wakati kulimbabo, Nkaambo babweza Mwaami wangu, alimwi tandizi pe kuti bamubika kuli.''
Nakaamba eechi, wakachebuka alimwi wabona Jesu kayimvwi aawo, pesi takaziba pe kuti ngu Jesu.
Jesu wakamwaambila, ''Yo mwanakazi ulilaanzi? Ngwani ngolanguula?'' Wakayeya kuti ngu sichilili. akaako wakati kulinguwe, ''Yo mwaalumi, na wamubweza, ndaambile nkuwamubika, alimwi ndiyomubweza.''
Jesu wakati kulinguwe, ''Meli.'' Wakachebuka, alimwi wati kulinguwe muchi Alamayiki, ''Labboni,'' (chitolekelwa kuti: ''Muyiisi.'')

Jesu wakati kulinguwe, ''Utandijati, nsinayinka kujulu kuli Taata, pesi inka kubakkulana  bangu alimwi ubaambile kuti ndiyobwiinka kujulu kuli Taata wangu a Taata wenu, alimwi Leza wangu a Leza wenu.''
Meli Magadalina wakasika alimwi waambila basikwiiya , 'Ndamubona Mwaami,'' alimwi azintu nzyaakamwaambila.

Nikwakaba goko, mubuzuba oobo, izuba taanzi lya mviki, alimwi amakkoma aakooko basikwiiya nkubakabede, akalijalidwe mukuyoywa ba Juda, Jesu wakasika alimwi wiima aakati kabo wasikwaamba kuti, '''Luumuno kulindinywe.''
Nakamana kwaamba eezi, wakabatondezya maboko aakwe a bbazu lyakwe. Mpawo basikwiiya nibakabona Mwaami, bakabotelwa.
Jesu lino wakabaambila alubo, Luumuno kulindinywe. Mbuli Taata mbwakandituma, lino ndili kumutuma.''
Aawo Jesu naakaamba eezi, wayoyela aalimbabo alimwi wasikuti kulimbabo, ''Mutambule Muuya Uusalala.
Kufumbwa chibi chani nchimuyolekelela, ngachalekelelwa; kufumbwa ngumubweedezezya chibi, ngazyabweedezegwa.''
Tomasi, umwi wenkamu yabalikkumi ababili, utegwa Didimasi, takali aantomwe pe abamwi aawo Jesu naakasika.

Bamwi basikwiiya nikwakiinda chiindi bakati kulinguwe, ''Twamubona Mwaami.'' Wakabaambila kuti, '''Ado ndabona mumaboko aakwe impa zya zipikili, alimwi ndibike munwe mukati ke mpa zya zipikili, akubika luboko lwangu mubbazu lyakwe, nsikoyoosyoma.''

Nikwakayinda mazuba ali musani aatatu basikwiiya bakwe bakali mukati alubo, alimwi Tomasi wakali aakati kabo. Jesu wakanjila aawo makkoma kaajalidwe, alimwi wiimikila akati kabo, wati, ''Luumuno kulindinywe.''
Lino wakati kuli Tomasi, ''Seyomeka munwe wako, alimwi ubone maboko aangu, sikila amunwe wako, alimwi ubike mumampango aangu, utabi uutasyomi, pesi syoma.''
Tomasi wakasandula alimwi wakati kulinguwe, ''Mwaami wangu a Leza wangu.''
Jesu wakati kulinguwe, ''Nkaambo wandibona, wasyoma. Balilongezegelwe batanaabona, alimwi basyoma.''
Lino Jesu wakachita zitondezyo zyiingi kunembo lya basikwiiya, zitondezyo zyakatalembwa pe mumagwalo,
pesi eezi zyakalembwa kuti tusyome kuti Jesu ngu Kkilisito, Mwana wa Leza, alimwi mukusyoma, ube aabuumi muzina lyakwe.
Nikwakayinda eezi zintu Jesu wakaliyubununa lwakwe mwini alubo kuli basikwiiya bakwe ku lwizi lwa ku Tibbaliyasi. Oobu mbombubo mbwakaliyubununa lwakwe mwini.
Sayimoni Pita wakali aantomwe a Tomasi uutegwa Didimasi, Nataniel uuzwa ku Kkana mu Galili, ibana ba Zebbedi, alimwi ababili basikwiiya ba Jesu.
Sayimoni Pita wakati kulimbabo, ''Ndiyobuya ku kuloba.'' Bakati kulinguwe, ''Aswebo, tuyobwiinka anduwe.'' Bakiinka alimwi banjila mubwaato, pesi  takwe nchibakajata busiku boonse.
Lino, nkakuli kwa chifumofumo, Jesu wakaliimvwi kunkomwe yalwizi, pesi basikwiiya tebakaziba pe kuti wakali Jesu.
Akaako Jesu wakati kulimbabo, ''Yo balombwana, muli aachakulya na?'' Bakamusandula, ''Tatukwe.''

Wakati kulimbabo, ''Kamuwaala bunsabwe bwenu kubbazu lyalulyo lwa bwaato, alimwi muyoojana zimwi.'' Akaako bakawaala bunsabwe bwabo, pesi tebakakonzya pe kubukwelela mukati akaambo kakuvulisya kwe nswi.

Alimwi sikwiiya Jesu ngwakali kuyandisya kapati wakati kuli Pita, ''Ngu Mwaami.''Aawo Sayimoni Pita naakamvwa kuti Mwaami, wakadelula chisamo chakwe chaanze (nkaambo wakali maya), alimwi waliwaalila mulwizi.
Bamwi basikwiiya bakaza mubwaato (tebakali kule pe kuzwa anyika, mbuli myaanda yobile yatukkokola kuzwa aawo), alimwi bakayobukkwela bunsabwe buzwide nswi.
Aawo nibakazwa aanze aatala anyika, bakabona makkala aamulilo nkakulazikidwe muswi aatala lyawo achinkwa.
Jesu wakati kulimbabo, ''Mweete zimwi nswi nzimwajata.''
Sayimoni Pita wakayinka aajulu akukkwela bunsabwe aanyika, kakuzwide baswi ba pati, mwaanda omwe amakkumi musamu aatatu mbuzyakabede, pesi nikuba kuti zyakali nyingi, bunsabwe tebwakadeluka pe.
Jesu wakati kulimbabo, ''Kamuza akulya chilyo chachifumo.'' Takwe aakati kabasikwiiya wakayanda kumubuzya kuti, ''Nduweni?'' Bakali zizi kuti ngu Mwaami.
Jesu wakaza wabweza chinkwa, alimwi wachipa kulimbabo, a nswi azilazyo.
Oolu lwakali lwatatu Jesu kali kuliyubununa mwini kuli basikwiiya musule aakubuka kwakwe kuzwa kubafu.

Nebakamana kulya chilyo chachifumo, Jesu wakati kuli Sayimoni Pita, ''Sayimoni mwana wa Joni, ulandiyanda na kwiinda eezi?'' Pita wakati kulinguwe, ''Iyi Mwaami wangu, ulizi kuti ndilakuyanda.'' Jesu wakati kulinguwe, '''Sanina mbelele zyangu.''
Wakati kulinguwe lwabili, ''Sayimoni mwana wa Joni, ulandiyanda na?'' Pita wakati kulinguwe, ''Iyi Mwaami wangu, ulizi kuti ndilakuyanda.'' Jesu wakati kulinguwe, ''Bamba mbelele zyangu.''

Wakati kulinguwe lwatatu, ''Sayimoni mwana wa Joni, ulandiyanda na?'' Pita wakali wanyema nkaambo Jesu wakali wamubuzya lwatatu, ''Ulandiyanda na?'' Wakati kulinguwe, ''Mwaami, ulizizi zyoonse eezi zintu, ulizi kuti ndakuyanda.'' Jesu wakati kulinguwe, ''Sanina mbelele zyangu.

Nchobeni, nchobeni, ndakwaambila, niwakachili muniini, wakalikulizwaatika akweenda kufumbwa nkuwakali kuyanda, pesi niwakkomena, uyootandabika maboko aako, alimwi umwi uyookuzwatika a kukubweza kukutola nkotayandi kwiinka.''
Lino Jesu wakachaamba eechi kuchitila musyobo walufu Pita ngwatakalemeke Leza. Nakamana kwaamba eechi, wakati kuli Pita, ''Nditobele.''
Pita wakachebuka alimwi wabona sikwiiya ooyo Jesu ngwakali kuyandisya nkayoobubatobela, ooyo wakali aafwifwi kubbazu lya Jesu kuchiindi cha chilalilo alimwi wakati, ''Mwaami, utakakuuzye?''
Pita wakamubona akwaambila Jesu, ''Ulachita biyeni mwaalumi ooyu?''
Jesu wakati kulinguwe, ''Na ndayanda kuti akkale kusikila ndaboola, niinzi eecho kulinduwe? Nditobele.''

Lino aaka kaambo kakasaalila kuli babunyina, kuti ooyo sikwiiya takoyoofwa. Pesi Jesu teensi wakateedi kuli Pita kuti ooyo sikwiiya takoyoofwa , pesi, ''Na ndayanda kuti ukkale kusikila ndaboola, niinzi eecho kulinduwe?''
Ooyu ngonguwe sikwiiya uupa bukamboni aatala azintu , alimwi iwakalemba zintu eezi, alimwi tulizi kuti bukamboni bwakwe mbwanchoonzyo.
Kuli zintu zyiingi alubo Jesu nzyakachita. Na chimwi achimwi chakalembwa aansi, ndibona kuti niiba nyika lwayo teyalikunokonzya pe kubamba magwalo anoli alembwa.
Kwaakali mwaalumi munyika ya uzi wakalikutegwa Jobbu : alimwi Jobbu taakali achibi pe wakali luleme , umwi ooyo wakali kuyowa Leza wakasanduka kuzwa kububi.
Kwakali zyedwe kuli nguwe baana balombe bali musanu ababili abasimbi batatu.

Wakali ambelele zyuuli zili musanu azibili, zyuulu zitatu zyambongolo,zipani myaanda musanu zyabasune, amadonki myaanda musanu alimwi abalanda bapati biingi. Wakali mwalumi mupati loko kubantu boonse bakujwe.
Kuzuba alimwi lyakutumwa kwamwana mulombe, wakali kubapa pobwe mung'anda yakwe. Bakali kutumwa akwita bachizi batatu kuti bazolye akunywa kulimbabo.

Mazuba apobwe nakamana, Jobbu wakali kubatumizya akubasalazya. Wakali kubuka kuseni loko akupa chipayizyo chuumpidwe chamusanu awumwi chamwana wakwe nkaambo wakali kwamba kuti,''Chilakonzya kuti nchiimwi chiindi baana bangu babisya akutukila Leza mumyooyo yabo,'Jobbu wakali kuchita eezi chiindi choonse.
Mpawo lyakali izuba eelyo bana baLeza bakaza kukulitula beni kunembo lyaJehova. Satan alakwe wakeza ambabo.
Jehova wakati kuli satan,'Nkukuli ooku nkuwazwida?' Mpawo satan wakasandula Jehova akwamba kuti,'Ndazwa akwendenda anyika,kuza akubweda musule akunembo aalinjiyo.''
Jehova wakati kuli satan, wamulaanga na Jobbu mulanda wangu? Nkaambo takwe pe uuli mbuli nguwe anyika,utakwe chibi alimwi mwaalumi ululeme,uumwi ooyo uyowa Leza alimwi usandukide kuzwa kububi.''
Mpawo satani wakasandula Jehova akwaamba kuti,''Ulamuyowa na Jobbu Leza kuti kaatakwe kaambo?

Taakwe nwaamubikkila chikachizyo na chimuzyungulukide ng'anda yakwe, achizyungulukide zyoonse eezyo zyakwe kuzwida kumabbazu  woonse? Wakalongezya milimu yamaanza aakwe ,alimwi zivubwa zyakwe zyakazuzya inyika yoonse.
Lino tandabika jaanza lyako ugume zyoonse nzyaali aazyo, alimwi ubone naa takwe natakutukile kumeso aako.''
Jehova wakati kuli satani,''Boona zyoonse eezyo nzyali aazyo zili mujaanza lyako.Alinguwe mwini tatandabiki pe jaanza lyako aalinguwe,'''Mpawo satani wakeenda wazwa kuzwa kubuliwo bwaJehova.
Chakasika chiindi muli limwi zuba, baana bakwe balombe abasimbi bakali kulya akunywa wayini mung'anda yamukulana wabo mupati.
Mutumwa wakasika kuli Jobbu akwamba kuti,''Basune bali kulima alimwi madonki ali kuchela kumbali lyabo.
Mpawo basebbiya bakawida alimbabo alimwi akubatola kuule. Mbuuli kubalanda bakabawumya aambali lyapanga. Ime andikke ndime nindachala kuti nkubuzye.''
Naakachili kwambula umwi wakasika lubo akwamba kuti,''Mulilo waJehova waawa kuzwa kumajulu akuumpa imbeelele abalanda.Ime andikke ndime nindachaala kuti nkubuzye.

Naakachili kwambula, umwi wakasika lubo akwaamba kuti,''Bachalidiya bakabaamba inkamu zitatu, balwisya mbongolo alimwi bazitola kuule.Mbuli kubalanda,babaawumya aambali lyapanga.Imebo andikke ndime ndachala kuti nkubuzye.''
Naakachili kwaambula mpawo uumbi wakasika lubo akwaamba kuti,''Baana bako balombe abasimbi balikulya akunywa wayini mung'anda yamukulana wabo mupati.
Luuwo luulanguzu lwakasika kuzwa kunkanda akuuma zyooko zine zyang'anda. Yakawida abantu baniini,alimwi bakafwa. Ime ndime andikke nindachaala kuti nkubuzye.''
Mpawo  Jobbu wakabuka wadeluula chikobeela chakwe wapaala mutwe wakwe, walaala busyu bakwe kabulangide aansi, alimwi kalokukomba Leza.
Wakati, ''Ndakaali meeya eelyo nindakazwa aanze  kuzwa mwinda lyabaama, alimwi ndiyooba meeya ndayobweda nkuko. Nguwe nguJehova wakapa, alimwi nguJehova unyanzya .Izina lyaJehova ngalilongezegwe,
''Muuli zyoonse nkani eezi Jobbu taakwe nakabisya pe nikuba kutukila Leza akupa Leza mulandu.
Mpawo lyakali zuba elyo bana balombe ba Leza nibakeza kuzolibonia kuli Jehova. Satani alakwe wakeza kuzolibonia kunembo lya Jehova.
Jehova wakati kuli Satani, ''Wazwida kuli webo?'' Mpawo Satani wakasandula Jehova akuti, ''Ndazwa kukwendeenda anyika, kuzwa kukwenda musule akunembo alinjiyo

Jehova wakati kuli Satani, ''Wamubona na mulanda wangu Jobbu? Nkambo takukwe umwi ulimbuli nguwe anyika, mwalumi utakwe kampenda ululeme, umwi uyoowa Leza akuchija chibi. Uchendelela kukujatilila kusyomeka kwakwe, nikuba kuti wakandileesya kulwisyania anguwe, kukumunyonyoona katakwe kaambo.''
Satani wakasandula Jehova akuti, 'Lukanda kulukanda, nchobeni; muntu ulakupa zyonse nzyalazyo akambo kabuumi bwakwe.
Pesi tandabika janza lyako lino akuguma mafuwa akwe anyama yakwe, alimwi bona naa takutukili kubusyu bwako.''
Jehova wakati kuli Satani, ''Bona, ulimujanza lyako; mbuumi bwakwe luzutu mbutelede kuguma.''
Mpawo Satani wakazwa kunembo lya Jehova. Wakawuma Jobbu azilonda zyuumpa zyuma loko kuzwa kundyato zyamawulu akwe kusika kumutwe wakwe.
Jobbu wakabweza chimpanzi chalukaye kulikwazya anchicho, alimwi wakakkala aansi akati kadyota.
Mpawo mwanakazi wakwe wakati kulinguwe, ''Uchijatilide na kulusyomo lwako? Tukila Leza alimwi ufwe.''
Pesi mbuli mwanakazi mufubafuba mbwaambula. Tukatambule zibotu kuzwa kuli Leza akutatambula zibi na?'' Mumakani woonse aya, Jobbu takabisya amulomo wakwe.

Lino elyo benzinyina a Jobbu batatu nibakamvwa aabubi bonse obu bwakali bwawida alinguwe, awumwi wabo wakeza kuzwa kubusena bwakwe: Elifazi mu Temani, Bbilidadi mu Suhiti, a Zofa mu Namatiti. Bakabamba chiindi chakuza kuzolila anguwe akumuumbulizya.
Eelyo menso abo kulaale, tebaka muziba pe. Bakanyampula majwi abo akukwila; awumwi wakadelula zyakusama zyakwe akulundumuna lusuko momooya aatala lyamutwe wakwe mwini.
Mpawo bakakkala anguwe aansi kwamazuba alimusanu aabili amansiku ali musanu aabili. Takukwe omwe wakamba jwi kuli nguwe, nkambo bakabona kuti machise akwe akali mapati.
Musule azeezi, Jobo wakasamuna mulomo wakwe akutukila zuba ndyakazyalwa.
Wakati,
''Buzuba mbundakazyalwa ngabufwidilile, mansiku ayo aakati, 'Mulombe watumbukwa.'
Oobo buzuba ngabube mudima! Leza atabi azyakuchita pe ambubo, nuba mumuni utakabali mulindilyo.
Mudma antomwe amwenzule walufu ngaziliyande libe lyazyo. Akube kuti chiyoba chipone ajulu lyalyo; azyonse zichitya kuti izuba lisiye chakasimpe ngazilipenzye.
Kwamba busiku oobo, mayoba asiya mbii kabutola. Akube kuti litakondwi akati kamazuba amumunyaka oyo; litakasiki mumweelwe wamyeezi.
Langa, obo busiku ngiibe ngomwa; kutakazwi niliba jwi lyalukondo mulindilyo.
Ngabatukile zuba eelyo, aabo bakonzya kubusya Levitani. Akube kuti nyenyeezi zyakumabbililo zisiye.
Elyo zuba ngalikalanguule mumuni, pesi litakuujani; nekuba kuyobona zikowe zyabunsi oobo,
nkaambo lyakakachilwa kujala milyango yezyalilo lyabaama, alimwi telyakakonzya kundisisila mapenzi mumenso aangu.
Nkaambonzi nindakatafwa bunsi oobo nindakazwa muzyalilo lyabaama? Nkaambonzi nindakatapeda muuya wangu buunsi obo baama nibakandizyala?
Nkaamboonzi mawulu aabo nakanditambula? Nkaamboonzi inkolo zyabo nizyakandibukulusya kuti nyonke?
Nkaambo kwalino nenga ndilede zwangu chumunizi. Nekunga ndilede nkelyumuzizye antomwe
abaami abendelezi baanyika, aabo bakaliyakila tubanda twabo ooto twakaba mumatongo kwaino.
Nakuti nikunga ndilede abana babaami aabo bakali angolide, aabo bakazuzizye maanda aabo ansiliva.
Nakuti chimwi chindi nikunga nkeyandotumbukwa akufwa mpawo, mbuli bana bavwanda abo bakatabona mumuni wazuba.
Ooko basizibi nkubamana mumapenzi; ooko bakatede nkubalokulyokezya.
Ooko baane nkubalyiibide antoomwe zwabo; takwe pe anibamvwa ijwi lyasikwenzya bazike.
Bonse baniini abapati nkobabede; mulanda nkwawangunukide kuli simalelo wakwe.
Nkaambonzi mumuni nuupegwa kulooyo ulimukuusa? Nkaamboonzi buumi nibupegwa kulooyo usululwa mumuuya,
kulooyo ulakwizya lufu kalutamusikili pe; kuli ooyo usyalufu kwinda usya lubono lusisidwe?
Nkaambonzi mumuni nupegwa kuli yooyo ukondwa kwindilide alimwi ulabotelwa naajana kabanda?
Nkaambonzi mumuni nuupegwa kumuntu ulanzila zisisidwe, oyo muntu Leza ngwazyungulukide mulubaya?
Nkaambo kulakwizya kwangu kulachitika kwinda kulya; kukuluma kwangu kulatilwa mbuli manzi.
Nkaambo chintu nchindakali kuyoowa chandisikila; echo nchindakali kuyoowa chazosika alindime.
Takwepe nenkalwa moyo, nyumwide nee, alimwi nsikwe kulyokezya pe; anukuti mapenzi ngandisikila.''
Mpowo Elifazi mu Temanete wakasandula akuti,
na umwi weezya kuti awambule anduwe, sa uyoba utalindili? Pesi ngwani ukonzya kukwambula?
Bona, wakalayilila biingi; wakasimya batete maboko.
Majwi ako akagwasizya kufumbwa wakali kuwa; wakasimya kuteketa kwamazwi.
Pesi lino mapenzi asika kulinduwe , alimwi ulongedwe; zyakujata webo; alimwi wapengana.
Teensi kuyowa kwako  teensi kusyoma kwako, anzila yakusyomeka kwako bwabulangilizi bwako?
Yeeya ataala azezi, wenche :Ngwani wakanyonyonwa elyo katakwe katakwe mulandu? Na mbaani bantu  baluleme bakajayigwa?
Mbuli mbondakabona, abo basyanga bubi alimwi babyala  mapenzi balatebula  mbubo.
Akuyoya kwa Leza balafwa; abukali bwakwe balaligwa.
Kuvuluma kwamulavu; ijwi lyamulavu uyoosya, menyo abana baba lavu - alatyoka.
Balavu bachembede balafwa nkaambo kakubula zyakujatwa; bana bamulavu muzyazi balamwayisigwa koonse koonse.
Lino amwi majwi akeza chakusisikizya kuli ndime, alimwi kutwi kwangu kwakatambula kuvwiyavwiya kwalyo.
Mpawo kwakasika mumiyeyo kuzwa kuzilengano  mansiku, eelyo ngozi mpati niziwida bantu.
Kwakali mansiku eelyo kuyowa akukankama nekwakaba ataala alindime, alimwi woonse mafuwa angu akateketa.
Mpawo muuya wakiinda kunembo lyabusyu bwangu, alimwi isusu lyanyama yangu lyakanyanyamuka.
Awo muuya wakiima nji, pesi takwe pe nendakawuziba chiimo chawo. Chiimo chakali kunembo lyameso angu; kwakalikumuna, alimwi ndakamvwa ijwi kalyamba kuti,
'''sena muntu ufwika nga ulalulama kwiinda Leza? sena muntu ulasalalisya kwiinda mulengi wakwe?
Laanga, na Leza tabiki  kusyoma kubalanda bakwe ; na ulapa mulandu kubangelo bakwe bafubafuba,
uyeeyanzi  loko kuti  kuti nisimpe kuli abo bakala mumanda abulongo, njiyani intalisyo ilimuvu,bapwayika mbuli pempe?
Akati kachifumo golezya balanyonyonwa; balafwidilila kwalyoonse katakwe naba omwe ubayeya limbi.
Tazili ntambo zyakadunsulwa akati kabo?Balafwa; balafwa kabatakwe busongo.
Lino koyita; kuli uumwi na uutakakuvwiile? Kuli iili uusalala nguyootobela?
Nkaambo kunyema kujaya mwaalumi chifubafuba; bbivwe lijaya chimpulungwe.
Ndakabona mntu chifubafuba kasimpa miyanda, pesi ndakatuka muunzzi wakwe chakufwambaana.
Bana bakwe bali kule akukwabililwa; balipwayawidwe kumulyango wadolopo. Takwe naba womwe sikubavuna.
Basinzala balalya butebuzi bwabo; balabubweza nikuba kuzwa aakati kamwaamvwa. Basinyota bayoofwekembula buvubi bwabo.
Nkaambo buyumuyumu tabuzwi aanze pe mumuseele; nikuba mapenzi taameni kuzwa aantundubwi.
Pesi muntu uzyalilwa mapenzi, mbuli nsasi mbiyuulukila kujulu.
Pesi ndiyoosandukila kuli Jehova lwakwe; kulinguwe ndiyoobika kaambo kangu -
ooyo uuchita zintu zipati zitafunkulukiki, zintu zibotu zitabaliki.
Ulanda mvula munyika, akutuma maanzi mumyuunda.
Uchita eezi kuti atansike aajulu aabo bali aansi; kubanyampula akubakwabilila aabo balila.
Ulamwaya mabambe aabantu bazi milimu ya maboko, kuti maanza aatakonzyi kuchiti chizwidilila.
Ulacha basongo mumilimu yanchito zyamaboko aabo; mabambe aabantu banyongene alafwambanisigwa kusisigwa kumamanino aabo.
Balaswaanana amudima zuba kalibala, akuumpulika sikati aanga mansiku.
Pesi ulavuna muntu muchete kuzwa kupanga kumilomo yabo, awubula kuzwa kujaanza lyabantu bali aanguzu.
Aboobo muntu uufwaba uli aabulangilizi, alimwi bataluleme balamuumuzya.
Langa, ulilongezegelwe ooyo Leza ngwazyotolola; aboobo utanyansyi kululamikwa a Singuzuzyoonse.
Nkaambo ulayasa mpawo waponia; ulayasa mpawo maboko aakwe alaponia.
Uyookuvuna kuzwa mumapenzi aali musanu alimwi; nchoonzyo, mumapenzi ali musanu aabili, takwe bubi buyookuguma pe.
Munzala uyokuvuna kuzwa kulufu, amunkondo kuzwa kumaboko aapanga.
Uyoosisikana kuzwa kung'ondo yalulimi; alimwi tokoyooyowa lunyonyooko nilusika.
Lunyonyooko a bbalangwe uyooziseka. Tokoyoyoowa banyama bamusokwe.
Nkaambo uyooba aachizuminano amabwe aali mumuunda wako, abanyama bamusokwe bayooba a luumuno anduwe.
Uyoziba kuti tente lyako lilikwabililidwe; uyoswaya mbelele zyanko alimwi takwe nchotakabule pe.
Uyooziba lubo kuti mbuto yako iyooba mpati, kuti lunyungu lwako luyooba mbuli masokwe aanyika.
Uyoosika kukabanda kako muminyaka iizulide, mbuli chilwi chamisunta yazilyo eecho chiinka kujulu muchiindi chayo.
Bona, twayilangisisya nkani eeyi; ili mbuboobu; iswiilile alimwi uyizibe.''
Eelyo Jobbu wakasandula akwamba kuti,
''Akaka, kansinga machise angu akeelwa biyo; Kansinga penzi pati lyangu lyalikkwa achipimyo!
Kwalino lyayinoba lilema kwinda seele lyamundwizi. Nchinchicho majwi angu akali abiyo.
Nkambo tuunta twamupati kampatila tuli muli ndime, muuya wangu ulanywa buyoka; kukwila kwa Leza kwakalibamba kakutobelezyaana atala andime.
Ndonki yamulusaka inga ilalila chakubulikwa bulangizi na kakuli kuti lilabwizu? Naa kuti musune unga ulalila munzala na kakuli kuti ulachakulya?
Eecho chitanoni inga chilaligwa na kachitakwe mwinyo? Nakuti kuli bunono na mubutuba bwa jii?
Ndakakaaka kubaguma; balimbuli kulya kusesemya kulindime.
Akaaka, kuti ndibe achikumbizyo changu; akaaka, kuti Leza uyondipa chintu nchiyandula:
kuti chikabotezye Lezakukupwayulwabiyo, kuti akangunune janza lyakwe akundinunsula kuzwa kubunini oobu!
Eechi aboobo ngachibe chuumuzyo chaangu - nikuba ndilakondwa kumachise aayo aatacheyi: eecho nsikakakide majwi awu Salala Uumwi.
Niinzi nguzu zyangu, kuti ndikeezye kulinda? Niinzi majinkilo aangu, kuti ndikalampye buumi bwangu?
Inguzu zyangu ninguzu zyamabwe na? Naa kuti nyama ninguzu ibumbidwe amukuba na?
Teensi nchoonzyo na kuti tandikwe lugwasyo mulindime, akuti busongo bwakagusigwa kuzwa mulindime?
Muntu wamba kufwa, busyomesi bwelede kutondezegwa amwenzinyina; nekuba kuliyooyo utakaakata benjofu bwasinguzu zyoonse.
Pesi bakwesu bakalisyomekede kuli ndime mbuli mufolo wamunkanda,
mbuli kalonga kamanzi ako kayinda chabuyo, ikakasizigwa ampeyo aatala angawo, alimwi nkambo kaluume lwakalibumba lyakaliyuika mulimbabo.
Nilyakayaaya lilamwayika; na kulapya, lulayeemuka kuzwa abusena bwabo.
Mpuumba ezyo zyeenda munzila zipaambukila manzi; balatuntulika munyikaitagwisyi chintu mpawo balafwa.
Mpuumba zyaku Tema zyakalanga nkuko, kakuli kuti inkamu zyaku Syebba kazili abulangizi muli nzizyo.
Bakabijilwa nkambo bali syomede kuti balajana meenda. Bakeenda nkuko, pesi bakeenwa.
Kwalino nywebo benzuma muli chintu biyo kuli ndime; mulabona bube bwangu buyoosya mpawo mwayoowa.
Kuli nindakaamba kuti naa kuli ndinywe, ''Mundipe chintu  nakundipa chipo kuzwa kubuvubi bwanu'
na, 'Mundivune kuzwa kujanza lyasinkondoma' naa, kundidyamizya kujanza lyabadyaamizyi'?
Ndiyiisye, alimwi ndiyojata luumuno lwangu; ndichite ndimvwisisye mpondakabisya.
Achisa biyeni majwi alusinizyo! Pesi inkazyanio zyanu, zindichibula biyeni?
Mubamba kunyansya majwi angu na, kobweza majwi amuntu wabulikilwa luuwo?
Nchoonzyo, mulawuma nkakata kumwana utakwe wisi, akukazyania amwenzinyokwe mbuli chakusambala.
Nkiinkako, lino, akaka mulange kuli ndime, nkambo kasimpe nsikonzyi kubeja kubusyu bwenu.
Muleke, ndamukombelezya; kutabi kutalulama andinywe; Nchoonzyo nkambo kwiita kwangu kuliluleme. Kuli bubi na alulimi lwangu?
Sena mulomo wangu tukoonga ulamvwa zitalikabotu na?
Sena muntu tajisi mulimu muyumu aanyika? Mazuba aakwe taalimbuli amuntu uupedwe mulimu?
Mbuli muzike mbwayandisya loko mweenzule yagoko, mbuli mwaalumi similimu mbwayanduula mbadalao yakwe -
alimwi ndachitwa kuti ndikakatile myeezi yamapenzi; ndakapegwa mansiku aazwide mapenzi .
Eelyo nilala aansi, ndaamba kulindime, 'Ndiilili nindiyoobuka alimwi ndiilili busiku nibukateende?' Ndilizwide kuwalwawalwa kuya akuza mane do kubuchedo bwabuzuba.
Nyama yangu ilizwatikidwe mayoka alimwi amavwinga aalusuko; zilonda mukanda lyamubili wangu alimwi mpawo zilayaya alimwi zilatalika bupya.
Mazuba aangu alafwaambaana kwiinda kwiinda cheenzyo chasikuluka; ziliinda kazitakwe bulangilizi.
Leza, koyeya kuti buumi bwangu nduyoyo buyo; liso lyangu talikuyobona bubotu limbi.
Liso lyaLeza, undibona, talikoyondibona limbi; Meso aaLeza ayooba aalindime, pesi tandikonoliwo pe.
Mbuli  joba mbuli lyigwa akumwayika, aboobo ooyo winka aansi mukabanda takoyofumpuka limbi.
Takoyoboola limbi kung'anda yakwe; nikuba kuti busena bwakwe kuyoomuziba limbi.
Aboobo nsikoyoolingulula mulomo wangu; njoowambuula amachise aamumoyo wangu; njootamawuka mukulula kwamoyo wangu.
Sena ndililwizi naa chiyoosyo chamulwizi eecho nchomubika kuti chindilinde .
Eelyo nindaamba kuti kuti, 'Bulo bwangu buyoondumbulizya alimwi chuuno changu chiyoomana kunyontawuka kwangu ,'
mpawo ulandiyoosya amalota alimwi alandikonga kwiinda muzilengano,
aboobo kuti ndalikunosala kusinwa akufwa kwiinda kubamba aaya mafuwa aangu.
ndasula buumi bwangu; teendachili kuyanda kuba muumi lyoonse; amundileke andike nkaambo mazuba aangu ngabuyo.
Niinzi muntu chakuti weelede kumuswiilila, chakuti welede kubika miyeeyo yako aalinguwe,
chakuti weelede kumulingulula kuseni koonse, alimwi umusunke chiindi choonse.
Chiyolampa byeeni chiindi kuzwa nutakabule kundilanga, kuzwa  notakabule kundilanga  chiindi cheelela kuti ndimene mate aangu?
Ndikuba kuti ndabisya, chiyoochitaanzi echi kulinduwe, iwe nuulanga  bantu? Nkamboonzi nuwachita chilangilio kulindime, kuti ndibe mukuli kulinduwe.
Nkamboonzi nutalekeleli milandu yangu alimwi akugwisya chibi changu? Nkaambo lino sena ndiyolala aansi mulusuko; uyondiyanduula chakuchenjela pesi nsikonoochiboneka.''
Mpawo Bbilidadi muSyuhayi wakasandula wati,
Kuyooba chiindi chilamfu biyeni kolikwaamba zintu eezi? Kuyooba chiindi chilamfu biyeni majwi aamulomo wako natakabe luuwo lupati?
Sa Leza ulalesya lubeteko? Sa Singuzuzyoonse ulalesya basalali?
Bana benu bakamubisizya; tulizizi eezi nkaambo wakabapa mukuboka kwazibi zyabo.
Pesi kakulikuti mwakamuyanduulisisya Leza akwaamba nkumbizyo zyako kuliSinguzuzyoonse.
Na kamusalala akwiima nji, mpawo uyolikopa lwakwe mwini kukwiiminina nduwe akukubweedezya kubusena bwako bweelede.
Nikuba kuti matalikiloaako akali maniini, kale mamanino aako ayooba mapati.
Nchekaka kobuzya kumazyalani, alimwi udunamine kuli eecho masyanene nchibakayiya.
(Twakazyalwa jilo alimwi tatuzi nchitu munyika nkaambo mazuba eesu munyika mweenzule.)
Tabakoyookuyisya na akukwaambila? Tabakoyowamaba na majwi kuzwa mumyoyo yabo?
Kujana papulasi yajanika na aatakwe chisiko? Kujana tete lyakomena kakutakwe manzi?
Aawo naachili kamweemvwe alimwi nkatanaatemwa pe, alaswaba kunembo lyayi wi misamu.
Aboobo lubo ninzila zyabo boonse baluba Leza; bulangizi bwabatakwe tuleza luyonyonyooka.
Chiyandisyo chakwe chiyoomwayika, alimwi lusyomo lwakwe luliwizuukide mbuli luubi.
Useyama kung'anda yakwe, pesi tikoyomugwasya pe; uyoyijatilila pesi tikoyoyima pe.
Munsi lyazuba ngukamweemvwe, alimwi miyanda yakwe ileendelela muchilili chakwe choonse.
Miyanda yakwe ilaangidwe mbuli zilwi chamabwe; balanguula busena bubotu aakati kamabwe.
Pesi kuti ooyu muntu wanyonyoonwa kuzwa kubusena bwakwe, mpawo eeyo nyika iyomukaka akwaamba kuti, 'Takwe nindakakubwene pe.'
Bona, oolu''ndukondo'' lwamiyeeyo yamuntu uuli boobu;  imwi misamu iyosyuuka kuzwa kumuse wamusyobo ooyu mubusena bwakwe.
Bona, Leza takoyootanda muntu utakwe chibi; nikuba kubweza kuboko kwabasimuchita zibi.
Alubo ayoozuzya mulomo wako alusesyo, milomo yako aloompololo.
Aabo bakusula bayozwaatikwa bweeme; tente lyababi talichiyoobi limbi.''
Mpawo Jobbu wakasandula akwamba kuti,
''Ndizi kasimpe kuti eezi mbubo. Pesi biyeni muntu mpanga ulaba mubululami a Leza?
Kuti kayanda kukazyania a Leza, takonzyi pe kumusandula muzyiindi zili chuulu.
Leza musongo mumoyo alimwi mupati kampatila munguzu; Ngwani wakali waliyumya lwakwe aatala anguwe mpawo wazwidilila? --
Nguwe ooyo ugwisya zilundu kaatakwe ngwachenjezya naba umwi muntu eelyo ulazisanduula mukunyema kwakwe--
nguwe oyo ukankamya nyika kuzwa mubusena alimwi akuchitya zyigwasizye kuti zikankame.
Ngonguwe Leza ukozyenie ooyo ubuzya zuba kuti talizwi, alimwi talizwi pe alimwi ooyo uvumba nyenyezi,
Ooyo alikke utalamuna majulu akulyatwida aansi mayuwe amulwizi,
oyo uchita banyama beenda mulongo, ba Oliyoni, anyenyezi inyingi zyakumusanza.
Uchita zintu zipati zitatobezeki, azintu zyiingi zigambya eezyo zitakonzyi kubalika.
Boona, ulenda andime alimwi nsimuboni pe; ulinda alubo pesi nsikonzyi pe kuti mubone.
Kuti watola chintu chimwi kule, ngwaani ukonzya kumwikizya? Ngwani ukonzya kwaamba kuti kuli nguwe, Úchitayi?'
Leza takogwisigwa pe bukali bwakwe; bagwasyi ba Lahabbu bayovundaama munsi lyakwe.
Mubuche buli biyeni mbunkonzya kumusandula, nkonzye na kusalula majwi akwambuula awe?
Nikuba kuti ndali luleme, tendali kukonzya pe kumusandula. Ndali kukumbila luzyalo kupela amubetesi wangu.
Nikuba ndamwita alimwi wandivwila, tendali kuswilizya kujwi lyangu.
Nkambo ulandityola mukunyema kwakwe akuvuzya zilonda zyangu kaatakwe kambo.
Tandizumizye pe kuti mbukulusye kuyooya kwangu; pesi ulandizuzya alunyemo.
Kuti kakuli makani anguzu, Langa, Mupati kampatila! Kuti kakuli makani abubotu , ngwani ukonzya kumwiita?
Nikuba kuti ndiluleme, mulomo wangu uyondisola; alimwi nikuba kuti nsikwe chibi, majwi angu ayondochitya kuti nkabe amulandu.
Nsikwe chibi pe, pesi tandikwe ndaaba pe nikuba lili atala andime; Ndilanyansya buumi bwangu ndemwini.
Tazichiti musiyano pe, nchenchicho nchingamba kuti ulajaya bantu batakwe zibi abalazibi aamwi.
Eelyo moondo wakubajaya achakufwambaana, ulaseka batakkalinkene batakwe mulandu.
Inyika ilipedwe mumaanza aabantu basizibi; Leza ulavumba masyu ababelesi baabo. Kuti kakutali nguwe ooyo uzichita, mpawo ngwani oyo?
Mazuba angu afwambanisya loko kwinda mutumwa uyobuchijana; mazuba aangu aaya kuule; taakwe pe chibotu nchalokubona.
Abakafwambana loko mbuli mateete amaato, aalimwi chakufwambana mbuli igumbe lyulukilaa aansi achakufwambana na kukana kankuku.
Kuti ndaamba kuti ndiyoluba aatala akutongawuka kwangu, kuti njogwisya busyu bwangu bunyemede alimwi nkabotelwe,
Ndiyowaala mapenzi aangu woonse nkambo ndizi kuti tokooyonditola mbuli muntu utakwe chibi.
Ndiyotukilwa; nkamboonzi, Mpawo, nkayezya na chabuyo?
Kuti ndalisanzya amanzi asikunkwe akuchita maboko aangu aasalale kwindilila,
Leza uyondiwala mukalonga, alimwi zisamo zyangu zinoli tazichiyandikani pe kuli ndime.
Nkambo Leza temuntu pe, mbuuli mbumbede, kuti nkonzye kumusandula, kuti tukonzye kuza aamwi kubetekelwa.
Takwe mubetesi pe akkati kesu uunga ulakonzya kubika kuboko kwakwe alindiswe.
Taawope uumbi mubetesi ukonzya kugwisya kaponda kuzwa kulindime, ooyo ukonzya kubamba kuyoowa kupati kuzwa kukundiyoosya.
Mpawo njowambuula akutayomuyowa. Pesi mbuuli mbuzibede zintu lino, nsikonzyi pe kuchita oobo.
Ndachimwa abuumi bwangu; ndiyowamba chakwaangunuka kukaambo kangu; ndiyowamba mukunyema kwamuuya wangu.
Ndiyowamba kuti kuli Leza, ''Utandinyansyi; nditondeezye nchondipeda mulandu.
Sena nchibotu kulinduwe kuti nga ulandipenzya, kulandilangila ansi mulimu wamaanza aako aawo nkoli kulombozya makanze ababi?
Uli aamenso aanyama na? Ulabona na mbuli muntu mbabona?
Mazuba ako ali mbuli mazuba abulengwe bwamuntu na minyaka yako mbuli minyaka yabantu,
kuti ubuzye bubi bwangu akuyanduulisisya aatala achibi changu,
nikuba ulizi kuti tandijisi kaambo alimwi takwe naba womwe uukonzya kundivuna kuzwa kuluboko lwako?
Maboko aako akandichita alimwi andizwatika, nikubaboobo ulikundimwaya.
Koyeeya, ndakukumbila, kuti wakandibumba mbulibulongo; nga ulandileta lubo na mubulongo?
Tonditililide ansi na mbuli malili akundiyumya mbuli chiizi?
Wakandizwaatika chikumba anyama alimwi wandisumina aantomwe amafuwa amilambi.
Wakandipa buumi achizuminano chabusyomesi; lugwasyo lwako lwakabamba muuya wangu.
Nikubaboobo zintu eezi wakalizisiside mumoyo wako - ndilizi kuti nzizyo nziwakali kuyeeya:
kuti nsinga ndakabisya, walikuchibona; tewalikunondilekelela bubi bwangu.
Nsinga ndakachita bubi, mawe kulindime; alimwi nikuba ndakachita bululami, takwe nindali kubusya mutwe, mukuti ndilizuzigilwe amawuse - bona machise angu!
Na mutwe wangu wakabusigwa, walikunondivwima mbuli mulavu; alimwi wali kunolitondeezya lwako mwini azigambyo zyanchito zyanguzu kukulwisya ndime.
Uleeta bakamboni bapya kuzolwisya ndime alimi wayungizya bukali bwako kukulwisya ndime; wandiyubilila abasilumamba bachilimvwa.
Nkaambonzi, mpawo, niwakandeeta anze etumbu? Ngandalombozya kuti anoli ndakagwisya muuya wangu akuti anoli takwe linso lyakandibona pe.
Ndakalikunooba anga tendakali ndabawo pe; ninga ndakabwezegwa kuzwa mutumbu kuya mukabanda.
Sena mazuba angu taali mache biyo? Ima kabi, ndisiye endike, kuti ndikonzye kuba aakulyookezya buniini
nkensinayinka nkwesikonzyi kuboola, kunyika yamudima acheenzule chalufu, nyika eeyo iisiya mbuli aakati kabusiku,
nyika yacheenzule chalufu, kazitakwe mweelwe, ooko mumuni uli mbuli aakati kabusiku.'''
Mpawonya Zofati waku Namati wakayingula wakati,
''Sena makani maanji aali boobu taayandi kwiingulwa? Uyelede kusyomwa na mwalumi ooyu kumakani maanji ngajisi?
Sa kuli kankayizya kwako nkwakuti bamwi bantu bakkale kabuumwide chakubula kaambo? Nuwanyaka, inga kulabulika sikukuusya nsoni?
Nkaambo uwamba kuti kuli Leza,  'Nzesyoma zilasalala, nsikwe kaambo mumenso aako.'
Pesi bona, Leza ulakonzya kwambula chakukulwana;
mukukutondezya nsiswa mubusongo! Nkaambo mupati Leza mukumvwisisisya zintu zintu zyonse. Koziba kuti nziche Leza nzyayandawula kuzwa kuli nduwe kwinda bupati bwamilandu yako.
Nkubona wamu mvwisisisya na Leza mukumuyandawula? Nkubona ulaziba mabelekelo aakwe na mubuzwide?
Aako kambo nkalamfu mbuli julu nkolibede; aboobo nkubona ulachita buti? Kuli nikide kwinda lufu; nkubona ulazibaayi?
Bulamfu bwayo buli mbuli nyika, alimwi bulikwankwamukide kwinda lwizi lupati.
Na wayinda akkati alimwi akujalila umwi mukati, na wayita umwi kulubeta, ngwani unga ulamukasya?
Nkambo ulibazi bantu batali mbibaabo; kuti wabona chibi sena tachizibi?
Pesi bafubafuba tabakwe kumvwisisisya; bazomvwisisisya mbongolo yazozyala muntu.
Pesi tuteedi wapeda moyo wako kububotuakutandabika janza lyako kuli Leza;
tutedi bubi buli mujanza lyako; pesi wabubikka kule anduwe, akulesya kukkazika busofwaazi muchikkalilo chako.
Mpawonya chabwini uyonyampula busyu bwako chakubula buusu; nchobeni, uyoyima chakutayoowa.
Uyoluba koonse kusesemya kwako; uyokuyeeya mbuli kweenda kwamanzi.
Buumi bwako buyomweka kwinda sikati; nekuba kuti kwaba mudima, kuyoba mbuli chifumofumo.
Unokwabililidwe nkambo kuli chilangililo; nchobeni, uyojana lukwabililo kalukuzyungulukide akulyokezya mulindulo.
Alimwi uyolala ansi kuyolyokezya, alimwi tawope uyokuyoosya; nchobeni, banji bayoyandawula luse lwako.
Pesi menso abantu basizibi ayofwidilila; bayobula enzila yakuchijila; bulangizi bwabo bwamagozezyo mbwalufu.''
Mpawo Jobbu wakavwiila akwamba kuti,
''Takwe kudooneka pe ndinywe bantu; busongo buyofwa andinywe.
Pesi ndili akumvwisisisya mbuli ndinywe. Nsili ansi pe kulindinywe. Nchoonzyo, ngwani utazi zintu zili mbuli eezi?
Ndili chintu chakuti mbeyakilene aabo baseke - Ime, muntu wakiita Leza alimwi wamuvwiila! Imebo, mwalumi uululeme alimwi utakwe kampenda kabi - lino ndaba nsesyo.
Mumizezo yawumwi ulyiibide kuli kabi ketelezya kuswekelwa, uyeya munzila iyeta kuswekelwa kwingi kuli aabo bali akuulu kuyadalika.
Zibbakasa zyababbi zilazwidilila, abaaba banyemya Leza balimvwa kabakwabilidwe, maboko aabo beni mbibaba Leza babo.
Pesi kwalino buzya banyama, alimwi balakuyiisya; buzya bayuni bamujulu, alimwi balakwambila.
Kana kuti wambuule aanyika, alimwi ilakuyiisya; baswi bamulwizi bayokulayilila.
Nguuli munyama mukati kabaaba boonse uutazi pe kuti kuboko kwa Jehova nkukwachita
oobu?Mujanza lyakwe mumuli buumi bwachintu choonse chipona amuuya wabantu boonse.
Kutwi takusunki majwi na mbuli bwaasa mbubulabila kulya kwayo?
Mubantu bakachembaala muli busongo; mubulamfu bwamazuba muli kumvwisisisya.
Muli Leza muli busongo abupati; uli akwaambuzya akumvwisisisya.
Boona, ulamwaya, alimwi tachikonzyi pe kuyakwa lubo; kuti wabikka muntu muntolongo, takukonzyi pe kuba lwangunuko.
Boona, kuti wajalila manzi, zilayuminwa akupya; alimwi kuti wabatuma kunze, anga bagambya nyika.
Aalinguwe kuli nguzu abusongo; bantu beneedwe asikubeena boonse bali munguzu zyakwe.
Uuzulwida bambuuzyi kule munsumba zitasamine mukulilila, usandula babetesi baba zifubafuba.
Ugwisya inketani zyabulemu kuzwa kubaami; upopelezya kalembo muzibuno zyabo.
Uuzulwida bapayizi kule ansumba zitasamide mukulilila alimwi uzunda bantu bapati.
Ugwisya majwi abaabo bakali basyomwa alimwi abweza kumvwisisisya kwa bazuluzi.
Utulida kunyansya kubana babaami akwangununa ibbanti lyabantu basimide.
Ulayubununa zintu zinikide zyamumudima akweeta myeenzule inikide kumumuni.
Usimya manyika, alimwi ulamwaya; ulakomezya manyika, alimwi ulabinga lubo mbuli basungwa.
Ulagwisya kumvwisisisya kuzwa kubazuluzi babantu baansi;  ulabachita kuti bapengane munkanda mutakwe nzila.
Balazulumba mumudima mutakwe mumuni; ubachita kuti badadalike mbuli muntu ukoledwe.
Bona, linso lyangu lyazibona zyoonse eezi; kutwi kwangu kwamvwa akuchimvwisisisya.
Nzyozi, nchimwinya ambebo ndizizi; nsili munsi lyako pe.
Nikuba boobo, chili mbubo kuti ngaambule a Singuzu zyoonse ndipeekezya kuyeeya aamwi a Leza.
Pesi muninania bwini azyakubeja; moonse muli basilisi batakwe lugwasyo pe.
Aah, nikutali kuti moonse kamuumuna! Oobo mbubwali kunooba busongo bwenu.
Lino amvwe kuyeeya kwangu; amuswilizye kukombelezya kwamilomo yangu.
Sena ulambwida Leza anzila iitaluleme, alimwi uyoomwiminina kowambuula kowambuula chalweeno na?
Sena uyomutondeezya kusalula?Sena uyomukazizya mulandu Leza?
Chiyokubotela na nayokusenuuka. Sena inga ulamweena mbuuli mbonga uleena bantu?
Nchobeni uyokukkalalila kuti mukusisikizya watondezya kusaluula.
Sena bwami bwakwe tabukuyoosyi, alimwi kuyoosya kwakwe takukulimbi na?
Twaambo twako tutalubiki ntusimpi twadota; inkwabililo zyako ninkwabililo zyabulongo.
Uumuna, ndisiye andike, kuchitila kuti ngambe, kufumbwa chitandisikile takwe makani.
Ndilatola nyama yangu ndemwini mumeno aangu; ndilatola buumi bwangu mumaboko aangu.
Bona, na wandijaya,  tandichinooli abulangizi pe; nikuba boobo, ndiyokwabilila nzila zyangu kunembo lyakwe.
Eechi nchichiyooba kaambo kalwaangunuko lwangu, nkambo taakwe muntu uutakwe Leza uyosika kunembo lyakwe.
Leza, swilizya kabotu kwambuula kwangu; twambo twangu ngatusie kumatwi aako.
Bona lino, ndabamba kabotu; nkwabilizyo zyangu; ndilizi kuti nsikwe mulandu pe.
Ngwani ooyo uunga ulakazyania andime inkuta? Na waziba kuchita oobo, alimwi na ndajanika nkelubizizye, elyo ndali kuumuna akutakata abuumi bwangu.
Leza, ndichitile zintu zyobile biyo, mpawo nsikoyoyuba pe kuzwa kubusyu bwako:
Gwisya kuboko kwako kwabudyamizyi aali ndime, alimwi utalekeli bukkali bwako kuti bundiyoosye.
Lino kondiita, elyo ndiyovwiila; naa kuti ngambuule anduwe, alimwi undivwiile.
Mbungana busofwazi azibi zyangu? Andizibe bubaya bwangu achibi changu.
Nkamboonzi nosisa busyu bwako kuli ndime akundijata mbuuli sinkondonyokwe?
Sena inga ulapenzya itu liyabupupuluka? Nkubona wandila isuko jumu na?
Nkambo ulemba izintu zibi aatala andime; undichita kuti ndikkone zibi zyabucheche bwangu.
Alimwi ulangide mawulu aangu; ulalangisisya nzila zyangu zyoonse; ulasenuuka busena aawo zituta zyamawulu angu mpuzyeenda
nikuba kuti ndili mbuli chintu chibolede, chizakala mbuli chisamo chakaliwa amunanze.
Mwaalumi uzyedwe kumukaintu, ukkala kwamazuba mache loko alimwi uzwide mapenzi.
Ulamena alubuwa mbuli dubaluba akuligonka aansi; eelyo ulanyana mbuli cheenzule kakoyofwidilila.
Nikubaboobo ulalanga na zimwi zyazeezi? Ulandeeta na kulubeta anduwe?
Ngwani uyoyeta chintu chisalala kuli eezi zintu zisofweede? Taakwe uumwi.
Mazuba abaalumi alitalidwe. Mweelwe yamyeezi yakwe ilanduwe; alimwi akumuyakila kuti atayindilili.
Komufutatila kuti ajane luumuno, kusikila buzuba bwamulimo wakwe bumane.
Chilakonzeka kuba bulangizi kumusamu; na wagonkelwa aansi, ukonzya kuzosyuuka lubo, kuchitila kuti zisyuukila zyawo zitazomaninini.
Nikuba kuti miyanda yawo inocheembaala mumuseele,
nekuba kuti kinunkuzya maanzi, iyosyuuka akukomezya mitabi mbuli katembwaani.
Pesi mwaalumi ulafwa; ulamana nguzu; chanchooncyo, mwaalumi ulaleka kuyooya, alimwi nkokuuli nkwabede?
Mbuuli maanzi mbwayuminina mumulonga, alimwi mbuli mulonga mbumana manzi akuyuminina,
eelyo bantu balalala aansi alimwi tababuki lubope. Mane majulu akamaninine, taakwe nibayobuka nikuba kubusigwa kung'onzi zyabo.
Oh, nichakali chibotu kuti wandisisa munyika yabafwide, kondibamba kumbali mane kunyema kwako kukamane, eelyo akundiyeeya chakusika chiindi!
Kuti mwaalumi nafwa, unochili muumi lubo na? Kuti kakuliboobo, ndapeekezya kuyolindila makatalo aangu manedo chiindi chikasike chakulemutuzigwa.
Uyondiita, alimwi njokuvwiila. Uyoba achiyandisyo nkaambo kamilimo yamanza aako.
Uyoyeleka mweelwe alimwi akuyondibamba nkambo kantaamo zyangu; tokoyobamba mukondo wazibi zyangu.
Insotoko zyangu ziyojalilwa muchibikilo changu; uyovumba boonse bubi bwangu.
Pesi nikuba zilundu zikakolomoke alimwi kakutakwe achizwa; nekuba mabwe asunzulusigwa kuzwa mubusena bwawo;
maanzi akasunzulusye mabwe; kukunka kwakwo kukakokolole lusuko lwanyika. Muleeyi nzila, ulazimaazya bulangizi bwamwaalumi.
Ulamuzunda kwalyoonse, alimwi uyoyinda; uyosandula busyu bwakwe alimwi akumutumina kuti afwe.
Kuti bana bakwe balombe balemekwa, takonzyi kuchiziba eechi; na tebalemekwa, takonzyi kuchiziba eechi.
Ulamvwa biyo machise alamubili wakwe, alimwi ulikwilila lwakwe mwini.
Mpawo Elifazi muTemanayiti wakasandula kati,
''Kulelede na kuti muntu musongo asandule anzila ilaluzibo lutagwasyi alimwi alizuzuzye amuuwo wakujwe?
Kulelede na kuti abuzyanie twambo tutagwasyi na ankazyanio zitakwe bubotu mbuzichitya?
Chanchoonzyo, ulawubula bulemu kuli Leza; ulalilebya kulipeda kwako kulinguwe,
nkaambo bubi bwako buyiisya mulomo wako; ulasala kuba alulimi lwabuchenjeezu.
Mulomo wako ulakusampawula, pepe wangu; chanchoonzyo, iyako milomo ipabukamboni anduwe.
Ndonduwe mwalumi mutaanzi na wakazyalwa? Wakalengwa zilundu kazitana kubawo na?
Wakali wamvwa na busongo busisikene bwaLeza? Ulalitimuna busongo bwako na?
Nzeezili nzyozi swebo nzetutazi? Nzezili nzyomvwisisisya eezyo zitamo mulindiswe?
Iswebo toonse tulaamvwi mumitwe alimwi tulibaalumi bapati loko bachembeede kwinda wuso.
Ingumbulizyo zyaLeza ninche na kuli nduwe, majwi mabotu alangene anduwe?
Nkaambonzi moyo wako nuyanda kukusowa? Nkaamboonzi menso aako nalaba,
zyakuti wapilusya muuya wako kukupapila Leza alimwi akweeta majwi aliboobo kuzwa mukanwa lyako?
Muntu niinzi loko ku.ti asalale? Mbobuli oyo uzyedwe kumwanakazi mbwanga ulalulama?
Langa, Leza takonzyi kusyoma nibaba basalali bakwe; nkasimpe, majulu tasalali kumenso aakwe;
mbobuli mbwayindwa oyo usofweede abusyachivulemwangu, muntu unywa zibi mbuli mbwanywa manzi!
Ndilakutondeezya; swilila kuli ndime; ndiyokwambila webo zintu nzindakabona,
zintu ezyo bantu basongo nzibakalungulula kuzwa kumawisaabo, zintu ezyo bansiku nzibakatasisa.
Eezi zyakali basinsiku babo, abo abalike bakapedwe nyika, alimwi mbembabo bakatindwa mbali abanakwenda.
Muntu sizibi ulapilimuka mumachise mazuba akwe wonse, mweelwe mamyaaka eyo ibambululwa kulisikupenzya kuti apengaane.
Mizuzumo yaziyoosyo mwiili mumatwi aakwe; nekuba kalimubuvubi, sikumwayuula uzomuzida.
Takonzyi pe kuyeeya kuti ngawuzoozwa mumudima; ipanga lilamulindila.
Ulayinka kumasena manji kayanduula chinkwa, kati, 'Chilikuli mpo?' Ulizi kuti izuba lyamudima lilafwiifwi.
Kupengana akulebuuka nzezimuyoosya; zilamuzunda lwakwe, mbuli mwami ulibambilide nkondo.
Nkaambo wakatantamuka kule ajanza lyakwe kulwana Leza alimwi wakalisumpula kalwisya Singuzu,
oyu muntu sizibi ulachijanina kuli Leza ansiko njuumu, antobo niini loko.
Aaka nkasimpe, nikuba kuti wavumba busyu bwakwe azibi zyakwe alimwi akulibunganisizya zibi zyakwe muchikungu,
alimwi akuyoliponena mumadolopo atelede kukkalwa; mumaanda atakwe muntu uwakkala lino alimwi akali elela kuti abemulwi wamatongo.
Takwe pe natakabe muvubi; buvubi bwakwe tabukoyokkala alimwi mbono zyakwe tazikoyotandabala atala anyika.
Takwepe natakazwe mumudima; mulilo uyoyuminizya munsonga; akuyooya kwamulomo waLeza uyochijila kule.
Ngakube kuti atasyomi kuzintu zitagwasyi, kalyena lwakwe; nkaambo zitagwasyi ziyooba njempindu yakwe.
Ziyochitika kachitana kusika chindi chakufwa kwakwe; mitabi yakwe tikoyovovwela mbulisokwe tete.
Uyokulumbuka michelo yakwe kitana kubizwa mbuli magilepuvayini; uyokulumbuka malubaluba aakwe mbuli maluba amu olifa.
Nkaambo kabunga kabatayoowi Leza tabakoyozyala pe; mulilo uyosyukuta matente amasinkamulomo.
Bayominta bubi alimwi bayotumbuka bubi; izyalilo lyabo liyominta lweeno.''
Mpawo Jobbu wakasandula wati,
''Ndakamvwa zyiingi zintu ziliboobu; monse muli basikundumbulizya buyo batagwasyi.
Eno majwi abuyo ayoba aampamanina na? Nchinzi chinyonyongene kuli nduwe chipa kuti usandule boobu?
Ambebo ndali kwambula mbuli mbochita, niinga wali muchiimo changu, ndali kubwezelela akuswanizya majwi antomwe kukukazya akuguna akutikinia mutwe wangu kukuninda kwako.
Ndalikuno kusimya amulomo wangu, akukankama kwamulomo wangu kuyokweetela kulyokezya!
Kuti ndaambula, kuusa kwangu takuchesegwi; na ndalilesya kwambula, ndagwasigwa biyeni?
Pesi lino, Leza, wandichita ndawizuka; wachita bang'anda yangu tongo.
Wandichita kuti ndiyuminine, eechi chalo mbukamboni bundilwana; kukotela kwamubili wangu kulandibukila, akundibeda kamboni bundikazya.
Leza wandikwamuna mukunyema kwakwe akundipenzya; wandilumina ntwiino mubunyeme, sinkondoma ulandilangisisya nalokundikwamuuna.
Bantu bakandilanga kabeeseme, bakanduuma kuseya chakundisoka; bakandibunganina chakundilwisya.
Leza wandaaba kubantu batakwe Leza, alimwi undisowela mumaanza abasizibi.
Ndakakkede obotu, we wandikwamuuna akkati. Iyi, wandijata munsingo akupwaya ndazapuuka; alimwi wachita chipimyo chakwe.
Basitunta balindizyungulukide; Leza uyasa insa zyangu alimwi tandileki; utila mululwe wangu aansi.
Uladinka bulambo bwangu chakwindulula, ulachijana alindime mbuli silumamba.
Ndasuminina masaka achikanda changu. Ndayasa lwija lwangu aansi.
Busyu bwangu bwasalala akukwila; munkowe zyangu muli mwenzule walufu
nikuba takwepe lupyopyongano mumaanza angu, alimwi inkombyo yangu ilasalala.
Yomusele, utavumbi bulowa bwangu; kulila kwangu kutabi abusena bwakulyokeezezya.
Nikuba lino, bona, bukamboni bwangu bulikujulu; oyo undiminina ulikujulu.
Benzuma balandiseka pele menso aangu atila misozi kuli Leza.
Ndakumbila kamboni ulikujulu kuti akkazizye muntu oyu a Leza mbuli muntu mbwachita angwayakilene awe!
Nkambo elyo yayinda minyaka miche biyo, Ndiyoyinka kubusena oko nkwesikabule kuyoboola.
Muuya wangu ulityokede, amazuba aangu amana; kabanda kalandilindila.
Nkasimpe ndila basikundunina; menso aangu alanga buyo bunongi.
Bikka chisyomezyo , chakuti webo uzondiminine; nguni umwi unga ulandigwasya?
Nkambo webo, Leza, wakabachita kuti batamvwisisisyi;  nkaako tokabazumizyi kuti bandizunde.
Oyo ubejelezya benzinyina kumpindu, bana bakwe balafwa nzala.
Pele wandichita kuba chisesemyo kubantu; balandiswida kubusyu.
Amenso aangu awofwaala nkambo kabuusu; zyonse zimpanzi zyamubili wangu zyanyana mbuli munzinzimwa.
Bantu baluleme balakankama akambo kazeezi; abatakwe mulandu balasokwa abantu bataluleme.
Baluleme balayima munzila yabo; oyo ujisi maboko asalala unoyabukkula munguzu.
Pele nywebo nyoonse, amuboole lino; nsikajani musongo akati kanu.
Mazuba angu amana; katakwe chakulangila, aziyandisyo zyamumoyo zyamana.
Bantu aaba, banongi; aaba, basandula mansiku kuba sikati; amumuni waba afwifwi kumudima.
Kuti munzi ngundilangila nkabanda; alimwi ndakayala bulo bwangu mumudima;
alimwi nindakawulika kabanda kuti, 'Nduwe ndeende,' alimwi akunkonye, 'Kuti nduwe baama na muchizi wangu,'
bulikuli bulangizi bwangu? Njolangila kuli bulangilo bwangu, ngwani ukonzyanzya kububona?
Lusangaula abulangizi lulabbila antomwe ambebo mumilyango yachikkalilo chabafu netuyoselukila mukabanda?'''
Mpawo Bbilidadi mu Syuli wakasandula wakati,
''Uyoowumuna lili kwaambula kwako? Yeesesya, mpawo musule tuyoowambuula.
Nkaambonzi nitubwezwa mbuli ng'ombe, bafubafuba kumenso aako?
Iwe nooliyawuula mubunyeme bwako, kujana nyika yasiilwa nduwe na nikuba mabwe kugwisigwa aamasena aawo?
Nchobeni mumuni wamuntu mubi uyoozimwa; nsasi yamulilo wakwe tikoyoomweka pe.
Mumuni uyoodimaana mutente lyakwe; lampi lyakwe aajulu alinguwe liyoozimwa.
Ntaamo zyamanguzu aakwe ziyoofwinsigwa; mabambe akwe mwini ayomuwisizya aansi.
Nkaambo uyoowaalilwa mukazamba amawulu akwe mwini; uyoowida mugodi.
Chiteezyo chiyomucha kasindi; kakole kayoomujata.
Kkole lyabufwizyo linoosisilidwe nguwe aansi; alimwi chiteezyo munzila.
Njoosyo ziyoomuyoosya mabbazu woonse; ziyoomutandaania kutusindi twakwe.
Buvubi bwakwe buyooba nzala, anguzuuzu kubbazu lyakwe.
Zizo zya mubili wakwe ziyoolyigwa; nchobeni bulwazi bupati buyoolya zizo zya mubili wakwe.
Wazavuulwa kuzwa ku bulondozi bwatente lyakwe akwiinkisigwa ku mwami wa njoosyo.
Bantu batali nzubo zyakwe bayookkala mutente lyakwe baakubona kuti salufa ulimwaywidwe mumunzi wakwe.
Miyanda yakwe iyooyumisigwa munsi; aajulu ntabi zyakwe ziyoogonkwa.
Kuyeeyegwa kwakwe kuyoomana munyika; takoyooba ezina pe mumigwagwa.
Uyowandwa kuzwa mumumuni kuya mumudima alimwi uyowandwa kuzwa munyika eeyi.
Takwe bana na lunyungu aakati kabantu bakwe, takwe wakasyaala kapona ooko nkwakali wakkala.
Aabo bakkala kumbo bayooyosegwa kulizeezyo zitakachitike kulinguwe limwi zuba; aabo bakkala kujwe bayookankabala anchicho.
Nkasimpe mbiibede myuunzi yabantu batasalali, masena abaabo batazi Leza.''
Mpawo Jobbu wakasandula alimwi wakati,
''Kuyoba chiindi chilamfu chili biyeni koli kundifwabya akundikwamuna tumpanzi amajwi?
Eezi zyiindi zilikkumi wanditama; tamufwi nsoni kuti mwandijata bubi.
Na kakali kasimpe kuti ndakabisya, kubisy kunoli makani angu ndemwini.
Na nchoonzyo mulalisumpula aatala lyangu akundifubaazika,
mpawo muleelede kuziba kuti Leza wandichitila bubi akundijata mukansabwe kakwe.
Bona, ndoompolola, ''Bukali!'' pesi takwe nejana nsasndulo pe. Ndakwiilila lugwasyo, pesi takwe luumuno.
Wandisinkila nzila zyangu kuchitila kuti nsyiindi, aliwmi wabika mudima munzila yangu.
Wandisamununa bulemu bwangu, akundigwisya ngwaani yabwami mumutwe wangu.
Wandityolweeda ansi kumabbazu woonse, alimwi ndayinka; wanyampula lusyomo lwangu mbuli musamu.
Alubo wabusya kunyema kwakwe kulindime; akundibona mbuli sinkondonyina.
Lumamba lwakwe lwasika antoomwe; balandiyubilila akuzyunguluka tente lyangu.
Wabika bakulana bangu kule andime; bandizi batantamuka kuzwa kulindime.
Balauzubo lwangu bandikaka; beenzuma bandiluba.
Aabo beenzu bakali bakkala mung'andda yangu antoomwe abalanda bangu banakazi bandibona mbuli muzwakule; ndilimuzwamasi kunembo lyabo.
Ndilayita mulanda wangu, pesi tandipi nsandulo pe nikuba ndimukombelezye amulomo wangu.
Muuya ngweyoya weeta mulandu kumwanakazi wangu; ndilasesemya nikuba kulibaabo bakazyalwa kuzwa muda lyabaama.
Nikuba bana baniini balandiniaka; na ndanyampuka kuti ndaambuule, balandisampawula.
Boonse benzuma bandizi balandichimwa; aabo mbeyanda bakandisandukila.
Mafuwa angu alanamatila kuchikumba akunyama yangu; ndipona biyo alukanda lwameno angu.
Mundifwide luzyalo, mundifwide luzyalo, nobenzuma bangu, nkaambo luboko lwaLeza lwandiguma.
Nkaambonzi nimunditobelela mbuli Leza mbachita? Muyoyikkuta na nyama yangu?
Ikaka, kuti majwi angu akalembwe ansi! Ikaka, kuti akalembwe mubbuku!
Ikaka, kuti alulembo lyabulotwe akabulo akalembwe mumwaala kwalyoonse!
Pesi mbuli ndime ndilizi kuti Muvuni wangu ulapona, alimwi kuti kumamanino uyooyima aanyika;
kusule lyalukanda lwangu, kwaamba kuti, mubili ooyu, wanyonyoonwa, mpawo nyama yangu iyoobona Leza.
Ndiyomubona amenso angu ndemwini - ime, alimwi peepe uumbi muntu. Moyo wangu ulikulilawuka mulindime.
Na wati, 'Tuyomupenzya buti! Miyanda yamapenzi akwe ali mulinguwe,'
mpawo amuyowe panga nkaambo kakuti kunyema kweeta chisubulo chapanga, kuchitila kuti muzibe kulilubeta.''
Mpawo Zofa muNamatayi wakasandula alimwi wakati,
''Miyeeyo yangu ichita kuti ndisandule kufwambaana nkaambokakupenga kuli mulindime.
Ndilimvwide lutuko lundisampula, pesi mukumvwisisisya kwangu muuya ulandisandula.
Tamulizi na eeli simpe kuzwa kuzyiindi zyachiindi, eelyo Leza nakabika muntu aanyika:
kuzunda kwamuntu sizibi nkufwiifwi, alimwi kubotelwa kwamuntu utakwe Leza kukkala chiindi chifwiifwi?
Nikuba bulamfu bwakwe bulasikila kumajulu, alimwi mutwe wakwe ulasikila kumayoba,
pesi muntu uuliboobu uyooloba lyoonse mbuli mazyu aakwe; aabo bakamubwene bayooti, 'Ulikuli?'
Uyoowuluka kayinka mbuli loto alimwi tachikuyoojanwa; nchobeni uyotandwa mbuli chilengano chamansiku.
Linso lyakamubwene talichiyomuboni limbi; busena bwakwe tabuchiyoomuboni lubo.
Bana bakwe bayokumbila lulekelelo kubantu bachete; maboko aakwe ayoyelede kuboozya buvubi bwakwe.
Mafuwa aakwe alizwide manguzu abukubusi bwakwe, pesi ayolala aansi anguwe mulusuko.
NIkuba kutalulama kulanona mumulomo wakwe, nikuba ulakusisa kunsi lyalulimi lwakwe,
nikuba ulakujata mumoomo alimwi takuleki kuti kwiinke  pesi ulakubamba kakwiimvwi mumulomo wakwe -
chakulya mumala aakwe chisanduka kulula; chiba chikozyo chanzoka mukati kakwe.
Ulamena buvubi , pesi uyoobuluka lubo; Leza uyoobutandila aanze kuzwa mutumbu lyakwe.
Uyoonyonka chikozyo chanzoka; lulimi lwachisasa luyomujaya.
Takoyoononeezya tulonga, tuzwide buchi amalili.
Uyoboozya mulimu wamulimu wakwe alimwi takoyookonzya kuulya; takoyoobunoneenwa buvubi mbwakajana mumabbindawuko aakwe.
Nkaambo woombya alimwi wasowa bantu bachete; wabweza chabukali maanda ngakatayaka pe.
Akaambo kakuti takwe nazi kukkuta pe lwakwe mwini, takoyookonzya pe kubamba kufumbwa chintu nchabotelwa mulinchicho.
Takwe chicheede nchaakatalya; aboobo kuzwidilila kwakwe takukoyoba kwalyoonse pe.
Mubuvule bwabuvubi bwakwe uyoowida mumapenzi; luboko lwawoonse uuli mubuchete luyomulwisya.
Eelyo nayoyanda kuzuzya tumbu lyakwe, Leza uyowaala kuyoosyakwabukali bwakwe alinguwe; Leza uyowisizya alinguwe nachinoolya.
Nikubakuti muntu ooyo uyoochija kuzwa kuchilwanisya chabutale, kavwi kamukkuba kayomuyasa.
Uyookagwisya kuzwa kusule lyakwe alimwi bbazu libalama lilazwa muchini chakwe. Kuyowa kupati kulaza aatala anguwe.
Mudima uumaninide ulibambilidwe buvubi bwakwe; mulilo utafulidwi uyomulya; uyolya eecho chicheede mutente lyakwe.
Majulu ayoyubununa chibi chakwe, alimwi nyika iyomubukila mbuli kamboni.
Buvubi bwang'anda yakwe buyoomana; zintu zyakwe ziyoloba mubuzuba bwabukali bwaLeza.
Eechi nchaabilo chamuntu mubi kuzwa kuli Leza, lukono ndwabambilidwe aLeza.''
Mpawo Jobbu wakasandula alimwi wakati,
''Amuswiilile loko kumajwi angu, alimwi eechi ngachikabe luumbulizyo ndumuyondipa.
Mukabe andime, alimwi mebo alubo ndiyowambuula; ndamana kwambuula, mundinonge.
Mbuli ndime, lung'ung'u lwangu luli kumumtu na?
Amulange ndime alimwi mukankamane, mubike maanza enu amilomo yenu.
Chiindi nendiyeeya aataa akupengana kwangu, ngandayowa, alimwi mubili wangu ulakankama.
Nkaambonzi bantu babi nibiinkilila kunembo kabapona, bachembaale alimwi akukomena munguzu mpati?
Lunyungu lyabo lulayimikwa ambabo kunembo lyabo, alimwi bana babo balayimikwa kumenso abo.
Maanda aabo alibambikene kuzwa kukuyowa; nekuba musako waLeza alimbabo.
Pule wabo ulazyalisya; takachilwi pe kuchita oobo; mpwizi yabo ilzyala alimwi tayisowi pe.
Balatuma bana babo mbuli butanga, alimwi bana babo balazyana chakukondwa.
Balayimba amatambolini atuntimbwaakukondwa anyimbo zyamutetele.
Balamana mazuba aabo mukuzwidilila, alimwi balafwa chuumunizi kabaya kuSyiyoli.
Bati kuliLeza, 'Kozwa kulindiswe nkaambo takwe nitulakamina kufumbwa luzibo lwanzila zyako.
Niinzi Singuzuzyoonse, kuti tumukombe? Nimpinduunzi njetujana na twakomba kulinguwe?'
Langa, lusumpuko lwabo taluli mumaanza aabo na beni? Takwe nchekonzya kuchita pe aluchenjezyo lwabantu babi.
Kukabe tungane  aawo lampi lyabantu babi kalizimwa, na bubi ntenda zyabo kaziza aatala ambabo? Leza umwaya tungane mawuse aalimbabo mukunyema kwakwe?
Kuyooba tungane kuti bakabe mbuli chuungu chipupululwa aluuwo na mbuli chuungu chibwezwa akambizi?
Mwaamba kuti, ''Leza ulabika kuliwumwi awumwi mulanda wabana bakwe kuti bawuliye.' Amuleke alililiyile mwini kuchitila kuti azibe mulandu wakwe.
Amuleke menso akwe abone lunyonyookolwakwe mwini, alimwi anywe bukali bwaSinguzuzyoonse.
Nkaaambo uyolela buti bana bakwe musule lyakugonkelwa myeelwe yamyeezi yakwe?
Kujana kwaba na naba womwe unga ulayisya Leza luzibo mbokunga ulabeteka nikuba aabo balikujulu?
Umwi mwaalumi ulafwa mubuzule bwanguzu zyakwe, kawumwide lyoonse alimwi kalyiibide.
Mubili wakwe ulizwide mukupa, alimwi mumpolyo wamafuwa aakwe muteteete.
Umwi mwaalumi ulafwa mubuusu bwamuuya wakwe, ooyo wakatabona chintu chibotu.
Boonse baloona ansi mulusuko; boonse imvwinyu zilabavumba.
Bona, ndilizi miyeyo yako, anzila nzolangilila kundibisizya aazyo.
Nkaambo mwaamba kuti, ''Lino ilikuli ng'anda yamwana waMwami? Lilikuli tente oomo mwaalumi mubi mwakali wakkala?'
Temwakababuzya na basilweendo? Tamuzi na bukamboni mbubakonzya kwaamba,
kuti mwaalumi mubi ulagwisigwa kuzwa kuzuba lyamapenzi, alimwi akufutulwa kuzwa kubuzuba bwabukali?
Ngwani uusula nzila yamuntu mubi kubusyu bwakwe? Ngwani uutakamuliilile kulizeezyo nzyakachita?
Pesi ulanyampulwa kuya kuchuumbwe; baalumi bayoolinda kabanda kakwe.
Magadi aamumpati ayomunonena; bantu boonse bayomutobela, mbuli mbukwakakli bantu biingi kunembo lyakwe.
Mpawo muyonduumbulizya biyeni azyamayabwe mukuti munsandulo zyenu takwe chiliwo pesi kubeja luzutu?''
Mpawo Elifazi wakuTemani wakasandula wati,
''Muntu nga ulaba alugwasyo na kuli Leza? Mwalumi wabusongo nga ulaba alugwasyo kuli nguwe na?
Chilabotezya na kuli Singuzu kuti koli musalali? Zili kuli nguwe na kabiyo kuti wachita kuti nzila zyako zibule kampenda?
Ngazilaboobo nkaambo kakumulemeka kwako na kuti akukkalalile alimwi akutole kulubeta?
Tebubi bwako bwiingi na? Taakwe mamanino na kuzibi zyako?
Nkaambo wakayanda chijatisyo chachikwelete kumwananyokwe katakwe nchiwachitila pe alimwi mwamusamununa zizwaato wasyaala maya.
Takwepe niwakapa maanzi kubantu bakongedwe akunywa; wakiima balenzala zyakulya
nikuba lwako, mwalumi ulanguzu, wakavubide nyika, nikuba lwako, mwalulumi walikulemekwa, wakapona mulinjiyo.
Wakabatuma bamukabafu kabali chinkwamaanza; maanza abatakwe mawisi akatyololwa.
Nkinkaako, tukole nkotuli tulikuzyungulukide, alimwi kuyowa kulakupenzya.
Mpuuli amudima, kuchitila kuti utakaboni; mulwi wameenda ulakuvumba lwako.
