Sa Leza takope mubulamfu bwamajulu? Kolanga bulamfu bwanyenyeezi, zili kulamfu buti!
Ulaamba kuti, 'Niinzi nchazi Leza?
Tuyoba tuche tulimusitide, zyakuti takonzyi kutubona; uleenda mubupati bwamajulu.'
Uyolondola na nzila zyachiindi ezyo zyakeendwa abansiku,
aabo bakachegwa kachitanasika chiindi chabo, aabo balentalisyo zyakakukululwa mbuli mulonga,
aabo bakambide kuti kuli Leza, 'Kozwa kulindiswe; aabo bakateedi, 'Niinzi nchanga ulachita kulindiswe Singuzu?'
Nekuba kuti wakazuzizye maanda aabo azintu zibotu; mizeezo yabasizibi ilikule andime.
Bantu baluleme balabona bubisyi bwabo alimwi balakondwa; batakwe bubi balabaseka chakubaninda.
Baamba kuti, 'Nchoonzyo aabo bakatubukilide bakagonkwa; mulilo wakasyukuta buvubi bwabo.'
Lino kozuminana a Leza alimwi ukabe alumuno anguwe; munzileeyo, bubotu buyosika kulinduwe.
Kotambula, ndakukombelezya, malayilile kuzwa kumulomo wakwe; kolondola majwi aakwe mumoyo wako.
Kuti na waboola kuli Singuzu, uyoyakululwa, kuti wagwisya wabasowela kule bataluleme mumatente aako.
Vwikila buvubi bwako aansi mulusuko, ingolide ya Ofaya akati kamabwe akutusensa,
alimwi Singuzu uyokubeda buvubi bwako, nsilva njebesi kuli nduwe.
Nkaambo kaako uyokondwa muli Singuzu; uyonyampula busyu bwako kuli Leza.
Uyochita nkombyo zyako kuli nguwe, alimwi uyokumvwa; uyobika zikonke zyako kuli nguwe.
Alimwi uyowamba kufumbwa chintu, alimwi chiyozumininwa nkambo kako; mumuni uyomunika munzila zyako.
Leza uselusya muntu ulikankayizya, alimwi uvuna oyo ulamenso alifwiinsya.
Ukonzya kuyovuna muntu oyo ujisi zibi; oyo uyovunwa kwindila mubusalali bwamanza aako.''
Elyo Jobbu wakasandula wakati,
''Asunu kutongawuka kwangu nkwakunyema; kuboko kwangu nkulemu nkambo kakuvuluma kwangu.
Oh, elyo ndime uuzi, nkwesikamujane! Oh, kuti nkasike kubusena bwakwe!
ndalikunobikka kambo kangu kabotu kunembo lyakwe akuzuzya mulomo wangu ankazyanio.
Ndiyoyiiya mabala ayo ngayo ndisandula akuyomvwisisisya ezyo nzyayowamba kulindime.
Uyondikazya na munguzu zyakwe mpati? Inee, uyondiswilizya.
Aawo muntu ululeme ukonzya kukazya atala anguwe. Munzila eyi njolulamikilwa kwalyoonse amubetesi wangu.
Bona, ndaya kujwe, pesi tako, akumbo, pesi nsimubwene.
Kunyika, oko nkwali amulimu, pesi nsilikumubona pe, akumusanza, oko nkwaliyubide mwini kuti nditamuboni.
Pesi ulizi inzila njetola; elyo nakandisunka, ndiyoozwa mbuli ngolida.
Indyato zyangu zilijisilidi antamo zyakwe; Ndichili munzila yakwe alimwi nsina leya pe.
Nsina kuzwa kumilayo yakumulomo wakwe; Ndakabamba majwi akumulomo wakwe kwinda chibela chakulya.
Pesi ngumwi siluzyalo, ukonzya kumuboozya? Echo nchayanda ulachichita.
Nkambo ulabwezya malayilile aakwe atala andime; mbiingi balimbuli nguwe.
Nkambokaako, ndiyoweede mubuliwo bwakwe; eelyo nendiyeeya atala anguwe, Ndiyoweede nguwe.
Nkambo Leza wandetusya moyo wangu, Singuzu zyonse wandiyoosya.
Tendakeetwa kumamanino  nkambo kamudima, nkambo kamudima usiya mbii ujalide chakuvumba busyu bwangu.
Nkamboonzi zyiindi zyakubeteka bantu basizibi nizitabikidwe asinguzu? Nkamboonzi abo basyomeka kuli Leza nibatakonzyi kubona mazuba akwe akusika kwakubetekwa?
Kulibantu basizibi abo bagwisya impa zyamigaano; kuli bantu basizibi abo batola nutanga achakwaangila alimwi balabubika mumachelelo aabo beni.
Balabinga madonki ababo batakwe bamawisi; balabweza basune babamukabafu mbuli balindizi.
Balaangila bantu babulide kuzwa munzila yabo; bantu bafwaba baanyika boonse balaliyubika kuzwa kuli mbabo.
Bona, aba bantu bafwaba balayinka kumilimu yabo beni mbuli madonki amusokwe munkanda, kabalanguula chakulya chaku chenjela; chimwi chindi ba Alabbu bakabape chakulya kubana babo.
Bantu bafwaba balatebula mumansiku munkuba zyabamwi bantu; balachela misansa kuzwa kubutebuzi bwabaabo bantu basizibi.
Balalala chinswe mansiku woonse nkabatakwe zisamo; tabakwe zyakulivumba kumpeyo.
Balinabide atuvula twamuzilundu; balalala kufwafwi kumabwe mapati nkambo tabakwe maanda.
Kuli bantu basizibi aabo balagwisya bamuchaala kuzwa kunkolo zyabamanyina, alimwi bantu basizibi abo balatola bana mbuli balindizi kuzwa kubantu bafwaba.
Pesi bantu bafwaba balendeenda nkabali chinswe nkabatazweete nekuba beenda anzala, bala bweza misunta yazilyo zyabamwi bantu.
Bantu bafwaba balachita mafuta akkati kama olifa aababo basizibi; baladina wayini yabasizibi, pesi beni bayofwa anyota.
Kuzwa mumadolopo bafwa balatongela, alimwi myuuya yabayaswa ilakwilila lugwasyo. Pesi Leza taipenzyi kububi.
Bamwi babaaba bantu basizibi balapapila kumumuni; tabazi inzila zyawo, nunka kukkala munzila zyawo.
Sikujaya ulabuka nkabutana kucha alimwi ulajaya bafwaba ababulide bantu; mumansiku ulimbuli mubbi.
Alubo, linso lyasimamambi lilalindila kabbundibundi; ulati, 'Takwe linso litakandibone.'Ulavumba busyu bwakwe.
Mumudima bantu basizibi balasya mumaanda; pesi balayuba muzyiidi zyamasikati; nkambo tabayandi mumuni.
Nkambo bonse akkati kabo, mudima usiya mbii ulimbuli mafumina; nkambo mbazolwani aziyoosyo zyamumudima usiya.
Balakukulwa, nekuba boobo, mbuli fulu lyamanzi; chimpanzi chanyika yabo chilitukidwe; takwe naba omwe uya kumisansa yakwe kukubeleka.
Mbuli bbalangwe aachikkasalizi mbuziyeemusya sikunkwe kuba maanzi, aboobo tubanda tulatola abo bakabisya.
Izyalilo elyo lyakamuzyala liyomuluba; isenda liyomulya chakunonelwa kulinguwe; takoyoyeyegwa limbi; muleyinzila, basizibi bayotyolwa mbuli musamu.
Sizibi ujaya mukayintu oyo utazyede bana; wachita bubi kuli mukamufu.
Nekubaboobo Leza ulatanda bantu basinguzu anguzu zyakwe; ulanyampuka alimwi tabayumyi mubuumi.
Leza ngabachita kuti bayeye anga bali kwabilidwe, alimwi bali boteledwe atala ababo, pesi menso akwe ali atala lyanzila zyabo.
Aba bantu balisumpukide; pesi, mukayindi kanini, bayoofwa. Ninchobeni, bayoyetwa ansi; bayobunganisigwa mbuli boonse bamwi; bayogwisigwa mbuli ngala.
Na tembukubede, ngwani ukonzya kundamba mubeji; ngwani uunga ulachita majwi angu abe abuyo?''
Eelyo Bbiludadi mu Syuhayiti alimwi wakasandula,
''Wakajisi kuyoowa akwendelezegwa; ulachita mabambe mumasena aakwe alikulamfu kujulu.
Mpukuli na kugola kwamyeelwe yankamu zyaba silumamba bakwe? Nkulini mumuuni wakwe nkuutabalami?
Eelyo mbubuuli muntu mbwaba mululami kuli Leza? Mbobuli oyo iwakazyalwa kumwanakazi mbwaba musalali, kutambulika kuli nguwe?
Langa, nekuba amwezi tuukwe mumuni kuli nguwe; inyenyeezi tazisalali mumenso aakwe.
Mboobuli mbwali muche muntu, nchiyokaansi - mwana wamuntu, ngwani chiyokaansi!''
Mpawo Jobbu wakasandula akwaamba kut,
''Wakamugwasya biyeni ooyo wakatalikwe nguzu!
Wakakugwasya biyeni kuboko ooko kutakwe nguzu! Wakamuchenjezya biyeni umwi ooyo wakatali abusongo alimwi akwamba kuli nguwe iluzibo ilumvwikka!
Alwani lugwasyo ndwakaamba majwi aaya? Nguwani muuya oyo wakazwa muli nduwe?
Bafwide bachitwa kuti bakankame, boonse bakkala mulingawo.
Kabanda kali chinswe kunembo lya Leza; kumwayisigwa kwalo takukwe kuvumbwa pe atala anguwe.
Ulatandabika kuzwa kujulu lyakujwe aajulu abusena butakwe chintu, akwaanzika inyika atakwe chintu.
Ulanga manzi mumayoba aakwe mapati, pesi mayoba aakwe tazakali pe munsi lyakwe.
Ulavumba busena bwamwezi akuzuzya mayoba alindilyo.
Wafwiinsya kuzyunguluka mugaano aajulu lyamanzi mbuli mukondo akati kamumuni amudima.
Minsende yakujulu yakazuungana akuyosegwa kwakukalala kwakwe.
Wakawumunizya lwizi amanguzu aakwe; mukumvwisisisya kwakwe wakatyoloola Lahabbu.
Kwiinda mukuyoowa kwakwe wakachita majulu kuti alibonie; ijanza lyakwe lyakayasa inzoka yakali kuyobuchija.
Bona, eezi nzizyo pesi mikondo yanzila zyakwe, Nkunini biyeni kuvwiiya nkuntamvwe aatala anguwe! Ngwani ukonzya kumvwa muzumo wanguzu zyakwe?''
Jobbu nakatalika kwaambula akuti,
''Kuti nkasimpe kuti Leza uupona, oyo wanditolela bululami bwangu, Singuzu zyoonse, ooyo wachita buumi bwangu mukuchisa,
kabuli buumi bwangu buli mulindime, akuyoya kuzwa kuli Leza, kuli mulindime mumpemo zyangu, eechi nchicho nchintachite.
Milomo yaansi tiwambuli chakuusa, nekuba lulimi lwangu talubeji;
Nsizumini kuti nywee nobatatu muliluleme; kusikila nkafwe nsikoyozumina mulandu.
Ndasinizya mukululama kwangu alimwi nsikoyo lulekezya lwinke pe; Ikuyeeya kwangu takundisiyi kule mukupona kwangu.
Akubekuti sinkondoma, kali mbuli muntu sizibi ; akube kuti oyo undibukila abe muntu utasalali.
Nkambo ninzi bulangilizi butakwe Leza eelyo kuti Leza wamujaya, kuti Leza watola buumi bwakwe?
Leza takonzyi kumvwa kulila kwakwe kuti masukusyo amuzida?
Ulaliswenzya na lwakwe kuli singuzu zyoonse akwiita Leza choonse chiindi?
Njokuyiisya ijanza lya Leza mbulibede; nsikoyo kuyubunwida miyeyo yasinguzu zyoonse.
Bona, nywebo monse mwalibonena eezi. Lwanu; Nkamboonzi nimwambuula zyonse zintu zitaluleme?
Eechi nchechibeela chamuntu ubisizye kuli Leza, ilukono lwasikubotezya ndwatambula kuzwa kuli singuzu zyoonse:
Ikuti ibana bakwe bayungizya, zichitilwa panga; lunyungu lwakwe talukoyojana kulya kwelede.
Abo bayofutuka kuli nguwe bazovwikkwa achiyoosyo, abamukabafu tabakonzyi kubalilila lwabo.
Nikuba kuti muntu sizibi bungania nsiliva mbuli lusuko,
akuyobungania zizwato mbuli bulongo, Ulalundika zisamo, pesi bantu baluleme bayozwata abasyomekede bantu bawazula nsiliva akati kabo.
Ulayaaka ng'anda yakwe mbuli kawuubi, mbuli ng'anda muliindi njachita.
Ulalala aansi abulo bunotede, pesi tayinkilili kunembo kachita boobu; ulajula menso akwe, azyoonse zilayinda.
Ziyoosyo zilamutola mbuli maanzi: izambangulwe lilamutola kuchiindi chamansiku.
Luuwo luzwa kujwe lulamutola, alimwi ulayinka; lulamugwisya kuzwa kubusena bwakwe.
Lulalisowela kulinguwe alimwi talwimikili pe; Uleezya kulifutula ajanza lyalo.
Lulakaamba maboko aalo kuli nguwe akufota kuzwa kubusena bwakwe.
Nchobeni nkuuli mugodi wansiliva, abusena oko nkwisalazigwa ngolide.
Lubulo lulagwisigwa munyika; mukkuba wayeemunwa kuzwa mubbwe.
Bantu balanguula mumudima kusikila kumamanino, kusikila nkubayiila, imabwe mwabambidwe alimwi mumudima muche.
Ulapwaya akufula mpwiido kuzwa kubantu; masena aayo aakalubwa kufwambana kuulu kwaumwi awumwi.  Ulanziika kule kuzwa kubantu; ulazungaana kuya akuboola.
Kuli zyanyika, omo muzwa chakulya, yakasandukila kumbi mbuli mulilo.
Mabwe aayo mbusena oko mabwe mayandisi nkwaazwa, asuko lyayo lilijisi ngolida.
Takwepe kayuni kawuluka kazi inzila eyo, nikuba linso lyansika libona.
Banyama balisumpula tabana kweenda muleeyo nzila pe, nikuba balavu bayoosya tabanayinda ooko.
Muntu ulatandabika janza alwaale, akukolomona zilundu amiyanda yazyo.
Ulajula tulonga akkati kamabwe; menso akwe alabona zintu ziyandisi zyoonse oko.
Ulajala tulonga kuti tuteendi pe; zisisidwe ooko ulazyeeta anze kumumuni.
Nkukuli busongo nkubukonzya kujanwa? Nkukuli kubusena bwakumvwisisisya?
Muntu tawuzi muulo wabo pe; nikuba kujanika kunyika yabaponi.
Manzi malamfu alikunsi anyika awamba kuti, 'Tensi muli ndime pe'; lwizi lwamba kuti, 'Tensi kuli ndime pe.
'Tabukonzyi kuulwa angolide; nikuba nsiliva tikonzyi kweelwa mbuli muulo wabo.
Tabukonzyi kwelanisigwa angolide yaku Ofili, atubwe tuyandisi tatubuli.
Ingolide amabwe aabalangala takonzyi kwelanisigwa ambubo pe mubulemu; nikuba tumwekamweka twangolide iisalala inga tulakonzya kuchinchanisigwa ambubo.
Takwepe bulemu bwambaanyina nikuba mabwe mayandisi nchobeni; muulo wabusongo wiinda mabwe asalala pyu.
Tubwe tuyandisi tatukonzyi kwelanisigwa ambubo pe; nikuba ingolide isalala tikonzyi kwelanisigwa abulemu bwabo pe.
Kuzwa kuli, mpawo, busongo nkubuzwa? Mbubuli busena bwakumvwisisisya?
Busongo bulisisikene kuzwa kumenso azilengwa zipona zyoonse alimwi balisisidwe kuzwa kubayuni bakujulu.
Lunyonyooko a lufu zyamba kuti, 'Twakamvwa ntwiintwi biyo atala ambubo amatwi eesu.'
Leza ulamvwisisisya inzila yambubo; ulizi busena bwabo.
Nkambo ulalanga kumamanino anyika akubona zili ansi lyamajulu.
Wakachita nguzu zyamuuwo akweleka maanzi miingi.
Imvula wakibikila milawu akubamba inzila yandabi.
Mpawo wakabona busongo akubwambilizya; wakabutalisya, nchobeni, alimwi wakabulingula.
Kubantu wakaamba kuti, 'Boona, kuyoowa kwa Mwami - mbobubo busongo; kukuzwa kuchibi nkokumvwisisisya.'''
Jobbu wakeendelela anembo kaamba kuti,
''Ikaaka, koonzyo ndaba mbuli mbundakabede myeezi yakayinda Leza nakandibamba,
chimunisyo chakwe nichakamweka aamutwe wangu, alimwi nindakayinda mumudima amumuni wakwe.
Aakaka, kwanoli ndaba mbuli mumazuba aakusima kwangu buzolwani bwa Leza nibwakali ateente lyangu,
eelyo Singuzu zyonse nakachili andime abana bangu kabandizyungulukide,
eelyo nzila yangu niyakavumbidwe amawumba, alimwi ibbwe lyakanditilila tulonga twamafuta!
Nindakazwa kumulyango wamuunzi, nindakali kukkala mubusena bwangu mulubuwa lwaamunzi,
bakubusi bakandibona akusosoloka kuzwa kuli ndime mululemeko, abachembele bakabuka akundiimina.
Bana babaami bali kuumuna kwambuula nindali kusika; bali kuvumba maboko kumilomo.
Majwi abasilutwe ali kuumuzigwa, mpawo lulimi indimi zyabo zyali kunamatila kumalakunya.
Nkambo kumana kwamatwi abo kundimvwa, bali kundilongezya; kumana kwakundibona kwabo, bali kupa bukamboni kuli ndime akuzumina aandime
nkambo ndakavuna uumwi wakali muchete nakalila awumwi utakwe wakali aawisi nakali bulide sikumugwasya.
Lulongezyo lwayooyo wwali waamba kunyoonyoka lwakasika aalindime; Ndakachita moyo wamukamufu kwiimba chalukondo.
Ndakasama bululami, alimwi bwali mbuli chikobela amusini.
Ndakali menso kubantu boofu; ndali kuulu kubantu balemene.
Ndakali wisi kubantu babulide; Ndakali kulingulula makani nikuba aayoyo ngundandatakezi.
Ndakatyola myeebo yabantu bataluleme; Ndakasomona nchakali wazunda kuzwa aakati aameno aakwe.
Eelyo ndakaamba kuti, 'Ndiyoofwida muchisaba changu; Ndiyoyungizya mazuba aangu mbuli sanga zyamuseele.
Miyanda yangu yatandabala kuyosika kumaanzi, alimwi muume uloona busiku boonse aamitabi yangu.
Lulemeko mulindime lukkede ndupya; alimwi buta bwanguzu zyangu buli bukulusidwe choonse chiindi mujanza lyangu.'
Bantu balikuswilila kuli ndime; bali kundilindilila; bakakkalachumunizi kuti bamvwe lulayo lwangu.
Kwinda kwamajwi aangu, teebali kwambuula lubo pe, kwakabawida mbuli maanzi aalimbabo.

Bona, toyelede kuyoosegwa akambo kakundiyoowa; nekuba kuti mutolo wangu walema alinduwe.

Nekubaboobo, ikuti bataswilizya, bayomana apanga, bayoofwa nkaambo kakutaziba.
Aabo ibatakwe Leza mumyooyo yabo, balazulila kunyema kwabo; tabalili lugwasyo nekuba Leza wabaanga.
Balafwa mubwanike bwabo; buumi bwabo bumaninina kuli basimamambe.
Leza uvuna bapeengana mukupenzegwa kwabo.
Nchobeni, ulayanda kukugwisya mumakatazyo aako, akukutola kubusena bukwazeme, butakwe buyumu, balantafula ilakulya kubotu kuzwide mafuta.
Pesi uyandisya kubeteka bantu basizibi; lubeta akululamika zyakakujata webo.
Utalekeli kunyema kwako kukusisye mukuseka bamwi, na kukomena kwamulo kuti kukulesye.
Buvubi bwako bulakupewuusya kukukatazigwa na? Naakuti manguzu ako awalawonkubona alakugwasya na?
Utayandi busiku, kuti ukabisizye bamwi, awo bantu mpubajigwa mumasena aabo.
Chenjela utanjili mukubisya nkambo kakuti ulikusunkwa, nkuko kuti ukabe kule akubisya.
Laanga, Leza ulanyampulwa mumanguzu aakwe; ngwani muyiisyi ulimbuli nguwe?
Ngwani umulayila anzila zyakwe?  Ngwani unga ulati kulinguwe, 'Wabisya akutachita bululami?
Yeeya kulumbayizya nchito zyakwe, ezyo bantu nzibakiimba.
Bantu boonse bakazilangila kule inchito eezyo.
Langa, Leza mupati, pesi tamumvwisisisyi obotu; myeelwe yamyaaka yakwe tibaliki pe.
Nkaambo ulavwela manzi akwe ngayeta mbuli mvula,
ayo atika kuzwa mumayoba abantu bakwe.
Nchobeni, mpawli na umvwisisisya kuzula kwamayoba atupulang'anda yakwe na?
Bona, uluzuzya tulabi twakwe alinguwe akujala miyanda yalwizi.
Muli eyinzila ulabeteka bantu akubapa kulya kwiingi.
Ulazuzya maboko akwe atulabi mane akalayile kuti atuume mpa.
Muzuzumo wato utondezya kusika kwamvula mpati, ang'ombe zilatumvwa na twasika.
Nchoonzyo moyo wangu uladuntawuka; buligwisigilwe kuzwa kubusena bwawo.
Mumvwe, mumvwe kundidima kwejwi lyakwe, kundindima kuzwa mumulomo wakwe.
Ulakutuma kunyika yoonse alimwi ulatuma tulabi kamasimpilo aanyika.
Ijwi lilavuuma musule lyawo; ulandindima ajwi lwakwe lyabwaami; takasyi kalabi aawo ijwi lyakwe nilyamvwikana.
Leza ulandindima chakugambya ejwi lyakwe; uchita zintu zipati nzitutakonzyi kumvwisisisya.
Nkaambo waamba kuti kumpeyo, 'Wida aanyika'; mubweelene kumvula yalunywaanywa, 'Ba mvula mpati.'
Ulakonzya kwiimika kuboko kwamuntu woonse kuti kutabeleki, kuchitila kuti bantu boonse mbakachita babone zichito zyakwe.
Mpawo zinyama zilayuba akukkala mumalindi aazyo.
Muuwo ulazwa kumusanza amuuwo kuzwa kunyika.
Akuyoya kwaLeza bbwemanzi lilapegwa; buyanzene bwamanzi bulayumisigwa mbuli butale.
Nchoonzyo ulalemena joba amutontomena; ulamwaya lulabi lwakwe mukati kamayoba.
Ulanyona mayoba mbuli mukubamba kwakwe kuchitila kuti achite kufumbwa nchaalayililka kuti achite aatala lyanyika yoonse.
Uchita kuti zyoonse eezi zichitike; chimwi chiindi zilachitikana kukululamika, chimwi chiindi kuchitila nyika yakwe, alimwi chimwi chiindi mbuli nchito zyakusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe.
Swiilila kuli zezi, Jobbu; imikila alimwi uyeye aatala amilimo mibotu yaLeza.
Ulizi na kuti mayoba akayimikwa buti akulekela lulabi kuti lwiinde aakati kawo?
Uamvwisisisya na kulengelela kwamayoba, milimo yaLeza mibotu, ngwani uululeme muluzibo?
Ulamvwisisisya na kuti zizwaato zyanu zikasaala buti aawo nyika kayiyimvwi nkaambo muuwo uzwa kumusanza?
Ulakonzya na kuyala julu mbulimbachita - ijulu, lisimide mbuli chiboniboni chabutale?
Tuyiisye nzitukonzya kwaamba kulinguwe nkaambo tatukonzyi kukazyania kabotu nkaambo kakusiya kwamiyeeyo yesu.
Aambilwe na kuti ndilapeekezya kwambuula aawe? Kujana muntu wapeekezya kumenwa na?
Lino, bantu tabakonzyi kulanga kuzuba nilichitowa kujulu muuwo niwayinda akusalazya mayoba.
Kuzwa kunyika nkukuzwa mumuni uutowa kuzwa kubulemu bwaLeza buyoosya.
Mbuli Singuzuzyoonse, tatukonzyi kumubona! Mupati munguzu; tadyaamizi bululami abusalali bwiingi.
Ninkaako bantu balamuyowa. Taswiilili pe aabo bachenjede mumiyeyo yabo.''
Lino Jehova wakavwiila Jobo kuzwa kuguwo alimwi wakati,
''Ngwani ooyu uyeta mudima kumizeezo yangu amajwi aatakwe luzibo?
Lino lyaange muchibuno chako mbuli mwaalumi eelyo ndiyokubuzya mibuzyo, aboobo uyoondisandula.
Ndindakayimika ntalisyo yanyika wakali kuli ? Ndibuzye, kuti kolaakumvwisisisya.
Ngwani wakeeleka migaano yayo? Ndibuzye, kuti kozi. Ngawani wakoolola kakole kakweela kulinjiyo.
Mpaali ntalisyo yayo mpiiyalidwe? Ngwani wakabika bbwe lyachooko
nizyakayimba nyenyezi zyabuchedo alimwi abana baLeza nebakoompolola mukusekelela kwabo?
Ngwani wakajalila lwizi azijazyo nilwakasika aanze, nilwakatuluka kuzwa mwida -
eelyo nindakapanga mayoba chibe chikkobela, alimwi mudima mupati.
Eechi nchichicho nchindakabika mpa aanze aalwizi amugaano , alimwi akulupingila zyelano azijazyo,
kandaamba kuti, 'Mpawo mpoyosika akutayinda, nikuba boobo, aawa mpawo mpiyoobika mugaano kumayuwe aalisumpula.'
Saa wakapa malayilile kuchifumo, naa kuchita chifumo kuziba busena bwacho,
kuti chijate nyika azyooko  akusansamuna babi kuzwa kuli njiyo?
Eelyo nyika ilasandulwa kukulibonia mbuli bulongo mbubusanduka; zyoonse zintu ziyoyima kaziboneka loko mbuli mabala-mabala aali aachisamo.
Kubantu babi balanyayigwa zyiindi zyabo  zyabo 'zyamumuni'; makuko aabo aasumpukide ayootyolwa.
Sa wakiinka kuzwa maanzi aalwizi? Sa wakalyata mububbile bwalwizi?
Sa wakatondeezegwa milyango yalufu kuli nduwe?
Saa wakamvwisisisya bweelanisyo bwanyika mbububede? Ndaambile, kuti kozizi zyoonse.
Ilikuli nzila iiya kubusena bwakulyookezya bwamumuni - amudima, bulikuli busena bwawo?
Kozulwida mumuni alimwi amudima kumasena aazyo amulimu? Yanduula nzila yakuboola kuzwa kumaanda aazyo yazyo?
Chakutadoneeka ulizi, nkaambo wakalizyedwe kale; nkaambo mweelwe wamazuba aako akomenesya!
Wakanjila muziyobwedo zyasikkunkwe, naa wakabona zilongeledo zyachivulamabwe,
eezi zintu nzindakamba kwamazuba miingi amapenzi kwamazuba akulwana ankondo?
Njiili nzila kalabi nkukakkala aamuuwo wakujwe umwayigwa biyeni aatala aanyika?
Ngwani wakachita inzila yazambangulwe lwamvula, naa ngwani wakalenga nzila yamuzumo,
kuchita kuti mvula iwe aatala aanyika kutakkali bantu, alimwi aatala lyachimpayuma, awo kutakwe muntu,
kukutya masena aamwayukide alimwi asiiyidwe, alimwi kuctita kuti inyika isyuuke masokwe?
Eno imvula ilawiisi na, naa, ngwani uuzyala malosi aalume?
Azwa mumaanza ani mankaakamba? Ngwani wakazyala chaanda chituba anze ajulu?
Maanzi alalisisa meni alimwi ngaaba mbuli mabwe; aajulu kwabubbile ngakwaba chikoto aamwi.
Ulakonzya kusunga bulilima muchisankata naa kusungulula nzyaanzyo zyaOliyoni?
Ulakonzya kusolweda ntanda kuti ibe muchiindi cheelede? Kujana wazulwida bbule abana bakwe?
Ulizi na milawu yakujulu? Ulakonzya na kwiimika milawu yakujuliu aanyika?
Ulakonzya na kunyampula jwi lyako kusika kumayoba , kuti akuzuzizye mvula nyingi ikuvumbe? Ulakonzya kweeta lulabi kuti lwiinke, kuti ikambe kulinduwe, 'Tulaano.'
Ngwani waka bika luzibo mumayoba alimwi wakatambika kumvwisisisya kubuma?
Ngwani uubala mayoba mubusongo bwakwe? Ngwani uunga ulatila maanzi kuzwa munongo zyakujulu
eelyo suko nilyachijaana ayumide mavwinga aanyika alajatana aamwi.
Ulakonzya na kuvwimina mulavu muzyazi naa kukutya nzala yabana bakwe babalavu
eelyo nibafugeme mumasempo aabo alimwi nibawusa muziyubilo nkabalala mukwiimina.
Ngwani uujanina basinkondonyina babachikwangala eelyo bana babo nibalila kuli Leza  alimwi nibadadalika akubula chakulya.
Ulizi na kuti mpongo zyamutulundu zizyala chiindiinzi twana twazyo? Nga ulalipeda na kweebela nzyazi zyazyo nezizyala?
Ngaulakonzya na kubala myeezi njezitola kaziminsi? Ulichizi na chindi nchezitumbuuka acho twana?
Zilayondoba ansi akuzyala twana twazyo, alimwi mpawo ngazyamaninsya machise azyo akuzyala.
Twana twazyo ngatwasima akukomena muntandabale zyamyuunda; balabbudilaanze akutachiyobola lubo.
Ngwani wakalekela donki lyamusokwe kuti lyangunuke? Ngwani wakangununa zyanzyo zyandonki,
eeyo njindakachitilide munzi wayo muAlabbiya, ng' anda yayo munyika yamwinyo?
Ulaseka chamusoko kulusabilo lwamudolopo; takwepe anamvwa kompolola kwabeenzyi bamyota.
Ulavuluma atala lyatulundu kumachelelo aakwe; ooko ulalanguula woonse masokwe matete kuti alye.
Musune wamusokwe ngaulakondwa na kukubelekela? Ngaulazumina na kulala mubbondo lyako?
Nkubona ulabelesya kakole na kukwanga musune wamusokwe kuti ukafolole? Nkubona ulafolola na kayobukutobelela?
Ngankubona ulamusyoma na akaambo kanguzu zyakwe mpati? Ngankubona ulamusiila mulimo na kuti achite?
Nkubona ulalangilila kuti akwetele miila ako kumunzi na, kuti akubunganisizye miyungi kuti izopolegwe?
Mababa empoo alavukuvigwa chakulisumpula, pesi ayamababa amilimba njaluyando na?
Nkaambo ilasiya mayi ayo amuseele, alimwi ilasiya kuti kalokukasalilwa mulusuko;
ilaluba kuti kuulu kukonzya kwalyata na kuti munyama wamusokwe ukonzya kwaalyata.
Ilajata chabukali twana twayo mbotatedi tatwensi twayo pe; tiyoowi pe kuti machise ayo akuzyala ulabona aaba abiyo,
nkaambo Leza wakiipa busongo alimwi takwe nakiipa kumvwisisisya.
Muchiindi nichijana kabotu, ilaseka chalweeno kumabbiza abasikwagada.
Wakalipa nguzu namp ibbiza? Wakalisamika nsingo yalyo na anzangala?
Wakali walichitya kuti lisotoke mbuli mpasu na? Nguzu zyakujindimuka kwalyo kulayoosya.
Lilajindimuka changuzu akukondwa munguzu zyalyo; lilafwambanina kuyoswanizya zilwisyo.
Lilasunka buyoofu alimwi taliyosegwi; talinzeemuki pe kupanga.
Zyeenzyo zilamonywa mumbali lyalyo, kumbali kakuli sumu limweka antomwe apanga.
Lilamena musele chabukali akuyoosya; akulila kwamweembo, takonzyi kwimikila abusena bomwe.
Kufumbwa niwalila mweembo, uwamba kuti, 'Aha!' Wanunkiizya bweema bwenkondo kuzwa kule, lompololo lwabazuluzi benkondo akukwiitilizya kwabo.
Nkubusongo bwako na gumbe nkwawuluka, zyakuti ulatalamuna mababa akwe kumyuuwo yakumusanza?
Nkumalayilile aako na nsika nchiyaka chizumbo chayo kumasena alikujulu loko?
Ilakkala kundengelezegwa alimwi ichita munzi wayo kumpela lyandengelezegwa, mpaasimide.
Kuzwa ooko ilalanguula chakulya chayo; menso ayo abonena kule loko.
Atwana twayotunywa bulowa; ooko bantu nkubajiilwa, nkonkuko nkwiibede.''
Jehova wakiinkilila kunembo kwambuula kuliJobbu; wakati,
''Uuyanda kukazya uulelede na kweezya kuzyotolola Singuzuzyoonse? Ooyo uukazyania aLeza ngasandule.''
Mpawo Jobbu wakasandula Jehova wati,
''Bona, nsili chintu; ndilakusandula buti? Ndajala mulomo wangu.
Ndakaamba lomwe, alimwi nsikoyoosandula pe; nchobeni tobilwe, pesi nsikoyooyinkilila kunembo pe.''
Mpawo Jehova wakasandula Jobbu kuzwa muguwo pati liyoosya wati, ''
Lino sunga chibunu chako mbuli mwaalumi, nkaambo ndiyookubuzya mibuzyo, alimwi weelede kuyoondisandula.
Kujana uyooti nsiluleme na? Uyondipa mulandu na kuti ukaambe kuti uliluzi webo?
Uli aakuboko kuli mbuli kwaLeza na, alimwi kujana ulabboba na ejwi lilimbuli lyakwe?
Lino lizwatike mubulemu amukutambulika; lizwatike mubweebesi amububotu.
Mwaya kunyema kwako; langa woonse uulisumpula akumweeta aansi.
anga woonse uulisumpula akumweeta aansi; lyatuuka basizibi ooko nkubayimvwi.
Kabavwike munyika antoomwe; kaange masyu aabo kumasena aasisikine.
Mpawo ndiyookuzuminina aatala anduwe kuti jaanza lyako lyalulyo lilakonzya kukufutula.
Langa lino kumvuvu, njindakalenga aawo nindakakulenga; ilalya bwizu mbuli ng'ombe.
Bona lino, nguzu zyakwe zili muchibunu chakwe; nguzu zyakwe zili mumilambi yatumbu lyayo.
Uchita muchila wakwe mbuli musida; milambi yazibelo zyayo ilijisini.
Mafuwa eeyo alimbuli mumachubbu aamukuba; mawulu aayo mbuli tuponda twabutale.
Ngusilutwe wabanyama baLeza. Luzutu Leza, wakayilenga, nguukonzya kwiizunda.
Nkaambo tulundu twiipa chakulya; banyama bamusokwe basaanina afwiifwi.
Ilala munsi lyankubbwi mumaanzi; zilayuba mumizi mutusensa.
Nkubbwi zilayivumba amatu aazyo; misamu yamutulonga iliizyungulukide.
Bona, na mulonga wazuzya nkomwe zyawo, tiyoowi pe; ili aabusichamba, nikuba Jodani wazula wapawula.
Mpali na ukonzya kwiicha akulobyo, na kwiidonkola mpemo yayo akakole?
Kujana wagwisya Leviyatani na akalobyo? Na kwaanga myeebo yakwe entambo?
Kujana wamubika kakkole na mumpemo yakwe, na kudonkola mweebo wakwe akalobyo?
Uyookukombelezya na kulinduwe? Uyoowambuula majwi mabombe na kulinduwe?
Uyoochita chizuminano na anduwe, kuti ukamubweze mbuli mulanda kwalyoonse?
Uyoosaana anguwe na mbuli mbuunga ulacita akayuni? Kujana wamwaanga na kubalanda bako basimbi?
Kujana mbunga yabalobi bamuyanda na? Kujana bamwaanzaania na kuti akawuzye aakati kabasikuuzya?
Kujana mwazuzya chikumba chakwe amasumu na mutwe wakwe amasumu aanswi?
Bika jaanza lyako aalinguwe lomwe luzutu alimwi uyooyeeya nkondo akutazooyichita limbi pe.
Bona, bulangilizi bwawooyo uuchita eezi mabejo; umwi takoyoowaalilwa aansi na akaambo kakuyoowa?
Tawo pe uukonzya kunyongania Leviyatani; mpawo ngwani uukonzya kwiimikila kunembo lyangu?
Ngwani lutaanzi wakandipa chimwi chintu kuti nzzmuliye? Kufumbwa choonse chili aansi aajulu lyoonse nchichangu.
Nsikoyoowumuna pe aatala amawulu aaLeviyatani, nikuba aatala amakani aanguzu zyakwe, nikuba aatala amubili wakwe waluzyalo.
Ngwani uukonzya kumuzwaatununa chkobela chakwe? Ngwani uukonzya kunjila zizwaato zyakwe zyempi?
Ngwani uukonzya kujula makoma aabusyu bwakwe - buzwide meno chili chiyoosyo?
Sule lyakwe lizwide mibunda yantobo, yaangidwe aamwi mbuli aachaanzyo chiyumu.
Zili aafwiifwi kuli chimwi achimwi zyakuti muuya tukonzyi pe kwiinda aakati kazyo.
Zilisweenene kuli chimwi achimwi; zilisweenene zyakuti tazikonzyi pe kwaanzanisigwa.
Mumuni ulamweka kuzwa kukuyoya kwakwe; menso akwe ali mbuli zikowe zyakumachedo.
Mumulomo wakwe kuzwa mulilo uupya, nsasi zyamulilo zilasotoka kazizwa.
Kumansonono akwe kuzwa busi mbuli bwachilongo chili kubila aamulilo wafulidwa kuti upye loko.
Kuyoya kwakwe kutenta malasya akuba bbila; mumulomo wakwe kulazwa mulilo.
Munsingo yakwe kuli nguzu, akuyoosya kulazyana kunembo lyakwe.
Mafwindi eenyama zyakwe alisweenene; alinamatide aalinguwe; taagwisiki pe.
Moyo wakwe muyumu mbuli bbwe - nchobeni muyumu mbuli ziyo.
Aawo nalibusya lwakwe mwini, nikuba baleza balayoowa; akaambo kakuyoowa, balabweedela musule.
Na panga lyamugonka, takwe nchilimuchita - nikuba sumu, kanta na chilwanio chiyasa.
Lubulo ulubona mbuli muzi, amukuba mbuli chisamu chibolede.
Kanta takamuchiti kuti achije; kulinguwe mabwe aangwelebele ngaaba buungu.
Nkoli ngazyaba mbuli mizi; ulaseka kumusabilo wesumu.
Zipanzi zyakwe zili aansi zili mbuli zifwapu zyakalongo kakafwa; usiya mukondo uuyanzabukide mumatope mbuli chileyi chipola.
Uchita maanzi kuti abile mbuli kalongo kamaanzi aabila; uchita lwizi mbuli kalongo kamafuta.
Uchita kuti mumuni umweke musule lyakwe; umwi ulabonaanga mulungu waba aamvwi.
Tawo pe weelene aawe aanyika, wakabumbwa kuti apone chakutayoowa.
Ulabona choonse chilisumpula; mwami kuli boonse bana balombe bakulisupula.''
Kuzwawo Jobbu wakasandula Jehova wakati,
''Ndilizizi kuti ulakonzya kuchita zyoonse zintu, zyakuti takwe nzyokanza zikonzya kwimikizigwa.
'Ngwani oyu utakwe abusongo unga ulingaania makanze?' Nchoonzyo, ndakambula zintu nzindakatali kumvwisisisya, zintu zyakali ziyumu loko kulindime kuti nzimvwe, ezyo nzindakateezi.
Wakati kulindime, 'Teelela, lino, alimwi ndiyowambuula; ndiyokubuzya zintu webo, alimwi uyondibuzya mebo.'
Ndakali ndamvwa atala anduwe amatwi aangu, pesi kwaino menso angu akubona.
Nchenchicho nchindalisola lwangu; ndasanduka mulusuko amudota.''

Zyakachitika kuleecho chindi nakamana kwambula majwi aya kuli Jobbu, Jehova wakati kuli Elifazi muTemanayiti, ''Bukali bwangu balungene ayebo antomwe abeenzinyokwe bobile, nkaambo takwe niwakaambula atala andime ezyoziluleme, mbuli mbwakachita mulanda wangu Jobbu.

Lino kuzwaawo, amulibwezele basipule balimusanu ababili antomwe abagutu balimusanu ababili, mwiinke kumulanda wangu Jobbu, alimwi mukapede chipayilo chenu chakuumpa. Mulanda wangu Jobbu uyomukombela, alimwi ndiyotambula nkombyo yakwe, kuchitila kuti nsikamunyonyoni akambo kabufubafuba bwenu. Takwepe nimwakambula zibotu atala andime, mbwakachita mulanda wangu Jobbu.''
Elyo Elifazi muTemanayiti, Bbiludadi muKkusyayiti, aZofa muNamatayiti bakiinka alimwi bakakuchita mbuli Jehova mbaakabalayilila, alimwi Jehova wakatambula Jobbu.
Elyo Jobbu nakakombela bazolwani bakwe, Jehova wakababwededezya zyoolwe. Jehova wakamubwedezya kwindulwidwe tubili kwinda nzyakajisi kutaanguna.

Mpawo boonseni bakulana baJobbu, antomwe abachizi bakwe, aboonse bakamwizi kumatangunino, bakasika kulinguwe akuzolya zyakulya mung'anda yakwe. Bakamufwida luzyalo akumumbulizya nkambo kamapenzi ayo Jehova ngaakali wamwetela, alimwi umwi awumwi wakapa Jobbu kampanzi kansiliva akangolide.

Jehova wakalongezya mamanino abuumi bwaJobbu kwiinda bwakutanguna; wakajisi tanga lyambelele zyulu kkumi azyulu zyone, nkamela zyuulu musanu achimwi, zipani zyabasune chuulu chomwe, alimwi achuulu chomwe chamadonki mazyazi.
Alimwi wakalijisi bana balombe balimusanu ababili antomwe abasimbi botatwe.
Wakawuzika mwana wakwe musimbi mutaanzi zina lyakuti nguJemima, wabili nguKkeziya, awatatu nguKkeleni Hapuchi.
Munyika yoonse tawope mukayintu wakajanika kalimubotu mbuli bana basimbi baJobbu. Wisaabo wakabapa lukono antomwe abachizi babo.
Musule lyazeezi, Jobbu wakapona myaka ili 140; wakabona bana bakwe antomwe abazukulu, kuyosikila kuzyalane lyane.
Mpawo Jobbu wakafwa, kaliwachembaala amazuba azulide.
Eeli ndejwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli Jowelu mwana mulombe wa Petuwelu.
Mumvwe eechi, nywebo nobapati, alimwi amuswiilizye, moonse nywebo nimukkala munyika eeli. Kuli chiliboobu na chakali chachitika na mumazuba anu na kumazuba a abamawuso?
Amwaambile bana banu aatala anchicho, alimwi bana banu baambile bana babo, a bana babo izyalane liza.
Eecho chakasiigwa a chisozi, chisozi chipati chakalya; eezyo zyakasiigwa a chisozi chipati, mpasu yakalya; alimwi chakasyaala kumpasu, chivwinyu chakalya.
Amubuke, nywebo nobachankolwa, alimwi mulile! Amoompolole, moonse nobanywi ba wayini, nkaambo wayini munono wagwisigwa kulindinywe.
Nkaambo chisi chasika aatala anyika yangu, basimide alimwi batabaliki. Meno aakwe meno a mulavu, alimwi uli aameno a mulavu muzyazi.
Wachita lubuwa lwa masansa aangu kuba busena bwatongo alimwi mukuyu tuchikwe chintu. Wakakwampa makwa aawo akwasowa; intabi zilatuba bu.
Woomoka mbuli nakalindu uuzwete masaka nkaambo kalufu lwa sibwinga wakwe muniini.
Chituzyo chazilyo a chituzyo chakunywa zyakagwisigwa kuzwa mung'anda ya Jehova. Bapayizi, balanda ba Jehova, amulile.
Myuunda yaba matongo; nyika yalila nkaambo zilyo zyanyonyooka. Wayini mupya wayuminina; mafuta taachiwo pe.
Amuuse nsoni, nywebo nobalimi, alimwi moompolole, nywebo nimubyala, nkaambo ka bulotwe a bbali. Nkaambo butebuzi bwamumyuunda bwamana.
Misaansa yapusama, alimwi mikuyu yayuma; mi pomegilenati, a mikunka, a mimbula - amisamu yoonse yamumuunda yapusama. Nkaambo lukondo lwapusama kuzwa kumukowa wabantu aaba.

Amuzwaate masaka alimwi mulile, nywebo nobapayizi! Amoompolole, nywebo nobalanda ba chipayililo. Musike, mukalale busiku boonse mumasaka, nywebo nobalanda  ba Leza wangu. Nkaambo chituuzyo chazilyo a chituuzyo chakunywa zyakalesegwa kuzwa kung'anda ya Leza wanu.
Amwiitilile kulyiimya kusalala, alimwi akuswaanana kusalala. Mukabunganie basilutwe abakkali benyika ku ng'anda ya Jehova Leza wanu, alimwi mukalile kuli Jehova.
Maawe kubuzuba! Nkaambo buzuba bwa Jehova bwaamba kusika. Buyooza alunyonyooko kuzwa kuli Singuzuzyoonse.
Sa teensi chakulya chakasigwa na kumenso eesu, alimwi lukondo akubotelwa kuzwa kung'anda ya Leza wesu?
Inseke zilabola munsi lyamaganga aazyo, zitula zyakasiigwa a matala akanyonyoonwa, nkaambo zilyo zyakayuma.
Mbuli ng'ombe mbuzitongela! Matanga aabo ayobweenda mukubulikilwa nkaambo taakwe machezezyo. Nikuba matanga aambelele alikoomba.
Jehova, ndalila kulinduwe. Nkaambo mulilo wakatenta machezezyo woonse amulusaka, alimwi mabangabanga akatenta yoonse misamu yamumyuunda.
Nikuba banyama bamusokwe balilila nduwe, nkaambo maanzi amutulonga akayuminina, alimwi mulilo wakatenta machezezyo amulusaka.
Amulizye mweembo mu Ziyoni, alimwi amuume mubila a chilundu changu chisalala! Bantu boonse bamunyika ngabakankame mukuyowa, nkaambo buzuba bwa Jehova bwasika; nchoonzyo, buli afwifwi.

Mubuzuba bwamudima akusiya, mubuzuba bwa mayoba amakumbi aasiya mbi. Mbuli gonta lizuzizye chilundu, impi mpati  iili amanguzu iyoobuza. Takwe nikwakali kwaba mpi ili mbuli njiyo, alimwi takwe niyooba pe limbi, nikuba musule la mazyalane miingi.

Mulilo ulikutenta zyoonse kunembo lyayo, alimwi musule lyayo mabangabanga ali kutenta. Nyika yaba mbuli muunda wa Ideni kunembo lyayo, pesi musule lyayo kuli nkanda yakanyonyoonwa. Nchobeni, takwe chiyoonzwenga kuzwa kulinjiyo.
Impi yakaboneka mbuli mabbiza, alimwi balachijaana mbuli ba simabbiza.
Balasotoka amuzuzuzmo mbuli oowo wankalaki aajulu azilundu, mbuli muzuzuzmo wa mabangabanga aamulilo aayo aatenta misunta, mbuli mpi yamanguzu ilibambilinde kulwana.
Mubuliwo bwabo bantu balimukulila alimwi masyu aabo boonse aliwuside.
Balachijaana mbuli basikulwana banguzu; balatanta malambo mbuli basilumamba; baleenda, woonse mukululama, alimwi tabatyoli milongo yabo pe.
Kakutakwe naba womwe uutontela umwi kumbali; baleenda, umwi awumwi munzila yakwe; baliinda mukulwisya alimwi tabawidi anze kwa muzila.
Baafwambaana muchisi, balachijaana abulambo, balatanta mumaanda, alimwi baliinda muzimpulunguzyo mbuli babbi.
Nyika ilazungana kunembo lyabo, majulu alakankama, izuba a mweezi zilasizigwa, anyenyeezi zilaleka kumweka.

Jehova wanyampula ijwi lyakwe unembo lya mpi yakwe, nkaambo basinkondo bakwe bavula; nkaambo balisimide, aabo babweza malayilile aakwe. Nkaambo buzuba bwa Jehova mbupati alimwi bulayoosya. Ngwani uunga ulafutuka?
''Pesi nikuba lino,'' mbwaamba Jehova, ''Amuboole kulindime amoyo wanu woonse. Mulyiimye, mulile, alimwi musintikile.''

Mudelule myoyo yanu kutensi zikobela zyanu luzutu, alimwi muboole uli Jehova Leza wanu. Nkaambo uli aluse a luzyalo, tafwambanai kunyema alimwi kazwide buuya buli aluyando lwiingi, alimwi ulalilesya kukubapa chisubulo.
Ngwani uuzi? Kujana waboola na akuba aluzyalo, akusiya chilongezyo musule lyakwe, chipo chakunywa a chipo chazilyo cha Jehova Leza wanu?
Amulizye mweembo mu Ziyoni, mwiitilile kulyiimya kusalala, alimwi mwiite mbungano iisalala.
Mubunganie bantu; mwiite mbungano iisalala. Amubunganie bazululi; mubunganie bana abanikenike. Basibwiinga ngabazwe mumaanda aabo, abanabwiinga bazwe muzikalilo zyabo.

Bapayizi, balanda ba Jehova, ngabalile aakati kamanjililo a chipayililo. Ngabaambe kuti, ''Lekelela bantu bako, Jehova, alimwi mutachiti lukono lwanu kuchintu chansesya, kuti zisi zikabasampawule. Nkaambonzinibatakaambe aakati kamanyika kuti, 'Nguli Leza wabo?'''
Mpawo Jehova wakasungwaalila nyika yakwe alimwi wakaba aluzyalo aabantu bakwe.
Jehova wakasandula bantu bakwe, ''Amubone, ndiyomutumizya zilyo, wayini mupya, a mafuta. Muyokutisikana anzizyo, alimwi nsichiyomuchiti chisesemyo aakati kamaasi.

Ndiyogwisya basikumulwana bakunyika kule andinywe, alimwi ndiyobatandila munyika njumu alimwi yakasiigwa. Basinembo ba mpi yabo bayooya mulwizi lwa kujwe, abali musule bayooya mulwizi lwa kumbo. Bweema bwayo buyoonyampuka, alimwi chigunsu chayo chiyoonyampuka.'' Nchobeni, wachita zintu zipati.
Utayowi, nyika; sekelela a kukondwa, nkaambo Jehova uyookuchitila zintu zipati.
Mutayowi, nobanyama bamusokwe! Nkaambo machelelo amusokwe ayoosyuka, misamu iyoozyalamichelo, mikuyu a misaansa iyochita butebuzi bwayo buzwide.
Amusekelele, nobantu ba Ziyoni, alimwi mubotelwe muli Jehova Leza wanu. NKaambo uyomupa mvula ntulukwa muchiindi cheelede akumweetela lunywanywa, mvula ntulukwa ayamusule mbuli chiindi chiinda.
Mbuwa zyakupolela ziyozula bulotwe, aziyobwedo ziyofwasuuka a wayini mupya a mafuta.
''Ndiyomubozezya minyaka yazilyo zyakalyigwa a chisozi - chisozi chipati, nswabanda, a chamusokonya - impi yangu yanguzu njindakatuma aakati kanu.
Muyolya zyiingi alimwi muyookuta, alimwi muyolumbayizya zina lya Jehova Leza wanu, ooyo wachita zigambyo aakati kanu, alimwi nsikoyoyeta limbi kuusa abantu bangu.
Muyoziba kuti ndili aakati ka Izilayeli, alimwi kuti ndime Jehova Leza wanu, akuti takwe umbi pe, mpawo nsikoyoyeta kuusa abantu bangu.

Kuyoochitika musule lya zeezi kuti ndiyotila Muuya wangu aanyama yoonse, alimwi bana benu balombe a bana benu basimbi bayosinsima. Manene banu bayoolota ziloto; baalumi banu baniini bayobona zilengano.
Alubo ndiyotila Muuya wangu kubalanda a kubalanda banakazi.
Ndiyootondeezya zigambyo kujulu aanyika, bulowa, mulilo, a misumpuululu yabusi.
Izuba liyooba mudima amweezi uyooba bulowa, buzuba bupati buyoosya bwa Jehova nkabutanaasika.

Kuyooba kuti woonse wiita muzina lya Jehova uyoofutulwa. Nkaambo a Chilundu cha Ziyoni a mu Jelusalema kuyooba aabo batakanzwensegwe, mbuli mbakaamba, alimwi aakati basikufutuka kuli baabo Jehova mbatakiite.
Amubone,mumazuba ayo amuchiindi echo, eelyo nenjoobozya bange muJuda aJelusalema,
Njobungania  zisi zyoonse, akuzileta mumumpata waJehosafati. Njobabeteka nkuko,nkaambo kabantu bangu achisi chaIzilayeli, abo mbibakamwayisya akati kamasi, akaambo kakuti bakaabana nyika yangu,
Babawulila zisolo bantu bangu, balawuzya mulombe kubumambe, akuuzya musimbi awayini kuti banywe.
Lino,  nkaambonzi nuwanyemena ndime,Tulo,Sidoni azyoonse zisi zyaba Filisitiya? Mulandibozezya na? Nikuba temwandibozezya, Ndiyofwambana kubozya zibbadazyo zyanu atala amitwe yanu.
Nkaambo mwabweza nsiliva yangu angolide yangu, alimwi mwatola zintu zyangu ziyandisi muzikombelo zyanu.
Mwawuzya bantu baJuda aJelusalema kubaGilikki, kuchitila kuti babe kule kuzwa kunyika yabo.
Laanga, ndamba kubabusya, kuzwa kubusena nkumwakabawuzizizye, akubwedezya zibbadazyo atala amitwe yanu.
Njowuzya bana banu balombe abasimbi, mumamanza abantu baJuda.Bayobawuzya kubantu bakuSebbani, kuchisi chilikule, mbawamba Jehova.
''Amwambe aya akati kazisi:'' Mulibambilile lwanu nubeni inkondo, mubusye balumi basinguzu, mubabuzye baswene afwifwi, aboonse balumi basilumamba babuke.
Mufule maamba anu abe mapanga azizibyo zyatufulo zibe masumu.Mutetete awambe kuti, 'Ndime singuzu.'
Mufwambane amusike, moonse nozisi zyeengelede; mubungane moonse antoomwe nkukoko. Jeheva, yeta basilumamba bapati.
Muleke zisi zibuke lwazyo akwiinka kumumpata waJehosafati. Nkaambo nkuko nkwentanokkede akubeteka zisi zizyungulukide.
Mubikke chigonsyo, nkaambo zyakutyola zyabizwa. Muboole, mupole masansa, nkaambo zibikkilo zyazula.Idindi lyazula, nkaambo abubi bwabo mbupati.''
Kuli makamu, makamu mumumpata walubeta. Nkaambo buzuba bwaJehova bwaba afwifwi mumumpata walubeta.
Izuba amwezi ziyoba mudima , inyenyezi zyasowa mumuni wazyo.
Jehova uyovuluma kuzwa kuziyoni, alimwi uyonyampula ijwi lyakwe kuzw kuJelusalema. Majulu anyika ziyozungaana, pesi Jehova uyoba cheenzule kubantu bakwe, alimwi ndimpangala lyabantu baIzilayeli.
''Muyoziba kuti Ndime Jehova Leza wanu ukkala muZiyoni, muchilundu changu chisalala. Mpawo Jelusalema uyosalalisya, abazwamasi tabakoyoyinda mulinguwe alimbi.

Kuyoba mbuli obiya buzuba bwakuti zilundu ziyogwisya wayini munono, tulundu tuyokunka malili, toonse tulonga twa Juda tuyoyenda manzi, alimwi kasensa kayozwa mung'anda yaJehova akutilila mumumpata waSitimu.
Ijipiti uyosowegwa mbuli chintu biyo, aEdomu uyosowegwa mbuli nkanda, nkaambo kampyompyongano zyakachitika kubantu baJuda,nkaambo bakatila bulowa bwabatakwe mulandu munyika yabo.
Pesi Juda uyokkalilila lyoonse aJelusalema  uyokkalilila kuzwa kuzyalani kusikila kuzyalani.  Njoobwedezya bulowa bwabo obo mbuntana bweedezya,nkaambo Jehova ulikkede muZiyoni.''
Lino ijwi lya Jehova lyakasikila Jona mwana mulombe wa Amitayi, liti,
Nyampuka uyinke kuNinive, idolopo pati, alimwi ukakambawuke, nkaambo bubi bwawo bwasika munembo lyangu.

Pele Jona wakanyampuka akuchija kuzwa mubuliwo waJehova akwiinka kuTasyisyi. Wakaseluka kuya kuJopa alimwi wakakujana bwaato buya kuTasyisyi.  Aboobo wakaliya akunjila mubwaato kuti ayinke aabo kuTasyisyi, kuzwa kubuliwo bwaJehova.
Pesi Jehova wakatumina iguwo pati loko mulwizi alimwi kwakaba mayuwe mapati mulwizi. Kwakaba aanga bulakwamuka bwaato chakufwambana.

Mpawo basikweenzya bakayowa loko alimwi umwi awumwi wakalila kuli Leza wakwe. Bakasowela mumaanzi zintu zyakali mubwaato kuti buubilwe. Pesi Jona wakali waselukila aansi mulikamwi kaanda aakati kabwaato, alimwi wakalilede mung'onzi mpati loko.
Aboobo mweendelezi wakamwiinkila akumwaambila kuti, "Niinzi nchochita iwe nulikoona? Buka! Yita Leza wako! Amwi Leza wako walinotuyeya kuti tutafwi."
Umwi awumwi wakambila mwenzinyina kuti, "Sika, tusonde, aboobo kuti tuzibe kuti nguni wayuchitila bubi bulokuchitika akati kesu. " Aboobo bakasonda, alimwi inkakata yakawida Jona.
Mpawo bakaambila Jona kuti, "Ikaka tubuzye kuti ngwani ulokuchita bubi bwatuchitikila. Ubeleka mulimuunzi? a;imwi wazwida kuli? Nchiichili chisi chako, alimwi uzwa kubantu bakuli?"
Jona wakabambila kuti, "NdimuHebbulayo, alimwi ndayoowa Jehova, Leza wakujulu, wakalenga lwizi anyika njumu."
Nkaambo baalumi bakalizi kuti wachija kuzwa mubuliwo bwaJehova, nkaambo wakali wabambila.
Mpawo bakaambila Jona kuti, ''Tuchite byeeni kuti lwizi lutuumunine swe?'' Nkambo lwizi lwavula mayuwe. Jona wakabaambila kuti, ''Amundibweze akundisowela mulwizi.
Mpawo lwizi luyomuumunina nkaambo ndilizi nkambo kangu nchikulo kuchitika mayuwe mapati aakati kenu.
Nekuba boobo, baalumi bakayambisya kuti basike aanyika, pesi teebakakonzya pe nkaambo lwakasika mpulu vula akuvula kubanyemena.

Aboobo bakakwiilila Jehova akwamba kuti, ''Twakumbilisya, Jehova, twakumbilisisya, utatuleki tufwe nkaambo kabubi bwayoyu mwaalumi, alimwi utabiki bulowa bwa uululeme aalindiswe nkaambo iwe, Jehova, wachita chikubotezya we.''
Aboobo bakabweza Jona alimwi bakamusowela mulwizi, alimwi lwakawumuna kuzungaana.
Mpawo bakapa chipayizyo kuli Jehova alimwi bakachita chikonke.
Mpawo Johova wakabambide muswi mupati loko kuti umene Jona, alimwi Jona wakali mwida lyamuswi kwamazuba aatatu amansikuotaatwe.
Mpawo Jona wakakomba kuli Jehova Leza wakwe mubula bwamuswi.
Wakamba kuti, ''Ndakayita kuli Jehova atala akupenga kwangu alimwi wakandivwila; kuzwa kukabanda kamwida ndakakwiilila kugwasigwa! Wakamvwa ijwi lyangu.
Wakandiswela alamfu, mumoyo walwizi, alimwi milonga yakalindindizyunguluka; amayuwe ako oonse a mpwmpwa zyakayinda atala lyangu.
Ndamba kuti, 'Nditandidwe kuzwa kumeso ako; Nikuba boobo nkatambye meso ako kung'anda yaLeza isalala'.
Maanzi miingi akandijalila akundizyunguluka kusika kunsingo yangu; Maanzi malamfu akandizyunguluka; Insaku zyamulwizi zyakalambila kuzyunguluka mutwe wangu.
Ndakaseluka kunsi antalisyo yazilundu; Inyika aziyako zyayo zyakandijalila kwalyoonse. Pele wakaboozya buumi bwangu kuzwa mumulindi waJehova Leza wangu!
Eelyo muuya wangu nwakawizuka mulindime, ndakiita Jehova kumizezo; mpawo inkombyo yangu yakasika kulindime, kung'anda yaLeza isalala.
Balaswilizya kulibaleza batagwasyi akukaka chizuminano chakusyomeka.
Pesi me, ndiyopayila kuli nduwe ajwi lyakupa kulumba; Ndiyozuzikizya eecho nchindakakonkezya. Lufutuko luzwa kuli Jehova!''
Mpawo Jehova wambila inswi, alimwi yakaluka Jona atala lyanyika injumu
Ijwi lyaJehova lyakasika kuli Jona lwabili, liti,
Nyampuka, kuya kuNiniva, eliya dolopo pati, akuyookambawuka makani ngindakulayilila kuti ukabape.
Aboobo Jona wakanyampuka akwiinka kuNinive, mbuli mbwakalayililwa ajwi lyaJehova. Lino Ninive lyakali dolopo pati loko, lweendo lwamazuba otaatwe.
Jona wakatalika kunjila mudolopo alimwi nakamaninsya lweendo lwazuba limwi wakayita akwamba kuti, "Mukati kamazuba alikkumi aane,  Niniva iyoonyonyonwa ."
Bantu bakuNinive bakasyoma Leza akubambilila kulyiimya kulya. Mpawo boonse bakazwaata zisamo zyamasaka, kuzwa kumupati kusikila kumuniini.
Makani akasika chakufwambana kumwaami wakuNinive. Wakanyampuka kuzwa achuuno chakwe chabwaami, wakazwatununa zisamo zyakwe, wakalivumba azisamo zyamasaka, akukkala mudyota.

Wakatumizya mulumbe iwaamba kuti, "MuNinive, anguzu zyamwaami abeendelezi bakwe: 'Mutaleki muntu naba munyama, niziba ng'ombe, nikuba mbelele, utalabili nichiba chilibuti. Zitabi nizilya, nikuba kunywa.
Pele muchite kuti muntu aantomwe amunyama bavumbwe azisamo zyamasaka akoompololisya kuli Leza. Akube kuti umwi awumwi aleke kuzwa kububi bwakwe akuzwa kunguzu eziya zili mumaanza aakwe.
Ngwani uuzi? Leza umwi ulatontozya bukali akuyeya bumbi amiyeeyo yakwe akulesya bukkali bwakwe buyoosya  aboobo kuti tutanyonyooki.
Leza wakabona nchitozyabo, kuti baleke inzila zyabo zyabubi. Aboobo mpawo Leza wakaleka miyeeyo yakwe ilaatala akubanyonyona eeyo njakaambide kuti uliichita, alimwi takayichita pe.
Pesi ezi tezyakamubotezya pe Jona wakanhyema loko.

Aboobo Jona wakakomba kuli Jehova akuti, ''Aa, Jehova, eezi tenzizyo naa nzindakaambide nindakachili muchisi changu? Aalya nchinchicho nchindakachita kusanguna akwezya kuchijila kuTasyisyi--nkambo ndakalizi kuti nduwe Leza siluzyalo, Ulabuuya, utafwambani kunyema alimwi luyando lwako ndupati, alimwi ulaleka kutumina lunyonyooko.
Kuzwawo lino Jehova, Ndakukumbila, gwisya buumi bwangu mulindime, nkambo kufwa kwandibotela kwiinda kupona.''
Jehova wakaamba kuti, ''Nchibotuna kuti kunyemede loko?''
Mpawo Jona wakazwa anze lyadolopo akuyokkala kujwe lyadolopo. Mpawo wakayaka chitumba wakukkala munsi lyachenzule kuti abone chitasikile dolopo.
Jehova Leza wakamubambila bbonobono akulichita kuti limene ajulu lya Jona kuti amubikile mwenzule amutwe akumugwisya kubijilwa. Jona wakali wabotelwa loko nkambo kabbonobono.
Pesi Leza wakabamba isenda nibwakacha kuseni mpolitantila izuba. Lyakalya ibbonobono alimwi ibbonobono lyakapusama.

Alimwi izuba nilyakapasula kuseni kutobela, Leza wakabamba luuwo ilupya luzwa kujwe. Alubo izuba lyakawuma Jona lino wakakkatala. Mpawo Jona wakalombozya kufwa. Wakamba kuti kulinguwe, nkubotu kufwa kwinda kupona.''
Mpawo Leza wakambila Jona kuti, ''Sa nchibotu kuti unyeme obu nkambo kabbonobono na?'' Mpawo Jona wakati, ''Nchibotu kuti ndinyemede nikuba kufwa.'''
Jehova wakati, ''Wafwida insoni ibbonobono ndiwatabelekela pe, andiwakatachita kuti limene. Lyakamena mansiku alimwi lyakazofwa mansiku.
Aboobo imebo, sa nsikkonzyi kufwida nsoni Niniva, eliya dolopo pati, mulibantu bayinda 120,000 batazi musiyanso akkati kakuboko kwalulyo akuboko kwachimweensi, alimwi abanyama bayingi?''
Lino chakasika chiindi akuzwa kufwa kwa Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova wakambula a Joshuwa mwana wa Nuni, Mozesi similimo wamwami, wakati,
''Mozesi, mulanda wangu, wafwa. Lino nkambo kako , buka, zubuka oyu Jodani, iwe abantu aba boonse muye munyika eyo njeyo bapa--bana ba Izilayeli.
Ndamupa busena boonse kufumbwa ndyato zyamawulu anu mpuziyolyata. Njozipa ndinywe, mbubonya mbundakasyomezya Mozesi.
Kuzwa munkanda a Lebbanoni, kule kule amulonga mupati, Yufuleti, ayoonse nyika ya Hititisi, akusika kulwizi lupati, oko izuba nkolibbilila, iyoba nyika yenu.
Takwepe naba omwe uyosyaala kayimvwi kunembo lyenu wonse mazuba akupona kwenu. Ndiyoba anywebo mbuli mbundakali a Mozesi. Nsikoyo kufutatila nanka kukusiya pe.
Koyuma akuba mukozu. Uyochitya bantu aba bakakone nyika eyo njindakasyomezya basikale babo kuti njoyipa mbabo.

Koyuma akuba mukozu loko. Uchenjele akulemeka wonse mulawu wa Mozesi mulanda wangu ngwakulayilila. Utachebuki kuzwa kulinguwo nikuba kululyo nikuba kuchimwensi, kuchitila kuti mube achoolwe konse nkomuya.
Kwalyonse uyowambula atala abbuku eli lyamulawu. Uyoyeeya ndilyo sikati amansiku kuchitila kuti ulemeke zyoonse zilembedwe mulindilyo. Alimwi uyozwidilila akuba aacholwe.
Tendakakulayilila na? Koyuma akuba mukozu! Utayoowi. Jehova Leza wako uli ayebo konse nkoya.''
Elyo Joshuwa wakalayilila bazuluzi babantu,
''Amwiinde muzilawu akulayilila bantu, ''Amulibambile zyakuligwasya lwenu nubeni. Mumazuba otatwe, muyozubuka oyu Jodani akunjila akuvuba nyika eyo Jehova njayomupa kuti mwiivube.''
Kuba Lubbenayiti, ba Gaditisi antomwe achisela chaluzubo lwa Manase, Joshuwa wakati,
''Amuyeeye ijwi elyo Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova, ndyakamulayilila wakati, 'Jehova Leza wenu wamupa kulyokezya, alimwi wamupa eyi inyika.'
Banakazi benu abanini benu, ambono zyenu ziyokkala munyika eyo Mozesi njamupa musule lya Jodani. Pesi balumi basikulwana bayoyinka aamwi abalombe akuyobagwasya
kusikila Jehova akabape kulyokezya mbuli mbwakapa nduwe. Mpawo uyobweda kunyika yako akwivuba, inyika eyo Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova njamupa musule lya Jodani, oko izuba nkolizwida.''
Alimwi bakasandula Joshuwa, kuti, ''Zyonse nziwatulayilila tulazichita, akoonse nkotutuma tulayinka.
Tuyokulemeka mbubonya mbuli mbotwakalemeka Mozesi. Kupela Jehova Leza wako kanoli ayebo, mbuli mbwakali a Mozesi.
Kufumbwa upapila akukazya malayilile aako akutaswilila majwi ako uyojayigwa. Biyo koyuma akuba mukozu.''

Lino Joshuwa mwana wa Nuni wakatuma bantu bobile kuzwa ku Shitimu mbuli basikutweela nyiika. Wakati, Ámwiinke, mukalange inyika , kunyanya ku Jelikko.'' Bakinka akusikila kung'anda ya simamambe utegwa Lahabbu, akuyowona nkukoko.
Umwi wakamwambila mwami wa Jelikko, ''Langa, bantu baku Izilayeli bazokuno kuzolangalanga nyika yesu.''
Mwami wa Jelikko wakatuma ijwi kuli Lahabbu akuti, ''Gwisya bantu abo basika kulinduwe banjila mung'anda yako, nkambo bazida kuzolangalanga nyika yonse.''
Pesi mwanakazi wakabweza bantu abo akubasisa. Wakasandula, ''Iyii, bantu bakasika kuli ndime, pesi tendakabaziba ankubakazwida.
Bazwa ano nkakuchisiya, kuchindi chakujalwa kwamilyango. Nsizi pe nkobaya. Na mwabatobela muyobeezya kuti mwafwambana.''
Pesi wakaba tansika akaluli kang'anda akubasisa amwi azisiko zyabulonje nzyakayanikide aanze akaluli.
Eelyo bantu bakinka kuyobubatobela mumugwagwa ubatola kuchito chaJodani. Milyango yakajalwa mpawo mpawo akuzwa kwaba sikubatobela.
Bantu kabatana kulala aansi mansiku, wakinka kulimbabo akaluli.
Wakati, ''ndilizi kuti Jehova wamupa inyika alimwi buyofu bwanu bwasikilandiswe. Boonse abo bapona munyika bayomwayika kunembo lyako.

Twakamvwa Jehova mbwakayuminizya manzi alwizi lusalala kuchiindi nimwakazwa ku Ijiputi. Mpawo twakamvwa nzyakachitila kubaami bobile ba Amoli kubbazu limwi lya Jodani---Sihoni antomwe a Ogii-- oyo nguwakamaninsya kunyonyoona.
Mpawo mpawo mbutwakamvwa kuti, myoyo yesu yakayaaya alimwi katachikwe pe bukozu bwakasyala muli umwi naba omwe -- nkambo Jehova Leza wanu, ngu Leza kujulu aatala amunyika aansi.
Lino bwayino, inche mundisyomezye muli Jehova kuti, mbuli mbundaba aluzyalo kuli ndinywe, mbubo andinywe amukandichitile mbubo ang'anda yataata chaluzyalo. Amundipe chitondezyo chisinizizye
kuti mukape kupona kuli taata, bakulana, bachizi aboonse beng'anda zyabo, alimwi ezyo ziyotuvuna kuzwa kulufu.''
Bantu aba bakati kulinguwe, ''Buumi bwesu mbubwenu, naa nkufwa! Na kamutambuli atala anzitwayobwendela, mpawo, kuchindi Jehova nchayotupa nyika eyi tuyofwidwa luzyalo akusyomeka kuli nduwe.''
Elyo wakabaselusya antambo aansi bayinda ampulunguzyo. Ng'anda njakali kukkala yakayakidwe mukati kabulambo bwamunzi.
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Mwiinke muzilundu alimwi mukayube na basikumutobela bayomubona. Mukayube nkuko kwamazuba otatwe kusikila basikumutobela bakabole. Mpawo mukinke kunembo alwendo lwenu.''
Bantu aba bakati kulinguwe, ''Tatukoyo wangwa na kuchisyomezyo nchitwa kasyomezyania kuti, na temwakuchita eechi.
Chindi nchetuyobola munyika eyi, uyelede kuyowanga intambo eyi isalalisya ampulunguzyo eyo njiwakatuseluzya ansi. alimwi muyoswanana mung'anda yawuso abanyoko, bakulana bakoabe ng'anda yawuso boonse.

Kufumbwa uyendeenda aanze amilyango yamanda anu munzila, bulowa bwabo buyoba amitwe yabo alimwi tatukwepe mulandu. Pesi na ijanza lyatandabikwa ali umwi uli anywebo mung'anda, bulowa bwakwe buyoba amitwe yesu.
Pesi na mwambuula atala amakani esu, muyo wangununwa kuchikonke nchimwakatukonkezya.''
Lahabbu wakasandula, ''Nzimwamba azichitwe.'' Wakabaleka bayinka akumusiya. Mpawo wakanga intambo isalalisya ampulunguzyo.
Bakanyampuka akutanta muzilundu alimwi bakayokkala mazuba otatwe kusikila basikubatobela babweeda. Basikubatobela bakalanguula kumbali amigwagwa alimwi takwepe angubakajana.
Bantu bobile bakabweeda akuzubuka alimwi bakabola kuli Joshuwa mwana wa Nuni, akumwambila zyoonse, zyakachitika kuli mbabo.
Bakati kuli Joshuwa, ''Nkasimpe Jehova wakapa inyika eeyi kulindiswe. Bonse bakkala munyika eyi tabakoyokonzya pe kutukasya nkambo baliyowede nkambo kesu.''
Joshuwa nakabuka chifumofumo, alimwi wakalanga kuzwa ku Syilimu. Akusika ku Jodani, wenya abantu boonse ba Izilayeli, alimwi bakakkala nkukonya nkabatana kuzubuka mutala.
Nikwakayinda mazuba otatwe, bazuluzi bakayinda akkati kakakuti;
bakalayilila bantu, ''Eelyo nimwabona ibbokesi lyachizuminano cha Jehova Leza wenu, abapayizi kuzwa kuba Levi nkabali bwezede, mulelede kuzwa kubusena obu akulitobela.

Kwelede kuba mweenya akati kenu andilyo ukonzya kuba zyuulu zyobile zyatukkokola. Tamwelede kuswena afwifwi andilyo, kuchitila kuti mubone inzila njimukonzya kwinka anjiyo, mbomunga tamuna bunsi mwinda enzila eyi.''
Joshuwa wakati kubantu, ''Kamulisalazya nobeni junza, nkambo Jehova uyochita zigambyo akati kenu.''
Mpawo Joshuwa wakambila bapayizi, ''Mubweze bbokesi lyechizuminano, alimwi mwiinde kunembo lyabantu.'' Aboobo bakanyampula ibbokesi lyechizuminano alimwi bakiinda kunembo lyabantu.
Jehova wakambila Joshuwa, ''Buzuba obuno ndakuchita kuti ube mwalumi mupati kumenso aba Izilayeli boonse. Baloziba kuti mbuli mbundakali a Mozesi, ndinoli ayebo.
Ulalayilila bapayizi abo babweza ibbokesi lyachizuminano,  'Elyo nimwasika biyo kumaanzi a Jodani, mulelede kwimikila mumo mumulonga wa Jodani.''
Mpawo Joshuwa wakambila bantu ba Izilayeli, ''Kamuza okuno, akuswilila kumajwi a Jehova Leza wanu.
Mulicheechi mulaziba kuti Leza upona uli akati kanu alimwi uyotanda kuzwa kunembo lyanu ba Kkenanayiti, ba Hititi, ba Hiviti, ba Peleziti, ba Gigasyiti, ba Amolayiti, aba Jebbusyiti.
Amubone ! Ibbokesi lyachizuminano chamwami wanyika yoonse lilazubuka kunembo lyanu muli Jodani.
Lino kosala balumi kuzwa kumikowa yaba Izilayeli, omwe mwalumi kuzwa kulumwi.

Eelyo indyato zyamawulu abapayizi abo babweza ibbokesi lya Jehova, mwami wanyika yoonse, zyatompa maanzi a Jodani, manzi a Jodani ayowanzana, alimwi nekuba manzi ayo ayeta kaseluka kuzwa kukalonga kali atala kayoyimikila kweeta akwimikila kuchilwi chomwe.''
Nkinkaako elyo bantu bakalonga kuyotimbula Jodani, bapayizi abo bakabwezede ibbokesi lyachizuminano bakayinka kunembo lya bantu.
Mpawo -mpawo abo bakabwezede ibbokesi nibakasika ku Jodani, alimwi amawulu ababo bakabwezede twango twakatompa mumanzi (Lino Jodani ulayeta moonse munkomwe zyawo chindi choonse chakutebula),

Manzi ayo akayetede kaseluka kuzwa kutala lya kalonga akayimikila akulundana chiilwi chomwe. Manzi akayimikila kweeta kuzwa kule loko. Manzi akayimikila kweta kuzwa ku Adamu, munzi oyo ulikumbali lya Zaletani, inzila yonse kuselukila kulwizi lwa Alabba, lwizi lwamwinyo. Bnatu bakazubuka mutala kufwafwi aku Jelikko.
Bapayizi abo bakabwezede ibbokesi lya chizuminano cha Jehova bakayimikila anyika njumu mukati aakati ka Jodani kusikila bantu boonse ba Izilayeli bazubuka batimbula anyika injumu.
Elyo bantu boonse nibakatimbula mutala lya Jodani, Jehova wakati kuli Joshuwa,
''Kolisalila balumi balikkumi ababili kuzwa akati kabantu, uumwi mwalumi kuzwa kumukowa omwe.
Kobapa mulazyo oyu: 'Kamubweza mabwe alikkumi abili kuzwa akati lya Jodani oko bapayizi nkubayimvwi anyika injumu, alimwi ubete mutala anduwe alimwi ubalazike aansi mubusena oko nkomuyolala sunu.''
Mpawo Joshuwa wakayita balumi balikkumi ababili abo mbakali wasala kuzwa kumikowa yaba Izilayeli, omwe kuzwa kumukowa.

Joshuwa wakati kulimbabo, ''Kamuya mutala kunembo lyabbokesi lya Jehova Leza wenu mukati akkati ka Jodani. Umwi awumwi akabweze bbwe atala lyamakkuko akwe, mbuli myeelwe yamikowa yabantu ba Izilayeli.
Echi chiyoba chitondezyo akkati kanu elyo bana banu nibakumubuzya kumazuba aachiza, Áya mabwe chambaanzi kuli ndinywe?'

Mpawo muyobambila kuti, 'Manzi a Jodani akaanzaana kunembo lyebbokesi lyachizuminano cha Jehova. Elyo nilyakayinda atala lya Jodani, manzi a Jodani akadunsukana. Aboobo aya mabwe chiyoba chiibalusyo kubantu ba Izilayeli kwalyoonse.''

Bantu ba Izilayeli bakachita mbuli Joshuwa mbwakaba layilila bakabweza mabwe alikkumi aabili kuzwa aansi lya Jodani, mbuli Jehova mbakambila Joshuwa. Bakabweza mabwe mbuli myelwe yamikowa yabantu ba Izilayeli. Bakazubuka awo mabwe, mutala kubusena oko nkubakakoona alimwi bakakwabika ansi nkuko.

Mpawo Joshuwa wakayimika mabwe alikkumi aabili mukati akati kamulonga wa Jodani, mubusena oko ndyato zyaba payizi abo bakabwezede ibbokesi lyechizuminano nkulyakimvwi. Chibalusyo mpuchili muzuba elino.

Bapayizi abo bakabwezede ibbokesi bakayimikila mukati akati lya Jodani kusikila zyoonse ezyo Jehova nzyakalayilide Joshuwa kuti aambile bantu zyamaninina, mbuli zyonse ezyo Mozesi nzyakalayilila Joshuwa. Bantu bakafwambana alimwi bakazubuka mutala.
Eelyo boonse bantu nibakamana kuzubukila mutala, ibbokesi lya Jehova abapayizi bakazubukila mutala kunembo lyabantu.
Bamukowa wa Lubbeni, bamukowa wa Gadi, achimpanzi chimwi chamukowa wa Manase chakazulula kunembo lyabantu ba Izilayeli bakapanga mbuli nkamu yabasilumamba, mbuli Mozesi mbwaka baambilide.
Kusikila kuzyuulu zyone zyabalumi bakasamide zilwanisyo zyankondo bakayinda kunembo lya Jehova, zyankondo kunembo lyantandabale ya Jelikko.
Mubuzuba obo Jehova ndyakakomezya Joshuwa mumenso aba Izilayeli boonse. Bakamulemekezya - bukozyenie mbuli mbubakalemya Mozesi-mumazuba akwe woonse.
Mpawo Jehova wakambuula kuli Joshuwa,
''Layilila bapayizi abo babwezede ibbokesi lyabukamboni baze atala kuzwa ku Jodani.''
Aboobo, Joshuwa wakalayilila bapayizi, ''Muze atala kuzwa ku Jodani.''

Elyo bapayizi babwezede bbokesi lyachizuminano cha Jehova nibakazwa akati ka Jodani, alimwi ndyato zyamawulu abo zyakanyampulwa kuzwa kunyika injumu, mpawo manzi a Jodani akaboola kubusena bwawo akapaya munkomwe mazuba oone akayinda.
Bantu bakeza atala kuzwa ku Jodani muzuba lyakkumi mumwezi mutanzi. Bakakkala mu Gilugalu, kujwe lya Jelikko.
Mabwe alikkumi aabili ayo ngibakabwezede kuzwa kumulonga wa Jodani, Joshuwa wakayimika mu Gilugalu.
Wakati kubantu ba Izilayeli, ''Elyo lunyungu lwanu nibaakubuzya bamawisi muzyindi ziboola, 'Ino mabwe aya awambanzi?'
Mukabambile, Óku nkonkuko Izilayeli nkwakazubukila mutala lya Jodani anyika injumu.'

Jehova Leza wenu wakayuminizya maanzi a Jodani kuchitila ndinywe, kusikila mwazubuka mutala, Bukozyenie mbuli Jehova Leza wanu mbwakachita kulwizi lwamatete, olo ndwakayuminizya kuchitila ndiswe kusikila twazubuka,
Kuchitila kuti boonse bantu banyika bazibe kuti kuboko kwa Jehova kuli anguzu, alimwi kuti balemeke Jehova Leza wenu kwa Lyoonse.

Eelyo boonse baami baba Amolayitisi baliku bubbila bwa Jolodani, aboonse baami baba Kkenani, bakali mujeendezya lya Lwizi Lupati, nibakamvwa Yahweh wakali wayuminizya maanzi a Jolodani mane bantu ba Izilayeli bazubuka, myoyo yabo yakayaya, abobob tekwakachili muya pe mulimbabo nkambo kabantu ba Izilayeli.
Aalecho chiindi Yahweh wakati kuli Joshuwa, ''Fula tufulo tubosya uyindulule lubo kupalula boonse bana balombe ba Izilayeli.''
Mpawo Joshuwa wakalipangila tufulo tubosya akupalula boonse bana balombe bamu Izilayeli ku Gibbiya Halaloti.
Echi nchenchicho Joshuwa nchakaabapalula: Boonse baalumi bakazwa mu Ijiputi, antomwe abasilumamba boonse, bakali bafwa munkanda, munzila nkabali bazwa ku Ijiputi.
Nekuba kuti boonse baalumi bakazwa mu Ijiputi bakali palwiidwe, nekuba boobo takwe wabana balombe bakazyalilwa munkanda munzila kuzwa ku Ijiputi takwe wakkapalwidwe pe.

Mukuti bana ba Izilayeli bakeenda minyaka makumi one munkanda mane ado boonse bantu, nkokuti, boonse balumi bankondo bakali bazwa mu Ijiputi, bafwa, nkambo tabakaswilila ijwi lya Yahweh. Yahweh wakakonka kulimbabo kuti takoyobaleka bakabone nyika njakali wakonka kuli basikale babo kuti uyotupa, inyika ikunka malili abuchi.
Bakali bana babo mbakabusya abusena bwabo abo Joshuwa mbaka palula, nkambo teensi bakali bapalulwa pe munzila.
Awo boonse nkabali bapalulwa, bakakkala mpobaka bungene manedo kuyopona kwabo.
Eelyo Yahweh wakati kuli Joshuwa, ''Sunu ndamwaya chisesemyo cha Ijiputi kuzwaalindinywe.'' Aabobo izina lyabusena lyakiitwa kuti Giligali ambuli sunu.
Ibantu ba Izilayeli bakakkala ku Giligali. Bakabamba ipobwe lya Pasika mubuzuba bwakkumi aane bwamwezi, igolezya, mumisena ya Jelikko.
Mubuzuba bwakiinda Pasika, ndilyo izuba, bakalya butebuzi bwanyika achinkwa chitakwe buswezyo amututu ukangiidwe.
Imana yakaleka kuloka kuzwa kujulu mubuzuba nibakalya kulya kwanyika. Tekwakachilikwe mana kubana ba Izilayeli, pesi bakalya ikulya kwamunyika ya Kkenani oyoy munyaka.

Awo Joshuwa nakali afwifwi a Jelikko, wakanyampuula menso akwe akulanga, alimwi wakabona mwalumi wakiimvwi kunembo lyakwe; wakali wasomona ipanga lyakwe awo lyakali mukuboko kwakwe. Joshuwa wakiinka kuli nguwe akuti, ''Uliwesu nakuti uli wabasinkooma ?''
Wakati, ''Kunyina Ndisilutwe wabasilumamba ba Yahweh. Yino ndasika.'' Eelyo Joshuwa wakalala abusyu ansii anyika kumukomba akuti kulinguwe, ''Utyeni simalelo wangu kumulanda wakwe ?''
Silutwe wabasilumamba ba Yahweh wakati kuli Joshuwa, ''Gwisya nsangu zyako kuzwa kumawulu ako, nkambo busena mpoyiimvwi bulasalala.'' Ezi nzenzizyo Joshuwa nzyakachita.
Yino yoonse milyango ya Jelikko yakali jalidwe nkambo kabasilumamba ba Izilayeli. Takwe wakali kuzwa aanze alimwi takwe wakali kunjila mukati.
Yahweh wakati kuli Joshuwa, ''Boona, ndaba Jelikko mumaboko ako, mwaami wayo, abasilumamba babo bayiide mulimu wabusilumamba.
Mwelede kuzyunguluka idolopo, boonse baalumi bankondo nkabaya buzyunguluka idolopo lomwe. Mwelede kuchita obu kwamazuba musanu abumwi.

Ba payizi bali musanu ababili belede kubweza myeembo yameeja yabagutu bambelele kunembo lyabbokesi lyachizuminano. Mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili, welede kuzyunguluka idolopo musanu atubili, mpawo bapayizi belede kulizya mweembo.

Mpawo belede kulizya amoompololo usika kule ameja abagutu bambelele, awo nimwayomvwa mweembo bantu boonse belede kuyowompolola amompololo mupati, awo bulambo buyokolomokela aansi boonse. Basilumamba bayelede kuyolwisya, awumwi nkaya kunembo.''
Mpawo Joshuwa mwana wa Nuni wakiita bapayizi akubaambila kuti, ''Mubweze bbokesi lyachizuminano, kube bapayizi bali musanu ababili babweze myeembo yameja abagutu kunembo lyabbokesi lya Yahweh.
Wakati kubantu, ''Kamuya mukazyunguluke idolopo, ibalumi bale zyoombo zyakulwisya bayoyenda kunembo lyabbokesi lya Yahweh.''

Mbuli mbaakabambila bantu, ibapayizi bali musanu ababili bakabweza myembo yameja abagutu bambelele kunembo lya Yahweh. Nibakanyampuka, bakasiba mweembo, ibbokesi lyachizuminano lya Yahweh lyakaba tobela.
Balumi bakajisi zyakulwania bakeenda kunembo lyabapayizi, bakasiiba musule abbokesi, mpawo bapayizi bakasiba myeembo yabo chakutaleka.
Pesi Joshuwa wakalayilila bantu, nkawamba kuti, ''Mutawompololi. Takwe musindo uyelede kuzwa kumilomo yenu mane kuyosika mubuzuba mbwesikambe kuti mompolole.
Mpawo biyo mpomutaka wompolole.'' Aboobo wakachita kuti ibbokesi lya Yahweh lizyunguluke idolopo lomwe buzuba oobo. Mpawo bakanjila munkambe yabo, akukkala busiku munkamba.
Mpawo Joshuwa wakabuka chifumo fumo kuseni, ibapayizi bakabweza ibbokesi lya Yahweh.

Bapayizi bali musanu ababili bakali kubweza myeembo yameja abagutu bambelele kunembo lyebbokesi lya Yahweh, bakeenda obotu obotu akulizya myembo. Basilumamba bajisi zyoombo bakali kuyobweenda kunembo lyabo. Pesi awo balindizi nibakeenda musule abbokesi lya Yahweh, eelyo myembo yakalila chakutaleka.
Bakazyunguluka idolopo lomwe mubuzuba bwabili akubweda kunkamba. Bakazichita eezi kwamazuba musanu abumwi.

Mwakali mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili nibakafuma kubuchedo, akuzyunguluka idolopo munzila yachiyanza chabo, kulechi chindi bakinda musanu atubili. Kwakali mulindileli izuba nibakazyunguluka idolopo zyiindi musanu azibili.
Kwakali muzuba lyamusanu abili, awo bapayizi nibakalizya myembo, mbakalayilila bantu Joshuwa, ''Moompolole! Nkambo Yahweh wamupa idolopo.

Idolopo azyonse zilimulindilyo ziyobikwa kumbali kuli Yahweh kuti zikanyonyoonwe. Alike biyo Lahabbi simamambe nguyofutuka - welwakwe ababo boonse mbanolabo mung'anda yakwe - nkambo wakasisa balumi mbitwakatumide.

Pesi inywebo, muchenjele atala akubweza zintu zibikilidwe kuyonyonyonwa, kuchitila kuti mwayomana kuzibika impaa yakunyonyoonwa, mutakayeeyi lubo kubweza chomwe chazyo. Kuti mwayochita eechi, muyochita kuti bana bankamba ya Izilayeli chibe chibi chintu chalunyonyoko akuyoyeta mapenzi alimbabo.
Yonse insiliva, ingolida, azimwi zintu zipangidwe a bbulonze a butale zibambilidwe Yahweh. Zyelede kwinka muchiyobwedo cha Yahweh.''
Nebakasiba myembo, bantu bakachita mompololo mupati mpawo bulambo bwakawa bwelana anyika, eelyo wonse mwalumi wakachijana nkaluleme mudolopo akuyolichita buzike.
Bakanyonyoona chakumaninina zyoonse zyakali mudolopo epanga - balumi abanakazi, banini abapati, ing'ombe, mbelele antomwe amadonki.
Eelyo Joshuwa wakati kubalumi bobile bakinkide kuyotweela nyika, ''Kamuya mung'anda yasimamambe. Mumugwisye mwanakazi aboonse mbalaabo, mbuli mbumwaka konka kulinguwe.''
Awo balombwana bakali basikutweela bakanjila akuyoyeta Lahabbi aanze. Bakeeta wisi, banyina, banyandumi bakwe azyonse nzubo zyakwe nzyakaleezyo. Bakabeta kubusena aanze aankamba ya Izilayeli.
Bakalitenta idolopo azyonse zyakali mulindilyo. Bito insiliva, ngolida, azibelesyo zyabbulonzi abutale nzezyabikwa muchiyobwedo chamung'anda ya Yahweh.
Pesi Joshuwa wakazuminana a Lahabbu simamambe, ng'anda yawisi antomwe abonse mbakalabo kuti bafutuke. Ulapona mu Izilayeli abwakosunu nkambo wakasisa balumi Joshuwa mbakatumide kuyotweela mu Jelikko.

Elyo Joshuwa wakabalayilila achiindi eechi achikonke, nkati, ''Ulitukidwe oyo muntu kunembo lya Yahweh uyakulula idolopo eeli, Jelikko. Aa muulo wabumi bwamwanakwe mutanzi mulombe, mbwayoyasya intalisyo aamulo wabuumi bwamwanakwe mulombe keela, mbwatakimike mulyango wawo.''
Eelyo Yahweh wakala Joshuwa, empuwo zyakwe zyakazula nyika yoonse.

Pesi bantu ba Izilayeli bakachita chakutasyomeka aatala azintu eezyo zyakapambwidwe kulunyonyoko.Akkani mwana mulombe wa Kkami mwana mulombe wa Zebbedi mwana mulombe wa Zela, kuzwa musyobo wa Juda, wakabweza zimwi zintu eezyo zyakali pambwidilwe kunyonyonwa, alimwi bukali bwa Jehova bwabukila bantu ba Izilayeli.
Joshuwa wakatuma baalumi kuzwa ku Jelikko kusika ku Ayi, akali afwiifwi aku Bbeti Aveni, kujwe lya Bbeteli. Wakati kulimbabo, ''kamuya mukatweele Ayi.

Eelyo nibabweeda kuli Joshuwa, bakati kuli nguwe ''Utatumi bantu boonse pe ku Ayi. Tuma baalumi bali zyuulu zibili na zitatu kuti bayinke akuyolwisya Ayi. Utachiti kuti bantu boonse babeleke munkondo, nkaambo mbache mumweele.''
Eelyo kwakayinka baalumi bali mbuli zyuulu zitatu kuzwa kuli basilumamba, pesi aaba bakachija kuzwa kubaalumi ba Ayi.

Baalumi baku Ayi bakajaya baalumi bali mbuli makumi aatatu amusanu awumwi mbuli mbubakali kubatandania kuzwa kumulyango wadolopo mbuli kule kwamabwe apandwiidwe, akubajaya mbuli mbubakali kuseluka kuchilundu. Myoyo yabantu yakayaaya akuba mbuli maanzi.
Mpawo Joshuwa wakadeluula zikobela zyakwe. We abapati ba Izilayeli bakabika lusuko mumitwe yabo akuvundama aansi kunembo lya bbokesi lya Jehova, kakkede aawo kusikila kugolezya.

Mpawo Joshuwa wakati, "Aa, Jehova Mwaami, nkambonzi nwaaleta bantu aaba kutala lya Jodani kwalyoonse? Kutupeda kumaanza aba Amoli kuti batunyonyone?  Kakuli kuti twachita muzeezo usiyene akukkala kulubazu lumbi lwa Jodani!
Mwaami, ndaambe biyeeni, kakuli ba Izilayili kabali bafutatila basinkondonyina?
Nkaambo ba Kkenani abantu boonse bakkede munyika bayomvwa anzizyo. Bayotuzunguluka akuchita bantu bamunyika kuti balube zina lyesu. Uyoolichitilanzi zina lyako pati?''
Jehova wakaamba kuti kuli Joshuwa, ''Buka! Nkaamboonzi nuvundeme abusyu bwako?
Ba Izilayeli babisya. Batyola chizuzmunano changu nchindakabalayilila. Babba zimwi zintu eezyo zyakalisalidwe. Bakabba alimwi basisa chibi chabo akubika eezyo nzibakabweza aakati kazintu zyabo.

Kube boobo, bantu ba Izilayeli tabakoyoyima kunembo lyabasinkondonyina. Bafutatila musule aabo kuzwa kuli basinkondonyina nkaambo lwabo bapambulwa kulunyonyoko. Tandikwe kuyoba aandinywe limbi pe kunze kwakuti munyonyone zintu zyakaleelede kunyonyonywa pesi zichili akati kanu.

Buka! Salazya bantu kulindime akubambila kuti, 'Mulisalazye lwanu kwiitila bwajunza. Nkaambo Jehova, Leza waba Izilayeli, wati, ''Kulizintu zipambwidwe kumbali kuti zinyonyonwe zichili aakati kanu, Izilayeli. Tamukonzyi kwiiminana abasinkondo nyokwe kusikila mujosye eezyo kuzwa akati kanu zyoonse zintu zyakapambudwe kuti zinyonyonwe.
Chifumo, mweelede kulitondeezya amisyobo yanu. Musyobo ooyo Jehova ngwasala uyooza aafwiifwi amikowa yabo. Mukowa ooyo Jehova ngwasala weelede kuza aafwiifwi mpuli imwi ayimwi.

Kuyooba kuti umwi usalidwe ayooyo ulazintu eezyo zyakapambwidwe kulunyonyooko, uyootentwa, we azyoonse nzyalaazyo, nkaambo watyola chizumunano cha Jehova mpawo nkaambo wachita chintu chifwisya bweeme mu Izilayeli.
Mpawo, Joshuwa wakabuka chifumo fumo akuleta ba Izilayeli aafwiifwi, musyobo amusyobo alimwi musyobo wa Juda wakasalwa.
Joshuwa wakaleta mikowa ya Juda aafwiifwi, amukowa wa Zela wakasalidwe. Wakeeta aafwiifwi mukowa waba Zela muntu amuntu, a Zabbodi wakasalwa.
Wakeeta impuli ya Zabbodi aafwiifwi muntu amuntu, a Chani mwana wa Kkani, mwana wa Zabbodi mwana wa Zela, kuzwa kumusyobo wa Juda, wakasalwa.
Mpawo Joshuwa wakati kuli Achani, ''Mwanaangu, amba choonzyo kunembo lya Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, akulyambilila kuli nguwe. Inche ndambile nchwachita. Utandisisili pe.''
Achani wakasandula Joshuwa kuti, ''Ichoonzyo ndakabisizya Jehova Leza wa Izilayeli. Nchechi nchindakachita

:Nindakabona akati kazisaalo jansi mbotu kuzwa ku Bbabbiloni, myaanda iibili yamashekkeli yansiliva, achibbabbi changolide chakali kulema mashekkeli ali makumi musanu, ndakaayandisya akuzibweza. Alisisidwe munyika akati katente lyangu, ansiliva ilikunsi kwayo. ''
Joshuwa wakatuma batumwa, aabo bakachijaana kutente alimwi ooko kwakali zintu. Eelyo nibakalanga bakazijana zilisisidwe mutente lyakwe ansiliva aansi aazyo.
Bakabweeza zintu kuzwa akati katente akuzileta kuli Joshuwa akubantu boonse ba Izilayeli. Bakazikunina kunembo lya Jehova.

Mpawo Joshuwa aba Izilayeli boonse mbakalaabo, bakabweeza Achani mwana wa Zela, ansiliva ajansi, achibbabbi changolida, bana bakwe balombe abasimbi, ng'ombe zyakwe, madonki, mbelele, atente lyakwe azyoonse nzyakali aazyo, bakazileta kumusena wa Akkoli.
Mpawo Joshuwa wakati, ''Nkamboonzi mwatupenzya? Jehova ulakupenzya sunu.'' Ba Izilayeli boonse bakamuuma amabwe. Mpawo bakawuma boonse amabwe akubawumpa amulilo.

Bakalundika chilwi chipati chamabwe aatala lyakwe eecho chiliwo kusikila buzuba bwasunu. Jehova waselusya bukali bwakwe bupati. Nkikaako zina lyabusena nchilitegwa Musena wa Akkoli kusikila buzuba bwasunu.
Jehova wakati kuli Joshuwa, ''Utayowi; utadyamizigwi. Bweza bantu boonse basinkondo. Koya ku Aayi. Boona, ndapeda mwaami wa Aayi mumaanza aako, bantu bakwe, adolopo lyakwe anyika yakwe.
Uyochita Aayi amwaami wakwe, mbuli mbwakachitila ku Jelikko amwaami wakwe, kunze kwakuti ukabweze zisalo azivuubwa zyanu nobeni. Amukayube kusule lyadolopo.''
Mpawo KJoshuwa wakabuka akubweza baalumi basilumamba akuya  ku Aayi. Eelyo Joshuwa wakasala zyuulu zili makumi aatatu aabalumi - basinguzu bakozu - alimwi wakabatuma mansiku.
Wakabalayilila kuti, ''Abone, muyoyaka kamulangide dolopo, kusule aalyo. Mutakayi kule loko pe kuzwa kudolopo, pesi moonse mulibambile.
Ime abalumi boonse mbendili aabo tuyoswena kudolopo, mpawo nibayosika kuti batulwane, tuyobachija mbuli mbotwakachitide.
Bayotwandilila kusikila tukabagwisye kuzwa kudolopo. Bayowamba kuti, ''Banotuchija mbuli mbubakachitide kale chiindi chakiinda.' Aboobo tuyo bachija.
Elyo nywebo muyubunuke kubusena nkomuyubide, alimwi muyojata idolopo. Jehova Leza wenu uyoyipa mujanza lyenu.
Nimwayolitola idolopo, mukalyuumpe amulilo. Muyochita eechi na mwalemeka milayizyo njimwakapegwa mujwi lya Jehova. Boona, Ndamulayilila.''
Joshuwa wakabatuma, mpawo bakeenda kubusena bwakuyubila, akuyoyuba, akati ka Bbeteli a Aayi kumbo kwa Aayi. Pesi Joshuwa wakoona mansiku aayo akati kabantu.
Joshuwa wakafuma chifumofumo akubweza basilumamba kuti balibambile, Joshuwa abapati ba Izilayeli, mpawo bakalwana bantu ba Aayi.
Basilumamba boonse mbakali aabo bakaya buswenenena kudolopo. Bakasika afwifwi adolopo mpawo bakkala kubbazu lyakunyika yaku Aayi. Lino kwakali musena akati kabo a Aayi.
Wakabweza mweelwe ulimbuli zyuulu zili musanu wabalumi akubayubika kulubazu lwakumbo lyadolopo aakati ka Bbeteli a Aayi.
Bakabikka basilumamba boonse, basilumamba bapati kumbo kwadolopo, abalindizi loko kulubazu lwakunyika. Joshuwa wakoona busiku oobo kali mumusena.

Kwakaba kuti mwaami waku Aayi nakibona, lwakwe abasilumamba bakwe bakabuka chifumofumo akuchijaninakuyolwisya Izilayeli kubusena bumwi oobo bwakalangene amusena wamulonga wa Jodano. Tewakalizi pe kuti basikuyuba balibalindide kuti babalwisye kuzwa kusule lyadolopo.
Joshuwa aba Izilayeli boonse bakachita kuti bazundwe kunembo lyabo, akuchija kabaya kunkanda.
Bantu boonse bakali mudolopo bakayitwa antomwe kuti babatobele, eelyo bakatobela Joshuwa mpawo bakatandilwa kule kuzwa kudolopo.
Takwe mwalumi wakachaala ku Aayi a Bbeteli utayinkide kuyobandila ba Izilayeli. Bakalisiya idolopo akusiya kalijulidwe nibakatobela ba Izilayeli.
Jehova wakati kuli Joshuwa, ''Tondeka isumu eelyo lili mukuboko kwako kunembo lya Aayi, nkambo ndiyoopa Aayi mumaanza aako.'' Joshuwa wakabweza isumu eelyo lyakali mujanza lyakwe kartondekede dolopo.
Basilumamba bakali yubide bakachijana chakufwambana kubusena bwabo nakatandabika ijanza lyakwe.  Bakachijana akunjila mudolopo akulifumpa. Bakafwambana kuliteenta mumulilo.

Bantu baku Aayi bakachebuka akulanga musule. Bakabona busi buzwa kudolopo buunta kujulu, mpawo tebakakonzya kunzwenga kunzila eeyi nikuba muli iimbi. Nkambo basilumamba ba Izilayeli bakali bachijila munkanda lino babweda musule kuyolanga aabo bakali kubalindilila.
Eelyo Joshuwa aba Izilayeli boonse nibakabona basikubayubilila bajata dolopo abusi bwanyampuka , bakazyunguluka akujaya bantu ba Aayi.

Bamwi bakazwa kudolopo kababalwanya, aboobo akuti bajatwe akati, aba Izilayili kabali akati, umwi kulubazu oolu awumwi kulubazu ooluya. Izilayili yakalwanya bantu ba Aayi; takwe pe wakapona na kuchija.
Bakamubamba mwaami waku Aayi, oyo ngubakajata kachipona akumweeta kuli Joshuwa.

Nikwakaba kuti Izilayili kali wamana kujaya boonse bakali kukkala ku Aayi mumunda uli afwifwi ankanda ooko nkubakabatandila, alimwi muchindi boonse, kuli wakumamanino, wakawida kumamanino epanga., ba Izilayeli boonse bakabweda ku Aayi. Bakabalwanya ampela yapanga.
Boonse abo bakawa buzuba obo, boonse baalumi abanakazi, bakali zyuulu zilikkumi azibili, bantu boonse ba Aayi.
Joshuwa takabwedezya musule pe janza lyakwe elyo lyakali lyasika kajisi isumu, kusikila wamaninsya kujaya boonse bantu baku Aayi.
Ba Izilayili bakabweza zivuubwa luzutu achisaalo kuzwa kudolopo kuti zibe zyabo, mbuli Jehova mbwakalayilide Joshuwa.
Joshuwa wakawuumpa Aayi akusandula akuba chilwi chamatongo kwalyoonse. Mbusena bwakasiigwa kusikila buzuba bwasunu

Wakangilila mwaami wa Aayi amusamu kusikila golezya. Izuba nilyakabbila, Joshuwa wakapa mulayizyo mpawo wakabweza mutunta wamwaami kuzwa kumusamu akuwalila kunembo lyamilyango yadolopo. Ooko nkubalundika chilwi chipati chamabwe atala lyawo. Chiilwi echo mpuchili amubuzuba bwasunu.
Joshuwa wakayakila Jehova chipayililo, Leza wa Izilayili, atala a Chilundu cha Ebbalu,

mbuli Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova mbwakalayilide bantu ba Izilayili, mbuli mbokwakalembedwe mubbuku lyamulawu wa Mozesi: ''Chipayililo chizwa kumabwe atabezedwe, iitakwe wakabamba ambezyo yalubulo.''Wakapeda achipayililo chakuumpa kuli Jehova, akupeda chipayililo chaluumuno.
Nkuko, kunembo lyabantu ba Izilayili, wakalemba atala amabwe lugwalo lwamulawu wa Mozesi.

Ba Izilayili boonse, bapati babo, basimilimu ababetesi bakalimvwi kumabazu woonse abbokesi kunembo lyamupayizi aba Levi basikunyampula bbokesi yachizuminano cha Jehova - Ibeenzu abazyalwa muchisi - chisela chimwi chakayimikila kunembo lyachilundu cha Gezilimu achimwi chisela chakayimikila kunembo lyachilundu cha Ebbalu. Bakalongezya bantu ba Izilayeli, mbuli Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova mbwakalayilila kumatangunino.
Mukuya kwechindi, Joshuwa wakabala majwi woonse amumulawu, zilongezyo alutuko, mbuuli mbukwakalembedwe mubbuku lyamulawu.

Kaatakwe bbala niliba limwi kuzwa kuli aayo wonse Mozesi ngakalayilila kuti Joshuwa ngatabalide kunembo lyambungano ya Izilayeli, kubikkilizya abanakazi, bana banini, abeenzu aabo bakakkede akkati kabo.

Mpawo boonse baami bakali kukkala mutala a Jodani munyika yazilundu, alimwi amunyika zili munsi zitobelezya nkomwe ya Lwizi Lupati kulanzya ku Lebbanoni - ba Hiti, ba Amoli, ba Kkenani, ba Perizi, ba Hivi, alimwi a ba Jebbu -
aaba bakajatana aantomwe munsi lyabuzuluzi bumwi, kuti babusye nkondo aatala a Josyuwa a Izilayeli.
Eelyo bantu bakkala mu Gibbiyoni nibakamvwa eezyo Josyuwa nzyakachita ku Jelikko a ku Ayi,

bakachita babambe abuchenjezu. Bakiinka mbuli batumwa. Bakabweza masaka aazakede alimwi baakabika aamadonki aabo. Alubo bakabweza zibikilo zya wayini zyachiindi zizakede, zideluukide, alimwi zyakaligambiikidwe.
Kumawulu abo bakazwata mbatata zyachiindi alimwi zyakagambiikidwe, alimwi bakazwata zizwaato zyachiindi, zyakadeluuka. Zibunge zyabo zyoonse nzibakabambide zyakali zyayuma a kusasa.
Mpawo bakaya kuli Josyuwa kumusaasa ku Giligalialimwi bakati kuli nguwe alimwi a kubaalumi ba Izilayeli, ''Tweenda kuzwa kunyika iilikule loko, aboobo chita chizuminano andiswe.''
Baalumi ba Izilayeli bakati ku ba Hivi, ''Amwi mukkala aafwifwi andiswe. Kujana tulachita chizuminano biyeni andinywe?''
Bakati kuli Josyuwa, ''Tuli balanda bako.'' Josyuwa wakali kulimbabo, ''Ndinywe bani? Mwazwa kuli?''
Bakati kuli nguwe, ''Bazike bako basika aano nkabazwa kunyika iili kule loko, nkaambo kezina lya Jehova Leza wako. Twamvwa makani aatala anguwe alimwi aatala azyoonse nzyakachita mu Ijipiti -
alimwi azyoonse nzyakacita ku baami bobile ba Amoli mutala aa Jodani - kuli Sihoni mwaami wa Hesyibboni, alimwi akuli Ogi mwaami wa Bbasyani wakali ku Asyitaloti.

Bapati besu alimwi boonse bakkali munyika yesu bakati kulindiswe, 'Amubweze bulilu bwalweendo muluboko lwenu. Mwiinke kuyobaswaanizya alimwi mukatedi kulimbabo, ''Tuli balanda benu. Mukachite chizuminano andiswe.''
