Eechi nchibunge chesu, chachilikukasaala eelyo nitwakchibweza kuzwa kumaanda esu mubuzuba nitwakanyampuka kuza kulindinywe. Pesi lino, amubone, chayuma alimwi chisasa.
Eezi zibikilo zya wayini zyakali zipya nitwakazizuzya, alimwi amulange, lino zilikuzuza. Zisamo zyesu alimwi ambatata zyesu zyazakala mulweendo lulamfu loko.'''
Aboobo ba Izilayeli bakabweza kumwi kulya kwabo, pesi tebakabuzya Jehova pe kuti abazulwide.
Josyuwa wakachita luumuno ambabo alimwi wakachita chizuminano ambabo, kubaleka kuti bapone. Bazuluzi babantu alubo bakachita chikonke kuli mbabo.
Mazuba aatatu kayindide ba Izilayeli kabachitide eechi chizuminano ambabo, bakazooziba kuti mbaasimayakilane babo alimwi kuti  bakali kukkala afwifwi.
Mpawo bantu ba Izilayeli bakazwa alimwi bakasika kuzisi zyabo  mubuzuba bwa tatu. Zisi zyabo zyakali Gibbiyoni, Kkefira, Bbiloti, a Kkiliyati Jelimu.

Bantu ba Izilayeli takwe nibakabalwana pe nkaambo bazululi babo bakai bachita chikonke aatala ambabo kunembo lya Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli. Boonse ba Izilayeli bakali kunyontawuka aatala abazululi babo.
Pesi  boonse bazululi bakati kubantu boonse, ''Twakachita chikonke aatala ambabo a Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, alimwi lino tatukonzyi kubachitila bubi.
Eechi nchicho nchitutachite kulimbabo: Kuti tukaasye kufumbwa bukali buli buti bukonzya kusika alindiswe akaambo ka chikonke nchitwakakonkezya kulimbabo, tuyoobaleka bakapone.''
Bazululi bakati kubantu babo, ''Mubaleke bapone.'' Aboobo, ba Gibbiyoni bakaba basikutema nkuni alimwi basikuteka manzi ba ba Izilayeli boonse, mbuli mukwaamba kwa bazululi.
Josyuwa wakabiita alimwi wakati, ''Nkaambonzi nimwakatweena eelyo nimwakati, 'Tuzwa kule loko andinywe', eelyo nkamukkala omuno aakati kesu?
Lino, akaambo kacheechi, mwatukwa alimwi bamwi benu banoli bazike kwalyoonse, aabo batema nkuni alimwi bateka manzi mun'anda ya Leza wangu.''

Bakasandula Josyuwa alimwi bakati, ''Akaambo kakuti zyakaambwa ku balanda bako kuti Jehova Leza wako wakalayilila Mozesi kuti amupe nyika yoonse, alimwi kuti munyonyoone boonse bakkali benyika kunembo lyenu - aboobo twakayowa kapati nkaambo kamawumi esu akaambo kako. Nkinkaako nchitwakachita chintu eechi.
Lino, langa, ulitujisi munguzu zyako. Kufumbwa chiboneka kachili kabotu alimwi kachiluleme kuli nduwe kuti uchite kulindiswe, chita.''
Aboobo Josyuwa wakabachitila eechi: Wakabagwisya kuzwa kubweendelezi bwabantu ba Izilayeli, kuchitila kuti ba Izilayeli batabajayi pe.
Buzuba oobo Josyuwa wakachita ba Gibbiyoni basikutema nkuni alimwi basikuteka manzi aaluundu, alimwi a kuchipayililo cha Jehova, kusika mubuzuba obuno, mubusena Jehova mbwasala.

Lino eelyo Adoni-Zedeki, mwaami wa Jelusalema, nakamvwa kuti Josyuwa wakatumba chisi cha Ayi alimwi wachinyonyoona chakumaninina (mbuli mbakachita ku Jelikko a mwaami wayo), alubo wakamvwa bantu ba ku Gibbiyoni mbubakachita luumuno a ba Izilayeli alimwi ambubali kukkala aakati kabo.

Bantu baku Jelusalema bakayowa kapati loko nkaambo Gibbiyoni chakali chisi chipati, mbuli chimwi chachisi cha bwaami. Chakali chipati kwiinda Ayi, alimwi boonse baalumi bacho bakali ba sinkondo bapati.
Aboobo Adoni-Zedeki, mwaami wa Jelusalema, wakatumina makani kuli Hohani, mwaami wa Hebbuloni, kuli Pilamu, mwaami wa Jamuti, kuli Jafiya, mwaami wa Lachisi, a kuli Debbe, mwaami wa Egiloni:
''Amusike kulindime alimwi mundigwasye. Ngatulwane Gibbiyoni nkaambo bachita luumuno a Josyuwa alimwi abantu ba Izilayeli.''

'Baami bali musanu ba ma Amoli, mwaami wa Jelusalema, mwaami wa Hebbuloni, mwaami wa Jamuti, mwaami wa Lachisi, alimwi a mwaami wa Egiloni bakasika, boonya alimwi a basilumamba babo. Bakalibambila kulwana Gibbiyoni, alimwi bakabalwana.

Bantu ba Gibbiyoni bakatuma makani kuli Josyuwa alimwi a kuli basilumamba ku Giligali. Bakati, ''Mufwambane! Mutatantamuni maboko enu kuzwa kubalanda bako. Musike kulindiswe chakufwambana alimwi mutuvune. Mutugwasye, akaambo kakuti baami boonse ba ma Amoli bakkala munyika yazilundu babungana aantomwe kuti batulwane.''
Josyuwa wakeenda kuzwa ku Giligali, wenya alimwi a boonse baalumi benkondo mbaakali aabo, alimwi a boonse baalumi basikulwana.
Jehova wakati kuli Josyuwa, ''Mutabayowi pe. Ndabapeda muluboko lwako. Takwe naba omwe utakakwiimikizye kukubalwana.''
Josyuwa wakasika alimbabo chakufwambana, nkali weenda busiku boonse kuzwa ku Giligali.

Jehova wakapilingania basinkondonyina kunembo lya ba Izilayeli, alimwi Izilayeli wakabajaya boonse alujeyo lupati ku Gibbiyoni alimwi bakabatandaania mumugwagwa uutanta kuuya ku Bbeti Horon, alimwi bakabajaya mu mugwagwa ku Azeka a Makkeda.

Nibakachija kuzwa ku Izilayeli, nkabankunuka chilundu kuzwa ku Bbeti Holoni, Jehova wakawala mabwe mapati aansi nkaazwa kujulu nkaawida aajulu lyabo yoonse nzila kusika ku Azeka, alimwi bakafwa. Mbiingi bakafwa akaambo ka chivula-mabwe kwiinda bakajayigwa amapanga a baalumi ba Izilayeli.

Mpawo Josyuwa wakaambuula kuli Jehova mubuzuba Jehova nakapa baalumi ba Izilayeli kuzunda ba ma Amoli. Mboobu mbwakaamba Josyuwa kuli Jehova  kunembo lya bana Izilayeli, ''Zuba, koyimikila ku Gibbiyoni, alimwi mweezi, mu Mumpata wa Ayijaloni.''

Zuba lyakiimikila nji, alimwi mweezi wakiima kweenda kusikila chisi chabwedezya bukali kuli basinkondonyina babo. Tazilembedwe na eezi mu Bbuku lya Jasya? Izuba lyakakkala aakati kajulu; telyakabbila pe zikonzya kuba buzuba boonse.
Takwe nikwakaba buzuba buli boobu musule lyalyo nikuba kunembo lyalyo, eelyo Jehova nakalemeka ijwi lyamuntu. Akaambo kakuti Jehova wakali kulwana nkondo nkali kulubazu lwa ba Izilayeli.
Josyuwa alimwi aba Izilayeli boonse mbakali aabo bakabweda kumusasa ku Giligali.
Lino baami bali musanu bakali baloboka alimwi bayuba munkomwe ku Makkeda.
Zyakaambilwa Josyuwa, ''Babonwa!-baami bali musanu bakayubide munkomwe ku Makkeda!''
Josyuwa wakati, ''Mukunkulisye mabwe mapati kumulomo wenkomwe alimwi mubike basilumamba mpaawo kuti babalinde.
Mutalikkalili lwenu. Mutandaanie basinkondonyokwe alimwi mubalwane kuzwida kusule. Mutabazumizyi pe kuti banjile muzisi zyabo, nkaambo Jehova Leza wanu wabapeda muluboko lwanu.''
Josyuwa alimwi abana balombe ba Izilayeli nibakamana kubajaya alujeyo lupati, kusikila baamba kumana kubanyonyoona kumaninide; bache biyo bakafutuka bakanzwengede bakasika kuzisi zikwabililidwe.
Mpawo mpi yoonse yakabweeda muluumuno kuli Josyuwa ku musasa ku Makkeda. Takwe naba omwe wakeezya kwambuula bbala lyomwe aatala abantu ba Izilayeli.
Mpawo Josyuwa wakati, ''Mujule mulomo wenkomwe alimwi kuzwa munkomwe mweete kuli ndime aaba baami bali musanu.''
Bakachita mbuli mbakaamba. Bakeeta kuli nguwe aaba baami bali musanu kuzwa munkomwe-mwaami wa Jelusalema, mwaami wa Hebbuloni, mwaami wa Jamuti, mwaami wa Lachisi, alimwi a mwaami wa Egiloni.

Eelyo nibakeeta baami kuli Josyuwa, wakiita woonse mwaalumi wa Izilayeli. Wakati kuli basilutwe ba basilumamba aabo bakiinkide anguwe kunkondo, ''Mulyate mawulu anu munsingo zyabo.'' Aboobo bakasika babalyata nsingo zyabo.
Mpawo wakati kulimbabo, ''Mutayowi alimwi mutafweluki. Amusime alimwi mube basungu. Eechi nchicho Jehova nchatakachite kuli basinkondonyokwe mbimutakalwane.''
Mpawo Josyuwa wakabalwana alimwi wakabajaya baami. Wakabaanzika amisamu iili musanu. Bakalengelela amisamu kusikila goko.

Eelyo nilyakabbila zuba, Josyuwa wakapa malayilile, alimwi bakabaseluzya kuzwa mumisamu alimwi babawaalila munkomwe mubakayubide. Bakabika mabwe mapati amulomo wenkomwe. Aayo mabwe mpachili kusikila obuno buzuba.

Muli eeyi nzila, Josyuwa wakatumba makkeda muloobo buzuba alimwi wakajaya muntu woonse oomo epanga, kubikilizya a mwaami. Nchobeni wakanyonyoona muntu woonse oomo. Takwe wakasyaala kapona oomo. Wakachita ku mwaami wa Makkeda mbuli mbakachita ku mwaami wa Jelikko.
Josyuwa alimwi a ba Izilayeli boonse bakeenda kuzwa ku Makkeda kuya ku Libina. Wakanjila munkondo a Libina.

Jehova alubo wakapa muluboko lwa Izilayeli-antomwe a mwaami wabo. Josyuwa wakayuuma ebbazu lyapanga linenga alimwi a muntu woonse mulinjiyo. Takwe nakasiya uupona mulinjiyo. Wakachita ku mwaami wayo mbuli mbakachita ku mwaami wa Jelikko.
Mpawo Josyuwa alimwi aba Izilayeli bakali anguwebakeendelela anembo kuzwa ku Libina kusika ku Lachisi. Wakayaka musasa kumbali lyayo alimwi wabusya nkondo anjiyo.
Jehova wakapeda Lachisi muluboko lwa IZilayeliJosyuwa wakayitumba mubuzuba bwa bili alimwi akwiiyuma ebbazu lyepanga, alimwi amuntu woonse uli mulinjiyo, mbuli mbakachita kuli Libina.
Mpawo Holamu, mwaami wa Geza, wakasika kuzogwasya Lachisi. Josyuwa wakamulwana alimwi abasilumamba bakwe mane kusikila kakutachikwe nikuba womwe upona wakachaala.
Mpawo Josyuwa alimwi a Izilayeli woonse bakeendelela anembo kuzwa ku Lachisi kusika ku Egiloni. Bakayaka musasa kumbali lyayo alimwi bakabusya nkondo aatala anjiyo,
alimwi bakayitumba mubuzuba mbuboobo. Bakayuuma ebbazu lyepanga alimwi bakanyonyoona lyoonse woonse uli mukati, mbuli Josyuwa mbakali wachita kuli Lachisi.
Mpawo Josyuwa alimwi woonse Izilayeli wakeendelela anembo kuzwa ku Egiloni kusikila ku Hebbuloni. Bakabusya nkondo aatala anjiyo.

Bakayitumba alimwi bakayuma ebbazu lyepanga, antoomwe a mwaami alimwi azilawo zyayo, alimwi boonse bantu mulinjiyo. Bakasiya kakutakwe bapona. Mbuli mbubakali bachita kuli Egiloni, chakumaninina bakachinyonyoona alimwi a muntu woonse muli njiyo.
Mpawo Josyuwa wakapiluka, alimwi yoonse mpi ya Izilayeli yakali anguwe, alimwi bakeendelela anembo ku Debbi alimwi bakabusya nkondo aatala anjiyo.

Bakayitumba, mwaami wayo alimwi zyoonse zilawu zyayo zilil afwifwi anjiyo. Bakabawuma ebbazu lyapanga alimwi chakumaninina bakanyonyoona woonse muntu mulinjiyo. Takwe nibakasiya uupona. Bakachita kuli Debbi alimwi a mwaami wayo mbuli mbubakachita kuli Libina alimwi akuli Hebbuloni.

Josyuwa wakazunda nyika yoonse, nyika yazilundu, Negevi, misena, alimwi anyika zili munsi azilundu. Boonse baami bazyo takwe wakasyaala kali muumbulu. Chakumaninina wakanyonyoona choonse chipona, mbuli Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, mbakamulayilila.
Josyuwa wakabawuuma kuzwa ku Kkadesyi Bbaniya kusikila ku Gaza, alimwi yoonse nyika ya Gosyeni kusikila Gibbiyoni.
Josyuwa wakatumba boonse baami aaba alimwi anyika zyabo chiindi chomwe nkaambo Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, wakalwanina Izilayeli.
Mpawo Josyuwa, alimwi woonse Izilayeli wakali anguwe, bakabweda ku musasa ku Giligali.
Eelyo Jabbini, mwaami wa Haza, nakamvwa eezi, wakatumina mulumbe kuli Jobbabbu, mwaami wa Madoni, kumwaami waku Simuloni, akumwaami waku Akkisatu.
Wakatumina alimwi mulumbe kubaami aabo bakali kunyika yachilundu kubbazu lyakunyika, mumasena aamulonga Jodani kumusanza wa Kkineleti, munkunukizi, amu Napoti Doli kusika kumbo.
Alimwi wakatumina mulumbe kuba Kkenani kujwe akumbo, ba Amoli, ba Hiti, ba Pelezi, ba Jabbusi, munyika yachilundu, aba Hiva, kumbali lya chilundu Hemoni munyika ya Mizipa.
Basimpi babo boonse bakeza ambabo, mweelwe mupati wasilumamba, mweelwe uuli mbuli muse wakuchito chakulwizi, Bakali aamweelwe mupati wambong'olo ankalaki.
Baami boonse aaba bakaswaanana kuchiindi chakaambilenwe, akuyaka misasa kumaanzi aku Meloni kukubamba nkondo a Izilayioli.
Jehova wakti kuli Joshuwa, "Mutayoowi kumeso aabo, nkaambo juunza kuchiindi eechino ndilikubaaba kuli Izilayili mbuli baalumi bafwide. Muyoodunsula mbong'olo zyabo, akuyoowumpa nkalaki zyabo."
Joshuwa abaalumi boonse bankondo bakeza. Bakasika chakufwambaana kumaanzi aku Melomu, akulwisya sinkondonyina.
Johova wakaaba sinkondo mujanza lya Izilayili, akubawuma akubaandila ku Sidoni, Misilepoti Mayimu, akumusena waku Mizipa kujwe. Bakabawuma kusikila taakwe nikuba umwi wabo wakachaala.
Joshuwa wakachita kulimbabo mbuli Jehova mbakamwaambila. Wakadunsuula mbong'olo akuumpa nkalaki.
Joshuwa wakabweeda kuchiindi eecho akujana Haza. Wakayasa mwaami wayo apanga. (Haza wakali silutwe wamaami aaya woonse.)
Bakayasa apanga chilengwa chipona choonse chakali waawo akubasala kuti banyonyoonwe, kwakuti tekwakachaala nikuba chilengwa chuumi. Mpawo wakawumpa Haza.
Joshuwa wakabweza manguzu woonse aabaami aaba.  Alubo wakaanga boonse baami babo akubayasa amulomo wapanga, mbuli Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova mbakamulayililide.
Izilayili taakwe nakawumpa miinzi yakayakidwe aa zyuulu, kusiya Haza luzutu. Joshuwa ngwakawumpa.

Basimpi ba Izilayili bakabweza buvubi boonse kuzwa kumiinzi eeyi antoomwe azivuubwa kuba zyabo beni. Bakajaya muntu woonse amulomo wapanga kusikila boonse bafwa. Taakwe chilengwa chipona nchibakasiya kachiyoya.

Mbuli Jehova mbakalayilide mulanda wakwe Mozesi, munzila njiyonya eeyo, Mozesi njakalayilila Joshuwa, alimwin Joshuwa wachichita. Taakwe nchakasiya kachitachidwe kuli zeezyo zyoonse Jehova nzyakalayilide Mozesi kuti aachite.
Joshuwa wakabweza nyika yoonese eeyo: muunzi wachilundu, Negevi yoonnse, nyika yoonse ya Goseni, bulundu lundu, sena lya Mulonga Jodani, muunzI wachilundu wa Izilayili achamunkunukizi.
Kuzwa kuchilundu Halaki afwafwi a Edomu akuya kunyika kuyoosika ku Bbaala Gadi mumusena munsi lya Lebbanoni aansi lya chilundu cha Hemoni wakaanga baami babo boonse akubajaya.
Joshuwa wakabamba nkondo kwachiindi chilamfu abaami boonse.
Takukwe muunzi woomwe wakachita luumuno abasimpi ba Izilayili kunze kwaba Hivi bakakkede mu Gibbiyoni. Izilayili wakabweza myuunzi yoonse mulumamba.
Nkaambo ngu Jehova wakabayumya myoyo yabo kuti babambe nkondo mukwiiminana aa Izilayili, kuchitila kuti abanyonyoone chimaninide kutakwe luse, mbubonya mbwakalayilide Mozesi.

Mpawo Joshuwa wakeza kuchiindi eecho akunyonyoona ba Anakkimu. Wakachita eezi kumuunzi wachilundu ku Hebbuloni, Debba, Anabbu, akuzisi zyoonse zya Juda zyachilundu, akuzisi zyoonse zya Izilayili zyachilundu amunyioka yoonse yachilundu ya Izilayili. Joshuwa wakabanyonyoona boonse chakumaninizya amyuunzi
yabo.Takukwe waba Anakkimuwakasyaala munyika ya Izilayili kunze kwaku Gaza, Gati a Sidodi.

Nkaako Joshuwa wakabweza nyika yoonse, mbuli Jehova mbwakaamba kuli Mozesi. Joshiuwa wakayipa mbuli lukona kuli Izilayili, kwaabila kuluumwi awumwi wamukowa yabo. Mpawo nyika yakaba akulyookezya kuzwa kunkondo.

Lino aba mbibaami banyika, abo baalumi ba Izilayeli mbibakazunda. Ba Izilayeli bakabweza bukkalao bwanyika kujwe kubbazu lya Jolodani oko zuba nkulizwida, kuzwa kumusena wamulonga Anoni kusika kuchilundu Hemoni, ayoonse Alabba kusika kujwe.

Sihoni, mwaami waba Amoli, walikukkala mu Heshibboni. Wakeendelezya kuzwaku Alowa, ili amoombe wamumpata wagolonkolo lya Anoni kuzwa akati kamusena, achisela cha Giledi kukunuka kuyosika kumulonga Jabbokku aamugaano waba Amoni.

Sihoni alubo wakeendelezya atala lya Alabba kuyosika kulwizi lwa Kkinalati, kuya kujwe, kuya kulwizi lwa Alabba (lwizi lwamwinyo ) kutola kujwe, nzila yoonse kusika Bbeti Jeshimoti akumusanza, kulanga kukuulu kwaminkuni yachilundu Pisiga.
Ogu, mwaami wa Bbashani, umwi wabakasyaala waba Lefayimu, wali kukkala mu Ashitalati amu Adileyi.
Wakeendelezya mutala lyachilundu Helimoni, Salekka,  a Bbashani yoonse, kusika kumugaano wabantu ba Geshuli aba Makkati, achisela cha Giledi, kusika kumugaano wa Sihoni, mwaami wa Heshibboni.
Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova, abantu ba Izilayeli bakali babazunda, alimwi Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova, wakapa nyika mbuli lukono kuba Lubbeni, ba Gadi, akuchisela chamukowa wa Manase.

Aba mbibaami banyika abo Joshuwa abantu ba Izilayeli mbibakazunda kubbazu lyakumbo kwa Jolodani, kuzwa ku Bbaalu Gadi mumusena afwifwi a Lebbanoni kusika kuchilundu Halakki munsi lya Edomu. Joshuwa wakapa nyika kumikowa ya Izilayeli kuti ibelukono kulimbabo.
Wakabapa nyika yazilundu, nyika zyamukkuti, Alabba, mumbali lyezilundu, amunkanda, a Negevi - nyika yaba Hiti, Amoli, Kkenani, Peliziti, Hiviti, aba Jebbusi.
Baami balikubikkilizya mwaami wa Jelikko, mwaami wa Ayi uli ambali lya Bbeteli,
mwaami wa Jelusalemu, mwaami wa Enayimu,
mwaami wa Jamuti, mwaami wa Lakkishi,
mwaami wa Egiloni, mwaami wa Geza,
mwaami wa Debbi, mwaami wa Geda,
mwaami wa Homa, mwaami wa Aladi,
mwaami wa Libbina, mwaami wa Adulamu,
mwaami wa Makkeda, mwaami wa Bbeteli.
mwaami wa Tapuwa, mwaami waku Hefa,
mwaami waku Afekki, mwaami waku Lashaloni,
mwaami waku Madoni, mwaami waku Haza,
mwaami waku Shimuloni Meloni, mwaami waku Akkishafu,
mwaami wa Taanakki, mwaami wa Megido,
mwaami wa Kkedeshi, mwaami wa Jakkinimu mu Kkamelu,
mwaami waba Dooli mu Nafoti Doli, mwaami waku Goyimu mu Giligali,
a mwaami waku Teza. Mweelwe wabaami wakali makkumi aatatu awumwi boonseni.
Lino Joshuwa wakali wachembaala loko Jehova nakati kulinguwe, "Wachembaala loko, pesi kuchi;li nyika nyingi yakutola.
Eeyi ninyika ichisyeede: Zilikiti zyoonse zyaba Filisiti, azyoonse eezyo zyaba Gesuli,

kuzwa ku Siholi, iili kujwe lya Ijipiti, akulanga kunyika kuya kumugaano wa Ekkuloni, chizibidwe kuba lubono lwaba Kkenani; beendelezi bali musanu baba Filisiti, aabo ba Gaza, Asidodi, Asikkaloni, Gati, a Ekkuloni- chilawpo chaba Aviti.
Kumusanza (chilawo chaba Aviti); nyika zyoonse zya ba Kkenani, kuzwa ku Ala eeyo yaba Sidoni, kuyoosika ku ku Afekki ili aamugaano waba Amoni;
nyika yaba Gebbali, yoonse yaba Lebbanoni kulanga kujwe, kuzwa ku Bbaalu Gadi kunsi lyachilundu Hemoni kusika ku Lebbo Hamati.

Alimwi, boonse bakkali bamunyika yachilundu kuzwa ku Lebbanoni kulakusika Misilefoti Mayimu, kubikilizya abantu boonse ba Sidoni. Ndiyobatandila aanze kunembo lyabasimpi ya Izilayili. Ube aachoonzyo kupa nyika ku Izilayili mbuli lukono, mbuli mbundkakulayilila.
Abila nyika eeyi mbuli lukono kumikowa ili musanu ayine akuchisela chamukowa wa Manase."
Achimwi chisela chamukowa wa Manase, ba Lubbeni, aba Gadi bakatambula liukono lwabo oolo Mozesi ndwakapa kujwe kubbazu lya Jodani,
Kuzwa ku Aloli, ili aamagolelo aamumpata wamulonga Anoni ( kubikilizya amuunzi ooyo uli aakati kamumpata), kusika kuntandabale yoonse ya Medeba kuyoosika ku Dibboni;
Yoonse myuunzi ya Sihoni, mwaami waba Amoli, wakeendelezya mu Hesibboni, kusika kiumugaano waba Amoni;
Gileedi, akuchilawo chaba Gesuli, Maakkati, boonse bakuchilundu Hemoni, koonse Bbasani kusika Salekka;
bwami boonse bwa Ogu mu bbasani, wakeendelezya mu Asitaloti a Edileyi- aaba mbabo bakasyaala mbuli kapumba kache waba Lefayimu- Mozesi wakabawuma akubatandila aanze.
Pesi bantu ba Izilayili tebakatandila aanze pe ba Gesuli na ba Maakkati, anikuti, Gesuli a Maakkati bakaali aakati ka Izilayili kusika kubuzuba oobuno.
Kumukowa wa Levi luzutu Mozesi nkwati wakapa lukono. Zipayizyo zya Jehova, Leza wa Izilayili, chichitwa aamulilo, ndulukono lwabo, mbuli Leza mbakaamba kuli Mozesi.
Mozesi wakapa lukono kumukowa wa Lubbeni, luzubo aluzubo.
Chilawo chabo chakali kuzwa ku Aloli, kumagozezyo aamumpata wamulonga Anoni, amuunzi ooyo wakali aakati kamusena, aa ntandabale yoonse ya  Medeba.
Alubo Lubbeni wakatambula Hesibboni amyuunzi yakwe yoonse eeyo iili muntandabale, Dibboni, a Bbamoti Bbalu, a Beti Baalu Meyoni,
a Jayazi, a Kkedemoti, a Mefati,
a Kkiliyatayimu, a Sibbima, a Zeleti Saya aachilundu chamusena.
Alubo Lubbeni wakatambula Bbeti Piyoli, nkunukizi zya Pisiga, Bbeti Jesimoti,

myuunzi yoonse yantandabale, a bwami boonse bwa Siyoli mwaami waba Amoli, wakali weendelezya mu Hesibboni, nguwenya Mozesi ngwakazunda aawe antoomwe abasilutwe ba Midiya, Evi, Lekkemu, Zuli, Hali, a Lebba, bana bamwaami Sihoni, wakakkede munyika.
Bantu ba Izilayili bakajaya Bbalamu lubo apanga mwana mulombe wa Bbiyoli, wakali kuchita busondi, aakati kabo boonse mbibakajaya.
Mugaano wamukowa wa Lubbeni mulonga Jodani; ooyu ngumugaano wabo. Oolu lwakali lukono lwamukowa wa Lubbeni, kakupedwe kuluumwi awumwi wamukowa wakwe, magunzi amyuunzi yabo.
Ncheechi Mozesi nchakapa kumusyobo wa Gadi, mukowa amukowa:
Zilawo zyabo zyali Jeza, myuunzi yoonse a Gileedi achisela chanyika yaba Amoli, kusika ku Alowa, iili kujwe lya Labba,
kuzwa ku Hesibboni kusika ku Lamati Mizipa a Bbetonimu, kuzwa ku Mahanayimu kusika kuchilawo cha Debbi.

Mumusena, Mozesi wakabapa Bbeti Halamu, Bbeti Nimula, Sakkoti, a Zafoni, yoonse yabwami bwa Sihoni mwaami wa Hesibboni, a Jodani mbuli mugaano, kusika kunsi kumagozezye aa Lwizi lwa Kkineleti, kilanga kujwe kutala aa Jodani.
Oolu nduulukono lwamusyobo wa Gadi, mukowa amukowa, amyuunzi yabo azilawo zyabo.
Mozesi wakapa lukono kuchisela chamukowa wa Manase. Lwakapegwa kuchisela chamukowa chalunyungu lwa Manase, mukowa amukowa.
Chilawo chabo chakali kuzwa ku Mahanayimu, Bbasani yoonse, bwami boonse bwa Ogu mwaami wa Bbasani, awoonse madolopo a Jeli, aali mu Bbasani, myuunzi iili makumi musanu akkumi lyomwe;
chisela cha Gileedi, a Asitaloti a Edileyi (myuunzi yabwami bwa Makka mwana mulombe wa Manase - chisela chabantu ba Makka, mukowa amukowa.
Oolu nduulukono oolo Mozesi ndwakapa kulimbabo amadandabalwa aa Moyabbu, kutala lya Jodani kujwe lya Jelikko.
Mozedi takapa lukono pe kumukowa wa Levi. Jehova, Leza wa Izilayili, ndukono lwabo, mbuli mbakaamba kulimbabo.
Aaya ngemasena aanyika eyo bana ba Izilayeli ngebatambula mbuli lukono munyika ya Kkenani, eyo Eliyeza mupayizi, Joshuwa mwana wa Nuni abasilutwe bazyiinga zyamusyobo wa Izilayeli nzebakasalilwa.
Lukono lwabo lwakasaligwa akuwala chisolo kumikowa ili musanu ayiine achisela, mbubo mbuli Jehova mbwakalayilila kwindilila kuli Mozesi.
Nkabela Mozesi wakali wapa chaabilo chamikowa yobile achisela mutaleelyo a jolodani, pesi takwe chaabilo pe nchakapa bana ba Levi.

Mukowa wa Jozefu wakali misyobo yobile, Manase a Ifulemu. BaLevi takwe nebakapegwa pe chaabilo chalukono munyika, pesi biyo imwi myuunzi kuti bakkale mukati, ilamachechezezyo aazivubwa alimwi azimwi izyambono zyabo.
Bana ba Izilayeli bakachita mbuli Jehova mbwakalayilila Mozesi, nkenkaako bakayisala inyika.
Eelyo bana ba Juda bakaza kuli Joshuwa ku Giligala. Kkalebbu mwana Jefuni mu Kkezini, wakati kuli nguwe, ''Ulizi ezyo Jehova nzyakaambila Mozesi muntu wa Leza atala andime anduwe kuKkadeshi Bbaniya.
Ndakali aminyaka iili makumi oone awo Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova nakandituma kuyolangalanga inyika. Ndakamubozezya makani alimwi akali mumoyo wangu kuti nkaachite.
Pesi bakwesu abo bakiinka antomwe andime bakakankamya myoyo yabantu akuyoowa. Pesi ndakatobela Jehova Leza wangu chakumaninina.
Mozesi wakakonka elyo zuba, kaamba kuti, ''Nchobeni inyika awo kuulu kwako mpokwakalyata iyooba lukono lwako abana bako kwalyoonse, nkambo watobela Jehova wangu chakumaninina.'

Kwaino, boona ! Jehova wakandibamba nkandili muumi eyi minyaka iili makumi oone amusanu, mbubo mbuli mbwakaamba kuzwa kuchiindi echo Jehova nakaamba ijwi eli kuli Mozesi, awo Izilayeli kachiyobweenda munkanda. Kwaino, langa ! Sunu obuno ndaba minyaka  ili makumi musanu aatatu aminyaka musanu.
''Ndichili muyumu asunu mbuli mbondakabede buzuba obo Mozesi mbwakandituma. Inguzu zyangu lino zichilimbubo mbuli echo chindi, zyakunkondo akwiinka akukuboola.

Lino kondipa eyi inyika yachilundu, eyo Jehova njakandisyomezya mubuzuba obo. Nkaambo wakamvwa obo buzuba kuti ba Anakkimu mbokakkede amyuunzi isimide kampatila. Ziyochitka kuti Jehova uyoba andime alimwi kuti nkabatande, mbubo mbuli Jehova mbaakamba.''
Mpawo Joshuwa wakamulongezya akumupa Hebbuloni mbuli lukono kuli Kkalebbu mwana wa Jefuni.
Nkeenkako Hebbuloni yakaba lukono lwa Kkalebbu mwana wa Jefuni mu Kkenizi ambuli sunu, nkambo wakatobela Jehova, Leza waba Izilayeli chakumaninina.
Lino izina lya Hebbuloni kumatangunino lyakali kutegwa Kkiliyati Alibba. (Alibba wakali muntu mupati akkati kaba Anakkimu). Eelyo nyika yakalyookezya kunkondo.
Ichaabilo chanyika yamukowa wa Juda, chinga achiinga, chakasika kumusanza kuya kumugano wa Idomu, ankanda ya Zini nkili njiyo ilikule kuya kumusanza.
Mugano wabo wakumusanza wakali kuzwa kumamanino aalwizi lwa Munyo, kuzwa kumusundila oyo ulangide kumusanza.

Mugano wabo umwi wakali kwiinda kubbazu kumusanza wachilundu cha Akkilabbimu akwinda ku Zini, alimwi akutantiila kumusanza wa Kkadeshi Bbaniya, akutobezya Heziloni, akuya ku Ada, awo mpowakazyunguluka akuya ku Kkalikka.
Wakayinda kuya kumulonga wa Ijiputi,akuyosika kumagolelo awo kulwizi. Oyu ngwakali mugano wabo wakumusanza.
Mugano wakujwe ndwizi lwa Munyo, kumatalikilo a Jolodani. Mugano wakunyika wakatalikila kuzwa kumusundila walwizi kumatalikilo a Jolodani.
Wakayinda ku Bbeti Hogila akwiinda kubbazu lyanyika lya Bbeti Alabba. Elyo wakiinda kubbwe lya Bbohani mwana wa Lubbeni.

Eelyo mugano wakiinda kuya ku Debbili kuzwa kumumpata wa Akkoli, alimwi kuya kunyika, kuzyungulukila ku Giligali, ilikubbazu lyakalundu ka Adumini, ilikumusanza wamumpata. Eelyo mugano wakiinda kumaanzi a Enishemeshi kuya ku Eni logeli.

Elyo mugano wakiinda kumumpata wa Bbeni Hinomu kuya kumusanza wachisi cha Jebbusi ( itegwa Jelusalema) Elyo wakinda amutwe wachilundu chilaangene amumpata wa Hinomu, kumbo, nchenchicho chilikumamanino kunyika yamumpata wa Lefayimu.
Elyo mugano wakaseluka kuzwa amutwe wazilundu kuya kusensa lya Nefitowa, alimwi wakazwa kuya kumyunzi yakuchilundu cha Efuloni. Elyo mugano wakanyona ku Bbaala ( itegwa Kkiliyati Jeyalimu ).

Elyo mugano wakazyunguluka kumbo lya Bbaala kuya kuchilundu cha Seyili, akwinda kubbazu lyachilundu cha Jelimu kubbazu lyakumbo ( nchenchicho Kkesaloni ),  wakaseluka kuya ku Bbeti Shemeshi, alimwi wakataaluka kuya ku Timina.
Mugano wakayindila kubbazu lyakalundu ka Ekkiloni kali kunyika, mpawo akuzyunguluka kuya ku Shikkeloni akwiinda kuchilundu cha Bbala, kuzwawo wakaya ku Jebbuneli.
Mugano wakagolela a lwizi. Mugano wakumbo wakali Lwizi Lupati anyika ilimumbali aalo, oyu ngomugano uzyungulukide musyobo wa Juda, chiinga a chiinga.
Mukubamba mulawu wa Jehova kuli Joshuwa, Joshuwa wakapa Kkalebbu mwana wa Jefuni malayilile eenyika akati kabana ba Juda, Kkiliyati Alibba, itegwa Hebbuloni ( Alibba nguwisi wa Anakki).
Kkalebbu wakatanda bana ba Anakki botatwe: Sheshayi, Ahimani a Talimayi, lunyungu lwa Anakki.
Wakazwa oko akuyolwana abana ba Debbe (ilyalikwiitwa kuti Kkiliyati Sefa ).
Kkalebbu wakati, ''Muntu utakalwanisye Kkiliyati Sefa akwizunda ndiyopa mwanangu musimbi Akkisa kulinguwe kuti amukwate.''
Mpawo Otiniyele mwana wa Kkenezi, mukulana wa Kkalebbu, nakayizunda, Kkalebbu wakamupa Akkisa mwanakwe musimbi kuti akwate.
Kuzwa mpawawo, Akkisa wakeza kuli Otiniyele alimwi wakamusungilizya kuti akumbile muunda kuli wisi. Awo nakaseluka kuzwa ambongolo yakwe Kkalebbu wakati kuli nguwe, ''Uyandaanzi ?''
Akkisa wakasandula, ''Kondipa choolwe mbuli mbwandipa inyika yaku Negebbi: kondipa alimwi tusensa twamanzi.'' Elyo Kkalebbu wakamupa tusensa twaatala atusensa twaaansi.
Olu ndolukono lwabana ba Juda, chiinga a chiinga.
Lino myuunzi yamukowa wa Juda ilikumusanza, ibambene amugano wa Idomu, njeyi Kkabbizeli, Edeli, Jaguli,
Kkina, Dimona, Adada,
Kkedeshi, Hazoli, Itinani,
Zifi, Telemu, Bbiyaloti.
Hazoli Hadata, Kkeliyoti Heziloni ( alimwi walikutegwa Hazoli )
Amamu, Shema, Malada,
Hazali Gada, Hezimoni, Bbeti Peleti,
Hazali Suwali, Bbelisebba, Bbiziyotiya.
Bbaala, Iyimu, Ezemu,
Elitodi, Kkesili, Holima,
Zikkilagi, Madimana, Sansana,
Lebbayoti, Shilihimu, Ayini, a Limoni. Eyi myuunzi ilimakumi obile amusanu ayine antomwe, kubikilizya atunzuunzi twayo.
Mutulundulundu kwakali myuunzi eyi, Esitawoli, Zola, Ashina,
Zonowa, Eni Ganimu, Topuwa, Enamu,
Jalamuti, Adulamu, Sokko, Azekka,
Salayimu, Aditayimu, a Gedela ( nkokuti, Gedelotayimu ). Eyi myuunzi ilikkumi ayine antomwe atunzuunzi twayo.
Zenani, Hadasa, Magadaligadi,
Dileni, Mizipa, Jokkoteli,
Lachisi, Bbozikati, Egiloni.
Kkabboni, Lahimasi, Kkitilisi,
Gedeloti, Bbeti Dagoni, Naama, Makkeda, Eyi myuunzi ilikkumi amusanu awumwi antomwe kubalikizya atuunzuunzi twayo.
Libbina,Eta,Asani,
Ifita, Asina, Nezibbi,
Kkeyila, Akkizibbi, Malesa. Eyi myuunzi ilimusanu ayine kubikkilizya atuunzuunzi twayo.
Ekkiloni amyuunzi atunzuunzi twayo twiizyungulukide;
kuzwa ku Ekkiloni kusikila kuLwizi Lupati, yoonse myunzi ibambene a Ashidodi, kubikilizya atunzuunzi twayo.
Ashidodi amyunzi yayo atunzuunzi twayo; Gaza, amyunzi atunzuunzi twayo; kuya kukalonga ka Ijiputi, akuya ku Lwizi Lupati akumbali kwalo.
Muchisi chilazilundu, Shamili, Jatili, Sokko,
Dana, Kkiliyati Sana ( itegwa Debbili ),
Anabbi, Eshitemo, Animu,
Gosheni, Holoni, a Gilo. Eayi njemyunzi ilikkumi awumwi kubalikizya atunzuunzi twayo.
Alabbu,Duma, Eshani,
Janimu, Bbeti Tapuwa,Apekka,
Humuta, Kkiliyati Alibba, ( ngonguwo Hebbuloni ), a Ziya. Eyi njimyuunzi ili musanu ayine, kubikkilizya atunzuunzi twayo.
Mayoni, Kkameli, Zifu,Juta,
Jezileli, Jokkodemu, Zanowa,
Kkayini, Gibbiya, a Timina. Eyi njemyunzi ilikkumi kubikkilizya atunzuunzi twayo.
Halihuli, Bbeti Zuli, Gedali,
Malati, Bbeti Anoti, a Elitekkoni. Eyi njemyunzi ilimusanu awumwi, kubikkilizya atunzuunzi twayo.
Kiliyati Baali ( nguwo Kkiliyatijelimu ), a Labba. Eyi njemyunzi yobile kubikkilizya atuunzuunzi twayo.
Munkanda, kwakali Bbeti Alabba, Middini, Sekkakka,
Nibbishani, muunzi wa Muunyo, a Eni Gedi. Eyi njemyunzi ilimusanu awumwi, kubikkilizya atunzuunzi twayo
Pesi kuba Jebbusi, ibakakkede mu Jelusalemu, lunyungu lwa Juda bakakachilwa kubatanda, nkenkako ba Jebbusi balikkede antomwe alunyungu lwaJuda ambuli sunu.
Chaabilo chanyika chamukowa wa Jozefu weendelela kuzwa ku Jodani iili ku Jelikko, kujwe lyatusawu twa Jelikko, mukati kankanda, kaziya kuzwa ku Jelikko kwiinda munyika yazilundu zya Bbeteli.
Eelyo yakayinka kuzwa ku Bbeteli kusika ku Luzi akutaalukila kusika ku Ataloti kubusena bwaba Aliki.
Mpawo yakayinka aansi lya kumbo kubusena bweendelezegwa aba Jefuleti, mbuli kusika kubusena bweendelezegwa aa Lowa Bbeti Holoni, alimwi kiiya ku Gaza; yakamanina ku lwizi.
Kwakali mbuboobu kuti musyobo wa Jozefu, Manase a Efulemu bakatambula lukono lwabo.
Busena bweendelezegwa aamusyobo wa Efulemu, mukowa amukowa: Mugaano walukono lwabo luli kujwe lwakeenda kuzwa ku Ataloti Ada ambuli kusika ku Apa Bbeti Holoni,
akuzwa ooko yakiinkilila kusika ku lwizi. Kuzwa ku Mikkimelati iili kumusanza yakalanga kulubazu lwaku jwe kaziya ku Tanati Silo akwiinda mumo kujwe kusika ku Jonoya.
Mpawo yakayinka aansi kuzwa ku Jonoya kusika ku Ataloti aku Naala, akusika ku Jelikko, kayimanina ku Jodani.
Kuzwa ku Tapuwa mugaano wakayinka kumbo kukalonga ka Kkana akumanina ku kulwizi. Oolu ndwaali lukono lwamusyobo wa Efulemu, mukowa amukowa,
kali antoomwe amadolopo aayo aakali salidilwe musyobo wa Efulemu mukati kalukono lwamusyobo wa Manase - mumadolopo woonse, kubikilizya amagunzi aabo.
Tebakabatandila aanze pe ba Kkenani bakali kukkala mu Gaza, kuti ba Kkenani bakkale mukati muli Efulemu kusika buzuba bwamusanu pesi bantu aaba bakachitwa kuti bachite mulimu wakumanikizigwa.

Eechi chakali chaabilo chanyika yamusyobo wa Manase (wakali mwana mutaanzi wa Jozefu)-ngonguwe, wa Makkili, wakali mwana mutaanzi wa Manase aboobo lwakwe wakali wisi wa Gileedi Lunyungu lwa Makkili lwakaabidilwe nyika ya Gileedi a Bbasyali, nkaambo Makkili wakali mwaluumi wankondo.

Nyika yakaabilwa kuli boonse bamusyobo wa Manase; kipegwa mikowa yabo -Abbiyeza, Heleki, Aziliyelu, Sekkemu, Hefa, a Semida. Aaba mbakali baluumi balunyungu lwa Manase mwana mulombe wa Jozefu, wakayimikizigwa aamukowa wabo.

Lino Zelofeyadi mwana mulombe wa Hefa mwana mulombe wa Gileedi mwana mulombe wa Makkili mwana mulombe wa Manase tewakali aabana balombe pe, pesi bana basimbi biyo. Mazina aabana basimbi bakwe bakali Mala, Nowa, Wogila, Milika, a Taliza.

Bakasikila Eliyeza mupayizi, Joshuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni, abazuludi, alimwi bakaamba kuti, "Jehova wakalayilila Mozesi kuti atupe lukono aakati kabakulana besu." Eelyo mukutobelezya malayilile aa Jehova, wakabapa banakazi aabo, lukono aakati kabakulana babo bakuli wisi.
Zipanzi zili kkumi zyanyika zyakaabilwa Manase mu Gileedi a Bbasani, iili kulubazu lumwi lwa Jodani,
nkaambo bana basimbi ba Manase bakatambula lukono aakati kabana bakwe balombe. Nyika ya Gileedi yakaabilwa boonse balungu lwa Manase.
Busena bweendelezegwa aa Manase bwakali kwiinka kuzwa kuli Aseli kulosika ku Mikkimetati, buli kujwe lya Sekkemu. Eelyo mugaano wakeenda kumusanza kuli baabo bakkala munsi lyakasawu ka Tapuwa.
(Nyika ya Tapuwa yakali ya Manase, pesi dolopo lya Tapuwa kumugaano wa Manase wakali wabantu ba Efulemu.)

Mugaano wakeenda aansi kusika kukalonga ka Kkana. Madolopo aaya aali kumusanza wakalonga aali akati kamadolopo aa Manase aakali aa Efulemu. Mugaano wa Manase wakali kunyika kulubazu lwakalonga, mpawo wakali kujinka kulwizi.
Nyika yakumusanza yakali ya Efulemu, anyika yakunyika yakali ya Manase; lwizi ndwakali mugaano. Kulubazu lwa kunyika lwa Asya lwakali kunoosikika akujwe, Isakka.

Alubo muli Isakka amuli Asya, Manase wakabwezede Bbeti Sani amagunzi aawo, Ibbuleyamu amagunzi aawo bakkali ba Doli amagunzi aawo, bakkali ba Endo amagunzi aawo, bakkali ba Tanakki, amagunzi aawo, abakkali ba Megido amagunzi aawo (agunzi lyachitatu ngu Nafeti).
Aboobo musyobo wa Manase tewakabweza pe madolopo aayo, kwaba Kkenani bakiinkilila aanembo kukkala munyika eeyi.
Bantu ba Izilayili nibakakomena munguzu, bakabika ba Kkenani mumulimu wakumanikizigwa, pesi tebakabamaninizya pe kubatanda.

Eelyo lunyungu lwa Jozefu lwakaamba kuti kuli Joshuwa, "Nkamboonzi nwatupa chipanzi chimwi chanyika achipanzi chimwi chalukono, mbukunga tuli bayingi mumweelwe, aboobo toonse biyo Jehova wakatulongezya?"

Joshuwa wakati kulimbabo, "Na mulibantu bamweelwe mupati, mwiinke lwanu mulusaka allimwi nkuko mukalikukwide lwanu lubuwa munyika yaba Pelizi ayaba Lefayimu. Muchite eechi, mbulikuti nyika yazilundu ya Efulemu nindiini loko kuli ndinywe."

Lunyungu lwa Jozefu lwakati, "Nyika yazilundu tituzulili pe swebo. Pesi ba Kkenani bakkala musyena bali aankalaki zyalubulo, abamwi boonse bali mu Bbeti Syani amagunzi aawo, abaabo bali musyena lya Jezilili."
Eelyo Joshuwa wakati kung'anda ya Jozefu -kuli Efulemu akuli Manase, "Muli bantu bamweelwe mupati, akuba aanguzu mpati. Tamweelede kuba aachipanzi chimwi biyo chanyika chaabilidwe ndinywe.

Nyika yazilundu ayalo iyooba yanu. Nekuba kuti ndusaka, muyoolukukula akulubweza kusika kunembo aamugaano. Muyoobanda ba Kkenani, nekuba kuti bali aankalaki zyalubulo, alimwi nikuba kuti mbaasinguzu."
Lino imbungano yoonse yabantu ba Izilayeli yakabungana antomwe ku Shilo. Bakabikka matente akubungana nkukoko alimwi bakazunda nyika kunembo lyabo.
Kwakachili misyobo musanu ayibili akati kabantu ba Izilayeli abo baka tanakupegwa lukono lwabo.
Joshuwa wakati kubantu ba Izilayeli, ''Mulatola chiindi chilibiyeni kamutayinki munyika eyo Jehova, Leza wamizimu yenu, njakamupa?

Mulisalile lwenu balumi batatu kuzwa kulumwi awumwi musyobo, alimwi ndiyobatuma kuzwa.Bayobamba akwendenda munyika kujulu akunsi. Bayolemba bupanduluzi bwayo kabali amubono kulukono lwabo, alimwi elyo bayoboola kuli ndiswe.
Bayoyiganuuna muzimpanzi zilimusanu azibili. Juda uyosyala munyika yabo ilikumusanza, alimwi ng'anda ya Jozefu iyoyinkilila anembo munyika yabo ilikunyika.
Muyopandulula nyika muzibela zili musanu azibili akweeta bupanduluzi okuno kuli ndime. Ndiyowaala chisolo kulindinywe ano kunembo lya Jehova Leza wesu.

Ba Levi tabakwe chimpanzi akkati kenu, kubupayizi bwa Jehova ndukono lwabo. Gadi, Lubbeni, achisela chamusyobo wa Manase bakatambula lukono lwabo, afwifwi a Jodani. Oolu ndukkono oolo Mozesi mulanda wakwe ndwabapa.''

Eelyo balumi bakanyampuka akwinka. Joshuwa wakalayilila abo bakayinka kuti bakalembele bupanduluzi bwanyika, kuti, ''Mwinke kujulu aansi  munyika alimwi mulembe bupanduluzi bwayo akuboola kulindime. Ndiyowala chisolo kulindime ano kunembo lya Jehova ku Shilo.''

Balumi bakeenda akwinka kujulu aansi munyika akulemba bupanduluzi bwayo mupepa kwindilila muzisi zyabo muzimpanzi zili musanu azibili, kabatobelania zisi chimwi achimwi chibela. Mpawo bakabweeda kuli Joshuwa mubbunganino ku Shilo.
Eelyo Joshuwa wakawala chisolo kulimbabo ku Shilo kunembo lya Jehova. Zyakaliwo nkuti Joshuwa wakapa nyika kubantu ba Izilayeli, alimwi kuti umwi awumwi wakapedwe chimpanzi chanyika.
Kwabululwa kwanyika kumusyobo wa Bbenjamini mukowa akumukowa. Busena bwanyika yabo njibakapedwe bwakabikidwe akati kalunyungu lwa Juda alunyungu lwa Jozefu.
Kubbazu lyaku Nyika, mugano wakinkila anembo kuyosika kumibundo yaku Nyika yatulundu ku Mboo. Ooko wakakusika kunkanda ya Bbeti Aveni.

Kuzwawo mugano wakiinda kutobelezya kubbazu lyaku Musanza ku Luzi ( busena bukozyenie aku Bbeteli ). Eelyo mugano wakiinka munsi ku Atoloti Ada, kumbali achilundu chaku Musanza wa Bbeti Holoni. Eelyo mugano wakiinka kulilimbi bbazu:

Kubbazu lya Kumbo wakanzyoonoka kunembo lyaku Musanza, kawuzulwida kunembo lyachilundu kawutimbula kuzwa ku Bbeti Haloni. Oyu mugano wakakugolela ku Kkiliyati Bbali ( chamba kuti, Kkiliyati Jiyalimu), chisi echo chakali chamusyobo wa Juda. Eechi chakachitika mugano kubbazu lyaku Mboo.
Kubbazu lyaku musanza anze lyaku Kkiliyati Jiyalimu. Mugano wakiinka kuzwa oko kosika ku Efulemu, kukalambwa kamanzi a Nefuta.

Mpawo mugano wakakunuka kunsi lyachilundu oyo wakalangene amusena wa Bbeni Hinomu, oyo wakali kumamanino aku Nyika yamusena wa Lifeyimu. Elyo wakiinka kunsi kumusena wa Hinomu, kumusanza wamunkuni wa Jebbusiti, akwinkila anembo kunsi ku Eni Logelu.

Wakanzyonokela kubbazu lyaku nyika, kuyinka kubbazu lyaku Eni Shemeshi, alimwi kuzwa awo wakayinka kuzwa kuya ku Giliyati, ooyo wakalangene anzila yaku Adimimu. Mpawo wakakunuka kunsi kubbwe lya Bbohani mwana mulombe wa Lubbeni.
Wakinda kunyika yekkuko lya Bbeti Alabba akunsi alimwi akuyosika ku Alabba.
Mugano wakinda kunyika yakukkuko lya Bbeti Hogila. Mugano wakagolela kunyika yamisamu yalwizi lwamwinyo, kumagolelo akumusanza wa Jolodani. Oyu wakali mugano wakumusanza.
Jolodani wakachita wakwe mugano kubbazu lyakumboo. Olu lwakali lukono lwamusyobo wa Bbenjamini, mugano kuzwa amugano, uzyunguluka koonse.
Lino chisi chamusyobo wa Bbenjamini, mukowa akumukowa, bakalezisi ezi: Jelikko, Bbeti, Hogila, Emekki Kkezizi,
Bbeti Alabba, Zemalayimu, Bbeteli,
Avimu, Pala, Ofila,
Kkefa Amoni, Ofini, antomwe Gebba. Bakali kkumi azisi zyobile, kubikilizya amagunzi abo.
Aboobo kwakali zisi zya Gibbiyoni, Lama, Bbiloti,
Mizipa, Kkefila, Moza,
Lekkemu, Ipilu, Talala,
Zela, Helefi, Jebbusi ( likozyania a Jelusalemu), Gibbiya, alimwi a Kkiliyati. Kwakali zisi kkumi azine, kuswanizya amagunzi abo. Olu lwakali lukono lwaba Bbenjamini kumikowa yabo.
Inkaba yabili yakawida kuli Simiyoni, mukowa akumukowa. Lukono lwabo lwakali akkati alukono ololwakali lwaluzubo lwaba Juda.
Bakali a Bbiyasebba kulukono lwabo, Sebba, Molada,
Haza Suwalu, Bbala, Ezemu,
Elutoladi, Bbetelu, alimwia Homa.
Simiyoni abobo wakala Zikkilagi, Bbeti Makkabboti, Haza Susani,
Bbeti Lebbawoti, antomwe a Saluheni. Ezi zyakali zisi zilikkumi azitatu, kubikilizya amagunzi abo.
Simiyoni alimwi wakali a Ayini, Limoni, Eeta, antomwe a Asani. Ezi zyakali zisi zine, kubikilizya amagunzi abo.
Eezi zyakali amwi, kubikilizya amwi  amyunzi yabo kuzyunguluka ezi zisi kule mbuli Bbalati Bbiya ( bukozyenie aku Lama mu Ninivu). Olu lwakali lukono lwa luzubo lwa Simiyoni, mukowa akumukowa.

Lukono lwaluzubo lwa Simiyoni lwakanza chimpanzi chabusena bwaluzubo lwa Juda. Nkambo chimpanzi chanyika chakapedwe kuluzubo lwa Juda chakali chipati loko kuli mbabo, luzubo lwa Simiyoni lwakutambula lukono lwabo kuzwa akkati kachibeela chabo.
Inkaba yatatu yakawida kuluzubo lwa Zebbuluni, mukowa akumukowa. Mugano walukono lwabo utalikila ku Salidi.
Mugano wakinka ajulu kubbazu lyakububbila afwifwi a Malala alimwi wakakusika ku Dabbeseti; mpawo wakinkilila kuyosika kukasensa kakalangene a Jokkinemu.
Kuzwa ku Salidi mugano wakakomena kubbazu lyakubuzwezuba afwifwi akujwe akwinka kumugano Kisiloti Tabba. Kuzwa awo wakinka ku Dabbelati alimwi mane ku Jofiya.
Kuzwa awo wakinda kubbazu lyakubuzwezuba ku Gati Hefa, alimwi mane ku Eti Kkazini; utobela wakinka ku Limoni alimwi wakakomena afwifwi aku Neya.
Mugano wakinka kuchiswi kunyika yaku Hanatoni akugolela Mumpata wa IfutaElu.
Obu busena bubikilizya antomwe azisi zyaku Kkata, Nahalali, Simuloni, Idala, a Bbetelehemu.
Olu ndulwakali likono lwamukowa wa Zebbuluni, mukowa amukowa,  kubikilizya antomwe amagunzi abo.
Inkaba yane yakawida kuli Izakka, mukowa akumukowa.
Busena bwabo kubikilizya a Jeziliyeli, Chezuloti, Sunemu,
Hafalayimu, Siyoni, antomwe a Anahalati.
Aboobo kubikilizya a Labbiti, Kisiyoni, Ebbezi,
Lemeti, Eni Ganimu, Eni Hada, antomwe a Bbeti Pazezi.
Imigano yabo aboobo wakajata Tabba, Siakazuma, antomwe a Bbeti Syemesi, alimwi kugolela ku Jolodani. Akali kkumi azisi zitatu, kubikilizya amagunzi abo.
Olu lwakali lukono lwaluzubo lwa Izakka kwindila kumukowa wabo - zisi, kubikilizya antomwe amyunzi.
Inkaba yasanu yakawida kuluzubo lwa Asa, mukowa akumukowa.
Busena bwabo kabuswanizya a Helukkati, Hali, Bbeteni, Akkisafu,
Alameleki, Amadi, antomwe a Misalu. Kumbo kumugano oyo mugano wakalikwankwamukide kuyosika ku Kkamelu aku Siholi Libbinati.

Elyo wakakomena kubbazu lyakubuzwezuba ku Bbeti Dagoni alimwi wakiinka kule mbuli ku Zebbuluni, alimwi akumumpata wa Ifuta Elu, kubbazu kunyika kuyosika ku Bbeti Emekki aku Neyiyelu. Elyo wakinkilila kunembo doku Kkabbulu afwifwi akunyika.
Elyo wakinkilila doku Abbudoni, Lehobbu, Hamoni, aku Kkana, kule mbuli ku Sidoni Mpati.
Mugano wakakomena musule ku Lama, alimwi eelyo chisi chizyungulukide ku Taya. Elyo mugano wakakkonena ku Hosa akugolela kulwizi, mubusena bwa Akkizibbu,
Umah, Afekki, aku Lehobbu. Zyakali makumi atatu zisi, kubikilizya amyunzi yabo.
Olu lwakali lukono lwaluzubo lwa Asha, mukowa akumukowa -- zisi kubikilizya amyuunzi yabo.
Inkaba yamusanu ayimwi yakawida kuluzubo lwa Nafitali, mukowa akumukowa,.
Mugano wabo wakachija kuzwa ku Helefu, kuzwa ku Okku ku Zananimu, kuyosika ku Adami Nekkebbu aku Jabbunelu, kule mbuli ku Lakkumu; wakakugolela ku Jolodani.
Mugano wakakukonena ku bbazu lyakububbila ku Azinoti Tabba alimwi wakinkilila ku Hakkokku; wakuguma Zebbuluni kumusanza, akuyosika ku Asha nkwili kumbo alimwi Juda nkwali  kujwe kumulonga Jolodani.
Zisi zyabo zyakazyungulukide zyakali Zidimu, Zeli, Hamati, Lakkati, Kineleti,
Adama, Lama, Haza,
Kkedesi, Edileyi, antomwe a Eni Haza.
Aboobo kwakali Yiloni, Migidali Elu, Holemu, Bbeti Anati, aku Bbeti Syemesi. Zyakali kkumi azitatu zisi, kubikilizya amagunzo abo.
Olu ndolwakali lukono lwabo kumukowa wa Nafutali, mukowa amukowa-amagunai, kubikilizya atunzuzi twabo.
Inkaba yamusanu azibili yakawida kuluzubo lwa Dani, mukowa akumukowa.
Busena bwalukono lwabo lwakabikilizya antomwe a Zola, Esitoli, Ili Syamesi,
Shalabbinu, Ayijaloni, antomwe a Itila.
Alimwi kukubikilizya a Eloni, Timuni, Ekkiloni,
Eluteke, Gibbetoni, Bbalati,
Jewudi, Bbene Bbelakki, Gati Limoni,
Mee Jakkoni, alimwi a Lakkoni kubikilizya abusena butimbula kuzwa ku Jopa.

Elyo busena bwamukowa wa Dani bwakali swekede kulimbabo, Dani wakibukila Leshemu, wakilwana, akwitola changuzu akwilwana apanga; akutola buvubi bwayo akukkala mulinjiyo. Alimwi bakawuzika zina limbi Leshemu, akwiyita kuti Dani musule lyabensiku babo.
Olu ndulwakali lukono lwamukowa wa Dani, mukowa akumukowa-azisi, kubikilizya amyunzi yabo.
Elyo nibakamaninsya kwabana nyika mbuli lukono lwabo, bantu ba Izilayeli bakapa lukono akati kabo kuli Joshuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni.
Amulayililo wa Jehova bakamupa chisi echo nchakambide, imunati Shela munyika yazilundu ku Efulemu. Wakayakulula chisi akupona nkuko.

Olu ndukono Eliyeza mupaizi, Joshuwa mwanamulombe wa Nuni, antomwe abazuluzi bamikowa ya Izilayeli bakapegwa ankaba ku Shilo, kunembo a Jehova, kumulyango watente lyakubunganina. Elyo bakamaninsya kwabulula nyika.
Mpawo Jehova wakambila Joshuwa wakati,
''Ambula abana ba Izilayeli, utedi, ''Musale dolopo lyakuchijila elyo ndindakambide kuli ndinywe akuboko kwa Mozesi.
Chita echi nkambo oyo utajayi muntu achali akinke nkuko. Aya madolopo ayoba busena bwakuchijila kuzwa kulumwi awumwi oyo uyanda chiboozyo chabulowa bwamuntu wakajiigwa.

Uyo chijanina kuli limwi lyamadolopo alimwi uyoyima awo anjililwa dolopo amulyango, alimwi akuyo pandulula penzi lyakwe kubapati badolopo. Mpawo bayomubweza bakamunjizye mudolopo alimwi bakamupe busena bwakuti akapone akati kabo.

Kuti umwi wenu waza kuti sikutema mulawu wabulowa bwamuntu oyo wakajiigwa, mpawo muntu wadolopo tayelede kujata oyo wakajaya kumutola kumulawu. Tabelede kuchita obo nkambo wakajaya simayake nyina katalangili kuchitobo, alimwi takalikwe chibi kulinguwe chachiindi.

Ulelede kukkala mudolopo elyo mane akayimikile kunembo lyabusena bwaku betekwa, mane lufu lwawoyo wakali kupayila mbuli mupayizi mupati wamazuba ayo. Mpawo oyo wakajaya muntu achitensi chali pe welede kubweda kuchisi chakwe alimwi kumunzi wakwe, kuzwa muchisi nchachijilide.''

Aboobo bama Izilayeli bakasala Kadesi mu Galili munyika yakalundu ka Nafutali, Shechemu munyika yakalundu munyika ya Efulemu, alimwi a Kkiliyati Abba (bukozyenie a Hebbuloni) munyika yakalundu ya Juda.

Musule lya Jolodani kujwe lya Jelikko, bakasala Bbeza mukati kankanda kumulundu oko nkubakakkede baluzubo lwa Lubbeni; Lamoti Giliyadi, kuzwa kumusyobo wa Gadi;  alimwi a Golani mu Bbashani, kuzwa kumusyobo wa Manase.

Aya ngakali madolopo akasalidwe abantu boonse ba Izilayeli alimwi abeenzu bakali kukkala kkala akkati kabo, kuchitila kuti kufumbwa ujaya mwenzinyina pepe achali balelede kuchijila kuli mbabo kuti bamuvune. Oyo muntu tayelede kufwa amaboko ayoyo wakali kuyanda kutema mulandu wabulowa bwakatika, mane oyo wakakosola mulandu akiime anembo lyambungano.
Mpawo oyo muzulwidi walunyungu lwaba Levi bakeza kuli Eliyeza mupayizi, kuli Joshuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni, alimwi akuba zuluzi bampuli zyabasikale akkati kabantu ba Izilayeli.
Bakamba kuti kulimbabo mu Shilo munyika ya Kkenani, ''Jehova wakalayilila nduwe kujanza lya Mozesi kuti atupe dolopo kuti tukkale mumo, amachezezyo ambono zyesu.''
Aboobo kwinda mumalayilile a Jehova, bantu ba Izilayeli bakapeda zintu zyabo kumadolopo atobela, antomwe awayo mpubakali kuchezezya, kuba Levi.

Kujata kulunyungu lwama Kkohatiti kwakapa mpindu eyi: Ba payizi--balunyungu lwa Aloni oyo wakazwide kuba Levi--bakatambula madolopo kkumi aatatu akapegwa kuzwa kumukowa wa Juda, kuzwa kumukowa wa Simiyoni, alimwi akumukowa wa Bbenjamini.
Ayamwi wonse mazyalane a Kkohati bakatolegwa kuzisi zilikkumi kuzwa kulunyungu lwamukowa wa Efulemu, Dani, alimwi kuzwa akkati kamukowa wa Manase.
Mpwao bantu bakazwa kuzwa ku Geshoni bakapegwa, kwinda mukuwala chisolo, kkumi azitatu zisi zyamikowa yalunyungu lwa Izakka, Asha, Nafutali, antomwe achisela chabamukowa wa Manase mu Bbashani.
Bantu bamazyalane a Melali, mukowa amukowa, bakatambula kkumi azibili zisi kuzwa kumumukowa wa Lubbeni, Gadi, antomwe a Zebbuluni.
Aboobo bantu ba Izilayeli bakapa, akupeda zyiingi, ayo madolopo ( kuswanizya amachezezyo abo) kubapayizi, mbuli Jehova mbwakali walayilila mukuboko kwa Mozesi.
Kuzwa kumikowa ya Juda a Simiyoni, bakapeda nyika kumadolopo, aya awambidwe amazina.
Aya madolopo akapedwa kumazyalane a Aloni, abo bakali akkati kaluzubo lwa Kkohati, bakali kuzwa kumikowa yaba Levi. Nkambo kuwalwa kutanzi kwachisolo kwaka widilide alimbabo.
Ba Izilayeli bakapa Kkiliyati Abba ( Abba wakali wisi wa Anakki), busena bukozyenie a Hebbuloni, munyika yakalundu ka Juda, antomwe amachezezyo akazyungulukide.
Pesi inkuba zyadolopo, mukwindila mumyunzi yabo, wakali bapegwa kale kuli Kkalebbu mwana mulombe wa Jefuni, mbuli chabilo chakwe.
Oko kumazyalane a Aloni mupayizi bakapa Hebbuloni amachezezyo ayo--echo chakali chisi chamachijilo amuntu kufumbwa wajaya umwi wakwe chakutayeyela kumujaya-- antomwe a Libbina amachezezyo ayo,
Jatiya amachezezyo ayo, aku Eshitemowa amachezezyo ayo.
Alimwi bakapa Holoni amachezezyo ayo, Debbiya amachezezyo ayo,
Ayini amachezezyo ayo, Juta amachezezyo ayo, antomwe a Bbeti Syemesi amachezezyo ayo. Akali musanu awane madolopo ayo akapedwe kuzwa kumikowa eyi ibili.
Kuzwa kumukowa wa Bbenjamini bakapegwa Gibbiyoni amachezezyo ayo, Gebba amachezezyo akwe,
Anototi amachezezyo akwe, antomwe a Alumoni amadolopo --akwe aane.
Madolopo akapedwe kubapayizi, kumazyalane a Aloni, bakali madolopo alikkumi atatu antomwe, kubikkamwi amachezezyo abo.
Elyo banamaleya babantu ba Kkohatitisi abo bakalikuzwa ku kumikowa yaba Kkohatitisi yaba Levi- bakali amadolopo ngibakapedwe kuzwa kumukowa wa Efulemu kwinda mukuwala chisolo.
Kuli mbabo bakapegwa Syechemu amachezezyo ayo munyika yachilundu cha Efulemu--chisi chakali chamachijilo amuntu kufumbwa wakajayide muntu kutali echali--Geza antomwe amachezezyo ayo,
Kkibbuzayimu amachezezyo ayo, antomwe a Bbeti Holoni amachezezyo akwe--madolopo aane kwabikamwi.
Kuzwa kumukowa wa Dani, luzubo lwa Kkohati lwakapegwa Elutekke amachezezyo ayo, Gibbetoni amachezezyo ayo,
Ayijaloni amachezezyo ayo, antomwe a Gati Limoni amachezezyo ayo--madolopo aane mumweelwe.
Kuzwa kuchisela chamukowa wa Manase, luzubo lwa Kkohati wakapedwe kuli Tanakki amachezezyo ayo antomwe a Gati Limoni amachezezyo ayo-zisi zibili.
Kwakali kkumi lyamadolopo antomwe aluzubo lwa Kkohatiti, kubikamwi amachezezyo abo.

Kuzwa kuchisela chalunyungu lwa Manase, kuluzubo lwa Geshomu, ezyo zyakali zimwi zyechibbululu zyaba Levi, alimwi bakapeda Golani mu Bbashani amachezezyo abo - idolopo lyakuyubila kuti wajaya muntu kakutensi achali pe, antomwe aba Eshitela amachezezyo abo - madolopo ali abili kubikamwi.
Kuluzubo lwa Geshoni abalabo bakapa Kkishoni kuzwa kumukowa wa Izakka, antomwe amachezezyo ayo, Dabbelati amachezezyo ayo,
Jamuti amachezezyo ayo, antomwe a Eni Ganimu amachezezyo ayo - madolopo aane.
Kuzwa kumukowa wa Asha, bakapeda Mishalu amachezezyo, Abbudoni amachezezyo abo,
Helukkati amachezezyo ayo, antomwe a Lehobbu amachezezyo ayo - madolopo oone kwabikamwi.

Kuzwa kumukowa wa Nafutali, bakapa kumikowa ya Geshoni Kkedeshi mu Galili amachezezyo ayo - chisi chamachijilo chamuntu kufumbwa wajaya muntu kutali echaali; Hamoti Doli amachezezyo ayo, antomwe a Kkatani amachezezyo ayo - madolopo atatu kwabikamwi.
Kwakali madolopo alikkumi atatu antomwe, azwa kuluzubo lwa Geshoni, kubikamwi amachezezyo abo.
Zyonse kuba Levi - luzubo lwa Melali - bakapegwa kuzwa kumukowa wa Zebbuloni: Jokkinimu amachezezyo ayo, Kkata amachezezyo ayo,
Dimuna amachezezyo ayo, antomwe a Nahalalu amachezezyo ayo - madolopo aane kwabikamwi.
Kuluzubo lwa Melali bakapegwa kuzwa kumukowa wa Lubbeni; Bbeza amachezezyo abo, Jaha amachezezyo abo,
Kkedemoti amachezezyo ayo, antomwe a Mefati amachezezyo ayo - madolopo aane.
Kuzwa kumukowa wa Gadi bakapegwa Lamoti mu Giliyadi amachezezyo ayo - chisi chakuchijila kumuntu kufumbwa wajaya muntu kutali echali - antomwe a Mahanayimu amachezezyo ayo.
Imikowa ya Melali abalabo bakapegwa Heshibboni amachezezyo ayo, antomwe a Jaza amachezezyo ayo. Ayo akali madolopo aane kwabikamwi.
Ayo wonse akali madolopo akapedwe nyingi nzubo zyamukowa wa Melali,abo bakali kuzwa kumukowa wa Levi - kkumi amadolopo obile kwabikamwi akapedwe kulimbabo kwinda mukuwala chisolo.
Madolopo aba Levi bakabwezegwa akkati kanyika yabantu ba Izilayeli akali madolopomakumi aane alamusanu aatatu, kubikilizya amachezezyo abo.
Aya madolopo alimwi akali amachezezyo awo ali afwifwi. Zyakali mbuboobo kumadolopo wonse.
Abobo Jehova wakapa Izilayeli inyika yoonse njakabuzizye kuzwa kuli basikale babo. Ba Izilayeli bakabweza buvubi bwayo alimwi bakakkala mpuwawo.
Takwepe nikuba womwe waba sing'andanyina wakali kubazunda. Jehova wakapeda basinkondonyina mumaanza abo.
Takwe pe nikuba womwe akkati kabo zyoonse zisyomezyo zibotu Jehova nzyaka bambilide kung'anda ya Izilayeli zyakakachila kuti zichitike. Zyonseni zyakachitika mbukwakelede.
Kuchiindi echo Joshua wakayita ba Lubbenayiti, ba Gaditisi, alimwi achisela chamukowa wa Manase.
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Mwakachita zyoonse Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova nzyakamulayilila. Mwakaswilila ijwi lyangu mulizyonse nzindakamulayilila.
Tensi mwakabasiya bana bakwanu mazuba miingi aya, kusika kubuzuba obu sunu, alimwi mwakazuzikizya nzimwali kulangilwa kuti muchite kumilayizyo ya Jehova Leza wenu.

Lino Jehova Leza wanu wapa kulyookezya kubana bakwanu, mbuli mbwakasyomezezye. Nkambo kaako amunyone alimwi mwinke kumabbakasa anu munyika yanu, eyo Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova njakamupa kuleliya limwi ibbazu lya Jodani.

Muchenjele loko kukubamba milayizyo amulawu oyo Mozesi mulanda wa Jehova njakamulayilila, kuyanda Jehova Leza wanu, kwenda munzila zyakwe zyoonse, kubamba milayizyo yakwe, akukakatila kulinguwe akumukomba amoyo woonse.''
Elyo Joshuwa wakabalongezya akubamwayisya, alimwi bakabweda kumabbakasa abo.

Lino kuchisela chomwe chamukowa wa Manase Mozesi wakabapede lukono muBbushani, pesi kulichimwi chisela Joshuwa wakabapa lukono kubbazu lyabana bakwabo munyika ilikumusanza wa Jodani. Joshuwa wakabwedezya kumabbakasa aabo, wakabalongezya

alimwi wakati kulimbabo, ''Amubwede kumabbakasa anu amali nyiingi, alimwi azivubwa zyiingi, ansiliva angolide, alimwi amukuba ansimbi, alimwi azyakusama zyiingi loko. Mukaabane nzimwajana kuliba sinkondonyokwe abana bakwanu.''

Eelyo lunyungu lwa Lubbeni, lunyungu lwa Gadi, achisela chamukowa wa Manase bakabweda kumunzi, bakasiya bantu ba Izilayili ku Shilo, eyo ilimunyika yaku Kkenani. Bakanyampuka kabaya kubusena bwa Gilidi, kunyika yabo, eyo njibakavubide bolwabo beni, mukuswilizya milayizyo ya Jehova, kujanza lya Mozesi.

Elyo nibakasika kuJodano eyo ilimunyika ya Kkenani, ba Lubbenayiti aba Gaditisi alimwi achisela chamukowa wa Manase bakayaka chipayililo kulubazu lwa Jodani, chipayililo chipati loko alimwi chiindilide.

Bantu ba Izilayili bakamvwa ezi alimwi bakati, ''Langa ! Bnatu ba Lubbeni, Gadi, achisela chamukowa wa Manase bakayaka chipayililo kunembo lyanyika ya Kkenani, ku Geliloti, mubusena bulafwifwi a Jodani kulubazu olo lwabantu ba Izilayili.''
Awo bantu ba Izilayili nibakamvwa eezi, imbunga yoonse yabantu ba Izilayili bakabungana antomwe ku Shilo kuti bayinke bakabusye inkondo ambabo.
Mpawo bantu bakwa Izilayili bakatuma batumwa kuliba Lubbenayitisi, ba Gaditisi akuchisela chamukowa wa Manase, munyika ya Giliyadi. Alubo bakatuma Finiyasi mwana wa Eliyaza, mupayizi,
alimwi anguwe, bazulwidi balikkumi, umwi kuzwa kuliimwi ayimwi impuli yaluzubo lwa Izilayeli, alimwi woonse umwi wabo kalisimutwe wampuli akati kamukowa wa Izilayili.
Bakasika kubantu ba Lubbeni, Gadi akuchisela chamukowa wa Manase, munyika ya Giliyadi, alimwi bakaambula ambabo:

''Mbungano yoonse ya Jehova iwaamba eechi, nchinyamanzi echi chakutasyomeka nchimwachitila Leza wa Izilayili, nimwaleka buzuba obuno kutobela Jehova akuliyakila chipayililo buzuba obuno mukupapila Jehova?
Sena chibi chesu ku Piyoli techakazulide? Pele tatuna kusika lino kulisalazya kuli nchicho. Nkambo kachibi kwakasika chinyonyooko kumbunga ya Jehova.
Muleke na anywebo kutobela Jehova mubuzuba bwasunu obu? Naa anywebo mwapapila Jehova sunu, junza ulanyemena yoonse mbunga ya Izilayeli.

Naa inyika eyo njimuvubide yasofwala, elyo mulelede kwiinda muye kunyika oko ntempele lya Jehova nkolibede alimwi mukalitolele ziliko akati kesu. Biyo mutapapili Jehova, nanka kupapila ndiswe akuliyakila chipayililo chiimbi chitali chipayililo cha Jehova Leza wesu.
Tensi Akkani mwana wa Zela wakatyola lusyomo mumakani azintu ezyo zyakabambilidwe Leza? Tensi bukali bwakawida abantu boonse ba Izilayili? Ulya mwalumi takanyoonyoka alike pe nkambo kabubi bwakwe.''
Mpawo mikowa ya Lubbeni, Gadi, achisela chamukowa wa Manase bakavwiila kabasandula basilutwe bamikowa ya Izilayili:
''Simanguzu, Leza, Jehova ! Simanguzu, Leza, Jehova _ Ulizi, alimwi Izilayili lwakwe ngazibe ! Naa kwakali kupapa, nanka kwakalikuleya kwakulusyomo kuchitilwa Jehova, mutatufwidi nsoni mubuzuba obuno

nkambo twayaka chipayililo kutulesya kuzwa kutobela Jehova. Na twakayaka chipayililo kuti tupedekezye zipo zitentedwe, zipo zyamayila, nanka zipo zyalumuno, mpawo Jehova achite kuti tulibbadalile tobeni.
Nee ! Twakachichita nkambo kakuyowa kuti muchindi chiboola bana benu balakonzya kwamba kuti kubana besu, 'Mulenyamanzi chakuchita a Jehova, Leza waba Izilayili?
Nkambo Jehova wakachita Jodani abembungano akati kandiswe andinywe. Inywe nobantu ba Lubbeni abantu ba Gadi, tamukwe chakuchita a Jehova, Élyo bana benu inga balalesya bana besu kukomba Jehova.
Elyo twakati, 'Mutuleke lino tuyake chipayililo, chitali chezipo zitentedwe nanka kufumbwa chituuzyo,

Pele chibe bukamboni akati kesu andinywe, alimwi akati kamazyalani esu aachiza, kuti tukachite milimo ya Jehova kunembo lyakwe, ezipo zyakutenta zyesu alimwi azituuzyo zyesu azipo zyaluumuno zyesu, kuti bana banu batakaambi kubana besu kuchiindi chibola, ''Tamukwe chaabilo muli Jehova.''

Elyo twakati, ''Naa ezi zyakaambwa kulindiswe nanka kubana besu bachiza muchiindi chichiza, twelede kutio, ámulange ! Echi chilakozyania achipayililo cha Jehova, echo bamatatesu nchibakayakide, chitali chezipo zyakutenta, nikuba zituuzyo, pele mbuli bukamboni akati kesu andinywe.'

Azibe k ule andiswe zyakupapila Jehova, alimwi sunu amuleke kumutobela mukuyaka chipayililo chazipo zyakutenta, chazipo zyamiila, nikuba zyechituuzyo, chitali chipayililo cha Jehova Leza wesu echo chilikunembo lyantempele lyakwe.'''
Awo Finiyasi mupayizi abendelezi babantu, chamba, basilutwe bamikowa ya Izilayeli abo mbakalawe, bakamvwa majwi ayo bantu ba Lubbeni, Gadi a Manase ngibakaamba, kuti chakali chibotu mumeso abo.

Finiyasi mwana wa Eliyaza mupayizi wakati  kubantu ba Lubbeni, Gadi a Manase, ''Sunu twaziba kuti Jehova ulakati kesu, nkambo temwachita echi chileesyo chalusyomo chichitilwa nguwe. Lino mwavuna bantu ba Izilayeli kuzwa kujanza lya Jehova.''

Mpawo Finiyasi mwana wa Eliyaza mupayizi, abendelezi bakaboola kuzwa kuma Lubbenayitisi, aba Gadisi, kuzwa kunyika ya Giliyadi, kubweda kunyika ya Kkenani, kubantu ba Izilayili alimwi wakababozezya ijwi kuli mbabo.

Makani aabo akabota mumeso abantu ba Izilayili. Bantu bakwa Izilatili bakalongezya Leza alimwi tebakazowambula limbi aatala akubusya nkondo kuliba Lubbeni, aba Gadi, kuti banyonyoone nyika oko nkubakali bakkala.
Ba Lubbeni aba Gadi bakazika chipayililo ''Kamboni,'' nkambo bakati mbombukamboni akati kesu kuti Jehova ngu Leza.''
Nikwakayinda mazuba mayingi chiindi Jehova nakamana kupa ba Ia Izilayili kwakutakataazigwa kuli basinkondonyina boonse bazyungukide, alimwi Joshuwa wakili wachembala akuba aamyaka miinji,
Joshuwa wakayita ba Izilayili boonse - bapati abasilutwe ababetesi abeendelezi - akwaamba kuti kulimbabo; "Ime ndachembala alimwi ndaba aamyaka miinji.
Inywe mwabona zintu zyoonse Jehova Leza wanu nzyakachitila ndinywe nkaambo Jehova Leza wanu nguwakamulwanina.
Boona! ndamwaambila eezi zisi zisyeede kuti muzizulide mbuli lukono lwanu amukowa wanu ooyo kuzwa ku Jodani, amisyobo yoonse njindanyonyoona, mane kusikila kulwizi lupati lwakumbo.
Jehova Leza wanu uyoobatandila aanze. Uyoobabagusya kuzwa kuli ndinywe. Uyoobweza nyika yabo, akubweza buvubi bwanyika yabo, mbuli mbakamusyomezya Leza wanu.
Nkaako aamuliyumye loko, kuti mujatisye akuchita zyoonse zilembedwe mubbuku lyamulawu wa Mozesi, mutaleyi kuzwa kuli nzizyo, nikuba kululyo nikuba kulumwensi,
kuti mutavwelaani aamisyobo eeyi isyeede, mutavwelaani aayo pe. Mutaambi mazina aamizimu yabo, nikuba kunkezya njiyo, nikuba kwiivundamina nikuba kubafugamina.
Pesi, aamukakatile kuli Jehova Leza wanu, mbubonya mbumwakachita mubuzuba bwasunu.
Nkaambo Jehova wamutandila misyobo mipati iili aanguzu. Anukuti nywe nubeni, taakwe muntu naba omwe wakayimikila chakumulwisya akusikila sunu.
Kufumbwa uumwi muntu wamweelwe wanu uyoochita kuti chuulu kuti chikachije nkaambo kakuti Jehova Leza wanu nguumulwanina, mbubonya mbwakamusyomezya.
Amuchenjele loko, kuti muyande Jehova Leza wanu.
Pesi na mwabweeda musule akukakatila kumisyobo eeyi isyeede njimukkede aayo nikuba kukwatana aayo, nikuba aambabo abalabo aandinywe,

eelyo muyooziba kuti Jehova Leza wanu takwe kuyoobatanda limbi bantu bamisyobo eeyi kuzwa aakati kanu. Pesi, bayoomubeda kakole achigeche, chiyasyo chamumabazu aanu, amaamvwa amumeso aanu, mane mukamaninine munyika eeyi mbotu kuti Jehova Leza wanu njakamupa.

Lino mebo ndobweenda aanzila njibayinkaayo bantu boonse, alimwi muliizi amyoyo yanu yoonse amiyeeyo yanu yoonse kuti taakwe bbala lyakachilwa kuzwidilila kuzwa kuzintu zibotu Jehova Leza wanu nzyakasyomezya aatala aandinywe. Zyoonse biyo zyakachitika, taakwe nichiba chimwi chakawida aansi.

Pesi mbubonya jwi limwi alimwi Jehova Leza wanu ndyakasyomezya kulindinywe lyazulila, alimwi Jehova uyoomuletela zintu zyoonse zibi mane akamunyonyoone kuzwa munyika eeyi mbotu Jehova Leza wanu njamupede.

Uyoochita eechi na mwasotoka chizuminano cha Jehova Leza wanu, nchamulayilila kuti mubamba. Na mwayinka akukomba baleza bambi akubakotamina, eelyo bukali bwa Jehova buyoomubukila, alimwi muyofwambaana kunyonyooka kuzwa munyika mbotu eeyo njakamupa."

Eelyo Joshuwa wakabungania mikowa yoonse ya Izilayeli ku Shechemu alimwi wakiita bapati ba Izilayeli, wakiita basilutwe babo, wakiita babetesi babo abendelezi babo alimwi bakaliswenzya kunembo lya Leza.

Joshuwa wakati kubantu boonse, ''Mbuboobu mbwawamba Jehova, Leza wa Izilayeli, Uti, 'Basikale benu kuchindi chayinda bakalikukkala mutala amulonga Yufuletesi - Tela, wisi wa Abbulahamu a wisi wa Naho - alimwi bakali kukkomba bamwi baleza.
Pele ndakabweza wuso kuzwa mutala a Yufuletesi alimwi ndakamutola munyika ya Kkenani mpawo ndakamupa lunyungu lwiingi kwindila kumwana wakwe Izaka.
Alimwi kuli Izaka ndakapa Jakobo a Isawu. Isawu ndakamupa nyika yachilundu cha Seyili kuti ibeyakwe, pele Jakobo abana bakwe bakaya kunsi ku Ijiputi.
Ndakatuma Mozesi a Aaloni alimwi ndakapenzya bana Ijiputi amapenzi. Musule lyayaya ndakamugwisya.
'Ndakagwisya basikale benu mu Ijiputi, alimwi mwakasika kulwizi. Ba Ijiputi bakabatandania azikkochikala abasikugada mabbiza kuyosika ku Lwizi lwa Matete.

Elyo basikale benu bakayita kuli Jehova, wakabikka mudima akati kanu abana ba Ijiputi. Wakeeta lwizi antomwe kuti lubavumbe. Mwakazibona nzindakachita mu Ijiputi. Mpawo mwakakkala munkanda  kwachiindi chilamfu.
Ndakamweete kunyika yama Amalayiti bakali kukkala kuli limwi bbazu lya Jodani. Bakalwana andinywe mpawo ndakabapeda mumaboko enu. Mwakabweza nyika yabo, mpawo ndakabanyonyoona kunembo lyanu.
Mpawo Bbalaki mwana wa Zipol, mwaami wa Mowabbu, wakanyampuka alimwi wakalwana ba Izilayeli. Wakatuma akwiita Bbalamu mwana wa Bbewo, kuti azomutukile.
Pele Bbalamu tendakamuswilila. Isimpe, isimpe wakamulongezya aboobo ndakamuvuna kuzwa kukuboko kwakwe.

Mwakaya mutala a Jodani mpawo mwakasika ku Jelikko. Bendelezi ba Jelikko bakamulwana kabala ba Amolayiti, ba Peliziti, ba Kkenani, ba Hitayiti, ba Gigasayiti, ba Hivitizi, aba Jebbusayiti. Ndakamupa kuzunda atala lyabo alimwi ndakapeda munsi lyabwendelezi bwenu.
Ndakatumina mamvo kunembo lyenu, mwakabatanda ibami bobile ba Amplayiti kunembo lyanu. Tezyakachitika nkambo kapanga lyanu kana buta bwenu.
Ndakamupa inyika njimwakatabelekela amadolopo ngimwakatayaka alimwi mukkala mulingawo. Mulya michelo yazilili azililizyama Olifa nzimwakatabyala pe.'
Lino mumuyowe Jehova alimwi mumukkombeabwini boonse akusyomeka; mugwisye baleza aabo basikale banu mbibakali kukkomba mutala lya Yufuletisi amu Ijiputi, mukkombe Jehova.

Kuti kazitaluleme kumenso anu kukkomba Jehova, amulisalile mubuzuba obuno ngomutakkombe, kana baleza bakali kukkombwa abasikale benu mutala a Yufuleti, kana baleza bama Amolayiti bamunyika eyi njomukkede. Pele imebo abe ng'anda yangu tulakkomba Jehova.''
Bantu bakasandula alimwi bakati, ''Tatukoyoleka Jehova kuti tukakombe bamwi baleza,

nkambo ngu Jehova Leza wesu wakatweta iswe abasikale besu kuzwa kunyika ya Ijiputi, kuzwa kung'anda yabuzike, alimwi iwakachita zitondezyo zipati kumenso esu, alimwi wakatubamba munzila yonse njitwakeenda alimwi akuzwa kumanyika woonse ngitwakiinda.
Elyo Jehova wakatanda bantu boonse kunembo lyesu, kubikilizya ma Amolayiti bakali kukkala munyika eyi. Aboobo aswebo tuyokkomba Jehova, ngonguwe Leza wesu.''
Pele Joshuwa wakati kubantu, ''tamukonzyi kukkomba Jehova nkambo ngu Leza usalala; ngu Leza sibuzuba; takoyolekelela milandu yenu azibi zyenu.
Kuti mwakkaka Jehova akukkomba baleza benzu elyo uyochengunuka alimwi akamutapatile. Uyomulobya, musule lyakumuchitila bubotu.''
Pele bantu bakati kuli Joshuwa, ''Pepe tulakkomba Jehova.''
Mpawo Joshuwa wakati kubantu, ''Mulibakkamboni lwenu nubeni ikuti mwalisalila Jehova kuti mumukkombe.'' Bakati, ''Tulibakkamboni.''
Lino musowe baleza beenzu mbimulaabo, mpawo mupilusye myoyo yenu kuli Jehova Leza wa Izilayeli.''
Bantu bakati kuli Joshuwa, ''Tuyokkomba Jehova Leza wesu. Tuyoswilila ijwi lyakwe.
Joshuwa wakapanga chizuminano abantu buzuba oobo. Wakabikka mmbeta amilawu ku Shekkemu.
Joshuwa wakalemba makkani aya mubbuku lyamulawu wa Leza. Wakabweza bbwe pati wakalyimika munsi lyamukkotokoto wakali kumbali lyachikombelo cha Jehova.
Joshuwa wakati kubantu boonse, ''Amulange eli ibbwe liyoba kamboni kulindiswe. Lyaamvwa majwi woonse Jehova ngaamba kulindiswe. Aboobo liyooba kkamboni alindinywe kuti mwakukkaka Leza wenu.''
Lino Joshuwa wakabwedezya bantu awumwi kubusena bwakwe.
Musule lyazeezi zintu Joshuwa mwana wa Nuni mulanda wa Jehova, wakafwa, kala minyaka ili 110 yakukkomena.
Bakamuzika mumugaano wabusena mbwakakkonede ku Timatisela inyika yachilundu cha Efulemu kubwiinganyika bwakalundu ka Gashi.
Bana ba Izilayeli bakakkomba Jehova mumazuba woonse a Joshuwa amumazuba abapati bakasyeede nakafwa Joshuwa, abo bakabona zintu zyoonse Jehovanzyakabachitila bana ba Izilayeli.

Mafuwa a Jozefu, bantu ba Izilayeli ndibakazide awo kuzwa ku Ijiputi bakavwikka ku Shekkemu mukampanzi kunyika Jakobo nkakawulide kubana ba Hama, wisi wa Shekkemu. Wakakakawula mwaanda womwe wansiliva, mpawo yakaba lukono lwabana ba Jozefu.
Eliyaza mwana wa Aaloni alakwe wakafwa. Bakamuvwika kuGibbiya, chisis cha Finiyasi mwana wakwe, njaakapedwe. Yakali muzilundu lundu nyika ya Efulemu.
Judi, mulanda wa Jesu Kkilisito amunyina wa Jemusi, kuli baabo bayitidwe, bayandwa muli Leza Taata babikidwe akaambo ka Jesu Kkilisito.
Luse aluumuno aluyando aluvuzigwe kuli ndinywe.
Nibayandwa, kandichili kubika nguzu zyoonse kumulembela aatala alufutuko luzibikene, ndakaba akumulembela nywebo kandimusumpula kuti mukakatile loko lusyomo lwakaabilwa boonse bantu ba Leza basalala.

kuli bakanjila chakusisikana aakati kanu . Aaba mbaalumi bakalitandidwe ankaambo kalubeteko. Mbaalumi batakwe buleza bakasandula luzyalo lwa Lesu wesu akuba azisusi zibi, aabo bakaka simalelo  a Mwami, Jesu Kkilisito.
Lino ndayanda kumuyeezya - nikuba mwakalizi loko - kuti Leza wakafutula bantu kuzwa munyika ya Igiputi pesi aampela wakabamwayisya aabo abakatazunina.
Alubo, baangelo batakwe bakabamba chuuno chabwendelezi, pesi aabo bakasya busena bwabo bulikabotu bwakukkala - Leza wakabamba kuzyaanzyo zitamani, akunjila mumudima, walubeteko lwazuba bupati.
Aboobo, Sodoma a Gomola amadolopo azisi zyengeelede aakati kabo balinjizya beni mumamambi anchinto zyabumambi aabo balabeleka mbuli chitondeezyo chabaabo bapenzengwa aachisubulo chamililo utamani.
Munzila ikozyene aaba basikulota alabo bakasofwaazya mibili yabo. balakaka bwami akusampawula aabo bali aabulemu.
Nikuba alakwe Mayikkelo mwaangelo mupati, nibakali kukazyana a Satani akunyanzyana anguwe munta wa Mozesi, takakonzya kweeta lubeteko aatala anguwe, pesi wati, "Akukalalile Mwami!"
Pesi bantu aaba balasampawula kufumbwa nchibatamvwi; anzibamvwa zyabube buliwo, mbuli banyama batayeeyi, eezi nzenzizyo zyakabamwaya.
Maawe kuli mbabo!" Nkaambo bayeenda munzila ya Kkayini akunjizigwa mukubisya kwa Bbalamu ankaambo kampindu, balafwa mulupapilo lwa Kkola

Aaba bantu mabwe ajeeya kumapobwe aluyando, kupobola andinywe chifwisya bweeme -beembeli balisanina beni. Mayoba atakwe mvula aabwezegwa aaluuwo; misamu yakulwaka itakwe michelo - bafwide tubili banonkwedwe.
Mayuwe ali aabukali amulwizi, akubumba bubi, inyenyeezi ziya bwendeende, babambilidwe kusiya kwamudima mawuse kwalyoonse.
Inoki mwana wamusaanu kuli Adamu, wakasinsima aatala ambabo, wakati, "Bona! Mwami ulasika azyuulu azyuulu zyabasalali bakwe uzosika kuzoopa lubeta kuli boonse.

Uzoosika kuzoopa luteko luli boonse. uyoosika kuzooyumununa zyoonse zitali zyabuleza akumilimu njibakachita munzila ityaliyabuleza akumajwi akumajwim woonse ankondo atakwe aatakwe buleza kuli basizibi nzibaakamba aatala anguwe."
Aaba mbasikunyontooka abasikutongawuka mukutobela zbi zyabo. Milomo yabo ilaambulisya chakulikankayizya, impuwo zyabpo kukasya bamwi.
Pesi nubayandwa amuyeeye majwi akaambwa kuchiindi aba apositoli ba Mwami wesu Jesu Kkilisito.
Bakati kuli ndinywe, "Kuchiindi chakumamanino kuyooba basikunoonga batobela miyeeyo yabo itali yabuleza
."Abaa mbaaba bachita kwanzyanya; mbaasinyika alubo tabakwe muuya.
Pesi nywebo, nobayandwa, amusime lwanu mulusyomo lupati lusalala, akukomba mu Muuya Uusalala.
Amukkale muluyando lwa Leza, akulinda luse lwa Mwami Jesu Kkilisitu weeta buumi butamani.
Amube aaluse kuli baabo batasyomi.
Futula bamwi akubagwisya kuzwa mumulilo. Kuli bamwi amube aaluse lwakuyoowa. Choonzyo nikuba chisamo chasofwazigwa amubili.
Lino kuliyooyo umukasya kuzwa mukuwa amukuchita kuti mwiimikile kunembo lyabulemu bwabuliwo butakwe bubi mbubakwaamba alukondo lupati,
kuli Leza luzutu mufutuli wesu mukwiinda muli Jesu Kkilisito Mwami wesu,akube bulemu, bupati anguzu, abwami, zyiindi zyoonse zyakaliwo, lino akwalyoonse. Amen.
Munzi wakazwide bantu lino wabatongo wabambuli mukamufu, nekuba wakali mupati kuzisi. Wakali namalelo kuzisi, pesi lino waba muzike.
Ulalila chakutyoka mansiku, misozi yakwe ijala maseya aakwe. Tawope kubayandisi bakwe umumbulizya. Benzinyina bonse bakamusowa. Bakaba basinkondonyina.
Musule akufwaba akupenzegwa, Juda yakatolwa mubuzike musule lyakupenzegwa akubelesegwa kapati . Ukkede mukati kazisi pesi tijene kulyokezya pe. Basikumupenzya boonse bamwenzya akati kamafwabi akwe.
Migwagwa ya Ziyoni ilalila nkambo tawope usika kumapobwe abikidwe. Milyango yakwe yoonse yabula bantu. Bapayizi bakwe balangonga. Basimbi bakwe balimukupengana, akuli nguwe kwalula luu.
Basikumupenzya baba basimalelo bakwe; basinkondonyina balokuzwidilila Jehova wamupenzya akuvula kwazibi zyakwe. Bana bakwe batete batolwa mubuzike kunembo lyasikutanda.
Waswekelwa bulemu bwakwe boonse mwana musimbi wa Ziyoni. Basilutwe bakwe baba mbuli insya zyabula machelelo, akwinka kabatakwe manguzu kuli sikubatanda.

Mumazuba akwe akupenzegwa akubula munzi, Jelusalemu uyoyeeya zyonse zibotu nzyakalazyo mumazuba ayinda. Bantu bakwe nibakawida mujanza lyasikubatanda takwepe wakamugwasya. Basinkondonyina nibakamubona bakaseka kunyonyooka kwakwe.
Jelusalemu wakabisya loko, nkinkaako, wakanyansigwa mbuli chintu chisofweede. Bonse ibakali kumulemeka bamubawusya nkambo bakabona chinswe chakwe. ulang'onga akuyanda akuyanda kuchija.
Busofwi bwakwe buli muziwaalo zyakwe. Takayeeya janza lyakwe, kuwa kwakwe kwakali kugambya. Tawope wakamumbuulizya. Wakalila, ''Amulange kupengaana kwangu, Jehova, nkambo sinkondoma walisumpula!''
Sinkondoma wabika janza lyakwe alizyonse zintu zyesu. Wababona bezisi kabanjila abusena bwakwe busalala, nikuba wakali wamba kuti batanjili pe muchikombelo chakwe.
Bantu bakwe boonse bakang'onga kabayanduula chinkwa. Bakapa zipo zyabo kuti bajane kulya kuti bapone. Langa, Jehova, undiyeeye, nkambo ndasampawulwa.
Tachili chintu chigambya, kuli ndinywe nimwinda? Amulange, mpali na upenzegwa mbuli ndime, mbuli  kuti Jehova wandimvwisya machise muzuba bwakunyema kupati.
Wakatuma muulo wakanji akuakuwazunda mafuwa angu kuzwa kujulu.  Wayalila mawulu angu kansabwe akundibwedezya kusule. Wandichita ndabula undigwasya mpawo wandimana manguzu.
Ijokwe lyazibi zyangu zyangiidwe ajanza lyakwe. Zilisuminwe zyasikubikwa mumukosi wangu. Wandibuzya manguzu. Leza wandipedekezya mumanza abo, mpawo nsichikonzyi kwimikila.

Leza watontela kumbali boonse balumi basinguzu bakali kundilwanina. Wandichitila kabunga kandilwanisya kuti azikizye baalumi bangu balamanguzu. Leza walyata nakalindu waku Juda abusena budininwa masansa.
Nkaambo kazezi zintu ndilalila, menso angu alikukkunka misozi; nkambo mumbulizi ulikule ambebo, ooyo ubusilizya buumi bwangu. Bana bangu babulide ubaswaya nkambo sinkondoma wandizunda.
Ziyoni watalamuna maboko akwe; tawope uyanda kumumbulizya. Jehova wambila aabo bakkede munsi lya Jakkobbu kuti babe basinkondonyina. Jelusalemu nchintu chisofweede kulimbabo.
Jelusalemu uliluleme, nkambo ndakakazya milawo yakwe.  Muswilile nobantu bonse, mubone kufwaba kwangu.. Banakalindu abaalumi basinguzu bangu bakinka mubwange.
Ndabiita bayandwi bangu, pesi bandeena, Bapayizi abapati bangu bamana mumunzi kabachiyanduula chakulya kuti bapone.
Ndilange, Jehova nkambo ndapeengana; mwida lyangu mwamyonga, amoyo wangu wakkatazika, nkambo tendakaswilila pe. Aanze, ipanga lilokulizya; mung'anda kuzwide lufu.
Bakuumwa kulila kwangu, pesi tawope undumbulizya. Basinkondoma boonse bamvwa mapenzi angu, alimwi balabotelwa anziwandichitila. Walyeeta izuba ndiwakaambide.
Lino bachite babe mbuli ndime. Bubi bwabo boonse ngabuze kubusyu bwako. Bachite mbuli mbuwakandichitila nkambo kazibi zyangu. Nkwiingi kulila kwangu amooyo wangu wizuuka.
Mwami wavumba mwana musimbi waZiyoni munsi lyajoba lyakunyema kwakwe. Wawaalila lubono lwaIzilayeli aansi kuzwa kujulu. Tayeeya chilyatililo chakwe mubuzuba bwakunyema kwakwe.

Mwami wamena alimwi takwe nakaba aaluzyalo kumadolopo woonse aaJekkobbu. Mumazuba aakunyema kwakwe wakawaalila aansi myuunzi iikwaabililidwe yamwana musimbi waJuda; mukuubula wawaalila aansi bwami abeendelezi bwabo.
Alunyemo lupati wagwisya lwija loonse lwaIzilayeli. Wagwisya jaanza lyakwe lyalulyo kunembo lyasinkondo. Watenta Jekkobbu mbuli mulilo uuyaka uusyukuta zyoonse zyuuzyungulukide.
Mbuli sinkondo, watondeka kanta kakwe kulindiswe, alulyo lwakwe ulilibambilide kuyasa. Wajaya boonse bakali kumubotezya mutente lyamwana musimbi waZiyoni; watulida bukali bwakwe mbuli mulilo.
Mwami waba mbuli sinkondo. Wamena Izilayeli. Wamaena maanda akwe woonse. Wamwayuula zichijilo zyakwe. Wayungizya kulila akoomoka mukati kamwana musimbi waJuda.

Wabukila chikombelo chakwe mbuli ng'anda yachilili. Wamwaya busena busalala bwakuswaananina. Jehova wachia busena busalala bwakuswaananina abuzuba butegwa Sabata kuti bulubinkane muZiyoni, nkaambo wanyansya mwami amupayizi mubukali bwakunyema kwakwe.

Mwami wakaka chipayililo chakwe alimwi waleka chikombelo chakwe chisalala. Wapa malambo aabwami bwakwe mumaanza aasinkondo. Banyampula loompololo mung'anda yaJehova, mbuli mubuzuba busalidwe bwapobwe.

Jehova wayeeya kunyonyoona bulambo bwamwana musimbi waZiyoni. Watandabika kakole kakweela alimwi taakasya jaanza lyakwe kukunyonyoona bulambo. Wachita zichijilo abulambo kuti bulile; antoomwe zyakaloba.

Milyango yakwe yakabbila munyika; wanyonyoona akutyoloola tuponda twamulyango wakwe. Mwami wakwe amwana musimbi wamwami bali aakati kamanyika, mulawu tuuchiwo vpe abasinsimi bakwe tabachijani chilengano kuzwa kuliJehova.
Basilutwe bamwana mulombe waZiyoni balakkala aanyika muluumuno. Babika lusuko aamitwe yabo akuzwaata masaka. banakalindu baJelusalemu bakotamika mitwe yabo aanyika.

Menso angu akatala akaambo kamisozi yabo; tumbu lyangu lilaguluma; zyangu zyamukati zilagwisigilwa aanze akaambo kalunyonyoono  lwamwana musimbi wabantu bangu, bana atunsabila balakatala mumigwagwa yamuunzi.
Baamba kuti  kumanyina, ''Nchili chakulya awayini?'' aawo nibakatala mbuli mwaalumi wachiswa mumigwagwa yamuunzi, mawumi aabo alitilidwe aanze muluyando lwamamama aabo.
Ndilatyeni kulinduwe, mwana musimbi waJelusalemu? Kujana ndakweezyanisya aanyamaanzi, kuti ndikuumbulizye, nakalindu waZiyoni? Chilonda chako nchipati mbuli lwizi. Ngwani ukonzya kukuponia?
Basinsimi bako bakubonena zilengano zyakubeja zyabuyo. Tebayanzaala zibi zyako kuti zyoolwe zyako zikuboolele, pesi bali aakwaamba kulinduwe kwakubeja kusowa.

Boonse biinda munzila balakambilila maboko kulinduwe. Balafota akutikinia mitwe yabo aatala amwana musimbi waJelusalemu akwaamba kuti, ''Ooyu ngumuunzi na ngubakali kuti, 'Kubotezegwa kwaBubotu,' 'Lukondo lwaNyika Yoonse'?''
Boonse basinkondonyokwe balajula milomo yabo aatala anduwe. Balasimbula akuluma ntwino mubunyeme akwaamba kuti, ''Twamumena! Oobu mbuzuba mbutwakali kulindila! Twakakkala kuti tububone!''
Jehova wachita nzyabambide kuti achite. Wazuzikizya jwi lyakwe. Wamuzunda chakutaba aaluzyalo, nkaambo wazumizya sinkondo kuti abotelwe aajulu aandinywe; wanyampulwa lwija lwabasinkondonyokwe.
Moyo wabo wakalilila kuMwami, malambo aamwana musimbi waZiyoni! Misozi yako ngikakunke mbuli mulonga mansiku asikati. Utakalyookezyi pe, menso ako kutalyookezya.

Buka, lila mansiku, kumatalikilo aakati kabo! Tila moyo wako mbuli maanzi kunembo lyabusyu bwaMwami. Nyampula maanza ako kulinguwe akaambo kamawumi aabana bako bafwa nzala muchimpetu chamugwagwa umwi awumwi.''
Bona, Jehova, ulange aabo mbuwachitila munzila eeyi. Sena banakazi kabalya michelo yamatumbu aabo, bana mbibakabamba? Bapayizi abasinsimi bakajayigwe na muchikombelo chaMwami?
Boonse baniini abapati balilede mulusuko lwamumigwagwa. Banakazi abaalumi bangu baniini bajayigwa epanga; wabajaya kotabafwidi nsoni.
Wayita, mbuli mboyita bantu kubuzuba bwapobwe, basinkondoma kulubazu lwangu, mubuzuba bwalunyemo lwaJehova takwe wakanzwenga na kupona; aabo mbindakabamba akulela, sinkondoma wanyonyoona.
Ndime ooyo mwaalumi wakabona makataazyo munsi akaponda kaJehova kakunyema.
Wakanditanda akuchita kuti ndeende mumudima kutali mumuni.
Nchobeni wasandwida kuboko kwakwe akati kangu lubo alubo, izuba lyoonse mbulizulwa.
Wachita nyama yangu achikanda changu kuchembaala; wakatyola mafuwa aangu.
Wakayaka bulambo bwakundilwisya, alimwi wakandizyungulusizya aabukali abuyumi.
Wakandichita  kuti ndikale mumasena aasiya, mbabo bakafwa chiindi.
Wakayaka bulambo bundizyungulukide alimwi nsikonzyi kuchija.
Wakachita macheni aangu kuti aleme  alimwi nikuba boobo ndayita aakulila lugwasyo, wandijalila aanze nkombyo zyangu.
Wajala nzila yangu abulambo amabwe aabezedwe, awachita nzila zyangu zyapilingana.
Ulimbuli bbule uulindide kundiluma, ulavu uuyubide;
Wakapindimuna nzila zyangu, wakandichitila kuba tongo.
Wakavunga buta bwakwe wandiiita mbuli chakuyasa kavwi kakwe.
Wakayasa nsa zyangu akavwi kakwe.
Ndakaba chisesyo kubantu bangu boonse, lwiimbo lwabo lwakundininda izuba lyoonse.
Wakandizuzya misamu iilula akundaangila kunwa mululwe.
Wakachita meno aangu kunyeela a bubwebwe, alimwi wandibumbulusya mudyota.
Muuya wangu luumuno; ndabula kuti kuzwidilila niinzi.
Aboobo nditi, ''bulangilizi bwangu bwamana abulangilizi bwangu muli Jehova.''
Yeeya makataazyo aangu akutuntulika kwangu, mululwe akululilwa.
Ndachiyeeya lyoonse amuuya wangu ulalifwiinsya mulindime.
Pesi ndayeeya alimwi nkaambo ndaabulangilizi:
Luyando lupati lwa Jehova tabumani pe abuuya bwakwe tabumani pe,
Ndupya chifumo choonse; kusyomeka kwako nkupati.
''Jehova ndukono lwangu,'' mbuuwamba muuya wangu, nkabela ndiyoosyoma mulinguwe.
Jehova mubotu kulaabo bamulindila, kumyuuya iimuyanduula.
Nchibotu kulindila chuumunizi kulufutuko lwa Jehova.
Nchibotu kuti mwaalumi ayumye jokwe kubuniini bwakwe.
Mumuleke akkale alike chuumunizi, awo niligwabika aalinguwe.
Ngabike mulomo wakwe mulusuko- amwi kuchinoli bulangilizi.
Ngakape seya lyakwe kulooyo uumuma, alimwi ngakazuzigwe azuule alusampawuko.
Nkaambo Leza tayootukaka kwa lyoonse.
Pesi nikuba wachita machise, uyooba aaluzyalo mukwiindila mukuvula kwaluyando lwakwe lutamani.
Nkaambo takataazyi kuzwa mumoyo wakwe nakombya bana babantu.
Kuvwinyuuna amawulu baange boonse bamunyika,
kukasya muntu nzyeelede kunembo lyamupati kampatila,
kukasya muntu nzyeelede kukubetekwa kunkuta- mwaami takouoozuminana azintu zyamusyobo ooyo! Na Leza taazizumizya?
Ngwani waambula alimwi zichitike, ado kuti mwaami wazyaamba?
Tazizwi mumulomo wamupati kampatila na ezyo mapenzi azibotu?
Muntu muumi ulatongawuka biyeni? muntu ulatongawuka biyeni aatala achisubulo chazibi zyakwe?
Ngatulingule nzila zyesu, alimwi tubweede kuli Jehova.
Atunyampule myoyo yesu amaboko eesu kuli Leza uuli kumajulu:
Twakabisya akupapa.
Mwalivumba akunyema akututobela, wajaya alimwi taakwe nchasiya.
Walijala ajoba kuchitila kuti kutabi nkombyo iiyinda.
Watuchita mbuuli makololo atombe alimwi watuchita mbuuuli tombe akati kabantu.
Boonse basinkondoma batutuka,
Buyoofu adindi bwatusikila, kunyonyona akujaya.
Menso aangu akunka milonga yaamisozi nkaambo kakunyonyonwa kwabantu bantu.
Menso aangu alazwa misozi nkaataleki, kakutakwe lugwasyo,
mane Jehova kujulu alange aansi abone.
Menso aangu ayeta kuusa kumoyo wangu nkaambo kabana bangu basimbi boonse mudolopo.
Ndalikuvwimwa mbuuli muyuni abaabo bakali basinkondoma; bakalikundivwima kaatakwe kambo.
Bakadyunkula buumi bwangu mudindi,
