alimwi bakawaala bbwe aalindime, alimwi bakaachita maanzi afwasuuka, avumba mutwe wangu. Ndakati, 'Ndakadyunkulwa!'
Ndakiita muzina lyako, Jehova, kandili mudindi damfu.
Wakamvwa jwi lyangu mpundakati, 'utajali kutwi kwako kukulila kwangu lugwasyo.'
Wakaza aafwifwi mubuzuba mpindakakwiita kulinduwe; Wakati, ''utayoowi.'
Mwaami, wakalwanina kaambo kamoyo wangu, wavuna buumi bwangu!
Jehova, wabona babi mbubakachita kulindime; Beteka kambo kangu.
Wabona kubweedezya nkoto kwabo, zyoonse nzibabamba kundilwisya.
Wakamvwa kutukila kwabo,Jehova, alimwi zyoonse nzibabamba tala andime.
Milomo amiyeeyo yabasinkondoma ilaza kundilwisya buzuba boonse.
Langa mbubakkala alimwi mbubabuka; balandininda anyimbo zyabo.
Bweedezya kulimbabo zibeelede,Jehova,kwiindila muzichita zyamaboko aabo.
Uyoochita myoyo yabo kutawusa lutuko lwako lube aatala lyabo!
Batobele mukunyema akubanyonyona kuzwa kunsi lya Julu, jehova!''
Ingolida yakabisigwa; ingolide isalala mbiyakasanduka! mabwe asalala alisowedwe achoko chamigwagwa woonse.
Bana balombe babotu  ba ziyoni bakeelede bulemu bwabo mungolide isalala, pesi lino balangika mbuuli nkomeki zyabulongo, mullimu wamaboko amubumbi!
Tanzya bawunpe balanyonsya bana babo, pesi bana basimbi babantu bangu baba aamoyo mubi, mbuuli mpoo zili muchimpayumu.
Lulimi lwamwana uunyonka lulanamatila kubwaasa bwamulomo wakwenkaambo kanyota, bana balakkumbila chakulya, pesi tachiwo.
Abo bakabide kulya zinono lino baleezukide mumigwagwa. Abo bakakkomena kabazwaata zizwaato lino bacha kulala mumalwi amadota.
Chisubulo chamwana musimbi wabantu bangu mbupati kwiinda chibi chasodomu, chakanyonyonwa mukiindi kanini alimwi taakwe maboko aakaguma aalinguwe pe.
Bazuluzi bakwe bakalisalede kwiinda sikunkwe,kutubisya kwiinda malili; mibili yabo yakali kusalalisya kwiinda mabwe, bube bwabo bwakali mbuuli Safila.
Lino chiwa chabo kwasiya kwiinda muye; tabachilemekwipe mumigwagwa. Zikkumba zyabo zyakanamatila aamafuwa aabo; zyayuminina mbuuli nkuni.
Abo bakajayigwa apanga balimbubo mbubo kwiinda aabo bakajayigwa anzala, banyana, bayaswa akookubula zilyo zyamumuunda.
Maboko aabanakazi bawuya akajika  bana babo; bakaba chakulya chabo muchiindi eecho mwana  muimbi wabantu bangu bakali kunyonyonwa.
Jehova wakatondeezya bukkali bwakwe boonse; wakatulida kunyema kwakwe kuyoosya. Wakayasya mulilo mu Ziyoni wasyukuta ntalisyo zyakwe.
Baami banyika taakwe nibakasyoma pe, nikuba bantu bamunyika takwe wakasyoma pe, kuti wajana basinkondonyina balanjilana kumulyango we Jelusalema.
Ezi zyakachitika nkaambo kazibi zyabasinsimi bakweazibi zyabapayii bakwe  abo bakatila bulowa bwabalulami akati kakwe.
Bakatuntulika, boofu, mumigwagwa.Bakali sofweede loko abulowa bwakuti takwe wakalikukonzya kuguma zizwaato zyabo.
''Oko! noosofweede!'' bantu bakalilila. ''oko! oko! utagumi! mpawo bakatuntulika; Bantu bakati kumanyika, ''Tabachizokkali mumo limbi pe.''
Jehova lwakwe wakabamwaya; Tokoyobalanga limbi pe. Tebakalemeka Bapayizi, alimwi tebakatondeezya kulemeka bapati.
Menso esu akachilwa, kulangilila lugwasyo chabuyo; kuzwa kumalambo eesutwakalikulangilila kuchisi chakatalikukonzya kutuvuna.
Bakatobela ntaamo zyesu, kuti tutakonzyi kweenda mumigwagwa yesu. Mamanino esu akali abaafwifwi amazuba eesu aya kumamanino, mamanino eesu asika.
Basikututobela besu balaaluno kwiinda chuungwe wakujulu. Bakatwaandila kuzilundu akutulinda munkanda
kuyoya kwamumpemo zyesu-bananikidwe ba Jehova-nguwe wakajiswi mumalindi aabo; eezyo mbuuli mbuzyakaambidwe, ''munsi lyamweenzule tuyoopona akati kazisi.''
Botelwa akukondwa, mwana musimbi wa Edomu, iwe nookkala munyika ya Uzi. Pesi akulinduwe nkomeki iyoosika; unookoledwe akuligwisya zizwaato kuba maya.
Mwana musimbi wa Ziyoni; Chisubulo chako chiyoomana; takoyooyungizya buzike bwako pe. Pesi mwana musimbi wa Edomu, uyo chisubulo kukubisya kwenu; uyooyubununa zibi zyenu.
Yeya,Jehova, ninzi zyakachika kulindiswe; Langa akubona mbotusampawulwa.
Lukkono lwesu lwakapegwa benzu; Ng'anda zyesu kubazwakule.
Twakaba bamuchala, batakwe wisi, amamama esu alimbuli bamukabafu.
Twelede kubbadala ansiliva kumanzi  ngitunwa; alimwi twelede kubhadala ansiliva kuti tujane nkuni zyesu.
Abo bayotutobela balafwifwi musule andiswe, twakatala alimwi tatujani kulyokezya pe.
Twalipeda ku Igipiti aku Asiliya kuti tujane chakulya chiingi.
Bama taata esu bakabisya, alimwi tabachiwo, alimwi tulemenywa milandu yabo.
Bazike balikutwendelezya, alimwi takwe ukonzya kutuvuna mumanza abo.
Tujana chinkwa chesu luzutu kuti twapeda mawumi esu, nkambo kapango lilimunkanda.
Chikanda chesu chakomena mbuli muchiko chipya nkambo kakupya kwanzala.
Banakazi bakasofwazigwa mu Ziyoni; alimwi banakalindu bamuchisi cha Juda.
Baana balombe babami bakalikwanzikwa amaboko abo; alimwi takwe nibakatondezya kulemeka pe bapati.
Balumi banini, bakali kwangilwa kuziya amaziyo, aabalombe balemenwa inkuni.
I bapati bazwa amulyaango wadolopo, alimwi balumi banini basiya ntuntimba twabo.
Lukondo lwamoyo yesu lwakamana alimwi kuzyana kwesu kwabakulila.
Musini wazwa mumutwe wesu; mawe kulindiswe; nkaambo twabisya !
Nkaambo kazintu ezi moyo yesu yakachiswa,  nkaambo kazezi meso esu tachibonesyi pe.
Kambo Chilundu cha Ziyoni chaba matongo, bamwaaba balendenda mulinchicho.
Pesi webo, Jehova, ulendelezya kwalyoonse, alimwi uyokkala achuno chabwami kumazyalane woonse.
Nkaambonzi niwatuluba kwalyoonse? Nkambonzi nutusowa kwaachindi chilamfu mumazuba ako?
Tubozye kulinduwe, Jehova, alimwi tulabozegwa. Bukulusya mazuba esu mbuli mbakabede chiindi-
ado kuti watutakata alimwi ulitunyemenede zyindilide.
Jehova wakayita kuli Mozesi alimwi wakaambula kulinguwe kuzwa mutente lyakuswaanana, wakati,

''Ambuula kubantu ba Izilayeli alimwi ubaambile, 'Eelyo kufumbwa mwaalumi kuzwa aakati kenu weeta chipayizyo kuli Jehova, eta mbuli chipayizyo chako munyama, nikuba kuzwa kutanga lyen'ommbe nikuba kulungundu lwambelele

Na chipayizyo chakwe kachili chipayizyo chakutentwa kuzwa ku tanga, weelede kupa n'enze itakwe kampenda pe. Uleelede kupa aamulyango watente lyakuswaanana, kuchitila kuti ikatambulwe kunembo lya Jehova.
Uleelede kulowampa lubono lwakwe amutwe wachipayizyo chakutentwa, alimwi mpawo chiyootambulwa kachiimvwilidi nguwe kukuchita kubukulusigwa kwakwe mwini.
Mpawo uleelede kujaya mupule kunembo lya Jehova. Bana baombe ba Aloni, bapayizi, bayoopa igazi aloimwi lisansiilwe achipayililo eecho chili amulyango watente lyakuswanana.
Mpawo uleelede kufunda chipayizyo chakutentwa alimwi achinenge zibe zituli.
Mpawo bana balombe ba Aloni bayookutula mulilo aachipayililo alimwi babambe inkuni zili amulilo.
Mpawo bana balomba ba Aloni, bapayizi, bayoobika zituli, kuswaanizya mutwe amafuta, aankuni zili amulilo ooyo uli achipayililo.

Pesi zyamukati amawulu aacho weelede kuzisanzya amanzi. Mpawo mupayizi uyootenta zyoonse zili achipayililo mbuli chipayizyo chipayizyo chakutentwa. Chiyoogwisya bweema bununkilila kuli ndime; chinoli nchipayizyo chachitilwa ndime amulilo.
Na chipayizyo chakwe chachipayizyo chakutentwa kachizwa kulungundu, imwi yambelele na imwi yampongo, weelede kupa keenze katakwe kampenda.
Uleelede kuyookajayila kulubazu lwa kumusanza kwachipayililo kunembo lya Jehova. Bana balombe ba Aloni, bapayizi, bayoosansiila gazi lyako kumabazu woonse achipayililo.
Uleelede kukanenga kabe zituli aamwi amutwe alimwi amafuta aako, alimwi mupayizi uleelede kubika zituli aankuni zili amulilo ooyo uli achipayililo,

pesi zyamukati alimwi amawulu uleelede kuzisanzya amanzi. Mpawo mupayizi uyoopalila koonse, alimwi akatente achipayililo. Nchipayizyo chakutentwa, alimwi chiyogwisya bweema bunubkilila kuli Jehova; chinoli nchipayizyo chachitilwa nguwe amulilo.
Na chipayizyo chakwe kuli Jehova kuti chibe chipayizyo chakutentwa chabayuni, mpawo uleelede kweeta mbuli chipayizyo nikuba nziba na mwana wankwilimba.
Imupayizi uleelede kucheeta kuchipayililo, agwisye mutwe wacho, alimwi achitente achipayililo. Mpawo igazi lyacho lyeelede kuyogwisigilwa kumbali lya chipayililo.
Uleelede kugwisya chiyangilo azili mulinchicho, alimwi akuchisowela kumbali lyachipayililo kulubazu lwa kujwe, kubusena bwadota.

Uleelede kuyoyidelula ijulike amababa aayo, pesi tayelede kwiwanzanya pe kuti ibe zipanzi zibili. Mpawo mupayizi uyoyitenta achipayililo, aankuni eezyo zili amulilo. Iyooba chipayizyo chakutentwa, alimwi iyogwisya bweema bununkilila kuli Jehova; iyooba chipayizyo chachitilwa nguwe amulilo.
Eelyo umwi ayeta chipayizyo chazilyo kuli Jehova, chipayizyo chakwe cheelede kuba busus bunante bwa bbale, alimwi uyotila mafuta alimbubo akubika tununkilizyo alimbubo.

Uyotola chipayizyo kubana balombe ba Aloni bapayizi, alimwi ooko mupayizi uyogwisya busu bunante bwa bbale buzuzya jaanza buli aamafuta atununkilizyo alimbubo. Mpawo mupayizi uyootenta chipayizyo aachipayililo mbuli chipayizyo chiiminini. Chiyogwisya bweema bununkilila kuli Jehova; chinoli nchipayizyo chachitilwa nguwe amulilo.
Kufumbwa chiyoosyala chachipayizyo chazilyo chiyooba cha Aloni abana bakwe balombe. Chilasalalisya kuli Jehova kuzwa kuzipayizyo kuli Jehova zyachitwa amulilo.

Eelyo waakupa chipayizyo chazilyo chitakwe busweezyo bwayokwa muchikko, cheelede kuba chibunge chiteteete chabusu bunante bwa bbale bwaswanizigwa amafuta, nikuba chibunge chiyumu chitakwe busweezyo, chinanikidwe mafuta.
Na chipayizyo chako chazilyo chayokelwa muchiyokelo chabutale chisalebete, cheelede kuba cha busu bunante bwa bbale butakwe busweezyo bwaswanizigwa amafuta.
Uleelede kuchikkwamuuna muzipanzi alimwi utulide mafuta alinchicho. Eechi nchipayizyo chazilyo.
Na chipayizyo chako chazilyo chilijikidwe muchijikilo, cheelede kachichitidwe abusu bunantde bwa bbale a mafuta.
Uleelede kweeta chipayizyo chazilyo kuli Jehova chichitidwe kuzwa kuzintu eezi, alimwi chiyoopedekezegwa ku mupayizi, ooyo utakacheete ku chipayililo.

Mpawo mupayizi uyobweza zimwi kuzwa ku chipayizyo chazilyo mbuli chipayizyo chiiminini, alimwi uyoochitenta achipayililo. Chinoli nchipayizyo chichitidwe amulilo, alimwi chiyogwisya bweema bununkilila kuli Jehova.
Chiyoosyaala ku chipayizyo chazilyo chiyooba cha Aloni abana bakwe balombe. Chilasalalisya kuli Jehova kuzwa kuzipayizyo kuli Jehova zyachitwa amulilo.
Takwe chipayizyo chazilyo nchoyoopa kuli Jehova chiyochitwa abusweezyo, nkaambo towelede kutenta busweezyo, nikuba buchi, mbuli chipayizyo chachitwa amulilo kuli Jehovaa.
Uyoozipa kuli Jehova mbuli zipayizyo zya michelo mitanzi, pesi tazikoyoobelesegwa kukugwisya bweema bununkilila pe achipayililo.

Uleelede kulunga chimwi achimwi chazipayizyo zyako zyazilyo amwinyo. Towelede pe kuzumizya mwinyo wachizuminano cha Leza wako kuti ukabulike kuzipayizyo zyako zyazilyo. Azipayizyo zyako zyoonse uleelede kupa mwinyo.
Na wapa chipayizyo chazilyo chamichelo mitanzi kuli Jehova, pa zilyo zipya ziyokedwe aamulilo alimwi zyaziigwa kuba busu.
Mpawo uleelede kubika mafuta atununkilizyo alimbubo. Eechi nchipayizyo chazilyo.
Mpawo mupayizi uyootenta chipanzi chazilyo zyaziigwa a mafuta a tununkilizyo mbuki chipayizyo chiiminini. Eechi  nchipayizyo chachitwa amulilo kuli Jehova.
Na umwi wayeta chipayizyo kachili chipayizyo chabulyidilano cha munyama kuzwa kutanga, nikuba n'enze na mpwizi, uleelede kupa munyama utakwe kampenda kunembo lya Jehova.
Uyoobika luboko lwakwe aatala amutwe wa chipayizyo chakwe alimwi akachijaye kumulyango watente lyakuswaanana. Mpawo bana balombe ba Aloni bapayizi bayosansila gazi kumabazu a chipayililo.
Mwaalumi uyopa chipayizyo chachipayizyo chabulyidilano amulilo kuli Jehova. Mafuta aajala na aanamatide kuzizo zyamukati,
alimwi a nsa zyobile amafuta aazyo aabambene achibuno, a chipanzi cha chini, aantomwe a nsa - uyoogwisya zyoonse eezi.

Bana balombe ba Aloni bayootenta aatala achipayililo aamwi achipayizyo chakutentwa, chili aankuni zili amulilo. Eezi ziyoopa bweema bununkilila kuli Jehova; chiyooba chipayizyo chichitidwe kuli nguwe amulilo.
Na chamwaalumi chipayizyo chachipayizyo chabulyidilano kuli Jehova kachili chizwa ku lungundu; indyalumi na mpwizi, weelede kweeta chipayizyo chitakwe kampenda.
Na kapa mbelele kuchipayizyo chakwe, mpawo weelede kupa kunembo lya Jehova.
Uyoobika luboko aatala aamutwe wachipayizyo chakwe akwiijaya kunembo lyatente lyakuswaanana. Mpawo bana balombe ba Aloni bakasansiile gazi kumabazu aachipayililo.

Mwaalumi uyoopa chipayizyo chazipayizyo zyabulyidilano kachili chipayizyo chichitidwe amulilo kuli Jehova. Mafuta, muchila uneneede udyunkwidwe aafwifwi amusana, amafuta aajala zizo zyamukati a woonse mafuta ali aafwifwi azizo zyamukati,
a nsa zibili amafuta aazyo, ali muchibuno, achipanzi chachini, aamwi a nsa - uleelede kugwisya zyoonse.
Mpawo mupayizi uyochitenta a chipayililo mbuli chipayizyo chakutentwa chakulya kuli Jehova.
Na chipayizyo cha mwaalumi kayili mpongo, mpawo uyoyipa kunembo lya Jehova.
Uleelede kubika luboko lwakwe aamutwe wampongo alimwi akijaye kunembo lyatente lyakuswaanana. Mpawo bana balombe ba Aloni bakasansiile gazi lyayo kumabazu achipayililo.
Mwaalumi uyoopa chipayizyo chakwe chichidwe amulilo kuli Jehova. Uyoogwisya mafuta aajalide zizo zyamukati, a woonse mafuta ali aafwifwi azizo zyamukati.
Uyoogwisya alubo insa zibili amafuta alaalinzizyo, ali muchibuno, achipanzi chachini aamwi a nsa.
Mupayizi uyootenta zyoonse achipayililo kachili chipayizyo chakutentwa chakulya, kuti zyeete bweema bununkilila. Woonse mafuta azwa kuli Jehova.
Chiyooba chipona kwalyoonse chamulawukwiindila mumazyalane abantu bako mubusena boonse nkuyooyaka munzi, kuti utakalyi mafuta na gazi.'''
Yawe wakaambula a Mozesi, wakati,

''Wambila bantu bakwa Izilayeli, 'Eelyo umwi nabisya katayandide kuti abisye, mukuchita kufumbwa zintu eezyo Yawe nzyakalayilila kuti zitanoochitwi, alimwi na wachita chintu eecho chikasigwa, zitobela zyeelede kuchitwa.
Na kakuli kuti mupayizi mupati wabisya mukweeta bubi kubantu bakwe, mpawo ngakapede kuchibi chakwe nchakachita ikapule kachili kanini katakwe kampenda kuli Yawe mbuli muliiyo wechibi.
Weelede kweeta sipule kumulyango wedumba lyembungano kunembo lya Yawe, abike maanza akwe amutwe wasipule, alimwi akajaye sipule kunembo lya Yawe.
Mupayizi munanike uyoobweza bumwi bulowa bwa sipule akubutola kudumba lyakubunganina.
Mupayizi uyoobbizya munwe wakwe mubulowa akusansila bumwi bulowa musanu atubili kunembo lya Yawe, kunembo lyamulembo wachisitilizyo chabusena busalalisya.

Mpawo mupayizi uyobika bumwi bulowa aameja a chipayililo chatununkilizyo kunembo lya Yawe, ichili mudumba lyakubunganina, alimwi uyotila bumwi boonse bulowa a chikkalilo chachipayizyo chazipayizyo zitentwa, eechi chili amulyango wadumba lyakubunganina.
Uyoogonkola inyama yoonse yasipule wachitulo chazibi; imafuta ayo avumba nyama yamukati, luvumbula lwamafuta loonse ilujisini azyamukati,
insa zyobile aluvumbula luli alinzizyo, zibambene a lulyang'anga, aantomwe aluvumbula lwachini, aantomwe ensa - akazigonke zyoonse eezi.
Uyoyinenga yoonse, mbuli mbwayinenga kuyigisya kuli sipule wachipayizyo chachituzyo chalumuno. Mpawo mupayizi uyozitente zipanzi eezi achipayililo kazili zipayizyo zyakutenta.
Ichitobo chapule alimwi ayimwi nyama yasyala, aantomwe amutwe wayo alimwi amawulu aayo azyamukati alimwi abufumba,

ayimwi yoonse nyama yapule - ngakabweze eeyi yoonse  akwitola aanze ambungano akwitola kubusena oobo mbobakasalazizya ndime, ooko nkobasowela mulota; bayotenta nyama isyede ankuni. Beelede kuyotenta nyama isyede eeyo ooko kusowelwa mulota kuchaala.
Na imbungano yoonse ya Izilayeli yabisya kitayandide kubisya, alimwi imbungano kitazi kuti babisya akuchita zintu eezyo Yawe nzyakalayilila kuti zitachitwi, alimwi na balimvwa mulandu,
mpawo, eelyo chibi nchibakachita chazibinkana, mpawo mbungano yoonse yeelede kuyopa chituzyo chapule munini wachituzyo chachibi kunembo lya dumba lyakubunganina.
Bapati bembungano bayobika maboko amutwe wapule kunembo lya Yawe, alimwi pule uyojayigwa kunembo lya Yawe.
Mupayizi munanike uyoyeta bumwi bulowa bwapule kudumba lyembungano,
alimwi mupayizi uyoobbizya munwe wakwe mubulowa akuyoolisansila musanu atubili kunembo lya Yawe, kunembo lya chisitikizyo.

Uyobika bumwi bulowa ameja achipayililo eecho chili kunembo lya Yawe, eecho chili mukati kedumba lyakubunganina, alimwi uyotila boonse bumwi bulowa etako lyachipayililo chazituzyo zyakutentwa, eecho chili amulyango wadumba lyembungano.
Uyonenga akugwisya mafuta kuzwa kulinchicho akuyochitenta achipayililo.
Eezyo nzenzizyo nzyayelede kuchita apule. Mbubonya mbuli mbwakachita apule utililwa zibi, mbombubo mbwayelede kuyochitila pule oyu, alimwi mupayizi uyopa chituuzyo cha bantu, alimwi bayolekelelwa.
Uyobweza pule akumugwisya anze kwembungano akuyomutenta mbuli mbwakatenta pule mutaanzi. Eechi nchechituuzyo chazibi zyembungano.
Na muzuluzi wabisya katakwe chilangilizyo chakubisya, mukuchita kufumbwa chezintu Leza wakwe nzyakakasya kuti zitanoochitwi,
alimwi uli azibi, mpawo chibi chakwe nchakachita chazibisigwa kuli nguwe, uleelede kulyeetela mpongo yachipayizyo, pule utakwe kampenda.
Uyobika kuboko kwakwe amutwe wampongo akwiijana abusena aawo mpubajiila zituzyo zitentwa kunembo lya Yawe. Eechi chinoli nchituuzyo chezibi.
Mpawo mupayizi uyootola bulowa bwachituuzo amunwe wakwe akuyobubika aameja a chipayililo chazituuzyo zitentwa, alimwi uyootila aanze bulowa eethako lya chipayililo chazituzyo zitentwa.
Uyotenta mafuta woonse  achipayililo, mbubonya mbuli mafuta aachipayililo chazituuzyo zya luumuno. Mupayizi uyoobamba chituuzyo chamuzuluzi katulangene ezibi zyakwe, alubo mweendelezi uyoolekelelwa.
Na umwi wabantu biyo wabisya katakwe chilangilisyo chakubisya, mukuchita kufumbwa chazintu eezyo Yawe nzyaakamulayila kuti atachiti, alimwi aawo nazootilimuka akulimvwa mulandu,
mpawo chibi chakwe nchakachita chazibinkana, mpawo weelede kuyoyeta mpongo yachipayizyo chakwe, mpwizi itakwe kampenda, kayili yachibi nchakachita.
Uyoobika maboko aakwe ajulu lya chituuzyo akujaya chituuzyo chazibi abusena bwazituuzyo zyakutentwa.
Mupayizi uyoobweza bumwi bulowa amunwe wakwe akuyobika ameja achipayililo chazituuzyo zitentwa. Uyotila anze obo bumwi boonse bulowa bwasyaala eetako lya chipayililo.

(03) @LEV 8:2	<p-n>@Levitikkasi 8:2</p-n>	''Bweza Aloni abana bakwe balombe, zyakusama amafuta akunanika mupule wachipayizyo chazibi, abagutu bambelelebabili alimwi achisuwo chazibunge chitakwe busweezyo. 
(03) @LEV 8:3	<p-n>@Levitikkasi 8:3</p-n>	Bungania imbungano yoonse kumulyango wakubunganina.
Mpawo Mozesi wakachita ezyo Yahuwe nzyakamulayilila, alubo mbungano yakabungana aamwi kumulyango watente lyakubunganina.
Mpawo Mozesi wakati kumbungano, "Eechi nchicho Yahuwe nchalayilila kuti chichitwe."
Mozesi wakeeta Aloni abana bakwe balombe akubasanzya amanzi.
Wakazwatika Aloni chigogo akumwanga lukumba muchibuno chakwe, wakamuzwatika antambo akubika efodi alinguwe, wakamwangila efodi alinguwe ili alutambo lweebeka ndwakanzya aalinguwe muchibuno.
Wakabikka sami lyakaango aali nguwe, alimwi musami lyakaango wakabikka Ulimu a Tumimu.
Wakamuzwatika chitambala amutwe, alimwi achitambala, kunembo aacho, wakabika mbede yangolida, musini usalala, mbuli Yahuwe mbakali wamulayilila.
Mozesi wakabweza mafuta akunanika, wananika chikombelo azyoonse zyakali mumo akuzipeda kuli Yahuwe.
Wakasansila mafuta akunanika aachipayililo kwazyiindi zili musanu azibili akunanika chipayililo azyoonse zibelesyo zyacho, achisambilo atako lyacho kuti azibambile Yahuwe.
Wakatila amwi mafuta akunanika aamutwe waAloni akumunanika kuti amusalazye.
Mozesi wakeeta bana balombe ba Aloni akubazwatika zizwato. Wakabaanga mulembo kumitwe yabo mbuli Yahuwe mbakamulayililde.
Mozesi wakeeta mupule wakupayizya chibi, alubo Aloni abana bakwe balombe bakabikka maboko aabo aamutwe wasipule ooyo ngubakeetede mbuli chipayizyo chachibi.
Wakamujaya, mpwo wabweza bulowa wabubikka ameja aachipayililo amunwe wakwe, wasalazya chipayililo, wakatila bulowa aatako lyachipayililo akuchisala kuli Leza kuchitila kuti kube bumwi mulinchicho.
Wakabweza mafuta woonse aayo akali mukati, mwakaputidwe chini, ansa zibili amafuta aazyo, alubo Mozesi wakazitenta achipayililo.
Pesi, pule achitobo, anyama yakwe, amafumba wakazitentela aanze aalubuwa, mbuli Yahuwe mbakali wamulayilila.
Mozesi wakimikizya mugutu wambelele kuti chibe chipayizyo chakumpa, alubo Aloni abana bakwe balombe bakabikka maboko aabo aamutwe wamugutu wambelele.
Wakamujaya akusansila bulowa bwakwe kumabazu woonse achipayililo.
Wakanenguula mugutu wambelele waba zikkata zikkata, alimwi wakatenta mutwe azikkata amafuta.

Wakasanzya zyamukkati ansumba amaanzi, alimwi wakatenta mugutu wambelele woonse aachipayililo. Chakali chipayililo chitentedwe chakali abwema bubotu bwa aloma, chituzyo chakachitwa aamulilo kuli Yahuwe mbuli Yahuwe mbakalayilide Mozesi.
Eelyo Mozesi wakatola umbi mugutu wambelele, mugutu wakusalazya, alimwi Aloni abana bakwe balombe bakabikka maboko aabo amutwe wamugutu wambelele.
Aloni wawukajaya, alimwi Mozesi wakabweza bumwi bulowa, akububikka kumpela akutwi kwa Aloni kwakuchilisyo, akulambika kuchaala chakuboko kwachilisyo chakwe, akuchala chipati chakukuulu kwakwe.

Wakeeta bana baAloni balombe, wakabikka bulowa bumwi kumpela kwamatwi aabo akuchilisyo, akuchala chipati chakukuulu kwabo kwakuchilisyo.  Mpawo Mozesi wakasansila bulowa kumabazu woonse aachipayililo.
Wakabweza  mafuta, mafuta amuchila, awoonse mafuta aayo akaali mukati, akasiside chini, insa zibili amafuta aazyo achibelo chakuchilisyo.

Muchisuwo chazibunge chitakwe busweezyo eecho kunembo lya Yahuwe, wakabweza chibunge chimwi chitakwe buswezyo, achimwi chibunge chakananikidwe mafuta, amweendo, akuzibikka aamafuta aachibelo chakuchilisyo.
wakazibikka zyoonse mumaboko aaAloni amumaboko abana balombe ba Aloni akuzivukuzya kunembo lya Yahuwe mbuli chipayizyo chakuvukuzya.

Mpawo Mozesi wakazibweza kuzwa kumaboko aabo akuzitenta achipayililo mbuli chipayizyo chakuumpa. Zyakali zyakupayizigwa zyakagwisya bweema bununka kabotu bwa Aloma. Chakali chipayizyo chakachitwa amulilo kuli Yahuwe.
Mozesi wakabweza katiti akukavukuuzya mbuli chituzyo chakuvukuuzya kuli Yahuwe. Chakali chaabilo cha Mozesi chamugutu wambelele kunanikwa kwamupayizi, mbuli Yahuwe mbakamulayilide.

Mozesi wakabweza amwi mafuta aakunanika abulowa bwakali achupayililo; wakasansila eezi ali Aloni, azizwato zyakwe, abana bakwe balombe, azizwato zyabana bakwe anguwe. Muli eyi nzila wakatula Aloni azizwato zwakwe, abana azizwato zyabo kuli Yahuwe.

Eelyo Mozesi wakati kuli Aloni abana bakwe, "Bizya nyama kumulyango watente lyakubunganina, akulya chibunge chili muchisuwo chakusalazigwa, mbuli mbundakulayilila, kuti, Aloni abana bakwe balombe bayozilya.
Kufumbwa eecho chichaala kunyama na kuchibunge welede kuzitenta.
Twelede pe kuzwa aanze amulyango wakunjilila kwamazuba aali musanu aabili, kusikila kumazuba akunanikwa kwako akazuzikizigwe. Nkambo Leza ulakusalazya kwazyiindi zili musanu azibili.
Eecho chachtwa zuba eeli - Yahuwe wakachilayilia kuti chichitwe kuti kuchitwe bumwi kulinduwe.
Uyokkala sikati amansiku kwazyiindi zili musanu azibili kumulyango wakuswanana, akubamba imbeta zya Yahuwe, kuti atafwi, nkambo eezi nzindakalayilwa."
Eelyo Aloni abana bakwe balombe bakachita zyoonse zintu eezyo Yahuwe nzyakali wabalayilila kwiindila kuli Mozesi.
Mubuzuba bwamusanu atatu  Mozesi wakiita Aaloni abana bakwe abapati ba Izilayili.
Wakati kuli Aaloni, ''Bweza mwana ang'ombe kuzwa mutanga chibe chipayizyo chazibi, amugutu utakwe kampenda wakutenta achipayizyo, akuzipeda kuli Jehova.
Uyelede kwambila bantu ba Izilayili ikuti, ''Amubweze moongo wampongo chibe chipayizyo chezibi amusune amwana wambelele, zyoonse kazila amunyaka umwi kazitakwe kampenda, zibe chipayizyo chakutenta;
Alubo mubweze musune amugutu abe chipayizyo chalumuno kufutula kunembo lya Leza, achipayizyo chazilyo zivwelene amafuta, nkambo sunu Jehova ulalibonia kuli nduwe.''
Mpawo bakayeta zyoonse Mozesi nzyakabalayilila kutente nkubakali kuswananina, ambungano zyonse zyaba Izilayili bakasika akukomba kunembo lya Jehova
Mpawo Mozesi wakati, ''Eezi nzizyo Jehova nzyakamulayilila kuti muchite. Eelyo, kuti bulemu bwakwe bukalitondezye kuli ndinywe.''

Mozesi wakati kuli Aaloni, ''Swena afwifwi achipayililo alimwi uzope chipayizyo chezibi akutenta chipayizyo, akulivumbila mulandu lwako abantu, akupa chipayizyo chabantu kuti uvumbile milandu yabo, mbuli Jehova mbwakalayilila.
Aboobo Aaloni wakayinka afwifwi akujaya mwana weng'ombe wachipayizyo chazibi, wakali wakwe.
Ibana ba Aaloni balombe bakatondezya bulowa kuli nguwe akutompa kanwe kakwe mukati akubika ameja achipayililo.
Nekuba boobo wakatenta mafuta azivumbide insaa, chini achipayililo mbuli chipayizyo chezibi mbuli Jehova mbwakalayilila Mozesi.
Inyama echitobo wakazitenta aanze amusasa.
Alimwi wakajaya chipayizyo chakutenta, abana bakwe bapa bulowa, oobo mbwakasansiila woonse mabazu achipayililo.
Mpawo bakamupa chipayizyo chakutenta, chimpanzi  echimpanzi, antomwe amutwe, akuzitenta achipayililo.
Wakasanzya zyamukati amawulu akuzitenta atala echipayizyo chakutenta achipayililo.
Aaloni wakatondezya chipayizyo kubantu - Impongo, mpawo wakazibweza mbuli chipayizyo chazibi zyabo akwijaya; Wakayipayilila kuba chipayilo chezibi mbuli mbakachita kumpongo ntaanzi.
Wakatondezya chipayizyo chakutenta akuumpa kuli Jehova mbwakalayilila.
Wakapedekezya chipayilo chezilyo wakazuzya ijanza lyakwe anzizyo akuzitenta achipayililo aantomwe achipayizyo chakutenta chakuseni.
Wakajaya alubo musune amugutu achipayizyo chachipo chaluumuno, chakali chabantu. Bana ba Aaloni bakamupa ganzi, Eelyo ndyakasansiila mabazu woonse achipayililo.
Nikubaboobo, bakanenga mafuta amupule weng'ombe amugutu, muchila unenede, amafuta abumba insa zyamukati, avumbide chini.
Bakabweza zimpanzi zyakanengwa kuzigwisizya akuzibikka akatiti, alimwi Aaloni wakatenta mafuta achipayililo.
Aaloni wakavukuzya katiti amwendo wachilisyo mbuli chipo chakuvukuzya kunembo lya Jehova, mbuli Mozesi mbwakalayilila.
Mpawo Aaloni wakanyampula maboko akwe kubantu akubalongezya, mpawo wakaseluka aansi kuzwa kukupayila chipayizyo chezibi, chipayizyo chakutenta, achipayizyo chalumuno.
Mozesi a Aaloni bakanjila mutente lyakuswanana, mpawo wakabbuda lubo akulongezya bantu, Alimwi bulemu bwakalibonia kubantu boonse.
Mulilo wakaseluka kuli Jehova akulombya chipayizyo chakutenta amafuta achipayililo. Bantu boonse nibakabona eezi bakavundama aansi.
Nadabba a Abbihu, bana ba Aaloni, awumwi wakabweza chitentelo chakwe, wabikka mulilo, atununkilizyo. Alimwi bakapayizya Jehova mulilo ngwatakazumizya, ngwatakabalayilila kuti bawu payizye.
Elyo kwakazwa mulilo mulilo kuli Jehova akuba nyonyoona, alimwi, bakafwa kunembo lya Yahuwe.

Mpawo Mozesi wakati kuli Aaloni, ''Ezi nzizyo Yahuwe nzyakali kwambula chindi nakati, 'Njoyubununa busalali bwangu kuli aabo baswena kuli ndime. Njolumbayizigwa akuli bonse bantu.'' Aaloni takwe anchaakamba.
Mozesi wakayita Misayeli a Elifaza, bana ba Izilayeli wisilenzi wa Aaloni, akubambila kuti, ''Amubole okuno akubweza banabakwanu akubagwisya kunembo lyabusena busalala akubatola anze lyamalabba.''
Elyo bakeza afwifwi akubabweza, nkabachizwete zibaki zyabo, babatola anze lyamalabba, mbubonya  Mozesi mbwakalayililwa.

Alimwi Mozesi wakati kuli Aaloni akuli Eliyazeli a Alutamala, bana bakwe, ''Mutanolekeli masusu anu mumitwe yenu katebede, alimwi mutadeluuli zyakusama zyenu kuchitila kuti mutafwi, alimwi kuti Jehova atanyemi ambungano yoonse. Pesi amuzumizye nzubo zyenu, engánda yoonse ya Izilayeli, balile nkambo kabaabo mulilo wa Jehova ngwakabika kuti bapye.
Tamwelede kuzwa anze lyatente lyambunganino, mulaafwa, nkambo bunanike bwamafuta a Jehova buli alindinhwe.'' Alimwi bakachita mbubonya Mozesi mbwakalayilila.
Yahuwe wakambula a Aaloni, wakati,
''Utanywi wayini nanka kufumbwa chikola, nanka bana bako abo baali ayebo, chiindi nimuya mutente lyambunganino, kuti mutafwi. Echi chiyoba chizuminano chalyoonse mumazyalani anu woonse,
kwanzania zisalala azyabuyo, azisofwede a zitasofwede,
kuchitila kuti mukayisye bantu ba Izilayeli zyonse zizuminano zya Yahuwe nzyakalayilila kwinda kuli Mozesi.''

Mozesi wakambula a Aaloni a Eliyazela a Alumatala, abana bakwe basyede, ''Mubweze zilyo zyakupayizya ezyo zisyala kupayizizya Yahuwe zyakutenta akuzilya kazitakwe bumena kumbali lyachipayililo, nkambo nchintu chisalalisya.
Mwelede kuchilya mubusena busalala, nkambo nchaabilo chako abana bako chaabilo chachipayizyo nchatentelwa Yahuwe, nkambo eechi nchenchicho nchindakalayililwa kuti nkwambile.

Lukolo lwakangununwa achibelo chakatulilwa Yahuwe, mulelede kuzilya abusena busalala nkazitambulika kuli Leza. Iwebo abana bako balombe abasimbi mulelede kuzilya nzimwapegwa, nkambo nchenchicho nchibamupa mbuli chabilo chako achabilo chabana bako kuzwa muzituuzyo nzibapayizya bantu ba Izilayeli.

Chibelo chakapedekezegwa alukolo lwangununwa, bazyete antomwe azipayizyo zyamafuta zyakutenta akuzivukuzya kunembo lya Yahuwe. Ziyoba zyako abana bako anduwe mbuli chaabilo kwalyonse, mbuli Yahuwe mbakalayilila.''
Lino Mozesi wakabuzya atala ampongo yakupayizya zibi, alimwi kwakazojanwa kuti yatentwa kale. Mpawo wakanyemena Eliyazala a Alutamala, bana ba Aaloni bakasyede; wakati,
''nkambonzi temwalya chipayizyo chezibi abusena busalalisya, nkambo nchechintu chisalalisya, alimwi Yahuwe wamupa kuti mutole zibi zyambungano, akumana milandu kunembo lyakwe?
Amubone, bulowa bwacho tebwaletwa mukati mubusena busalala, alimwi mwalelede kuchilya mubusena busalala, alimwi mbundakalayilila.''

Mpawo Aaloni wakasandula Mozesi, ''Bona, sunu balichitila chipayizyo chezibi akutenta chipayizyo kunembo lya Yahuwe, alimwi echichintu chakachitika kulindime sunu. Na ndalya chipayizyo chazibi sunu, chilamubotezya na Yahuwe?''
Nakamvwa oobo Mozesi wakakkutisika.
Yahuwe wakambula kuli Mozesi alimwi akuli Aaloni, kati,
''Wambula kubantu ba Izilayeli, utedi, 'Ezi nzezintu zipona nzimukonzya kulya akati kabanyama boonse balimunyika.
Mulakonzya kulya kufumbwa munyama ulensumba zyanzene alimwi kaselula.

Nekubabobo bamwi babanyama tabaseluli nikuba kabalensumba zyanzeene, alimwi tamwelede pe kubalya banyama bali mbuli nkamela nkambo ilaselula pesi tikwe nsumba zyandeene pe. Aboobo nkamela ilisofwede kulindinywe.
Alakwe chibila, nkambo ulaselula pesi takwe nsumba zyanzene, alakwe ulisofwede kulindinywe.
Akalako kasulwe, nkambo kalaselula pesi takakwe insumba zyanzeene, kalisofwede kulindinywe.
Ngulube nikuba ilansumba zyanzeene, tayiseluli, ilisofwede kulindinywe.
Tamwelede kulya kufumbwa nyama zyazyo, nikuba kuguma mituunta yazyo. Zilisofwede kulindinywe.
Banyama bakkala mumaanzi mbimukonzya kulya mbabo boonse balatuyambyo amakwa, nanka mulwizi nikuba mumilongo.
Pesi zyonse zilengwa zipona zitakwe tuyambilo amakwa mulwizi nanka mumilonga, kujatikizya zyoonse zyeenda mumaanzi alimwi azilengwa zipona zyoonse zili mumaanzi - zyeelede kumusesemya.
Mbukunga zilamusesemya, tamwelede kulya nyama zyezyo; aboobo mitunta yazyo iyelede kumusesemya.
Kufumbwa chikkala mumanzi alimwi kachitakwe tuyambyo amakwa chilasesemya kulindinywe.
Kubayuni tuyuni twelede kumusesemya alimwi ntomutelede kulya nkambo tulasesemya ntootu: chuungwe,
ikkubi alimwi a syatongo, biimbe, kufumbwa musyobo wabalubanze,
misyobo yoonse yabachikwangwala,
tumba alimwi achipolo, kadoondwe alimwi kufumbwa musyobo wamagumbe.
Mwelede kusesemwa alakwe sikabandwa, insika alimwi a siyaswimuumba,
syapililyo alimwi a sikusiku aba moomba,
tongola, kufumbwa amusyobo wankolekole, ing'angayabayuni, alimwi aka mpembelezya akalako.
Toonse tuuka tulamababa twenda amawulu aane tulasesemya kulindinywe.
Mulakonzya kulya kufumbwa musyobo watuuka tuuluka oto lubo tweenda amawulu aane kupela na katujisi mawulu alempingu zyakusotoka anyika.
Mulakonzya kulya kufumbwa musyobo wansozi, nswabanda, ediingo nanka chamusokonia.
Pesi toonse tuuka tuluka tulandyasyo zyone twelede kusesemya kulindinywe.
Mulasofwala kuyosika goko abanyama aba  na mwaguma mutunta wabo.
Nabaani ubweza umwi wamitunta yazyo uyeleede kwaacha zisamo zyakwe alimwi ulaba usofwede mane kuyosika goko.
Munyama woonse ulensumba zyanzeene kazitaanzene bumaninide nanka utaseluli ulisofwede kulindinywe.
Kufumbwa chintu cheenda abula bwacho akati kabanyama boonse ane balisofwede  kulindinywe. Nabaani uuguma mutunta uliboobu ulasofwala mane likabe goko.
Kufumbwa ubweza mutunta ulibobo uyelede kwaacha zisamo zyakwe alimwi uyelede kwacha zisamo alimwi ulasofwala mane kukabe goko. Aba banyama bayosofwala kulindinywe.
Kubanyama bayavula aansi anyika, aba mbibanyama banosofwede kulindinywe: silukobo, imbeeba, misyobo yoonse yabasyadolyo bapati,
ziliinde, kalindibwami, ikkwamala, ibbulu, alimwi achamuntambwe.
Kubanyama boonse bayavula, aba mbibanyama batondwa kulindinywe. Kufumbwa ubaguma nibafwide uyosofwala manelikabe goko.

Na umwi wabo wafwa alimwi wawida alichimwi chintu, echo chintu chilasofwala, nichiba chakalundwa achisamu, mulembo, chikkumba, nikuba amasaka. Kufumbwa chichibelesegwa chelede kubikwa mumanzi, chiyosofwala manelikabe goko. Mpawo chiyosalala.
Nkambo konse ikalongo kabulongo omo na awo munyama usofwede mpawida, kufumbwa chilimumo mukalongo chilasofwaala, alimwi mulelede kupwachula kalongo aako.
Kufumba chakulya chinga chilaligwa pesi kulimanzi azwa mukalongo aka chilisofwede. Kufumbwa chinywigwa chizwa mukalongo kalibobu chilisofwede.

Kufumbwa chintu  awo umwi wamitunta eyii mpawida chilasofwala, nakuti ibe woveni nichiba chitofu chinini, chelede chipocholwe tube tufwapula zilisofwede alimwi zyelede kukkala kazisofwede kulindinywe.
Kasensa nakuti chikala chitekwa manzi chikkala kachisalede; pesi kufumbwani uguma mutunta ulisofwede.
Nakuti kufumbwa chimpanzi chamutunta chawida kufumbwa embuto zyakubyala, eyimbuto inochisalala.
Pesi kuti na manzi abikwa embuto, alimwi na chimwi chimpanzi chamutunta chawida alinjiyo, awo imbuto ilasofwala kulindinywe.
Na umwi munyama ngomuzumizigwa kulya wafwa, awo oyo uguma mutunta wawo ulasofwala manedo kukabe goko.
Kufumbwa ulya umwi wamitunta uyelede kuyowacha zisamo zyakwe alimwi ulasofwala mane likabe goko. Kufumbwa muntu ubweza mutunta uliboobu ulawacha zisamo zyakwe alimwi ulasofwala mane kukabe igoko.
Munyama woonse uyavula anyika ulasesemya, tayelede pe kulyigwa.
Kufumbwa chintu cheenda aabula, alimwi, kufumbwa chenda amawulu aane, na kufumbwa chintu chilamawulu miingi - boonse banyama bayavula enyika, aba tamwelede kubalya, nkambo balasesemya.
Tamwelede kulisofwazya azilenge zipona ezyo ziyavula; tamwelede kulisofwazya anzizyo, kuti mukachitwe babi anzizyo.
Nkambo ndime Yahuwe Leza wenu. Mulelede kulibamba musalale, abobo, alimwi ngamusalale, nkambo ndasalala.  Tamwelede kulisofwazya nobeni amusyobo kufumbwa wamunyama uyenda enyika.
Nkambo ndime Yahuwe, wakamugwisya munyika yaku Ijiputi, kuti nzobe Leza wenu. Aboobo mulelede kusalala, nkambo ndilasalala.
Oyu mulawu ulazyakuchita abanyama, tuyuni, zyoonse zilenge zipona ezyo zyeenda mumaanzi, alimwi ezilengwa zyoonse ziyavula anyika,
Kuti kube kusiyanisigwa akati kazisofweede azisalala, akati kazintu zipona zinga zilaligwa azintu zipona zinga tazikoligwa.''
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi,
''Koya ukambuule kubantu ba-Izilayeli, ukambe kuti, na mwanakazi waminta akutumbuka mwana mulombe , aboobo ulasofwala kwamazuba aakwe alimusanu abili mbuli mbakali wasofwala kwamweezi.
Mubuzuba bwamusanu aatatu lulomo lwamwana mulombe lwelede kupalulwa.

Eelyo kusalazigwa kwamwanakazi kuzwa kubulowa bwakwe kuyoyimikilila anembo kwamwazuba aali makumi aatatu alatutatu. Tayelede kujata nekuba chomwe chintu chisalala na kunjila mudumba lyambungano kwamazuba akusalazigwa kwakwe katana zulila.

Pesi na kwazyalwa mwana musimbi eelyo ulasofwala kwamviki zibili, mbubonya mbali kumazuba akutondwa kwakwe. Eelyo kusalazigwa kwabanyina kwinkilila kunembo kwamazuba aali makumi musanu akkumi amusanu alimwi. (60)

Nakamana mazuba akusalazigwa kwamwana mulombe na musimbi, welede kweeta mwana wambelele ula mwaka uumwi mbuli chipayizyo chakutentela, amwana wankwilimba na inziba mbuli chipayizyo chzibi, kumulyango wedumba lyembunganino, kumupayizi.
Mpawo uyopa chipayizyo eecho kunembo lya Jehova akumubozya, alimwi uyosalazigwa kuzwa kubulowa bwakwe. Ooyo mulawu wamwanakazi ooyo utumbuka mwana mulombe na musimbi.
Na katakonzyi kweta mwana wambelele, eelyo weelede kweeta inziba izibili na bana benkwilimba bobile, uumwi abe mbuli chipayizyo chezibi, alimwi mupayizi uyomuswanizya, eelyo mwanakazi uyosalala.''

Jehova wakambula kuliMozesi a Aloni, wakati, "Wakati kufumbwa muntu awo naaba akuzimba niiba nsanga, nikaba kabata kalibonina loko, aachikumba chamubili wakweino mpawo kanjilwa tuzunda, mpawo kwaba chilwazi

Aboobo mupayizi ulachisenuuka chilwazi muchikumba chamubili wakwe. Na kuti boya buli aabusena kulichilwazi bwatuba alimwi kuti naa chilwazi kachilangikaanga chilinikide kwinda kuba ejulu biyo lyachikumba, nkokuti mbulwazi butabukila. Musule akusenuukwa kwakwe amupayizi , welede kumwamba kuti tasalali pe.

Na kuti kabata kalibonia loko muchikumba chamubili wakwe kakatuba, alimwi kakalangikaanga takabbide loko pe kunsi achikumba, alimwi kuti boya bulaabusena bulachilwazi teebwasanduka kutuba, nkokuti mupayizi welede kumupambula oyo ulaabulwazi kwamazuba musanu aabili.
Mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili, mupayizi weleede kumusenuuka kuti abone kuti we muluzibo lwakwe bulwazi teebwiindilia na, akutayendelela muchikumba chamubili. Kuti teebwachita boobo.

Mupayizi welede kumupambula lubo kwamazuba musanu aabili. mupayizi uyoomusenuuka alimwi mubuzuba bwamusanu atubili kuti abone kuti abone kuti bulwazi buli mbubombubo,  alimwi teebwiindilila akuyendebuka muchikumba chamubili. Kuti teebwindilila, mupayizi uyowambilizya kuti oyu muntu wasalala. Nifumukwa biyo.  Weelede kusapa ngubo zwakwe, elyo wasalala.
Pele kuti fumukwa lyindilila musule akulitondeezya kwakwe kumupayizi akukusalazigwa kwakwe, ino welede kulolitondeezya lubo kumupayizi.
Mupayizi uyosenuuka kuti abone kuti naa fumukwa lyindilila muchikumba chamubili. Na kuti lyiindilia, eelyo mupayizi weelede kuzibisya kuti tasalali pe. Mbulwazi butabukila.
Kuti bulwazi bwechikumba chamubili butabukila bwaba mumuntu, oyu muntu welede kweetwa kumupayizi.
Mupayizi ulamusenuuka kuti abone na kakuli aazimbide katuba muchikumba chamubili, akuti na boya bwasanduka kutuba, na kuti kulinyama ichisa awo aazimbide.
Kuti kiiliwo, nkokuti mbulwazi bwachikumba chamubili butasilikiki, alimwi mupayizi weelede kuzibisya kuti tasalali. Takoomupambula pe, nkaambo tasalali kale pe.
Na kuti chilwazi chasaalila muchikumba chamubili woonse akuzuzya chikumba chamubili woonse mumuntu ooyo ulaachilwazi kuzwa kumutwe mane do kumawulu aakwe, mbuli mukubona kwamupayizi,
elyo mupayizi weelede kumusenuuka kuti abone na chilwazi chazuzya mubili wakwe woonse. Na kakuli mbubo, mupayizi welede kuzibisya kuti muntu oyo ulaachilwazi ulasalala.
Pele kuti kwalibonia nyama iichisa aalinguwe, unooli tasalali pe.
Mupayizi weelede kulanga nyama iichisa akumwaamba kuti tasalali pe nkaambo nyama iichisa tiisalali pe. Mbulwazi butabukila.
Pele kuti nyama iichisa yasanduka yatuba alimwi nkokuti oyo muntu weelede kuya kumupayizi.
Mupayizi uyoomusenuuka kuti abone naa nyama yasanduka kutuba. Na kakuli boobo, mupayizi ulazibisya kuti oyo muntu ulasalala.
Na muntu kali aakalonda achikumba chamubili alimwi kapona,
alubo aabusena bwakalonda kwatuba kakuzimbibe niliba bbata lilibonia loko, kalisalala salala - butuba, ino lyeelede kutondeezegwa kumupayizi.

Mupayizi ulalisenuuka kuti abone na liboneka kalinikide kunsi achikumba, alimwi do boya bulimpawo bwasanduka kutuba. Na kakuli mbubo, mupayizi welede kumwaamba kuti tasalali pe.  Mbulwazi butabukila,  na kuti chakala aawo aakali kalonda.
Pele na mupayizi wasenuuka, wasikubona kuti taakwe  boya butuba mulindilyo, alimwi kuti taakwe munsi lyachikumba pesi kuti lyawumbuka, eelyo mupayizi welede kumupambula kwamazuba musanu aabili.
Kuti bwasaalila loko muchikumba, eelyo mupayizi welede kumwaamba kuti tasalali pe. Mbulwazi butabukila.
Pele kuti ibbata lilibonia loko lwakalililamubusena bwalyo kalitayendebuki pe, nkokuti nibbata lyakalonda elyo mupayizi weelede kumwaamba kuti ulasalala.
Kuti chikumba kachipya anyama iichisa yakupya yasalala - butuba naakuti bbata lituba,

eelyo mupayizi uyoolisenuuka kuti abone naa booya buleebbata eelyo bwasanduka kutuba, akuti naa lilangika kalinikide kunsi echikumba. Kuti kakuli boobo, nkokuti mbulwazi butabukila. Bwazwida aapyide, ino mupayizi weelede kumwaamba kuti tasalali pe. Mbulwazi butabukila.
Na kuti mupayizi wasenuuka wasikujana kuti taakwe boya butuba mubbata alimwi kuti tabumo munsi aachikumba pesi lyawumbuka, awo mupayizi welede kumupambula kwamazuba musanu aabili.
Eelyo mupayizi welede kumusenuka mubuzuba bwamusanu atubili. Kuti lyasaalila loko muchikumba, awo mupayizi welede kumwaamba kuti tasalali pe. Mbulwazi butabukila.
Kuti na bbata lyakalilila mubusena bwalyo kalitasaalili muchikumba pesi lyawumbuka biyo nkokuti nkuzimba kuzwa mukupya, awo mupayizi welede kumwamba kuti ulasalala, nibbata biyo lyakupya.
Na kuti mwaalumi na mwanakazi kajisi bulwazi butabukila aamutwe naaba aakalezu,

awo mupayizi welede kumusenuuka muntu ooyo kuti abone kuti naa ulabulwazi butabukila akuyanda kubona kuti do bulangika kabunikide kunsi echikumba, alimwi kuti kuli boya na bwasyamuntondo, buuba mukati. Kuti kabaliwo awo, mupayizi weelede kumwaamba kuti tasalali pe. Nchipele.
Na kuti mupayizi wasenuuka chilwazi chibaba akubona kuti tachiwo kunsi echikumba, alimwi kuti takwe boya busiya mukati, awo mupayizi ulamupambula muntu alaabulwazi bubaba kwamazuba musanu aabili.
Aabuzuba bwamusanu atubili mupayizi uyosenuuka bulwazi akubona kuti teebwasaalila na. Kuti kakutakwe boya bwasyamuntondo, alimwi kuti bulwazi kabulangika kuti bulinikide kunsi aachikumba,
awo welede kunyoolwa, pesi busena bulechilwazi tabweelede kunyoolwa pe, alimwi mupayizi welede kumupambula muntu ulaabulwazi kwamazuba musanu aabili lubo.

Mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili mupayizi uyosenuuka bulwazi kubona kuti bwimikila na kusaalila muchikumba. Kuti kabulangika kutanika kwinda chikumba, awo mupayizi welede kumwaamba kuti ulasalala. Oyo muntu welede kusapa zisamo zyakwe, aboobo uyoosalala.
Pesi kuti bulwazi bubaba bwasaalila loko muchikumba musule mupayizi kali wamwaamba kuti ulasalala,
eelyo mupayizi welede kumusenuuka lubo. Na bulwaazi bwasaalila muchikumba, mupayizi tachelede kuyandula boya bwasyamuntondo pe. Muntu oyu tasalali pe.
Pesi kuti mumaboneno amupayizi bulwazi bubaba bwiimikila kusaalila alimwi boya busiya bwamena mubusena obo, nkokuti bulwazi bwapona. Ulasalala alimwi mupayizi welede kumwaamba kuti ulasalala.
Na kuti mwaalumi naba mwanakazi kalaa mabata atuba aachikumba,
mupayizi welede kumusenuuka oyo muntu kuti abone kuti mabata taatabukili loko,  nkokuti ndifumukwa lyafumpuka muchikumba. Ulasalala.
Kuti susu lyamwaalumi lyakuluka mumutwe wakwe,  ngusimpanza, pesi ulasalala. Na susu lyakwe lyakuluka kunembo amutwe wakwe, alimwi nkumu yakwe kiitakwe susu, ulasalala.
Pesi kuti kakuli kalonda kasalala salala - butuba aampanza yakwe aankumu, mbulwazi butabukila bwamunjila.
Elyo mupayizi welede kumusenuuka kuti abone do kuzimba kwabusena bulechilwazi chitabukila muchikumba.
Kuti kakuli boobo, nkokuti ulaabulwazi butabukila alimwi tasalali. Mupayizi nchobeni kumwaamba kuti tasalali pe nkaambo kachilwazi  chakwe chilaamutwe wakwe.

Muntu ulaabulwazi butabukila weelede kuzwata zizwato zidelukide, susu lyakwe lyelede kulengelela biyo alimwi weelede kuvumba busyu bwakwe kusika aampemo yakwe alimwi koompolola, 'Nsisalali, nsisalali.'
Mazuba woonse ngalabulwazi butabukila unooli katasalali. Nkaambo tasalali abulwazi bukonzya kusaalila, weelede kukala alike. Weelede kukkala kunze amusasa.
Chisamo chatapukilwa tuzunda twachipele, nichiba chaboya naa chabuluba,
kufumbwa chilukidwe kuzwa kuboya nikuba kubuluba naa chikumba kufumbwa chintu chakachitwa eechikumba - na kuti kakuli twatapukila twakamweemvwe naa tusalala -
salala aachisamo, aachikumba, chintu chilukidwe kufumbwa chintu chakabambwa kuzwa kuchikumba nkokuti nchipele chisaalila; cheelede kutondeezegwa kumupayizi.
Mupayizi weelede kuchisenuuka echo chintu kuti inga chilaba atuzunda twachipele na; weelede kupambulwa kufumbwa chintu chilaatuzunda twachipele kwamazuba musanu amazuba obile.

Weelede kuzoosenuuka lubo kubawo kwachipele buzuba bwamusanu atubili. Naa chasaalila muchisamo na kufumbwa chilukidwe aboya nichiba chikumba kufumbwa kuti mulinchincho mwakabelesegwa chikumba, nkokuti, nchipele chijaya nkokuti echo chintu tachisalali.

Weelede kuchuumpa echo chisamo, nichiba chilukidwe aboya naa buluba, nichiba chikumba kufumbwa chakachitwa aachikumba kufumbwa chintu mulinchicho mujanika chipele chijaya, nkaambo chilakonzya kuzyala bulwazi . Echo chisamo chelede kutetwa loko mane chilote.
Kuti mupayizi wachisenuka chisamo eecho,mpawo wabona kuti tuzunda twachipele tetwasaalila muchisamo naa muchisamo chilukidwe aaboya naa buluba nichiba chikumba,
elyo uyoobalayilila kuti bachisape echo chisamo mulinchicho mwajanika tuzunda twachipele , alimwi weelede kuchipambula lubo kwamazuba musanu amazuba obile.

Elyo mupayizi uyosenuuka chisamo musule aakusapwa kwacho echo chisamo chajanika atuzunda twachipele. Na chipele techasanduka mubala nikuba kuti techasaalila, tachisalali pe.  Weelede kuchuumpa echo chisamo, nikuba kuti mpaali mputwachitapukila tuzunda twachipele.

Na mupayizi wachisenuuka chisamo, alimwi kuti aalya ayeeyelwa  tuzunda twachipele atubuluka nichisampwa , awo welede kudelula chibela chakatapukilwa kuzwa kuchisamo choonse nikuba kuzwa kuchikumba, naa kuzwa kuchisamo chilukidwe.

Naa kuti aawo aakalokela ziyeeyelwa kuti zilaatuzunda twachipele muchisamo kazichiboneka, naa muchisamo chilukiidwe , nikuba muchintuunzi zwacho chechikumba, nkokuti chilikusaalila. Weelede kuumpa kufumbwa chintu chileechipele.

Chisamo , kufumbwa chilukidwe kuzwa kuboya nikuba buluba, naa chikumba - naa kufumbwa chintu chakachitwa aachikumba - naa wachisapa chintu echiya, echiya chakatampukilidwe chazwa, awo chintu eecho ngachisapwe lubo lwabili, elyo chiyoosalala.

Ooyu ngomulawo aatala azeziya zitapukila chaboya naa kuti chabuluba, naa kufumbwa chilukidwe kuzwa kuboya naa buuba, nikuba chikumba, kufumbwa chintu chakachitwa achikumba, kuchitila kuti uchaambe chilasalala naa kuti tachisalali.
Jehova wakaambula a Mozesi, wakati,''
00yu nguyoba mulawu wabantu basimalwazi mubuzuba bwakwe bwakusalazigwa. Welede kweeta kumupayizi.
Mupayizi uyoozwa mugunzi, kuyoolangisisya muntu kuti bulwazi bwachikumba butabukila bwaponana.
Mpawo mupayizi uyolayilila kuti ooyo welede kusalazigwa welede kubweza tubbili tupona, tuyuni tuswankukide, musamuwa seela, sikaleti yani, ahayisopu.
Mupayizi uyomulayilila kuti akajaye kamwi kayuni aatala amanzi mapya aali mukalonga.
Awo mupayizi uyoobweza kayuni kuumbulu amusamu wa seda, asikaleti yani ahayisopi alimwi uyanike zyoonse zintu eezi, aantomwe akayuni kawumbulu, mugazi lyakayuni kakajayigwa aatala lyamaanzi mapya,

Mpawo mupayizi uyoosansila maanzi aya kumuntu welede kusalazigwa kuzwa kubulwazi tuli musanu atubili, alimwi mupayizi uyowambilizya kuti wasalala. Mpawo  Mupayizi uyowangunona kayuni kawumbulu mumyundai julikide.

Muntu uulikusalazigwa uyoosanzya zisamo zyakwe, uyoogela susulyakwelyoonse, akulisanzya mumaanzi, aboobo uyosalala. Musule lyabobo welede kuza mugunzi, pesi uyookala aanze ebbakasa lyakwekwamazuba musanu aabili.

Mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili welede kugela susu lyakwe lyoonse mumutwe, alimwi weelede kugela ndezu azikowe zyakwe. Welede kugela lyoonse susu lyakwe, alimwi welede kusanzya zisamo zyakwe akusamba lwakwe mu maanzi, mpawo unooli wasalala.

Mubuzuba bwamusanu aatatu welede kubweza bana ba mbelele beenze bobile batakwe kampenda, komwe kakabelele kapwizikatakwe kampendakabi kali aamunyaka omwe wakazyalwa, atutatu kukkumi lyaka efa kafulawa iswenene amafuta mbuuli chipo chazilyo, atanda lyomwe lyamafuta.
Mupayizi umusalazya uyoyimikizya muntu uyelede kusalazigwa, aantomwe azeezyo zintu, kunembo lya Jehova kumulyango wabbakasa lyamuswaangano.
Mupayizi uyoobweza kana kakabelele keenzeakukaaba mbuuli chipo chakulibeteka, antomwe atanda lyamafuta, uyobabekelela kuchipo chakulekelela kunembo lya Jehova.

Welede kujaya mbelele ngenze mubusena mubajayila chipo chakubisya azipo zitentwa, mubusena bwa chikombelo, nkaambo chipo chakubisya ncha mupayizi, mbuuli mbukubede chipo chakulibeteka, nkaambo nchisalali loko.
Mupayizi uyoobweza limwi gaze liyachipo chakulibeteka akulibika aampela lyakutwi kwakuchilisyo chamuntuuyelede kusalazigwa, kuchaala chakukuboko kwakwe kwakuchilisyo,
Mpawo mupayizi uyoobweza mafuta kuzwa mutanda atile mujaanza lyakwe lyakuchimweensi,
atompe kanwe kakwe mumafuta aalimujaanza lyakuboko kwechimweensi, asansiile aamwi mafuta akanwe kakwe kaliikwindulula tuli musanu atubili kunembo lya Jehova.

Mupayizi uyobika amwi mafuta aali mujaanza lyakwe kupmela yakutwi kwamuntu uyanda kusalazigwa,akuchaala chakwe chakukuboko kwakuchilisyo, Weelede kubika mafuta aaya atala lya ganzi aazwa kuchipo chakuli beleka,
kumafuta amwi achaala mujaanza lyamu payizi, uyoowabika aamutwe wamuntu uuyand kusalazigwa, alimwi mupayizi uyoowamba milandu yakwe kunembo lya Jehova.
Mpawo mupayizi uyoopa chipo chazibi akwaambilizya ooyo uyanda kusalazigwa akambo kabusofwaazi bwakwe, alimwi musule lyaboobo uyoojaya chipo chaku lenta.
Mpawo mupayizi uyopa chipo chakutenta chipo chazilyo  aachipayiililo, mupayizi uyomwambilizya muntu ooyu, alimwi mpawo uyoba musalali.

Nikuba boobo, kuti muntu ooyu kali muchete katakwe lubono oolu, aawo uyobweza mbelele ngenze yomwe ikabe chipo chakuli beteka chiyolekelelwa, kukumuchitila chaambilizyo, akamwi kakkumi lyamunsuma wafulawa iswenene amafuta kuti chibe chipo chazilyo, atanda lyamafuta kuti chibe chipo chazilyo, atanda lyamafuta,
aantomwe anziba zyobile naakuti bana benkwilimba bobile, kufumbwa nzyakkonzya akujana; kayuni komwe kayoba chipo chazibi kamwi kakabe chipo chakutenta.
Mubuzuba bwamusanu atutatu weelede kuzyeeta kukusalazigwa kumupayizi, kumanjililo aabbakasa lya muswaangano, kunembo lya Jehova.
Mupayizi uyobweza mbelele yachipo, alimwi uyoyibweza atanda lyamafuta amu olivi, alimwiuyoozinyampwida mujulu awo. nazotondezya kuli Jehova.

Uyojaya mbelele yachipo chakulibeteka, alimwi uyobweza limwi gaze lyachipo chakulibeteka akulibika ampela lyakutwi kwachilisyo kwayoyo uyanda kusalazigwa akuchaala chakuboko kwakwe kwachilisyo, akuchaala chakuulu kwakwe kwachilisyo.
Mpawo mupayizi uyotulida amwi mafuta mujanza lyakuboko kwakwe mwini kwachimweensi.
Alimwi uyoosansila akanwe kakwe kachaamwi mafuta aali mujanza lyakwe lyachimwensi kayindulula kuli musanu atubili kunembo lya Jehova.

Mupayizi aawo uyobika amwi mafuta aali mukuboko kwakwe ampela lyakutwi kwachilisyo chayooyo uyanda kusalazigwa, kuchhaala chakubokokwakwe chkuulu kwakuchilisyo, ali mbubo busena mpabika ganzi lya chipo chakulibeteka,
uyobika aamwi mafuta aachala mujaanza lyakwe aamutwe wayoyo uyanda kuslazigwa, kukuchita chaambilizyo chakwe kunembo lya Jehova.
Weelede kwaba imwi nziba nakuti mwana wankwilimba, kufumbwa mbuli muntu mbakonzya  kujana_
komwe mbuuli chipo chazibi akamwi mbuli chipo chaku tenta, aantomwe achipo chazilyo. Mpawo mupayizi ulachita chaambilizyo chayoyo uuyanda kusalazigwa kuli Jehova.
Ooyu  ngumulawu wamuntu uulabulwazi bwachikumba butabukila, uutakonzyipe kujana mweelo wazipo zyakusalazigwa kwakwe.
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi a Aloni, wakati,
awo nimwaza mubusena bwa Kkenani oobo mbundakamupa mbuuli chakujata, alimwi kuti ndabika bulwazi bwa nkubi oobo bwendelela munganda mubusena mbumujisi
mpawo ooyo mwani nganda welede kwamba kuti, ''kubaanga kulindime kulichintu chili mbuuli bulwazi bwa nkubi munganda yangu.
Mpawo mupayizi uyoolayilila kuti bagwisye zyoonse zili munganda katanaanjila kuti akabone bukamboni bwa nkubi, kuchitila kuti takukabi chintu chisofweede munganda. Musule lya bobo mupayizi
welede kunjila kuti akabone nganda. Welede kulangisisya  kuti nkubi akubona kuti tayili kubulambo bwanganda, akubona kuti chiboneka akamwemvwemvwe kana kusalalasalala mubulindilindi bwabulambo.
Kuti nganda kayili aankubi, mpawo mupayizi ulazwa anze anganda ajale mulyango wanganda kwamazuba musanu abili.
Mpawo mupayizi uyooboola lubo mubuzuba bwa musanu amazuba obile kuzolangisisya akubona kuti nkubi yeendelelana kubulambo bwanganda.
Kuti kayili yendelela mpawo mupayizi uyolayilila kuti bakagwisye mabwe aayo ali azitondeezyo zya nkubi alimwi basowe mubusena busofweede aanze adolopo.
Uyooyanda kuti boonse bulambo bwa mukati kenganda bupalwe, alimwi beelede kubweza zyoonse zitabukilidwe bulwazi zyapalwa bazitole aanze adolopo bakazisowe mubusena busofweede.
Beelede kuyoobweza amwi mabwebabike oomu mwagwisigwa mabwe, alimwi beelede kubelesya bulongo bupya kukubuumuna nganda.
Kuti nkubi yaboola lubo akutabukila munganda oomo mwakagwisigwa mabwe alimwi alimwi bulambo bwaka palwa akubuumunwa lubo,
Awo mupayizi welede kunjila akulangisisya nganda kuti abone kuti kubi yasaalila, nkokuti nkubi ilajaya yasaalila, nkokuti nkubi ilajaya alimwi nganda ilisofweede.
Inganda yeelede kumwayigwa. mabwe, mapulanga abuulongo boonse bwakubuumuna munganda bwelede  kubwezwabukasowegwe mubusena busofweede kunze aadolopo.
Mukuyungizya, kufumbwa uunjila munganda mumazuba ngiijalidwe uyoosofwala mane golezya.
Kufumbwa ulala munganda weelede kusanzya zisamo zyakwe, alimwi kufumbwa walyida munganda weelede kusanzya zisamo zyakwe.
Kuti mupayizi wanjila munganda kukuyilangisisya kuti abone kuti nkubi yasaalila na munganda musule akubumunwa bupya, mpawo, kuti nkubi yamana, uyoowambilizya kuti nganda yasalala.
Mpawo mupayizi welede kubweza tuyuni tobile twakusalazya nganda, azisamu zya seda, asikaleti  yaani, ahayisopu.
Uyojaya kamwi katuyuni aatala lyamaanzi kumulonga
uyoobweza zisamu zya seda, ihayisa isikaleti yani, akayuni kawumbulu, akuzinika mugazi lyakayuni kajiigwa mumaanzi mapya, akusansiila nganda musanu atubili.
Uyosalazya nganda agazi lya kayuni amaanzi mapya, akayuni kawumbulu, azisamu zya seda, Hayisopu asikaleti yaani.
Pesi uyoleka  kayuni kawumbulu kakeenda kuzwa mudolopokuya kumasena aajulikene. Mulieeyi nzila weelede kuchita chaambilizyo changanda, alimwi iyoosalala.

Mpawo Joni wakati kumakamu akalikuza kuzo bbabbatizigwa anguwe, ''Nywebo nobana bachipile! ngwani wakamuchenjezya kuti muchije kuzwa kubukali bulokuza?

Aaboobo, muzyale michelo mibotu iitondezya kusanduka alimwi mutataliki kwaamba mukati kanu, ''Tula Abulahamu kali taata wesu; mbundamwambila kuti Leza ulakonzya kusumpula bana ba Abulahamu kuzwa kumabwe aya.
Alino kaleba kalibikidwe kale kumiyanda yamisamu. Aboobo kufumbwa musamu utazyali muchelo mubotu ulawugonkela kunsi akuuwalila mumulilo.''
Alimwi makamu akendelela kunembo akumubuzya bakati, ''Niinzi mpawo nzitutachite?''
Wakasandula akuti kulimbabo, ''Na kulumwi uujisi twakuzwata tubili, uleelede kwabana amuntu utakwe ayooyo ujisi chakulya ayiite mbobo.''
Abasimutelo abalabo bakaza kuzo bbabbatizigwa, akwamba kuli nguwe kuti, ''Muyisi, niinzi nchitweelede kuchita?''
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Mutakabwezi mali nyiingi njimutabuzizigwe kubweza."

Bamwi basilumamba abalabo bakamubuzya, bakati, ''Aniswe ninzi nchitweelede kuchita?'' Wakati kulimbabo, ''Mutakabwezi mali kufumbwa kulumwi changuzu, alimwi mutakapenzyi omwe chakubeja. amukakutisikane amiholo yanu.''
Lino bantu nibakachili kulindila chakupekezya kusika kwa Kkilisto boonse bakali kugamba mukati kamooyo yabo aatala aJoni, kutii ngunguwe Kkilisto.

Joni wakasandula wakati kuliboonse, ''Imebo lwangu ndamubbabbatizya amanzi, pele kulumwi ulobuza ulanguzu kwiinda ndime, aboobo nsikonzyi nikuba nkwangununa misungo yansangu zyakwe. Uyomu bbabbatizya aMuya Uusalala antomwe amulilo.
Kajisi pologwe yakupupuluzya mujanza lyakwe chakusalazya lubuwa lwakwe akubunganya bbali munganda yakwe. Pele uyowumpa buungu amulilo alimwi mulilo tukoyoozima pe."
Mubwingi bwakumusumpula Joni wakalikwambula makani mabotu kubantu.
Alimwi Heloda kali mwendelezyi wakazumizigwa kukukwata mwanakazi wamwana wakwabo Helodiyasi azyoonse zintu zibi Heloda nzyakachitide,
wakayungizya ezi kulimbabo boonse, akujalila Joni muntolongo.
Lino nichakasika chiindi aawo bantu boonse bakabbabbatizigwa Jesu alakwe wakabbabbatizigwa, nibakachili kukomba, majulu akajulika,
aMuuya Uusalala muchimo chamubili wakaza  mbuli nziba, alimwi jwi lyakazwa kujulu ''Ulimwana wangu ngwendiyandisisya. Ndabotelwa anduwe."
Mpawo Jesu naakatalika mulimu wakwe wakali amyaaka yakuzyalwa makumi aatatu. Wakali mwana mulombe (mbuli mbukwakaklikuyelelwa) kuti Josefa mulombe waHeli,
mwana waMatati, mwana waLevi, mwana Melichi, mwana wa Janayi, mwana waJosefa.
Josefa wakali mwana wa Matatiyasi, mwana wa Amos, mwana wa Naumi, mwana wa Esili, mwana wa Nagayi,
mwana wa Mati, mwana wa Matatiyasi, mwana wa Simiyoni, mwana wa Josekki, mwana wa Juda.
Joda wakali mwana waJowanani, mwana wa Lesa, mwana wa Zelubbabbeli, mwana wa Salatiyeli, mwana wa Neli,
mwana wa Melikki, mwana wa Elimadamu, mwana wa Eli,
mwana wa Joshuwa, mwana wa Eliyeza, mwana wa Jolimu, mwana wa Matati, mwana wa Levi
Levi wakali mwana wa Simiyoni, mwana wa Juda, mwana wa Josefa, mwana wa Eliyakim, mwana wa
Meliya, mwana wa Mena, mwana Matata, mwana wa Natani, mwana wa Davida,
mwana wa Jese, mwana wa Obbeti, mwana wa Bbowazi, mwana wa Salimoni, mwana wa Nasiyoni.
Nashoni wakali mwana wa Aminadabu, mwana Adimini, mwan wa Alini, mwana wa Heziloni, mwana wa Perez, mwana wa Juda,
mwana wa Jakkobo, mwana wa Isakka, mwana wa Abbulamu, mwana wa Tela, mwana wa Nawoli,
mwana wa Selugi, mwana wa Lewu, mwana wa Pelegi, mwana wa Ebba, mwana wa Shela.
Sila wakali mwana wa Kkayinani, mwana wa Alipazada, mwana wa Semu, mwana wa Nowa, mwana wa Lameki,
mwana wa Metusela, mwana wa Inoki, mwana wa Jaledi, mwana wa Mahalaleli, mwana wa Kkayini,
mwana wa Inosi, mwana wa Seti, mwana wa Adamu, mwana wa Leza.
Mpawo Jesu, kazwide Muuya Uusalala, wakaboola kuzwa kumulonga wa Jodani, wakazulwidwa a Muuya kuya munkanda
ooko nkwakaakusunkwa mazuba makumi one adyabbulosi. Takwe nchakalya mumazuba aayo, kumamanino achiindi echo wakaba aanzala.
Dyabbulosi wakati kulinguwe. ''na kana koli mwana wa Leza lailila ibwe eli libe chinkawa.''
Jesu wakamusandula wati, ''Zililembedwe, 'Muntu taponi achinkwa luzutu pe.'''
Mpawo dyabbulosi wakazulida Jesu akutomudenzya bwaami boonse bulanyika muchindi chinini.
Mpawo dyabbulosi wakati kulinguwe, ''Ndilapa nduwe bwendelezi  boonse abulemu mbuli mbundakabupegwa, alimwi ndilakonzya kupa kufumbwa ngundiyanda.
Kuti mpawo, na wafugama akundikomba, zilaba zyako.''
Pesi Jesu wakamusandula wati,  ''Zililembedwe, 'Ulelede kukomba Mwaami Leza wako, akumumanina milimu yakwe.'''
Mpawo dyabbulosi wakatola Jesu ku Jelusalema akumubikka ansonge yakaluli katempele, akumwambila kuti, ''Na koli mwana wa Leza liwaalile, aansi kuzwa aawa.
Nkaambo kulilembedwe kuti, 'Uyolailila bangelo  bakwe atala andinywe, kuti bakukwabilile,
mpawo bayokunyampula amaboko aabo, kuchitila kuti utakaligubbuli.'"
Nakamusandula Jesu  wakati, ''Kulaambidwe kuti, 'Utabiki Mwami Leza  wako kumisunko.''
Mpawo diyabbulosi nakamana ku sunka Jesu, wakeenda wakamusiya kusikila chiindi chimbi.
Jesu wakabweda ku Galillaya munguzu zyamuuya, a makani atala anguwe akazulila mukati kachisi chizyungulukide.
Mpawo wakasanguna kuyisya muzikombelo zyabo alimwi wakalumbaizigwa aboonse.
Nakasika ku Nazaleta nkwakakomenezegwa, a mbuli muchiyanza, wakannjila muchikkomnbelo muzuba bwa sabata wakayimikila akubala chakompolola.
Mabhuku amunsinsimi Isaya akapegwa mumaboko akwe. Wakajula bhuku akujana ndawu yakalembedwe kuti.

''Muuya wa Leza uli aalindime, nkaambo wakandinaanika kuti ndaambe makani mabotu kuli bafwaba, wakandituma kuzowamba lwaangunuko kuli aabo baangidwe akuzobonia batakuboni, kwangununa aabo baadyaminizigwe,
kuzowamba munyaka wa Luse.''
Nakajula mabhuku, wakapa lubo kuli baka bungene kabakkede aansi. Menso aboonse bakali muchikombelo kamulangide.
Wakatalika kwambula ambabo, "Sunu eli jwi lyazuzikizigwa mukumvwa kwanu.''
Boonse awo bakambula zibotu atala anguwe akugamba majwi aakwe alumbayizigwa akalikuzwa mumulomo wakwe, bakali kuti, ''Ooyu temwana wa Josefa na?''
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Chamasimpe muyowaamba kasimpi aaka kulindime, musilisi liponye omwini. Kufumbwa nzitwakamvwa nzuwakachita mu Kapenawumu, ita zikozyenie akudolopo lyakulindinywe.
Pele wakati, ''Nchobeni ndamwambila kuti takwe musinsimi utambulwa mudolopo lyakwe.
Pele mukasimpe ndamubuzya kuti kwakali bamuka bafu biingi mu Izilayeli muchiindi cha Elayija, ijulu nilyajalwa kwaminyaka iitatu amyeezi iilamusanu awumwi alimwi nzaala mpati yakasika munyika.
Pele Elayija taakwe nakatumwa nikuba kuli umwi wabo, pele kuli Zalafati mu  Sidoni,  kulimukamufu ukkala nkukooko.
Kwakali bali aazipele  biingi mu Izilayeli kwamazuba a Elisya musinsimi, pele takwe nikuba umwi wakali salazidwe  kusiya Namani muSayilini.''
Boonse bantu muchikombelo bakazula kuyoowa nibakamvwa zintu eezi.
Bakabuka bamutanda kuti azwe mudolopo akumuizya atala akalundu idolopo lyabo nkulyakayakilidwe nkumbali kulundu, kabayanda kuti bakamutontele aansi.
Pesi wakayinda akati kabo waya kuli bumbi busena.
Alimwi wakeendelela akuya ku Kkapenamu, idolopo lilimu Galilii, alimwi wakasanguna kubayiisya atala aSabata.
Bakagamba enjisyo yakwe, nkaambo wakali kwambula changuzu.
Lino muchikombelo kwakali mwaalumi wakali aamuuya mubi wadayimona, alimwi wakalila akoompolola ajwi pati ,
''Aah! Niinzi nzitwelede kuchita anduwe, Jesu waku Nazareta? Wasika kuzotujaya na? Ndilizi kuti nduweni - Uusalala wa Leza!"
Jesu wakamutukila dayimona, akwaamba kuti, ''Utaambuli zwa mulinguwe. Aawo dayimona nakamuwisya mwaalumi aakati kabo, wakazwa mulinguwe, alimwi telyakamuchisa abunini.
Boonse bantu bakagamba, alimwi bakaliswini kwambula atala anzizyo umwi awuumwi. Bakati , ''Musyobo nzi wamabala ali obu? Wakulayilila myuuya mibi  chabwendelezi anguzu alimwi yazwa.''
Alimwi makani mabotu akatalika kuyanzala kumabazu woonse akuchisi.
Mpawo Jesu wakazwa muchikombelo, alimwi wakanjila mung'anda ya Sayimoni. Lino banyinazyala ba Sayimoni bakalikuchiswa akupya mubili, alimwi bakabakombelezezya kuli nguwe.
Mpawo wakayimikila kunembo lyamwanakazi akukalalila kupya kwamubili, alimwi bwakamusiya bulwazi. Mpawo, wakanyampuka akutalika kubakutawukila.
Mpawo zuba nilyakabbila, bantu bakamwetela Jesu boonse bakali aamalwazi asiyenesiyene wakabika maboko akwe kuli boonse akubaponia.
Madayimona alawo akazwa kubayingi babo,  kalikulila kaamba kuti, ''Uli Mwana wa Leza!'' Jesu wakakalalila ma daimona  alimwi akutazumizya kuti uaambule nkaambo akalizi kuti ngu Kkilisto.
Lino nibwakasika buzuba bwakulyokezya, wakaya kubusena buumwide. Makamu abantu akalikumulanguula akasika nkwaakabede. Bakeezya kumukasya kuti atazwi pe akati kabo.
Pele wakati kulimbabo, ''Ndilelede alimwi kukambawuka ijwi atala abwami bwa Leza kumadolopo miingi, nkaambo aka nkikambo nkindakatuminwa.''
Alimwi wakeendelela kukambawuka muzikombelo zyoonse zyamu Judiya.
Lino kwakachitika kuti bantu nibakabungene munsi a Jesu akuswilila jwi lya Leza, awo nakimvwi kulubbazu lwalwizi lwa Genesareti.
Wakabona maato obile kagwisigilwe kunkomwe ya lwizi. Basikuzuba nswi bakali bazwa mulingawo bakali kusanzya tunsabwe twabo.
Jesu wakanjila mulilimwi lya bwaato, ilyakali lya Sayimoni , akumukumbila kuti aligwisye kuzwa mumanzi kwamusinzo mufwifwi anyika. Alimwi wakakkala ansi akuyiisya bantu anze abwaato.
Awo nakamana kwambuula, wakati kuli Sayimoni, ''Bweeza bwato ububike mumanzi uwaale mansabwe kuti uche.''
Sayimoni wakasandula wati, ''Mwaami, twabeleka busiku boonse pesi takwe nchitwajata, pesi mujwi lyako, ndilawala mansabwe.
Lino nibakachita oobo, bakabungika nswi nyinji, a nsabwe zyabo zyakalikudeluka.
Mpawo bakobola benziina bakali muli bumwi bwaato kuti baboole akuzobagwasya. Bakasika akuzuzya maato obile, alimwi batalika kubbila.
Aboobo Sayimoni Pita, nakachibona wakawida kumawulu a Jesu, wati, ''Kozwa kulindime nkaambo ndimwaalumi uuchita zibi, Mwaami.''
Nkaambo wakagamba, aboonse mbakali aabo,  kunswi nzibakajata eezyo nzibakatola.
Eechi chakabikkilizya Jemusi a Joni, bana ba Zebediya, bakali basimulimunyina a Sayimoni. Jesu wakati kuli Sayimoni, ''Utayoowi nkaambo kuzwa sunu kuya kunembo uyozuba bantu.''
Nibakeeta maato aabo kunze, bakasiya zyoonse akutomubela.
Chakachita kuti nakali kuli limwinya dolopo mwaalumi wakazwide chipele wakali mo. Elyo nakamubona Jesu, wakawida kubusyu bwakwe akumukumbila, wati, ''Mwaami, kuti wayanda kondi salazya.''
Mpawo Jesu wakatambika janza lyakwe wamujata, wati "Ndilayanda kosalala." Mpawaawo chipele chakamusiya.

Wakamulayila kuti atawambili naba omwe, mpawo  wakamwambila kuti, ''Yinka munzila yako, ukalitondezye kumupayizyi ukatuule chipayizyo chakusalazigwa kwako, mbuli mbwakalailila Mozesi bube bukamboni kuli mbabo."
Pele impuwo atala anguwe yakiinka kule, elyo makamu abantu akasika antoomwe kuti amvwe kuyisya kwakwe akuponisigwa kumalwazi aabo.
Pesi we wakanoonga waya kumasena asisikene kuyookomba.

Kwati limwi zuba kuli eecho chiindi naakali kuyiisya, kwakali baFalisi abayisyi bamulawu bakali kkede aawo, bakazwide kumasena miingi amu Galili, Judiya aku Jelusalema. Nguzu zya Mwami zyakali anguwe zyakuponia.
Nkabela bamwi baalumi bakaza babwezede umwi mwaalumi aabulo wakayuminide mubili, bakayandula nzila yakumunjizya mukati kuti bamubike aansi kunembo a Jesu.
Tebakajana nzila yakumweeta mukati akambo kamakamu, lino bakinka aachiluli chang'anda baseluzya mwalumi achiluli abulo bwakwe, akati lyabantu kunembo lya Jesu.
Naakabona lusyomo lwabo, Jesu wakati, ''Yomwaalumi zibi zyako zyalekelelwa.''
Lino balembi bamulawu aba Falisizi bakatalika kubuzya bakati, ''Ngwani oyo waambula chakusampawula ngwani ukonzya kulekelela zibi kunze kwa Leza alikke?
Pesi Jesu, wakabona mbubakali kuyeeya, wakasandula wati kuli mbabo, ''Nkaamboonzi nimulibuzya mumyoyo yanu?
Nchichili chuuba kwaamba kuti, 'Zibi zyako zyako zyalekelelwa akwaamba kuti nyampuka uyende?'
Pele kuti mukazibe kuti mwana wamuntu ulaanguzu aanyika zyakulekelela zibi, ndati kuli nduwe, ''Nyampuka bweza bulo bwako uye kung'anda yako.''
Mpawaawo wakabuka kunembo lyabo wabweza bulo bwakwe mpaakalede. Mpawo wakiinka kung'anda yakwe, kayabulumbayizya Leza.
Boonse bakagamba mpawo balumbaizya Leza. Bakazuzigwa buyoofu bati, ''Twabona zintu zyiindilide sunu.''
Musule lyazezi zyakachitika, Jesu wakazwa wayinka eelyo wakabona simutelo uutegwa Levi kakkede aatente lyabasimutelo. Wakati kuli nguwe, ''Nditobele.''
Mpawo Levi wakabuka wamutobela wasiya zyoonse musule.
Nkabela Levi wakachitila Jesu pobwe pati mung'anda yakwe, kwakaliko basimutelo biingi abantu bakakkede aabo aatafula kuti  balye ambabo
pesi ba Falisi bakalikutongawukila basikwiiya bakwe kabati, "Nkaamboonzi nalya abasimutelo abasizibi?"
Jesu wakabasandula wati, "Bantu batachiswi tabayandi musilisi, pesi luzutu aabo bachiswa.
Tendakazida baluleme pesi aabo basizibi kuti basanduke."
Bakati kulinguwe, "Basikwiiya ba Joni bakalikulyiimya kulya akukomba abasikwiiya baba Falisi bachita mbubo. Pesi basikwiiya bako balalya akunywa."
Mpawo Jesu wakati kulimbabo, "Mpali na uukonzya kwaamba kulibasikutambwa kupobwe kuti balyiimye chakulya sikukwata kachiliwo?
Pesi buzosika buzuba aawo sikukwata natazo bwezwe kuzwa kulimbabo, kumazuba aayo bazolyimya."

Lino Jesu wakaamba chikozyanisyo kulimbabo. "Taakwe naba omwe uudelula chigamba chachisamo chipya akuchibelesya aachisamo chikulukulu. Kuti wachita oobo uladeluula chisamo chipya. Lino chigamba chizwa kuchisamo chipya tachikonzyi kweelela kuchisamo chikulukulu.
Taakwe uubika wayini mupya muchibikilo chachiindi. Kuti wachita oobo wayini mupya ulabbalula chibikilo. Lino wayini ooyo uyoofusuka alimwi chibikilo achilacho chilanyonyooka.
Pele wayini mupya welede kubikwa muchibikilo chipya chakubikila wayini.
Taakwe naba omwe uunywa wayini mukulukulu uuyanda kunywa wayini mupya, uwamba kuti wachiindi ulimbubo.
Lino zyakachitika muSabata awo Jesu nakalikuyabweenda akwiinda akati kamyuunda yazilyo, alimwi basikwiya bakwe bakabweza nseke zyazilyo, kabapukapuka akati kamaboko abo, akulya.
Pele bamwi babaFalisi bakati, ''Nkaamboonzi nimuchita chitali mumulawu mubuzuba bwaSabata?''
Wakasandula Jesu wakati, ''Sa  tamunabala eezyo nzyakachita Davita awo naakaba aanzala, mwini ambakali abo?

Wakanjila mung'anda yaLeza alimwi wabweza chinkwa chisalala mpawo walya chisela, alimwi wapa chimwi kuli baabo mbakalabo kuti balye, nikuba chakalimumulawu luzutu kuti bapayizi abalikke bachilye.'' Mpawo wakati kulimbabo,
''Mwana a Muntu ngoMwami waSabata.''
Zyakachitika kuti imwi Sabata wakanjila muchikombelo chamaJuda wayisya bantu. Mumoomo mwakali mwalumi wakali akuboko kwachilisyo kwakayumide.
Balembi bamulawo abaFalisi bakamulangisisya kuyanda kubona kuti ulaponya umwi na muSabata, kuti bamujanine kaambo kakumupa mulandu.
Pele wakalizizi nzibakali kuyeeye alimwi wakati kumwalumi wakali akuboko kuyumide, ''Nyampuka mpawo wiimikile akati kaboonse.'' Aboobo wakanyampuka wayimikila aawo.
Jesu wakati kulimbabo, ''Ndamubuzya, chili mumulawu na muSabata kuchita bubotu na bubi kuvuna buumi na kujaya?''
Mpawo wakalangalanga kuli boonse wasikuti kumwaalumi, ''Tandibika luboko lwako.'' Wakachita mbubo, alimwi lwakatalamuka.''
Pesi bakazula kunyema abasikwaambilana kuti bamuchite buti Jesu.
Zyakachitika mumazuba aayo mpakayinka kuchilundu kukukomba. Wakiinkila kunembo mansiku woonse mukukomba kuli Leza.
Nibwakacha, wakayita basikwiya bakwe kulinguwe, alimwi wakasala bali kkumi ababili, aabo mbakati mbatumwa.
Mazina abatumwa mbaba Sayimoni (oyo ngwakati Pita) a mukulana wakwe Endulu, Jemusi, Joni, Filipu, Bbatolomiyo,
Matayo, Tomasi, Jemusi mwana wa Alufiyasi, Sayimoni walikutegwa muZiloti,
Judasi Sikkaliyoti, wakazoba sikwaaba Jesu.
Pele Jesu wakaseluka kuzwa kuchilundu ambakali aabo mpawo wiimikila antandabale amakamu mapati abasikwiya bakwe a bantu biingi bazwa kuJudiya a kuJelusalema akunkomwe yalwizi lwaTaya a Sidoni.
Bakaza kuzoswiilila kulinguwe akuponesegwa zilwazi zyabo. Bantu bakali kukatazigwa amyuuya mibi bakaponesegwa abalabo.
Woonse wakali munkamu wakali kweezya kumuguma nkambo manguzu akuponya akali kuzwa mulinguwe, alimwi wakabaponya boonse.
Mpawo wakalanga kulibasikwiiya bakwe alimwi wati, ''Mulilongezedwe nywebo nobachete, nkambo bwami bwaLeza mbubwanu.
Mulilongezedwe nywebo nimufwa nzala, nkambo muyokkutisigwa. Mulilongezedwe nimulila lino, nkambo muyooseka.
Mulilongezedwe nywebo nimuyosulwa abantu, alimwi bayomusaamika akumusampawula, akaambo kaMwana waMuntu.
Mukabotelwe mubuzuba oobo akusotoka mulukondo, nkambo chakasimpe muyooba ampindu mpati kujulu, nkaambo basikale babo bakajisi basinsimi munzila ilibobu.
Pele chabija kulindinywe nibavubi, nkaambo mwatambula kale luumbulizyo lwanu.
Chabija kulindinywe nimukkusi lino, nkaambo muyooba anzala, chabija kulindinywe nimuseka lino, nkaambo muyolila akukwiila muchindi chitobela.
Chabija kulindinywe na woonse muntu kawamba bubotu andinywe, nkaambo mbubo basikalebabo mbubakabajisi basinsimi bakubeja.
Pele ndati kulindinywe nimulikuswilizya, yanda basinkondonyokwe alimwi muchite zibotu kulimbabo bamusula.
Mulongezye baabo bamutuka alimwi mukombele aabo bamusukuusya.
Kuli wooyo ukuuma seya mupe lubo alimbi. Na umwi muntu wabweza chibaki chaajulu utamwiimi chakunsi.
Pa kumuntu woonse uukukumbila. Na umwi muntu wabweza chintu chako utamwaambili kuti achiboozye kulinduwe.
Mbuli mboyanda kuti bantu bakuchitile weelede kubachtila ayebo mbuboobo.
Na wayanda luzutu aabo bakuyanda mbulumbuunzi buli kulinduwe? Nkaambo nikuba abasizibi balabayanda aabo babayanda.
Na wachitila kabotu aabo bakuchitila kabotu, zikugwasyanzi? Nkaambo abalabo basizibi balazichita eezyo.
Na kogwasya biyo aabo bakonzya kukubweedezya nzuwabapa, chikugwasyayi? Nkaambo basizibi abalabo balapa basizibinyina, kuti bajane mpindu ikozyenie.

Pesi muyande basinkondonyokwe mubachitile zibotu. Mupegwe mutalangili kupegwa lubo aboobo mpindu yenu iyooba mpati alimwi muyooba bana ba Simajulu, nkaambo we lwakwe uli aaluyando nikuba akulaabo batakwe luyando abasizibi.
Mube aaluzya nkaambo Wuso alakwe ulaaluzyalo.
Mutabeteki, alimwi tamkoyobetekwa. Mutapi mulandu, alimwi tamukoyoopegwa mulandu. Mukalekelele bamwi, alimwi muyolekelelwa.
Pa, alimwi chiyoopegwa kulinduwe. Cheelelo chibotezya - chisindiidwe akuzula chakufusuuka - chiyootiliilwa aazibelo zyako. Nkaambo mweelo ngobelesya nguwonya uyoobelesegwa kulinduwe."
Mpawo wakabaambila lubo chimbi chikozyanisyo. "Sa muntu moofu ulakonzya na kukwela moofunyina? Na wachita boobo, bobile te balawida mugolonga, anga tabakoowida na?
Sikwiiya takomeneni muyiisyi wakwe pe, pesi woonse kuti wayiisigwa ulamba mbuli muyiisyi wakwe.
