Mulalobya ijwi lya Leza nkaambo katunsiyansiya twanu ntumwakabamba. Alimwi mulachita zintu zyiingi zilimbuli eezyo.”
Mpawo Jesu wakayita makamu makamu wati kulimbabo, “Amundiswilizye, moonse, mumvwisisisye.
Takwe chili kunze amuntu chikonzya kumuninaania na chanjila mulinguwe pe. Chininaania muntu ncheecho chizwa mukati mumoyo wamuntu.”
Jesu kali wasiya makamu makamu, akunjila mung'anda, basikwiiya bakwe bakamubuzya aatala achikozyano eechi.
Jesu wakati, “Tamunaaba akumvwisisisya pe?” Tamubwene na kuti taakwe chinjila mumuntu chili kunze kwamuntu chinga chilamuninaania chanjila mukati mulinguwe,  mbukunga
tachinjili mumoyo wakwe pe, pesi mubula biyo mpawo chazwa kunze.” Mukwaamba oobu Jesu wakasalazya zyakulya zyoonse.
Wakati, “Chizwa mumuntu nchechichita kuti aninaane.
Nkaambo mukati kamyoyo yabantu, mumuzwa mizeezo mibi, busofwaazi muli zyamalale, kubba, bujayi,
bwamu, bwaanka, luuni, lweeno, cheendwe, ibbivwe, kubejelezya, kulisumpula abufubafuba.
Zibi eezi zyoonse zizwa mumoyo,  nzizininaania muntu.”
Wakanyampuka aabusena oobo akuya kuchlikiti cha chaTaya aSidon. Wakanjila mung'anda alimwi taakayanda kuti bantu, naba omwe bazibe mpabede, nekuba boobo wakakachilwa kuyuba kuti bantu batamuboni.
Mpawo aawo umwi mwanakazi wakali aamwana wakanjidwe muuya uusofweede, mbaakamvwa biyo aatala aJesu wakaza wawida kumawulu aakwe.
Mwanakazi ooyu wakali wamusyobo wabaGilikki wakazyalilwa kuSiliya Fonisiya. Wakakumbila Jesu kuti atande muuya mubi uzwe mumwana wakwe.
Wakamwaambila wati, “Weelede kulekela bana kuti balye saansi. Nkaambo tachili kabotu pe kubweza chakulya chabana mpawo usowele bankala.”
Pesi wakamuvwiila wati, “Iiyi, Mwami, nekuba boobo abalabo bankala balabwezelela bumbulumbulu bulosya bana munsi lyatafula.”
Mpawo wakamwaambila kuti, “Mbuwasandula oobo, enda biyo, muuya mubi wazwa kale mumwana wako.”
Mpawo wakajokela kung'anda wajana mwana ulilede aabulo, muuya mubi kuuli wazwa kale.
Lino Jesu wakazwa kubusena bwaTaya wakeenda wayinda muSidoni, katozya kulwizi lwaGalili mpawo wanjila muchilikiti chaDekkapolisi.
Ooku, bamwi bantu bakamweetela mwaalumi musinkematwi kali sichilimilimi, mpawo bakamukumbila kuti amubikke kuboko kwakwe amuponia.
Wakamubweza wakamugwisya mubantu biingi wamutola kumbali, wakamunjizya minwe mumatwi. naakaswida wamudompa alulimi.
Mpawo wakalungumana walanga kujulu, watula choyo, wati kulinguwe, “Efifata,” nkukwaamba kuti, “Sinkuka!”.
Nizyakachitwa eezi mwaalumi uulya akasinkuka matwi aakwe, alulimi lwakwe lwakaangunuka mpawo watanguna kwaambuula kabotu.
Wakabalayilila kuti bataambili bantu. Pesi naakanoonga wabalayilila oobu, bantu nibakayindilila loko kwaambuula azyakachitika.
Bantu bakazula kugamba kabaamba kuti, “Uchita kabotu loko muzintu zyoonse. Ulaponia basinkematwi abasichilimilimi.”
Kumazuba aayo, kwakaba lubo bantu bayingi loko, alimwi kabatajisi   chakulya. Jesu wakayita basikwiiya bakwe mpawo wakati kulimbabo,
''Ndabeetelela bantu aaba nkaambo baba aamazuba aatatu katuli amwi kale alimwi tabakwe chakulya.
Ndabambila kuti kabaya kumyuunzi yabo kaatakwe nchibalya, bayoowizuka munzila. Bamwi babo bazwa musinzo mulamfu''.
Basikwiiya bakwe bakamusandula, ''Nkookuli nkotuyoojana chinkwa chizulide  chiyookkutya bantu aaba, mubusena butakwe chintu buliboobu?''
Wakababuzya, ''Mujisi zinkwa zyongana?'' Bakaamba kuti, ''Musanu azibili''.
Wakalayilila nkamu kuti ikkale aansi. Wakabweza zinkwa musanu azibili, wakapa kulumba alimwi wakazikwamuna. Wakapa basikwiiya bakwe kuti bape bantu, alimwi bakabapa bantu.
Bakalijisi lubo nswi nche. Naakamana kubalumbila, wakalayilila basikwiiya kuti baabe azeezi lubo.
Bakalya bakkuta, mpawo bakabwezelela  bufwefwelenga bwakachaala, zizuma zipati zilimusanu azibili.
Kwakali bantu bakonzya kuba zyuulu zyone.
Mpawo wakabaambila kuti bamwayike. Nibakanjila mubwaato abasikwiiya bakwe, bakaya kuchisi chakuDayimanuta.
Mpawo baFalisi bakazwida aanze batalika kumukazya. Bakakumbila zitondeezyo zyakujulu, kabamusunka.
Wakagamba kapati weefula, wati, ''Nkaamboonzi izyalane eli niliyandula zitondezyo? Nchobeni ndamwambila kuti, taakwe chitondeezyo chiyoopegwa kuzyalane eli''.
Mpawo wakabasiya, wanjila lubo mubwaato, wabweeda mutala eeliya.
Lino basikwiiya bakaluba kubweza chinkwa. Tebakachilikwe chinkwa nikuba chomwe mubwaato.
Wakabalayilila wakati, ''Amuchenjele kubumena bwabaFalisi akubumena bwaHelodi''.
Basikwiiya bakabonisyania umwi awumwi, ''Nkaambo kakuti tatukwe chinkwa?''.
Jesu wakaziziba eezi, wakati kuli mbabo, ''Nkaamboonzi nimulikubonisyania aatala akubula chinkwa? Sa tamunaakubona? Tamumvwisisisyi na? Teemujatilakule makani ngendimwaambila?
Meso mulijisi, tamuboni na? Matwi muli aawo, tamumvwi na? Sa tamwiibalukwi?
nindakakwamuna zinkwa zilimusanu aakati kabantu balizyuulu zilimusanu, nzingana zizuma zyakazula zyabufwefwelenga bwazinkwa nzimwakabwezelela? Bakati kulinguwe, ''Ikkumi azibili.
''Nindakakwamuna zinkwa zilimusanu azibili aakati kabantu balizyuulu zyone, nzingana zizuma zyabufwefwelenga bwazinkwa nzimwakabweza?'' Bakati kulinguwe, ''Musanu azibili''.
Wakati, ''Sa tamunakumvwisisisya na?''
Bakasika kuBetisayida. Bantu bankuko bakamwetela umwi mwalumi mofu alimwi bakakumbila Jesu kuti amugume.
Jesu wakamujata kuboko mwaalumi mofu, akwiinka aawe aanze eegunzi. Lino wakamuswida mate aamenso aakwe akumubika maboko, wabuzya kuti, ''Kuli ncholiikubona na?''
Wakalanga kujulu wakati, Ndabona baalumi balangika aanga misamu iliikweenda.
Alimwi wakabika lubo maanza aatala ameso aakwe, aboobo mwaalumi wakabona, menso aakwe akapona, akubona zintu zyoonse kabotu.
Jesu wakamutuma wakati koya kumuunzi wenu, ''Utakanjili mudolopo pe''.
Jesu wakiinka abasikwiiya bakwe mugunzi lyaKayisala Filipo. Kabachili munzila wakabuzya basikwiiya bakwe, ''Bantu bandaamba kuti ndimeni?''
Bakamusandula bakati, ''Joni muBbizyi. Bamwi baamba kuti Elayija, alimwi bamwi bati nduwe uumwi wabasinsimi''.
Wakababuzya beni, ''Pesi nywebo mundaamba kuti ndimeni?'' Pita wakati kulinguwe, ''Nduwe Kkilisito''
Jesu wakabalayilila kuti batambili nikuba omwi muntu aatala anguwe.
Wakasanguna kubayiisya aatala akuti Mwana waMuntu uyoofwabisigwa muzintu zyiingi, alimwi uyookakwa abapati, akubapayizi bapati akubalembi, akuyoojayigwa, pesi mumazuba aatatu uyoobuka.
Wakaamba makani aaya oobotu oobotu. Mpawo Pita wakamutola kumbali akumukalalila
Pesi Jesu wakachebuka akulanga basikwiiya bakwe mpawo wakakalalila Pita wakati, ''Kozwa kusule lyangu, Satani! Tobikide miyeeyo yako kuzintu zyaLeza pe, pesi kuzintu zyabantu''.
Mpawo wakayita makamu abasikwiiya antoomwe, wakabaambila kuti, ''Na kuli umwi uyanda kunditobela weelede kulitakata lwakwe mwini, abweze chingano chakwe, akunditobela
Kufumbwa uyanda kufutula buumi bwakwe uyoobusweekelwa, ayooyo usweekelwa buumi bwakwe akuyanda kwangu akujwi lyangu uyoobujana.
Chimugwasyaanzi  muntu kuvuba nyika yoonse pesi akasweekelwe buumi bwakwe?
Tachiwo pe muntu nchanga uleelanisya aabuumi bwakwe?
Kufumbwa ufwa bweeme akaambo kangu amajwi angu muzyalane eeli lyabumambe achibi, Mwana waMuntu uyoowusigwa bweeme anguwe aakusika mubulemu bwaWisi antoomwe abangelo basalala''.
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Nchobeni ndati kuli ndinywe, mpubali bamwi benu bayimvwi aawa batakabule kufwa pe kabatanaabona Bwami bwaLeza kabusika anguzu.
Nikwakayinda mazuba aalimusanu alimwi, Jesu wakabweza Pita, Jemusi aJoni wakeenda ambabo aatala achilundu chipati, lwabo abalike. Mpawo wakasanduka kunembo lyabo.
Zyakusama zyakwe zyakamwekesya, zyakatubisisya, kwiinda kutubya batubya nkubanga balatubya aako.
Mpawo Elayija kali aMozesi wakalibonia kulimbabo alimwi wakalikwaambuula aJesu.
Pita wakasandula akwaamba kuti kuliJesu, ''Muyiisyi, nchibotu kuba aano toonse, atuyake zilawu zyotatwe, chimwi chibe chako, chimwi chibe chaMozesi alimwi chimwi chibe chaElayija''.
(Taakachichizi pe chakwaamba, nkaambo bakali bayoowa).
Ijoba lyakasika akubavumba. Mpawo ijwi lyakazwa mujoba kaliti, ''Ooyu ngomwana wangu ngundiyandisya. Amumuswiilile''.
Aboobo, nibakalangalanga, bakabona kakutachikwe muntu akati kabo pe kunze Jesu alikke.
Nibakalikuya buseluka kuzwa achilundu, wakabalayilila kuti tabeelede kwaambila naba omwe anzibakabona kusikila Mwana waMuntu akabuke kuzwa kubafu.
Aboobo bakaabamba makani aayai, pesi bakalikuzuwisyania chabo chabo zikonzya kwaamba ''Kubuka kuzwa kubafu''.
Bakamubuzya, ''Nkaamboonzi balembi nibakati Elayija nguyelede kutalika kusika?''
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Elayija ulelede kutalika kusika kuzoobambulula zintu zyoonse. Lino nkaamboonzi nikulembedwe kuti Mwana waMuntu weelede kufwabisigwa kuzintu zyiingi akunyonganisigwa?
Pesi ndamwaambila kuti Elayija wakasika, bakachita kufumbwa nzibayanda kuchita alinguwe mbuli mbukulembedwe aatala anguwe''.
Mpawo nibakasika kuli basikwiiyanyina, bakabona nkamu mpati yakabazyungulikide, abalembi bakali kukazyania aabo.
Lino nibakabona Jesu, makamu woonse akagamba nibakamuchijanina bakamujuzya.
Wakabuzya basikwiiya bakwe, ''Muliikukazyaniaanzi ambabo?''
Umwi wakalinkamu wakasandula, ''Muyiisyi, ndeeta mwana wangu kulinduwe ulaamuuya umuchitya kuti ataambuuli pe.
Umumana manguzu akumuwunsizya aansi akuzwa fulu mumulomo, ngawayuma ntwiino, akuyuma mubili. Ndakakumbila basikwiiya bako kuti bamugusye pesi bakakachilwa''.
Wakabasandula, ''Nozyalane litasyomi, ndakkala andinywe kwachiindi chillamfu buti? Ndiyoomukazikila moyo kusikila lili? Mumweete ookuno''
Bakamweta mulombe kulinguwe. Kuchiindi muuya nuwakabona Jesu, mpawo aawo wakamuwisya wamugwigwimya. Mulombe wakawida aansi akuzwa fulu mumulomo.
Jesu wakabuzya wisi, ''Kwaba chiindi chilamfu biyeni kazichitikana?'' Wisi wakati, ''Kuzwa kachili mwanikenike''.
Chimuwisizya mumulilo na mumaanzi akweezya kumujaya. Na kokonzya kuchita kufumbwa, tufwide luzyalo utugwasye''.
Jesu wakati kulinguwe, ''Na kosyoma, zyoonse zintu zilakonzeka kuliyooyo usyoma!''
Mpawo wisi wamwana wakalila akwaamba kuti, ''Ndilasyoma! kondigwasya kutasyoma kwangu!''

Jesu naakabona makamu kabachijanina kulimbabo, wakatanda ooyu muuya uusofweede akwaamba kuti, ''nomuuya wasyataambi, amuuya musinkamatwi ndakulayilila akukwaambila kuti, zwa mulinguwe, utazoonjili limbi mulinguwe''.
Lyakalila akugwigwimya mulombe akuzwa mulinguwe. Mulombe wakalangika mbuli uufwide, biingi bakati, ''wafwa''.
Pesi Jesu wakamujata kuboko wamunyampula mpawo mulombe wakayimikila.
Jesu naakasika mung'anda, basikwiiya bakamubuzya chakusisikizya, ''Nkaamboonzi nitwatawutanda?''
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Eezi zyamusyobo ooyu tazitandiki pe, pesi akukomba''.
Bakeenda kuzwa awo akwiinda muGalili. Takalikuyanda pe kuti bazibinkane nkubakabede,

nkaambo wakalikuyiisya basikwiiya bakwe. Wakati kulimbabo, ''Mwana waMuntu uyoopendekezegwa mumaboko aabantu, alimwi bayoomujaya. Aakujayigwa, kuyooyinda mazuba aatatu mpawo uyoobuka lubo kuzwa kubafu.
Pesi tebakazimvwisisisya pe nzyakalikwaamba, alimwi bakalikuyoowa kumubuzya.
Mpawo nibakasika kuKkapenawumi. Mpawo naakanjila mung'anda wakababuzya, Mwalikwaambaanzi munzila?''
Pesi bakawumuna. Mbulikuti bakalibuyobukazyania umwi awumwi amweenzinyina kabali munzila aatala akuti ngwani mupati.

Naakakkala aansi, wakayita basikwiiya bakwe balikkumi ababili kabali boonse alimwi wakati kulimbabo, ''Na kuli uyanda kuba wakusanguna, weelede kuba wakumaninsizya kuli boonse akuba mulanda waboonse''.
Wakabweza mwana muniini wamubika aakati kabo. Wakamubweza akumubika aamakuko aakwe alimwi wakati kulimbabo,
''Kufumbwa utambula mwana ooyu muzina lyangu watambula ndime, kufumbwa ooyo unditambula tatambuli ndime pesi utambula ooyo wakandituma''.
Joni wakati, ''Muyiisyi, twabona umwi katanda myuuya mibi munzina lyako alimwi twamukasya, nkaambo tatutobeli pe''.
Pesi Jesu wakati, ''Mutamukasyi, mbulikuti taakwe utakachite milimu mipati muzina lyangu kuzwa mpawo akaambuule zibi aatala andime.
Kufumbwa utatulwani nguwesu.
Kufumbwa ukupa nkomeki yamaanzi kuti unywe muzina lyangu nkaambo uli waKilisito, nchobeni ndamwaambila kuti, takoyooyisweekelwa mpindu yakwe.
Kufumbwa uchita kuti umwi wabaaba baniini bandisyoma kuti balebwe, kunooli nkubotu kulinguwe kuti aangililwe nkando yebbwe munsingo akuwaalilwa mulwizi.
Na kuboko kwako kwakubisizya, kudunsule. Nchibotu kunjila mubwami bwakubotelwa kwiinda kuba amaboko abili pesi waakuwaalilwa mubbibi lyamulilo utazimi.
ooko nkonye zyabo nkuzitafwi amulilo nkuutazimi.
Na kuulu kwako kwakuchita kuti ubisye, kudunsule. Nchibotu kunjila mubuumi bwakubotelwa kuli chilema kwiinda kuba amawulu abili pesi waakuwaalilwa mubbibi lyamulilo.
ooko nkonye zyabo nkuzitafwi amulilo nkuutazimi.
Na linso lyako lyakuchita kuti ubisye, linonkole. Nchibotu kunjila mubwami bwakujulu alinso limwi kwiinda kuba amenso aabili pesi waakuwaalilwa mubbibi lyamulilo,
ooko nkonye zyabo nkuzitafwi amulilo nkuutazimi.
Nkaambo woonse muntu uyoolungwa amulilo.
Munyo mubotu, pesi na munyo wasampuka, ulachitwa biyeni kuti ulweele lubo? Amulungane aakati kenu nobeni, alimwi mube aalumuno kuli umwi awumwi''.
Jesu naakazwa kubusena oobo wakaya kuchisi chakuJudiya akubusena bwamutala aamulonga Jodani, alimwi bantu biingi bakaza lubo kulinguwe. Wakali kubayiisya lubo, mbuli mbaakali kuchita lubbe.
Mpawo baFalisi bakaza kulinguwe kuzoomusunka alimwi bakamubuzya kuti, ''Chili mumulawu na kuti mwaalumi aleke banakwe?'' Wakabasandula wati,
''Wakamulayililaanzi Mozesi?''
Bakati, ''Mozesi wakazuminina mwaalumi kulemba lugwalo lwakulekana alimwi akumubweedezya kulimbabo''.
''Nkuyuma kwamyoyo yenu chakapa kuti alembe mulawo ooyu'', Jesu wakabaambila kuti.
''Pesi kuzwa kumatalikilo aakulenga, 'Leza wakabalenga, mwaalumi amwanakazi".
''Akaambo kaako mwaalumi uyoosiya wisi abanyina akakamantane abanakwe,
alimwi bobile bayooba nyama yomwe! Aboobo tabachili bobile pe, baba nyama yomwe''.
Aboobo Leza nzyaaswaanizya antoomwe, kutakabi muntu uzyaanzania pe''.
Aawo nibakali mung'anda, basikwiiya bakamubuzya lubo aatala achechi.
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Kufumbwa uuleka mwanakazi akukwata umbi walichita mumambi akubisizya ngwaaleka.
Na mukayintu waleka mulumi wakwe wakwatwa awumbi mwaalumi, wachita bumambi''.
Mpawo bakamweetela bana babo baniini kuti abagume, pesi basikwiiya bakabakalalila.
Pesi Jesu naakazibona, teezyakamubotezya pe alimwi wakati kulimbabo, ''Muzumizye bana baze kulindime, mutabakasyi, nkaambo bwami bwaLeza mbubwabo baliboobo.
Chakasimpe ndamwaambila kuti, kufumbwa muntu utatambuli bwami bwaLeza mbuli mwana muniini takonzyi kuyoobunjila pe''.
Mpawo wakabanyampula bana alimwi wabalongezya akubika maanza akwe aalimbabo.
Naakatalisya lweendo lwakwe, umwi mwaalumi wakachijaana wazoofugama kunembo lyakwe alimwi wabuzya, ''Muyiisyi mubotu, ndichite buti kuti ndikajane buumi butamani?''
Jesu wakati, ''Nkaamboonzi nonditi "mubotu"? Tawo pe mubotu naba omwe kunze kwaLeza alike.
Uliizi milawo: 'Utajayi, utachiti bumambi, utabbi, utabejelezyi umwi, utabbi chakweenena, lemeka uso abanyoko.''
Mwaalumi wakati, ''Muyiisyi, zyoonse eezi zintu ndakazitobelezya kuzwa kandichili mukubusi''.
Jesu wakamulanga alimwi wamuyanda. Wakati kulinguwe, ''Uchisyeede aachintu chomwe. Weelede kuuzya zyoonse nzoli aazyo alimwi upe kubachete, eelyo uyoojana buvubi kujulu. Mpawo usike, unditobele''.
Pesi akaambo kamakani aaya wakawusa kapati alimwi wakayinka kawuside, nkaambo wakavubide loko.
Jesu wakalangalanga mpawo wakati kulibasikwiiya bakwe, ''Nchiyumu buti kubavubi kunjila mubwami bwaLeza!''
Basikwiiya bakagamba kumajwi akwe.
Pesi Jesu wakabaambila lubo, ''Nobana, nchuuba kuti nkamela yiinde mumpako yenaliti kwiinda muvubi kuti anjile mubwami bwaLeza''.
Bakagamba kapati alimwi baambilana kuti, ''Ngwani unga ulakonzya kufutulwa?''
Jesu wakabalanga alimwi wati, ''Kubantu tachikonzeki, pesi kuliLeza chilakonzeka. Nkaambo zintu zyoonse zilakonzeka aLeza''.
Pita wakatalika kwaambuula kulinguwe, ''Bona, twasiya zyoonse twakutobela''.
Jesu wakati, ''Nchobeni ndamwaambila, taakwe pe wasiya ng'anda na banyandumi na bachizi na banyina na bana na myuunda akaambo kangu alimwi akaambo kamakani mabotu,
uutakabule kutambula zyiindulwidwe mwaanda munyika oomuno lino: ng'anda abanyandumi abachizi amamama abana asmyuunda, antoomwe akupenzegwa, mpawo munyika iitobela, buumi butamani.
Pesi biingi balikumatangunino bayooba bakumamanino, mpawo bakumamanino, bataanzi''.

Bakali mumugwagwa kabatansya kuJelusalema, Jesu kazulwide . Basikwiiya bakagamba, alimwi abaabo bakali kutobela musule bakayoowa. Mpawo Jesu wakabweza bali kkumi ababili wabatola kumbali alubo watalika kubaambila zizoochitikana kulinguwe kuchiindi chitobela afwiifwi.
''Amubone, tuyobutansya kuJelusalema, alimwi Mwana waMuntu uyoowabwa kubapayizi bapati abalembi. Bayoomupa mulandu walufu akumwaaba kulibamasi.
Bayoomusyonsya, bayoomuswida mate, bayoomuuma, alimwi bakamujaye. Pesi kwiinda mazuba aatatu uyoobuka".
Jemusi aJoni, bana baZebbedi, bakaza kulinguwe bati, ''Muyiisyi, tuyanda kuti mutuchitile kufumbwa nzituyoomukumbila''.
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Niinzi nchimuyanda kuti ndikamuchitile?''
Bakati, ''Tuzumizye kuti tukakkale anduwe mubulemu bwako, umwi kuchilisyo umwi kuchimweensi.''
Pesi Jesu wakabasandula, ''Tamuchizi nchimuliikukumbila pe. Mulakonzya na kunywa nkomeki njesikanywe na kukakatila kulubbizyo ndwesikabbizigwe aalo?''
Bakati kulinguwe, ''Tulakonzya.'' Jesu wakati kulimbabo, ''Nkomeki njesikanywe, muyooyinywa, alimwi lubbizyo ndwesikabbizigwe aalo, anywebo muyolubbizigwa.
Pesi kuti utakakkale kuchilisyo na kuchimweensi ngwani teensi ndime uuzyaamba pe, pesi nkukwabaabo bakubambilidwe.''
Aawo bamwi balikkumi nibakamvwa eecho, bakatalika kunyemena Jemusi aJoni.
Jesu wakabayita kulinguwe wati, ''Mulizi aabo baambwa kuti mbeendelezi babamasi balabalemezya, alimwi basilutwe babo balatondeezya manguzu aabo alimbabo.
Pesi tazikoyooba mbubo pe akati kenu. Kufumbwa uuyanda kuba mupati akati kenu weelede kuba mulanda wenu,
alimwi kufumbwa uuyanda kuba mutanzi akati kenu weelede kuba muzike waboonse
Nkaambo Mwana waMuntu taakazida kuzookutawukilwa pe, pesi kuzookutawukila, alimwi akupa buumi bwakwe kuti azoowangunune biingi.''
Bakasika kuJelikko. Kachizwa muJelikko abasikwiiya bakwe ankamu mpati, mwana waTimiyasi, Bbatimiyasi, moofu sikukumbila, wakalikkede kumbali amugwagwa.
Naakamvwa kuti nguJesu muNazalini, wakatalika koompolola wati, ''Jesu Mwana waDeviti, ndifwide luzyalo!''
Biingi bakamuniakiizya mwaalumi moofu, bamwaambila kuti awumune. Pesi wakompolola changuzu, ''Mwana waDeviti, ndifwide luzyalo!''
Jesu wakayimikila alimwi wabalayilila kuti bamwiite. Bakamwiita mwaalumi moofu, bati, ''Sima! Nyampuka! Uliikukwiita.''
Wakasowela aansi chikobela chakwe, wavundumuka alimwi wasika kuliJesu.
Jesu wakamusandula wati, ''Niinzi nchuyanda kuti ndikuchitile?'' Mwaalumi moofu wakati, ''Muyiisyi ndiyanda kubona.''
Mpawo Jesu wakati kulinguwe, ''Koya. Lusyomo lwako lwakuponia.'' Mpawo aawo wakabona lubo, alimwi wakamutobela mumugwagwa.
Nibakasika kuJelusalemu kabali aafwiifwi akuBbetipeji aBbetani akuChilundu chitegwa chamaOlivi, Jesu wakatuma basikwiiya bakwe bobile,
wakati kuli mbabo, “Amwiinke kugunzi lilikunembo lyenu. Mbumutakanjile biyo, muyoojana mwana wedonki waangidwe nkuko, utanaabelesegwa anaba womwe muntu. Mukamwaangunune mumweete okuno.
Na kwaba uyoomubuzya kuti, "Muzichitilaanzi eezi"? mukamwaambile kuti, ‘Mwami nguulikumuyanda mpawo ulamuboozya aano muchiindi chifwiifwi.”
Bakayinka baakumujana mwana wedonki ulaangidwe kumbali aamulyango, kumanjililo aamuunzi mpawo bakamwaangununa.
Bamwi bantu bakayimvwi mpawo bakabuzya kuti, “Muchitaanzi, nimwaangununa mwana wedonki ooyu?”
Bakasandula mbuli Jesu mbaakabaambilide, mpawo bantu bakabazumizya kuti beende.
Nibakamweeta mwana wedonki kuliJesu bakayala majansi amusana wakwe mpawo Jesu wakatanta wakkala aalinguwe.
Bantu biingi bakayala milembo yabo mumugwagwa, bamwi bakayala matu ngibakatemede mumyuunda.
Bakazulwide abakalimusule bakoompolola kabati, “Hhossana! Ulilongezezegwe ooyo uuza muzina lyaMwami.
Bulilongezegegwe bwami buyoobuza bwataata wesu Deviti! Hhossana mujulu lyamajulu!”
Jesu wakanjila muJelusalema akwiinka kuChikombelo,  wakalangalanga zyoonse. Lino lyakali lyaba goko mpawo wakayinka kuBbetani abalikkumi aababili.
Buzuba butobela nibakaboola kuzwa ku Bbetani, wakali waba aanzala.
Mukubona mukuyu amatu aawo chakule, wakayinka kuyoobona kuti ulaamichelo na. Naakasika afwiifwi wabona matu luzutu kakutakwe michelo pe, nkaambo teensi chakali chiindi chankuyu pe.
Eelyo wakaambila mukuyu kuti, “Taakwe utazoolye muchelo lubo pe kulinduwe.” Basikwiiya baakwe bakamumvwa kaawamba majwi aayo.
Bakasika muJelusalema, mpawo wakanjila muchikombelo wakatalika kwaandingania bakalikuula akuuzya mukati. Wakatonta matebuli aabasimuchincha mali ezyuuno zyabaabo bakalikuuzya nkwilimba.
Mpawo taakwe naakazumizya pe naba omwe kuti anjile aachikonzya kuuzigwa, mulubaya lwachikombelo.
Mpawo naakabayiisya wakati, “Tachilembedwe na kuti: `Ng'anda yangu iyootegwa ning'anda yakukombela kwamanyika woonse’? Pesi nywebo mwayichita ng'anda yabasikubba.”
Bapati babapayizi abasimilawo bakaamvwa makani aaya eelyo bakayanduula nzila yakumujaya aayo. Bakalikumuyoowa nkaambo nkamu yoonse yakagambisigwa enjiisyo yakwe.
Nilyakaba goko, bakazwa mudolopo.
Chifumofumo kabayobweenda, bakabona mukuyu kuuyumide kuzwa kumiyanda.
Pita wakayeeya mpawo wakati kuli Jesu, “Muyisi wangu langa! Mukuyu nguwakatuka wayuma!”
Jesu wakasandula kuti, “Amube aalusyomo muli Leza.
Ndimwaambila kasimpe kuti, na umwi wati kuchilundu, "Koya ukaliwaalile mulwizi,’ katadoneeki mumoyo wakwe pesi kasyoma kuti eezyo nzyawamba ziyoochitika, nzenzizyo Leza nzyatakachite.
Nkikaako ndamwaambila kuti: Kufumbwa nchimuyookumbila mukukomba, amusyome kuti muyoochijana, mpawo chiyooba chanu.
Mpawo na wayimikila kokomba, na kowangilide uumwi moyo, mulekelele, nkokuti Wuso wako ulikujulu akulekelele zibi zyako.
[“Nkaambo na nywebo kamutalekeleli bantu bali aamilandu kulindinywe, alakwe Wuso uulikujulu takoyoomulekelela pe milandu yenu”.]
Bakasika lubo kuJelusama. Eelyo Jesu naakayobweenda mulubuwa lwachikombelo, bapayizi bapati, abalembi abapati bembungano bakaza kulinguwe.
Bakati, “Uzichita aanguzuunzi eezi zintu, alimwi ngwani ukupa nguzu zyakuzichita?”.
Jesu wakasandula kuti, “Ndilabuzya mubuzyo womwe. Mundisandule, mpawo ndiyoomwaambila kuti muunguzu zyani mwendiikuchita zintu eezi.
Lubbabbatizyo lwaJohani, lwakalikuzwa kujulu na, nanka lwakazwa kumuntu? Mundisandule!”
Bakayizya aatala amakani aaya mpawo bakakazyania bati, “Twaamba kuti, ‘Luzwa kuzulu,’ ulatubuzya kuti 'Nkamboonzi nimutamusyomi?’
Twaamba kuti, 'Luzwa kumuntu’....”, bakayoowa bantu nkaambo muntu woonse wakalizi kuti Joni musinsimi mwinimwini.
Mpawo bakasandula Jesu kuti "Tatuzi pe." Mpawo Jesu wakabaambila kuti, “Ambebo nsikoomwaambila pe kuti manguzu aani ngechita aawo zintu eezi”.

Mpawo wakasanguna kubaambila maambila mbali wakati, “Mwaalumi umwi wakabyala misamu yamisansa. Wakayakila lubaya aalinjiyo, wakasya dindi lyakudinina masansa, akuyaka ngaze yasikulinda. Alimwi wakajana bupa bamwi balimi mpawo wakaya kuchisi chimbi.
Muchiindi chakutebula wakatuma umwi wababelesi bakwe kuyoobweza michelo yamasansa.
Pesi balimi abo bakakumujata, akumuma, akumwaanda kakutakwe nchaakabweda aacho pe.
Wakatuma uumbi mubelesi; ooyo mwaalumi bakamutulula mumutwe akumusampawula. Wakatuma uumbi, alubo ooyo bakakumujaya.
Wakatuma bambi biingi; bamwi bakawumwa, bamwi bakajayigwa.
Kwakasyaala omwe biyo wakutuma, kali mwana ngwaakali kuyandisya kapati. Wakamutuma kali wakumaninsizya, wakati, "Bayoomulemeka mwana wangu."
Pesi balimi bakaambilana kuti, "Ooyu ngusimulya lukono. muze tumujaye, mpawo lukono luyooba lwesu."
Bakamuvumpila akumujaya, akumuwaalila aanze aamuunda wamisansa.
Aboobo ulachita buti mwanimuunda? Ulasika akujaya balimi, akape bambi muunda wamisansa.
Tamunaakwaabala na malembe?:
Mwami nguwakachichita eechi, mpawo chilabotezya kumenso eesu?’ ”
Eelyo bakayanduula nzila yakumwaanga aayo nkaambo bakaziba kuti wakali kwaamba mbabo kumaambila mbali aaya. Pesi bakayoowa nkamu yabantu yakaliwo, nkikaako bakamusiya mpawo bakeenda.
Muchiindi chitobela bakatuma bamwi babaFalisi abaHelodi kuliJesu kuti bakamuteya mumakani aakwe.

Bakasika kulinguwe bakati, “Muyiisyi, tulizi kuti ulimwaalumi ulaabulemu usyomekede. Topenzegwi abantu, nkaambo toswiilizyi makani aamuntu na kulanga chiwa chamuntu; pesi uyiisya nzila yaLeza mbuli mbiibede amubwini. Chileelede na kutela kuliSiza na peepe? Tweelede kuti tuliye na, nanka peepe?”
Pesi Jesu wakalizi kuupawupa kwabo, wati kulimbabo, “Kaamboonzi nimuliikweezya kunditeya?”, “Amundeetele kobili lyenu ndiibone mbulibede.”
Bakalyeeta kobili, alimwi wakababuzya kuti, “Mbubwani busyu oobu? Alimwi ndizina lyani lilembedwe mpawo?” Bakasandula kuti, “NzizyaSiza.”
Mpawo Jesu wakati kulimbabo, “Amupe Siza zyaSiza, alimwi mupe Leza zyaLeza.” Bakagamba aatala anguwe.
Mpawo ba Saduki, baamba kuti takwe bubuke, bakaza kulinguwe amubuzyo. Bakati,
“Muyiisyi, Mozesi wakatulembela kuti, 'Na mukulana wamulumi wafwa mpawo wasiya mwanakazi kabatakwe bana, ooyo mwaalumi weelede kukwata mukamufu mpawo azyalile mukulana."
Kwakali bana bachaalumi bali musanu ababili. Mutaanzi wakakwata mpawo wakafwa katasiide mwana naba womwe.
Wachibili wakamukwata mukamufu, pesi alakwe wakafwa katasiide mwana. Chakaba mbubo akuli watatu.
Tawope akati kababa bali musanu ababili wakasiya mwana. Kumamanino, alakwe mwanakazi wakafwa.
Kububuke bwabafu, ooyu mwanakazi uyooba wani? Mbukunga boonse kabali musanu abatatu bakalimukwete."
Jesu wakasandula kuti, “Teensi nchicho na chimupede kusweeka, nkaambo tamwaazi pe malembe niziba nguzu zyaLeza?"
Akuti bafu nibayoobuka, tabakoyookwata nikuba kukwatanisigwa; bayooba mbuli bangelo kujulu.

Lino mukwaamba aatala abafu nibayoobuka temwakabala na muBbuku lyaMozesi, kuli zeezyo zyakachitika kuchiteyo, Leza mbakaambula kulinguwe kati, ‘Ndime Leza waAbbulamu, Leza waAyizeki, alubo Leza waJekkobbu?'
Tali Leza wabafwide pe, ngwabawumi. Musweekede loko.”

Umwi wabayisyi bamulawo naakasika wakamvwa kabakazyania, kabwene kuti Jesu wakali wabapa nsandulo mbotu, wakabuzya Jesu kuti, “Nguuli mulawo mupati kwiinda imwi akati kamilawo yoonse?” Jesu wakamusandula kuti,
“Ngooyu: ‘Amuswiilile, nobanaIzilayeli, Mwami Leza wesu, Mwami ngumwi.
Yanda Mwami Leza wako amoyo wako woonse, akanzimwe kako koonse, amizeezo yako yoonse, mpawo amanguzu aako woonse.’ Wabili ngooyu:
‘Yanda simayakilane wako mbuli mboliyanda.’ Tawuwo pe mulawo mupati wiinda eeyi.”
Ooyu mwaalumi wakasandula kuti, “Waamba kabotu muyiisyi, waamba kabotu kuti Leza ngumwi alubo takukwe umbi kunze kwakwe alike.
Kumuyanda amoyo wako woonse, akumvwisisisya kwako alubo amanguzu aako woonse, mpawo akuyanda simayakilane wako mbuli mboliyanda nkubotu loko kwiinda zipayizyo.”
Lino Jesu naakabona kuti wasandula chabusongo, wakati kulinguwe, “Tolikule pe aBwami bwaLeza.” Eelyo kuzwa aawo tawope naba omwe wakeezya kumubuzya iimbi mibuzyo.
Jesu kaliikuyiisya mulubuwa lwachikombelo, wakabuzya mubuzyo wakati, “Nkamboonzi bayiisi bamulawo nibati Kkilisito mwana waDeviti?
Deviti lwakwe, kali muMuuya Uusalala, wakachaamba antanganana wakati:  "Mwami wakati kuMwami wangu, kkala kukuboko kwachilisyo kwangu
We lwakwe Deviti umwiita kuti ‘Mwami.’ Ani nga ulaba mwana wakwe biyeni?” Inkamu yabantu mpati yakamuswiilizya chakubotelwa.
Mukuyiisya kwakwe Jesu wakati, “Amubachenjelele bayiisyi bamulawo, balayandisya kusama magubo malamfu akujuzigwa kumasambalilo,
akupegwa zyuuno zyabalemekwa mumambungano akulemekwa kapati aabungene bantu.
Balanyonyoona maanda abamukabafu kabakomba ankombyo ndamfu chakweebwa. Aaba bantu bayoopegwa chisubulo chipati.”
Jesu wakakkala kumbali lyachiyoobwedo chazituuzyo mung'anda yaLeza; bantu nibakalikuwaala mali muchiyobweedo. Bavubi biingi bakalikuwaala mali nyingi.
Pesi mukamufu muchete wakabika biyo tupeni tobile, tweelene aaseleni lyomwe.
Lino wakayita basikwiiya bakwe, wakati, Ndiikumwaambila kasimpe kuti, ooyu mukamufu wabika kwiinda boonse muchiyobwedo.
Boonse bapa kuzwa mubuvule bwabuvubi bwabo, pesi ooyu mukamufu, wabika zyoonse nzyaalangilide mubuumi bwakwe kuti apone anzizyo.”
Aawo Jesu naakalikweenda kuzwa muchikombelo, umwi wabasikwiiya bakwe wakati kuli nguwe, ''Muyiisyi langa mabwe aziyako zigambya!''
Wakati kulinguwe, ''Ulizibwene na iziyako zipati eezi? Takwe niliba limwi bbwe litakabule kukolomokela aansi''.
Kakkede aachilundu chitegwa chamaOlivi, chilangene aachikombelo, Pita aJemusi aEndulu bakabuzya kavweetwa,
''Twambile eezi zintu ziyoochitika lili? Ncheechilii chiyooba chitondeezyo chazintu eezi kuti zyaamba kuchitika?''
Jesu wakatalika kubambila, ''Amukachenjele kuti kutakabi uyomwena.
Bayingi bayoza muzina lyangu kabati, 'Ndime nguwe', pesi bayooyena bayingi.
Chiindi nimuyoomvwa nkondo antwiintwi zyankondo, mutakalikataazyi; eezi zintu zyeelede kuyoochitika, pesi mamanino anooli kaatanaasika pe.
Nkaambo chisi chiyoobukilana echisinyina, abwami buyoobukilana abwaminyina. Kuyooba kuzungaana kwamasena mayingi anzala mpati. Eezi matalikilo amachise aakutumbuka.
Amukalinde. Bayoomupeda kukubetekwa, alimwi muyoowumwa muzikombelo. Muyooyima kunembo lyabeendelezi abami nkaambo kangu, kuti bukabe bukamboni kuli mbabo.
Pesi makani mabotu ayelede kuyookambawukwa kumasi woonse saansi.
Baakumwaanga akumupeda, mutakalikatazyi kuti muyotyeni pe. Mulicheecho chiindi nzimutakaambe muyoozipegwa, teensi ndinywe mutanoowambuule pe, nguMuuya Uusalala utanoowambuule mulindinywe.
Mukulana uyoowuzya mwanike kulufu, awisi, mwana wakwe. Bana bayoobukilana abazyali babo bakabatole kulufu.
Muyoosulwa abantu boonse nkaambo kazina lyangu. Pesi utakajatilile mane kukabe kumamanino, ooyo muntu uyoofutulwa.
Nimuyoobona chisesemyo chalunyonyooko kachiimvwi mpuchiteelede kwiimikila (Ooyo ubala ngamvwisisisye), abanoolimu Judiya abachijile mumalundu,
Ooyo uli aachiluli changanda ataseluki pe kuya mung'anda nikuba kuyootola chintu mukati,
ayooyo uulimumuunda atakabweedi kukutola chisamo.
Pesi maawe kuli babo bamitide abaabo banyoonsya bavwanda mumazuba aayo!
Amukombe kuti eezi zitakachitiki muchiindi chempeyo.
Nkaambo aayo anooli mazuba akupengaana kupati, aatanaabuunsi aba pe, kuzwa kumatalikilo, Leza naakalenga nyika, kusikila lino, nkabela kaatachizoobi limbi pe.
Kakutali kuti Mwami wakaafwiinsya mazuba, taakwe muntu walikuzoofutulwa pe. Pesi akaambo kabaabo basale aabo mbaakasala, wakaafwiinsya mazuba.
Lino na umwi wati kulindinywe, "Amulange, ngoyu Kkilisito!' nakuti "Amulange, nguulya" mutakasyomi pe.
Nkaambo kuyooba abaKkilisito bakubeja abasinsimi bakubeja alimwi bayoopa zitondeezyo azigambyo kuchitila kweena, nikuba basale nizyalikukonzeka.
Amukalindile! Ndamwambila zintu zyoonse kunembo lyachiindi.
Pesi musule lyamazuba akupenzegwa, zuba liyooba mudima, amweezi tukoyoopa mumuni wawo,
Nyenyeezi ziyooloka kuzwa kujulu, aalawo manguzu aalikujulu ayoozungaanisigwa.
Alimwi bayoomubona Mwana waMuntu kaza mumayoba amanguzu abulemu.
Alimwi uyootuma bangelo bakwe, uyoobungania aamwi basale bakwe kuzwa kumabazu one, kuzwa kumamanino anyika kusika kumamanino aajulu.
Amwiiye chiiyo kuzwa kumukuyu. Mwabona ntabi zyasyuka, mwaziba kuti miinza aswena.
Mbuboobo, mwabona zintu eezi kaziliikuchitika, muzibe kuti waswena, waba afwiifwi amilyango.
Nchobeni, ndamwaambila kuti, eeli zyalane talikoyooyinda pe eezi zintu kazitanaachitika.
Ijulu anyika ziyooyinda, pesi majwi angu takoyooyinda pe.
Pesi buzuba oobo nichiba achiindi, takwe muntu uzi, nikuba bangelo kujulu, nikuba Mwana, kunze kwaTaata.
Muchenjele! Mulinde, nkaambo tamuchizi pe chiindi eecho.
Zilimbuli muntu wabweza lweendo, wasiya wabika ng'anda yakwe mumaanza aabalanda bakwe kuti bayibambe, umwi awumwi aamulimu wakwe, wabaambila balinda ng'anda kuti batawoni.
Aboobo amuchenjele nkaambo tamuzi pe kuti nchiindiinzi simalelo wang'anda naboola; zilakonzya kuba goko, na aakati kabusiku na mukuku naalila, na nibwacha.
Na kuti asike mpawawo, atakajani kamuliikoona.
Nzemwaambila nzengambila kumuntu woonse kuti: Linda!''

Lino kwakasyeede mazuba abili kuti kutalike Pobwe lyaKwiindilila alyaMikamu yaChinkwa chitakwe Bumena. Bapayizi bapati abalembi bakali kulanguula nzila isisikene njibalikunoomujata aayo Jesu akumujaya.
Nkaambo balikwaamba kuti ''kutabi muchiindi chapobwe, kuti kutabi kunyongana aakati kabantu''

Lino Jesu kalimu Bbetani mung'anda y Sayimoni sichisenda, kachili mukulya aatebuli, kwakasika mwanakazi kulinguwe akankuli katununkilizyo tudula loko, twamusdyobo wanadi. Wakakapwaya kankuli akutila nadi aamutwe wakwe.
Pesi kuli bamwi bakabijilwa. Bakambuuzyania aakati kabo kabati, ''Ani wanyonyweedaanzi?
Tununkilizyo ootu twalikukonzya kuuzigwa amuulo wiinda myaanda yotatwe yamali mpawo kayipegwa bachete''. Mpawo bakamukalalila.
Pesi Jesu wakati, ''Amumusiye alike. Mumukataazizyaanzi? Wandichitila chintu chibotu.
Bachete munooli aabo kale lyoonse, mpawo kufumbwa chiindi nimwayanda mulakonzya kubachitila kabotu, pesi tamukoyooba andime pe lyoonse.
Wachita eecho nchakoonzya. Wananika kale mubili wangu kuti ukazikwe.
Ndamwaambila kasimpe kuti, kufumbwa makani mabotu nkwaayookambawukwa munyika yoonse, eechi nchachita mwanakazi ooyu chinoowambuulwa, mukumuyeeya''.
Mpawo Judasi Isikkaliyoti, umwi wabalikkumi ababili wakaya kubapayizi kuti akamwaabe kulimbabo.
Lino bapayizi bapati nibamvwa oobo, bakabotelwa akumusyomezya kuti ulapegwa mali. Wakatalika kuyanduula mweenya wakumwaaba kulimbabo.
Mubuzuba butaanzi bwachinkwa chitakwe bumena, lino nibakapayizya kabelele kapobwe lyakundilila, basikwiiya bakati kuli nguwe, ''Nkookuli nkoyanda kuti tukakumbambile kulyida pobwe lyakwindilila?''
Wakatuma basikwiiya bakwe babili akubaambila kuti, ''Kamuya mugunzi, mpawo muyooswaanana aamwaalumi unyampwide munkuli wamaanzi. Mukamutobele.
Ooko nkwayoonjila mun'anda mukamutobele mukati, mukateedi kulimwaning'anda, "Muyiisyi wati, ''Ilikuli yangu ng'anda yabeenzu nkwesikalyide Pobwe lyaKwiindilila abasikwiya bangu?''
Uyoomutondeezya ng'anda mpati yamujulu ibambidwe kabotu. Mukatubambile mumo''.
Mpawo basikwiiya bakazwa bayinka mumuunzi. Lino bakazijana zyoonse mbuli mbaakabambila, eelyo bakabambila chakulya chaPobwe lyaKwindilila.
Nikwakaba goko, wakaza abalikkumi ababili.
Aawo kabachivuumene aatebuli akulya, Jesu wakati, "Kasimpe ndamwaambila kuti umwi wenu ngundiliikulya aawe uyoonduuzya".
Mpawo boonse bakawusa loko, alimwi umwi awumwi wakati kulinguwe, ''Masimpe teensi ndime pe?''
Jesu wakasandula wakati kulimbabo, ''Nguumwi wabalikkumi ababili, ooyu uulikusunsila aamwi  andime mundyido''
Aboobo Mwana waMuntu uyooyinka mbuli mbukulembedwe aatala anguwe. Pesi maawe kuli yooyo muntu wachitya kuti Mwana waMuntu awuzigwe, chalikubota anooli muntu ooyo taakazyalwa''.
Nibakalikulya Jesu wakabweza chinkwa, wachilongezya, akuchikwamuna. Wabapa akwaamba kuti, ''Mubweze eechi. Ngomubili wangu''.
Alimwi wakabweza nkomeki, wapa kulumba akubapa, eelyo bakanywa boonse.
Wakati kulimbabo, ''Oobu mbobulowa bwangu bwachizuminano, bulowa butililwa bayingi.
Kasimpe ndamwaambila kuti, Nsikoyoowunywa limbi pe ooyu muchelo wamasansa kusikila buzuba oobo nindiyoowunywa mubwami bwaLeza''.
Nibakamana kwiimba lwiimbo, bakazwa baya kuchilundu chitegwa chamaOlivi.
Jesu wakati kulimbabo, ''Moonse muyoowa, mbuli mbukulembedwe kuti, "Ndiyoowuma mweembeli butanga "buyoomwayika".
Pesi ndayoobusigwa, ndiyoomuzulwida kuya muGalili''.
Pita wakati, ''Nikuba kuti boonse bawa, mebo pe''.
Jesu wakati kulinguwe, ''Kasimpe ndakwaambila, sunu, iyii, mbubo oobuno busiku mukombwe kutanaakokolika tubili uyoondikaka tutatu.
Lino Pita wakati na kazyaamba kufa ayebo, nsikoyookukaka pe. Boonse bakasyomezya bukozyenie.
Bakasika kubusena butegwa Gesemane, mpawo Jesu wakati kulibasikwiya bakwe, ''Amukkale aawa nenchiya kukukomba''.
Wakabweza Pita, Jemusi aJoni, wiinka aabo mpawo watalika kupengaana akukataazika.
Wakati kuli mbabo, ''Muuya wangu wawusa kapati, nikuba kusika kulufu. Muchaale aawa kamulindide''
Kabachiya kunembo, Jesu wakawida aansi akukomba kuti nichali kukonzeka chiindi eechi chimwiinde mbali.
Wakati, ''Abba, Taata, kulinduwe zintu zyoonse zilakonzeka. Gwisya nkomeki eeyi kulindime pesi kutabi kuyanda kwangu pe, pesi kwako''.
Wakaboola, wakajana baloona, mpawo wakati kuli Pita, ''Sayimoni, muliikoona? Tamukonzyi kulinda hhola lyomwe?
Mulinde akukomba kuti mutanjili mukusunkwa.
Lino wakazwa lwabili waakwiindulula kukomba amajwi ngawo.
Naakaboola lubo wakajana baliikoona, nkambo meso aabo akali alema. Tebakaziba chakwaamba kulinguwe.
Wakaboola lwatatu wakati kulimbabo, ''Muchoona akulyookezya? Kwazulila! Chiindi chasika. Amulange! Mwana waMuntu uliikuuzigwa mumaanza abasizibi.
Munyampuke; tweende. Amulange, sikunduuzya waba afwiifwi.''
Kachaambuula, Judasi, umwi wabalikkumi ababili wakasika, ankamu mpati kabajisi mapanga amasumu, kuzwa kubabapayizi bapati, abalembi, abapati.
Lino sikumuuzya wakapa chitondeezyo, wati, ''Ooyo ngundiyoomyonta ngonguwe. Amumujate mumutole atamuchiji pe.''
Judasi naakasika, mpawo aawo wakaya kuliJesu wati, ''Muyiisyi!'', mpawo wamumyonta.
Mpawo bakamujata bamwaanga.
Pesi umwi wabaabo bakayimvwi wakasomona panga wakakwezula akudunsula kutwi kwamuzike wamupayizi mupati.
Jesu wakati kulimbabo, ''Muza aanga muyanda mubbi, amapanga, amakoli kuzoondijata?
Nindakali aandinywe lubbe akuyiisya muchikombelo teemwakandaanga pe. Pesi eechi chachitika kuti malembe azuzikizigwe''.
Boonse mbaakali aabo Jesu bakamusiya akuchija.
Mulombe wakalizambilide biyo  mulembo uutentema wakali kuyobutobela Jesu. Bantu nibakamuvumpila,
wakasiya mulembo utentema wachija kali chinkuna.
Bakatola Jesu kumupayizi mupati. Bamubunganina bapayizi bapati, abapati abalembi.
Lino Pita wakali kuyobutobela chakulekule kuyoosika kulubuwa lwamupayizi mupati. Wakakkala aakati kabalindi bakalikuyoota mulilo.
Lino bapayizi bapati ankuta yoonse yabaJuda bakalikuyanduula bukamboni bwakubeja kuchitila kuti bamutole bamujaye. Pesi teebakabujana pe.
Bayingi bakaleta bukamboni bwakubeja aatala aanguwe, pesi bukamboni oobu teebwakalikuzuminina pe.
Bamwi bakayima  akupa bukamboni bwakubeja aatala anguwe; Kabati, ''
Twakamumvwa kati, 'Ndiyoomwaya ng'anda yaLeza yakayakwa aamaanza, mukati kamazuba aatatu ndiyooyaka iimbi itayakwi aamaanza pe''.
Nikuba boobo bukamboni bwabo teebwakazumina pe.
Mupayizi mupati wakayimikila aakati kabo wabuzya Jesu kuti, ''Tujisi nsandulo na? Niinzi eezi aaba baalumi nzibapeda bukamboni aatala anduwe?''
Pesi we wakawumuna, taakwe naakasandula chintu pe. Alubo mupayizi mupati wakamubuzya kuti, ''Nduwe Kkilisito, Mwana wawulongezegwe na?''
Jesu wakati, ''Ndime! alimwi muyoomubona Mwana waMuntu aakukkala kululyo lwakuboko lwasinguzu akuboola amayoba aakujulu.''
Mupayizi mupati wakadelula zisamo mpawo wati, ''Sa tuchiyanda bakamboni bambi?
Mwalimvwida mbaatuka Leza. Mutyeni?'' Mpawo bakamupa mulandu weelela lufu.
Bamwi bakatalika kumuswida mate akumuvumba busyu akumunabba, akwaamba kuti kulinguwe, ''Sinsima!'' Basolooli bakamubweza akumuuma.
Eelyo Pita kachili munsi mulubuwa umwi wabalanda basimbi bamupayizi mupati wakaza kulinguwe.
Naakabona Pita kaliikuyota mulilo, wakamulangisisya akwaamba kuti, ''Mwakali aamwi aaJesu muNazaleta''.
Pesi wakakaka akwaamba kuti tandimuzi pe nikuba kumvwisisisya nzoliikwaambuula'. Lino wakazwa waya anze aamulyango. Mpawo mukombwe wakakokolika.
Pesi mulanda musimbi wakamubona mpawo watalika kwaamba lubo kuli baabo bakayiimvwi mpawo, ''Ooyu mwaalumi nguumwi wabo!''
Lino wakakaka lubo. Nikwakayinda kayindi kaniini, aabo bakayimvwi aawo bakati kuliPita, "Nkasimpe uli umwi wabo, nkaambo ayebo ulimunaGalili.''
Wakatalika kulibika mulutuko akukonka. "Ooyu mwaalumi ngoliikwaambuula aatala anguwe nsimwizi pe mebo".
Mpawo mukombwe wakakokolika lwabili. Eelyo Pita wakaayeeya majwi aaJesu aakuti, "Mukombwe katanaakokolika tubili, uyoondikaka tutatu'' alimwi wakawusa akulila.
Muchifumofumo, bapayizi bapati bakabungana abapati abalembi ankamu yoonse yaJuda. Bakamwaanga Jesu bamutola. Bakamupedekezya kuliPayileti.
Payileti wakabuzya kuti, ''Nduwe Mwami wabaJuda na?'' Wakasandula kuti, ''Waamba''.
Bapayizi bapati bakali kumutamikizya zintu zyiingi.
Alubo Payileti wakamubuzya kati, ''Tosanduli na?'' Langa kuvula zintu nzibali kukutamikizya!''
Pesi Jesu taakamusandula pe, mpawo eecho chakamugambya Payileti.
Kuchiindi chapobwe, Payileti wanoonga wabaangunywida umwi wabaange, mwaange ngubatanooli bakumbila.
Mpawo kwakali mwaalumi utegwa Bbalabbasi muntolongo abamwi bakali amilandu yabujayi muchiindi chalupapi.
Makamu akaza kuli Payileti mpawo bakatalika kukumbila kuti abachitile mbuli mbabachitila lubbe.
Payileti wakabasandula wati, ''Muyanda kuti ndimwaangunwide Mwami wabaJuda na?''
We wakalizi kuti nkaambo kabbivwe bapayizi bapati nchibakaaba Jesu kulinguwe.
Pesi bapayizi bapati bakasungilizya makamu kuti balilile kwangununwa kwaBbalabbasi.
Payileti wakasandula lubo wakati, ''Ani mpo ndichite biyeni aMwami wabaJuda?''
Bakawompolola lubo, ''Ngabambulwe!''
Payileti wakabaambila kuti, ''Mulanduunzi ngwakachita?'' Pesi bakayinkilila kunembo akoompolola kabati, ''Amumubambule''.
Payileti wakayanda kukutisika makamu, eelyo wakabaangunwida Bbalabbasi. Wakamupenzya Jesu mpawo wamupeda kuti akabambulwe.
Basilumamba bakamutola bamunjizya mubbetekelo (alingawo maanda afulumende mapati), mpawo bakayita imbunga yabasilumamba.
Bakamusamika kulembo wamubala wantumbula Jesu, mpawo bakazinga musini wamaamvwa bakamusamika.
Bakatalika kumuseka kabati, ''Mwalemekwa, Mwami wabaJuda!''.
Bakali kumumuuma mumutwe atete mpawo akumuswida mate. Bakamufugamina akumukotamina.
Nibakamana kumusyonsya, bakamugwisya mulembo wamubala wantumbula mpawo bamusamika zisamo zyakwe, eelyo bakamutola kuyoomubambula.
Umwi mwaalumi, Sayimoni wakuSayilini, wakayobuza kuzwa kumyuunzi (wakali wisi waAlekizanda aLufusi), mpawo bakamwaangila kuti amubwezele chiingano.
Basilumamba bakasisya Jesu kubusena butegwa Gologota (bunga nibwapandululwa butegwa, ''Busena bwazipepe zyamitwe'').
Bakamupa wayini ivwelengene andulwe, pesi taakanywa pe.
Bakamubambula mpawo bakaabana zisamo zyakwe, kwiindila mukusonda kuti babone nchatajane umwi awumwi wabasilumamba.
Chakali chiindi chahhola lyatatu nibakamubambula.
Achikwaankwani bakalemba mulandu ngubakamupa, bakati, ''Mwami wabaJuda''.
Bakamubambula aamwi ababbi babili, umwi kululyo lwakwe umwi kuchimweensi chakwe.
Malembe akazuzikizigwa akuti, ''Wakabalikizigwa aamwi abasikutyola milawo".
Abo bakali kwiinda nibakamubona bakali kutikinia mitwe kabati, ''Aa! webo nookonzya kumwaya chikombelo akuchiyakulula mumazuba otatwe,
livune useluke achiingano!''
Munzila ikozyenie, bapayizi bapati bakali kumuniaka antoomwe abalembi, kabati, ''Wakafutula bamwi, pesi takonzyi kulifutula.
Akube kuti Kkilisito, Mwami waIzilayeli, aseluka lino aachiingano, kuti tubone akusyoma.'' Abalabo bakabambulwa aamwi anguwe bakamuseka.
Muhhola lyamusanu alimwi, mudima wakazulila busena boonse kusikila kuhhola lyamusanu aane.
Muhhola lyamusanu aane Jesu wakoompolola ajwi pati wakati, ''Eloyi, Eloyi, sabakkatani?'', chipandululwa kuti, ''Leza wangu, Leza wangu wandisilaanzi?''
Bamwi babaabo bakayimvwi kumbali bakamvwa majwi akwe mpawo bakati, ''Langa, ulikwiita Elayija.''
Umwi wakachijaana, wakanika nsinsa muwayini iilweela, wayibikka aatete, mpawo wakamupa kuti anywe. Mwaalumwi ooyu wakati, ''Atubone na Elayija ulasika kuzoomwaangula.''
Eelyo Jesu wakoompolola ajwi pati mpawo wafwa.
Mulembo wamuchikombelo wakadeluka muzipanzi zibili kuzwa kujulu kusika aansi.
Eelyo mupati wabasilumamba balimwaanda wakayimvwi kalangide Jesu, naakabona kuti wafwa munzila eeyi, wakati, ''Masimpe mwaalumi ooyu wali Mwana waLeza.''
Kwakaliko alimwi banakazi bakali kweebela chakulekule. Akati kabo kwakali Maliya Magadalini, Maliya (bayina aaJemusi mwanike aJosesi).
Naakali muGalili bakalikumutobela mpawo akumukutawukila. Alimwi banakazi bayingi abalabo bakamusindikila kuJelusalema.
Nilyakaba goko, akaambo kakuti lyakaliZuba lyaMabambe, nkokuti, buzuba kakutanaaba buzuba butegwa Sabata,
Jozefu wakuAlimatiya wakasika. Wakali kulemekwa kali umwi wankamu yabapati bechisi wakali kulindila bwami bwaLeza. Wakayinka chabusichaamba kuli Payileti waakukumbila mutunta waJesu.
Payileti chakamugambya kuti Jesu wakali wafwa kale. Wakayita mupati wabasilumamba bali mwaanda mpawo wakabuzya kuti Jesu wakali wafwa kale na.
Eleyo Payileti naakaziba kuzwa kumupati wabasilumamba balimwaanda kuti Jesu wafwa, wakuupa Jozefu mutunta.
Jozefu wakawula mulembo utentema wakamwangununa achingano, wamuvungilizya amulembo utentema, mpawo wamulazika muchuumbwe chamumpako yabbwe. Eelyo wakatendelesya bbwe wajala mulyango wachuumbwe.
Maliya Magadalini aMaliya bayina aJosesi bakabubona busena Jesu mbwaakalazikwa.
Nibwakamana buzuba butegwa Sabata, Meli Magadalini, Meli banyina aJemusi aSalome bakawula tununkilizyo kuti bayinke kuyoonanika mutunta waJesu.
Chifumofumo mubuzuba butaanzi bwamviki, zuba mbulyakapasula biyo bakayinka kuchuumbwe.
Kabachili munzila bakabuzyania umwi awumwi kuti, “Ngwani uutakatugwisizye bbwe kuzwa kumulyango wachuumbwe?”
Pesi nibakatambya menso, bakabona bbwe kalili lyasunzuluzigwa kale nkaambo lyakali pati loko..
Nibakanjila muchuumbwe, bakabona mwaalumi mukubusi kasamide chisamo chituba, kakkede kululyo, mpawo bakagamba akuyoowa.
Wakati kulimbabo, “Mutayoowi. Mulanguula Jesu muNazeleta, wakabambulwa aachiingano. Wabuka! Amulange aabusena mpubakamubikide.
Pesi kamuya, mukaambile basikwiiya bakwe aPita kuti, "Ulazulula kunembo lyenu kaya kuGalilii. Nkuko nkumuyoomubona, mbuli mbwaakamwaambilide,”
Bakazwa muchuumbwe; bakatalika kuchijaana, bakalikuteketa kabagambide. Taakwe nchimbakaambilana pe nkaambo bakali bayoowa loko.
Mubuzuba butaanzi bwamviki, naakabuka, wakasanguna kulitondeezya kuli Meli Magadalini, ooyo ngwaakali watanda myuuya mibi ilimusanu ayiibili kuzwa mulinguwe.
Wakayinka wakwaambila aabo bakali kweenda aawe, bakali koomoka akulila.
Pesi nibakamvwa kuti Jesu muumi akuti wamubona, teebakasyoma pe.
Nikwakayinda zintu eezi, wakalibonia munzila iisiyene kuli babili, nibakalikuyoobweenda kuya kumyuunzi.
Bakayinka kuyoowaambila basikwiiya boonse, pesi taakwe nibakabasyoma pe.
Mukweenda kwachiindi Jesu wakalibonia kulibalikkumi awumwi nibakali kulya; wakabakalalila mukutasyoma akuyuma kwamyoyo yabo, nkaambo bakakaka kuzuminina aabo bakamubona naakabuka.
Wakabaambila kuti, “Kamuya munyika yoonse alimwi mukakambawukile  zilengwa zyoonse makani mabotu.
Kufumbwa uusyoma akubbizigwa uyoofutulwa, pesi kufumbwa uutasyomi uyoopegwa mulandu.
Alimwi zigambyo eezi ziyoobatobela boonse basyoma: Bayootanda myuuya mibi muzina lyangu. bayoowambuula mumilaka mipya.
Na baakujata nzoka, alimwi nibayoonywa chijaya, tachikwe kuyoobachisa pe, bayoobika maanza aabachiswa, alimwi bachiswa bayoopona.”
Mpawo Mwami naakamana kubaambila, wakatolwa kujulu mpawo wakakukkala kululyo lwaLeza.
Mpawo basikwiiya bakazwa, akuyookambawuka koonse koonse, alimwi Mwami wakabeleka aabo akusiimya ijwi lyakwe azitondeezyo zyakabatobela.
Zyakaambwa atala a Niniva. Bbuku lyachilengano lya Nahumi, mu Elikko.
Jehova ngu Leza sibuzuba alimwi ulabwedezya; Jehova ulabwedezya alimwi uzwide bukali; Jehova ulabwedezya basinkondonyina, alimwi bukali bwakwe bulindiilila kuli basinkondonyina.
Jehova ulamuka munguzu, takoyoleka basizibi Jehova ulachita inzila yakwe mukambizi amuguwo alimwi amumayoba ndusuko lwamawulu akwe.
Ulakalalila lwizi akuchita kuti luyuminine, ulayuminizya milonga yoonse. Basyani ulizukide alakwe Kkalameli, maluba a Lebbano awizuka.
Zilundu zilakankama mubuliwo bwakwe, atulato tulundu tulayaaya, nyika ilakolomoka munsi lyakwe, iyii, inyika abantu boonse bakkala mulinjiyo .
Ngwani ukkonzya kwima mubukkali bwakwe? Ngwani unga wayiminana akuyoosya kwakunyema kwakwe? Kunyema kwakwe kutilwa mbulwa mulilo, alimwi ndoomba zilakwamunwa anguwe.
Jehova mubotu, ngemachijilo muzuba lyamapenzi, alimwi ulabatambula bayuba muli nguwe.
Pele ulabachita mamanino azwide basinkondonyina azambangulwe lyindilide, ubatobela mumudima.
Nchinyamanzi bantu nchiba papila Jehova? Ulachita mamanino azwide kuli nchicho, mapenzi takoyoba lubo lwachibili.
Mbuli mamvwa alengelela alimwi mbuli zinywa bachankolwa, bazosyukutwa mbuli makuba mayumu.
Kuzwa kuli nduwe, Niniva, kuzwa umwi ubambila Jehova bubi. Sikumbulizya mubi.
Nzezi zyaambwa a Jehova, ''Nikuba balizwide manguzu amyeelwe ilizwide, nikuba boobo bayomwayika bantu babo bayoyinda. Pele iwebo, Juda: Nikuba kuti ndakupenzya, nsikoyokupenzya limbi pe.
Lino ndatyola na jokwe lyabantu kuzwa kuli nduwe; ndiyodunsula nketani.''

Jehova wapa mulayizyo atala anduwe, Niniva: ''Takuchiyobi lunyungu lwambwa azina lyako. Ndiyonunsula zibezedwe azibumbidwe abutale kuzwa kumaanda abaleza bako. Ndiyokubambila kabanda kako, nkambo ulasoleka.''
Langa, kuzilundu kuli ndyato zyawumwi uyeta makani mabotu, uwambilizya lumuuno! Sekelela mapobwe ako, Juda, alimwi zuzikizya zikonke zyako, nkambo mubi takoyokufumpa limbi, wanunsula chimaninide.
Umwayula uleza kuzokulwisya. Lindila bulambo bwadolopo, langa mugwagwa, simya chikungu chako, boozya amwi manguzu ako woonse.
Nkambo Jehova ulakubwedezya bulemu bwa Jakobe, mbuli bulemu bwa Izilayeli, nikuba basikusala basala akunyonyoona mitabi yamasansa abo.
Intobo yabalumi basinguzu zyasalala, alimwi basilumamba basama zisalalisya, nkalaki zimweka abutale muzuba ndibachitwa kuti balibambile, alimwi masumu alavukuzigwa mumuuwo.
Inkalaki zilachijana mumigwagwa; zilafwambana kwinka akuboola mumigwagwa mipati. Zilangika mbuli mimuni, alimwi alimwi zichijana mbuli kalabi.
Ukugonkola tumpanzi mpanzi ulayita basiimpi bakwe, balabbuvulana nibayenda; balafwambana kulwisya bulambo bwadolopo. Intobo mpawi yabambilwa kukwabililwa basikulwisya.
Milyango ilamilonga yajulwa amanguzu, ang'anda yamwami yadilika.
Huzabbu wazwatununwa alimwi watolwa; balanda bakwe bachikayintu boomoka mbuli inziba, balawuma inkolo zyabo.
Niniva ulimbuli kalambwa kamanzi kazuza, bantu bayo balamwayika mbuli maanzi afwambana kweenda. Bamwi balompolola ''Yimikila, Yima,'' pesi takwepe awumwi wakabachebuka.
Bweza insiliva, bweza insiliva, nkambo takwe mamanino abuvubi, kuzyebeka zyoonse zya Niniva nzintu zibotu.
Niniva wasamununwa akumwayigwa. Moyo wamuntu woonse wayaaya, mwazwi amuntu woonse awumana, alimwi kukwila kuli azikungu zyoonse, busyu bwabo bwatubuluka.
Ayakuli lino masenengo abalavu, busena oko bana babalavu nkubali kusaninwa, busena oko balavu abazyazi nkubali kwendela, abana, oko kutakwe nchibayoowa?
Mulavu wadunsula zyalumina bana bakwe; wazyunguluka zilumwa kubalavu banakazi, alimwi wazuzya mapako zyalumwa. Malindi akwe amitunta ikwamwidwe.

''Bona, Imebo ndikukazizye webo-aya ngaamba Jehova wamakamu. Ndiyotenta inkalaki zyako mubusi, alimwi panga liyoolya balavu bako bachikomena. Imebo ndiyonunsula zivwimwa kuzwa kunyika yako, alimwi majwi abatumwa bako takoyomvwigwa alimbi.''
Maawe kudolopo lizwide bulowa! Lizwide mabejo alubono lwakubba, babbidwa balanguwe lyoonse.
Pesi lino kuli muzuzumina wachimboko akuzuzuma kwamavili, kulika kwama bbiza, ankalaki zizobukwemba.
Balikulwisya basikutanta mabbiza, balamwesya mapanga, masumu alabekema, malwi abajayidwe, malwi mapati amitunta. Takwe magolelo amitunta: basikubalwisya balawa ajulu ayo.
Ezi zilokuchitikana nkambo kamichito yachitumpya menso yaba simamambe  babotu, bazi kabotu zyakulowa, uzya nyika kwinda mumilimo yabulozi.
''Langa, ndakukazya webo-mbwamba Jehova wamakamu-ndiyovumbula chikketi chako kusikila kumenso akutondezya zyamubili wako zisiswa kunyika, mawuse ako kumaami.
Ndiyowaala alinduwe bubi busesemya akukusofwazya; njokubikka ukabe chebelwa.
Kuyoba kuti kufumbwa ukulanga uyochija akuzwa kuli nduwe akwamba; Niniva wanyonyonwa, ngwani utakamukwilile?' Ndiinke kuli nkwentikajane sikumumbulizya?''
Niniva, ino ulikabotu na kwinda Tebbesi, eyo ijisi Mulonga Nayili, oyo iwakazyungulukidwe amanzi, chilivunio chakwe chakali lwizi alimwi ndulwakali bulambo bwayo.
Kkushi a Ijiputi ngakali manguzu akwe, alimwi tekwakali magolelo kuli njiiyo. Puti a Libbiya mbibakali kumugwasya.

Pele Tebbesi wakatolegwa, wakanjila mubuzike, bana bakwe banini bakadelulwa delulwa amapambukilo anzila zyoonse, basinkondonyina bakawala zisolo kubaalumi bakwe balemekezegwa, alimwi boonse balumi bakwe bapati bakali sungidwe anketani.
Iwebo lwako uzokolwa; uzoyezya kuyuba alimwi uyoyandula mayubilo kuli basinkondonyokwe.
Zichijilo zyako ziyumu ziyooba mbuli mukuyu ulankuyu solonsya: Naa zyatikinisigwa, ziyowida mumulomo wasikulya.
Bona, bantu balakkati kako mbanakazi; 'Milyango yanyika yao yajulwa loko kuli basinkondonyokwe, mulilo walya minkulu yayo.
Yinka uteke manzi akusinkilwa, yumya zichijilo zyako, yinkamubulongo ulyatule bulongo bwakubumbya, bweza zikkombula zyazitina.
Mulilo uyokulya ooko, alimwi panga liyokunyonyoona. Liyokulya mbuli bana bansozi mbubakalya zintu zyoonse. Mulichite muvule mbuli bana bansozi, mubebiingi mbuli nsozi zyakakomena.
Wabavuzya loko basambazi bako kwinda nyenyezi kujulu, pele balimbuli bana bansozi: zilamaninsya munyika mpawo zyawuluka.
Baami bako bali mbuli tanga lyansoozi. Bapati babasilumamba balimbuli nsozi ziyuba mubulambo muzuba nikutontola. Pele zuba nilibbuda zilamwayika, alimwi kubusena nkozyiinka takuzinkenwe pe.
Mwami waku Asiliya, bembeli bako balokona balemekwa bako balilede balokulyokezya. Bantu bako balisapeene muzilundu, alimwi takwepe sikuba bunganya.
Takwepe kupona kukonzya kuba kuzilonda zyako. Zilonda zyako zilinikide. Kufumbwa umvwa mpuwo atala anduwe uyokambilila mukusekelela atala lyako. Ngwani wakata katazigwa abubi bwako?
Majwi a Nehemiya mwana mulombe wa Hakkaliya: Kwalino zwakachitika mumwezi wa Kkisilevi, mumunyaka wamakkumi abili, mbokunga ndakali mung'anda yabwami yaku Susa,

ikuti umwi wabakwesu, Hanani, abamwi balumi bakazwa ku Juda, alimwi ndakababuzya makani abantu baba Juda, alimwi ndakababuzya amakani aba Juda bakachija kubuzike, kabunga kache kaba Juda kakaliwo, alimwi atala Jelusalemu.
Bakati kuli ndime, ''Abo balimuchilikiti bakafutuka kukwangwa balimumapenzi mapati balasampawulwa nkambo bulambo bwa Jelusalemu bulimwayikide, alimwi amilyango yamanjililo ilipyide amulilo.''
Elyo nindakamvwa majwi ayo, ndakakkala ansi ndakwila, alimwi kwamazuba manji ndakinkilila kunembo akuchiswa moyo akulyiimya kulya alimwi akukomba kunembo lya Leza waku julu.
Mpawo ndakati, ''Nduwe Jehova, Leza wakujulu, Leza oyo mupati alimwi uyosya, ubamba chizuminano antomwe aluyando luteeli kulibabo bamuyanda akulondola milayizyo yakwe.

Koswilila inkombo yangu alimwi ujule menso ako, kuchitila kuti inkombyo yamulanda wako eyo njindokukomba kunembo lyako sikati amansiku nkekombela bantu ba Izilayeli balanda bako. Ndikukwilila zibi zyabana ba Izilayeli, ezyo nzitwakakubisizya. Katulamwi lwangu abeng'anda yataata bakabisya.
Twakachita chakukubisizya chindilide, alimwi akutabamba malayilile, imbeta, antomwe amilawo njiwakalayilila mulanda wako Mozesi.
Akaka kamuyeeya majwi ngimwakalayilila mulanda wanu Mozesi, 'Na wachita chakutasyomeka njoku mwayisya akkati kabantu,

pesi nakuti waboola kuli ndime akutobela malayilile angu akwachita, nekuba kuti bantu bako bakali mwayikide munsi munsi lyamajulu malamfu, njobabungania kuzwa nkukoko akubeta kubusena obo mbwendakasala kuti nchite kuti izina lyangu likabedelele.'
Lino mbaba balanda bako abantu bako, abo mbiwakavuna amanguzu ako mapati ajanza ijumu.

Jehova, ikaka ndakukumbila, kotelela lino kunkombyo yamulanda wako antomwe akunkombyo yabalanda abo balipeda kulemeka izina lyako. Lino kopa kuzwidilila kubalanda bako sunu, alimwi akumuzumizya luzyalo mumenso awoyu muntu.'' Ndakabeleka mbuli simwaaba kulya kumwami.
Mumwezi wa Nisani, mumwaka wamakkumi abili amwami Atakizassesi simwami, wakasala wayini, alimwi ndakitola wayini akuyoyipa kumwami. Lino takwepe nindakali bumwi bunsi ndawusa kunembo lyakwe.
Pesi mwami wakati kuli ndime, ''Nkambonzi busyu bwako nibuuside? Totondezyi nikuba kuchiswa. Ooku nkuusa kwamumoyo.'' Eelyo ndakayowa loko.

Ndakati kumwami, ''Akube kuti mwami apone kwalyoonse! Nkambonzi busyu bwangu nibutelede kuusa? Idolopo, ibusena bwatubanda twabamatata, bulicheede mumatongo, alimwi milyango yalyo akakolomonwa amulilo.''
Mpawo mwami wakandambila, ''Uyanda kuti ndikuchitileenzi?'' Elyo ndakakomba kuli Leza wakujulu.
Ndakasandula kumwami, ''Nakuti kachibotelezya kumwami, akuti balanda bako bachita kabotu kumenso aako, mulandituma ku Juda, kuchisi chatubanda twaba matatata, kuti nkatuyakulule.''
Mwami wakandisandula ( mukaakwe alakwe wakali kkede kumbali lyakwe) ''Nchilamfu biyeni chindi nchotanobbudide alimwi uyojoka lili?'' Mwami wakabotelwa nindakamupa chiindi chakuzwa kwangu.

Mpawo ndakati kumwami, ''Nakachibotelezya mwami, magwalo aapegwe kuli ndime akambo kabazululi balimutala lyabbooma lyamulonga kuchitila kuti bakandizumizye kwinda akkati kamasena aabo kulwendo lwangu lwaku Juda.

Akube alimwi lugwalo, lwa Asafu mulindizi wasaka lyamwami, kuchitila kuti akandipe masamu kuti nchite minsende yamilyango yabendelezi afwifwi achikombelo, abulambo bwachisi, azya ng'anda njesikakkale.'' Aaboobo nkambo ijanza bbotu lya Leza lyakali alindime, mwami wakazumina chikumbizyo changu.
Ndakaza kubendelezi basilutwe bazilikiti musule lyamulonga alimwi ndakabapa magwalo akazwide kumwami. Lino mwami wakali watuma abendelezi basikundisindikila babasilumamba antomwe aba mabbiza.
Muchindi Sanibbalati mu Hloniti antome a Tobbiya mu Amonayiti mulanda nakamvwa ezi, bakawusa kapati kwakuti umwi wabo wakeza kuzokumbila kuti azogwasizye bantu ba Izilayeli.
Elyo ndakasika mu Jelusalemu alimwi ndakakkala mazuba atatu.

Ndakabuka mansiku, Mebo lwangu abamwi balumi bache. Takwepe ngundakabuzya zyakandibuzya Leza nzyakali wabika mumoyo wangu kuti nchitile Jelusalemu. Tekwakalikwe munyamankala wakalandime, kusiya oyo ngundakagede kupela.

Ndakazwidanze mansiku Kumulyango Wakukalonga, ulangeene aku Chikala chaba Mwaaba alimwi akuyosika ku Mulyango wa Bufumba, alimwi akuyolanga langa bulambo bwa Jelusalemu, oyo wakali wakolomoka chakwanzana, alimwi milyango yamasamu yakali yasyukutwa amulilo.
Mpawo ndakinkilila kunembo kuyosika ku Mulyango wa Kasensa akuyosika ku Dambwa lya Mwami. Ibusena bwakali manikide loko kuti munyamankala ngundakagede ayinde mpawo.
Mpawo ndakeenda busiku oobo nketobelezya musena alimwi akuyobulanga langa bulambo, alimwi ndakakunyona musule akuzonjila nketobezya Kumulyango Wamusena, alimwi ndakaboola.

Bendelezi tebakaziba pe kuti ndakali kuli nakuti niinzi nchindakachita, alimwi tendakalina kuba zibisya pe ba Juda, nibaba bapayizi, nibaba basongo, nibaba basilutwe, nibaba banamalye bakachita mulimo.

Ndakati kulimbabo, ''Mulabwene mapenzi ngituli mulingawo, Jelusalemu mbwiyalala mumatongo alimwi milyango yayo yakamwayulwa amulilo. Kamubola, ngatuyakulule bulambo bwa Jelusalemu, kuchitila kuti tutazochibi mukusekwa.''

Ndakabambila kuti kuboko kubotu kwa Leza wangu kwakali alindime alimwi kabiyo atala amajwi amwami ayo ngakali wambuula kuli ndime. Bakati, ''Ngatunyampuke alimwi tukayake.'' Alimwi bakasimya maboko abo kumulimo mubotu.

Pesi muchindi Sanibbalati mu olonayiti, antomwe a Tobbiya mu Amonayiti mulanda, antomwe a Gesyemu mu Alabbu nibakamvwa atala azezi, bakaseka akutuniaka swebo, alimwi bakati, ''Muchitaanzi? Sena mulokupapila mwami na?

Elyo ndakabasandula, ''Leza wakujulu ulatupa kuzwidilila. Iswebo tulibalanda alimwi tuyonyampuka alimwi tuyake. Pesi nywebo ytamukwepe chaabilo, tamuwe chelelo, alimwi tamukwepe chibalusyo chakwamba a Jelusalemu.''

Mpawo Eliyasyibbu mupayizi mupati wakabuka amukulana wakwe mupayizi, bakayaka mulyango wambelele. Bakasalazya loko kuli nguwo akubikka milyango mpiyelede. Bakasalazya loko kule kung'anda ndamfu yamyaanda akule kuyosika kung'anda ndamfu ya Hananelu.
Kubbazu kuli nguwe balumi baku Jelikko bakabeleka, kubbazu ambabo Zakku mwana mulombe wa Imuli wakayaka.
Ibana balombe ba Hasena bakayaka mulyango wabaswi. Bakawuyaka amingwamba yawo, akubikka milyango, azijazyo aminkulu yawo.
Memeloti wakayakulula lubo limbi bbazu. Mwana mulombe wa Uliya mwana wa Hakkozi. Kubbazu ambabo Mesyulamu wakayakulula. Mwana mulombe wa Bbelekkiya mwana mulombe wa Mesyezabbeli.
Kubbazu ambabo Zadokki wakayakulula. Mwana mulombe wa Bbana. Kubbazu ambabo ba Tekkoyiti bakayakulula, pesi bazuluzi babo bakakaka kuchita mulimo ngubakambilidwe abasikubabelesya babo..
Joyiyada mwana mulombe wa Pasiya a Mesyulamu mwana mulombe wa Bbesadiya wakayakulula mulyango wachiindi. Bakawuyakulula amingwamba, akubikka milyango yawo, aminkulu yawo amingwamba.

Kubbazu ambabo kwakali bantu baku Gibbiyoni abaku Mizipa-Melatiya ba Gibbiyonayiti aba Jadoni ba Melonayiti, abo bakali balumi bazwa ku Gibbiyoni aku Mizipa, bakachita kuyakulula abusena bwakali mupati wachisi Kusule lya Mulonga nkubakali kukkala.

Kubbazu anguwe Uziyeli mwana mulombe wa Hahayiya, umwi wabafuzi bangolida, wakayakulula, kubbazu anguwe kwakali Hananiya, ooyo wakali kulungisya tununkilizyo. Bakayakulula alimwi Jelusalemu kule kuyosika kumulyango uukwezeme.
Kubbazu ambabo Lefaniya mwana mulombe wa Haa wakayakulula. Wakali mwendelezi wachimpanzi chabboma lya Jelusalemu.
Kubbazu ambabo Jedayiya mwana mulombe wa Halumapu wakayakulula kubbazu ang'anda yakwe. Kubbazu anguwe Hutusyi mwana mulombe wa Hasyabbeniya wakayakulula.
Makkiya mwana mulombe wa Halimu a Hasyubbi mwana mulombe wa Pahati-Mowabbu wakayakulula limbi bbazu damfu lyazikko.
Kubbazu ambabo Syalumu mwana mulombe wa Halohesyi, mwendelezi wachimpanzi chabbooma lya Jelusalemu, wakayakulula, kwindila mubana bakwe basimbi.

Hanuni abakali kukkala mu Zanowa bakayakulula mu Lyango waku Musena. Bakuyaka alimwi bakabikka milyango yawo, zyakwanzya, alimwi amingwamba. Bakayakulula zyuulu zytukokola kule kuyosika mbuliku Mulyango wa Bufumba.
Malukkija mwana mulombe wa Lekkabbu, mwendelezi wabbooma lya Bbeti Hakkemu, wakayakulula mulyango wabufumba. Wakawuyaka akubikka milyango yawo, minkulu amingwamba.

Syalumu mwana mulombe wa Kkolu-Hoze, mwendelezi wabbooma lyaku Mizipa, wakayakulula Mulyango waku Kasensa. Wakayaka, alimwi wakabikka chivumbilizyo mpawo wabikka azijazyo, zyanzyo, antomwe amingwamba. Alimwi wakayakulula bulambo bwaku Chilambwa cha Silawome kubbazu kuchilili chamwami, kule kuyosika mbuli kumatantilo atola kumunkuni kuzwida kudolopo lya Deviti.

Nehemiya mwana mulombe wa Azibbuki, muzuluzi wachisela chimwi chabboma lyaku Bbeti Zuwa, wakayakulula kuyosika kubusena katimbula kuzwa kutubanda twaDeviti., kusika kuchilambwa chakapangidwe abantu, akuyosika kung'anda yamwalumi simangu mapati.
Kuzwa nguwe ba Livayiti bakayakulula, kubikilizya a Lehuni mwana mulombe wa Bbani alimwi kubbazu anguwe, Hasyabbiya, mwendelezi wabboma lyaku Kkila, kubboma lyakwe.
Nikwakazwa mbabo balombe babo bakayakulula, kubikilizya Bbinuyi mwana mulombe wa Henadadi, mwendelezi wachisela chabboma lya Kkila.
Wakatobela kubbazu lyakwe, Eza mwanamulombe  wa Jeshuwa, mwendelezi wa Mizipa, wakayakulula chimwi chimpanzi echo chakalangide kumulundu wakuchilwisyo kuchiswi chabulambo.
Kuzwa nguwe Bbalakki mwana mulombe wa Zabbayi wakasungwlila kuyaka chiimbi chabili, kuzwa kunyoneno lyabulambo kusika kumulyango wang'anda ya Eliyasyibbu mupayizi mupati.
Kuzwa nguwe Memeloti mwana mulombe wa Uliya kali mwana mulombe wa Hakkazi wakayakulula chabili, kuzwa kumulyango wang'anda ya Eliyasyibbu kusikila kumamanino ang'anda ya Eliyasyibbu.
Kubbazu anguwe kuli mupayizi, imwalumi uzwa mukati mu Jelusalemu, wakayakulula.
Kuzwa mbabo Bbenjamini a Hasyubbi bakayakulula bulangene ang'anda yabo.  Kuzwa kulimbabo Azaliya mwana mulombe wa Maseyiya mwana mulombe wakayakulula kubbazu lyang'anda yakwe.
Kuzwa kuli nguwe Bbinuyi mwana mulombe Henadadi nguwakayakulula chimwi chimpanzi, kuzwa kung'anda ya Azaliya kusika kuchiswi chabulambo.
Palalu mwana mulombe wa Uzayi wakayakulula ajulu lyachiswi chabulambo alimwi akung'anda ndamfu iyakujulu kuzwa kung'anda yamujulu yamwami kumanjililo asikulinda.

Kubbazu kulinguwe Pedayiya mwana mulombe wa Palosyi nguwakayakulula. Lino intempele yabalanga bakali kukkala mu Ofelu nguwakayakulula kuyosika achiimo chilangene a Mulyango wa Manzi kubbazu kubuzwezuba bwabuyake bwang'anda ndamfu.
Kuzwa nguwe ba Tekkoyiti bakayakulula chimbi chimpanzi echo chakalangene chisanza chipati yamulimu kulale mbuli kuyosika ku Ofelu.
Bapayizi bakayakulula kujulu kuMulyango wa Mabbiza, umwi kulangeene ang'anda yakwe.
Kuzwa mbabo Zadokki mwana mulombe wa Lima wakayakulula limwi bbazu lilangeene ang'anda yakwe. Elyo, kuzwa nguwe Syemayiya mwana mulombe wa Syekkaniya, mulindizi wamulyango wakujwe, wakayakulula.

Kuzwe nguwe Hananiya mwana mulombe wa Syemiya, antomwe a Hanuni wamusanu awumwi mwana wa Zalafu, wakayakulula chimwi chimpanzi. Kuzwe nguwe Mesyulamu mwana mulombe wa Belekkiya wakayakulula kubbazu lilangene amayake mpakkala.
Kuzwe nguwe Malukkija, umwi wabafuzi bangolide, wakayakulula ng'anda yamulanda wachikombelo alimwi abasambazi bakalangene amilyango akuyosikila kumatantilo aakuchiswi chamanyoneno.
Bafuzi bangolida abasambazi bakayakulula akati kamatantilo aku Mulyango waMbelele.
Lino eelyo Sanibbalati nakamvwa tulokuyaka bulambo, zyakamupa bulingu we, wakanyema kapati loko, alimwi wakabasampawula baJuda.

Mubuliwo bwabakulana bakwe abasilumamba baSamaliya, wakati, "Niinzi nchibabolokuchita aaba bamaJuda batasimide? Sa balakonzya kuyakulula dolopo lyabo beni? Sa bayopa zipayizyo? Sa bawumana mulimu muzuba limwi? Sa bayobozya kubuumi mabwe kuzwa kumalwi adilikide musule akuti akaali awumpwa.
Tobiya muAmolayiti wakali aanguwe, alimwi wakati, "Aanoli Mwaaba kupela wayinka ajulu kuyobona eezyo nzibalokuyaka. Uyomwaya mabwe abulambo bwawo aansi!"
Mvwa , Leza wesu, nkaambo tulisulidwe. Bweedezya matusi aabo aamitwe yabo beni akubapa baabwe  munyika yabuzike.
Utavumbi pe milandu yabo akuchita kuti zibi zyabo zitamwasigwi pe kuzwa kunembo lyako, nkaambo bakakalazya basikuyaka kuti banyeme.
Aboobo twakayaka bulambo boonse bwakaswaanana kusika kuchisela chabulamfu bwacho, nkaambo bantu bakali  achiyandisyo chakubeleka.

Pesi eelyo Sanibbalati, Tobbiya, muAlabbiyiyeni, MuAmolayiti, alimwi amuAsyidodayiti nakamvwa kuti mulimu wakuyakulula bulambo bwaJelusalemu wakali kuya kunembo, alimwi masena aakatyokede mumilmbo  akali kaajalwa, kunyema kupati kwakabawumpa muli mbabo.
Bakabamba boonse alimwi bakaza kuyolwana aJelusalemu akuchita kuti kube kutamvwisisyaniya mukati.
Pesi twakakomba kuliLeza wasu alimwi wakabika sikulinda mbuli chikwabilizyo kuli mbabo sikati amansiku nkambo kaziyoosyo zyabo
Mpawo bantu baJuda bakati, "Inguzu zyabaabo babweza mikuli zyakachila . Kuli malwi miingi loko , alimwi tatulokonzya pe kuti tuyakulule bulambo.
Basinkondoma bakati, "tabakoyoziba pe naa kubona kuyosikila tukasike aakati kabo akubajaya, alimwi akwimikizya mulimu."
Kuli eecho chiindi, baJuda, aabo bakakkede aafwiifi ambabo bakasika kuzwa kumabazu woonse akwambuula kulindiswe kwazyindi zilikkum, akutuchenjezya aatala lyamabambe ngibakali kuchitaaatala andiswe.
Aboobo ndakabika bantu muzibaka zilaansi zyabulambo mumasena aboneka . Ndakabika mpuli imwi ayimwi amapanga aayo, adaantambwa.

Mpawo ndakalanga, akwiimikila, alimwi ndakati kuli basilutwe, akubeendelezi akubantu boonse,      Mutabayowi pe. Amuyeezye mwaami, ooyo muapati kapatila. Mulwanine muli zyanu, bana banu balombe abasimbi, banakazi banu amyuunzi yanu."
Chakasika chiindi eecho basinkondoma nibakamvwa kuti mabambe aabo akazibwa kulindiswe,  akuti Leza wakali wanyemena mabambe aabo, toonse twakabweeda kumilambo, umwi awumwi kumulimu wakwe.

Aboobo kuzwa kuli eecho chiindi chibela chabalanda bangu bakabeleka kuyakulula bulambo kupela, alimwi chabamwi chibela chakajisi ingumba, intobo, daantambwa, akuzwata zyakulwaniya, bo bazuluzi bakaliimvwi kusule abantu boonse baJuda.
Alimwi bantu bakali kuyaka bulambo alimwi bakabwezede mikuli bakalibambide lubo buvubi bwabo. Umwi awumwi wakachita mulimu wakwe akuboko kumwi, alimwi kumwi kuboko kwakajisi chilwaniyo chakwe.
Woonse muyaki wakalizweete ipanga lyakwe kalibikibe muchibuno kulilimwi bbazu, alimwi oobo mbubo mbwakali kubeleka. Umwi ooyo wakali kulizya mweembo wakalikkede kubbazu lyangu.
Ndakati kulibasilutwe akubeendelezi akubantu boonse, "Mulimu mupati akuvulisya, alimwi tulisenseene kumilambo, kule kule akuluumwi.
Mwelede kufwambana kubusena ooko nkomumvwa mweembo kuulila akuyoobungana nkuko, Leza wesu uyotulwanina,"
Aboobo twakalikuchita mulimu. Chisela abamwi chakajisi ngumba kuzwa kubuchedo kuyosikila kuzwa kwanyenyeezi.

Ndakati lubo kubantu kuchiindi eecho, "Akube kuti woonse mwaalumi amulandaakwe bakkale mansiku woonse aakati kaJelusalemu, aboobo bayoba balindi besu kuchiindi chamansiku alimwi kuyooba basikubeleka kuchiindi nikwacha.

Aboobo nikuba ndime, naa bakulana bangu, naa balanda bangu, naa baalumi balinda banditobela, takwepe wesu wakachincha zisamo zyeesu, alimwi umwi awumwi wesu wakabwezede chilwaniyo chakwe, nikuba kuti naali kuya kumaanzi,
Mpawo bantu abanakazi babo bakali kulilisya loko kabalilila bakwabo baJuda.
Nkambo kwakali bamwi bakamba kuti " Antomwe abana balombe abasimbi tuli bingi. Aboobo atubweze maila kuti tulye akupona."
Kwakkali bamwi lubo bakamba kuti, " tulokukweletesya myunda yesu, amisansa yesu amanda esu kuti tujane maila muchindi chanzala."
Bamwi bakaamba kuti, " Twacheneka mali kuti tuliyo mutelo mumyuunda yesu ayamisansa.

Nikuba kuti inyama yesu abulowa bulikozyene mbuli yabakulana besu, alimwi bana besu balakozyania mbuli bana babo. Twangilwa biya kuti tuuzye bana besu balombe abana besu basimbi kuti babebazike . Bamwi bana besu basimbi  bachitwa bazike kale. Pesi tatukwe nguzu zyakubagwasyankambo bamwi bantu lino bali mumyunda amumisansa."
Ndakanyema loko nindakamvwa kulila kwabo amajwi aya.

Mpawo ndakayeya obu, alimwi ndakainka chakulibombya akulitondezya kubapati akubendelezi. Ndakabambila kuti, "Inwe mulayandisya kuyungizya umwi kuzwa kumukulana wakwe." Ndakababusizya mbungano mpaati loko

akubambila kuti, " Nkambo iswe lwesu, tulachita mukwindila munguzu zyesu, tulamununa bakulana besu baJuda bakauzigilwe kuzisi, pesi mwakawuzya bakulana banu kuti banununwe kuzwa kulindiswe!" Bakumuna akubula ajwi lyakwambula.
Alimwi ndakamba kuti, " Nzimulokuchita tazilizibtu pe. Sa tamwelede kweenda chakuyowa Leza wesu kuti  ataleki kutuka zisi zili abasinkondoma?
Ime abakulana ababelesi bangu tulokubacheneka mali amaila. Pesi twelede kwimikila kuyungizya imbi mali atala azikwelete ezi.
Amubwedezye myunda yabo kuli elino zuba, amisansa yabo, azilili zyama olifa, amanda abo, ayimwi mali yabo, maila, wine mpya, alimwi amafuta alya ngimwakatola changuzu kuzwa kuli mbabo."

Mpawo bakamba kuti, "Tulabwedezya ezyo nzitwakatolede kuzwa kulimbabo, alimwi takwe chitutakayande pe kulimbabo. Tuyochita mbuli mbuwamba." Mpawo ndakayita bapayizi, alimwi ndakachita kuti bakonke kuchitila kuti bachite mbuli mbubakasyomezya.

Ndakasansamuna mupeto wazyakusama zyangu akwamba kuti, "Aboobo Leza kasansamuna nganda yakwe akupa woonse muntu oyoo utabambi chisyomeyo chakwe. Aboobo kasansamunwa akuchala katakwe chintu." Yoonse mbungano yakati, "Ameni," alimwi bakalumbayizya Jehova abantu bakachita nzibakasyomezezye.

Aboobo kuzwa chindi nindakatondekwa kuba muzuluzi wabo munyika yaJuda, wazwa kumyaka ilimakumi abili akusikila ilimakumi atatu abili mumunyaka wamwami Atasisi, myaka ilikumi ayibili, nikuba ndime na bakulana bangu takwe walya chakabambilidwe muzuluzi.

Pesi bazuluzi batanzi bakaliwo musule lyangu bakabikkila bantu mikuli milemu, alimwi batola kuzwa kulimbabo masekeli ansililva alimakumi one ansiliva kuti kube chilyo chaboo chamazuba onse awayini. Nibaba babelesi babo bakali baami atala lyabantu. Pesi tendakachita oobo pe nkaambo kakuyowa Leza.
Ndakayinkilila anembo akubeleka bulambo alimwi tetwakawula nyika, alimwi tetwakawula nyika, alimwi balanda bangu boonsenbakali bungene nkuko nkambo kamulimu.
Atafula lyangu kakali baJuda abendelezi, alimwi balumi balimwanda amakumi masanu kusiya abo bakaza kulindiswe kuzwa akati kazisi zyakatuzyungulukide.

Lino eecho chakalikubambwa mubuzuba bumwi abumwi, musune umwi, imbelele zilimusanu ayimwi zisalidwe, atuyuni, muzuba lyakumi mawayini amusyobo wonse, mulizyonse eezi takwe nindakayanda zilyo zyamuzuluzi, nkambo mulimu wakalimulemu kubantu aba.
Ukandiyeye, Leza wangu, Kuzibotu, nkambo kazyoonse nzindakachitila bantu aba.

Lino elyo Sanibbalati, Tobbiya, a Geshemu mu Alabbiyeni abamwi boonse basinkondoma nibakamvwa kuti ndayakulula malambo alimwi takwe busena bwaka chimwayikide mulimbubo, nekuba kuti tendakayina yimika makoma amilyango.
Sanibbalati a Geshemu bakandiita nkabati, ''Kweza, tuswanane antomwe kumwi kukkuti lya Oono.'' Pesi nkabayeeya kundibisizya.
Ndakabatumina batumwa kulimbabo, nkengwamba, ''Ndikuchita mulimo mupati, alimwi nsikonzyi pe kuseluka munsi. Nkambonzi mulimo nutimikile chindi nchesyusiye akuselukila kuli ndinywe?''
Bakanditumina mulumbe ukozyenie zyiindi zyoone, mpawo ndakali kusandula nsandulo zikozyenie choonse chindi.
Sanibbalati wakatuma mulanda wakwe kuli ndime bukozyenie akuchiindi chamusanu, nkajisi lugwalo lujulidwe mujanza lyakwe.

Mulindulo nkamulembedwe, kulindime, ''Kwamvwigwa akkati kamanyika, mpawo Geshemu alimwi wazyamba, kuti iwebo aba Juda mulayeya kupapila, nchenchicho nchiwayakulula bulambo. Kuzwa kumilumbe oyo nzuwamba lwako wamba kuba mwami wabo.

Alimwi ulibikide basinsimi kuti bakambawuke obu atala anduwe mu Jelusalemu, nkabati, ''Kuli mwami muli Juda!' Ube akasimpe kuti mwami uyowamvwa makani aya. Nkiinkako kweza, bola tuzowambule umwi akulumwi katulamwi.''
Aboobo ndakabatumina ijwi kuli nguwe ilyamba kuti, ''Takwe pe zintu zyakachitika zilimbuli nzuwamba, ulamba miyeyo wako biyo.''
Nkambo boonse bakali kuyanda kutuyoosya, nkabayeeya kuti, ''Maboko abo alaleka milimo, mpawo milimo tichichitiki pe.'' Pesi lino, Leza, ikaka koyumya maboko angu.

Ndakayinka kung'anda ya Semaya mwana wa Delaya mwana mulombe wa Mehetabbelu, oyo wakajalilidwe mumunzi wakwe. Wakati, ''Atuswanane antomwe mumung'anda ya Leza, mukati muchikombelo, alimwi atujale makoma achikombelo, nkambo bayobuza kuzojaya. Mansiku balasika kuzokujaya.''
Ndakasandula kuti, ''Ngamuntu ulimbuli ndime ngunga ulachija na? Ngamuntu ulimbuli ndime ulachijila muchikombelo na kuyolifutula bumi bwangu ndemwini? Nsikochijila mukati pe mebo!''
Ndakaziba kuti tensi Leza pe wamutuma, pesi wakandambila chisinsimi atala andime. Tobbiya a Sanibbalati bakamuula.
Bakamuula kuti akonzye kundiyoosya, kuchitila kuti ndikonzye kuchita nzyawamba mpawo ndibisye, kuchitila kuti bandipe izinabbi mpawo nsampawulwe.
Koyeeya Tobbiya a Sanibbalati, Leza wangu kwindila kunchito zyabo. Alimwi utalubi musinsimi wechanakazi Nowadiya antomwe abamwi boonse basinsimi boonse abo bakeezya kundiyoosya.
Aboobo bulambo bwakamana muzuba lya makkumi obile amusanu bwamwezi wa Elulu, kunembo lyamazuba alimakkumi musanu aabili.
Eelyo boonse basinkondoma besu nibakamvwa anchicho, woonse maasi akatwengelede, akayoowa mpawo bakafwinsigwa loko mumenso abo beni. Nkiinkako bakaziba mulimo wakachitwa mukugwasigwa a Leza.
Muchindi echi bapati baba Juda bakatumina magwalo manji kuli Tobbiya, amagwalo akasika kuzwa kuli Tobbiya kulimbabo.

Nkambo bakali banji mu Juda abo bakangiidwe achikonke kuli nguwe, nkambo wakali mukwansa kuli Sekkaniya mwana mulombe wa Aala. Mwana wakwe Jehohanani wakali wamubweza mbuli mukayintu wakwe mwana musimbi wa Mesulamu mwana mulombe wa Bbelekkiya.
Alubo bakali kwambula atala amilimo mibotu alimwi amajwi aangu bakatola kuli nguwe. Magwalo akatumizigwa kuli ndime kuzwa kuli Tobbaya kuti andiyoosye.
Muchindi bulambo nibwakamana alimwi nindakamana kwimika makkoma mubusena, antomwe abalindizi bamilyango abayimbi aba Levayiti bakasaligwa,
ndakabika mukula Hamani kukwendelezya atala Jelusalemu, antomwe a Hanania oyo wakali silutwe wang'anda yabwami, nkambo wakali mwalumi usyomeka alimwi kayoowa Leza kwinda bantu banji.

Ndakati kuli mbabo, ''Mutajuli milyango ya Jelusalemu kusikila izuba likasaale. Aboobo balindizi bamilyango kabachilindila, mujale milyango akwilindila, musale basikulindila akkati kababo bakala mu Jelusalemu, bamwi babe abulangizi bwabo, balindile kubusena bulangene amunzi wabo.''
Lino chisi chakali kwazeme mpawo kachili chipati, pesi nkakuli bantu bache mulinchicho, alimwi kakutakwe manda akali ayakululwa.

Leza wangu wakachibika mumoyo wangu kuti mbunganie antomwe bapati, abendelezi, alimwi abantu kuti balembwe ampuli zyabo.  Ndakajana ibhuku lyamazya;lane aaboibakatanguna kujoka mpawo ndakajana zyakalembedwe mulindilyo.
Aba mbibantu babbooma abakazwa mubuzike Nebbukkadinezala mwami wa Bbabbiloni mbakatolede mubuzike.

Aba bakayeeya bbuku lyakalembedwe mpuli zyabo, pesi telyakajanwa pe, abobo bakagwisigwa kuzwa kubapayizi mbuli batasalali.
Alubo mwendelezi wakabambila kuti tabako zumizigwa kulya chimpanzi chakulya chaba payizi kuzwa kuzipayililo kusikila kunyampuke mupayizi antomwe a Ulimu a Tumimu.
Imbungano yoonse antomwe yakali 42,360,
