Bamwi kuzwa akkati kabasilutwe bampuli zyabasiluzubo bakapa zipo zyakugwasya milimo. Mwendelezi kapa Sinkomo Chuulu, changolide, amitiba ili 50, antomwe a 530 mpasya zyabupayizi.
Bamwi basilutwe bempuli zyanzubo bakapa milimo zyuulu zya ngolida antomwe 2,200 ansiliva.
Aba bamwi bantu bakapa ziputu zyangolida, antomwe azyuulu zibili zyansiliva, antomwe a makkumi musanu abili ampasya zyabupayizi.

Aboobo bapayizi, ba Levayiti, balindizi bamilyango, basikwimba, bamwi bantu, balanda bantempele, mpawo aboonse ba Izilayeli bakali kukkala mumyunzi yabo. Mumwezi wamusanu ayibili bantu ba Izilayeli bakakazikwa mumyunzi yabo.''
Boonse bantu bakabungana mbuli muntu omwe abusena bukwazeme kunembo lyamulyango wamanzi. Bakambila Ezila mulembi kuti ayete bbuku lyamulawu wa Mozesi, oyo Jehova ngwakalayilila Izilayeli.
Muzuba tanzi lyamwezi wamusanu ayibili, Ezila mupayizi wakayeta mulawu kunembo lyambungano, akkati kabalumi abamakayintu, mpawo aboonse bakkonzya kumvwa akumvwisya.

Wakalanga kubusena bukwazeme kunembo lyamulyango wamanzi, mpawo wakabala kuzwa kuli ndilyo kuzwida chifumo kuseni kuyosikila sikati, kunembo lyabalumi abakayintu, mpawo kufumbwa walikumvwisya, alimwi aboonse bantu bakali kuswilizya bbuku lyamulawo.

Alubo Ezila mulembi wakayimikila atala lyachisamu echo bantu nchibakachitila makani ngawonya. Bakalimvwi kumbali lyakwe kwakali Matitiya, Shema, Ananiya, Uliya, Hilikkiya, antomwe a Maseyiya, kubbazu luchilisyo chakwe; alimwi Pedayiya, Mishayelu, Malukkija, Hashumu, Hashibbadana, Zekkaliya, alimwi a Meshulamu bakalimvwi kubbazu lyakwe lyakochimwensi.
Ezila wakajula bbuku kumenso abantu boonse, nkambo wakayimvwi atala lyabantu, mpawo nakalijula bantu boonse bakanyampuka.
Ezila wakalongezya Jehova, Leza mupati, mpawo bantu  boonse bakanyampula maboko abo mpawo bavwiila, ''Ameni! Ameni!'' Alimwi bakakotamina ansi akukomba Jehova kabavundeme.

Alakwe Jeshuwa, Bbani, Shelebbiya, Jamini, Akkubbu, Shabbetayi, Hodiya, Maseyiya, Kkelita, Azaliya, Jozabbadi, Hanani, Pelayiya- mu Levayiti -- wakagwasizya bantu kuti bamvwisisye mulawu, bantu kabachimvwi kubusena bwabo.
Bakabala mubbuku, Imulawo wa Leza, kabotu akupandulula majwi mbwawamba alimwi bantu bakamvwisisisya kubalwa.

Nehemiya mwendelezi , a Ezila mupayizi a mulembi, mpawo aba Levi abo bakali kupandulwida bantu bakati kubantu boonse, ''Elizuba lilasalala kuli Jehova Leza wenu. Mutawomoki nekuba kukwila. Nkambo bantu boonse bakoomoka nibakamvwa majwi amumulawu.

Abobo Nehemiya wakati kuli mbabo, ''Kamuya, mukalye zinenede azimwi zinona zyakunywa, mutumizye zimwi zyazyo kuliyoyo watabambilide, nkambo elino zuba lilasalala kumwami wesu. Utatyompwi, nkambo lukondo lwa Jehova nzyenguzu zyanu.''
Abobo ba Levi bakata bantu kuti bawumune, nkabalokuti, ''Lumuno ! Nkambo zuba elino lilasalala. Mutakatyompwi.''
Alubo bantu boonse bakayinka kuyolya akuyonywa akuyowabana kulya akusekelela alukondo lupati nkambo bakalibamvwisisisya majwi ayo akali azibisigwa kulimbabo.
Muzuba lyabili bazuluzi bempuli zyaluzubo bazwa kubantu boonse, bapayizi aba Levayiti, bakeza antomwe kuli Ezila mulembi kuti bamvwisisye majwi amulawo.
Bakajana kuli lembedwe mumulawo mbuli Jehova mbwakalayilila kwinda kuli Mozesi kuti bantu ba Izilayeli balelede kukkala mumaanda muzyiindi zyamapobwe amyeezi wamusanu ayibili.

Balelede kwambilizya mumasena aabo, amu Jelusalemu, nkabati, ''Kamuya muchilundu, akuyoboozya intabi zizwa kumu Olifa ami Olifa yamulusaka, akuzwa kumisiiwe, akutukunka akumisamu ijiisi matu manji, mukachite maanda, mbuli mbukulembedwe.''

Abobo bantu bakayinka akuyoyeta intabi akulichitila lwabo beni maanda, umwi awumwi atululi twakwe, mubusena oobo, mubusena yabusena bweng'anda ya Leza, mubusena bukwazeme kunembo lyamulyango wamanzi, aakkati kamulyango wa Efulemu.

Woonse mabunga ababo bakabweede kuzwa mubwaange bakachita maanda akukkala mulingawo. Kuzwida mumazuba a Joshuwa mwana wa Nuuni muzuba elyo, bantu ba Izilayeli tebakayina sekelela pobwe eli, aboobo lukondo lwabo lwakaba lupati loko.

Alimwi zuba abuzuba, kuzwa kuzuba tanzi kusikila kuzuba lyamamanino, Ezila wakali kubala kuzwa mubbuku lya mulawo wa Leza. Bakali kubamba pobwe lyamazuba alimusanu aabili mpawo muzuba lyamusanu aatatu kwakaba imbungano, mukuzumina malayilile.
Lino mubuzuba bwamakkumi obile aane mumwezi nguwonya bantu ba Izilayeli bakali bungeene aakulyimya, mpawo nkabazwete masaka, akulibika dyota amitwe yabo.
Ilunyungu lwa Izilayeli lwakali pambula kuzwa kubeenzu. Bakayimikila balyambila zibi zyabo akunchito mbii zyabasikale babo.

Bakayimikila mumasena aabo, mpawo muzuba lyomwe lyachine lyabuzuba bakali kubala kuzwa mubbuku lyamulawu wa Jehova Leza wabo. Alubo muzuba lyyanche bakali kulya mbawula zibi akuvundama kunembo lya Jehova Leza wabo.
Ba Levayiti, Jesuwa, Bbaani, Kkadimiyelu, Sebbaniya, Bbuni, Selebbiya, Bbani, antomwe a Kkenani, bakayimikila mpawo bayiita Jehova Leza wabo ejwi pati.

Alimwi ba Levayiti, Jeshuwa, a Kadimiyelu, Bbani, Hashabbuneya, Hodiya, Shebaniya, antomwe a Petahiya wakati, ''Mwimikile akupa kulumbayizya kuli Jehova Leza wanu kwalyoonse.'' ''Ngaba longezye izina lyako mubulemu, akusumpulwa atala azyoonse zilongezyo andumbayizyo.
Nduwe Jehova. Awulikke. Wakachita julu, ijulu ilili kujulu, amakamu woonse awo, aanyika azyonse zilimulindulo. Wapa buumi kuli boonse, amakamu akujulu akukombe.
Nduwe Jehova, Leza wakasala Abbulamu, akumugwisya kuzwa ku Ulii yaku Chaludiya, akumupa izina lya Abbulahamu.

Wakajana moyo wakwe wakali syomekede kunembo lyako, mpawo wakachita chizuminano anguwe kuchipa kulunyungu lwakwe inyika yama Kkananayiti, ba Hiti, ba Amolayiti, ba Peluzi, ba Jebbusi aba Gilugasi. Wakabamba chisyomezyo chako nkambo uliluleme.
Wakabona mapenzi abamataata mu Ijiputi akumvwa kulila kwabo kulwizi lwa Matete.

Wakachita zitondezyo azigambyo kuli Falo, akubalanda bakwe boonse, aakubantu boonse banyika yakwe, mbuli mbumwizi kuti ba Ijiputi mbubaka muchitila chakumusampawula atala andinywe. Pesi wakali janina izina lyempuwo mbubonya mbojisi sunu.
Alubo wakaandula lwizi kunembo lyabo, aboobo bakayinda akkati kalwizi atala lyanyika njuumu; akuwala abo bakali kubatobela mumuninga, mbuli ibbwe mumanzi malamfu.
Wakaba zulwida amusumpululu wajoba muchindi chamasikati, mpawo amusumpululu wamulilo chindi chamansiku kumunika inzila kuchitila kuti balyendelele.
Atala lyachilundu cha Sinayi wakaseluka wakambula ambabo kuzwa kujulu mpawo wabapa bululami amulawu wakasimpe, ambeta mbotu amilayizyo.
Wakalichitila Sababta lisalala lyazibwa kuli mbabo, mpawo wabapa milawu aambeta amulawu kwinda muli Mozesi mulanda wako.
Wakabapa chibunge kuzwa kujulu kunzala yabo, aamanzi kuzwa kubbwe kunyota yabo nkali, mpawo wakabambila kuti biinke mukkati bakali janine nyika njiwakakonka chikonke kukubapa.
Pesi lwabo abaluzubo besu bakachita chakulisumpula, akuyumya nsingo zyabo mpawo tebakaswilila kumilawo yako.

Bakakaka kuswilila, mpawo tebakayeeya atala azigambyo ezyo nziwakachita akkati kabo, pesi bakayumya nsingo zyabo, amukupapila kwabo bakalisalila muzuluzi sikubabwedezya mubuzike bwabo. Pesi uli Leza uzwide lulekelelo, luzyalo alwetelelo, utafwambani kukunyema, mpawo uyimvwi mumilayizyo waluyando. Tewakaba takata pe.
Nekuba kuti nebakali fulila ching'ombe kuzwa kumudaka wansimbi akuti, 'Ooyu ngo Leza wako oyo wakakweta kuzwa ku Ijiputi; akumuchita milimo isampawula loko,

lwako, mulwetelelo lwako, tewakabatakata pe munkanda. Imusumpululu wajoba kukubazulwida munzila tewakabasiya pe muchindi chamasikati, nekuba musumpululu wamulilo muchindi chamansiku kubamunikila inzila kuchitila kuti beende.
Wakabapa muuya wako mubotu kuti ubayiisye, aa maana ako tewakabanyanzya kuzwa kumilomo yabo, aa manzi wakabapa nibakafwa nyota.
Kwaminyaka ilimakumi aane wakabapa munkanda, takwepe nchibakabula. Zyakusama zyabo tezyakadeluka akundyato zyabo tekwaka zimba pe.
Wakabapa maami azisi akuzyabilo kulimbabo banyika yoonse. Alubo bakatola buvubi bwanyika ya Sihoni mwami wa Hezibboni aakunyika ya Ogi mwami wa Bbasani.
Wakabavuzya baana babo mbuli nyeenyezi zyakujulu, mpawo wakabeeta munyika eeyo njiwakambila bamawisi kuti biinke mulinjiiyo akwikona.

Aboobo bantu bakanjila akuvuba nyika akubombya kunembo lyabo bakakede munyika, ba Kkenanayiti. Wakabapa mumaboko abo, a baami babo abantu banyika, obo ba Izilayeli mbwakonzya kuchita ambabo mbuli mbuba kondelezya.

Bakabweza masi akayakilidwe amabaya aanyika ilampindu, akuuvuba maanda akazwide azintu zyoonse zibotu, amikala iyakasyidwe kale, myuunda yamasansa aama olifa, aamichelo yaminsamu mubwingi.  Aboobo bakalya akukkuta mpawo bakaneneya akukondwa mububotu bwako bupati.
Mpawo bakakatazya alimwi bakakupapila. Bakasowa mulawu kusule lyabo. Bakajaya basinsimi bako bakabachenjezya kuti bapiluke kuli nduwe, aakuchita milimo mipati yabusampuzi.

Aboobo wakabaaba mumaboko abasinkondo nyina, abo bakabapenzya. Muzyindi zyamapenzi abo, bakakwilila nduwe, mpawo wakabamvwa kuzwa kujulu, aakambo kaluzyalo wakabatumina basikubavuna aabo bakabavuna kuzwa kumaboko abasinkondonyina.

Pesi musule akulyookezya, bakachita bubi lubo kunembo lyako, mpawo wakabatakata kumaboko aba sinkondonyina, aboobo bakabapenzya. Muzyiindi zyamapenzi abo, baka kwilila nduwe, mpawo wakabamvwa kuzwa kujulu, aa kwachindi chiingi akambo kalwetelelo lwako wakabavuna.

Wakabachenjezya kuti bakonzye kuboola kumulawu wako. Nekubaboobo bakachita chakulisumpula mpawo tebakaswilila kumalayilile aako. Bakabisya kuma layilile ako aapa buumi kuli oyo kufumbwa uwatobela. Bakafutatila amakuko abo akuymya nsingo. Bakafutatila amakuko abo akuyumya nsingo yabo akukaka kuswilila.
Kumyaka myiingi wakabajatila moyo akubachenjezya amuuya kwinda mubasinsimi  bako. Nekubaboobo tebakaswilila. Aboobo wakabapa mumaboko abantu banyika.
Pesi muluzyalo lwako lupati tewakabajaya chakubamaninsya nanka kubasowa, nkambo nduwe siluzyalo Leza sibuuya.

Lino nkiinkako, Leza wesu -- ulimupati, singuzu, alimwi uyoosya Leza uubamba chizuminano aluyando --utachiti kuti buyumuyumu obu bubanga mbuche mumenso ako butusikila, mubaami besu, mubazuluzi besu, akuba payizi, aakuba sinsimi, akuli bamataata, mpawo akubantu boonse kuzwa kumazuba abaami ba Asiliya kusikila sunu.
Uliluleme muli zyoonse eezyo zitusikila, nkambo nduwe ochita chakusyomeka, pesi swebo twachita chakubisya.
Baami besu, buzuluzi bwesu, bapayizi besu, abamatata besu tebakabamba milawu yako, nikuba kuswilizya kumalayilile aako, nikuba kuswilizya kamalayile kana mabambe ngwaka bachenjezya.
Nekuba mubwami bwabo, nibakachili kukondwa bupati bwabubotu kuli mbabo, mumyuunda mipati ilabutebuzi bubotu njiwakabapa kunembo lyabo, tebaka kumanina milimo nanka kusiya nchito zyabo zyabubi.
Lino twaba bazike munyika njwakapa bamatata kuti babotelwe michelo yayo aazipo zibotu zyayo, mpawo langa, twaba bazike mulinjiyo!
Butebuzi bwesu bupati bwanyika yesu bulabweza abaami mbwabika kuti batwendelezye nkambo kazibi zyesu. Bendelezye mibili yesu aambono zyesu mbuli mbubayanda. Tuli mumapenzi mapati.
Nkambo kazyonse ezyi, tulatangana chizuminano chakusinizya mubulembo. Amulembe ajalilidwe kumazina aba zuluzi besu, Levayiti, aba payizi.''
Mumalembe akajalidwe nkonkuko omo Nehemiya, mwendelezi, mwana mulombe wa Hakkaliya antomwe a Zedekkiya,
Selayiya, Azaliya, Jelemiya,
Pasihuwa, Amaliya, Malukija,
Hatushi, Shebbaniya, Malukku,
Halimu, Melemoti, Obbadiya,
Daniyele, Ginetoni, Bbalukku,
Mesulamu, Abbija, Mijamini,
Maziya, Bbilugayi, a Shemayiya. Aba bakali bapayizi.
Ba Levayiti mbaba: Jeshuwa mwana mulombe wa Azaniya, Bbinuyi wamumpuli ya Henadadi, Kkadimiyelu,
antomwe abasimulimonyina ba Levayiti, Shebbaniya, Hodiya, Kkelita, Pelayiya, Hanani,
Mikka, Lehobbu, Hashabbiya,
Zakka, Shelebbiya, Shebbaniya,
Hodiya, Bbani, antomwe a Bbeninu.
Bazuluzi babantu bakali ba: Paloshi, Pahati-Mowabbu, Elamu, Zatu, Bbani,
Bbuni, Azigadu, Bbebbayi,
Adonija, Bbigivayi, Adini,
Ataa, Hezekkiya, Azuwa,
Hodiya, Hashumu, Bbezayi,
Halifu, Anatoti, Nebbayi,
Magipiyasi, Meshulamu, Hezi,
Meshezabbelu, Zadoku, Jaduwa,
Pelatiya, Hanani, Anayiya,
Hoshiya, Hananiya, Hashubbu,
Haloheshi, Piluha, Shobbeki,
Lehumu, Hashabbina, Maseyiya,
Ahiya, Hanani, Anani,
Malukku, Halimu, antomwe a Bbana.

Kuli bamwi babantu, bakali bapayizi, ba Levi, basikulinda milyango, basikwimba, babeleki bamuchikombelo, antomwe abonse bakalyanzania lwabo beni kuzwa kubantu benyika akuligwisya lwabo beni kumulawo wa Leza, kubikilizya abanakazi babo, abana babo balombe abana babo basimbi, boonse bakali aluzibo akuswilila,

bakaswanana antomwe abakulimbabo, abapati abalyanga lwabo beni achisyomezyo antomwe achikonke kuti beende mumulawo wa Leza, oyo wakapedwe Mozesi mulanda wa Leza, alimwi akubamba alimwi akutobelezya milawu yoonse ya Jehova Mwami wesu ambeta zyakwe amilazyo yakwe.
Twakasyomezya kuti tatukoyopa bana besu basimbi bkubantu bamunyika nanka bana babo basimbi kubana besu balombe.

Alimwi twakabasyomezya alimwi kuti bantu benyika beeta zintu naa kufumbwa zilyozyakuzya mubuzuba bwa Sabata, tatukoyowula kulimbabo mubuzuba bwa Sabata na mubuzuba bumwi busalala. Yoonse minyaka yamusanu ayibili tunoyoleka kuti myunda yesu ilyokezye, alimwi tayolekelela zikwelete zyoonse.
Twakazumina kutambula milawu yakupa chimpanzi chatatu chashekeli mumwaka umwi awumwi wamulimu mung'anda ya Leza,

kuti tubike chibunge chamabonwabonwa achazituuzyo zitulwa lyoonse, azyatuuzyo zyakutenta mu Sabata, amumwezi mupya wamapobwe alimwi abikidwe mapobwe, antomwe akuzituuzyo zisalalisya, akuchipayizyo chazibi chakutuuzizya ba Izilayeli, mbubonya mbuli milimo yesu yamung'anda ya Leza wesu.

Bapayizi, ba Levayiti, antomwe abantu bakawala zisolo zyankakata zyazipo zyazisamu. Inkakata zyakali kusala kuti njili impuli iyelede kuzoyeta zisamu mung'anda ya Leza kuchindi chitalidwe awumwi awumwi munyaka, kuti zitentwe achipayililo cha Jehova Leza wesu, mbuli mbokulembedwe mumulawo.
Twakasyomezya kweta mung'anda ya Jehova imichelo mitanzi ilimwa muuvu lyesu, amunyaka amunyaka michelo mitanzi izwa kumusamu umwi awumwi.

Bana besu balombe batanzi, abana bang'ombe zyesu - kwindila mbuli mbukulembedwe mumulawu-abatanzi beng'ombe zyesu abambelele zyesu tuyozyeta kung'anda ya Leza wesu, akubapayizi babeleka mung'anda ya Leza wesu.

Tuyoyeta busu bwesu butanzi bunante  azilyo zyazituuzyo, amichelo yamisamu umwi awumwi awayini mupya amafuta, kubapayizi, kumanda akulondweda amung'anda ya Leza. Tuleta kuba Levi zyakkumi zizwa kuvu lyesu nkambo ba Levi balabweza zyakkumi zyoonse zizwa mudolopo motubeleka.
Mupayizi, alunyungu lwa Aaloni, balelede kuba aba Levi chindi nibatambula zyakkumi. Ba Levi beelede kweta chimpanzi chekkumi mung'anda ya Leza wesu mutwanda twang'anda yakulondweda.

Nkambo bantu ba Izilayeli antomwe abalunyungu lwa Levi belede kweta zilyo, wayini mpya, amafuta mung'anda yakubambila oko nkozikkala zibelesyo zisalala alimwi akoko bapayizi balimukubeleka, antomwe abasikulinda milyango, abasikwimba mpubakkala. Tatukoyolekelela ng'anda ya Leza wesu.
Bazuluzi babantu balikukkala mu Jelusalemu, abamwi babantu bakasala kweta omwe wabali kkumi kuzokkala mu Jelusalemu, chisi chisaala, alimwi abo balimusanu abane bakasyala mulilimbi dolopo.
Mpawo bantu bakalongezya boonse abo bakalipeda kukkala mu Jelusalemu.

Aaba mbasilutwe bendelezi ibakkede mu Jelusalemu. Aboobo, mumadolopo a Juda aumwi walikupona abuvubi bwakwe mwini, kubikilizya aba Izilayeli, bapayizi, ba Levi, basikubamba chikombelo abazike balunyungu lwa Solomoni.

Mu Jelusalemu kwakali kukkala bamwi basimukowa bab Juda abamwi balunyungu lwa Bbenjamini. Ibantu bakwa Juda bakalimo: Atayiya mwana mulombe wa Uziya mwana mulombe wa Zakkaliya mwanamulombe wa Amaliya mwana mulombe wa Shefatiya mwana mulombe wa Mahalalelu, wamukowa wa Pelezi.
Kwakali Maseya mwana wa Bbaluki, mwana mulombe wa Kkoli-Hoze mwana mulombe wa Hazayiya mwanamulombe wa Joyalibbu mwana mulombe wa Zekkaliya, wamukowa wa Shela.
Boonse balunyungu lwa Pelezi oyo wakali kukkala mu Jelusalemu bakali 468. Bakali balumi basintanze bakalibakali.
Aba ndolunyungu lwa Bbenjamini: Saalu mwana mulombe wa Meshulamu mwana mulombe wa Jowebbu mwana mulombe wa Pedayiya mwana mulombe wa Kkolayiya mwana mulombe wa Itiyelu mwana mulombe wa Jeshayi,
ababo bakali kumutobela, Gabbayi a Salayi, 928 balumi.
Jowelu mwana mulombe wa Ziikili wakali silutwe wabo, antomwe a Juda mwana mulombe wa Hasenyuwa wakali wabili mukwendelezya atala adolopo.
Kuzwa kubapayizi: Jedayiya mwana mulombe wa Jowalibbu, Jakkini,
Selayiya mwana mulombe wa Hilukkiya mwana mulombe wa Meshulamu mwana mulombe wa Zdokki mwana mulombe wa Melayoti mwana mulombe wa Ahitubbu, silutwe mupati wamung'anda ya Leza,

alimwi abenzinyina abo bakachita milimo yamung'anda, 822 balumi, antomwe a Adayiya mwana mulombe wa Jelohamu mwana mulombe wa Pelaliya mwana mulombe wa Amuzi mwana mulombe wa Zekkaliya mwana mulombe wa Pashiha mwana mulombe wa Malukija.
Bakulana bakwe bakali basilutwe banzubo, 242 balumi; antomwe a Amashisayi mwana mulombe wa Azalelu mwana wa Ahizayi mwana mulombe wa Mashilemoti mwana wa Imaa,
antomwe abakkulana babo, 128 basikulwana balumi basinchiki; muzuluzi wabo wakali Zabbidyelu mwana mulombe wa Hagedolimu.
Kuzwa kuba payizi: Syamayiya mwana mulombe wa Hasihubbu mwana mulombe wa Azilikkamu mwana mulombe wa Hashabbiya mwana mulombe wa Bbuni,
alimwi a Shabbetayi a Jozabbadi, oyo wakali kuzwa kuba zuluzi baba Levi alimwi bakali kulanga milimo yaanze yaku ng'anda ya Leza.

Kwakali Mataniya mwana mulombe wa Mikka mwana mulombe wa Zbbudi, amukowa wa Asafu, oyo wakali sikutondezya oyo wakatalika inkombyo zyakulumba, antomwe a Bbakibbukkiya, ngowabili akkati kabakkulana bakwe, a Abbuda mwana mulombe wa Syamuwa mwana mulombe wa Galalu mwana mulombe wa Jedutuni.
Bonse bapayizi mudolopo lisalala bakali mweelwe usika ku 284.
Basikulinda milyango: Akkubbu, Talumoni, antomwe abakkulana babo, abo bakali kulinda akulinda milyango, 172 balumi.
Bamwi baba Izilayeli bakasyede abapayizi aba Levi bakalimo mumadolopo woonse a Juda. Woonse awumwi awumwi wakakuponena muchabilo chakwe.
Basimililmo bamuchikombelo bakkala mu Opelu, amu Ziha aku Gishipa mbibakali kubendelezya bonse.

Silutwe uyendelezya ba Levi mu Jelusalemu wakali Uzi mwana mulombe wa Bbani mwana mulombe wa Hashabbiya mwana mulombe wa Mataniya mwanamulombe wa Mikka, balunyungu lwa Asafu, basikwimba atala amulimo wamung'anda ya Leza.
Bakali munsi lwamalayilile amwami, alimwi bakabikilwa bwendelezi bwakapegwa basikwimba abuzuba abuzuba kuzyabilo.
Mpawo Petayiya mwana mulombe wa Meshezabbelu, walunyungu lwa Zela mwana mulombe wa Juda, wakali kubbazu lyamwami kuli zyoonse zyakali kuchitika zyendelana abantu.
Mbuli ku myunzi akumyunda yabo, bamwi babantu ba Juda abo bakali kukkala mu Kkiliyati Abba atunzi twayo, antomwe amu Dibboni atunzi twayo, antomwe amu Jekabbuzelu atunzi twayo,
antomwe amu Jeshuwa, Molada, Bbeti Peleti,
Haza Syuwalu, alimwi a Bbiyasyebba atuunzi twayo.
Bamwi bantu ba Juda bakali kukkala mu Zikkilagi, Mekkona atunzi twayo,
Enilimoni, Zola, Jamuti,
Zanowa, Adulamu, atuunzi twayo, antomwe amu Lakkishi mumyunda yabo antomwe aku Azekka atuunzi twayo. Alimwi bakakkala kuzwa mu Bbiyasha=ebba kuyosika kuMweezi wa Hinomu.
Balunyungu lwaba Bbenjamayiti bakakkede mu Gebba, Mikkimasi, Ayija, Bbetelu atuunzi twayo,
Anatoti, Nobbu, Ananiya,
Haza, Lama, Gitayimu,
Hadidi, Zebboyimu, Nebbalati,
Lodi, amu Oono, musena wababezi.
Bamwi baba Levi abo bakali kukkala mu Juda bakapedwe kubantu ba Bbenjamini.
Aba bakali bapayizi aba Levi ibakeza antoomwe a Zelubbabbelu mwana wa Shelutiyeli antoomwe a Jeshuwa: Selayiya, Jelemiya, Ezila,
Amaliya, Malukku, Hatushi,
Shekkaniya, Lehumu, antomwe a Melemoti.
Kwakali ba Iddo, Ginetoni, Abbija,
Mijamini, Mowadiya, Bbiluga,
Shemayiya, a Joyalibbu, Jedayiya,
Salu, Amokki, Hilukkiya, a Jedayiya. Aba mbibakali basilutwe baba payizi antomwe akabunga kabo mumazuba a Jeshuwa.
Ba Levi kwakali Jeshuwa, Bbinuyi, Kkadimiyelu, Shelebbiya, Juda, alimwi a Mataniya, oyo wakali kwendelezya inyimbo zyazipo zyakulumba, antomwe ababo mbakali abo.
Bbakkibbukiya a Uni, ambibakali abo, bakima kumbali kulilimbi bbazu chindi nibakali kukomba.
Jeshuwa wakali wisi wa Joyakkimu, Joyakkimu wakali wisi wa Eliyashibbu, Eliyashibbu wakali wisi wa Joyiyada,
Joyiyada wakali wisi wa Jonatani, alakwe Jonatani wakali wisi wa Jaduya.
Mumazuba a Joyiyakkimu mbaba bakali bapayizi, bendelezi bamagunzi: Melayiya wakali mwendelezi wa Selayiya, Hananiya wakali mwendelezi wa Jelemiya,
Meshulamu wakali mwendelezi wa Ezila, Jehohanani wakali mwendelezi wa Amaliya,
Jonatani wakali mwendelezi wa Malukku, alimwi Jozefu wakali mwendelezi wa Shebbaniya.
Adina wakali silutwe wa Halimu, Helukkayi wakali silutwe wa Melemoti,
Zekkaliya wakali silutwe wa Ido, Mesulami wakali silutwe wa Ginetoni, alimwi
Zikkili wakali silutwe wa Abbija.  .... wa Miniyamini. Pilutayi wakali silutwe wa Moyadiya.
Shamuwa wakali silutwe wa Bbiluga, Jonatani wakali silutwe wa Shemayiya,
Matenayi wakali silutwe wa Joyiyalibbu, Uzi wakali silutwe wa Jedayiya,
Kkalayi wakali silutwe wa Salu, Ebba wakali silutwe wa Amokki,
Hashabbiya wakali silutwe wa Hilukkiya, alimwi Netaniyelu wakali silutwe wa Jedayiya.

Mumazuba a Eliyashibbu, bapayizi Eliyashibbu, Joyiyada, Johanani, alimwi a Jaduwa bakali lembedwe mbuli basilutwe bamyunzi, antomwe aba payizi bakali lembedwe mumazuba akwendelezya kwa Daliyasi waku Peziya.
Balunyungu lwaba Levi, basilutwe bamyunzi yabo bakali lembedwe mubbuku lyamilongo yamazyalane mane kuzosika kumazuba a Johanani mwana mulombe wa Eliyashibbu.

Bazuluzi baba Levi kwakali Hashabbiya, Shelebbiya, a Jeshuwa mwana mulombe wa Kkadimiyelu, antomwe ambibakali abo, bakayimvwi limbi bbazu ambabo kuti bape ntembawuzyo akupa kulumba, kabazuminana achimwi achimwi chazimpanzi, mukutobelezya mulawu wa Devidi, muntu wa Leza.
Mataniya, Bbakkibbukkiya, Obbadiya, Mesulamu, Talumoni, a Akkubbu bakali basikulinda amilyango kutwanda twakubbikkila twakali kumilyango.
Bakabeleka mumazuba a Joyakkimu mwana mulombe wa Jeshuwa mwana mulombe wa Jozadakki, amumazuba a Nehemiya wakali mwendelezi antomwe a Ezila mupayizi amulembi.

Akulipeda kwabulambo bwa Jelusalema, bantu bakabikka ba Levayiti kufumbwa nkobakali kukkala, kuti babeete ku Jelusalemu kuti bazosekelele kulipeda chakukondwa, antomwe akupakulumba akwimbilila azilizigwa, nyeele amyeembo.
Ibulyidilane bwaba sikwimba bwakabungana antomwe kuzwa muchisi echo chakazyungulukide Jelusalema alimwi akuzwa kumyunzi yaku Netofatitisi.
Alimwi bakeza kuzwa ku Bbeti Gilugalu akuzwa kumyuunda yaku Gebba aku Azimaveti, nkambo basikwimba bakali baliyakila myunzi izyunguluka Jelusalemu.
Bapayizi aba Levayiti bakali salazya lwabo beni, alimwi bakasalazya bantu, milyango, antomwe abulambo.

Alimwi ndakamvwa bazuluzi baba Juda kabatanta kuyosika ampela lyabulambo, alimwi ndakasala zimpanzi zibili zyaba sikwimba zipati abo bakapa kulumba. Chimwi chimpanzi chakayinka kubbazu lyaku chilisyo lyabulambo kabalangene amu Lyango wa Bufumba.
Hoshayiya achimpanzi chabazuluzi ba Juda bakabatobela,
alimwi musule lyabo kwakinka Azaliya, Ezila, Meshulamu,
Juda, Bbenjamini, Shemayiya, Jelemiya,

antomwe abamwi babana babapayizi bakinka amiteteele, alimwi Zekkaliya mwana mulombe wa Jonatani mwana mulombe wa Shemayiya mwana mulombe wa Mataniya mwana mulombe wa Mikkayiya mwana mulombe wa Zakkuwa mwana mulombe wa Asafu.

Kwakaliko alimwi inzubo zya Zekkaliya, Shemayiya, Azalelu, Milalayi, Gilalayi, Mayi, Netaniyelu, Juda, Hanani, antomwe azibelesyo zilizigwa zyakwimbya zya Davida muntu wa Leza. Ezila mulembi wakali kunembo lyabo.

Kubbazu lyam Mulyango Wakasensa bakali kwinka kabaluleme manekuyosika kumatantilo adolopo lya Davida, kubbazu lyamatantilo  kubulambo atala lyabusena bwa Devidi, ku Mulyango Wamaanzi kubbazu lyakujwe.

Chimwi chibeela chabasikwimba bakapa kulumba bakiinda kulilimbi bbazu balanzya kumbi. Ndakabatobela ajulu abulambo achimwi chibela chabantu, ajulu a Ng'anda ndamfu ya Zijikilo, kuyosika ku Bulambo Bukwazeme,

alimwi ajulu lya Mulyango wa Efulemu, alimwi aku Mulyango Mukulukulu, alimwi aku Mulyango Wanswi antomwe aku Ng'anda ndamfu ya Hananelu akusika ku N'g'anda ndamfu ya Mwaanda, kusika ku Mulyango wa Mbelele, alimwi bakakwimikila ku Mulyango waba Sikulinda.
Zyonse zibunga zyaba sikwimba kwabaabo bakalikupa kulumba bakatola busena bwabo mung'anda ya Leza, alimwi ambebo ndakatola busena achimwi chimpanzi chabasilutwe.
Amwi abalo bapayizi bakatola busena bwabo: Eliyakkimu, Maseyiya, Miniyamini, Mikkaya, Eliyonayi, Zekkaliya, a Hananiya, antomwe amiteteele,
alimwi a Masayiya, Shemayiya, Eliyaza, Uzi, Jehohanani, Malukkija, Elamu, antomwe a Eza, abasikwimba bakabachita kuti bamvwikke antomwe a Jezilahiya wakali silutwe wabo.

Bakapa zipayizyo zipati obo buzuba, alimwi bakakondwa, nkambo Leza wakali wabachita kuti bakondwe akubotelwa kupati. Alimwi abalabo bamakayintu abana babo bakakondwa. Nkinkako lukondo lwa Jelusalemu lwakali kumvwikka kule.

Mubuzuba obo balumi bakasalwa kuti babe mbabo basikulanga maanda akulondweda zyakali kugwisigwa., michelo mitanzi, antomwe azyakkumi, kubunganisya mulingawo zyonse zimpanzi mbuli mbukwakambidwe mumulawo atala abapayizi alimwi atala aba Levi. Umwi awumwi wakali pedwe mulimu kuti abeleke mumyunda yakali afwifwi adolopo. Zyakuti Juda wakakondwa atala lyaba payizi aba Levayiti abo bakimvwi kunembo lyabo.
Bakachita milimo ya Leza wabo, antomwe amilimu yakusakatizya, mbombubo mbubakachita basikwimba abasimilyango, akubamba changuzu zya Davida a Solomoni mwana wakwe mulombe.
Nkambo chindi loko, mumazuba a Devidi  a Asafu, kwakali bazulwidi babasikwimba, elyo kwakali inyimbo zyakulumbayizya azyakupa kulumba kuli Leza.

Mumazuba a Zelubbabbelu amumazuba a Nehemiya, boonse ba Izilayeli bakali kupa zyakulya zyazuba azuba kuli basikwimba akubalindizi bamilyango. Bakalikubikka kumbali zimwi zyakulya zyaba Levayiti, alimwi ba Levi bakali kubikkambali chimwi chimpanzi kababikkila chimwi chimpanzi chalunyungu lwa Aaloni.
Mubuzuba obo bakabala mubbuku lya Mozesi kabaswilizizye bantu. Kwakajanika mukati kuti takwepe nikwakalembedwe atala aba Amonayiti nibaba ba Mowabbayiti bakelede kuza mumbungano ya Leza, kwalyoonse.
Eechi chakachitika nkambo takukwe nibakeza kubantu ba Izilayeli achibunge antomwe amanzi, bonya bakawula Bbaalami kuti atukile ba Izilayeli. Nekuba boobo, Leza wakachincha lutuko kuba zilongezyo.
Mukufwambana mbubakamvwa mulawo, bakanzanya kuzwa mu Izilayeli wonseni muntu muzwakule.
Lino musule lyayaya Eliyabbu mupayizi wakasalwa ajulu lyatwada twamanda a Leza. Wakali siluzubo wa Tobbiya.

Eliyashibbu wakabambila Tobbiya ng'anda yakulondweda mpati, eyo njibakali kubelesya mumazuba akayinda mubakali kubikila mayila ezipo, wayini mupya, antomwe a mafuta, ayo akali kubambilwa ba Levi, basikwimba, aba sikulinda milyango, antomwe azyakali kugwisizigwa ba payizi.

Pesi muchindi echi chonseni tindakali mu Jelusalema pe. Nkambo mumunyaka wamakkumi atatu awumwi wa Atakizazasi mwami wa Bbabbiloni ndakinka kumwami. Nikwakayinda kayindi ndakakumbila mvumo kumwami kuti njeende,
alimwi ndakajoka ku Jelusalemu. Ndakamvwisisisya bubi obo Eliyashibbu mbwakali wachita mukupa Tobbiya ng'anda yakulondweda munkuta yakali mung'anda ya Leza.
Ndakanyema loko alimwi ndakasowa boonse beng'anda ya Tobbiya  azintu zyabo anze ang'anda yakulondweda.
Ndakalayilila kuti basalazye ng'anda yakulondweda, alimwi ndakabwedezya mukati zintu zyamungánda ya Leza, imbuto yezipo, antomwe atununkilizyo.
Ndakayiya kuti ba zimpanzi zyaba Levi tezyakapedwe pe kulimbabo, alimwi bakali bachija, umwi awumwi kumunda wakwe, ba Levi abasikwimba abo bakajata mulimo.
Eelyo ndakabalulama basikwendelezya alimwi ndakati, ''Nkambonzi ing'anda ya Leza niyalekelelwa?'' Ndakababungania antomwe alimwi ndakabimika umwi awumwi abusena bwakwe.
Mpawo bonse ba Juda bakeeta zyekkumi zyambuto, wayini mupya, alimwi a mafuta mung'anda yakulondweda.

Ndakasala basinkomo atala angánda yakulondweda Shelemiya mupayizi  antomwe a Zadoki mulembi, alimwi akuzwa kuba Levi, Pedayiya. Wakali kubatobela ngu Hanani mwana mulombe wa Zakka mwana mulombe wa Mataniya, nkambo bakabalidwe mbuli basyomekede. Milimo yabo yakali yakwabulula chakwelania kubenzinyina.
Mundiite chakundiyeezya, Leza wangu, atala azezi, alimwi utakalubi yoonse milimo mibotu eyo njindakachita mung'anda ya Leza antomwe amilimo yonse.

Mumazubayo ndakabona mu Juda bantu kubeleka kuzisinino zya wayini mubuzuba butegwa Sabata alimwi kabeta milwi yambuto akuzinyumpuzya ma donki, antomwe a wayini, masansa, nkuyu, alimwi amisyobo isiyene yamikuli ilema, eyo njibakeeta mu Jelusalemu mubunsi bwe Sabata. Ndakabakasya kuti bakali kuuzya zyakulya mubuunsi bwe Sabata.
Balumi baku Taya bakali kukkala mu Jelusalemu bakeeta inswi antomwe amisyobo yoonse yazintu, alimwi bakazyuzya mubunsi bwe Sabata kubantu ba Juda antomwe amudolopo!
Mpawo ndakambula abazuluzi ba Juda, ''Niinzi echi nchemulokuchita chintu chibi loko, kusofwazya buzuba butegwa Sabata?
Bamawuso tebakachichita na echi? Leza wesu takwe nakapa chisubulo alindiswe alimwi akuchisi ? Kwayino mulokweta chakwindilila bukali ali Izilayeli mukusampawula buzuba bwa Sabata.''

Mbukwakasiya biyo kumilyango ya Jelusalemu kakutanakuba Sabata, ndakalayilila kuti milyango ijalwe alimwi tabelede pe kwijula mane kukiinde Sabata. Ndakabikka bamwi babalanda bangu kumilyango kuchitila kuti kutabi mikuli injizigwa mukati mubunsi bwa Sabata.
Basimakwebo abasikuzya yonse misyobo yazyuzigwa bakabungana aanze kwa Jelusalemu lumwi na tubili.
Pesi ndakabachenjezya, ''Nkambonzi nimubungana aanze kwanulambo? Kuti muzochite obu lubo, Ndiyobika maboko ajulu lyenu!'' Kuzwa echo chiindi tebakazosika lubo pe mu Sabata.

Mpawo ndakalayilila ba Levi kuti balisalazye lwabo beni, alimwi basike kumilyango, kuti bazosalazye buzuba bwa Sabata. Muzondiyezye kuti ambebo nzochiyeye echi, Leza wangu, alimwi undifwide luzyalo nkambo kachizuminano mukulifwinsya kunembo lyangu.
Mumazubayo ndakabona ma Juda abo bakakwete banakazi baku Ashidodi, Amoni, a Mowabbu.
Chibeela chabana babo bakambula mulaka wachi Ashidodi. Takwepe naba omwe wabo wakambula mulaka wachi Juda, pesi kupela mulaka wawumwi wabantu bambi mubakali kukkala.
Ndakabinkila, ndakabatukila, elyo bamwi babo ndakabawuma akuba kwela masusu. Ndakabachita kuti balikombelezye kumwami, nkanditi, ''Tokoyopa bana bako basimbi kuli babo balombe, kana kuti ilwako webo.

Tensi Solomoni mwami wa Izilayeli wakaamba kubanakazi aba? Akkati kamanyika manji tekwakali mwami uli mbuli nguwe, eelyo Leza wakamuchita kuti abe mwami wa Izilayeli yoonse. Nekwakatali boobo, banakazi bakwe bazwakule bakamuchitya kuti abisye,
Tuyelede kukuswilila akuchita ezi zibi zipati, akuchita chakutasyomeka kuli Leza nkambo kakukwata bazwakule banakazi?''
Umwi wabana balombe ba Joyiyada mwana mulombe wa Eliyashibbu mupayizi mupati wakali mukwansa kuli Sanibbalati mu Holoniti. Nekubabobo ndakamuchitya kuti achije kuzwa kunembo lyangu.
Kobayita kuti bayeye, Leza wangu, nkambo basofwazya bupayizi, antomwe achizuminano chabupayizi achabu Levi.
Nkenkaako ndakasalazya kuli zyoonse zyakunze, ndabika milimu yabapayizi aba Levi awumwi achibela chakwe.
Ndaabila zipo zyazisamu muchiindi azya michelo mitaanzi. Kondiyeezya, kondiyeezya, Leza wangu, kuti kubote.

Jehova wakambuula kuli Mozesi mutente lyakubunganina munkanda ya Sinayi. Eechi chakachitika mubuzuba butanzi bwa mweezi wabili mumwaka wabili kakuli kuti bantu ba Izilayeli kabali bazwa kunyika ya Ijipita. Jehova wakati,
''Amuchite kubalwa kwabantu boonse ba Izilayeli muluzubo lumwi alumwi, mumpuli zyabamawisi. Mubabale amazina.

Mubale baalumi boonse, awumwi muntu, uli amyaka ilimakumi aabili nakwiinda. Mubale boonse banga balalwana mbuli basilumamba  ba Izilayeli. Iebo a Aaloni mwelede kulemba mweelwe wa baalumi bali munkamu zyabasilumamba.
Mwaalumi uzwa kumukowa umwi, awumwi musyobo, muzulwidi wamukowa, welede kubeleka anduwe mbuli muzulwidi wamukowa wakwe. Awumwi muzulwidi welede kuzulwida baalumi bayolwanina musyobo wabo.
Aaya ngimazina abazulwidi belede kulwana antomwe anduwe: kuzwa musyobo wa Lubbeni,
kuzwa kumukowa wa Simiyoni, Elizuli mwana wa Seluweli mwana wa Zulishadayi;
Kuzwa kumusyobo wa Juda, Nasoni mwana mulombe wa Aminadabu;
kuzwa kumusyobo wa Isakka, Nataniyeli mwana mulombe wa Zuwala;
kuzwa kumusyobo wa Zebbulani,Eliyabu mwana mulombe wa Heloni;
Kuzwa kumusyobo wa Ifulemu mwana mulombe wa Jozefu, Elisama mwana mulombe wa Amihudi, kuzwa kumusyobo wa Manase, Gamaliyeli mwana mulombe wa Pedahuzuli,
kuzwa kumusyobo wa Bbenjamini, a Bbinadani mwami wa Gidiyoni,
Kuzwa kumusyobo wa Dani, Ahiyeza mwana mulombe wa Amisadayi,
kuzwa kumusyobo wa Asa, Pagiyeli mwana mulombe wa Okkalani;
kuzwa kumusyobo wa Gadi, Eliyasafu mwana mulombe wa Dewuyeli;
alimwi kuzwa kumusyobo wa Nafutali, Ahila mwana mulombe wa Enani.''
Aaba mbibaalumi bakasalwa kuzwa kubantu. Bakazulwida misyobo yabamawisi. Mbibakali bazululi bamikowa mu Isilayeli.
Mozesi a Aloni bakabweeza baalumi aaba, bakalembwa amazina,

aantomwe a baalumi aba bakabungania baalumi boonse ba Izilayeli mubuzuba butaanzi bwamwezi wabili. Mpawo umwi awumwi mwaalumi wamyaaka ili makumi obile akwiindilila wakaziba basikale bakwe. Wakeelede kuulika mazina amikowa ampuli zyalunyungu kuzwa kulibamawisi.
Mpawo Mozesi wakalemba myeelwe yabo munkanda ya Sinayi, mbuli Jehova mbakamulayilide kuti achite.

Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Lubbeni, mwana mulombe mutaanzi wa Izilayeli, kwakabalwa mazina aboonse baalumi bali aminyaka ili makkumi obile yakuzyalwa nakwiindilila bakonzya kuya kunkondo, kuzwa kumalembe aabamawisi bamikowa empuli zyabo.
Bakabala 46,500 baalumi kuzwa kumusyobo wa Lubbeni.
Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Simiyoni kwakabalwa mazina aboonse baalumi bali aminyaka ili makkumi obile yakuzyalwa nakwiindilila bakonzya kuya kunkondo, kuzwa kumalembe aabamawisi bamikowa empuli zyabo.
Bakabala baalumi59,300 kuzwa kumusyobo wa Simiyoni.
Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Gadi kwakabalwa mazina aboonse baalumi bali aminyaka ili makkumi obile yakuzyalwa nakwiindilila bakonzya kuya kunkondo, kuzwa kumalembe aabamawisi bamikowa empuli zyabo.
Bakabala 45,650 baalumi kuzwa kumusyobo wa Gadi.
Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Juda kwakabalwa mazina aboonse baalumi bali aminyaka ili makkumi obile yakuzyalwa nakwiindilila bakonzya kuya kunkondo, kuzwa kumalembe aabamawisi bamikowa empuli zyabo.
Bakabala 74,600 baalumi kuzwa kumusyobo wa Juda.
Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Isakka kwakabalwa mazina aboonse baalumi bali aminyaka ili makkumi obile yakuzyalwa nakwiindilila bakonzya kuya kunkondo, kuzwa kumalembe aabamawisi bamikowa empuli zyabo.
Bakabala 54,400 baalumi kuzwa kumusyobo wa Isakka.
Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Zebbuloni kwakabalwa mazina aboonse baalumi bali aminyaka ili makkumi obile yakuzyalwa nakwiindilila bakonzya kuya kunkondo, kuzwa kumalembe aabamawisi bamikowa empuli zyabo.
Bakabala 57,400 baalumi kuzwa kumusyobo wa Zebbuloni.

Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Efulemu mwana mulombe wa Jozefu kwakabalwa mazina aboonse baalumi bali aminyaka ili makkumi obile yakuzyalwa nakwiindilila bakonzya kuya kunkondo, kuzwa kumalembe aabamawisi bamikowa empuli zyabo.
Bakabala 40,500 baalumi bazwa kulunyungu lwa Efulemu.

Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Manase mwana mulombe wa Jozefu kwakabalwa mazina aboonse baalumi bali aminyaka ili makkumi obile yakuzyalwa nakwiindilila bakonzya kuya kunkondo, kuzwa kumalembe aabamawisi bamikowa empuli zyabo.
Bakabala 32,200 baalumi kuzwa kumukowa wa Manase.
Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Bbenjamini kwakabalwa mazina aboonse baalumi bali aminyaka ili makkumi obile yakuzyalwa nakwiindilila bakonzya kuya kunkondo, kuzwa kumalembe aabamawisi bamikowa empuli zyabo.
Bakabala 35,400 baalumi kuzwa kumusyobo wa Bbenjamini.
Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Dani kwakabalwa mazina aboonse baalumi bali aminyaka ili makkumi obile yakuzyalwa nakwiindilila bakonzya kuya kunkondo, kuzwa kumalembe aabamawisi bamikowa empuli zyabo.
Bakabala 62,700 baalumi kuzwa kumusyobo wa Dani.
Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Asya kwakabalwa mazina aboonse baalumi bali aminyaka ili makkumi obile yakuzyalwa nakwiindilila bakonzya kuya kunkondo, kuzwa kumalembe aabamawisi bamikowa empuli zyabo.
Bakabala 41,500 baalumi kuzwa kumusyobo wa Asya.
Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Nafutali kwakabalwa mazina aboonse baalumi bali aminyaka ili makkumi obile yakuzyalwa nakwiindilila bakonzya kuya kunkondo, kuzwa kumalembe aabamawisi bamikowa empuli zyabo.
Bakabala53,400 baalumi kuzwa kumusyobo wa Nafutali.
Mozesi a Aaloni bakabala boonse baalumi, aantomwe a baalumi balikkumi ababili bakali kuzulwida misyobo ilikkumi ayibili ya Izilayeli.
Aboobo bonseni bantu ba Izilayeli kuzwa kuminyaka ilimakumi obile na kwiinda, boonse bakonzye kulwana munkondo, bakabalwa mumpuli zyabo.
Bakabala 603,550 baalumi.
Pesi bantu bakali balunyungu luzwa kuli Levi tebakabalwa pe,
nkaambo Jehova wakali wamba kuli Mozesi,
''Tamweelede kubala musyobo wa Levi na kubabikilizya mumweelwe wabantu ba Izilayeli.

Kwinda boobo, mutume ba Levi kuti babambe idumba mumalembe achizuminano, akubamba zyonse zibelesyo zilimudumba. Ba Levi baleelede kunyampula tente, alimwi baleelede kunyampula zibelesyo zili mutente. Beelede kubamba chikombelo akuchita musasa uzyungulukide idumba.
Eelyo dumba niliyogwisigwa kuya kulibumbi busena, ba Levi baleelede kuli mwaya. Eelyo idumba nilyeelede kuyakwa, ba Levi baleelede kuyoliyaka. Kufumbwa mwenzu usika afwifwi edumba uleelede kujayigwa.
Eelyo bantu ba Izilayeli nibayoyaka matente aabo, awumwi muntu weelede kuchita bobu afwifwi andembela eyi yankamu ya basilumamba.

Nikuba boobo, ba Levi baleelede kuyaka matente abo kuzyunguluka dumba lyechizuminano chakuli fwinsya kuti lunyemo lwangu lutasikili bantu ba Izilayeli. Ba Levi beelede kubamba dumba lyechizuminano chamilawu.''
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakachita eezi zintu zyoonse. Bakachita zintu zyoonse ezyo Jehova nzyakabalayilila kwiinda muli Mozesi.
Jehova wakaambula lubo kuli Mozesi a Aloni, wakati,
''Umwi awumwi waba Izilayeli weelede kukkala mbuli mbwayanda, andembela zya n'anda zyabamawisi babo. Bayookala kabazyungulukide itente lyakubunganina kuma bazu woonse.
Aabo bayookkala kujwe kwa tente lyakubungaanina, oko zuba nkuli zwida, mbankamu ya Juda alimwi bayookala mbuuli mbubayada. Nasyoni mwana wa Aminadabu nguwe muzuluzi wabantu ba Juda.
Mweelwe wabantu ba Juda ngu 74,600.
Musyobo wa Isakka weelede kubambana amusyobo wa Juda. Netanelu mwana mulombe wa Zuwa weelede kuzulwida basilumba ba Isakka.
Mweelwe wankamu yakwe ngu 54,400 bantu.
Musyobo wa Zebbuloni weelede kubambana a Isakka. Eliyabbu mwana mulombe wa Heloni weelede kuzulwida basilumamba ba Zebbuloni.
Mweelwe wankamu yakwe ngu 57,400.
Woonse mwelwe wabantu bakali mumusasa wa Juda ngu 186,400. Bayookkala lutaanzi.
Kubbazu lyakumusanza kunoli musasa wa Lubbeni mbuli mbubayanda. Muzuluzi wamusasa wa Lubbeni ngu Elizu mwana mulombe wa Syedewu.
Mweelwe wankamu yakwe ngu 46,500.
Simiyoni weelede kubambana a Lubbeni. Muzuluzi wabantu ba Simiyoni ngu Syelumuyeli mwana mulombe wa Zulisadayi.
Mweelwe wabantu munkamu yakwe ngu 59,300.
Musyobo wa Gadi nguutobela. Muzuluzi wabantu ba Gadi ngu Eliyasafi mwana mulombe wa Dewuweli.
Mweelwe wankamu yabantu bakwe ngu 45,650.
Mweelwe wabantu boonse bakatumidwe kumusaasa wa Lubbenni, mbuli munkamu zyabo, ngu 151,450. Mbibayotobela lwabili kukkala.

Chitobela, itente lyakuswaanana lyeelede kuzwa anze a ba Levi aakati kamisasa yoonse. Bayelede kuyozwa mumusasa mbuli mukunjila kwabo mumusasa. Woonse mwaalumi weelede kali aabusena bwakwe, andembela yakwe.
Kubbazu lyakumbo kunoli zimpanzi zyamusasa wa Efulemu munsi aamakkalilo abo. Muzuluzi wabantu ba Efulemu ngu Elisyama mwana mulombe wa Amihudi.
Mweele wankamu ngu 40,500.
Afwifwi ambabo musyobo wa Manase. Muzuluzi wa Manase ngu Gamaliyeli mwana mulombe wa Pedazuli.
Mweelwe wankamu yakwe ngu 32,200.
Uutobela unoli mukkowa wa Bbenjamini. Muzuluzi wa Bbenjamini  ngu Abbidani mwana mulombe wa Gidiyoni.
Mweelwe wankamu yakwe ngu 35,400.
Boonse abo bakabalidwe mumusasa wa Efulemu ngu 108,100. Mbibatakabe batatu ku kukkala.
Kubbazu lyakunyika kunoli nkamu zyamusasa wa Dani. Muzuluzi wa bantu ba Dani ngu Ahiyeza mwana  mulombe wa Amisyaddayi.
Mweelwe wankamu yakwe ngu 62,700.
Bantu bamusyobo wa Asya bakakkala babambana a Dani. Muzuluzi wa Asya  ngu Pegiyeli mwana mulombe wa Okkilani.
Mweelwe wankamu yakwe ngu 41,500.
Musyobo wa Nafutali nguutobela. Muzuluzi wa Nafutali ngu Ahila mwana mulombe wa Enani.
Mweelwe wankamu yakwe ngu 53,400.
Boonse abo bakabalwa mumusasa wa Dani ngu 157,600.. Bayoochalila kuzwa mu musasa, munsi lya ndembela yabo.''
Aaba mba Izilayeli, bakabalwa mbuli mumpuli zyabo. Boonse bakabalwa mumisasa yabo mbuli munkamu zyabo, bali 603,550
Pesi ba Levi tebakabalikizigwa pe aantomwe abantu ba Izilayeli, mbuli Jehova mbakalayilila Mozesi.
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakachita zyoonse eezyo Jehova nzyakalayilila Mozesi. Bakakkala kumbali andembela zyabo. Bakazwa mumusasa amikowa yabo, mbuuli mumabambe ampuli zyabamawisi babo.
Lino ndolu lwaano lwa lunyungu lwa Aloni a Mozesi eelyo Jehova naakambula a Mozesi achilundu cha Sinayi.
Mazina abana balombe ba Aloni ngaya; Nadabu mutanzi, a Abihu, Eliyaza, a Itamala.
Aya ngimazina abana balombe ba Aloni, bapayizi bakananikwa alimwi bakalongezegwa kuti babeleke mbuli bapayizi.
Pesi Nadabu a Abihu bakafwa kunembo lya Jehova nibakapeda mulilo utatambuliki munkanda ya Sinayi. Nadabu a Abihu tebakalikwe abana pe, aboobo Eliyaza a Itamala bakabeleka mbuli bapayizi awisi Aloni.
Jehova wakambuula kuli Mozesi wakati,
''Eta musyobo wa Levi ubeete kuli Aloni mupayizi kuti bamugwasye.
Bayelede kuchita milimu mubusena bwa Aloni aantomwe aluundu loonse kunembo lyatente lyakuswanana. Beelede kubeleka mudumba.
Beelede kujata kabotu zyoonse zibelesyo mutente lyakuswanana, alimwi bayelede kugwasya musyobo wa Izilayeli kuchita mulimu wamudumba.
Weelede kupa ba Levi kuli Aloni abana bakwe balombe. Bapedwe chakumaninina kuti bamugwasye kubelekela bantu ba Izilayeli.
Weelede kusala Aloni abana bakwe balombe mbuli bapayizi, pesi kufumbwa muzwakule utaze aafwifwi weelede kujayigwa.
Jevova wakambula kuli Aloni wakati,
''Langa ndabweza ba Levi kuzwa akati kabantu baba Izilayeli. Ndachita eechi muchiindi chakutola mwana  mutaanzi  mulombe aakati kabantu ba Izilayeli. Ba Levi mbibangu .

Boonse bana bataanzi mbibangu. Mubuzuba mbundakawuma boonse bana bataanzi munyika ya Ijipiti, ndakabika aambali mebo boonse bana bataanzi mu Isilayeli, kubikilizya babantu ababanyama. Mbibangu. Ndime Jehova.''
Jehova wakambula kuli Mozesi munkanda ya Sinayi wakati,
''Bala lunyungu lwa ba Levi muli imwi ayimwi mpuli, munzubo zyabo. Bala woonse wachaalumi uli amwezi uumwi wakuzyalwa  akwinda.''
Mozesi wakababala, katobelezya ijwi lya Jehova, mbuli mbakalayililwa kuti achite.
Mazina abana ba Levi mba Gesyoni, Kohati, a Melali.
Nzubo zyakazwa kubana balombe ba Kohati  ngu Libbini a Syimeyi.
Nzubo zyakazwa kubana balombe ba Geshoni ngu Amulamu, a Izala, a Hebbuloni, a Uziyeli.
Nzubo zyakazwa kubana balombe ba Melali bakali Mali, a Musi. Eezi ninzubo zya Levi, mbuzitobelana nzubo anzubo.
Nzubo zya ba Libbinayiti azya ba Syimeyiti zizwa ku Gelisyoni. Eezi ninzubo zya ba Gesyoni.
Boonse baalumi balaamweezi umwi na kwiinda bakabalwa, kusika kumweelwe 7,500.
Nzubo zya ba Gesyoni beelede kukkala  kubbazu kububbila kwadumba.
Eliyasafu mwana mulombe wa Layeli weelede kuzulwida luzubo lwalunyungu lwa ba Gesyoni.
Impuli ya Gesyoni yeelede kulingulula busena bwakuswananina kubikilizya aamwi adumba . Beelede kulingulula kubusena, chakuvumbwa kwacho, aantomwe achisitilizyo chaamulyango chabusena bwakuswananina.

Beelede kulingulula masani alengelela aalubuwa, masani abelesegelwe mbuli kumulyango watente lyakubunganina - lubuwa luzyunguluka chikombelo achipayililo amubusena busalala. Beelede kulangalanga tukole twambunganino a zyoonse zili mukati.
Eezi ninzubo zizwa kuli Kohati: luzubo lwa ba Amulamu , luzubo lwa ba Izyalati, luzubo lwa ba Hebbuloni, aantomwe aluzubo lwa ba Uziyeli. Zyoonse nzubo eezi zizwa ku ba Kohati.
8,600 baalumi bakabalwa bakali amwezi omwe na kwiinda kuti babambe zintu zya Jehova.
Nzubo zya Kohati zyeelede kukkala kubusena bwakumusanza bwakudumba.
Elizafani mwana mulombe wa Uziyeli weelede kuzulwida nzubo zya ba Kohati.
Beelede kubamba bbokesi, tafula, chikazikilo cha lampi, chipayililo, zintu zisalala eezyo zibelesegwa mumilimu yabo, chivumbilizyo, aantomwe amulimu woonse.
Eliyaza mwana mulombe wa Aloni weelede kuzulwida baalumi aabo bazulwida ba Levi. Weelede kulangalanga baalumi babamba busena busalala.
Nzubo zyobile zyakazwa ku Melali: luzubo lwa ba Mali aluzubo lwa ba Musyi. Eezi nzubo zyakazwa ku Melali.
6,200 baalumi bakabalwa bakali amweezi umwi na kwiinda wakuzyalwa.
Zuliyeli mwana mulombe wa Abbiheli weelede kuzulwida nzubo zya Melali. Beelede kukkala abusena bwakulubazu lwaku bwiinganyika bwa dumba
Ilunyungu lwa Melali lweelede kubamba bubumbwe bwedumba, minkulu yakwiinga, zikazikilo,  azibelesyo azimwi zyendelana ambabo, kubikilizya
aanjimayima azyaanzikilo zizyunguluka dumba, ampako zyazyo, azilindilindi zyazyo amamanizyo, alimwi amakkole.

Mozesi a Aloni alimwi abana babo beelede kukkala kubuzwezuba  bwadumba, kunembo bwatente lyakuswanana, kazi kubuzwezuba. Mbibayiminini mukuyozuzikizya milimu yamubusena busalala amilimu yakubantu baIsiyayeli. Kufumbwa muzwakule uyosika mubusena busalala welede kujayigw.
Mozesi aAloni bakabala boonse baalumi banzubo zya Levi bakali amweezi umwi akwindilila, mbuli Jehova mbakaamba. Bakabala zyuulu amakumi abili azibili baluumi.
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Bala boonse bana bataanzi balombe baantu ba Isilayeli abo bali amweezi umwi wakuzyalwa akwiinda. Lemba mazina aabo.
Weelede kundetela ba levi - kunze kwa boonse bana bataanzi bana baIsilayeli azivubwa zyaba Levi kusiya bana bataanzi bazivubwa zyalunyungu lwa Izilayeli.''
Mozesi wakabala boonse bana bataanzi ba Isilayeli mbuli Jehova mbwakamulayilila kuchita. Wakabal a bana boonse ba bataanzi baalumi amazina, bala mweezi uumwi akwiinda.
Wakabala zyulu zili makumi abili alamyaanda iibili amakumi musanu aabili a baalumi batatu.
Alubo, Jehova wakambula kuli Mozesi. Wakati,
''Bweza baLevi kwinda boonse bana bataanzi baIsilayili, ubwezele baLevayiti.'' Zivubwa kusiya zivubwa zyabantu. Balevi mbibangu- ndime Jehova.
Weleede kubutania  masekeli alimusanu alufutuko wa umwi awumwi basika kumyaandaa myaanda iibili amkumi musanu aayitatu yabama bataanzi ba Izilayili bayiinda kumyeelwe yaba Levi.
Welede kubelesya sekeli lyakubusena busalala mbuli mububotu bwakulema kwalyo. Syekeli lyendelana amakumi aabili ama gela.
Weleede kupa muulo walufutuko mbuli mbwakaliya kuli Aloni abana bakwe balombe."
Mpawo Mozesi wakabungania muliyo wachiyunuzyo kuli baabo bakayindilila mweelwe wababo bakavunwa aba Levi.

Mozesi wakabunganizya mali kuzwa kubana batanzi babantu ba Izilayili. Wakabungania chuulu chimwi amyaanda itatu ilamakumi musanu ayimwi amusanu masyekeli, bulemu bwasekeli bwamubusena busalala. Mozesi wakapa mali yalununuko mbuli Aloni akubana bakwe.
Mozesi wakachita zyoonse nzyakambilidwe kuchita kwiinda kujwi lya Jehova, mbuli Jehova mbakamulayilila

Pesi bamwi baalumi mbakiinkide aabo bakati, '''Tatukonzyi kubalwania bantu nkaambo balisimide kwiinda ndiswe mbutubede.''

Aboobo bakamwaya mulumbe uutasungwaazyi pe kubantu ba Izilayeli aatala anyika njibakatwela. Bakati, ''Nyika njitwakalanga ninyika iilya bakkali bamumo. Bantu boonse mbitwakabona nkuko mbantu balamfu loko.
Oko twakabona mabbabbani, lunyungu lwa Anakki, bantu bakazwakumabbabbani. Mukubona kwesu twakali mbuli maduuntila nitwakalyeezyanisya ambabo, alimwi mbubo mbutwakabede kumenso aabo, lubo.''
Mansiku aayo luundu lwakalila chakoompololesya.
Boonse bantu bakanyansya Mozesi a Aloni. Iluundu loonse lwakati kulimbabo, ''Tupeekezya kuti nitwakafwidilide munyika ya Ijipiti, nikuba omuno munkanda!
Nkaambonzi Jehova natweeta munyika eeyi kuzoofwa aapanga? Ibanakazi besu abana besu baniini bazooba basaalwe. Tachili mbubo na kuti tubwede ku Ijipiti?''
Bakati kuli umwi awumwi, ''Atusale uumbi muzululi, alimwi tubwede ku Ijipiti.''
Mpawo Mozesi a Aloni bakalala chakuvundama kunembo lya mbungano yaluundu lwa bantu ba Izilayeli.
Josyuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni a Kkelebbu mwana mulombe wa Jefune, bakali bamwi babaabo bakatumidwe kuyootwela nyika, bakadelula zizwato zyabo.
Bakaambula kuluundu loonse lwabantu ba Izilayeli. Bakati, ''Inyika njitwakiinda munlunjiyo akwiibona ninyika mbotu loko.
Na Jehova wabotelwa andiswe, mpawo uyotutola kunyika mbotu alimwi akiipe kulindiswe. Inyika ikunka malili a buchi.
Pesi mutabukili Jehova, alimwi mutakayowi bantu bali munyika, nkaambo bo nchilyo kulindiswe. Chitabilizyo chabo chiyogwisigwa kulimbabo, nkaambo Jehova uli andiswe. Mutabayowi.''
Mpawo nkamu yoonse bakaamba batulilwe amabwe. Pesi bulemu bwa Jehova  bwakaboneka aatente lyakuswaninana kubantu  boonse ba Izilayeli.
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Kuyoosika lili bantu aaba kabachindinyansya? Kuyoosika lili kabachikachilwa kundisyoma, kutalanga zyoonse zitondezyo zyanguzu zyangu eezyo nzindakachita aakati kabo?
Ndiyobawumya malwazi, nsikoyobapa lukono, alimwi ndikachite kuzwa kumukkowa wanu beni chisi chipati alimwi chili anguzu mpati kwiinda mbuli mbubabede.''
Mozesi wakati kuli Jehova, ''Na mwachita eechi, mpawo bana Ijipiti bayoomvwa aatala anchicho, nkaambo wakavuna bantu aaba kuzwa kulimbabo anguzu zyako.

Bayozyambila kubakkali benyika iino. Bakamvwa kuti iwe, Jehova, uliwo aantomwe abantu aaba, nkaambo ulabonwa busyu kubusyu. Ijoba lyako lyiima aatala abantu besu. Uleenda kunembo lyabo mumusumpuululu wajoba mubuzuba alimwi mumusumpuululu wamulilo mansiku.
Lino na wajaya bantu aaba mbuli uumwi muntu, mpawo manyika akamvwa mpuwo yako ayowambula alimwi bakatedi,
''Nkaambo Jehova takoyootola bantu munyika njakakonkezya kubapa, wabajaya munkanda.'
Lino, ndakukombelela, belesya manguzu aako mapati. Nkaambo wakaamba kuti,

'Jehova ulanonoka kunyema alimwi ulakkalilila muluyando lukkalilide. Ulalekelela milandu ansotoko. Takoyookonzya kuyozimazya bubi eelyo nayoyeta chisubulo chachibi chabasikale kulunyungu lwabo, kuyosika kuzyalane lyatatu alimwi  alyane.'
Indulula, ndakukombelezya, eechi chibi chabantu akaambo kabupati bwakusyomeka kwachizumina chako, mbuli mbwakali kulekela kale bantu bantu aaba kuzwa kuchiindi nibakali mu Ijipiti kusikila lino.''
Jehova wakati, ''Ndabalekelela mbuli muchikumbizyo chako,
pesi chakasimpe, mbuli mbechipona, alimwi mbuli nyika yoonse mbiyoozuzigwa aabulemu bwangu,
boonse bantu aabo bakabona bulemu bwangu a zitondezyo zyanguzu nzindakachita ku Ijipiti a munkanda - bakandisunka kwazyiindi zili kkumi akutaswiilizya ijwi lyangu alimwi tebakaswiilizya ijwi lyangu.
Akkako nchobeni takwe nibatakabone nyika aatala anjiyo eeyo njindakasyomezya kuli basikale babo. Takwe naba omwe ooyo wakandisampawula uyoyibona,
kunze kwamulanda wangu Kkelebbu, nkaambo uli aamuya usiyene alimwi ulanditobela me amoyo wakwe woonse. Ndiyoomweta oomo munyika mwakabede, alimwi lunyungu lwakwe luyotola chaabilo chanjiyo.
(Lino ba Amaleki aba Kkenani bakali kukkala mumumpata.) Junza amubwede alimwi mukayinke munkanda anzila ya Lwizi lwa Matete.''
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi akuli Aloni. Wakati,
''Kukabe lili nkechiba amoyo mulamfu aatala aluundu lubi oolu lundinyansya? Ndakamvwa kutongawuka kwabantu ba Izilayeli aatala andime.
Amba kuti kulimbabo, ''Mbuli mbechipona,' mbwaamba Jehova, 'mbuli mbumwakaamba kumatwi angu, ndiyoochita eechi kuli ndinywe:
Mitumba yanu iifwide iyowida munkanda, moonse nimwakatongawuka aatala andime, inywe nimwakabalwa ku kabalwebalwe, yoonse myeelwe yabantu kuzwa kuminyaka iili makkumi aabili akuya kujulu.
Nchobeni tamukoyonjila munyika njindakamusyomezya kuti mukachite muunzi wanu, kunze kwa Kkelebbu mwana mulombe wa Jefuni a Josyuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni.
Pesi bana banu baniini aabo mbimwakaamba kuti mbibatakalobe, ndiyobanjizya munyika. Bayoyimvwa nyika njimwakakaka!
Mbuli ndinywe, mitumba yenu iifwide iyowida munkanda.
Bana benu bayooba beembezi munkanda kwaminyaka ili makkumi one. Beelede kubweza mpindu yanchito zyenu zyakupanduka kuyosikila kumamanino aamitumba yenu munkanda.

Mbuli kumyeelwe yamazuba ngimwakabweza kukutwela nyika - mazuba aali makkumi one, muleelede mbubo kubweza mpindu yaczibi zyanu kwaminyaka ili makkumi one - munyaka omwe kuzuba lyomwe, alimwi mweelede kuziba kuti chili buti kukazyania andime.
Ime, Jehova, ndaambula. Nchobeni ndiyochita eechi kuluundu lubi oolo lubungene aantomwe kukubukila ndime. Bayogwisigwa chakumaninina, alimwi aano bayoofwa.'''
Aboobo baalumi Mozesi nbakatumide kuyotwela nyika, aabo bakaboola alimwi bachita luundu loonse kuti lutonawuke aatala a Mozesi akumwaya mulumbe mubi aatala anyika -
aaba baalumi bakeeta mulumbe mubi aatala anyika bakawisigilwa aansi, alimwi bakafwa achilwazi kunembo lya Jehova.
Kuli baabo baalumi bakayinka kukutwela nyika, luzutu Josyuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni a Kkelebbu mwana mulombe wa Jefune mbibakasyaala kabali bawumi.
Eelyo Mozesi nakaamba majwi aaya kubantu boonse ba Izilayeli, bakalila kapati.
Bakabuka chifumofumo kuseni akwiinka aatala achilundu alimwi bakati, ''Langa, tuli aano, alimwi tuzooyinka kubusena Jehova mbwakatusyomezya, nkaambo twakabisya.''
Pesi Mozesi wakati, ''Nkaambonzi nimwanyongania mulawu wa Jehova? Tamukoyoozwidilila pe.
Mutayinki, nkaambo Jehova tali andinywe pe kukumukwabilila kuzwa ku kuzundwa kuzwa kuli basinkondonyokwe.
Ba Amaleki a ba Kkenani nkubali, alimwi muyojayigwa apanga nkaambo mwazwa kukutobela Jehova. Aboobo takoyooba andinywe pe.''
Pesi bakakakatila kutanta kweenda kuya munyika yachilundu; nikubaboobo, pe pe Mozesi nikuba bbokesi lyachizuminano cha Jehova lyakazwa kumusasa.
Mpawo ba Amaleki bakaseluka aansi, alimwi ama Kkenani bakali kukkala mutulundu ooto. Bakalwisya ma Izilayeli alimwi bakabazunda yoonse nzila kusika ku Homa.
Mpawo Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi. Wakati,
''Ambuula kubantu ba Izilayeli alimwi uteedi kulimbabo, 'Eelyo mwakuyinka munyika oko nkomuyookkala, eeyo Jehova njayomupa,

muleelede kuyobamba chituzyo chamulilo kuli Jehova, nikuba chituzyo chakutentwa na chipayizyo chakuzuzikizya chizuminano na kuti chituzyo chakulimvwida, na kuti chituzyo chamapobwe anu, kuti zigwisye mweema uununkilila kuli Jehova kuzwa kutanga lya n'ombe na lyambelele.
Muleelede kupa kuli Jehova zituzyo zyakutentwa aantomwe azituzyo zyazilyo zyakkumi zya chisuwo chazilyo bunante bwachibunge buvwelenganisigilwe achipanzi chomwe mulizine zyakankuli kamafuta.
Muleelede lubo kupa achituzyo chakutentwa , na kuti zyachipayizyo, chomwe mulizine zyakankuli ka wayini yachituuzyo chakunywa kumwana wambelele uwmi awumwi.

Na kolikupa chituuzyo chamugutu wambelele, uleelede kubamba chituuzyo chazilyo zipanzi zyobile mukkumi zyazisuwo zyabusu bunante bwachibunge buvwelenganisigilwe akapanzi komwe mulizitatu zyakankuli kamafuta.
Kuchituuzyo chakunywa, muleelede kupa chipanzi chomwe mulizitatu zyakankuli kawayini. Chiyoogwisya bweema bununkilila kuli Jehova.
Eelyo nemubambila mupule wan'ombe mbuli chipayizyo chakutentwa na mbuli chipayizyo chakuzuzikizya chikonke, na kuti mbuli chipayizyo chabulyidilano kuli Jehova,
mpawo uleelede kupa aantomwe amupule chituuzyo chazipanzi zyotatwe mukkumi zyazisuwo zyabusu bunante bwachibunge buvwelenganisigilwe aachisela chakankuli kamafuta.
Muleelede kupa mbuli chipayizyo chakunywa chachisela chakankuli kawayini, mbuli chipayizyo chichitidwe amulilo, kuti chigwisye bweema bununkilila kwa Jehova.
Cheelede kuchitwa munzila eeyi kuli umwi awumwi mupule wan'ombe, mugutu atubelele twaalumi na kuti mpongo niini.
Choonse chipayizyo nchemubamba akupa cheelede kuchitwa mbuli mbukwaambidwe aawa.
Boonse bakazyalilwa muchisi beelede kuchita zintu eezi muleeyi nzila, eelyo kufumbwa muntu nayeta chipayizyo chichitidwe amulilo, kuti chigwisye bweema bununkilila kuli Jehova.

Na muzwakule ulikkede andinywe, nikuba kufumbwa uukkala aakati kanu kumazyalane woonse abantu banu, weelede kuchita chipayizyo chakutentwa kukuchitila Jehova mweema uununkilila. Uleelede kuchita mbuli mbumuchita.

Kweelede kuba mulawu womwe uukozyania waluundu  alimwi awamuzwakule uukkala andinywe, mulawu walyoonse kumazyalane aabantu bako boonse. Mbuli mbobede, abbobo mbubo alubo silyeenda mbayelede uukkala andinywe. Uleelede kuchita mbuli mbomuchita kunembo lya Jehova.
Mulawu ukozyania a malayilile ayelede kubeleka kulindinywe akumuzwakule ngumukkala aawe.'''
Lubo Jehova wakaambuula kuli Mozesi. Wakati,
''Ambuula kubantu ba Izilayeli alimwi uteedi kulimbabo, 'Eelyo mwakusika munyika ooko nkwesikamutole,
eelyo mwakulya kulya kuzwa munyika , muleelede kuyoopa chituuzyo akucheeta kulindime.
Kuzwa kubufunke bwabusu bwachibunge butaanzi muleelede kupa chibunge kuti muchifufumune mbuli chipo chakufufumunwa kuzwa kuchipolelo. Muchifufumune muleeyi nzila.
Muleelede kundipa chipo chifufumikidwe kwiinda kumazyalane abantu banu kuzwa kubufunke bwanu butaanzi.
Chimwi chiindi muyoobisya kamutakanzide kuchita oobo, eelyo nimwataswiilila malayilile woonse ngindaambula kuli Mozesi -
zyoonse nzindamulayilila kwiinda muli Mozesi kuzwa mubuzuba mbundakasanguna kumupa malayilile akumazyalane woonse abantu banu.

Kukaambo kakubisya kamutakanzide luundu kalutazizi, mpawo luundu loonse lweelede kupa mupule muniini mbuli chipayizyo chakutentwa chigwisya bweema bununkilila bwa Jehova. Aantomwe achechi kweelede kupangwa chipo chazilyo alimwi achipo chazyakunywa, mbuli mbukulayililidwe mumabambe, ampongo ndyalumi mbuli chipo chachibi.

Mupayizi weelede kusalazya luundu lwabantu ba Izilayeli. Bayoolekelelwa nkaambo chibi chakaba chakulubizya. Beeta chipayizyo chabo, chipayizyo chachitwa amulilo kulindime. Beeta chipayizyo chabo chachibi chakutaziba kulindime.
Mpawo luundu loonse lwabantu ba Izilayeli luyoolekelelwa, alimwi lubo amazwakule bakkede aambabo, nkaambo boonse bantu bakabisya kabatakanzide.
Na muntu wabisya katakanzide, mpawo weelede kupa mpongo ndyanakazi iili amunyaka womwe mbuli chipayizyo chachibi.
Mupayizi weelede kusalazya muntu wabisya kunembo lya Jehova katakanzide. Ooyo muntu uyoolekelelwa kusalazigwa kwaakuchitwa.
Mweelede kuba amulawu ukozyanua kuli yooyo uuchita chintu katachikanzide pe, mulawu ngumwi biyo wamuzwakule mubamtu ba Izilayeli amuzwakule wakkala mukati kabo.
Pesi muntu uchita chintu munzila ikazya, naba muzyalwe wamuchisi nanka abe muzwakule, ulipa kalezaleza kulindime. Ooyo muntu weelede kugwisigwa aakati kabantu bakwe.
Akaambo kakuti walangilila aansi majwi aangu akutyola malayilile angu, muntu ooyo weelede kwaandilwa aato. Chibi chakwe chinoli alinguwe.'''
Aawo bantu ba Izilayeli nibakali munkanda, bakajana muntu nkabungika zisamu mubuzuba bwa Sabata.
Aabo bakamujana bakamweeta kuli Mozesi, Aloni, alimwi akuluundu loonse.
Bakamubamba mu chitookesi nkaambo tekwakalinaambwa pe kuti kuchitwa biyeni aatala anguwe.
Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Mwaalumi ooyo nchobeni weelede kujayigwa. Loonse luundu lweelede kumutulula mabwe aanze aagunzi.''
Aboobo loonse luundu lwakamweeta aanze aagunzi alimwi bakamutulula mabwe wafwa mbuli Jehova mbakali walayilila Mozesi.
Alubo Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi. Wakati,

''Ambuula kubana ba Izilayeli alimwi ubalayilile kuti balipangile beni zyaanzikilo zyakukobekela kuzwa kumipimpito yazisamo zyabo, kuzikobeka kuzwa kuluumwi mupimpito antambo yamuteme. Beelede kuchita eechi kumazyalane woonse aabantu babo.
Chiyooba chiyeezyo chiyandisi kulindinywe, eelyo mwayoochilanga, kumilawu yangu yoonse, kukwabweza kuchitila kuti mutakalilangi mumyoyo yanu a kuumenso aanu alimwi akuchita bumambe nobeni kulimbabo.
Muchite eechi kuchitila kuti muchibike mumiyeyo alimwi mubambe milawu yangu yoonse, alimwi kuti musalale, kubambilwa ndime, Leza wenu.
Ndime Jehova Leza wanu, wakamweeta kuzwa munyika ya Ijipiti, kuzooba Leza wanu. Ndime Jehova Leza wanu.''

Lino Kkola mwana mulombe wa Iza mwana mulombe wa Kkohati mwana mulombe wa Levi, kabali aa Datani a Abbilamu bana balombe ba Eliyabbu, a Oni mwana mulombe wa Peleti, lunyungu lwa Lubbeni, wakabuta bamwi baalumi.
Bakabukila Mozesi, aantomwe abamwi baalumi kuzwa kubantu ba Izilayeli, 250 bazululi baluundu aabo bakazibikene loko muluundu.

Bakalibungania aamwi aantomwe kuti biinkile Mozesi a Aloni. Bakati kulimbabo, ''Mwaya kule loko! Loonse luundu lulipambwidwe, boonse umwi awumwi wabo, alimwi Jehova uli aakati kabo. Nkaambonzi nimulisumpula aatala abamwi baluundu lwa Jehova?''
Eelyo Mozesi  nakamvwa eezi, wakalala wavundama.

Wakaambula kuli Kkola akuli boonse mbakali aabo, ''Kuseni Jehova uyoozibisya aabo bali bakwe alimwi ooyo upambwididwe nguwe. Uyooyeta ooyo muntu afwifwi anguwe. Ooyo ngwayosala uyoomweta afwifwi anguwe mwini.
Chita eechi, Kkola alimwi akabunga kako koonse. Mukabweze zitentelo zyatununkilizyo
junza alimwi mukabike amulilo a tunumkilizyo mulinzizyo kunembo lya Jehova. Ooyo umwi Jehova ngwatasale, ooyo muntu uyoobambilwa  kuli Jehova. Mwaya kule loko, inywe lunyungu lwa Levi.''
Alubo, Mozesi wakati kuli Kkola, ''Lino swiilizya, inywe nolunyungu lwa Levi:

nchintu chiniini na kulindinywe kuti Leza wa Izilayeli wakamwaanzanisya kuzwa kuluundu lwa Izilayeli, kuti amweete afwifwi anguwe mwini, kuchita mulimu mudumba lyakukombela lya Jehova, alimwi kuti mwiime kunembo lyaluundu akubamanina milimu bo?
Wakamweeta afwifwi, alimwi anzubo zyako zyoonse, lunyungu lwa Levi, aantomwe anduwe, anikuti ulikuyandula bupayizi ayebo!
Nkikaako iwe ankamu yako mwabungana aantomwe kubukila Jehova. Ngwani Aloni ooyo ngumutongawuka aatala anguwe?''
Mpawo Mozesi wakiita Datani a Abbilamu, bana balombe ba Eliyabbu, pesi bakati, ''Tatukooza pe.
Nchitu chiniini na kuti wakatweeta kuzwa kunyika ikunka malili a buchi, kuzotujaya swebo munkanda? Lino uyanda kulichita mweendelezi aatala andiswe!
Mukuyungizya, tewatweeta munyika iikunka malili a buchi, nikuba kutupa swebo myuunda alimwi myuunda yamasaansa mbuli lukono. Lino uyanda kutoofwazya azisyomezyo zyako zyabuyo? Tatukooza kulinduwe.''
Mozesi wakanyema loko alimwi wakati kuli Jehova, ''Utakalemeki chipo chabo. Takwe nindabweza mbongolo yomwe kuzwa kulimbabo, alimwi takwe umwi wabo ngundakachisa pe.''
Mpawo Mozesi wakati kuli Kkola, ''Junza iwe ankamu yako yoonse muleelede kwiinka kunembo lya Jehova - iwe ambabo, a Aloni.

Umwi awumwi wanu weelede kubweza chitentelo chatununkilizyo chakwe alimwi abike tununkilizyo mulinchicho. Mpawo umwi awumwi muntu weelede kweeta kunembo lya Jehova chitentelo chakwe chatununkilizyo, 250 (myaanda iibili amakkumi ali musanu) zitentelo zyatununkilizyo. Iwe a Aloni, lubo, mweete zitentelo zyatununkilizyo umwi awumwi.''

Akaako mwaalumi woonse wakabweza chitentelo chatununkilizyo chakwe, bakabika mulilo milinzizyo, kwayalwa tununkilizyo mukati, alimwi bakiimikila boonse amulyango kutente lyakuswanana aantomwe a Mozesi a Aloni.
Kkola wakabungania luundu loonse akwiiminana aatala a Mozesi a Aloni amulyango watente lyakuswanana, alimwi bulemu bwa Jehova bwakaboneka ku luundu loonse.
Mpawo Jehova wakaambua kuli Mozesi alimwi akuli Aloni:
''Amulyaanzanie lwenu kuzwa kuluundu oolu kuchitila kuti ndikonzye kubanyonyoona chakufwambaana.''
Mozesi a Aloni bakavundamika masyu aabo aansi alimwi bakati, ''Leza, Leza wamyuuya yoonse yabantu, na umwi muntu wabisya, kujana ulanyemena luundu loonse na?''
Yawe wakasandula kuli Mozesi. Wakati,
''Ambuula ku luundu. Tedi, 'Zwa kuzwa kumatente aa Kkola, Datani, a Abbilamu.'''
Mpawo Mozesi wakanyampuka akwiinka kuli Datani a kuli Abbilamu; bapati ba Izilayeli bakamutobela.
Wakaambula ku luundu alimwi wakati, ''Lino muzwe mumatente aababa bantu basofweede alimwi mutagumi kufumbwa chintu chabo, nkaambo mwachita oobo muyoonyonyooka azibi zyabo zyoonse.''

Aboobo luundu kulubazu loonse lwa Kkola, Datani a Abbilamu lwakabasiya. Datani a Abbilamu bakazwa aanze alimwi bakiimikila amilyango yamatente aabo, aantomwe abanakazi babo, bana babo balombe, alimwi abana babo.
Mpawo Mozesi wakati, ''Acheechi muyooziba kuti Jehova wandituma kuti ndichite milimo yoonse eeyi, nkaambo tensi ndiichita mukuyanda kwangu.
Na bantu aaba bafwa lufu mbuli mbukufwigwa kale, mpawo Jehova unoli tanditumide pe.

Pesi na Jehova walenga chimwi chipya, alimwi nyika yajula mulomo wayo akubamena, aantomwe anzibalaazyo zyoonse, alimwi bayiinka aansi kabachipona mu Syiyoli, mpawo muleelede kumvwisisisya kuti aaba baalumi bakanyansya Jehova.''
Mpawompawo Mozesi mbakamana kwaambula majwi aaya, nyika yakajulika kunsi lyabaalumi aabo.
Nyika yakajula mulomo wayo alimwi yabamena, mpuli zyabo, alimwi aboonse bantu bakalikuzwa kuli Kkola, kubikilizya zyoonse nzibakali aazyo.
Akaako bo alimwi azyoonse nzibakali aazyo zyakaya aansi kazipona mu Syiyoli. Nyika yakajala aatala aambabo, alimwi bakamana kuzwa kuluundu.
Boonse ba Izilayeli bakabazyungulukide bakachija nibakamvwa kulila kwabo. Bakakwiila chakoompolola, ''Amwi inyika ilatumena aswebo!''
Mpawo mulilo wakazwa kuli Jehova alimwi wajaya baalumi bali 250 aabo bakapede tununkilizyo.
Alubo Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi wakati,

''Ambuula kuli Eliyeza mwana mulombe wa Aloni mupayizi alimwi  ngakabweze zitentelo zyatununkilizyo kuzwa kumabangabanga aamulilo, nkaambo zitentelo zyatununkilizyo zipambwidilidwe kulindime. Mpawo mumuleke amwayuule makkala aayaka kulekuke.

Bweza zitentelo zyatununkilizyo zyabaabo basweekelwa buumi bwabo nkaambo kachibi chabo. Ngazikachitwe zikabe ndido zipwayidwe mbuli zyakuvumba aatala achipayililo. Aabo baalumi bakalizipede kunembo lyangu, akaako zipambwidilidwe kuli ndime. Chiyooba chitondezyo chabuliwo bwangu kubantu ba Izilayeli.''
Eliyeza mupayizi wakabweza zitentelo zyatununkilizyo zya mukkuba eezyo zyakali kubelesegwa  aabaalumi aabo bakatentwa, alimwi bakapwayigwa kuba zijazyo zya chipayililo,

kuba chiyeezyo kubantu ba Izilayeli, kuchitila kuti kutabi uzwa aanze utali walunyungu lwa Aloni uyokonzya kuza akutenta tununkilizyo kunembo lya Jehova, kuti batakabi mbuli Kkola akabunga kakwe - mbuli Jehova mbakalayilila kwiinda muli Mozesi.
Pesi chifumo chitobela loonse luundu lwabantu ba Izilayeli bakatongawuka aatala a Mozesi a Aloni. Bakati, ''Mwajaya bantu ba Jehova,''
Mpawo zyakachitika, eelyo luundu nilwakabungana aamwi kubukila Mozesi a Aloni, kuti bakalanga kutente lyakubunganina alimwi, mulange, ijoba lyakalilivumbide. Bulemu bwa  Jehova bwakaboneka,
alimwi Mozesi a Aloni bakasika kunembo lya tente lyakuswanana.
Mpawo Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi. Wakati,
''Inka kule kuzwa kunembo lya luundu oolu kuchitila kuti ndibanyonyoone chakufwambana.'' Mpawo Mozesi a Aloni bakavundamina aansi amasyu aabo.

Mozesi wakati kuli Aloni, ''Bweza chitentelo chatununkilizyo, bika mulilo mulinchicho kuzwa kuchipayililo, bika tununkilizyo mulinchicho, chitole ku luundu chakufwambaana, alimwi uchite chakumana milandu yabo, nkaamb bukkali buyobuza kuzwa kuli Jehova. Chiyoosyo chatalika.''

Akaako Aloni wakachita bmuli mumalayilile a Mozesi. Wakachijaana kunjila aakati kaluundu. Chiyoosyo chakatanguna kuzulila aakati kabo bantu, aboobo wakabika chitentelo chatununkilizyo alimwi akumana milandu yabantu.
Aloni wakiimikila aakati kabafwide abachipona; munzila eeyi chiyoosyo chakiimikila.
Aabo bakajayigwa achiyoosyo bakali 14,700 (zyuulu zilikkumi azine zili aamyanda ili musanu ayibili) mumweelwe, kunze kwabaabo bakafwa mukaambo ka Kkola.
Aloni wakabweeda kuli Mozesi kumulyango watente lyakuswanana, alimwi chiyosyo chakamana.
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi. Wakati,
''Ambuula kubantu ba Izilayeli alimwi ubweze misako kuzwa kulimbabo, uumwi kuzwa kumukowa wabasikale, misako ilikkumi ayibili. Lemba zina lyawumwi awumwi amusako wakwe.
Weelede kulemba zina lya Aloni amusako wa Levi. Kweelede kuba musako womwe wamuzululi kuzwa kumukowa wabasikale bakwe.
Weelede kubika misako mutente lyakubunganina lyachizuminano chamilawu, ooko nkweswanana anduwe.
Kuyoochitika kuti musako wamwaalumi ngundisala uyosyuuka. Ndiyoochita intongawuko kuzwa kubantu ba Izilayeli kuti zikayimikile, eezyo nzibaambula aatala anduwe.''

Aboobo Mozesi wakaambuula kubantu ba Izilayeli. Boonse bazululi bamikowa bakamupa misako, muisako omwe kuzwa kumuzululi umwi awumwi, uusalidwe kuzwa kuli wumwi wamikowa yabasikale, misako ilikkumi ayibili yoonse. Musako wa Aloni wakaliwo aakati kayo.
Mpawo Mozesi wakabika misako kunembo lya Jehova mukati lyatente lyachizuminano chamilawu.

Muzuba litobela Mozesi wakanjila mutente lyachizuminano chamilawu alimwi, amubone, musako wa Aloni wamukowa wa Levi wasyuuka. Wakaba aazisyuukilwa zyakakomena  alimwi wazyala ndelema a ma alumondi aabizidwe!
Mozesi wakagwisya aanze yoonse misako kuzwa kunembo lya Jehova katola kubantu boonse ba Izliayeli, alimwi umwi awumwi mwaalumi wakabweza musako wakwe.

Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Bika musako wa Aloni kunembo lyachizuminano chamilawu. Uubambe kuti ube mbuli chitondezyo chamilandu aatala abantu aaba bakandipapila kuti umanisye kutongawuka aatala andime, na bayoofwa.''
Mozesi wakachita mbubonya mbuli Jehova mbakamulayilila.
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakaambuula kuli Mozesi alimwi bakati, ''Tuyoofwa aano. Tuyooloba toonse!
Kufumbwa woonse uusika, uuswena afwifwi kudumba lya Jehova, uyoofwa. Tweelede kuloba na toonse?''

Jehova wakati kuli Aloni, ''Iwe, bana bako balombe, alimwi lunyungu lwabasikale bako muzoozyiiminina zibi zyoonse nzibakachita aabusena bwakukombela busalala. Pesi iwe luzutu a bana bako balombe bali aanduwe muyoyiiminina zibi zyoonse zyakachitwa awumwi uuli mubupayizi.

Mbuli kuli baabo benzinyokwe bamukowa wa Levi, mukowa wabasikale bako, weelede kuyobeeta aantomwe anduwe kuti bwaswaanane anduwe alimwi bakagwasizye muchiindi eelyo iwe a bana bako balombe nimuyoobeleka kunembo lyatente lyachizuminano chamilawu.
Beelede kukubelekela alimwi atente lyoonse. Nikubaboobo, tabeelede pe kusika afwifwi kufumbwa kuchintu chili mubusena busalala na chijatanisigilwe achipayililo, nakuti bo alimwi alubo we muyoofwa.
Beelede kuswanaana anduwe alimwi babambe kabotu tente lyakuswaninana, a woonse mulimu uujatanisya tente. Muzwakule tayelede kukuswena afwifwi pe.
Weelede kwiiminina busena busalala alimwi a chipayililo kuchitila kuti kunyema kwangu kutasiki kubantu ba Izilayeli lubo.
Langa, mebo lwangu ndakasala benzinyokwe ba ba Levi kuzwa aakati kamazyalane aba Izilayeli. Aaba babachipo kulinduwe, bapegwa kuli kulindime kuti bachite mulimu ujatanisya kutente lyakuswaninana.

Pesi luzutu iwe alimwi abana bako balombe mulakonzya kubeleka kubupayizi kulangilila kuzintu zyoonse zijatanisigilwe achipayililo alimwi zyoonse zintu zilimukati kachisitikizyo. Inywe lwanu mweelede kuzuzikizya milimu eeyo. Kufumbwa muzwakule uuswena afwifwi uleelede kujayigwa.''

Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Aloni, ''Langa, ndakupa mulimu wakutambula zipayizyo zyabunganisigilwa ndime, azyoonse zipayizyo zisalala eezyo bantu ba Izilayeli nzibapa kulindime. Ndapa eezi zipayizyo kulinduwe alimwi akubana bako balombe mbuli chaabilo nchiinkilila aanembo.

Eechi chiyooba chako kuzwa kuzintu zisalala eezyo zyabambwa kuzwa kumulilo. Kuzwa kulizyoonse zipayizyo zyabo - zipayizyo zyoonse zyazilyo, zipayizyo zyoonse zyachibi, zipayizyo zyoonse zyamilandu - zipambwidilidwe kulinduwe alimwi akubana bako balombe.
Eezi zipayizyo zilasalala loko; boonse baalumi beelede kuzilya, nkaambo zilasalala kulindinywe.

Eezi nzipayizyo zitabe zyenu, zibikidwe kumbali kuzwa kulizezyo zipo zyabo zyakuvukuuzya zyabantu ba Izilayeli. Ndazipa kulinduwe, kubana bako balombe, alimwi kubana bako basimbi, mbuli chibeela chako chalyoonse. Boonsd basalidwe kusalala mumpuli yanu baleelela kulya kufumbwa zipayizyo eezi.
Woonse mafuta mabotu, yoonse iwayini impya alimwi azilyo zipya, amichelo mitaanzi eeyo bantu njibandipa - zyoonse zintu eezi ndazipa kulinduwe.
Butebuzi butaanzi kulizyoonse zilimunyika yabo, nzibayeta kulindime, ziyooba zyako. Woonse uusalala mumpuli yako uleelela kuzilya eezi zintu.
Choonse chintu chipedekezegelwe mu Izilayeli chiyooba chako.

Zintu zyoonse zijulila luzyalo, boonse bana bataanzi aabo bantu mbibapayizya kuli Jehova, boonse babantu alimwi abanyama, bayooba bako. Nikubaboobo, bantu beelede kuunununa boonse bana balombe bataanzi babanyama batasalali.

Eezyo zyoonse ziyandikana kuulwa lubo abantu zyeelede kuulwa kazili zyaba aamweezi womwe kukomena. Mpawo bantu balakonzya kuziboozya akuzyuula, kumuulo wamasyekeli aali musanu, mukulema kulimumweelo wa syekeli lyamubusena bwakukombela busalala, lyeelene a magela alimakkumi obilwe.

Pesi bana bataanzi ben'ombe, na bana bataanzi bembelele, na bana bataanzi bempongo - tamweelede pe kuunununa banyama aaba; basalilidwe kuli ndime. Weelede kusansiila gazi lyazyo aachipayililo alimwi utente mafuta aazyo mbuli chipayizyo chachitwa amulilo, mweema uubotezya kuli Jehova.
Inyama yazyo iyooba yako. Mbuli lukkolo lunyampwidwe a chibelo chakuchilisyo, nyama yazyo iyooba yako.

Zyoonse zipayizyo zisalala eezyo bantu nzibapedekezya kuli Jehova, ndazipa kulinduwe, alimwi akubana bako balombe akubana bako basimbi  bali aanduwe, mbuli chaabilo chako chiinkilila aanembo. Nchizuminano chitamani chamwinyo, nchizuminano chaanga chitamani, kunembo lya Jehova kulinduwe alimwi akulunyungu lwako luli aanduwe.''
Jehova wakati kuli Aloni, ''Tokoyoojana lukono munyika yabantu, nikuba kujana chaabilo chalubono aakati kabantu. Ndime chaabilo chako alimwi lukono lwako aakati kabantu ba Izilayeli.
Kulunyungu lya Levi, langa, ndapa zyoonse zyakkumi muli Izilayeli mbuli lukono lwabo mukubozezya kunchito nzibachita mukubeleka kutente lyakuswaninana.
Kuzwa lino kaziya kunembo bantu ba Izilayeli tabeelede kuswena afwifwi atente lyakuswaninana, nkaambo balachiiminina chibi eechi akufwa.

Ba Levibeelede kuchita mulimu uujisini kutente lyakuswaninana. Beelede kwiiminina kufumbwa chibi chilimpawo. Eechi uyooba mulawu utamani kusikila kumazyalane abantu bako. Aakati kabantu ba Izilayeli tabeelede kujana lukono.

Nkaambo zyakkumi zyabantu ba Izilayeli, eezyo nzibapa mbuli zio kulindime - nzizyo nzyepa ba Levi mbuli lukono lwabo. Nkinkaako nchindakaamba kuti kulimbabo, 'Tabeelede kujana lukono aakati kabantu ba Izilayeli.'''
Jehova wakaambuula kuli Mozesi alimwi wakati,

''Weelede kwaambula kuba Levi alimwi utedi kulimbabo, 'Eelyo notambula kuzwa kubantu ba Izilayeli chekkumi nchindapa kulinduwe kuzwa kulukono lwako, uyopa chipo kuzwa kulinchicho kuli Jehova, chekkumi chachekkumi.
Chipo chako chiyobwezwa anduwe mbuli kuti nchekkumi chazilyo kuzwa kulubuwa lwakupolela na butebuzi bwawayini kuzwa kuchisinino chamasaansa.
Aboobo weelede kupa kuli Jehova kuzwa kuli zyakkumi zyoonse nzyotambula kuzwa kubantu ba Izilayeli. Kuzwa kulinzizyo weelede kupa chipo kuli Aloni mupayizi.
Kuzwa kuzipo zyoonse nzyotambula, weelede kupa kuli Jehova. Weelede kuchita eechi kuzwa kuzintu zyoonse zibotu alimwi akuli zisalalisya zinoli zyapegwa nduwe.'
Aboobo weelede kwaamba kuti kulimbabo, 'Eelyo nopedekezya chibotu kulizyoonse, mpawo zyeelede kupegwa ba Levi mbuli butebuzi buzwa kulubuwa lwakupolela alimwi akuchisinino chamasaansa.
Uyookonzya kulya zyoonse zipo zyako zizwa kufumbwa busena, iwe alimwi ampuli zyako, nkaambo mufolo wako mukubozezya kumulimu wako mutente lykuswaninana.
Tokoyooba amulandu kukulya alimwi akukunywa eechi, na wapedekezya kuli Jehova zibotu zyazeezyo nziwatambula. Pesi towelede kusofwaazya zipayizyo zisalala zyabantu ba Izilayeli, na uyoofwa.'''
Jehova wakambula kuli Mozesi a Aloni wakati,
'' Ayaa  mabambe, aamulawu ngwindiikumulayilila :waambe kubantu baku Izilayeli kuti beelede kweeta kuli nduwe ngombe mpwizi iisalala iitakwe kabala naa kampenda, alimwi itanaabuunsi yabweza jokwe.
Mupe  ngombe mpwizi kuli Eliyaza mupayizi. Weelede kwiyeta aanze aagunzi, alimwi umwi muntu weelede kwiijaya kunembo lyakwe.
Eliyaza mupayizi weelede kubweza limwi gaze lyayo amunwe wakwe akulisaansila tuli musanu atubili kuya kunembo lya bbakasa lyamuswaangano.
Ingombe mpwizi yeelede kutentwa kalangide-chikumba chayo, nyama yayo, alimwi gaze lyayo abufumba bwayo, bweelede kutentwa.
Mupayizi weelede kubweza masamu aaseda, hisopu, aluchinda lusalalisya, akuziwaala zyoonse mukati ka ngombe mpwizi iilikutentwa.
Eelyo weelede kusanzya zisamo zyakwe alimwi asambe mumaanzi. Eelyo ukonzya kuza mugunzi, oomo mwayo kkalilila kasofweede ado igolezya.
Ooyo watenta ngombe mpwizi weelede kusanzya zizwaato zyakwe mumaanzi alimwi asambe mumaanzi. Uyookkalilila kasofweede ado igolezya.

Umwi muntu usalala welede kuyola dota lya ngombe mpwizi akulibika aanze aagunzi mubusena busalala. Eeli dota lyeelede kubambilwa luundu lwabantu baku Izilayeli. Bayooswanizya dota amaanzi akusalazigwa  ,kuzwa kuchibi mbulikuti dota lyakazwa kuchipo chachibi.
Oyo wayola dota lyangombe mpwizi weelede kusanzya zizwaato zyakwe,  uyookkalilila kasofweede ado golezya. Oyo uyoba mulawu walyoonse kubantu ba Izilayeli abazwakule bakkala aambabo.
Kufumbwa uuguma mubili uufwide wawumwi mwaalumi uyosofwaala kwamazuba musanu aabili.
Muntu uuli bobo weelede kusalazya mubuzuba bwatatu amuzuba lyamusanu amazuba obile. Mpawo uyoosalala. Pesi kuti talisalazya muzuba lya tatu, aawo takoyosalalape muzuba lyamusanu amazuba obile.

Kufumbwa uuguma muili wamwaalumi wafwa, alimwi taalisalazya- ooyo muntu usofwaazya chikombelo cha Jehova. Ooyo weelede kugwisigwa mu Izilayeli nkaambo taasansilwa maanzi abusofwaazi.Uyookkalilila nkasofweede, ibusofwaazi bwakwe buyookalilila aalinguwe.
Oyu ngomulawu walyoonse umwi muntu naafwida mubbakasa. woonse muntu uunjila mubbakasa alimwi woonse uulimubbakasa kale bayoosofwaala kwamazuba musa amazuba obile.
Choonse chibikilo chitakwe chivunisyo chiyoosofwaala.
Mulinjiyeeyo nzila kufumbwa muntu uuli aanze abbakasa uuguma muntu wajayigwa apanga awumwi mubili uufwide, ifuwa lyamuntu, na kuti kabanda- ooyo muntu uyoosofwaala kwamazuba musanu amazuba obile.
Muchitile oobu muntu uusofweede bweza dota kuchipo chakutenta uliswaanizye munkomesi amaanzi mabotu.

Umwi muntu uusalala eelyo weelede kubweza Hisopu, ayinike mumaanzi, alimwi alisansayile aabbakasa, azibikilo zyoonse zilimubbakasa, abantu bakali wo, akumuntu ooyo waguma fuwa, wakajayigwa oyo wakafwa, na kuti kabanda.

Mubuzuba bwatatu amubuzuba bwamusanu amazuba obile, muntu uusalala weede kusansayila muntu uusofweede. Mubuzuba bwamusanu amazuba obile muntu uusofweede welede kulisalazya. Welede kusanzya zizwaato zyakwe alimwi asambe mumaanzi. Igolezya ulasalala.

Pesi kufumbwa muntu uukalilila nkasofweede- oyo munyu uyoogwisigwa muluundu, nkambo wasofwaazya lubuwa lwa Jehova lwakukkombela. Maanzi aakusalazya taasansayilwa pe aalinguwe, ulakkalilila nkasofweede.
Ooyo uyoba mulawu wiinkilila kunembo nkawulangene aazyimo eezyo. Oyo uusansayila maanzi akusalazya  weelede kuzwaata izwaato zyakwe. Oyo uuguma maanzi akusalalzya uyoosofwaala ado goko.
Kufumbwa nchaguma muntu uusofweede chiyoosofwaala. Muntu uuchiguma uyoosofwaala ado golezya.''
Aboobo bantu ba Izilayeli, iluundu loonse lwakayinka munkanda ya Zini mumweezi mutaanzi, bakaakukkala muKkadesi oko  Miliyemu wakaakufwa alimwi nkwakazikilwa.
Teekwakali maanzi pe aalundu, aboobo bakabungana aantomwe kuli Mozesi a Aloni.
Ibantu bakangunguna kuli Mozesi bakati,'' chakali chibotu ninga twakali fwide andiswe awo beenzuma ma Izilayeli nibakafwa kunembo lya Jehova!
Nkaambonzi niwakeeta lundu lwa Jehova munkanda eeyi kuti bazoofw iswe abanyama besu?
Nkaambonzi iwe niwajkatuchita kuti tuzwe ku Ijipiti akutweeta kubusena buyoosya ? Aboobo takwe busena bwe mbuto, nkuyu, misaansa, pomagilenada, alimwi taawe maanzi aakunwa.''

Aboobo Mozesi a Aloni bakeenda kuzwa kunembo lya mbungano. Bakaya kumulyango wa tente lyakubunganina alimwi wakalala akuvundama akumenso. Nkuko bulemu bwa Jehova bumwekamweka nkubwakaakuli bonia kuli mbabo.
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi kuti,''

Bweza mufunko akubungaania luundu, Iwe a Aloni mukkulana wako wachaalumi. Mwaambule kubbwe kunembo lya menso aabo, alimwi ulilayilile kuti likkunke maanzi. Muyoogwisya maanzi aabo kuzwa kubbwe eelyo, alimwi mweelede kuyowapa kuluundu akubanyama babo kuti banywe.''
Mozesi wakabweza kafunko kuzwa kunembo lya Jehova, mbuuli Jehova mbwaakamulayilila kuti achite.
Eelyo Mozesi a Aloni bakabungania luundu  aantomwe kunembo lya bbwe. Mozesi wakati kulimbabo ,'' Amuswiilile lino, inywe nimupapila. Tweetena maanzi kuzwa kubbwe eeli kuli ndinywe?''
eelyo Mozesi wakanyampula kuboko kwakwe akuuma bbwe tubili  amufunko wakwe, alimwi maanzi miingi akazwa. Luundu lwakanywa azivuubwa zyabo zyakanywa.
Mpawo Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi a Aloni,'' nkambo inywe temwandisyoma  kana kundilemeka mbuuli kusalala mumeso abantu ba Izilayeli, tokoyosisyape  imbunga munyika njindakapa.''
