Obu busena bwakayitwa kuyi maanzi a Melibba nkambo bantu ba Izilayeli batongawuka a Jehova nkuko, alimwi wakalitondeezya lwakwe kuli mbabo mbuuli busalali.
Mozesi wakatuma batumwa kuzwa ku Kkadesyi kumwaami wa Idomu : Mukkulana wako Izilayeli wakaamba eechi: ''ulibwizi boonse buyumuyumu  obo bwakatuchitikila.
Ulizi kuti basikale besu bakaselukila ku Ijipii babatuvuba chabuyumuyumu alubo abasikale besu.
Elyo nitwakayita kuli Jehova, wakamvwa majwi eesu alimwi wakatuma angelo akutugwisya ku Ijipiti. Langa, tuli mukkadesyi, Bolopo lili kuma golelo anyika yanu.

Ndikukukkumbila kuti mutuleke twiinde munyika yako.Tatukooyinda mumaanda pe kana kumi saansa, nikuba kunwa maanzi muzikkala zyako. Tuyooyenda nkatutobezya mugwagwa waku mwaami. Tatukoyookkona nikuba kulubazu lwaluboko lwalulyo na kulumweensi kusikila tukayinde kumagolelo aanyika yanu.''
Pesi mwaami wa Idomu wakamusandula,'' Tamukooyinda oomuno. Na mwachita, Ndasika apanga kuzoomulwisya.''

Mpawo bantu ba Izilayeli bakati kuli nguwe,'' tuyooyinka katutobelezya mugwaagwa. Na swe kana banyama besu kuti banywa maanzi ako, tuyobbadala.Tulekele biyo twiinde nkatwiinda amawulu, nkatutachitide kufumbwa chintu chimbi.''
Pesi mwaami wa Idomu wakasandula,'''Tamukooyinda pe.'' Aboobo mwami wa Idomu wakeza akwiiminana a Izilayeli aluboko lulaanguzu abasilumamba banji.
Mwami wa Idomu wakakaka kubazuminina ba Izilayeli kuti batimbule kabayinda kumagolelelo abo. Nkambo ka cheechi Izilayeli wakanyona akuzwa kunyika ya Idomu.
Aboobo bantu bakeenda kuzwa ku Kkadesyi. Bantu ba Izilayeli, luundu loonse, lwakasika kuchilundu cha Ho.
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi a Aloni kuchilundu cha Ho, kuma goleloa Idomu wakati,''
Aloni weelede kuyoboloka kubantu bakwe, Lino tokoyoonjila pe munyika eyo njindakapa kubantu ba Izilayeli. Echi nchenchicho nkaambo inywe moonse mwapapa kwiiminana ajwi lyangu kumaanzi a Melibba.
Bweza Aloni a Eliyaza mwana mulombe wakwe, alimwi ubeete ataala kuchilundu cha Ho.
Ugwisye Aloni magemesi aabupayizi kuli nguwe alimwi waasamike ali Eliyaza mwana mulombe wakwe. Aloni kufwa alimwi ayobolwe kuli nguwe abantu bakwe nkuko.''
Mozesi wakachita mbuli Jehova mbwakamulayilila. Bakatanta atala lyachilundu cha Ho kunembo lyamenso aluundu loonse.

Mozesi wakatola zikobela zyakusama zya Aloni zyabantu ba payizi kuzwa kuli nguwe akuzisamika ali Eliyaza mwana wakwe mulombe. Aloni wakafwa nkuko aatala lya chilundu.Mpawo Mozesi a Eliyaza bakaseluka.
Elyo luundu lyoonse nilwakabona kuti Aloni wafwa, chisi choonse chakalila Aloni kwamazuba ali makkumi otatwe.
Aawo mwami wa Kkenati mu Aladi, wakali kukkala mu Nigivi, wakamvwa kuti Izilayeli wakali kweenda amugwagwa kuya ku Atalimu, wakalwana a Izilayeli akubweza bamwi babo buzike.
Izilayeli wakakonkezya kuli Jehova akuti,'' na watuchita kuti tuzunde bantu aaba, mpawo tuyakunyonyona chkumaninizya madolopo aabo.''
Jehova wakaswiilila kujwi lya Izilayeli alimwi wakabapa kuzunda ba kkenaniti bakanyonyona chakutasiya madolopo aabo. Oobo busena bwakategwa Homa.
Bakweenda kuzwa kumulundu Howa amugwagwa kuyosika kulwizi lwa Lidi akuzyunguluka nyika ya Idomu. Bantu bakatyompwa bakali munzila.
Bantu bakatongooka atala a Jehova a Mozesi !'' Nkaambonzi niwakatugwisya kuzwa mu Ijipiti kuti tuzoofwe munkanda? takukwe chibunge , maanzi, alimwi tatubotelwipe achakulya chibi eechi.''
Mpawo Hehova wakatuma nzoka zilaabuyoka bukkali akati kabantu. Bazoka bakaluma bantu; bantu biingi bakafwa.
Bantu bakasika kuli Mozesi akuti,'' Twakakubisizya nkaambo twakatongawuka atala a Jehova anduwe.Komba kuli Jehova kuti agwisye nzoka alindiswe.'' Aboobo Mozesi wakakombela bantu.
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi,''panga nzoka akwibikka achisamu chisididwe.Ziyochitika kuti woonse wakalumwa uyopona , kuti mwaalumi alange kulinjiyo.''
Aboobo Mozesi wakapanga wanzoka akunamatika achisamu chisididwe.Kuti nzoka yaluma kufumbwa muntu, kuti mwaalumi walangide amukuba wanzoka,uyopona.
Mpawo bantu baIzilayeli bakeendelela kunembo akuyobungana a Obboti.''
Bakeenda kuzwa mu Obboti akubungana alye Abbalimu munkanda ilangide ku Mowabbu kubuzwe zuba.
Kuzwa awo bakeendelela akuyobungana musena lya Zeledi.
Kuzwa awo bakeendelela akuyobungana kulilimwi bbazu lyamulonga wa Anoni, uli munkanda kuyindilila kuzwa kumugano wa Amolayiti. Mulonga wa Anoni uchita mugano wa Mowabbu, akati ka Mowabbu a Amolayiti.
Nkinkako nchikwambwa mumapepa alembedwe ankondo ya Jehova, ''...wahebbu muSupa, aasyena lya Anoni,
munkunu wasyena utozya kubbazu lyadolopo lya Ar litobelezya mugano wa Mowabbu.''
Kuzwa aawo bakeenda kuya ku Bbiya, chikala Jehova nchakati kuli Mozesi, ''Bunganizya bantu antoomwe kuti ndibape maanzi''.
Mpawo baIzilayeli bakayimba lwimbo olu:'' Zuzya chikkala mwimbe atala anchicho.
Atala achikkala echo bazululuzi besu nchibakasya, chikkala chakasyigwa abasyabusongo, ankoli amusako.''Mpawo kuzwa munkanda bakeenda kuya ku Matana.
Kuzwa ku Matana bakeenda kuya ku Nahaliyewu, alimwi kuzwa ku Nahaliyewu kuya ku Bbomoti,
alimwi kuzwa ku Bbomoti kuyosika kusena munyika ya Mowabbu. Nkonkuko kumpela achilundu cha Pisiga chilanga ansi ankanda .
Mawo Izilayeli batumwa kumwami wa Sihoni, mu Amolayiti kuti,
''Atwiinde munyika yanu. Tatukoyoyinda nikuba kulumwi muunda wamisansa. Tatukoyoonywa maanzi muzikala zyanu. Tuyakweenda anzila yamwami kuyosika twazubuka mugano wanu.''
Pesi mwami waSihoni takoyozumizya Izilayeli kuzubuka mugano wabo. Ani kuti , Sihoni wabungania basilumamba bakwe boonse akulwisya munkanda. Asike ku Jahazi nkwakakulwana chakulwisya Izilayeli.
Izilayeli basilumamamba baSihoni kabelesya lyapanga akubweza nyika yanu kuzwa ku Anoni kusika kumulonga wa Jabbokki, mbuli nyika yabantu ba Amoni.Lino mugaano wabantu ba Amoni wakayakilwa.
Izilayeli wakabweza madolopo woonse aa Amolayiti akukkala muli woonse, kubikkilizya Heshibboni abamwi boonse bamuminzi.
Heshibboni lyakali dolopo lyamwami Sihoni waku Amolayiti, wakalwana chakulwisya mwami wa Mowabbu wakinda .Sihoni wakabweza nyika yoonse kuzwa kuchilawo chakwe kuyosika kumulonga wa Anoni.
Nkinkako abo baambula mutusimpi bati ,'' muze ku Heshibboni.
Muleke dolopo lya Sihoni liyakululwe akwimizigwa lubo. Mulilo ungandama kuzwa ku Heshibboni,Ibbalabala kuzwa mudolopo lya Sihoni lyakanyonyona Ar ya Mowabbu, alimwi banaayo bakumasena aajuiu a Anoni.

Maawee kulinduwe, Mowabbu! Wanyonyonwa, bantu ba Kkimoshi. Mwaalumi wakachita bana bakwe  balombe  kuti bachije kabaya buchijana, alimwi bana bakwe basimbi bayooba basungwa ba mwami waSihoni wa Amolayiti.
Pesi twakazunda  Sihoni. Heshibboni  wapazuulwa kuyosika mu Dibboni. Twakazunda boonse kuyosika mu Nofa, isika ku Medibba.''
Aboobo Izilayeli wakatanguna kukkala munyika ya ba Amolayiti.
Kuzwawo Mozesi wakatuma baalumi kuyolanga Jaza. Bakabweza yabo akutandania ba Amolayiti bakali mumo.
Mpawo bakapiluka akuya amugwagwa wa Bbashani. Og mwami Bbashani wakazwa chikazyania ambabo, mwami abasilumamba bakwe, bayolwisya ku Edileyi.

Kuzwawo Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi,''mutamuyoowi, nkaambo ndamupa kuti mumuzunde basilumamba bakwe boonse, anyika yakwe. Chita kuli nguwe mbuuli mbwakachita kumwaami Sihoni wa Amolayiti, wakakkede ku Hesibboni.''
Aboobo bakamujaya, bana bakwe balombe, abasilumamba bakwe boonse, kusikila kakutachikwe wabantu bakwe wakachaala kapona. Mpawo wakabweza nyika yabo.
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakeenda kusika bakukkala mumbuwa za Mowabbu afwifwi a Jelikko, kuli limwi bbazu lya Mulonga Jodani kuzwa ku chisi.
Bbalakki mwana mulombe wa Zipoo waakabona zyoonse ba Isilayili nzibakachita kuba Amoni.
Mowabbu wakayoowesya loko kubantu nkaambo bakali biingi, alimwi Mowabbu wakali muku kankama loko kubantu ba Izilayili.

Mwami wa Mowabbu wakali mupati ba Midiyeni,'' inkamu eeyi iyolya zyoonse zili akati kesu mbuuli musune mbuulya sokwe mumuunda.'' Lino Bbalakki mwana mulombe wa Zipo wakali mwami waba Mowabbu kuchiindi eecho.

Wakatma batumwa kuli Bbalamu mwana mulombe wa Bbiyo, uliku Peta ulikubbazu lyamulonga wa Ifulesi, ilimunyika yachisi chakwe abantu bakwe. Wakamwiita wati,'' Langa, chisi chasika ano kuzwa kuzwa ku Ijipiti. Bavumba busyu bwanyika alimwi balimunsi kuli ndime.

Ikaka boola lino akunditukilila chisi eechi, nkaambo balaanguzu loko kuli ndime. Ambweni inga ndilakonzya kuba lwanisya akubatanda aanze munyika. Ndilizi kuti abo mbolongezya bayolongezegwa, boobo mbutuka bayootukwa.''
Aboobo bapati ba Mowabbu alimwi abapati ba Midiyeni bakazwa, kababweza mbaddala yabusondi. bakaza kuli Bbalamu alimwi bakaambula kulinguwe majwi a Bbalakki.
Bbalamu wakati kulimbabo, ''Mukakkale aano mansiku aasunu. Ndiyoomweetela eecho Jehova nchataambe kulindime.'' Aboobo bazululi ba Mowabbu bakakkala a Bbalamu mansiku aayo.
Leza wakasika kuli Bbalamu alimwi wakati, ''Mbaani baalumi aaba bakazinde kulinduwe?''
Bbalamu wakasandula Leza, ''Bbalaki mwana mulombe wa Zipo, mwaami wa Mowabbu, wabatuma kulindime. Wakati,
'Langa, bantu bazwa ku Ijipiti balavumba aatala lyanyika yangu. Lino sika alimwi ubatuke nkaambo kangu. Ambweni ndiyookonzya kuyobalwana alimwi akuyobatandaania.'''
Leza wakasandula Bbalamu,'' Twelede kweenda abaalumi aabo. Tweelede kutuka bantu ba Izilayili nkaambo bakalongezegwa.''
Bbalamu wakabuka kuchifumo akuti kubazulwidi ba Bbalakki, '' mubweede kunyika yanu nkaambo Jehova wakaka kundizumizya kwiinka andinywe,''
Eelyo bazulwidi ba Mowabbu bakabuka babweda lubo kuli Bbalakki. ''Bakati, ''Bbalamu wakaka kuza andiswe.''
Bbalakki wakatuma lubo bambi bazulwidi bakali kwiinda kunembo mukulemekwa kwiinda nkamu yakusaanguna.
Bakasika kuli Bbalamu akwaamba kuli nguwe kuti,'' Bbalakki mwana mulombe wa Zipoo waamba Eechi,' Ikaka kutabi chimwi webo chikwiimikizya kusika kuli ndime,
nkaambo ndiyokufozya kabotu zyiindilide akukupa bulemu bupati, alimwi mebo ndiyochita kufumbwa chubuzya ndime kuti ndichite. Aboobo boola alimwi unditukilile bantu aaba.'''

Bbalamu wakasandula nkati kubaalumi ba Bbalaki, 'Nekuba mebo Bbalakki wandipa nganda yakwe izwide nsiliva angolide , ime nsyelede kweenda kunembo kajwi lya Jehova, Leza wangu, akuchita ziche nazindilide kwinda nzyambila ndime.
Lino mpawo, ikaka mwimikile lubo  aano mansiku, kwitila kuti ndikabe kandiya kufumbwa chiindi Jehova nchambila ndime.''
Leza wakasika kuli Bbalamu mansiku alimwi wakati kulinguwe, '' Mbunga baalumi aaba basika kuzokwita buka alimwi winke aabo. Pesi uchite biyo ezyo nzindakubuzya kuchita.''
Bbalamu wakabuka kuseni, wagada mbongolo yakwe, alimwi wakiinka aabazululi ba Mowabbu.
Pesi nkaambo wakiinka, kunyema kwa Leza kwakabusigwa. Mungelo wa Jehova wakalyiimika mumugwagwa mbuli umwi sikulwana a Bbalamu, wakagede mbongolo yakwe. Balanda ba Bbalamu babili bakali anguwe lubo.

Mbongolo yakabona mungelo wa Jehova kayimvwi mu mugwagwa apanga lyakwe kalili mu luboko lwakwe. Mbongolo yakazwa mu mugwagwa alimwi yakanjila mu muunda. Bbalamu wakuuma mbongolo kuti imubweedezye mu mugwagwa.
Mpawo mungelo wa Jehova wakiimikila munzila iimanikide aakati kamyuunda yamasansa, kakuli bulambo kulubazu lwakuchilisyo chakwe alimwi bumwi bulambo kuchimwensi chakwe.
Mbongolo yakabona mungelo wa Jehova alubo. Yakaya kubulambo akumanikizya kuulu kwa Bbalamu kulimbubo. Bbalamu wakayuuma alubo.
Mungelo waJehova wakayinka kunembo akwiima alibumbi busena bumanikide ookokwakatalikwe mweenya wakuchebukila kufumbwa kulilimwi bbazu.
Mbongolo yakabona mungelo waJehova, akulala munsi lyaBbalamu. Lunyemo lwa Bbalamu lwakabuka, alimwi wakawuma mbongolo amufunko wakwe.
Mpawo Jehova wakajula mulomo wambongolo kuti yaambule. Yakati kuli Bbalamu, ''Ndachita nyamanzi kulinduwe zyakupa kuti unduume tutatu?''
Bbalamu wakasandula mbongolo, ''Nkukuti wakachita chabufubafuba andime. Nsinga ndakali aapanga muluboko lwangu. Nsinga lyakaliwo, ninga ndakakujaya.''
Mbongolo yakati kuli Bbalamu, ''Tensi ndilimbongolo yako na ndiwakagada buumi bwako boonse kusika buzuba obuno? Ndakali ndayanda kuzichita na eezi limwi zuba?'' Bbalamu wakati, ''Pe.''
Mpawo Jehova wakajula meso a Bbalamu, elyo wakabona mungelo wa Jehova ulimvwi mumugwagwa apanga kajisi mujaanza lwakwe. Bbalamu wakavundama aansi akuvundamisya busyu bwakwe.
Mungelo wa Jehova wakati kulinguwe, '' Nkambonzi nwawuma mbongolo oobu tutatu Langa , ndaza umwi ulabukali kulinduwe nkaambo nchito zyako kunembo lyangu nzibi.
Mbongolo yandibona akuleya  kuzwa kulindime ziindi ezi. Nansyo tiyakaleya kuzwa kulindime, iloko ndalikukujeya akuvuna buumi bwayo.''
Bbalamu wakati kumungelo wa Jehova, ndabisya. Tendalizi kuti uliimvwi akati akati kanzila . Aboobo uno, na tachikubotezyi webo, ndila bweeda musule.''
Pesi mungelo wa Jehova wakati kuli Bbalamu, '''kuya kunembo a baalumi. Pesi weelede biyo kwamba majwi ngindakwaambila.'' Aboobo Bbalamu wakayinka abazululi ba Bbalakki.
Eelyo Bbalakki nakamvwa kuti Bbalamu wakali wasika, wakazwa aanze kuyooswanana aanguwe kudolopo lili mu Mowabbu ku Anoni, lili kumugaano.
Bbalakki wakati kuli Bbalamu,'' Tindakatuma baalumi na kuli nduwe kuti bakwiite? nkaambonzi nutakasikide? Tandikonzyina kukulemeka ?''
Mpawo Bbalamu wakasandula Bbalakki,'' Bona, ndaza kuli nduwe. Tandikwe na lino nguzu zyakwaamba kufumbwa chilibiyeeni? Ndikonzya kwamba biyo majwi Leza ngakabika mumulomo wangu''
Bbalamu wakeenda a Bbalakki, akusika ku Kiliyata Huzoti.
Mpawo Bbalakki wakachipayizyo chabasune ambelele akupa nyama kuli Bbalamu abazulwidi mbaakali aabo.
Chifumo, Balakki wakatola Bbalamu kubusena bulaatala bwa Bbaali kuzwa awo Bbalamu nkwalikukonzya biyo kubona chibeela chaba Izilayeli kumusansa wabo.
Bbalamu wakati kuli Bbalakki, ''Yaka zipayililo zili musanu azibili ano alimwi bamba bapule balimusanu ababili abagutu balimusanu ababili.''
Aboobo Bbalakki wakachita mbuli Bbalamu mbakakumbide. Mpawo Bbalakki a Bbalamu bakapedekezya mupule wan'ombe alimwi a mugutu wambelele aachipayililo.

Mpawo Bbalamu wakati kuli Bbalakki, ''Imikila kuchipayililo chako chakutentwa alimwi ndiyoyenda. Ambweni Jehova uyoosika kuzondiswanizya. Kufumbwa nchanditondeezya ndiyokwambila.'' Aboobo wakayinka aansonge yakalundu itakwe misamu.
Wakatambya meso aakwe alimwi wakabona ba Izilayili kababungene, abamwi mumukowa wabo, alimwi muuya wa Leza wakasika aalinguwe.
Wakatambula chisinsimi eechi alimwi wakati, "Bbalamu mwana mulombe wa Bbiyoli waamba kwambuula, mwaluumi ulaameso ajulikide.
Mpawo wakachita mbuli Bbalamu mbakamwambilide. Alimwi Bbalakki aBbalamu bakapeda musune amugutu kuzipayililo zyoonse.

Mpawo Bbalamu wakati kuli Bbalakki,''imikila azipo zyako zyakuntentwa alimwi ndiyoyinka. Alimwi Jehova uyoza azosinane ambebo.Kufumbwa nzyayonditondezya nzomubuzya.''Mpawo wakeenda waya ajulu achilundu chitakwe misamu.
Mpawo Leza wakaswana Bbalamu, alimwi Bbalamu wakati kulinguwe, ''Ndakayaka zipayililo zili musanu azibili, alimwi amugutu awumwi awumwi''.
Jehova wakapa mulumbe kumulomo waBbalamu alimwi wakati,'' bweda kuli Bbalakki ukambulawe.''
Aboobo Bbalamu wakabweeda kuli Bbalakki, wakiimvwi kumbali lyachipayililo chakwe chakutenywa, alimwi boonse bazuluzi ba Mowabbu bakali anguwe.
Mbuli masena  mbwaasabalala, mbuli zilili zili kumbali aamulonga, mbuli tunembe twakabyalwa a Jehova, mbuli minsamu itegwa misida ili aambali aamanzi.
Mpawo Bbalamu wakabweda kuli Bbalakki,oyo wakiimvwi afwifwi achipayililo chakutenta,alimwi boonse bazululi baku Mowabbu bakalawe.
Mpawo Bbalamu wakatalika kusunsima alimwi wakati, ''Bbalakki wakandigwisya kuzwa ku Alamu, mwaami wa Mowabbu kuzwa kuzilundu zyakujwe. Kweza unditukilile Jakkobbu, wakati kweza utuke Izilayeli.''
Kujana ndiyobatuka biyeni aabo Leza mbatatukide pe? Kujana ndiyofusana biyeni abaabo Jehova mbatafusani aabo?
Leza uyomugwisya kuzwa ku Ijipiti. Uyooba aanguzu mbuli musune wanyati. Uyoolya zisi zilwaana aatala anguwe. Uyootyolawula mafuwa aabo muzipanzi. Uyobayasa atwaanta twabo.
Ndabatuka biyeni abo Leza mbakatukide? Ndabakazya biyeni abo Jehova mbatakazyi pe?.
Nkaambo kuzwa aajulu lyabbwe ndibona nguwe; kuzwa kuchilundu ndamulanga. Bona, mpubali bantu bapona abalikke alimwi mutakabachiti mbbuli chisi chabuyo.

Nguni ukonzya kubala lusuko lwa Jakkobbu nikuba myelwe yachimpanzi chane chabana ba Izilayeli? muleke ndifwide lufu lwamuntu baluleme, Alimwi buumi bwangu bumane mbbuli bwakwe.'' Bbalakki wakati kuli Bbalamu wakachitaayi kuli ndime ndakakwiita kuti utabe basinkondoma pesi, wakabalongezya''
Bbalakki wakati kuli Bbalamu, ''Wachitaanzi kuli ndime? Ndakweeta kuti utuke basinkondoma bangu, pesi langa, wabalongezya.''
Bbalamu wakasandula alimwi wakati, ''Kujana ndakachilwa kubamba kwaamba luzutu eezyo Jehova nzyabika mu mulomo wangu?''
Eelyo Bbalamu wakasandula Bbalaki, "Ndakaamba kuti kubatumwa bako mbwakatuma kulindime,

''Nikuba kuti Bbalaki wakandipa ng'anda ya bwaami izwiide siliva angolida, tendakali kukonzya kwindilila jwi lya Jehova pe alimwi chibi na chibotu, na kufumbwa choonse nchindinga ndilayanda kuchita. Ngandilaamba eezyo kupela Jehova zyakandilayilila kuti ndaambe. Tendaamba eechi kulimbaabo?
Lino oobu, langa, ndiyobweeda musule kubantu bangu. Pesi chakusanguna leka ndikuchenjezye eecho bantu aaba nchibayochita kubantu bako kumazuba aalikunembo.
Bbalamu wakasandula wati,'' tandeelede na kuzibikila maanu loko kwaamba ezyo Jehova nzyakabikka mumulomo wangu?''
Abobo wakamwambila Bbalakki wati kulinguwe.'' Ndakumbila aza antome andime kunyika imbi oko nkoyobabona. Uyobona biyo mubufwifwi bwabo, tensi bonse pe. Oko uyonditukila mbabo.''
Abobo wakabweza Bbalamu wamutola kumuunda wa Zopimu, kujulu achilundu cha Pisiga, alimwi wayaka zipayililo zili musanu azibili wakapeda mupule amugutu alichimwi chipayililo.
Aboobo Bbalakki wakati kulinguwe, ''Ikaka kweza andime kuli bumwi busena ooko nkoyookonzya kubabona. Uyoobona bali afwifwi babo, pe pe boonse. Ooko uyoobatuka akaambo kangu.''
Aboobo wakatola Bbalamu mumuunda wa Zofini, aajulu a Chilundu Pisiga, alimwi wayaka zimbi zipayililo zili musanu azibili. Wakapayilila musune a mugutu ali chimwi achimwi chipayilio.
Mpawo Bbalamu wakati kuli Bbalakki, ''Imikila awa kumbali lya chipayililo chako chakutenta, aawo neyoswanaana a Jehova okuya.''
Bbalamu wakasanguna chisinsimi eechi. Wakati, "Bbalamu mwana wa Bbiyoli waambula, mwalumi ulameso ajulikide.
Eechi chinsinsimi chawumwi umvwa jwi lizwa kuli Leza, ulaluzibo luzwa Kumupati kampatila, ulazilengano kuzwa kuli Singuzu Zyoonse, kunembo lyayooyo ngwafungamina aa meso ajulikide.
Alimwi Bbalamu wakati kuli Bbalakki,'' imikila awa afwifwi achipo chakutenta,Eelyo ndiyoswaanana a Jehova oko.
Aboobo Jehova wakaswanana a Bbalamu alimwi wakabika mulumbe mumu lomo wakwe. waakati, '' Bweda kuli Bbalakki ukamupe mulumbe wangu.
Aboobo Jehova wakaswana Bbalamu alimwi wakabika mulumbe mumulomo wakwe. Wakati, ''Bweeda kuli Bbalakki alimwi umupe mulumbe wangu.''
Bbalamu wakabweda kulinguwe, alimwi langa, wakaliimvwi kumbali la chipayililo chakwe chakutenta, alimwi bazululi ba Mowabbu bakali anguwe. Mpawo Bbalakki wakati kulinguwe, ''Watyeni Jehova?''
Bbalamu wakatanguna chisinsimi chakwe. Wakati, ''Nyampuka, Bbalakki, alimwi umvwe. Swiilila kuli ndime, iwe mwana mulombe wa Zipola.

Ndamubona, pesi tali aano pe lino.  Ndalanga kulinguwe, pesi tali afwaafwi. Inyeenyenzi iyoozwa kuli Jakobo. Alimwi nkoli yabwami iyobuka kuzwa ku Izilayili uyopwasula beendelezi ba Mowabu alimwi akumwaya lunyungu loonse lwa Seti.
Bbalamu wakakboola kuli nguwe, Alimwi langa, wakaliimvwi afwifwi achipayizyo chakutenta, Alimwi bazululi ba Mowabbu bakali anguwe. Mpawo Bbalakki wakati kulinguwe, wakatyeni Jehova?''
Eelyo Edomu iyooba lukono lwa Izilayili alimwi Seyili alakwe uyoba lukono lwabo, basinkondo ba Izilayili, aabo Izilayili mbayozunda anguzu.
Kuzwa kuli Jekobo mwaami uyozwa uyobweeza bwendelezi, alimwi uyomwaya baponena mumunzi wabo.
Bbalamu wakaba wakwe. wakati,''nyampuka, Bbalakki, alimwi mvwa, Ndiswiilile, iwe yomwana mulombe wa Zippo.
Leza temuntupe oyo kujana ulabeja, Na kuti muntu uulya mayila, unga ulachija boongo bwakwe. Walinawamba chintuna mpawo waleka kuchichita? Walinawamba kuti nzomuhitila chintu wazo leka kuchichita.
Leza tensi muntu pe, kuti ulabeja, nikuba muntususu, kuti ulakonzya kuchincha boongo bwakwe. Wakasyomezya chintu na nchakatachita? Wakali wati ulachita chintu na nchakatazochita?
Langa, ndalayililwa kuti ndilongezye. Lezawapachilongezyo, alimwi nsikonzyi kuchibweedezya musule.
Eelyo Bbalamu wakalanga kuli Amaleki mpawo wakatanguna chinsinsimi chakwe . Wakati, " Amaleki wakali waba mupati wazisi, pesi kumamanino aakwe kuyoba lunyonyoko."
Langa, wandipa chilongezyo, Alimwi andikonzyi kuchibwedezya.
Takwe nakali kulangilila ntenda pe muli Jakkobbu, alimwi takwe nakabona penzi pe muli Izilayeli. Jehova Leza wabo uli aambabo. Alimwi koompolola kwa baami kuli aambabo.
Leza wakabagwisya kuzwa mu Ijipiti amanguzu alimbuli amusune wamusokwe.
Takwe busondi buyolwania Jakkobbu, alimwi takwe kusonda kuyonyonyona Izilayeli. Anokuti, ziyanda kwambulwa aatala a Jakkobbu a Izilayeli, 'Langa Leza nzyatuchitila!'
Langa, bantu babuka mbuuli mulavu mwanakazi, mbuli mulavu mbalanga ambajata. Talali pe mane walya nchali kuvwima alimwi wanywa bwachecho nchajaya.''
Mpawo Bbalakki wakati kuli Bbalamu, ''Tobatuki na kubalongezya  lyoonse.''
Pesi Bbalamu wakasandula alimwi wakati kuli Bbalakki, ''Tensi ndakakwaambila kuti ndeelede kwaamba zyoonse ezyo  Jehova nzyandaambila kuti ndaambe?''
Aboobo Bbalaki wakasandula Bbalamu, ''Sika lino, ndiyokutola kuli bumwi busena. Ambweni ziyobotezya Leza akaambo kako kuti ubatuke ooko akaambo kangu.''
Aboobo Bbalakki wakabweza Bbalamu wamutola aajulu lya Chilundu Piyo, eecho chilanga munkanda.
Bbalamu wakati kuli Bbalakki, ''Ndiyakile zipayililo zili musanu azibili aano alimwi ubambile basune bali musanu ababili a bagutu bali musanu ababili.''
Aboobo Bbalakki wakachita mbuli Bbalamu mbakaamba; wakapayilila musune a mugutu aachipayililo chimwi achimwi.
Eelyo Bbalamu nakaboona kuti zibotezya Jehova kulongezya baIzilayeli, taakinkape, mulizimwi zyiindi, kubelesya basondi. Nikuba kuti kwalanzya muchimpayuma
Wakanyampula meso alimwi wabona Izilayeli nkakkede, abamwi mumukowa wabo, alimwi muuya waLeza wakaselukila aalingguwe.
Wakatambula chisinsimi alimwi wakati, ''Bbalamu mwana mulombe waBbowa waamba kwaambuula, mwaalumi ulameso aajulide loko.
Ulaambuula alimwi ulalimvwa ijwi lyaLeza. ulbona chilengano kuzwa kuli Leza, kunembo lyayooyo ngwafugamina meso aakwe nkaajulide.
Mabotu byeeni matente aako, Jakkobbu, busena oobo mpokkala, Izilayeli!
Mbuli makuti aayalide, mbuli zilili zilimunsi aamulonga, mbuli gompe libyalidwe aaJehova, mbuli musida kumbali amaanzi.
Maanzi alooyeta kuzwa muzibikilo zyawo, alimwi mbuto zyayo iyooba amaanzi miingi. Mwaami wabo uyooba mupati kwiinda Agagi, alimwi bwaami bwabo buyoopegwa bulemu.
Leza uyoomugwisya muIjipiti. Uyobeenguzu mbuli zyamunyati. Uyolya nyika zyoonse nzimulwana. Uyotyola mafuwa aabo. Uyobayasa alunta lwakwe.
Ulabwata mbuli mulavu, mbuli mulavu muzyazi. Ngwani ukkonzya kumuchelezya? Woonse umulongezya ajane kulongezegwa; woonse umutuka ajane lutuko.''

Bbalakki wakabusya bukkali bwakwe aatala aBbalamu alimwi alimwi wakuuma maboko aakwe aantomwe  chabukali. Bbalakki wakati kuli Bbalamu, ''Ndakwiitila kuti utukw basinkondoma, pesi boona, wabalongezya kwiindilidwe tutatu.
Aboobo ndisiye lino mpawawa alimwi ubweede kumuunzi. Ndakati ndakupa mpindu mpati, pesi Jehovawachita kuti utajani pe kufumbwa mpindu.''
Mpawo Bbalamu wakasandula Bbalakki, ''Ndakati kubatumwa mbwakandituminide, '

Nikuba kuti Bbalakki wandipa busena bwakwe bwabwaami buzwide nsiliva agolide, nsikoyootaluka ijwi lwaJyejhova, alimwi kufumbwa chitu chibo naa chibotu, naa kuti ufumbwa chintu nchinga ndilayanda kuchita. Ndikonzya kwaambauula kupela eezyo Jehova nzyaandibuzya kuti ndaambe.' Nsindakazyaamba na kulimbabo?
Lino, boona, ndilabweeda kubantu bangu. Pesi leka ndikuchenjezye sansiina eezyo bantu bangu nzibatakachitekubantu bako mumazuba ayobuza.''
Lino izina lyamwalumi wa Izilayeli wakajayigwa amwanakazi waku Midiyani wakali Zimuli mwana mulombe wa Salu, muzuluzi wamizimu yempuli akati kaba Simeyoti.
Izina lyamwanakazi wakajayigwa mu Midiyani wakali Kkozibi mwana musimbi wa Zuli, wakali silutwe wamusyobo ampuli mu Midiyani.
Bbalamu wakatalika kusinsima. Wakati, ''Bbalamu mwana mulombe waBbuwa wambuula, Mwaalumiulameso aajulikide loko.
Eechi nchisinsimichayoyo umvwa majwi kuzwa kuli Leza, ulaluzibo kuzwa Kumupati, uleechilengano kuzwa Kumupati, Kunembo lyakwe ulafgana nkajulide meso.
Lino Jehova wakambula kuli Mozesi akuti,
''Amubachite basinkondo nyokwe ba Midiyani akubalwana,

Nkambo bamubweza mbuli basinkondonyokwe akumupenzya. Bamunjizya muchibi kumakani a Piyoli akumuchizi wabo Kkozibi, mwana musimbi wamwendelezi mu Midiyani, ooyo wakajayigwa muzuba lyachilwazi chitabukila mutwambo twa Piyoli.''

Ndilimubwene, pesi tawope limo aawa. Nilangide kulinguwe, pesi tali aafwiiwi pe. Nyenyeezi iyoozwa kuliJakkobbu, alimwi kuyobuka nkoli yabwaami muli Izilayeli. Uyonyoona bazului baku Mowabbu alimwi uyonyoona lunyungu loonse lwaSeti
Mpwawo Edomu luyoba lukona lwaIzilayeli, alimwi Siya  iyooba lukono lwabo lubo, basinkondonyina ba Izilayeli,  aabo Izilayeli mbatakazunde changu.
Kuyoozwa mwaami kuli Jakkobbu utakabe abweendelezi, alimwi uyoonyonyoona bakasyeede kuzisi zabo.''
Mpawo Bbalamu wakalanga Amaleki alimwi wakatalika chisinsimi. Wakati, ''Amalekki yakalimpati kulizimwi nyika, pesi kumagolelo aakwe uyonyoonyonwa.''
Mpawo Bbalamu wakalanga kulibaKkenayayiti alimwi wakatalika kusinsima. Wakati, ''Busena oobu mpumukkala bulisimide, alimwi achizumbo chako chil mumabwe.
Nekubaboobo, nobaKkenayiti muyolyigwa amulilo eelyo ba Asiliya mbatakamubweze bazike.''
Mpawo Bbalamu wakatalika chisinsimi chakwe chakugozya. Wakati, ''Mawee! Ngwani utakafutuke eelo Jehova aakuchita eezi?
Zikkepe ziyoosika kuzwa kunkomwe zyaku Kkitimu; bayolwisya  Asiliya alimwi bayoozunda Ebba, pesi aabo, abalabo, bayochinka mukunyonyooka.
Mpawo Bbalamu wakanyamuka alimwi wakeenda. Wakabweeda kumuunzi wakwe., alimwi alakwe Bbalakki wakeenda.
Izilayeli wakakkala mu Syitimu, alimwi mpawo baalumi bakatalika kuchita bumambe abanakazi baku Mowabbu,
nkaambo baMowabbu bakatamba bantu kuchipayizyo chabaleza babo. Lino bantu bakalya akukotamina baleza babaMowabbu.
Mpawo baalumi ba Izilayeli bakanjila mukukomba Bbaala wa Piyoli, alimwi bukali bwa Jehova bwakabukila Izilayeli.
Aboobo Mozesi a Eliyaza mupayizi wakambula kulimbabo akunyika itandabede ya Mowabbu kubbazu lya Jolodoni ku Jelikko akuti,
''Bala bantu, kuzwa kumyaka ili makumi aabili kaziya kunembo, mbuli Yahuwe mbakalayilila Mozesi abantu ba Izilayeli, bakazwa kunyika ya Ijipiti.''
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Jaya boonse bazuluzi babantu akubalengelezya kunembo lyangu kuti bayanikwe azuba, kuchitila kuti kunyema kwangu kuyosya kuzwe akati kaba Izilayeli.''
Aboobo Mozesi wakambila bazuluzi ba Izilayeli kuti, ''Umwi awumwi wanu uleelede kujaya bantu bakasweenene kukukomba Bbaala wa Piyoli.''
Lubbeni wakali mutanzi kukuzyalwa kuli Izilayeli kuzwa kumwana wakwe mulombe Hanokki kwakazwa mukowa wama Hanokkayitisi.
Kuzwa Heziloni kwakaza mukowa wama Hezilonayiti kuzwa Kkami kwakaza mukowa wama Kkamiti.
Eyi njiyakali mikowa ya Lubbeni, bantu bakali mweelwe uli 43,730 balumi.

Mpawo umwi mwaalumi wabana ba Izilayeli wakasika akweeta mpuli yakwe yakumwanakazi mu Midiyani. Ezi zyakachitika kumeso a Mozesi akuluundu loonse lwabantu ba Izilayeli, nibakachili kulila kumanjililo a teente lyakubunganina.
Eelyo Finiyasi mwana mulombe wa Eliyeza mwana mulombe wa Aloni mupayizi, nakabona eezi, wakanyampuka akati kaluundu akubweza sumu mukuboko kwakwe.

Wakatobela mwaalumi wa Izilayeli mutente akuwala sumu lyakuyasa babili, bakalamwi mwaalumi wa Izilayeli amwanakazi. Aboobo zilwazi zitabukila Leza nzyakatumide kubantu ba Izilayeli zyakamana. Abo bakafwa azilwazi zitabukila bakali zyuulu zili makkumi abili azine mumweelwe.
Jehova wakaambila Mozesi kuti,

''Finiyasi mwana mulombe wa Eliyazi mwanamulombe wa Aaloni mupayizi, wagwisya bukali bwakunyema akati kabantu ba Izilayeli nkambo wakali musungu achiyandisyo akati kabo. Tendakabanyonyona pe bantu ba Izilayeli mubukali bwangu buyoosya.
Mbuliboobo amba kuti, ''Jehova waamba kuti, ''Langa, ndapa Finiyasi chizuminano changu  chaluumuno.
Lwakwe we anzubo zyakwe musule akwe, chiyooba chizuminano chabupayizi butamani nkambo wakali kusungwalila ndime, Leza wakwe. Wakajatanisya bantu bamu Izilayeli.'''''
Lino izina lya mwaalumi wa Izilayeli wakajayigwa aantomwe amwanakazi mu Midiyeni wakali Zimuli mwana mulombe wa Sawulo, muzululi wampuli yabasikale aakati ka ma Simiyoni.
Izina lya mwanakazi mu Midiyeni wakajayigwa wakali Kkozibi mwana musimbi wa Zule, wakali silutwe wamukowa a mpuli mu Midiyeni.
Mikowa yazyalane lya Gadi njeyi: kwinda muli Zefoni, mukowa wama Zefonitisi, kwinda muli Hagi, mukowa wama Hagitisi, kwinda muli Shuni, mukowa wama Shunitisi,
Kwinda muli Ozini, mukowa wama Ozinitisi, kwinda muli Eli, mukowa wama Eliti,
Kwinda muli Alodi, mukowa wama Aloditi, kwinda muli Aleli, mukowa wama Alelayiti.
Eyi njemikowa yalunyungu lwa Gadi, bantu bakali mweelwe 40,500.
Aboobo Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi wakati,
''Bweza ba Midiyeni mbuli basinkondonyokwe alimwi ubalwane,

nkaambo bakamubweza mbuli basinkondonyina kwiinda mulweeneno lwabo. Bakamuzulwida mububi mukaambo ka Piyo alimwi amukaambo kamuchizi wabo Kkozibi, mwana musimbi wamuzululi mu Midiyeni, ooyo wakajayigwa mubuzuba bwa dwazi mukaambo ka Piyo.''
Bana ba Juda bakali Eli a Onani, pesi balumi aba bakafwida munyika ya Kkenani.
Mikowa yalumwi lunyungu lwa Juda yakali eyi: kwinda m uli Shela, mukowa wama Shelanayitisi, kwinda muli Pelezi, mukowa wama Peleziti, akwinda muli Zela, mukowa wama Zelahitisi.
Izyalane lya Pelezi lyakali eli: kwinda muli Heziloni, mukowa wama Hezilonitisi, kwinda muli Hamuli, mukowa wama Hamulitisi.
Eyi njemikowa yazyalane lya Juda, bantu bakali mweelwe uli 76,500.
Mikowa yalunyungu lwa Isakka yakali eyi: kwinda muli Tola, mukowa wama Tolayitisi, kwinda muli Puwa, mukowa wama Puyitisi,
Kwinda muli Jashubbi, mukowa wama Jashubbitisi, kwinda muli Shimulomu, mukowa wama Shimulonitisi.
Eyi njiyakali mikowa ya Isakka, bantu bakali mweelwe uli 64,300.
Mikowa yazyalane lya Zebbulani yakali eyi: kwinda muli Seledi, mukowa wama Seleditisi, kwinda muli Eloni, mukowa wama Eloniti, kwinda muli Jahileli, mukowa wama Jahilelitisi.
Eyi njiyakali mikowa yalunyungu lwa Zebbuluniti, mweelwe wabantu uli 60,500.
Mikowa yalunyungu lwa Jozefu yakali Manase a Efulemu.
Izyalane lya Manase lyakali eli: kwinda muli Makkili, mukowa wama Makkilitisi, ( Makkili wakali wisi wa Giliyadi) kwinda muli Giliyadi, mukowa wama Giliyaliditisi.
Izyalane lya Giliyadi lyakali eli: kwinda muli Lezeli, mukowa wama Lezelayiti, kwinda muli Helekki, mukowa wama Helekitisi,
Kwinda muli Asili, mukowa wama Asilayiti, kwinda muli Shechemu, mukowa wama Shechemitisi,
Kwinda muli Shemida, mukowa wama Shemidayitisi, Kwinda muli Hefa, mukowa wama Hefelitisi.
Zelofohadi mwana mulombe wa Hefa takalikwe bana balombe, pesi basimbi bakali Mahila, Nowa, Hogila, Milikka, a Tiliza.
Eyi njiyakali mikowa ya Manase, bantu bakali mweelwe uli 52,700.
Mikowa ya Shutela, mukowa wama Shutelahitisi, kwinda muli Bbeka, mukowa wama Bbekaliti, kwinda  muli Tahamu, mukowa wama Tahanitisi.
Izyalane lya Shutela lyakali, kuli Elani, mukowa wama Elanitisi.
Eyi njiyakali mikowa yalunyungu lwa Efulemu, bantu bakali mweelwe uli 32,500. Aya akali mazyalane a Jozefu, nkubalwa kuli umwi awumwi mukowa wabo.
Mikowa yazyalane lya Bbenjamini yakali eyi: kwinda muli Bbela, mukowa wama Bbelayitisi, kwinda muli Ashibbelu, mukowa wama Ashibbelitisi, kwinda muli Ahilamu, mukowa wama Ahilamiti,
Kwinda muli Shepupamu, mukowa wama Shapamitisi, kwinda muli Hufani, mukowa wama Shufamitisi.
Izyalane lya Bbela bakali Adi a Naamani, kuzwa Adi kwakasika mukowa wama Aditisi, alimwi kuzwa Namani kwakaza mukowa wama Namayitisi.
Eyi njiyakali mikowa yazyalane lya Bbenjamini, bantu bakali mweelwe uli 45,600.
Mikowa yazyalane lya Dani yakali eyi, kwakali Shuhamu, mukowa wama Shuhamitisi.Eyi njiyakali mikowa yazyalane lya Dani.
Yoonse mikowa yama Shuhamitisi yakali mweelwe yabantu bali 64,400.
Mikowa yazyalane lya Asha yakali eyi: kwinda muli Imuna , mukowa wama Imunayitisi,kwinda muli Imuna Ishivi, mukowa wama Ishivitisi, kwinda muli Bbeliya, mukowa wama Bbeliyati.
Izyalane lya Bbeliya lyakali eli:  kwinda muli Hebba, mukowa wama Hebbeliisi, kwinda muli Makkiyeli, mukowa wama Makkiyelitisi.
Izina lyamwana musimbi wa Asha ngu Sela.
Eyi yakali mikowa yazyalane lya Asha, bantu bakali mweelwe uli 53,400.
Mikowa yazyalane lya Nafutali yakali eyi: kwinda muli Jahizeli, mukowa wama Jahizelitisi, kwinda  muli Guni, mukowa wama Gunitisi,
Kwinda muli Jeza, mukowa wama Jezelitisi, kwinda muli Shilemu, mukowa wama Shilemitisi.
Eyi yakali mikowa ya Nafutali, bantu bakali mweelwe uli 45,400.
Oku nkukwakali kubala kumaninide kwabantu ba Izilayeli: 601,730.
Yahuwe wakambula kuli Mozesi akuti;
''Nyika yelede kwabanwa akati kabantu aba mbuli lukono kwindilila mweelwe wamazina abo.
Kumikowa mipati welede kupa lukono lwingi, alimwi kumikowa minini welede kupa lukono luche. Kuli zyoonse mpuli ulelede kupa lukono kwendelana amweelwe wabantu bakabalidwe.
Nkenkakako, nyika iyelede kwabanisigwa chakutasalula. Balelede kukona nyika mbuli mbuya kabanisizigwe akati kamusyobo yabasikale babo.
Lukono lwabo lweelede kwabanisigwa akati kamukowa mupati amunini, kayipegwa kulimbabo chakutasalula.''
Mikowa yama Levayiti, yakabalwa mukowa amukowa, yakali eyi: Kwinda muli Geshomu, mukowa wama Geshomayitisi, kwinda muli Kkohati, mukowa wama Kkohayitisi, kwinda muli Melali, mukowa wama Melalitisi.
Mikowa ya Levi yakali eyi:
Izina lya mwanakazi wa Amulamu wakali Jochebbedi, kuzyalane lya Levi, wakazyalwa kuma Levitisi mu Ijipiti. Wakazyalila Amulamu bana babo, bakali Aaloni, Mozesi a Miliyemu, muchizi wabo.
Kuli Aaloni kwakazyalwa Nadabbu a Abbihu, Eliyaza a Itamali.
Nadabbu a Abbihu bakafwa nibakapa kunembo lya Yahuwe mulilo utatambuliki.

Balumi bakali balidwe akati kabo bakali mweelwe uli zyuulu makumi abili ataatu, boonse bakali a mweezi umwi wakuzyalwa kaziya kunembo. Pesi tebakabalidwe akati kazyalane lya Izilayeli nkambo takwe pe lukono lwakapegwa kulimbabo akati kabantu ba Izilayeli.
Aba bakali bamwi bakabalwa a Mozesi a Eliyaza mupayizi. Bakabala bantu ba Izilayeli munyika itanabede ya Mowabbu kubbazu lya Jodani ku Jelikko.
Pesi akati tekwakalikwe muntu wakalibalidwe a Mozesi a Aaloni mupayizi chiindi zyalane lya Izilayeli nilyakabalwa mulusaka lwa Sinayi.
Nkambo Yahuwe mbakaambide kuti boonse bantu balelede kufwa mulusaka munkanda. Takwe muntu wakachaala akati kabo, kusiya Kkalebbu mwana mulombe wa Jefune a Joshuwa mwana wa Nuni.
Zyakachitika awo musule lya dwazi Jehova ndyakaamba kuli Mozesi a Eliyeza mwanamulombe wa Aloni mupayizi. Wakati,
''Bala luundu lwabantu ba Izilayeli,kuzwa kumyaka ili makumi aabili akuzyalwa kaziya kunembo, ampuli zyabasikale babo, boonse bakonzya kuya kunkondo ya Izilayeli.''
Bakayima kunembo lya Mozesi, Eliyaza mupayizi, basilutwe, akunembo lyaluundu kumulyango wateente lyakubunganina. Bakati,
''Ndeende wesu wakafwa munkanda. Taakali akati kabaabo bakabukila Jehova munkamu ya Kkola. Wakafwa akambo kachibi chakwe, alimwi takali abana.
Aboobo Mozesi a Eliyeza mupayizi bakaambula kulimbabo muntandabale zya Mowabbu kumbali lya Jodani ku Jelikko alimwi bakati,
''Mubale bantu, kuzwa kuminyaka ili makkumi obile kaziya kujulu, mbuli Jehova mbakalayilila Mozesi a bantu ba Izilayeli, bakazwa munyika ya Ijipiti.''
Nkamboyi izina lyandende wesu nilitagwisigwe kuzwa akati kabantu bamukowa wakwe nkambo taali amwana na? Amutupe nyika akati kababunyina bwandende wesu.''
Awo Mozesi wakaleta kambo kabo kunembo lya Yahuwe.
Lubbeni wakali mwana mutaanzi wa Izilayeli. Kuzwa ku mwana wakwe mulombe Hanokki kwakazwa mukowa wa ba Hanokki. Kuzwa kuli Palu kwakazwa mukowa wa ba Palu.
Kuzwa kuli Heziloni kwakazwa mukowa wa ba Heziloni. Kuzwa kuli Kkami kwakazwa mukowa wa ba Kkami.
Eeyi yakalimikowa ya Lubbeni, yakali amweelwe uusika 43,730 baalumi.
Jehova wakambuli kuli Mozesi akuti,
''Bana basimbi ba Zelofenadi balikwambula kabotu. Welede kubapa chakutaleka nyika buli lukono akati kababunyina bwawisi wabo, alimwi welede kubona kuti lukono lwawisi  wabo lwasikila alimbabo.
Welede kwamba kubantu ba Izilayeli akuti, 'Na muntu wafwa katakwe mwana, mpawo welede kuchita kuti lukono lwakwe luye kumwana wakwe wachisimbi.
Eliyabbu wakali mwana mulombe wa Palu.
Bana balombe ba Eliyabbu bakali ba Nemuyeli, Dathani, a Abbilamu. Aba bakali ba Dathani a Abbilamu aabo bakatobela Kkola eelyo nibakasunka Mozesi a Aloni alimwi bakapapila Jehova.
Na katakwe mwana musimbi, mpawo welede kupa lukono lwakwe kubakulana bakwe.
Na katakwe bakulana, mpawo welede kupa lukono lwakwe kubakulana bawisi.

Na wisi katakwe bakulana, mpawo welede kupa lukono lwakwe  kuli babunyina bali afwifwi mumukowa wakwe, alimwi welede kwiibweza kuba yakwe. Oyu uyoba mulawu ubambwa akwamba wabantu ba Izilayeli, mbuli Jehova mbwalayilila ndime.''
Inyika yakajulika mulomo wayo akubamena boonse antomwe a Kkola chindi choonse batobeli bakwe nibakafwa. Muchiindi echo, mulilo wakajaya bantu bali 250, bakaba chitondezyo chaluchenjezyo.
Pesi lubazu lwa Kkola telwakafwa pe.
Mikowa yazyalane lya Simiyoni njeyi: kwinda muli Nemuyeli, mukowa wama Nemuyelitisi, kwinda muli Jamini, mukowa wama Jaminitisi, kwinda muli Jakkini, mukowa wama Jakinitisi,
kwinda muli Zela, mukowa wama Zelakkitisi, kwinda muli Shawulu, mukowa wama Shawulitisi.
Eeyi yakali mikowa ya mikowa ya Simiyoni, yakali aamweelwe usika 22,200 baalumi.
Mikowa yalunyungu lwa Gadi yakali eeyi: Kwiindila muli Zefoni, mukowa wa ba Zefoni, kwiindila muli Hagi, mukowa wa ba Hagi, kwiindila muli Syuni, mukowa wa ba Syunayi,
kwiindila muli Ozini, mukowa wa ba Ozinayi, kwiindila muli Eli, mukowa wa ba Eli,
kwiindila muli Alodi, mukowa wa ba Alodi, kwiindila muli Aleli, mukowa wa ba Aleli.
Eeyi yakali mikowa yalunyungu lwa Gadi, yakali aamweelwe uusika 40,500 baalumi.
Yahuwe wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Bweza Joshuwa mwana wa Nuni, mwalumi ukkala muuya wangu mulinguwe, akubika janza lyako alinguwe.
Mubike kunembo lya Eliyaza mupayizi akunembo lyaluundu loonse, akumulayilila kunembo lyameso abo kuti abazulwide.
Bana balombe ba Juda bakali Eli a Onani, pesi baalumi aaba  bakafwa munyika ya Kkenani.
Mikowa yalumwi lunyungu lwa Juda yakali eeyi: kwiindila muli Syela, mukowa wa ba Syelani, kwiindila muli Pelezi, mukowa wa ba Pelezi, alimwi kwiindila muli Zela, mukowa wa ba Zerahi.
Lunyungu lwa Pelezi bakali aaba: Kwiindila muli Heziloni, mukowa wa ba Heziloni, kwiindila muli Hamuli, mukowa wa ba Hamuli.
Eeyi yakali mikowa ya lunyungu lwa Juda, yakali aamweelwe uusika 76,500 baalumi.
Welede kubika zimwi inguzu zyako alinguwe,kuchitila kuti luundu loonse lwabantu ba Izilayeli nga balamuswilila.

Uyoyenda kunembo lya Eliyeza mupayizi kuyoyandula kuyanda kwangu kulinguwe kwinda mumizezo ya Yulimu. Zinoli kukulayilila kwakwe kuti bantu bakazwe anze akuyonjila mukati, bonse welwakwe abantu boonse ba Izilayeli balanguwe, luundu loonse.''
Mpawo Mozesi wakachita mbuli Yahuwe mbakamulayilila. Wakabweza Joshuwa akumubika anembo lya Eliyaza mupayizi akuluundu loonse.
Wakamubika maanza aakwe alinguwe akumulayilila zyakuzulwida, mbuli Yahuwe mbwakamulayilila kuti achite.
Mikowa yalunyungu lwa Isakka yakali eeyi: Kwiindila muli Tola, mukowa wa ba Tolayi, kwiindila muli Puwa, mukowa wa ba Puwa,
kwiindila muli Jasyubbi, mukowa wa ba Jasyubi, kwiindila muli Syimuloni, mukowa wa ba Syimuloni.
Eeyi yakali mikowa ya Isakka, yakali aamweelwe uusika 64,300 baalumi.
Mikowa yalunyungu lwa Zebbuluni yakali eeyi: Kwiindila muli Seledi, mukowa wa ba Seledi, kwiindila muli Eloni, mukowa wa ba Eloni, kwiindila muli Jaleli, mukowa wa ba Jaleli.
Eeyi yakali mikowa ya ba Zebbuluni, yakali aamweelwe uusika 60,500 baalumi.
Mikowa yalunyungu lwa Jozefu kwakali Manase a Ifulemu.
Lunyungu lwa Manase bakali: kwiindila muli Makkili, mukowa wa ba Makkili (Makkili wakali wisi wa Giliyadi), kwiindila muli Giliyadi, mukowa wa ba Giliyadi.
Lunyungu lwa Giliyadi bakali aaba:Kwiindila muli Iyeza, mukowa wa ba Iyezali, kwiindila Helekki, mukowa wa ba Helekki,
kwiindila muli Asiliyeli, mukowa wa ba Asiliyeti, kwiindila ,muli Syekkemu, mukowa wa ba Syekkemu,
kwiindila muli Syemida, mukowa wa ba Syemidayi, kwiindila muli Hepa, mukowa wa ba Hepali.
Zelofehadi mwana mulombe wa Hepa takalikwe bana balombe pe, pesi luzutu bana basimbi. Mazina aabana bakwe basimbi bakali Mala, Nowa, Hogila, Milukka, a Teza.
Eeyi yakali mikowa ya Manase yakali aamweelwe uusika 52,700 baalumi.
Mikowa yalunyungu lwa Ifulemu yakali eeyi: Kwiindila muli Syutela, mukowa wa ba Syutelahi, kwiindila muli Bbekka, mukowa wa ba Bbekkali, kwiindila muli Tahani, mukowa wa ba Tahani.
Lunyungu lwa Syuteala bakali, a Elani, mukowa wa ba Elani. Eeyi yakali mikowa yalunyungu lwa Ifulemu, yakali aamweelwe uusika 32,500 baalumi.
Aaba lwakali lunyungu lwa Jozefu, bakabalwa muli umwi awumwi mukowa.
Mikowa yalunyungu lwa Bbenjamini yakali eeyi: Kwiindila muli Bbela, mukowa wa ba Bbela, kwiindila muli Asyibbeli, mukowa wa ba Asyibbeli, kwiindila muli Ahilamu, mukowa wa ba Ahilamu,
kwiindila muli Syepupamu, mukowa wa ba Syepupamu, kwiindila muli Hufamu, mukowa wa ba Hufamu.
Lunyungu lwa Bbela bakali Adi a Namani. Kuzwa kuli Adi kwakazwa mukowa wa ba Adi, alimwi kuzwa kuli Namani kwakazwa mukowa wa ba Namani.
Eeyi yakali mikowa yalunyungu lwa Bbenjamini. Bakali 45,600 baalumi.
Mikowa yalunyungu lwa Dani yakali, a Syuhamu, mukowa wa ba Syuhami. Eeyi yakali mikowa yalunyungu lwa Dani.
Yoonse mikowa ya ba Syuhami wakali mweelwe wa 64,400 baalumi.
Mikowa ya lunyungu lwa Asya yakali eeyi: Kwiindila muli Imuna, mukowa wa ba Imunayi, kwiindila muli Isyivi, mukowa wa ba Isyivayi, kwiindila muli Bbeliya, mukowa wa ba Bbelayi.
Lunyungu lwa Bbeliya bakali aaba: Kwiindila muli Hebba, mukowa wa ba Hebbali, kwiindila muli Malikkiyeli, mukowa wa ba Malikkiyeli.
Izina lya mwana musimbi wa Asya wakali Sela.
Eeyi yakali mikowa ya lunyungu lwa Asya, yakali amweelwe uusika 53,400 baalumi.
Mikowa ya lunyungu lwa Nafutali yakali eeyi: Kwiindila muli Jazili, mukowa wa ba Jazilayi, kwiindila muli Guni, mukowa wa ba Gunayi,
kwiindila muli Jeza, mukowa wa ba Jezali, kwiindila muli Syilemu, mukowa wa ba Syilemayi.
Eeyi yakali mikowa yalunyungu lwa Nafutali, yakali amweelwe wa 45,400 baalumi.
Oobu bwakali buzule bwabubalwe bwabaalumi ba Izilayeli: 601,730.
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi wakati,
''I nyika yeelede kwaandanisigwa  aakati ka baalumi aaba mbuli lukono mbuli mumweelwe wa mazna aabo.
Kumikowa mipati weelede kupa lukono lwiingi, alimwi kumikowa miniini weelede kupa lukono luche. Kumpuli ayimwi weelede kupa lukono kazyeendelana amweelwe wa baalumi bakabalwa.
Nikulibuti, nyika yeelede kwaandanisigwa achisolo. Baleelede kuyookona nyika mbuli mbitakaandanisigwe aakati kamikowa yabamataata aabo.
Lukono lwabo lweelede kuyoowandanisigwa aakati kamikowa mipati a miniini, kiyoopegwa kulimbabo achisolo.''
Mikowa ya ba Levi, kayibalidwe mukowa a mukowa, yakali eeyi: Kwiindila muli Gesyomu, mukowa wa ba Gesyomi, kwiindila muli Kkohati, mukowa wa ba Kkohati, kwiindila muli Melali, mukowa wa ba Melali.
Mikowa ya Levi yakali eeyi: mukowa wa ba Libbinayiti, mukowa wa ba Hebbulonayiti, mukowa wa ba Malayiti, mukowa wa ba Musyayiti, a mukowa wa ba Kkolahiti. Kkohati wakali walunyungu lwa Amulamu.
Izina lya mukayintu wa Amulamu wakali Jokkebbedi, walunyungu lwa Levi, wakazyalwa ku ba Levi mu Ijipiti. Wakazyalila Amulamu bana, bakali Aloni, Mozesi, a Miliyemu muchizi wabo.
Kuli Aloni kwakazyalwa Nadabbu a Abbihu, Eliyeza a Itama.
Nadabbu a Abbihu bakafwa aawo nibakapa kunembo lya Jehova mulilo uutatambuliki.

Bachaalumi bakabalwa aakati kabo bakali zyuulu zili makkumi obile azitatu, boonse bachaalumi bakali amwezi womwe kaziya kunembo. Pesi tebakali kubalikizigwa pe aakati kalunyungu lwa Izilayeli nkaambo takwe lukono pe lwakapegwa kulimbabo akaati kabantu ba Izilayeli.
Aaba mbimbabbo bakabalwa a Mozesi alimwi a Eliyeza mupayizi.Bakabala bantu ba Izilayeli muntandabale zya Mowabbu kumbali lya Jodani ku Jelikko.
Pesi aakati kabaaba tekwaliwo pe mwaalumi wakali wabalwa a Mozesi a Aloni mupayizi aawo balunyungu lwa Izilayeli nibakabalwa munkanda ya Sinayi.

Nkaambo kakuti Jehova wakali waamba kuti boonse bantu aabo nchobeni bayoofwa munkanda. Takwe mwaalumi wakasyaala aakati kabo, kunze kwa Kkelebbu mwana mulombe wa Jefune alimwi a Jozefu mwana mulombe wa Nuni.

Mpawo bakeza kuli Mozesi bana basimbi ba Zelofenadi mwana mulombe wa Hefa mwana wa Giliyadi mwana mulombe wa Makkila mwana mulombe wa Manase, bakumikowa ya Manase mwana mulombe wa Jozefu. Aaya akali mazina abana bakwe basimbi: Mahala, Nowa, Hogila, Milikka a Tiliza.
Bakiima kunembo lya Mozesi, Eliyeza mupayizi, bazululi, alimwi kunembo lya luundu kumanjililo atente lyakuswananina.
Bakati, ''Taata wesu wakafwida munkanda. Teensi wakali umwi wababo bakapapila Jehova kabali aantomwe a Kkola. Wakafwida zibi zyakwe, alimwi takalikwe bana balombe pe.

Uyelede kubaambila lubo kuti, ''Eechi nchechipo chipangwa amulilo nchimwelede kupa kuli Yahweh - bana bambelele beenze balamwaaka umwi nkatakwe kampenda, babili abuzuba mbuli chipo chakutenta chichitwa chiindi choonse.
Mwelede kupeda kabelele kamwi kuseni, aka kamwi kabelele mwelede kukapede goko.
Mwelede kupeda chakkumi chalusuwo chabusu bunante mbuli chipo chazilyo, chiswanizizigwe achimpanzi chomwe muzimpanzi zyone chakankuli kamafuta awondedwe.
Nkaambonzi zina lya taata wesu nilitakagwisigwe kuzwa aakati kabamukowanyina nkaambo takalikwe mwana mulombe  pe? Mukatupe nyika aakati kanzubo zya taata wesu.''
Aboobo Mozesi wakeeta kaambo kabo kunembo lya Jehova.
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi wakati,
''Bana basimbi ba Zelofohedi balikwaamba ziluzi. Uleelede kubapa nyika mbuli lukono aakati kanzubo zyawisi wabo, alimwi weelede kubona kuti lukono lwawisi lwasika kuli mbabo.
Uleelede kwaambula kubantu ba Izilayeli alimwi utedi, 'Na mwaalumi wafwa alimwi katakwe mwana mulombe, mpawo uleelede  kuchita lukono lwakwe kuti lupegwe kumwana wakwe musimbi.
Na katakwe mwana musimbi, mpawo uleelede kupa lukono lwakwe ku banyandumi bakwe.
Na katakwe banyandumi, muleelede kupa lukono lwakwe ku bakulana bawisi.

Na wisi wakwe katakwe bakulana, mpawo muleelede kupa lukono lwakwe kunzubo zili afwiifwi mumukowa wakwe, alimwi weelede kubwezela bakwe. Eechi chiyooba mulawu uubambilidwe bantu ba Izilayeli, mbuli Jehova mbakandilayilila.'''

Kumatalikilo kwamwezi woonse, mwelede kupeda chipayizyo chakuumpa kupeda chipayizyo chakuumpa kuli Yahweh. Mwelede kupeda bapule bang'ombe banini, mugutu womwe, abana bambelele bagutu bali limusanu ababili balamunyaka omwe kabatakwe kampenda.

Mweelede kupeda lubo zimpanzi zitatu - mukumi zyalusuwo lwabusu bunante bwachibunge mbuli chipayililo chazilyo chiswanizizigwe amafuta chamung'ombe umwi awumwi, a zimpanzi zyobile - mukumi zyabusu bunante bwachibunge mbuli chipayizyo chazilyo chiswanizigwe amafuta chamugutu womwe.

Mwelede kupa lubo chalusuwo chabusu bunante buswanizigilwe amafuta mbuli chipayizyo chazilyo chawumwi awumwi mwana mbelele. Eechi nchimwelede kuba chipo chachipayizyo chakumpilizya, kuti chigwisye mweema ununkilila, ichipayizyo chilundidwe amulilo kuli Yahweh.
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Tanta achilundu echi cha Abbalimu akubona nyika eyo njindapa bantu ba Izilayeli.
Wamana kwibona, webo, lwako, welede kuyobolwa kubantu bako, mbuli Aaloni mukulana wako.

Eechi chiyochitika nkambo nywebo nobabili mwakapapa kukazyana alulayo lwangu munkanda ya Zini. Oko, elyo manzi nakatuntumuka kuzwa mubbwe, mukunyema kwako wakakachilwa kundilemeka mbuli usalala kunembo lyameso aluundu loonse.'' Aya manzi aku Melibba ku Kkadeshi munkanda ya Zini.

Ichipayizyo chabantu chakunywa chelede kuba chisela chakankuli kawayini chamupule, chimpanzi chimwi - muzitatu chamugutu, a chimpanzi chomwe - muzine chakankuli kuli chamwana mbelele. Eechi nchichelede kuba chipayizyo chakutentela mwezi amwezi mumyeezi yoonse yamunyaka.
Kapule komwe kampongo mbuli chipayizyo chachibi kuli Yahweh chelede kupegwa. Eechi chiyoba mukuyungizizya kuzyumpilizyo chalubbe achipayizyo chakunywa antomwe anchicho.
Mpawo Mozesi wakambula a Jehova wakati,
''Akaka yebo, Jehova, Leza wamyuuya yabantu boonse, tondeka muntu azulwide luundu,
mwaalumi uuzwa akunjila kunembo lyabo akubazulwida anze akubaleta mukati, ikuchitila kuti luundu lwako lutabi mbuli imbelele zitakwe mweembeli.''
Mumwezi mutanzi, mubuzuba bwakkumi aane bwamwezi, nekusika Pasika ya Yahweh.
Mubuzuba bwakkumi aane bwamwezi ooyu ipobwe lyelede kuchitwa. Kwamazuba musanu aabili, chibunge chitakwe busweezyo chelede kulyigwa.
Muzuba taanzi, kwelede kuba muswangano uusalala kuti kupegwe Yahweh bulemu. Tamwelede kuchita milimu njemuchita mazuba woonse mubuzuba oobo.
Jehova wakati kuli Mozesi, ''Bweza Josyuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni, mwaalumi oomo Muuya wangu muukala, alimwi ubike luboko lwako alinguwe.
Kamubike kunembo lya Eliyeza mupayizi a kunembo lya luundu loonse, alimwi ukamulayilile kunembolyamenso aabo kuti abazulwide.
Nekuba boobo, mwelede kupa chipayiizyo chilundidwe aamulilo, chumpilizyo chipedwe kuli Yahweh.

Mwelede kupa bapule bachili banini, mugutu womwe, abana bambelele beenze bali musanu ababili balamunyaka omwe wakuzyalwa batakwe kampenda. Antomwe a sipule, mwelede kupa chipayizyo chazilyo chazimpanzi zyotatwe - mukkumi zyalusuwo lwabusu bunante buswanizizigwe amafuta, antomwe amugutu, zibili mukkumi.
Awumwi mwana mbelele wabali musanu ababili, mwelede kupeda chakkumi chalusuwo lwabusus bunante buswanizizigwe amafuta,
amupule womwe wampongo mbuli chipayizyo kuti mulisalazye nobeni.
Uleelede kubika bumwi bweendelezi bwako alinguwe, kuchitila kuti loonse luundu lwabantu ba Izilayeli bakonzye kumulemeka.

Uyooyinka kunembo lya Eliyeza mupayizi kuyooyanduula chiyandisyo changu aatala anguwe amizezo ya Yulimu. Nkuumalayilile aakwe ooko bantu nkubatakiinke anze alimwi akunjila mukati, boonse lwakwe alimwi abantu boonse ba Izilayeli bali anguwe, luundu loonse.''
Aboobo Mozesi wakachita mbuli Jehova mbakamulayilila. Wakabweza Josyuwa alimwi wakamubika kunembo lya Eliyeza mupayizi a kuluundu loonse.
Wakabika maboko aakwe alinguwe alimwi wakamulayilila kuti azulwide, mbuli Jehova mbaakamulayilila kuti achite.
Mwelede kupa eezi nkamuyungizizya kuzipayizyo zyakutentela nzemuchita lubbe ziyandikana achimwi chifumo.

Mbuli mbozipandulwidwe awa, mwelede kupa ezi zipayilo mbobucha, kwamazuba musanu aabili a Pasika, ikulya kwachipayilo chichitidwe amulilo, imweema mubotu kuli Yahweh. Zyelede kupedwa kakuyungizizigwa kulezyo zitentelelo zipegwa lubbe achipayililo chakunywa antomwe anchiicho.
Mubuzuba bwamusanu amazuba obile mwelede kuba embungano isalala kuti mulemye Yahweh, elyo tamwelede kuchita milimu njemuzibide kuchita mubuzuba obo.

Alubo mubuzuba bwakabalwe balwe, aawo mwayo peda chipayizyo chazilyo zipya kuli Yahweh mupobwe lya mviki, mwelede kuba ambungano isalala yakulemya Yahweh,mukutachita milimu njemuchita lubbe mulelyo zuba.
Mwelede kupa chuumpilizyo kuti chigwisye mweema mubotu kuli Yahweh. Mwelede kupeda bapule banini babili, mugutu womwe abana bambelele musanu ababili beenze balamunyaka womwe.

Mupedekezye lubo chipayizyo chazilyo kuti zyende amafuta; Busu bunante buswanizizigwe amafuta, azimpanzi zitatu - mukuumi chalusuwo lwabusu bunante buswanizizigwe amafuta chawumwi mupule azimpanzi zyobile kuli chamugutu womwe.
Mupede chakkumi chalusuwo lwabusu bunante buvwelanisizizigwe amafuta chawumwi awumwi mwana wambelele,
alimwi amupule wampongo womwe kuti mulisalazye nobeni.
Mwayopeda aba banyama batakwe kampenda, antomwe azipayiizyo zyazyo zyakunywa, echi chelede kuba chakuyungizizizya kuzipayizyo zyakuumpilizya zyalubbe achipayizyo chazilyo anchicho.''
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi wakati,

''Layilila bantu ba Izilayeli alimwi utedi kulimbabo, 'Muleelede kupa zipayililo kuli ndime azyiindi zisalidwe, chikkafu cha zipayizyo zyangu zichitidwe amulilo kuti zindigwisizye bweema bununkilila.'

Mulelede kutenta chipayizyo chakutenta kuti kube bweema bubotu bwa Yahuwe. Mulelede kupayila kapule keng'ombe komwe, mugutu omwe, abana bembelele bagutu balimusanu ababili balamwaka omwe wakuzyalwa, batakwe kampenda pe.

Alubo weelede kuti kulimbabo, 'Eechi nchipo chachitwa amulilo nchimweelede kupa kuli Jehova - mbelele n'enze ili amunyaka womwe kukomena itakwe kampenda, zyobile limwi alimwi zuba, mbuli chipo chakutenta chalubbe.
Yomwe mbelele mweelede kwiipayila kuseni, alimwi imwi mbelele mweelede kwiipayila golezya.
Mweelede kupayila kkumi lya chisuwo chabusu bunante mbuli chipo cha zilyo, chivwelengene aa chimpanzi chomwe muli zine cha mafuta.
Eechi nchipo chakutenta chalubbe chakalaililwa a Chilundu Sinayi kuti chigwisye bweema bununkilila, chipayililo chakachitwa amulilo kuli Jehova.
Chipo chakunywa anchicho cheelede kuba chimpanzi chomwe muli zine kuli imwi yambelele. Mweelede kutulida aansi mubusena busalala chipo chakunywa cha wayini nkali kuli Jehova.

Imwi mbelele mweelede kwiipayilila golezya aantomwe achimbi chipayililo chazilyo mbuli chimwi chapayililwa kuseni. Mweelede alubo kupa chimbi chipo chakunywa aantomwe anchicho, chpo chachiwa amulilo, kuti chigwisye bweema bununkilila kuli Jehova.
Mubuzuba bwekkumi mumwezi wamusanu ayibili mwelede kuba akubungana kusalala kukulemeka Yahuwe.

Mulelede kulibombya alimwi m utabeleki. Mulelede kupayila chipayizyo chakutenta kuchita bwema bununkilila bwa Yahuwe. Mulelede kupayizya mupule uchili m unini weng'ombe omwe, mugutu omwe, atwana kwambelele twalumi tuli m usanu atubili tulamunyaka omwe. Tatwelede kuba akampenda pe.

Mubuzuba bwa Sabata muleelede kupayila mbelele n'enze zyobile, ayimwi kayili amunyaka womwe kukomena iitakwe kampenda, alimwi zibili muli zili kkumi zisuwo zyabusu bunante mbuli chipo chazilyo, chivwelengene a mafuta, alimwi a chipo chakunywa anchicho.
Eechi cheelede kuba chipo chakutenta mu Sabata imwi ayimwi, kuyungizya ku chipo chakutenta chalubbe alimwi a chipo chakunywa chili anchicho.

Kumatalikilo aamwezi umwi, muleelede kupa chipayilo chakutenta kuli Jehova. Muleelede kupayila basune baniini bobile, mugutu womwe, alimwi ambelele n'enze zili musanu azibili zili amunyaka womwe wakukomena zitakwe kampenda.

Alubo muleelede kupa zitatu mu kkumi zyazisuwo zyabusu bunante mbuli chipo chazilyo chivwelengene amafuta kumusune umwi awumwi, alimwi zibili mu kkumi zyabusu bunante mbuli chipo chazilyo chivwelengene amafuta ku mugutu womwe.

Alubo muleelede kupa chekkumi chachisuwo chabusu bunante chivwelengene amafuta mbuli chipo chazilyo kumbelele ayimwi. Eechi cheelede kuba chipo chakutenta, kuti chigwisye bweema bununkilila, chipo chachitwa amulilo kuli Jehova.

Mubuzuba bwakkumi amusanu bwamwezi wamusanu ayibili mulelede kuba akubungana kusalala kukulemeka Yahuwe. Tamwelede pe kuchita mulimu walubbe mulelyo izuba pe, alimwi mulelelede kubamba ipobwe lyakwe mazuba alimusanu aabili.

Mulelede kupayila chipayizyo chakutenta, chituuzyo chichitwa amulilo kukuchita bweema bununikilila bwa Yahuwe. Mulelede kupayila bapule beng'ombe bachili banini balikkumi abatatu, bagutu bobile, atwana twambelele twalumi tulikkumi atune tulamunyaka omwe. Akamwi kakatakwe kampenda pe.

Zipo zyakunywa zya bantu zyeelede kuba chisela cha chikkali cha wayini ku musune, chomwe chazitatu cha chikkali ku mugutu, alimwi chomwe chazine chachikkali ku mbelele ku mbelele. Eechi cheelede kuba chipo chakutenta kuli umwi awumwi mwezi mumunyaka.
Mpongo n'enze yomwe mbuli chipo chachibi kuli Jehova cheelede kupayilwa. Ooku kunoli nkuyungizya kuchipo chakutenta chalubbe alimwi a chipo chakunywa anchicho.
Mumwezi mutaanzi, mubuzuba bwa kkumi aane bwa mwezi, kuza Kwiinda kwa Jehova.
Mubuzuba bwa kkumi amusanu bwa mwezi ooyu pobwe lyeelede kuchitwa. Kwa mazuba ali musanu aabili, chibunge chitakwe bumena cheeled kuyolyigwa.
Mubuzuba butaanzi, muleelede kuyooba akuswaanana kusalala kwa kulemeka Jehova. Tamweelede kuyoochita milimu yalubbe mubuzuba oobo.
Mubuzuba bwabili bwakubungana, mulelede kupayila bapule beng'ombe banini balikkumi ababili, bagutu bobile, abana bembelele balumi balamunyaka omwe balikkumi abane, kabatakwe tumpenda pe umwi awumwi.
Mulelede kuzichita antomwe achipayizyo chabusu chakunywa chabapule beng'ombe, chabagutu, alimwi achabana bambelele, kuchita zipayizyo zyiingi mbuli mbukulayilidwe.
Mulelede kupayizya impongo yomwe ndyalumi mbuli chipayizyo chachibi mukuyungizya zipayizyo zyakutenta zyalubbe, chipayizyo chazyo chabusu, achipayizyo chabo chakunywa.

Nikubaboobo, muleelede kupa chipayililo chachitwa amulilo, chipo chakutenta kuli Jehova. Muleelede kupa basune bobilwe, mugutu womwe, alimwi a mbelele zili musanu azibili zili amunyaka womwe wakukomena, zitakwe kampenda.
Aantomwe a musune, muleelede kupa chipo chazilyo cha zitatu mukkumi cha chisuwo chabusu bunante bukandidwe amafuta, alimwi aantomwe a mugutu, zibili mu kkumi.
Ayimwi ayimwi mbelele zili musanu azibili, muleelede kupa chimwi mu kkumi chachisuwo chabusu bunante bukandidwe amafuta,
alimwi yomwe mpongo n'enze mbuli chipo chachibi kulichitila kuswanizya lwenu.
Mubuzuba bwatatu bwakubungana, mulelede kupayila bapule beng'ombe balikkumi awumwi, bagutu bobile, abana bambelele balumi balikkumi abane kabalamunyaka omwe, batakwe kampenda awumwi.
Mulelede kuzichita antomwe achipayizyo chabusu achipayizyo chakunywa chabapule beng'ombe, chabagutu, achabana bambelele, kuchita zipayizyo zyiingi mbuzyakalayililwa.
Mulelede kupayila impongo yomwe ndyalumi mbuli chipayizyo chachibi mukuyungizya kuzipayizyo zyakutenta zyalubbe, chipayizyo chabusu, azipayizyo zyazyo chakunywa.
Muleelede kupa eezi mukuyungizya kuchipo chalubbe chakutenta chiyandika chifumo choonse.

Mbuli mbukupandulwidwe aawa, muleelede kupa zipo eezi mazuba woonse, kwamazuba ali musanu aabili aaPobwe, chikkafu cha chipo chachitwa amulilo, bweema bununkilila bwa Jehova. Cheelede kupayilwa mukuyungizya ku chipo chakutenta chalubbe alimwi a chipo chakunywa anchicho.
Mubuzuba bwa musanu aabili muleelede kuyooba akuswaanana kusalala kwakulemeka Jehova, alimwi tamweelede kuyoochita milimu yalubbe mubuzuba oobo.

Alubo mubuzuba bwa michelo  mitanzi, eelyo mwaakupa chipo chazilyo chipya kuli Jehova mu Mviki zya ku Sekelela, muleelede kuyooba aakuswanana kusalala kwakulemeka Jehova, alimwi tamweelede kuyoochita milimu yalubbe mubuzuba oobo.

alimwi yomwe mpongo n'enze kulichitila kuliswanizya lwenu.
Eelyo mwaakupayila banyama aabo batakwe kampenda , aantomwe azipo zyakunywa, ooku kuyooba kuyungizya kuchipo chakutenta chalubbe a chipo chazilyo.'''
