Mozesi wakaambila bantu ba Izilayeli zyoonse eezyo Jehova nzyakamulayilila kuti aambe.
Mozesi wakambula kubazululi bamikowa yabantu ba Izilayeli. Wakati, ''Ezi nzizyo Jehova nzyakalayilila.

Eelyo na muntu wapanga chisyomezyo kuli Jehova, nanka kukonka chikonke chakulyanga achisyomezyo chakulyanga tayelede kuleka majwi ngakaamba. Uyelede kubamba chisyomezyo chakwe kukuchita zyonse zyazwa kumulomo wakwe.
Eelyo mwanakazi munini uchikkala abazyali bakwe kuti wapanga chikonke kuli Jehova akulyaanga lwakwe mwini, kachili mun'anda yawisi,
na wisi wakwe wamvwa chikonke chakwe achisyomezyo nchalyanga lwakwe, kuti takwe nawamba chintu chakumubozya, elyo zyonse zikonke zinoima biyo, azyonse zikonke nzyalyangilila lwakwe zinoyimvwi.
Pesi na wisi wakwe wamukakila aawo naamvwa aatala anzizyo, takwe chazikonke zyakwe na zisyomezyo zyakwe nzyakalyaambila ziyookonzya kwimikila; Jehova uyoomulekela nkaambo wisi wakwe wamukasya.
Kuti wakwatwa amwaalumi musule lyakuchita chikonke na milomo yakwe yaamba chisyomezyo chitaluleme anchicho nchalyaanga,
alimwi mulumi wakwe naamvwa aatala anchicho pesi takwe nchaamba kulinguwe, mpawo zikonke zyakwe zyoonse ziyyoyima, alimwi zisyomezyo nzyaakalyaanga aazyo ziyooyima.
Pesi na ,ulumi wakwe wamwiimika mubuzuba nayoomvwa aatala anchicho, mpawo wamwaya chikonke nchaakachita, kwambuula kusofwede kwamilomo yakwe ankuko nkwakalyaanga, alimwi Jehova uyomwaangununa.
Pesi nichiba chikonke chamukamufu na mwanakazi wakalekwa, weelede kuchita eecho nchasyomezya.
Kuti mwanakazi wachita chikonke mung'anda yamulumi wakwe na wakalyaanga achisyomezyo chili aachikonke,
alimwi mulumi wakwe wamvwa aatala anchicho pesi katakwe nchaamba kulinguwe alimwi tamukasyi, mpawo zyoonse zikonke ziyoyima. Mpawo choonse chikonke nchaakalyaanzya zhiyoyima.
Bakabweza loonse lubono abasungwa , boonse bantu abanyama.

Bakeeta basungwa, lubono, azintu zyoonse nzibakabweza kuli Mozesi, kuli Eliyeza mupayizi, alimwi akuluundu lwabantu baku Izilayeli. Bakeeta eezi kumusaasa kuntandabale yanyika ya Mowabbu, kubbazu lya Jodani afwifwi a Jelikko.
Pesi na mulumi wakwe wazikasya mubuzuba nakazimvwa, mpawo kufumbwa chizwa mumulomo wakwe aatala azikonke na zisyomezyo tazikoyoyima pe. Mulumi wakwe wakazikasya, alimwi Jehova uyomwaangununa.
Chimwi chikonke achisyomezyo chimupenzya, mulumi wakwe ulachichita kuti chiime na mulumi wakwe wachimwaya.

Pesi na mulumi wakwe taamba chintu buzuba abuzuba, nkokwaamba kuti ulasimya zikonke azisyomezyo zyakwe zyoonse zyaanga nzyakachita, alimwi ziyoyima nkaambo takwe nchakaamba pe mubuzuba nakamvwa aatala anzizyo.
Na mulumi wakwe wamwaya chikonke chamwanakazi wakwe nkali wamvwa aatala anzizyo mpawo uyobweza mulandu wakwe.''
Eeyi milayizyo Jehova njakaambila Mozesi kuti ayaambilizye - milayizyo aakati kamwaalumi amukakwe alimwi aakatai kawisi amwana wakwe musimbi aawo nachili musimbi mumpuli yawisi.
Langa, aaba banakazi bakachita kuti bantu baku Izilayeli, kwiinda kunchenjezyo ya Bbalamu, bachite chibi kuli Jehova munkani ya Pewo, eelyo bulwazi nibwakeendelela muluundu lwa Jehova .
Lino mpawo, jaya woonse mwaalumi mubana baniini, alimwi jaya woonse mwanakazi wakaziba mwaalumi mukulala aawe.
Pesi mukalibwezele lwanu nobeni boonse basimbi baniini batanaaziba mwaalumi akulala aawe.

Moonse nimwajaya kufumbwa muntu nikuba kuguma kufumbwa muntu wajayigwa mweelede kukkala aanze aamusaasa kwamazuba aali musanu aabili. Mubuzuba bwatatu a mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili mweelede kulisalazya a nzimwakabweza.
Mweelede kusalazya choonse chizwaato alimwi zyoonse zichitidwe aachikumba chamunyama a boya bwampongo, alimwi zyoonse zichitidwe achisamu.''
Eliyeza mupayizi wakati kulibasilumamba aabo bakali baya kunkondo, ''Ooyu mulawu wakaambwa ooyo Jehova ngwakapa Mozesi:
Ingolide, nsiliva, mukuba, butale, gabba, a liidi,

alimwi zyoonse zizunda mulilo, mweelede kuzibika mumulilo, alimwi chiyoosalala. Mpawo mweelede kusalalzya zintu eezyo amanzi aakusalazya. Kufumbwa chitakonzyi kunjila mumulilo mweelede kuzisalazya amanzi aayo.
Mweelede kusanzya zizwaato zyanu mubuzuba bwa musanu aabili, alimwi mpawo muyoosalala. Musule aboobo muyookonzya kuza mumusaasa wa Izilayeli.''
Mpawo Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi wakati,
''Bala zyoonse zintu eezyo zyakabwezwa, zyoonse bantu abanyama. Iwe a Eliyeza mupayizi alimwi abasilutwe bampuli zyamizimu yamikowa
beeled kwaanzania lubono lwakajanika muzipanzi zyobile. Anzaania aakati kabasilumamba aabo bakiinkide kuyolwana alimwi aluundu loonse.

Mpawo waambe mutelo ngwesipegwe kuzwa kulibasilumamba bakiinkide aanze kuyoolwana. Ooyu mutelo weelede kuba uumwi muli iimwi ayimwi ilimyaanda musanu, ukonzya kuba bantu, n'ombe, madonki, mbelele, na mpongo.
Bweza mutelo ooyu kuzwa kuchisela chabo alimwi wuupe Eliyeza mupayizi mbuli chipo chitapedekezegwe kuli ndime.

Alubo kuzwa kuchisela chabantu ba Izila.yeli, weelede kubweza uumwi kuzwa kulizimwi azimwi zili makkumi musanu - kuzwa kubantu, n'ombe, madonki, mbelele, a mpongo. Pa eezi ku ba Levi aabo babamba chikombelo changu.''
Aboobo Mozesi a Eliyeza mupayizi bakachita mbuboobo Jehova mbakali walayilila Mozesi
Lino lubono lwakachaala kuli oolo lwakali lwabwezwa abasilumamba lwakali mbelele zili 675,000 (zyuulu zili musanu achimwi chili aamyaanda iii musanu ayibili amusanu),
zyuulu makkumi musanu aali aabili azibili zyan'ombe,
zyuulu makkumi musanu achimwi akkumi lyomwe lyamadonki,
alimwi zyuulu makkumi otatweamakkumi obile zyabanakazi bakatanaziba mwaalumi mukulala anguwe.
Ichisela chakabambilidwe basilumamba chakalikweela mbelele zili 337,000,
ooko kwakazwa chipanzi cha Jehova chambelele zyakali 675.
In'ombe zyakali zyuulu zili makkumi otatwe amusanu achimwi ooko kwakazwa chipanzi cha Jehova chakali makkumi musanu aabili azibili.
Madonki akali 30,500 ooko kwakazwa chipanzi cha Jehova chakali makkumi musanu alimwi akamwi.
Bantu bakali zyuulu zili kkumi amusanu achimwi zyabanakazi ooko kwakazwa chipanzi cha Jehova chakali makkumi otatwe azibili.
Mozesi wakabweza mutelo ooyo wakeelede kuba chipo chipedekezegwa kuli Jehova, wakachipa kuli Eliyeza mupayizi, mbuli Jehova mbakalayililide Mozesi.
Mbuli kuchisela chabantu baku Izilayeli eecho Mozesi nchakali wabweza kuzwa kuli basilumamba bakali baya kunkondo -
chisela chaluundu chakali 337,500 chambelele,
zyuulu zili makkumi otatwe amusanu achimwi zya n'ombe,
30,500 madonki,
alimwi zyuulu zili kkumi amusanu achimwi chabanakazi.

Kuzwa kuchisela chabantu baku Izilayeli, Mozesi wakabweza chimwi kuli zimwi azimwi zili makkumi musanu, koonse kubantu a kubanyama. Wakazipa kuba Levi aabo bakali kubamba chikombelo cha Jehova, mbuli Jehova mbakali wamulayilila kuti achite.
Mpawo basilutwe balumamba, balayilizi bakali kwiinda zyuulu alimwi biiminizi bakali kwiinda myaanda, bakaza kuli Mozesi. Bakati kulinguwe,
''Bazike bako babala basilumamba bali munsi lya bulayilizi bwesu, alimwi takwe naba omwe mwaalumi wabulika.
Tweeta chipo cha Jehova, eecho awumwi mwaalumi nchaajana, zintu zya ngolide, maleti alimwi anchoko, nweenwe zya siginet, madikezi, alimwi aminkonde, kuti tulichitile zibombyo kunembo lya Jehova.''
Mozesi a Eliyeza mupayizi bakatambula kuzwa kulimbabo ingolide alimwi zyoonse zintu zyabubezi.
Yoonse ngolide yazipo eezyo nzibakapa kuli Jehova - zipo zyakazwa ku balayilizi  balumamba zyuulu a kubiiminizi ba myaanda - zyakali kulema ma syekeli 16,750.
Awumwi silumamba wakali wabweza lubono, awumwi mwaalumi walibwezela.

Mozesi a Eliyeza mupayizi bakabweza ngolide kuzwa ku balyilizi  ba zyuulu zyalumamba alimwi akubiiminizi ba myaanda. Bakayitola mutente lyakuswaninana mbuli chiyeezyo cha Jehova chabantu baku Izilayeli.
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi wakati,
''Bwedezezya nkondo kubantu ba ku Midiyeni nkaambo kanzibakachita kubantu ba Izilayeli. Musule akuchita oobo, uyoofwa alimwi ukabunganisigwe kubantu bako.''
Aboobo Mozesi wakaambula kubantu. Wakati, ''Bape mwaango wankondo bamwi baalumi bako kuchitila bakakonzye kuyoolwana baku Midiyeni alimwi bakachite chisubulo cha Jehova aalimbabo.
Woonse musyobo wabantu mu Izilayeli yoonse weelede kutumizya chuulu chabasilumamba kunkondo.''

Aboobo kuzwa kuzyuulu zyabaalumi mu Izilayeli, chuulu chomwe kuzwa kuli umwi awumwi musyobo wabantu wakapedekezegwa kuzwa kumikowa ya Izilayeli, izyuulu zilikkumi azibili zyabaalumi bakali aamwaango wankondo.
Eezi ninyika eezyo Jehova nzyakawuma kunembo lya luundu lwa Izilayeli, alimwi masena mabotu kuzivubwa. Iswe, tobalanda bako, tuli alubono lwiingi loko.''
Bakati, ''Na twajana luzyalo kumenso aako, leka nyika eeyi ipegwe kulindiswe, tobaland bako, mbuli buvubi. Utatuvhiti kuti tuzubuke mutala lya Jodani.''

Mpawo Mozesi wakabatuma kukulwana, chuulu kuzwa kuli umwi awumwi musyobo wabantu, aantomwe a Finiyasi mwana mulombe wa Eliyeza mupayizi, alimwi aamwi malembe kuzwa kubusena busalala a myeembo njakajisi yakusibila zilayililo.
Bakalwanisya Midiyeni, mbuli Jehova mbakali walayilila Mozesi. Bakajaya woonse mwaalumi.
Bakajaya baami baku Midiyeni aantomwe aboonse bantu babo bafwide: Evi, Lekemu, Zu, Haa a Leba, bosanwe baami baku Midiyeni. Alubo bakajaya Bbalamu mwana mulombe wa Bbewo, apanga.
Bamataata banu bakachita mbubonya nindakabatuma kuzwa ku Kkadesyi Bbaniya kuyootwela nyika.
Bakayinka ku Mumpata wa Esyikkolu. Bakiibona nyika alimwi bakatyompa myoyo yabantu ba Izilayeli zyakuti bakakaka kunjila munyika eeyo Jehova njakabapa.
Ilumamba lwaku Izilayeli lwakabinga banakazi baku Midiyeni, bana babo, matanga aan'ombe zyabo zyoonse, matanga aambelele zyabo, alimwi alubono lwabo loonse. Bakabweza eezi mbuli mufolo walubono.
Bakatenta woonse madolopo aabo ooko nkubakali kukkala alimwi amisaasa yabo.
Bukali bwa Jehova bwakabuka mubuzuba oobo. Wakakonka alimwi wakati,

'Nchobeni takukwe wa baalumi wakazwa ku Ijipiti, kuzwa kumyaaka ili makkumi obile akuya kunembo, uyobona nyika eeyo njindakakonkezya kuli Abbulahamu, kuli Ayizeki, alimwi a kuli Jakkobbu, nkaambo tebakamaninina mukutobela ndime, kunze kwa
Kkelebbu mwana mulombe wa Jefune mu Kkenizi, alimwi a Josyuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni. Luzutu Kkelebbu a Josyuwa mbibakatobela ndime chakumaninina.'
Bakabweza zyoonse zyakajayigwa a basunge, bantu a banyama.

Bakeeta baange, zyakajayigwa, azintu zyakatumbwa kuli Mozesi, kuli Eliyeza mupayizi, alimwi a kuchisi chabantu ba Izilayeli. Bakeeta eezi kumusasa mumagezi a Mowabbu, kumbali lya Jodani afwifwi a Jelikko.
Mozesi, Eliyeza mupayizi, alimwi boonse bazululi baluundu bakiinka kuyoobaswanizya aanze amusaasa.
Pesi Mozesi wakabanyemena beendelezi balumamba, balayilili ba zyuulu alimwi biiminini bamyaanda, bakazwa kukulwana.
Mozesi wakati kulimbabo, ''Te mwabaleka boonse banakazi kabapona?
Langa, aaba banakazi bakachita kuti bantu baku Izilayeli, kwiinda kunchenjezyo ya Bbalamu, bachite chibi kuli Jehova mukaambo ka Piyo, eelyo bulwazi nibwakeendelela mu luundu lwa Jehova.
Lino mpawo, jaya woonse mwaalumi aakati kabana baniini, alimwi ujaye woonse mwanakazi wakaziba mwaalumi mukulala aawe.
Pesi mulibwezele boonse basimbi baniini batanaziba mwaalumi mukulala aawe.

Moonse nimwajaya kufumbwa muntu na kuguma kufumbwa wajayigwa weelede kukkala kunze kwagunzi kwamazuba ali musanu aabili. Mubuzuba bwatatu alimwi azuba lyamusanu aabili muleelede kulisalazya nobeni alimwi abaange benu.
Muleelede kusalazya choonse chizwaato alimwi a zyoonse zichitidwe achikumba chamunyama aboya bwampongo, alimwi achoonse chichitidwe achisamu.''
Aboobo Mozesi wakasandula kulimbabo wati, ''Na mwachita nzimwaamba, na mwalipa mwaango lwanu kwiinka kunembo lya Jehova kukulwana,
mpawo boonse baalumi bako balipa mwaango beelede kuzubuka  mutala lya Jodani kunembo lya Jehova, kusikila mane akaande basinkondonyina kuzwa kunembo lyakwe
alimwi nyika ikazundwe kunembo lyakwe. Mpawo kuzwa aawo muyooboola. Tamukoyooba amulandu kunembo lya Jehova alimwi akunembo lya Izilayeli. Nyika eeyi iyooba buvubi bwanu kunembo lya Jehova.
Eliyeza mupayizi wakati kuli ba silumamba aabo bakali baya kunkondo, ''Oyu mulawu waambwa ooy Jehova ngwaapa kuli Mozesi:
Ingolide, nsiliva, bbulonzi, butale, gabba, alimwi a lidi,

alimwi zyoonse zikazyania amulilo, muleelede kuchibika kwiinda mumulilo, alimwi chiyoosalala. Mpawo muleelede kusalazya zintu eezyo amanzi aakusalazya. Kufumbwa chitakonzyi kwiinda mumulilo muleelede kuchisalazya amanzi aayo.
Muleelede kusanzya zizwaato zyenu mubuzuba bwamusanu aabili, alimwi mpawo muyoosalala. Musule aboobo muyookonzya kuza mu musasa wa Izilayeli.''
Pesi kuti temachita oobo, langa, unoli wabisizya Jehova. Amube akasimpe kuti chibi chanu chiyomweezya.
Muyake madolopo aampuli zyanu alimwi azyaata zyambelele zyanu; mpawo mukachite mbuli mbumwaamba.''
Lunyungu lya Gadi a lya Lubbeni lwakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi lwati, ''Balanda bako bayoochita mbuli iwe, simalelo wesu, mbaalayilila.
Mpawo Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi wakati,
''Bala zyoonse zintu zyakajanika zyakabwezwa, zyoonse bantu alimwi abanyama. Iwe a Eliyeza mupayizi alimwi abasilutwe bempuli zyamizimu yamikowa
beelede kwaanzania lubono lwakajanika muzimpanzi zyobile. Uzyaanzanie aakati ka basilumamba bakiinkide kukulwana alimwi aluundu loonse.
Bana besu baniini, banakazi besu, alimwi amatanga eesu woonse alubono ayookala ooko ku madolopo a Giledi.
Nikubaboobo, iswe, balanda bako, tuyoozubuka kunembo lya Jehova akuya kuyolwana woomse mwaalumi walipa mwaango wakulwana nkondo, mbuli nduwe, simalelo wesu, mbowaamba.''
Mpawo waambe mutelo ngwesipegwe kuzwa kuli basilumamba bakiinkide kukulwana. Mutelo ooyu weelede kuba womwe muli zili myaanda ili musanu, zikonzya kuba bantu, n'ombe, madonki, mbelele, na mpongo.
Bweza mutelo ooyu kuzwa kuchisela chabo alimwi uwupe Eliyeza mupayizi kuchipo chitakapedekezegwe kulindime.

Alubo kuzwa kuchisela chabantu ba Izilayeli, uleelede kubweza chomwe kuzwa kuli zili makkumi ali musanu - kuzwa ku bantu, n'ombe, madonki, mbelele, alimwi a mpongo. Pa eezi ku ba Levi aabo babamba chikombela changu.''
Aboobo Mozesi a Eliyeza mupayizi bakachita mbuli Jehova mbakali walayilila Mozesi.
Aboobo lunyungu lwa Gadi a lwa Lubbeni lwakasandula alimwi lwakati, ''Mbuli Jehova mbakaamba kulindiswe, balanda bako, eechi nchicho nchetuyoochita.
Tuyoozubuka mutala katulibambilide akulipa mwaango kunembo lya Jehova munyika ya Kkenani, pesi buvubi bwalukono lwesu buyosyaala andiswe okuno kubbazu lya Jodani.''
Lino lubono lwakachaala kuli oolo basilumamba ndubakabweza lwakali 675,000 mbelele,
makkumi musanu aabili ali azibili zyuulu zya n'ombe,
makkumi musanu alimwi ali aachulu cha madonki,
alimwi makkumi otatwe azibili zyuulu banakazi bakatazi mwaalumi mukulala aawe.

Aboobo ku lunyungu lwa Gadi a lwa Lubbeni, alimwi alubo kuchisela chamukowa wa Manase mwana mulombe wa Jozefu, Mozesi wakapa bwaami bwa Sihoni, mwaami wa ba Amoli, alimwi wa Ogu, mwaami wa Bbasyani. Wakapa kulimbabo nyika , alimwi wakaabanisya kulimbabo boonse madolopo aayo amigaano yawo, madolopo anyika ibazyungulukide.
Lunyungu lwa Gadi lwakayakulula Dibboni, Ataloti, Alowa,
Atuloti Syopani, Jaza, Jogubbeha,
Bbeti Nimula, alimwi a Bbeti Halani mbuli madolopo aakkwabilildwe aali azyaata zyembelele.
Ichisela chakabambilwa basilumamba chakali kweela 337,000 mbelele,
ooko kwakazwa chimpanzi cha Jehova cha mbelele zyakali 675.
N'ombe zyakali zyuulu zili makkumi otatwe amusanu achimwi ooko kwakazwa chimpanzi cha Jehova chakali makkumi musanu amakkumi obile aabili.
Lunyungu lwa Lubbeni lwakayakulula Hesyibboni, Eliyele, Kkiliyatayimu,
Nebo, Bbalu Miyoni - mazina aawo akazochinchwa kunembo, alimwi a Sibima. Bakapa mazina aambi kumadolopo aaya ngibakayakulula.
Lunyungu lwa Makke mwana mulombe wa Manase lwakayinka ku Giledi alimwi bakayibweza  kuzwa ku ba Amoli bakali mulinjiyo.
Madonki akali 30,500 ooko kwakazwa chimpanzi cha Jehova chakali makkumi musanu alimwi lili alimwi.
Bantu bakali zyuulu zili kkumi amusani alimwi zyabanakazi ooko kwakazwa chimpanzi cha Jehova chakali makkumi otatwe ababili.
Mozesi wakabweza mutelo ooyo wakeelede kuba chipo chipedekezegwa kuli Jehova. Wakachipa kuli Eliyeza mupayizi, mbuli Jehova mbakalayilila Mozesi.
Mpawo Mozesi wakapa Giledi ku ba Makkili, lunyungu lwa Manase, alimwi bantu bakwe bakakkala oomo.
Ja, walunyungu lwa Manase, wakiinka alimwi wakujata madolopo aabo alimwi wayita kuti Havoti Ja.
Noba wakiinka  alimwi wajata Kkenati amyuunzi yawo, alimwi  wakiita kuti Noba musule lyazina lyakwe.
Kuchisela chabantu baku Izilayeli eecho Moesi nchakali wabweza kuzwa kuli basilumamba bakali baya kunkondo -
chisela chaluundu chakali 337,500 mbelele,
n'ombe zili zyuulu makkumi otatwe amusanu alimwi,
30,500 madonki,
alimwi a banakazi bakali zyuulu kkumi amusanu achimwi.

Kuzwa kuchisela chabantu ba Izilayeli, Mozesi wakabweza chomwe kuli zimwi azimwi zili makkumi musanu, koonse kubantu alimwi akubanyama. Wakazipa ku ba Levi aabo bakali kubamba chikombelo cha Jehova, mbuli Jehova mbakali wamulayilila kuti achite.
Mpawo basilutwe ba basilumamba, balayilizi bakali kwiinda zyuulu, alimwi biiminini bakali kwiinda myaanda, bakaza kuli Mozesi.
Bakati kuli nguwe, ''Balanda bako babala basilumamba bali munsi lya bulayilizi bwesu, alimwi takwe naba womwe mwaalumi wabulika.
Tweeta chipo cha Jehova, eecho awumwi mwaalumi nchaajana, zintu zya ngolide, amaleti alimwi anchoko, nweenwe zya sigineti, madikezi alimwi aminkonde, kuti tulichitile zibombyo kuli Jehova.''
Mozesi a Eliyeza mupayizi bakatambula kuzwa kulimbabo ngolide alimwi azyoonse zintu zyabubezi.
Yoonse ngolide yazipo eezyo nzibakapa kuli Jehova - izipo zyakazwa ku balayilizi ba zyuulu alimwi akubiiminizi ba myaanda - zyakali kulema ma syekeli 16,750.
Awumwi silumamba wakabweza lubono, awumwi mwaalumi mwini.
Mozesi a Eliyeza mupayizi bakabweza ngolide kuzwa ku balayilizi ba zyuulu akubiiminizi ba maanda. Bakayitola mutente lyakuswananina mbuli chiyeezyo chabantu ba Izilayeli.
Lino lunyungu lwa Lubbeni a lwa Gadi lwakali abuvubi bupati lwalubono. Eelyo nibakabona nyika ya Jaza a Giledi, nyika yakali mbotu kuzivuubwa.
Aboobo lunyungu lwa Gadi alwa Lubbeni bakasika akwaambula kuli Mozesi, kuli  Eliyeza mupayizi, akubazuluzi baluundu. Bakati,
''Ooyu mweelwe wamasena ngitwakatwela: Ataloti, Dibboni, Jaza, Nimula, Hesyibboni, Eliyeli, Sebbamu, Nebbo, a Bbiyoni.

Bakeenda kuzwa ku Lamasesi mumweezi mutaanzi, kunyampuka mubuzuba bwa kkumi amusanu bwamweezi mutaanzi. Chifumo nikwakiinda pobwe lya Kwiindilila, bantu ba Izilayeli bakeenda aantanganana kumenso aboonse baku Ijipiti.
Eechi chakachitika kuba Ijipiti kabalikuvwika bana babo bataanzi, aabo Jehova mbakali wajaya aakati kabo, nkaambo alubo wakabika chisubulo kuli baleza babo.
Eezi ninyika eezyo Jehova nzyakawuma kunembo lyaluundu lwa Izilayeli, alimwi masena mabotu kuzivubwa. Iswe, tobalanda bako, tuli azivubwa zyiingi.''
Bakati, ''Na twajana luzyalo mumenso aako, leka nyika eeyi ipegwe kulindiswe, balanda bako, mbuli buvubi. Utatuchiti kuti tuzubuke mutala lya Jodani.''
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakeenda kuzwa ku Lamasesi akuyookkala ku Sakkoti.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Sakkoti akuyokkala ku Etamu, kumamanino enkanda.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Etamu alimwi babweda musule ku Pi Hahiloti, iilangene aa Bbali Zefoni kuli limwi bbazu, ooko nkubakaakukkala kabalangene a Migidoli.
Mozesi wakasandula kulunyungu lwa Gadi a lwa Lubbeni, ''Sena bakulana benu bayoyinka kunkondo nywebo kamuyakide okuno?
Nkaambonzi nimwatyompa myoyo yabantu ba Izilayeli kuzwa kukwiinka munyika eeyo Jehova njakabapa?
Bamataata benu bakachita mbubonya nindakabatuma kuzwa ku Kkadesyi Bbaniya kuyootwela nyika.
Bakayinka mu Mumpata wa Esyikkolu. Bakayibona nyika alimwi bakatyompya myoyo yabantu ba Izilayeli zyakuti bakakaka kunjila munyika eeyo Jehova njakabapa.
Bukali bwa Jehova bwakabuka mubuzuba oobo. wakachita chikonke alimwi wakati,

'Nchobeni takwe mwaalumi wakazwa mu Ijipiti, kuzwa kuminyaka ili makkumi obile kuya kunembo, uyoobona nyika eeyo njindakakonkezya kuli Abbulahamu, kuli Ayizeki, alimwi kuli Jekkobbu nkaambo tebakamaninina mukutobela ndima, kunze kwa
Kkelebbu mwana mulombe wa Jefune mu Kkenizi, alimwi a Josyuwa mwana mulombe wa Nune. Luzutu Kkelebbu a Josyuwa mbibakanditobela chakumaninina.'
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Lwizi lwa Matete alimwi bakukkala munkanda ya Sini.
Bakeenda kuzwa kunkanda ya Sini alimwi bakukkala ku Dofikka.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Dfikka alimwi bakukkala ku Alusyi.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Alusyi alimwi bakukkala ku Lefidimu, ooko kwakatalikujanika manzi kuti bantu banywe.

Aboobo bukali bwa Jehova bwakabuka aatala a Izilayeli. Wakabachita kuti batuntulike akuzyunguluka munkanda kwa myaaka ili makkumi one mane zyalane eelyo lyoonse lyakachita bubi kubusyu bwakwe lyanyonyoonwa.
Langa, wabuka mubusena bwawuso, mbubonya mbuli baalumi biingi mbubabisya, kukuyungizya bukali buyaka bwa Jehova aatala a Izilayeli.
Na wazwa kukumutobela, alubo uyoosiya Izilayeli munkanda alimwi unoli wanyonyoona bantu boonse aaba.''
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Lefidimu alimwi bakukkala kunkanda ya Sinayi.
Bakeenda kuzwa munkanda ya Sinayi alimwi bakukkala ku Kkibbuloti Hatava.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Kkibbuloti Hatava alimwi bakukkala ku Hazeloti.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Hazeloti alimwi bakukkala ku Litima.
Aboobo bakasika aafwifwi a Mozesi alimwi bakati, ''Tuzumizye kuti tuyake mbaya aano zya mbono  zyesu alimwi a madolopo aampuli zyesu.

Nikubaboobo, iswe tobeni tuyolibambila alimwi akulipa mwaango wankondo kuti twiinke abasilumamba ba Izilayeli mane kusikila tukabazulwide kuya mubusena bwabo. Pesi mpuli zyesu ziyokkala mu madolopo aakkwabililidwe nkaambo kabamwi bantu bachikala munyika eeyi.
Tatukoyoobweda kumaanda eesu do mane boonse bantu ba Izilayeli bajane lukono lwabo.
Tatukoyookona nyika aantomwe ambabo kubusena bumwi bwa Jodani, nkaambo lukono lwesu luli kokuno kubbazu lya kujwe lya Jodani.''
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Litima alimwi bakukkala ku Limoni Pelezi.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Limoni Pelezi alimwi bakukkala ku Libuna.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Libuna alimwi bakukkala ku Lisa.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Lisa alimwi bakukkala ku Kkehelata.
Aboobo Mozesi wakabasandula, ''Na mwachita nzimwaamba , na mwalibambila lwenu kwiinka kunembo lya Jehova kunkondo,
mpawo awumwi mwaalumi uulibambilide weelede kuzubuka mutala lya Jodani kunembo lya Jehova, do mane akagwisye basinkondonyina kuzwa kunembo lyakwe
alimwi inyika ikazundwe kunembo lyakwe. Mpawo musule uyoboola. Takwe notakabe amulandu kuli Jehova alimwi akuli Izilayeli. Nyika eeyi iyoba buvubi bwenu kunembo lya Jehova.
Pesi na temwachita oobo, langa, munoli mwabisizya Jehova. Amube akasimpe kuti chibi chenu chiyoomweezya.
Muyake madolopo aampuli zyenu alimwi a zibaya zya mbelele zyenu; mpawo mukachite nzimwakaamba.
''Lunyungu lwa Gadi a Lubbeni lwakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi wakati, ''Balanda bako bayoochita mbuli nduwe, simalelo wesu, mbuwalayilila.
Bana besu, banakazi besu, matanga esu, alimwi a mbono zyesu ziyosyaala omuno mu madolopo a Giliyadi.
Nikubaboobo, iswe, balanda bako, tuyoozubuka kunembo lya Jehova akuya kuyoolwana, woonse mwaalumi uulibambilide kulwana, mbuli nduwe, simalelo wesu, mbuwaamba.''
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Tahati alimwi bakukkala ku Tela.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Tela alimwi bakukkala ku Mitikka.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Mitikka alimwi bakukkala ku Hasyimona.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Hasyimona alimwi bakukkala ku Moseloti.
Aboobo Mozesi wakapa malayilile aatala ambabo kuli Eliyeza mupayizi, kuli Josyuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni, alimwi akubazululi bakuzyalane lyabasikale balunyungu lwabantu ba Izilayeli.

Mozesi wakati kulimbabo, ''Na lunyungu lwa Gadi a lwa Lubbeni lwazubuka mutala aa Jodani andinywe, woonse mwaalumi walipa mwaango wakulwana nkondo kunembo lya Jehova, alimwi na nyika yazundwa kunembo lyanu, mpawo muyobapa nyika ya Giledi mbuli buvubi.
Pesi na tebazubuka andinywe kabalibambilide, mpawo bayojana buvubi bwabo aakati kanu munyika ya Kkenani.''
Aboobo lunyungu lwa Gadi a lwa Lubbeni lwakasandula alimwi bakati, ''Mbuli Jehova mbaakamba kulindiswe, tobalanda bako, eechi nchicho nchetuyoochita.
Tuyoozubuka mutala katulibambilide kunembo lya Jehova kunjila munyika ya Kkenani, pesi buvubi bwalukono lwesu buyoosyaala andiswe mutala eelino lya Jodani.''

A boobo ku lunyungu lwa Gadi a lwa Lubbeni, alimwi alubo kuchisela chamukowa wa Manase mwanan mulombe wa Jozefu, Mozesi wakapa bwaami bwa Sihoni, mwaami wa ba Amoli, alimwi a bwa Ogi, mwaami wa Bbasyani. Wakapa nyika kulimbabo alimwi wakabaabanisya madolopo alimwi amigano yawo, madolopo aanyika ibazyungulukide.
Lunyungu lwa Gadi lwakayakulula Dibboni, Ataloti, Alowe,
Atiloti Syopani, Jeza, Jogubbeya,
Bbeti Nimula, alimwi Bbeti Halani mbuli madolopo aasalazigilwe aali azibaya zya mbelele.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Abbilona alimwi bakukkala ku Eziyoni Gebba.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Eziyoni Gebba alimwi bakukkala munkanda ya Zini ku Kkadesyi.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Kkadesyi alimwi bakukkala ku Chilundu cha Holi, kumamanino anyika ya Edomu.
Lunyungu lwa Lubbeni lwakayakulula Hesyibboni, Eliyale, Kkiliyatayimu,
Nebo, Bbalu Miyoni - mazina aabo akachinchwa, a Sibbima. Bakapa mazina amwi kumadolopo ngibakayakulula.
Lunyungu lwa Makki mwana mulombne wa Manase lwakayinka ku Giledi alimwi bakayibweza kuzwa ku ma Amoli bakali mukati.

Aloni mupayizi wakaya ku Chilundu cha Holi mbuli malayilile a Jehova alimwi wakakufwa nkuko mumunyaka wa makkumi one bantu ba Izilayeli kabali bazwa munyika ya Ijipiti. mumweezi wamusanu, mubuzuba butaanzi bwa mweezi.
Aloni wakali aaminyaka iili mwaanda amakkumi abili ayitatu yakuzyalwa muchiindi nakafwa a Chilundu cha Holi.
Mpawo Mozesi wakapa Giledi ku ma Makili, lunyungu lwa Manase, alimwi bantu bakwe bakakkala nkukooko.
Jayi, lunyungu lwa Manase, wakanjila alimwi wajata madolopo aakwe alimwi akwayita kuti Havoti Jayi.
Nobba wakayinka alimwi wajata Kkenati amyuunzi yayo, alimwi wakachiita kuti Nobba, kutobelezya zina lyakwe.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Chilundu cha Holi alimwi bakukkala ku Zalumona.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Zalumona alimwi bakukkala ku Punoni.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Punoni alimwi bakukkala ku Obboti.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Obboti alimwi bakukkala ku Iye Abbalimu, aamugaano wa Mowabbu.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Iye Abbalimu alimwi bakukkala ku Dibboni Gadi.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Dibboni Gadi alimwi bakukkala ku Alumoni Dibbulatayimu.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Alumoni Dibbulatayimu alimwi bakukkala muzilundu zya Abbalimu, zilangene a Nebo.
Bakeenda kuzwa kuzilundu zya Abbalimu alimwi bakukkala muntandabale zya Mowabbu aambali lya Jodani ku Jelikko.
Bakakkala aambali lya Jodani, kuzwa ku Bbeti Jesyimoti kuyosika ku Abbelu Syitimu muntandabale zya Mowabbu.
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi muntandabale zya Mowabbu aambali lya Jodani ku Jelikko alimwi wakati,
''Ambuula kubantu ba Izilayeli  alimwi uteedi kulimbabo, 'Eelyo mwakuzubuka mutala lya Jodani munyika ya Kkenani,

mpawo muleelede kuyotanda bantu boonse bakkala oomo kunembo lyanu. Muleelede kuyomwaya zintu zyabo zyoonse zibezedwe. Muleelede kuyomwaya zintu zyabo zyoonse zitulidwe alimwi mukanyonyoone zilawo zyabo zyoonse zili kumasena aalikujulu.
Mulelede kubweza buvubi bwanyika alimwi mukakkale mulinjiyo nkambo ndakamupa nyika kuti mukiivube.

Mulelede kukona nyika achisolo, kweendelana kumukowa umwi awumwi. Kumikowa mipati muleelede kupa chaabilo chipati chanyika, alimwi kumikowa miniini muleede kupa chaabilo chiniini chanyika. Kufumbwa ooko chisolo nkuchitakawide kuli uumwi mukowa, nyika eeyo iyooba yawo. Muyokona nyika kwindila kumisyobo yabamawuso banu.

Pesi na temwabatanda kunembo lyanu bakkala munyika eeyo,  mpawo bantu mbimutakazumizye kukkala bazooba mbuli zintu biyo mumeso aanu alimwi akuba mamvwa mumabazu anu. Bayoochita mawumi aanu kuti akayume munyika ooko nkumuyookkala.
Mpawo lino chiyoochitika eecho nchindali kuyanda kuchita kubantu aabo, ndiyochichita alimwi kulindinywe.'''
Aaya ngaakali meendelo abantu ba Izilayeli kabalibazwa  munyika ya Ijipiti ankamu zyabo zya basilumamba aansi aabuzuluzi bwa Mozesi a Aloni.
Mozesi wakalemba aansi masena kuzwa ooko nkubakazwida akooko nkubakali kuya mbuli Jehova mbwakabalayililide. Aay ngaakali meendelo aabo, kuzwa mukweenda kuya mukweenda.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Lamesesi mu mwezi mutaanzi, kuzwa mubuzuba bwa kkumi amusanu bwa mwezi mutaanzi. Chifuma nikwakiinda Pobwe, bantu ba Izilayeli bakeenda aantanganana kumenso aboonse ba Ijipiti.
Eechi chakachitika ku ba Ijipiti kabali kuzikka bana babo bataanzi, aabo Jehova mbakali wajaya aakati kabo, nkaambo alubo wakapa chisubulo kuli baleza babo.

Mugaano wanu uyoonyona kumusanza kuzwa kuchilundu cha Akkalabbimu alimwi ukiinde kawutobelezya munkanda ya Zini. Kuzwa ooko, uyootobelezya kumusanza wa Kkadesyi Bbaniya alimwi ukiinkilile ku Haza Ada akunembo kuyoosika Azimoni.
Kuzwa ooko, mugaano uyoonyona kuzwa ku Azimoni, kuulangide kukalonga ka Ijipiti akukatobela kuya kulwizi.
Bantu ba Izilayeli bakeenda kuzwa ku Lamesesi akuyookkala ku Sakkoti.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Sakkoti akuyookkala ku Etamu, ku mamanino aankanda.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Etamu alimwi bakabweeda musule ku Pi Hahiloti, iili kuli limwi bbazu lilangene a lya Bbalu Zefoni, ooko nkubakakukkala kabalangene a Migidoli.
Mugaano wakumbo uyooba aagolela busasa bwa Lwizi Lupati. Ooyu uyooba mugaano wanu wakumbo.
Mugaano wanu wakunyika uyooyendelela kutobela mukondo ngwesikabike mpa kuzwa ku Lwizi Lupati kusika ku chilundu cha Ho,
mpawo kuzwa kuchilundu cha Ho kuyoosika ku Lebo Hamati, mpawo kuya ku Zedadi.
Mpawo mugaano uyooyinkilila ku Zipuloni alimwi ukagole ku Haza Enani. Ooyu unoli mugaano wanu wa kunyika.
Mpawo bakeenda kuzwa kuli lumwi lubazu lwa Pi Hahiloti alimwi baakwiinda aakati kalwizi kabaya munkanda. Bakeenda lweendo lwamazuba aatatu kuya munkanda ya Etamu alimwi bakukkala ku Mala.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Mala alimwi baakusika ku Elimu. Ku Elimu kwakali tusawu twamanzi tuli kkumi atubili alimwi a misamu yatukunka iili makkumi ali musanu ayibili. Nkuko ooko nkubakayookkala.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Elimu akuyokkala kumbali lya Lwizi lwa Matete.
Mpawo muleelede kubika mpa kumugaano wanu wakujwe kuzwa ku Haza Enani kumusanza wa ku Syepamu.
Mpawo mugaano wakujwe uyookunuka kuzwa ku Syepamu kuyoosika ku Libbila, kubaazu lyakujwe lya Ayini. Mugaano uyooyinkilila kuutobela kubbazu lyakujwe lya lwizi lwa Kkinaleti.
Mpawo mugaano uyooyendelela kumusanza kuutobela Mulonga Jodani kuyoosika kumugaano wakujwe lya Lwizi lwa Mwinyo. Eeyi iyooba nyika yanu, kutobelezya migaano yayo kiizyuungulukide.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Lwizi lwa Matete akuyookkala munkanda ya Chibi.
Bakeenda kuzwa munkanda ya Chibi akuyookkala ku Dofika.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Dofika akuyookkala ku Alusyi.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Alusyi Akuyookkala ku Lefidimu, ooko kwakatajanika manzi abantu kuti banywe.
Mpawo Mozesi wakalayilila bantu ba IZilayeli alimwi wakati, ''Eeyi ninyika njimuyootambula akwaabilwa aachisolo, eeyo Jehova njakalayilila kupa kumikowa iili musanu ayine alimwi akuchisela chamukowa.

Mukowa walunyungu lwa Lubbeni, kuutobelezya kupegwa kwazintu kumukowa wabasikale babo, alimwi mukowa walunyungu lwa Gadi, kuutobelezya kupegwa kwazintu kumukowa wabasikale babo. achisela chamukowa wa Manase bakatambula nyika yabo boonse.
Mikowa yobile achisela chamukowa bakatambula chaabilo chabo chanyika mutala lya Jodani ku Jelikko kulanga kujwe, kuya ku buzwezuba.''
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Lifidimu akuyookkala munkanda ya Sinayi.
Bakeenda kuzwa kunkanda ya Sinayi akuyookkala ku Kkibbuloti Hatava.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Kkibbuloti Hatava akuyookkala ku Hazeloti.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Hazeloti akuyookkala ku Litima.
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi wakati,
''Aaya ngemazina aabantu bayowandaania nyika yalukono lwanu: Eliyeza mupayizi a Josyuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni.
Weelede kusala uumwi silutwe kuzwa kumikowa yoonse kukwaandania nyika yamisyobo yabo.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Litima akuyookkala ku Limoni Pelezi.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Limoni Pelezi akuyookkala ku Libbina.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Libbina akuyookkala ku Lisa.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Lisa akuyookkala ku Kkehelata.
Kuzwa kumukowa wa Bbenjamini, Elidadi mwana mulombe wa Kkisiloni.
Kuzwa kumukowa walunyungu lwa Dani muzuluzi, Bbukki mwana mulombe wa Jogili.
Kuzwa kulunyungu lwa Jozefu, wamukowa alunyungu lwa Manase muzuluzi, Haniyeli mwanamulombe wa Efodi.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Kkehelata alimwi bakukkala ku Chilundu cha Syepa.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Chilundu cha Syepa alimwi bakukkala ku Halada.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Halada alimwi bakukkala ku Makkeloti.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Makkeloti alimwi bakukkala ku Tahati.
Kuzwa kumukowa walunyungu lwa Efulemu muzululi, Kkemuyeli mwana mulombe wa Syeputani.
Kuzwa kumukowa walunyungu lwa Zebbuloni muzululi, Elizafani mwana mulombe wa Panakki.
Kuzwa kumukowa walunyungu lwa Izakka muzululi, Palutiyeli mwanamulombe wa Azani.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Tahati akuyookkala ku Tela.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Tela akuyookkala ku Mitikka.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Mitikka akuyookkala ku Hasyimona.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Hasyimona akuyookkala ku Moseloti.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Moseloti alimwi bakukkala ku Bene Jakani.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Bene Jakani alimwi bakukkala ku Holi Hagidigadi.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Holi Hagidigadi alimwi bakukkala ku Jotibbata.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Jotibbata alimwi bakukkala ku Abbilona.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Abbulona akuyookkala ku Eziyoni Gebba.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Eziyoni Gebba akuyookkala munkanda ya Zini ku Kkadesyi.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Kkadesyi akuyookkala ku Chilundu Ho, kumamanino aanyika ya Edomu.

Aloni mupayizi wakatanta Chilundu Ho mbuli mu malayilile a Jehova alimwi wakafwa nkukooko mumwaaka wa makkumi aane bantu ba Izilayeli kabazwide munyika ya Ijipiti, mumwezi wasanu, mubuzuba butaanzi bwamwezi.
Aloni wakali a 123 minyaka kukomena aawo nakafwa a Chilundu Ho.
Mu Kkenani, mwaami wa Aladi, wakalikukkala munkanda yakumusanza munyika ya Kkenani, wakamvwa akuboola kwabantu ba Izilayeli.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Chilundu Ho akuyookkala ku Zalumona.
Bakeenda kuzwa kualumona akuyookkala ku Punoni.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Punoni akuyookkala ku Obboti.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Obboti akuyookkala ku Iye Abbalimu, amugaano wa Mowabbu.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Iye Abbalimu akuyookkala ku Dibboni Gadi.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Dibboni Gadi akuyookkala ku Alumoni Dibbulatayimu.
Bakeenda kuzwa ku Alumoni Dibbulatayimu akuyookkala muzilundu zya Abbalimu, zilangene a Nebbo.
Bakeenda kuzwa kuzilundu zya Abbalimu akuyookkala muntandabale ya Mowabbu mumbali lya Jodani ku Jelikko.
Bakakkala aambali lya Jodani, kuzwa ku Bbeta Jesyimoti kusika ku Abbelu Syitimu muntandabale zya Mowabbu.
Jehova wakaambuula kuli Mozesi muntandabale zya Mowabbu kumbali lya Jodani ku Jelikko alimwi wakati,
''Ambuula kubantu ba Izilayeli alimwi utedi kulimbabo, 'Eelyo mwakuzubuka Jodani kuyoonjila munyika ya Kkenani,

mpawo muleelede kutanda bantu boonse bakkala munyika eeyo kunembo lyanu. Muleelede kuyoonyonyoona zitoombe zyabo zibezedwe. Muleelede kuyoonyonyoona zintu zyabo zyoonse zichitidwe abutale alimwi mukamwaye masena aabo ali aajulu.
Muleelede kuyoyivuba nyika alimwi mukakkale mulinjiyo, nkaambo ndamupa nyika kuti muyivube.

Muleelede kwiikona nyika achisolo kwiindila kumukowa umwi awumwi. Kumukowa mupati muleelede kuupa chimpanzi chipati chanyika, alimwi kumikowa miniini muleelede kuyipa zimpanzi ziniini zyanyika. Kufumbwa nkuchitakawide chisolo kuli umwi mukowa, nyika eeyo iyooba yabo. Muyookona nyika kwiindila kumisyobo ya bamawuso.

Pesi na temwabatanda bakkala munyika eeyo kunembo lyanu, mpawo bantu mbimutakazumizye kukkala aantomwe ambabo bayooba mbuli zintu mumenso enu amamvwa mumabazu anu.Bayoochita buumi bwanu kuti buyume munyika ooko nkomuyookkala.
Mpawo lino kuyoochitika kuti eecho nchindali kuyanda kuchita kubantu aabo, ndiyochichita kulindinwe alubo.'''
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi wakati,
''Layilila bantu ba Izilayeli alimwi utedi kulimbabo, 'Eelyo mwakunjila munyika ya Kkenani, nyika eeyo iyooba yanu, nyika ya Kkenani a migaano yayo,
mugaano wanu wakumusanza uyoozwida munkanda ya Zini kuutobelezya mugaano wa Edomu. Magolelo aakujwe lyamugaano wakumusanza unoli aamukondo uujinka kumagolelo aakumusanza a Lwizi lwa Mwinyo.

Mugaano wenu uyonyona ku musanza kuzwa ku kalundu ka Akkilabbimi alimwi kweendelela akutobelezya munkanda ya Zini. Kuzwa aawo uyoochijaana ku musanza wa Kkadesyi Bbaniya alimwi kweendelela ku Haza Ada akunembo kusika Azimoni.
Kuzwa aawo, mugaano uyonyona kuzwa ku Azimoni kuulangide ku kalonga ka Ijipiti alimwi akukatobela kusika kulwizi.
Mugaano wa kumbo uyoba aagolela busasa bwa Lwizi Lupati. Oyu uyooba mugaano wenu wakumbo.
Mugaano wenu wa kunyika uyoyendelela kutobela mukondo ngotakabike mpa kuzwa ku Lwizi Lupati kusika ku Chilundu cha Ho,
mpawo kuzwa ku Chilundu cha Ho kusika ku Lebo Hamati, mpawo kuya ku Zedadi.
Mpawo mugaano uyoyendelela kuya ku Zipuloni alimwi ukagole ku Haza Enani. Ooyu uyooba mugaano wenu wa kunyika.
Mpawo muleelede kubika mpa ya mugaano wanu wa kujwe kuzwa ku Haza Enani ku musanza wa ku Syepamu.
Mpawo mugaano wa kujwe uyookunuka kuzwa ku Syepamu kusika Libbila, kulubazu lwa kujwe lwa Ayini. Mugaano uyooyendelela kuutobelezya lubazu lwa kujwe lwa Lwizi lwa Kkinaleti.
Mpawo mugaano uyooendelela ku musanza kuutobela Mulonga Jodani kusika  ku Lwizi lwa Mwinyo. Eeyi iyoba nyika yanu, kutobelezya migaano yayo iizyungulukide.'''
Mpawo Mozesi wakalayilila bantu ba Izilayeli alimwi wakati, ''Eeyi njenyika njimuyotambula aakwabilwa, eeyo Jehova njakalayilila kupa ku mikowa ili musanu ayine alimwi a kuchisela cha mukowa.

Mukowa wa lunyungu lwa Lubbeni, kutobelezya kupegwa kwa zintu kumukowa wa basikale babo, alimwi mukowa wa lunyungu wa Gadi, kutobelezya kupegwa zintu kumukowa wa basikale babo, alimwi a chisela cha mukowa wa Manase bakatambula nyika yabo boonse.
Mikowa yobile a chisela cha mukowa bakatambula chaabilo chabochanyika mutala lya Jodani ku Jelikko kulanga kujwe, kuya ku buzwezuba.''
Jehova wakaambula kuli Mozesi alimwi wakati,
''Aya mazina abaalumi bayowandaania nyika ya lukono lwanu: Eliyeza mupayizi a Josyuwa mwana mulombe wa Nuni.
Weelede kusala uumwi silutwe kuzwa kumikowa yoonse kukwaandania nyika yamisyobo yabo.
Aaya ngemazina a baalumi: Kuzwa kumukowa wa Juda, Kkelebbu mwana mulombe wa Jefune.
Kuzwa kumukowa walunyungu lwa Simiyoni, Syemuyeli mwana mulombe wa Amiludi.
Kuzwa kumukowa wa Bbenjamini, Elidadi mwana mulombe wa Kkisiloni.
Kuzwa kumukowa wa lunyungu lwa Dani muzululi, Bbukki mwana mulombe wa Jogili.
Kuzwa ku lunyungu  lwa Jozefu, kumukowa wa lunyungu lwa Manase muzululi, Haniyeli mwana mulombe wa Efodi.
Kuzwa kumukowa wa lunyungu lwa Ifulemu muzululi, Kkemuweli mwana mulombe wa Syipitani.
Kuzwa kumukowa wa lunyungu lwa Zebbuloni muzululi, Elizafani mwana mulombe wa Panakki.
Kuzwa kumukowa wa lunyungu lwa Isakka muzululi, Palitiyeli mwana mulombe wa Azani.
Kuzwa kumukowa walunyungu lwa Asya muzululi, Ahihudi mwana mulombe wa Syeloni.
Kuzwa kumukowa walunyungu lwa Nafutali muzululi, Pedaheli mwana mulombwe wa Amiludi.''
Jehova wakalayilila baalumi aaba kuti baandanie nyika ya Kkenani akwiipa umwi awumwi wamikowa ya Izilayeli chaabilo chabo.
Jehova wakambula kuli Mozesi mumbuwa zyaku MOwabbu kumbali aJodani kuJelikko alimwi wakati,
''Layilila bantu ba Izilayeli kuti baabe zimwi zimpanzi zyenyika bape baLevi. Beelede kubapa zimwi zisi kuti bakkale mumo aimwi anyika yamweemvwe izyungulukide zisi eezyo.
BaLevi bayooba azisi eezi bakakkale mulinzuzyo. Busena bwamweemvwe bunoli bwangombe zyabo, butanga bwambelele almwi aboonse banyama babo.
Busena bwamwemvwe buzyungulukide zisi nzyotakape baLevi bwelede kuzwida kubulambo bwachisi kusikila kuchuulu chomwe chatukokola kumabbazu oonse.

Weelede kweela zyuulu zibili zyatukokola kuzwa kuchisi nkoya kujwe, alimwi zyuulu zyatukokola nkoya kumusanza, zyuulu zibili zyatukokola koya kumbo, alimwi zyuulu zibili zyatukokol koya kunyika. Oobu busena bwamweemvwe buyooba bwezisi zyabo. Zisi zyabo ziyooba aakati.

Zisi zilimusanu akamwi nnzotakabape baLevi zyeelede zikabele mbuli zisi zyachiyubilo. Welede kupedekezye masena aaya naakti muntu wajaya uumwi wachijila nkuko. Alubo pedekezya zisi zili makkumi aane azibili.
Zisi nzyotakapee baLevi zyelede kuka makkumi aane amusanu azitatu. Weelede kubapa abusena bwamweevwe wazyo.
Mikowa mipati yabantu baIzilayeli, mikowa ileenyika mpati, yeelede kupedekezya zisi zyiingi. Mikowa miniini yeelede kupeda zisi iche. Awumwi mukowa weelede kupeda baLevi mbuli mbuwakaabildwe.''
Mpawo Jehova wakaambila Mozes alimwiwakati,
''Ambuula abantu baIzilayeli alimwi yuteedi kulimbabo, 'Eelyo nimutakazubuke Jodani kuya munyika yaKkenani,
mpawo mweelede kusala zisi zitakabeleke mbul ziyubilo zyenu, busena oobo muntu wajaya uumwi nkatalangilide akonzye kuchijila.
Zisi zyeelede kuba ziyubilo kuzwa kulibababwedezya mpindu, kuchitila kuti similandu atajayigwi nkatanatongwa kunembo aalundu.
Weelede kusala zisi zilimusanu achimwi mbuli sisi zyachiyubilo.
Welede kupeda zisi zitatu mjtaala aaJodani alimwi zitatu munyika yaKkenani. Ziyooba zisi zyakuyubila.

Nkaambo bantu baIzilayeli, nkaambo kabazwakule, nkaambo kakufumbwa uukala aakati kenu, eezi zisi zilimusanu akamwi ziyobeleka mbuli chiyubilo kuchitila kuti kufumbwa uujaya umwi nkatalangilide achije.
Pesi naa simulandu wapuunta sinkondonyina akabulo kabutale, alimwi naa sinkondonyina wafwa, mpawo simulandu nga waba mujayi. Weelede kwanchoonzyo watolwa kulufu.
Naa simulandu watulula sinkondonyina abbwe mmaboko aakwe, lkonzya kujaya sinkondonyina, alimwi naa sinkondonyina wafwa, mpawo simulandu mujayi wanchoonzyo. Weelede kwanchoonzyo watolwa kulufu.
Naa simulandu wapuunta sinkondonyina achilwanisyo chachisamu chikonzya kujaya sinkondonyina, alimwi naa sinkondonyina wafwa mpawo simulandu kwanchoonzyo mujayi. Welede kwanchoonzyo watolwa kulufu.
Sikubwedezezya wabulowa welede kutola simulandu kulufu. Eelyo namuswana, uubwedezezya kubulowa welede kumutola kulufu.
Naa wapuunta uumwi mulunyemo naa kuti wamutulula chimwi, nkayubide kuti amubwatilile, kuchitila kuti sinkondonyina afwe,

naa kuti wamupuuntila aansi mulunyemo amabooko aakwe kuchitila kuti sinkondonyina aafwe, mpawo simulandu wamupuunta welede kwanchoonzyo watolwa kulufu. Mujayi. Sikubweedezezya wabulowa utola sikujaya kulufu eelyo namuswaana.
Pesi naa simulandu champawao watulula sikuumwa nkakutakwe lunyemo luliwo naakuti watulula chiwaalwa chakuuma sikuumwa katalangilide
naakuti wawaala bbwe likonzya kujaya sikuumwa nkatamubwene sikuumwa, mpawo simulandu talisinkondonyina asikuumwa; taalikweezya kumuchisa sikuumwa. Peso eechi nchicho chakuchita naa sikuumwa wafwa.
Muleeyo nzila, luundu lwelede kubeteka akati kasimulandu asikubwedezya zyabulowa mukutobelezya mulawu.

Luundu lweelede kuvuna simulandu kuzwa kunguzu zyasikubwedezya zyabulowa. Luundu lwelede kubwedezya simulandu kuchisi chakuyubila ooko nkwakachijilide lutaanzi. Welede kukkala nkuko koosikila akafwe ooyo mupayizi mupati unooliwo, ooyo wakananikwa amafuta aasalala.
Pesi naa simulandu kufumbwa chiindi wasotoka mugaano wachisi chakuyubila nkwaakachijila,
naakuti sikubwedezya kubulowa wamujana aanze amugaano wachisi chakuyubila kwakwe alimwi naakuti wajaya simulandu, sikubwedezya chabulowa taakwe napegwa mulandu wakumujaya.

Eezi ziba nkaambo kakuti simulandu weelede kukkalila muchisi chakuyubila koosikila mupayizi mupati akafwe. Musule akufwa kwamupayizi mupati, simulandu ulakkonzya kubweeda kunyika ooko nkwalabuvubi bwakwe.
Mbuyoba mulawu wambeta aakati  kenu numazyalani woonse kumasena nkumukkala.
Naa muntu wajaya mweenzinyina, mujayi welede kujiigwa, mbuli mbuzyapegwa bukkamboni. Pesi majwi awumwi mukamboni alike taakonzyi kubika muntu kukufwa.
Alubo, tamweelede kuzumina kusalazigwa akambo kabuumi bwamujayi ulaamulandu wakujaya. Weelede kujayigwa nchobeni.
Tamweelede kuzumina kusalazigwa kulooyo wachijila kuchisi chakuchijila. Tamwelede  muliimwi nzila kumuzumizya kukkala aalubono lwakwe mane do mupayizi mupati akafwe.

Mutasofwaazyi muleyi nzila inyika njimukkala, nkaambo bulowa buzwa mukujaya muntu bulisofwaazya nyika. Takwe kulekelelwa kukonzya kuchitwa kunyika eelyo bulowa nkabuli bwakatilwa aalinjiyo, aanze aakuti abulowa bwayooyo wakabutila.
Nkinkaako tamwelede kubisya nyika momukkala nkaambo ndipona mulinjiyo. Ime, Jehova, ndipona aakati kabantu baIzilayeli.'''

Mpawo bazululi bempuli zyabamawisi kumukowa wa Giledi mwana mulombe wa Makili (wakali mwana mulombe wa Manase), ooyo wakali wamukowa walunyungu lwa Jozefu, wakaza alimwi waambuula kunembo lya Mozesi alimwi kunembo lyabazululi bakali basilutwe bampuli zyabamawisi zyabantu ba Izilayeli.
Bakati, ''Jehova wakakulayilila iwe, simalelo wesu, kupa chaabilo chanyika achisolo kubantu  ba Izilayeli. Wakalayililwa a Jehova kupa chaabilo cha Zilofehadi mukwesu kubana bakwe basimbi.

Pesi na bana bakwe basimbi bakwatwa a baalumi bawumwi musyobo wabantu ba Izilayeli, mpawo chaabilo chabo chanyika chiyoogwisigwa kuzwa kuchaabilo chabamataata eesu. Chiyooyungizigwa ku zyaabilo zyamisyobo eeyo njibanjila mulinjiyo. Muliyeeyo nzila, chiyoogwisigwa kuzwa kuchaabilo nchibakapedwe chalukono.

Muliyeeyo nzila, eelyo munyaka wakulizya mweembo wabantu ba Izilayeli waakusika, mpawo chaabilo chabo chiyooyungizigwa kuchaabilo chamusyobo ooyo ngubanjila mulinguwo. Muliyeeyi nzila, chaabilo chabo chiyoobwezegwa kuzwa kuchaabilo chamusyobo wabamataata eesu.''
Aboobo Mozesi wakapa malayilile kubantu ba Izilayeli, ku jwi lya Jehova. Wakati, ''Eezyo zyakaambwa kumusyobo walunyungu lwa Jozefu zililuleme.
Eezi nzizyo Jehova nzyaalayilila aatala abana basimbi ba Zilofehadi. Waamba kuti, 'Mubaleke bakwatwe kulaabo mbibayeya kuti bali kabotu, pesi beelede bakwatwe mukati kamusyobo wamukowa wawisi.'

Takwe chaabilo chabantu ba Izilayeli cheelede kuchincha kuzwa kuluzubo lumwi kuya kuli lumwi. Umwi awumwi wabantu ba Izilayeli weelede kwiinkilila kunembo a chaabilo chakwe kuzwa kuli bamataata baluzubo lwakwe.

Woonse mwanakazi wabantu ba Izilayeli ooyo uujisi chaabilo kumusyobo wakwe weelede kukwatwa amuntu uzwa kumusyobo wabamawisi. Eezi zili boobu kuchitila kuti woonse wabantu ba Izilayeli akonzye kuba alukono kuzwa kuli bamawisi bakwe.
Takwe chaabilo cheelede kuchinchwa kuzwa kuluumwi kachiya kuluumwi musyobo. Woonse muntu wamusyobo wabantu ba Izilayeli weelede kubamba lukono lwabamataata bakwe.''
Aboobo bana basimbi ba Zelofehadi bakachita mbuli Jehova mbakalayililide Mozesi.
Mala, Tiza, Hogila, Miluka, a Nowa, bana basimbi ba Zelofehadi, bakakwatana aabalunyungu lwa Manase.
Bakakwatana aabamikowa yalunyungu lwa Manase mwana mulombe wa Jozefu. Muli yeyi nzila, lukono lwabo lwakakalilila muluzubo oomo kwakali kuzwa mukowa wawisi.
Aaya malayilile a milawu Jehova njakapa a Mozesi kubantu ba Izilayeli mumagezi a Mowabbu kumbali lya Jodani ku Jelikko.

Chilengano cha Obbadiya. Mwami Jehova wakamba ezi atala a Edomu: Twakambwa makani kuzwa kuli Jehova alimwi mwiminizi wakali watumwa akati kamanyika, kawamba kuti, "Munyampuke! Ngatunyampuke tulangane anguwe tulwane!"
Amulange, ndiyomuchita kuti mukabe bache akati kamanyika; muyonyansigwa kapati.
Kulisumpula kwamyoyo yanu kwamwena lwanu, inywebo nimukkala mung'anzi zyamabwe, mumyunzi yenu milamfu; nimwamba kuti mumyoyo yenu, "Ngwani uyotuselusizya ansi?"
Nikuba kuti mulikulu mbuli lubanze alimwi nikuba zizumbo zyenu zibikidwe kujulu akati kanyenyezi, njomuselusya kuzwa nkukoko, mbwawamba Jehova.

Kuti basikubba basika kulinduwe, kuti bafumpi basika mansiku-mbubuli mbonga ulanyonyoonwa!- tabakonga balakubbida na mubwingi mbuli mbubanoli bayanda? Kuti basikutebula misansai baza kuli nduwe, tabakonga balasiya na nacheya masansa?
Mbuli Isawu mbwakali walangisigwa, buvubi bwakwe bwakasisidwe bwakayolwa!

Bonse balumi mbozuminene abo chizuminano bayokutumina munzila yako kuyosika kumugano.  Balumi bakali alumuno anduwe bakakweena, alimwi bakubukila. Abo balya chinkwa chako bakateya kakole munsi lyako. Takwe kumvwisisisya mulinguwe.
Nsikoyonyonyona na mubuzuba obo, mbwaamba Jehova, balumi bapampu kuzwa ku Edomu alimwi akumvwisisisya kuzwa muchilundu cha Isawu?
Baalumi benu basinguzu bayokanduka, Tamani, kuchitila kuti bonse baalumi benu bakagonkwe kuzwa kuchilundu cha Isawu akujayigwa.
Nkambo kankondo yakachitwa kumupati wako Jakkobbu, muyovumbwa ansoni, alimwi muyogonkwa kwalyoonse.
Mubuzuba niwakimikila kumbali, mubuzuba bazwakule nibakabweza buvubi bwakwe, alimwi beenzu nibakanjila kumilyango yakwe, alimwi bakawala chisolo nkambo ka Jelusalemu, ayebo wakali mbuli umwi wabo.
Pesi utakondelelwi buzuba bwamupati wako, mubuzuba mbuzyatamwendela kabotu, alimwi utakondelelwi aatala abantu ba Juda mubuzuba bwalunyonyooko lwabo; utakali sumpuli mubuzuba bwamapenzi aabo.
Utakanjili kumilyango yabantu bangu mubuzuba bwamafwabi aabo; utakakondelelwi aatala mbubapenga mubuzuba bwamapenzi aabo, utakayoli buvubi bwabo mubuzuba bwamafwabi aabo.
Utayimikili awanzanina migwagwa kuti ugonkelansi basikuloboka, alimwi utakaabi aabo basyede kabapona mubuzuba bwamapenzi.
Nkambo buzuba bwa Jehova bulafwifwi atala amanyika woonse. Mbuli mbomwachita, ziyochitwa mbubo kulindinywe; michito yenu iyomubolela amitwe yenu.
Nkambo mbuli mbomwakanywa achilundu changu chisalala, mbombubo amanyika amwi woonse ayonywa kwalyoonse. Bayonywa bakamene alimwi kuyobanga mbuli takwepe anibakaponede.
Pesi Muchilundu cha Ziyoni kuyoba abo batakasyale alimwi chiyosalala; alimwi ang'anda ya Jakkobbu iyovuba buvubi bwayo.

Ing'anda ya Jakkobbu iyoba mulilo, alimwi ing'anda ya Jozefu iyoba mabangabanga, alimwi ing'anda ya Isawu iyoba zisiko ziyumide, alimwi bayobatenta, mpawo bayobamena. Takukoyoba naba upona kung'anda ya Isawu, nkambo Jehova mbwawamba obu.''

Bantu bazwa ku Negevu bayopenzya chilundu cha Isawu alimwi bantu bakumasena akumusanza bayovuba nyika yaba Filisitiya. Bayovuba nyika ya Efulemu alimwi anyika ya Samaliya, alimwi Bbenjamini uyovuba Giliyadi.
Basale balikunyika zimbi babasilumamba babantu ba Izilayeli bayovuba nyika yaKkenani kuyosika kule mbuli ku Zalefati. Balikumanyika aku Jelusalemu, abo bali mu Sefaladi, bayovuba madolopo aku Negevu.
Basikubavuna bayotanta ku Chilundu cha Ziyoni kuti bakendelezye aatala akalundu kanyika ya Isawu, alimwi abwamwi buyoba ba Jehova.
Pawulu, mwaange waKkilisito Jesu, amukwesu Timoti kuliFilimoni, mweenzuma uyandika kali mubelesima,
akuliAfia muchizi wesu, akuliAkkipasi silumambama, akumbungano iiswaanana mung'anda yenu.
Luzyalo alube kulindiwe aluumuno luzwa kuliLeza Taata wesu aMwami Jesu Kkilisito.
Ndikkala nkelumba Leza wangu aawo mpekwaamba munkombyo zyangu,
nkaambo ndimvwa aatala alusyomo ndojisi kuMwami Jesu aluyando ndojisi kubantu bakwe boonse basalala.
Ndikomba kuti kwaabana kwalusyomo lwako kuboneke akukupa kumvwisisisya kuzwide kwachintu choonse chibotu nchituli aacho muliKkilisito.
Ndakabotelwa akuumbulizigwa  kupati nkaambo kaluyando lwako, akuti myoyo yabantu baLeza basalala yakakatalusigwa anduwe mukwesu.
Lino, nikuba kuti ndijisi boonse busichaamba muliKkilisito bwakukulayilila webo kuchita nzyooyelede kuchita,
pesi akaambo kaluyando, ndikumbila kulinduwe kwiinda kuti, mebo, ndePawulu, munene mpawo lino mwaange waKkilisito.
Mebo ndikukumbila nduwe aatala amwana wangu Onesimasi, ngundakazyala munketani zyangu.
Nkaambo chiindi chamana taakalikwe mulimu kulindiwe, pesi lino wabamilimu koonse kulinduwe akulindime.
Ndamutuma alimwi kulinduwe, uliinguwe moyo wangu.
Ndalikuyandisya kuti ndimubambe afwiifwi andime kuti andikutawukilile nduwe milimu kwachiindi chiniini nkechili munketani nkaambo kamakani mabotu.
Pesi teendalikuyanda kuchita chimwi chintu kanditakwe nzumizyo yako. Teendalikuyanda pe kuti nchito zyako mbotu zizwe kukusinikizigwa pesi kuzwa kububotu bwakuliyandila.
Chimwi chiindi wakaanzanisigwa anduwe kwakayindi, kuchitila kuti azooboololele limwi.
Tachizoobi muzike limbi pe, pesi kwiinda muzike, waba mwana wakwesu muyandisi. Uliyandikene, kapati kulindime, chakwindilila kulinduwe, kunyama amuMwami.
Na kondijisi mbuli similimunyokwe, mutambule mbuli ndime.
Na kali wakakubisizya nikuba ujisi chikweelete chamusyoboonzi, chibike kulindime.
Mebo, ndePawulu, ndalemba eezi akuboko kwangu. Mebo lwangu ndizooliya, kanditadomboli kuti webo abube bwako ulichikwelete kulindime!
Mbombubo , mukwesu, ndigwasye muMwami, bukulusya moyo wangu muliKkilisito.
Akusyoma kwangu aatala akuswiilila kwako, ndakulembela. Ndizi kuti ulachita kwiinda nzindakumbila.
Mundibambile lubo ng'anda yabeenzu, nkaambo ndilangilila kuti kwiindila munkombyo zyenu ndizooba andinywe lubo.
Epafulasi, mwaangema muliKkilisito Jesu, wamujuzya.
AMakko alakwe, aAlisitakkasi aDemasi aLukka, babelesima.
Luzyalo lwaMwami wesu Jesu Kkilisito lube amuuya wenu. Ameni.
Pawulu a Timoti, ibabelesi ba Kkilisito Jesu, ibabelekela bantu ba Leza basalala muli Jesu Kkilisito ibali ku Filipi, abeendelezi bapati abadikoni.
Iluzyalo alumuno luzwa kuli Leza taata wesu a Mwaami Jesu Kkilisito alube kulindinywe.
Ndilumba Leza wangu chindi choonse nindimuyeeya,
lyoonse, munkombyo zyangu zyonse nzindimuchitila, nkekkomba mukubotelwa
nkaambo kakujatisyania andinywe ijwi kuzwa kubuzuba butaanzi kuzosika lino.
Ndilakkutisika anchicho chintu eechi, chakuti oyo iwakatalika mulimo mubotu mulindinywe uyoyinkilila kunembo akuchita kuti akawumane ado kubuzuba bwa Jesu Kkilisito.
Chilikabotu kuti ndilimvwe kabotu aatala andinywe nkaambo muli mumoyo wangu. Moonse mwalijisini andime chaluzyalo nikuba mukujalilwa muntolongo akububotu bwangu amukusisikizigwa kwajwi.
Nkaambo Leza ngukamboni wangu, mukumuyandisya kwangu moonse alwetelelo lwa Kkilisito Jesu.
Aboobo njeyi inkombyo yangu: Kuti luyando lwanu lukomene mubwiingi lyoonse muluzibo akumvwisisisya koonse
kuchitila kuti mubotye eecho chibotu kwindilila, alimwi mukuti mube aabwini akutaba amulandu mane busike buzuba bwa Kkilisito,
nkamuzwide muchelo wabululami ooyo uuza kubulemu akutembawulwa kwa Leza kwindila muli Jesu Kkilisito.
Lino ndiyanda  kuti muzibe, nobakwesu, kuti ezi zyakachitika kulindime zyagwasya loko kukunyampula kwendelela kwajwi.
Nkaambo kaako inketani zyangu muli Kkilisito zyaboneka kuli basikulinda muunzi wa Mwaami akubantu boonse.
Ibakwesu biingi bajana kumvwisisisya mu Mwaami akambo kanketani zyangu, alimwi baba abukozu bwakwambula ijwi kabatayoowi.
Nchonzyo bamwi bakonzya kukambawuka Kkilisito chakutangalilana abulwani na, alimwi bamwi bachita amoyo mubotu.
Ibamusule bachita aluyando, mukuziba kubi ndabikwa aano kuti ndikwabilile ijwi.
Pesi ibakayinda bakambawuka Kkilisito amizeezo yakulipa, pepe mubwini. Bayeeya kuti balandiinda mpuwo aawo nenchisungidwe.
Ani niinzi lino ? Ado kuti munzila zyoonse  nikuba zyajungwe lyakubeja kana lyakasimpe - Kkilisito uli kukkambawukwa, alimwi eezi zilandibotezya. Iyii, alimwi ndiyobotelwa,
nkaambo ndilizi kuti eezi ziyondipa kwangununwa kwinda munkoombyo zyenu alugwasyo lwa Muuya wa Jesu Kkilisito.
Kuzumana kwabulangizi alusyomo lwangu kuti taakwe mbundiyooba amawuse pesi ndiyoba aanguzu, lino mbuli kuti lyoonse, Kkilisito uyomemezegwa mumubili wangu, nikuba mukupona kana kulufu.
Nkaambo kuti ndipone ngu Kkilisito alimwi kufwa nimpindu.
Pesi aanoli kwali kuti ndipona munyama, eechi chaamba mulimu uzyala michelo kuli ndime. Pesi ndilasala chili ? Nsichizi pe.
Nkaambo ndilimanikizigwe azintu zibili. Ikupeekezya kwangu nkuti ndizwe ndikabe aa Kkilisito, kachili nchechintu chibotu loko,
Pesi kupona munyama mukubona kachili chintu chipati kuli ndinywe.
Mukukkutisika acheechi, ndilizi kuti ndiyochala akwinkilila kunembo andinywe, kuchitila kuzwidilila akubotelwa kwenu mulusyomo.
Kuchitila kuti  muli ndime mukajane twaambo twingi tutakamupe kupakala muli Kkilisito Jesu aawo ndakuubola lubo kulindinywe.

Inywe amulyendelezye biyomunzila iyendelana aajwi lya Kkilisito,kuchitila kuti ndaboola kuzomubona kana tendabola,ndikonzye kumvwa aatala andinywe, kuti muliimvwi njii mumuuya omwe, amuzeezo oomwe wakufundumanina lusyomo lyajwi kali antoomwe.
Tamukongwi nikuba muli iili inzila abaabo mbimu suleene aabo. Eechi nchikozyanisyo kuli mbabo ichaamba kumwayika kwabo, pesi kuli ndinywe ndufutuko - alimwi luzwa kuli Leza.
Nkaambo lwakapegwa biyo kuli ndinywe akambo ka Kkilisito kutali kuti biyo musyome mulinguwe, pesi akuti mumufwabile,
kamuli ensandulo lukazyanio ndumwakabona mulindime, alimwi lino mulalumvwa muli ndime.
Ndiyeeya kuti kuli kusungwazigwa muli Kkilisito.Ndiyeyela kuti kulikulyiiba kujanika muluyando lwakwe.Ndiyeyela kuti kuli luswanano lwa Muuya. Ndiyeyela kuti kuli kufwidwa nsoni alwetelelo.
Amuzuzye kubotelwa kwangu mukuba bamwi amumuzeezo omwe, amukuba aluyando lomwe, kamujisini amumuuya, akuba anchito ikozyenie yoomwe.
Tamuchiti chintu mubufubafuba kana mukulipenzya biyo. Pesi mumawuse mwelede kubona bamwi kabali kabotu kwinda ndinywe.
Umwi awumwi wenu atalangi nzyayanda lwakwe mwini biyo,pesi alange alimwi iziyanda bamwi.
Amube acho echi mumizeezo yanu ichakali muli Kkilisito Jesu.
Ooyo, nikuba kuti wakapona muchiimo cha Leza, taakalibona kayelene pe a Leza mbuli chintu chakujatilila kuli nchicho.
Pesi, wakalyubula akulibika muchiimo chamubelesi, aboobo wakazyalwa muchiimo chikozyenie abantu.
Wakalibombya akusyomeka kuyosika kuchiindi chalufu, akukuyofwa achiingano.
Nkinkaako Leza wakamunyampula loko alimwi.
Wakachita obo kuchitila kuti muzina lya Jesu woonse mazwi akatifuke, imazwi aababo balikujulu abali aansi abali munsi aanyika.
Wakachita boobo kuchitila kuti zyoonse indimi zikape bukamboni bwakwamba kuti Jesu Kkilisito ngu Mwaami, kubulemu bwa Leza Taata.
Nkokuti lino, nobayandwa, mbuli mbumulemeka kale lyoonse, kutaamba neliwo biyo pesi kapati nensiwo, amubelekele lufutuko lwanu mukuyowa amukukankama.
Nkaambo ngu Leza uulikubeleka muli ndinywe munzila zibili zyakuyanda akukubelekela kubotelwa kwakwe kubotu.
Muchite zintu zyoonse kamutatongooki nikuba kukazyania.
kuchitila kuti mumaninine tamubi akampenda,ibana ba Leza ibatakwe ibubi mukati kabuzyalane bubbilingene alimwi bulangililwa aansi, oomo mumumvwika mbuli malampi munyika yoonse.
Amujatilile kujwi lya buumi kuchitila kuti mubuzuba bwa Kkilisito ndikalidundiizye kuti tendakachijana biyo kana kubelekela mayabwe.
Pesi nikuba kuti ndilikutilwa mbuli chipo kuchipayililo akuba mulimo walusyomo lwanu, Ndilalumba akubotelwa andinywe moonse.
Muli njiyeeyo inzila yomwe anywebo mweelede kulumba akubotelwa andime.
Pesi ndilasyoma ku Mwaami Jesu kuti atume Timoti kuli ndinywe kufwambana, kuchitila kuti ambebo ndisungwazigwe.
Nkaambo nsikwe uumbi uulimbuli nguwe, uuli aluyando andinywe.
Nkaambo boonse bayanduula nzibayanda beeni, izitaala azya Jesu Kkilisito.
Pesi mulizi bupati bwakwe, nkaambo mbuli mwana uli awisi, nkinkaako wakabeleka andime mujwi.
Aboobo ndisyoma kumutuma kufwamabana awoo ndabona kuti zintu zilandendela byeni.
Pesi ndilasyoma ku Mwaami kuti ambebo lwangu ndize kufwambana.
Pesi ndibona kuti chilelede kutuma Epafuloditasi kuti aboole kulindinywe.  Mukwesu alimwi mubelesima, alimwi ngu silumambaama, alimwi ngusinyenda wenu kali mubelesi wa nzindibula.
Nkaambo wakatyompedwe loko, alimwi wakali wazimba kubandinywe moonse, nkaambo mwakamvwa kuti wakali kuchiswa.
Nkaambo nchoonzyo wakalichisidwe kwakuti wakasifwe. Pesi Leza wakamufwida luzyalo, kakutali nguwe biyo, pesi akulindime, kuchitila kuti nsikabi aamawuse ajulu lyamawuse.
Nkokuti chilimubusungu kwindilide kuti ndimutume, kuchitila kuti mwamubona lubo mubotelwe, alimwi nditawusi loko.
Mumutambule Epafuloditasi mu Mwaami alukondo loonse. Mulemeke bantu balimbuli nguwe.
Nkaambo wakasifwe akaambo kamulimu wa Kkilisito. Wakasanga buumi bwakwe mukundibelekela akuzuzikizya eezyo nzimwakatali kukkonzya kundichitila.
Ichamamanino nobakwesu, amubotelwe mu Mwaami. Nkaambo kuti ndimulembele lubo zintu ezi teensi penzi pe kulindime, alimwi chilandikwabilila.
Amuchenjelele bankala. Amuchenjelele aabo babelesi babisyi. Amuchenjelele zikonzya kumuchelezya.
Nkaambo ndiswe bapalwidwe -- abo bakomba a Muuya wa Leza, alimwi balamantukwe muli Kkilisito Jesu, alimwi tatukwe lusyomo kunyama.
Nikuba boobo, ime lwangu ndakonzya kusyoma kunyama. Kuti kaliwo umwi muntu uyeeya kuti ulasyoma kunyama, ime ndikonzya kusyoma kwindilila.
Ndakapalulwa mubuzuba bwamusanu amazuba ootatwe, kubantu ba Izilayeli, kumusyobo waba Bbenjamini, mu Hibbulu waba Hibbulu; mbuli mukulemukezya mulawo, mufalisi.
Ndakasungwala chenguzu kukupenzya imbungano. Alimwi kumakani aabusalali kumulawu, tendakalikwe mulandu.
Pesi zyoonse zintu zyakali mpindu kulindime, ndazibona kakuli kuswekelwa akambo ka Kkilisito.

Isimpe nkuti, lino ndibona zyoonse mbuli mayabwe nkaambo kabukkolokolo bwaluzibo lwa Kkilisito Jesu Mwaami wangu. Nkaambo kakwe ndisiya zyoonse zintu - alimwi ndazibona mbuli tombe - kuchitila kuti ndijane Kkilisito
akuti ndijanike mulinguwe, akuti nsijaniki aabusalali bwakulichitila kumulawu, pesi kuti eezyo zizwa mukusyoma kuli Kkilisito - ibusalali buzwa kuli Leza uuli lusyomo lwangu.
Nkaambo lino ndiyanda kumuziba anguzu zyakubuka kwakwe abuzolwani bwa koomba kwakwe akubuka mbuli nguwe kulufu lwakwe.
Kuchitila kuti mulimwinzila ndikakonzye kubuka kuzwa kubafu.
Teensi kwaamba kuti ndazijana kale pe zintu eezi, kana kuti ndili libambilide kumaninina, pesi ndilipeda kukujatilila kuli eecho nchindakabwezelwa kuti ndijate a Kkilisito Jesu.
Nobakwesu, nsiyeeyi kuti ime lwangu ndakachijatilila kale pe, Pesi chintu chomwe nchindichita: Nkuluba echo chakiinda akunangatila eecho chili kunembo.
Ndijatisya kuya kunembo kubulangizi nkelamuzeezo wakujana lwiito lwa Leza undinyampula muli Kkilisito Jesu.
Toonse swebo nitwakakkomena, atuyeye boobu. Alimwi kuti chimwi chintu wachiyeeya busiyene, alimwi Leza ulachiyubununa kuli nduwe.
Muliimwi inzila, kumaboneno aachecho nchitwajana, atubambe nguyooyo mweelo wachiimo.
Amundiiye, nobakwesu. Amulangisisye aabo bayobwenda muchikkozyano nchimulacho muli ndiswe.
Mbiingi bayobwenda - aabo mbindikkala nkemwambila atala ambabo, alimwi lino ndikumwambila akulila - mbuli basinkondonyina baachingano cha Kkilisito.
Imagolelo aabo nkunyonyooka. Nkaambo leza wabo mbula bwabo, alimwi bulemu bwabo buli mukuusa kwabo. Bayeeya zintu zyanyika.
Pesi ibukkale bwesu bulikujulu, ooko nkutulindide Mufutuli kuti aboole, i Mwaami Jesu Kkilisito.
Uyosandula mibili yesu myuuba akayichite mibili ilengedwe mbuli wakwe mubili wabulemu, uubumbidwe abupati bwanguzu zyakwe kuti zintu zyoonse zilangane aanguwe.
Nkinkaako, nobakwesu bayandwa mbindizimbide, ikubotelwa kwangu abulemu, muli yeeyi inzila kulizyandamene mu Mwaami, benzuuma nimuyandwa.
Ndili kukkombelezyania a Ewuyodiya, alimwi ndili kukkombelezyania a Sintiki, kuti babe amoyo omwe mu Mwaami.

Iyii, ndili kumukkumbila, nobasindikizyi bangu bakasimpe, kuti mugwasye banakazi aba ibakabeleka andime kukwendelezya ijwi antoomwe a Kkilementi abamwi boonse mbindibeleka aabo, bali amazina aalembedwe mu Bbuku lya Buumi.
Amubotelwe mu Mwaami lyoonse. Alimwi ndinowamba kuti, amubotelwe.
Muchite kuti bubombe bwanu buzibinkane kubantu boonse. Mwaami waaba afwifwi.
Tamubilili chintu nichiba chomwe. Anu kuti, mulizyoonse mukukkomba alimwi akutongooka akupa zilumbyo, izikkumbilo zyenu azizibinkane kuli Leza,
alimwi Lumuuno lwa Leza, lwiinda kumvwisisisya koonse, luyokwabilila myoyo yanu amizeezo yanu muli Kkilisito Jesu.

Kumamanino, nobakwesu, kufumbwa zintu zyanchoonzyo, kufumbwa zintu zyabulemu, kufumbwa zintu zyabwiini, kufumbwa zintu zisalala, kufumbwa zintuzyebeka, kufumbwa zintu zyaambwa kabotu, kuti kakuli chimwi chibotu kwindilila, kuti kakuli chintu chiyanda kulumbayizigwa, amuziyeeye zintu eezi.
Izintu nzimwakiiya, akutambula, akumvwa akubona kulindime, amuchite zintu ezi, alimwi Leza waluumuno uyooba aandinywe.
Ndili akubotelwa kupati mu Mwaami nkaambo lino mwakonzya kubambulula bupya imandiyeyelo anu. Nkasimpe kuti mwali kundiyeeya kale, pesi tekwakali mweenya pe wakuti mundigwasye.
Nsili mukwambila kuti ndilibulide pe. Nkaambo ndakiiya kukkutisika muzyiimo zyoonse.
Ndilibwizi buchete, munzila zyoonse zintu amuzintu zyoonse ndakiiya insiswa yakusaninwa kabotu alimwi akuba enzala, alimwi akuba azyoonse na mukubula.
Ndakonzya kuchita ezi zintu kwinda mulinguwe ooyo undisimya.
Nikuba boobo, mwakachita kabotu kwabilana andime nindali mubuyumuyumu.
Inywe nobantu baku Filipi mulizi loko kuti kumatalikilo aajwi, aawo nindakazwa mu Masedoniya, takwepe imbungano yakandigwasya  munzila yakundipa kana kutambula kunze kwandinywe luzutu amulikke.
Koonse ani ndakali mu Tesalonika, mwakanditumizya twiingi lugwasyo lwazintu nzindakabulide.
Tachaambi kuti ndiyanda kupegwa pe. Pesi, ndiyanda muchelo uuyungizya impuwo yenu.

Ndakatambula zintu zyoonse, kazikkwene kana kwindilila. Ndakakkutisikana. Ndakazitambula kuzwa kuli Epafuloditasi izintu nzimwakamutumizya. Nzintu zinunkilila bunonono, mbusange butambulika akubotelezya kuli Leza.
Leza wangu uyomupa zyoonse nzimubula mbuuli mubuvubi bwakwe amubulemu muli Kkilisito Jesu.
Lino kuli Leza a Taata akube bulemu bwalyoonse alyoonse. Ameni.
Mujuzye boonse bazumina muli Kkilisito Jesu. Balikumujuzya loko bakwesu mbindaabo.
Bamujuzya boonse bazumini ba Leza baluleme bali kokuno, ikapati aabo bempuli ya Siiza.

Iluzyalo lwa Mwaami Jesu Kkilisito lube amyuuya yanu.  Amwi malembe mapati abasikale mumulaka wechi Giliki ayungizya kuti, Ameni, alimwi kuli amwi malembe aansiku muchiGiliki aalabbala eelyo kumamanino kwa lyoonse bbuku lya Chizuminano Chipya. Alimwi kuli malembe mapati miingi aansiku muchi Giliki aatakwe Amen ku mamanino.
Tusimpi twaSolomon mwana mulombe wa Devidi, mwami wa Izilayeli.
Ootu ntusimpi twakuyiisya busongo alulayo, kuyiisya majwi akumvwisya.
Batambula lulayo lwakuchenjela, bululami, ambeta, abololoki.
Ootu ntusimpi atulako twakupa busongo , allimwi kupa luzibo alumvwisyo kuli bachikula.
Basongo ngabaswilile alimwi bakaliyungizya lwiiyo lwabo, alimwi basimaanu balalijanina lulayo,
kumvwisya tusimpi otu, zikozyanyo, alimwi majwi abasongo atulabiko twabo.
Kuyoowa Jehova matalikilo aluzibo - bafubafuba balasampawula busongo alulayo.
Mwana wangu mulombe, swilila milayo yawuso alimwi utasowi mulawo wabaamako;
bayooba mbuli ngala zyamuutwe wako aluwenje lulengelela kuzwa mumukosi wako.
Mwanangu mulombe, kuti basizibi beezya kukubikka muzibi zyabo, ukakaake kubatobela.
Kuti bati, ''Kweza aswebo, atulale tulinde bulowa, atuyube alimwi tujate bantu batakwe kampenda nkabatakwe nchibachitide;
Akube kuti tubamene nkabachipona, mbuli kachimvumwe mbagwisya abo baponi; alimwi tubachite mbuli abo biinka aansi mudindi lyabafu.
Tuyojaya zyoonse zintu ziyandikana;
Waala chisolo chako mulindiswe alimwi tuyooba achikwana chomwe antoomwe''--
mwanangu mulombe, utakeendi ansi munzila ambabo; utakazumizyi kuulu kwako kuti kukalyate mpobalyata;
mawulu aabo alachijanina kububi alimwi alafwambana kukuyotila bulowa.
Nkaambo tazilikabotu kuteya kazamba kunembo akayuni.
Aba bantu balala nkabalindide bulowa bwabo -- balajata buumi bwabo beni.
Aboobo mbuzibede inzila zyabantu boonse babotelwa alupyopyongano; abo bataluleme balajaya abo bajatilila mulinzizyo.
Busongo buliita chakompolola  mumigwagwa, buloongolola mumasambalilo;
amitwe yamadolopo alalompololo ulakwiila anze, kumanjililo adolopo lyamulyango balaamba kuti,
''Mulaleka lili inywebo nobantu nimutazi, mulayandisya masampu, muyokkala na mukusampawula, alimwi muyoleka lili inywebo nobafubafuba, mulaleka lili kusula luzibo?
Amusole kutapatila kwangu; ndiyotulida muuya wangu kuli ndinywe; ndiyochita kuti imajwi angu azibinkane kulinduwe.
Ndakakwiita, alimwi wakakkaka kundiswilila; ndakatandabika ijanza lyangu, pesi taakwe wakandiswilila pe.
Pesi mwakasampawula lulayo lwangu loonseni alimwi temwakaswilila kuchenjezya kwangu.
Ndiyoseka mapenzi eenu, njomusampawula chiindi chakuyoowa kwenu --
eelyo buyoofu bwenu buyooza mbuli guwo alimwi mapenzi enu mbuli kambizi, elyo nimuyopenga akuchiswa mumyoyo yenu.
Mpawo bayondiita, alimwi nsikoyobavwiila pe; bayondiyanduula, pesi tabakoyondijana pe.
Nkambo bakasowa luzibo alimwi tebakaba akuyoowa Jehova pe,
tabakoyotobela milzyo yangu pe, alimwi bakanyansya milawu yangu yoonse.
Bayolya michelo yanzila zyabo, alimwi amichelo yamakanze abo bayozuzikizya.
Nkambo batezi balajayigwa kuti basiya nzila, alimwi kulyiiba kwabatezi kuyobajaya.
Pesi kuloyo ayoyo uswilila kulindime bayokkala kabotu alimwi bayooba aluumuno kaatakwe ntenda.''
Mwanangu mulombe, kuti watambula majwi aangu alimwi ubambe kabotu malayilile angu kulinduwe,
chita matwi ako aswilile kubusongo alimwi bika moyo wako kukumvwisisisya,
Kuti walilila kumvwa akoompolola kumvwisisya,
kuti wayiyanduula uliyanduula mbuli nsiliva alimwi akuyanduula kumvwisisisya mbuli mboyanduula zintu ziyandikana zisisidwe,
mpawo uyomvwisisisya kusya kwa Jehova alimwi uyojana luzibo lwa Leza.
Nkambo Jehova upa busongo; kuzwa kumulomo wakwe kuzwa luzibo akumvwisisisya.
Ulalondweda baluleme luzibo; Nintobo kulibaabo beenda chakololoka;
ulabamba inzila zyambeta alimwi ulalulamika inzila zyabaluleme bakwe.
Mpawo uyomvwisisisya bululami, lubeta abololoki, alimwi anzila zyoonse nzibotu.
Nkaambo busongo buyoozwa mumoyo wako,aaluzibo lwako luyookondelezya muuya wamuntu.
Manu alakubamba; kumvwisisya kuyokubamba.
Ziyokuvuna kuzwa kunzila zyabasizibi , kuzwa kulaabo bambula zintu zipilingene,
Aabo basiya nzila ziluleme alimwi nkabenda munzila zyamudima.
Bakakondwa kuti bachita  zintu zibi alimwi balayandisya kupilingana zyabubi.
Balatobela nzila zinyonyongene, akubelesya kupilingana balasisa nzila zyabo.
Busongo akuyoowa bubi kuzwa kumwanakazi sizibi , kulazwa kumwanakazi upilingene uwamba majwi akoongelezya
. Ulasowa chiyandisyo chakwe chakubucheche akuluba chizuminano cha Leza.
Nkaambo nganda yakwe itola lulufu, alimwi nzila zyabo ziyobatola mukabanda.
Abo boonse batakanjile mulinguwe tabakoyoobola pe alimwi tabakoyosika kunzila zyabuumi.
Aboobo uyoyenda munzila zyabantu babotu alimwi uyotobela zyabantu baluleme.
Nkaambo baluleme bayochita munzi munyika eyo, alimwi abo balondokede bayokkala mulinjiyo.
Pesi basizibi bayonyonyonwa kuzwa kunyika, alimwi abo basyomekede bayonyonyonwa kuzwa mulinchicho.
Mwana wangu muiombe, utakalubi milayo yangu alimwi londola njisyo zyangu mumoyo wako,
Nkaambo kongola kwamazuba akko aminyaka yabuumi bwako; ziyooyeta lumona kulinduwe.
Utakaleki luyando aakusyomeka kukamusiye; zyangilile amwi munsingo yako; zilembe ansi atafula yamoyo wako.
Mpawo uyojana luzyalo aampuwo mbotu kumeso aLeza akubantu.
Syoma muli Jehova amoyo wako woonse alimwi utakasyomi muluzibo lwako;
Muzibye munzila zyako zyoonse alimwi uyochita nzila zyakwe ziluleme.
Utakachenjeli mumeso ako; yowa Jehova alimwi yowa  zibi.
Chiyopa kupona kunyama yako alimwi kukatalusya mubili wako.
Lemeka Jehova ambono zyako alimwi akabalwebalwe wamichelo  yako,
alimwi katula kako kayozula azisinizzyo zyako zinozwide, nkayizwide wayini mupya.
Mwanaangu mulombe, utasampawuli malayilile aJehova alimwi utakatapatili kulikatazya kwakwe,
nkaambo Jehova ulempya abo mbayanda, mbuli ndeende mbwalulamika mwana wakwe mulombe umubotezya.
Oyo ujana busongo ulilongezedwe; kabiyo ulajana kumvwisisisya.
Ezyo zyojana kuzwa mubusongo mbubotu kwiinda nsiliva nzyiyokupa alimwi kujana kwako nkubotu kwiinda ngolida.
Busongo bulayandikana kwinda mabwe abalangala, alimwi atakwe nzyayandisya zyelene
anguwe. Koongola kwakwe kwamazuba akwe mujanza lyakwe lyalulyo; kukuboko kwakwe kwachimwensi mulibuvubi aabulemu.
Inzila zyakwe zyakubotezya alimwi ninzila zyaluumuno.
Musamu wabuumi kulibaabo bajatisya; kulibaabo bajatisya kulinguwe baabotelwa.
Abusongo Jehova wakalenga nyika; akumvwisisisya wakachita julu.
Aluzibo lwakwe manzi malamfu akapambule alimwi moyo akalosya lume.
Omwanangu mulombe, jatisya maanu abusongo, alimwi zitazwi kumenso enu.
Kuyooba buumi kumuuya wako alimwi amunkonde munsingo yako.
Mpawo uyoyenda munzila yako chakutayoowa alimwi kuulu kwako takukoyotyezemuka;
elyo noyolala ansi tokoyoyoowa pe; kulala kwako kunoli kunono.
Utakayoowi mafwabi achibukilambuta na zichitika zyetelezegwa abasizibi, elyo niziyooza,
nkambo Jehova unolikubbazu lyako alimwi uyopewusya kuulu kwako mukuchigwa mutukole.
Utakakkasyi lugwasyo kulibaabo balweelede, elyo nkokuti manguzu aako kukubelesya.
Utakaambi kuli simabambanwa wako, ''Yinka, alimwi ukaboole lubo, alimwi junza ndizokupa.'' kakulikuti mali ulayo mpuwawo.
Utakayeeyi kuchitila mwenzinyokwe bubi -- ooyo ukkala afwifwi alimwi ukusyoma.
Utakazyanyi amuntu utakwe kaambo, uutana kuchitila chibi.
Utabi amunyono kumuntu silunya na kusala imwi yenzila zyakwe.
Nkambo muntu upilingene ulasesemya kuli Jehova, pesi uyeta bantu baluleme mubuzumini bwakwe.
Lutuko lwa Jehova lulimung'anda yamuntu uchita zibi, pesi ulalongezya munzi wabantu baluleme.
Ulasampaula basimasampu, pesi babombede ulabapa luzyalo.
Bantu basongo balakkona bulemu, pesi bafubafuba bayonyampulwa mumawuse ensoni zyabo.
Muswilile, nobana bangu balombe, , kumajwi awuso, alimwi muswililisye nkokuti muzibe kuti kumvwisisisya niinzi.
Ndilikumupa mabambe mabotu; mutaysowi njiisyo zyangu.
Nkechili mwana mulombe wandeende, ndakali kuyandisigwa alimwi ndakali mwana omwe wabaama,
wakandiyiisya alimwi wakati kulindime, ''Chita kuti moyo wako ujatisye kumajwi, bamba milawu angu upone.
Kolijanina busongo akumvwisisisya; utalubi alimwi utasowi majwi amulomo wangu,
utabusowi busongo alimwi uyokutabilila; muyande alimwi uyokutabilila.
Busongo nchintu chibotu loko, aboobo kolijanina busongo alimwi kufumbwa ncholijanina aboobo kolijanina luzibo.
Buyoobika busongo alimwi uyokusumpula; uyokulemeka niwaya mukkakatila.
Uyobikka ingala iyebeka mumutwe wako; uyokupa musini mubotu.''
Swilila, mwana nomulombe, alimwi tambula majwi angu, alimwi uyokupa musini mubotu.'' Swilila, mwanangu nomulombe, alimwi tambula majwi angu, alimwi uyoba aaminyaka myiingi mubuumi bwako.
Ndakuyiisya munzila yabusongo; ndakweenzya mumigwagwa iluleme.
Chiindi noyenda, takwepe utakiime munzila yako alimwi kuti wachijana tokoyolebwa pe.
Jatilila kumilawo, tokachileki chikakusiye; chibambe, nkambo mbobuumi bwako.
Utakatobeli nzila zyabasizibi alimwi koyobweda munzila amwi abaabo bachita zibi.
Koyileka,  uteendi mulinjiyo; bbuda mulinjiyo alimwi ukatole imbi inzila.
Nkambo tabakonzyi kulala kusika bachita zibi alimwi balabbidwa mukutalala mane do bachitya muntu kuti alebwe.
Nkambo balalya chinkwa chabubi alimwi balanywa wayini wabukali.
Pesi nzila zyabantu baluleme ilimbuli mumuni ungwengwemuka chilamunika kutamani mane mosika kumaninina kwazuba kwasika.
Inzila zyabataluleme zili mbuli mudima - tabazizipe zibadadalisya.
Omwana wangu mulombe, swilila kumajwi angu; chenjeka kutwi kwako kuli nzyewamba.
Utakabazumizyi kuzwa kumenso aako; balondole mumoyo wako.
Nkaambo majwi angu mbuumi kuli abo bajana alimwi alaponia kumibili yabo.
Bamba moyo wako kabotu akuubamba chibotu, nkambo kuzwa kulinguwo nkokuzwa buumi.
Sowa majwi apilingene kuzwa kuli nduwe aakusowa zyambo zibi.
Chita menso aako alulame kukulanga kunembo azikowe zyako zilangisisye kunembo lyako.
Chenjela mukwenda kwamawulu aako; mpawo inzila zyako zyoonse zizoba kabotu.
Utaleyi nekuba kululyo na kuchimwensi; kasya kuulu kwako kububi.
Omwana wangu mulombe, swilila kubusongo bwangu; chenjeka kutwi kwako kukumvwisisisya kwangu,
kuchitila kuti ukonzye kusaluula alimwi milomo yako ikwabilile luzibo.
Nkambo milomo yamwanakazi simamambe ilalosya buchi alimwi akwaamba kwakwe mutete mbuli mafuta,
pesi kumamanino ilalula luu mbuli mululwe, ilabosya mbuli chipanga.
Kuulu kwakwe kulinka ansi kulufu; njendelo yakwe ilenda munzila zyoonse kitola mukabanda.
Tabiki mizezo kunzila zyabuumi. Kwenda kwakwe nkwakupampalika; takwepe nkwaya.
Lino, mwana omulombe, swilila ndime; utakandiswilili kuzwa kumajwi amulomo wangu.
Tantamuna nzila zyako kuzwa kuli nguwe alimwi utakasweni afwifwi amulyango wanganda wakwe.
Muleyonzila tokoyopa bamwi pe bulemo bwako na minyaka yabuumi bwako kubantu batakwe buya;
bazwakule tabakoyolya mbono zyako; ezyo nziwakabelekela tazikoyonjila mung'anda yabazwakule.
Kumamanino abuumi uyotongeka elyo nyama amubili wako niziyomana manguzu.
Uyowamba kuti, ''Mbuli mbundakasulide lulayo alimwi moyo wangu wakasampawula luchenjezyo!
Tendakali kuswilila pe bayisyi bangu na kuchenjeka kutwi kwangu kuli baabo bakandilaya.
Ndakali ndanyonyooka loko akkati kambungano yabantu, mukati kwakuswanana kwabantu.''
Konywa manzi kuchikala chako alimwi konywa manzi kuzwa kuchikala chako.
Sa nchibotu na kuti manzi ako akunke alimwi abetulonga mumigwagwa.
Akabe ako olike alimwi atanywigwi abenzu mboli kwenda ambabo.
Kasensa kako kalongezegwe alimwi ukakondwe, sekelela amwanakazi wabulombe bwako,
nkambo ulimbuli mwana wansya naa mwana wanjelele. Inkolo zyakwe zikukkutye chiindi choonse; alwinkilile anembo akukkutisika aluyando lwakwe.
Nkambo kanzi nzyoyelede, mwana wangu mulombe, sa nchibotu kulamwa mwanakazi mwenzu; sa nchibotu kukumbatana inkolo zyamwanakazi muzwakule?
Jehova ulabona zyoonse zichita muntu alimwi ulalanga nzila zyonse nzyachita.
Milimo yasizibi ilamuteya mwini; tukole twasizibi zyakwe zilamucha.
Uyofwa nkambo kakubula lulayo; ulanyonyooka mubufubafuba bwakwe bwiinji.
Mwanaangu na wabika kumbali mali yako mbuli chizuminano chachikwelete chasimabambanwa wako, kuti wapa chisyomezyo chachikwelete chamuntu ngotazi,
eelyo unoli wateya kakole kulinduwe achizuminano chako alimwi wachigwa kumajwi aamulomo wako.
Na wachigwa kumajwi aakko, mwanaangu, chita eechi alimwi ulivune mbuli kuti wawida mukuboko kwasimabambanwa wako; inka alimwi ukalibombye akwaamba mulandu wako kuli simabambanwa wako.
Utapi menso aako ng'onzi azikowe zyako kuguna.
Kolivuna mbuli nsya kuzwa mumaboko aamuvwimi mbuli kayuni kuzwa mukuboko kwasikuteya.
Langa manyenya, iwe nomuntu mukandu, langisisya nzila yakwe alimwi ube musongo.
Takwe mwami, muzululi na mweendelezi,
nikuba boobo ulabamba zilyo zyakwe muchiindi champeyo alimwi muchiindi chakutyola ulabamba eecho nchayanda kulya.
Ulawona kwachiindi chlamfu chili buti, iwe nomuntu mukandu? Uyosinsimuka lili kuzwa kukoona?
''Koona bunini, kuguna kuche, kusukata maboko bunini mukulyookezya'' -
alimwi buchete bwako bulaza mbuli mubbi alimwi kubula mbuli silumamba.
Muntu uuzwide bubi - muntu sizibi - upona akwambuula kwakwe kupilingene,
ulafwinya menso aakwe, ulachita zitondeezyo amawulu aakwe akutondeka aminwe yakwe.
Ubamba bubi akupilingana mumoyo wakwe; choonse chiindi ulapilingania akunyongania.
Akaako mafwabi akwe ayomusikila chakufwambana; mukayindi uyotyolooka akubula kuponesegwa.
Kuli zintu zili musanu achimwi Jehova nzyasulide, zili musanu azibili zisesemya kulinguwe:
menso aamuntu ulisumpula, lulimi lwaamba mabejo, maboko aayo aatila bulowa bwabantu batakwe milandu,
moyo uuyeya makanze aabubi, mawulu afwambana kuchijanina kuchita bubi,
kamboni uyoya mabejo alimwi awoyo ubyala kutamvwanana aakati kabakulana.
Mwanaangu lemeka malayilile awuso alimwi utaleki njisyo yabanyoko.
Choonse chiindi yaangilile mumoyo wako;  yaangilile mumukosi wako.
Aawo noyenda iyokukwabilila; aawo nolala inokulangide, inoyokulanga; alimwi noyobuka iyokuyisya.
Nkaambo malayilile nilampi, alimwi njisyo mumuni; kululamikwa kuza aamalayilile ninzila yabuumi.
Ilakuvuna kuzwa kumwanakazi simamambe, kuzwa kumajwi mateteete aamwanakazi simamambe.
Uteenwi  mumoyo wako akubona bubotu bwakwe alimwi utamulekeli kuti akuche azikowe zyakwe.
Koona aasimamambe kulawulwa amweelwe wachinkwa., pesi mwanakazi wawumwi ulamuula abuumi bwako boonse.
Sa muntu kubona wabweza mulilo akaango kakwe kazitapyide na zyakusama zyakwe?
Sa muntu kubona weenda aatala lyamakala aapya nkatapyide ndyato zyakwe?
Mbabede muntu wiinkila mwanakazi wasimayakilanwa wakwe; umujata takayolekwi kubetekwa.
Bantu tabasampawuli mubbi na wabba kukukutya ziyandisyo zyakwe aawo nali enzala.
Pesi na wajatwa uyoliya musanu atubili eecho nchabba; welede kugwisya akupa zyoonse zidula zili mung'anda yakwe.
Ooyo uchita mamambe takwe maanu; ooyo ubuchita ulijaya lwakwe mwini.
Zilonda abweeme nzizyo nzyayelede alimwi lusampawuko lwakwe talukoyogwisigwa.
Nkaambo bbivwe lichita muntu kuti abe abukkali; takoyotondeezya luzyalo lwakwe aawo nayoyanda kubwedezya.
Takoyotambula luliyo alimwi takonzyi kuulwa, nikuba wamupa zipo zyiingi.
Mwanangu, bamba majwi angu ubambe amilazyo yangu mulinduwe.
Bamba milazyo yangu upone, bamba mulawo wangu mbuli chintu chiyandisi.
Zyaange ezi atunwe twako; zilembe amoyo wako.
Wambila busongo kuti, ''Ulimuchizangu,'' akwiita luzibo kuti mwenzinyokwe,
ikuti ulibambe kumwanakazi simamambi, mwanakazi utalilemeki, ulamajwi mabotu.
Ndakali langide ampulunguzyo yang'anda yang'anda yangu.
Ndakalanga ibantu batakwe maanu, akkati kabana balombe ndakabona muupya mufubafuba.
Ooyo mwana mulombe wakaselezya anzila iyakuchooko yakwe akululama ng'anda yakwe.
Kwakali mumutungazuba, igolezya, mudindi chamansiku amudima.
