Kufumbwa uulaya uwmi, kunembo uyojana buuya bwiingi kuzwa kuliwoyo ufula alulimi lwakwe.
Kufumbwa uchenga wisi abanyina akwaamba kuti, ''Eecho techibi pe,'' mweenzinyina wasikujaya.
Muntu muuny ulabusyalupyopyongano, pesi ooyo usyoma muliJehova uyozwidilila.
Umwi ooyo usyoma mumoyo wakwe mufubafuba , pesi kufumbwa weenda mubusongo uyooligwisya muntenda.
Ooyo upa bachete takwe nchayobula, pesi kufumbwa ujala menso akwe kulimbabo uyotambula lutuko lwiingi.
Basizibi nibanyampuka, bantu balalisisa; pesi nibafwa, baluleme balayungizigwa.
Muntu ooyo uutambula luchenjezyo lwiingi pesi kayumya mukosi wakwe uyootyoka muchiindi chakutapona.
Eelyo bantu baluleme nibavula, bantu balakondwa, pesi sizibi na waba mweendelezi, bantu balalila.
Kulooyo uyanda busongo uchita wisi kuti abotelwe, pesi ooyo uyenda abasikuula ulanyonyoona mbono.
Mwami ulabusya nyika mulubeta, pesi ooyo ulya makulo ulayiwisizya aansi.
Mwaalumi uwongelekezya mwenzinyina uteya buzamba mumawulu aakwe.
Muchibi chamuntu sizibi ulachigwa, pesi muntu uululeme uliimba chalukondo.
Muntu uululeme ulizi bachete mbubeelede kubetekwa; pesi sizibi tamvwisyi aaya makani.
Basikasampusampu babusya nkondo, pesi aabo bachenjede balalesya bukkali .
Eelyo muntu musonga nakazyaniya amufubafuba, ulabwanta akuseka, alimwi takukoyooba luumuno pe.
Muntyu ulaanyota abulowa ulasula muntu ooyo uululeme alimwi ulayanduula buumi bwayooyo uululeme.
Bafubafuba balatondeezya kunyema, pesi basongo balalijata akuumuna.
Naa kuti mweendelezi waswilizya mabejo, basilutwe bakwe boonse bala babi.
Muntu muchete asikumupenzya tabasiyene pe, nkambo Jehova upa mumuni kumeso aabo boonse.
Naa kuti mwaami wabeteka bachete chakasimpe, chuuno chakwe chabwaami chiyima kwakutamani.
Musako akutapatila zyeeta busongo, pesi mwana uulekelelwa biyo uyoowusisya banyina.
Eelyo bantu babi nibali munguzu,  chibi chilavula, pesi bantu basalala bayoobona kuwa kwabaabo basizibi.
kolaya mwana wako alimwi uyookupa kulyookezya; uyooyeta kubotelwa mubuumi bwako.
Awo kutakwe zilengano bantu tabayoowi kuchita zitondwa, pesi ooyo uulondola mulawo ulilongezegedwe.
Mulanda takoyoolayigwa amajwi, nikuba kuti ulamwisisisya, alimwi takwe sikuvuwa pe.
Ulimubwena na mwaalumi uufwambaana kunyema? Kulibulangilizi bwiingi kumufubafuba kwiinda kulinguwe.
Kulooyo uulela bubi mulanda wakwe kuzwa kubwanikenike, kumamanino kuyoba mapenzi.
Muntu uunyemede ulabusya bukkali alimwi muntu sinkazi ulachita milandu mwiingi.
Kulisumpula kwamuntu kulamuselezya aansi, pesi ooyo ulaamoyo wakuliselezya uyoopegwa bulemu.
Oooyo upona aamuntu uubba ylasula buumi bwakwe mwini; ulamvwa lutuko alimwi taakwe zyawamba.
Kuyowa kwamwaalumikulateyesya kakkole, pesi ooyo usyoma muliJehova ulakkala kabotu.
Mbiingi bayandawula busyu bwamweendelezi, pesi kuliJehova nkwajana lubeta lubotu.
Mwaalumi utaluleme ulasesemya bantu baluleme, pesi ooyo uleenzila ziluleme uwololokede kubantu basizibi.
Majwi a Agaa mwana mulombe wa Jaka - mutolo. Oyu mwalumi wakambila Itiyeli Ukali:
Nchobeni ndimbuli munyama kwinda naba muntu alimwi tandimvwisisisyi mbuli muntu.
Tandiyide busongo pe; nekuba luzibo lwamusalali.

Ngwani wakiinkide kujulu aakuboola ansi? Ngwani wakaswanizya luwo mumanza akwe? Ngwani wakajata manzi muchikobela? Ngwani wakimika masimpilo woonse enyika? Ngwani zina, alimwi ngwani zina lyamwanakwe mulombe? Nchobeni ulizi!
Lyoonse ijwi lya Leza lilasyomeka; nintibi kulibaabo bachijila kuli nguwe.
Utakayungizyi kumajwi akwe, uyokutapatila, alimwi uyochitwa mubeji.
Zintu zibile zyekumbila kulinduwe, utakanditantamuki nketana kufwa:
Tola zintu zyabiyo aabubeji kule andime. Kandipebuchete nabuvubi, ndipe chikulya biyo nchenjanda.
Nkambo ndazintu zyiingi, ndakonzya kukaka aakuti, ''Ngwani Jehova?'' nakuti ndaba muchete, ndakonzya kubba akutapenzya izina lyaLeza.
Utakalengeli kaambo muzike kuli simalelo wakwe, na uyokutuka alimwi uyojana lutuko.
Kuli mazyalane atuka mawisi alimwi akuta longezya manyina.
Kuli mazyalane aluleme kumenso abo beni, alimwi tabanasanzigwa kuzwa kubusofwazi bwabo.
Kuli mazyalane alamenso ajulidwe, alimwi nkowe zyabo zilalijula!
Kuli mazyalane abomeeno abo mapanga abachibanda babo ntufulo, aboobo balalya bantu bachete kuzya kunyika alimwi balamaninsya batengwana.
Munsyundu ujisi bana basimbi bobile: "Paa akupa"balalila. Kuli zintu zitatu zitakutikani, zyoone zitatedi, ''Kwakkwana'':
Siyoli; nonsundi; inyika itakuti manzi; alimwi mulilo utatedi, "Kwakkwana!''
Linso lisampawula wisi akutalemeka banyina uyovwipulwa abachikwangala bakukalonga akaligwe amakkubi.
Kuli zintu zitatu zindibotezya loko, izine nsezimvwisisisyi;
Inzila yachuungwe mujulu; anzila yanzoka abbwe; anzila yabwato akati kalwizi; alimwi anzila yamwalumi ulobwenda amwanakazi.
Mbubonya mbibede inzila yamwanakazi simamambe; ulalya akulichumuna mulomo wakwe alimwi wati, ''Takwe nchindachita chibi.''
Munsi kazintu zitatu zikankamya nyika; alimwi munsi kazintu zyoone nzyikachilwa:
muzike kuti wabamwami; mufubafuba nakuti wakkuta chakulya,
mwanakazi usampawulwa nakuti wakwatwa; alimwi mulanda musimbi wabweza busena kwanamalelo wakwe
Zintu zyone zyenyika zinini alimwi zilabusongo loko:
tunjenene ntuuka tutakwe manguzu, pesi tulabamba kulya kwato muchiindi chamiinza;
bachibila tesi banyama bayosya pe, psesi bachita maanda abo mumabwe.
Nsozi tazikwe mwami, pesi zyoonse zilenda mumindando.
Mbuli dyolo, ulakonzya kumujata amanza ako obile, pesi ulajanika mumaanda abaami.
Kuli zintu zyotatwe zigambwa mukwenda kwazyo alimwi zyoone zigambya mukwenda kwazyo:
mulavu, ulisimide kwinda bamwi banyama bamusokwe - tatandwi awumwi munyama nyina;
muzingi ulikankayizya, mpongo; alimwi amwami ulabasilumamba balimunsi lyakwe.
Nakuti wakali mufubafuba, nkolinyampula nomwini, na kulisumpula - bika kuboko kwako amulomo wako.
Mbuli kukopwa kwamalili kuchita mafuta alimwi mbuli mpemo yamuntu mbigwisya mukkota kuti yalichisa, mbukubede kubusya bukali kweta nkondo.
Majwi aamwana Lemuyeli - mulazyo banyika ngubakamuyeezya.
Niinzi, mwanaangu mulombe?
Utaabili ngizu zyako kumwanakazi, naa nzila yako kulibaabo banyonyona baami.
Teensi zyabaami pe, Lemuwelu, teensi zyabaami kuti banywe wayini, na bazuluzi kubeenkosya yachakunywa chileenguzu,
nkaambo eelyo nibanywa balaluba eezyo nzibakakonka, akunyonganiya zyeelelo zyaboonse basalidwe.
Pa chakunywa chileenguzu kumuntu baabo bapengede mumoyo.
Ulanywa alimwi ulaluba buchete bwakwe alimwi takoyoyeya mafwabi aakwe.
Ambwiida aabo bataambuuli, kumilandu yaboonse balikupengana.
Ambuula akubeteka mumweele ooyo ulikabotuakumwayisya milandu yabafwaba abayanda lugwasyo.
Ngwani ukonzya kujana mwanakazi mubotu? Bulemu bwakwe bulikule kwiinda nchoko.
Moyo wamulumaakwe ulasyomena mulinguwe alimwi takoyooba muchete pe.
Uchita zintu zibotu mulinguwe alimwi kutakwe bubi mumazuba aakupona kwakwe.
Ulasaluula nchinda aboya, alimwi ulazibeleka anguzu zyamaboko aakwe.
Ulimbuli maato abasambazi; uleeta chakulya chakwe kuzwa kule.
Ulanyampuka nikuba mansiku akupachakulya kumulumaakwe alimwi ulaboniya milimu kubalanda bakwe bachanakazi.
Ulayeeya muunda akuwula; amuchelo wamaboko aakwe ulabyala masaansa.
Ulalizwaatila nguzu akuchita maboko aakwe asime.
Ulabona zimuchitila mpindu mbotu, boonse busiku bulamfu lampi lyakwe talizimi.
Ulabika kuboko kwakwe kumusako, alimwi ulalujata luchinda lwakoosa.
Ulatambika kuboko kwakwe kubantu bachete; ulasikila akuboko kwakwe kubantu bafwaba.
Tayoowi mpeyo kunganda yakwe, nkaambo nganda yakwe yoonse isamide zizwaato sisalala.
Ulachita zyakuvumba bulo bwakwe, alimwi ulazwaata zyamweemvwe.
Mulumi wakwe ulizibinkene aamulyango, eelyo nakala abazululi banyika.
Ulachita zisamo zyeebeka akuzyuuzya, alimwi kubasambazi ulapa inkumba.
Ulisamikidwe manguzu aabulemu, alimwi ulaseka kuzyiindi ziza.
Ulajula mulomo wakwe abusongo alimwi mulawu waluzyalo ulaalulimi lwakwe.
Ulalangilizya nzila zyabenganda yakwe akutalya chinkwa chabutolo.
Bana bakwe balanyampuka akumwiita kuti ulilongezegedwe, alimwi mulumaakwe ulamutembawula, nkati
''Banakazi biingi bakachita zibotu, pesi ulabiinda boonse,''
Kubotezya kuleena, kubota nkwabiyo, pesi mwanakazi uuyowa Jehova, uyotembawulwa .
Mumupe michelo yamaboko aakwe alimwi milimu yakwe ikatembawulwe mumilyango yakwe.
Ulilongezezegwe muntu uteendi mukulayililwa abasizibi, nakuti kwimikila munzila abasimuchita zibi, nakukkala mubbwalo lyabasikaniakoniako.
Pesi chiyandisyo chakwe chili mumulawo wa Jehova, alimwi aamulawu wakwe ulayeesesya chakukomba mansiku asikati.
Uyooba mbuli musamu wakabyalwa kumbali atulonga twamanzi ooyo uuzyala michelo yawo muchindi chawo, uuli amatu atapusami, zyoonse nzyachita zilazwidilila.
Basizibi teensi mbubabede pe, pesi bali mbuli tombe lipupululwa aluuwo.
Nkiinkako basizibi tabakoyoyima pe mulubeta, nikuba basizibi mulubunga lwabasalali.
Nkaambo Jehova nguusala nzila yabasalali, pesi nzila yabasizibi iyofwidilila.
Nkaambonzi manyika naali mumasukusyo, alimwi nkaamboonzi bantu nibachita mabambe atazwidilili?
Baami banyika babweza chiimo chabo antomwe alimwi baleli balajatana antoomwe mukukazyania a Jehova akukazyania amutumwa wakwe, kabati,
''Atudeluule tugwisye zisamo nzibatubikilide alimwi tusowe nketani zyabo.''
Ooyo uukkede mumajulu ulabanyanyaala; Mwami ulabanyansya.
Mpawo uyowambuula ambabo mubukali bwakwe akubakolongania mubukali bwakwe, kati,
''Imebo lwangu ndakananika Mwami wangu aa Ziyoni, chilundu changu chisalala.''
Ndiyo wambilizya malayilile aa Jehova. Wakandaambila kuti, ''Uli mwana wangu mulombe. Oobuno buzuba ndilaba wuso.
Ndikumbile, alimwi ndiyokupa manyika kuti ibe lukono lwako aminkome yanyika kuti iibe buvubi bwako.
Uyozityola akabulo mbuli nkomesi yasikubumba uyozipwaya zikabe tumpanzi tumpanzi.
Nkiinkako linobu, inywebo nobaami, amuchenjezegwe, amuzyotololwe, nobatongi banyika.
Amukombe Jehova mukuyoowa alimwi mubotelwe akuteketa.
Mumyoonte mwana mulombe nakuti amunyemene, alimwi muyoofwa munzila aawo bukali bwakwe kabupya kwachiindi chinini biyo. Balongezegedwe biyeni aabo bayanduula kuyuba muli nguwe.
Intembawuzyo ya Deviti, aawo nakachija kuzwa kuli Abbusalomu mwana wakwe mulombe. Jehova, mbangana basinkondoma! Mbiingi bandisandukila.
Mbiingi baambuula ataala andime, ''Taakwe lugwasyo ndwejene kuzwa kuli Leza.'' Sela.
Pesi webo, Jehova, ulintobo indizyungulukide, busalali bwangu, alimwi ooyo uundinyampula mutwe.
Ndinyampula ijwi lyangu kuli Jehova, alimwi ulandisandula kuzwa kuchilundu chakwe chisalala. Selah
Ndakalala ansi ndawona; ndakasinsimuka, nkaambo Jehova wakandikwabilila.
Nsikooyowa luundu lwabantu aabo balibunga kundilwana kumabazu woonse.
Nyampuka, Jehova! Ndivune, Leza wangu! Nkaambo uyowuma boonse basinkondoma kumweebo; uyotyola meno aabasizibi.
Lufutuko luzwa kuli Jehova. Ndalomba zilongezyo zyako zibe aabantu bako. Sela
Nywebo nobantu, kuyosika lili kamusanduula bulemu bwangu kubuchita mawuse? Kuyooba lili kamuyanda eecho chitakwe muulo akuyanduula manwa? Selaha
Pesi muzibe kuti Jehova walibikila basyomeka kumbali. Jehova uyoomvwa aawo ndaakumwita.
Teketa mukuyoowa, pesi utabisyi! Yeeya chakukomba mumoyo wako aabulo bwako chumuunizi. Selaha
Pedekezya zipayilo zyabusalali alimwi ubike kusyoma kwako kuli Jehova.
Biingi bati, ''Ngwani utakatutondeezye kufumbwa chintu chibotu?'' Jehova, nyampula mumuni wabusyu bwako aali ndiswe.
Wapa moyo wangu kubotelwa kwiingi kwinda bamwi aawo zilyo zyabo awayini mpya nizyavulisya.
Chili muluumuno kuti ndiyolala aansi akoona, kuchitila nduwe olikke, Jehova, ndichite ndifutuke alimwi nkekwabilikene.
Swiilizya kawuulo kalwiito lwangu, Mwami wangu a Leza wangu, nkambo nkuuli nduwe nkundikomba.
Jehova, chifumofumo umvwa kulila kwangu; chifumofumo ndileeta butongawusi bwangu kuli nduwe nkelindila chabulangizi.
Nchoonzyo toli Leza uusala bubi pe; bantu babisyi tabakoyooba beenzu bako pe.
Basinkazi tabakoyoyiima pe mpobede; ulabasula boonse bachita zitalomene.
Uyojaya babeji; Jehova taduundizyi bantu bali alupyopyongano alweeno.
Pesi mbuli ndime, akaambo kakusyomeka kwachizuminano chako chipati, ndiyooza mung'anda yako; mukuyubunwidwa ndiyokotama chabulemu kunembo lyachikombelo chako chisalala.
O Mwami, ndizulwide mubusalali bwako akambo kabasinkondoma; chita kuti nzila yako ilulame kulindime.
Nkaambo takukwe simpe pe mumilomo yabo; buntu bwabo bwamukati buli aalunyonyoono; igulyukumena lyabo nkabanda kaaseme; balabbodola manwa alulimi lwabo.
Babbusye bubi, Leza; kubamba kwabo akube kuwa kwabo! Babinge bazwe akambo kakwendeelela kwazisampuzi zyabo, nkaambo bakusandukila.
Pesi ndakumbila kuti boonse bayubila muli nduwe babotelwe; baleke bawompolole muluyando nkaambo ulabakwabilila; baleke babotelwe muli nduwe, aabo bayanda zina lyako.
Nkaambo uyolongezya basalali, Jehova; uyoba zyungulusya lusalo mbuli ntobo.
Koba aaluse kulindime, Jehova, nkaambo ndilimuteteete; ndiponie, Jehova, nkaambo afuwa angu alakankama.
Muuya wangu wapenzegwe kapati. Pesi webo, Jehova - eezi ziyooyinkilila kusika lili?
Boola, Jehova! ndiwununune. Ndivune akaambo kabusyomesi bwachikonke chako!
Nkaambo mulufu takwe noyooyeegwa pe. MuSyiyoli ngwani utakakulumbe.
Ndakatala akulila kwangu. Mansiku woonse ndilazuzya bulo bwangu amisozi; amisozi yangu ndilazuzya musego wangu.
Menso angu alabundulata abuusu; alalengwaana akaambo kabasinkondoma bangu.
Kamuzwa kulindime, moonse nimuchita bubi; nkaambo Jehova wamvwa musabilo wakulila kwangu.
Jehova wamvwa lukumbilo lwaluse lwangu; Jehova watambula nkombyo yangu.
Boonse basinkondoma bangu bayoowugwa nsoni akupenzegwa kapati. Bayooboola alimwi bayoonyanisigwa kufwambana.
Lwiimbo Deviti ndwakafula, oolo ndwakayimbila Jehova, akambo kamajwi aa Kkusyi mu Bbenjamayiti. Jehova Leza wangu, ndiyuba mulinduwe! Kondivuna kuli boonse banditandania, alimwi undiyokole.
Kwataba boobo, balandijata balandikwamuna mbuli mulavu mbwachita, kundizapula mutumpanzi tumpanzi kakutakwe sikundeeta mubulondozi.
Jehova Leza wangu, na ndachita eechi, alimwi maboko aangu kajiisi mulandu -
na ndamuchitila bubi oyo wakkede muluumuno andime, na kumuchija sinkondoma, kataakwe kaambo, awo mvwa majwi aangu.
Mpawo leka sinkondoma andilyide buumi bwangu mane andiinde; ngalyatuuke buumi bwangu mulusuko. Selah
Nyampuka, Jehova, mubunyeme bwako; nyampuka uyimikizyanie abunyemi bwaba sinkondoma; buka nkambo kangu uchite twambo tululeme ooto ntuwakalayilila akambo kabo.
Inyika zyakubunganina; bweza alimwi lomwe biyo busena bwako mbubwelede kubiinda.
Jehova kozibeteka nyika; kondilwanina, Jehova, nkaambo ndiluleme alimwi nsikwe mulandu, Nosumpukide Kwiinda.
Inchito imbi zyabasizibi ngazisike kumamanino, pesi kobayaka bantu baluleme, Leza uululeme, iwebo nuusenuuka myoyo amiyeeyo.
Intobo yangu izwa kuli Leza, ooyo uvuna baluleme mumyoyo.
Leza mubetesi ululeme, ngu Leza ubanyemenede babi buzuba abuzuba.
Kuti muntu kateempwi, Leza ulanona ipanga lyakwe alimwi ulabaambila buta bwakwe inkondo.
Ubambila kubelesya zilwanisyo kumulwana; uchita kuti tuvwi twakwe tube tuvwi twandabi zyamulilo.
Koyeeya oyo uuminsi busofwazi, uuminta mabambe aabunyonyooni, uutumbuka bubeji buchisa.
Uusya dindi, linikide, mpawo awide mudindi ndyaasya.
Mabambe aakwe abunyoonyoni abweda kumutwe wakwe, nkaambo buluti bwakwe buboola amutwe wakwe mwini.
Ndiyoopa kulumba kuli Jehova nkaambo kakubeteka kwakwe kululeme; ndiyoyimba ntembawuzyo kuli Jehova Uusumpukide Kwinda.
Kuzwa mumubono wabana abavwanda wakasimya intembawuzyo nkaambo kabasinkondonyokwe, kuchitila kuti uwumuzye boonse basinkondo asikukkwichizya.
Nendilanga kujulu kumajulu aako, aayo aakachitwa aminwe yako, mwezi anyenyezi, nziwakabika muzilawo,
mbupatiinzi buli mubantu nobayeeya, niinzi loko nchobapeda?
Asi wakabaselezya bunini loko munsi lyabantu bakujulu alimwi wakabasamika bulemu abulumbu.
Umuchita kuti ayendelezye aatala azintu zyoonse munsi amawulu aakwe:
mbelele zyoonse abasune, alimwi nibaba banyama bamusokwe,
bayuni ba,mujulu, alimwi abaswi bamulwizi, zyoonse zyiinda mukukunka kwalwizi.
Jehova Mwami wesu, mbweebesiinzi oobu bwezina lyako munyika yoonse!
Kuli silutwe wabasikwiimba. Intembawuzyo ya Deviti. Ndiyoopa kulumba kuli Jehova amoyo wangu woonse; ndiyolumba nchito zyoonse zigambya.
Ndiyokondwa akubotelwa muli nduwe; Nosumpukide Kwindilila!
Basinkondoma nibachebuka, balalebwa akuloba kunembo lyako.
Nkaambo wakwabilila kaambo kangu kaluleme; ukkala aachuno chako chabwami, mubetesi ululeme!
Wakakkalalila manyika; wabanyonyoona babi; walobya zina lyabo mane kukabe kutamani.
Sinkondo wakakkolomoka mbuuli matongo awo niwakazunda magunzi aabo. Kuyeyegwa kwabo koonse kwaloba.
Pesi Jehova mpali lyoonse; wakasimya bwami bwakwe mubululami.
Uyoyibeteka nyika abululami, alimwi uyobakosweda milandu yamanyika mukweelanisya kubotu.
Alimwi Jehova uyoba mpembezyo yabaabo badyamizigwa impembezyo muzyiindi zyamakatazyo.
Aabo balizi izina lyako balasyoma muli nduwe, nkaambo webo Jehova, tobatantamuki pe abo bakuyanduula.
Amwiimbe ntembawuzyo kuli Jehova, oowo weendelezya mu Ziyoni; Mwambile manyika eezyo nzyakachita.
Nkaambo Leza ulakkwichizya kutila kwabulowa ulayeeya; talubi pe kulila kwabaabo badyamizigwa.
Kondifwida luzyalo, Jehova bona mbendi dyamizigwa abaabo bandisula, webo nokonzya kundikwempa kumilyango yalufu.
Ikaaka, nindakonzya kwambilizya intembawuzyo yako yoonse. Mumilyango yamwana mwanakazi wa Ziyoni ndiyobotelwa mulufutuko lwako!
Inyika zyabbila ansi mudindi nzilyakasya; mawulu aabo ajatwa mukansabwe nkbakasisa.
Jehova walipa kuzibinkana; wabeteka; imubi weneenwa enchito zyakwe mwini. Selah
Ibabi balabwedezegwa akutolwa kuGehena, zyoonse nyika ziluba Leza.
Nkaambo babulide tabakoyolubwa pe lyoonse, nibuba bulangizi bwabaabo badyamizigwa tabukoyoopuuntwa pe kwalyoonse.
Buka, Jehova; utazumizyi muntu kuti akuzunde; inyika ngazibetekwe kunembo lyako.
Bayoosye, Jehova; inyika ngazizibe kuti nga mbantu biyo. Selah
Nkaamboonzi, Jehova, niwimina kule? Nkaamboonzi nolisisa muzyiindi zyamakataazyo?
Nkaambo kakasampusampu kabo, bantu babi, batandaabo badyamizigwa; pesi inche, ibabi ngabachigwe abumpelenge bwabo mbubachita.
Nkaambo imuntu mubi ulalidundilizya loko aziyandisyo zyamoyo wakwe; ulongezya balyabi, kutukila Jehova.

Lwiimbo lwakutansya. Jehova, akaambo kaDeviti koyeya mafwabi aakwe woonse.
Koyeya mbajakonkezya kuliJehova, mbuli mbutwakasomezya kuli Singuzu Umwi waJakkobbu.
Wakati, ''Nsikoyonjila mung'anda yangu na kulala abulo bwangu,
Nsikoyoopa ng'onzi kumenso angu na kulyookezya kuzikowe zyangu
kusikila ndajanina Jehova busena, chipayililo chaSinguzu Umwi waJakkobbu.''
Bona, twakazimvwa muEfulata; twakazijana munkuba zyaJaa.
Tuyoyinka muchikombelo chaJehova; tuyolumbayizya kumawulu akwe.
Buka, Jehova, kunika yako yakulwanina, iwe abbokesi lyanguzu zyako!
Bapayizi bako ngabasamikwe anguzu zyabululami; nkabela basyomekede bako boompololo chalukondo.
Kuchitila mulanda wako Deviti, utafutalili mwami wako unanikidwe.
Jehova wakakonka chikonke kuli Deviti, chikonke chini nchatakatyole pe: ''Ndiyobika umwi walunyungu lwako achuuno chako.
Na bana bako balombe babamba chizuminano changu amilawu njesikabayisye, bana babo alubo bayookkala aachuuno chako chabwami kwalyoonse.''
Nchobeni Jehova wasala Zayoni, wamuyandisya kuchuuno chakwe.
''Eechinchilyookezezyo changu lyoonse. Ndiyopona aano nkaambo ndamuyandisya.
Ndiyomulongezya kapati azijatika. Ndiyokutya bachete bakwe achinkwa.
Ndiyozwatika bapayiza bakwe alufutuko, basyomekede bakwe bayowompololisya chakukondwa.
Ooko ndiyochita kuti lwija lukasyuukile Deviti akubika lampi lyamunanike.
Ndiyovumba basinkondonyina bakwe abweeme, pesi alinguwe musini wakwe uyobekema.''
Kuli mbuli mafuta mabotu amutwe kaatikila aachilezu - chilezu chaAloni, alimwi mpawo kaatikila kunsi kumupimpito wazisamo zyakwe.
Kuli mbuli lume lwaHemoni luwida azzilundu zyaZayoni. Nkaambo ooko Jehova wakalayilila chilongezyo - buumi butamani.
Amunyampule maboko enu kubusena busalalaalimwi mulongezye Jehova.
Inche Jehova amulongezye kuzwa kuZayoni, ooyo wakalenga julu anyika.
Amutembawule Jehova. Amutembawule zina lyaJehova. Amumutembawule, nywebo nobalanda baJehova,
nywebo nimwiima mung'anda yaJehova, mumbuwa zyang'anda yaLeza.
Amutembawule Jehova, nkaambo mubotu; amwiimbe ntembawuzyo kuzina lyakwe, nkaambo nkubotu kuchita oobo.
Nkaambo Jehova mwini walisalila Jakkobbu, Izilayeli mbulilubono lwakwe.
Ndilizi kuti Jehova mupati, kuti Leza wesu uli aatala lyabaleza boonse.
Kufumbwa nchaayanda Jehova, ulachichita kujulu, aansi, mulwizi amulikoonse kunika kwalwizi.
Uleeta mayoba kuzwa kule, kuchita tulabi kusindikizya mvula akweeta luuwo kuzwa mung'anda yakwe yakubambila.
Wakajaya bana bataanzi baIjipiti, boonse babantu ababanyama.
Wakatuma zitondeezyo azigambyo aakati kako, Ijipiti, kulwisyania aFalo abalanda bakwe boonse.
Wakalwisya manyika miingi akujaya baami bapati,
Sihoni mwami wamaAmoli aOgu mwami waBbasyani amaami aaKkenani.
Wakatupa nyika yabo mbuli lukono, lukono kuli Izilayeli bantu bakwe.
Izina lyako, Jehova, ndyalyoonse; impuwo yako, Jehova, njalyoonse kumazyalani woonse.
Nkaambo Jehova ulalwanina bantu bakwe alimwi uli aaluzyalo kubalanda bakwe.
Zitoombe zyamanyika ninsiliva angolide, milimu yamaanza abantu.
Zitoombe eezyo zili aamilomo pesi tazyambuuli; zili aamenso , pesi taziboni;
zili aamatwi, pesi tazimvwi; nikuba muuya mumilomo yazyo.
Aabo bachibumba bali mbuli nzizyo, mbuli kubede boonse basyoma mulinzizyo.
Nolunyungu lwaIzilayeli, mulongezye Jehova; lunyungu lwaAloni, mulongezye Jehova.
Lunyungu lwaLevi, mulongezye Jehova; nywebo nimulemeka Jehova, mulongezye Jehova.
Alongezegwe Jehova muZayoni, ooyo uukkala muJelusalemu. Tembawula Jehova.
Mupe kuluma kuliJehova, nkaambo mubotu. (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
Mupe kulumba kuliLeza wabaleza. (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
Mupe kulumba kuMwami wabami; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
kulinguwe alike uuchita zigambyo zipati; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
kulinguwe kwiinda mubusongo wakalenga majulu; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
kulinguwe wakayala nyika aatala lyamanzi; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
kulinguwe wakachita mimuni mipati; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
kulinguwe wakapa zuba kuti lyeendelezye sikati, (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
mweezi anyenyeezi kuti zyeendelezye mansiku; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
kulinguwe wakajaya bana bataanzi baIjipiti; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
akugwisya Izilayeli kuzwa aakati kabo; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
ajaanzi lisimide akuboko kusumpwidwe; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
kulinguwe wakaandula Lwizi lwaMatete; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
akuchita Izilayeli kuti ayinde aakati kalo; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
pesi wakabbizya Falo ampi yakwe muLwizi lwaMatete; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
kulinguwe wakazulwida bantu bakwe kwiinda munkanda; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
kulinguwe wakajaya bami bapati; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
kulinguwe wakajaya bami bali aampuwo; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
Sihoni mwami wamaAmoli (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
aOgu mwami waBbasyani; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
kulinguwe wakapa nyika yabo mbuli lukono; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
lukono kuliIzilayeli mulanda wakwe; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
kulinguwe wakatuyeeya akutugwasya mukufwisigwa nsoni kwesu; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
kulinguwe watupa kuzunda aatala lyabasinkondoma besu; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
uupa kulya kuzintu zyoonse zipona; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
Mupe kulumba kuliLeza wakujulu; (Kusyomeka kwachizuminano chakwe takumani.)
Kumbali lyamilonga yaBbabbiloni twakakkala aansi alimwi twakalila nitwakayeeya aatala aZayoni.
Ooko kumizimbwa iili aakati kayo twakaanzika tuntimbwa twesu.
Ooko bakatwaangide nkubakayanda nyimbo kuzwa kulindiswe, alimwi aabo bakatupenzya nkubakayanda kuti tubotelwe, nkabati, ''Mutwiimbile lumwi lwanyimbo zyaZayoni.''
Tulayimba buti lwiimbo lwaJehova munyika yabweenzu?
Na ndaluba nduwe, Jelusalemu, kuboko kwangu kwalulyo ngakulube kukonzya kwalo.
Leka lulimi lwangu lunamatile kubwaasa bwamulomo wangu nindayokuluba, na tendayandisya Jelusalemu kwiinda kubotelwa kwangu kupati.
Koyeeya, Jehova, eezyo baEdomu nzibakachita mubuzuba Jelusalemu nakawa. Bakati, ''Ngumwayigwe, ngumwayigwe kusikila kuntslisyo zyawo.''
Mwana musimbi waBbabbiloni, uyoonyonyoonwa kufwambaana - ikaka ngalongezegwe muntu nikuba ani uukubozezya mpindu kuli eezyo nziwakachita kulindiswe.
Ikaka ngakalongezegwe, nikuba ani ubweza akuwaalila bana bako aamwaala.
Intembawuzyo yaDeviti. Ndiyokupa kulumba amoyo wangu woonse; kunembo lyabaleza ndiyolkwiimbila ntembawuzyo.

Ndiyokotama munsi lyang'anda yako iisalala alimwi ndiyoopa kulumba kuzina lyako nkaambo kachizuminano chako chisyomekede akusyomeka kwako. Wakachita ijwi lyako alimwi azina lyako kuba aachiyandisyo chiindilide kwiinda zintu zyoonse.
Mubuzuba mbundakakwiita wakandivwiila, wakandiimika alimwi wakasimya muuya wangu.
Boonse bvaami banyika bayokiupa kulumba, Jehova, nkabeka bayoomvwa majwi aazwa mumulomo wako.
Nchobeni bayoyimba nchito zyaJehova nkaambo bulemu bwaJehova mbupati.
Nkabela nikuba Jehova uli kulamfu pesi ulabamba bali aansi, pesi balisumpula ubazi chakulaale.
Nikuba ndayenda aakati kantenda uyobamba buumi bwangu; uyosikila kuboko kwako kukulwana alunyemo basinkondoma, alimwi kuboko kwako kwalulyo kuyondivuna.
Jehova uli aandime kusikila kumamanino; chizuminano chako, Jehova, chisyomekede chilapona kwalyoonse. Utabasiyi aabo mbuwakalenga amanza aako.
Ulizi nindikkala aansi anindinyampuka; ulamvwisisisya mayeeyelo angu kuzwa kule.
Ulalanga nzila yangu akulala kwangu; ulizizi nzila zyangu zyoonse.
Kakutanaaba jwi aalulimi lwangu, ulizi chakumaninina, Jehova.
Kusule lyangu akunembo lyangu ulindizyungulukide alimwi ulabika kuboko kwako aalindime.
Luzibo lulibobu ndwiingi loko kulindime, lulimujulu loko alimwi nsikonzyi kulusikila.
Nkuukuli nkwenga ndaya kuzwa kumuuya wako? Nkokuli nkwenga ndachijila kuzwa kubuliwo bwako?
Na ndstanta kuya kumajulu uliko; na ndachita bulo Mukabanda, bona uliko.
Na ndawuluka amababa aachifumo akuyokkalal kubunike bwazimpanzizyalwizi,
nikuba ooko kuboko kwako kuyondizulwida, kuboko kwako kwachilisyo kuyojatilila aalindime.
Na ndakati, ''Nchobeni mudima uyondivumba, imumuni uyoba mansiku kuindime,''
nikuba mudima tukoyosiya kulinduwe. Mansiku ayomunika mbuli sikati, nkaambo mudima amumuni zyobile zilakozyania.
Wakalenga zyamukati kangu; wakandilenga mukazyalilo kabaama.
Ndiyokulumbayizya nkaambo ndakalengwa ziyoosya alimwi zigambya. Milimu yako ilagambya. Muuy awangu ulizizi kabotu eezi.
Mafuwa aangu takasisidwe kuzwa kulinduwe nindakalengwa munsikswa, nindakalengwa bunonoono mubunike bwanyika.
Wakalindibwene mukati kakazyalilo; mazuba woonse ngepedwe akalembwa mubbuku lyako nekuba lyakasanguna kalitanaachitika.
Mibotu biyeni miyeyo yako kulindime, Leza! Myiingi biyeni kukwiiswanizya!
Na ndeezya kwibala myiingi kwiinda muse mumweelwe. Nebuka, ndichili anduwe.
Niinga kojaya basizibi luzutu, Leza; muzwe kulindime inywe nobaalumi basinkondo.
Balakupandukila akuchita chalweeno, basinkondonyokwe balaamba chakubeja.
Nsibasuli na, Jehova, aabo bakusula? Nsibaseki na aabo bakubukila akukulwanisya?
Ndabasua chakumaninina, bakaba basinkondoma.
Ndilingule, Leza, uzibe moyo wangu; ndisunke uzibe miyeyo yangu.
Langa na kulinzila mbi mulindime, ndizulwide kunzila iitamani.
Bala bamba bubi mumyoyo yabo; balabusya nkondo mazuba woonse.
Malimi aabo alachisa mbuli nzoka; buyoka bwanzoka buli mumilomo yabo. Selah
Kondibamba kuzwa kumaanza amubi, Jehova; kondikwabilila kuzwa kubaalumi basinkondo aabo babamba kundijaya.
Balisumpula bandibikkila chilebyo; bakwazamuna kansabwe; bandibikkila kakkole. Selah
Ndakati kuli Jehova, ''Nduwe Leza wangu; koswilila nendikwilila luzyalo.''
Jehova, Mwami, Nduwe singuzu ulakonzya kundivuna; ulakwabilila mutwe wangu mumazuba ankondo.
Jehova, utabapi kupekeezya kwabo basizibi; utalekeli kwenda kwabo kuti kuzwidilile. Selah
Aabo bandizyungulukide bamuusya mitwe yabo, kwamba kwamilomo yabo nkubi kubavumbe.
Amuleke malasya mapya abawide, bawale mumulilo, mumulindi utagooli, tabakoyobuka limbi.
Akube kuti bantu bandimi batabi alukwabililo aanyika; ibubi ngabumuvwime mwaalumi sinkondo bamuume afwe.
Ndilizi kuti Jehova ulatonga chakubayanda bapenzegwa alimwi akuti ulabapa lwaangunuko babula.
Nchobeni baluleme bayoopa kulumba kuzina lyako; ibaluleme bayopoena mubuliwo bwako.
Buzuba abuzuba ndiyokulongezya; Ndiyotembawula zina lyako kwalyonse alyonse. Jehova Mupati alimwi alimwi uyotembawulwa kapati; bupati bwakwe tabuyanduuliki.
Jehova, bika chikwabililo aatala aamulomo wangu; kwabilila kkoma lyamilomo yangu.
Utalekeli moyo wangu uyandisye chimwi chibi na kujanikana munchito mbi abaalumi bayeya bubi. Ikaka nsikalyi chimwi chazilyo zyabo.
Izyalane lyomwe liyotembawula inchito zyako kusika kulilimbi alimwi liyowambilizya zichito zyako zipati.
Ndiyoyeeya chakukondwa aatala abulemu bwako busalala alimwi aatala abubotu bwanchito zyako.
Muntu musalali nganduume; bunooli mbuuya kulindime. Ngandilaye; kunoli mbuli mafuta aamutwe wangu; ikaka mutwe wangu utakakaki kwaatambula. Pesi nkombyo yangu ili aatala anchito mbi.
Bazululi babo bayowaalilwa ansi kuzwa aajulu lyatulundu; bayomvwa kuti majwi aangu mabotu.
Bayowamba kuti, ''Mbuli umwi nalima akutyoloola nyika, mbubo mafuwa eesu mbamwayigwa kumulomo waSyiyoli.''
Bayowaambuula aatala anguzu zyamilimo yako iyebeka, alimwi ndiyowambilizya bupati bwako.
Bayowambilizya bubotu bwako bwindilide, alimwi bayoyiimba aatala abusalali bwako.
Jehova uli abuuya aluzyalo, tofwambani kunyema alimwi mupati mukwima njiii muluyando.
Jehova mubotu kuli boonse; nsoni zyakwe zibombede zili atala amilimo yakwe yoonseni.
Bonse mbiwachita balakulumba, Jehova; basyomekede bako bayokulongezya.
Bayowambula atala abusalali bwa bwami bwako, alimwi bayowamba atala anguzu zyako.
Bayozibisya kubantu boonse inchito zya Leza impati akusalalisya kwabubotu bwa bwami bwakwe.
Bwami bwako mbwami bwalyoonse, alimwi bakutobela bayobotelwa kumazyalane wonse.
Jehova ulagwasya boonse bawa akubabusya aboonse bagogomene.
Menso aboonse alindide nduwe; ulabapa kulya kwabo kuchindi cheelede.
Ujula ijanza lyako akukkutisika ziyandisyo zyazintu zipona zyoonse.
Jehova musalali munzila zyakwe zyonse alimwi ulasyomeka muli zyonse nzyachita.
Jehova uli aafwifwi kuli boonse bamwiita kuli nguwe, kuli boonse bamwiita kuli nguwe chakumusyoma.
Ulazuzikizya chiyandisyo chabaabo bamulemeka; ulamvwa kulila kwabo alimwi ulabafutula.
Jehova ulabalingula boonse aabo bamuyanda, pesi uyojaya boonse basizibi.
Mulomo wangu uyowambuula intembawuzyo zya Jehova; muleke boonse bantu balongezye zina lyakwe lisalala kwalyonse alyonse.
Ndatila kulila kwangu kunembo lyakwe; ndamwaambila mapenzi angu.
Eelyo muuya wangu niwiizukide mulindime, ulizi nzila zyangu, Munzila eeyo mweyinda bakanditeya kakole.
Ndalanga kululyo lwangu alimwi ndabona kuti takwe naba womwe uubikide maanu aatala andime. Takwe machijilo kulindime; takwe uubikide maanu aatalaabuumi bwangu.
Ndakakwiita, Jehova; ndakati, ''Ulichichijilo changu, chaabilo changu mjnyika yabawumi.
Walongezegwa ooyo uuli a Leza wa Jakkobbu kulugwasyo lwakwe, uuli aabulangizi muli Jehova Leza wakwe.
Jehova wakalenga julu anyika, lwizi, azyonse zili mulinzizyo; utobelezya kusyomeka kwalyoonse.
Swiilila kukwiita kwangu, nkaambo ndawizuulwa; ndivune kuzwa kulibaabo bandipenzya nkaambo bali aanguzu kwiinda ndime.
Gwisya muuya wangu kuzwa kuntolongo kuchitila kuti ndikape kulumba kuzina lyako. Basalali bayoobungana kabandizyungulukide nkaambo wabota kulindime.''
Uupa bululami kuli badyamizigwa alimwi upa kulya kuli balanzala;. Jehova ulangununa kubaange;
Jehova ulajula menso aaboofu; Jehova ulanyampula aabo bavuumene; Jehova uyanda bantu baluleme.
Jehova ulakwabilila bazwakule munyika; ulanyampula batakwe mawisi abamukamufu, pesi ulabasandukila basizibi.
Jehova uyotonga lyoonse, Leza wako, Ziyoni, wamazyalane woonse. Alumbayizigwe Jehova.
Utanjili mulubeteko antoomwe abalanda bako, nkaambo kubusyu bwako taakwe uululeme pe.
Sinkondoma wavwima muuya wangu; wandivwinyuuna aanyika; wandichita kuti ndikkale mumudima mbuli aabo bafwansiku.
Muuya wangu wawizuuka mulindime; moyo wangu wayoowa.
Ndayeeya mazuba akayinda; ndayibaluka milimu yako yoonse; Ndayubununa zyakachitwa amaanza aako.
Ndatandabika maboko aangu kulinguwe; muuya wangu uleenyota munyika yachimpayuma. Selah
Kundivwiila chakufwambaana, Jehova, nkambo muuya wangu wawizuuka. Utandisisili busyu bwako, naa ndaba mbuli aabo bayinkila mumulindi.
Andimvwe chizumunano chabusyomesi muchifumofumo, nkaambo ndasyoma mulinduwe.  Nditondeezye nzila njiyelede kweenda, nkaambo ndanyampula muuya wangu kulinduwe.
Kondivuna kulibasinkondoma, o Jehova; ndachijila kulinduwe kuti ndiyube. Ndiyiisye kuchita kuyanda kwako, nkaambo nduwe Leza wangu, Muya wako mubotu undizulwide munyika iiluleme.
Jehova, nkaambo kezina lyako, kondibamba nkechili muumi.
Mubusyomesi bwachizuminano chako nyonyoona basinkondoma alimwi nyonyoona boonse basinkondo babuumi bwangu, nkaambo ndilimulanda wako.
Uli busyomesi bwachizuminano changu achiyubilo changu, nganze yangu yaajulu alimwi ooyo uundivuna, ntobo yangu alimwi ooyo nkweyubila, ooyo uuzunda manyika aansi angu.
Jehova, niinzi muntu nomuyeeya na mwana wamuntu ooyo ngoyeeya?
Muntu ulimbuli muuya uyoyegwa; mazuba aakwe ali mbuli cheenzule chiinda.
Chita mayoba aseluke akuza aansi, Jehova; guma zilundu akuzichita busi.
Tuma kumweka kwalulabi akumwayisya basinkondoma; waala tuvwi twako akubabweedezya mukunyangana.
Selusya janza lyako kuzwa kujulu; kondivuna kuzwa kumanzi miingi, kuzwa mumaanza aabenzu.
Milomo yabo yambuula mabejo, alimwi jaanza lyabo lyalulyo ndyamabejo.
Ndiyoyimba lwiimbo lupya kulinduwe Leza; mukakobela kali aantambo zili kkumi ndiyoyimba ntembawuzyo kulinduwe,
uupa lufutuko kubaami, wakavuna Deviti mulands wako kuzwa kupanga lyabubi.
Ndivune alimwi undaangunine  kuzwa mumaboko aabenzu. Milomo yabo yaamba mabejo, aluboko lwabo lwalulyo ndwamabejo.
Amumutembawule Jehova, nobaami banyika azisi zyoonse, bana babaami aboonse baleli baansi,
boonse baalumi banini abanakazi banini, bacheembede abana.
Bana benu balombe ababe mbuli misamu iikkomena kumweelwe uuzwide mubukombe bwabo abana besu basimbi mbuli chooko chibezedwe chaminsende, chibezedwe mbuli eezyo zyamung'anda yamwami.
Ng'anda zyesu zyakulondweda zizule amisyobo yoonse yabutebuzi, alimwi alimwi mbelele zyesu zizyale zyuulu azyuulu zili makkumi mumyuunda yesu.
Amubaleke boonse batembawule zina lya Jehova, nkambo zina lyakwe alilikke ndili nyampwidwe alimwi busalali bwakwe buli yungizizigwe aatala aanyika amajulu.
Wakanyampula lwija lwabantu bakwe kuntembawulo kuzwa kuli bakwe boonse basyomeka, ma Izilayeli, bantu bali afwifwi anguwe. Atembawulwe Jehova.
Mpawo ng'ombe zyesu zibe aabana biingi. Takwe naba uumwi utamwaye malambo eesu; kutakabi kulila nikuba kweema mumigwagwa yesu.
Balilongezegelwe bantu bali aazilongezyo zili boobu; bali aalukondo bantu aabo Leza wabo uuliJehova.
Ndiyookulongezya buzuba abuzuba; ndiyootembawula zina lyako kwalyoonse alyoonse.
Mupati Jehova akutembawulwa kapati; bupati bwakwe tabuyanduuliki.
Limwi zyalane liyootembawula nchito zyako kuzyalane litobela akwaamba milimo yako mipati.
Ndiyooyeesesya bubotu bwabulemu bwako akumilimu yako mibotu myeebesi.
Bayowamba manguzu aamilimu yako mibotu, alimwi ndiyowamba bupati bwako.
Bayowamba bubotu bwako bwiingi, alimwi bayooyimba aatala abusalali bwako.
Jehova uli aaluzyalo aluse, ulanonoka kunyemaalimwi mupati muluyando lwiimvwi nji.
Jehova mubotu kuli boonse; luse lwakwe lubombe luli aatala aamilimu yakwe yoonse.
Zyoonse nziwakapanga ziyoopa kulumba kulinduwe, Jehova; basyomekede bayookulongezya.
Bayoowambuula aatala abulemu bwabwami bwako, alimwi bayoowamba aatala amanguzu ako.
Bayoozibya bantu biingi aatala amilimu mipati yaLeza abulemu bwabubotu bwabwami bwakwe.
Bwami bwako mbwami bwakyoonse, abweendelezi bwako bulakkalilila kumazyalane woonse.
Jehova ulagwasya boonse baliikuwa akubusya boonse bakoteme.
Boonse menso aabo alinda nduwe; ulabapa chakulya chabo aachiindi cheelede.
Ulatandabika jaanza lyako akupa chakulya kuchilengwa choonse.
Jehova ulasalala munzila zyakwe zyoonse akusyomeka kulizyoonse nzyachita.
Jehova uli afwiifwi kulibaabo bamwiita, boonse bamwiita chakasimpe.

Mpawo mungelo wamusanu wakalizya mweeembo wakwe , ndakabona nyenyeezi kujulu yakali yawida ansi anyika. Inyenyeezi eyi yakapegwa achijaluzyo mulyango wamulindi uutagoli.

Kuzwa mubusi insozi zyakaza anyika , alimwi zyakapegwa nguzi mbuli zyakabanze anyika.
Zyaka ambilwa kuti zipazi sokwe lyaansi naba mweevwe wazilimwa naba musamu, pesi buyo bantu abo batakwe nibakali mpa yaLeza ankumu zyabo.
Tezyakazumizigwa kubajaya bantu abo, pesi biyo kuti basubulwe kwamweezi ilimusanu. Busaki bwazyo bwakali mbuli bwakaniozi kakabanze nikaluma muntu.
Kumazuba ayo bantu bayoolangula lufu pesi tabakooyolujana pe.  Bayooyandisya kapati kufwa , pesi lufu luyobasosoloka.
Insozi eezi zyakali kulangika mbuli madonki abambilwa baya kunkondo. Amitwe yawo kwakali chilimbuli musini  wangolida, abusyu bwawo bwakali mbuli bwabantu.
Aakali asusu mbuli lyabanakazi, amenyo awo akali mbuli menyo amulavu.
Balaachikwabilizya akaango mbuli zikwabilizyo zyansimbi, alimwi musindo wamababa awo ulimbuli munkalaki amadonki achijanina nkondo.
Akalamichila ilatuniozi mbuli twakabanze; mumuchila yawo mwakali busaki bwakuchisya bantukwamyezi ilimusanu.
Bali mbuli mwami wabo mungelo wamumulindi utagoli. Izina lyakwe muchiHibbulu walikutegwa Abbadoni, muchiGilikki kali azina litegwa Apoloni.
Inkondo tanzi yakayinda. Amubone! kwayinda eezi kuchili nteenda zibili zichiza.
Mungelo wamusanu awumwi wakalizya mweembo wakwe, alimwi ndakamvwa ijwi kalizwa mumeja achipayililo changolida chipedwa kunembo lyaLeza.
Akwambila mungelo wamusanu awumwi wakali amweembo," Angununa bangelo bane bakangwa kumulonga mupati wakuEfulate."
Bangelo bane bakali balibambila kuhola elyo , kubuzuba obo, kumweezi oyo, amunyaka oyo, bakangununwa kuti bajaye chisela chatatu chabantu.
Mweelwe wabasilumamba bakali amusana wamadonki bali zyulu zyamyanda ili makumi abili. Ndakamvwa mweelo wabo.

Mbuboobu mbundakabona madonki muchilengaano changu abaabo bakali biinga (akkede). Zikwabilizyo zyabo zyakali kusalala, zyamyiiye azya syantondo. Mitwe yamadonki yakali mbuli mitwe yabalavu amunkanwa yawo mwakazwa mulilo, busi asalufa.
Chisela chatatu chabantu chakajayigwa azibela zitatu: mulilo, busi, asalufa wakazwa munkanwa lyawo.
Nkaambo nguzu zyamadonki zyakali munkanwa lyawo amumichila - nkaambo michila yawo yakali mbuli nzoka, kalamitwe eyo yakali kumezya zilonda kubantu.

Kulyokezya kwabantu, abo batakwe bakajegwa achibela eechi, tebakasanduka kumilimu yamaboko, na kuleka kukomba basikazwa achikozyano chazibeze zyangolide, siliva, mukuba, mabwe, achisamu - zintu zitaboni, akumvwa, akweenda.
Nikuba kutasanduka kubujayi bwabo , kumasampu abo, kubwaamu akunchito zyakubba.

Mpawo ndakabona uumbi mungelo wamanguzu kaza kuzwa kujulu. Wakali mujoba, alimwi kwakali fulichoongwe ajulu lyamutwe wakwe. Busyu bwakwe bwakali mbuli zuba alimwi mawulu aakwe akali mbuli misumpuululu yamulilo.
Wakajisi chakulembela chiniini, eecho chakajulwa mujanza lyakwe. Wakabika kuulu kwakwe kwachilisyo mulwizi alimwi kwachimweensi anyika.
Mpawo wakoompolola ajwi pati mbuli mulavu wabutambo. Eelyo nakoompolola, mizuzumo ili musanu ayibili yakaambula amajwi aayo.
Eelyo mizuzumo ili musanu ayibili niyakaambula, ndakali ndaamba kulemba, pesi ndakamvwa ijwi kuzwa kujulu lyakati, ''Ngayibe nsiswa eezyo zyaambwa amizuzumo ili musanu ayibili. Utazilembi pe aansi.''
Mpawo mungelo ngundakabona kayimvwi alwizi alimwi  anyika wakanyampula luboko lwakwe lwachilisyo kujulu.

Wakakonka awoyo uupona lyoonse alimwi chakutamana, wakalenga julu alimwi azyoonse zili mukati kalyo, nyika alimwi azyoonse zili alinjiyo, alimwi a lwizi alimwi azyoonse zili mulindulo, alimwi mungelo wakati, ''Takuchiyoobi limbi kunonoka.
Pesi mubuzuba eelyo mungelo wa msanu ababili nayowamba klizya mweembo wakwe, mpawo bupati bwa Leza buyoozuzikizigwa, mbuli mbakaamba majwi mabotu kubalanda bakwe basinsimi.''
Ijwi ndindakamvwa kuzwa kujulu lyakaambula lubo kulindime: ''Inka, bweza chilembelo chijulikene chili muluboko lwa mungelo uyimvwi milwizi alimwi aanyika.''

Mpawo ndakiinka ku mungelo alimwi ndamwaambila kuti andipe chilembelo chiniini. Wakati kulindime, ''Bweza chilembelo alimwi uchilye. Chiyoochita kuti bula bwako bukalule, pesi mumulomo wako chinoli chinono mbuli buchi.''
Ndakabweza chilembelo chiniini kuzwa kuluboko lwa mungelo alimwi ndachilya. Chakali kunona mbuli buchi mumulomo wangu, pesi musule lyakuchilya, bula bwangu bwakalula.
Mpawo umwi wakati kulindime, ''Weelede kusinsima lubo aatala abantu biingi, manyika, misyobo, alimwi a baami.''
Itete lyakapegwa ndime kuti ndibelesye mbulikasamu kakweelesya. Ndakabuzigwa, "Buka mpawo upime Ng'anda ya Leza achipayiililo, abaabo bakomba mumo.
Pesi utapimi lukoono lwaanze lwa Ng'and ya Leza, mbukunga lwakapegwa kubamasi. Baloolyatawuka idolopolisalala kwamwezi makumi aane aabili.
Ndilakupa bakamboni bangu babili anguzu zyakusinsima ali chuulu amyaanda iibili amakumi musanu alimwi, kabasamide zisamo zyamasaka."
Bakamboni aaba misamu iibili yamawooliva azikkazikilo zibili zyamal;ampe zyakaliimvwi kunembo lyamwami wanyika.
Na umwi wasala kubanyonyoona, mulilo ulazwa mumilomo yabo akuli yabasinkondonyina. ooyo kubanyonyoona weelede kujayigwa munzila eeyi.

Bakamboni aaba balenguzu, zyakujala mulengalenga kuti kutabi mvula iwa kuchiindi chamazuba ngibasinsima. Balaanguzu zyakusandula maanzi kuba bulowa akuuma nyika amusyobo ulibuti wachisozi kufumbwa mpubayanfila.
Nibanooli bamanisya bukamboni bwabo, chinyama chizwa mumulindi utagoli  chiyyobusya nkondo aatala ambabo. Uuyoobazunda akubajeya.
Mibili yabo iyoowona mumugwagwa wadolopo pati (kachilikwiimikila Sodoma a Ijiputi ) nkwakabambulwa Mwami wabo.
Kumazuba aatatu achisela bamwi kubantu boonse, kumukowa woonse, kumyaambo yoonse, akuzisi zyoonse bayoolanga mibili yabo. tabakoyooyizumizya pe kuti ikabikwe muchuumbwe.
Aabo ba[pona munyika bayookondwa atala ambabo akupobola. Alimwi bayotumizya zipo kuli umwi awumwi ankaambo kabasinsimi babili bakapenzya aabo bakkede munyika.
Pesi kunembo kwamazuba aatatu achisela muuya wabuumi uzwa kuli Leza uyoobanjila, eelyo bayooyima amawulu  aabo.Kuuyoowa kupati kuyoowida aabo bakabona.
Elyo bayoomvwa jwi pati kuzwa kujulu kaliti kulimbabo, "Amuze ookuno!"  eelyo bayoyinka kujulu mujoba, awwo basinkondonyina kabalangide.

Kuchiindi eecho kuyooba muzuzumo mupati, pesi kuchipanzi chili kkumi chadolopo chiyoowa. Zyuulu zyabantu zilimusanu azbili ziyoojayigwa aamuzuzumo, aabo bayoofutuka bayoyoowa akupa bulemu kuli Leza wajulu.
Lyachibili penzi lyakayinda: Bona! Penzi lyatatu lilasika chakufwambaana. Kwakalio mabbalabala atulabi, amizuzumo, akugutuma akuzuzuma kwanyika, avula mabwe.
Elyo angelo wamusanu ababili wakasiba mpeta,alubo majwi mapati akambuulwa kujulu eelyo akati, ''Bwami bwanyika bwaba bwami  bwa Mwami wesu aKkilisito wakwe, aboobo uyoyendelezya kwalyoonse."
Pesi bapati bali makumi aabili abane, bakkala azyuuno zyabwami bwabo kunembo lya Leza, bakawida kumasyu aabo akukomba Leza.

Bkati, "Tupa kulumba kulinduwe, Mwami Leza Singuzu zyoonse, ooyo uliwo awakaliwo, nkaambo wabweza nguzu zyako mpati akusanguna kweendelezya. Mabbuku mabotu amalembe aachi Giliki chansiku chili atwaambo wakaliwo, uzooba wo pesi kumabbuku amwi alino achi Giliki akayungizya twaambo:ayooyo uzosika.

Zisi zyakanyema, pesi bukali bwako bwasika.Chiindi chasika chabafwide kuti batongwe akuti nywebo mukape balanda banu basinsimi bulumbu abantu ba Leza basalala, abaabo bakayoowa zina lyako, batachikayandikani abalaanguzu. Chiindi chako chasika chakunyonyoona aabo banokunyonyoona nyika."
Elyo ng'anda ya Leza ili kujulu yakajulwa alubo akkiyi yachizuminano yakaboneka mukati ka Ng'anda.
Chitondeezyo chipati chakaboneka mujulu: mwanakazi uvumbidwe azituba,uli amwezi kunsi aamawulu amusdini wanyenyeezi zili kkumi azibili amutwe wakwe.
Wakalimitide, akulila mumachisen aakutumbuka, wakachiswa mukutumbuka.
Mpawo kwakaboneka achimwi chiytondeezyo kujulu: Langa! Kwakali Simwaaba mupati usalala ooyo wakali amitwe ili musanu ayibili ameja alikkumi, alimwi kwali misini ili musanu ayoibili aamutwe wakwe.
Muchila wakwe wakayiila chatatu chanyenyeezi zili kujulu akuziwaalila ansi. Lino Simwaaba wakayimikila kunembo  lyamwanakazi ooyo wakali waba afwiifwi akutumbuk,kuti natatumbuke akamene mwana.
Wakatambula mulombe, mwana mulombe, ooyo uyooyendelezya masi woonse amufunko walibulo. Mwanaakwe wakakwempelwa kuli Leza achuuno chakwe,
mpawo mwanakazi wakachijila munkanda, ooko Leza nkwakabambide busena bwakwe, kuti abambwe kwamazuba ali chuuluamyaanda iibili ilaamakumi musanu awumwi. (1, 260)
Lino kwakaba nkpondo kujulu. Mikkeyeli abaangelo bakalwana a Simwaaba abaangelo bakwe bakajosezya.
Pesi Simwaaba tewakalijisi nguzu zyakuzunda.Lino twkwakajanika busenabwabo pe kujulu we abaangelo bakwe.
Simwaaba mupati ooyo muzoka wachiindi utegwa Dyabulosi na Satani,wakeena nyika yoonse -wakawaalwa ansi munyika, abaangelo bakwe bakawaala antoomwe anguwe.
Mpawo ndakamvwa jwi pati kujulu:
Bakamiuzunda abulowa bwa Mwana ambelele akujwi lyabukamboni bwabo, nklaambo tebakali kuyandisya buumi bwabo kusika kuliufu.
Nkaambo kaako amusekelele, nye nomajulu amoonse nomukkala mulingawo! Pesi maaawe kunyika akulwizi,
Lino SImwaaba nakabona kuti wawalilwa ansi munyika,  wakaandilila mwanakazi wakatiumbuka  mwana mulombe.

Lino mwanakazi wakapegwa mababa aabili achuungwe mupati kuti awuluke aye kubusena mbwaakabambilidwe kunkanda. Oobu mbubusena ooko nkwayoobambwa nkwayookutawukilwa kwachiindi chazyiindi achisela chachiindikuzwa kubusyubwa Muzoka.
Muzoka wakaluka maanzi kuzwa kumulomo wakwe mbuli mulonga kuti akachite zambangulwe litakatole mwanakazi.
Pesi nyika yakamugwasya mwanakazi. Nyika yakajula mulomo wayo akumena mulonga ooyo kuzwa kumulomo wa Simwaaba.
Mpawo Simwaaba wakasiya mwanakazi akuya kutanguna nkondo abana bakwe boonse, aabo bakaswiilila milaazyo ya Leza akujata bukamboni atala a Jesu.
Mpawo Simwaaba wakayimikila museele lyakumbali alwizi
Lino ndakabona chinyama chifumpuka kuzwa mulwizi. Chakali ameja alikkumi amitwe ili musanu ayibili. Atala ameja kwakali misini ili kkumi, aatala amutwe  uumwi kwakali izina lyalweeno .

Chinyama eechi nchindakabona chakali mbuuli nemba. Zituta zyacho zyakali mbuuli zituta zya nengo, amulomo wacho wakali mbuuli mulomo wamulavu. Simwaaba wakachipa nguzu zyakwe, achuuno abwami bupati bwakweendelezya.

Umwi mutwe wachinyama wakali aachilonda chipati, pesi chilonda eecho chipati chakali chapona. Lino nyika yoonse yakali yagamba nibakali tobela chinyama. Bakamukomba umwi  simwaaba nkaambo wakapa chinyama bwaami.
Bakachikomba chinyama, achilacho, bakati,'' ngwani uuli mbuuli chinyama?'' nguni uunga ulachilwana.
Lino chinyama chakapegwa mulomo oyo wakali kwambuula majwi amasampu. Chakazumizigwa kweendelezya bwaami kwamyezi ilimakkumi aane amyezi iibili.
Mpawo chinyama chakajula mulomo wacho kuti chaambuule masampu kuli Leza, kusampawula zina lyakwe anganda yakwe abaabo bakkala kujulu.
Lino chinyama chakazumizigwa kutalika  nkondo abantu ba Leza basalala akubazunda. Alimwi, chakapegwa bwaami bwakweendelezya misyobo yoonse, bantu milaka achisi.
Boonse bakkala anyika bayoochikomba, woonse uulazina lyakatalembedwe mubbuku lyabuumi, lya Mwanaambelele wakajayigwa kuzwa kumatalikilo aanyika.
Naa kuli uulakutwi aswiilile naa kuli uumwi utolwa mubuzike, mubuzike uyotolwa.
Naakuli uujayigwa aapanga,  apanga uyojayigwa. Ndoolu lukakatilo lwakwiitwa alusyomo lwabantu ba Leza basalala.
Lino ndakbona chinyama chimbi chizwa munyika.  Chakalaameja aabili mbuuli mwanaambelele, akwaamba mbuuli simwaaba.
Wakabelesya bwaami boonse bwachinyama chitaanzi mumeso aakwe, akuchita nyika abaabo bakkala mulinjiyo akukomba chinyama chitaanzi- eecho chilaachilonda chakaponesegwa.

Mpawo ndakabona uumbi munyama kazwa munyika. Wakali aameja obile mbuli mbelele, alimwi chakalikwaambula mbuli simwaaba. Wakatondeezya woonse manguzu a munyama mutaanzi kunembo lyakwe, alimwi wakachita nyika alimwi abaabo bapona alinjiyo kuti bakombe munyama mutaanzi - ooyo wakali aachilonda chakaponisigwa.
Chakachita maleele aagambya. Chakachita mulilo kuti useluke kuzwa kujulu kunembo lyabantu.
Azizitondeezyo chakapegwa nguzu kachiimikilila chinyama, wakeena aabo bakkala munyika. wabaambila kuti babikkile chinyama chikozyanio - wakaliyasidwe apanga, pesi wakapona.
Wakazumizigwa kupa muuya wakuyoya kuchikozyanisyo chachinyama kuti chikozyanisyo echo  kuti chaambuule akuchita boonse aabo bakakakukomba chinyama kuti  bajayigwe.
Alimwi wakaangila bantu boonse, batabalwi, abasinguzu, bavubi abachete, baangunwidwe abazike, kuti babikwe impa aakuboko naa ankumu.
Chakaba chiyumu kuli boonse kuula naa kuuzya ado uula mpa yachinyama, ooyo ngumweelwe wimikilila zina lyacho.

Oku mbombubo busongo. Naa kuli uujisi maanu ,abale mweelwe wachinyama,ooyu ngu,mweelwe wachinyama. Nkaambo ngumwelwe wamuntu. Mwelwe wakwe ngwa myaanda iili musanu awumwi iila makkumi musanu alimwi  iila musanu awumwi.
Ndakalanga mpawo ndakabona Mwanaambelele uliimvwi atalachilundu cha ziyoni. Bakalaanguwe bakali zyuulu zili mwaanda  amakkumi aane abane bakali azina lyakwe alya Wisi  zina kalilembedwe ankumu zyabo.
Ndakamvwa jwi  lizwida kujulu limvwikka mbuuli maanzi miingi aaboboma amuzumo mupati. Imuzumo ngundakamvwa lubo wakali mbuuli basituntimbwa balizya tuntimbwa.

Bakalikwiimba lwiimbo lupya kunembo aamusini mpawo kunembo bawuka bone bapona abaalumi bapati. Takwe bakali kukkonzya kwiimba lwiimbo ado aba bali  zyuulu mwaanda amakumi one azine bakawulidwe kuzwa kunyika.

Aba mbembabo bakatali sofwaazizye abanakazi bakalibambide lwabo beni kulizyamalalano. Mbiimbabo bakatobela Mwanaambelele kufumbwa nkwaakali kuya. Aba mbimbabo bakafutwidwe kuzwa akati kamisyobo mbuuli michelo mitaanzi  aya Mwanaa
mbelele.  Takwe mabejo  akajanikide mumilomo yabo tabakwe kampenda.
Ndakabona uumbi mungelo uuyobuluka mujulu, wakajisi makani mabotu aatamani aakwaambila baabo bakali kupona aanyika - kuli woonse masena, misyobo, milaka, akubantu.
Wakiita ajwi pati,'' muyoowe Leza akumupa bulemu.  Nkaako chiindi chakwe chalubeta chasika.  Mumukombe, ooyo wakalenga julu , anyika  alwizi, mpawo atusensa twamaanzi.''
Awumbi mungelo - wa bili mungelo - wakatobela nkayoobwamba,'' Waawa, waawa  Bhabbiloni mupati  wakasungilizya woonse maasi kuti anywe wayini yakwe  yabwamu.''
Awumbi mungelo - watatu mungelo- wakabatobela, wakaamba ajwi pati,'' Naa kuli muntu uukomba chinyama achikozyanio chacho mpawo akutambula bulembo bwacho aankumu yakwe naanka mukuboko kwakwe,

ooyo nguutakanywe wayini wabukkali bwa Leza,  iwatilwa chakutavwelwa aamanzi muchinywido chabukkali bwakwe  muntu ooyu uunywa uyopenzegwa amulilo wasilufa  kunembo lyabaangelo basalala ba Leza akunembo lya Mwanaambelele.
Ibusi bwamapenzi aabo bula lunta lyoonse kukabe butamani mpawo tabakwe kulyookezya bunini sikati kana mansiku - aabo bakomba banyama azikozyanio, mpawo abaabo boonsebatambula bulembo bwazina lyakwe.
Mbuboobo mbuluboneka lwito lwabakakakatila  lwabantu basalala ba Leza,  aabo babamba milaazyo ya Leza a lusyomo lwabo lwamuli Jesu.''
Ndakamvwa ijwi lyakazwa kujulu lyakati'' lemba eechi: balilongezegelwe aabo batakafwe mumwaami.''  ''Iyi,''  mbaawamba Muuya '' naakuti balyookezye mumakataazyo aabo, lino milimo yabo ilabatobela.''
Ndakalanga mpawo ndakabona joba lituba, aatalaajoba kwakakkede uumwi uukozyaniya amwanaamuntu.  Wakali amusini wa ngolida atala mutwe wakwe mpawo mujaanza lyakwe wakajisi jekeso libosya.

Mpawo kwakazwa mungelo uumbi muchikombelo mpawo wakiita ajwi pati kuli yooyo wakakkede atala ajoba: '' Bweza jekeso lyako akutanguna kutebula. Nkaambo chiindi chakutebula chasika,  abutebuzi bwanyika bwabizwa .
Lino ooyo wakakkede  ajulu ajoba wakavukuzya jekeso lyakwe aatala nyika, mpawo nyika yakatebulwa.
Awumbi mungelo wakazwa muchikombelo mujulu; alakwe wakali aajekeso.

Awumbi mungelo wakazwa kuchipayililo chatununkilizyo, nguwe wakali aanguzu atala amulilo. wakoomplola ajwi pati kuli yoyo wakajisi jekeso libosya,'' tola jekeso lyako libosya akutebula muzikamu zyamichelo kuzwa mumisamu yanyika, nkaambo michelo yayo yabizwa.''
Mpawo mungelo wakavukuuzya jekeso lyakwe kunyika mpawo watebula michelo yamusamu wanyika . Watebula misamu yanyika akwaawala mudindi pati lyakutebwida lyabukkali bwa Leza.
Mwakalyatuukwa mudindi eelyo lyakutebwida aanze aamunzi,  mpawo abulowa bwakatilwa kuzwa kulinchicho kuyosika mumukosi wa bbiza, kwachelesyo chili chulu amyaanda ilimusamu awumwi.

Lino ndabona chimwi chitondeezyo mujuiu, nkachili chipati mpawo kachigambya: Bakali bangelo bakali musanu ababili nkabajisi zipenzyo zili musanu azibili, ezizipenzyo nzyakumamaninsizyo, mulinzizyo bukkali bwa Leza buno maninide.

Ndakabona chimwi chili mbuuli lwizi lwachi boniboni chivwelene aamulilo. Lino aabo bakayimvwi mbembabo bakazundide chinyama achikkozyanisyo chacho mpawo amweelwe wazina lyacho . Bakalijisi tuntumbwa ntubakapedwe a Leza.

Bakali kwiimba lwiimbo lwa Mozesi, mulanda wa Leza, mpawo alwimbo lwaMwana wa mbelele: '' nkupati akugambya kuchita kwenu, Mwami Leza, singuzu. Zililuleme mpawo nzyakasimpe nzila zyanu, Mwami wamanyika.
Ngwani uutakuyoowi ,Mwami ,akulemekezya zina lyako? Nkambo nduwe olike usalala. Woonse maasi ayosika akuyokukkomba kunembo lyako nkaambo bululami bwako anchito zyayubununwa.''
Musule lyazintu ezi ndakalanga, mpawo chikkombelo nkakuli chilawo chabumboni chakali julidwe mujulu.
Kuzwa muchikombelo kwakabbuda bangelo balimusanu ababili nkajisi zipenzyo zili musanu azibili. Kabasamide zisamo zituba zingayima, alimwi balaangide aatwango twabo intambo zyangolida.
Umwi wabanyama bane bapona wakapa kubangelo bali musanu ababili zibikilo zyangolida zizwide bukali bwa Leza, kuli yoyo upona kwa lyoonse akutamani.
Chikombelo chakali zwide abuusi buzwa kubulemu bwa Leza akunguzu zyakwe. Takwe wakali kukkonzya kunjila kusikila zipenzyo zilimusanu azibili zyabangelo bali musanu ababili bamaninina.
Ndakamvwa Ijwi lyoompolola anze atempele akwamba kuba angelo bali musanu ababili, ''Kwiiya akakatile anyika mitiba ili musanu ayibili yabukali bwa Leza.''
Mungelo wakusanguna wakainka akutila mutiba wakwe munyika;  kubija amachise azilonda zyakazwa mubantu kuli baabo bakalembedwe bulembo bwachinyama, abo bakakomba chikozyanio chacho.
Mungelo wachibili wakatila mutiba wakwe mulwizi, Akaba bulowa, mbuli bulowa bwamuntu ufwide, azintu zyoonse zipona mulwizi zyakafwa.
Mungelo wachitatu wakatila mutiba wakwe mumilonga amutusensa twamanzi, aboobo akaba bulowa.
Ndakamvwa mungelo wamanzi kaamba kuti, ''Uli mululami - umwi uliwo awakaliwo Usalala alikke - nkambo wabeteka zintu ezi.
Nkambo bakatila bulowa bwabantu abasinsimi ba Leza basalali, wabapa bulowa kuti banywe; nzinzizyo nzibakali kuyanda.''
Ndakamvwa nsandulo kuzwa kuchipayililo, ''Iyii, Mwami Leza Singuzu zyoonse, kubeteka kwako nkwakasimpe alimwi kuliluleme.''
Mungelo wachine wakatila mutiba wakwe aazuba, alimwi lyakazumizigwa kuti litente bantu amulilo.
Bakatentwa akupya, alimwi bakasampawula zina Leza, uli anguzu atala zilwazi zyoonse. Tebakasanduka pe nikuba kumupa bulemu.
Mungelo wamusanu wakatila mutiba wakwe achuuno chachinyama, akusiya kwakazulila abwami bwacho. Bakaluma ndiimi zyabo nkambo kamachise.
Bakasampawula Leza wakujulu nkambo kamachise abo azilonda, aboobo bakachili kukaka kusanduka kunchito zyabo.
Mungelo wamusanu awumwi wakatila mutiba wakwe mulonga mupati, Efulatisi. Maanzi awo akayuminina kukubambila nzila ya Mwami kuti asike kuza kujwe.
Ndakabona myuya miibi itatu yakali kulangika mbuli zyaande yakali kizwa kumulomo wasimwaba, akuchinyama, akuba sinsimi babeji.
Myuuya yamadimoni ichita zigambyo azitondezyo. Yakali kwiinka anze kubaami banyika yoonse akulibungania antomwe nkambo kakulwana kupati kwazuba lya Leza Singuzu zyonse.
''Mulange ! ndasika mbuli mubbi ! Ulongezezegwe ngooyo ubamba akulangilila, ukkede kazwete chibaki chakwe kuti ateendi kali chiinswe akuti bataboni bube bwakwe busisya.
Bakabeeta antomwe abusena bwitwa kuti Amagedoni muchi Hebbelu.
Mungelo wamusanu atubili wakatila mutiba wakwe muluwo. Mpoonya Ijwi ipati lyakoompolola kuzwa muntempele akuchuno, kalyamba kuti, ''Kwamana !''

Kwakali mimuni yandabibi, kundindima kuli abukali, akuswanana kwandabi amizuzumo, akuteketa kwanyika kuyoosya - kuteketa kwanyika kupati kutana kubonwa kuzwa muntu mpaakabeda anyika,lino nkukuteketa kwenyika kupati.

Idolopo ipati lyakanzana muzibela zyotatwe, amanyika amadolopo akawa. Mpawo Leza wakayita kuti abone Bbabbiloni mupati,, alimwi wakapa dolopo nkomesi itilidwe wayini wakalundwa kuzwa kubukali bwindilide.
Tusuwa toonse twakamana, azilundu takwe nizyakachili kuboneka pe.
Chivulamabwe chipati, chakelwa atala achipo, chakasika aansi kuzwa kujulu atala abantu. Bakasampawula Leza azilwazi zyachivulamabwe nkambo zilwazi zyakali kuyosya loko.
Umwi wabaangelo balimusanu ababili bakajisi mitiba wakasika akundambila kuti, ''sika, ndiyokutondezya chibi chasibwamu mupati ukkede atala amanzi mingi,
Oyo, baami baansi ngubakachita awe bwamu, awayini wabwamu bwakwe bayakide ansi bakakolwa.''

Mpawo angelo wakandibweza mumuuya akunditola munkanda, alimwi ndakabona mwanakazi ukkede amunyama uusalala wakali zwide mazina akusampawula. Echo chinyama chakali amitwe ilimusanu ayibili ameja aali kkumi.

Mwanakazi wakazwete zisamo zyamusyobo wamuntumbula azisalala kazingayima alimwi zyakalivwelene angolida, amabwe mayandisi, amabwe akubumba atuba. Wakajisi inkomesi izyangolide mumaboko akwe zyakazwide zintu zitayandiki azisofwede abwamu bwakwe.
Ankumu yakwe wakalembedwe izina lyakali abupanduluzi busisikene:  ''Babbiloni mupati, banyina babasimamambe  abusofwazi bwazintu zyansi.''
Ndakabona mwanakazi kakoledwe bulowa bwabantu basalala ba Leza abulowa bapenzegwa nkambo kakusyoma Jesu. Nindakamubona, ndakayowesya kapati.
Pesi mungelo wakandambila kuti, ''ninzi nchoyowa? Ndiyokupandulwida zisisikene zyiminina mwanakazi achinyama chimubwezede, chinyama echo chilamitwe ilimusanu ayibili ameja alikkumi.

Chinyama nchiwakabona kachipona, tachchiponi pe lino, alimwi chamba kusika aansi loko amulindi. Mpawo ulayinkila mukunyonyoka. Abo bapona munyika, abo bajanika mazina aabo katalembedwe pe mubbuku lyabuumi kuzwa muntalisyo yanyika - bayoyowesya nibakubona chinyama, nkambo chakaliwo, alimwi lino tachiwope, alimwi chiyoboola.
Eechi chaamba boongo bulabusongo. Mitwe ilimusanu ayibili ntulundulundu tuli musanu atubili omo mwanakazi mwakkede.
Kuli baami alubo bali musanu ababli, baami balimusanu baliwide, umwi uchipona, alimwi bamwi tabanasikape, alimwi nazosika, uyelede kuzoyimikila kayindi kanini.
Chinyama chakasikide, alimwi pesi tachiponi pe, ngomwani wamusanu atutatu , uzwa kulibali musanu ababili aboobo uya kulunyonyoko lwakwe.
Meeja aalya nguwakabona alikkumi mbibaami balikkumi batana tambula bwami bwabo, pesi bayotambula bwandelezi mbuli baami klwachiindi chomwe antomwe achinyama.
Obu mbubongo bumwi, alimwi buyopa nguzu abwendelezi kuchinyama.
Bayoliya nkondo amwana mbelele, pesi mwanambelele uyobazunda nkambo ngu Leza waba leza, a Mwami wabami- abaabo balawe mbayitwe, basalidwe, abasyomekede.''
Mungelo wakandambila kuti, ''Manzi ngiwakabona  awo simamambe mpakakkede, mbibantu, biingi manyika amyambo.
Meja alikkumi ngiwakabona - boo lwabo achinyama bayosula simamambe. Bayochisiya achilikke achintanda, bayochilya nyama yacho alimwi bayochitenta chikamaninine mumulilo.
Nkambo Leza wabikka mumyoyo yabo kuti babweze makanze akuzuminina kupa nguzu abwendelezi kuchinyama mane Ijwi lya Leza lizuzikizigwe.
Mwanakazi nguwabona nidolopo pati eliya lilanguzu zyakwendelezya atala abami banyika.''
Nikwakinda zintu ezi ndakabona umbi angelo kaseluka aansi kalikuzwa  kujulu.Kajisi bwendelezi  bupati, aboobo nyika yakamwesegwa abulemu bwakwe.
Wakakwilila ajwi ijumu, wati, ''Waawa, waawa Bbabbiloni mupati ! Waba chikkalilo chamadimoni, chiyobwedo chamyuya yoonse isofwede, achiyobwedo chatuyuni tusofwede atusesemya.
Nkambo zisi zyoonse zyanywa wayini wabwamu bwakwe. Bami banyika bakachita bwamu anguwe. Abalabo bendelezi baansi abavubi buzwa kunguzu nzyalibotezya anzila yakupona kwakwe.''
Alimwi ndakamvwa limbi ijwi lizwa kujulu liti, ''Kamuzwa aanze kuzwa kulinguwe, nobantu bangu, kuchitila kuti mutawanisigwi zibi zyakwe, akuchitila kuti mutatambuli niziba zipenzyo zyakwe.
Zibi zyakwe zyatanta kujulu, kule, aboobo Leza wayeya inchito zyakwe imbi.
Mumubbadale mbuli mbakabbadala bamwi, amumubbadale kobile mbuli mbachita; munkomeki njakali kuswanizya muswanizye tubili akulinguwe.
Mbuli mbakali kulemya lwakwe akupona mukulyiiba, amupe koomba amawuse. 'Ndakala mbuli namalelo; tandili mukamufu pe, aboobo tandikoyobona koomba.
Nkaambo kako mubuzuba bomwe zipenzyo zyakwe ziyo musikila: Lufu, anzala: Uyo syukutwa amulilo, nkambo Mwami Leza ngusinguzu aboobo ngomubetesi wakwe.''
Baami banyika bakachita bwamu chakulibotezya aboobo baakenda chakutalyunanga anguwe bayolila akoomoka nibayobona busi bwakutentwa kwakwe.
Bayoyimikila kule, akuyowa zipenzyo zyakwe, akuti, ''Maawe, maawe kuchisis chipati, Bbabbiloni, chisi chili ampuwo ! Nkambo muchindi chomwe lubeteko lwako lwasika.''
Abalabo bendelezi benyika bakwiila akomba nkambo tachikwe naba omwe uyobawulila alimbi -

Makwebo angolida, ansiliva, mabwe mayandisi, angale, amasani asalala tyu, azimvwalimvwali, ayoonse misyobo yamasamu amukomba, azyonse zibikilo zyameja anzovu, azyonse zibikilo zyakatwa amasamu mayandisi, azyamundalila, azyamukuba, azya mabweluuma,
Kkinamono, tununkilizyo, alibbano, aamula, wayini, amatuta, abusu bunante, abulotwe, ang'ombe ambelele, ambizi ankalaki, amyuya yabantu.
Muchelo oyo ngoyandisya anguzu zyako zyakumana kuzwa kulinduwe. Zyoonse zyoolwe zyako azi kubotezya zyakukubulika, tazichika bonwi limbi pe.
Bendelezi bazintu ezi abo bakaba bavubi akambo kakwe bayoyima kule kuzwa kuli nguwe musinzo nkambo kakuyowa kupenzegwa kupati.
Bayoti,
Muchiindi chomwe boonseni buvubi bwakambilwa kufwa.'' Boonse basibana musyoloma, boonse bantu beenda alwizi, amulwizi bakayimikila kule.
Bakakwila nibakabona busi bwakutentwa kwamubili wakwe. Bakaati, ''Nchichili chisi chibanga  nchisi chipati ?''

Bakalivwikila lusuko amitwe yabo, akukwila kupati, akwema akoomoka, ''Maawe, mawe kuchisi chipati balikuli boonse bakajisi maato abo mulwizi bakavubisigwa kuzwa kuli nguwe. Pele muchindi choomwe bakambilwa kufwa,''
''Amusekelele kwinda kwakwe amajulu,nywebo nobantu basalala anobatumwa anobasinsimi, pele Leza wamwetele  lubeta alinguwe !''
Angelo singuzu wakabweza ibbwe lilimbuli iziyo pati aboobo waliwala mulwizi, wamba wati, ''Munzila eyi, Bbabbiloni, yochisi chipati, uyosowegwa aansi chabukkali aboobo tochikabonwi limbi pe.
Ijwi lyabasituntimbwa, basinyele abasimweembo talichiyomvwigwi limbi muli nduwe. Abasimilimo niba ilibuti tabakoyojanwa limbi mulinduwe. Takukoyomvwigwa kuvuuta kwaziyo limbi muli nduwe.
Mumuni walampi tuchikamuniki limbi mulinduwe. Ijwi lyabasibwinga talikoyomvwigwa limbi muli nduwe, pele basambazi bako bakali bapati baansi, aboobo maasi akeenwa amasalamusi ako.
Mulinguwe bulowa bwaba sinsimi abwa basalali ba Leza bwaka janwa, abulowa bwababo boonse bakajayigwa aansi.''
Nikwakayinda zintu ezi ndakamvwa chakamvwikka aanga mongololo wajwi pati lyabantu bingi kujulu kalilo kwita aanze, ''Haleluya. lufutuko, bulemu, amanguzu nga Leza wesu.
Bubetesi bwakwe mbwakasimpe kabululeme, nkambo wakabeteka simwaba mupti oyo wakasofwazya inyika abwaamu amamambe wakabwedezya igaze lyamulanda, wakwe kuzwa kujanza lyakwe.''
Bkaambula lubo lwabili, ''Haleluya ! Busi bwakabuka kuzwa kulinguwe kwalyonse alyoonse.
Bapati bali makumi abiliaane azilengwa zipona zyakavundama ansi akukomba Leza, wakakkede achikkalilo. Bakali kwamba kuti, ''Ameni, Haleluya !''
Mpawo ijwi lyakazwa anze kuzwa kuchikkalilo, kalyamba kuti, ''Alumbwe Leza wesu, moonse nubalanda bakwe inywe nimumuyowa amwi abatali bapati ababo bali amanguzu.''
Mpawo ndakamvwa chakamvwika anga ndijwi mwelwe wabantu, mbuli muzumo wamanzi mayingi, achili mbuli muzumo wakuswanana kwendaabi.
Atusekelele akubotelwa akumupa bulemu ! Nkambo kakukondelwa kwapobwe lyakukwatana kwamwana mbelele lyasika, asibwinga ulilibambilide kale we.
Wakazumizigwa kuti azwatikwe ziboneka kazilangika kazili kabotu.''  ( Nkambo ziboneka kabotu zitondezya kululama kubantu ba Leza basalala).
Mungelo wakati kulindime, lemba ezi!  Balilongezezegwe mbaabo batambidwe kupobwe lyalukwatano kwamwana mbelele.'' Wakati lubo ayamakani a Leza akasimpe.''

Ndakawida andyato zyakwe kuti mukombe wakati kuli ndime, utachiti eechi ! Ndumwi mulanda anduwe abakulana bako bajisi bukamboni atala a Jesu. Koomba Leza, nkambo bukamboni bulatala a Jesu muuya wachisinsimi.''
Mpawo ndakabona ijulu lijukide nkabela ndakalanga alimwi kwakali ibbiza lituba. Ooyo sikuligada uyitwa kuti musyomeki wakasimpe. Zili abululami eezyo zyabeteka ampindu yankondo.
Menso akwe akali mbuli insasi zyamulilo, amutwe wakwe kwakali misini myingi. Wakali ezina lyakalembedwe alinguwe elyo utakwe wakalizi pesi weluzutu.
Wakali chisamo chakali kunikidwe mubulowa, nkabela Ijwi lyakwe lyiitwa kuti ndijwi lya Leza.
Basilumamba bakujulu bakali kuyabumutobela amabbiza atuba, kabazwete masila mabotu, atuba akunjenjema.
Mukanwa kwakazwa ikafulo kabosya nkinkako kawumya manyika, nkabela uyobayendelezya amufunko wansimbi. Ulolyatula idindi lyakudinina wayini lyabukali bwakunyema kwa Leza Singuzyonse.
Ulazina lilembedwe achibaki chakwe achibelo chakwe, ''Mwami wabaami, a Mwami wabaami.''
Ndakabona mungelo kayimvwi aazuba. Wakali kwita aanze ajwi pati kutuyuni tuuluka atalaamutwe, ''Muboole, mubungane amwi kupobwe lya Leza.
Mubole mulye nyama yabami, nyama yabendelezi, inyama yamabbiza abasikwagada anyama yabantu boonse, bangunwidwe abazike, nibababatakwe bulemo abasingu.''
Ndakabona chinyama abami baansi abasinkondo babo. Bakali bungene kuchitila kuti bakalwane ayoyo sikugada bbiza abasilumamba bakwe.

Chinyama chakajatwa anguwe abasinsimi babeji bakali kuchita zitondezyo kaliwo. Azitondezyo ezi wakeena abo bakali batambula bulembyo bwachinyama ababo bakali kukomba chikkozyanio. Babili aaba bakasowelwa mubbila lyamulilo kabachipona mubbila lyamulilo wasilufa.
Baami bonse bakajayigwa efulo lyakazwa kumulomo wasikugada bbiza. Toonse tuyuni twakalya nyama yabo yonse.
Mpawo ndakabona mungelo kaaza aansi kuzwa kujulu. Nguwakajisi luzibo anguzu atala adindi litakwe magolelo, alimwi wakalijisi inketani mpati mujanza lyakwe.
Wakamujata mankonga sikupenzya, sikweenena wachiindi, uuli nguwe satani. Alimwi wakamusunga kwamyaka ili chuulu chomwe.

Wakamuwaala mudindi litakwe magolelo. Wakalijala alimwi wabuumuna atala anguwe. Eezi zyakali kuchitilwa kuti atakonzyi kweenena iluundu lwazisi alimbi mane kwiinde chuulu chamwaaka. Musule lyaboobo kweelede akangununwe kwachiindi chifwifwi.

Mpawo ndakabona izyuno zyabwami. Alinzizyo kwakakkede aabo bakapedwe inguzu zyakwendelezya. Alimwi ndakabona myuuya yababo bakakosolwa mitwe akaambo kakupa bukamboni atala a Jesu alimwi bakali bakkaka kutambula  impa ankumu zyabo zyabo na kuboko. Bakapona alimwi bakendelezya a Kkilisitu kwachuulu chamyaka.
Ibiingi bakafwa tebakabuka akupona mane yayinda myaka iili chuulu chomwe. Ooku nkubuka kutanzi kuzwa kukufwa,

Ulongezezegwe akusalala ngooyo ulachakuchita abubuke butanzi kubafu ! Ilufu lwabili talukwe nguzupe kubantu aaba. Bayooba bapayizi ba Leza a Kkilisitu alimwi bayoyendelezya aamwi anguwe kwachuulu chamyaaka.
Niyakamana myaaka ilichuulu, satani uyogwisigwa muntolongo yakwe.
Uyoyinkaanze kuti akeenene manyika kuzyooko zyone zyanyika - Gogu a Magogo - kuti akabeete kunkondo. Bayoba biingi mbuli muse wamulwizi.
Bakayinka kujulu kwinda intandabale yabuyanza bwanyika akuzyunguluka igunzi lyabasalali ba Leza - idolopo liyandika. Pesi kwakaza mulilo kuzwa kujulu wakabalya.
Satani, ooyo wakabeena, wakawalilwa mubbibi lyamulilo, wasalufa, ooko munyama abasinsimi babeji nkubakawalilwa. Bayosukusigwa imansiku asikati kwalyoonse alyonse.
Mpawo ndakabonachuuno chabwami chituba ayooyo ulikkede aalinchicho. Inyika amajulu zyamwayika kuchija kuabawo kwakwe, pesi tekwakali busena pe bwakuti bayinke.

Ndakabona bafwide - ibalempuwo abatakwe mulimo - kabayimvwi kunembo lyachuno chabwami, alimwi mabbuku akajulwa. Alimwi ibbuku lyakajulwa - ibbuku lyabuumi. Ibafwide bakali kubetekwa azezyo zyakalembedwe mumabbuku, mbuli munchito zyabo.
Ilwizi lwakapedekezegwa bafwide bali mulindulo. Ilufu a Hadesi zyakapedekezegwa bafwide bakali muli nzizyo, alimwi bafwide bakabetekwa kwindila munchito zyabo.
Ilufu a Hadesi zyakawalilwa mumulungu wa mulilo. Oolu ndolufu lwabili - ibbibi lyamulilo.
Nakuti izina lyawumwi telyajanika kalilembedwe mubbuku lya Buumi, wakali kuwalilwa mumulungu wamulilo.
Mpawo ndakabona ijulu pya enyika mpya, nkambo ijulu lyakutanguna anyika yakusanguna zyakali zyfwa, alwizi telwakachiliwo.
Ndakabona dolopo usalede iJelusalema impya, ilyakeza aansi kuzwa kujulu kuli Leza kalibambidwe mbuli mwinga mbabambila mulumi wakwe.

Ndakamvwa ijwi pati lizwa kuchuno chabulemu kaliti, ''Boona ! ibusena bwachikkalilo cha Leza buli mubantu, alimwi uyokkala ambabo. Byaoba bantu bakwe alimwi Leza lwakwe uyoba ambaabo alimwi uyoba Leza wabo.
Uyosiinda misozi yonseni kumenso aabo, alimwi takuchikabi lufu, kana kuusa, kana kulila, naba machise. Izintu zyechiindi zyamana.
Ooyo iwakakkede achuno chabwami wakati, ''Boona ! Ndichita zintu zyonse kuti zibe zipya.''  Wakati, ''Lemba zintu eezi aansi nkambo aaya majwi alasyomeka alimwimi ngakasimpe.''
Wakandaambila kuti eezi zintu zyayinda ! Ndendime Alufa a Omega, imatalikilo amagozezyo. Kuli ooyo uumvwa nyota, ndinomupa chakunywa kakutakwe muulo kuzwa kukasensa kamaanzi abuumi.
Ooyo uzunda uyokkona zintu eezi, alimwi ndiyoba Leza wakwe, alimwi uyoba mwana wangu.
Pesi kuli abo bayowa, batakwe lusyomo, abazumina masunko, abajayi abasibwamu, bakomba zikozyanisyo, ababeji boonse, busena bwabo buyooba kubbibi pati lyamulilo uuyaka. Oolo ndolufu lwabili.''

Umwi wangilozi izili musanu azibili, wakeza kuli ndime, oyo wakajisi insoosa zili musanu azibili izyakajisi michelo yamelelezyo ilimusanu azibili, alimwi wakati, ''Kweza okuno ! ndilakutondezya bwiinga, imukayintu wa Mwana wa Mbelele.
Mpawo wakandibweza mumuunda wanditola kuchilundu ichipati chilamfu akuyonditondezya dolopo usalala Jelusalemu kaliza aansi kuzwa kujulu kuli Leza.
Jelusalemu yali abulemu bwa Leza,  alimwi ibwebeesi bwayo bwali mbuli inchooko mbotu loko, mbuli ibbwe lyachimpanzi cha jasipa injoloma.
Yali abupati, ibulambo bulamfu buli amilyango ili kkumi ayibili, kakuli zyooko zili kkumi azibili kumilyango. Amilyango kwakali lembedwe imazina alikkumi aabili aamisyobo yabana ba Izilayeli.
Kubuzwezuba kwakali milyango yotatwe, kumbo kwakali milyango yotatwe, kunsi kwakali milyango itaatu alimwi, akububbila kwakali milyango yotatwe.
Ibulambo bwalubaya bwadolopo bwakali antalisyo zili kkumi azibili, alimwi antalisyo kwakali mazina aali kkumi aabili abasikwiiya ba Mwana wa Mbelele.
Ooyo wakaambuula andime wakajisi mweelo wakabulo kangolida wakweela idolopo, amilyango yalyo, abulambo bwalyo.

Idolopo lyakali tendebete bwelene mabbazu woonse, bulamfu bwalyo bwakalelene abwiinge bwalyo. Wakeela idolopo amweelo wakabulo,izyuulu ikkumi azibili zya sitadiya kumweelo wabulamfu ( bulamfu bwalyo, bwanda, abwiime mujulu zyakalelelene).
Wakeela alimwi ibwanda bwawo, wajana kuti buli azikokola zili mwanda amakumi aane azine,mbuli mumwelo wabuntu (kakuli alubo ngumweelo wendangilo).
Bulambo bwakayakidwe ajasipa alimwimidolopo lyakayakidwe aangolide lwayolwayo, mbuli bunjoloma bbalabala.

Intalisyo zyabulambo zyakali bambikene abubotu bwamisyobo yoonse yamabwe mebeesi. Itaanzi yakali jasipa, lyabili lyakali safile, lyatatu lyakali ageti, lyaane lyakali emaludi. Lyasanu lyakali Onikisi,

lyamusanu alimwi lyakali koneliyeni, lyamusanu aabili lyakali kilayisolayiti, lyamusanu aane lyakali tofazi, alyekkumi lyakali kilayisofelusi, lyakkumi alimwi lyakali jasiniti, alyakkumi aabili lyakali ametiyisiti
Milyango ilikumi ayibili yakali ma piyeluzi aali kkumi aabili umwi awumwi mulyango wakabambidwe apiyeluzi yomwe. Migwagwa yedolopo yakali ngolida lwayo lwayo, mbuli bbalabal libalangala.
Tendakabona chikombelo pe mudolopo, nkambo i Mwami Leza mupati kampatila a Mwana wa Mbelele mbabo chikombelo chedolopo.
Idolopo telyakali kuyanda kumunikwa aazuba kana mweezi pe nkambo busalali bwakali kumweka aalindilyo, alimwi itunga mulilo lyayo ngu Mwana waMbelele.
Imanyika anoyoyenda amumuni wadolopo eelyo. Ibaami baansi bayoyeta bulemu bwabo muli ndilyo.
Milyango yalyo tayikoyojalwa pe chiindi chesikati, alimwi takukoyooba mansiku pe ooko.
Bayoyeta ibulumbu abulemu bwamanyika muli ndilyo.
Pesi takwe chisofweede pe chiyofwa chanjila muli ndilyo, nikuba umwi muntu uuchita chamasunko nakuti chakweneena, pesi aabo biyo bali amazina aalembedwe mubbuku lya Buumi lya Mamwana wa Mbelele.
Alimwi mungelo wakanditondezya mulonga wamanzi abuumi, abalangala mbuli klusti. Akali kweenda kuzwa kuchuno chaLeza achaMwana ambelele
kwiinda akati kamigwagwa yachisi. Kumbali lyawo mulonga kwakali musamu wabuumi, kuzyede ikumi ayibili misyobo yamichelo, aboobo nkuzyalo michelo yawo amweezi amweezi. Maatu amusamu ngakuponya nyika.
Takuyoba limbi lutuko. Chuuno chaLeza achaMwana mbelele chiyoba muchisi, aboobo babelesi bakwe bayomubelekela.
Bayoobona busyu bwakwe, aboobo izina lyakwe liyooba ankumu zyabo.
Takuyoba limbi mansiku tabachiyoyandi mumuni walampi nikuba wazuba nkaambo Mwami Leza uuyobamunikila. Bayoyendelezya lyoonse alyonse.
Mungelo wakandambila kuti, " Aya majwi ngalusyomo akasimpe. Mwami, Leza wamyuuya yabasinsimi, watuma mungelo wakwe kuti atondezye babelesi bakwe azezyo zitachitike lino."
Langa! Ndila boola lino! Ulilongezedwe oyo usyoma majwi abusinsimi bwamubbuku eli.
Ime, nde Joni, ndime ndakamvwa akubona eezi zintu. nindakamvwa akuzibona , ndakawida ansi ndimukombe oyo mungelo wakali kunditondezya zintu ezyo.
Wakandambila kuti, '' Utachiti obo! Andime ndimubelesi nyokwe, mwana wabanakwanu waba sinsimi, ababo basyoma majwiamubbuku eli. Kkomba Leza! ''
Alimwi wakandambila kuti, " Utanamatiki majwi abusinsimi abbuku eli, nkaambo nchiindi chili afwifwi.
Oyo utaluleme, muleke kachiya buchita zitaluleme. Oyo uchilisimatombe muleke kachiyabuchitisya bululami . Oyo usalala muleke kachiyabuchitisya busalali."

Langa! Ndila boola lino.  Bulumbu bwangu buli  andime, bwakulumbula awumwi kumilimo yakwe.

(66) @REV 22:16	<p-n>@Chiyubunuzyo 22:16</p-n>	Ime, nde Jesu, ndakatuma mungelo kuti amulungunwide makani aya muzikombelo.  Ndime muyanda walunyungu lwa Davida, intanda imwekesya yakubuchedo.
Muuya anabwinga bati, "Boola!" Muleke oyo umvwa awambe kuti, " Boola!" Oyo woonse uli anyota, mumuleke awangunuke kunwa manzi abuumi.
Ndalungulula kuli woonse oyo umvwa majwi abusinsimi bwabbuku eli: Na umwi wayungizya kuli ngawo, Leza ulamuyungizizya zipenzyo ezyo zilembedwe atala aleli bbuku.
Na umwi wagwisya kuzwa mumajwi abbuku lyabusinsimi, Leza uyoomugwisisya lukono lwakwe kumusamu wabuumi amuchiisi chisalala ezyo zilembedwe atala abbuku eli.
Oyo ulungulula eezi zintu uti, " Iyii! Ndilaboola lino." Ameni! Boola,Mwami Jesu!
Luzyalo lwaMwami Jesu lube anywe moonse. Ameni.
Pawulo, mulanda waJesu Kkilisito, wakayitwa kuti abe mu positoli, alimwi wakasalilwa kukuchita mulimu waLeza.
Eli ndilyo vangeli ndyakasyomezya chiindi kwiinda mubasinsimi bakwe mumalembe aasalala.
Zili aatala aMwana wakwe, wakazyalwa kuzwa kulunyungu lwaDeviti mukwiinda munyama.
Akubuka kuzwa kubafu, wakaambwa kuti Mwana waLeza uli a manguzu mapati kwiinda muMuya wa busalali - Jesu Kkilisito Mwami wesu.
Kwiinda mulinguwe twakatambula luzyalo abutumwe akaambo kakuswiilila chalusyomo aakati kamanyika woonse, kuchitila zina lyakwe.
Aakati kawaaya manyika, alubo mwakayitwa kuti muli bakuli Jesu Kkilisito.
Oolu lugwalo ndulwabaabo bali muLoma, bayandwi baLeza, bayitwa kuti bantu basalala. Luzyalo alube kulindinywe, alimwi luumuno luzwa kuli Leza Taata wesu alimwi Mwami Jesu Kkilisito.
Lutanzi, ndilumba Leza wangu kwiinda muli Jesu Kkilisito akaambo kenu moonse, akuti lusyomo lwenu lwaambilizigwa munyika yoonse.
Leza ngu kamboni wangu, ngundibelekela mumuya wangu kumakani mabotu aMwana wakwe, aawo mpeyinkila kunembo nkewamba atala andinywe.
Ndilakumbila lyoonse munkombyo zyangu kuti mubunini ndikonzye kuzwidilila lino akuyanda kwaLeza mukuza kulindinywe.
Nkaambo ndilayandisya kumubona, kuti ndimupe zimwi zilongezyo zyaMuya, kuti ndikonzye kumusimisya.
Nkokuti, ndilayanda kusungwazigwa akanu kenu, kwiinda mulusyomo lwawumwi awumwi, lwangu alimwi alwangu.

Lino nsiyadi pe kuti mube batazi, bakwesu, kuti kiingi ndakalikuyanda kusika kulindinywe, pele ndakalikukachisigwa kusila lino. Ndakali kuyanda echi kuti nkonzye kuba amuchelo akati kenu alubo mbuli akati kabaMaasi.
Ndimesichikwelete kubili kubaGiliki alimwi akubazwakule, koonse kubasongo alimwi akubafubafuba.
Nkaambo, mbuli ndime, ndililibambilide kwaambawula ivangeli alubo kulindinywe nimuli kuLoma.
Nkaambo nsiwusigwi nsoni avangeli, nkaambo manguzu aLeza kulufutuko kuli woonse uusyoma, kubaJuda alimwi kuba Giliki.
Mukuti mulindilyo bululami bwaLeza bwayubununwa kuzwa kulusyomo kuya kulusyomo, mbuli mbukwakalembwa, ''Basalali bayoopona chalusyomo.''
Nkaambo mukali bwaLeza bwayubununwa kuzwa kujulu aatala abusofwazi alimwi akutalulama kwabantu, aabo babwedezya musule isimpe akaambo kakutalulama.
Ezi nkukuti eecho chizibinkene aatala aLeza chilaboneka kulimbabo. Nkaambo Leza wabamunikila.
Nkaambo bube bwakwe butaboneki bwakatondeezegwa aantanganan kuzwa kumatalikilo akulengwa zintu. Bube oobu ninguzu zyakwe zitamani alimwi abunajulu. Akaambo kaako, aaba bantu tabachikwe ntami pe.
Ezi nkukuti, nikuba bakalizi aatala aLeza, tebakamulemya mbuli Leza, nikuba kumupa bulumbu. Pesi, baka bafubafuba  mumiyeeyo yabo, alimwi myoyo yabo itamvwisisisyi yakasizigwa.
Bakali kulyaamba kuti bali abusongo, pele bakaba bafubafuba.
Bakachinchanisya bulemu bwaLeza uutanyonyooki kucikkozyanyo chachitombe chamuntu uunyonyoka, cha bayuni, chabanyama bali amawulu one, alimwi chazintu ziyavula.
Akaako Leza wakabaaba kunkosya yamyoyo yabo yabusofwazi, kuti mibili yabo ikabule kulemekwa aakati kabo.
Mbimbabo bakachinchaanya kasimpe kaLeza kumabejo, alimwi bakakomba akulemya zilengwa kwiinda Mulengi, uyolumbayizigwa chakutamana. Amen.
Akaambo kacheechi, Leza wakabapeda kumpeekezyo zitakwe bulemu, nkaambo banakazi babo bakachinchanya bubelesi bwabo mbubakalengwa aambubo kulizeezyo ziteendelani aabukkale.

Mbuli munzila eeyi, baalumi abalabo bakasiya nzibakeelede kuchita abanakazi alimwi baba eenkosya yakuyanda umwi awumwi. Aaba mbaalumi bakachita a baalumi chiteelede pe, alimwi bakatambula mulilwabo lubeta lweendelana akutabotya kwabo.
Nkaambo tebakayeeya kubika Leza mukubonesya kwabo, wakabapa muzezo utali kabotu, kuchitila mbabo kuti bachite ezyo zintu zitali kabotu pe.
Bakazuzigwa akutalulama koonse, busofwazi, butangazi, alimwi a mabejo. Balizwide bbivwe, bujayi, lukajyanyo, lweeno, alimwi amiyeyo mibi.
Mbavwiyi, mbaasibupampu bwakubba, alimwi mbaasimusula-Leza. Balalupyopyongano, mbaachuundwe, alimwi balalisumpula. Mbaasimubamba zibi, alimwi tabaswiilili bazyali babo.
Tabakwe kumvwisya; tabasyomekede pe, batamvwidi luzyalo alimwi batakwe luse
Balamvwisya milawu yaLeza, kuti aabo bachita zintu ziliboobu baleelede kufwa. Pele pe pe kuti balachita biyo zintu ezi, balabotelwa abaabo bamwi bazichita
Akaako tokwe chikachizyo, iwe muntu, iwe nuubeteka, nkaambo nchobeteka muli umwi mulinduwe ulalipa mulandu.
Pele tulizi kuti lubeta lwaLeza lweendelana akasimpe na lwawida aali baabo bachita zintu zili boobu.
Pelelangisisye eechi, iwe muntu, nuubeteka aabo bachita zintu zili boobu nikuba ulachita zili boobo ayebo.Uyoonzwenga na kulubeta lwaLeza?
Na uyeeya buniini aatala abuvubi bwabubotu bwakwe, kuchedwa kwalubeta lwakwe, alimwi alukakatilo lwakwe? Tamuzi na kuti bubotu bwakwe buchitilidwe kuti bumuzulwide kukusanduka?
Pele nkaambo kakuyuma akutasanduka kwamoyo nkoli kulilondweda bukali mubuzuba bwabukali, nkokuti, buzuba bwakuyubununwa kwalubeta lululeme lwaLeza.
