Mubayeezye kuti balibombye kubendelezi akulibasimulawu, kamubaswlizya, akulibambila kuli yonse milimu mibotu
Mubayezye kutawambula bubi awumwi, kutaba achiyandisyo chakulwana, alimwi abusichamba, akutondezya kuliwinsya kubantu bonse.

Nkambo limwi lyamazuba iswe lwesu twakali abaya batayeeyi akutaswilizya. Twakazulwidwa mukusweka alimwi akuba mubuzike kwinda aziyandisyo zisiyene siyene alimwi azibotezya. Twakali kupona mububi amumabbivwe. Twakali chisesemyo alimwi katutayandani abamwi.
Pesi eelyo buuya bwa Leza Mufutuli wesu antomwe aluyando lwakwe lwakumisyobo yoonse yakayubunuka,
Tensi kwakali kwamilimo yabusalali obo mbutwakachita swebo, pesi mukwinda muluse lwakwe elyo wakatufutula, kwindila mukusanzigwa a Muuya Uusalala.
Leza wakafonkola watila Muuya Uusalala alindiswe mukwinda mumufutuli wesu Jesu Kkilisito.
Ezi wakazichita kuti tululamikwe kuluzyalo, tuzobe basikukona katulabulangizi bwabuumi ibutamani.
Oyu mulumbe ulasyomeka. Ndiyanda kuti mwambule chabusichaamba atala azintu ezi, kuchitila kuti abo bakasyoma muli Leza bajatisye mumilimo mibotu. Makani mabotu, alalugwasyo kubantu boonse.
Pesi amuleke kukazyania kwabufubafuba alimwi amazyalani amikowa amapenzi akutamvwanana atala amulawo. Ezyo zintu tazikwe mpindu alimwi tazigwasyi.
Mumukake nabaani uyetelezya kwanzaana akati kanu, nimwamana kumuchenjezya lumwi na tubili,
mbuli mbomuzi kuti muntu uliboobo wakasanduka kuzwa munzila iluleme alimwi ulokubisya ulikulipa mulandu lwakwe.
Elwo nindatuma Atemasi naba Tuchikkasi kulindinywe, ufwambane alimwi usike kulindime ku Nikkopolisi, oko nkundakayeeya kulomaninsya chindi champeeyo nkendinkuko.
Ufwambane utume Zenasi, unikide kumilawu, antomwe a Apolosi, enzila yakuti batakabuli chintu.
Bantu besungabayiiye kulinjizya lwabo beni kumilimu mibotu eyo ipa ziyandisi akufwambana alimwi kuti batabi bantu batazyali michelo.
Boonse abo balandime balikumujuzya. Mubajuzye bonse abo batuyanda mulusyomo. Luzyalo alube anywebo moonse.
Mumwezi wamusanu ayitatu mumunyaka wabili wabwendelezi bwa Daliyasi, ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli Zekkaliya mwana mulombe wa Bbelekkiya mwana mulombe wa Ayido, musinsimi, kaliti,
''Jehova wakali wabanyemena loko bamawuso!
Baambile kuti, 'Jehova wamakamu waamba obu: Amubole kuli ndime! -- oku nkwaambula kwa Jehova wamakamu -- alimwi njoboola kulindinywe, mbwawamba Jehova wamakamu.

Kamutabi mbuli bamawuso banu abo basinsimi mbibaka kwilila kuchindi chakayinda, kabati, ''Jehova wamakamu waamba obu: Amupiluke kuzwa kunzila zyenu zyabubi akuzichito zyenu zibi!'' Pesi teensi bakamvwa alimwi takwe nibakandiswilizya -- oku nkwaambula kwa Jehova.'
Bamawuso -- balikuli? Alimwi basinsimi -- tabaponi na kwalyoonse?

Pesi majwi angu amalayilile aangu ayo ngindakalayilila balanda abasinsimi bangu, tensi ngaawo na akeenzya bamawuso? Abobo bakasanduka akwaamba kuti, 'Mbuli Jehova wamakamu mbwatukanzila kutuchitila mbuli nzila yesu anchito mbuzipandulula, aboobo wakalangana aswebo.'''

Mubuzuba bwamakkumi obile aane bwamwezi wakkumi akamwi, wamweezi wa Syebbati, mumunyaka wabili, wabwendelezi bwa Daliyasi, Ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli Zekkaliya mwana mulombe wa Bbelekkiya mwana mulombe wa Ayido, musinsimi, kaliti,

''Ndakabona mansiku, alimwi, langa! Muntu wakatantide mbizi iisalala, alimwi wakali akkati kamisamu matili eyo yakali mumupata; amusule lyakwe kwakali zyakali kusalala, azisalalasalala mbuli musinza wenyangu ambizi zituba.''
Ndakati, ''Nzinyamanzi ezi zintu, Mwami?'' Elyo mungelo wakaambula andime wakati kuli ndime, ''Ndiyokutondezya kuti nzintu ezi nzinyamanzi.''
Elyo muntu wakiimvwi akkati kamisamu yamatili wakasandula akuti, ''Ezi nzezyo Jehova nzyakatuma kuyabulingula nyika yoonse.''
Bakasandula mungelo wa Jehova oyo uyimvwi akkai kamisamu yamatili; bakati kuli nguwe, ''Twalikuyabulingula nyika yoonse; mubone, nyika yoonse yakkala chakukkalilila akutontoola.''

Elyo mungelo wa Jehova wakasandula akuti, ''Jehova wamakamu, nchiindi chilamfu biyeni nchotakakkake kubafwida luzyalo ba Jelusalemu amyunzi yaba Juda, eyo njwakabanyemena kwaminyaka makkumi musanu amakkumi obile?''
Jehova wakasandula mungelo oyo wakambwiide andime, amajwi mabotu, majwi akukombelezya.
Aboobo mungelo oyo wakaambwide andime wakandaambila kuti, ''Wongolola akuti, 'Jehova wamakamu waamba obu: Ndaba abuzuba a Jelusalemu a Ziyoni abuzuba bupati loko!
Ndinyemede loko amaasi akkede chakulyiiba. Kuchiindi nchindaka banyemenede bunini, bakiindilila kubisya kwabo.

Nkambo kaako Jehova wamakamu waamba obu: Ndaboola ku Jelusalemu chaluzyalo. Ng'anda yangu ilayakwa mumo -- oku nkwaambula kwa Jehova wamakamu -- antambo yakweelesya iyotandabikwa alinguwe Jelusalemu!'
Alubo woongolola, akuti, 'Jehova wamakamu waamba obu: Myuunzi yangu iyozuzigwa lubo abubotu, alimwi Jehova uyowumbulizya lubo Ziyoni, alimwi uyosalwa lubo Jelusalemu.'''
Elyo ndakanyampula menso angu ndakabona meja oone!
Ndakaambula amungelo wakambwide ambebo, ''Nzinyamanzi ezi?'' Wakandisandula, ''Aya meja ayo akamwayisizye Juda, Izilayeli, a Jelusalemu.''
Elyo Jehova wakanditondezya bafuzi boone.

Ndakati, ''Bantu aaba baza kukuchitanzi?'' Wakandisandula, akwamba kuti, ''Aya meja akamwayisizye Juda kuchitila kuti takwe muntu unyampula mutwe wakwe. Pesi bafuzi beza kuzobayosya, kuzotambisya meja azisi akusumpula lwija kulwisya nyika yaba Juda akwimwayisya.''
Alwabili ndakanyampula menso angu alimwi ndakabona mwalumi akakole kakwelesya mujanza lyakwe.
Ndakati, ''Ulobuya kuli?'''Aboobo wakandambila kuti, ''Koyeleka Jelusalemu, kuyoziba busasa aabulamfu bwayo.''
Mpawo mungelo wakambwiide andimi wakeenda alimwi awumbi mungelo wakabbuda kuyomuswanizya.
Amungelo wabili wakamwambila kuti, ''Chiijana akwambila uulya mulombwana; ukatedi, 'Jelusalemu uyokkala muchisi chijulikene nkambo kama kamumakamu abantu azivuubwa zilimulinguwe.
Nkambo kuli ndime -- oku nkwaambula kwa Jehova -- ziyoba bulambo bwamulilo bumuzyungulukide, alimwi ndiyooba bulemu mukati kakwe.
Amubuke! Amubuke! amuchije kuzwa kunyika yakulubazu lwakunyika -- oku nkokwambula kwa Jehova -- nkambo ndamwandania mbuli myuuwo yoone yakujulu! -- oku nkwambula kwa Jehova.
Amubuke! muchijile ku Ziyoni, Inywebo nimukkala abaana basimbi baa Bbabiloni!'''
Nkambo musule lya Jehova wamakamu wandilemetezya alimwi wandituma kuli zezyo ziisi zimubisizya - nkambo kufumbwa ukuguma, wajata mboni lya linso lya Leza!--musule lyakuchita ezi Jehova, wakati,
''Imebo lwangu ndiiyo kunkumuna kuboko kwangu atala lyabo, alimwi bayobisigilwa nkambo kabazike babo.'' Elyo uyoziba kuti Jehova wamakamu wandituma.
Amwimbile chalukondo,  akubotelwa, nobana basimbi ba Ziyoni, nkambo imebo ndemwini ndamba kuboola  kuzokkala akkati kenu!--oku nkokwaambula kwa Jehova.''
Mpawo zisi zipati ziyolinjizya azyaalo kuli Jehova muzuba eelyo. Mbwawamba, ''Mpawo muyooba bantu bangu; nkambo ndiyokkala akkati kaanu,'' alimwi uyoziba kuti Jehova wamakamu wandituma kuli ndinywe.
Nkambo Jehova uyokkona Juda mbuli lukono lwakwe lululeme munyika iisalala alimwi lwabili uyosala Jelusalemu kuba wakwe.
Amuumune, nonse nozilenge, kunembo lya Jehova, nkambo walibusya kuzwa kubusena busalala bwakwe!
Mpawo Jehova wakanditondezya Josyuwa mupayizi mupati kayimvwi kunembo lyamungelo wa Jehova alimwi Satani wakalimvwi kulubazu lwajanza lyalulyo lwakwe kukumubejelezya chibi.
Mungelo wa Jehova wakati kuli Satani, ''Jehova akutapatile webo, Satani; Jehova, oyo wakasala Jelusalemu, akutapatile! Sa oyu teensi chisimbi chagwisigwa kuzwa mumulilo naa?''
Josyuwa kasamide zizwaato zyamatombe nakiimvwi kunembo lyamungelo.

Mungelo wakambula alimwi wakati kulimbabo bakiimvwi kunembo lyakwe, ''Amugwisye zizwaato zyamatombe kuzwa kulindinywe.'' Mpawo wakati kuli Josyuwa, ''Langa! ndagwisya mulandu wako kuzwa kuli nduwe alimwi njokusamika azyakusama zibotu zyebesi.''
Mpawo ndakati, ''Bamusamike chitambala chisupukide amutwe wakwe!'' Aboobo bakasamika chintambala chisambide amuutwe wa Josyuwa akuzwata zizwaato zisupukide, awo mungelo wa Jehova nakachiimvwi ambabo.
Elyo mungelo wa Jehova wakasungwaala kulayilila Josyuwa aakuti,

''Jehova wamakamu mbuboobu mbwawamba: Naa uyende munzila zyangu, alimwi ubambe malayilile aangu, mpawo uyoyendelezya ng'anda yangu akutonga nkuta zyangu, nkambo njokuzumizya kunjila akusika akkati kabaaba bayimvwi kunembo lyangu.
Swilila, Josyuwa omupayizi mupati, webo abazolwani bako abo bakkede anduwe! Nkambo baalumi aba nchitondezyo, nkambo mebo ndayeta mulanda ii Mutabi.

Lino langa kubbwe ndindabikka kunembo lya Josyuwa. Kuli menso alimusanu aabili aabbwe lyomwe, alimwi njoolemba bulembo -- oku nkwaambula kwa Jehova wamakamu -- alimwi njogwisya zibi kuzwa kunyika eyi muzuba lyomwe.
Muzuba elyo -- oku nkwaambula kwa Jehova wamakamu -- moonse muyotambana asimabambanwa wakwe muchisiko chamusansa wakwe aamunsi amukkuyu wakwe.''
Mpawo mungelo oyo wakali kwambuula andime waboola akundibusya mbuli muntu ubusigwa kuzwa kung'onzi zyakwe.

Wakandaambila kuti, ''Niinzi nchobwene?'' Ndakati, ''Ndibwene chikkalilo chalampi chilundidwe koonse angolide, chilachibikilo ajulu aacho. Chila malampi musanu aabili alimwi malampi musanu aabili milomo kujulu lyalimwi alimwi lampi.
Kuli misamu yama olifa yobile kumbali anchicho, Umwi kullyo lwalubazu lwachibikilo aalimwi kulubazu lwakuchimweensi.''
Aboobo ndakabuzya mungelo ngundakali kwaambula awe. Ndakati, ''Zyambaanzi zintu eezi, Simalelo wangu?''
Mungelo ooyo wakalikwambuula andime wakasandula akwamba kuti kulindime, ''Saa tozizi ezi nchizyaamba?'' Ndakati, ''Pepe, simalelo wangu.''
Aboobo wakati kuli ndime, ''Eli ndijwi lya Jehova kuli Zelubbabbelu: Chintu chipati teensi inguzu, pesi ngu muuya, mbwaawamba Jehova wamakamu.
Nduweni, O chilundu chipati? Kunembo lya Zelubbabbelu uyooba ntundubwi, alimwi uyogwisya ibbwe lyaatala kuti likoompolole kuti 'Luzyalo! Luzyalo kuli nchiicho!'''
Ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli ndime, nkaliti,
''Maboko a Zelubbabbelu ngawo akayaala ntalisyo yang'anda eyi alimwi maboko akwe ayoyimaninsizya.'' Mpawo uyoziba kuti Jehova wamakamu nguwandituma kuli nduwe.
Ooyo wasampawula izuba lya zintu zinini? Aaba bantu bayosekelela aakubona chipimyo mujanza lya Zelubbabbelu. ( Aaya malampi alimusanu aabili ngomenso aa Jehova aayo alobulanga nyika yoonse.)
Mpawo ndakabuzya kumungelo, ''Eyi munsamu yobile yama olifa njaanzi iyiimvwi kulumweensi akululyo lwazyimikilillo zya malampi?''
Alubo ndakabuzya kuli nguwe, ''Njaanzi eyi mitabi yobile yama olifa iili kumbali lyamatililo obile aangolida aatila mafuta?''
Mpawo wakandambila kuti, ''Saa tozizi eezi?'' Ndakati, ''Pepe, simalelo wangu.''
Aboobo wakati, ''Aba mbana bamafuta ama olifa bayimvwi kunembo lya mwami wanyika yoonse.''
Mpawo ndakaboola kuzotambya menso aangu, alimwi ndakabona, ibbuku liyabuuluka!
Mungelo wakandaambila kuti, ''Niinzi nchobwene?'' Ndakasandula, ''Ndibwene ibbuku liyabuuluka, tukkokola makkumi obile bulamfu atukkokola kkumi bubanzi.''

Mpawo wakandaambila kuti, ''Ezi nzyentuko zimwayikide atala lyanyika yoonse. Nkambo woonse mubbi uyonyonyooka mbuli mbukaamba kuli limwibbazu, alimwi woonse ooyo ukonka chikonke chakubeja uyonyonyooka mbuli kaamba kulilimwi bbazu.

''Njolugwisya -- aya ngimalayilile a Jehova wamakamu -- Aboobo liyonjila mung'anda yamubbi aamung'anda yayooyo ukonka chakubeja azina lyangu. Liyokkalilila mung'anda yakwe alimwi liyosyukuta masamu aamabwe ayo.''
Mpawo mungelo wakali kwambula andime wakabbuda anze alimwi wakandaambila kuti, ''Tambya menso aako akubona eecho chizabuza!''
Ndakati, ''Nchiinzi?'' Wakati, ''Eechi nchisuwo chila chizwato chizabuza. Eezi nzezibi zyabo zili munyika yoonse.
Mpawo chivunisyo chakajalide chakavunuka achisuwo alimwi kwakali mwanakazi munsi lyacho wakakkede mulinchicho!
Mungelo wakati, ''Obu mbobubi!'' Wakamuwaala lubo mukkati kalusuwo, aakuwaala chivunisyo atala lyamulyango.

Ndakatambya menso angu alimwi ndakabona banakazi bobile bayobuza kunembo lyangu, aaluuwo lwakali mumabaaba aabo -- nkambo bakala mababa mbuli mababa aa toongo. Bakanyampula lusuwo akkati kanyika aa julu.
Aboobo ndakati ku mungelo wakali kwaambula andime, ''Nkokuli nkubayobutola chisuwo?''
Wakati kuli ndime, ''Kukuyoyaka chikombelo munyika ya Syina chayo, kuchitila kuti naa chikombelo chamana, bayotuula chisuwo mpoonya awo atako lyacho.''
Mpawo ndakaboola akutambya menso aangu alimwi ndakabona inkalaki zyone zilazwa akkati kazilundu zyobile; aa zilundu zyobile zyakalundidwe amukuba.
Inkalaki intanzi yakajisi mbizi zisalala, inkalaki yabili yakajisi mbizi zisiya;
inkalaki yataatu yakajisi imbizi zituuba, alimwi inkalaki yaane yakajisi mbizi zyamabala mabala.
Aboobo ndakasandula akuti kumungelo ngwani wambuula andime, ''Niinzi eezi, simalelo wangu?''
Imungelo wakasandula akwamba kuti kulindime, ''Eyi myuuwo yone yakujulu iizwa kubusena oko nkubakimvwi kunembo lya mwami wanyika yoonse.
Elyo ilambizi isiya ilobuya kuchisi chakunyika; imbizi zituba zilobuya kumbo kwachisi; ambizi zyamabala mabala zilaya kuchisi chakumusanza.''
Ezi imbizi zisimide zyakaya akuyeeya kwiinka kuyobwendeenda moonse munyika, alimwi mungelo wakati, ''Ukeendende munyika yoonse!'' alimwi bakazwa  munyika yoonse.
Mpawo wakandiita akundaambila akuti, ''Langa kuli ezyo ziyobuya kuchisi chakunyika; ziyotontoozya muuya wangu nchobeni kuchisi chakunyika.''
Aboobo ijwi lyakasika kuli ndime, nkaliti,
''Bweza chituuzyo kuzwa kubantu babuzike --kuzwa kuli Heludayi, Tobbija, aa Jadayiya -- alimwi weende muzuba lyomwe aakutola mung'anda ya Josiya mwana mulombe wa Zofani, oyo wakazwa ku Bbabbiloni.
Mpawo tola nsiliva angolide, uchite munsini akuubikka atala lya mutwe wa Josyuwa mwana mulombe wa Jehozadaki, mupayizi mupati.
Ukamwaambile kuti, Jehova wamakamu nguwaamba echi: Oyu mwalumi, izina lyakwe Nchisyukila! Uyokomena oko nkwabede alubo mpawo uyoyaka chikombelo cha Jehova!

Ngonguwe oyo utakayake chikombelo cha Jehova, alimwi unosamide bulemu bubotu, alimwi uyokkala akwendelezya kuchikkalilo chakwe. Uyooba mupayizi kuchikkalilo chakwe, alimwi uyobikka luumuno akkati kababili.
Munsini uyopegwa Heludayi, Tobbija, aa kuli Heni mwana mulombe wa Zefaniya mbuli chibalusyo muchikombelo cha Jehova.
Mpawo abo balikule bayoboola aakuyaka kuti Jehova wamakamu wandituma kuli nduwe; nkambo echi chiyochitikana na nchobeni mwaswilila kujwi lya Jehova Leza wenu!'''
Elyo mwami Daliyasi naakali mwendelezi kwaminyaka yoone, mubuzuba bwachine bwa Kkisilevi, (ulinguwo mweezi wamusanu ayine), ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli Zekkaliya.
Ibantu ba Bbeteli bakali batuma Syaleza a Legemu-Meleki abantu babo kuti bakumbile kunembo lyabusyu bwa Jehova.
Bakaambuula kubendelezi aabo bakali kung'anda ya Jehova wamakamu akubasinsimi; bakati, ''Ndilelede na kulila mumwezi wasanu kukwinda mukulyiimya, mbuli mbundakachita muleezi muminyaka myiingi?''
Aboobo ijwi lya Jehova wamakamu lyakasika kuli ndime, kalyaamba kuti,

''Wambuula kubantu boonse baanyika akuba payizi akwamba kuti, ''Eelyo nimwakalyimisizye kukulya akukwiila mumwezi wasanu amumwezi wamusanu ayibili muminyaka eeyi ilimakkumi alimusanu ayibili, nkasimpe na kuti mwakali kulyimisizya kuli ndime?
Eelyo nimwakali kulya akunywa, temwakali kulilyida akulinywida lwanu na?

Taali ngingawo na majwi aayo Jehova ngaakamba kwinda kujanza lyabasinsimi batanzi, eelyo Jelusalemu azisi zyengelede nizyakayakwa akuzwidilila, aba Negevi anyika zilaansansi kuyakumbo nizyakayakwa?'''
Ijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli Zakkaliya, kalyaamba kuti,
''Jehova wamakamu waamba oobu, Beteka chabululami bwakasimpe, mubusyomesi bwachizuminano, muluzyalo. Akube kuti muntu umwi awumwi achite eechi kumukulana wakwe.
Aatala amukamufu amuchaala, muzwakule, alimwi amuntu muchete -- utabadyamizyi pe, alimwi taakwe pe uyelede kubikka kuchisa aluumwi mumoyo wako.'
Pesi bakaka kuti baswilizye akukkazika makkuko aabo chabufubafuba. Bakasinka matwi aabo kuchitila kuti tabakonzyi kumvwa.

Bakayumya myoyo yabo mbuuli buyumu bwabbwe kuchitila kuti batamvwi mulawu naakuti majwi a Jehova wamakamu. Wakali watumizya makani aaya kubantu kwinda kumuuya wakwe muchiindi chakayinda, kwinda kumulomo wabasinsimi. Pesi bantu bakakkaka kuti baswilizye, aboobo Jehova wamakamu wakabanyemena loko.
Zyakachitika awo eelyo nakayinka tebakaswilizya pe. Mulinjiyo nzila ikozyenie,'' waamba Jehova wamakamu,'' Bayoyita aanze kuli ndime, pesi nsikoyoswilizya pe.

Nkambo njobamwaya akambizi kunyika zyoonse ezyo nzibatanakuziba, alimwi enyika iyooba tongo kunembo lyabo. Nkambo taakwe pe naba omwe utakayinde kwinda munyika naa kubweda kulinjiyo mbuli kuti bantu bachita nyika yabo imbotu kuba nyika yabuyo.''
Ijwi lya Jehova wamakamu lyakandisikila, kalyaamba kuti,
''Jehova waamba oobu: Ndime sibuzuba a Ziyoni abuzuba bupati loko, alimwi ndamusungwalila achabukali bupati loko!

Mbuboobu mbwawamba Jehova wamakamu: Ndaboola ku Ziyoni alimwi ndiyokkala akkati ka Jelusalemu, nkambo Jelusalemu uyoyitwa kuti dolopo lyakasimpe achilundu cha Jehova wamakamu chiyoyitwa Kuti Nchilundu Chisalala!
Jehova wamakkamu waamba obu: Maneene amachembele bayooba alimwi mumigwagwa ya Jelusalemu, alimwi muntu woonse uliyanda mufunko mujanza lyakwe nkambo unoli wacheembaala loko.
Migwagwa yadolopo iyozula balombe abasimbi balisenia muli njiyo.

Jehova wamakkamu waamba oobu: Kuti chimwi kachilangika aanga tachikkonzeki mumenso abantu bacheede kumazuba aayoo mazuba, sa chilalangika anga chilakkachila mumenso angu? -- mbuboobu Jehova mbwawamba.
Jehova wamakkamu waamba oobu: Amubone, ndaamba kuvuna bantu bangu kuzwa kunyika yakujwe akusikila kunyika yakumbo!
Nkambvo njobapilusya, alimwi bayokkala akkati ka Jelusalemu, aboobo bayoba bantu bangu lubo, alimwi njooba Leza wabo mukasimpe amubululami!

Jehova wamakkamu waamba kuti: Lino inywebo nimwinkilila anembo akumvwa ijwi ndilyonya eelyo lyakazwa kumilomo yabasinsimi eelyo intalisyo yang'anda yangu niyakabikkwa --eyi ning'anda yangu, Jehova wamakkamu: Kamusimya maboko abobiya kuti intempele iyaakwe.

Nkaambo kusule lyamazuba aayo takwe zilimwa pe nikuba kumuntu naba munyama, alimwi tekwakali lumvwanano pe kuzwa kuli basinkondo kuli uyinka naba uboola. Ndabikka kuti muntu woonse alwisye simayakenyina.
Pesi kwalino takukoyoba mbuli mumazuba akamana pe, njooba antoomwe abacheede babantu aaba -- aayaa ngimalayilile a Jehova wamakkamu.
Nkambo imbuto zyaluumuno ziyobyalwa; musansa uyobelela uyopa michelo yawo anyika iyoopa zilyo zyayo; ijulu liyoopa luume lwalyo, nkambo njochita bacheede babantu aba kuti bakkone zintu ezi.
Wakali chikkozyanio kulizimwi zisi alutuko, ng'anda ya Juda ang'anda ya Izilayeli. Aboobo njokunununa lwako webo alimwi uyoba chilongezyo. Utayoowi; Koyumya maboko aako!
Nkambo Jehova wamakkamu waamba oobu: mbuli mbundakabambide kukuchisa eelyo bamawuso nibakandikalazya -- mbwawamba Jehova wamakkamu -- akutaleka bukkali,
aboobo njobamba muli aya mazuba kuchita bubotu lubo mu Jelusalemu ang'anda ya Juda! Utayoowi!
Eezi nzezintu nzoyelede kuchita: Waamba kasimpe, kumuntu woonse asimayakilane wako. Ubeteke chakasimpe, akululama, aluumuno mumilyango yanu.
Mutabambi kuchita bubi pe mumyoyo yanu kuli umwi awumwi, alimwi mutayandi zikonke zyakubeja -- nkambo eezi nzezintu nzinsulide! aaya ngemalayilile a Jehova.''
Mpawo ijwi lya Jehova wamakkamu lyakandisikila, lyakati,

''Jehova wamakkamu waamba obu: Kulyiimya kwamweezi waane, akwamweezi wasanu, awamusanu, awamusanu ayibili, awamwezi wakkumi ayooba zyiindi zyakukkondwa, akubotelwa, akusekelela pobwe lyang'anda ya Juda! Kuzwa waawo amuyande kasimpe aluumuuno!
Mbuuboobu Jehova wamakkamu mbwawamba: Bantu bayooboola lubo, nikuba aabo biingi bakkala mumadolopo miingi asiyenesiyene.
Bantu bakkala mulilimwi dolopo baloyinka kuli limbi dolopo akwaamba kuti, 'Atufwambane twinke tukakumbile kunembo lyabusyu bwa Jehova akuyo yanduula Jehova wamakkamu! Iswe lwesu tulayinka.'
Bantu biingi azisi zilanguzu ziyobola kukulanguula Jehova wamakkamu mu Jelusalemu akakumbila luzyalo kuli Jehova!

Mbuboobu mbwawamba Jehova wamakkamu: Kulaayo mazuba baaluumi balikkumi kuzwa kumulaka woonse azisi bayojata lupimpito lwachikobela chamu Judaakwamba kuti, 'Atweende anduwe, nkambo twaamvwa kuti Jehova ulanduwe!'''
''Aaya ngemalayilile ajwi lya Jehova wambila nyika ya Hadilakki a Damasikkasi, busena bwakulyokezezya lwayo; nkambo menso amuntu woonse anzubo zyoonse zya Izilayeli aalangide kuli Jehova.
Aaya aalo ngemalayilile awambila Hamati, oyo uzyungulukide atala lya Damasikkasi, achooko chawo Taaya a Sidoni, nkambo mbasongo loko.
Taaya waliyakila machijilo akulundika nsiliva mbuli lusuko angolida yakasalazigwa mbuli bulongo bwamumigwagwa.
Langa! Mwami uyomunyanzya akumwaya nguzu zyakwe mulwizi, aboobo uyotentwa amulilo.
Asyikkeloni uyobona akuyoowa! Awalo Gaza uyokankama kapati! Ekkiloni, Chilangililo chakwe chiyomubijila! Mwami uyofwidilila kuzwa ku Gaza, alimwi Asyikkeloni uyomwayisigwa akuba tongo!
Bazwakule bayowuchita myuunzi yabo mu Asyidoni, alimwi njomaninsya kuli sumpula kwaba Filisitiya.
Nkambo njogwisya bulowa bwabo kuzwa kumilimo yabo azisesemyo zyabo kuzwa akkati kumeno aabo. Mpawo bayooba bacheede nkambo Leza ulayanda lunyungu mu Juda, awalo Ekkiloni uyooba mbuli Jebbusi.
Njoyaka chakuzyunguluka nyika yangu akulwisya sinkondo abasikalumamba, aboobo takwe naba omwe utakiinde nikuba kuboola, nkambo takwepe mudyamizi uyobiinda, nkambo linobu ndabona amenso aangu!

Sekelela loko, omwana musimbi wa Ziyoni! Wompolola, mwana musimbi wa Jelusalemu! Kolanga! Mwami wako ulaza kuli nduwe. Uliluleme alimwi muzundi. Ulibombede alimwi ulitantiide imbongolo, amwana mweenze wambongolo.

Mpawo njolobya nkalaki kuzwa kuli Efulemu ambongolo kuzwa ku Jelusalemu, abuta bwankondo buyonyonyoonwa kuzwa kunkondo; nkambo uyowambula lumuuno kuzisi, abwendelezi bwakwe buyoba kuzwa kulwizi akulwizi, akuzwa kumu Longa kusikila kumamanino anyika!
Mbuli nduwe, nkambo kachizuminano chabulowa anduwe, njowangununa baange bako kuzwa kumulindi ooyo utakwe manzi.
Bweeda kumachijilo, nomwaange wabulangizi! Sunu nchobeni ndakwambila kuti uyoboola kuli nduwe tobile,
nkambo ndapeta Juda mbuli buta. Efulemu njomuzuzya kuyoosya kwangu. Ndakopengania bana bako balombe, Ziyoni, ndalwisya bana bako balombe, Gilisi, akukuchita webo, Ziyoni, mbuli panga lyasilumamba!''
Jehova walibonia kuli mbabo, amivwi yakwe iyoyasa mbuli lulabi! Nkambo mwami wangu Jehova uyolizya mweembo alimwi unoyabwiinka mutumbizi twaku Temani.

Jehova wamakkamu ulabakwabilila, alimwi bayobakkwamuna akuyozunda mabwe amuchingwindi. Mpawo bayonywa akoompolola mbuli baalumi banywide wayini, alimwi bayozuzigwa wayini mbuli mitiba, mbuli chooko chachipayililo.
Aboobo Jehova Leza wabo uyobamvwa mulilelyo zuba, mbuli butanga bwambelele zyabantu bakwe. Aabo mabwe mayandisi amusyini ang'ayima munyika yakwe.
Mbabotu biyeni alimwi bayoba beebesi biyeni! Balombe balabotesegwa amyiila aba nakalindu balabotezegwa awayini unoona!''
Amukumbile imvula kuli Jehova muchindi chachilimo -- Jehova uchita indabo -- alimwi nguupa boonse imvula azisyu zyamyuunda.
Nkambo zikozyanio zyamizimu zyambuula bubi; basondi nzibabona nzyakubeja; balaamba ziloto zyakubeja akupa lumbulizyo lutagwasyi, aboobo nchibasweeka mbuli mbelele akupenga nkambo taakwe mwembeli pe.
''Bukali bwangu busikila bwabukila bwembeeli; mbasipule bempongo -- bazuluzi -- aboo njobapenzya. Jehova wamakamu alimwi uyogwasya butanga bwakwe, ing'anda ya Juda, akubachita mbuli bbiza munkondo!
Kuli Juda kuyozwa ibbwe lyachooko; kuli nguwe nkwiyoozwa inkanka yateente; kuli nguwe nkukutakazwe buta bwankondo; kuli nguwe bazuluzi boonse nkubayoozwa aamwi.
Bayooba mbuli basilumamba basinguzu balyatawula basinkondonyina mubutope bwamumigwagwa munkondo; bayochita nkondo, nkambo Jehova ulamba oobo, alimwi bayowusisya aboo basikweenzya mabbiza ankondo.
Njoyumya ng'anda ya Juda akufutula ng'anda ya Josefa, nkambo njobachitulula akubafwida luzyalo. Bayoba mbuli kuti tendakabatakatide pe, nkambo ndime Jehova Leza wabo, alimwi njobavwiila.
Mpawo Efulemu uyoba mbuli silumamba, amyoyo yabo iyokondwa mbuli basikunywa wayini; bana babo bayobona akusekelela. Myoyo yabo iyosekelela muli ndime!
Njobiita akubabungania nkambo njobavuna, alimwi bayovula mbuli mbubakabede, kalekale!
Ndakabamiza akkati kabantu, pesi bayondiyeeya mebo kuzisi zili kule, aboobo lwabo abana babo bayopona akuboola.
Nkambo njobaboozya kuzwa k unyika ya Ijiputi akuyobabungania ku Asiliya. Njobaboozya kunyika ya Giliyadi aku Lebbanoni mane do katutachikwe busena bwabo pe.

Njoyinda akkati kalwizi lwamachise aabo; njowuma mayuwe alwizi oolo alimwi njoyuminizya bboonze lyamaanzi a Nayili. Abulemu bwa Asiliya buyoselusigwa, ankoli yabwami yaku Ijiputi kuzwa kubantu baku Ijiputi.
Njobayumya lwangu, alimwi baloyenda muzina lyangu -- mbuboobu Jehova mbwawamba.''
Jula milyango yako, Lebbanoni, kuti mulilo ukatente misida yako!
Kolila omusamu waSipulasi, nkaambo munsamunyokwe munsida wawa !  Yakali aabulemu yanyonyoka! Kolila, Omubanga waku Basyani, nkaambo lusaka loonse lulitentedwe.
Kulokumvwikka kulila kwabeembeli, nkaambo bulemu bwabo bwakamwayisigwa! Kulijwi lyakuvuluma kwabana babalavu, nkaambo kulisumpula kwamulavu jodani kwamwayisigwa!
Mbuboobu Jehova Leza wangu mbwambuula, ''Mbuli mweembeli mbalanga butanga bubambilidwe kujayigwa!
(Aabo bazyuula balazijaya alimwi tabakwe mulandu pe, abasikuzyuuzya balaamba kuti, 'Jehova ngalongezegwe! Ndaba muvubi! nkaambo beembeli babelekela butanga bamunaazyo tabakwe nsoni anzizyo.)

Nkaambo nsikoyoobafwida nsoni kunyika njebakkala! - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova. Bona! Ime lwangu ndemwini ndaba afwiifwi kusandula muntu woonse kwiindila kujanza lyasimabambanwe wakwe amujanza lyaMwami wakwe alimwi bayomwaya nyika alimwi takukwe womwe ngwendiyovuna kuzwa mujanza lyabo.''

Aboobo ndakaba mweembeli wabutanga buyanda kujayigwa nkaambo kababo basambala mbelele. Ndakabweza misako yobile; umwi musako ndakawulika kuti ''Luzyalo'' alimwi umwi ''Kujatana.'' Muliyeeyi nzila ndakeembela butanga.
Mumwezi womwe ndakajaya beembeli batatu. Tendakaba aalwetelelo pe ambabo, alimwi bakalindisulide.

Mpawo ndakati kulibanaazyo, ''Nsikoyoobeleka mbuli mweembeli wako pe limbi. Imbelele eezyo zilimukufwa ngazifwe biyo; imbelele eezyo zilimukunyonyoonwa - azyalo ngazinyonyoonwe. Mbelele eezyo zisyeede imwi ayimwi  ngayilye nyama yasimabambane wayo.''
Aboobo ndakabweza musako wangu ''Luzyalo'' ndawutyola kukutyola chizuminano nchindakali ndachita amazyalane aangu.
Mubuzuba oobo chizuminano chakatyolwa, alimwi kuli aabo bakalikuuzya mbelele abakali kundilanga bakaziba kuti Jehova wambuula.
Ndakati kulimbabo, ''Na kazili zibotu kulindinywe, mukandiliye mufolo wangu. Pesi na kakutali boobo, mutachiti.'' Aboobo bakandiphimina - zimpati zili makkumi otatwe zyansiliva.

Mpawo Jehova wakati kulindime, ''Waala nsiliva muchibikilo, kumufolo mubotu loko ngobakulemya anguwo!'' Eelyo ndakabweza tumpanzi twansiliva tuli makkumi otatwe alimwi ndakazibika muchibambilo chang'anda yaJehova.
Mpawo ndakatyola wachibili musako, ''Lujatano,'' kutyolabuzolwane aakati kaJuda aIzilayeli.
Jehova wakati kulindime, ''Alubo, bweza zibelesyo zyabeembeli bafubafuba zibe zyako,

nkaambo bona, ndaamba kukubika mweembeli mubusena bwanyika. Takoyoozibamba pe mbelele zifwidilila. Takoyooziyanduula pe mbelele zisweekede, nikuba kusilika mbelele zityokede. Takoyoosanina mbelele zifwefwema, pesi uyoolya nyama yambelele zineneede alimwi uyokwamuna nzumba zyazyo.
Mawe kubeembeli batakwe lugwasyo balekela butanga bwabo! Ipanga ngalisike kumulwisya kujanza lyakwe akulinso lyakululyo lwakwe! Ijanza lyakwe likanyane alimwi linso lyakwe lyakululyo likoofwale!''
Ooku nkwambula kwajwi lya Jehova aatala aba Izilayeli--nkwambuula kwa Jehova, wakatandabika milengalenga akubikka ntalisyo yanyika, akulenga muuya wamuntu mulinguwe.

''Bona, ndaamba kuchita Jelusalemu munkomeki ipanga bantu boonse akupapalisya misyobo yabo yoonse yabantu beengelede alimwi kuyooba mbuboobo mbuli kuli Juda kuchindi chakusunzuluka atala a Jelusalemu.
Mubuzuba oobo njochita Jelusalema ibbwe idemu kubantu boonsekufumbwa uyoyezya kubweza ibbwe elyo liyomupwachuula loko, alimwi zisi zyoonse ziyobungana atala amunzi oyo.

Mubuzuba oobo -- oku nkwambilizya kwa Jehova--Ndiyowuma mbizi zyoonse alupyopyongano mpawo asikuzigada chakumupenzya. Ajulu ang' anda ya Juda ndiyojula menso angu pesi zyoonse mbizi zyabantu njozyumaboofu.
Eelyo baami ba Juda bayowambwa mumyoyo yabo , 'Bantu bakkede mu Jelusalemu manguzu esu nkaambo ka Jehova wamakamu, Leza wabo.'

Mumazuba ayo njochita kuti baami bama Juda babe mbuli lukkaye lwamulilo akkati kankuni alimwi mbuuli mabangabanga akkati kamayila ayimvwi, nkaambo bayosyukutwa bantu boonse bazyungulukide kululyo lwabo akuchimweensi chabo. Jelusalemu alimwi ichinokkede abusena bwayo.''
Jehova uyofutula matente a Juda lutaanzi, kuchitila kuti bulemu bwang' anda ya Davida antomwe abulemu bwabaabo bakkala mu Jelusalemu butakkomeni kwinda bwa Juda.

Mubuzuba oobo Jehova uyoba chikwabilizyo chababo bakkala mu Jelusalemu, alimwi mubuzuba oobo aabo bakompeme aakkati kabo bayooba mbuli Devidi, aboobo ng' anda ya Davida iyooba mbuli Leza, mbuli mungelo wa Jehova kunembo lyabo.
''Mubuzuba oobo ndiyosanguna kumwaya zisi zyoonse eezyo zilwisya Jelusalemu.

Pesi ndiyotila muuya waluzyalo akukombelezya ng'anda ya Davida abakkede mu Jelusalemu, aboobo bayolanga alindime, oyo umwi ngubakayasa. Bayowomoka mbuli uumwi uwomokela mwana mwana mulombe umwi biyo; bayomukwila chakuusa mbuli baabo bakwila lufu lwamwana mulombe mutanzi.
Mubuzuba oobo kukwiila kwamu Jelusalemu kuyoba mbuli kulila kwa Hadadi Limoni muntandabale ya Megido.

Nyika iyowomoka, alimwi mukowa umwi awumwi uyowanzana kuzwa kumukowa umwi. Mukowa wang' anda ya Davida uyowanzana abanakazi baabo bayowanzana kuzwa kubaalu babo. Mukowa wang' anda ya Natani iyowanzana abanakazi babo bayowanzana kuzwa kubaalumi baabo.
Mukowa wang'anda ya Levi uyowanzaana abanakazi baawo kuzwa kubaalumi baabo.

Mukowa waba Simayiti uyowanzaana abanakazi baabo bayowanzaana kuzwa kubaalumi -- awumwi awumwi mukowa uyowanzaana abanakazi bayowanzaana kuzwa kubaalumi. Woonse mukowa wakasyala kumikowa -- umwi awumwi mukowa uyowanzana abanakazi bayowanzana kuzwa kubalumi.
''Mubuzuba oobo kasensa kayojulwa kung'anda yaDeviti akubakkali bamu Jelusalemu, akaambo kazibi abusofwaazi bwabo.
Mubuzuba oobo - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova wamakamu - njogonka mazina aamituni yamunyika kuti atakayeyeegwi limbi. Ndiyogwisya basinsimi amuuya usofwede kuzwa munyika.

Na umwi muntu wiinkilila kunembo akusinsima, wisi abanyina bakamuzyala bayomwambila kuti, 'Tokoyopona pe, nkaambo waamba zyakubeja muzina lyaJehova!' Mpawo wisi abanyina bakamuzyala bayomuyasa aawo natakasinsime.
Mubuzuba oobo awumwi musinsimi uyofwa bweeme kuchilengano chakwe aawo natakaambe kusinsima. Basinsimi aaba tabakoyozwaata chikobela chaboya  pe, kuchitila kweena bantu.
Nkaambo awumwi uyowamba kuti, 'Nsili musinsimi pe! Ndili muntu buyo uubeleka muse, nkaambo nyika yakaba mubeleko wangu nindakachili mwaalumi muniini!'
Pesi umwi uyowamba kuti, 'Ani eezi zilonda zili aakati kamaboko nzyenyamanzi?' mpawo uyosandula kuti, 'Ndakachisigwa ababo bakali mung'anda yamweenzuma.'''

''Panga! Buka iwe lwako ukalwisye mweembeli, mwaalumi wiima afwifwi andime - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova wamakamu. Uma mweembeli alimwi mbelele zilamwayika! Nkaambo ndiyoboozya janza lyangu kui baabo bandilwisya.
Mpawo chiyoosika chiindi chakuti munyika yoonse - ooku nkwaamba kwaJehova - kuti zimpanzi zibili mulizitatu iyogonkwa! Aabo bantu bayoloba; uumwi luzutu muli batatu uyosyaala.

Ndiyoyeta chimpanzi chatatu akubiinzya mumulilo akubasalazyambuli nsiliva mbiisalazigwa; ndiyobasunka mbuli ngolide mbiisunkwa. Bayoyita zina lyangu, ambebo ndiyobavwiila akwaamba kuti, 'Aaba mbantu bangu!' alimwi bayowamba kuti, 'Jehova nguLeza wangu!'''
Amubone! Buzuba bwa Jehova buyosika zisalala zyenu niziyowabwa akkati kenu.

Nkambo njobungania manyika manyika woonse kuzolwisya Jelusalemu kunkondo nkabela chisi chiyozundwa. Maanda ayomwayigwa abanakazi bayojatwa chibbalo. Chisela chachisi chiyotolwa mubuzike, pesi bamwi bantu tabakoyogwisigwa muchisi.
Pesi Jehova uyonyampula akuyolwisya kumanyika manyika mbuli mbwakali kuchita mubuzuba bwalumamba.

Nkabela mubuzuba oobo zituta zyamawulu akwe ziyoyimikila achilundu chama Olifa, chilikujwe lya Jelusalemu. Lino chilundu cha Olifa chiyowanduka akkati kuzwa kujwe kuyosika kumbo kukabe mumpata mupati loko nkabela chisela chimwi chachilundu chiyobweda musule kunyika achisela chimwi chiyoswena kumusanza.

Elyo uyozwa aansi amumpata akkatai ka Jehova azilundu, nkambo mumpata uli akkati kazilundu uyotana kumabbazu aayo ku Azeli. Nkabela uyozwa mbubonya mbumwakachija muzuzumo wanyika mumazuba a Uziya, mwami wa Juda. Mpawo Jehova Leza wangu uyosika abasalali boonse bayooba anguwe.
Lino mubuzuba oobo takukoyooba mumuni, impeyo nikuba chaanda.
Mubuzuba oobo, kuyooba sikati luzutu Jehova ulizi obo, takukoyoba isikati amansiku pe, nkambo chiindi chagoko kuyooba mumuni.
Mubuzuba obo kuyokunka maanzi mawumi kuzwa ku Jelusalemu. Chisela chimwi chawo chiyoya kulwizi lwakujwe achisela chimwi chiyoya kulwizi lwakumbo, mumayinza amuchilimo
Jehova uyooba mwami wanyika yoonse. Mubuzuba obo kuyooba Jehova alikke, Leza womwe, azina lyakwe lyomwe alilikke.

Inyika yoonse iyoba mbuli Alabba, kuzwa ku Gebba kuyosika ku Limoni kumusanza wa Jelusalemu. Jelusalemu uyoyinkilila anembo akunyampuka akusyala mubusena bwawo, kuzwa kumulyango wa Bbenjamini kubusena oko mulyango mutaanzi mpubede, kusika kumulyango wakuchooko, akuzwa kuchisanza cha Hananeli akuyosikila kudindi lyamwami lyakusinina wayini.
Nkabela bantu bayokkala mu Jelusalemu alimwi takukoyooba lunyonyooko kuzwa kuli Jehova akubalwisya lwabo. Jelusalemu uyokkala chakulyiiba.

Eechi nchechuumyo cha Jehova nchaati wumye bantu boonse baza kukuzolwisya nkondo yaku Jelusalemu: Uyobozeka nyama zyabo nibachimvwiamawulu aabo. Menso abo ayobola mumankolyo aabo andimi zyabo ziyobola mukanwa lyabo.
Mubuzuba obo bayosikilwa lupyopyongano lupati alimwi janza lyawumwi uyotambika kujulu chakumana umwi awumwi mwenzinyina.
Juda uyobusya inkondo akulwisya Jelusalemu. Nkambela lubono lwabamasi loonse lwengelede manyika--ingolida, nsiliva azyakusama zyiingi loko.
Alimwi lumyo lulimbubonya luyowida ambizi akumabbiza akunkamela ambong'olo abanyama boonse muzilawo abalabo bayoswanana epenzi likozyenie.
Lino ziyochitikila boonse basyeede mumanyika manyika aakasika kuzolwisya Jelusalemu bayelede kwinkilila kunembo munyaka amunyaka kukuyokkomba Mwami, Jehova wamakamu akuzoolya pobwe lyazilawo.
Chiyochitika kufumbwa nyika amanyika alansi abula kuyosika ku Jelusalemu kukuzokomba mwami, Jehova wamakamu, lino Jehova takoyoyeta mvula kuli mbabo.
Akulako luzubo lwabana ba Ijipita talwiinki kunembo, lino tabakoyotambula mvula pe. Chuumyo cha Jehova chiyowuma manyika woonse atiinki kuyobamba pobwe lyazilawo.
Eechi nchenchicho chisubulo chabana ba Ijipita achisubulo chanyika yoonse bakatiinka kukuyobamba Pobwe lya Zilawo.
Mubuzuba obo, milangu yambizi iyoti, ''Salila Jehova,'' azilako zibikkilo zyamu ng'anda ya Jehova ziyooba mbubonya mbjuli mitiba ilikunembo lyachipayililo.

Nkambo zilongo zyoonse zili mu Jelusalemu amuchisi cha Juda ziyosalalila Jehova waakamu, boonse basika kuzopayila bayolida akujika muli nzizyo. Mubuzuba oobo takukoyoba limbi musambazi mung'anda ya Jehova wamakamu.
Elyi ndijwi lya Jehova lyakasika kuli Zefaniya mwana mulombe wa Amatiya imwana mulombe wa Hezekkiya, mumazuba a Josiya mwana mulombe wa Aamoni, mwami waku Juda.
''Ndiyomaninizya kumwaya zyoonse kuzwa kubuyale bwanyika-eechi nchaambilizyo cha Jehova.
Ndiyojaya bantu abanyama; Ndiyojaya bayuni bakujulu abaswi bamulwizi, matongo antomwe abasizibi. Nakmbo ndiyogonka bantu kuzwa aanyika - eechi nchaambilizyo cha Jehova.
Ndiyosikila akuboko kwangu ku Juda aboonse bakkala mu Jelusalemu. Ndiyogonka akugwisya loonse lunyungu lwa Satani mubusena oobu amazina woonse aabantu bakkomba zibumbwa mukkati kabapayizi,
bantu bangu bakkomba mibili yakujulu aatala amaanda, abantu bakkomba akukonka kuli Jehova pesi alimwi kabakonka amwami wabo.
Ndiyogonka alimwi abo bakaleka kutobela Jehova, aabo bata chiyaanduli Jehova kana kukumbila bululamiki bwakwe.''
Wumuna kunembo lya Mwami Jehova! Nkambo izuba lya Jehova lyaba aafwifwi; Jehova wabamba chipayizyo alimwi wasala beenzu bakwe.
''Chiyoochitika mubuzuba bwa chipayililo cha Jehova, kuti ndiyopa chisubulo kubana bamwami basimbi abalombe, amuntu woonse usamine ngubo zyakulaambi manyika.
Oobo buzuba ndiyoopa chisubulo boonse bataluuka luwa, aabo bazuzya ng'anda ya simalelo wabo alupyopyongano alweeno.

Nkinkaako chiyooba mulelyo izuba - eechi nchaambilizyo cha Jehova - kuti kukwiila kwakupengaana kuyozwa mumulyango wamufwi, kulyeema kuzwa kuchilikiti chabili, alimwi muzuzumo wakuwa mupati kuzilundu.
Mukwile, nimukkala muchilikiti chabusamabazi, nkambo boonse bantu baku Kkenani bayomana; boonse aabo beela nsiliva bayogonkwa.
Ziyochitika muchiindi echo  ndakuyanduula Jelusalema amalampi akupa chisubulo bantu bakakkala mumichelo yabo akwaamba kuti mumyooyo yabo, ''Takwe nzyatachite pe Jehova, nikuba chibotu kana chibi.'
Buvubi bwabo buyooba lusuko, alimwi maanda aabo ayooba lunyonyooko lutakatidwe! Bayoyaaka maanda pesi tabakoyowakkala pe, akubwaala michelo yawayini pesi tabakoyonywa wayini yayo.
Buzuba bwa Jehova bupati bwaba afwifwi, afwifwi akufwidilika kufwambana! Muzumo wazuba lya Jehova uyooba walumamba lulila chakulyeema!
Oobo buzuba buyoba vwakunyema, buzuba bwakutyompwa amachise, buzuba bwaluuwo alunyonyoono, buzuba bwamudima akumweeka, buzuba bwamayoba amudima uunikide.
Buyooba buzuba bwamyeembo atuwuulo twanchenjezyo kumadolopo akwabilidwe azilwanino zyamujulu.
Nkambo njoyeta kutyompwa kubantu, kuchitila kuti bakuumpulike kukwenda mbuli muntu utakuboni mbuli kuti babisizya Jehova. Ganzi lyabo liyotilwa mbuli lusuko, azizo zyabo zyamukkati mbuli mafumba.

Taakwe niba nsiliva yabo kana ngolida itakakonzye kubafutula mubuzuba bwabukkali bwa Jehova. Mumulilo wabbivwe lyakwe nyika yoonse iyoligwa, nkambo uyoyeta chimaninide, magolelo aayoosya aabantu boonse bakkala munyika.
Muliyobolole - mubungane, nochisi chitakwe nsoni-
nikutana chitika lunyonyooko alimwi izuba eelyo lyiinde mbuli mankuwe, kakutanasika bukkali bwa Jehova buyoosya kuli nduwe, kakutanasika lunyonyoono lwa Jehova kuli nduwe.
Yandauula Jehova moonse nobantu baboombe aanyika nimulemeka bulemu bwakwe; Muyanduule bululami. Muyanduule bantususu, alimwi muyokwabililwa mubuzuba bwalunyonyoono lwa Jehova.
Nkambo Gaza iyotakatwa, alimwi Asyikkeloni iyoba chimwaye. Asyidodi bayomugwisya akalanga bwaseme, alimwi bayonyuukula Ekkiloni!
Maawe kuli baabo bakkala mukkati lyalwizi, bantu baku Kkeleyati! Jehova waambula chakumusula, Kkenani, chisi chama Filisitiya. Ndiyomujaya mane moonse mukamane.
Nkokuti kkuti lyalwizi likabe machelelo abaasikwembela azinywido zyambelele.

Busena bwakunkomwe buyooba bwalusinga lwe ng'anda ya Juda, batakeembele mbono zyabo nkukooko. Bantu babo bayolala aansi golezya mumaanda aa Asyikkeloni, nkambo Jehova Leza wabo uyobabamba akuli boonse buvubi bwabo.
''Ndamvwa boondongani ba Mowabbu abwambuuzi bwabantu ba Ammoni aawo nibakoondongania bantu bangu akunjilingania mibaano yabo.

Nkiinkaako, mbuli mbwempona-echi nchaambilizyo cha Jehova muleli, Leza wa Izilayeli - Mowabbu uyooba mbuli Sodomu, alimwi mbuli Gomola; busena bwabuyo alimwi kalilikkomba lyamwinyo, lyakabisigwa kwalyoonse. Pesi lusinga lwabantu bangu luyobamana, alimwi bantu bangu batakachaale bayobweza zyoonse.''
Eezi ziyochitika kuli Mowabbu a Aamoni nkambo kakuliyanda kwabo, mbuli mbuba kondongania akuba basinkazi kubantu ba Jehova muleli.
Mpawo Jehova uyoyoosya kuli mbabo, nkambo uyojaya boonse baleza bamaasi. Wonse muntuuyomukkotamina abulemu, awumwi kuzwa kubusena bwakwe, kuzwa kumasena ankomwe zyamanyika woonse.
Inywebo noba Kusyiti anywebo muyoyaswa apanga lyangu,
alimwi kuboko kwa Leza kuyolwana bakumbo kukamwaye  Asiliya, kuchitila kuti Niniva ikabe chisofwazi chakatakatwa, chiyumu mbuli nkanda.

Mpawo imbono ziyolala aansi nkukooko, woonse munyama wamanyika, zyoonse adumba wamunkanda atumba lusaka bayolyookezya aatala achiimo chakwe. Kiito kayoyimba kuzwa mumpulunguzyo; Itombe liyoba amulyango; minkulu yakwe yakaluli yakubeza iyooba antanganana.

Eechi nchisi chalukondo chakapona kachitayoowi, eecho chakati mumoyo wacho, ''Ndime, alimwi takwepe  ngweyelene awe.''' Mbuli mbaaba bulemu, busena bwakulala ansi banyama. Woonse muntu uyinda afwifwi anguwe ulang'ung'una akunyunganyunga mfayindi yakwe kuli nguwe.
Maawe kuchisi chankazi! Chisi chabukali chawumuzigwa.
Techaswilila pe kujwi lya Leza, nikuba kutambula kubambululwa kuzwa kuli Jehova. Tasyomi pe muli Jehova alimwi takoyinka pe kuli Leza wakwe.
Bana bakwe babwami balombe bababalavu bavuluma mukati kakwe. Babetesi bakwe baba bawumpe bamansiku batasiyi chintu chizokukunywa bwacha.
Basinsimi bakwe mbaalumi bakali alimwi mbasampawusi chijazya. Bapayizi bakwe bakapindila chisalala alimwi bachita lupyopyongano kumulawu.
Jehova uliluleme muli nguwe. Takonzyi kuchita chibi chifumo achifumo uyo yanzabula lubeta lwakwe! Tachikoyosiswa pe mumumuni, anukuti basyambisya tabazi kuba amawuse.
''Ndajaya zisi, ziyako zyabo lyaba tongo. Migwagwa yabo ndayichita tongo, kuchitila kuti kutabi muntu uyinda mumo. Madolopo aabo amwayigwa kuchitila kuti kutabi muntu ukkala mumo.

Ndakati, ÍNchoonzyo muyondiyoowa. Amuzumine kuzyotololwa alimwi tamukaanzanisigwi amyuunzi yenu azezyo nzindabamba kuchita kuli ndinywe.' Pesi bakali aabusungu bwakutalika chifumo chimwi achimwi akubbiningizya nchito zyabo zyoonse.

Nkinkaako amundilinde - eechi nchaambilizyo cha Jehova-mane do kubuzuba mbundiyobuka akujata sizibi. Mbukunga muzezo wangu ngwakuswanizya manyika, kubungania bwami, kutila bukali bwangu aalimbabo-boonse bukali bwangu bupya mulilo; nkambo mumulilo wabbivwe lyangu yoonse nyika iyomenwa.
Pesi aawo ndiyosalazya milomo yabantu, kuti boonse  akonzye kwiitilila muzina lya Jehova kuti limuvune kukkuko akkuko.
Kuzwa kusule lyamulonga kuchibandikomba - bantu bangu bamwayikene - bayoyeeta zipo zindeelede.

Muli eelyo izuba tokoyobikwa mumawuse pe aatala anchito zyako ezyo nzimwakandikaka azyo, mbuli kuli muleecho chiindi ndinooli nkegwisya mukati kenu aabo bakali nkabayiizya mukuliyanda kwakoalimwi nkambo tochinochiti zyankazi achilundu changu chisalala.
Pesi ndiyosiya mukati kenu bantu balaansi bachete, alimwi bayoojana bukkale muzina lya Jehova.
Lunyungu lwa Izilayeli taluchinotyoli mulawu nikuba kwambuula manwa, alimwi takwe lulimi lwakweneena lutakajanike mumilomo yabo; nkokuti ziyochela akulala ansi, alimwi takwepe muntu utakazikonzye.''
Yimba, omwana musimbi wa Ziyoni!  Wompolola Izilayeli. Botelwa alimwi unoneezye amoyo wako woonse, yomwana musimbi wa Jelusalemu.
Jehova wagwisya chisubulo chako; watanda basinkondonyokwe! Jehova ngumwami wa Izilayeli aakati kenu. Tokoyoyoowa lubo chibi!
Muli oobo buzuba bayowambila Jelusalemu kuti, ''Utayoowi, Ziyoni. Utalekeli maboko aako kuti abule nguzu.
Jehova Leza wako uli mukati kenu, mupati loko wakamufutula. Uyopakala aatala anduwe muluyando; uyoba mumunizi atala anduwe muluyando lwakwe; uyobotelwa aatala anduwe alompololo lwalukondo.
Ndiyobungania aabo balila, aabo batakonzyi kwinka kupobwe lyaambwa, nkokuti tokoyooba abweeme anchicho.

Boona, ndaamba kulwana aabo boonse bakudyamiizya. Muli eecho chindi, ndiyofutula muima akubungania idombe. Ndiyobachita mbuki chilumbayizyo, alimwi ndiyosandula bweeme bwabo bukabe kuzibinkana munyika yoonse.

Muli echochiindi ndiyokuzulwida; muleecho chindi ndiyomubungania aantomwe. Ndiyomupa kuzibinkana andumbayizyo mukkati kabantu boonse benyika aawo ndaakuboozya lubono lwenu loonse kumenso eenu,'' mbwawaamba Jehova.
